pratipādya vyādhīnāṃ doṣāṇāṃ ca kāryakāraṇasambandhaṃ punaranyathā jijñāsyamāha- bhūya ityādi|- bhūyaḥśabdaḥ punararthe| jijñāsyaṃ jñātumabhilaṣaṇīyam| etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati- prākkila vyādhīnāṃ vātādimūlatvaṃ jijñāsitam, atrānyat punarapi jñātumeṣṭavyamityarthaḥ; anye bhūyo bahutaramiti vyākhyānayanti| kecit ‘bhūyo'tra jijñāsyate’ iti paṭhanti| nityaḥ saṃśleṣa iti sarvadā apṛthaktvaṃ, yathā- sūryātapayoścandrajyotsnayoḥ pāvakoṣṇatvayoriti| paricchedo viśleṣaḥ pṛthaktvaṃ; yathā- paṭakuvindakayorghaṭakumbhakārayoḥ kuvindakaḥ tantuvāyaḥ kuṇḍalasuvarṇakārayorityādi| athāpyanyatheti ‘athavā anyatheti’ iti pā. ko'rthaḥ? anityaḥ saṃśleṣaḥ| pūrvapakṣamāśaṅkya samādhānamāha- atrocyata ityādi| pratyākhyāyeti parityajyetyarthaḥ| nanu, yadi doṣān parityajya jvarādayo na bhavanti, tarhi sambandho'stītyāśaṅkānirākaraṇāyāha- atha ca na sambandha iti|- ‘sarvadā’ iti śeṣaḥ| kathaṃ na sarvadā sambandha ityatra dṛṣṭāntamāha- vidyudvātetyādi| ākāśaśabdenākāśastho megha ucyate; satyapyākāśa iti vidyamāne'pi jalada ityarthaḥ| nimittata iti sāmagrīta ityarthaḥ| tata eveti tasyāḥ sāmagryā evetyarthaḥ| aparadṛṣṭāntamāha- taraṅgabudbudādaya iti| taraṅgaḥ jalalaharī| śāśvatika iti nitya ityarthaḥ||11||

bhavati cātra-
vikāraparimāṇaṃ ca saṅkhyā caiṣāṃ pṛthak pṛthak |
vistareṇottare tantre sarvā bādhāś ca vakṣyate ||12||

‘vistaraṃ nimittāni caiṣāṃ pratirogaṃ vakṣyāma’ iti yaduktaṃ prāk tat pratipādayannāha- vikāraparimāṇaṃ cetyādi| vikāraparimāṇaṃ ceti iyaṃ samudāyasaṅkhyā, tathā ca ‘vyādhīnāṃ tu sahasraṃ yacchataṃ viṃśatireva ca’- (u. taṃ. a. 66) ityuttare tantre vakṣyate| saṅkhyā caiṣāṃ pṛthak pṛthagiti iyamavayavasaṅkhyā; tathā ca- ṣaḍarśāṃsi, catasro'śmaryaḥ, aṣṭādaśa kuṣṭhānīti nidānasthāne vakṣyate| sarvābādhāśca vakṣyata iti jvarātīsāraśoṣādayaḥ| cakāro'tra bhinnakrame| tena vikāraparimāṇaṃ ca sarvābādhāścottare tantre vakṣyata iti sambadhyate; na punaḥ ‘uttare tantre’ iti ‘saṅkhyā caiṣāṃ pṛthak pṛthag’ ityatra sambadhyate| anye tu vyākhyānayanti “ vikārā jvarādīnāmupadravarūpatayā tṛṭchardiprabhṛtayaḥ, tatparimāṇamadhikamadhyahīnabhedena vikāraparimāṇam; ‘aṣṭau jvarāḥ, ṣaḍatīsārāḥ’ ityādi saṅkhyā ca pṛthak pṛthak; sarvābādhāśca śārīramānasā iti; sarvametaduttare tantre vakṣyate vyākhyāsyatyācāryaḥ” iti||12||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne vyādhisamuddeśīyo nāma caturviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||24||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne caturviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||24||

div.head: aṣṭavidhaśastrakarmīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto 'ṣṭavidhaśastrakarmīyam adhyāyaṃ ‘aṣṭavidhaśastrakarmaṇyamadhyāyaṃ’ iti pā. | “athātaḥ śastrakarmavidhiviniścayamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1|| chedyāstu bhagandarārśo'rbudaduṣṭavraṇanāḍīcarmakīlatilakālakamedogranthiśleṣmanimittāścāmayāstathāmāṃsasirāsnāyukotho māṃsakandī māṃsāsthigatamapi śalyamutsaṅgaḥ śataponako jatumaṇirvalmīkamadhruṣo'dhimāṃsamāṃsasaṅghātagalaśuṇḍikā ityevamādayo vikārāḥ||2|| bhedyāstu sarvajāmṛte vidradhyanuśayī pramehapiḍakā granthayaśca visarpāścāditastrayastrayo vṛddhayaśca vidārikāvamanthaupuṣkarikā nāḍyaḥ stanarogāśca sahopadaṃśaiḥ śothāśca sarvasarāḥ prāyaśaḥ kṣudrarogāstālupuppuṭatuṇḍikerīgilāyuprabhṛtayo'ntaḥ pūyaśalyā ye ca bhedaḥ samutthā aśmarīhetorbastiśca||3|| lekhyāścatasro rohiṇyo vraṇanetravartmārśo'dhijihvopajihvāmāṃsocchrāyāḥ kilāsā dantavaidarbhaḥ pañca medojāśca||4|| vedhyāstu sirodaravṛddhiprabhṛtayaḥ||5|| eṣyāstu gatimanto ‘nāḍyaḥ’ śalyāni ca||6|| āhāryāstu dantāntaḥ- śarkarāśmarīmūḍhagarbhaṅkarṇamalaśalyāni pādaśarkarāśca||7|| visrāvyāvidradhiḥ sarvā bhavedanyatra sarvajāt||8||’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

tatra pūrvaṃ chedyakarmaṇa eva darśitatvāttadbhedameva darśayannāha- chedyā bhagandarā ityādi| granthiḥ ślaiṣmika iti āmo na tu pakvaḥ| tilakālaka iti kṣudrarogaparipaṭhitaḥ; na tu śūkadoṣoktaḥ, tasyāsādhyatvāt| vraṇavartmeti klinno vraṇauṣṭhaḥ| arbudāni sarvāṇi| arśo vātikaṃ ślaiṣmikaṃ ca| carmakīla iti gudapārśvavartī māṃsāṅkuraḥ| snāyvādibhiḥ saha kothaśabdaḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate, kothaḥ pūtībhāvaḥ| śataponaka iti śūkadoṣapaṭhitaḥ; anye tu “bhagandaragrahaṇenāpyupāttasya śataponakasya punarupādānamatyantacchedanārtham, ananyapratīkāratvāt”||1-4||

lg.l: ādito ye visarpāś ca vṛddhayaḥ savidārikāḥ |
tuṇḍikerī gilāyuś ca pūrvaṃ ye ca prapākiṇaḥ |
bastis tathā'śmarīhetor medojā cakrastu ‘pañca medaḥsamutthānā’ iti paṭhitvā, ‘galāgaṇḍagranthyapacyarbudavṛddhayaḥ’ iti vyākhyānayati ye ca kecana ||8||

ab.seg: bhedyaviṣayaṃ darśayannāha- bhedyā ityādi| granthayastraya iti vātapittakaphajāḥ| ādito ye visarpāśceti vātapittaśleṣmajāḥ| vidārikā kṣudrarogeṣu| avamanthaka iti śūkadoṣeṣu| vṛndāviti ekavṛndo vṛndaśca kaṇṭhagatarogeṣu| puṣkarikā śūkadoṣeṣu| puppuṭau tāludantajāviti tālupuppuṭo dantapuppuṭaśca| pūrvaṃ ye ca prapākiṇa iti bhagandarādayaḥ| bastistathā'śmarīhetoriti aśmarīnimittameva bastirbhedyo nānyahetoḥ, abhede dhruvamaraṇādbhede ca saṃśayāt||5-8||

div.ab: lekhyaviṣayaṃ darśayannāha- lekhyāścatasra ityādi| catasro rohiṇyaḥ iti vātapittaśleṣmasannipātotthāḥ, raktajāḥ punarekāntāsādhyatvādiha noktāḥ| vartma iti vraṇavartma netravartma cetyarthaḥ| maṇḍalaṃ kaṇḍūkuṣṭhādīnām| māṃsakandī svalpamāṃsāṅkuraḥ||9||-

ab.seg: vedhyaviṣayaṃ darśayannāha- vedhyā ityādi||10||

lg.l: eṣyā nāḍyaḥ saśalyāś ca vraṇā unmārgiṇaś ca ye |11|

div.ab: eṣyaviṣayaṃ darśayannāha- eṣyā ityādi| eṣyā iti lohādiśalākayā'ntaranveṣaṇīyā ityarthaḥ, śalyasthitijñānārthaṃ, sukhenāpakarṣaṇāya ca| unmārgī tiryaggatiḥ|11|-

lg.l: śalyāni mūḍhagarbhāś ca varcaś ca nicitaṃ gude |12|

div.ab: āhāryaviṣayaṃ darśayannāha- āhāryā ityādi| āhāryā ākarṣaṇīyāḥ| śarkarāstisra iti mūtraśarkarā pādaśarkarā dantaśarkarā ceti||11||-

lg.l: srāvyā vidradhayaḥ pañca bhaveyuḥ sarvajād ṛte ||12||
kuṣṭhāni vāyuḥ sarujaḥ śopho yaś caikadeśajaḥ |
arbudāni visarpāś ca granthayaś cāditaś ca te |
su(śu)ṣiro galaśālūkaṃ kaṇṭakāḥ kaṇṭakā jihvākaṇṭakāḥ’ iti cakraḥ kṛmidantakaḥ |

div.ab: visrāvyaviṣayaṃ darśayannāha- srāvyā ityādi||12-15||-

lg.l: sīvyā ‘sīvyā bhedaḥ samutthāśca bhitvā vilikhitā gadāḥ| kaphagranthiralpapāliḥ karṇaḥ sadyovraṇāśca ye|| śirolalāṭākṣikūṭakarṇauṣṭhanāsāgaṇḍakṛkāṭikābāhūdarasphikpāyuprajananamuṣkādiṣu pradeśeṣvacaleṣu māṃsavatsu ca sīvyet| jānukūrparasandhyādiṣu ca pracaleṣvalpamāṃseṣu na sīvyet| vāyunirvāhiṇo'ntarlohitaśalyāḥ saviṣāśca na sīvyāḥ| tatra sīvyaṃ vraṇamabhisamīkṣya calāsthipāṃsutṛṇaromaśuṣkaraktādīnapohyotkṛṣya yathāsthānaṃ sthāpayitvā snāyusūtrabālānāmanyatamena sīvyet, tṛṇāśmantakamūrvātasīnāṃ valkalaiḥ| sūcyastu tisra upadiśyante- dvyaṅgulātryaṅgulā dhanurvakreti| tatra māṃsaleṣvavakāśeṣu tryasrā, sandhyasthisvalpamāṃseṣvavakāśeṣu ca dvyaṅgulā vṛttā, pakvāmāśayayormarmasu ca dhanurvakrā'rdhatṛtīyāṅgulā| gophaṇikā tunnasevanī villitakamṛjugranthiśceti samāsena sīvanavikalpāḥ| teṣāṃ nāmabhirevākṛtayaḥ prāyeṇa vyākhyātāḥ| teṣāṃ prahāramāsādyopayogaṃ buddhvā bandhe na cātisannikṛṣṭāṃ viprakṛṣṭāmalpagrāhiṇīmatigrāhiṇīṃ vā sūcīṃ pātayet| bhavati cātra- dūre nipatitā bādhaṃ sannikṛṣṭe'valuñcanam| alpagrahāttadvadeva vraṇe kuryādatastyajet|| samyak sīvitamavekṣya madhughṛtairañjanamadhukarodhrāpriyaṅguśallakīphalarasāñjanakṣaumamasīcūrṇaiḥ pratisārya bandhenopacaret|| bhavanti cātra ślokāḥ- etadaṣṭavidhaṃ karma” ityādistāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ medaḥsamutthāś ca bhinnāḥ sulikhitā gadāḥ ||16||
sadyovraṇāś ca ye caiva calasandhivyapāśritāḥ ‘calasandhivyayāśrayāḥ’ iti pā|17|

div.ab: sīvyaviṣayaṃ darśayannāha- sīvyā ityādi| medaḥsamutthā iti ye kecana medobhavavikārāḥ| bhinnā iti vidīrṇā ityarthaḥ| sulikhitā gadā iti niravaśeṣalikhitā ityarthaḥ| vyapāśritā iti viśeṣeṇāśritā ityarthaḥ| ‘sādhyāḥ’ iti kecit paṭhanti||16||-

lg.l: na kṣārāgniviṣair juṣṭā na ca mārutavāhinaḥ ||17||

ab.seg: atha ke na sīvyā ityāha- na kṣāretyādi||17||

div.ab: teṣu kiṃ kartavyamityāha- teṣvityādi|18|-

lg.l: pāṃśuromanakhādīni calam asthi bhavec ca yat ||18||
rujaś ca vividhāḥ kuryus tasmād etān viśodhayet ||19||

ab.seg: kān viśodhayedityāha- pāṃśvityādi| anye ‘tṛṇādīni’ iti paṭhanti| kasmādete viśodhyā ityāha- ahṛtānītyādi||18-19||

lg.l: sīvyet ‘sūtrādibhiryathāyogyatayā sīvyediti yojyam| vellitabandhavadvellitakam| tryasratvaṃ bṛhattvaṃ ca māṃsalāvakāśasya dūravedhyatvāt| sandhyādīnāmalpavedhyatayā vṛttātvamalpatvaṃ ca| pakvāśayādāvantaḥ praveśatayā vakrā’ iti cakraḥ sūkṣmeṇa sūtreṇa valkenāśmantakasya vā ||20||
sīvyed gophaṇikāṃ vā'pi sīvyed vā tunnasevanīm |
ṛjugranthim atho vā'pi yathāyogam athāpi vā ||22||
āyatā tryaṅgulā tryasrā māṃsale cā'pi pūjitā ||23||
ity etās trividhāḥ sūcīs tīkṣṇāgrāḥ susamāhitāḥ ||24||
nātidūre nikṛṣṭe vā sūcīṃ karmaṇi pātayet ||25||

div.ab: tatra saptānāṃ chedyādikarmaṇāmavacāraṇasyānyatra darśitatvāt sīvyasya punaratraiva vistareṇa nirdiśannāha- tato vraṇamityādi| samunnamya unnataṃ kṛtvā| aśmantakaḥ amlaloṭakasadṛśo vṛkṣaḥ| kṣaumamiti kṣumā atasī tasyā idaṃ kṣaumam| snāyuriti śaṇākāra upadhātuviśeṣaḥ, yena dhanūṃṣi nahyante| mūrvā caurasnāyuḥ, yayā pūrvadeśe guṇān kurvanti dhanuṣām| anye kovidārasadṛśayugmapatrāṃ latāviśeṣāṃ mūrvāmācakṣate| tānairiti tantubhirityarthaḥ| vellitakaṃ vakram| gophaṇikāṃ gophaṇākārām| tunnasevanīmiti yathā vastraṃ pāṭitaṃ tantuvāyakāḥ sandadhati tadvattunnasevanīṃ sīvyet| ṛjugranthimiti ṛjugrantheḥ sadṛśo bandho yasyāṃ sevanyāṃ sā ṛjugranthiḥ| tryasreti tridhāretyarthaḥ| phalakoṣaḥ aṇḍakoṣaḥ| susamāhitāḥ iti suhastā ityarthaḥ| parimaṇḍalā iti vartulā ityarthaḥ| sannikṛṣṭe nikaṭa ityarthaḥ| avaluccanamiti truṭanamityarthaḥ||20-26||-

lg.l: atha kṣaumapicucchannaṃ susyūtaṃ ‘saṃsyūtaṃ’ iti pā. pratisārayet |

tato vraṇaṃ yathāyogaṃ baddhvā''cārikam ādiśet ‘atra vraṇarohe krameṇa sūtracchedo'pi jñeyaḥ| yaduktaṃ bhoje- “yadā manyeta saṃśliṣṭāṃ peśyā peśīṃ tvacā tvacam| tadā bandhanamekaṃ dve trīṇi vā mokṣayet kramāt” iti cakraḥ||28||

ab.seg: sīvanasya paścātkarma darśayannāha- atha kṣaumetyādi| kṣaumeṇa atasīvastreṇa, picunā kārpāsatūlena, ābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ channamityarthaḥ| susyūtamiti ‘samyaksīvitam’ iti loke| pratisārayet avacūrṇayedityarthaḥ| avacūrṇanadravyāṇyāha- priyaṅgvañjanetyādi| añjanaṃ sauvīrāñjanam| samantata iti sarvatretyarthaḥ| kṣaumadhyāmeneti atasībhavavastrabhasmanā| ācārikamādiśediti vraṇitopāsanīyoktamācāraṃ kathayedityarthaḥ| kecidiha chedyādīni gadyenaiva paṭhanti yāvat ‘baddhvā''cārikamādiśet’ iti||27-28||

saṅkṣepoktiriyaṃ, vistaro'sya vakṣyata iti darśayannāha- etadityādi| aṣṭagrahaṇaṃ punaryadiha kṛtaṃ taccarakoktaṣaṭsaṅkhyānirākaraṇārtham ‘pāṭanaṃ vyadhanaṃ caiva chedanaṃ lekhanaṃ tathā| pracchānaṃ sīvanaṃ caiva ṣaḍvidhaṃ śastrakarma tat” (ca. ci. a. 25) iti||29||

tatrāṣṭānāmapi karmaṇāṃ vyāpadaṃ darśayannāha- hīnātiriktamityādi| gātracchedanamātmanaḥ iti śastrakarma kurvataḥ svaśarīra ‘svaśarīrocchedanam’ iti pā. chedanamityarthaḥ| catasro vyāpada iti; anye tu ‘etā hi tisra’ iti paṭhanti; sa tu pramādapāṭhaḥ||30||

lg.l: yadā prayuñjīta bhiṣak kuśastraṃ tadā sa ‘saśeṣān’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ śeṣān kurute vikārān ||31||

ab.seg: vyāpado hetūn darśayannāha- ajñānetyādi| ahitavākyayogaḥ śatruvacanaprayogaḥ| pramohe vaicittyam ‘pramoho jñānavato'pi karmasamaye sammohaḥ|’ iti cakraḥ| aparaiśca bhāvairiti prayojanavyagratvādibhirityarthaḥ| kuśastramiti ‘īṣadartho'yaṃ kuśabdaḥ kriyāviśeṣaṇam’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ īṣacchastram| sa śeṣāniti sa iti vaidyaḥ śeṣān aparānityarthaḥ||31||

lg.l: taṃ kṣāraśastrāgnibhir auṣadhaiś ca bhūyo 'bhiyuñjānam ayuktiyuktam |
jijīviṣur dūrata eva vaidyaṃ vivarjayed ugraviṣāhitulyam ||32||

ab.seg: prāguktājñānādidoṣadūṣitaṃ vaidyaṃ pratyāturaḥ kiṃ kuryādityāha- taṃ kṣāraśastrāgnibhirityādi| taṃ tathāvidhaṃ bhiṣakchadmacaram| ayuktiyuktaṃ yathā bhavatītyarthaḥ| jijīviṣuḥ jīvitumicchuḥ| dūrata eva vaidyaṃ vivarjayediti tasmai darśanamapi na dadyāt||32||

lg.l: tad eva yuktaṃ tv ati marmasandhīn hiṃsyāt sirāḥ snāyum athāsthi caiva |
mūrkhaprayuktaṃ puruṣaṃ kṣaṇena prāṇair viyuñjyād athavā kadācit ||33||

ab.seg: hīnavyāpadamabhidhāyātiriktaśastravyāpadaṃ darśayannāha- tadevetyādi|- tadeva śastraṃ, yuktaṃ prayuktaṃ, tu punararthe, atīti atiśayena, prāṇairviyuñjyāditi prāṇaiḥ saha viyogaṃ kārayedityarthaḥ||33||

lg.l: bhramaḥ pralāpaḥ patanaṃ pramoho viceṣṭanaṃ saṃlayanoṣṇate hārāṇacandrastu ‘saṃlapanoṣṇate ca’ iti paṭhati, ‘saṃlapanaṃ rahasi bhāṣaṇaṃ, cittavibhramādaspaṣṭamananyāpekṣibhāṣaṇamityetat’ iti vyākhyānayati ca ca |
srastāṅgatā mūrcchanam ūrdhvavātas tīvrā rujo vātakṛtāś ca tās tāḥ ||34||
māṃsodakābhaṃ rudhiraṃ ca gacchet sarvendriyārthoparamas tathaiva |
daśārdhasaṅkhyeṣv api vikṣateṣu sāmānyato marmasu liṅgam uktam ||35||

ab.seg: marmasandhisirāsnāyvasthipañcānāṃ chedanāt pañcaprakārāmatiriktaśastravyāpadaṃ darśayitvedānīṃ teṣveva marmādiṣu viddheṣu yāni liṅgāni bhavanti tāni sāmānyena darśayannāha- bhrama ityādi|- bhramaḥ cakrārūḍhasyeva| pralāpaḥ asambaddhabhāṣaṇam| patanam anūrdhvasthitiḥ| pramohaḥ naivātyantaṃ cittanāśaḥ| viceṣṭanaṃ vigatakāyaparispandanam| saṃlayanaṃ suṣuptāvasthasyeva cittasyākarmaṇyatā| uṣṇatā śarīrasya paritāpaḥ| srastāṅgatā śarīraśaithilyam| mūrcchanaṃ cetanācyutiḥ| ūrdhvavāta iti śvāso'trābhipreto na rogaviśeṣaḥ| māṃsodakābhaṃ māṃsadhāvanajalasadṛśam| uparamo nivṛttiḥ| daśārdhasaṅkhyeṣviti ‘daśārdhasaṅkhyeṣviti sirāsnāyvasthisandhimāṃsātmakatayā pañcasaṅkhyakeṣu marmasu’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ ‘tadeva yuktaṃ’ ityādiślokokteṣu marmasandhiśirāsnāyvasthiṣu pañcasu kṣateṣu viddheṣu||34-35||

lg.l: surendragopapratimaṃ prabhūtaṃ raktaṃ sraved vai kṣatataś ca vāyuḥ |
karoti rogān vividhān yathoktāṃś chinnāsu ‘sirāsu cchinnāsvatha vikṣatāsu’ iti pā. bhinnāsv athavā sirāsu ||36||
kaubjyaṃ śarīrāvayavāvasādaḥ kriyāsv aśaktis tumulā rujaś ca |
cirād vrraṇo rohati yasya cāpi taṃ snāyuviddhaṃ manujaṃ vyavasyet ||37||
śophātivṛddhis tumulā rujaś ca balakṣayaḥ parvasu bhedaśophau |
kṣateṣu sandhiṣv acalācaleṣu syāt sandhikarmoparatiś ca liṅgam ||38||
ghorā rujo yasya niśādineṣu sarvāsv avasthāsu na ‘ca naiti śāntim’ iti pā. śāntir asti |
tṛṣṇāṅgasādau śvayathuś ca ruk ‘rūkṣaḥ’ iti pā. ca tam asthividdhaṃ manujaṃ vyavasyet ||39||

ab.seg: amarmaviddhasirādiliṅgaṃ darśayannāha- surendatyādi| surendragopapratimamiti indragopakīṭasannibhamityarthaḥ| yathoktāniti śoṇitavarṇanīyoktaśirorogādhimanthādīn| kaubjyamityādi kaubjyamiti antarbahirāyāmajaṃ dvidhā| avayavāvasāda iti avayavasya svakarmaṇyasāmarthyam| kriyāsvaśaktiriti sāmānyena sarvaśarīrasya, kriyāścātrotkṣepaṇāpakṣepaṇaprasāraṇākuñcanalakṣaṇāḥ| tumulā gahanāḥ; anye tu “vātapittaśleṣmajanitā ekatra vyākulībhūtavedanāstumulā ucyante” iti vadanti| vyavasyet jānīyādityarthaḥ| śophātivṛddhirityādi śophaḥ prasiddhaḥ| parvasviti sandhiṣu| bhedaḥ sphuṭanamiva| caleṣviti śākhāhanukaragrīvāsu calāḥ sandhayaḥ||36-39||

lg.l: yathāsvam etāni vibhāvayec ca liṅgāni marmasv abhitāḍiteṣu |40|

div.ab: sirādīnāṃ marmarahitānāṃ viddhalakṣaṇamabhidhāya sirādimarmaviddhalakṣaṇamatideśena darśayannāha- yathāsvamityādi| cakāro'yaṃ bhinnakrame etāni cetyatra draṣṭavyaḥ, tena na kevalaṃ bhramapralāpādīni pūrvoktāni , kintu ‘kintu’ iti hastalikhitapustake na paṭhyate avamarmaviddhasirādiliṅgānyapi yathāsvaṃ boddhavyānītyarthaḥ|40|-

lg.l: sparśaṃ na jānāti vipāṇḍuvarṇo yo māṃsamarmaṇy abhitāḍitaḥ syāt ||40||

ab.seg: anuktasya māṃsasya marmaviddhalakṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha- sparśamityādi| sirādivanmāṃsamapi pūrvaṃ kuto na nirdiṣṭamiti cet? kevalamāṃsaviddhasyāvyāpakatvāt| kecidācāryā bhramapralāpādīni liṅgāni sadyaḥprāṇaharādīnāṃ marmaṇāṃ manyante, ata eva teṣāṃ mate daśārdhasaṅkhyeṣvityatra sadyaḥprāṇaharakālāntaraprāṇaharaviśalyaprāṇaharavaikalyakararujākarākhyeṣu pañcasu marmasviti vyākhyānaṃ, tathā teṣāṃ mate yāni sirādīnāṃ ‘surendragopapratimāṃ’ ityādilakṣaṇānyuktāni tānyapi sirādimarmaviddheṣu jñātavyāni, na punarmarmarahitasirādividdheṣu, ata eva teṣāṃ mate ‘yathāsvametāni vibhāvayecca’ ityatra na cakārārthaṃ kathayanti, kintu surendragopapratimamityādyuktalakṣaṇeṣvantarbhāvayanti yathāsvamityādipāṭham||40||

lg.l: ātmānam evātha jaghanyakārī śastreṇa yo hanti hi karma kurvan |
tam ātmavān ātmahanaṃ kuvaidyaṃ vivarjayed āyur abhīpsamānaḥ ||41||

ab.seg: atiriktaśastravyāpadamabhidhāya vaidyasyaivātmagātracchedanavyāpadaṃ darśayannāha- ātmānamevetyādi| ātmānameveti svāṅgamevetyarthaḥ; śastragrahaṇadhāraṇāvacāraṇānabhijñatvāddhinastītyarthaḥ| jaghanyakārī atihīnakarmakārī| taṃ tathāvidhaṃ kuvaidyam| ātmavān buddhimān, ‘ātura’ iti śeṣaḥ| ātmahanam ātmacchedinam, ātmatudam iti kecit paṭhanti| āyuḥ jīvitam||41||

lg.l: tiryak praṇihite śastre doṣāḥ pūrvam udāhṛtāḥ |

ab.seg: tiryakśastrapraṇidhānakarmavyāpadaṃ darśayannāha- tiryakpraṇihita ityādi| doṣāḥ pūrvamudāhṛtā iti agropaharaṇīyādhyāye ‘sirāsnāyucchedanam’ (sū. a.5) ityādayo doṣāḥ| doṣaparihāraṃ darśayannāha- tasmādityādi||42||

lg.l: mātaraṃ pitaraṃ putrān bāndhavān api cāturaḥ |
apy etān abhiśaṅketa vaidye viśvāsam eti ca ||43||

div.ab: idānīṃ vaidyaṃ pratyātureṇa kiṃ kartavyamityāha- mātaramityādi| atra śloke prathamo'piśabdaḥ samuccaye, dvitīyastu sambhāvanāyām| visṛjati dadāti| ātmanā svayameva| ātmānaṃ śarīram| enaṃ vaidyam||43||-

lg.l: tasmāt putravad evainaṃ pālayed āturaṃ bhiṣak ||44||

ab.seg: vaidyenaivaṃvidhe āture viśvaste yat kartavyaṃ tadāha- tasmādityādi| emāturamityatra sambandhaḥ| sādhvekaputravat pālayedityarthaḥ||44||

lg.l: dharmārthau kīrtim ity arthaṃ ‘kīrtiprītyarthaṃ’ iti pā satāṃ grahaṇam uttamam |
prāpnuyāt svargavāsaṃ ca hitam ārabhya karmaṇā ||45||

ab.seg: samyakpālane mahadeva phalaṃ bhavatīti darśayannāha- dharmārthāvityādi| satāṃ grahaṇamuttamamiti śiṣṭānāṃ madhye grahaṇamupādānamuttamaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ||45||

lg.l: karmaṇā kaścid ekena dvābhyāṃ kaścit tribhis tathā |
vikāraḥ sādhyate kaścic caturbhir api karmabhiḥ ||46||

ab.seg: sādhyo'pi vyādhiranekakarmasādhyo bhavatīti darśayannāha- karmaṇetyādi| karmaṇeti chedyādikena snehādikena vā; apiśabdāt pañcādibhirapi| kecit ‘dharmārthau’ ityādiślokamadhyāyānte paṭhanti||46||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne 'ṣṭavidhaśastrakarmīyo nāma pañcaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||25||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne pañcaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||25||

athātaḥ pranaṣṭaśalyavijñānīyam adhyāyaṃ ‘pūrvādhyāye'ntaḥśalyam’ ityuktam, atasteṣāmantaḥ sthitaśalyānāṃ jñānārthaṃ pranaṣṭaśalyavijñānīyo'bhidhīyate| pranaṣṭamāpātato'nupalabhyamānam’ iti cakraḥ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athātaḥ pranaṣṭaśalyetyādi||1-2||

‘śala’ ‘śvala’ āśugamane dhātūḥ; tayor ādyasya śalyam iti ‘tatra śalyanirūpaṇameva darśayitumudyato niruktyā śalyarūpamāha- śala hiṃsāyāmityādi| atra śaladhātoścaurādikaṇijantāt ‘erac’ (pā. a. 3/3/56) ityacā ‘śala’ iti rūpaṃ, tena śalanaṃ hiṃsanaṃ śalaḥ| tathā ca śalasya hiṃsāyā nimittaṃ saṃyogo yasya tat śalyam| yatpratyayāt śalyamiti rūpasiddhiḥ| asya dvayī pravṛttiḥ| ekā niruktyā śalyaṃ sarvavyādhīnāha, yaduktaṃ- ‘yatkiñcidābādhakaraṃ tatsarvaṃ śalyasañjñitam’ iti| aparā tu rūḍhyā śarādau vartate| tatra niruktyarthameva parigṛhyāha- taddvividhamityādi|’ iti cakraḥ| ‘śalati ‘śala’ gatau (bhvā. 843) adhnyāditvāt (u. 4/ 112) yaḥ’ iti amaravyākhyāyāṃ bhānudīkṣitaḥ| ‘śala’ hiṃsāyāṃ dhātuḥ, tasya yatpratyayasya śalyamiti rūpaṃ bhavati’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ rūpam ||3||

tatra śalyasya svakīyalakṣaṇabodhārthaṃ niruktiṃ darśayannāha- śaletyādi| ‘śala’ ‘śvala’ āśugamana iti ‘śala’ ‘śvala’ āśugatau dhātūanayorāśugamanamityarthaḥ, tayorādyasya śaladhātoḥ śalyamiti rūpaṃ niṣpadyata ityarthaḥ; ‘śala’ hiṃsāyāṃ dhātuḥ tasya śalyamiti rūpama iti kecit paṭhanti; apare ‘śala’ ‘rujāyām’ iti paṭhanti||3||
tad dvividhaṃ śārīram āgantukaṃ ca ||4||
tasya cikitsopayogibhedaṃ darśayannāha- tadavityādi||4||
sarvaśarīrābādhakaraṃ śalyaṃ, tad ihopadiśyata ity ataḥ ‘ityataḥ śalyaśāstramiti asmiñchāstre niruktyarthameva śalyasya gṛhītvā sarvābādhaviṣayatayā upadeśa iti bhāvaḥ’ iti cakraḥ śalyaśāstram ||5||
kathaṃ punaḥ śalyaśāstrametaducyata ityāha- sarvaśarīretyādi|- sarvaśarīre yena abādhā bhavati tat śalyaṃ; tadihopadiśyate kathyate'taḥ, śalyaśāstrametadityarthaḥ||5||

tatra ‘tatretyādinā śārīraśalyavivaraṇe dantanakharomādīnāmādau grahaṇaṃ dantādiṣu rūḍhyarthaśalyaśabdasyāpi yogāt| tathāhi- dantaścalitaḥ śārīraṃ śalyam, anyagātrapraviṣṭaṃ mukhyaṃ śalyaṃ ca bhavati| evamuktarūpo nakhaḥ| tathā akṣipratipakṣmaroma śārīraṃ śalyam, anyatra śarīrapradeśe vraṇāntargataṃ mukhyaṃ ca śalyamiti| annaṃ duṣṭaṃ śalyameva ābādhakaratvāt| dhātvādayo'pi duṣṭāḥ śalyam| āgantuśalyodāharaṇe śārīravyatirekeṇeti mānasaśokādiśalyasyāpi grahaṇārtham’ iti cakraḥ śārīraṃ dantaromanakhādi dhātavo 'nnamalā doṣāś ca duṣṭāḥ; āgantv api śārīraśalyavyatirekeṇa yāvanto bhāvā duḥkham utpādayanti ||6||

śārīrāgantukayorbhedamāha- tatretyādi| ādiśabdāt kaiścit śmaśrupūyapakṣmāṇi gṛhyante| dhātavo rasādayaḥ; malā mūtrapurīṣakarṇamalasvedanetraviṭprabhṛtayaḥ, doṣā vātādayaḥ| paramete dhātvannadoṣā duṣṭāḥ santaḥ śalyabhūtāḥ; amumevārthaṃ kecidduṣṭāśceti cakārāt kathayanti| dhātavo'nnamalā ityādyasamastānāṃ pṛthagupādānaṃ yat kṛtaṃ tadupadhātugrahaṇārtham| āgantuśalyaṃ pratipādayannāha- āgantvapītyādi| bhāvā iti padārthātṛṇakāṣṭhapāṣāṇalohaloṣṭraprabhṛtayaḥ||6||

adhikāro hi lohaveṇuvṛkṣatṛṇaśṛṅgāsthimayeṣu; tatrāpi viśeṣato loheṣv eva ‘lohamayeṣveva’ iti pā., viśasanārthopapanna
tvāl lohasya; lohānām api durvāratvād aṇumukhatvād dūraprayojanakaratvāc ca śara evādhikṛtaḥ | sa ca dvividhaḥ karṇī ‘karṇavān’ iti pā., ślakṣṇaś ca; prāyeṇa vividhavṛkṣapatrapuṣpaphalatulyākṛtayo vyākhyātāḥ, vyālamṛgapakṣivakrasadṛśāś ca ||7||

tatrāpi ‘mukhyaśalyaśabdaviṣayaṃ cikitsābhedārthaṃ pṛthakkurvannāha- adhikāro hītyādi’ iti cakraḥ prasiddhaśalyabhedān darśayitumāha- adhikāro hītyādi| adhikāro yogyatvaṃ śalyatvena lohādiṣu| lohādibhirmayaśabdaḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| teṣāṃ madhye lauhasya prādhānyaṃ darśayannāha- tatrāpīti; teṣāmapi madhye| viśeṣata atiśayena| loheṣveveti ‘adhikāraḥ’ ityanuvartate| kathaṃ punarloheṣvevādhikāra ityatra hetumāha- viśasanārthopapannatvāllohasyeti; māraṇārthuyuktatvāllohasyetyarthaḥ| loheṣvapi kuntādibhedenānekaprakāreṣu śarasyaiva prādhānyaṃ darśayannāha- lohānāmityādi|- lohādīnāmapi kuntādīnāmapi madhya ityarthaḥ| śaraḥ kāṇḍaḥ, adhikṛta iti yogya ityarthaḥ| anye tu ‘durvāratvāt’ ityatra ‘nirvāhitvāt ‘nirvāhitvāt śarīrapraveśanīyatvāt| ‘nirvāsitvāt’ iti pāṭhāntare kālāntarāvasthāyitvādityarthaḥ| dūraprayojanakaratvaṃ dūre sthitena dhātvavagāhakena śareṇa vedanāniṣpādanādityarthaḥ’ iti cakraḥ ’ iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- deśāddeśāntaraprāpaṇaśīlatvādityarthaḥ; anye tu ‘nirvāsitvāt’ iti paṭhanti, tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ| tasya śarasyāpaharaṇopayogibhedaṃ darśayannāha- karṇītyādi|- karṇīti karṇayuktaḥ, ślakṣṇaḥ akarṇa ityarthaḥ| ‘karṇavāna’ ityanye paṭhanti, tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ| tadākṛtīnāmānantyena darśayitumaśakyatvāt saṅkṣepeṇa sadṛśanānāvidhavastvākṛtisārūpyeṇa darśayannāha- prāyeṇetyādi| prāyeṇeti bāhulyenetyarthaḥ| vividhavṛkṣapatrākṛtayaḥ pippalapatrakaravīrapatrādyākārāḥ, puṣpākṛtayo mālatīkumudotpalapatrādyākārāḥ, phalākṛtaya elādyākārāḥ| siṃhavyāghrādimukhasadṛśāḥ sarpaphaṇākārā vā; mṛgavaktrasadṛśāḥ śrugālamārjārādimukhasamānāḥ; pakṣivaktrasadṛśāḥ kākakaṅkādivaktrasadṛśāḥ ‘phalākṛtaya iti śarasya apravṛddhaphalādisādṛśyamityarthaḥ| vyālamṛgapakṣimukhetyanena uddhṛtadaṃṣṭrākṛtitā śarasyocyate’ iti cakraḥ||7||

sarvaśalyānāṃ ‘śarīre sarvaśalyānāṃ gatayaḥ pañcadhā smṛtāḥ| ṛjvāgatamavāñcīnaṃ tirya gūrdhvamadhogatam’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ tu mahatām aṇūnāṃ vā pañcavidho gativiśeṣa ūrdhvam adho 'rvācīnas tiryag ṛjur iti ||8||

śarāṇāmāharaṇopayogigatibhedān darśayitumāha- sarvaśalyānāmityādi| tatra, ūrdhvagativiśeṣo'dhastādāgatasya śarasya, adhogativiśeṣa upariṣṭādāgatasya śarasya, arvācīnagativiśeṣaḥ paścādāgatasya śarasya, tiryaggativiśeṣaḥ pārśvābhyāmāgatasya śarasya, ṛjugativiśeṣo'gradeśādāgatasya śarasya| anye tu vyatyayena pañcagatipāṭhaṃ paṭhanti, kiñcidanyathā vyākhyānayanti; taccāsmābhirvistarabhayānna likhitam| anye tu ‘śarīre sarvaśalyānāṃ’ ityādipāṭhaṃ paṭhanti||8||

tāni ‘tāni yadā vegakṣayāt ...... śarīrapradeśeṣu, tatra śalyalakṣaṇamucyamānamupadhāraya’ iti hārāṇacandrasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ| pratighātāditi asthyādinā vegapratibandhāt| vegakṣayastu svata eva| peśīśabdena peśyormadhyam, ata eva vraṇavastugṛhītamāṃsādasya bhedaḥ| prabhṛtigrahaṇāt sirābhyantaragrahaṇam|’ iti cakraḥ vegakṣayāt pratighātād vā tvagādiṣu vraṇavastuṣv atiṣṭhante, dhamanīsroto 'sthivivarapeśīprabhṛtiṣu vā śarīrapradeśeṣu ||9||

yathā śalyāni śarīre sthitiṃ kurvanti tathā hetuṃ darśayannāha- tānītyādi| tāni śalyāni marmāvaraṇeṣu sannāhādiṣu pratighātādveganivṛtterityarthaḥ| tvagādiṣvityatrādiśabdānmāṃsasirāsnāyusandhikoṣṭhāsthimarmāṇi gṛhyante| avatiṣṭhanta iti ‘śalyāni’ iti śeṣaḥ| śalyāvasthāne tvagādibhyo'dhikamapi sthānaṃ sambhavatīti pakṣāntaramāha- dhamanītyādi| dhamanyādibhistribhiḥ saha vivaraśabdaḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyate; vivaraṃ chidraṃ, peśī māṃsakhaṇḍaḥ, vāśabdena pakṣāntaraṃ sūcayati| śarīrapradeśeṣviti dhamanyādaya eva śarīrapradeśāsteṣvityarthaḥ| avatiṣṭhante śalyānīti sambadhyate||9||

tatra śalyalakṣaṇam ucyamānam upadhāraya | tad dvividhaṃ sāmānyaṃ vaiśeṣikaṃ ca | śyāvaṃ piḍakācitaṃ śophavedanāvantaṃ muhur muhuḥ śoṇitāsrāviṇaṃ budbudavad unnataṃ mṛdumāṃsaṃ ca vraṇaṃ jānīyāt saśalyo 'yam iti; sāmānyam etal lakṣaṇam uktam | vaiśeṣikaṃ tu- tvaggate vivarṇaḥ śopho bhavaty āyataḥ kaṭhinaś ca; māṃsagate śophābhi(ti)vṛddhiḥ śalyamārgānupasaṃrohaḥ pīḍanāsahiṣṇutā coṣapākau ca; peśyantarasthe 'py etad eva coṣaśophavarjaṃ; sirāgate sirādhmānaṃ sirāśūlaṃ sirāśophaś ca; snāyugate snāyujālotkṣepaṇaṃ saṃrambhaś cogrā ruk ca; srotogate srotasāṃ svakarmaguṇahāniḥ; dhamanīsthe saphenaṃ raktam īrayann anilaḥ saśabdo nirgacchaty aṅgamardaḥ pipāsā hṛllāsaś ca; asthigate vividhavedanāprādurbhāvaḥ śophaś ca; asthivivaragate 'sthipūrṇatā'sthitodaḥ saṃharṣo balavāṃś ca; sandhigate 'sthivac ceṣṭoparamaś ca; koṣṭhagata āṭopānāhau mūtrapurīṣāhāradarśanaṃ ca vraṇamukhāt; marmagate marmaviddhavac ceṣṭate | sūkṣmagatiṣu śalyeṣv etāny eva lakṣaṇāny aspaṣṭāni bhavanti ||10||

tvagādiśalyānāṃ lakṣaṇāni nirdiśannāha- tatretyādi| tatra teṣu tvagādiṣvityarthaḥ| lakṣaṇaṃ cihnam| upadhāraya śṛṇu| tatra prathamaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇamāha- śyāvamityādi| piḍakācitamiti piḍakāvyāptam|| sāmānyamabhidhāya vaiśeṣikaṃ lakṣaṇamāha- vaiśeṣikamityādi| coṣaḥ cūṣyata iva vedanāviśeṣaḥ, pipāsetyanye| coṣaśophavarjaṃ pākābhāvāt| snāyugata ityādi| snāyujālotkṣepaṇaṃ snāyusamūhasyordhvaṃ nayanaṃ, saṃrambhaḥ śvayathuḥ| srotasāṃ svakarmaguṇahāniriti rasādivahānāṃ srotasāṃ rasādivahanādikarma, guṇāḥ punareṣāṃ vātādivahānāmaruṇapītasitaraktādayo varṇāḥ, teṣāṃ hānirityarthaḥ| dhamanīstha ityādi| aṅgamardaḥ sphuṭanikā, hṛllāsaḥ asakṛtṣṭhīvanam| saṃharṣa iti mārutopadravo romāñcaprāyo vedanāviśeṣaḥ ‘saṃharṣaḥ saṅghaṭanam’ ityanye| ceṣṭoparama ‘ceṣṭoparamaścalasandhiṣu jñeyaḥ’ iti cakraḥ iti ākuñcanaprasāraṇādihāniḥ| koṣṭhagate ityādi| āṭopaḥ satodo vātasaṅkṣobhaḥ, ānāho vātamūtrapurīṣādinirodhaḥ| marmaviddhavat ceṣṭate iti sirādimarmaviddhe yāni liṅgāni bhavanti tānītyarthaḥ; ceṣṭate ceṣṭāṃ kurute| sthūlaśalyānāṃ lakṣaṇamabhidhāya sūkṣmaśalyalakṣaṇamāha- sūkṣmagatiṣu śalyeṣviti| aspaṣṭāni iti asphuṭānītyarthaḥ||10||

mahānty alpāni vā śuddhadehānām anulomasanniviṣṭāni rohanti viśeṣataḥ kaṇṭhasrotaḥsirātvakpeśyasthivivareṣaḥ | doṣaprakopavyāyāmābhighātājīrṇebhyaḥ ‘kālāntarakope hetumāha- doṣetyādi| etadeva ca kālāntarakopitvamanviṣyāharaṇe iha vaktavye kāraṇaṃ jñeyam’ iti cakraḥ pracalitāni punar bādhante ||11||

idānīṃ śalyapranaṣṭasya hetuṃ darśayannāha- mahāntītyādi| śuddhadehānāmiti vātādyadūṣitadehānāṃ pākābhāvādrohantītyarthaḥ| anulomasanniviṣṭānīti romamānukūlyena praviṣṭānītyarthaḥ| viśeṣataḥ ityatiśayena, kaṇṭhādiṣu praviṣṭāni śalyāni ‘rohanti' iti śeṣaḥ| kecit ‘mahānti’ ityatra sthāne ‘mṛdūnyalpāni’ iti pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti| yadi rūḍhānyapyadoṣakarāṇi tat kiṃ teṣāṃ vijñānenāharaṇena cetyāha- doṣaprakopetyādi||11||

tatra, tvakpranaṣṭe snigdhasvinnāyāṃ mṛnmāṣayavagodhūmagomayamṛditāyāṃ tvaci yatra saṃrambho vedanā vā bhavati tatra śalyaṃ vijānīyāt, styānaghṛtamṛccandanakalkair vā pradigdhāyāṃ śalyoṣmaṇā''śu visarati ghṛtam upaśuṣyati cālepo yatra tatra śalyaṃ vijānīyāt; māṃsapranaṣṭe snehasvedādibhiḥ kriyāviśeṣair aviruddhair āturam upapādayet, karśitasya tu śithilībhūtam anavabaddhaṃ kṣubhyamāṇaṃ yatra saṃrambhaṃ vedanāṃ vā janayati tatra śalyaṃ vijānīyāt; koṣṭhāsthisandhipeśīvivareṣv avasthitam evam eva parīkṣeta; sirādhamanīsrotaḥsnāyupranaṣṭe khaṇḍacakrasaṃyukte yāne vyādhitam āropyāśu viṣame 'dhvani yāyāt yatra saṃrambho vedanā vā bhavati tatra śalyaṃ vijānīyāt; asthipranaṣṭe snehasvedopapannāny asthīni bandhanapīḍanābhyāṃ bhṛśam upācaret, yatra saṃrambho vedanā bhavati tatra śalyaṃ vijānīyāt; sandhipranaṣṭe snehasvedopapannān sandhīn prasaraṇākuñcanabandhanapīḍanaiḥ bhṛśam upācaret, yatra saṃrambho vedanā vā bhavati tatra śalyaṃ vijānīyāt, sandhipranaṣṭe snehasvedopapannān sandhīn prasaraṇākuñcanabandhanapīḍanair bhṛśam upācaret; yatra saṃrambho vedanā vā bhavati tatra śalyaṃ vijānīyāt, marmapranaṣṭe tv ananyabhāvān marmaṇām uktaṃ parīkṣaṇaṃ bhavati ||12||

tvagādipraviṣṭānāṃ vijñānopāyaṃ darśayannāha- tatretyādi| saṃrambho rāgaśothābhisambhavaḥ| āśu visaratīti śīghraṃ vilīyate| māṃsetyādi| kriyāviśeṣaiḥ sahāturamupapādayet yojayedityarthaḥ| karśitasya āturasyetyarthaḥ| śithilībhūtamanavabaddhaṃ kṣubhyamāṇaṃ ‘śalyaṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ, kṣubhyamāṇamiti caladityarthaḥ| evameveti pūrvoktanyāyenetyarthaḥ| khaṇḍacakrasaṃyukte yāna iti khaṇḍitacakrasamanvite ratha ityarthaḥ| āropyeti ārohyetyarthaḥ, viṣame'dhvani nimnonnatamārge ityarthaḥ| snehasvedopapannāni snehasvedayuktānītyarthaḥ| marmapranaṣṭe ityādi marmāṇi tvagādiṣvaṣṭasu vraṇavastuṣveva bhavanti, nānyatra bhavantityananyabhāvānmarmaṇāṃ pranaṣṭaśalye tvagādyuktameva parīkṣaṇaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ||12||

sāmānyalakṣam api ca hastiskandhāśvapṛṣṭhaparvatadrumārohaṇadhanurvyāyāmadrutayānaniyuddhādhvagamanalaṅghanaplavanaprataraṇa- vyāyāmair jṛmbhodgārakāsakṣavathuṣṭhīvanahasanaprāṇāyāmair vātamūtrapurīṣaśukrotsargair vā yatra saṃrambho vedanā vā bhavati tatra śalyaṃ vijānīyāt ||13||

sāmānyavijñānopāyamapi darśayannāha- sāmānyalakṣaṇamityādi| aṣṭasvapi tvagādivraṇavastuṣvavasthitaśalyasya lakṣaṇaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇam| hastiskandhādibhiḥ sahārohaṇaśabdaḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| dhanurvyāyāmaḥ iti dhanurākarṣaṇajanitaśramaḥ, drutayānamiti śīghragamanaṃ, niyuddhaṃ bāhuyuddhaṃ, laṅghanamiti kuḍyādīnāmutplutyātikramaṇaṃ, plavanaṃ utpatanaṃ, prataraṇaṃ nadyādau, vyāyāmaḥ śarīrāyāsajanakaṃ karma| jṛmbheti pītaikamārutocchvāsasya vyāttamukhena parimokṣaṇaṃ, udgāreti udgatasya vāyorudgiraṇamudgāraḥ, kāseti doṣaduṣṭodānānugataprāṇavāyornirgamanaṃ bhinnakāṃsyadhvanikaṃ kāsaḥ, kṣavathuriti ūrdhvasroto'vasthitaprāṇodānayorākulitayornāsāvivarato nirgamanaṃ kṣavathuḥ, ṣṭhīvanaṃ kaphādesthūtkaraṇaṃ, hasanaṃ hāso vikṛtāṅgavacaḥkṛtyajātasya hāsyarasasya sthāyībhāvo'ṅgakapolanāsauṣṭhaspandanalakṣaṇaḥ, prāṇāyāmeti prāṇavāyorāyamanamavarodhanaṃ prāṇāyāmaḥ, utsargaśabdo vātādibhiḥ saha pratyekaṃ sambadhyate, utsargaḥ pramocanam| kecid ‘yatra saṃrambho vedanā vā’ ityatra’ sthāne ‘utsargervā yatra todādayastatra śalyaṃ vijānīyāt’ iti pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- ādiśabdāt pākarāgaśothādayaḥ| śyāvaṃ piḍakācitamityādīni pūrvoktasāmānyalakṣaṇāni sannikṛṣṭāni; etāni punarhastiskandhārohaṇādīni viprakṛṣṭāni; yata etaireva śyāvaṃ piḍakācitamityādi lakṣayitavyam; ityanayoḥ sāmānyalakṣaṇapāṭhayorna paunaruktyam||13||

bhavanti cātra-
yasmiṃs todādayo deśe suptatā gurutā'pi ca |
ghaṭṭate ‘ghaṭṭite’ iti pā. bahuśo yatra śūyate rujyate 'pi ca ||14||

lg.l: āturaś cāpi yaṃ deśam abhīkṣṇaṃ parirakṣati |

ab.seg: pranaṣṭaśalyavijñānopāyamuddiśyāparāṇyapi rājārṣiḥ punarliṅgāni niścayārthamāha- yasminnityādi| yasmin deśe śarīrāvayave| todādayo ‘bhavanti’ ityadhyāhāraḥ| ādigrahaṇād rāgapākādayaḥ| suptatā sparśanānabhijñatvam| ghaṭṭate bahuśo yatreti yasmin pradeśe bahuśo vāraṃvāraṃ puruṣaḥ svayameva ghaṭṭate cālayati| tudyate'pi cetyatra pīḍāyā atiśayakhyāpanaṃ na punaruktiḥ| āturaścāpi yaṃ deśamityādi| āturo yaṃ deśamabhīkṣṇamanavarataṃ rakṣati, kiṃviśiṣṭaḥ? saṃvāhyamāno mṛdyamānaḥ, kathaṃ bahuśo vāraṃvāraṃ; etena yadā yadā''turo mṛdyate tadā tadā taṃ deśaṃ rakṣatītyarthaḥ||14-15||

niḥśalyasya lakṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha- alpābādhamityādi| alpābādham alpaduḥkham| nīrujaṃ nirgataśūlādivedanam| mṛduparyantaṃ mṛdvantam, nirāghaṭṭaṃ niścalam| eṣaṇetyādi| cikitsako vaidhaḥ, niḥśalyamiti nirdiśet kathayet; kiṃ kṛtvā? dṛṣṭvā, kayā eṣaṇyā lohādiśalākayā, sarvataḥ sarvatra, kathaṃ? yathāmārgaṃ mārgānatikrameṇa; kathaṃ kathayet nūnaṃ niścitaṃ, kasmāt? prasāraṇādākuñcanācca alpāpi yadi bādhā na bhavatītyarthaḥ| ‘alpabādhaṃ’ ityatra ‘alpatāpaṃ ityanye paṭhanti,| kecita ‘anunnatam’ iti na paṭhanti, aśūnamityanenaiva gatārthatvāt||16-17||

lg.l: asthyātmakaṃ bhajyate tu śalyam antaś ca śīryate |
prāyo nirbhujyate śārṅgam āyasaṃ ceti niścayaḥ ||18||

ab.seg: āharaṇopayoginīṃ hetubhedenāntaḥ sthaśalyāvasthāṃ darśayannāha- asthyātmakamityādi| asthyātmakam asthijaṃ; bhajyata iti svayaṃ dvidhā tridhā vā bhavatītyarthaḥ| etenaivāsyāharaṇe'vayavāntaraṃ vicāryāharaṇaṃ ‘vidāryāharaṇaṃ’ iti pā. kartavyamityabhiprāyaḥ| śīryate ‘śīryate kaṇaśaḥ sphuṭyate’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ| ‘bhidyata iti vidīrṇaṃ bhavati, śīryate iti naikāvayavaṃ bhavati| yattu viṣāṇetyādi asthyātmakaṃ na viśīryate iti vaktavyaṃ, tatra kṣayaṃ na yātītyarthabhedānna virodhaḥ| nirbhujyata iti kubjaṃ bhavati iti’ cakraḥ iti śaṭatītyarthaḥ| nanu, ‘keśāsthiveṇudārupalāni tu na viśīryante’ ityagre vakṣyati, atra tu ‘antaśca śīryate’ iti kathayati, tatkathaṃ na virodhaḥ? ucyate antaśca śīryata iti cakāro viṣayabhedapratipādanārthaṃ; tena keṣāñcidevāsthanāṃ śīrṇatvaṃ na sarveṣāmiti nāsti virodhaḥ| nirbhujyate iti kuṭilībhavati| śārṅgamiti śṛṅgamayam| āyasaṃ ceti lohamayamapi nirbhujyata ityarthaḥ||18||

lg.l: pacanti raktaṃ māṃsaṃ ca kṣipram etāni dehinām ||19||

ab.seg: vārkṣādīnāṃ viśalyaghne marmaṇi pākāt svayaṃ patitānāmavaśyamanirharaṇīyatvaṃ ‘patanārthaṃ’ iti pā. darśayannāha- vārkṣetyādi|- vārkṣyaṃ vṛkṣamayaṃ, vaiṇavaṃ veṇumayaṃ, tārṇaṃ tṛṇamayam| nirhriyante tu no yadīti anirharaṇaṃ ca viśalyaprāṇaharapradeśe boddhavyam| pacanti raktaṃ māṃsaṃ cetyādinā vārkṣādīni śalyāni pākāt svayaṃ patantītyuktaṃ bhavati||19||

lg.l: kānakaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ raitikaṃ trapu sīsakam |
cirasthānād vilīyante pittatejaḥpratāpanāt ‘pittatejaḥ jaṭharāgnirūpapittatejaḥsahakṛto dohoṣmā’ iti cakraḥ||20||

ab.seg: viśalyaprāṇaharādiṣu pradeśeṣu kānakādīnāmanāharaṇe'doṣaṃ darśayannāha- kānakamityādi| raitikamiti rītiḥ pittalabhedaḥ, tanmayaṃ raitikam| kecidatra raitikamiti padaṃ vihāya kṛṣṇāyastrapusīsakam’ iti paṭhanti||20||
anyeṣāmapi kāṃsyaprabhṛtīnāṃ kānakādidharmaṃ darśayannāha- svabhāvetyādi||21||

lg.l: śalyāni na viśīryante śarīre mṛnmayāni ‘anena ca naṣṭaśalyāvasthākathanena asthyātmakamavayavāntaramanviṣyāhartavyaṃ, śārṅgādi haṭhātkṛtvā hartavyaṃ, vārkṣādi śīghramāhartavyaṃ, kānakādīnāṃ pramādabhayādanāharaṇe'pi na doṣa iti prayojanamuktam’ iti cakraḥ ca ||22||

ab.seg: apareṣāṃ cirakālasaṃsthitāvapi na śarīradhātubhirekatvamiti darśayannāha- viṣāṇetyādi|- viṣāṇaṃ śṛṅgaṃ, dāru kāṣṭhaṃ, upalaḥ pāṣāṇaḥ, na viśīryanta iti na śaṭantītyarthaḥ| mṛnmayāni mṛttikāmayāni||22||

lg.l: yo vetti viṣṭitaṃ śalyaṃ sa rājñaḥ kartum arhati ||23||

ab.seg: adhyāyapiṇḍārthajñānena vaidyastuti darśayannāha- dvividhamityādi|- dvividhaṃ dviprakāraṃ karṇī ślakṣṇaśceti; anye śarīrāgantubhedena dvaividhyaṃ manyante| pañcagatimaditi ūrdhvādho'rvācīnatiryagṛjugatikam| tvagādivraṇavastuṣviti tvagādivraṇavastuṣvaṣṭāsu viṣṭitaṃ vividhaprakāraṃ sthitam| rājagrahaṇaṃ pradhānasaṅgrahārtham| kartumiti pratīkāraṃ kartumityarthaḥ, arhati yogyo bhavati| ‘yo vettyadhiṣṭhitaṃ śalyaṃ’ iti kecit paṭhanti||23||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne pranaṣṭaśalyavijñānīyo nāma ṣaḍviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||26||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne ṣaḍviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||26||
athātaḥ śalyāpanayanīyam adhyāyaṃ ‘pūrvādhyāyoktavidhinā jñātasya śalyasya nirharaṇārthaṃ śalyāpanayanīyo'bhidhīyate’ iti cakraḥ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
śalyaṃ dvividham avabaddham anavabaddhaṃ ca ||3||
avabaddhamanavabaddhaṃ ceti tatrāvabaddhaṃ viśeṣeṇā''saktam; anye tu “asthyādipraviṣṭamavabaddham ‘asthyādikhadaṣṭaṃ’ iti pā., itaradanavabaddham” iti manyante||1-3||

tatra samāsenānavabaddhaśalyoddharaṇārthaṃ pañcadaśa tāḍapatrapustake ‘nava hetūn vakṣyāmaḥ’ iti paṭhyate, tatra bhedanadāraṇapīḍanavamanavirecanaprakṣālanāni na paṭhyante| eṣāṃ vyākhyānagranthe (5 sūtre)'pi bhedanadāraṇapīḍanavamanavirecanaprakṣālanānāṃ vyākhyānaṃ na paṭhyate tāḍapatrapustake| ‘bhedanadāraṇapīḍanavamanavirecanaprakṣālanāni pratikṣipyāvaśiṣṭāni ye paṭhanti teṣāṃ bhedanadāraṇe pācanottarakarmatayā pācane, pīḍanaṃ pramārjane, vamanaṃ pratimarśe, virecanaṃ pravāhaṇaṃ prakṣālanaṃ ca pariṣeke (pramārjane)'ntarmāvanīyam’ iti cakraḥ hetūn vakṣyāmaḥ | tad yathā- svabhāvaḥ, pācanaṃ, bhedanaṃ, dāraṇaṃ, pīḍanaṃ, pramārjanaṃ, nirdhmāpanaṃ, vamanaṃ, virecanaṃ, prakṣālanaṃ, pratimarśaḥ, pravāhaṇam, ācūṣaṇam, ayaskānto, harṣaś ceti ||4||

tatrānavabaddhasyaiva prathamamaṅgīkṛtasya parisaṅkhyāya hetūn pariharaṇe darśayannāha- tatretyādi| tatreti tayormadhye| svabhāvaḥ prakṛtiḥ; pācanamiti apakvaśalyasya pācanadravyaiḥ pākavidhānaṃ; bhedanamiti vṛddhipatrādibhiḥ śastraiḥ sphoṭanaṃ; dāraṇamiti cirabilvādibhirmiśrakoktairauṣadhairvidāraṇaṃ; pīḍanamiti ‘dravyāṇāṃ picchilānāṃ’(sū. a.37) ityādimiśrakoktairdravyaiḥ kṛtvā pīḍyate yat; pramārjanamiti bālavastrābhiḥ proñchanaṃ; nirdhmāpanamiti pradhamanam, etaduktaṃ bhavati pippalīkaṭphalādicūrṇasya nāḍyā nāsāntaḥprāpaṇaṃ; pratimarśaḥ aṅgulyādigharṣaṇaṃ; pravāhaṇaṃ vi(ni)kunthanam; ācūṣaṇaṃ mukhaśṛṅgaiḥ kṛtvā yaccūṣyate; ayaskāntaḥ pāṣāṇaviśeṣaḥ, yadyapyayaskānta iti sāmānyenopāttastathā'pyatra karṣako grāhyaḥ; harṣastuṣṭiḥ||4||

tatrāśrukṣavathūdgārakāsamūtrapurīṣānilaiḥ svabhāvabalapravṛttair nayanādibhyaḥ patati | māṃsāvagāḍhaṃ śalyam avidahyamānaṃ pācayitvā prakothāt tasya pūyaśoṇitavegād gauravād vā patati | pakvam abhidyamānaṃ bhedayed dārayed vā | bhinnam anirasyamānaṃ pīḍanīyaiḥ pīḍayet pāṇibhir vā | aṇūny akṣaśalyāni ‘akṣiśalyāni akṣigataśalyāni| pravāhaṇam adhaḥpreraṇam’ iti cakraḥ pariṣecanādhmāpanair bālavastrapāṇibhiḥ ‘pariṣecanopadhamanaiḥ’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ pramārjayet | āhāraśeṣaśleṣmahīnāṇuśalyāni ‘āhāraśeṣaṃ kaṇṭhagataṃ śleṣasiṅghāṇakaṃ niśvāsotkāsanābhyāṃ nirdhamet, etannirdhamanaṃ nāma| annaśalyāni vamanāṅgulisparśanaprabhṛtibhiḥ prabhṛjyoddharet, eṣa pratimarśo nāma’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ śvasanotkāsanapradhamanair nirdhamet | annaśalyāni vamanāṅgulipratimarśaprabhṛtibhiḥ | virecanaiḥ pakvāśayagatāni | vraṇadoṣāśayagatāni prakṣālanaiḥ | vātamūtrapurīṣagarbhasaṅgeṣu pravāhaṇam uktam ‘virecanairvā pravāhaṇenoddharet, etatpravāhaṇaṃ nāma’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ| mārutodakasaviṣarudhiraduṣṭastanyeṣv ācūṣaṇam āsyena viṣāṇair vā | anulomam anavabaddham akarṇam analpavraṇamukham ayaskāntena | hṛdy avasthitam anekakāraṇotpannaṃ śokaśalyaṃ harṣeṇeti ||5||

svabhāvādihetorviṣayamāha- tatrāśrukṣavathūdgāretyādi| tatra teṣāṃ pañcadaśānāṃ madhye| etairaśruprabhṛtibhiḥ svabhāvabalaṃ svabhāvaśaktiḥ, tataḥ pravṛttairāgatairhetubhirnayanādibhyaḥ śarīrapradeśebhyo rajaḥprabhṛti śalyaṃ patatītyarthaḥ| pācanaviṣayamāha- māṃsāvagāḍhamityādi| avagāḍham abhyantaragatam| avidahyamānam apacyamānam| prakothāttasyeti pūtibhāvānmāṃsasyetyarthaḥ| bhedanadāraṇayorviṣayamāha- pakvamityādi| pīḍanaviṣayamāha- bhinnamityādi| anirasyamānam aniṣkrāmantam| pramārjanaviṣayamāha- aṇūnītyādi| akṣāṇi indriyāṇi| pariṣecanaṃ dhārābhiṣecanam| ādhmāpanam akṣiṣu mukhamārutasya prāpaṇam| nirdhmāpanaviṣayamāha- āhāraśeṣatyādi|- bhuñjānasya nāsāntarādisthitamannamāhāraśeṣaḥ| hīnānāṃ patitānāṃ bhraṣṭānāṃ śalyānāmalpāvayavā hīnāṇuśalyānyucyante| śvasanaṃ śvāsaḥ, utkāsa utkṛṣṭaṃ kāsanam| nirdhamet niṣkāsayet| vamanapratimarśayorviṣayamāha- annaśalyānītyādi| annaśalyaṃ vamanena patati, aṅgulipratimarśena ca; aṅgulipratimarśaḥ aṅgulyādigharṣaṇam| virecanaviṣayaṃ darśayannāha- virecanaiḥ pakvāśayagatānīti|- pakvāśayagatāni ‘śalyāni’ iti śeṣaḥ| prakṣālanaviṣayamāha- vraṇetyādi| vraṇadoṣaḥ pūyaḥ, sa eva śalyaṃ, vraṇāśayagatānyanyānyapi śalyānītyarthaḥ| pravāhaṇaviṣayamāha- vātetyādi| saṅgaḥ apravṛttiḥ| cūṣaṇaviṣayamāha- mārutetyādi| ayaskāntaviṣayamāha- anulomamityādi| harṣaviṣayamāha- hṛdyavasthitamityādi| kecidanavabaddhaśalyaharaṇamadhye bhedanadāraṇapīḍanavamanavirecanaprakṣālanāni na manyante, teṣāṃ mate bhedanadāraṇayoravabaddhaśalyaviṣayatvaṃ, pīḍanādīnāṃ caturṇāṃ yathāsambhavamukteṣvevāntarbhāvaḥ||5||

sarvaśalyānāṃ tu mahatām aṇūnāṃ vā dvāv evāharaṇahetū bhavataḥ- pratilomo 'nulomaś ca ‘yathā śalyaṃ praviṣṭaṃ tenāhriyamāṇaṃ pratilomaṃ, parāmukhenāhriyamāṇamanulomam| pratilomaviṣayo'rvācīnaṃ nātidūrapraviṣṭaṃ, tatpraveśamārgeṇaivāharaṇīyam, evaṃ ca pratilomāharaṇaṃ bhavati| parācīnaṃ tu parānirgatamukhaṃ tanmukhenaivāhartavyaṃ, tathā cānulomaṃ bhavati, tasya punaḥ praveśamārgeṇānayanena sthūlaśalyāgreṇa punarbahudeśaghaṭṭanaṃ bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ| anirgatamukhamapi yathā'nulomaṃ parācīnamāhriyate tadāha- uttuṇḍitamityādi| chedanīyamukhaṃ chedanārhadeśamukham| etacca chedayitvā''haraṇaṃ karṇavataḥ śalyasya jñeyam| taddhi praveśamārgeṇāhriyamāṇaṃ bahuśarīrapradeśaṃ karṇāvaṣṭabdhaṃ hinasti, tena parāgbhāgameva stokaṃ chedayitvā nirhriyate, tena karṇavataḥ śalyasyālpopaghātena nirgamo bhavati| yāni tvakarṇavanti parānirgatamukhāni tāni chedanīyamukhānyapi praveśamārgeṇaiva pratilomaṃ hartavyāni’ iti cakraḥ||6||
pañcagatīnāṃ śalyānāmapi sarveṣāmamārgamārgabhedena dvividhamāharaṇaṃ darśayannāha- sarvaśalyānāmityādi| praveśamārgeṇaivāharaṇaṃ pratilomaṃ, tadviparītaṃ cānulomam||6||

tatra pratilomam arvācīnam ānayet ‘nahyarvācīnaṃ nāmottuṇḍitaṃ kvacidapi pratilomamāhartuṃ yujyate, nāpi cātidīrghaṃ tadanulomaṃ chedānubandhena saṅgharṣaprakarṣeṇa cāśaṅkitatvāt, tadidamucyate uttuṇḍitamiti| uttuṇḍitamudgatakaṇṭakācitamukhaṃ, chidyate'neneti kṛtyalyuṭorbāhulyācchedanīyaṃ dhārā mukhe yasyeti chedanīyamukhaṃ, tātparyādarvācīnaṃ śalyaṃ chittvā nirghātayedānulomyenāharaṇārthaṃ parācīnaṃ kartumiti śeṣaḥ| atra chittveti śalyadairghyapariṇāhasaṅgharṣakṛtopatāpaśaṅkājihāsārthamidaṃ chedanaṃ tāvatyaṃśe kartavyaṃ yāvatyaṃśe chinne sukhaṃ śalyaṃ parācīnaṃ bhavitumarhatīti sudhiyo manyante| na ca vidhirayaṃ sarvatra sāmprataṃ bhavatītyata āha- chedanīyetyādi| apiśabdaḥ pūrvapakṣavyāvṛttyarthaḥ| hastaśakyamiti kriyāviśeṣaṇaṃ| kukṣyādyantarapatitāni kukṣyādimadhyapatitāni kukṣyādiṣvarvācīnānīti yāvat, cakārāduttuṇḍitāni śalyāni chedanīyamukhāni dhārāmukhānyapi, yathāmārgaṃ pratilomaṃ hastenaivāpahartuṃ yateteti samanvayaḥ’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ| ‘apanayet’ iti pā., anulomaṃ parācīnam ||7||

pratilomānulomāharaṇayorviṣayamāha- tatretyādi| tatreti tayormadhye| arvācīnamiti nātidūrapraveśāt, niviṣṭaśalyadvārāpekṣayā kāyasya pūrvārdhasthitaṃ śalyamārvācīnamucyate| tattu śalyaṃ pratilomamānayet| ko'rthaḥ? pāścātye'rvācīnadeśe ānayet, praveśamārgeṇaivānayet; anulomena parārdhena nirhriyamāṇamaviddhamapi bahutaraṃ pradeśaṃ vedhayet; tatra maraṇamupadravā vā bhavanti| anulomamityādi| parācīnamiti dūrapraviṣṭaṃ; kāyasya parārdhanirgataṃ śalyamucyate| tacchalyamanulomamānayet| ko'rthaḥ? agretane parācīne pradeśe ānayet||7||
uttuṇḍitaṃ ‘uttuṇḍitaṃ śalyaṃ budbudavadabhimukhībhūtam’ iti aruṇadattaḥ chittvā nirghātayec chedanīyamukham ||8||

yadā tvanativegācchalyamagretanapradeśena nirgatamuttuṇḍitamukhaṃ ca bhavati tadā tasya śalyasya chedanīyamukhasya chedyapradeśajaṭitasya parācīnānulomaharaṇe kīdṛśaṃ vidhānamiti darśayannāha- uttuṇḍitamityādi| uttuṇḍitamūrdhvaṃ niḥsaranmukhamiva| nirghātayediti itastataścālayeddhastena mudgarādinā vā; tataścānulomamāharet| chedanīyamukhamiti kaṇṭakakharjūrīpatraprabhṛtikam, etenottuṇḍitaṃ chedanīyamukhaṃ parānnirgatamukhaṃ chedyapradeśajaṭitaṃ ca śalyaṃ parācīnānulomāharaṇaviṣaya ityuktaṃ bhavati||8||
chedanīyamukhāny api kukṣivakṣaḥkakṣāvaṅkṣaṇaparśukāntarapatitāni ca hastaśakyaṃ yathāmārgeṇa hastenaivāpahartuṃ prayateta ||9||

kiṃ chedanīyamukhasya sarvatrāyaṃ vidhirnetyāha- chedanīyetyādi| vakṣa iti hṛdayam| hastenāhartuṃ yacchakyate śalyaṃ tat hastaśakyam| yathāmārgeṇeti praveśamārgeṇetyarthaḥ| hastenaiveti hastenaivoddharet, na kadācinmudgarādibhiścālayet| prayateta prayatnaṃ kurvīta| anye tu ‘acchedanīyamukhāni ‘karṇavato'pyacchedyamukhasya pratilomaṃ praveśamārgeṇaivāharaṇamāha- acchedanīyamukhānyapītyādi| eteṣāṃ mukhacchede mahatī vyāpanmaraṇaṃ vā bhavati| tena praveśamārgeṇaiva karṇamardanaṃ kṛtvā yantreṇa vā karṇaṃ yantrayitvā chedanīyaṃ| pracchedanaṃ ca kṛtvā pratilomameva haraṇamatretyarthaḥ’ iti cakraḥ tu’ ityādi pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- na kevalamanuttuṇḍitānyanirghātyamukhānyapīti samuccīyate tuśabdena, tāni kukṣyādipatitāni sarvāṇyevācchedyatvādanirghātyāharaṇīyāni ‘…chedanirghātyāharaṇīyāni’ iti pā.| etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati- parācīnānāmapi śalyānāmanulomamāharaṇīyānāmapi pratilomamevāharaṇaṃ kartavyam, anulomāharaṇe kukṣyādiṣu mahān chedānubandho bhavet| parśukāntarapatitāni cetyasyāgre, “anuttuṇḍitaśalyāni chedanīyamukhāni ca| anirghātyāni jānīyādbhūyaśchedānubandhataḥ”- iti bhojasaṃhitoktaṃ kecit pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti, sa ca pramādapāṭhaḥ, nibandheṣvadarśanāt||9||

hastenaivāpahartum aśakyaṃ ‘śalyāpaharaṇaṃ hastenaiva yathāyogyatayā prāyaḥ kartavyaṃ, tenāśakye yantreṇetyāha- hastenetyādi| viśasyeti yantrapraveśanirodhakaṃ pradeśaṃ śastreṇa chittvā’ iti cakraḥ viśasya ‘vimṛṣya śastreṇa vā’ iti pā. śastreṇa yantreṇāpaharet ‘athāharet karaprāpyaṃ kareṇaivetarat punaḥ| dṛśyaṃ siṃhāhimakaravarmikarkaṭakānanaiḥ|| adṛśyaṃ vraṇasaṃsthānādgrahītuṃ śakyate yataḥ| kaṅkabhṛṅgāhvakuraraśarārivāyasānanaiḥ|| adṛśyaṃ vraṇasaṃsthānādgrahītuṃ śakyate yataḥ| kaṅkabhṛṅgāhvakuraraśarārivāyasānanaiḥ|| sandaṃśābhyāṃ tvagādisthaṃ tālābhyāṃ suśiraṃ haret| suśirasthaṃ tu nalakaiḥ śeṣaṃ śeṣairyathāyatham’ (vā. sū. a. 28)||10||

hastenāpahartumaśakye śalye kiṃ vidhānamiti darśayati- hastenetyādi| viśasya chittvā śastreṇetyarthaḥ| kecit ‘hastena cāhartumaśakye aviśasya yantreṇāpaharet’ iti pāṭhaṃ manyante| teṣāṃ mate aviśasya acchittvetyarthaḥ, hastena ceti cakāreṇa yantrāharaṇāśakyasya śalyasya viśasyetyupalabhyate||10||

bhavati cātra-
śītalena jalenainaṃ mūrcchantam avasecayet |
saṃrakṣed asya ‘marmasaṃrakṣaṇaṃ pānīyaghṛtābhyaṅgatarpaṇādinā’ iti cakraḥ marmāṇi muhur āśvāsayec ca tam ||11||

śalyāharaṇe upadravacikitsāsūtraṃ nirdiśannāha- śītalenetyādi| enamiti śalyāturam| avasecayediti siñcedityarthaḥ| āśvāsayediti kṣīratarpaṇādidānena| bāhulyenāmuṃ pāṭhaṃ kecinna paṭhanti| gayadāsena tu paṭhitvā'yaṃ pāṭho'trāntare vyākhyātaḥ, yuktaścāyaṃ, tasmāt paṭhanīya eva||11||

tataḥ śalyam uddhṛtya nirlohitaṃ vraṇaṃ kṛtvā svedārham agnighṛtaprabhṛtibhiḥ ‘svedārhaṃ saṃsvedya, agninā avadahya, ghṛtena tarpayitveti yojyam| atrātisrutaraktā ghṛtatarpaṇīyāḥ| tatra bhojaḥ- “agnikṛtyā vraṇā ye tu teṣvagnimavacārayet| svedayetsaktupiṇḍībhiḥ svedakṛtyān samantataḥ|| tarpayettarpaṇīyāṃśca sukhoṣṇena ca sarpiṣā’ iti saṃsvedyāvadahya pradihya sarpirmadhubhyāṃ baddhvā''cārikam upadiśet | (sirāsnāyuvilagnaṃ śalākādibhir vimocyāpanayet; śvayathugrastavāraṅgaṃ samavapīḍya śvayathuṃ; durbalavāraṅgaṃ kuśādibhir baddhvā|) ||12||

hṛte śalye paścātkarma darśayannāha- tata ityādi| nirlohitamiti arudhiravantam ‘rudhiravarjitam’ iti pā.| saṃsvedyeti atiniḥsṛtaśoṇitamavedanaṃ sukhoṣṇena ghṛtena, taditaramagninā saṃsvedyeti sambandhaḥ| avadahyeti agnikṛtyān vraṇān dagdhvetyarthaḥ| pradihyeti lepayitvā, asvedyamatisrutaśoṇitaṃ ca| atra kecit ‘avadahya’ iti na paṭhanti, ‘pradihya’ ityasya sthāne ‘tarpayitvā’ iti paṭhanti| atra kecidgaḍḍurikāpravāheṇa bhojoktaṃ ‘sirāsnāyuvilagnaṃ śalākābhirvimocyāpanayet, śvayathugrastavāraṅgaṃ samavapīḍya śvayathuṃ, durbalavāraṅgaṃ kuśādibhirbaddhvā’ iti pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti, pravāhapaṭhitā vyākhyānayanti ca- vāraṅgaṃ śastranālam, avapīḍya śvayathumapanayediti sambandhaḥ; kuśādibhiḥ badhvā ‘apanayet’ ityatrāpi yojyate; kuśā vaṃśavetrādikambī| ayaṃ ca vidhistantrāntarādavaseyo na suśrutasaṃhitāyāmasti, tantrāntaradarśanālasaistvatraivānīya likhita ityatra na paṭhanīya eva||12||

hṛdayam abhito ‘hṛdayabhita iti hṛdayasamīpe pārśve ityarthaḥ| hṛdayodvejanaṃ ca śalyakāryapīḍāparijñānārthamityeke| hṛdayodvejanena līnasya yantrasya sambandho na bhavatītyarthaḥ| yathāmārgeṇa durupaharaṃ chedena mukhaṃ viśālaṃ kṛtvā haraṇīyam| tatra tathā chedanaṃ kartavyaṃ yathā sirādikṣaṇanenānyadeśāpabādho na bhavati’ iti cakraḥ vartamānaṃ śalyaṃ śītajalādibhir udvejitasyāpahared yathāmārgaṃ; durupaharam anyato 'pabādhyamānaṃ pāṭayitvoddharet ||13||

vakṣaḥpatiteṣu viśeṣavidhimāha- hṛdayamityādi| hṛdayamabhito vartamānamiti hṛdayasamīpe sthitamityarthaḥ| udvejitasya udvignahṛdayasya, śītajalādudvejanaṃ ca klamaparihārāya| yathāmārgamiti yenaiva mārgeṇa praviṣṭaṃ tenaivāpaharedityarthaḥ| tenāśakye upāyāntaraṃ darśayannāha- durupaharamityādi| duḥkhenopahriyate taddurupaharam| anyata iti anyasminnapi pradeśe| apabādhyamānamiti marmapīḍākaraṃ, ‘śalyaṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ| pāṭayitveti dārayitvetyarthaḥ||13||

asthivivarapraviṣṭam asthividaṣṭaṃ vā'vagṛhya pādābhyāṃ yantreṇāpaharet, aśakyam evaṃ vā balavadbhiḥ suparigṛhītasya yantreṇa grāhayitvā śalyavāraṅgaṃ ‘vāraṅgaṃ śastrādimayasya śalyasya śikhākāraṃ’ ityaruṇadattaḥ| ‘vāraṅgaṃ śastramastake śikhākāro'vayavaḥ’ iti hemādriḥ pravibhujya dhanurguṇair baddhvaikataś cāsya pañcāṅgyām upasaṃyatasyāśvasya vaktrakavike ‘pañcāṅgyā pañcānāmaṅgānāṃ caturṇāṃ pādānāṃ mukhasahitānāṃ samāhāraḥ pañcāṅgī bandhaviśeṣaḥ, tayā pañcāṅgyā baddhasya’ iti aruṇadattaḥ badhnīyāt, athainaṃ kaśayā tāḍayed yathonnāmayañ śiro vegena śalyam uddharati; dṛḍhāṃ vā vṛkṣaśākhām avanamya tasyāṃ pūrvavad baddhvoddharet ||14||

avabaddhaśalyasya hastenāpahartumaśakyasya nirharaṇopāyaṃ darśayannāha- asthītyādi| asthivivarapraviṣṭamiti asthicchidrāntargatam| vidaṣṭamiti atyāsaktam| suparigṛhītasya āturasyetyarthaḥ| pravibhujya vakrīkṛtya| dhanurguṇairiti murvārkasūtramayaiḥ| ekata ekasmin pradeśe| asyeti śalyavato narasya| pañcāṅgyāmiti bandhaviśeṣe| upasaṃyatasya baddhasya| aśvasya ghoṭakasya, vaktraṃ mukhaṃ, tatra kavikā kaṭakaṃ, tatra badhnīyāt śalyamiti sambandhaḥ| enam aśvaṃ, kaśayā saṭṭayā, unnāmayanniti uccaiḥ kurvan| pakṣāntaramāha- dṛḍhāṃ vā vṛkṣaśākhāmityādi| avanamya namayitvā, tasyāmiti vṛkṣaśākhāyām| anye tu ‘dṛḍhāṃ’ ityasya sthāne ‘pañcāṅgī’ iti manyante; tatra pañcāṅgīṃ pañcabhiḥ śākhāntarairyutāṃ śākhāṃ vadanti| apare tu pañcāṅgīṃ plakṣāśvatthodumbaranyagrodhavetasānāmiti kathayanti| anye tvevaṃ paṭhanti ‘aśakyamevaṃ vā balavadbhiḥ suparigṛhītasya yantreṇa grāhayitvā śalyavāraṅgaṃ pravibhujya dhanurguṇairbaddhvaikato'śvavaktrakavike badhnīyāt, athainaṃ kaśayā tāḍayedyathonnāmayañchiro vegena śalyamuddharati, nāmitāyāṃ pañcāṅgyāṃ vṛkṣaśākhāyāṃ vā pūrvavadbaddhvoddharet’ iti||14||

adeśottuṇḍitam aṣṭhīlāśmamudgarāṇām anyatamasya ‘adeśottuṇḍitamiti pakṣe acchedanīyadeśottuṇḍitamityarthaḥ| asthideśottuṇḍitamityanye| tatrāsthirotho'sthyuttuṇḍitatvam’ iti cakraḥ prahāreṇa vicālya yathāmārgam eva yantreṇa ||15||
kukṣyādyacchedanīyapradeśottuṇḍitānāmasthyādividaṣṭānāṃ yathāmārgāpaharaṇopāyaṃ darśayannāha- adeśetyādi| yathāmārgameva yantreṇeti ‘apaharet’ iti śeṣaḥ| ‘asthideśottuṇḍitaṃ’ ityanye paṭhanti||15||

vimṛditakarṇāni ‘vimṛditakarṇāni karṇavantītyacchedanīyamukhapatitāni| chedanīyamukhe tu deśe karṇavatāmanulomameva chedayitvā''haraṇamāha- anābādhākaretyādi’ iti cakraḥ karṇavanty anābādhakaradeśottuṇḍitāni purastād eva ||16||

karṇavatāmāharaṇaṃ ca darśayannāha- vimṛditetyādi| karṇavadyacchalyaṃ tadanābādhakarapradeśottuṇḍitaṃ yadā bhavati tadā vimṛditakarṇikaṃ kṛtvā, ko'rthaḥ? saṅkucitakarṇikaṃ kṛtvā, purastādeva ko'rthaḥ? agretane pradeśe eva, ‘ākarṣayet’ iti śeṣaḥ||16||
jātuṣe kaṇṭhāsakte kaṇṭhe nāḍīṃ praveśyāgnitaptāṃ ca śalākāṃ, tayā'vagṛhya śītābhir adbhiḥ pariṣicya sthirībhūtaṃ śalyam uddharet ||17||

jātuṣaśalyasya vidhānaṃ darśayannāha- jātuṣa ityādi| jātuṣe lākṣāmaye| kaṇṭhāsakte galalagne| nāḍīmiti tāmrādiracitanalikāṃ, sthirībhūtāmutpannagāḍhatām| śiśavo jātuṣaiḥ śalyaiḥ krīḍanti, te yadā pramādānnigilanti tadā'yaṃ vidhirveditavyaḥ| anye tu jātuṣāṇi sirādiṣveva gha(ja)ṭitāni manyante||17||
ajātuṣaṃ tu jatumadhūcchiṣṭapraliptayā śalākayā pūrvakalpenety eke ||18||
ajātuṣe kaṇṭhāsakte vidhimāha- ajātuṣamityādi| jatu lākṣā, madhūcchiṣṭaṃ sikthakam, pūrvakalpeneti śītodakasthirībhūtamityarthaḥ||18||

asthiśalyam anyad vā tiryakkaṇṭhāsaktam avekṣya keśoṇḍukaṃ ‘keśānāṃ samūhaḥ keśondukam’ iti aruṇadattaḥ| ‘keśondukaḥ keśapuñjaḥ’ iti hemādriḥ| ‘uṇḍukaṃ nāma viśeṣeṇa prasādakiṭṭataḥ pariṇāmimalāśrayaḥ sthūlakṣudrāntrayorantarālastho golaḥ, vakṣyati ca- ‘uṇḍukasthaṃ vibhajate malaṃ maladharā kalā’ iti, tathā ca keśo'yamuṇḍukamiveti keśoṇḍukaṃ ‘paruṣavyāghraḥ’ iti vat| ‘upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ sāmānyaprayoge’ iti pūrvanipātaḥ ‘keśaguḍaka’ iti niṣkarṣaḥ’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ dṛḍhaikadīrghasūtrabaddhaṃ dravabhaktopahitaṃ pāyayed ā kaṇṭhāt pūrṇakoṣṭhaṃ ca vāmayet, vamataś ca śalyaikadeśasaktaṃ jñātvā sūtraṃ sahasā tv ākṣipet; mṛdunā vā dantadhāvanakūrcakenāpaharet praṇuded vā 'ntaḥ | kṣatakaṇṭhāya ca madhusarpiṣī leḍhuṃ prayacchet triphalācūrṇaṃ vā madhuśarkarāmiśram ||19||

asthyādiśalyasyātyantaṃ kaṇṭhāsaktasyāharaṇamuddiśannāha- asthiśalyamityādi| keśoṇḍukaṃ bālakṛtaṃ biṭukam| upahitaṃ sahitam| sahasā tvākṣipediti śalyanirgamanārtham| dantadhāvanakūrcakeneti dantadhāvanānāṃ karañjakādīnāṃ kuṭṭitāgraṃ kūrcakaṃ, tenāpaharedityarthaḥ| praṇudedvā'ntariti bahiranirgacchadantaḥ praṇudet praveśayedityarthaḥ| ‘keśondukaṃ’ ityādi kecit pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti| āhṛtakaṇṭhaśalyasya paścātkarma darśayannāha- kṣatakaṇṭhāyetyādi||19||
udakapūrṇodaram avākśirasam avapīḍayed dhunīyād vāmayed vā bhasmarāśau vā nikhaned ā mukhāt ||20||

udakaṃ yadā'ntarniviṣṭaṃ jalamṛtādīnāmudare bhavati tadā tasyāpaharaṇopāyaṃ darśayannāha- udaketyādi| avākśirasamadhomukhīkṛtam, avapīḍayedudaraṃ, dhunīyāt kampayet, vāmayet gharṣaṇairavākśirasameva, nikhanet praveśayet, āmukhāditi mukhaparyantam||20||
grāsaśalye tu kaṇṭhāsakte niḥśaṅkam anavabuddhaṃ skandhe muṣṭinā 'bhihanyāt, snehaṃ madyaṃ pānīyaṃ ‘snehaṃ sukhodakaṃ vā’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ vā pāyayet ||21||
kaṇṭhāsaktagrāsāharaṇopāyamāha- grāsaśalye ityādi| anavabuddhamiti ajñātaṃ yathā bhavati| abhihanyāditi prahāraṃ dadyādityarthaḥ||21||

bāhurajjulatāpāśaiḥ ‘pāśaśalye tu’ iti pā. kaṇṭhapīḍanād vāyuḥ prakupitaḥ śleṣmāṇaṃ kopayitvā sroto niruṇaddhi, lālāsrāvaṃ phenāgamanaṃ sañjñānāśaṃ cāpādayati; tam abhyajya saṃsvedya śirovirecanaṃ tasmai tīkṣṇaṃ vidadhyād rasaṃ ca vātaghnaṃ dadyād iti ||22||
bāhurajjavādipīḍitakaṇṭhaprakupitavāyuśleṣmāpaharaṇopāyamāha- bāhvityādi| pāśaśabdo bāhvādibhiḥ saha pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| kecidamuṃ pāṭhaṃ na paṭhanti||22||

bhavanti cātra-
śalyākṛtiviśeṣāṃś ca sthānāny āvekṣya buddhimān |
tathā yantrapṛthaktvaṃ ca samyak śalyam athāharet ||23||

lg.l: karṇavanti tu śalyāni duḥkhāhāryāṇi ‘duḥkhānyāharaṇe viduḥ’ iti pā. yāni ca |
ādadīta bhiṣak tasmāt tāni yuktyā samāhitaḥ ||24||
etair upāyaiḥ śalyaṃ tu naiva niryātyate ‘nirhāryate’ iti pā. yadi |
matyā nipuṇayā vaidyo yantrayogaiś ca nirharet ||25||
śothapākau rujaś cogrāḥ kuryāc chalyam anāhṛtam |
vaikalyaṃ maraṇaṃ cāpi tasmād yatnād vinirharet ||26||

ab.seg: śalyākṛtīnāmānantyādanuktamapi kartavyaṃ darśayannāha- śalyākṛtītyādi| sthānāni śiro'kṣikarṇanāsāhṛdayādīni| karṇavatāṃ durāharatvaṃ darśayannāha- karṇavantītyādi| ādadīteti saṅgṛhṇīyādityarthaḥ| yuktyeti yogena, na tu hīnayogātiyogamithyāyogaiḥ| samāhitaḥ sāvadhānaḥ| avaśyaṃ nirharaṇīyasya śalyasyoktaiḥ prakārairanāharaṇe'nuktopāyamanuktayantrakaraṇasūtramuddiśannāha- etairityādi| naiva niryātyate yadīti naiva niṣkāsyate yadītyarthaḥ| matyā nipuṇayā vaidya iti matyā nipuṇayā svakarmaṇi pravīṇayā buddhyā yuktaḥ| yantrayogaiśca nirharediti yogaiḥ saṃyogaiḥ, yogaiśceti cakārādanuktaguṇādibandhanādi samuccīyate| śalyasyānāharaṇe doṣaṃ darśayannāha- śothapākāvityādi| amuṃ ślokaṃ kecidatra na paṭhanti, nyāyacandrikāyāṃ tu paṭhitatvādavaśyaṃ paṭhanīya eva||23-26||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne śalyāpanayanīyo nāma saptaviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||27||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne saptaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||27||

div.head: viparītāviparītavraṇavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto viparītāviparītavraṇavijñānīyam adhyāyaṃ ‘pūrvādhyāyaiḥ samāsavistarābhyāṃ vraṇānuddiśyāturopakramaṇīyādhyāye cikitsā sūtrayitavyā| sā tu sāriṣṭatvādgatāyuṣi na sidhyati, ato'riṣṭajñānārthaṃ riṣṭapratipādakādhyāyeṣu sāmānyāriṣṭasvarūpābhidhāyakatayā viparītavraṇavijñānīyo'bhidhīyate| viparīto vraṇaḥ sādhyādanyaḥ sāriṣṭatayā vivakṣitaḥ’ iti cakraḥ| ‘viparītavraṇavijñānīyaṃ’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

lg.l: phalāgnijalavṛṣṭīnāṃ puṣpadhūmāmbudā ‘dhūma iha kāṣṭhamanthanajanyaḥ vahneśca pūrvabhāvī vivakṣito bhāvivahnigamakatayā’ iti cakraḥ yathā |

ab.seg: niyatāniyatabhedena dvividhamariṣṭaṃ prakāśayitumāha- phalāgnītyādi| atra yathā puṣpaṃ phalasya bhaviṣyattvaṃ khyāpayati, ko'rthaḥ? puṣpaṃ phalaṃ bhaviṣyatīti; yathā ca dhūmo'gniṃ khyāpayati, yathā'mbudo jalavṛṣṭim, evamariṣṭāni pañcatāṃ mṛtyuṃ khyāpayanti; ‘bhāvinīm’ iti śeṣaḥ| ariṣṭānyatra maraṇalakṣaṇāni| nanu, atra kimarthaṃ puṣpadhūmāmbudā iti bahavo duṣṭāntā uktāḥ? ekenaiva gatārthatvāt| ucyate, puṣpāmbudau hetū phalajalavṛṣṭyorjñāpakāvaniyatau, na hyavaśyaṃ kāraṇena kāryaṃ kartavyameva; ityanenāniyatadṛṣṭāntena dūtadinimittajamariṣṭamaniyatamuktaṃ; dhūmāt kāryādagneḥ kāraṇasya yaj jñānaṃ tanniyatam, etena niyatadṛṣṭāntena doṣajamariṣṭaṃ niyatamuktam; ityaniyataniyatabhedena dvividhamariṣṭaṃ prakāśayanti bahavo dṛṣṭāntā iti na doṣaḥ||1-3||

lg.l: tāni ‘ariṣṭasya maraṇādavaśyaṃ prāgbhāvamāha- tāni saukṣmyādityādi| saukṣmyāt kaṇṭakādi sadapi sūkṣmajijñāsāṃ vinā nopalabhyate| tathā pramādādanavahitaiḥ sadapi nopalabhyate| āśu vyatikramāditi bhūtvā kṣaṇena nāśāt, etadapi sarvathā'vadhānaṃ vinā nopalabhyate| yathā vidyudādi kṣaṇamātrasthāyibhūtamapi nopalabhyate| na tvasambhavādityanena maraṇe'vaśyambhāvitvamuktaṃ, carake'pyuktaṃ ‘maraṇaṃ cāpi tannāsti yannāriṣṭapuraḥsaram’ (ca. i. a. 2)| tathā riṣṭe'pi maraṇaniyamamāha- dhruvamityādi saukṣmyāt pramādād vā tathaivāśu vyatikramāt |
gṛhyante nodgatāny ajñair mumūrṣor na tv asambhavāt ||4||

ab.seg: avaśyamevāriṣṭasya maraṇabhavanaṃ darśayannāha- tānītyādi| mumūrṣoḥ martumicchoḥ prāṇina udgatānyapi prakaṭitānyapyariṣṭānyajñairmanuṣyairna gṛhyante na jñāyante| kuto hetorityāha- saukṣmyāditi; paramāṇuvat| pramādādveti madirāmadamattasya vastunyavimarśa iva| āśu vyatikramāditi yadaivāriṣṭamutpannaṃ tadaiva maraṇāditi, utpalaśatapatravyatibhedavat; anye tvāśuvyatikramaṃ yadaivāriṣṭamutpannaṃ ‘tadaiva’ iti pā. tadaiva nivartata iti manyante| na tvasambhavāditi na punarasambhavānna gṛhyante, apitu sambhavantyapyariṣṭānyuktaiḥ kāraṇairajñairna gṛhyanta ityabhiprāyaḥ| doṣajamariṣṭamadhikṛtya ariṣṭena maraṇasya niyatatvaṃ darśayannāha- dhruvamityādi||4||

riṣṭe'pi maraṇanivṛttimupāyaviśeṣairāha- brāhmaṇairityādi| kilaśabdo'trāgamārthaṃ sūcayati; evaṃ kila āgame pratipāditamityarthaḥ| amalairiti rāgādidoṣarahitaiḥ| brāhmaṇebhyo'parānapi darśayannāha- rasāyanatapojapyetyādi|- rasāyanaparā iti svabhāvavyādhinivāraṇaviśiṣṭauṣadhacintakāḥ, te rasavīryauṣadhaprabhāveṇa maraṇaṃ nivārayanti| tathā tapaḥparāḥ tapasvinaḥ, te'pi viśiṣṭatapaḥprabhāveṇa maraṇaṃ nivārayanti | japyaparāḥ siddhamantracintakāḥ, te'pi mantraśaktiyuktāḥ pañcatvaṃ niṣedhayanti | etacca niyatāniyatariṣṭaviṣayaṃ jñeyam||5||

lg.l: nakṣatrapīḍā ‘nakṣatrapīḍeti janmakālasthitagrahaviśeṣairnakṣatrapīḍā yathā kālāntarabhāvimaraṇasūcikā kālāntareṇaiva pacyamānaduṣṭamaraṇaṃ gamayati| tathā'riṣṭānyapi kānicit cirakālapacyamānamārakakarmajanyāni cirabhāvimaraṇavyañjakānīti vākyārthaḥ| ariṣṭapākamiti riṣṭakāraṇamārakakarmaprapākam|’ iti cakraḥ bahudhā yathā kālaṃ ‘kālāt’ iti pā. vipacyate |
tathaivāriṣṭapākaṃ ca bruvate bahavo ‘bahudhā’ iti pā. janāḥ ||6||

ab.seg: kathaṃ punaḥ kālāntare pañcaviṃśativarṣādāvariṣṭapīḍā bhavatītyāha- nakṣatretyādi|- vipacyate phalatītyarthaḥ| pākaḥ phalam||6||
ariṣṭāparijñānadoṣaṃ darśayannāha- asiddhimityādi|asiddhiṃ dharmārthakāmādīnāṃ hānim||7||

lg.l: gandhavarṇarasādīnāṃ viśeṣāṇāṃ svabhāvataḥ ‘svabhāvato vaikṛtamityanena asvābhāvikasya vikṛtasyāpi nātiṣṭatvamiti darśayati| etacca vaikṛtamadṛśyamānahetukaṃ mārakakarmakṛtameva riṣṭaṃ jñeyam| pakvaḥ pātonmukho maraṇonmukha iti yāvat’ iti cakraḥ| ‘samāsataḥ’ iti pā.|
vaikṛtaṃ yat tad ācaṣṭe vraṇinaḥ pakvalakṣaṇam ||8||

ab.seg: asya tantrasya śalyatvāttatra ca vraṇasya prādhānyāttasyaivāriṣṭāni prāṅnirdeṣṭumāha- gandhetyādi | gandhavarṇarasādīnāmiti ādigrahaṇena śabdasparśayorapi saṅgrahaḥ; etena pañcāpīndriyārthā uktā bhavanti, rūpasya varṇagrahaṇena gṛhītatvāt| svabhāvataḥ prakṛtito yadvaikṛtamanyathātvaṃ, tadācaṣṭe tat kathayati, vraṇinaḥ puruṣasya, pakvalakṣaṇaṃ pātalakṣaṇaṃ, yathā pakvaṃ phalaṃ patatyeva tathā'sāvapi vraṇī patatyevetyarthaḥ||8||

lg.l: kaṭus tīkṣṇaś ca visraś ca gandhas tu pavanādibhiḥ |

div.ab: tatra prākṛtaṃ gandhaṃ darśayannāha- kaṭurityādi| atra lājātasītailasamāstrayo gandhā yathāsaṅkhyena vātapaittika-vātaślaiṣmika-pittaślaiṣmikā dvandvajā jñeyāḥ| ete trayo'pīṣadvisrāśca svabhāvājjñeyāḥ| atasīśabdenātasītailaṃ, tailaṃ tilatailam| jñeyāḥ prakṛtigandhāḥ syuriti jñātavyāḥ prakṛtigandhā bhaveyuriti| ‘kaṭustīvraśca’ iti kecit paṭhanti||9||-

lg.l: sagandhā divyagandhāś ca mumūrṣūṇāṃ vraṇāḥ smṛtāḥ ||11||
sagandhāḥ paṅkagandhāś ca bhūmigandhāś ca garhitāḥ ||12||

ab.seg: vikṛtigandhān darśayannāha- ata ityādi| ato'nyadgandhavaikṛtamiti ata ebhyaḥ pūrvoktebhyaḥ kaṭvādiprākṛtagandhebhyo'nyadgandhavaikṛtam| tāneva vikṛtagandhānāha- madyetyādi| sumanā jātī, sagandhāḥ samagandhāḥ| divyagandhā iti aparo'pi ya uttamagandhaḥ| mumūrṣūṇāmiti martumicchūnāṃ prāṇinām| śvā kukkuraḥ, dhvāṅkṣaḥ kākaḥ, pūtivallūraṃ pūyasahitaṃ śuṣkamāṃsaṃ, matkuṇāḥ śayyādijāḥ kṣudrakīṭāḥ, etaiḥ samānagandhā ityarthaḥ||10-12||

lg.l: na dahyante na cūṣyante bhiṣak tān parivarjayet ||13||
dūyante vā'pi dahyante bhiṣak tān parivarjayet ||14||
kṛṣṇās tu ‘kṛṣṇā ye tvaruṇasrāvā’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ ye tanusrāvā vātajā marmatāpinaḥ |
svalpām api na kurvanti rujaṃ tān parivarjayet ||15||

ab.seg: varṇānnirdeṣṭumāha- kuṅkumetyādi| dhyāma īṣatkṛṣṇaḥ| na dahyante na dāhayuktā bhavanti| cūṣyanta iti cūṣaṇamiva vedanāviśeṣaḥ| pittavarṇe sati yat pittavedanā dāhādikā na bhavanti, tadvaikṛtaṃ varṇasya| kecit “śyāmākuṅkumakaṅkuṣṭhasavarṇāḥ pittadoṣataḥ| na dahyante na dūyante bhiṣak tān parivarjayet”- iti pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- śyāmā priyaṅguḥ, kaṅkuṣṭhaṃ suvarṇakṣīriniryāsaḥ, na dahyante nātitapyante na dūyante na paritapyante kintu paritāpamātrayuktā bhavanti” iti| sa ca nibandheṣu na dṛśyate; yatra tu dṛśyate, tatra gaḍḍarikāpravāhaḥ, tasmāt pūrvaḥ pāṭho nyāyyaḥ| kaṇḍūmanta ityādikāḥ kaphena, teṣāṃ dāharuje varṇavaikṛtaṃ; dūyante iti pīḍāṃ kurvanti| kṛṣṇāścetyādi ye vātajā vraṇāḥ kṛṣṇāstanusrāvā marmatāpinaśca yadā svalpāmapi pīḍāṃ na kurvanti tadā vātaje varṇavaikṛtam| atra rasavaikṛtaṃ yadyapi noktaṃ tathā'pi vātapittakaphavraṇeṣu yathākramaṃ kaṣāyakaṭumadhureṣu pipīlikādyupasarpaṇādanuktamapi jñeyaṃ, gandhavarṇarasādīnāmityatroddeśasūtre rasasyoktatvāt||13-15||

lg.l: kṣveḍanti ghurghurāyante jvalantīva ca ye vraṇāḥ |
tvaṅmāṃsasthāś ca pavanaṃ saśabdaṃ visṛjanti ye ||16||
ye ca marmasv asambhūtā bhavanty atyarthavedanāḥ |17|

ab.seg: śabdavaikṛtaṃ darśayannāha- kṣveḍantītyādi| kṣveḍanti khaṭakhaṭāśabdaṃ kurvanti| ghurghurāyanta iti śvamārjārādīnāṃ kopādantargataśabdo ghurghurāśabda ucyate| jvalantīveti jvalanta iva dṛśyante| tvaṅmāṃsasthānāṃ vraṇānāṃ saśabdapavanavāhitvaṃ śabdavaikṛtaṃ, koṣṭhagatānāṃ tu saśabdapavanavāhitvaṃ prakṛtireva||16||

lg.l: dahyante cāntar atyarthaṃ bahiḥ śītāś ca ye vraṇāḥ ||17||
dahyante bahir atyarthaṃ bhavanty antaś ca śītalāḥ |18|

div.ab: sparśavaikṛtamadhikṛtyāha- dahyante ityādi||17||-

ab.seg: ākṛtiviśeṣavaikṛtamadhikṛtyāha- śaktītyādi| śaktirāyudhaviśeṣaḥ, dhvajaḥ patākādaṇḍaḥ| yeṣu vraṇeṣu| avabhāseran śobhante| prāsādo devatānarendrāṇāmadhiṣṭhānam, ākṛtiratra rūpameva| rūpaṃ ca pañcendriyārthamadhye| aparamapi rūpaviśeṣamāha- cūrṇāvakīrṇā ityādi| atrāpi sāmānyākāreṇa rūpameva boddhavyam||18-19||
gandhādivaikṛtaṃ samāpya, upadravāsādhyatvaṃ prasaṅgato yuktyāgataṃ darśayannāha- prāṇetyādi| prāṇakṣayaḥ śaktilakṣaṇabalakṣayaḥ, māṃsakṣaya upacayalakṣaṇabalakṣayaḥ||20||

lg.l: kriyābhiḥ ‘bheṣajavikārayuktau riṣṭamāha- kriyābhirityādi| carake upadravāśca bheṣajavikārayuktiśca riṣṭādhikaraṇatayoktā’ iti cakraḥ samyag ārabdhā na siddhyanti ca ye vraṇāḥ |
varjayet tān api prājñaḥ saṃrakṣann ātmano yaśaḥ ||21||

ab.seg: anuktamapyaśeṣāriṣṭamupagṛhṇannāha- kriyābhirityādi||21||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne viparītāviparītavraṇavijñānīyo nāmāṣṭāviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||28||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne'ṣṭāviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||28||

div.head: viparītāviparītadūtaśakunasvapnanidarśanīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto viparītāviparītasvapnanidarśanīyam adhyāyaṃ ‘viparītasvapnanidarśanīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ| ‘viparītāviparītadūtaśakunasvapnanidarśanīyamadhyāyaṃ’ iti hārāṇacandrasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi| svapnaśabdānantaraṃ luptādiśabdanirdeśānnakṣatravelātithinimittaśakunāniladeśavaidyavāgdehamanaśceṣṭā api gṛhyante||1-2||

lg.l: ṛkṣaṃ velā tithiś caiva nimittaṃ śakuno 'nilaḥ ||3||
deśo ‘gehe’ iti pā. vaidyasya vāgdehamanasāṃ ca viceṣṭitam |
kathayanty āturagataṃ śubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubham ||4||

ab.seg: atrādhyāye nirdeśyān dūtādīnupadarśayannāha- dūtetyādi| dūtaśabdo'tra darśanasambhāṣaveśaceṣṭitaiḥ saha sambadhyate| gamanāya praśnāya vā''gataḥ puruṣo dūtaḥ| ceṣṭā cātra kāyakṛto vyāpāraḥ, ṛkṣāṇi ārdrādīni, velā madhyāhnādikāḥ, tithayaḥ caturthyādayaḥ, nimittaṃ sarpādidarśanaṃ ‘nimittaṃ pūrṇakumbhādi, śakunaḥ pakṣī’ iti cakraḥ, deśo vaidyasya bhūmibhāgaḥ, vāgdehamanasāṃ ca viceṣṭitamapi vaidyasyaiva| āturagatamiti āturāśritamityarthaḥ| svapnāḥ paścānnirdeśyāḥ||3-4||

lg.l: pākha(ṣa)ṇḍāśramavarṇānāṃ ‘pāṣaṇḍā vedabāhyāśramāḥ saugatādayaḥ’ iti cakraḥ sapakṣāḥ karmasiddhaye |
ta eva viparītāḥ syur dūtāḥ karmavipattaye ||5||
vaidyaṃ ya upasarpanti dūtās te cāpi garhitāḥ |7|

div.ab: prathamaṃ dūtadarśanamadhikṛtyāha- pākhaṇḍetyādi| pākha(ṣa)ṇḍāḥ kāpālikādayaḥ, āśramā brahmacārigṛhasthavānaprasthayatayaḥ, varṇā brāhmaṇādayaḥ| sapakṣā iti tadyathā- kāpālī kāpālikasya, brahmacārī brahmacāriṇaḥ, vipro viprasyetyādayaḥ| karmasiddhaye kāryasiddhyartham| | ta eva viparītā iti kāpālikasya brahmacārī, brahmacāriṇaḥ kāpālītyādi| karmavipattaye iti cikitsitanāśāya| napuṃsakamiti na pumān na ca strī| strīti yoṣidityarthaḥ| bahava iti prabhūtā ityarthaḥ| naikakāryā iti naikasmin kārye ye dūtāḥ samāgatā ityarthaḥ| asūyakā iti parasparaṃ kalahaṃ kurvāṇāḥ| gardabhoṣṭrarathaprāptā iti gardabhoṣṭrayuktena rathenāgatā ityarthaḥ| prāptā vā syuḥ paramparā iti āgatā vā bhaveyuḥ, paramparā paṅktiḥ, etena paṅktiṃ kṛtvā yadā''gacchanto bhavantītyuktam| vaidyaṃ ya upasarpantītyādi ye dūtā evaṅguṇaviśiṣṭā vaidyamupasarpanti samīpamāgacchanti ‘āgacchantaḥ’ iti pā., te garhitā eveti sambhāvanīyāḥ| atra caśabda evakārārthaḥ, apiśabdaḥ sambhāvanāyām||5-6||-

ab.seg: veṣamadhikṛtyāha- pāśetyādi| pāśo dīrghaḥ paśūnāṃ bandhano rajjuvalayaḥ, daṇḍo lauhādivalayairnibaddho dīrghaniṣṭhurakāṣṭhayaṣṭiḥ, āyudhāni khaḍgaśaktyādīni| pāṇḍuretaravāsasa iti kṛṣṇapītaraktavastrāḥ| ārdrajīrṇāpasavyaikamalinoddhvastavāsasa iti ārdraṃ stimitaṃ, jīrṇaṃ purātanam, apasavyaṃ dakṣiṇāśritamuttarīyavāsaḥ, ekam ekavastradhāriṇaṃ, malinamadhautaṃ, uddhvastaṃ pāṭitaṃ vastram| nyūnādhikāṅgā iti nyūnā hastādyavayavairhīnāḥ; adhikāṅgā iti ekaviṃśatyaṅgulyādiyuktāḥ| udvignā iti bhītāḥ| vikṛtā iti paṅgukubjavāmanādayaḥ| raudrarūpiṇa iti bhairavoddhatakarkaśāḥ (bhayāvaharūpiṇaḥ ayaṃ pāṭho hastalikhitapustake na paṭhyate )||7-8||

lg.l: rūkṣaniṣṭhuravaktāras tv amaṅgalyābhidhāyinaḥ ‘... vādāścāpyamāṅgalyā ...’ iti pā.|9|

div.ab: dūtasambhāṣāmadhikurvannāha- rūkṣetyādi| rūkṣaṃ maitrīrahitaṃ vacaḥ, niṣṭhuraṃ kaṭhoravacanam| amaṅgalyābhidhāyina iti gatabhṛtanaṣṭaruditetyādivacanamamaṅgalam|9|-

lg.l: chindantas tṛṇakāṣṭhāni spṛśanto ‘rudantaḥ stanayostathā’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ nāsikāṃ stanam ||9||
phalaṃ pakvam asāraṃ vā gṛhītvā'nyac ca tadvidham ||12||
nakhair nakhāntaraṃ vā'pi kareṇa caraṇaṃ tathā |
vaidyaṃ ya upasarpanti dūtās te cāpi garhitāḥ |15|

ab.seg: ceṣṭitamadhikṛtyāha- chindanta ityādi| vastrānto daśāhīnasya vastrasyāntam, anāmikā pavitrāṅguliḥ, keśā mastakavālāḥ, romāṇi śarīrodbhavā vālāḥ, daśāḥ sadaśasya vastrasya prāntāḥ| srotovarodhetyādi srotovarodhādiṣu nikṣiptapāṇayaḥ; srotaḥ karṇādichidram, avarodhaḥ skandhadeśaḥ, hṛt kamalamukulākāramadhomukhaṃ, gaṇḍo gallaḥ, mūrdhā mastakam, uraḥ kaṇṭhahṛdayāntarālaḥ, kukṣirvaṅkṣaṇapārśvāntarālaḥ| kapālopaletyādi| karaśabdaḥ kapālādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate, tena kapālādikarā ityādi boddhavyaṃ; kapālo mṛdbhāṇḍakhaṇḍaḥ, upalaḥ pāṣāṇaḥ, bhasmeti dagdhakāṣṭhādikṣāraḥ, asthi haḍḍaṃ, tuṣā dhānyāditvacaḥ, aṅgāro'bhasmasātkṛto dagdhakāṣṭhakhaṇḍaḥ| vilikhanto mahīmiti vilikhanto nakhādinā vidārayantaḥ pṛthivīmityarthaḥ| kiñcinmuñcanta iti kiñcidvastu hastena gṛhītaṃ muñcantaḥ| loṣṭabhedina iti mṛtpiṇḍasphoṭanaśīlā ityarthaḥ| digdhāṅgā iti liptāṅgā ityarthaḥ| raktasraganulepanā raktamālādhāriṇo raktavilepanāścetyarthaḥ| phalamityādi| asāramiti abhyantarasāravarjitam| anyacca tadvidhamiti anyadapi vastu pakvamasāraṃ ca| nakhairnakhāntaraṃ vā'pi kareṇa caraṇaṃ tathetyatra 'gṛhītvā' iti sambandhaḥ| upānadityādi|- upānat pādahitā, carmahastā veti carmamayasaṭṭādidhāriṇaḥ| vikṛtavyādhipīḍitā iti galatkuṣṭhādivikṛtavyādhipīḍitāḥ| vāmācārā iti viparītavyavahārāḥ| śvāsina iti śramajanitaśvāsayuktāḥ ‘adhvajanitaśvāsayuktāḥ’ iti pā.| vikṛtekṣaṇā iti puṣpitanetrādayaḥ| yāmyāṃ diśi dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi, prāñjalayaḥ prasāritāñjalayaḥ| viṣamaikapade sthitā iti viṣame ekasmin sthāne ūrdhvībhūtāḥ| upasarpanti samīpaṃ gacchanti||9-14||

lg.l: dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ deśe tv aśucau vā hutāśanam |
nagnaṃ bhūmau śayānaṃ vā vegotsargeṣu vā'śucim |
prakīrṇakeśam abhyaktaṃ svinnaṃ viklavam eva vā ||16||
vaidyaṃ ya upasarpanti dūtās te cāpi garhitāḥ |17|

div.ab: ceṣṭitameva ceti cakāreṇānuktā'pi vaidyaceṣṭā samuccīyate, tāṃ dūtadarśane nirdiśannāha- dakṣiṇetyādi|- dakṣiṇābhimukhamiti dakṣiṇadiṅmukham| deśe padeśe| aśucau apavitre| hutāśanaṃ jvalayantam agniṃ jvālayantam| pacantamiti pākaṃ kurvāṇam| krūrakarmaṇi paśuvadhādike| udyantamudyamaṃ kurvāṇam| 'kṣurakarmaṇi' ityeke paṭhanti, tatra muṇḍanādikarmaṇyudyamaṃ kurvāṇamityarthaḥ| vegotsargeṣviti mūtrapurīṣotsargeṣu| aśucimiti apavitram| prakīrṇakeśaṃ vimuktakeśam| abhyaktaṃ tailādinā| svinnaṃ prasvedasahitam| viklavaṃ vihvalam| vaidyaṃ ya upasarpantītyādi itthambhūtaṃ vaidyaṃ ye dūtā upasarpanti te garhitā ninditā bhavantītyarthaḥ||15-16||-

lg.l: vaidyasya paitrye daive vā kārye cotpātadarśane ||17||

div.ab: velāmadhikṛtyāha- vaidyasyetyādi| paitrye pitṛkārye| daive devakārye| utpātadarśana iti utpātānāṃ bhūmidivyāntarīkṣāṇāṃ darśane||17||-

ab.seg: nakṣatramadhikṛtyāha- kṛttikāsvityādi||18||

lg.l: caturthyāṃ ‘navamyāmatha ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vā pakṣasandhidineṣu ca’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ vā navamyāṃ vā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ sandhidineṣu ca |
vaidyaṃ ya upasarpanti dūtās te cāpi garhitāḥ ||19||

ab.seg: tithimadhikṛtyāha- caturthyāmityādi| sandhidināni devapretakāryāhāṇi||19||

lg.l: etena ‘etena śeṣaṃ vyākhyātamiti vyādhisamānaguṇe deśādau dūtadarśanaṃ vigarhitaṃ, viparītaguṇe ca praśastaṃ| tena vātaroge pravātādi ninditaṃ, nivātādi praśastamityādyūhyamityarthaḥ’ iti cakraḥ śeṣaṃ vyākhyātaṃ buddhvā saṃvibhajet tu tat ||21||
vijñāyaivaṃ vibhāgaṃ tu śeṣaṃ budhyeta paṇḍitaḥ |23|

div.ab: viśiṣṭarogeṣu viśiṣṭavelādi darśayannāha- svinnetyādi| svinnābhitaptā dūtā jvalanasya samīpataḥ sannidhānādyadā vaidyaṃ madhyāhna upasarpanti tadā garhitā iti sambandhaḥ| etena śeṣamityādi śeṣaṃ vātaroge śītapravātādiṣviti jñeyam, aśubhamityarthaḥ| raktapittetyādi| jalarodheṣu jalanirodhayuktapradeśeṣu| vijñāyetyādi| śeṣaṃ budhyeteti udāvartamūtrakṛcchrādau jalavegadarśanādikaṃ praśastamiti jānīyāt||20-22||-

lg.l: śuklavāsāḥ śucir gauraḥ śyāmo vā priyadarśanaḥ ||23||
svasyāṃ jātau svagotro vā dūtaḥ kāryakaraḥ smṛtaḥ |
goyānenāgatas tuṣṭaḥ ‘goyānaṃ govāhyaśakaṭaḥ, etacca praśastataratvāduktaṃ, tenāniṣiddhamaśvādiyānamapyaviruddhameva’ iti cakraḥ pādābhyāṃ śubhaceṣṭitaḥ ||24||
smṛtimān ‘dhṛtimān’ iti pā. vidhikālajñaḥ svatantraḥ pratipattimān |
svasthaṃ prāṅmukham āsīnaṃ same deśe śucau śucim |
upasarpati yo vaidyaṃ sa ca kāryakaraḥ smṛtaḥ ||26||

ab.seg: athāviparītadūtadarśanādikaṃ nirdiśannāha- śuklavāsā ityādi| goyāneneti vṛṣabhārūḍho vṛṣabhayuktayānārūḍho vetyarthaḥ; anye tu 'goyānena paśuyānena' ityarthamāhuḥ, gośabdasya paśuvācitvāt; etena yāmyādiyānakharoṣṭrādikavarjamaśvādiyānamuktam| svatantraḥ svapradhānaḥ| pratipattimāniti pratipattiratra jñānaṃ pragalbhatā vā| śuklavāsāḥ śucirgaura ityādidarśanamuktam| śubhaceṣṭita ityanena ceṣṭoktā| alaṅkṛta iti veṣa uktaḥ| sambhāṣaśvātra viparītasambhāṣaviparyayādanukto'pi jñeyaḥ| tathāhi, tatra 'rūkṣaniṣṭhuravaktāra' ityuktam, atra tu tadviparyayeṇa 'snigdhakomalābhidhāyina' ityaviparītasambhāṣo jñeyaḥ| tathā velānakṣatratithīnāmuktānāmeva viparītatvaṃ, tato'nyadaviparītatvamiti| kathambhūtaṃ vaidyamupasarpan dūtaḥ kāryakārī bhavatītyāha- svasthamityādi| svastham ādhivyādhivarjitam, āsīnamupaviṣṭaṃ, śucau pavitre deśe, śuciṃ vaidyam, itthambhūtaṃ vaidyaṃ yo dūta upasarpati sa kāryakārī bhavati| kecinnibandhakārā amuṃ pāṭhaṃ na paṭhanti||23-26||

lg.l: śuklavarṇāś ca pūjyante prasthāne darśanaṃ gatāḥ ||27||

strī putriṇī savatsā gaur vardhamānam alaṅkṛtā ‘vardhamānā svalaṅkṛtā’ iti pā.| ‘vardhamānā iti śarāvāḥ, te ca svalaṅkṛtā iti ālepādinā maṇḍitāḥ| kecidalaṅkṛtā iti kanyāviśeṣaṇaṃ manyante| anye tvaṅkāropitaṃ kumāraṃ kumārīṃ vā vardhamānamāhuḥ’ iti cakraḥ|
kanyā matsyāḥ phalaṃ cāmaṃ svastikaṃ modakā dadhi ||28||
hiraṇyākṣatapātraṃ vā ratnāni sumano ‘sumanā’ iti pā. nṛpaḥ |
apraśānto 'nalo vājī haṃsaś cāpaḥ śikhī tathā ||29||
śastaṃ haṃsarutaṃ nṝṇāṃ kauśikaṃ caiva vāmataḥ |
prasthāne yāyinaḥ śreṣṭhā vācaś ca hṛdayaṅgamāḥ |32|

ab.seg: athāviparītalakṣaṇānyāha- māṃsetyādi| māṃsamāmamatra| udakumbha iti atrodakumbhaśabdena pūrṇo riktaśca ghaṭo gṛhyate; tatrāturagṛhe praviśan pūrṇaḥ, āturagṛhānniḥsaran rikta iti gṛhyate| ātapatraṃ chatram| vṛṣo vṛṣabhaḥ| śuklavarṇāḥ padārthāḥ kārpāsāsthitakrabhasmakṣārādivyatiriktāḥ sumanodadhyakṣatamauktikādayaḥ| pūjyante ślāghyante| gatāḥ prāptāḥ| vardhamānaṃ śarāvaḥ, anye tu viśiṣṭameva darpaṇaṃ maṅgalyārthaṃ caṣakaṃ vā vardhamānamācakṣate ‘anye tvaṅkāropitaṃ kumāraṃ kumārīṃ vā vardhamānamāhuḥ’ iti cakraḥ| alaṅkṛtā kanyā bhūṣaṇavatī kanyā| kecit ‘vardhamānāḥ svalaṅkṛtā' iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- ālepanadhavalatvādisvalaṅkṛtāḥ śarāvā vardhamānā iti| svastikaṃ muktādāmaviśeṣaḥ, anye svastikaṃ svastikākāraṃ dūrvāśakalamaṇḍitaṃ dhavalaṃ darpaṇasaktaṃ mṛnmayaṃ gomayakṛtaṃ vā maṅgalyamavatāraṇakārthaṃ kurvate māṅgalikakṛtstriyaḥ| modakā laḍḍukāḥ| hiraṇyaṃ svarṇam, anye kapardakānyāhuḥ; akṣatā lājāḥ, anye'kṣatāni yavadhānyānyāhuḥ; pātraṃ taṇḍulabhṛtaśarāvādikam| anye tu ‘akṣatapātram' ityekameva taṇḍulabhṛtaśarāvamicchanti| ratnāni māṇikyādīni| sumana iti śobhanamānasamityarthaḥ, ‘vaidyasya' iti śeṣaḥ| nṛpaḥ pṛthvīpatiḥ, anye tu ‘śobhanacitto rājā' ityāhuḥ| apraśānto'nalaḥ prajvalitavaiśvānaraḥ| vājī ghoṭakaḥ| cāṣaḥ karaṭāsaḥ| śikhī mayūraḥ| brahmadundubhītyādi|- brahmeti vedaḥ, dundubhiḥ niḥsvānaḥ, jīmūto meghaḥ, eteṣāṃ svanāḥ śabdāḥ śastāḥ| siṃhetyādi| hreṣitaṃ vājidhvaniḥ| gajabṛṃhitaṃ hastisvanaḥ| rutaṃ śabdaḥ| rutaśabdaḥ kauśikaṃ cetyatrāpi sambandhanīyaḥ, tenolūkasya rutamityarthaḥ| yāyina iti gacchantaḥ puruṣāḥ; viparītaṃ ‘rājabhavanaṃ’ iti pā. nimittaṃ paścāddarśanīyam||27-31||

lg.l: vāmā vā dakṣiṇā vā'pi śakunāḥ karmasiddhaye ||33||
punnāmānaḥ khagā vāmāḥ strīsañjñā dakṣiṇāḥ śubhāḥ |
darśanaṃ vā rutaṃ vā'pi na godhākṛkalāsayoḥ ||37||
dūtair aniṣṭais tulyānām aśastaṃ darśanaṃ nṛṇām |

ab.seg: śakunān nirdiśannāha- patretyādi| nīruja iti kṛmidāvāgnyādyanupahatān| āśritaśabdo nabhaḥprabhṛtibhiḥ saha pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| nabha ākāśaṃ, veśma gṛhaṃ, dhvajā patākā devādīnāṃ, toraṇamārdravaṃśādiracitaṃ pratolyākāraṃ, vedikā iti vivāhādinimittamāmeṣṭakādiracitaścaturakaḥ| dikṣu śāntāsviti pūrvāsūttarāsu cetyarthaḥ; anye tu āliṅgitā'vadhūmitadīptavarjitāsvityācakṣate| vaktāra iti śabdāyamānāḥ| pṛṣṭhato'nugā iti pṛṣṭhapradeśānugatā ityarthaḥ| viparītāñ śakunānnirdiśannāha- śuṣke ityādi| aśanihate vajrahate| apatre patrarahite| vallinaddhe latāveṣṭite| sakaṇṭake kaṇṭakasahite| itthambhūte vṛkṣe ‘āśritā' ityadhyāhāraḥ| aśmā pāṣāṇaḥ| bhasma rakṣā| viṭ viṣṭhā| tuṣā dhānyatvacaḥ| pāṃśuḥ dhūliḥ| caityaṃ śmaśānavṛkṣaḥ| dīptasvarāḥ kusvarāḥ cicīcīkārādayaḥ, kharasvarāḥ utkaṭaśabdāḥ| dikṣu dīptāsviti āgneyayāmyanaiṛutīṣu| punnāmānaḥ khagā vāmā iti punnāmadheyāḥ pakṣiṇo vāmapārśve vaktāraḥ śubhāḥ; tadyathā- haṃsakāraṇḍavacakravākādayaḥ| strīsañjñā dakṣiṇāḥ śubhā iti kokilābalākādayaḥ strīsañjñā dakṣiṇapārśvavartinaḥ śubhāḥ| etena strīpuṃsañjñāḥ pakṣiṇa itthameva śubhāḥ, anyathā aśubhāḥ, iti paramārthato viparītaśakunameva kathitaṃ bhavati| pūrvānuktaviparītanimittaṃ nirdiśannāha- dakṣiṇādityādi| atrāpi tadviparyayeṇa dakṣiṇagamanaṃ praśastamityuktaṃ bhavati| nobhayamiti ubhayamapi vāmadakṣiṇamapi gamanaṃ na praśastamityarthaḥ| bhāsetyādi bhāso gokulacārī gṛdhraviśeṣaḥ| ubhayamiti vāmadakṣiṇamiti| darśanaṃ vā rutamityādi| kṛkalāsaḥ ‘kaṇṭikāyā' iti loke; pūrvadeśīyāstu girigiṭamācakṣate| godhākṛkalāsayordarśanaṃ rutaṃ vāmato dakṣiṇataḥ purataḥ pṛṣṭhato vā na praśastamiti| dūtairaniṣṭairityādi| aniṣṭairiti napuṃsakagardabhoṣṭrarathaprāptādibhistulyānāṃ samānānāmanyeṣāmapi nṛṇāṃ darśanaṃ prasthāne na praśastam| kulatthetyādi| kulatthādīnāṃ pātramaṅgārādipūritaṃ ca neṣṭaṃ na praśastamityarthaḥ| prasannetaramadyānāmityādi| prasannā madyasyoparyaccho bhāgaḥ; taditareṣāṃ madyānāṃ pūrṇamapraśastaṃ, tathā raktasarṣapapūrṇaṃ ca na praśastam| śavakāṣṭhetyādi śavādīnāṃ pathi mārge saṅgamāḥ saṃyogā na praśastāḥ| śavo mṛtakaḥ| kāṣṭhaṃ dāru, palāśaṃ parṇam| ‘śuṣkāṇāṃ' ityatra sthāne kecit ‘rūḍhānāṃ' iti paṭhanti| teṣāṃ mate rūḍhānāṃ purāṇānāmityarthaḥ| neṣyante na praśasyante| patitāḥ pañca mahāpātakinaḥ| antaḥsthāḥ caṇḍālādayaḥ| dīno nirutsāhaḥ||32-40||

lg.l: mṛduḥ śīto 'nukūlaś ca sugandhiś cānilaḥ śubhaḥ |

ab.seg: anilaṃ nirdiśannāha- mṛdurityādi| anukūlaḥ pṛṣṭānugāmī| pratilomaḥ abhimukhaḥ||41||

rogaviśeṣādapi nimittaviśeṣamanuktaṃ nirdiśannāha- granthītyādi| vyādhiviśeṣeṇa anuktena vyādhibhedenetyarthaḥ| nimittamiti śubhāśubhasūcakam| anye tu- "evaṃ vyādhiviśeṣeṇa nimittamupadhārayet" ityamuṃ pāṭhamanyathā paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca, sa cābhāvānna likhitaḥ||42-43||

sāmānyaṃ śabdanimittaṃ darśayannāha- tathaivetyādi| ākruṣṭamākrośaḥ ākruṣṭādibhiḥ svanaśabdaḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| hākaṣṭaṃśabdaḥ khedārthaḥ| ākranda ākrośasvanaḥ| amuṃ ślokaṃ bāhulyena na paṭhanti| pañjikākāragayadāsena tu viśiṣṭapāṭhaśuddhikāreṇa likhito vyākhyātaścetyatrāpi likhitaḥ||44||

lg.l: pratiṣiddhaṃ tathā bhagnaṃ ‘lagnaṃ’ iti pā. kṣutaṃ skhalitam āhatam |
daurmanasyaṃ ca vaidyasya yātrāyāṃ na praśasyate ||45||

ab.seg: vaidyasyāpi gehe vāgādiceṣṭitaṃ darśayannāha- pratītyādi| pratiṣiddhamiti niṣedhavacanaṃ ‘māgaccha' ityādikaṃ, bhagnaṃ kīlakādibhaṅgavacanaṃ, kṣutaṃ chikkitaṃ; trayametadvāgviceṣṭitam| ‘bhagnaṃ' ityasya sthāne kecit ‘lagnaṃ' iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- lagnaṃ vastrādisaṅgaḥ| skhalitamāhatametat kāyaviceṣṭitam| skhalitaṃ luṇṭhanaṃ pādādeḥ, āhatamiti āhananam| daurmanasyaṃ cittaviceṣṭitam||45||

lg.l: praveśe 'py etad uddeśād avekṣyaṃ ca tathā''ture |
pratidvāraṃ gṛhe cāsya punar etan na gaṇyate ||46||

ab.seg: vaidyagṛhavidhimāturagṛhe'pyatidiśannāha- praveśe ityādi| etat pūrvoktaṃ śubhāśubhanimittaṃ, praveśe'pyavekṣyaṃ draṣṭavyam| uddeśāt saṅkṣepāt| āture āturagṛhe| pratidvāraṃ dvāraṃ prati| gṛhe gṛhābhyantare, asya āturasya, etat pūrvoktaṃ nimittaṃ, na gaṇyate na manyata ityarthaḥ| kecit ‘pratidvāraṃ gṛhaṃ cāsya' ityādi pāṭhaṃ manyante| pratiśabdo lakṣaṇā(ṇe')rthe; tena dvāraṃ lakṣīkṛtya, gṛhaṃ ca lakṣīkṛtyeti| atroddeśāt saṅkṣepādāture'pyavekṣyamiti sambandhaḥ||46||

lg.l: khaṭvordhvapādā madyāpo vasā tailaṃ tilās tṛṇam ||47||
prasthāne vā praveśe vā neṣyante darśanaṃ gatāḥ ||48||

ab.seg: āturagṛhe gatasya yātronmukhasya ca vaidyasya viparītanimittaṃ darśayannāha- keśabhasmetyādi| muṇḍā muṇḍitamuṇḍāḥ| asitāmbarā raktavastrāḥ||47-48||

lg.l: vaidyāsanāvasādo vā rogī vā syād adhomukhaḥ |
pramṛjyād vā ‘pramṛdyādvā’ iti pā. dhunīyād vā karau pṛṣṭhaṃ śiras tathā |
hastaṃ cākṛṣya vaidyasya nyasec chirasi corasi ||51||
yo vaidyam unmukhaḥ paśyann unmārṣṭi svāṅgam āturaḥ |
na sa sidhyati vaidyo vā gṛhe yasya na pūjyate ||52||
bhavane pūjyate vā'pi yasya vaidyaḥ sa sidhyati |53|
