prāgdravyasaṅgrahaṇīyādhyāye vyādhipratyanīkā dravyagaṇā uktāḥ, saṃśodhanasaṃśamanīye tu doṣapratyanīkaprāyāḥ pañcakarmopayoginaḥ śodhanadravyasaṅgrahagaṇā vātādiśamanadravyagaṇāśca kathayitavyā iti; tatra dvividhaṃ saṃśodhanaṃ- vamanaṃ virecanaṃ ca; tatra vamanapūrvakatvādvirecanasya prathamaṃ vamanadravyagaṇamabhidhātumāha- madanetyādi| jīmūtako devadālī, ikṣvākuḥ kaṭukālābūḥ, dhāmārgavaḥ pītapuṣpā koṣātakī, kṛtavedhanaḥ koṣātakībhedaḥ, sarṣapāḥ śvetasarṣapā viśeṣeṇa vamanārhāḥ, kovidāraḥ kāñcanāraḥ, karbudāraḥ śleṣmāntakaḥ ‘bavahāra’ iti ‘lihūsāḍaka’ iti ca deśabhāṣayā prasiddhaḥ, ariṣṭo nimbaḥ, vidulo vetasaḥ, bandhujīvo madhyāhnapuṣpakaḥ ‘marunīyā’ iti loke, śvetā śvetavacā, śaṇapuṣpī śaṇasadṛśaviṭapaḥ ‘saṇahulī’ iti loke, bimbī kindurikā, vacā dvitīyā'ruṇā, mṛgervārurindravāruṇī, citrā ‘citrā citraphalā goḍumbā’ iti cakraḥ citrāṇḍikā paṭolaphalākāraphalā āraṇyakacaṇḍaketyarthaḥ, anye dravantīmāhuḥ| śeṣaṃ prasiddham| ūrdhvabhāgaharāṇi vamanakarāṇītyarthaḥ| eṣāṃ ‘kṛtavedhanāntānāṃ vamanādhyāye prādhānyena prayogābhidhānāt prādhānyaṃ, sarṣapādīnāṃ tu vamanadravyopasarjanatvam’ iti cakraḥ madhye kāniciddravyāṇi sākṣādvāmayanti kānicidvamanadravyamilitāni| kecidācāryā ‘dvāviṃśatidravyāṇi’ ityatra gaṇe niyamamāhuḥ| eṣābhavayavavibhāgamāha- tatretyādi||3||

vivṛtāśyāmādantīdravantīsaptalāśaṅkhinīviṣāṇikāgavākṣīcchagalāntrīsnuksuvarṇakṣīrīcitrakakiṇihīkuśakāśatilvakakampillakaramyakapāṭalāpūgaharītakyāmalakabibhītakanīlinīcaturaṅgulairaṇḍapūtīkamahāvṛkṣasaptacchadārkā jyotiṣmatī cety adhobhāgaharāṇi | tatra tilvakapūrvāṇāṃ mūlāni ‘mūlavarge snuhīpāṭhānmūlamapi snuhyā gṛhyate, kṣīravarge pāṭhācca kṣīramapi| kampillakastu tvagvarge pāṭhāttvacā grāhya eva, paraṃ vaidyavyavahārāccarakavacanācca tasya phalarajo gṛhyate| uktaṃ hi carake ‘kampillakāragvadhayoḥ phalaṃ yat kuṭajasya ca’ (ca. sū. a. 1) iti| āragvadhasya patraṃ virecanaṃ, carakavacanāt phalaṃ ca| pūtikasya tu patraṃ virecanamuktaṃ, carake tu ‘pūtikaḥ kṛṣṇagandhā ca’ ityādinā tvak pradhānamuktā, teneha prayogeṣu grahītavyā| kośātakyādīnāṃ svarasā ubhayabhāgaharāḥ| phalaṃ tu kośātakīdevadālyorvāmanamuktam’ iti cakraḥ, tilvakādīnāṃ pāṭalāntānāṃ tvacaḥ, kampillakaphalarajaḥ, pūgādīnām eraṇḍāntānāṃ phalāni, pūtīkāragvadhayoḥ patrāṇi, śeṣāṇāṃ kṣīrāṇīti ||4||

virecanadravyāṇi nirdiśannāha- trivṛdityādi| trivṛt raktamūlā ‘nisotṛ’ iti lokeḥ; śyāmā kṛṣṇamūlā trivṛt; dantī dantinī; dravantī dantībhedaḥ ‘saṃvarī’ iti loke; saptalā sātalā sehuṇḍabhedaḥ, apare budhnāmāhuḥ; śaṅkhinī yavatiktābhedaḥ, śvetabudhnetyapare; viṣāṇikā meṣaśṛṅgī; gavākṣī śvetapuṣpendravāruṇī; chagalāntrī vṛddhadāra(ru)kaḥ; snuk sehuṇḍaḥ; suvarṇakṣīryanantāsadṛśapatrā ‘hiyāvali hiyāvaliḥ ‘hiravī’ iti kāśmīre prasiddhā ’ iti loke, ‘kaṅguṣṭha’ ityapare; kiṇihī kaṭabhī; tilvakaḥ svalparodhraḥ; kampillako rocanikaḥ svanāmakhyātaḥ; ramyako drekkā ‘bakāiṇi’ iti loke, paṭolamūlamityapare; nīlinī nīlabudhnā(hnā), ‘śrīphalikā’ iti loke; caturaṅgulaḥ kiramālakaḥ, atraike caturaṅgulasthāne ‘pañcāṅgula’ iti paṭhanti, teṣāṃ mate pañcāṅgula eraṇḍaḥ, anye tu pañcāṅgulaśabdena paṭolaphalasadṛśaphalāṃ latāṃ snigdhapatrāṃ śāradaphalāmāhuḥ; pūtīkaścirabilvaḥ; mahāvṛkṣaḥ sehuṇḍabhedaḥ, tasya kṣīram, etena na punaruktadoṣaḥ; saptacchadaḥ saptaparṇaḥ; jyotiṣmatī kākamardanikā| adhobhāgaharāṇīti virecanānītyarthaḥ| śeṣaṃ sugamam| eṣāmavayavavibhāgamāha- tatretyādi||4||
kośātakī saptalā śaṅkhinī devadālī kāravellikā cety ubhayatobhāgaharāṇi | eṣāṃ svarasā iti ||5||

ubhayabhāgaharāṇi nirdiśannāha- kośātakītyādi| kośātakī ghoṣakaḥ; saptalā snuhībhedaḥ, apare śrīphalikāmāhuḥ; devadālī svanāmakhyātā, ‘devalī’ iti loke| ubhayatobhāgaharāṇīti vamanāni virecanāni cetyarthaḥ| etāni kośātakīprabhṛtīni niyamenobhayatobhāgaharāṇi, gavākṣīprabhṛtīnāṃ pūrvoktānāṃ tu patrādiviśeṣeṇa kadācidvāmakatvaṃ kadācidvirecakatvamiti na teṣāmubhayatobhāgaharatvam| eṣāṃ kośātakyādīnāṃ kiṃ gṛhyata ityāha- eṣāmityādi| tatra svarasagrahaṇaṃ kaṣāyādinivāraṇārtham||5||

pippalīviḍaṅgāpāmārgaśigrusiddhārthakaśirīṣamaricakaravīrabimbīgirikarṇikākiṇihīvacājyotiṣmatī- karañjārkālarkalaśunātiviṣāśṛṅgaveratālīśatamālasurasārjakeṅgudīmeṣaśṛṅgīmātuluṅgīmuraṅgīpīlu- jātīśālatālamadhūkalākṣāhiṅgulavaṇamadyagośakṛdrasamūtrāṇīti ‘hiṅgvādīnāṃ mūlāntānāṃ svarūpakathanena sarvāṅgaprayogaṃ darśayati’ iti cakraḥ śirovirecanāni | tatra karavīrapūrvāṇāṃ phalāni, karavīrādīnām arkāntānāṃ mūlāni, tālīśapūrvāṇāṃ kandāḥ, tālīśādīnām arjakāntānāṃ patrāṇi, iṅgudīmeṣaśṛṅgyos tvacaḥ, mātuluṅgīmuraṅgīpīlujātīnāṃ puṣpāṇi, śālatālamadhūkānāṃ sārāḥ, hiṅgu lākṣe niryāsau, lavaṇāni pārthivaviśeṣāḥ; madyāny āsutasaṃyogāḥ, śakṛdrasamūtre ‘gomūtraśakṛdrasau’ iti pā. malāv iti ||6||

śirovirecanadravyāṇi nirdeṣṭumāha- pippalītyādi| apāmārgaḥ śikharī ‘andhaḍaka’ iti loke; śigruḥ śobhāñjanakaḥ; siddhārthaḥ sarṣapaḥ; śirīṣo viṣaghātī svanāmakhyātaḥ;karavīraḥ ‘kaṇavīra’ iti loke; bimbī kundurukā; girikarṇikā sephandaḥ; kiṇihī kaṭabhī; jyotiṣmatī kakundanī; arkālakau arkadvayaṃ; śṛṅgaveraṃ śuṇṭhī; tālīśaṃ tālīśapatraṃ; tamālaṃ tamālapatraṃ, patrakamiti loke; surasā ‘tulasī’ iti loke; arjakaḥ kuṭherakaḥ; iṅgudī iṅgukaḥ; meṣaśṛṅgī meḍhaśṛṅgaḥ putrañjīvakasadṛśapatro vṛkṣaḥ, anye karkaṭaśṛṅgamāhuḥ; mātuluṅgī surabhiphalā vanajā'raṇyabījapūrakaḥ; muraṅgī raktakusumaḥ śobhāñjanakaḥ, pīlurmadhuraphalaḥ ‘pīlu’ iti loke; jātī mālatī; śakṛdraso gomayarasaḥ; mūtraṃ gomūtram| śirovirecanānīti nasyaprayogeṇa śirasthaṃ śleṣmāṇaṃ virecayanti srāvayantītyarthaḥ| śeṣaṃ prasiddham| eṣāmavayavavibhāgamāha- tatretyādi| niryāsau svarasāvityarthaḥ| lavaṇāni pārthivaviśeṣā iti pṛthivyā avayavaviśeṣāḥ, etena svarūpeṇaiva lavaṇāni grāhyāṇītyuktam| madyānyāsutasaṃyogā iti sandhānakasaṃyogo madyam, ata eva tadapi svarūpeṇaiva grāhyam| śakṛdrasamūtre malāviti ete malau, tasmādete api svarūpeṇa grāhye||6||

saṃśamanāny ata ‘saṃśamanaṃ nāma yaddoṣaṃ doṣagrahaṇagṛhītaṃ ca vyādhiṃ saṃśodhanaṃ vinā kṣapayati, samaṃ ca nodīrayati’ iti cakraḥ ūrdhvaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ- tatra bhadradārukuṣṭhaharidrāvaruṇameṣaśṛṅgībalātibalārtagalakacchurāśallakīkuberākṣīvīratarusahacarāgnimantha- vatsādanyeraṇḍāśmabhedakālarkārkaśatāvarīpunarnavāvasukavaśirakāñcanakabhārgīkārpāsīvṛścikālīpattūrabadarayavakolakulatthaprabhṛtīni vidārigandhādiś ca dve cādye pañcamūlyau samāsena vātasaṃśamano vargaḥ ||7||

saṃśodhanamabhidhāya saṃśamanaṃ nirdiśannāha- bhadradārvityādi| saṃśamanānīti samyak śamayatīti saṃśamanaṃ, samyaktvaṃ ca duṣṭadoṣasyānirharaṇapūrvakaṃ śamanam, aduṣṭasyānudīraṇaṃ ca; vyādhisaṃśamanaṃ tu prastutavyādheḥ saṃśamanamaprastutavyādheranudīraṇam| taduktaṃ- “na śodhayati yaddoṣān samānnodīrayatyapi| samīkaroti ca kruddhān tat saṃśamanamucyate” iti| doṣaśabdo'tra doṣeṣu doṣakāryeṣu vyādhiṣvapi ca vartate, kārye kāraṇopacārāt| meṣaśṛṅgī meḍhaśṛṅgaḥ, putrañjīvakatarusadṛśapatro vṛkṣaḥ, anye karkaṭaśṛṅgamāhuḥ; balātibale śuklapītapuṣpaṃ balādvayaṃ; ārtagalaḥ kakubhaḥ, kecidārtagalaṃ kaṇṭakīvṛkṣamācakṣate; kacchurā kuṅkumardanikā, ‘kacchurā śūkaśimbiḥ’ ityanye; kuberākṣī kāṣṭhapāṭalā, po(pe)ṭiketyanye; vīratarurbilvanāsikā, śara ityanye; sahacaraḥ kaṇṭaśeliyākaḥ; agnimanthaḥ ‘agnivadhūḥ’ iti pūrvadeśe prasiddhaḥ; vatsādanī guḍūcī, vīryeṇa guḍūcī vātaṃ hanti, rasena kaphapitte; aśmabhedakaḥ pāṣāṇabhedakaḥ, vasukaḥ śivamallikā, bakapuṣpamiti loke; vaśiraḥ sūryāvartaḥ, apāmārga ityapare; kāñcanako dhattūrakaḥ, ‘karcūra’ ityanye paṭhanti, karcūraḥ śaṭī; kārpāsī vanakārpāsikā, kārpāsaviṭapasadṛśī; vṛścikālī vṛściyākaḥ; pattūraḥ kucandanam| śeṣaṃ prasiddhaṃ, pūrvaṃ vyākhyātaṃ ca| prabhṛtigrahaṇānmāṣatilātasīprabhṛtīnāṃ grahaṇam| samāsena saṅkṣepeṇa, vistareṇa tvannapānādyanilaharagrahaṇaśrutipratipāditaṃ yāvadbhūjalānalaguṇabahulaṃ dravyaṃ vātasaṃśamanamiti||7||

candanakucandanahrīberośīramañjiṣṭhāpayasyāvidārīśatāvarīgundrāśaivalakahlārakumudotpalakanda(da)līdūrvāmūrvāprabhṛtīni kākolyādiḥ sārivādir añjanādir utpalādir nyagrodhādis tṛṇapañcamūlam iti samāsena pittasaṃśamano vargaḥ ||8||

pittasaṃśamanaṃ nirdiśannāha- candanetyādi| candanaṃ śrīkhaṇḍaṃ; kucandanaṃ raktacandanaṃ; hrīberaṃ bālakaṃ; payasyā kṣīrakākolī; vidārī vidārīkandaḥ; śaivalaṃ śaivālaṃ; kahlāraṃ raktotpalaṃ ‘bṛhatpatrikā’ iti loke, anye saugandhikotpalaṃ; kumudotpalaṃ śvetotpalaṃ, kandalī śvetaślakṣṇabahupuṭakandaviśeṣaḥ ‘sarpacchatrakam’ iti loke; mūrvā kandalīsadṛśasvalpaviṭapaḥ ‘hadhoḍa’ iti loke| prabhṛtigrahaṇādanuktamapi madhuratiktakaṣāyaṃ dravyaṃ grāhyam| samāsagrahaṇena tvannapānādau pittaharatvena yadanyadapyuditaṃ khabhūmijalānilabhūyiṣṭhaṃ tadapi pittaśamanaṃ grāhyam| nanu, candanakucandane sārivādau, payasyā kākolyādau, utpalādīnyutpalādigaṇe paṭhitānyeva, tatkathaṃ pṛthaṅnirdeśa iti? brūmaḥ, samastavyastānāṃ tricaturāṇāṃ guṇaviśeṣajñāpanāya pṛthak pāṭhaḥ| yaṣṭīmadhukaṃ tu śītakaṣāyādikalpanayā pittaṃ śamayati vāmanīyadravyasaṃyutaṃ tu vāmanīyamiti na doṣaḥ||8||

kāleyakāgurutilaparṇīkuṣṭhaharidrāśītaśivaśatapuṣpāsaralārāsnāprakīryodakīryeṅgudīsumanā- kākādanīlāṅgalakīhastikarṇamuñjātakalāmajjakaprabhṛtīni vallīkaṇṭakapañcamūlyau pippalyādir bṛhatyādir muṣkakādir vacādiḥ surasādir āragvadhādir iti samāsena śleṣmasaṃśamano vargaḥ ||9||

kaphasaṃśamanaṃ nirdiśannāha- kāleyaketyādi| kāleyakaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇacandanaviśeṣo ‘malayādricandanam’ iti loke; tilaparṇī hulahulaḥ; śītaśivaṃ karpūraṃ, śatapuṣpābhedameke, gavedhuketyapare; saralā trivṛt; prakīryā kaṇṭakī viṭapakarañjaḥ; udakīryā cirabilvaḥ; iṅgudī iṅgukaḥ, ‘putrañjīvaka’ ityanye; sumanā jātī; kākādanī hiṃsrā; lāṅgalakī kalikārikā; hastikarṇo gajakarṇākāraikapatraḥ, ‘bhūpalāśa’ iti loke, raktairaṇḍa ityanye; muñjātakaḥ; svanāmakhyātaḥ svalpakanda uttarāpathe; lāmajjakamuśīrabhedaḥ| keṣāñcidatra pippalyādivacādipaṭhitānāṃ punarvacanaṃ viśeṣeṇa kaphasaṃśamanatvadarśanārthaṃ; muñjātakasya ‘muñjātakaḥ uttarāpathe prasiddhaḥ| ayaṃ tantrāntare vātapittaharaḥ prasiddhaḥ, tena nātra paṭhanīyaḥ’ iti cakraḥ vātapittaharatve'pi śleṣmaharatvena prāyastridoṣaharatvaṃ darśayanti| prabhṛtigrahaṇādanuktakaṭutiktakaṣāyāṇāmupasaṃhāraḥ| samāseneti vistareṇa tvannapānādau tathā tejo'nilākāśaguṇabhūyiṣṭhamanuktamapi dravyaṃ kaphasaṃśamanamiti||9||

tatra sarvāṇy evauṣadhāni ‘sarvāṇīti saṃśodhanāni saṃśamanāni ca| vyādhiśabdenātra doṣasyāpi grahaṇāddoṣabalamapyavekṣyam| tatra vyādherdoṣasya balatvaṃ hetubāhulyālliṅgabāhulyācca, durbalatvaṃ tadviparyayāt| agnerbalatvaṃ guruvṛṣyādijaraṇaśaktyā, ucitāhārapākāśaktyā durbalatvam| dehabalaṃ ca vyāyāmena, viparyayeṇa daurbalyam| upacayāpacayābhyāṃ ca dehabalaṃ jñeyam| puruṣagrahaṇena manaso balābale api grāhye| anyavyādhimiti atiyogajanyavyādhiṃ doṣaṃ vā| madāḥ śarīramanobalabhraṃśakṛtā jñeyāḥ| atipātayatīti atidoṣapātanaṃ karoti| saṃśamanāpekṣayā saṃśodhanamatiyuktamativyāpattikaraṃ bhavatyeva| vyādhyapekṣayā hi prādhānyena bheṣajamātrā| sā tu samyakpākārthamagnibalaṃ puruṣabalaṃ cāpekṣate| nanu, uktadoṣapramāṇānurūpo hi bheṣajapramāṇavikalpo balapramāṇāpekṣo bhavati, tataśca hīnamebhyo dattamiti bahuvacanamanupapannam? naivaṃ, bahuvacanaṃ tāvadbalavati vyādhau tathā balavatorvyādhipuruṣabalayostathā balavatsu vyādhipuruṣāgniṣu, ityādivikalpabahutvādapyupapannaṃ| kintu vyādhibalamātrasamaṃ bheṣajaṃ balavatyagnau puruṣe vā alpamātratayā upayuktaṃ sat tayorbalenābhipūyālpaśaktikaṃ kriyate, tena vyādhimapi na tathā śamayati, tena hīnamebhya iti bahuvacanamupapannam’ iti cakraḥ vyādhyagnipuruṣabalāny abhisamīkṣya vidadhyāt | tatra, vyādhibalād adhikam auṣadham upayuktaṃ tam upaśamya vyādhiṃ vyādhim anyam āvahati; agnibalād adhikam ajīrṇaṃ viṣṭabhya vā pacyate; puruṣabalād adhikaṃ glānimūrcchāmadān āvahati saṃśamanam; evaṃ saṃśodhanam atipātayati | hīnam ebhyo dattam akiñcitkaraṃ bhavati | tasmāt samam eva vidadhyāt ||10||

ataḥparaṃ saṃśodhanasaṃśamanadravyamātrāṃ niyamayannāha- tatretyādi| sarvāṇīti saṃśodhanāni saṃśamanāni cetyarthaḥ| vyādhyagnipuruṣāṇāṃ ca balaṃ śaktimabhisamīkṣya nyūnādhikabhāvena, vidadhyāt kuryāt| vyādhiśabdena doṣā rogāśca| teṣāṃ vyādhyādīnāṃ balādikamanapekṣya bheṣajaprayoge kriyamāṇe vyādhyādibalādhike doṣaṃ nirdiśannāha- tatretyādi| viṣṭabhya vā pacyata iti cirakālaṃ sthirībhūya śūlādikaṃ kṛtvetyarthaḥ| glāniḥ śarīraśaithilyaṃ, mūrcchā cetanācyutiḥ, mado madyamattasyeva; āvahati karoti| śamanamiti saṃśamanauṣadhamityarthaḥ| saṃśodhanadoṣamāhu- evaṃ saṃśodhanamiti|-evametaddoṣaṃ saṃśodhanamapi karotītyarthaḥ| atipātayati atipātanamapyadhikaṃ karotyāturabalasyetyarthaḥ| vyādhibalanyūnāyā auṣadhamātrāyā dāne doṣamāha- hīnetyādi| akiñcitkaraṃ na kiñcit karoti anarthakamityarthaḥ; anye'kiñcitkaramalpārthakaramityāhuḥ; nañ īṣadarthe| siddhihetumupādhiṃ darśayannāha- tasmādityādi| samameva rogādisamabalamityarthaḥ||10||

bhavanti cātra-
roge śodhanasādhye tu yo bhaved doṣadurbalaḥ |
tasmai dadyād bhiṣak cakrastu ‘taṃ samīkṣya bhiṣagdadyāt’ iti paṭhati vyākhyānayati ca- ‘samīkṣyeti samyagbalaṃ nirūpya’ iti prājño doṣapracyāvānaṃ mṛdu ||11||

durbalasya balavacchodhanaṃ na kartavyamityāha- roga ityādi| yo bhaveddoṣadurbalaḥ yaḥ puruṣo dauṣairdurbalo na tūpavāsādibhiḥ; yasmāddoṣadurbale doṣaharaṇādeva balaṃ bhavati, upavāsādikṛśe tvapahṛte'pi doṣe balaṃ na bhavati| doṣapracyāvanaṃ virecanam| mṛdviti mṛduvīryaṃ caturaṅgulavirekādi||11||

lg.l: cale doṣe mṛdau koṣṭhe nekṣetātra balaṃ nṛṇām |

ab.seg: avasthāviśeṣeṇāvyādhidurbale'pi śodhanaṃ darśayannāha- cala ityādi| cale iti svasthānāccalita ityarthaḥ| atreti cale doṣe| mṛdau koṣṭha ityasyāmavasthāyāmityarthaḥ| avyādhidurbalasyāpi upavāsādidurbalasyāpi, hi yasmādarthe, tadā bhavet ‘hitam’ ityadhyāhāraḥ| ‘avyādhidurbalasyāpī’ ityatra kecit ‘avyāpaddurbalasyāpi’ iti paṭhanti| avyāpacchodhanaṃ hitaṃ tadā bhavatītyarthaḥ; avyāpacchodhanaṃ taducyate śūlādīni yanna karoti| atrāntare kecit paṭhanti- svayamityādi| na cāyaṃ sarvanibandheṣu dṛśyata iti||12-13||

vyādhyagnipuruṣeṣu madhyamabaleṣu kiyanmātramauṣadhaṃ dadyādityāha- vyādhyādiṣvityādi| madhyeṣu madhyamabaleṣu| kvāthasyāñjaliriṣyata iti kvāthagrahaṇācchṛtaśītaphāṇṭānāṃ, na tu svarasakṣīrayoḥ, te hi gurutvādalpapramāṇe prayoktavye| añjaliścatvāri palāni| biḍālapadakaṃ karṣa ityarthaḥ| akṣasammita iti karṣapramāṇa ityarthaḥ, kalko dravapiṣṭaḥ| etena vyādhyādiṣu hīnabaleṣvañjalyādayo'pyapakarṣaṇīyāḥ, teṣāmevādhike bale tūtkarṣaṇīyā iti| anuvāsanāsthāpanaśirovirecanādīnāmanyatra mātroddeśaḥ kārya iti||15||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne saṃśodhanasaṃśamanīyo nāmaikonacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||39||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne ekonacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||39||
athāto dravyarasaguṇavīryavipākavijñānīyam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

athāta ityādi| dravyādīnāṃ vijñānaṃ viśiṣṭajñānaṃ tadadhikṛtya kṛto'dhyāya ityarthaḥ| dravyamauṣadhamucyate, raso madhurādikaḥ, guṇāḥ śītoṣṇasnigdharūkṣamandatīkṣṇagurulaghupicchilaviśadaślakṣṇaparuṣakaṭhinamṛdudravasāndrasthirasarasthūlasūkṣmā viṃśatiḥ, vīryaṃ cāṣṭavidhaṃ, tadyathā- śītoṣṇasnigdharūkṣaviśadapicchilamṛdutīkṣṇāni, viṃśatiguṇānāṃ madhye eteṣāmaṣṭānāṃ guṇānāṃ vīryamiti sañjñā| nanu, guṇādvīryāṇāṃ ko bhedaḥ? ucyate- ya eva guṇā āmalakyāṃ ta eva harītakyām, asti ca vīrye viśeṣaḥ; tathāhi- uṣṇavīryā harītakī, śītavīryamāmalakamiti; etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati- dravyarasaguṇavipākairyat karma kartuṃ na śakyate tat karma kurvan prabhāvo vīryamucyate, tathāhi- “vīryaṃ śaktirutpattiviśeṣaḥ, sāmarthyaṃ prabhāva ityanarthāntaram”| yaddravyaṃ pariṇāmakāle svābhāvikaṃ rasaṃ parityajya rasāntaraṃ bhajate tatra ‘vipāka’ iti sañjñā||1-2||

kecid ācāryā ‘dravyādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ prādhānyamekīyamatena darśayituṃ dravyasya prādhānye prathamaṃ sahetukamekīyamatamāha- kecidityādi| etaccaikīyamatopadarśanaṃ samyagdravyādisvabhāvajñānārtham, abhiniviṣṭo hi vādī svapakṣasādhanārthaṃ svarūpaṃ prādhānyakhyāpakaṃ darśayati, tena cānte vakṣyamāṇācāryasiddhāntasahitena samyagarthapratītirbhavati| vyavasthitatvāditi avasthābhedena rasādibhede'pi dravyasya vyavasthitatvāt| yathā- āmraphalaṃ prathamaṃ kaṣāyāmlaṃ, madhye'mlaṃ, tato madhuram, evaṃ rasāvyavasthāne'pi dravyamātrarūpatayā vyavasthitatvam| nityatvācceti nityatvaṃ rasādināśe'pyavasthitatvamiha jñeyaṃ, vyavasthitatvaṃ tu rasānyathātve tadrūpatayā vyavasthitatvamiti bhedaḥ| kālādītyatrādiśabdena jalavātādayo gṛhyante| svajātyavasthānāditi pariṇāme'pi dravyaṃ svajātāvavatiṣṭhate na jātyantaraṃ bhavati, pārthivaṃ tu pārthivameva yadāpyaṃ tadāpyamevetyādisvajātyaparityāgaḥ| rasastu kṣīramadhuratvaṃ parityajyāmlatāṃ yātītyanusaraṇīyaṃ, jātiśceha pārthivatvādirūpā vyavasthitā'bhipretā, tena kṣīrasya dadhitvaṃ guḍasya śarkarātvamityādijātibhedo nodbhavanīyaḥ| pañcendriyagrahaṇādityatra pañcabhirindriyairdravyaṃ gṛhyate iti cakṣuṣā sparśanena tāvaddravyagrahaṇamavivādasiddhameva| ghrāṇarasanāśrotrāṇāmapi surabhi candanaṃ, madhuraḥ koṣakāraḥ, tathā susvarā vīṇetyādi sāmānādhikaraṇyajñānena dravyagrahaṇaṃ prati sphuṭataravyāpārād dravyagrāhakatvaṃ jñeyam| āśrayatvācceti rasādīnāṃ dravyamāśrayaḥ, tenāśritā rasādayaḥ paratantratvādapradhānāḥ, āśrayastu pradhānamityarthaḥ| kasmādrasādīnāmekadeśena vyādhayo na sādhyanta ityāha- niravayavatvāditi| kriyāvadguṇavat samavāyikāraṇaṃ dravyamiti kriyā karma, guṇā rasādayaḥ, samavāyikāraṇaṃ svasamavetakāryajanakam| ete kriyādayo rasādau vyāvṛtā itīhoktāḥ| sarvadravyavyāpakavijātīyavyāvṛttaṃ tu lakṣaṇamiha- kriyāguṇavattvameva| etadeva hi kriyāguṇayoryathākramaṃ dravyaṃ vyāpya kriyā dravye vidyate, guṇāḥ samavayantīti| vidyate iti sattāmātraṃ vyāptiḥ, samavayantīti vyāpya dravyamavatiṣṭhante, nahi nirguṇaṃ dravyaṃ kiñcidastīti’ iti cakraḥ bruvate- dravyaṃ pradhānaṃ, kasmāt? vyavasthitatvāt, iha khalu dravyaṃ vyavasthitaṃ na rasādayaḥ, yathā ‘tathāhi’ iti pā. āme phale ye rasādayas te pakve na santi; nityatvāc ca, nityaṃ hi dravyam anityā guṇāḥ, yathā kalkādipravibhāgaḥ, sa eva sampannarasagandho vyāpannarasagandho ‘vyāpannarasagandha’ iti pāṭho hastalikhitapustake nopalabhyate, ḍalhaṇenāpi na vyākhyātaḥ| ‘yathā- kālādipravibhāgāttadeva sampannarasagandhaṃ vyāpannarasagandhaṃ vā bhavati’ iti cakrasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ vā bhavati; svajātyavasthānāc ca, yathā
hi pārthivaṃ dravyam anyabhāvaṃ na gacchaty evaṃ śeṣāṇi; pañcendriyagrahaṇāś ca, pañcabhir indriyair gṛhyate dravyaṃ na rasādayaḥ; āśrayatvāc ca, dravyam āśritā rasādayaḥ; ārambhasāmarthyāc ca, dravyāśrita ārambhaḥ, yathā- ‘vidārigandhādim āhṛtya saṅkṣudya vipacet’ ity evam ādiṣu na rasādiṣv ārambhaḥ; śāstraprāmāṇyāc ca, śāstre hi dravyaṃ pradhānam upadeśe yogānāṃ, yathā- ‘mātuluṅgāgnimanthau ca’ ity ādau na rasādaya upadiśyante; kramāpekṣitatvāc ca rasādīnāṃ, rasādayo hi dravyakramam apekṣante, yathā- taruṇe taruṇāḥ sampūrṇe sampūrṇā iti; ekadeśasādhyatvāc ca, dravyāṇām ekadeśenāpi vyādhayaḥ sādhyante, yathā- mahāvṛkṣakṣīreṇeti; tasmād dravyaṃ pradhānaṃ, na rasādayaḥ, kasmāt? niravayavatvāt | dravyalakṣaṇaṃ tu ‘kriyāguṇavat samavāyikāraṇam’ iti ||3||

tatra pratyekaṃ dravyādiprādhānyamekīyamatena pratipādayiṣyan dravyaprādhānyaṃ prathamaṃ sakāraṇaṃ pratipādayannāha- kecidityādi| vyavasthitatvāditi| dravyaṃ hi vyavatiṣṭhate na rasādayaḥ, yathā- āmraphalamekameva prathamaṃ kaṣāyāmlaṃ paścādamlaṃ tato madhuramapi bhavati, na tu tadevāmraphalamāmrātakaṃ kośāmraṃ vā bhavati| dravyaprādhānye dvitīyaṃ hetumāha- nityatvādityādi|- nityatvāt kiyatkālāvasthitatvādityarthaḥ| anityā guṇā iti vināśina ityarthaḥ| kalketyādi ādigrahaṇāt svarasaśṛtaśītaphāṇṭānāmapi grahaṇam| sa eva kalkādipravibhāga eva| sampannarasagandho vā bhavatīti saṃyuktarasaḥ saṃyuktagandho vā bhavatītyarthaḥ| etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati- kalkādyavasthāsvapi dravyaṃ tadeva nānyataraddravyaṃ, rasagandhau tvanyau saṃyuktau bhavata iti guṇādanityāt ‘guṇā anityāḥ’ iti pā. dravyaṃ nityam| anye kalkādisthāne ‘kālādipravibhāgāt’ iti paṭhanti| teṣāṃ mate ādigrahaṇājjalavātadeśasomasūryā gṛhyante| tadyathā- ‘tā evauṣadhayo grīṣme niḥsārā rūkṣā’ (sū. a.6) ityādi| dravyaprādhānye tṛtīyaṃ hetuṃ darśayannāha- svajātyavasthānācceti|- svasyāṃ pārthivādijātāvavasthitatvādityarthaḥ| anyabhāvaṃ na gacchati āpyādijātiṃ na gacchati| caturthaṃ kāraṇaṃ darśayannāha- pañcetyādi| pañcabhirindriyairdravyaṃ gṛhyate, dravye gṛhīte tadāśrayā guṇā gṛhītā bhavanti; guṇāśca śabdasparśarūparasagandhāḥ| dravye śabdo'pyasti; yathā- pārthivadravye kaṭakaṭāśabdaḥ, āpye khalakhalāśabdaḥ, taijase taṭataṭāśabda ityādikaḥ| vāyavyadravyamākāśadravyaṃ cānumānagrāhyamamūrtatvāt| na rasādaya iti rasaguṇavīryavipākāstu na pañcendriyagrāhyā ityarthaḥ| pañcamaṃ hetuṃ darśayannāha- āśrayatvādityādi| āśraya idaṃ dravyaṃ rasādīnām| ṣaṣṭhaṃ hetuṃ darśayannāha- ārambhetyādi| ārambhasāmarthyāt upakramasāmarthyādityarthaḥ| saṅkṣudya cūrṇayitvetyarthaḥ| saptamaṃ hetuṃ darśayannāha- śāstretyādi| aṣṭamaṃ hetuṃ darśayannāha- krametyādi| taruṇe taruṇā iti abhinave abhinavā ityarthaḥ| navamaṃ hetumāha- ekadeśetyādi| dravyaprādhānyamabhidhāya dravyalakṣaṇamāha- dravyalakṣaṇamityādi| kriyāguṇavaditi kriyāguṇavaddravyamityarthaḥ; kriyā karma, guṇā uktā viṃśatiḥ| samavāyikāraṇamapi dravyameva; yathā- paṭe tantavaḥ, ghaṭe mṛtpiṇḍa ityādi; na ca kriyāyāṃ kriyā samavetā, na guṇeṣu guṇāśca samavetā iti||3||

nety āhur anye ‘dravyādapi rasaprādhānyaṃ darśayituṃ dravyaprādhānyaṃ niṣedhayati- netyāhuranye iti| ete dravyaprādhānyakhyāpakā hetavo vaktavyarasaprādhānyahetvapekṣayā aprayojakā ityabhimāno rasavādino jñeyaḥ| evaṃ vīryavādinastathā vipākavādinaśca ‘netyāhuranye’ iti vacanamanayā diśā vyākhyeyam| rasaprādhānye āgamāditi hetuḥ āgama eva kaṇṭharaveṇa rasasya prādhānyaṃ kathayatītyāhuḥ| upadeśāditi tu rasena dravyādisamudāyakāryopadeśādityarthabhedo neyaḥ| ṛṣivacanamiha vedaḥ| ṛṣaya āptāḥ| tadvacanatā ca vedasya ṛṣibhiḥ prathamamudāharaṇāt, na tu ṛṣikāryatayā| kiṃvā nyāyamate maheśvararūparṣivacanatā vedasya jñeyā| dravyādiprādhānyavicāre kasmādguṇa nodbhāvitā ityāha- raseṣu tu guṇasañjñeti| raseṣvityupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena vīryavipākayorapi guṇasañjñeti boddhavyaṃ, tena rasādiprādhānyavyutpādanena guṇaviśeṣaprādhānyaṃ labhyata ityarthaḥ|’ iti cakraḥ, rasās tu pradhānaṃ; kasmāt? āgamāt, āgamo hi śāstram ucyate; śāstre hi rasā adhikṛtāḥ, yathā- rasāyatta āhāra iti, tasmiṃs tu prāṇāḥ; upadeśāc ca, upadiśyante hi rasāḥ, yathā- madhurāmlalavaṇā vātaṃ śamayanti; anumānāc ca, rasena hy anumīyate dravyaṃ, yathā- madhuram iti; ṛṣivacanāc ca, ṛṣivacanaṃ vedo yathā- kiñcid ijyārthaṃ madhuram āhared iti, tasmād rasāḥ pradhānaṃ; raseṣu guṇasañjñā | rasalakṣaṇam anyatropadekṣyāmaḥ ||4||

rasaprādhānye ekīyaṃ darśanaṃ nirdiśannāha- netyādi| netyāhuranye dravyaprādhānyamanye na bruvata ityarthaḥ| tasmiṃstu prāṇā iti āhāre sati prāṇā ityarthaḥ| rasaprādhānye dvitīyaṃ hetumāha- upadeśādityādi| atraiva tṛtīyaṃ hetumāha- anumānādityādi| caturthaṃ hetumāha- ṛṣivacanādityādi| ijyārthaṃ yāgārthaṃ; madhuramāharediti madhurarasamāharet ānayet, na tu dravyamānayediti| guṇasyāpi kimiti na prādhānyaṃ sādhitamityāśaṅkyāha- raseṣvityādi| atrādiśabdo lupto draṣṭavyaḥ; etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati- rasādiprādhānyenaiva sādhitena guṇapradhānyaṃ sādhitaṃ bhavati| yathā dravyalakṣaṇamuktaṃ tathā rasasyāpi kimiti noktamityāha- rasalakṣaṇamityādi| anyatra rasavijñānīye||4||

nety āhur anye ‘vīryaprādhānyavādimatamāha- netyāhuranye ityādi| prādhānyāditi pradhānadharmayogāt, pradhānadharmaśca vīryavaśenauṣadhānāṃ kāryaniṣpādakatvam| atra vīryaśabdena dravyasya dvividhā'pi cintyā acintyā ca śaktirucyate| tatrācintyā śaktiryā tantrāntare prabhāva ityucyate sā grāhyā, tasyaiva ca vīryasya prabhāvākhyasya svatantre ‘taddravyamātmanā kiñcit’ ityanena grahaṇaṃ jñeyam| rasasya vipākasya ca śāstre pṛthaṅnirdeśānna vīryavyavahāraḥ, pariṇāmasaṅkhyādayo guṇā na śāstre tathā kāryakarā iti pṛthaktvena dravyarasādigaṇanāyāṃ gaṇyante| cintyāyāṃ vaidyasampradāyena śītoṣṇalakṣaṇaṃ dvividhamaṣṭavidhaṃ vā uṣṇaśītasnigdharūkṣaviśadapicchilamṛdutīkṣṇarūpamucyate| yadā dvividhaṃ vīryaṃ tadā snigdharūkṣādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāmapi pariṇāmasaṅkhyādivadaprādhānyaṃ vivakṣitaṃ jñeyam| snigdhādīnāmaprādhānyavivakṣāyāṃ rasādidharmatayaiva kāryagrahaṇaṃ| vakṣyati hi- ‘madhuro rasaḥ snigdhaḥ’ ityādi| aṣṭavidhavīryapakṣe tūṣṇādīnāṃ sarveṣāmeva balavatkāryakartṛvivakṣayā vīryatvamiti sthitiḥ| samprati śāstre vyavahārasiddhameva vīryaṃ vivecayannāha- tattu vīryamityādi| kathametānyuṣṇādīni vīryākhyānītyāha- etāni khalvityādi| svabalaguṇotkarṣāditi balaṃ śaktiḥ, sa eva guṇaḥ praśastatvāt| svaśaktirūpaguṇotkarṣāduṣṇādīni rasamabhibhūya svakāryaṃ kurvanti|’ iti cakraḥ| ‘vīryaṃ śaktiḥ, sā ca pṛthivyādīnāṃ bhūtānāṃ yaḥ sārabhāgastadatiśayarūpā bodhyā| sā ca dvividhā, cintyācintyakriyāhetutvena| tatra cintyakriyāheturyā dravyarasādīnāṃ svasvakarmaṇi svabhāvasiddhā śaktiḥ, acintyakriyāhetuśca prabhāvāparaparyāyā dravyāṇāṃ rasādyananurūpakāryakāraṇaśaktiḥ| uktaṃ ca- “bhūtaprasādātiśayo dravye pāke rase sthitaḥ| cintyācintyakriyāheturvīryaṃ dhanvantarermatam”- iti| etena dravyarasapākānāṃ svasvakāryakaraṇasāmarthyaṃ vīryamityarthaḥ| yatpunaścarake- “vīryaṃ tu kriyate yena yā kriyā”- (ca. sū. a. 26) ityanena rasādīnāmapi vīryatvamuktaṃ, taddharmadharmiṇorabhedādeva samarthanīyam| na caivaṃ dravyasyāpi vīryatvaprasaṅgaḥ| yeneti karaṇe tṛtīyā, karaṇasyaiva śaktitvāt, dravyasya ca kartṛtvāt| etena dravyakartṛke rasādikaraṇake kārye rasādīnāmapi vīryatvamityarthaḥ| suśrute'pyuktaṃ- “yena kurvanti tadvīryam”- (su. sū. a. 41) iti| atra kecit- nanu, yadi śaktireva vīrya na tarhi śītoṣṇādilakṣaṇam, atha śītoṣṇādilakṣaṇaṃ na tadā śaktilakṣaṇamiti| satyaṃ, paramārthataḥ śaktireva vīryaṃ, sā punarbalavatkriyānirvartanakṣamā rasādinā'yogānnirupādhiriti tasyāḥ śītoṣṇādayo guṇā upādhitvenāṅgīkṛtāḥ, te tu dravyasamavāyino rasādiṣu punarupacaritavṛttaya iti| uktaṃ ca- “guṇāḥ karmavyavasthāyai dravyāṇāṃ rasapākayoḥ| śakteḥ karmasu śaktā ye nirupādherupādhayaḥ”- ityāhuḥ| yatpunaḥ “mṛdutīkṣṇagurulaghusnigdharūkṣoṣṇaśītalam| vīryamaṣṭavidhaṃ kecit keciddvividhamāsthitāḥ|| śītoṣṇamiti” (ca. sū. a. 26)- iti matabhedenāṣṭavidhaṃ dvividhaṃ vā vīryamityuktaṃ carakeṇa, tatpāribhāṣikavīryapuraskāreṇa| vaidyake hi rasavipākaprabhāvātirikte prabhūtakāryakāriṇi guṇe vīryamiti sañjñā| tenāṣṭavidhavīryavādimate picchilaviśadādayo guṇā na rasādiviparītaṃ kāryaṃ prāyaḥ kurvantīti teṣāṃ rasādyupadeśenaiva grahaṇaṃ| mṛdvādīnāmaṣṭānāṃ tu rasādyabhibhāvakatvamasti| suśrute'pyuktam- “etāni khalu vīryāṇi svabalaguṇotkarṣādrasamabhibhūyātmakarma kurvanti”- (su. sū. a. 40) iti| śītoṣṇavīryavādimataṃ tvagnīṣomīyatvājjagataḥ śītoṣṇayoreva prādhānyājjñeyam| uktaṃ ca- “nānātmakamapi dravyagnīṣomau mahābalau| vyaktāvyaktaṃ jagadiva nātikramati jātucit”- (vā. sū. a. 9) iti| prathamavādimate śaktimātraṃ vīryaṃ, tadyogādrasādīnāmapi vīryasañjñā| pāribhāṣikavīryavādimate tu śaktiviśeṣo vīryaṃ, tadyogānmṛdutīkṣṇādīnāmeva vīryasañjñā nāpareṣāṃ guṇānāmiti| śāstre vyavahārastu pāribhāṣikavīryanayenaiveti| bhavanti cātra- “śaktimātraṃ tu vīryaṃ syāditi kecidbudhā viduḥ| tanmate dravyarasayoḥ pākasya ca guṇasya ca|| mṛdvādeḥ svakriyotpāde śaktivīryamiti sthitiḥ| taduktaṃ carake- ‘vīryaṃ kriyate yena yā kriyā|| nāvīryaṃ kurute kiñcit sarvā vīryakṛtā kriyā’| ityanena rasādīnāṃ vīryatvaṃ tadabhedataḥ|| mṛdvādayo guṇā hyaṣṭau vīryāṇītyūcire pare| yasmāt sarvaguṇotkṛṣṭāḥ śaktyutkarṣayutā amī|| vyavahāropayuktāśca nedṛśāstvapare guṇāḥ| tasmānna te vīryasañjñā iti śāstravidāṃ matam|| anye śītoṣṇabhedena vīryaṃ dvividhamūcire| agnīṣomamayaṃ viśvaṃ yata etaccarācaram”- iti| prabhāvo'cintyakriyāhetuvīryameveti śaktiviśeṣa eva prabhāva ityabhidhīyate| prabhāvasattve ca carake mānamapyuktam| yathā- “rasavīryavipākanāṃ sāmānyaṃ yatra lakṣyate| viśeṣaḥ karmaṇāṃ caiva prabhāvastasya sa smṛtaḥ” (ca. sū. a. 26) iti| sāmānyamiti tulyatā, karmaṇāṃ punarviśeṣo na tulyatetyarthaḥ| etena dravyayordvayo rasādisāmye satyapyekasmin dravye jāyate kāryaviśeṣaḥ, itaratra tu na jāyate, ityatra yatkāraṇatayā vācyaṃ tadeva prabhāva ityarthaḥ| tathā rasādisāmyabhāve'pi rasādijanyatvena yatkāryaṃ nāvadhārayituṃ pāryate tadapi prabhāvakṛtameva mantavyaṃ| yathā- maṇyādīnāṃ viṣaharaṇādikaṃ karma” iti dravyaguṇasaṅgrahavyākhyāyāṃ śivadāsasenaḥ| “vīryaṃ punarvadantyeke guru snigdhaṃ himaṃ mṛdu| laghurūkṣoṣṇatīkṣṇaṃ ca tadevaṃ matamaṣṭadhā|| carakastvāha vīryaṃ tat kriyate yena yā kriyā| nāvīryaṃ kurute kiñcit sarvā vīryakṛtā hi sā|| gurvādiṣveva vīryākhyā tenānvartheti varṇyate| samagraguṇasāreṣu śaktyutkarṣavivartiṣu|| vyavahārāya mukhyatvādbahvagragrahaṇādapi| ataśca viparītatvāt sambhavatyapi naiva sā|| vivakṣyate rasādyeṣu vīryaṃ gurvādayo hyataḥ|” iti vāgbhaṭaḥ (vā. sū. a. 9), vīryaṃ pradhānam iti | kasmāt? tad vaśe
nauṣadhakarmaniṣpatteḥ | ihauṣadhakarmāṇy ūrdhvādhobhāgobhayabhāgasaṃśodhanasaṃśamanasaṅgrāhikāgnidīpanapīḍanalekhanabṛṃhaṇa- rasāyanavājīkaraṇaśvayathukaravilayanadahanadāraṇamādanaprāṇaghnaviṣapraśamanādīni vīryaprādhānyād bhavanti | tac ca vīryaṃ dvividham uṣṇaṃ śītaṃ ca, agnīṣomīyatvāj jagataḥ | kecid aṣṭavidham āhuḥ- śītam uṣṇaṃ snigdhaṃ rūkṣaṃ viśadaṃ ‘guru laghu’ iti hārāṇacandrasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ| “neha gurulaghuśabdāvartanena viśadapicchilayoḥ pāṭho nyāyyaḥ, śāstre'smin kvacidapi tayorvīryatvenānupadeśādupadeśācca gurulaghunoḥ| vakṣyati ca ‘ye rasā’ ityupakramya ‘raukṣyalāghavaśaityāni na te hanyuḥ samīraṇam’ ityādi’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ picchilaṃ mṛdu tīkṣṇaṃ
ceti | etāni vīryāṇi svabalaguṇotkarṣād rasam abhibhūyātmakarma kurvanti | yathā tāvan mahatpañcamūlaṃ kaṣāyaṃ tiktānurasaṃ vātaṃ śamayati, uṣṇavīryatvāt; tathā kulatthaḥ kaṣāyaḥ, kaṭukaḥ palāṇḍuḥ, snehabhāvāc ca; madhuraś cekṣuraso vātaṃ vardhayati, śītavīryatvāt; kaṭukā pippalī pittaṃ śamayati, mṛduśītavīryatvāt; amlam āmalakaṃ lavaṇaṃ saindhavaṃ ca; tiktā kākamācī pittaṃ vardhayati, uṣṇavīryatvāt, madhurā matsyāś ca; kaṭukaṃ mūlakaṃ śleṣmāṇaṃ vardhayati, snigdhavīryatvāt; amlaṃ kapitthaṃ śleṣmāṇāṃ śamayati, rūkṣavīryatvāt, madhuraṃ kṣaudraṃ ca; tad etan nidarśanamātram uktam ||5||

apareṣāṃ vīryavādināṃ mataṃ nirdiśannāha- netyāhuranye ityādi|- īdṛśamanye na bruvanti| tadvaśeneti vīryavaśena| kāni punastānyauṣadhakarmāṇītyāha- ihauṣadhetyādi|- saṃśodhanaṃ vraṇādīnāṃ; saṃśamanamiti vamanavirecanādikaṃ vinā tatsthameva śamayati saṃśamanaṃ, saṃśamanabhedā eva sāṅgrahikādayaḥ; pīḍanamiti śālmalītvagādīnāṃ vraṇe karmaviśeṣaḥ; lekhanaṃ pattalīkaraṇaṃ; bṛṃhaṇaṃ śarīravṛddhikaraṃ; rasāyanaṃ vayaḥsthāpanādikaraṇaṃ; vājīkaraṇaṃ vājivadyenāpratihataḥ striyaṃ yāti, anye tu vājiśabdena śukramucyate, tato'vājino vājinaḥ kriyante yeneti vājīkaraṇaṃ, śukrotpādakamityāhuḥ; śvayathukaravilayaneti karavilayanaśabdau śvayathuśabdena saha pratyekaṃ sambadhyete, ‘śvayathuharavilayana’ ityeke paṭhanti; dahanaṃ kṣārādinā; dāraṇaṃ gṛdhrapurīṣādinā; mādanaṃ mattatākaraṇam, etacca madirādīnāṃ karma; prāṇaghnatvaṃ viṣādeḥ; viṣapraśamanatvamagadādīnāṃ; viṣapraśamanādīnītyatrādiśabdena vraṇaropaṇaromasañjananādayo gṛhyante| svabalaguṇotkarṣāditi svabalotkarṣāt svaguṇotkarṣāccetyarthaḥ| ātmakarma kurvanti vātādidoṣaśamanaṃ kopanaṃ vā kurvanti| abhibhūya nirākaraṇaṃ kṛtvetyarthaḥ| snehabhāvāccetyatrāpi vātaṃ śamayatīti yojyam| madhuraścekṣurasa ityādi na kevalaṃ vātaṃ śamayatīti vīryaṃ rasamabhibhūya prakopayatyapi vātamityarthaḥ| kaṭukā pippalītyādi atrārdrā pippalī yadi gṛhyate tadā tasyāḥ svāduśītatvāt kaṭuketi viśeṣaṇaṃ yuktaṃ na syāt, atha śuṣkā tadā tasyāḥ kaṭūṣṇatvāt pittaṃ hantīti viśeṣaṇamayuktaṃ bhavet; satyaṃ, ‘teṣu gurvī svāduśītā pippalyārdrā kaphāvahā’ ityatra pāṭhe śītā ceti cakāro draṣṭavyaḥ, tena na kevalaṃ śītā kaṭukā cetyarthaḥ, tato nārdrapakṣe doṣaḥ; śuṣkapakṣe tu ‘śuṣkā kaphānilaghnī sā vṛṣyā pittāvirodhinī’ ityatra pittena saheṣadvirodhinīti vyākhyānānna doṣaḥ; keṣāñcinmate ‘pittaprakopaṇī’ iti pāṭhaḥ, teṣāṃ mate pittaśamanīyatvaṃ pippalyā vīryavādināṃ mataṃ, na punaḥ satyameṣā pittaṃ śamayati; yadi vā ārdrā pittapraśamanī śuṣkā prakopaṇīti| amlamāmalakaṃ lavaṇaṃ saindhavaṃ caityatrāpi mṛduśītavīryatvāt pittaṃ śamayatīti yojyam| tiktā kākamācītyādi pittaṃ vardhayati kevalaṃ na ‘na tu samuditaṃ’ iti pā. tu prakopayati, tasyāstridoṣaghnītvāt| anye cātraivaṃ vadanti- vīryavādī evamuṣṇavīryāṃ kākamācīṃ manyate, ācāryastu nātyuṣṇaśītām, ata eva tridoṣaghnītvaṃ kākamācyā iti| madhurā matsyāścetyatrāpi pittaṃ vardhayantīti yojyam| mūlakaṃ bṛhanmūlakaṃ ; na punarbālakaṃ, tridoṣaghnatvāt||5||

bhavanti cātra-
ye rasā vātaśamanā bhavanti yadi teṣu vai |
raukṣyalāghavaśaityāni na te hanyuḥ samīraṇam ||6||

lg.l: ye rasāḥ pittaśamanā bhavanti yadi teṣu vai |
taikṣṇyauṣṇyalaghutāś caiva na te tat karmakāriṇaḥ ||7||
ye rasāḥ śleṣmaśamanā bhavanti yadi teṣu vai |

ab.seg: tasmād vīryaṃ pradhānam iti ||9||

dravyāśritaṃ vīryakarmābhidhāya rasāśritaṃ vīryakarmāha- bhavanti cātretyādi| ye rasā vātaśamanā madhurāmlalavaṇāḥ, ye rasāḥ pittaśamanā madhuratiktakaṣāyāḥ, ye rasāḥ śleṣmaśamanāḥ kaṭutiktakaṣāyāḥ||6-9||

nety āhur anye ‘idānīṃ vipākaguṇā vācyāḥ, ato vipākasvarūpaṃ nirūpyate- avasthāpākāpekṣayā viśiṣṭaḥ pāko vipākaḥ| vipākaśabdeneha lakṣaṇayā vipākādheya āhārasya rasaviśeṣo gauraveṇa lāghavena vā yukto'bhidhīyate| uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭena- “jāṭhareṇāgninā yogādyadudeti rasāntaram| rasānāṃ pariṇāmānte sa vipāka iti smṛtaḥ”- (vā. sū. a. 9) iti| atra rasānāṃ pariṇāmā madhurāmlakaṭurūpāstrayo'vasthāpākāḥ ṣaḍrasasyaivānnasyāmāśayādisthānasambandhamahimnā jāyante, te ca carake grahaṇīcikitsite “annasya bhuktamātrasya ṣaḍrasasya prapākataḥ” (ca. ci. a. 15) ityādinoktā anusandheyāḥ, teṣāmante'vasāne punarjāṭharāgnisaṃyoge sati yadrasāntaraṃ rasaviśeṣa udeti sa vipāka ityarthaḥ| carakeṇa tu traya eva vipākā aṅgīkṛtāḥ kaṭvamlamadhurabhedena| atastadvacanamupanyasyate- “kaṭutiktakaṣāyāṇāṃ vipākaḥ prāyaśaḥ kaṭuḥ| amlo'mlaṃ pacyate svādurmadhuraṃ lavaṇastathā”- iti (ca. sū. a. 26)| prāyaśa iti vacanāt pippalīkulatthādīnāṃ rasānanuguṇapākatāṃ darśayati| pākastu tejaḥsaṃyogarūpo raseṣu na sambhavatīti kaṭvādiśabdaistadādhāradravyāṇyucyante| etena yat kaiściducyate- “avasthāpākāvasāne ṣaḍrasasyaivānnasya kaṭurasatvena tadānīṃ tiktādirasānāmabhāvātteṣāṃ vipāko nopapadyate” iti| tadapyapāstaṃ, tiktādirasānāmabhāve'pi tadāśrayadravyasya vidyamānatvāditi| vastutastu, avasthāpākatrayeṇa tattadāmāśayādisthānamahimnā madhurāmlakaṭurasā udbhūtāḥ paraṃ kriyante, na tu sarvathā prākṛtarasābhibhavaḥ| anyathā'vasthāpākena prākṛtānāṃ madhurādirasānāṃ sarvathā'prākṛtatve teṣāṃ kaphādijanakatvābhidhānaṃ niravakāśaṃ syāditi| nanu, carake- “annasya bhuktamātrasya ṣaḍrasasya prapākataḥ” (ca. ci. a. 15)- ityādinā ṣaṇṇāmeva rasānāmaviśeṣeṇāvasthāpākavaśāt kaphādijanakatvamuktaṃ, tataścātra rasaviśeṣāṇāmeva doṣaviśeṣajanakatvamuktaṃ, tathā “kaṭutiktakaṣāyāṇāṃ vipākaḥ prāyaśaḥ kaṭuḥ”- (ca. sū. a. 26) ityādinā ca yo vipāka uktastat sarvaṃ virudhyate, avasthāpākenaiva bādhitatvāditi| naivaṃ, nahyavasthāpāko'yaṃ rasasvabhāvaṃ niṣṭhāpākaṃ bādhate, kiñcāvasthāyāṃ svakāryaṃ karoti| tena rasādayo'pi svakāryaṃ kurvanti, avasthāpāko'pi svīyaṃ kāryaṃ karoti, yathā- madhuratiktādyanekarase upayukte madhuro'pi svakāryaṃ karoti, tiktādayaśca svakāryaṃ kurvanti| ayaṃ tu viśeṣo- yadi madhurākhyasyāvasthāpākasya madhurādayaḥ śleṣmajanakā rasā anuguṇā bhavanti, tadā sa bahuśleṣmāṇaṃ janayati, yadā tu viparītakaṭukādiparigṛhīto bhavati, tadā stokamātraṃ kaphaṃ janayati| evaṃ pittajanakāvasthāpāke'pi vācyam| “kaṭutiktakaṣāyāṇāṃ” (ca. sū. a. 26) ityādinoktaśca niṣṭhāpāko rasamalavivekasamakālo, bhinnakāla evāvasthāpākaiḥ samamiti na virodhaḥ| sa ca bhinnakālo'pyavasthāpākajanyadoṣānuguṇatayā ananuguṇatayā vā'vasthāpākāhitadoṣāṇāṃ vardhanaṃ kṣapaṇaṃ vā karotīti niṣṭhāpākābhidhānaṃ śāstre prayojanavadeva| anye tvāhuḥ- yat- nānnasyāgnisaṃyogānmadhurādyavasthitaṃ bhavati, kintu kaphādisthāneṣu manuṣyāṇāṃ svabhāvādeva madhurādayo rasāstiṣṭhanti, te cānnaṃ svasvabhāvaṃ nītvā kaphādīn janayanti| uktaṃ hi tantrāntare- “madhuro hṛdayādūrdhvaṃ rasaḥ koṣṭhe vyavasthitaḥ| tataḥ saṃvardhate śleṣmā śarīrabalavardhanaḥ|| nābhihṛdayamadhye hi rasastvamlo vyavasthitaḥ| svabhāvena manuṣyāṇāṃ tatra pittaṃ vivardhate|| adho nābhyāstu khalvekaḥ kaṭuko'vasthito rasaḥ| prāyaḥ śreṣṭhatamastatra prāṇināṃ vardhate'nilaḥ|| tasmādvipākastrividho rasānāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ” iti| etacca tantrāntaraṃ śleṣmapittagatamadhurāmlarasavāyuprābhāvikakaṭurasābhiprāyeṇa varṇanīyam| te ca kaphādigatā rasā asmākamapyagnyāśayapākasahakāritayā'numatā eva, tasmādyathokta evārtho nyāyya iti| ayaṃ ca vipākādheyo (raso) na rasanendriyagrāhyaḥ, kintu tattatkāryeṇaivonnīyate| yathā- kaṭurasāyā uṣṇavīryāyā api śuṇṭhyā vṛṣyatvena madhuraḥ pāko'numīyate, tathā lavaṇasya sṛṣṭaviṇmūtratvena madhuraḥ pāka unnīyate, tathā tiktakaṣāyayorbaddhaviṇmūtratayā kaṭupāka unnīyata iti| nanu, lavaṇasya madhurapākitve pittaraktādikartṛtvamanupapannaṃ, tathā tiktakaṣāyayoḥ kaṭupākitve ca pittahantṛtvamanupapannam| naivaṃ, satyapi lavaṇasya madhurapākitve tatra lavaṇe uṣṇavīryaṃ yadasti tena tasya pittaraktādikārakatvaṃ, vipākastu tatra pittaraktakaraṇalakṣaṇe kārye bādhito'pi sṛṣṭaviṇmūtrādilakṣaṇe lakṣyata eva, tathā tiktakaṣāyayorapi kaṭuvipāko balavatā śītavīryeṇa bādhitatvānna pittajanakaḥ, baddhaviṇmūtratayā tu lakṣyata eva| etena yaducyate- lavaṇādiṣu vipāko yadi rasavīryābhyāṃ bādhitaḥ svakāryakaro na syāt, tat kiṃ tenopadiṣṭeneti, tannirastaṃ bhavati| yato'styeva sṛṣṭaviṇmūtratādi tatkāryamiti| na ca traya eva vipākāḥ kathaṃ bhavanti, tiktādayo'pi kuto na syuriti vācyaṃ| bhūtasvabhāvasyāparyanuyojyatvāt| nanu, yatra rasaviparītaḥ pāko yathā- lavaṇasya madhuraḥ, tiktakaṣāyayośca kaṭuḥ, sa ucyatāṃ| yastu samānaguṇo madhurasya madhuraḥ, amlasyāmlaḥ, kaṭukasya kaṭukaḥ, tatkathanena kiṃ prayojanaṃ| yato rasaguṇaireva tatra vipākaguṇo'pi jñāsyate| naivaṃ, lavaṇādivadvisadṛśarasāntarotpādaśaṅkānirāsārthamapi tatrānuguṇo'pi vipāko vaktavya eva| tathā yatra samānaguṇo vipākastatra balavatkāryaṃ bhavati, viparyaye tu durbalamiti jñeyam| suśrutena dvividha eva vipāko'ṅgīkṛto madhuraḥ kaṭukaśceti, dvaividhye ca bhūtānāṃ gurulāghavena dvaividhyameva hetuḥ| yaduktaṃ tenaiva- “tatra, pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśānāṃ dvaividhyaṃ bhavati guṇasādharmyād gurutā laghutā ca| tatra pṛthivyāpaśca gurvyaḥ, śeṣāṇi laghūni| tasmāddvividha eva vipāko bhavati”- iti (su. sū. a. 40)| atrāpi suśrutamate yadyapyamlalavaṇau madhuravipākau tathā'pi tayorvātaharatve sṛṣṭaviṇmūtratāyāṃ ca madhurakāryakaratvaṃ na punaḥ pittaharatve, tathā tiktakaṣāyayoḥ kaṭuvipākayorapi vātakartṛtve baddhaviṇmūtratāyāṃ ca kaṭukāryakaratvaṃ na punaḥ pittakartṛtve, acintyatvāt prabhāvasya| nanu, “pañcabhūtātmake dehe āhāraḥ pāñcabhautikaḥ| vipakvaḥ pañcadhā samyak svān guṇānabhivardhayet” (su. sū. a. 46)- ityanena pañcadhā'pi vipākastenaivoktaḥ, tatkathaṃ na virodha iti cet| naivam, upādhibhedena virodhābhāvāt| tatra hi bhūtabhedamavalambya pañcadhātvaṃ, atra tu lāghavagauravarūpaṃ bhūtaguṇadvaividhyamāśritya dvaividhyamuktamiti na virodhaḥ| yathā- pañcabhūtātmakatve'pi dravyāṇāṃ saumyāgneyatvāddvaividhyamiti| yatpunaḥ suśrutenāmlapāko na manyate taccarakamatānuyāyino na sahante, yato'mlapākatayaiva vrīhikulatthādīnāṃ pittakartṛtvamupapadyate, atha manyase- vrīhyāderuṣṇavīryatvena tatra pittakartṛtvaṃ? tadasat, madhurasya vrīhestanmate madhuravipākasyoṣṇavīryatāyāmapi satyāṃ na pittakartṛtvamupapadyate, rasavipākābhyāmekasya vīryasya bādhanīyatvāt| kiñcāmlapākatvād vrīhyādeḥ pittamamlaguṇamutpadyate, yadi tūṣṇavīryatākṛtaṃ syāttadā kaṭuguṇabhūyiṣṭhaṃ pittaṃ syāt, dṛśyate ca- vrīhibhakṣaṇādamlodgārādinā'mlaguṇabhūyiṣṭhataiveti| kiñca pṛthivīsomaguṇātirekānmadhuraḥ pāko bhavati, vāyvagnyākāśātirekācca kaṭurbhavati- iti pakṣe yadā vyāmiśraguṇātireko bhavati, tadā somāgnyātmakasyāmlasyotpādaḥ kathaṃ pratikṣepaṇīyaḥ| athavā tantrakārayoḥ kimanayoranena vacanamātravirodhena kartavyaṃ| yato yadamlapākaṃ carako brūte tat suśrutena vīryoṣṇamiti kṛtvā samādhīyate, anena na kaściddravyaguṇe virodhaḥ|’ iti dravyaguṇasaṅgrahavyākhyāyāṃ śivadāsasenaḥ| ‘vipāka iti pākaḥ pacanaṃ dravyāṇāṃ svarūparasayoḥ parā vṛttiḥ| sā ca svarūpāntaratvena rasāntaratvena ca pariṇatiḥ, tasyā viśeṣo vipākaḥ|....kasya rasasya kiṃ rasāntaratvenodayaḥ pariṇāmaḥ syādityata āha- ‘kaṭutiktakaṣāyāṇāṃ vipākaḥ prāyaśaḥ kaṭuḥ’ ityādi| bhuktānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ yaḥ kaṭustiktaḥ kaṣāyo vā rasaḥ sa sa rasaḥ khalu jāṭhareṇāgninā pacyamānānāṃ bhuktānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ rasākhyadhāturūpeṇa pariṇāme tatpākena pacyamānaḥ san prāyaśaḥ kaṭurvipākaḥ syāt| kaṭuśca kaṭuviśeṣeṇābhiniṣpannaḥ saṃstatra rasākhye dhātau vartate (evaṃ śeṣeṣvapi vyākhyeyam)...itthaṃ ca rasapākābhiprāyeṇa tridhā vipāka uktaḥ (carakeṇa)| suśrute bhūtaguṇapākābhiprāyeṇa dvidhā vipāka ukto gururlaghuśceti krameṇa madhurasañjñaḥ kaṭusañjñaśca’ iti carakaṭīkāyāṃ jalpakalpatarau gaṅgādharakavirājaḥ| “vipākaprādhānyavādimataṃ vīryavādimataṃ niṣedhayitvā prāha- netyāhuranye ityādi| vipākaḥ pradhānamiti pratijñā| vipākaśabdeneha lakṣaṇayā abhyavahṛtadravyāntapākādheya āhārasya rasaviśeṣo gauraveṇa lāghavena vā yukto'bhidhīyate, viśiṣṭo naiṣṭhikaḥ pāko vipāka ityarthaḥ| atra hetuḥ- samyaṅmithyāvipākatvāditi| asyārthaṃ vyākaroti- sarvadravyāṇītyādi| samyagvipakvāni guṇaṃ mithyāvipakvāni doṣaṃ janayanti| samyakpākaḥ samenāgninā, mithyāpākastu hīnātipākarūpo yathākramaṃ mandena tīkṣṇena cāgninā kriyate| tatra hīnāpāke āmavikārāḥ, tīkṣṇapāke ca bhasmakavikārā doṣāḥ| samapāke tu dhātusāmyaṃ guṇaśca| ayaṃ ca pāko yadyapi jaṭharāgnyadhīnaḥ sarvāhārasādhāraṇo natu dravyādhīno dravyaguṇarūpo ya ihādhikṛtaḥ ‘pippalyā madhuravipākaḥ, arghyaṃ madhu kaṭukam’ ityādinā pratipādanīyaḥ| ayameva pāka etatprakaraṇasiddhānte ca ‘taddravyamātmanā kiñcit’ ityādau darśitaḥ| tathā hyubhayorapi pākayoragnyādheyānyapākarūpatayā ekataḥ prādhānye sādhite'paratrāpi siddhaṃ bhavatīti granthārtho neyaḥ| kiṃvā samyakpāko dravyaguṇānuguṇaḥ pāko, yathā ‘citrakaḥ kaṭukaḥ pāke’, tathā ‘kṣīraṃ madhuraṃ rasapākayoḥ’ ityādi| atra hi dravyaguṇasadṛśa eka pākaḥ| mithyāpākaḥ dravyaguṇavisadṛśaḥ pākaḥ, yathā ‘pippalyaḥ kaṭukāḥ satyo madhuravipākāḥ’ ityādau| guṇaṃ doṣaṃ vā janayantīti samyakpāke tathā mithyāpāke ca pratyekaṃ yojanīyam| tena dravyaguṇānuguṇo hi madhuraḥ pākaḥ sṛṣṭaviṇmūtrādiguṇaṃ kaphajananaṃ doṣaṃ ca karoti, tathā dravyaguṇavisadṛśaśca pippalyāḥ kaṭukāyā madhuraḥ pāko yathoktaṃ guṇaṃ doṣaṃ vā karoti| asmin vyākhyāne abhimatavyākhyādhīnapākaprādhānye heturukto bhavatīti nāsaṅgatārthatvamasya, yasmādrasaṃ vīryaṃ ca tiraskṛtyāntyo vipāko guṇaṃ doṣaṃ vā janayati, tena vipākaḥ pradhānamiti| samprati svābhimatavipākasvarūpaṃ darśayituṃ parābhimatavipākānyupanyasati- tatrāhuranye ityādi| pratirasaṃ pākameva vivṛṇoti- madhuro madhurasyāmlo'mlasyetyādi| atra dṛṣṭāntamāha- yathetyādi| prakīrṇā ityuptāḥ| tena śāliyavādaya uptaprarūḍhāḥ phalitāśca śāliyavādisvarūpā eva bhavanti, atraiva pakṣe matāntaramāha- kecitpunarityādi| abalavanto rasā alpatayā balavatāmityulbaṇānāṃ rasānāṃ vaśatāṃ parādhīnatāmalpatāmiti yāvat| tena niṣṭhāpākena balavatā durbalarasābhibhavānna pratiniyamena madhurasya madhura eva pāko'mlasya vā'mlaḥ pāka ityādi pratiniyamābhāvādanavasthitaḥ pāka ityarthaḥ| matāntaraṃ carakasyāha- kecittrividhamityādi| etacca madhurādipākatrayaṃ naiṣṭhikaṃ| carakamataṃ kvacidrasadvārā'bhihitaṃ| yathā- “kaṭutiktakaṣāyāṇāṃ vipākaḥ prāyaśaḥ kaṭuḥ| amlo'mlaṃ pacyate svādurmadhuraṃ lavaṇastathā||” kvaciddravyadvārā'bhihitaṃ ‘pippalyaḥ kaṭukā madhuravipākāḥ’ ityādi| yadavasthāpāke “annasya bhuktamātrasya ṣaḍrasasya prapākataḥ| madhuraḥ prāk kaphodbhāvāt phenabhūta udīryate||” ityādinā carakoktaṃ, tannaiṣṭhikapākābhāvādevehānadhikṛtam| uktāni paramatāni dūṣayati- tattu na samyagiti| atra hetuḥ- bhūtaguṇāditi| pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśānāṃ dvaividhyaṃ bhavatītyādinā vaktavyagurulaghulakṣaṇadvaividhyena dvividhasyaiva pākasyopapannatvādityarthaḥ| āgamāditi ‘āgamastvāha’ ityādinā darśanīyaḥ| pittasya tu vidāhāvasthāyāmamlapākatā bhavati tayā samaṃ pākatraividhyaṃ ye'bhimanyante tanmataṃ caturthalavaṇapākaprasaṅgena dūṣayannāha- pittaṃ hi vidagdhamityādi| āgamāditi yaduktaṃ tadvyākaroti- āgamastvityādi| āgama iha dhanvantarivacanaṃ ‘dvividha eva pāko madhuraḥ kaṭukaśca’ iti| madhurakaṭupākayoryathākramaṃ gurutāṃ laghutāṃ ca cikitsopayuktāṃ darśayati- tayormadhurākhya ityādi| madhure gauravasya kaṭau ca pāke lāghavasyopapattiṃ darśayan bhūtaguṇāditi hetuṃ ca vyākaroti- tatra pṛthivītyādi| pañcānāṃ bhūtānāṃ kathaṃ dvaividhyamityāha- tadguṇasādharmyāditi| amlapākatayā pittakaratvaṃ yathā- ‘madhuraścāmlapākaśca vrīhiḥ pittakaro guruḥ’, ‘uṣṇāḥ kaṣāyāḥ pāke'mlāḥ kaphaśukrānilāpahāḥ| kulatthāḥ’ ityādau, tathā vipākaguṇe “pittakṛtsṛṣṭaviṇmūtraḥ pāko'mlaḥ śukranāśanaḥ” iti carakoktaṃ, tat sarvaṃ suśrute uṣṇavīryakāryaṃ kvaciddravyasvabhāva iti svīkriyate| tena prameye dravyaguṇe carakasuśrutayorvipratipattirnāstyeva| yattvatra vaktavyaṃ ‘pañcabhūtātmake dehe āhāraḥ pāñcabhautikaḥ| vipakvaḥ pañcadhā samyak svān guṇānabhivardhayet’ iti| anena pañcadhāpāko'bhihitaḥ, sa dravyasvarūpacintanīyo naitatpākadvayavirodhi, yathā pañcabhūtātmake'pi dravyāṇāṃ saumyāgneyatvād dvaividhyaṃ bhavati| yā tu carake avasthāpākābhidhāne antimapāke kaṭutā'bhihitā- ‘pakvāśayaṃ tu prāptasya śoṣyamāṇasya vahninā| paripiṇḍitapakvasya vāyuḥ syāt kaṭubhāvataḥ’ ityanena sā vātaprakopamātre hetuḥ, nānena madhurapākādheyasṛṣṭamūtrapurīṣatāsamyakśukrajananādivirodhinīti na virodhaḥ’ iti cakraḥ| ‘tatrāhuranye- pratirasaṃ pāka iti madhuro madhurasyāmlo'mlasyetyādi| yathāśāliyavādayaḥ prakīrṇāḥ svabhāvamuttarakālo'pi na parityajanti, tadvaditi| kecitpunarabalavanto balavatāṃ vaśamāyānti tasmādanavasthitaḥ pāka iti| kecittrividhamicchanti- madhuramamlaṃ kaṭukaṃ ceti| tattu na samyak, bhūtaguṇādāgamāccānyo'mlaḥ pāko nāsti, pittaṃ hi vidagdhamamlatāmupaityāgneyatvāt| yadyevaṃ lavaṇo'pyanyaḥ pāko bhaviṣyati, śleṣmā hi vidagdho lavaṇatāmupaitīti| āgamastviha dvividha eva pāko madhuraḥ kaṭukaśca’ iti cakrasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ, vipākaḥ pradhānam iti | kasmāt?
samyaṅmithyāvipakvatvāt; iha sarvadravāṇy abhyavahṛtāni samyaṅmithyāvipakvāni guṇaṃ doṣaṃ vā janayanti |
tatrāhur anye- prati rasaṃ pāka iti | kecit trividham icchanti- madhuram amlaṃ kaṭukaṃ ceti | tat tu na samyak, bhūtaguṇād āmāc cānyo 'mlo vipāko nāsti; pittaṃ hi vidagdham amlatām upaity āgneyatvāt; yady evaṃ lavaṇo 'py anyaḥ pāko bhaviṣyati, śleṣmā hi vidagdho lavaṇatām upaitīti | madhuro madhurasyāmlo 'mlasyaivaṃ sarveṣām iti kecid āhuḥ; dṛṣṭāntaṃ copadiśanti- yathā tāvat kṣīram ukhāgataṃ pacyamānaṃ madhuram eva syāt tathā śāliyavamudgādayaḥ prakīrṇāḥ svabhāvam uttarakāle 'pi
na parityajanti tadvad iti | kecid vadanti- abalavanto balavatāṃ vaśam āyāntīti | evam anavasthitiḥ, tasmād asiddhānta eṣaḥ | āgame hi dvividha eva pāko madhuraḥ kaṭukaś ca | tayor madhurākhyo guruḥ, kaṭukākhyo laghur iti | tatra pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśānāṃ dvaividhyaṃ bhavati guṇasādharmyād gurutā laghutā ca; pṛthivyāpaś ca gurvyaḥ, śeṣāṇi laghūni; tasmād dvividha eva pāka iti ||10||

aparaṃ vipākavādimataṃ nirdiśannāha- netyāhurityādi| netyāhuranye vīryaṃ pradhānamiti kecinna bruvate| tarhi kiṃ pradhānaṃ? vipākaḥ pradhānamiti, viśiṣṭaḥ pāko vipākaḥ| sarvadravyāṇyabhyavahṛtānīti iha sarvaśabdo vāmanīyadravyāṇi varjayitvā jñeyaḥ| guṇaṃ doṣaṃ vā janayanti guṇaṃ samyagvipakvāni, doṣaṃ mithyāvipakvāni| pratirasaṃ pāka iti rasaṃ rasaṃ prati pāka utpadyata ityarthaḥ| tattu na samyak, traividhyaṃ na samyagityarthaḥ| kathaṃ punastraividhyaṃ na samyagityāha- bhūtaguṇādityādi| etena traividhyaṃ nirastam| pratirasaṃ pāka iti pūrvoktaṃ sthāpayannāha- madhuro madhurasyetyādi| amlo amlasyaivaṃ sarveṣāmiti kecidāhuriti padacchedaḥ| dṛṣṭāntaṃ copadiśantīti pratirasapāke ityarthaḥ| ukhāgataṃ sthālīgatam| prakīrṇā iti bhūmau nikṣiptāḥ phalitaparyantā ityarthaḥ| tadvaditi evaṃ rasā api jaṭharāgnipakvāḥ svaṃ rūpaṃ madhurādikaṃ na tyajanti| tasmādityādi|- tasmāt kecit pratirasaṃ pākaḥ, kecittrividhaḥ, anye'balavanto balavatāṃ vaśamāyāntīti matānāmaniyatatvam; tasmādasiddhānta eṣa anāgama eṣa ityarthaḥ| svamatamidānīṃ darśayannāha- āgame ityādi| āgame śāstre| anye ‘āgamastviha’ iti paṭhanti; tatra tuśabdo'pyarthaḥ, athavā viśeṣārthastuśabdaḥ, tena pratyakṣādipramāṇāviruddho'pi śiṣṭāgama ityarthaḥ; athavā, āgamaśabdo'yaṃ siddhāntavacanaḥ, tena siddhāntaḥ punarihetyarthaḥ| pṛthivyapteja ityādi| pṛthivyādīnāṃ guṇasādharmyād guṇasamānatayā dvaividhyaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| guṇamevāha- gurutā laghutā ceti||10||

bhavanti cātra-
dravyeṣu pacyamāneṣu yeṣv ambupṛthivīguṇāḥ |
nirvartante 'dhikās tatra pāko madhura ucyate ||11||
bhavanti cātretyādi| nirvartante'dhikā iti jāyante utkaṭā ityarthaḥ||11-12||

lg.l: pṛthaktvadarśinām eṣa ‘samprati dravyādiprādhānye ekīyamatāni darśayitvā svamataṃ siddhāntarūpamāha- pṛthaktvetyādi| pṛthaktvena ekaikaśyoktena dravyādīnāmitaraprādhānyāpavādapūrvakaṃ prādhānyaṃ draṣṭuṃ śīlaṃ yeṣāṃ te pṛthaktvadarśinaḥ| eṣa ityanantaroktaḥ| vādasaṅgrahaḥ dravyameva pradhānamityādirūpo vādaparigrahaḥ| etatpakṣaviparītapakṣaṃ sarvaprādhānyaṃ siddhāntarūpatayā darśayanneva ekaikaprādhānyapakṣānniṣedhayannāha- caturṇāmityādi| samagrasyedaṃ sāmagryaṃ melakamityarthaḥ| atreti prādhānyacintāyām| vipaścita iti prāmāṇikāḥ| tena prāmāṇikecchayā melakasyaiva prādhānyaṃ phalati| sāmagryeṇa ceha dharmeṇa samagrā dharmiṇa eva vivakṣitāḥ| yatra dravyaprādhānyaṃ tatra rasādīnāmaprādhānyaṃ, yatra rasaprādhānyaṃ tatra dravyādīnāmaprādhānyamityādyanusaraṇīyam’ iti cakraḥ vādināṃ vādasaṅgrahaḥ |
caturṇām api sāmagryam icchanty atra ‘sāmarthyaṃ’ iti pā. vipaścitaḥ ||13||

ab.seg: evaṃ dravyarasavīryavipākavādināṃ savivādahetūni matāni nirdiśya svamataṃ dravyādisāmagryalakṣaṇaṃ nirdiśannāha- pṛthaktvadarśināmityādi| pṛthaktvadarśināṃ bhedadarśinām, eṣa vādasaṅgraha iti yojyam| vādasaṅgrahaśca dravyaṃ pradhānaṃ, rasāḥ pradhānamityādikaḥ| svamatamāha- caturṇāmityādi| caturṇāṃ rasaguṇavīryavipākānām| apiśabdaḥ samuccaye| na kevalamekasya dvayostrayāṇāṃ vā, caturṇāmapītyarthaḥ| sāmagryaṃ samudāyatvam| icchanti manyante| atra dravye| vipaścitaḥ paṇḍitāḥ||13||

lg.l: tad dravyam ātmanā “etadeva svasvaviṣaye dravyādiprādhānyamāha- tadityādi| taditi tasmāt dravyādisāmagryaprādhānyāt| atra dravyameva pañcamahābhūtavikāraviśeṣamannapānabheṣajarūpaṃ pāñcabhautikaśarīrasya dhātuvaiṣamyarūpaṃ doṣaṃ vikāraṃ vā dhātusāmyarūpaṃ doṣavikāropaśamaṃ samavāyikāraṇatayā kurvan kartṛtvena vyavasthāpyate| tadāśritāstu dravyaśaktirūpā rasavīryavipākā yathāyogaṃ nimittakāraṇatāṃ samavāyikāraṇatāṃ vā bhajanto na kartṛtayā vyapadiśyante, dravyaparādhīnatvāt| yattu ‘madhurāmlalavaṇā vātaṃ ghnanti’ ityādinā rasādīnāmapi kartṛtvaṃ vyapadiśyate, tadrasādiprādhānyatayā na tu paramārthataḥ, teṣāṃ nityaṃ dravyaparādhīnatvāt| tena dravyaprabhāvādeva rasādisādhye kārye dravyameva kartṛtayopadiśati- dravyamātmanetyādi| kiñciddravyamātmanā śaktyā prabhāvākhyayā doṣaṃ hanti karoti vā| doṣamiti doṣaśabdena vikāro'pi gṛhyate| śaktiḥ dravyasya svarūparūpā sāmānyaviśeṣātmikā nyāyadarśanasiddhā vā bhavatu, bhaṭṭanayasiddhā vā tadatiriktā kāryagamyā bhavatu, neha tadvicāraḥ prayojakaḥ| ubhayathā'pi śaktisiddheḥ| iyameva śaktistantrāntare prabhāvaśabdena, iha cācintyaśabdena vyavahiyate| rasavipākābhyāmiti samāsopadeśena bhūyasā'pi dravyādīnāṃ kāryakartṛtvaṃ sūcitam| atra doṣaharaṇakaraṇābhyāmeva sarvadravyakāryāvarodhaḥ| taddravyamātmanetyādinā svakārye sarvaprādhānye'pi mukhyakartṛtayā dravyaṃ pradhānamityuktam” iti cakraḥ kiñcit kiñcid vīryeṇa sevitam |
kiñcid rasavipākābhyāṃ doṣaṃ hanti karoti vā ||14||

ab.seg: nanu, tarhi dravyameva kriyākāri na rasādaya ityāśaṅkyāha- tadityādi|| ātmanā svayameva, dravyamātmanā kṛtvā kiñciddoṣaṃ hanti karoti vā, kiñciddravyameva vīryeṇa kṛtvā hanti karoti vā, kiñciddhanti karoti vā rasavipākābhyāṃ kṛtvā, sarvatra dravyaṃ hanane karaṇe ca kartṛkārakaṃ; tatra dravyamātmanā pārthivāpyataijasavāyavyākāśīyasvarūpeṇa doṣaṃ hanti, yathā- khadiraḥ kuṣṭhaṃ, doṣaśabdo'tra vyādhāvapi vartate; vīryeṇa dvividhenāṣṭavidhena vā sevitaṃ dravyaṃ doṣaṃ hanti, tacca mahatpañcamūlādikametasminnadhyāye kathitameva; rasena kṛtvā dravyaṃ doṣaṃ hanti, yathā- tiktā guḍūcyuṣṇavīryā'pi pittaṃ śamayati; vipākena kṛtvā dravyaṃ doṣaṃ hanti, yathā- śuṇṭhī kaṭukā'pi vātaṃ śamayati, madhuravipākatvāt||14||

lg.l: pāko ‘samprati pākādyapekṣaṇīyatayā pākādyāśrayatayā ca dravyaprādhānyaṃ darśayannāha- pāko nāstītyādi| śītavīryaṃ pṛthivījalāśrayaṃ madhuraṃ guruṃ ca pākaṃ niṣpādayati, tathā uṣṇavīryamagnyāśrayamākāśalāghavasahitaṃ kaṭukalaghupākaṃ ca janayati| dravyamādhārakāraṇamiti vipākavīryarasānāṃ sarveṣāmevādhārakāraṇatayā dravyaṃ pradhānamityuktaṃ bhavati| kiṃvā vipākādīnāṃ svasvakāryopadarśanametat| yathā- dravyopayogānantaraṃ rasaḥ svakāryaṃ karoti, tato vīryaṃ pariṇāmāvasthāyāṃ kāryaṃ karoti, tato'nte vipākaḥ| taduktaṃ carake- “raso nipāte dravyāṇāṃ vipākaḥ karmaniṣṭhayā| vīryaṃ yāvadadhīvāsānnipātāccopalabhyate” iti cakraḥ nāsti vinā vīryād vīryaṃ nāsti vinā rasāt |
raso nāsti vinā dravyād dravyaṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ ‘śreṣṭhamataḥ’ iti pā. smṛtam ||15||

ab.seg: rasādīnāṃ dravyakāryatvāddravyasya prādhānyaṃ darśayannāha- pāka ityādi| śreṣṭhatamaṃ praśasyatamam| etenāśrayo dravyam, āśrayiṇo rasādayaḥ||15||

lg.l: janma ‘atha dravyaṃ cedrasasya kāraṇaṃ, kāraṇaṃ ca nāvaśyaṃ kāryaṃ janayati, tat kiṃ rasaṃ vinā'pi dravyaṃ bhavatītyāśaṅkāṃ nirākurvannāha- janma tvityādi| tatra dravyaṃ kāryadravyaṃ dhānyaphalavṛkṣādi| janmaśabdena cābhivyaktirucyate’ iti cakraḥ tu dravyarasayor anyonyāpekṣikaṃ smṛtam |

vīryasañjñā ‘atha pāko nāsti vinā vīryādityādinā mukhyatayā rasaṃ dravyāśrayaṃ pratipādya rasāśrayatayā vīryasyāpi dravyāśrayatvaṃ paramparayā pratipāditaṃ, samprati rasavadvīryasyāpi dravyāśrayatvaṃ pratipādayannāha- vīryasañjñā ityādi| apiśabdāt sthūlasūkṣmādayo guṇā dravyāśrayatvena gṛhyante| atha rasāśrayāḥ pūrvamamī guṇā uktāḥ, tathā rasaguṇakathanena ca ‘madhuro rasaḥ śītaḥ’ ityādinā rasāśrayā vīryādayo guṇā vaktavyāḥ, tat kathamiha dravyā ucyanta ityāha- raseṣu na bhavantītyādi| etena paramārthato rasaguṇe nirguṇatvād vīryarūpā guṇāstathā'nye saṅkhyādayo na bhavantyeva| ekāśrayatayā tūpacārāt sukhena dravyaguṇapratītyarthaṃ gauravatayocyante’ iti cakraḥ guṇā ye 'ṣṭau te 'pi dravyāśrayāḥ smṛtāḥ |
raseṣu na bhavanty ete nirguṇās tu guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ ||17||

dravye ‘vipākasyāpi dravyāśrayatvena dravyaprādhānyamāha- dravye dravyāṇītyādi| dravye āhārarūpe, dravyāṇi āhāragatāni pṛthivyādīni, pacyante na rasā iti rasānāṃ paratantratvena svatantrapākāviṣayatvāt, dravye tvagnisaṃyogāt pacyamāne pākājjñāyamānatayā rasaḥ pacyata iti vyapadiśyata ityarthaḥ| yadā ‘dravyaṃ dravyeṇa’ iti pāṭhastadā dravyeṇeti jaṭharāgninā, iti viśeṣaḥ| prakaraṇavyutpāditaṃ dravyaprādhānyaṃ nigamayati- dravyaṃ śreṣṭhatamamiti| śeṣā bhāvā rasavīryavipākāḥ’ iti cakraḥ dravyāṇi yasmād dhi vipacyante na ṣaḍrasāḥ |
śreṣṭhaṃ dravyam ato jñeyaṃ, śeṣā bhāvās tad āśrayāḥ ||18||

ab.seg: kāryakāraṇabhāve'pi yathā'gnerdhūmo jāyate naivaṃ rasādayo dravyājjāyante kiṃ tarhi dravyarasādīnāṃ ca sahaiva janmeti darśayannāha- janma tvityādi| anyonyāpekṣikamiti anyonyāśritamekavelotpattirityarthaḥ| kimivetyāha- anyonyetyādi| dehaḥ śarīraṃ, dehī ātmā| evaṃ rasaṃ dravyāśrayaṃ pratipādya vīryamapi dravyāśrayaṃ pratipādayannāha- vīryasañjñā ityādi| apiśabdādanye'pi sthūlasūkṣmādayo guṇā dravyāśrayā eva| nirguṇāstu guṇāḥ smṛtā iti| ete śītādayaḥ sthūlasūkṣmādayaścānye guṇāḥ, raso'pi guṇaḥ, ato guṇeṣu guṇā na sambhavanti tasmāddravyasyaivaite śītādayo guṇā iti| tathā vipākamapi dravyāśrayameva pratipādayannāha- dravye ityādi| dravye pañcabhūtātmakadehe, dravyāṇi āhāradravyāṇi; na ṣaḍrasāḥ, niravayavatvāt| śeṣā bhāvā iti rasādaya ityarthaḥ, tadāśrayā iti dravyāśrayā ityarthaḥ| atra pāṭhāntarāṇi tadvyākhyānāntarāṇi ca bahūni santi, tāni vistarabhayānna likhitāni||16-18||

lg.l: amīmāṃsyāny acintyāni ‘idānīṃ dravyaviṣaye parīkṣārūpamīmāṃsāyā darśitatvādacintyadravyasvabhāve'pi mīmāṃsā vo mābhūdityāha- amīmāṃsyānītyādi| acintyāni yāni bheṣajāni yathā dantī citrakasamā'pi virecayati, lohākarṣakamaṇirlohamākarṣayatītyādyuktāni āgamāvadhāritāni mīmāṃsayā aparīkṣyāṇi| kathaṃ tarhi tāni jñātavyānītyāha- prasiddhāni svabhāvata iti| āgamādeva paraṃ prasiddhatamā bhavantītyarthaḥ| etena yāni cintyāni bheṣajāni teṣāṃ mīmāṃsā kartavyaiva’ iti cakraḥ prasiddhāni svabhāvataḥ |

ab.seg: yathoktabheṣajānāṃ svabuddhyā vicāraniṣedhaṃ nidarśayannāha- amīmāṃsyānītyādi| amīmāṃsyāni na vicāryāṇi, acintyāni yānyevācintyāni tānyevāmīmāṃsyāni| kāni punastāni? khadiratuvarakarasāñjanaharidrādīni kuṣṭhaghnāni, na tu sarvāṇi dravyāṇi; anyathā ‘vargamapi vargeṇopasṛjet’, tathā ‘bījenānena matimān kuryādbastiśatānyapi’(ci. a. 38) ityādi viruddhaṃ bhavet| svabhāvato janmataḥ| anye tu āgame yāni bheṣajāni prasiddhāni tānyamīmāṃsānyavicāraṇīyāni, kuto hetoravicāryāṇi? yataḥ svabhāvato'cintyāni teṣāṃ svabhāvaścintayituṃ na śakyata ityarthaḥ; yathā dravatvamapāmuṣṇatvamagnerityādi| kathaṃ punastāni prayojyānītyāha- āgamenopayojyāni; āgamenaivaikenopayogaḥ kārya ityarthaḥ||19||

lg.l: pratyakṣalakṣaṇaphalāḥ ‘āgamasyaivātra balavattvaṃ darśayannāha- pratyakṣetyādi| pratyakṣeṇa lakṣyate dṛśyate phalaṃ yāsāṃ dantīviṣaharamaṇiprabhṛtīnāṃ tāḥ pratyakṣalakṣaṇaphalāḥ| prasiddhā ityāgamaprasiddhāḥ| svabhāvata ityacintyasvarūpato virecakatvastambhanatvaviṣaharatvādeḥ| hetubhirityāgamaviruddhaiḥ kuhetubhiḥ| āgamānuguṇaiḥ saddhetubhirbheṣajādīni sarvāṇyeva parīkṣyāṇi| svāgamasyānumānābādhanīyatvamevodāharaṇenāha- sahasreṇetyādi| atra ‘ambaṣṭhādirvirecayati pṛthivītoyaguṇayuktatvāt, trivṛtādivat’ ityādi bahukuhetubhirapi āgamabādhitairnāmbaṣṭhādirvirecayati, kintvāgamoktaṃ saṅgrahaṇameva karoti’ iti cakraḥ prasiddhāś ca svabhāvataḥ |
tasmāt tiṣṭhet tu matimān āgame na tu hetuṣu ||21||

ab.seg: nanu, anumānaviruddhāni kathamāgamaikaprayojyānītyāśaṅkya, āgamasya pratyakṣaphalatvena balīyastvaṃ darśayannāha- pratyakṣetyādi| pratyakṣalakṣaṇaphalā hitāhitabhedena| kutaḥ punarhetubhirna parīkṣaṇīyaṃ bheṣajaṃ prasiddhalakṣaṇaphalamityāha- sahasreṇetyādi||20-21||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne dravyaguṇarasavīryavipākavijñānīyo nāma catvāriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||40||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||40||

div.head: dravyaviśeṣavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto dravyaviśeṣavijñānīyam adhyāyaṃ ‘pūrvādhyāyoktadravyasya tatrānuktaviśeṣavijñānārthaṃ, tathā tadadhikāreṇa ca vīryavipākayorjñānārthaṃ dravyaviśeṣavijñānīyo'bhidhīyate| dravyasya pāñcabhautikakāryadravyasya pārthivatvādaya iha viśeṣā vivakṣitāḥ’ iti cakraḥ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi| dravyasya viśeṣo bhedaḥ pārthivādikaḥ||1-2||

tatra pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśānāṃ ‘sarvakāryadravyāṇāṃ pañcabhūtārabdhatvaṃ darśayitvā| cikitsopayuktaṃ pārthivatvādiviśeṣamāha- tatra pṛthivyapteja ityādi| samudāyāditi melakāt| pṛthivījalādīnāṃ ca yadyapi viruddhaguṇatvaṃ tathā'pyadṛṣṭavaśādekadravyarūpakāryārambhakaṃ dṛṣṭatvādeva bhavati| yathā vātādīnāmekavyādhyārambhakatvaṃ, śukraśoṇitayogarbhajanakatvaṃ, sattvarajastamasāṃ vā mahadādyārambhakatvam| utkarṣaḥ pratyekaṃ pṛthivyādyutkarṣaḥ| abhivyañjaka iti pārthivatvādyabhivyañjakaḥ’ iti cakraḥ samudāyād dravyābhinirvṛttiḥ, utkarṣas tv abhivyañjako bhavati- idaṃ pārthivam idam āpyam idaṃ taijasam idaṃ vāyavyam idam ākāśīyam iti ||3||

tatra sarveṣāmeva dravyāṇāṃ pañcabhūtābhinirvṛttatvāt pṛthagdravyāṇāṃ pṛthivyādyārabdhānāṃ paramārthabhedo nāstītyutkarṣopādhibhedaṃ darśayannāha- tatretyādi| samudāyāt samavāyāt| dravyābhinirvṛttirdravyajanma| abhivyañjako jñāpakaḥ||3||

div.ab: tatra sthūlasāndramandasthiragurukaṭhinaṃ hārāṇacandrastu ‘sthūlasārasāndra’ ityādi paṭhati, ‘sāraṃ sthirāṃśaṃ pākādibhiḥ kṣayāpacayarahitamityetat’ iti ca vyākhyānayati gandhabahulam īṣatkaṣāyaṃ ‘atra guṇe gandhabahulamiti vacanāt pṛthivyāḥ sāṃsiddhikena gandhabāhulyena yogaṃ darśayati| evaṃ jalādiṣvapi sāṃsiddhikena rasādiviśeṣeṇa yogaṃ darśayan bahulaśabdaṃ kariṣyati| īṣatkaṣāyamiti pṛthivyanilayogājjñeyaṃ, yadvakṣyati- ‘pṛthivyanilaguṇabāhulyāt kaṣāyaḥ’ iti, prāyaśo madhuramiti madhurapradhānaṃ, pṛthivyā madhurarasakāraṇatvāt’ iti cakraḥ prāyaśo madhuram iti pārthivaṃ; tat sthairyabalagauravasaṅghātopacayakaraṃ viśeṣataś cādhogatisvabhāvam iti(1) |4|

tatra prabhūtaṃ dravyābhivyaktikāraṇaṃ pṛthivyādibhūtaguṇotkarṣaṃ nirdiśannāha- tatra sthūletyādi| sthūlaḥ sūkṣmaviparītaḥ, sāndrastanuviparyayaḥ, mandastīkṣṇaviparyayaḥ, saraviparītaḥ sthiraḥ, guruścirapākī, kaṭhino mṛduviparītaḥ| pārthivasya lakṣaṇābhidhānena guṇavattvamabhidhāya kriyāvattvaṃ darśayannāha- tatra sthairyetyādi| sthairyamacalatvaṃ, saṅghātaḥ kāṭhinyam, upacayo bṛṃhaṇam||4(1)||
śītastimitasnigdhamandagurusarasāndramṛdupicchilaṃ rasabahulam īṣatkaṣāyāmlalavaṇaṃ madhurarasaprāyam āpyaṃ; tat snehanahlādanakledanabandhanaviṣyandanakaram iti;(2) |4|

idānīmāpyadravyamabguṇotkarṣeṇa bhinnaṃ darśayannāha- śītamityādi| stimitamārdraṃ, jaḍamityanye| āpyasya lakṣaṇābhidhānena guṇavattvamabhidhāya kriyāvattvaṃ darśayannāha- tat snehanetyādi| hlādanaṃ sukhotpādanaṃ, kledanamārdrabhāvaḥ, bandhanaṃ saṃhatyāpādanaṃ, viṣyandanaṃ dravasrutiḥ||4 (2)||
uṣṇatīkṣṇasūkṣmarūkṣakharalaghuviśadaṃ rūpabahulam īṣadamlalavaṇaṃ kaṭukarasaprāyaṃ viśeṣataś cordhvagatisvabhāvam iti taijasaṃ; tad dahanapacanadāraṇatāpanaprakāśanaprabhāvarṇakaram iti;(3) |4|

āgneyadravyalakṣaṇaṃ tadbhūtaguṇotkarṣeṇa darśayannāha- uṣṇetyādi| tīkṣṇaṃ rājikāmaricādivat, sūkṣmaṃ srotonusaraṇaśīlaṃ, viśadaṃ picchilaviparītam| tasya kriyāvattvaṃ darśayannāha- dahanetyādi| dahanaṃ bhasmasātkaraṇaṃ, pacanamāhārādipākaḥ, dāraṇaṃ vraṇādeḥ, tāpanaṃ śarīrādisantāpanaṃ, prakāśanamabhivyaktiḥ, prabhā tejaḥ, varṇo gaurādiḥ||4(3)||
sūkṣmarūkṣakharaśiśiralaghuviśadaṃ sparśabahulam īṣattiktaṃ viśeṣataḥ kaṣāyam iti vāyavīyaṃ; tad vaiśadyalāghavaglapanavirūkṣaṇavicāraṇakaram iti;(4) |4|

vāyuguṇotkarṣādvāyavyaṃ dravyaviśeṣaṃ darśayannāha- sūkṣmetyādi| kharaṃ karkoṭakaphalavat, śiśiraṃ śītaṃ, viśadaṃ dhūlivat| tasyaiva karma darśayannāha- tadvaiśadyetyādi| glapanamavṛṣyatvaṃ, vicāraṇaṃ manaso'nekavikalpakāraṇaṃ; ‘vicaraṇakaram’ ityanye paṭhanti, tatra gativiśeṣakaramityarthaḥ; ‘vidhāraṇam’ ityanye||4(4)||

ab.seg: ślakṣṇasūkṣmamṛduvyavāyiviśadaviviktam avyaktarasaṃ śabdabahulam ākāśīyaṃ; tan mārdavaśauṣiryalāghavakaram iti(5) ||4||

div.ab: ākāśaguṇotkarṣeṇākāśīyaṃ dravyaviśeṣaṃ darśayannāha- ślakṣṇetyādi| ślakṣṇaṃ masṛṇaṃ, mṛdu komalaṃ, vyavāyīti samastadehaṃ vyāpya paścāt pākaṃ gacchati viṣamadyavat, viviktaṃ pṛthagbhūtam, avayavadvāreṇa śūnyamityanye, avyaktarasaṃ madhurādirasaviśeṣānupalabdheḥ| tasya karmāṇi nirdiśannāha- tanmārdavetyādi| śauṣiryaṃ chidrabhāvaḥ ||4(5)||

ab.seg: anena ‘evaṃ taduktapārthivādidravyasvarūpasya sarvasthāvarajaṅgamasya bheṣajatāpratipattiphalaṃ yathā bhavati tadāha- anenetyādi| nidarśyate pārthivādīnāṃ svarūpamaneneti nidarśanamāgamaḥ| tenāgameneti anantaroktena pārthivādidravyasvarūpapratipādakenāgamena| nānauṣadhibhūtamiti pratiṣedhadvayenauṣadhisvarūpamityarthaḥ| etadauṣadhitvaṃ sarvadravyāṇāṃ yathā bhavati tadāha- iti kṛtvā taṃ taṃ yuktiviśeṣamityādi| yuktiviśeṣamiti yojanāprakāram| sa ca yojanāviśeṣo bāhya ābhyantaro vā śāstre ukto vakṣyamāṇaḥ kālādyapekṣaḥ| arthamiti sādhyaṃ| tacca nānāvyādhighātena svasthapālanaviśeṣarūpam| svavīryaguṇayuktānīti svaśaktyā prabhāveṇa, guṇena ca rasavīryavipākādinā yuktāni| karmakarāṇīta karmaṇi samarthāni| kiṃvā svavīryayuktānīti svakīyakāryakaradharmayuktāni, kāryakṣamaṃ hi dravyadharmaṃ ‘yena kurvanti tadvīryaṃ’ ityanena vakṣyati| guṇaśabdo'yaṃ dharmavacanaḥ| etadevoktaṃ yuktyapekṣakāryaviśeṣe vīryaguṇayuktasya dravyasya kartṛtvaṃ bhedenāha- tāni yadetyādinā tatphalamityantena| yeneti prabhāveṇa rasena vīryeṇa vipākena vā| ayaṃ ca vīryaśabdaḥ pāribhāṣikavīryavacano na bhavati, kintu śaktimātravacanaḥ| tena prabhāvarasādayaḥ sarva eva svakāryaṃ kurvanto dravyasya śaktiparyāyarūpavīryavācyā iti jñeyāḥ| yanniṣpādayantīti ārogyaviśeṣaṃ svasthānuvṛttiviśeṣaṃ rasāyanaphalaṃ vā| atra sarvadravyabheṣajatvakathanaṃ viṣāgniprabhṛtīnāmapi tatsādhyaṃ prati kvacidvihitatvādyuktameva| yena viṣaṃ viṣaharaṇe udare ca vidhīyata eva| yattu madhughṛtādisaṃyogādinā viruddhaṃ, tat pratyekaṃ bheṣajaṃ kvacidbhavatyeva| saṃyuktaṃ ca vairodhikatvādbheṣajaṃ na bhavatīti na kācit kṣatiḥ| nahyatra sarvathā dravyāṇāṃ bheṣajatvaṃ pratijñātaṃ, kintu vivakṣitayojanādiyuktatveneti’ iti cakraḥ nidarśanena nānauṣadhībhūtaṃ jagati kiñcid dravyam astīti kṛtvā taṃ taṃ yuktiviśeṣam arthaṃ cābhisamīkṣya svavīryaguṇayuktāni dravyāṇi kārmukāṇi ‘karmakarāṇi’ iti pā. bhavanti | tāni yadā kurvanti sa kālaḥ, yat kurvanti tat karma, yena kurvanti tad vīryaṃ, yatra kurvanti tad adhikaraṇaṃ, yathā kurvanti sa upāyaḥ, yan niṣpādayanti tat phalam iti ||5||

idānīṃ sarvasyaiva jagataḥ sthāvarajaṅgamākhyasya pāñcabhautikatvena sarvamauṣadhaṃ kriyāguṇayogādibhirdarśayannāha- anenetyādi| nānauṣadhibhūtamiti anauṣadhibhūtaṃ dravyaṃ nāstīti sambandhaḥ| yuktiviśeṣamiti yuktiviśeṣo yojanāviśeṣastoyāgnisaṃskāravāsanabhāvanāmātrākālādyapekṣaḥ| arthaṃ ceti| arthaḥ prayojanaṃ nānāvyādhinirghātanaṃ, vīryaṃ śaktiḥ śītoṣṇādayo vā'ṣṭau śaktimanto guṇāḥ, guṇā gurvādayaḥ, anye tu vīryapradhānā guṇā vīryaguṇāste punaḥ saratvādayaḥ| kārmukāṇi kāryakarāṇi| tāni dravyāṇi yadā yasmin kāle, kriyāṃ kurvanti sa kālaḥ; kālaśca saṃvatsarātmā ṛtvākhyaḥ śītoṣṇavarṣalakṣaṇaścāturāvasthikaścābhipretaḥ| yadityādi karmaśabdenātra bheṣajadravyavyāpāraḥ śodhanādiruktaḥ| yenetyādi| vīryamiti śaktiḥ| yatretyādi| adhikaraṇamiti pañcamahābhūtaśarīrisamavāyilakṣaṇaḥ puruṣo'dhikaraṇam| yathetyādi| yena svarasakalkaśṛtaśītaphāṇṭaghṛtatailalehamodakotkārikādiprakāreṇa kurvanti sa upāyaḥ| yaditi svāsthyamasvāsthyaṃ vā||5||

tatra, virecanadravyāṇi pṛthivyambuguṇabhūyiṣṭhāni, pṛthivyāpo gurvyaḥ, tāni ‘tā’ iti pā. gurutvād adho gacchanti, tasmād virecanam adhoguṇabhūyiṣṭham anumānāt ‘anumānāllakṣayediti virecane yāni trivṛtādidravyāṇyuktāni tāni pṛthivyambuguṇagurutvayuktānyanumānājjñeyāni| gurutvānumānena ca gurutvakāryāntaravātaśamanāgnyananuguṇatvādi jñāyate| yattu pṛthivyambuguṇena gurutvādibhūyiṣṭhānumānaṃ tanna yujyate, na hi yat pṛthivyambuguṇagurutvabhūyiṣṭhaṃ tat sarvaṃ virecanaṃ, tathā sati māṣādīnāmapi gurutvādvirecakatvaprasaktiḥ| tasmādvirecakatvaprabhāvasahitaṃ gurutvaṃ virecakam| prabhāvapratītiśca yataḥ pramāṇādāgamādanyato vā tata eva ca virecakaṃ pratipannamiti| laghutvādūrdhvamuttiṣṭhate ityatrāpi prabhāvasahitāditi jñeyam| vāyuśca yadyapi tiryaggatistathā'pyūrdhvagenāgninā yukto yogavāhitvādūrdhvaṃ gacchatīti yuktam|’ iti cakraḥ; vamanadravyāṇy agnivāyuguṇabhūyiṣṭhāni, agnivāyu hi laghū, laghutvāc ca tāny ūrdhvam uttiṣṭhanti, tasmād vamanam apy ūrdhvaguṇabhūyiṣṭham; ubhayaguṇabhūyiṣṭham ubhayatobhāgam; ākāśaguṇabhūyiṣṭhaṃ saṃśamanaṃ; sāṅgrāhikam anilaguṇabhūyiṣṭham, anilasya śoṣaṇātmakatvāt; dīpanam agnigu
ṇabhūyiṣṭhaṃ, tatsamānatvāt; lekhanam anilānalaguṇabhūyiṣṭhaṃ; bṛṃhaṇaṃ pṛthivyambuguṇabhūyiṣṭham; evam auṣadhakarmāṇy anumānāt sādhayet ||6||

bhavanti cātra-
bhūtejovārijair dravyaiḥ śamaṃ yāti samīraṇaḥ |
bhūmyambuvāyujaiḥ pittaṃ kṣipram āpnoti nirvṛtim ||7||

lg.l: āgneyam eva yad dravyaṃ tena pittam udīryate |

ab.seg: tatretyādi| gurutvāditi gurutvalaghutve ceha prabhāvaviśeṣādhiṣṭhite trivṛtādimadanaphalādidravyasamavete grāhye, na tu gurutvalaghutvamātre; anyathā matsyapiṣṭānnamasūrādīnāṃ virecakatvaṃ kapiñjalalāvādīnāṃ ca vāmanīyatvaṃ syāt| adho gacchanti upalādivat| adhoguṇabhūyiṣṭhaṃ pṛthivyambuguṇabhūyiṣṭhamityarthaḥ| vamanetyādi ūrdhvamuttiṣṭhantīti dhūmavajjvālāvacca| vamanadravyamūrdhvaguṇabhūyiṣṭham agnivāyuguṇabhūyiṣṭhamityarthaḥ| ubhayaguṇabhūyiṣṭhamiti virecanavamananirdiṣṭabhūtacatuṣṭayaguṇabhūyiṣṭhamityarthaḥ| saṃśamanamiti “na śodhayati yaddoṣān samānnodīrayatyapi| samīkaroti kruddhāṃśca tat saṃśamanamucyate” iti| lekhanaṃ kaphamedasoḥ| nirvṛtiḥ śāntiḥ||6-9||

lg.l: evam etad guṇādhikyaṃ dravye dravye viniścitam |
dviśo vā bahuśo vā'pi jñātvā doṣeṣu ‘doṣeṣviti dravyaguṇaviparītaguṇeṣu, doṣaviparītaguṇaṃ hi dravyaṃ bheṣajamiti vyavasthitameva’ iti cakraḥ| ‘doṣe'vacārayet’ iti pā. cācaret ||10||

ab.seg: evamityādi| evamanena prakāreṇa| etat pūrvoktam| dviśa iti dvayordvayordoṣayoḥ| bahuśa iti bahūnāṃ doṣāṇāmityarthaḥ| doṣeṣu cācarediti cakārādrogeṣvapyevamācarediti samuccīyate||10||

tatra ya ime guṇā vīryasañjñakāḥ śītoṣṇasnigdharūkṣamṛdutīkṣṇapicchilaviśadās teṣāṃ ‘gurulaghumṛdutīkṣṇā’ iti hārāṇacandrasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ tīkṣṇoṣṇāv āgneyau, śītapicchilāv ambuguṇabhūyiṣṭhau ‘guruśītau pṛthivyambuguṇabhūyiṣṭhau’ iti hā.pā., pṛthivyambuguṇabhūyiṣṭhaḥ ‘ambuguṇabhūyiṣṭhaḥ’ iti hā.pā. snehaḥ, toyākāśaguṇabhūyiṣṭhaṃ mṛdutvaṃ, vāyuguṇabhūyiṣṭhaṃ raukṣyaṃ, kṣitisamīraṇaguṇabhūyiṣṭhaṃ ‘agnyākāśasamīraṇaguṇabhūyiṣṭhaṃ laghutvaṃ’ iti hā. pā. vaiśadyaṃ; vipākāv uktaguṇau | tatra, uṣṇasnigdhau vātaghnau, śītamṛdupicchilāḥ pittaghnāḥ, tīkṣṇarūkṣaviśadāḥ śleṣmaghnāḥ ‘gurūṣṇasnigdhā vātaghnāḥ, mṛduśītau pittaghnau, laghutīkṣṇarūkṣāḥ śleṣmaghnāḥ’ iti hā.pā. gurupāko vātapittaghnaḥ, laghupākaḥ śleṣmaghnaḥ | teṣāṃ mṛduśītoṣṇāḥ ‘mṛduśītoṣṇānāṃ sparśenāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavatīti sparśagrāhyā ityuktāḥ| yena saindhavagataṃ śītatvamānūpamāṃsagatamauṣṇyamityādi na sparśagrāhyaṃ, kintu kāryānumeyamāgamapratipādanīyaṃ vā, evamasparśādigrāhyeṣvapi tadudāharaṇamanusaraṇīyam’ iti cakraḥ sparśagrāhyāḥ, picchilaviśadau cakṣuḥsparśābhyāṃ, snigdharūkṣau cakṣuṣā, tīkṣṇo mukhe duḥkhotpādanāt ‘teṣāṃ śītoṣṇasnigdhā hlādanapācanastambhanādinā, rūkṣagurulaghavo virūkṣaṇopalepalekhanādinā, tīkṣṇo dahanapacanādinā, mṛdustadviparyāsenānumīyate’ iti hā.pā.| gurupākaḥ sṛṣṭaviṇmūtratayā kaphotkleśena ca, laghur baddhaviṇmūtratayā mārutakopena ca | tatra tulyaguṇeṣu bhūteṣu rasavaiśeṣyam upalakṣayet | tad yathā- madhuro guruś ca pārthivaḥ, madhuraḥ snigdhaś cāpya iti ||11||

tatretyādi| ime vakṣyamāṇāḥ| vipākayormadhurakaṭukayoḥ prāguktā guṇāḥ| tatroṣṇetyādi uṣṇasnigdhau vīryasañjñau guṇau| teṣāmaṣṭānāṃ vīryāṇāṃ madhye| mukhe duḥkhotpādanāditi atra cārtho draṣṭavyaḥ, tena ghrāṇaduḥkhotpādanācceti draṣṭavyam| snigdhaśceti cākārādguruśca||11||

bhavati cātra-
guṇā ya uktā dravyeṣu śarīreṣv api te tathā |
sthānavṛddhikṣayās tasmād dehināṃ dravyahetukāḥ ||12||
guṇā ityādi| guṇā viṃśatiradhikā vā| sthānaṃ doṣadhātumalasāmyenāvasthānaṃ, vṛddhirdoṣāderādhikyaṃ, kṣayaḥ hrāso doṣādīnām| dravyahetukāḥ pāñcabhautikadravyahetukāḥ||12||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne dravyaviśeṣavijñānīyo nāmaikacatvāriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||41||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne ekacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||41||

div.head: rasaviśeṣavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto rasaviśeṣavijñānīyam adhyāyaṃ ‘pūrvādhyāye dravyavīryavipākānāṃ viśeṣamabhidhāyāvaśiṣṭarasaviśeṣavijñānārthaṃ rasavijñānīyo'bhidhīyate| rasasya kāraṇasambhavasaṅkhyārthalakṣaṇādibhirvijñānārtho rasavijñānīyaḥ|’ iti cakraḥ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi| rasaviśeṣo madhurādiḥ, tasya vijñānaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ jñānam||1-2||

ākāśapavanadahanatoyabhūmiṣu ‘ekaikena śabdādiguṇena uttare uttare bhūte parivṛddhā ekottaraparivṛddhāḥ| tatrottarottare bhūte śabdādayo guṇāḥ pūrvabhūtānupraveśakṛtāḥ| śabdādayastvākāśādīnāṃ yathākramaṃ naisargikāḥ| yasmāt krameṇa śabdādayo naisargikāstasmādāpyo rasaḥ| sampratyapāmavyaktarasatve'pi yathā madhurādiviśeṣairanubhavatyāpyo rasastadāha- sa khalvityādi| śeṣabhūtāni jalavyatiriktāni catvāri| vidagdha iti pariṇataḥ| kālasahitabhūmyādisaṃsargāt pākādavasthāntaragataḥ ṣaḍvidho bhavatītyarthaḥ| nanu yadi śeṣabhūtayogānmadhurādiṣaḍvidhatvaṃ, tat kathaṃ ‘pṛthivyambuguṇabāhulyānmadhuro rasa’ ityanena madhure'pi rasaviśeṣe'pāṃ kāraṇatvamucyate? brūmaḥ- āpo rasānāmādhārakāraṇam, apāṃ pṛthivyamanupraveśāt pṛthivyapyādhārakāraṇameva, tenāpkṣitī api tadādhāratayā rasānāmabhivyaktau, abhivyakteśca madhurādirūpatāmantareṇāsambhavāt madhurādiviśeṣe'pi kāraṇe bhavataḥ| agnyādayastu trayo nīrasatayā madhurādiviśeṣe nimittakāraṇaṃ prādhānyena bhavanti, tadvyatirekeṇāmlādirasābhāvāt| rasābhivyakteścāgnyādibhūtatrayasannidhānaṃ vinā'nupapalabdherabhivyaktāvapi kāraṇatvamagnyādīnāṃ bhavati| taduktaṃ carake- “rasanārtho rasastasya dravyamāpaḥ kṣitistathā| nirvṛttau ca viśeṣe ca pratyayāḥ khādayastrayaḥ” (ca. sū. a. 1) iti| atrahi cakāradvayājjalakṣityorapi viśeṣe kāraṇatvaṃ, tathā khādīnāṃ ca nirvṛttāvapi kāraṇatvamuktaṃ, tena madhure viśeṣe'pyāṃ kāraṇatvādyuktameva ‘pṛthivyambuguṇabāhulyānmadhuraḥ’ iti’ iti cakraḥ yathāsaṅkhyam ekottaraparivṛddhāḥ śabdasparśarūparasagandhāḥ, tasmād āpyo
rasaḥ | parasparasaṃsargāt parasparānugrahāt parasparānupraveśāc ca sarveṣu sarveṣāṃ sānnidhyam asti, utkarṣāpakarṣāt tu grahaṇam | sa khalv āpyo rasaḥ śeṣabhūtasaṃsargād vidagdhaḥ ṣoḍhā vibhajyate; tad yathā- madhuro 'mlo lavaṇaḥ kaṭukas tiktaḥ kaṣāya iti | te ca bhūyaḥ parasparasaṃsargāt triṣaṣṭidhā bhidyante | tatra, bhūmyambuguṇabāhulyān madhuraḥ, bhūmyagniguṇabāhulyād amlaḥ, toyāgniguṇabāhulyāl lavaṇaḥ ‘toyāgniguṇabāhulyādamlaḥ, bhūmyagniguṇabāhulyāllavaṇaḥ’ iti pā., vāyvagniguṇabāhulyāt kaṭukaḥ, vāyvākāśaguṇabāhulyāt tiktaḥ, pṛthivyanilaguṇabāhulyāt kaṣāya iti ||3||

rasasāmānyasya prathamaṃ kāraṇasambhavaṃ darśayannāha- ākāśetyādi| ākāśapavanadahanatoyabhūmiṣu yathāsaṅkhyaṃ śabdasparśarūparasagandhā ‘jāyante’ iti śeṣaḥ| kiṃviśiṣṭāste? ekottaraparivṛddhā iti; tathāhi- śabdaguṇamākāśaṃ, śabdasparśaguṇo vāyuḥ, śabdasparśarūpaguṇaṃ tejaḥ, śabdasparśarūparasaguṇā āpaḥ, śabdasparśarūparasagandhaguṇā pṛthvī; parasparaṃ bhūtānupraveśāditthamekottarā vṛddhirjñeyā| āpyo jalasambhavaḥ| tatra sarveṣveva bhūteṣu sarvabhūtānāṃ sānnidhyamastīti darśayannāha- parasparasaṃsargādityādi| parasparasaṃsargāt anyonyasaṃyogāt, parasparānugrahāt anyonyopakārāt, parasparānupraveśāt anupraveśādekātmībhāvāt, sarveṣu bhūteṣu, sarveṣāmākāśādīnāṃ, sarveṣu dravyeṣvityanye| sarveṣu bhūteṣu sarvabhūtānāṃ sānnidhyamastīti sarva eva guṇāḥ sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ prāpnuvantītyāha- utkarṣāpakarṣādityādi|- utkarṣo vṛddhiḥ, apakarṣo hrāsaḥ; ākāśādhike dravye śabdo'dhikaḥ, vātādhike dravye sparśo'dhikaḥ, evaṃ śeṣeṣu bhūteṣu śeṣaguṇāḥ; tena sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ sarvātmakatve'pyutkarṣeṇābhidhānādāpya eva rasaḥ| yadi punarasau rasa āpya eva nānyabhūtajaḥ, sa evamapāṃ svabhāvenāvyaktarasatvāttenāpyavyaktarasena bhavitavyamityāha- śeṣetyādi| pānīyādanyāni bhūtāni śeṣabhūtāni, teṣāṃ saṃsargo milanaṃ, tato hetorāpyo raso'vyakto'pi kālasahāyabhūmiviyadanilānalasaṃsargeṇa paripākāntaraṃ gataḥ, ṣoḍhā vibhajyate ṣaṭ prakāro bhavati| tatra yasya yasya śeṣabhūtasya saṃsargādyo yo rasa utpadyate taṃ taṃ rasaṃ darśayannāha- tatretyādi| nanu ca, śeṣabhūtasaṃsargaḥ pratipādanīyaḥ, tat kathamudakopādanam? ucyate- niṣpattāveva toyaprādhānyamuktaṃ; viśeṣe tu na prāpnotīti viśeṣe'pi toyasya prādhānyapratipādanāya pṛthivyambuguṇabāhulyādityuktaṃ, ‘toyāgniguṇabāhulyādamla’ ityeke paṭhanti||3||
tatra, madhurāmlalavaṇā vātaghnāḥ, madhuratiktakaṣāyāḥ pittaghnāḥ, kaṭutiktakaṣāyāḥ śleṣmaghnāḥ ||4||
ṣaṇṇāṃ rasānāṃ kriyāviśeṣaṃ darśayannāha- tatretyādi||4||
tatra vāyor ātmaivātmā, pittam āgneyaṃ, śleṣmā saumya iti ||5||
doṣāṇāmutpattikāraṇamāha- tatretyādi| ātmaivātmeti ātmaiva yoniḥ, vāyuto vātotpattirityarthaḥ; pittamāgneyamiti analaḥ pittasya yonirityarthaḥ; śleṣmā saumya iti somādutpadyata ityarthaḥ||5||
ta ete rasāḥ svayonivardhanā, anyayonipraśamanāś ca ||6||
ta ete ityādi| svayonivardhanā iti yebhyaḥ kāraṇebhyo madhurādayo rasā utpadyante tāni vardhayantītyarthaḥ||6||

kecid āhuḥ- agnīṣomīyatvāj jagato rasā dvividhāḥ- saumyā āgneyāś ca | madhuratiktakaṣāyāḥ saumyāḥ; kaṭvamlalavaṇā āgneyāḥ | tatra madhurāmlalavaṇāḥ snigdhā guravaś ca, kaṭutiktakaṣāyā rūkṣā laghavaś ca; saumyāḥ śītāḥ, āgneyā uṣṇāḥ ||7||
kecidityādi| agnīṣomīyatvāditi agniśca somaśca yonirjagata ityarthaḥ|saumyāścāgneyāśceti cakāradvayāt sneharūkṣagurutvalaghutvairapi dvaividhyaṃ sūcayati||7||

div.ab: tatra śaityaraukṣyalāghavavaiśadyavaiṣṭambhyaguṇalakṣaṇo vāyuḥ, tasya samānayoniḥ kaṣāyo rasaḥ; so 'sya śaityāc chaityaṃ vardhayati, raukṣyād raukṣyaṃ, lāghavāl lāghavaṃ, vaiśadyād vaiśadyaṃ, vaiṣṭambhyād vaiṣṭambhyam iti; (1) |8|
madhuretyādi| samānayoniḥ tulyayonirityarthaḥ||8(1)||

auṣṇyataikṣṇyaraukṣyalāghavavaiśadyaguṇalakṣaṇaṃ pittaṃ, tasya samānayoniḥ kaṭuko rasaḥ; so 'sya auṣṇyā
d auṣṇyaṃ vardhayati, taikṣṇyāt taikṣṇyaṃ, raukṣyād raukṣyaṃ, lāghavāl lāghavaṃ, vaiśadyād vaiśadyam iti(2) |8|
auṣṇyetyādi||8(2)||

ab.seg: mādhuryasnehagauravaśaityapaicchilyaguṇalakṣaṇaḥ śleṣmā; tasya samānayonir madhuro rasaḥ, so 'sya mādhuryān mādhuryaṃ vardhayati, snehāt snehaṃ, gauravād gauravaṃ, śaityāc chaityaṃ, paicchilyāt paicchilyam iti (3) ||8||

tasya punar anyayoniḥ kaṭuko rasaḥ; sa śleṣmaṇaḥ pratyanīkatvāt kaṭukatvān mādhuryam abhibhavati, raukṣyāt snehaṃ, lāghavād gauravam, auṣṇyāc chaityaṃ, vaiśadyāt paicchilyam iti | tad etan nidarśanamātram uktaṃ bhavati (4) ||8||

div.ab: mādhuryetyādi| tasya śleṣmaṇaḥ| pratyanīkatvāt viruddhatvāt| nidarśanamātramuktamiti dṛṣṭāntamātramuktam||8(3-4)||

ab.seg: rasalakṣaṇam ata ūrdhvaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ- tatra, yaḥ paritoṣam utpādayati prahlādayati tarpayati jīvayati mukhopalepaṃ janayati śleṣmāṇaṃ cābhivardhayati sa madhuraḥ; yo dantaharṣam utpādayati mukhāsrāvaṃ janayati śraddhāṃ cotpādayati so 'mlaḥ; yo bhaktarucim utpādayati kaphaprasekaṃ janayati mārdavaṃ cāpādayati sa lavaṇaḥ; yo jihvāgraṃ bādhate udvegaṃ janayati śiro gṛhṇīte nāsikāṃ srāvayati sa kaṭukaḥ; yo gale coṣam utpādayati mukhavaiśadyaṃ janayati bhaktaruciṃ cāpādayati harṣaṃ ca sa tiktaḥ; yo vaktraṃ pariśoṣayati jihvāṃ stambhayati kaṇṭhaṃ badhnāti hṛdayaṃ karṣati pīḍayati ca sa kaṣāya iti ||9||

rasalakṣaṇamityādi| paritoṣaḥ parituṣṭiḥ| prahlādayati sukhamutpādayati| tarpayati tṛptiṃ karoti| jīvayati prāṇān dhārayati| upalepo malavṛddhiḥ| dantaharṣo dantakuṇṭhatā| kaphaprasekaḥ śleṣmāsrāvaḥ| śiro gṛhṇīte udvejakatvena, na tu kaphavātavedanābhiḥ| coṣa ākarṣaṇam| harṣo romaharṣaḥ||9||

div.ab: rasaguṇān ata ‘rasaguṇān rasadharmān’ iti cakraḥ ūrdhvaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ- tatra, madhuro raso rasaraktamāṃsamedo 'sthimajjaujaḥśukrastanyavardhanaś cakṣuṣyaḥ keśyo varṇyo balakṛt sandhānaḥ ‘balasandhānakṛt’ iti pā. śoṇitarasaprasādano bālavṛddhakṣatakṣīṇahitaḥ ṣaṭpadapipīlikānām iṣṭatamas tṛṣṇāmūrcchādāhapraśamanaḥ ṣaḍindriyaprasādanaḥ kṛmikaphakaraś ceti; sa evaṅguṇo 'py eka evātyartham āsevyamānaḥ kāsaśvāsālasakavamathuvadanamādhuryasvaropaghātakṛmigalagaṇḍān āpādayati tathā'rbudaślīpadabastigudopalepābhiṣyandaprabhṛtīñ janayati(1) |10|
rasaguṇānityādi| ṣaṣṭhamindriyaṃ manaḥ| tasyedānīmatisevyamānasyātisevāṃ doṣakarīṃ nidarśayannāha- sa evaṅguṇa ityādi||10(1)||

amlo jaraṇaḥ pācano dīpanaḥ pavananigrahaṇo 'nulomanaḥ koṣṭhavidāhī bahiḥśītaḥ ‘bahiḥśīta iti sparśaśītaḥ| nayanasammīlanaṃ sarvadā pihitākṣatvam’ iti cakraḥ kledanaḥ prāyaśo hy adyaś ceti; sa evaṅguṇo 'py eka evātyartham upasevyamāno dantaharṣanayanasammīlanaromasaṃvejanakaphavilayanaśarīraśaithilyāny āpādayati, tathā kṣatābhihatadagdhadaṣṭabhagnarugṇaśūnapracyutāvamūtritavisarpitacchinnabhinnaviddhotpiṣṭādīni pācayaty āgneyasvabhāvāt paridahati kaṇṭham uro hṛdayaṃ ceti(2) |10|

amlasya sevitasya guṇān darśayannāha- amla ityādi| jaraṇa āhārasya| pācano doṣāmayoḥ śothasya vā| anulomano vātamūtrapurīṣāṇām| tasyaikasyātisevitasya doṣaṃ nirdiśannāha- sa evaṅguṇa ityādi| romasaṃvejanaṃ romāñcaḥ| abhihatamabhighātaḥ, daṣṭaṃ vyāḍādibhiḥ, bhagnaṃ kāṇḍabhagnādyanekadhā, rugṇaṃ vakrībhūtaṃ, pracyutaṃ bhraṣṭaṃ svasthānāt, avamūtritaṃ mūtraviṣāṇāṃ jantūnāṃ mūtrasaṅgaḥ, visarpitaṃ sparśaviṣāṇāṃ jantūnāṃ visarpitasaṅgaḥ, chinnaṃ niḥśeṣataḥ, bhinnaṃ koṣṭhādi, viddhaṃ sirādi, utpiṣṭaṃ prahāracūrṇitādi||10(2)||

lavaṇaḥ saṃśodhanaḥ pācano viśleṣaṇaḥ kledanaḥ śaithilyakṛd uṣṇaḥ sarvarasapratyanīko ‘sarvarasapratyanīkatā lavaṇasya lavaṇayoge sarveṣāṃ rasānāmabhibhūtatvādanubhavasiddhatvājjñeyā’ iti cakraḥ mārgaviśodhanaḥ sarvaśarīrāvayavamārdavakaraś ceti; sa evaṅguṇo 'py eka evātyartham āsevyamāno gātrakaṇḍūkoṭhaśophavaivarṇyapuṃstvopaghātendriyopatāpamukhākṣipākaraktapittavātaśoṇitāmlīkāprabhṛtīn āpādayati(3) |10|

lavaṇarasaguṇakarmāṇi darśayannāha- lavaṇa ityādi| saṃśodhano vamanavirecanābhyāṃ, vraṇasya ca duṣṭasya| viśleṣaṇa iti pṛthakkaraṇaḥ pratyavayavānāṃ, cheditvāt| kledano vraṇasya| sarvarasānāṃ pratyanīko vipakṣa ucchedaka ityarthaḥ| mārgaviśodhano mūtranāḍīvraṇādimārgaviśodhanaḥ| tasyātisevyamānasya doṣaṃ darśayannāha- sa evaṅguṇa ityādi| koṭhaḥ pīḍakāḥ, puṃstvopaghātaḥ śukrakṣayaḥ, indriyopatāpaḥ cakṣurādīnāṃ svakarmaguṇahāniḥ, amlīketi amlodgāraḥ| āpādayati karoti||10(3)||

kaṭuko dīpanaḥ pācano rocanaḥ śodhanaḥ sthaulyālasyakaphakṛmiviṣakuṣṭhakaṇḍūpraśamanaḥ sandhibandhavicchedano 'vasādanaḥ stanyaśukramedasām upahantā ceti; sa evaṅguṇo 'py eka evātyartham upasevyamāno bhramamadagalatālvoṣṭhaśoṣadāhasantāpabalavighātakampatodabhedakṛt karacaraṇapārśvapṛṣṭhaprabhṛtiṣu ca vātaśūlān āpādayati(4) |10|

kaṭukasya prakṛtikarma nirdiśannāha- kaṭuka ityādi| avasādana anutsāhakṛt| tasyaivātisevitasya doṣaṃ nirdiśannāha- sa evaṅguṇa ityādi| bhramaścakrārūḍhasyeva; mada unmādapūrvarūpaṃ, harṣakṣayo vā||10(4)||

tiktaś chedano rocano dīpanaḥ śodhanaḥ kaṇḍūkoṭhatṛṣṇāmūrcchājvarapraśamanaḥ stanyaśodhano viṇmūtrakledamedovasāpūyopaśoṣaṇaś ceti; sa evaṅguṇo 'py eka evātyartham upasevyamāno gātramanyāstambhākṣepakārditaśiraḥśūlabhramatodabhedacchedāsyavairasyāny āpādayati(5) |10|
tiktasya prakṛtikarma nirdiśannāha- tikta ityādi| rocana iti itarabhakṣyavastūnāṃ, na punaḥ svayameva| tasyāpyatisevitasya doṣaṃ nirdiśannāha- manyāstambhetyādi| manye dve, tayoḥ stambha iti||10(5)||

ab.seg: kaṣāyaḥ saṅgrāhako ropaṇaḥ stambhanaḥ śodhano lekhanaḥ śoṣaṇaḥ pīḍanaḥ kledopaśoṣaṇaś ceti; sa evaṅguṇo 'py eka evātyartham upasevyamāno hṛtpīḍāsyaśoṣodarādhmānavākyagrahamanyāstambha- gātrasphuraṇacumucumāyanākuñcanākṣepaṇaprabhṛtīñ janayati ‘ākuñcanasyākṣepaṇaṃ niṣedha ityarthaḥ| kiṃvā ākuñcanamākṣepaṇaṃ ca karotītyarthaḥ’ iti cakraḥ||10||
