ab.seg: kṣudrakuṣṭhāni darśayannāha- sthūlāruṣkamityādi| sthūlāni aruṃṣi vraṇāḥ| sandhiṣu parvarṇām| sthūlāruṣkaṃ kaphāt| sthūlāruṣkamityasya sānvayaṃ nāma| kṣudrakuṣṭhapaṭhitasyāpi mahākuṣṭhamiti sānvayaṃ nāma, tasmin tvaksaṅkocādīnāṃ sarvāṅgagatvāt| ekakuṣṭhe'pi kṛṣṇāruṇaikavarṇatvena kṛtsnaśarīragasyaikakuṣṭhamiti sānvayaṃ nāma| mahākuṣṭhamekakuṣṭhamapi vātāt, todasvāpatvaksaṅkocādīnāṃ mahākuṣṭhe vātaikakāryatvāt; ekakuṣṭhe'pi kṛṣṇāruṇayorvātakāryatvāt; kaphāditi jejjaṭaḥ| kaṇḍūśoṣāvapi carmadalakuṣṭhe pittāt| tvagraktādīnisyādiśabdānmāṃsābunoravarodhaḥ| prāyaśaścordhvakāye iti prāyaśabdādadhaḥkāye'pi kadācit| sidhmaṃ vātānubandhakaphāt| soṣā kaṇḍūriti saha ūṣākaṇḍūbhyāṃ vartate yā sā tathā| yaiva pāṇyorvicarcī, saiva pādayorvipādikā| avadārayatītyavadāryā “kṛtyaluṭo bahulam” (pā. a. 3/3/113) iti kartari kṛtyaḥ, pādadāriketyarthaḥ| atraiva bhojaḥ- “doṣāḥ pradūṣya tvaṅmāṃsaṃ pāṇipādatalāśritāḥ| piḍakā janayantyāśu dāhakaṇḍūsamanvitāḥ|| dālyate tvak kharā rūkṣā pāṇyorjñeyā vicarcikā pāde vipādikā jñeyā sthānānyatvādvicarcikā||” iti| vicarcīvipādike pittakṛte, pittodrekāt, ‘śeṣāṇi pittaprabhavāṇi’ iti vacanāt; kaphavātāvapyatrāstaḥ, kaṇḍūdāraṇyordarśanāt| saiva pāṇyoḥ sphijośca tīvradāhaiḥ sphoṭairupagatā kacchūruktā| kacchūḥ pittāt, ‘tīvradāhaiḥ’ iti vacanena| sakaṇḍūḥ srāvahīnā| piḍakā rakasā, sā kaphāt| kṣudrakuṣṭheṣu pradhānān doṣānnirdiśannāha- tatrāruṣkamityādi| sthūlāruṣkarakasāsidhmeṣu kapho'dhikaḥ, vātodrekādekakuṣṭhaṃ, vātapittāttu parīsarpaṃ, aparāṇi ca pittādeva nirdiśet| aparāṇīti visarpakiṭibhavicarcīvipādikāpāmāḥ| sakaṇḍūḥ saiva tīvradāhasphoṭā kacchūriti na saṅkhyātirekaḥ| atra jejjaḍena- ekakuṣṭhe mahākuṣṭhe'pi kaphādhikyaṃ ceti svakalpitaślokaḥ- “aruḥ sasidhmaṃ rakasā mahacca yaccaikakuṣṭhaṃ kaphajānyamūni| vātena vidyāt parisarpamekaṃ śeṣāṇi pittaprabhavāṇi vidyāt” iti| tatra mahākuṣṭhe tvaksaṅkocasvāpabhedāṅgasādā vātakṛtāḥ, ekakuṣṭhe'pi kṛṣṇāruṇatvaṃ vātakṛtaṃ; kiñca kaphajatve tu kaṣṭatvamapyasya na syāt, kaphajasya kuṣṭhasya sukhasādhyatvāt; parisarpasyāpi vātakṛtatve srāvasphoṭajanmānupapattiḥ, vātajasyāvidyamānasrāvapākāt| kṣudrakuṣṭheṣu doṣānubandhe carakaḥ- “carmākhyamekakuṣṭhaṃ ca kiṭibhaṃ ca vipādikā| kuṣṭhaṃ cālasakaṃ jñeyaṃ prāyo vātakaphānvitam|| pāmā śatāruṣī sphoṭā dadruścarmadalaṃ tathā| pittaśleṣmādhikāḥ prāyaḥ kaphaprāyā vicarcikā” iti (ca. ci. 7)||9-16||

kilāsam api kuṣṭhavikalpa ‘kuṣṭhavikāraḥ’ iti tā. eva; tat trividhaṃ- vātena, pittena, śleṣmaṇā ceti | kuṣṭhakilāsayor antaraṃ- tvaggatam eva kilāsam aparisrāvi ca | tad vātena maṇḍalam aruṇaṃ paruṣaṃ paridhvaṃsi ca, pittena padmapatrapratīkāśaṃ saparidāhaṃ ca, śleṣmaṇā śvetaṃ snigdhaṃ bahalaṃ
kaṇḍūmac ca | teṣu sambaddhamaṇḍalam antejātaṃ raktaroma cāsādhyam agnidagdhaṃ ca ||17||

kilāsaṃ nirdiśannāha- kilāsamapītyādi| apiśabdaḥ sambhāvanāyāṃ, tena kilāsaṃ kuṣṭhavikṛtiriti sambhāvyate; anye tu, kimapi kilāsaṃ kuṣṭhavikalpo na bhavatītyapiśabdādāhuḥ; kiṃ tat kilāsaṃ kuṣṭhavikalpo na bhavati? ucyate- tvaggatamaparisrāvi ceti; antaraṃ bhedaḥ| tvaggatamiti kuṣṭhaṃ tvagraktamāṃsamadhiṣṭhāya tvaci darśayatyātmānaṃ, kilāsaṃ tu tvacameva kevalāmadhitiṣṭhatītyarthaḥ| anye tu ‘tvaggatameva kilāsasañjñaṃ, tadeva dhātvanupraveśācchvitrasañjñam’ ityāhuḥ| tathā ca viśvāmitraḥ,- “tvaggataṃ tu yadasrāvi kilāsaṃ tat prakīrtitam| yadā tvacamatikramya taddhātūnavagāhate|| hitvā kilāsasañjñāṃ ca śvitrasañjñāṃ labheta tat”- iti| vātādijānāṃ kilāsānāṃ lakṣaṇamāha- tadvātenetyādi| paridhvaṃsīti ghṛṣṭaṃ sadrajo vimuñcatītyarthaḥ| bahalaṃ sthūlam| ataḥ paramasādhyāvadhāraṇaṃ- teṣvityādi| teṣu vātapittaśleṣmajeṣu kilāseṣu| sambaddhamaṇḍalamiti parasparamabhinnamaṇḍalamityarthaḥ| ante jātam oṣṭhapāṇipādaguhyajam; anye tvatra ‘antarjātaraktaroma ca’ iti paṭhanti; antarmadhye jātāni raktāni lomāni yatra tattathā; te cācāryā ‘agnidagdhaṃ ca’ iti cakāreṇa pāṇipādaguhyauṣṭhajamanuktamapyasādhyaṃ samuccinvanti||17||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: tvagdoṣasāmānyāt kilāsaṃ nirdiśannāha- kilāsamapītyādi| apiśabdāt kuṣṭhavikalpo'pi kiñcitkilāsaṃ kuṣṭhavikalpo na bhavatītyāha- kuṣṭhakilāsayorantaramityādi| antaraṃ bhedaḥ| tvaggatameva kilāsaṃ, kuṣṭhaṃ tathā na bhavati; aparisrāvi ca, ‘kuṣṭhaṃ athā na bhavati’ iti śeṣaḥ| yadā tu raktādigataṃ parisrāvi tadā na kilāsasañjñaṃ, kiṃ tarhi kuṣṭhasañjñameva| tasya kuṣṭhāddhetuviśeṣo'pyasti doṣakopanaṃ viruddhādhyaśanādi pāpakarmāpi tatrāntare| tathāhi carakaḥ- “viprān gurūn dharṣayatāṃ” ityādi kuṣṭhahetūnabhidhāya, kuṣṭhādhyāye kilāsahetumapi doṣajananaṃ pāpakarmākhyaṃ cāha- “vacāṃsyatathyāni” (ca. ci. 7) ityādi| atra pṛthakkilāsahetavo na nirdiṣṭāḥ, tasya kuṣṭhaikasambhavatvāt| etāvad dṛśyameva kuṣṭhakilāsayorbhedaṃ viśvāmitrā'pyāha| tathāhi viśvāmitraḥ- “tvaggataṃ tu yadasrāvi kilāsaṃ tat prakīrtitam| yadi tvacamatikramya taddhātūnavagāhate|| hitvā kilāsasañjñāṃ tu kuṣṭhasañjñāṃ labhettadā” iti| tadapi dvividhaṃ vraṇakṛtaṃ, doṣajaṃ ca; tathā ca bhojaḥ- ‘śvitraṃ tu dvividhaṃ proktaṃ doṣajaṃ vraṇajaṃ tathā| tatra mithyopacārāddhi vraṇasya vraṇajaṃ smṛtam|| doṣajaṃ ca dvidhā proktamātmajaṃ parajaṃ tathā| paragātrāsanasparśādyattat parajamucyate|| tadātmajaṃ vijānīyādyaddeheṣvanilādijam| teṣāṃ lakṣaṇavaiśeṣyamuktaṃ śṛṇu mayā'nagha|| raktaṃ bhavati pittena kaphācchvetaṃ sapāṇḍukam| vātāt kṛṣṇāruṇaṃ tāmraṃ rūkṣaṃ tanu ca yadbhavet” iti| carakācāryāśayo'pi rasagatameva kilāsaṃ, tasyottarottaradhātutrayāśritaṃ tu nāmatrayaṃ “dāruṇaṃ vāruṇaṃ śvitraṃ kilāsaṃ nāmabhistribhiḥ| doṣe raktāśrite raktaṃ, tāmraṃ māṃsasamāśrite|| śvetaṃ medaḥśrite śvitraṃ, guru taccottarottaram” (ca. ci. 7) iti| atraivārthe bhālukiḥ- “saṃskārāt sahajāt sthānadoṣācchetatayā'pi tat| kilāsamabhivijñeyaṃ saṃsparśādeva dāhavat|| dāruṇaṃ tattu vijñeyaṃ māṃsadhātusamāśritam| medaḥśritaṃ bhavecchvetaṃ tathā śvitraṃ nirucyate” iti| cikitsābhedo'pi śvitrakilāsayorbhedaṃ kathayatveva; śvitrasya mahatī, laghvī kilāsasya| tasya sādhyāsādhyāvadhāraṇāyāha- sambaddhamaṇḍalamityādi| antejātamiti oṣṭhapāṇipādaguhyajaṃ, raktaroma cāsādhyaṃ kilāsam| tathā kilāsasyāsādhyatve carakaḥ- “saraktaroma bahulaṃ yacca bhinnaṃ parasparam| yacca varṣagaṇotpannaṃ tacchvitraṃ naiva sidhyati” (ca. ci. 7) iti| tathā bhoje'pi- “puṇḍarīkapalāśābhaṃ raktāntaṃ dīrgharoma ca| asādhyamanyathā jātaṃ yacchvitramacirotthitam|| chinnaṃ tu yadbhavecchvitraṃ tat sādhyamiti nirdiśet” iti| prāyeṇātrāpi kecit ‘antarjātaraktaloma’ iti paṭhanti| te punaragnidagdhaṃ ceti cakāreṇa pāṇipādaguhyauṣṭhajaṃ sanucinvanti||17||

kuṣṭheṣu tu tvaksaṅkocasvāpasvedaśophabhedakauṇyasvaropaghātā vātena, pākāvadaraṇāṅgulipatanakarṇanāsābhaṅgākṣirāgasattvotpattayaḥ ‘rāgāḥ śīghrotpattayaḥ’ iti tā. pittena, kaṇḍūvarṇabhedaśophāsrāvagauravāṇi śleṣmaṇā ||18||

kuṣṭhānāṃ saṅkṣepeṇoktatvādanuktamapi doṣaliṅgaṃ darśayannāha- kuṣṭheṣvityādi| vātakāryeṣu svedaścintyaḥ| ‘tvaksaṅkocasvāpāsvedau’ ityanye paṭhanti, tatra nañ svedaniṣedhārthaḥ; ‘vyādhisvabhāvāt svedo'pi syāt’ ityapare| kauṇyaṃ naṣṭakaratā| sattvotpattayaḥ krimīṇāṃ janmāni ‘utpattayaḥ’ iti pā.||18||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: kṣudrakuṣṭhānāṃ saṅkṣepeṇoktatvādanuktamapi doṣaliṅgaṃ nirdiśannāha- tatra kuṣṭheṣvityādi| svedameke vātakāryeṣu paṭhanti; tatra svedo vātakāryeṣu cintya eva| svedamanye manyante, kuṣṭhapūrvarūpeṣvapi svedapāṭhāt| vyādhiprabhāvāt svedo'pi syādityapare| śoṣo'ṅgaśoṣaḥ| nisvāpaḥ sparśākṣamatvam| kauṇyaṃ naṣṭakaratā| pittajeṣu jantūtpattiḥ kṛmijanma, pākātiśayāt| kaṇḍūvarṇabhedādayaḥ kaphasya||18||
tatrādibalapravṛttaṃ pauṇḍarīkaṃ kākaṇaṃ cāsādhyam ||19||

teṣāmasādhyatāṃ darśayannāha- tatretyādi| puṇḍarīkamādibalapravṛttaṃ śukraśoṇitadoṣajamasādhyam| nanu cādibalapravṛttamanyadapi kuṣṭhamasādhyameva, yadāha carakaḥ,- “ye cāpi kecit kulajā vikārāstāṃścāpyasādhyān pravadanti tajjñāḥ” (ca. ci. 6) iti; kulajā ityanena duṣṭaśukraśoṇitajā ucyante| puṇḍarīkagrahaṇaṃ sarveṣāmeva mahākuṣṭhānāmupalakṣaṇaṃ; teṣāmevottarottaradhātvanukrameṇa śukradhātorduṣṭijananasāmarthyāt| etena kṣudrakuṣṭheṣvādibalapravṛttatvaṃ nāsti, uttarottaradhātvananukramaṇābhāvena śukradoṣakaraṇe'sāmarthyāt| kākaṇakaṃ cāsādhyam, utpattāveva tridoṣabalapravṛttatvāt; dhātvanukramaṇena hi mahākuṣṭhānāmasthimajjaśukragatānāmasādhyatvamupariṣṭhādeva vakṣyati||19||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: teṣāmasādhyatāṃ nirdiśannāha- tatrādibalapravṛttamityādi| puṇḍarīkamādibalapravṛttaṃ śukraśoṇitadoṣajamasādhyam| nanu cādibalapravṛttamanyadapi kuṣṭhamasādhyameva; yadāha carakaḥ- “ye cāpi kecit kulajā vikārāstāṃścāpyasādhyān pravadanti tajjñāḥ (ca. ci. 7) iti; kulajā ityanena duṣṭaśukraśoṇitajānupakṣipati| ucyate- puṇḍarīkagrahaṇaṃ sarveṣāmeva mahākuṣṭhānāmupalakṣaṇaṃ, teṣāmevottarottaradhātvanukrameṇa śukradhātorduṣṭijananasāmarthyāt; etena kṣudrakuṣṭheṣvādibalapravṛttatvaṃ nāsti, uttarottaradhātvanukramaṇābhāvena śukradoṣakaraṇe'sāmarthyāt| kākaṇakaṃ cāsādhyamutpattāveva, tridoṣaprabalapravṛttattvāt| dhātvanukramaṇena hi mahākuṣṭhānāmasthimajjaśukragatānāmasādhyatāmupariṣṭhādeva vakṣati||19||

bhavanti cātra-
yathā vanaspatir jātaḥ prāpya kālaprakarṣaṇam kālaṃ krameṇa tu’ iti tā.|
antarbhūmiṃ vigāheta mūlair vṛṣṭivivardhitaiḥ ||20||

idānīmapratikāriṇa uttarottaradhātvanukramaṇe dṛṣṭāntaṃ darśayannāha- bhavanti cātretyādi| yathā vanaspatirvṛkṣaḥ, kālaprakarṣaṇaṃ kālādhikyaṃ prāpya, mūlaiḥ kṛtvā, antarbhūmiṃ vigāheteti sambandhaḥ| tvacīti atra tvakśabdena rasa uktaḥ, rasārabdhatvāt; tena rasasthamityarthaḥ||20-21||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: idānīmapratikāriṇāmuttarottaradhātvanukramaṇe dṛṣṭāntaṃ darśayannāha- yatā vanaspatirjāta ityādi||20-21||

lg.l: vaivarṇyaṃ rūkṣabhāvaś ca kuṣṭhe tvaci samāśrite ‘tvaksthe vaivarṇyamaṅgeṣu kuṣṭhe raukṣyaṃ ca jāyate’ iti tā.||22||
todaḥ sphoṭaḥ sthiratvaṃ ca kuṣṭhe māṃsasamāśrite ||24||
daurgandhyam upadehaś ca pūyo 'tha krimayas tathā |
yad apatyaṃ tayor jātaṃ jñeyaṃ tad api kuṣṭhitam ||28||

ab.seg: dhātugatakuṣṭhānāṃ lakṣaṇamāha- sparśahānirityādi| “prāgeva rasadhātuṃ kroḍīkṛtya doṣāḥ kuṣṭhārambhakāḥ, ato rasadhātulakṣaṇaṃ noktam” ityeke; apare tvakśabdena rasamāhuḥ| jāyata ityatrāpi sambadhyate| vipūyako durgandhatā| śoṇitasaṃśrite iti ‘jāyate’ ityatrāpi sambadhyate| bāhulyaṃ sthūlamaṇḍalatā| sphoṭaḥ tvacaḥ sphuṭanam| sthiratvaṃ kaṭhinamaṇḍalatā| kecidatrānyathā paṭhanti, sa ca pāṭho'bhāvānna likhitaḥ| atrāpi ‘jāyate’ ityadhyāhāraḥ| upadeho malavṛddhiḥ| atrāpi kecidanyathā ślokaṃ paṭhanti, so'pi pāṭho'bhāvānna likhitaḥ| śukragatasya kuṣṭhasya liṅgaṃ darśayannāha- kauṇyamityādi| tadapītyapiśabdāt pūrvoktānyapi rasādimajjāntagatāni liṅgāni bhavanti| kuṣṭhitaṃ sañjātakuṣṭham; anye tu ‘kuṣṭhavat’ iti paṭhanti, kuṣṭhasahitamityarthaḥ; anye ‘kuṣṭhilam’ iti paṭhanti, tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ| yadā strīpuṃsayoḥ kuṣṭhinorbījamupahataṃ syāttadā tayoḥ prajā notpadyate; upataptamātrabījayoḥ punaḥ prajopatāpa ‘prajopatāpayutotpadyate’ iti pā. utpadyate||22-28||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: kuṣṭhe tvacīti tvaksthe rasasthite ityarthaḥ| pūrvoktāni ca liṅgāni māṃsaprāpte iti rasaraktagatakuṣṭhaliṅgāni| medaḥsthānagate liṅgaṃ pūrvoktāni ca rasaraktamāṃsamedogataliṅgāni| śukragatasya liṅgaṃ darśayannāha- strīpuṃsayorityādi| kauṇyaṃ karabhaṅgaḥ| aṅgānāṃ bhedo bhaṅgaḥ| tadapītyapiśabdāt pūrvoktānyapi rasādimajjāntagataliṅgāni| apatyakuṣṭhajanakaśukradhātugatakuṣṭhaprasaṅgena āśrayaviśeṣāt pūrvamanuktasyāpatyakuṣṭhajanakasya strīraktadhātugatakuṣṭhasya vacanam| kuṣṭhikaṃ sañjātakuṣṭhaṃ; kuṣṭhilamityanye, tatra kuṣṭhavadityarthaḥ||22-28||

lg.l: medogataṃ bhaved yāpyam asādhyam ata uttaram ||29||

ab.seg: idānīṃ dhātvanukrame'pi sādhyādibhedaṃ darśayannāha- kuṣṭhamityādi| ātmavato jitendriyasya||29||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: idānīṃ dhātvanukrame'pi sādhyādibhedaṃ darśayannāha-kuṣṭhamātmavata ityādi||29||

lg.l: karmabhiḥ pāparogasya prāhuḥ kuṣṭhasya sambhavam ‘devadravyagurudravyaparasvaharaṇādibhiḥ| pāpmā pāpakṛtāmetat kuṣṭhamityabhiśabditam’ iti tā.||30||

ab.seg: kuṣṭhasya karmajatvaṃ darśayannāha- brahmastrītyādi| sajjanaḥ satpuruṣaḥ| parasvaṃ paradravyam||30||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: daivavyapāśrayacikitsārthaṃ karmajatvamathāsya darśayannāha- devadravyetyādi| brahmādibhiḥ saha vadhaśabdaḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyate| pāparogasyeti anenāpi karmajatvameva prakāśitam||30||

lg.l: mriyate yadi kuṣṭhena punar jāte 'pi gacchati |
nātaḥ kaṣṭataro rogo yathā kuṣṭhaṃ prakīrtitam ||31||
yas tena mucyate jantuḥ sa puṇyāṃ gatim āpnuyāt ||32||

ab.seg: kuṣṭhaṃ dīrgharogāṇāṃ pradhānamiti janmāntare'pi tadanubandhaṃ darśayannāha- mriyata ityādi| gacchati anugataṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ, kuṣṭhajanakasya karmaṇo'kṣīṇatvāt| āsthāya āśritya| sa puṇyāṃ gatimāpnuyāt, kṣīṇapāpatvāt||31-32||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: mriyate yadi kuṣṭhena hetubhūtena lakṣaṇabhūtena vā| punarjāte'pi gacchati kuṣṭhajanakasya karmaṇo'kṣīṇatvāt, saṃsarataśca dhātordoṣaduṣṭatvāt| āhārācārayoriti anena yuktivyapāśrayaṃ cikitsitamuktam| tapasaśca niṣevaṇādityanena daivavyapāśrayamuktam| puṇyāṃ gatimāpnuyāt kṣīṇapāpatvāt||31-32||

lg.l: kuṣṭhaṃ jvaraś ca śoṣaś ca netrābhiṣyanda eva ca |

ab.seg: saṃsargasambhavapradhānaṃ kuṣṭhamāśritya kuṣṭhiprabhṛtīnāṃ saṃsargaparihāraṃ darśayannāha- prasaṅgādityādi| prasaṅgāditi prasaṅgena abhyāsena kṛtāt, punaḥ punaḥ kṛtādityarthaḥ| idaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ gātrasaṃsparśādibhiḥ sarvaiḥ saha pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| sahaśayyāsanāditi ekaśayyāsanasthiteḥ| mālyaṃ puṣpam| aupasargikarogāḥ śītalikādayaḥ| saṅkrāmanti āviśanti||33-34||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: pradhānāśrayiṇo hi vidhayo bhavantīti saṃsargasambhavapradhānakuṣṭhamāśritya kuṣṭhiprabhṛtīnāṃ saṃsargasya parihāraṃ darśayannāha- prasaṅgādityādi| gātrasaṃsparśāt prasaṅgāt prasaṅgena kṛtādatyantābhyāsena kṛtādityarthaḥ| niśvāsādiṣu sarveṣveva prasaṅgāditi viśeṣaṇam| aupasargikā rogāḥ sāmānyādharmapravṛttā masūryādayaḥ| saṅkrāmanti narānnaramāviśanti| tadeva kathaṃ? pāpakṛtāṃ prasaṅgena pāpaṃ saṅkramati; taduktaṃ carake- “naro narakapātī svāttasya sambhāṣaṇādapi” (ca. sū. 1) iti; rogaprabhāvādityanye||33-34||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne kuṣṭhanidānaṃ nāma pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||5||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nidānasthāne pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ||5||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: iti sauśrute śalyatantre śrīgayadāsaviracitāyāṃ nyāyacandrikāyāṃ pañjikāyāṃ nidānasthāne kuṣṭhanidānaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ||5||
athātaḥ pramehanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi||1-2||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: athātaḥ pramehāṇāṃ nidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| kuṣṭhānantaraṃ pramehārambhaḥ, apatyasaṅkramyatvenobhayorapyapatyagatvāt, tridoṣārabdhatvasāmānyāt, mahāvyādhitvasāmānyāt, kālāntareṇāsādhyatvasādharmyāccikitsaikatvācca| atrāhurekestrīṇāṃ pramehā na bhavantīti; tathā ca tantrāntare- “rajaḥprasekānnārīṇāṃ māsi māsi viśudhyati| sarvaṃ śarīraṃ doṣāśca na pramehantyataḥ striyaḥ”- iti; etattu na yuktaṃ, sarvantrāprasiddheḥ, pratyakṣavirodhācca||1-2||
divāsvapnāvyāyām ālasyaprasaktaṃ śītasnigdhamadhuramedyadravānnapānasevinaṃ puruṣaṃ jānīyāt pramehī bhaviṣyatīti ||3||

pramehahetumāha- divāsvapnetyādi| prasaktaṃ prakarṣeṇa saktamatiśayenānuṣaṅgiṇam| medyaṃ meduraṃ medojanakamityarthaḥ| puruṣaṃ jānīyāt pramehī bhaviṣyati; tatrāhureke- strīṇāṃ pramehā na bhavanti, tathā ca tantrāntare- “rajaḥprasekānnārīṇāṃ māsi māsi viśudhyati| sarvaṃ śarīraṃ doṣāśca na pramehantyataḥ striyaḥ” iti; etattu na yuktaṃ, sarvatantrāprasiddheḥ pratyakṣavirodhācca||3||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: vyādhihetuṃ nirdiśannāha- divāsvapnaprasaktamityādi| prasaktaṃ prakarṣeṇa saktam| medyaṃ meduram| nidānaparivarjanārthametānyevātra pariharaṇīyāni||3||

tasya caivam pravṛttasyāparipakvā ‘caivampravṛttasya yadā vātapittaśleṣmāṇo medaścāparipakvamadho gatvā’ iti pā. eva vātapittaśleṣmāṇo yadā medasā sahaikatvam upetya mūtravāhisrotāṃsy anusṛtyādho gatvā baster mukham āśritya nirbhidyante tadā pramehāñ janayanti ||4||

samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- tasyetyādi| aparipakvā āmāḥ| medaseti atrāpiśabdo lupto draṣṭavyaḥ, tena vasādayo grāhyāḥ; anye ti ‘medaścāparipakvaṃ’ iti paṭhanti, cakoreṇānuktānapi vasādīn samuccinvanti| upetya gatvā| nirbhidyante niḥsarantītyarthaḥ| anye tu ‘vinirbhidyānte’ iti paṭhitvā, ‘tatraiva sthirti kurvanti’ iti tu vyākhyānayanti; apare ‘atidravatvaṃ yānti’ ityāhuḥ||4||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: sthānasaṃśrayalakṣaṇāṃ samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- tasya caivampravṛttasyetyādi| medaścāpariṇatamiti asamyakpariṇatam, āmarasavadatisnigdham| vinirbhidyante pratibadhyante, tatraivāspadaṃ kurvantīti yāvat| etena sthānasaṃśraya uktaḥ| tathāhi carake pramehanidāne pramehasamprāptau “trayāṇāmeṣāṃ nidānādiniśeṣāṇāṃ sannipāte kṣipraṃ śleṣmā prakopamāpadyate” ityārabhya yāvat “mūtravahānāṃ srotasāṃ vaṅkṣaṇabastiprabhavāṇāṃ medaḥkledopahitāni gurūṇi mukhānyāsādya pratirudhyante, tadā sthairyamasādhyatāṃ vā janayanti” (ca. ni. 4) iti| sthānasamprāptyanantaraṃ vyaktiṃ darśayannāha- tadā pramehāñjanayantīti||4||

teṣāṃ tu pūrvarūpāṇi- hastapādataladāhaḥ snigdhapicchilagurutā gātrāṇāṃ madhuraśuklamūtratā tandrā sādaḥ pipāsā durgandhaś ca śvāsas tālugalajihvādanteṣu malotpattir jaṭilībhāvaḥ keśānāṃ vṛddhiś ca nakhānām ||5||
pūrvarūpamāha- teṣāmityādi| keśānāṃ jaṭilībhāvo'nyonyamilanaṃ, svedamalabāhulyādrogaprabhāvācca||5||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: sthānasaṃśraye pūrvarūpaṃ darśayannāha- teṣāṃ pūrvarūpāṇītyādi| hastatalādidāhaḥ prabhāvāt| snigdhapicchilagurutā gātrāṇāṃ kaphena| madhuraśuklamūtratā ca tenaiva| kecijjaṭilībhāvaṃ keśānāṃ tathā nakhādīnāmativṛddhiṃ pūrvarūpe paṭhanti| tatra jaṭilībhāvaḥ keśānāṃ kaphaje paicchilyena rogaprabhāvādvā; keśaprabhṛtivṛddhiḥ śarīrasyātimalībhāvena, rogaprabhāvādityanye||5||
tatrāvilaprabhūtamūtralakṣaṇāḥ sarva eva pramehā bhavanti ||6||
pramehāṇāṃ sāmānyaṃ lakṣaṇamāha- tatretyādi| āvilaṃ samalam||6||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: sāmānyaṃ rūpaṃ pramehāṇāṃ darśayannāha- tatrāviletyādi| tatrāvilatvaṃ mūtrasya pramehadūṣyāṇāṃ medoraktamāṃsamajjāśukrodakavasālasīkaujasāṃ kvacideva pramehe kasyacideva dūṣyasyāvayavamiśrībhāvāt| teṣāmeva ca dūṣyāṇāṃ dravairekībhūtatvānmūtraprabhūtatvam| yadyevamanyeṣāṃ rasādidūṣyāṇāṃ kasmādatra grahaṇaṃ na kṛtam? atraike ‘medaścāparipakvaṃ’ ityatra medonantaramādiśabdo luptanirdiṣṭo draṣṭavya; tena rasādīnāmapyupagrahaḥ; anye tu ‘medaścāparipakvaṃ’ iti cakāreṇa rasādīnanuktānapi samuccinvanti||6||
sarva eva sarvadoṣasamutthāḥ saha piḍakābhiḥ ||7||
teṣāṃ pramehāṇāṃ pramehapiḍakānāṃ ca doṣaṃ nirdiśannāha- sarva evetyādi| etena pramehāṇāṃ pramehapiḍakānāṃ ca kuṣṭhavat sarvadoṣajatvamuktam||7||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: teṣāṃ pramehāṇāṃ pramehapiḍikānāṃ ca doṣaṃ nirdiśannāha- sarva eva sarvadoṣasamutthā iti| anena kuṣṭhavat sarveṣāṃ sarvadoṣajatvam| saha piḍikābhiḥ piḍakāśca sarvāḥsarvadoṣasamutthāḥ; taduktamihaiva- “ye yanmayā smṛtā mehāsteṣāmetāsu tanmayāḥ” iti; tena sarvamehānāṃ sarvadoṣajatvaṃ, tatpiḍakānāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ sarvadoṣajatvamiti| amumevārthamupariṣṭādvakṣyati| tathāhi- “vātapittamedobhiranvitaḥ śleṣmā pramehāñjanayati”, tathā “vātapittakaphaśoṇitamedobhiranvitaṃ pittaṃ svamehāñjanayati” tathā “śleṣmapittavasāmajjāmedobhiranvito vāyuḥ svamehāñjanayati”, iti sarvāsāṃ sarvadoṣajatvamapi||7||

tatra, kaphād udakekṣuvālikāsurāsikatāśanair lavaṇapiṣṭasāndraśukraphenamehā ‘kaphādudakekṣusurā.’ iti pā. daśa sādhyāḥ, doṣadūṣyāṇāṃ samakriyatvāt; pittān nīlaharidrāmlakṣāramañjiṣṭhāśoṇitamehāḥ ṣaḍ yāpyāḥ, doṣadūṣyāṇāṃ viṣamakriyatvāt; vātāt sarpirvasākṣaudrahastimehāś catvāro 'sādhyatamāḥ, mahātyayikatvāt ||8||

sarveṣāṃ sarvadoṣajatve'pyutkarṣato doṣagrahaṇaṃ darśayannāha- tatretyādi| udakamehaḥ, ikṣuvālikāmehaḥ ‘ikṣumehaḥ’ iti pā., surāmehaḥ, sikatāmehaḥ, śanairmehaḥ, lavaṇamehaḥ, piṣṭamehaḥ, sāndramehaḥ, śukramehaḥ, phenamehaśceti daśa pramehāḥ sādhyā yadyatiśayena medo dūṣitaṃ na bhavati| doṣadūṣyāṇāṃ samakriyatvāditi atra doṣaḥ śleṣmā, dūṣyāṇi rasamāṃsamedomajjāśukralasīkaujāṃsi, eṣāṃ kaṭutiktakaṣāyādibhiḥ samaiva kriyā| pittādityādi| yāpyā iti atrāpi yadyatiśayena bhedo dūṣitaṃ na bhavati| doṣadūṣyāṇāṃ viṣamakriyatvāditi atra doṣaḥ pittaṃ, dūṣyāṇi rasamāṃsādīni, eteṣāṃ tu viṣamā kriyā pittahantrī rasamāṃsādyutpādiketi| vātādityādi| mahātyayikatvāditi śīghraṃ vināśakāritvāt, mahātyayikatvaṃ punareṣāmuttarottarasārataradhātusrāvakaratvāt; viṣamakriyatvāccetyatrāpi sambadhyate||8||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: utkarṣato doṣagrahaṇāṃ nirdiśannāha- tatra kaphādityādi| tatra kaphasyaiva yathā nānāvidharūpamehābhinirvṛttistathopariṣṭāt svayameva pratipādayiṣyati| atraike carakaṃ vīkṣya śvetaśītamūrtapicchalācchasnigdhagurumadhurasāndraprasādamandeṣu guṇeṣu kaphajeṣūdakamehādiṣu kvacit kañcideva guṇamupavarṇayanti| tatra tanuśītācchaśvetairudakamehaḥ, madhuraśītenekṣuvālikāmehaḥ, acchena pittānurāgiṇā surāmehaḥ, mandamūrtābhyāṃ śanairmehaḥ, kaphavidāhavyaktena guruṇā lavaṇamehaḥ, śuklena piṣṭamehaḥ, sāndrapicchilābhyāṃ sāndramehaḥ, śvetasnigdhābhyāṃ śukramehaḥ, gurusnigdhābhyāṃ phenamehaḥ| ete sādhyāḥ, samakriyatvāddoṣadūṣyāṇām| pittāttu nīlādyāḥ ṣaṭ, pittaguṇaiḥ ṣaḍbhireva yathāsaṅkhyaṃ nīlapītāmlakṣāravisralohitairabhivyajyante| pittajā yāpyāḥ, viṣamakriyatvāddoṣadūṣyāṇām| pittadoṣaharī śītamadhurā medaskarī, medoharā tu laṅghanoṣṇādikā ca pittakarīti doṣadūṣyayorviṣamakriyatvam| vātāttu sarpirmehādayaḥ| tatra sarpirmehaścarake majjamehaḥ, kṣaudrameho madhumehaḥ, vasayā vasāmehaḥ; ityubhayatra samānam| ete asādhyāḥ, viṣamakriyatvāddoṣadūṣyāṇāṃ, mahātyayatvācca; mahātyayatvaṃ ca punareṣāmuttarottarasārataradhātusrāvakatvāt| eṣāṃ tu sādhyāsādhyatvaṃ vyabhicārakaṃ ‘sapūrvarūpāḥ kaphapittamehāḥ’ (ca. ci. 6) ityanenābhimataṃ cikitsate yathāvasaraṃ vakṣyāmaḥ||8||
tatra vātapittamedobhir anvitaḥ śleṣmā śleṣmapramehāñ janayati, vātakaphaśoṇitamedobhir anvitaṃ pittaṃ pittapramehān, kaphapittavasāmajjamedobhir anvito vāyur vātapramehān ||9||
idānīṃ sarveṣāmeva sarvajatvaṃ prakaṭayannāha- tatretyādi||9||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: tatra sarveṣāmeva sarvajatvaṃ darśayannāha- tatra vātapittetyādi||9||

tatra, śvetam avedanam udakasadṛśam udakamehī mehati; ikṣurasatulyam ikṣuvālikāmehī; surātulyaṃ surāmehī; sarujaṃ sikatānuviddhaṃ sikatāmehī; śanaiḥ sakaphaṃ mṛtsnaṃ śanair mehī; viśadaṃ lavaṇatulyaṃ lavaṇamehī; hṛṣṭaromā piṣṭarasatulyaṃ piṣṭamehī; āvilaṃ sāndraṃ sāndramehī; śukratulyaṃ śukramehī; stokaṃ stokaṃ saphenam acchaṃ phenamehī mehati ||10||

kaphajānāmanukrameṇa lakṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha- tatretyādi| sikatānuviddhaṃ vālukāmiśram| mṛtsnaṃ picchilam| lavaṇatulyaṃ lavaṇāmbutulyam| hṛṣṭaromā prāptaromañcaḥ| puṣṭarasatulyaṃ piṣṭamiśrodakatulyam| āvilamatyarthaṃ kaluṣaṃ, punarvacanāt| mehati mūtrayatītyarthaḥ||10||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: tatra śvetamityādi| ikṣuvālikā khaggalikā| sikatānuvuddhaṃ vālukāmiśram| lavaṇatulyaṃ lavaṇāmbutulyam| piṣṭarasatulyaṃ piṣṭamiśrodakatulyam| āvilam atyarthaṃ kaluṣaṃ, punarvacanāt| śukratulyaṃ śukrasadṛśaṃ; carake tu “śukrābhaṃ śukravimiśraṃ vā muhurmehati yo naraḥ| śukramehinamāhustaṃ puruṣaṃ kaphakopataḥ” (ca. ci. 6) iti; atrāpi śukronmiśramiti sakalameva śukrasamaṃ śukrābhaṃ, śukramiśraṃ veti boddhavyaṃ; vāstavaśukrajatve kaphajasyāpyasādhyatvaṃ syāt||10||

ata ūrdhvaṃ pittanimittān vakṣyāmaḥ- saphenam acchaṃ nīlaṃ nīlamehī mehati; sadāhaṃ haridrābhaṃ haridrāmehī; amlarasagandham amlamehī; srutakṣārapratimaṃ kṣāramehī; mañjiṣṭhodakaprakāśaṃ mañjiṣṭhāmehī; śoṇitaprakāśaṃ śoṇitamehī mehati ||11||

ata ityādi| srutakṣārapratimaṃ galitakṣāradravatulyam| mañjiṣṭhodakaprakāśaṃ śoṇitaprakāśaṃ ca mūtraṃ raktapitte'pi bhavati, tat ko'yaṃ pramehaviśeṣaḥ? atrocyate- raktapitte pramehapūrvarūpaṃ na bhavati, mañjiṣṭhāśoṇitamehayostu pramehapūrvarūpasambhava iti viśoṣaḥ||11||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: pittajeṣu nīlaṃ cāṣapakṣasadṛśavarṇam| tatra cāṣa indranīlapakṣaḥ praśastadarśanaḥ; kvacit ‘svarṇacūḍa’ iti| amlarasagandhamiti amlarasaṃ amlasacaritagandhaṃ ca; sa ca pittagandhena visreṇa vidāhasacaratvena| pittasya lohitādruṇānmañjiṣṭhāśoṇitamehau||11||

ata ūrdhvaṃ vātanimittān vakṣyāmaḥ- sarpiḥprakāśaṃ sarpirmehī mehati; vasāprakāśaṃ vasāmehī; kṣaudrarasavarṇaṃ kṣaudramehī; mattamātaṅgavad anuprabandhaṃ ‘anuprabaddhaṃ’ iti pā. hastimehī mehati ||12||
ata ityādi| anuprabandhaṃ satatam||12||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: vātaje sarpirmehaścarake majjamehaḥ, kṣaudrameho madhumehaḥ| tasya tu ‘madhumeha’ iti pāribhāṣikamupadravāṇāmabhāvenānyatra(?) bodhanārthamarthabhede'pi śabdamātrābhinnaṃ nāma kṛtam| hastimeho lasīkamehaḥ| carakaḥ punarasya samprāptau vitarate; tadyathā- “yadā tu lasīkāṃ mūtrāśaye'bhivahan” (ca. ni. 4) ityādi||12||

makṣikopasarpaṇam ālasyaṃ asyāgre ‘upadravānata ūrdhvaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ’ iti tāḍapatrapustake'dhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ māṃsopacayaḥ pratiśyāyaḥ śaithilyārocakāvipākāḥ kaphaprasekacchardinidrākāsaśvāsāś ceti śleṣmajānām upadravāḥ; vṛṣaṇayor avadaraṇaṃ bastibhedo meḍhratodo hṛdi śūlam amlīkājvarātīsārārocakā vamathuḥ paridhūpanaṃ ‘paridhūmāyanaṃ’ iti pā. dāho mūrcchā pipāsā nidrānāśaḥ pāṇḍurogaḥ pītaviṇmūtranetratvaṃ ceti paittikānāṃ; hṛdgraho laulyam anidrā stambhaḥ kampaḥ śūlaṃ baddhapurīṣatvaṃ ceti ‘śoṣaḥ kāsaḥ śvāsaśceti vātajānāmupadravā bhavanti’ iti tā. vātajānām | evam ete viṃśati pramehāḥ sopadravā vyākhyātāḥ ||13||

idānīṃ pratidoṣamupadravān darśayannāha- makṣikopasarpaṇamityādi| avadaraṇaṃ vidaraṇam| amlīkā amlodgāraḥ| vamathuḥ chardiḥ| paridhūpanaṃ samantatastāpaḥ| dāho'gnidagdhasyeva| laulyaṃ sarvarasābhikāṅkṣā vātajagrahaṇīvat||13||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: tatra pramehāṇāmupekṣayā pramehātiyogādatipramehaduṣṭamedasāmatipravṛddhadhātukṣayakṛtavātayutapūrvāvasthitakaphapittābhyāṃ copadravā jāyante, tān yathādoṣaṃ darśayannāha- makṣikopasaraṇamityādi| makṣikopasaraṇādayaḥ kāsāntāḥ kaphajānām| makṣikopasaraṇaṃ madhurāhārasya mūtrasvedaśleṣmaṇāṃ madhurībhāvāt| kāsaḥ kaphajānāṃ vātajānāṃ copadraveṣu paṭhyate; tatra sāmarthyāt kaphajakāsasyārdratā, vātajasya tu śuṣkatā| vṛṣṇāvadaraṇādayaḥ pāṇḍurogāntāḥ pittajānām| hṛdrogādayaḥ śvāsāntā vātajānām| laulyaṃ raseṣu gṛddhiḥ, vātajagrahaṇīvadvyādhiprabhāvāt| taduktaṃ vātagrahaṇyāṃ- “gṛddhiḥ sarvarasānāṃ” (ca. ci. 15) iti| idānīṃ prāgrūpaṃ nirdiṣṭamupasaṃharannupadravāṇāṃ pṛthagvyādhitvaṃ nirasyannāha- evamete ityādi| viṃśatipramehāḥ sopadravāḥ saha upadravairvartante, na pṛthagete vyādhaya ityarthaḥ||13||

tatra vasāmedobhyām abhipannaśarīrasya tribhir doṣaiś cānugatadhātoḥ pramehiṇo daśa ‘nava’ iti tā. piḍakā jāyante | tad yathā- śarāvikā, sarṣapikā, kacchapikā, jālinī, vinatā, putriṇī, masūrikā, alajī, vidārikā, vidradhikā ceti ||14||

piḍakānāmupadravaviśeṣāṇāṃ samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- tatretyādi| vasā māṃsasnehaḥ, ‘sakalaśarīsnehaḥ’ ityanye| abhipannaśarīrasya vyāptaśarīrasya| anugatadhātorvyāptadhātoḥ| piḍakāstu prāyeṇādhaḥkāya eva| tāsāṃ piḍakānāṃ nāmānyāha- tadyathetyādi||14||

lg.l: jālinī tīvradāhā tu māṃsajālasamāvṛtā ‘māṃsajālasamāśritā’ iti pā.||16||
mahatī piḍakā nīlā piḍakā vinatā smṛtā ayamardhaślokastāḍapatrapustake na paṭhyate|
mahaty alpācitā jñeyā piḍakā sā tu putriṇī ||17||
raktā sitā sphoṭavatī dāruṇā tv alajī bhavet ||18||
vidradher lakṣaṇair yuktā jñeyā vidradhikā budhaiḥ ||19||

ab.seg: tāsāṃ lakṣaṇāmāha- śarāvamātretyādi| gaurasarṣapasaṃsthānā gaurasarṣapākarā| jālinityādi| yadyapi ‘ye yanmayāsmṛtā mehāsteṣāmetāstu taktṛtāḥ’- ityagre vakṣyate, tathā'pi jālinī pittettarā jñeyā, tadvacanasya bāhulyenoktatvāt| mahatī sthūlā| alpāciteti sūkṣmapiḍakāveṣṭitā||15-19||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: paścādbhāvināmupadravāṇāṃ prasaṅgena piḍakānāṃ paścādbhāvinīnāmupadravaviśeṣāṇāṃ samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- tatra vasāmedobhyāmityādi| tatra vasā māṃsasnehaḥ; sakalaśarīrasneha ityanye, piḍakāsamprāptau carake ojograhaṇāt; ojaśca sakalaśarīrasnehaśukrasthitaḥ| taduktaṃ carake- “gurusnigdhāmlalavaṇānyatimātraṃ samaśnatām| dravamannaṃ ca pānaṃ ca nidrāmāsyāmukhāni ca|| tyaktavyāyāmacintānāṃ saṃśodhanamakurvatām| śleṣmā pittaṃ ca medaśca māṃsaṃ cātipravardhate|| tairāvṛtagatirvāyuroja ādāya gacchati| yadā bastiṃ tadā kṛcchro madhumehaḥ pravartate|| samārutasya pittasya kaphasya ca muhurmuhuḥ| darśatyākṛtiṃ gatvā kṣayamāpyāyate punaḥ|| upekṣayā'sya jāyante piḍakāḥ sapta dāruṇāḥ| māṃsaleṣvavakāśeṣu sandhiṣvapi ca marmasu|| śarāvikā kacchapikā jālinī sarṣapī tathā| alajī vinatākhyā ca vidradhī ceti saptamī” (ca. sū. 17) iti; sarvamehaviṣayo'yam, upekṣāmadhumehe vāyorāvaraṇavacanāt| yathā''ha carakaḥ- “śleṣmā pittaṃ ca medaśca māṃsaṃ cāti pravardhate| tairāvṛtagatirvāyuroja ādāya gacchati|| yadā bastiṃ tadā kṛcchro madhumehaḥ pravartate” (ca. sū. 17) iti| vātajeṣu mukhakaṣāyādi ca manāgasti| śeṇitātiyogādikṛteṣu dhātukṣayajeṣu vāyorāvaraṇaṃ nāsti| kiñca sarvamehopadraveṣu “pūtimāṃsapiḍikālajīvidradhyādayaśca tatprasaṅgādbhavanti” (ca. ni. 4) iti vacanāt tasya prasaṅgo hyanuvartate| tathā caraka eva piḍakāheturmadhumeha eva, “upekṣayā” (ca. sū. 17) iti vacanāt| anena hi meheṣvatigurusnigdhāmlalavaṇādibhojanena sahopekṣayā śleṣmādibhiratipravṛddhairāvaraṇaṃ tadaiva madhumehapiḍikāḥ sapta| tasyaivedaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ- “samārutasya pittasya kaphasya ca” (ca. sū. 17) ityādi| ityupekṣāmadhumeho'pi carake'styeva| svāmidāsācāryajaḍanandyādīnāṃ carakaṭīkākārāṇāṃ parokṣatvāt tadvartanaṃ pratyanuyogo nikhilaḥ| piḍikāstu sapta carake, suśrute nava| suśrute ye vinatāmadhīyate, ‘nīlā'vagāḍharujā’ ityādinā, tatpāṭhe tu saṅkhyātirekāt samānatantreṣvapāṭhāt sā na paṭhanīyā| tathāhi bhojaḥ- “śarāvikā sarṣapikā kūrmikā jālinī tathā| kulatthikā'lajī putrī vidārī vidradhī tathā| navaitāḥ piḍikā jñeyā mehināṃ lakṣaṇaiḥ śṛṇu”- iti| tasmāttulyatantrasaṃvādāttathaiva vinatā vihatā'stīti| masūrikaiva bhoje kulatthikā||14-19||

lg.l: ye yanmayāḥ smṛtā mehās teṣām etās tu tatkṛtāḥ |20|

ab.seg: piḍakājanakān doṣānāha- ye ityādi| ye yanmayā yaddoṣārabdhāḥ| teṣāṃ pramehāṇām| etā iti piḍakāḥ||20||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: nanu jālinī tīvradāhā pittakṛtā, samānatantre'pi pittakṛtatvamasyāḥ, tathāhi bhojaḥ- “parasparaṃ hi sambaddhāḥ piḍakāścaikadeśajāḥ| pittotkaṭā dāhayutā bhṛśarugjālinī” matā- iti; tatkathaṃ ‘ye yanmayāḥ smṛtā mehāsteṣāmetāstu tanmayāḥ’ iti? ucyate- pūrvaṃ piḍakānāmārambhakadoṣākathanāt doṣasvabhāvakāryāṇāṃ ca keṣāñcittāsvanukteranilādidoṣāvadhāraṇārthamidamuktaṃ- ye yanmayā ityādi| tatra tena vacanenāniyama eva niyamo, na punarhi niyamo'pi; kiṃ ca loke bāhulyenaitadvacanaṃ, yathā- chatriṇo yāntīti; achatriṣvapi chatribāhulyāttadvyapadeśaḥ| tathā śāstre'pi “āmāśayotkleśabhavo bhūyiṣṭhaṃ jvara ucyate”, śramaklamādijā jvarā alaṅghanīyā ityukteḥ; jaḍenaivaṃ bahutarameva pralapitam| piḍakālakṣaṇaṃ subodham| piḍakāstu prāyeṇādhaḥkāya eva; yadāha- “kṛcchraṃ śarīraṃ niṣpīḍya medomajjavasāyutaḥ| adhaḥ prakramate vāyustenāsādhyāstu vātajāḥ” iti| vātādidoṣairevādhonītatvāddūṣyāṇāṃ tathā rasāyanīnāṃ ca daurbalyānnordhvamuttiṣṭhante doṣāḥ, ato madhumehināmadhaḥkāye piḍakāḥ prādurbhavanti||20||

lg.l: gude hṛdi śirasy aṃse pṛṣṭhe marmaṇi cotthitāḥ |
sopadravā durbalāgneḥ ‘durbalasya’ iti pā. piḍakāḥ parivarjayet ||20||

ab.seg: tāsāmasādhyatāṃ darśayannāha- gude hṛdītyādi| aṃso bāhuśiraḥ| sopadravā iti “tṛṭkāsamāṃsasaṅkothamohahikkāmadajvarāḥ| visarpamarmarodhāḥ piḍakānāmupadravāḥ” (ca. sū. 17)| ‘sopadravālpakāyāgneḥ piḍakāḥ parivarjayet’ iti kecit paṭhanti| tatra sopadrava iti puruṣaviśeṣaṇam||20||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: tāsāmasādhyatāṃ nirdiśannāha- gude hṛdītyādi| kecidāsāmasādhyatāṃ cikitsite paṭhanti- “asādhyā ūrdhvabhagotthā marmotthāśca viśeṣataḥ”- iti| sopadravā iti saha upadravairvartanta iti sopadravāḥ| te copadravāstāsāṃ carakādavagantavyāḥ| tathāhi carakaḥ- “tṛṭkāsamāṃsakothaśvāsahikkāmadajvarāḥ| visarpamarmasaṃrodhāḥ piḍakānāmupadravāḥ” (ca. sū. 17) iti||20||

lg.l: adhaḥ prakramate vāyus tenāsādhyās tu vātajāḥ ||21||

ab.seg: vātajānāmasādhyatve hetuṃ darśayannāha- kṛtsnaṃ śarīramityādi| kṛtsnaṃ śarīraṃ niṣpīḍyeti niścyotayitvā mūtramārgeṇa samastān dhātūn pravāhayitvetyarthaḥ| vasetyupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena ojolasīkayorgrahaṇam| adhaḥ prakramate adhaḥ sphītībhavati prabalībhavatītyarthaḥ| gayadāsācāryastu āpātanikāpūrvaṃ pramehapūrvarūpāṇāmityādiślokatrayamanyathā paṭhati| asādhyāstviti pūrvahetubhyāṃ ceti tuśabdārthaḥ||21||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: vātajānāmasādhyatve hetuṃ darśayannāha- kṛtsnaṃ śarīraṃ niṣpīḍyetyādi| kaphapittameheṣu na kṛtsnaśarīrapīḍanaṃ, tayorniyatadehaviṣayacaratvāt; vasetyupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena ojolasīkayorapyavarodhaḥ| prakramate iti vṛttyādiṣvartheṣu kramaterātmanepadam| yasyāḥ pradhānabhūtadhātukṣayeṇa śarīraṃ durbalībhavati, vapuḥ punaḥ sphītībhavati, tenāsādhyā vātajāḥ; pūrvahetubhyāṃ ceti tuśabdārthaḥ||21||

lg.l: kiñcic cāpy adhikaṃ mūtraṃ taṃ pramehiṇam ādiśet ‘tasminbheho bhaviṣyati’ iti pā.||22||

ab.seg: idānīṃ pramehahetuyuktasya puruṣasya sāmānyākāreṇa lakṣaṇamāha- pramehapūrvarūpāṇāmityādi||22||

lg.l: kṛtsnāny ardhāni vā yasmin pūrvarūpāṇi mānave |
pravṛttamūtram atyarthaṃ taṃ pramehiṇam ādirot ‘pramehaṃ taṃ vinirdiśet’ iti pā.||23||

ab.seg: pramehasya pūrvoktasāmānyalakṣaṇasya śeṣaṃ lakṣaṇamāha- kṛtsnānītyādi| gayadāsastvāpātanikāpūrvaṃ pramehapūrvarūpāṇītyādiślokamanyathā paṭhati; yathā- idānīṃ pramehapiḍakācikitsitanirdeśyamarthaṃ pañcaguṇāśrayaṃ pūrvarūpaśophapiḍakāvasthākhyaṃ pratipādayannāha- pramehapūrvarūpāṇāmityādi| tasminmeho bhaviṣyatīti mehasya tat pūrvarūpam| tatra ca pūrvarūpe'patarpaṇaṃ vanaspatikaṣāyapānādikaṃ ca kartavyam| pravṛttamūtramatyarthamiti rūpajñānam| tatra rūpacikitsāviśeṣaḥ| taduktam- “evamakurvatastasya hīna prathamakarmaguṇasya madhurāhārasya mūtraṃ svedaḥ śleṣmā ca madhurībhavati, pramehaścābhivyakto bhavati, tatrobhayataḥ saṃśodhanam; evamakurvatastasya doṣāḥ pravṛddhā māṃsaśoṇite pradūṣya śothaṃ janayantyupadravāṃśca kāṃścit, tatroktaḥ pratīkāraḥ sirāmokṣaśca; etadapyakurvataḥ piḍakāḥ, tatkarmāpyakurvataḥ pañcatvam ‘pañcamaḥ’ iti pā. ” (ci. 19) iti||23||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: idānīṃ pramehapiḍakācikitsitanirdesyamarthaṃ pañcaguṇāśrayaṃ pūrvarūpaśophapiḍikāvasthākhyaṃ pratipādayannāha- pramehapūrvarūpāṇāmitādi| tasminmeho bhaviṣyatīti mehasya tat pūrvarūpam| tatra pūrvarūpe vidite “pūrvarūpeṣvapatarpaṇaṃ vanaspatikaṣāyapānaṃ” (ci. 13) ityādi kartavyam| kṛtsnāṇyardhāni vā yasmin pūrvarūpāṇi mānave pravṛttamūtramatyarthamiti rūpajñānaṃ; yaduktaṃ- “prabhūtāvilamūtralakṣaṇāḥ sarva eva pramehāḥ” iti| atra hi pūrvarūpāṇāmapi vidyamānatvāt kiṃ pūrvarūpāṇāṃ cikitsā rūpasya vetyāha- taṃ pramehiṇamādiśediti| vyādhiprabhāvādeva sakalapūrvarūpāṇāmanuvṛttāvipi nāriṣṭatvam| tatra rūpe cikitsāviśeṣaḥ| taduktaṃ- “tatraivamakurvatasya madhurāhārasya mūtraṃ svedaḥ śleṣmā ca madhurī bhavatī, pramehaścābhivyakto bhavati| tatrobhayataḥ saṃśodhanam| evamakurvatastasyoktā doṣāḥ pravṛddhā māṃsaśoṇitaṃ pradūṣya śothaṃ janayantyupadravāṃśca kāṃścit, tatroktaḥ pratīkāraḥ sirāmokṣaśca| etadapyakurvataḥ piḍakā; tatkarmāpyakurvataḥ pañcatvameva” (ci. 12) iti||22-23||

sarvapramehāṇāmavasthāntaraprāptānāṃ sajñāntaramasadhyitvaṃ ca darśayannāha- piḍakāpīḍitamityādi| sa ceti cakāra utpattau vātajānāmasādhyatvaṃ samuccinoti| atpattau ca sahajo yāpyatvādasādhyaḥ, pittajaḥ punarasādhyataraḥ, vātajaḥ punarutpattikrameṇāsādhyatamaḥ||24||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: upadravāṇāṃ pratyekadoṣanirdiṣṭānāmaśeṣāṇāṃ ca sambhavaṃ darśayannāha- piḍakāpīḍitamityādi| gāḍhamupasṛṣṭamupadravairiti piḍakāśothavidāhe enamupadravāḥ spṛśanti, piḍakānāmupekṣayā tu gāḍhamevopasṛjyate upadravaiḥ; tathā hi piḍakācikitsita evoktam- “evamakurvatastasya doṣāḥ pravṛddhā māṃsaśoṇite pradūṣya śothaṃ janayantyupadravāṃśca kāṃścit” (ci. 12) iti| arthāt pratyekavātādijapramehanirdiṣṭān| tatroktaḥ pratīkāraḥ śothasya vimlāpanādi, dvivraṇīye cāpatarpaṇādi| tatrāpyasādhyasakalopadravaśothapiḍakaḥ sādhyatāṃ nivartate, vā'sādhyatarāsādhyatamatāmetīti piḍakācikitsita eva vistareṇa vakṣyāmaḥ| sa ceti cakāraḥ samutpattau vātajānāmasādhyatvaṃ samuccinoti, kaphajaḥ sahajo yāpyatvādasādhyaḥ, pittajaḥ punarasādhyataraḥ, vātajaḥ punarutpattikrameṇāśādhyatamaḥ; ata evopekṣāmadhumeho yāpayituṃ śakyo nāyāpanāprayoga ityeke| anye punarasādhyānāṃ niyatānāṃ vikalpo nāstīti| yata upekṣayā prayogeṇātidoṣakartukeṇa vā na praśāmyati, na punarniyatāsādhyavikalpa iti| munayo hi śabdāntareṇa prastutasya vastuno'tiśayaṃ dyotayanti na punaruktasyaiva vā, tadyathā- “hantyaṣṭādaśa kuṣṭhāni tathā'ṣṭāvudarāṇi ca” iti| tatrodarāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ vā kuṣṭhānāṃ śabdīyāsādhyatā nānenocyate, kiṃ tarhi prayogaśaktiratiśayavatīti||24||

lg.l: sa cāpi gamanāt sthānaṃ sthānād āsanam icchati |
āsanād vṛṇute śayyāṃ śayanāt svapnam icchati ‘suptumicchati’ iti pā.||25||

ab.seg: idānīṃ madhumehino vihārākhyaṃ pañcavidhikriyāśrayaṃ ‘caturvidhakriyāśrayaṃ’ iti pā. liṅgaṃ darśayannāha- sa cāpītyādi| sthānamūrdhvabhavanamicchatīti sambandhaḥ| vṛṇute prārthayate| śayanāt śayyātaḥ||25||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: tasyedānīṃ madhumehino vihārākhyaṃ caturvidhakriyāśrayaṃ liṅgaṃ darśayannāha- sa cāpi gamanādityādi| gamanasthānāsanaśayanāni hi sarveṣāmeva vihāraḥ| anyānna tathā'valambate madhumehī, kiṃ tarhi nidrāmeva kevalāmavalambate| atraiva bhojaḥ- “prabhūtamūtraḥ puruṣaḥ pūrvarūpairupadrutaḥ| pramīḍha iti vijñeyo, madhumehī tu vakṣyate|| yasya gātre pramīḍhasya piḍakā jāyate bhṛśam| madhumehī sa vijñeyo yuktaścopadravairbhṛśam” iti||25||

yathā hi varṇānāṃ ‘śuklādivarṇānāṃ’ iti tā. pañcānām utkarṣāpakarṣakṛtena saṃyogaviśeṣeṇa śabalababhrukapilakapotamecakādīnāṃ varṇānām anekeṣām utpattir bhavati, evam eva doṣadhātumalāhāraviśeṣeṇotkarṣāpakarṣakṛtena saṃyogaviśeṣeṇa pramehāṇāṃ nānākaraṇaṃ bhavati ||26||

idānīṃ doṣāṇāṃ trayāṇāmapi yathā viṃśatipramehasambhavastathopamānenāha- yatetyādi| pañcānāṃ varṇānāṃ sitaharitakṛṣṇapītaraktānām| utkarṣāpakarṣakṛtena vṛddhihrāsakṛtena| babhruḥ kapilapiṅgalaḥ, kapotaḥ kapotābhaḥ, mecakaḥ śyāmalaḥ| malagrahaṇamupadhātubhūtavasālasīkayorudakasya copalakṣaṇam||26||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: idānīṃ doṣatritvāt tribhireva mehairbhavitavyaṃ, bhedo hi bhedavatāṃ kāraṇabhedāt kāryāṇāṃ vā svadharmabhedādbhavatīti kāraṇānāmeva vātādīnāṃ doṣadhātumalāhāraviśeṣeṇa kāryāṇāṃ pramehāṇāṃ bhedaṃ darśayannāha- yathā hītyādi| viśeṣayati parasparato vyāvartayatīti viśeṣaḥ, tena| sa ca kaphādīnāṃ svako guṇaḥ, tathā rasaraktamāṃsamedomajjaśukraujasāṃ ca svaguṇaḥ| malagrahaṇamupadhātubhūtavasālasīkodakasyopalakṣaṇam| āhāraścāpyatraiva ‘medyadravānnapānasevinaṃ’ ityuktaḥ| evameva vyādhisamuddeśīye'pyuktaṃ- “doṣadhātumalasaṃsargādāyatanaviśeṣānnimittaścaiṣāṃ vikalpaḥ” (sū. 24) iti| tatrāyatanaṃ parityajyāhāreṇa vihāramupalakṣya sakala eva vyādhisamuddeśīyokto'rthaḥ pratipāditaḥ||26||

bhavati cātra-
sarva eva pramehās tu kālenāpratikurvataḥ ‘apratikāriṇaḥ’ iti pā.|
madhumehatvam āyānti tadā 'sādhyā bhavanti hi ||27||
idānīṃ sarveṣveva prameheṣu pūrvarūpādīnāmupekṣālakṣaṇamanarthaṃ darśayannāha- bhavati cātretyādi| kālaḥ prathamakriyākālādikaḥ| apratikurvataḥ apratikriyamāṇasya||27||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: tatra sarveṣveva prameheṣu pūrvarūpādīnāmupekṣaṇalakṣaṇamanarthaṃ darśayannāha- sarva eva pramehāstvityādi||27||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne pramehanidānaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ ||6||
iti śrīḍahla(lha)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nidānasthāne ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ||6||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: iti sauśrute śalyatantre śrīgayadāsaviracitāyāṃ nyāyacandrikāyāṃ pañjikāyāṃ nidānasthāne pramehanidānaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ||6||

div.head: udaranidānam

ab.seg: athāta udarāṇāṃ nidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi||1-2||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: pramehānantaramudarārambhaḥ, udakavahasrotoduṣṭisambhavasāmānyāt, tridoṣajasādharmyānmahāvyādhitvasāmānyācca||1-2||

lg.l: dhanvantarir dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭho rājarṣir indrapratimo 'bhavad yaḥ ‘babhūva’ iti pā.|
brahmarṣiputraṃ vinayopapannaṃ śiṣyaṃ śubhaṃ suśrutam anvaśāt saḥ ||3||

ab.seg: yo dhanvantarirabhavat sa suśrutamanvaśāditi sambandhaḥ, śikṣitavānityarthaḥ| dharmabhṛtāṃ dhārmikāṇāṃ madhye| indrapratimo jñānaiśvaryādibhiḥ| brahmarṣirviśvāmitraḥ, rājarṣirapi tapasā brahmarṣitvaṃ prāptavān| vinayopapannaṃ jitendriyam| śubhamiti pūrvoktairanvayavayaḥśīlādiguṇairupetam||3||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: brahmarṣiputramiti viśvāmitro hi rājarṣireva brahmarṣitvaṃ tapasā gataḥ| vinayopapannamityanena vinayānvitena guravaḥ praṣṭavyāḥ, vinītasyaivānuśāsanaṃ kartavyamiti darśayati||3||

lg.l: pṛthak samastair api ceha doṣaiḥ plīhodaraṃ baddhagudaṃ tathaiva |
āgantukaṃ saptamam aṣṭamaṃ ca dakodaraṃ ceti vadanti tāni ||4||

ab.seg: udarāṇāṃ saṅkhyāmāha- pṛthagityādi| pṛthagdoṣaistrīṇi, samastairdoṣairekam; etena catvāri doṣapradhānāni| iheti asmiñchāstre| tānīti udarāṇītyarthaḥ| plīhodarādīni catvāri dūṣyapradhānāni| aṣṭamamiti saṅkhyoktyā plīhodarayakṛddālyudarayoraikyameva jñātavyam||4||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: tatra doṣaiścatvāri pṛthagekaśastrīṇi, sānnipātikaṃ ca dūṣyodaramityabhihitam| plīhodaramiti plīhodara eva yakṛdudbhavamapyavarudhyate, hetuliṅgacikitsitasāmānyāt| tatra plīhodare doṣau kaphapitte, dūṣyaṃ raktam| baddhagudamāgantuviśeṣaḥ, pṛthagliṅgacikitsitabhedāt| kṣatāntramapyāgantunimittaṃ kṣataje'bhihitam| dakodaram udakodaram, udakanimittaṃ srotovarodhajātam||4||

lg.l: snehādimithyācaraṇāc ca jantor vṛddhiṃ gatāḥ koṣṭham abhiprapannāḥ ||5||

ab.seg: udarāṇāṃ hetuṃ darśayannāha- sudurbalāgneritādi durbalāgneḥ atyantanaṣṭāgneḥ| ahitāśanasyeti viruddhasamaśanādhyaśanaviṣamāśanasya| snehādītyādiśabdādvamanavirecanāsthāpanānuvāsanaparigrahaḥ| mithyācaraṇaṃ yathoktānuṣṭānaparityāgaḥ| jantoḥ prāṇinaḥ| abhiprapannāḥ prāptā ityarthaḥ| kiṃviśiṣṭānyudaraṇi kurvanti? gulmākṛtivyañjitalakṣaṇāni gulmākṛtyā gulmarūpeṇa vyañjitāni prakaṭitāni lakṣaṇāni yeṣāṃ tāni tathā| punarapi kiṃviśiṣṭāni? ghorāṇi kṛcchratamāni||5||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: sthānasaṃśrayasyaiva samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- sadurbalāgnerityādi| ahitāśanasya durbalāgneriti- yadyapi hi vahnermāndyanimittānyanyānyapi santi, tathā'pyahitāśanamevāgnimāndyakāriṣu pradhānam| koṣṭhaṃ gatā iti sthānasaṃśrayaḥ| koṣṭhasthasattve'pi nātiśarīrādīnāmatinivṛttiḥ, udakavahasrotorodhaduṣṭisattvāt, sudurbalāgnitvādidoṣavat(?)| gulmākṛtivyañjitalakṣaṇāni gulmākṛtyā gulmarūpeṇa vardhate| tasya prāgutpattyākṛtirapi gulmena samānā||5||

lg.l: tvacaḥ samunnamya śanaiḥ samantād vivardhamāno jaṭharaṃ karoti |7|

ab.seg: samprāpti darśayannāha- koṣṭhādityādi| upasnehavaditi navaghaṭādyupasneho ‘navaghaṭādyupasnehe’ iti pā. yathā'ṇutamasrotobhirbahiḥsravad ‘bahiḥsrāvaḥ’ iti pā. dṛśyate tadvat koṣṭhādannasāro'nnaraso niḥsṛtya, śanaiḥ krameṇa, jaṭharamudarākhyaṃ rogaṃ karotīti sambandhaḥ| koṣṭhaśabdenātrāhārapākādhāra ucyate| kimbhūto'nnasāraḥ? duṣṭaḥ| punaḥ kimbhūtaḥ? anilaveganunno vātavegapreritaḥ| kiṃ kṛtvā? tvacaḥ samunnamya ānaddhāḥ kṛtvā| punaḥ kimbhūto rasaḥ? samantādvivardhamānaḥ samantāt sarvato vṛddhiṃ gacchan||6||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: sādhāraṇāṃ samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- koṣṭhādityādi| annasāro rasaḥ| koṣṭhānniḥsṛtyeti koṣṭhaśabdenāhārapākādhāro rasadoṣamūtrapurīṣavibhāgāśrayo grahaṇyabhidhāna ucyate, tatraiva sārākhyarasavibhāgāt| kathaṃ punaretat koṣṭhādantrāṇāṃ randhrābhāvādannarasasya niḥsaraṇamityāha- upasnehavat| nūtanaghaṭādupasneho yathā'ṇubhirbahiḥsrotobhirbahiḥ- sravad dṛśyate tadvat| yadyevaṃ nityamevodarāṇāṃ samprāptiḥ prāpnoti, upasnehena satatamevānnarasasya bahirnirgamanāt; naitadasti, udarārambhakadoṣadūṣitaśarīrasya rasasvedāmbuvahānāṃ srotasāṃ duṣṭeḥ, duṣṭiścaiteṣāṃ saṃvṛttamukhatvena vinivṛttamukhatvena ca; taduktaṃ carake- “svedavāhiṣu duṣṭeṣu pāruṣyaṃ lomaharṣaṇam| atisvedo na vā svedo paridāhaśca jāyate” iti| yadyevamata eva sroto'varodhānniḥsaraṇamavāpnoti| yathā''ha carakaḥ- “ruddhā svedāmbuvāhīni doṣāḥ srotāṃsi sañcitāḥ| prāṇāgnyapānān sandūṣya janayantyudaraṃ nṛṇām” (ca. ci. 13) iti| svedāmbuvāhisroto'varodhe punarambhaḥ| yadāha carakaḥ- “svedastu bāhyeṣu srotaḥsu pratihatagatistiryagavatiṣṭhamānastadevodakamāpyāyayati” (ca. ci. 13) iti| ata eva sarvāṅgakārśyamudariṇāmudarasya punaḥ pūrṇataiva| tasya dūṣyasya doṣān vinā vikārakāritā nāstītyāha- anilaveganunnastvacaḥ samunnamyeti| vṛddherayaṃ hetuḥ| sravan samantādannasāro'bhivardhamāno jaṭharamudaraṃ karoti| taduktaṃ carake- “mande'gnau malinairbhuktairapākāddoṣasañcayaḥ” (ca. ci. 13) ityādi||6||

lg.l: jīrṇāparijñānavidāhavatyo bastau rujaḥ pādagataś ca śophaḥ |8|

div.ab: pūrvarūpamāha- tadityādi| vināśaśabdo balādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| kāṅkṣā annābhilāṣaḥ| valī tvaksaṅkocaḥ| rājyo rekhāḥ ‘bhavanti’ iti śeṣaḥ| jīrṇāparijñānavidāhavatyo bastau ruja iti jīrṇāparijñānavidāhau vidyete yāsu bastirujāsu tāstathā| jīrṇāparijñānamannapariṇāmāniścayaḥ; jīrṇāparijñānaṃ tu yathāsambhavatvāt puruṣasyaiva jñeyam||7||-

lg.l: saśūlam ānāhavad ugraśabdaṃ satodabhedaṃ pavanātmakaṃ tat |9|

div.ab: vātodaramāha- saṅgṛhyetyādi||8||-

lg.l: yac coṣatṛṣṇājvaradāhayuktaṃ pītaṃ sirā bhānti ca yatra pītāḥ ||9||

div.ab: pittodaramāha- yadityādi| acirābhivṛddhi śīghravardhanaśīlam||9||-

lg.l: yac chītalaṃ śuklasirāvanaddhaṃ guru sthiraṃ śuklanakhānanasya ||10||
snigdhaṃ mahac chophayutaṃ sasādaṃ kaphodaraṃ tat tu cirābhivṛddhi |11|

div.ab: śleṣmodaramāha- yacchītalamityādi| sthiraṃ kaṭhinam| sasādamaṅgaglāniyuktam||10||-

lg.l: yasmai prayacchanty arayo garāṃś ca duṣṭāmbudūṣīviṣasevanād vā |
tenāśu raktaṃ kupitāś ca doṣāḥ kurvanti ghoraṃ jaṭharaṃ triliṅgam ||12||

tac chītavātābhrasamudbhaveṣu ‘tacchītavāte bhṛśadurdine ca’ iti pā.| ‘tacchītavātātapadurdineṣu’ iti tā. viśeṣataḥ kupyati dahyate ca sa cāturo mūrcchati samprasaktaṃ pāṇḍuḥ kṛśaḥ śuṣyati tṛṣṇayā ca ||13||
prakīrtitaṃ ‘dūṣyodaraṃ kīrtitametadeva’ iti tā. dūṣyudaraṃ tu ghoraṃ ... |14|

ab.seg: sannipātodaramāha- striya ityādi| striyo'nnapānaṃ nakharomamūtraviḍārtavayuktaṃ yasmai puruṣāya prayacchanti dadati| kimbhūtāḥ striyaḥ? asādhuvṛttā durācārāḥ| strīgrahaṇamatropalakṣaṇaṃ, tenānye'pi sannihitā avivekino grāhyāḥ| arayaḥ śatravaḥ| garān kṛtrimaviṣāṇi yasmai prayacchanti| duṣṭāmbu saviṣamatsyādisambandhāt| viṣameva dāvāgnivātātapādyabhibhavena mandatāṃ gataṃ viṣapītasya vā viṣaṃ dūṣīviṣaṃ; tena nakharomādinā viṣakalpena gareṇa dūṣīviṣeṇa vā''śu śīghraṃ raktaṃ kupitamiti boddhavyam| triliṅgaṃ vātapittaśleṣmaliṅgam| samprasaktaṃ nirantaram| dūṣyudaramiti yadeva sānnipātikodaraṃ tadeva dūṣyudaram, etena na saṅkhyātirekaḥ| ghoraṃ bhayānakaṃ, punarghoraṃ kaṣṭakāri||11-13||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: duṣṭāmbudūṣīviṣasevanādveti dūṣīviṣaṃ viṣameva dāvāgnivātātapādyabhibhavena mandatāṃ gatam| tenāśu raktaṃ kupitaṃ viṣasya raktadūṣaṇasvabhāvatvāt, āśukāritvācca| tat śītādiṣu viśeṣeṇa kupyati, dūṣīviṣakopasya tatraiva darśitatvāt| mūrcchatīti viṣasya mūrcchākaratvāt, prasaktaṃ nirantaraṃ mūrcchati| pāṇḍuśca bhavati, raktadoṣāt| dūṣyodarametadeva sānnipātikodaraṃ yadeva tadeva dūṣyodaram| etena na saṅkhyātirekaḥ| dūṣyantīti dūṣyāḥ, “kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam” (pā. a. 3/3/13) iti kapratyayaḥ; tasyodaraṃ, tena kṛtatvāt| atra bhojaḥ- “nakhalomārtavairyuktamannapānaṃ yadā striyaḥ| vaśīkartuṃ prayacchanti tadviṣatvāya kalpate|| dūṣīviṣaṃ sevitaṃ vā tasya raktaṃ prakopayet| raktaṃ viṣeṇa sanduṣṭaṃ trīn doṣān tattu kopayet” iti||7-13||

lg.l: vidāhyabhiṣyandiratasya jantoḥ praduṣṭam atyartham asṛk kaphaś ca ||14||
plīhābhivṛddhiṃ satataṃ karoti plīhodaraṃ tat pravadanti tajjñāḥ |
vāme ca pārśve parivṛddhim eti viśeṣataḥ sīdati cāturo 'tra ||15||

ab.seg: nibodha jānīhi| abhiṣyandi doṣadhātumalasrotasāṃ kledaprāptijanakam| asṛk kaphaśceti asṛggrahaṇena pittasyāpi grahaṇam| plīhā udarasya vāmapārśvasthitaḥ| eti gacchati| sīdati aṅgaglāniyukto bhavati| atra plīhodare||14-15||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: plīhodare vidāhiratatvena raktapittaṃ, tasya pittasya liṅgaṃ mando jvaraḥ; abhiṣyandiratatvena kaphaḥ, talliṅgaṃ mandāgnitvam||14-15||

lg.l: savyetarasmin yakṛti praduṣṭe jñeyaṃ yakṛddālyudaraṃ tad eva ||16||

ab.seg: yakṛddālyudarasya plīhodare evāvarodhaṃ darśayannāha- savyetarasminnityādi| savyetarasmin dakṣiṇapārśve| tadeva plīhodaraṃ yakṛddālyudaraṃ jñeyam| kva jñeyamityāha- yakṛti kālakhaṇḍe; kimbhūte? praduṣṭe; etena na saṅkhyātirekaḥ||16||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: yakṛddālyudarasya plīhodara evāvarodhaṃ darśayannāha- savyetare ityādi| svyetare dakṣiṇe| tadeva plīhodarameva||16||

lg.l: yasyāntram annair upalepibhir vā bālāśmabhir vā sahitaiḥ ‘pihitaṃ yathāvat’ iti pā. pṛthag vā |
sañcīyate tatra malaḥ sadoṣaḥ krameṇa nāḍyām iva saṅkaro hi ||17||
nirudhyate cāsya gude purīṣaṃ nireti kṛcchrād api cālpam alpam |
hṛnnābhimadhye parivṛddhim eti ta(ya)c codaraṃ viṭsamagandhikaṃ ca ||18||

ab.seg: baddhagudaṃ darśayannāha- yasyetyādi| yasya puruṣasya antraṃ nirudhyata iti sambandhaḥ| kairnirudhyata ityāha- annairityādi| upalepibhiḥ picchilādibhiḥ| vā atra samuccaye| sahitairiti ekatra militaiḥ samuditairityarthaḥ| pṛthagveti ekaikairityarthaḥ| malaḥ purīṣam| sadoṣo doṣatrayasahitaḥ| nāḍyāṃ praṇālikāyām| saṅkaro'vakaraḥ, pracuratṛṇādisamūha ityarthaḥ| nireti niḥsarati| baddhagudī vibhāvyaḥ sa puruṣo baddhagudī jñeyaḥ||17-18||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: baddhagudaṃ darśayannāha- yasyāntramannairityādi| upalepibhiḥ picchilādibhiḥ| pihitaṃ yathāvat sakalamityarthaḥ| malaḥ purīṣam| sadoṣaḥ saha doṣairvātādirvartata iti| purīṣamantre krameṇa cīyate saṅkaravat, doṣaireva miśrīkṛtatvāt| taduktaṃ carake- “varcaḥpittakaphān ruddhvā janayatyudaraṃ tataḥ” (ca. ci. 13) iti| atra pā(va)kasthāne antrasya purīṣāyatanasya ruddhatvāt bahu(ddha)gudasambandhamantraṃ gudamucyate| taduktaṃ carake- “pakṣmabālaiḥ sahānnena bhuktairbaddhāyane gude” iti (ca. ci. 13)||17-18||

lg.l: śalyaṃ yad annopahitaṃ tad antraṃ bhinatti yasyāgatam anyathā vā ||19||
tasmāt sruto 'ntrāt salilaprakāśaḥ srāvaḥ sraved vai gudatas tu bhūyaḥ |
nābher adhaś codaram eti vṛddhiṃ nistudyate 'tīva vidahyate ca ||20||

ab.seg: parisrāvyudaramāha- tata ityādi| yacchalyamannopahitamannasambaddhaṃ bhuktaṃ, tadantraṃ bhinatti vidārayati| yasya puruṣasya| śalyaṃ śarkarākāṣṭhāsthikaṇṭakādikam| āgatamanyathā veti vāśabdo'vadhāraṇe, tenānyathaiva vilomena tiryagevāgataṃ, natvanulomena| sruto galitaḥ||19-20||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: kṣatāntraṃ nirdiśannāha- śalyaṃ yadannopahitamityādi| śalyaṃ śarkarātṛṇakāṣṭhāsthikaṇṭakādi| annopahitaṃ bhuktaṃ pakvāśayādanyathā vilomenāgataṃ, tadantraṃ bhinatti vidārayati| antrāt srutaḥ salilaprakāśaḥ srāvo bhūyo bahuśca, doṣajeṣu punarupasnehasrāveṇālpa eva gudataśca sravate| antrasrāvasya bahirgatatvāt kathaṃ gudataśca srāvaḥ? ucyate- salilabāhulyena tenaiva chidreṇa salilasya pratyāgatvādupasnehādgudasrāvaḥ; taduktaṃ carake- “pūrayan gudamantraṃ ca janayatyudaraṃ tataḥ” (ca. ci. 13) iti| tatastasmāt srāvānnābheradho jaṭharaṃ vṛddhimeti, jalasyādhogāmitvāt| chidrodarajalodarayoradūradoṣatrayavyapadeśaḥ| tathā''ha chidrodare eva carakaḥ- “tadadhonābheḥ prāyo'bhinirvartamānaṃ jalodaraṃ syād, yathābalaṃ ca doṣāṇāṃ rūpāṇi darśayati” (ca. ci. 13) iti| chidrodarajalodarayoradūradoṣatrayayorapi todādivedanā vāyunā mārgāvaraṇādikupitena||19-20||

lg.l: yaḥ snehapīto 'py anuvāsito vā vānto virikto 'py athavā nirūḍhaḥ ||21||
pibej jalaṃ śītalam āśu tasya srotāṃsi duṣyanti hi tadvahāni |
snehopalipteṣv athavā 'pi teṣu dakodaraṃ pūrvavad abhyupaiti ||22||
snigdhaṃ mahat samparivṛttanābhi bhṛśonnataṃ pūrṇam ivāmbunā ca |
yathā dṛtiḥ kṣubhyati kampate ca śabdāyate cāpi dakodaraṃ ‘cāpyudakodaraṃ tat’ iti pā. tat ||23||

ab.seg: udakodaramāha- dakodaramityādi| dakodaram udakodaramityarthaḥ| tadvahāni toyavahāni| snehopalipteṣvathavā'pi teṣviti snehādipānaṃ vinā'pi teṣu srotaḥsu snehopalipteṣu yadā śītalaṃ jalaṃ pibettadā'pītyarthaḥ| pūrvavaditi kṣatāntrodare yathā salilasyādhogāmitvādadho nābherudarotpattiryathā ca gudādāsrāvastadvaditi; jejjaṭena punaḥ ‘pūrvavadityatrānyānyudarāṇi yathā bhavanti tathedamapi’ iti vyākhyātaṃ, tannecchati gayī| parivṛttanābhi| ucchalitanābhi| dṛtiḥ khallā| kṣubhyati calati| kampate ceti kampanamatiśayena calanam||21-23||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: dakodaraṃ darśayannāha- yaḥ snehapīta ityādi| yaḥ śītalamāśu jalaṃ pibet tasya snehapānānuvāsino'ntaḥsnehāvaliptasrotaso'tiśayavatī srotoduṣṭiḥ syāt; vāntaviriktanirūḍhāṇāmatiriktabhāvena vivṛtasrotasāṃ pūrvakarmapradhānakarmamandāgnīnāmatyambusevayā salilavahasrotasāṃ klomamūlānāṃ duṣṭirabhyupeyāt| dakodare eva samprāptivikalpaṃ darśayannāha- snehopalipteṣvityādi| athavā vinā'pi snehādipānaṃ śītalasalilasevākṛtāmudarasrotoduṣṭiḥ, snehopalipteṣvathavā'pi teṣu srotaḥsu dakodaramabhyupeti| pūrvavaditi pūrvavat kṣatāntrodare yathā salilasyādhogāmitvādadhonābherudarābhinirvṛttiḥ| taduktaṃ jalodare eva carake- “tasya rūpāṇi- anne'nākāṅkṣā pipāsā gudasrāvaḥ” ityādi| srotasāṃ duṣṭatvena bahirūpasnehena jalaniḥsaraṇaṃ sarveṣveva samam| pūrvavacchabdasyānya evārtho na punarvyākhyātaḥ||21-23||

lg.l: dāhas tṛṣṇā ca sarveṣu jaṭhareṣu bhavanti hi ||24||

ab.seg: teṣāmaṣṭānāmapi sāmānyaṃ liṅgaṃ darśayannāha- ādhmānamityādi| jejjaṭena punarete upadravā vyākhyātāḥ; tannecchati gayī||24||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: teṣāmaṣṭānāmapi sāmānyaliṅgaṃ darśayannāha- ādhmānamityādi| jaḍena (jejjaṭena) upadravā ete vyākhyātāḥ; tanna, carake vyādhīnāmapi rogasambhavānāmupadravatvena niṣiddhatvāt||24||

lg.l: ante salilabhāvaṃ hi bhajante jaṭharāṇi tu |
sarvāṇy eva parīpākāt tadā tāni ‘vidhyettyajeta vā’ iti pā. vivarjayet ||25||

ab.seg: sādhyāsādhyavibhāgamāha- anta ityādi| paripākāt pariṇāmena dakodaratā sarveṣāmeva; anyānyudarāṇi paripākādudakabhāvaṃ bhajante, dakodaraṃ prāgeveti viśeṣaḥ||25||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: sādhyāsādhyavibhāgāyāha- ante salilabhāvamityādi| paripākāt parimāṇena jalodaratā sarveṣāmeva| upasnehena niḥsṛtāntra(nna)rasātivṛddhena| sarveṣāmeva upasnehena niḥsṛtāntrarasamūlatvāttadeva kathamanudakatvaṃ? naiṣa doṣaḥ, tatra hyupekṣayā nātimandatvādagneḥ svalpatvāt prāgudarasyānudakatvamityucyate, alpatve'tadvyapadeśāt| tasya ca lakṣaṇaṃ carakeṇoktam- “aśothamaruṇābhāsaṃ saśabdaṃ nātibhārikam| sadā guḍaguḍāvacca sirājālagavākṣitam| nābhiṃ viṣṭabhya pāyau tu vegaṃ kṛtvā praṇaśyati| hṛdvaṅkṣaṇakaṭīnābhigudapratyekaśūlinaḥ|| karkaśaṃ sṛjato vātaṃ nāti mande ca pāvake| lolasyāvirase cāsye mūtre'lpe saṃhate viṣi| ajātodakamityetairyuktaṃ vijñāya lakṣaṇaiḥ| upācaret”- (ca. ci. 13) ityādi| ataḥ paramupasnehavanniḥsṛto'nnaraso nātyacchapicchilākāreṇa sambhavatyudare, sā punaravasthā pacyamānānāmudarāṇām| taduktaṃ carake- “tatra picchotpattau maṇḍalamudaraṃ guru stimitaṃ bhṛśamātatamākoṭitamaśabdaṃ mṛdusparśamapagatarājīkamākrāntaṃ nābhyāṃ parisarpati” (ca. ci. 13) iti| ataḥ paraṃ jātodakamudaraṃ; tasya lakṣaṇamudakodaranirdiṣṭaṃ “snigdhaṃ mahatsamparivṛtanābhi bhṛśonnataṃ pūrṇamivāmbunā ca” iti| carake'pi- “tasya rūpāṇi kukṣeratimātraṃ vṛddhiḥ sirāntardhānagamanamudakapūrṇadṛtisamasaṅkṣobhasparśaṃ ca bhavati| tathāvidhamacikitsyaṃ vidyāt (ca. ci. 13) iti||25||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne udaranidānaṃ nāma saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||7||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nidānasthāne saptamo'dhyāyaḥ||7||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: iti sauśrute śalyatantre śrīgayadāsaviracitāyāṃ nyāyacandrikāyāṃ pañjikāyāṃ nidānasthāne udarāṇāṃ nidānam||
athāto mūḍhagarbhanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi| mūḍho niruddhagatiḥ| taduktaṃ- ‘sarvāvayavasampūrṇo manobuddhyādisaṃyutaḥ| viguṇāpānasammūḍho mūḍhagarbho'bhidhīyate”- iti||1-2||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: athāto mūḍhagarbhanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| udarānantaraṃ mūḍhagarbhanidānārambhaḥ, udarasthāne cchinne śastrakarmasādhyatvasāmānyāt, mahāvyādhitvasāmānyācca| mūḍhaścāsau garbhaśceti mūḍhagarbhaḥ| mūḍho vyāsaktagatiḥ| tathā hi carakaḥ- “mūḍhavātānulomanaṃ” iti, tathā'trāpyanirgacchantamanilasammohitamiti||1-2||

grāmyadharmayānavāhanādhvagamanapraskhalanaprapatanaprapīḍanadhāvanābhighātaviṣamaśayanāsanopavāsavegābhighātātirūkṣa- kaṭutiktabhojanaśokātikṣārasevanātisāravamanavirecanapreṅkholanājīrṇagarbhaśātanaprabhṛtibhir viśeṣair bandhanān mucyate garbhaḥ, phalam iva vṛntabandhanād abhighātaviśeṣaiḥ; sa vimuktabandhano garbhāśayam atikramya yakṛtplīhāntravivarair avasraṃsamānaḥ koṣṭhasaṅkṣobham āpādayati, tasyā jaṭharasaṅkṣobhād vāyur apāno mūḍhaḥ pārśvabastiśīrṣodarayoniśūlānāhamūtrasaṅgānām anyatamam āpadya garbhaṃ cyāvayati ‘vyāpādayati’ iti pā. taruṇaṃ śoṇitasrāveṇa; tam eva kadācid vivṛddham asamyagāgatam apatyapatham anuprāptam anirasyamānaṃ viguṇāpānasammohitaṃ garbhaṃ mūḍhagarbham ity ācakṣate ||3||

tasya hetuṃ darśayannāha- grāmyadharmetyādi| grāmyadharmo maithunaṃ, yānaṃ rathādi, vāhanamaśvādi, adhvagamanaṃ padbhyāṃ mārgagamanaṃ, praskhalanamākhuḍanādi, prapatanaṃ prāsādādeḥ sakāśādatiśayena patanaṃ, prapīḍanamatiśayena pīḍanaṃ, pradhāvanamatiśayena dhāvanam, abhighātaḥ śastraloṣṭakaśādibhiḥ prahāraḥ, vegābhighāto vātādyavarodhaḥ, preṅkholanaṃ hindolanaṃ, garbhaśātanaṃ bheṣajena garbhapātanam| kecidetadgadyamanyathā paṭhanti, tattvabhāvānna likhitam| bandhanamatra ‘bandhanānnābhināḍībandhanāt’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ garbhāśayapratibaddhāḥ sirāḥ peśyaśca| mocane upamānamāha- phalamityādi| etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati- yathā vṛkṣe'paripakvaṃ phalamabhighātairakāla eva patati, tadvadyathoktapātanahetusāmarthyādaprasavakāla eva garbhaḥ patati| atikramya ullaṅghya| vivaraiḥ antarālaiḥ| avasraṃsamānaḥ adhaḥ patan| koṣṭhaśabdenāmāśayapakvāśayādisthānam| saṅkṣobhaścalanam| tasyāḥ striyāḥ| mūḍho vimārgagāmī ‘vimārgavatīṃ’ iti pā.| anyatamam ekatamam| āpādya nirvartya| taruṇaṃ garbhamapāno mūḍhaḥ san cyāvayatīti ‘vyāpādayatītyarthaḥ’ iti pā. sambandhaḥ| taruṇam aghanāṅgamavyaktacetanam| mūḍhagarbhasya niruktimāha- tamevetyādi| asamyagāgataṃ vilomabhāgenāgatam, avāggamanāt| apatyapathaṃ yonim| anuprāptam āśritam| anirasyamānam aniḥsarantam| sammohitaṃ mūrcchitam||3||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: tasya hetuṃ darśayannāha- grāmyadharmetyādi| grāmyadharmo vyavāyaḥ, yātyaneneti pānaṃ rathādi, vāhyata iti vāhanamaśvādi| praskhalanaṃ samucchritādeḥ| prapatanaṃ prapātādeḥ| atra grāmyadharmādayo vegavighātāntā vihāraviśeṣāḥ, atirūkṣādayaḥ punarajīrṇāntā āhāraviśeṣāḥ| garbhaśātanaṃ bheṣajena garbhapātanam| ... tasya kṣobhaḥ koṣṭhasaṅkṣobhaḥ| vāyurapāno mūḍhaḥ vimārgavartī| taruṇam aghanāṅgamavyaktacetanam||3||

tataḥ kīlaḥ ‘saṅkīlaḥ’ iti pā. pratikhuro bījakaḥ parigha iti | tatra, ūrdhvabāhuśiraḥpādo yo yonimukhaṃ niruṇaddhi kīla iva sa kīlaḥ; niḥsṛtahastapādaśirāḥ kāyasaṅgī pratikhuraḥ; yo nirgacchaty ekaśirobhujaḥ sa bījakaḥ; yas tu parigha iva yonimukham āvṛtya tiṣṭhati sa parighaḥ; iti caturvidho bhavatīty eke bhāṣante | tat tu na samyak; kasmāt? sa yadā viguṇānilaprapīḍito 'patyapatham anekadhā prapadyate tadā saṅkhyā hīyate ||4||

tasya cāturvidhyamāha- tata ityādi| tataḥ asamyagāgamanāt| tān prakārān prakaṭayannāha- tatrordhvabāhuśira ityādi| kāyasaṅgī niruddhakāyaḥ| ekaśirobhuja iti eko bhujaḥ śirasā saha yasya nirgacchatītyarthaḥ| parigha iveti parigho'rgalādaṇḍaḥ||4||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: “adhaḥ pārśvagato vā'pi tathaivākuñcito'pi vā| yo niḥsṛtya mukhaṃ yonerjñeyaḥ pratikhurastu saḥ|| yonidvārāttu nirgacchedyasyaikāṃśaśirobhujam| tamāhurbījakaṃ nāma mūḍhagarbhacikitsakāḥ|| yonimāśri(vṛ)tya yastiṣṭhet parigho gopuraṃ yathā| tathā'ntagarbhamāyantaṃ vidyāt parighasañjñakam” ityeṣāṃ caturṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ paripaṭhyate nāgārjunīyāt||4||

tatra, kaścid dvābhyāṃ sakthibhyāṃ yonimukhaṃ pratipadyate; kaścid ābhugnaikasakthir ekena; kaścid ābhugnasakthiśarīraḥ sphigdeśena tiryag āgataḥ; kaścid uraḥpārśvapṛṣṭhānām anyatamena yonidvāraṃ pidhāyāvatiṣṭhate; antaḥpārśvāpavṛttaśirāḥ kaścid ekena bāhunā; kaścid ābhugnaśirā bāhudvayena; kaścid ābhugnamadhyo hastapādaśirobhiḥ; kaścid ekena sakthnā yonimukhaṃ pratipadyate 'pareṇa pāyum; ity aṣṭavidhā mūḍhagarbhagatir uddiṣṭā samāsena ||5||

tānevānekaprakārān darśayannāha- tatretyādi| ābhugnaṃ saṅkucitam| ekena sakthnā ‘yonimukhaṃ pratipadyate’ iti sambandhanīyam| ābhugnaṃ sakthiśarīraṃ yasyetyarthaḥ| ‘yonimukhaṃ pratipadyate’ ityatrāpi sambandhanīyam| pidhāya ācchādya| antaḥpārśvāpavṛttaśirāḥ pārśvamadhyanikṣiptaśirāḥ| ekena bāhunā ‘yonimukhaṃ pratipadyate’ iti sambandhanīyam| kaścidityādi atrāpi ‘yonimukhaṃ pratipadyate’ iti sambandhanīyam| kaścidābhugnamadhya ityādi ‘yonimukhaṃ pratipadyate’ ityatrāpi sambandhanīyam| samāsenāṣṭavidhā vistareṇa tu tiryaggrīvorujaṅghāprakāreṇānantāḥ||5||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: catuḥsaṅkhyāprakārān tānevānekaprakārānnidarśayannāha- tatra kaściddvābhyāmityādi| samāsenāṣṭavidhāḥ, vistareṇa tiryaggrīvorujaṅghāprakāreṇānantāḥ||5||
tatra dvāv antyāv asādhyau mūḍhagarbhau, śeṣān api viparītendriyārthākṣepakayonibhraṃśasaṃvaraṇamakkallaśvāsakāsabhramanipīḍitān ‘… kṣepakavātavikārayonibhraṃśa ...’ iti pā. pariharet ||6||

teṣvasādhyānnirdiśannāha- tatretyādi| dvāvantyau saptamāṣṭamāvasādhyau svabhāvenaiva| anyeṣvapyavasthayā'sādhyatvaṃ darśayannāha- śeṣānapītyādi| viparītendriyārthādibhiḥ pīḍitā jananī yairmūḍhagarbhaiste tathāvidhāstān| viparītendriyārthā rūpādyarthagrahaṇabhrāntāḥ| yonibhraṃśo yonibahirgamanam| yonisaṃvaraṇaṃ yonisaṅkocaḥ| prasūtāyā vāyurasṛgārodhya bastiśiraḥprabhṛtiṣu śūlaṃ karoti sa makkallaḥ| bhramaścakrādhirūḍhasyeva bhramaṇam||6||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: teṣvasādhyānnirdiśannāha- teṣu dvāvityādi| tatraitau svabhāvenaivāsādhyau| anyeṣvapyavasthāmātrāsādhyatāṃ darśayannāha- śeṣānapītyādi| viparītendriyārthā rūpādyarthagrahaṇabhrāntāḥ| yonibhraṃśo'dhonirgamaḥ| yonisaṃvaraṇaṃ parāsaṅgaḥ, sa ca garbhiṇīvyākaraṇīye vyākhyātaḥ| makkallastu prasūtāyā vāyurasṛgārodhya bastiśiraḥprabhṛtiṣu śūlaṃ karoti sa makkallaḥ ‘makkallaḥ’ iti pā., tatsambhūto'pi vidradhirmakkallaḥ||6||

bhavanti ‘bhavanti cātra’ iti hastalikhitapustake na paṭhyate cātra-
kālasya pariṇāmena muktaṃ vṛntād yathā phalam |
prapadyate svabhāvena nānyathā patituṃ dhruvam ||7||

svabhāvaprajananakāle yathā mūḍhagarbho na bhavati tathā ślokadvayena darśayannāha- kālasyetyādi| yathā kālasya pariṇāmena kālakṛtaparipākena vṛntānmuktaṃ phalaṃ svabhāvena patituṃ prapadyate patanaṃ prāpnoti, anyathā kālaparipākābhāvena patituṃ na prapadyate patanaṃ na prāpnoti, evaṃ kālaprakarṣeṇa nāḍīnibandhanānmukto yo garbhāśayastho garbhaḥ sa jananāya prapadyate janma prāpnotītyarthaḥ||7-8||

lg.l: pataty akāle 'pi yathā tathā syād garbhavicyutiḥ ||9||

ab.seg: mūḍhagarbho yathā bhavati tathā darśayannāha- kṛmivātābhighātairityādi| garbhavicyutirdvividhā ‘garbhavicyutirapi dviprakārā’ iti pā. - dravasya srāvarūpeṇa, ghanāvayavasya pātarūpeṇa| tatra dravasya sravaṇe mūḍhagarbhanāma ‘mūḍhagarbhatā’ iti pā. nāsti, viguṇānilasammohānirgamalakṣaṇasyābhāvāt||9||

lg.l: ācaturthāt tato māsāt prasraved garbhavicyutiḥ ‘garbhavidravaḥ’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: paratastvastīti darśayannāha- ācaturthādityādi| garbhavicyutiḥ garbhavimuktiḥ; prasravet srāvarūpā bhavet| etena māsacatuṣṭayaṃ yāvanmūḍhagarbhatā nāstītyuktam| tata ityādi| tataścaturthamāsādūrdhvaṃ sthiraśarīrasya vicyutiḥ ‘garbhavicyutiḥ’ iti pā. pātaḥ pātarūpa bhavet| etena vicyutiriyaṃ na srāvarūpā; tasmāccaturthamāsānantaraṃ ghanāvayavatvānmūḍhagarbho bhavatītyuktam||10||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: svabhāvaprajananakāle yathā mūḍhagarbho na bhavati, anyathā tu bhavati, tathā darśayannāha- kālasya pariṇāmenetyādi| tasyākālacyutirapi dviprakārā- dravasya srāvarūpeṇa, ghanāvayavasya pātarūpeṇa| tatra dravasya sravaṇe mūḍhagarbhatā nāsti, viguṇānilasammohanirgamalakṣaṇasyābhāvāt| paratastanneti darśayannāha- ācaturthāttato māsādityādi| prasraved garbhasrāvakarmā(rūpā) vicyutiḥ, nātighanāvayavatvāt| paratastu pātavyapadeśaḥ, kiñcidghanatarāvayavatvāt; natu srāvaḥ, srāvalakṣaṇābhāvāt| pātaḥ pañcamaṣaṣṭhayorityupalakṣaṇaṃ, saptādimāsamapyupalakṣayati| ......carakādiṣu| bhoje tṛtīyamāsa eva cetanābhisambandhaḥ| tathāhi- bhojaḥ- “ātṛtīyāttato māsādgarbhaḥ sravati śoṇitam| ūrdhvaṃ saṃyāvabhūtastu garbho patati yoṣitām” iti| saṃyāvo nāma nātimṛdukaṭhinaḥ samitāśarkarākṛtabhakṣyaviśeṣaḥ| tatra bhojena caturthe māsi sarvāṅgapratyaṅgavibhāgaḥ pravyaktataro bhavati, tena tatrāpi nātikāṭhinyena srāvasādharmyāt sravatītyuktam| kāśyapīye'pyuktam- “ācaturthāttato māsāt prasrutaṃ śoṇitaṃ matam| tataḥ sthiraśarīrastu mūḍhaḥ patati kṛcchrataḥ” iti||7-10||

lg.l: pravidhyati śiro yā tu śītāṅgī nirapatrapā |
nīloddhatasirā hanti sā garbhaṃ sa ca tāṃ tathā ||11||

ab.seg: asādhyamūḍhagarbhagarbhiṇyorlakṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha- pravidhyatītyādi| pravidhyati tāḍayati, atiśayena dhunotītyarthaḥ| anye ‘apaviddhaśirā’ iti paṭhanti; tatrāvanataśīrṣetyarthaḥ| yā strī nirapatrapā lajjārahitā| nīloddhatasirā kṛṣṇoddhatasirā| sā garbhaṃ sa ca tāṃ tatheti sā strī garbhaṃ hanti, sa ca garbhavatīṃ strīṃ hantītyarthaḥ| tathā tena prakāreṇa||11||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: asādhyamūḍhagarbhagarbhiṇyorlakṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha- apaviddhaśirā ityādi| apaviddhaśirā avanataśīrṣā| nīlonnatasirā kṛṣṇonnatasirā||11||

lg.l: bhavaty ucchvāsapūtitvaṃ śūlaṃ ‘śūnatā'ntarmṛte’ iti pā. cāntarmṛte śiśau ||12||
garbho vyāpadyate kukṣau vyādhibhiś ca prapīḍitaḥ ||13||

ab.seg: garbhiṇīrakṣārthamantarmṛtasya garbhasyāpakarṣaṇāya tallakṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha- garbhāspandanamityādi| āvī prasavavedanā; athavā āvīśabdena yonermūtrakaphaprasekādīnyāvīliṅgānyucyante||12-13||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: mūḍhagarbhasya rakṣaṇārthaṃ mṛtasya punargarbhiṇīrakṣaṇārthaṃ vipātyākarṣaṇāya lakṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha- garbhāspandanamityādi| āviḥ prasavavedanā, tāsāmadarśanam| śūnatā'ntarmṛte śiśāviti utthānatvaṃ mṛtagarbhasyādhmānena| tasyāntargatasya maraṇahetuṃ mānasāgantuvyādhibhedena dvividhaṃ darśayannāha- mānasāgantubhirityādi| anye tvantarmṛtasya arbhakasya lakṣaṇaṃ nirdiśannāha- sa yadavetyādi paṭhanti| sa na paṭhanīyaḥ, mṛtagarbhasya garbhāspandanamityādinaiva paṭhitvāt||12-13||

lg.l: bastamāravipannāyāḥ vāgbhaṭe tvayaṃ śloko'nyathā paṭhyate| yathā,- “bastidvāre vipannāyāḥ kukṣiḥ praspandate yadi| janmakāle tataḥ śīghraṃ pāṭayitvoddharecchiśum”- iti| “garbhiṇyā mṛtāyā yadi kukṣiḥ praspandate'tyantaṃ calati| kva pradeśe? bastidvāre| kadā? janmakāle garbhaprasavonmukhe kāle| tadā kuśalo vaidyaḥ śīghraṃ kukṣipraspandanādanantaraṃ pāṭayitvā śiśuṃ bālakamuddharet” ityaruṇadattaṭīkā| hārāṇacandrastu ‘bastidvāre vipannāyāḥ’ iti paṭhitvā ‘janmakāle upasthite prasavakāle vipannāyā mṛtāyā yadi kukṣiḥ praspandate, tarhi tatkṣaṇāt bastidvāre bastiṃ dvāraṃ ca pāṭayitvā bhiṣak taṃ garbhamuddharet’ iti vyākhyānayati kukṣiḥ praspandate yadi |
tat kṣaṇāj janmakāle taṃ pāṭayitvoddhared bhiṣak ||14||

ab.seg: māturmṛtāyā api jīvato garbhasyāpakarṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha- bastamāretyādi| bastamāraśchagalavanmaraṇam, etena grīvāmoṭanenāśutamamakliṣṭaṃ maraṇamuktaṃ; tena vipannāyā mṛtāyāḥ striya ityarthaḥ| ayamabhiprāyaḥ- yathā bastaṃ nirucchvāsaṃ kṛtvā yājñikā mārayanti, evaṃ yā mṛtā tasyā ityarthaḥ| tatkṣaṇāt ghaṭikādvayamadhye, paratastu garbho'pi mriyata iti bhāvaḥ| anye ‘tatkṣaṇāt’ ityatra ‘muhūrtāt’ iti paṭhanti, tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ| janmakāle navamamāsādikāla ityarthaḥ| taṃ garbhaṃ, pāṭayitvā strīkukṣiṃ vidārya| atra kecit- “yadā so'ntarmṛto garbhaḥ śūno bastirivātataḥ| tenāvṛtāyā nāryāstu kukṣirānahyate bhṛśam|| utkṣipyanta ivāṅgāni mūtrabastiśca bhidyate| kloma plīhā yakṛccaiva phuphphusaṃ hṛdayaṃ tathā|| garbheṇa pīḍitaṃ hyetadūrdhvaṃ prakrāmati striyāḥ| sā śūyate muhyati ca kṛcchrocchvāsā ca jāyate|| pūtigandhastathā svedo jihvā tālu ca śuṣyati| vepate bhrāmyati tathā jīvitaṃ coparudhyate|| etairliṅgairvijānīyānmṛtaṃ garbhaṃ cikitsakaḥ”- iti paṭhanti; tanna paṭhanīyaṃ punaruktatvāt, jejjaṭādibhiḥ parihṛtatvācca| śrībrahmadevena tu kiñcidvyākhyātaṃ, tena tvārṣānārṣacintā na kṛtā||14||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: māturmṛtāyā api garbhasya jīvato'pakarṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha- bastamāravipannāyā ityādi| garbhaḥ praspandate yadi jīvato garbhasya spandanaṃ lakṣaṇam| bastamāraḥ chagalamaraṇaṃ grīvāvamoṭanenāśutamamakliṣṭamaraṇam| janmakāle iti navamādimāsakāle ityarthaḥ| muhūrtāditi prāgityadhyāhāryanāḍikādvayāt prāk, parastu garbho mṛta iti||14||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne mūḍhagarbhanidānaṃ nāmāṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||8||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nidānasthāne'ṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ||8||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: iti sauśrute śalyatantre śrīgayadāsaviracitāyāṃ nyāyacandrikāyāṃ pañjikāyāṃ nidānasthāne mūḍhagarbhanidānaṃ nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ||8||

div.head: vidradhinidānam

ab.seg: athāto vidradhīnāṃ nidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi||1-2||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: athāto vidradhernidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| mūḍhagarbhānantaraṃ śastrakarmasādhyatvasādharmyāt, antarvidradhāvapyudarotsedhasya sāmānyād vidradherārambhaḥ| nirupādhirvidradhisañjñeti svamataṃ, “śīghravidāhādvidradhiḥ” ityanye; taduktaṃ- “sa vai śīghravidāhitvādvidradhīti nirucyate”- (ca. sū. 17) iti||1-2||

sarvāmaragururidaṃ nikhilaṃ vidradhīlakṣaṇaṃ śiṣyārthamuvāceti sambandhaḥ| amṛtadānena sarve devā amarāḥ kṛtāḥ, tenāsau dhanvantariḥ sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ gururityarthaḥ| śrīmān jñānātiśayenaiśvaryeṇa ca yukta ityarthaḥ| nimittāntarabhūmipa iti nimitāntareṇa kāraṇāntareṇa nareṣvapi bhaiṣajyāmṛtapradānalakṣaṇena bhūpālatāṃ gata ityarthaḥ| anye tu ‘aputrasya kāśirājasya paramārādhanayā nirvāṇe cittamadhiṣṭhāya ‘nirvāṇāṃ tanūmadhiṣṭhāya’ iti pā. putratvamāpanna’ iti kāraṇāntaraṃ vyākhyānayanti| śiṣyāyovāca śiṣyārthaṃ kathitavānityarthaḥ| nikhilaṃ samastam| idaṃ vakṣyamāṇam| anena dhanvantarisvarūpopavarṇanena vidradhergarīyastvaṃ khyāpitaṃ bhavati||3||

lg.l: doṣāḥ śophaṃ śanair ghoraṃ janayanty ucchritā bhṛśam ||4||
mahāmūlaṃ rujāvantaṃ vṛttaṃ cā (vā') py athavā''yatam |
tam āhur vidradhiṃ dhīrā, vijñeyaḥ sa ca ṣaḍvidhaḥ ||5||
pṛthagdoṣaiḥ samastaiś ca kṣatenāpy asṛjā tathā |
ṣaṇṇām api hi teṣāṃ tu lakṣaṇaṃ sampravakṣyate ||6||

ab.seg: samprāptiṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ ca darśayannāha- tvagraktetyādi| bhṛśamityatiśayenocchritā iti sambandhaḥ| dhīrā dhīmantaḥ| etena samprāptiruktā| mahāmūlamityādi sāmānyalakṣaṇamuktaṃ, viśiṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇo'ruṇa ityādi, kāraṇaṃ tu sāmānyaṃ śophakāraṇābhidhānenaivoktam| saṅkhyāmāha- vijñeyaḥ sa ca ṣaḍvidha iti| sa vidradhiḥ| tadeva ṣaḍvidhatvamāha- pṛthagityādi| samastaiścetyekaḥ, kṣatenāpyekaḥ, asṛjā'pyeka iti ṣaṭ||4-6||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: sarvāmaraguruḥ śrīmāniti amarāṇāṃ gururiti amṛtoddhāraṃ smārayati; surā hyamṛtena dhanvantariṇoddhṛtena nirjarāmaraṇādamarīkṛtāḥ; ata eva sarvāmaraguruḥ| nimittāntarabhūmipa iti nareṣvapi svabhaiṣajyāmṛtapradānāya bhūpālatāṃ gata iti gamayati| yaduktaṃ prāk- “śalyaṃ mahacchāstravaraṃ gṛhītvā” (sū. 1) ityādi| etasyārthasya anya evādhyāye'pi pratipāditasya punaḥ pratipādanaṃ vidradhergarīyastvabodhanārtham; ata eva mahāvyādhīnāmanantarameva vidradherabhidhānam| vidradhilakṣaṇamiti lakṣyate aneneti lakṣaṇaṃ jñāpako heturiti| tacca lakṣaṇaṃ dvividhaṃ- sāmānyaṃ, viśiṣṭaṃ ca| tatra sāmānyaṃ ‘śothaṃ ghoraṃ mahāmūlam’ iti; viśiṣṭaṃ tu ‘kṛṣṇo'ruṇe vā’ ityādi| kārakahetavastu sāmānyaśothahetvabhidhānenoktāḥ| anye punarāhuḥ- vidradhiṣu paruṣādīni vātādīnāṃ svābhāvikaliṅgāni, kṛṣṇādīni kāryabhūtāni| sa vidradhiriti khyāta iti itiśabdena nirupādhireva vidradhisañjñā saṅketamātrākṛteti||3-6||
vātavidradhilakṣaṇamāha- kṛṣṇa ityādi| citrotthānaprapāka iti nānāprakārotthāno ‘nānāprakopapākaścetyarthaḥ’ iti pā. nānāprakārapākaścetyarthaḥ||7||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: citrotthānaprapāka iti citrau utthānaprapākau yasya, vāyorviṣamakriyatvāt||7||
pittavidradhimāha- pakvetyādi||8||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: paittike jvaradāhau sambhavamātrameva, pacyamāne punaratyantau bhavataḥ||8||
kaphajamāha- śarāvasadṛśa ityādi| śarāvasādṛśyena mahattvamuktam||9||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: kaphaje sarāvasadṛśatvena mahattvasūcanam||9||
teṣāṃ vidradhīnāṃ yathākramamāsrāvānāha- tanvityādi| eṣāṃ vātāpittakaphotthānāṃ vidradhīnām||10||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: pākānantarasambhavaṃ srāvaṃ darśayannāha- tanupītasitāścaiṣāmityādi| ete trayāṇāṃ vātapittakaphānāṃ yathāsaṅkhyena||10||

sānnipātikamāha- nānetyādi| nānāvarṇāḥ kṛṣṇapītaśuklāḥ, nānārujāstodadāhakaṇḍvādyāḥ, nānāsrāvāstanupītaśuklāḥ, te yasya santi sa yathoktaḥ| ghāṭāla iti ghāṭā ūrdhvabhāgo mahān yasyāstīti sa ghāṭālaḥ| viṣamo'sādhyatvāt| viṣamaṃ pacyate cāpīti cirāciragambhīrottānānunnatonnatabhedena ‘… nānatonnatabhedena’ iti pā.||10||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: sānnipātikaṃ darśayannāha- nānetyādi| nānāvidhā varṇavedanāsrāvā yasya sa tathā| tatra nānāvarṇāḥ kṛṣṇapītaśuklāḥ; vedanāstodadāhakaṇḍvādikāḥ, nānāsrāvāḥ kṛṣṇapītasitāḥ| viṣamaṃ pacyate cirāciragambhīrottānakṛtena bhedenāsamatvāt| vātaje'pi pākasrāvavaiṣamyamasti, natu gāmbhīryādīnāmapi varṇarujāsrāvāṇām, ata eva vātajasya sādhyatvamuktam| ghāṭāla iti “prāṇisthādāto lajanyatarasyām” (pā. a. 5/2/96) iti lac| atyutthānādgurutvena ghāṭā iva| tathā ca bhojaḥ- “bahudoṣo rasān sarvān rasate yo yadā naraḥ| tasya dehe tvagādīni doṣāḥ sandūṣya dehinaḥ|| kurvanti sarvarūpotthaṃ śothaṃ sarvarujānvitam| viṣamaṃ pāki (?) viṣamaṃ ghāṭālaṃ cirapākinam|| vyāmiśravarṇasrutikaṃ bhiṣaktaṃ parivarjayet” iti||10||

lg.l: tais tair bhāvair abhihate kṣate vā 'pathyasevinaḥ ||11||
jvaras tṛṣṇā ca dāhaś ca jāyate tasya dehinaḥ ||12||

ab.seg: āgantoḥ samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- taistairityādi| taistairiti aśvapatanagū(mū)ḍhaprahārādibhirityarthaḥ; tenāsrutaśoṇitapiccitādīnāṃ ‘srutaśoṇitapiśitādīnāṃ’ iti pā. grahaṇam| kṣate vetyatra taistairbhāvairiti tīkṣṇaprahārādibhirityarthaḥ; anena ca srutaśoṇitānāṃ chinnādīnāṃ grahaṇam| kṣatoṣmā vāyuvisṛto vātena vistāritaḥ| pittavidradhilakṣaṇo ‘bhavati’ ityadhyāhāraḥ||11-12||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: abhighātajasyāgantoḥ samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- taistairbhāvairityādi| prapatanaprahārādibhirhate'tyantaduṣṭaśoṇitānām| hate iti mathitādīnāmapyupalakṣaṇam| kṣate iti taistairbhāvairityādibhiḥ| kṣata iti srutaśoṇitānāṃ chinnādīnāmupalakṣaṇam| tatraikatra mathitapiccitayoḥ sirāmārgāvaraṇena vātakopaḥ, anyatra chinnādau dhātukṣayeṇātiraktāsrāvanimittena| tatrābhighātajasyopacārārthaṃ doṣaliṅgaṃ darśayannāha- pittavidradhilakṣaṇa iti| raktaṃ ca raktaje eva sravatīti pittavidradhiliṅgātideśaḥ kṛtaḥ; pītatvasyāvayavavikṛtatvāt||11-12||
raktavidradhilakṣaṇamāha- kṛṣṇasphoṭāvṛta ityādi||13||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: raktaje dāhapākādīnāṃ tīvratvamadhikam| raktasya dūṣyatvāddoṣaliṅgamatideśena nirdiśannāha- pittasya vidradhairliṅgairityādi| bhojaprabhṛtayastu raktavidradhiṃ nādhīyate| anye tviha raktaje'dhikavidhānārthaṃ raktajaṃ paṭhantyeva||13||

lg.l: uktā vidradhayo hy ete teṣv asādhyas tu sarvajaḥ ||14||

ab.seg: bāhyeṣvasādhyamāha- uktā ityādi| sarvajaḥ sānnipātikaḥ||14||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: bāhyeṣvasādhyaṃ nirdiśannāha- uktā vidradhaya ityādi| teṣvasādhyatvena tridoṣajaḥ pṛthak kriyate||14||

lg.l: pṛthak sambhūya vā doṣāḥ kupitā gulmarūpiṇam ||16||
gude bastimukhe nābhyāṃ kukṣau vaṅkṣaṇayos tathā ||17||
vṛkkayor yakṛti plīhni hṛdaye klomni vā tathā |
āmapakvaiṣaṇīyāc ca ‘āmapakvaiṣaṇīyena’ iti pā. pakvāpakvaṃ vinirdiśet |19|

ab.seg: antarvidradherhetusamprāptilakṣaṇānyāha- ābhyantarānityādi| saṃsṛṣṭabhojanāt ‘saṅkliṣṭabhojanādduṣṭadeśe bhojanāt’ iti pā. kadaśanabhojanāt| sambhūya militvā| gulmarūpiṇaṃ valmīkavatsamunnaddhaṃ vidradhiṃ kurvantīti sambandhaḥ; gulmarūpiṇaṃ kāṭhinyena, valmīkavatsamunnaddhaṃ sarvata unnatam| gurvasātmyetyādi vidāhibhiriti yāvaddhetuḥ, pṛthak sambhūya veti samprāptiḥ, gulmarūpiṇaṃ valmīkavatsamunnaddhamiti ca sāmānyalakṣaṇam| tatrāpi valmīkavatsamunnaddhatvaṃ pacyamānāvasthāyām| teṣāṃ vātādibhedabhinnānāṃ viśeṣavarṇaliṅgasaṅkhyādikaṃ bāhyavidradhivajjñeyam| jejjaṭastu ābhyantarasyāgantorabhāvameva manyate| teṣāṃ bāhyānāmābhyantarāṇāṃ ca sthānamāha- gude ityādi| gudādiṣu sthāneṣu doṣā vidradhiṃ kurvantīti sambandhaḥ| bastimukhe na tu bastau, tatra māṃsamedasorabhāvāt| vaṅkṣaṇa ūrumūlāśrayaḥ ‘gaṇḍaka’ iti loke| vṛkkau māṃsapiṇḍadvayam (eko vāmapārśvasthitaḥ, dvitīyo dakṣiṇapārśvasthitaḥ ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate )| yakṛt kālakhaṇḍaṃ dakṣiṇapārśvastham| plīhā udaravāmapārśve sthitaḥ| hṛdayaṃ kamalamukulākāramadhomukham| kloma kālakhaṇḍādadhastāt sthitaṃ dakṣiṇapārśvasthaṃ tilakaṃ prasiddham| teṣāmābhyantarāṇāmityarthaḥ||15-18||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: adhiṣṭhānaviśeṣeṇa viśeṣaliṅgajñānārthaṃ sādhyāsādhyaviniścayārthaṃ cābhyantarān vidradhīn darśayannāha- ābhyantarānityādi| abhyantarabhavān| pṛthak sambhūya veti samprāptiḥ| āganterābhyantarasya bāhyāgantuvidradhisamprāptyabhidhānenaiva samprāptiruktā| gulmarūpiṇamiti prathamaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ gulmarūpamevābhyantaravidradhīnām| valmīkavatsamunnaddhatvaṃ sarveṣāmeva samānam| śeṣaṃ varṇarujāsrāvādi bāhyavidradhilakṣaṇenaivāvagantavyam| ata evoktaṃ “sarvaśothavikāreṣu vraṇavallakṣayet bhiṣak” (sū. 22) iti| teṣāṃ sādhyāsādhyatvavibhāgārthaṃ lakṣaṇaviśeṣajñānārthaṃ cādhiṣṭhānaṃ nirdiśannāha- gude bastimukhe ityādi| āmapakvaiṣaṇīyācceti cakāro bhinnakrame, āmaṃ pakvaṃ ca vibhāvayediti| āmapakvaiṣaṇīyāditi lyablope pañcamī; tenāmapakvaiṣaṇīyamavekṣyetyarthaḥ||15-18||

lg.l: sarvāṅgapragrahas tīvro hṛdi śūlaś ca dāruṇaḥ |
śvāso yakṛti tṛṣṇā ca pipāsā klomaje 'dhikā ||22||

ab.seg: bāhyānāmābhyantarāṇāṃ cādhiṣṭhānaviśeṣeṇa lakṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha- adhiṣṭhānetyādi| āṭopaḥ saṅkṣobhaḥ| pārśvasaṅkocaḥ pārśvotpāṭanamiva| hṛdīti hṛdayotthe vidradhau, sarvāṅgapragrahādaya upadravā bhavantītyarthaḥ| ‘klomni pipāsā’ ityādi pāṭhāntaraṃ kecit paṭhanti, taccābhāvānna likhitam||19-22||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: adhiṣṭhānaviśeṣeṇa liṅgaṃ darśayannāha- gude vātanirodha ityādi| tathā āṭopaḥ saṅkṣobhaḥ| klomni pipāsā mukhasya śoṣaḥ; ‘pepīyate payaḥ’ ityanye paṭhanti, tatrātyarthaṃ pīyate paya ityarthaḥ| kukṣau mārutakopanaṃ vidradhikṛtamārganirodhāt| sarvāṅgapragrahaḥ sarveṣāmaṅgānāṃ prakarṣeṇa grahaṇamiva| tīvro dussahaḥ, ūrdhvādhastiryaksirādhiṣṭhānatvāddhṛdayasya||19-22||

lg.l: āmo vā yadi vā pakvo mahān vā yadi vetaraḥ |
sarvo marmotthitaś cāpi ‘marmotthitatvācca’ iti pā. vidradhiḥ kaṣṭa ucyate ||23||

ab.seg: tatra marmotthitānāṃ sarvāvasthāsu kaṣṭatvaṃ darśayannāha- āma ityādi| yadi vetara iti itaro'lpaḥ||23||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: marmotthitānāṃ sarvāsvavasthāsu kaṣṭatvaṃ darśayannāha- āmo vā yadi vā pakva ityādi||23||

lg.l: nābher uparijāḥ pakvā yānty ūrdhvam itare tv adhaḥ |
jīvaty adho niḥsruteṣu sruteṣūrdhvaṃ na jīvati ||24||

ab.seg: avasthāviśeṣādasādhyatvamāha- nābherityādi| nābheruparijāḥ plīhayakṛtklomakukṣihṛdayajāḥ, pakvā ūrdhvaṃ yānti sravanti| itare gudabastivṛkkavaṅkṣaṇajā adho yānti| eṣu cādhoniḥsruteṣu jīvati, nordhvaniḥsruteṣu| hṛnnābhibastijān varjayitvā ye'nye gudakukṣivaṅkṣaṇavṛkkaplīhayakṛtklomajāsteṣvantarvidradhiṣu bāhyāto bhinneṣu kadāciddaivavaśājjīvet, na punaritareṣvabhyantarato bhinneṣvityarthaḥ| hṛnnābhibastijānāṃ cāsādhyatvamagrevācyam||24-25||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: idānīṃ viśiṣṭāvayavavibhāgena sādhyāsādhyatvajñāpanārthamasya srāvanirgamamārgamaviśeṣaṃ darśayannāha- nābheruparijāḥ pakvā ityādi||24-25||

ābhyantaraṃ raktajaṃ nārīṇāmeva darśayannāha- strīṇāmityādi| strīṇāṃ raktāvidradhirjāyata iti sambandhaḥ| kimbhūtānāṃ strīṇām? apaprajātānāṃ, patitagarbhaṇāṃ; punarapi kimbhūtānāṃ? prajātānāṃ samyakkālaprasūtānām| ahitaiḥ śītarūkṣāhāravihāraiḥ||26||

lg.l: api samyak prajātānām asṛk kāyād aniḥsṛtam |

ab.seg: tasyaiva raktavidradherviśeṣamāha- api samyagityādi| makkallasañjñitaṃ makkallajanitaṃ, kāraṇe kāryopacārāt; ghṛtamāyuriti yathā| saptarātramapraśāntaḥ pittoṣmaṇā'ntaḥ pacyate, pakvaścāsādhyaḥ||27||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: ābhyantaraṃ raktajaṃ vidradhiṃ nārīṇāmeva darśayannāha- strīṇāmityādi| adhaḥprajātānām akālaprajātānām; ‘apaprajātānāṃ’ ityanye; tatra patitagarbhāṇāmityarthaḥ| prajātānāṃ samyakkāle prajātānāmityarthaḥ| tatrāpi raktanirodhe hetumāha- ahitairiti; śītarūkṣāhāravihāraiḥ| makkallasañjñitaṃ makkalajanitaṃ, kāraṇe kāryopacārāt; ghṛtamāyuriti yathā| tatra saptarātrādanupakrāntaḥ pittoṣmaṇā pacyate| atraivārthe bhojaḥ- “prajātānāṃ tu nārīṇāṃ makkallapratimaḥ sthiraḥ| saptarātrāt paraṃ kukṣau jāyate raktavidradhiḥ|| na cet praśāntaḥ saptāhādahitāśanataḥ kvacit| pacyate pittasaṃsargāttadā varjyo vijānatā” iti| kecidatrāpi “atha majjaparīpākaḥ” ityādikaṃ granthamadhīyate| prāyeṇa hi medosthisamāśraya eva vidradhiḥ sarvaḥ| yadāha- “tvagraktamāṃsamedosthi pradūṣyāsthisamāśritāḥ” iti| bhojenapyuktaṃ “sthitvā'sthni vā samuddhatasyuratyāt(?)| yasyāvapākakarmaṇā(?)'sthi vinirbhidya cirādvā prasavedyadi| vidagdho darśayedrūpaṃ vātādīnāṃ muhurmuhuḥ” iti| sarvavidradhiśeṣaṃ majjapākamicchanti||26-27||

lg.l: kasmān na pacyate gulmo vidradhiḥ pākam eti ca ||29||
evam prakāro gulmas tu tasmāt pākaṃ na gacchati ||31||
gulmas tiṣṭhati doṣe sve vidradhir māṃsaśoṇite |
vidradhiḥ pacyate tasmād gulmaś cāpi na pacyate ||33||

ab.seg: pṛthak sambhūya vā doṣāḥ kupitā gulmarūpiṇamityatraikarūpatvādantarvidradhigulmayoḥ kuto gulmādasya vidradheḥ pākakṛto viśeṣa ityāha- viśeṣamityādi| viśeṣaṃ bhedam| samutthānaṃ kāraṇaṃ, doṣā eva samutthānaṃ, tacca dvayostulyam| siddhāntamāha- na nibandho'stīti; niścitya bandhātīti nibandho mūlaṃ; tadgulmānāṃ mūlaṃ nāstīti, rasaraktādidūṣyāṇāmabhāvatvāt| kutaḥ punareṣāṃ śopharūpāṇāmapi mūlaṃ nāstītyāha- gulmākārā gulmarūpāḥ, svayamātmanaiva, doṣā vātādayaḥ, na punardūṣyasaṃśrayāḥ| vidradhermūlasambhave hetumāha- vidradhirmāṃsaśoṇite iti; ‘bhavati’ iti śeṣaḥ| tatra kathaṃ pitte kaphe vā drave vātajanitasya gulmasya sthitirityāha- vivarānucara ityādi| yathā'psu budbudakaḥ, evamprakāro vivarānucaraḥ sroto'nusā(cā)rī vātagranthirūpo gulmaḥ, ‘kaphapittayoḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ; tasmāt pūrvoktāddhetoḥ pākaṃ na yāti| amumevārthaṃ niyamayannāha- māṃsaśoṇitabāhulyādityādi| vidradhigulmayormūlasambhavāsambhavābhyāṃ pākāpākau pratipādya sthānaviśeṣādapi hetoḥ pākāpākau pratipādayannāha- gulmastiṣṭhatītyādi| gulmaścāpi na pacyata iti apiśabdena pacyate gulma iti kāyacikitsāyāmuktaṃ gulmapākitvaṃ samuccīyate||28-33||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
