ab.seg: yat prāguktaṃ “pṛthak sambhūya vā doṣāḥ kupitā gulmarūpiṇam” ityatraikarūpatvādantarvidradhigulmayoḥ kuto gulmādasya vidradheḥ pākakṛto viśeṣa ityāha- viśeṣamatha vakṣyāmītyādi| samutthānaṃ kāraṇaṃ dvayorvidradhigulmayoḥ samānaṃ, tat kiṃ gulmo na pacyata iti saṃśayamutpādya svayameva śiṣyāṇāṃ hitatayā siddhāntamātrasūtraṇamācāryeṇa kṛtam| evaṃ manyate- bhedo hi bhedavatāṃ kāraṇabhedādviruddhadharmādhyāsādvā, tatra kāraṇamabhinnamiti sarvathaivābhedena bhāvitavyamityāśaṅkyopādānakāraṇabhedenānayorbhedameva siddhāntaṃ darśayannāha- na nibandho'stītyādi| niścitya badhnātīti nibandho mūlaṃ rasaraktādi; dūṣyāṇāmabhāvādgulmānāṃ mūlaṃ nāstīti| kutaḥ punareṣāṃ mahattaraśotharūpāṇāṃ mūlaṃ nāstītyāha- gulmākārāḥ svayaṃ doṣā iti|- gulmākārā gulmarūpā ātmanaiva, doṣā vātādayaḥ; na punardūṣyasaṃśrayāḥ| vidradhestu mūlaṃ sahetumāha- vidradhirmāṃsaśoṇite; ‘bhavati’ iti śeṣaḥ| māṃsaśoṇite eva pākahetuḥ; tena cātropagīte| tatra kathaṃ pitte kaphe vā drave vātajanitasya gulmasya sthitirityāha- vivarānucaro gulmo hyapsu budbudako yathā| māṃsaśoṇitabāhulyādityādi| kinniviṣṭo gulmo bhavatītyāha- gulmastiṣṭhati sve doṣa iti; doṣe eva vātapittakaphasthānarūpe| doṣamātrāstitvaṃ punarapsu budbudako yathetyena pratipāditam| gulmaścāpi na pacyata ityapiśabdena pacyate'pi gulma iti kāyacikitsāsiddhaṃ gulmapākitvamuktaṃ samuccīyate| taduktaṃ carake- “raktapittātibāhulyāt kriyāmanupalabhya vā| gulmo yatra vidahyeta śastraṃ tatra bhiṣagjitam” (ca. ci. 5) iti| daivavaśādgulmo'pi kṛtaparigrahaḥ pacyate; sa khalu samūlatvādvidradhireveti dhānvantarīyāṇāṃ matamiti||28-33||

lg.l: hṛnnābhibastijaḥ pakvo varjyo yaś ca tridoṣajaḥ |34|

div.ab: hṛdityādi| etena sānnipātikaḥ pakvo yatra kutracit sthito vidradhirvarjanīyaḥ| kecidgulmavidradhyormānakathanāya ślokaṃ paṭhanti- “muṣṭipramāṇo gulmastu vidradhiśca tataḥ param”- iti; tataḥ paramiti muṣṭeradhika ityarthaḥ|34|-

lg.l: tataḥ sa vyādhinā tena jvalaneneva dahyate ||35||
athāsya karmaṇā vyādhir dvāraṃ tu labhate yadā |
tato medaḥprabhaṃ snigdhaṃ śuklaṃ śītam atho guru ||37||
bhinne 'sthni niḥsravet ‘prasravet’ iti pā. pūyam etad asthigataṃ viduḥ |

ab.seg: prāktanakarmavaśādupekṣaṇādvā yo vidradhiṣvasthyantargataḥ pāko bhavati tasya lakṣaṇamāha- athetyādi| sarvavidradhayo vātādinā yadā'sthyāśritya jāyante, upekṣaṇādanantaraṃ tadgatamajjā ca paripacyate tadetadrūpamuktam| so'sthimāṃsanirodheneti sa majjāparipākaḥ| tataḥ sa vyādhinā teneti tadā sa puruṣaḥ, tena vyādhinā majjaparipākena| asthi(tha)majjoṣmaṇā tena śīryate dahyamānavaditi tena majjoṣmaṇā, atha upekṣaṇādanantaraṃ, śīryate vinaśyati, kiṃvat? dahyamānavat| athāsya karmaṇeti karmaṇā śastrakarmaṇā| vyādhiḥ pūyam||34-38||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: hṛnnābhibastijo varjyaḥ etena sānnipātikastu punaḥ pakvo yatra kutracit sthito varjanīyaḥ| yaduktaṃ bhojena “sānnipātiko ya eva vidradhistaṃ vyāmiśravastuṃ pakvameva vivarjayet” iti| “muṣṭipramāṇo gulmastu” ityādi kecit paṭhanti; pūrvairapi sūranandivarāhādibhirgrantho vyākhyātārtha evāyam||34-38||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne vidradhinidānaṃ nāma navamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||9||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nidānasthāne navamo'dhyāyaḥ||9||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: iti sauśrute śalyatantre śrīgayadāsaviracitāyāṃ nyāyacandrikāyāṃ pañjikāyāṃ nidānasthāne vidradhīnāṃ nidānam||9||

div.head: visarpanāḍīstanaroganidānam

ab.seg: athāto visarpanāḍīstanaroganidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi||1-2||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: athāto visarpāṇāṃ nidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| vidradheranantaraṃ visarpādīnāmārambhaḥ| gambhīrasya vidradheḥ śothaviśeṣasya pratipāditatvenottānasya visarpaśothasyāvaśiṣṭatvād, valmīkavadunnatasya vidradheruktatvādanunnatasya visarpaśothasyāvaśiṣṭatvād, visrāvaṇasya sādharmyācca||1-2||

lg.l: tvaṅmāṃsaśoṇitagatāḥ kupitās tu doṣāḥ sarvāṅgasāriṇam ihāsthitam ātmaliṅgam |
kurvanti vistṛtam anunnatam āśu visṛtamunnatamāśu’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ paṭhati, ‘visṛtaṃ vistīrṇaṃ, unnataṃ mahāntam’ iti ca vyākhyānayati śophaṃ taṃ sarvato visaraṇāc ca visarpam āhuḥ ||3||

ab.seg: idānīṃ samprāptihetusvarūpaniruktīrāha- tvaṅmāṃsetyādi| tvaṅmāṃsaśoṇitagatāḥ kupitā doṣāḥ śophaṃ kurvantīti sambandhaḥ| kimbhūtaṃ śophaṃ? sarvāṅgasāriṇam| iha asmiñ śāstre, taṃ visarpamāhuriti sambandhaḥ| punarapi kimbhūtam? asthitam anavasthitaṃ, deśāddeśāntaragamanāt; anye tu āsthitaṃ prāptaṃ; kiṃ tat? ātmaliṅgam; etena vātādiśothaliṅgaṃ ‘vātādidoṣaliṅgaṃ’ iti pā. prāptamityarthaḥ; anye tu ihāsthitaṃ kvacidevāvayave sthitamiti vyākhyānayanti| vistṛtaṃ vistīrṇam| anunnataṃ tanutvācchophasya ‘tanutvaṃ’ iti pā.| visaraṇācceti cakārāt nānāprakāraṃ visarpatīti ‘sarpatīti’ iti pā. samuccīyate| tvaṅmāṃsaśoṇitagatā iti samprāptiḥ| kupitā doṣā iti hetuḥ| sarvāṅgasāriṇamityādi svarūpam| sarvato visaraṇācceti niruktiḥ||3||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: teṣāṃ visarpāṇāṃ sthānasaṃśrayasvabhāvasamprāptīḥ pratipādayan pūrvaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha- tvagmāṃsaśoṇitagatā ityādi| sarvāṅgasāriṇaṃ sarvāṅgānusaraṇaśīlam| asthitam anavasthitaṃ, deśāntaragamanāt; “ātmano liṅgamāsthitaṃ samprāptam” ityanye; tena vātādiśothaliṅgaṃ prāptamityarthaḥ, anavasthitatvaṃ punaḥ sarvāṅgānusāritvenaivoktam| vistṛtaṃ vistīrṇam| anunnataṃ tanutvācchophasya| visarpa ityarthasya vyāptyarthena sarvatopariśabdārthena viśabdena viśeṣitavyo'yaṃ prāya iti darśayannāha- taṃ sarvato visaraṇāccetyādi| visaraṇācceti cakāro niruktau viśabdasya vividhārthasya vācitvamapi samuccinoti| tathāhi visarpaniruktau carakaḥ- “vividhaṃ visarpati yato visarpastena sañjñitaḥ| parisarpo'thavā nāmnā sarvataḥ parisarpaṇāt (ca. sū. 17) iti||3||

lg.l: gaṇḍair yadā tu viṣamair atidūṣitatvād yuktaḥ sa eva kathitaḥ khalu varjanīyaḥ ||4||

ab.seg: teṣāṃ doṣabhedena viśiṣṭaṃ lakṣaṇāṃ darśayannāha- vātātmaka ityādi| asitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ| aṅgamardo vedanāviśeṣaḥ| idaṃ śuddhavātavisarpalakṣaṇamuktam| gaṇḍairityādi| gaṇḍairagnidagdhasadṛśaiḥ sphoṭairyukta iti sambandhaḥ| atidūṣitatvāt kābhyāṃ? vātapittābhyām| idaṃ pittānugatavātavisarpalakṣaṇamuktam| apare tu sakalenāpi ślokena śuddhavātavisarpalakṣaṇamāhuḥ, tanmate'tidūṣitatvād vātenaiveti boddhavyam||4||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: teṣāṃ doṣabhedena viśiṣṭaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ nirdiśannāha- vātātmaka ityādi| vāta ātmā heturyasya sa tathā| kecidvātātmaka eva ‘gaṇḍaiḥ’ ityādi granthamadhīyate| ayaṃ pittānugatena| tantrāntare punaryamagnivisarpa ityucyate| gaṇḍairiti sphoṭairagnidagdhanibhaiścopacīyate| ata evāyamasādhyo dvandvajatvāt||4||

lg.l: doṣapravṛddhihatamāṃsasiro yadā syāt srotojakardamanibho na tadā sa sidhyet ||5||

ab.seg: pittātmaka ityādi| jvarādibhiḥ prabhedāntairbahulaśabdaḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| kṣatajaprakāśa iti raktamiva yaḥ prakāśata ityarthaḥ| pūrvārdhena kevalapittārabdho visarpa uktaḥ| doṣapravṛddhītyādi doṣapravṛddhyā pittakaphavṛddhyā hataṃ māṃsaṃ sirāśca yasmin sa tathā| srotojakardamanibha iti añjanasadṛśakardamadravyatulyaḥ| anenottarārdhena kaphapaittiko visarpa uktaḥ||5||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: pittātmako drutagatiḥ drutavisaraṇaśīlaḥ| pittaje jvarādibhiḥ prabhedāntaiḥ saha bahulaśabdaḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyate| kṣatajaprakāśaḥ kṣatajavadraktavat prakāśate| tasyedānīṃ doṣasaṃsargeṇāvasthāyāmasādhyatvaṃ darśayannāha- doṣapravṛttihatamāṃsasira ityādi| doṣo'tra kaphapitte| srotojakardamanibhaḥ añjanasadṛśakardamadravyatulyasambhavapradeśaḥ| asyaiva visarpasya kaphapittajasya carake kardamasañjñā, asādhyatā'pi ca paṭhitā||5||

lg.l: śleṣmātmakaḥ sarati mandam aśīghrapākaḥ snigdhaḥ sitaśvayathur alparugugrakaṇḍuḥ |6|

ab.seg: śleṣmātmaka ityādi| sarati visarpati| kaphavātābhyāṃ granthivisarpaḥ, saḥ asādhya eva| sa purastādeva granthinirdeśa (?) iti nātra nirdiṣṭaḥ; atraiva ‘vātakaphavisarpaliṅgena nirdiṣṭenāvarudhyate’ ityanye||6||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: kaphavātābhyāṃ granthivisarpaḥ||6||

lg.l: sarvātmakas trividhavarṇarujo 'vagāḍhaḥ pakvo na sidhyati ca māṃsasirāpraśātāt ‘māṃsasirāpraṇāśāt’ iti pā.||6||

ab.seg: sānnipātikaṃ darśayannāha- sarvātmaka ityādi| trividhavarṇaruja iti pratyekaṃ vātādidoṣanirdiṣṭakṛṣṇapītasitādivarṇaḥ, vātādidoṣajanitavisarpanirdiṣṭatodadāhakaṇḍvādivedanaśca| avagāḍho'bhyantaramūlaḥ| praśātaḥ ‘praṇāśaḥ’ iti pā. śaṭanaṃ; māṃsasirāpraśātāt parato na sidhyati, māṃsasirāpraśātāt pūrvaṃ kṛcchrataḥ sidhyati||6||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: sānnipātikaṃ darśayannāha- sarvātmaka ityādi| trividhavarṇarujo'vagāḍhaḥ pratyekaṃ vātādidoṣanirdiṣṭakṛṣṇapītasitādivarṇaḥ, vātādidoṣajanitavisarpanirdiṣṭatodadāhakaṇḍvādivedanaśca| avagāḍha ityabhyantaramūlaḥ| asya carake antarja iti sañjñā| taduktaṃ carake- “bahiḥśritaḥ śritaścāntastathā cobhayasaṃśritaḥ| visarpo balameṣāṃ tu jñeyaṃ guru yathottaram|| bahirmārgāśritaṃ sādhyamasādhyamubhayāśritam| antaḥprakupitā doṣā visarpatyantarāśrayam|| bahirbahiḥprakupitāḥ sarvatrobhayasaṃsthitāḥ| marmopaghātāt sammohādayanānāṃ vighaṭṭanāt| tṛṣṇātiyogādvegānāṃ viṣamaṃ ca pravartanāt|| vidyāt visarpamantarjamāśu cāgnibalakṣayāt| ato viparyayādbāhyamanyairvidyāt svalakṣaṇaiḥ” (ca. ci. 21) iti| pakvo na sidhyatītyādyamasādhyavidradhilakṣaṇam| māṃsasirāpraṇāśāt parato na sidhyati, māṃsasirāpraṇāśāt pūrvaṃ kṛcchrataḥ sidhyati||6||

lg.l: sadyaḥkṣatavraṇam upetya narasya pittaṃ raktaṃ ca doṣabahulasya karoti śopham |
śyāvaṃ salohitam atijvaradāhapākaṃ sphoṭaiḥ kulatthasadṛśair asitaiś ca kīrṇam ||7||

ab.seg: sadya ityādi| doṣabahulasya pittaṃ raktaṃ ca śophaṃ karotīti sambandhaḥ| kiṃ kṛtvā? sadyaḥkṣatavraṇamupetya prāpya| kimbhūtaṃ śophaṃ? śyāvamityādiviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭam| doṣabahulasyeti kuṣṭhavātaraktadipūrvarūpādidoṣadūṣitadhātoḥ, taduktaṃ tayoḥ pūrvarūpe ‘kṣatavisarpaṇam’ (ni. 5) iti; anye tu tridoṣabahulasyetyarthamāhuḥ| kīrṇaṃ vyāptam||7||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: sadyaḥkṣatamityādinā kṣatavisarpaḥ| doṣabahulasyeti doṣo bahulo yasya sa tathā; kuṣṭhavātaraktadipūrvarūpādidoṣadūṣitadhātoḥ| taduktaṃ tayoḥ pūrvarūpe- kṣatavisarpaṇamiti| tathaiva bhojaḥ “śastraprahāraistaistaistu vyāladantanakhairapi| kṣate vā'pyathavā bhagne bahudoṣasya dehinaḥ|| raktaṃ pittaṃ ca kupitaṃ vraṇamāśu prapadyate| kurutaste samete tu vraṇaśothaṃ sudāruṇam|| ātataṃ tu tanusphoṭaiḥ kṛṣṇaiḥ pītakasannibhaiḥ| pittavīsarpavaccheṣaṃ tasya liṅgaṃ vinirdiśet” iti||7||

lg.l: sidhyanti vātakaphapittakṛtā visarpāḥ sarvātmakaḥ kṣatakṛtaś ca na siddhim eti |
paittānilāv api ca darśitapūrvaliṅgau sarve ca marmasu bhavanti hi kṛcchrasādhyāḥ ||8||

ab.seg: teṣāṃ sādhyāsādhyātvamāha- sidhyantītyādi| na siddhimeti na sādhyatāṃ yāti| darśitapūrvaliṅgā iti gaṇḍayukto vātavisarpaḥ, srotojakardamanibhaḥ pittavisarpa iti| anye tu ‘pittātmako'ñjanavapuśca tathā na sidhyet’ iti paṭhanti, cakāreṇa gaṇḍairyadā'tiviṣamairityevaṃviśiṣṭo vātiko'pyasādhya iti samuccīyata iti vyākhyānayanti| gaṇḍairyadā tu viṣamairityādinā vātajasya, srotojakardamanibhairityādinā| pittajasyāsādhyatvamuktaṃ yat punarucyate tat kṣatajasyāsādhyatāprasaṅgena, prasaṅgoktaṃ ca na paunaruktyamarhati||8||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: teṣāṃ sādhyāsādhyatāṃ nirdiśannāha- sidhyantītyādi| pittātmako'ñjanavapuśceti cakāreṇa gaṇḍairyadā tu viṣamairityevaṃviśiṣṭo vātiko'pyasādhya iti samuccīyate| anye punaravasthāntare vātakaphajasyāsādhyatvaṃ darśayitumanyathā paṭhanti- “paittānilāvapi ca darśitapūrvaliṅgau, kṛcchrāśca marmasu bhavanti hi sarva eva” iti| nanu prāgeva gaṇḍairyadā tu viṣamairityādinā vātajasyāsādhyatvamuktameva, tathā ‘srotojakardamavapuḥ’ ‘ityādinā pittajasya, tat kiṃ ‘paittānilāvapi ca’ ityādinā punarasādhyavacanamuktam? ucyate- kṣatajasyāsādhyatāprakrameṇa paittānilayorapi punarasādhyatāvacanamapūrvavacanaṃ; ata evoktaṃ- “prakramādutthito vādo na yāti punaruktatām| dūṣaṇaṃ dātumadhikaṃ cokte'pi punarucyate” iti||8||

lg.l: śophaṃ na pakvam iti ‘śopho na pakva iti’ iti pā. pakvam upekṣate yo yo vā vraṇaṃ pracurapūyam asādhuvṛttaḥ |
abhyantaraṃ praviśati pravidārya tasya sthānāni pūrvavihitāni ‘pūrvagaditāni’ iti ga. tataḥ sa pūyaḥ ||9||
tasyātimātragamanād gatir ity ataś ca nāḍīva yad vahati tena matā tu nāḍī |10|

ab.seg: nāḍīṃ nirdiśannāha- śophamityādi| vraṇamityatropekṣata iti sambandhaḥ| asādhuvṛttaḥ ahitāhārācāraḥ| sthānāni tvagādīni vraṇavāstuśabdābhihitāni| tasya pūyasya| ataśceti cakāro nāḍīniruktipakṣāntarasamuccaye| tāmeva nāḍīniruktimāha- nāḍīva yadvahati tena matā tu nāḍī; yena hetunā nāḍīvat praṇālīvadvahati yāti tena hetunā nāḍī matetyarthaḥ| śophaṃ na pakvamityādi hetuḥ, abhyantaramityādi samprāptiḥ, nāḍīvetyādi niruktiḥ||9||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: idānīṃ visarpasaṅkhyāparimitasāmānyāt, śothaprabaddhatvācca nāḍīrnirdiśannāha- śothaṃ na pakvamityādi| pakvameva śothamapakvamiti ya upekṣate, ata evāsādhuvṛttaḥ, vraṇe'pyahitāhāravihārayorativṛttatvāt| sthānāni pūrvagaditānīti tvagādīni vraṇavastuśabdābhihitāni| tāni sthānāni yadā'bhyantaraṃ prakarṣeṇa viśati pūyaḥ, atastvagādyantaniveśāt tasya pūyasya yadatimātraṃ gamanaṃ tato gatiriti gateścottaratra gatirityucyate| ityataśceti cakāro nāḍīgatiniruktipakṣāntaraṃ samuccinoti| yena hetunā nāḍīva praṇālīvajjalaṃ yāti, tenāpi hetunā nāḍī matetyarthaḥ| rogādeva rogaheturogasya nāḍīsañjñakasya samprāptyabhidhānaṃ taddoṣāt||9||

lg.l: doṣais tribhir bhavati sā pṛthag ekaśaś ca sammūrcchitair api ca śalyanimittato 'nyā ||10||

ab.seg: saṅkhyāṃ niyamayannāha- doṣairityādi| doṣaiḥpṛthagiti tisraḥ, ekaśaśca sannipatitairanyā, aparāśca tisraḥ| sammūrcchitairapi ca dvidoṣasaṃyogotthāḥ; anyathā apicakārau nirarthakau syātām| sammūrcchitairmiśrībhūtairityarthaḥ| śalyanimittato'nyā abhighātajā'paretyarthaḥ| gayī tu tribhirdoṣaiḥ pṛthak tisraḥ, ekaśaśca sammūrcchitairanyā sānnipātikī, śalyanimittā ca pañcamīti pañcaiva nāḍya iti vyākhyānayati||10||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: tatrāpi kālāntareṇa doṣānubandhe bhedasaṅkhyāniyamanaṃ nidarśayannāha- doṣaistribhirityādi| sammūrcchitairmiśrībhūtaiḥ, taireva sannipatitairityarthaḥ| śalyanimitto'nyā abhighātajā aparā||10||

lg.l: tatrānilāt paruṣasūkṣmamukhī saśūlā phenānuviddham adhikaṃ sravati kṣapāyām |11|

div.ab: teṣāṃ vātādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ lakṣaṇamāha- tatrānilādityādi| phenānuviddhaṃ phenamiśram|11|-

lg.l: tṛṭtāpatodasadanajvarabhedahetuḥ pītaṃ sravaty adhikam uṣṇam ahaḥsu pittāt ||11||

ab.seg: tṛṭtāpetyādi| tṛṭtāpādīnāṃ hetuḥ tṛṣādīn karotītyarthaḥ||11||

lg.l: jñeyā kaphād bahughanārjunapicchilāsrā rātrisrutiḥ stimitaruk kaṭhinā sakaṇḍūḥ |12|

div.ab: jñeyā kaphādityādi| bahughanārjunapicchilāsreti vipulasāndradhavalapicchilasrāvetyarthaḥ| atrāsraśabdaḥ srāvavācī cintya eva| anye tu ‘kaphādbahughanārjunapicchilasrut’ iti paṭhanti, tatra srut srāva ityarthaḥ| stimitarugiti mandavedanetyarthaḥ|12|-

lg.l: doṣadvayābhihitalakṣaṇadarśanena tisro gatīr vyatikaraprabhavās tu vidyāt ||12||

ab.seg: dvandvajā āha- doṣadvayābhihitetyādi| vyatikaraprabhavā dvandvajāḥ; vātapittajā, pittakaphajā, vātakaphajā ceti tisraḥ| gayī tu doṣadvayābhihitetyādi dvandvajānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ na paṭhati||12||

lg.l: dāhajvaraśvasanamūrcchanavaktraśoṣā yasyāṃ bhavanty abhihitāni ca lakṣaṇāni |
tām ādiśet pavanapittakaphaprakopād ghorām asu kṣayakarīm iva kālarātrim ||13||

ab.seg: sānnipātikīmāha- dāhajvaretyādi| asukṣayakarīṃ prāṇāpahāriṇīṃ; kāmiva? kālarātrimiva yamabhaginīmiva||13||

lg.l: naṣṭaṃ kathañcid anumārgam udīriteṣu ‘aṇumātramudīriteṣu’ iti pā. sthāneṣu śalyam acireṇa gatiṃ karoti |
sā phenilaṃ mathitam accham asṛgvimiśram uṣṇaṃ sraveta sahasā sarujā ca nityam ||14||

ab.seg: śalyanimittāṃ darśayannāha- naṣṭamityādi| udīriteṣu sthāneṣu tvagādiṣu| mathitamunmathitamiva| uṣṇamuṣṇasparśaṃ; ‘srāvaṃ’ ityadhyāhāraḥ||14||

div.ab: Nyā. Ca. tatrānilāt phenānubaddhaṃ phenamiśraṃ kṣapāyāmadhikaṃ sravati, śaityena tatra vātakopāt| pittaduṣṭā ahaḥsvadhikaṃ sravati, divoṣṇena pittakopāt| kaphādbahughanārjunapicchilāsrā vipulasāndradhavalacikkaṇasrāvetyarthaḥ| tatra asraśabdaḥ srāvavācī cintya eva| anye ‘bahughanārjanapicchilasrut’ iti paṭhanti| tatra sravateḥ sampadāditvādbhāve kvip| srut srāva eva| tridoṣajāyāmasukṣayakarīmiva kālarātriṃ yamabhaginīmiva| śalyanimittāṃ darśayannāha- naṣṭaṃ kathañcidityādi| kenā'pi prakāreṇa naṣṭam| anumārgaṃ mārgaṃ lakṣīkṛtya; ‘aṇumārgaṃ’ ityanye paṭhanti; tatrāṇumārgatvenaiva śalyasādṛśyāt kathañciditi nirarthakaṃ syāt| udīriteṣu sthāneṣu tvāgādiṣu| saphenilamiti phenavantaṃ; matvarthe| mathitam unmathitamiva| uṣṇam uṣṇasparśam| ete dharmāstu prasaraṇādau calatā śalyena māṃsādikṣobhena bhavanti| kṣatajānvitatvamapi srāvasya calatā śalyenādhiṣṭhānanāśakṛtatvāditi||11-14|| iti sauśrute śalyatantre visarpanāḍīvraṇanidānaṃ sampūrṇam|

lg.l: yāvatyo gatayo yaiś ca kāraṇaiḥ sambhavanti hi |
tāvantaḥ stanarogāḥ syuḥ strīṇāṃ tair eva hetubhiḥ ||15||

ab.seg: idānīṃ stanarogāṇāṃ saṅkhyāṃ hetuṃ ca darśayannāha- yāvatya ityādi| yāvatyo yāvatpramāṇā gatayaḥ, yaiśca kāraṇairvātapittakaphasannipātābhighātaiḥ, tāvantaḥ tāvatpramāṇāḥ||15||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: athātaḥ stanaroganidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| nāḍīnāmanantaraṃ paribhāṣikatvena stanarogārambhaḥ| stanarogahetusaṅkhye atideśena darśayannāha- yāvantyo gataya ityādi| yairhetubhirvātapittakaphasannipātābhighātairyāvatpramāṇā gatayastaireva kāraṇaistāvatpramāṇāḥ stanarogāḥ||15||

lg.l: doṣāvisaraṇāt tāsāṃ ‘doṣāvitaraṇāt’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ paṭhati, doṣāvitaraṇāt saṃvṛtadvāratayā stanāmayārambhakāṇāṃ doṣāṇāmavisarjanāt’ iti ca vyākhyānayati na bhavanti stanāmayāḥ ||16||

ab.seg: idānīṃ samānāyāmapi jātāvasambhūtagarbhāṇāṃ te rogā na bhavantīti darśayannāha- dhamanya ityādi| kanyānāmasambhūtagarbhāṇāṃ strīṇāmityarthaḥ| avisaraṇam aprasaraṇam||16||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: idānīṃ samānāyāmapi jātāvasambhūtagarbhāṇāṃ te rogā na bhavantīti darśayannāha- dhamanya ityādi||16||

lg.l: tāsām eva prajātānāṃ garbhiṇīnāṃ ca tāḥ punaḥ |
svabhāvād eva vivṛtā jāyante sambhavanty ataḥ ||17||

ab.seg: tāsāmeva sagarbhāṇāṃ prajātānāṃ ca tā eva dhamanyo vivṛtadvārā bhavantīti darśayannāha- tāsāmevetyādi| prajātānāṃ prasūtānām| tā iti dhamanyaḥ| vivṛtāḥ prasṛtadvārāḥ, jāyante bhavantītyarthaḥ| sambhavantīti ‘stanarogā’ iti śeṣaḥ||17||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: tāsāmeva sagarbhāṇāṃ prajātānāṃ ca tā eva dhamanyo vivṛtadvārā bhavantīti darśayannāha- tāsāmevetyādi| tatra hetvantaramapaśyannāha- svabhāvādeveti| sambhavantyato hetoḥ ‘stanarogāḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ||17||

lg.l: kṛtsnadehāt stanau prāptaḥ stanyam ity abhidhīyate ||18||

ab.seg: ‘sakṣīrau vā'pyadugdhau vā prāpya doṣā’ iti strīkṣīrasya stanarogāṇāṃ hetutvenoktatvāt strīkṣīrasyaiva sambhavamāha- rasaprasāda ityādi|- rasaprasādaḥ rasasya prasādo dhāma sārasteja ityarthaḥ| pakvāhāranimittaja iti prādhānyāt pakvāhāranimittaśabdena rasaḥ kathyate, tena rasaja ityarthaḥ| stanyaniruktimāha- kṛtsnadehādityādi| rasadhātorvyānavikṣiptasya sarvadehagatatvāt||18||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: idānīṃ ‘sakṣīrau vā'pyadugdhau vā’ iti strīkṣīrasya stanarogāṇāṃ hetutvenoktatvāt strīkṣīrasyaiva prabhavaṃ, tasya stanyasya prakṛtibhūtasya vikṛtasya ca prasaṅgena lakṣaṇaṃ ca darśayannāha- rasaprasāda ityādi| rasyasya prasādo rasaprasādaḥ, dhāma sāraḥ, tena madhuratā śuklatā ca| vātādidoṣaduṣṭasya punaḥ kaṣāyatvamamlatvamatimādhuryaṃ vā| pakvaścāsāvāhāraḥ, sa eva nimittaṃ yasya sa tathā, sa tu ‘rasa’ ucyate, prādhānyāt; na punarmalabhūtaṃ viṭ pakvam, aprādhānyādeva; tato jātaṃ, taduktaṃ carake- “rasāt stanyaṃ tathā raktamasṛjaḥ kaṇḍarāḥ sirāḥ” (ca. ci. 15) iti| tathā bhoje'pi- “sirāsnāyurajaḥstanyatvaco gativivarjitāḥ| dhātubhyaścopajāyante tasmātta upadhātavaḥ” iti| tasyedānīṃ ‘stanabhavaṃ stanyaṃ’ ityasyārthasya yogaṃ darśayannāha- kṛtsnāddehādityādi| rasadhātorvyānavikṣiptasya sarvadehagatvāt||18||

lg.l: viśas teṣv api gātreṣu yathā śukraṃ na dṛśyate |
sarvadehāśritatvāc ca ‘sarvadehāśritatve'pi stanyaṃ lakṣaṇatastathā’ iti hārāṇacandasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ śukralakṣaṇam ucyate ||19||
tad eva ceṣṭayuvater darśanāt smaraṇād api |
suprasannaṃ manas tatra harṣaṇe hetur ucyate |
āhārarasayonitvād evaṃ ‘āhārarasavīryatvāt’ iti tā. stanyam api striyāḥ ||21||
sneho nirantaras tatra prasrave hetur ucyate |23|

ab.seg: tasya śarīrābhyantarasthasyādṛśyasyāpi prasiddhopamānena pravartane hetuṃ darśayannāha- viśasteṣvapītyādi| śukralakṣaṇaṃ ‘stanyamucyate’ iti śeṣaḥ| kuta ityāha- yathā śukraṃ viśasteṣu chinneṣvapi gātreṣu na dṛśyate, tasmādvitīyaṃ hetumāha- sarvadehāśritatvāditi, śukravat samastaśarīrāśritatvāt| śukradṛṣṭāntena stanyasyābhyantaradarśanaṃ pratipādya tenaiva dṛṣṭāntena sāmagrītastasya pravartanādbahiḥ pratyakṣatāṃ pratipādayannāha- tadevetyādi| tadeva śukraṃ pravartate bahirniḥsarati| saṃharṣād viśiṣṭasparśasaṅkalpalakṣaṇāt| viśiṣṭasparśasaṅkalpe hetucatuṣṭayaṃ darśayannāha- iṣṭayuvaterityādi| iṣṭayuvatidarśanādihetucatuṣṭayena yaḥ saṃharṣaḥ sa suprasanna eva manasi bhavatīti manaso'pi suprasannasya kāraṇatvaṃ darśayannāha- suprasannamityādi| suprasannamīrṣyādyanabhibhūtam| evaṃ stanyamapi striyāḥ pravartate, śukramāhārarasayonitvāt pravartate stanyamapi tathā, tasmāt pravartate| nanu śukramāhārayonyapi saṃharṣāt kāraṇāt pravartate, atra ca kiṃ kāraṇamityāha- tadevetyādi| tadeva stanyaṃ śukravat sampravartate| apatyasaṃsparśādikāraṇacatuṣṭaye'pi sneho mūlakāraṇamiti tadeva darśayannāha- sneha ityādi| prasrave stanyasravaṇe| atrāpi catvāro hetavaḥ, paramiṣṭayuvatisthāne'trāpatyagrahaṇaṃ, mūlahetuharṣasthāne snehaḥ||19-22||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: tasya punaḥ śarīrābhyantarasthasya pramāṇairanupalbhyasyāpi prasiddhopamānena pravartane hetvantaraṃ darśayannāha- viśasteṣvapītyādi| viśasteṣu vikṛtteṣu| yat punarantaḥ pratyakṣaṃ na bhavati bahirapi tat pratyakṣaṃ na bhavatītyāśaṅkya sāmagrītastasya bahirāvirbhāvena pratyakṣatāṃ darśayannāha- tadeva ceṣṭayuvaterisyādi| saṃharṣāt iṣṭayuvaterviśiṣṭasparśasaṅkalpalakṣaṇāt| darśanādiṣvapi caturṣvanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ śukrabhāvābhāvāt samaulaṃ kāraṇaṃ harṣasyāpi darśayannāha- suprasannamityādi| suprasannam īrṣyādibhiranabhibhūtam| śukreṇa saha prastutasya stanyasya sādharmyāddhetuṃ darśayannāha- sarvadehāśritatvācceti| ubhayorapi sarvadehāśrayatvādityarthaḥ| atrāpi catvāra eva hetavaḥ| parimiṣṭayuvatisthāne atrāpatyagrahaṇaṃ, maulahetuharṣasthāne tu snehaḥ, suprasannasthāne nirantaraḥ; nirantaro niratiśaya ityarthaḥ||19-22||

lg.l: tat kaṣāyaṃ bhaved vātāt kṣiptaṃ ca plavate 'mbhasi ||23||
pittād amlaṃ sakaṭukaṃ rājyo 'mbhasi ca pītikāḥ |
kaphād ghanaṃ picchilaṃ ca jale cāpy avasīdati |
sarvair duṣṭaiḥ sarvaliṅgam abhighātāc ca duṣyati ||24||

ab.seg: stanyasya prabhavaṃ pravartanaṃ cābhidhāya prakṛtimabhidhātukāmaḥ parityājyatayā prathamaṃ vikṛtiṃ darśayannāha- tadityādi| kṣiptaṃ ceti cakāreṇānuktamapi tanutvādikaṃ samuccīyate| sakaṭukam īṣattiktaṃ, tikte'pi kaṭuśabdasya pravṛtteḥ| ambhasi ceti cakārānnīlalohitāśca rājyo draṣṭavyāḥ| picchilaṃ ceti cakāreṇa doṣasamplavaḥ sūcyate| avasīdati buḍati| abhighātāt patanapīḍanādikāt||23-24||

lg.l: yat kṣīram udake kṣiptam ekībhavati ‘ekatvaṃ yāti’ iti pā. pāṇḍuram |
madhuraṃ cāvivarṇaṃ ca prasannaṃ tad vinirdiśet ||25||

ab.seg: nirdoṣasya stanyasya lakṣaṇamāha- yadityādi| ekībhavati ‘ekatvaṃ yāti’ iti pā. ekatvaṃ yāti milatītyarthaḥ| avivarṇam īṣatpītādivarṇam| prasannaṃ prakṛtistham||25||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: stanyasya prakṛtimabhidhāya vikṛtiṃ nidarśayannāha- tadityādi| kṣiptaṃ ca plavate laghutvāt| kṣiptaṃ ceti cakāreṇa tanutvādīnyanuktānyapi samuccīyante| sakaṭukam īṣattiktamityarthaḥ; tikte'pi kaṭukaśabdapravṛtteḥ| rājyo'mbhasi ca pītikā iti cakāro bhinnakrame, tena pītikāśceti draṣṭavyaṃ, tena pittaduṣṭasya nīlalohitāśca rājyo draṣṭavyāḥ| toye cāpyavasīdati gurutvāt majjanāplavanābhyāṃ pradeśe ekībhāvopalambhāt| picchilaṃ ceti cakāreṇātimādhuryādyapi boddhavyam| prasannaṃ tu sādhāraṇaṃ pāṇḍuraṃ madhuraṃ ca| cakāreṇa kaphavardhakatve'pyanayoḥ stanyaprakṛtitvamityabhinirdiśyate| atipāṇḍutvamatimādhuryaṃ ca kaphavṛddhilakṣaṇam| vātakaphadoṣeṇātiviṣyandi| avivarṇam īṣatpītādiprakṛtivarṇam| prasannaṃ prakṛtistham||23-25||

lg.l: sakṣīrau vā 'py adugdhau vā prāpya doṣaḥ stanau striyāḥ |
raktaṃ māṃsaṃ ca sandūṣya stanarogāya kalpate ||26||

ab.seg: stanarogahetuṃ stanyaṃ prakṛtivikṛtibhirabhinirdiśya stanarogasamprāptiṃ darśayannāha- sakṣīrāvityādi| sakṣīrau garbhiṇyāḥ, tasyā dohasyāsambhavāt| adugdhau prasūtāyāḥ, tasyā dohasya sambhavāt| tatra yadā dohyāvadugdhau bhavataḥ, tadā kṣīrabharapīḍitā doṣāḥ kupitāḥ stanarogāya jāyante| stanarogāya kalpate stanarogārthe samartho bhavati||26||

lg.l: pañcānām api teṣāṃ tu hitvā śoṇitavidradhim |

ab.seg: teṣāmapi saṅkṣepārthaṃ lakṣaṇamatideśena nirdiśannāha- pañcānāmapītyādi| teṣāṃ stanarogāṇām| samānāni tulyāni, ‘bhavanti’ ityadhyāhāraḥ||27||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: tatra stanarogahetuṃ stanyaṃ prabhavaprakṛtivikṛtibhirabhinirdiśya stanarogasamprāptiṃ pratipādayannāha- sakṣīrāvityādi||26-27||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne visarpanāḍīstanaroganidānaṃ nāma daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||10||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nidānasthāne daśamo'dhyāyaḥ||10||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: iti sauśrute śalyatantre śrīgayadāsaviracitāyāṃ nyāyacandrikāyāṃ pañjikāyāṃ nidānasthāne daśamo'dhyāyaḥ||10||

div.head: granthyapacyarbudagalagaṇḍanidānam

ab.seg: athāto granthapacyarbudagalagaṇḍānāṃ nidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi||1-2||

lg.l: vātādayo māṃsam asṛk ca duṣṭāḥ sandūṣya medaś ca kaphānuviddham ‘tathā sirāśca’ iti tā.|
vṛttonnataṃ vigrathitaṃ tu śophaṃ kurvanty ato granthir iti pradiṣṭaḥ ||3||

ab.seg: teṣāṃ hetusamprāptilakṣaṇaniruktīrāha- vātādaya ityādi| vātādayo doṣā duṣṭā māṃsamasṛk ca sandūṣya śophaṃ kurvantīti sambandhaḥ| etena trayo granthaya uktāḥ| medaśca kaphānuviddhaṃ kaphasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ vāyudūṣitatvācchophaṃ karotīti sambandhaḥ| bhoje'pi vātakartṛtvaṃ medogranthāvabhihitam| tathā ca,- “vāyurmedo yadā māṃse saṅkṣipedathavā tvaci| tatra medobhavo granthiḥ śyāvo bhavati kaṇḍulaḥ”- ityādi| ayaṃ caturtho granthiḥ| cakārāt sirājo granthiḥ pañcamo grāhyaḥ| duṣṭā vṛddhiṃ gatā ityarthaḥ| vṛtto vartulaḥ, unnata ucchritaḥ| vigrathito'tyarthaṃ kaṭhinaḥ| vātādayo duṣṭā ityanena hetūpadeśaḥ, māṃsamasṛk ca sandūṣyeti samprāptiḥ, vṛttonnataṃ viprathitaṃ tu śophamiti lakṣaṇopadeśaḥ, ato granthiriti pradiṣṭa iti niruktiḥ||3||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: medogranthiḥ asyāgre kiñcidgranthaḥ khaṇḍitaḥ pṛthageva samprāptyā'nvitaḥ; yaduktaṃ bhoje- “vāyurmedo yadā māṃse vikṣipedathavā tvaci| tatra medobhavo granthiḥ śyāvo bhavati kaṇḍuraḥ ‘pāṇḍuraḥ’ iti madhukośe pāṭhaḥ|| kṛśaḥ kṛśe mahān sthūle granthirbhinnaśca pīḍitaḥ| tilakalkanibhaḥ srāvo ghṛtavaccāsya jāyate” iti| sirāgranthestu pṛthageva samprāptiḥ||1-3||

lg.l: āyamyate vyathyata ‘vyathyati tudyate ca’ iti tā. eti todaṃ pratyasyate kṛtyata ‘mathyati bhidyate ca’ iti tā. eti bhedam |
kṛṣṇo 'mṛdur bastir ivātataś ca bhinnaḥ sravec cānilajo 'sram accham ||4||

ab.seg: teṣāṃ vātādijānāṃ pratyekaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ lakṣaṇamāha- āyamyata ityādi| āyamyate vāyorākarṣaṇena dīrgha iva kriyate, ‘granthiḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| vyathyate vidhūyate| eti gacchati| todaṃ vyathām| pratyasyate kṣipyate| kṛtyate chidyate| eti bhedamiti bhedaṃ ca gacchati| amṛduḥ karkaśaḥ| bastirivātataśceti mūtrāśayavaddīrghaḥ| asraṃ rudhiram||4||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: āyamyata iti vāyorākarṣaṇena dīrgha iva kriyate| ‘vyadhyate’ ityatra ‘vyāthyati’ ityeke paṭhanti||4||

lg.l: dandahyate dhūpyati cūṣyate ‘cātimātraṃ’ iti pā. ca pāpacyate prajvalatīva cāpi |
raktaḥ sapīto 'py athavā 'pi pittād bhinnaḥ sraved uṣṇam atīva cāsram ||5||

ab.seg: dandahyate bhṛśaṃ dahyata iva| dhūpyati cātimātram atiśayena santāpaṃ karoti| pāpacyate bhṛśaṃ pacyata iva| prajvalatīva bhasmībhavatīva||5||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: pittagranthau dandahyate bhṛśaṃ dahyata iva| pāpacyate bhṛśaṃ pacyate iva| prajvalatīva prakarṣeṇa jvalatīva||5||

lg.l: cirābhivṛddhiś ca kaphaprakopād bhinnaḥ sravec chuklaghanaṃ ca pūyam ||6||

ab.seg: avivarṇa īṣadvivarṇaḥ| pāṣāṇavat pāṣāṇa iva ‘kaṭhina’ ityadhyāhāraḥ| saṃhananopapannaḥ saṅghātānvito mahānityarthaḥ||6||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: kaphagranthau śīto'vivarṇa iti īṣadvivarṇaḥ| pāṣāṇavat kaṭhinaḥ| saṃhananopapannaḥ saṃhatānvito mahānityarthaḥ||6||

lg.l: medaḥkṛto gacchati cātra bhinne piṇyākasarpiḥpratimaṃ tu medaḥ ||7||

ab.seg: śarīravṛddhikṣayavṛddhihāniriti dehāpyāyanahrāsābhyāmāpyāyanahrāsau yasya sa tathā| gacchati sravati meda iti sambandhaḥ| atra medogranthau bhinne sati, piṇyākasarpiḥpratimaṃ tilakalkastyānaghṛtasadṛśam||7||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: śarīravṛddhikṣayavṛddhihāniriti dehāpyāyanahrāsābhyāmāpyāyanahrāsau yasya sa tathā| gacchati cātra bhinne piṇyākasarpiḥpratimaṃ tu bhedaḥ| bhinne sati tilakalkastyānaghṛtasadṛśaṃ medo gacchati sravatītyarthaḥ||7||

div.ab:
vyāyāmajātair abalasya tais tair ākṣipya vāyur hi sirāpratānam |
sampīḍya saṅkocya viśoṣya cāpi granthiṃ karoty unnatam āśu vṛttam ||8||
granthiḥ sirājaḥ sa tu kṛcchrasādhyo bhaved yadi syāt sarujaś calaś ca |
aruk sa evāpy acalo ‘sa evāvicalaḥ’ iti pā. mahāṃś ca marmotthitaś cāpi vivarjanīyaḥ ||9|| iti granthīnāṃ nidānaṃ samāptam |

ab.seg: sirājasya grantheḥ samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- vyāyāmajātairityādi| vyāyāmajātaiḥ vyāyāmasamūhaiḥ| abalasya puruṣasya| sirāpratānaṃ sirāvistāram| sirājasya kṛcchrasādhyatvamāha- sa tu kṛcchrasādhya ityādi| tasyāsādhyatvamāha- arugityādi| mahāṃśceti cakāreṇa vātādijā apyevaṃrūpā varjanīyāḥ| marmotthitaśceti cakāreṇa arujo'pi vivarjanīyaḥ| anye punaratra “māṃsāsrajaṃ cārbudalakṣaṇena tulyaṃ hi dṛṣṭaṃ tvatha lakṣaṇajñaiḥ”- iti ṣaṣṭhaṃ granthiṃ paṭhanti| tanna, jejjaṭādibhiḥ parihṛtatvāt||8-9||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: sirājasya grantheḥ samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- vyāyāmajātairityādi| ayaṃ rujāyuktaḥ kṛcchrasādhyaḥ| sa cārujaścāpyacalo mahāṃśca marmotthitaścāpi vivarjanīyaḥ| taduktamanyatra- “sirājaścirasādhyastu sarvebhyo durupakramaḥ” iti| sa ceti cakāreṇa vātādijo'pyetādṛśalakṣaṇo'sādhya eva| tathā ca bhojaḥ- “durbalasya sirā vāyurmaithunādiprajāgaraiḥ| granthiṃ karoti prathitamākṣipan pariśoṣayan|| sirājālāvṛtaṃ kṛtsnaṃ pīḍayan sarujaṃ calam| pañcaitānarujān granthīnmarmajānacalāṃstyajet|| kapolagalamanyāsu duścikitsyāśca sandhiṣu| asādhyān varjayan sādhyān kṛcchrasādhyāṃśca sādhayet” iti| anye punaratra māṃsāsṛgjaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ granthiṃ paṭhanti- māṃsāsrajaṃ cārbudalakṣaṇena tulyaṃ hi ṣaṣṭhaṃ (dṛṣṭaṃ) tvatha lakṣaṇajñaiḥ” iti| ayamevārthaḥ samānatantreṣvapi pāramparyāt smaryate iti ca vadanti||8-9||

lg.l: granthiṃ sthiraṃ vṛttam athāyataṃ vā snigdhaṃ kaphaś cālparujaṃ karoti ||10||

taṃ granthibhis tv āmalakāsthimātrair matsyāṇḍajālapratimais tathā 'nyaiḥ ‘jāle jālākāre ādhāre matsyāṇḍaṃ matsyāṇḍajālaṃ, rājadantādiṣu draṣṭavyaṃ| tatsadṛśairmatsyāṇḍajālapratimaiḥ’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ|
kaṇḍūyutās te 'lparujaḥ prabhinnāḥ sravanti naśyanti bhavanti cānye |
medaḥkaphābhyāṃ khalu roga eṣa sudustaro varṣagaṇānubandhī ||12||

ab.seg: idānīmapacyāḥ samprāptyādīnāha- hanvasthītyādi| hanvorasthi hanvasthi; sandhiśabdo hanvasthyādibhirbāhvantaiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate; bāhusandhiśabdena kūrpasandhirucyate; akṣakaṃ koṣṭhakaṃ tasya sandhiḥ, etena grīvāgrakasandhirucyate ‘grīvādhaḥsandhiḥ’ iti pā.; manyā grīvāpaścimabhāgasthā dhamanī| hanvasthītyādisamprāptiḥ, granthiṃ sthiraṃ vṛttamityādilakṣaṇam| taṃ granthibhirityādi taṃ pūrvoktaṃ granthim| ananyavarṇaiḥ samānavarṇaiḥ| upacīyamānaṃ vardhamānam| cayaprakarṣāditi upacayātiśayādityarthaḥ| cayaprakarṣādapacīmiti niruktiḥ| khaluśabdo'pyarthaḥ| tena medaḥkaphau vātādidoṣāntarānuviddhau jñeyau| tathāhi bhojaḥ,- “vātapittakaphā vṛddhā medaścāpi samācitam| jaṅghayoḥ kaṇḍarāḥ prāpya matsyāṇḍasadṛśān bahūn|| kurvanti grathitāṃstebhyaḥ punaḥ prakupito'nilaḥ| tān doṣānūrdhvago ‘tridoṣān’ iti pā. vakṣaḥkakṣāmanyāgalāśritaḥ|| nānāprakārān kurute granthīn sā tvapacī smṛtā| vyāmiśradoṣajātā sā kṛcchrasādhyā prakīrtitā|| tāsāṃ vātottarā rūkṣā vātavedanayā'nvitā| kṣiprapākasamutthānā dāhayuktā tu paittikī|| gūḍhā vā'pākakaṭhinā kaphāt snigdhā'lparukkarā| medo'dhikā ślaiṣmikī ca viśeṣādatimārdavā|| apacī kaṇṭhamanyāsu kakṣāvaṅkṣaṇasandhisu| tāṃ tu mālākṛtiṃ vidyāt kaṇṭhahṛddhanusandhiṣu|| gaṇḍamālāṃ vijānīyādapacītulyalakṣaṇām”- iti| carake gaṇḍamālā gaṇḍe eva paṭhitā “medaḥkaphācchoṇitasañcayottho gaṇḍasya pārśve galagaṇḍa ekaḥ| syādgaṇḍamālā bahubhistu gaṇḍairdīptānale yūni balānvite ca|| sādhyā smṛtā pīnasapārśvaśūlakāsajvaracchardiyutā tvasādhyā” (ca. ci. 12)- iti| anye tu ‘medaḥkaphābhyāṃ punareṣa rogaḥ’ iti paṭhanti; punaḥśabdādadhikārthāddoṣāntarasambandhaḥ sthāpito bhavatīti ca vadanti| tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ| varṣagaṇānubandhī varṣasamūhasambandhītyarthaḥ| etena dīrgharogitvaṃ sūcitam| medaḥkaphābhyāmiti hetūddeśaḥ||10-12||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: grantheranantaramapacyārambhaḥ, granthiviśeṣādapacyāḥ, medaḥsamucchrayagranthipratyāsannataśca| tasyāḥ samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- hanvasthikakṣākṣaketyādi| hanvorasthi hanvasthi| sandhiśabdo hanvasthyādibhirbāhvantaiḥ saha pratyekamabhisambadhyate| bāhusandhiśabdena kūrparasandhirucyate| bāhumūlasandheḥ kakṣāśabdenaivopapannatvāt| akṣasandhiḥ grīvādhaḥsandhiḥ| eṣu sandhipradeśeṣūpacitaṃ dūṣyaṃ medaḥ, kaphaśca doṣo granthiṃ karoti| tamupacīyamānaṃ khalu anyairgranthibhirāmalakāsthipramāṇairmīnāṇḍākāraiḥ| cayaprakarṣādapacīti niruktiḥ| ‘cayāpakarṣāt’ iti kecit paṭhanti| sā punarupacayāpacayābhyāmapacīyate| upacayāpacayau darśayannāha- naśyanti bhavanti cānye iti| medaḥkaphābhyāmiti pūrvoktadoṣadūṣyayoreva niyamanam| khaluśabdo'pyarthaḥ, nipātānāmanekārthatvāt| tena medaḥkaphayoreva vātādidoṣāntarasaṃsargaṃ sūcayati| tathāhi bhojaḥ- “vātapittakaphā vṛddhā medaścāpi samācitam| jaṅghayoḥ kaṇḍarāḥ prāpya matsyāṇḍasadṛśān bahūn|| kurvanti grathitāṃstebhyaḥ punaḥ prakupito'nilaḥ| tān doṣānūrdhvago vakṣaḥkakṣāmanyāgalāśritaḥ|| nānāprakārāt kurute granthīn sā tvapacī smṛtā| vyāmiśradoṣajātā sā kṛcchrasādhyā prakīrtitā|| tāsāṃ vātottarā rūkṣā vātavedanayā'nvitā| kṣiprapākasamutthānā dāhayuktā tu paittikī|| gūḍhapākā ca kaṭhinā kaphāt snigdhā'lparuk sthirā| medodhikā ślaiṣmikī ca viśeṣādatimārdavā|| apacī kaṇṭhamanyāsu kakṣāvaṅkṣaṇasandhiṣu| tāṃ tu mālākṛtisamāṃ kaṇṭhahṛddhanusandhiṣu|| gaṇḍamālāṃ vijānīyātadapacītulyalakṣaṇām” iti| sthānakṛta eva bhedo'pacīgaṇḍamālayoḥ, grahaṇyatisārayoriva| gale eva mālāsthānā gaṇḍamālā carakeṇa paṭhitā- “medaḥkaphācchoṇitasañcayotthaḥ| galasya madhye galagaṇḍa ekaḥ syādgaṇḍamālā bahubhistu gaṇḍaiḥ|| sādhyāḥ smṛtāḥ pīnasapārśvaśūlakāsajvaracchardiyutāstvasādhyāḥ” iti| (ca. ci. ) ityapacīnāṃ nidānaṃ sampūrṇam||10-12||

lg.l: gātrapradeśe kvacid eva doṣāḥ sammūrcchitā māṃsam abhipradūṣya |
vṛttaṃ sthiraṃ mandarujaṃ mahāntam analpamūlaṃ ciravṛddhyapākam ||13||
kurvanti māṃsopacayaṃ tu śophaṃ tam arbudaṃ śāstravido vadanti |14|

ab.seg: idānīmarbudādīnāṃ samprāptyādīnāha- gātrapradeśe ityādi| kvacideva gātrapradeśe doṣāḥ śophaṃ kurvantīti sambandhaḥ| sammūrcchitā vṛddhiṃ gatāḥ| kvacidevāniyatapradeśe, na punarapacīvaddhanvasthyādisandhiṣveva| apākam avidyamānapākam| māṃsopacayaṃ māṃsasaṅghātam| gātrapradeśe kvacideveti samprāptiḥ| sammūrcchitā doṣā iti hetuḥ| vṛttaṃ sthiramityādi svalakṣaṇam| gayī tu ‘kurvanti māṃsocchrayamatyagādham’ iti paṭhati||13||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: apacyanantaramarbudārambhaḥ, medaḥkaphādhikajanmasāmānyāt| tasya samprāptimāha- gātrapradeśa ityādi| kvacidevāniyatapradeśe na punarapacīvaddhanvasthyādiṣveva| sammūrcchitā vṛddhāḥ| apākamiti avidyamānapākam| māṃsocchrayaṃ māṃsasaṅghātam| atyagādhamāṃsaṃ tanmūlatvāt; tasmādeva hetorarbudamapākam; agādhamāṃsocchrayamarbudaṃ jāyate, vastusvabhāvāditi||13||

lg.l: vātena pittena kaphena cāpi raktena māṃsena ca medasā ca ||14||
taj jāyate tasya ca lakṣaṇāni grantheḥ samānāni sadā bhavanti |15|

ab.seg: tajjāyate tadarbudaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| tasya ca lakṣaṇāni tasya vātapittakaphamedojasya||14||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: teṣāṃ vātapittakaphamedojānāṃ vātādigranthilakṣaṇairlakṣaṇāni samānāni||14||

lg.l: doṣaḥ praduṣṭo rudhiraṃ sirās tu sampīḍya saṅkocya gatas tv apākam ||15||
sāsrāvam unnahyati māṃsapiṇḍaṃ māṃsāṅkurair ācitam āśuvṛddhim |
sravaty ajasraṃ rudhiraṃ praduṣṭam asādhyam etad rudhirātmakaṃ syāt ||16||

ab.seg: raktajasyārbudasya lakṣaṇamāha- doṣaḥ praduṣṭa ityādi| praduṣṭo doṣaḥ sirāsu gato rudhiraṃ sampīḍya saṅkocya māṃsapiṇḍamunnahyatīti sambandhaḥ| unnahyati udbadhnātīva; anye tu ‘praduṣṭo doṣa unnahyati ucchrito bhavati, māṃsapiṇḍamāśuvṛddhiṃ śīghravardhanaśīlaṃ karoti’ iti vyākhyānayanti| apākam īṣatpākam||15-16||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: śoṇitajasya lakṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha- doṣaḥ praduṣṭa ityādi| apākamīṣatpākam, īṣadarthe nañ; alomikā piṇḍiketi yathā| doṣa unnahyati ucchrito bhavati| na kevalamunnahyati āśuvṛddhiṃ śīghravṛddhiṃ māṃsapiṇḍaṃ ca karoti| sravedajasram adhiṣṭhānabhūtasirārudhiraṃ; natu pākakṛtam, īṣadeva kledamātralakṣaṇasyāsrāvasyoktatvāt||15-16||

lg.l: muṣṭiprahārādibhir ardite 'ṅge māṃsaṃ praduṣṭaṃ prakaroti śopham ||17||
avedanaṃ snigdham ananyavarṇam apākam aśmopamam apracālyam |
praduṣṭamāṃsasya narasya bāḍham etad bhaven māṃsaparāyaṇasya ||18||

div.ab: māṃsajasya samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- muṣṭiprahārādibhirityādi| samupaiti samyaggacchati| bāḍham atiśayena| māṃsaparāyaṇasya māṃsabhakṣaṇaśīlasya| ‘muṣṭiprahārādibhiḥ’ ityatra kecit ‘kāṣṭhaprahārādibhiḥ’ iti paṭhanti||17-18||-

lg.l: samprasrutaṃ marmaṇi yac ca jātaṃ srotaḥsu vā yac ca bhaved acālyam ||19||
yaj jāyate 'nyat ‘sañjāyate yat’ iti pā. khalu pūrvajāte jñeyaṃ tad adhyarbudam arbudajñaiḥ |
yad dvandvajātaṃ yugapat kramād vā dvir arbudaṃ tac ca bhaved asādhyam ||20||

ab.seg: sādhyeṣvapītyādi| sādhyeṣvapīmāni vivarjayediti sādhyeṣu madhye imāni vakṣyamāṇāni vivarjayedityarthaḥ| adhyarbudamapi dvirarbudameva, anye ‘atyarbudaṃ’ iti paṭhanti| yaddvandvajātamityādi dvandvena yugmena jātaṃ dvandvajātaṃ; na kevalamadhyarbudaṃ dvirarbudaṃ, yaddvandvajātaṃ tadapi dvirarbudamityarthaḥ| bhedaśca tayoruparijātatvena pārśvajātatvena ca| etena dvirarbudadvitayamapyasādhyamuktam||19-20||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: māṃsajasya samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- kāṣṭhaprahārādibhirityādi| māṃsaparāyaṇasyeti māṃsaikaparasyātimāṃsavṛddhermāṃsajaṃ, tadasādhyaṃ; tathaiva samprasrutādīnyapyasādhyāni| adhyarbudam adhikamarbudam; adhyarbudaṃ yattadapi dvirarbudaṃ, yad dvandvena yugapadeva jātaṃ kramādvā tadadhyarbudaṃ dvirarbudamapi; dvayametadasādhyam| tathā ca bhojaḥ- “arbade tvarbudaṃ jātaṃ dvandvajaṃ vā'nujaṃ ca yat| dvirarbudamiti jñeyaṃ tadasādhyaṃ vinirdiśet” iti||17-20||

lg.l: na pākam āyānti kaphādhikatvān medobahutvāc ca viśeṣatas tu |
doṣasthiratvād grathanāc ca teṣāṃ sarvārbudāny eva nisargatas tu ||21||

ab.seg: teṣāṃ pākābhāve hetuṃ darśayannāha- na pākamityādi| granthyādiṣvapi kaphādayaścatvāro hetavaḥ santi, paramarbudeṣu viśeṣataḥ kaphasya medasaścādhikyaṃ tasmāt, tathā viśeṣato doṣasthiratvād doṣakāryasya māṃsocchrayasya tenaiva svarūpeṇa cirakālāvasthitiśīlatvāt, tathā grathanād granthirūpatvātteṣāṃ medaḥprabhṛtīnāṃ; nisargatastviti tuśabdo'pyarthaḥ, tena svabhāvādapyarbudāni pākaṃ na gacchatītyarthaḥ||21||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: teṣāṃ pākābhāve hetuṃ darśayannāha- na pākamāyāntītyādi| granthyādiṣvapi kaphādayaścatvāro hetavaḥ, arbudeṣu punaḥ kaphamedasorādhikyamiti viśeṣaḥ, tato na pākamāyānti| sarvāṇyevārbudāni pittaraktakṛtānyapi na pākamāgacchanti, kutaḥ? kaphādhikatvādityādi| viśeṣata iti viśeṣādatra kaphamedasorādhikyāt| tatraivāsiddhatāsādhanadoṣaṃ nirasyannāha- viśeṣato doṣasthiratvāt; kaphakāryasthiratvāt, tathā medaḥkāryake doṣakāryagrathanarūpāt; viśeṣeṇaivātra kaphamedasoḥ kāryasāmarthyenetyarthaḥ| nisargatastu atra tu śabdo'pyarthaḥ, svabhāvādapītyarthaḥ| bhoje'pyuktaṃ- “na pacyate sthiratvācca grathitatvāt svabhāvataḥ” iti| raktajamāṃsajayorapi doṣā evārambhakāḥ santi, tathā'pi tailadagdhavat raktajādivyapadeśa iti||21||

lg.l: vātaḥ kaphaś caiva gale ‘bhṛśaṃ’ iti pā. pravṛddhau manye tu saṃsṛtya tathaiva medaḥ |
kurvanti gaṇḍaṃ kramaśaḥ svaliṅgaiḥ samanvitaṃ taṃ galagaṇḍam āhuḥ ||22||

ab.seg: idānīṃ galagaṇḍasamprāptiṃ darśayannāha- vāta ityādi| vātādayo gaṇḍaṃ kramaśaḥ kurvantīti sambandhaḥ| kiṃviśiṣṭaṃ gaṇḍaṃ? svaliṅgaiḥ samanvitam| vātena kaphena ca galagaṇḍo bhavati, na pittena; svabhāvena pittajasya galagaṇḍasyābhāvāt||22||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: medaḥkaphavātārambhasamānārbudānantaraṃ galagaṇḍārambhaḥ| teṣāṃ samprāptiṃ nirdiśannāha- vātaḥ kaphaścetyādi| vātena kaphena ca galagaṇḍo bhavati na pittena, svabhāvena pittajasya galagaṇḍasyābhāvāt, pittajacāturthakavat| taduktaṃ carake- “caturthako darśayati prabhāvaṃ dvividhaṃ jvaraḥ| jaṅghābhyāṃ ślaiṣmikaḥ pūrvaṃ śirasto'nilasambhavaḥ” (ca. ci. 3) iti| atra ca gaṇḍaśabdasya sāmānyaśopharūpakārthavyudāsyarthaṃ svaliṅgairityuktaṃ; tāni tu galagaṇḍasya sāmānyaliṅgāni “nibaddhaḥ śvayathuḥ” ityādīni vakṣyamāṇāni||22||

lg.l: todānvitaḥ kṛṣṇasirāvanaddhaḥ kṛṣṇo 'ruṇo vā pavanātmakas tu |
medonvitaś copacitaś ca kālād bhaved atisnigdhataro 'rujaś ca ‘bhavet pratistabdhagalo'rujaśca’ iti, ‘bhavet pradigdhe ca gale'rujaśca’ iti ca pā.||23||
pāruṣyayuktaś ciravṛddhyapāko yadṛcchayā pākam iyāt kadācit vairasyam āsyasya ca tasya jantor bhavet tathā tālugalapraśoṣaḥ ||24||
sthiraḥ savarṇo 'lparugugrakaṇḍūḥ ‘gururugrakaṇḍūḥ’ iti tā. śīto mahāṃś cāpi kaphātmakas tu |
cirābhivṛddhiṃ kurute cirāc ca prapacyate mandarujaḥ kadācit ||25||
mādhuryam āsyasya ca tasya jantor bhavet tathā tālugalapralepaḥ |
snigdho mṛduḥ pāṇḍur aniṣṭagandho medaḥkṛto ‘medaḥśritaḥ’ iti pā. nīrug athātikaṇḍūḥ ||26||
pralambate 'lābuvad alpamūlo dehānurūpakṣayavṛddhiyuktaḥ ‘vivardhate hīyati cātra dehaḥ’ iti tā.| gayadāsasammato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ|
snigdhāsyatā tasya bhavec ca jantor gale 'nuśabdaṃ ‘galena’ iti pā. kurute ca nityam ||27||

ab.seg: tasyaiva vātādiviśeṣaliṅgāni nirdiśannāha- todānvita ityādi| aruja iti so'pi vātagalagaṇḍo yadā kālāt kālena kṛtvā medo'nvito bhavati, tadā arujo bhavatītyarthaḥ| yadṛcchayā ajñātahetuniyamena, pākamiyāt gacchet| kadācit na sarvakālam| vātajaṃ kaphajaṃ coktvā medojamāha- snigdha ityādi| gale'nuśabdamanunādaṃ pratiśabdamityarthaḥ||23-27||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: tasyaiva vātādiviśeṣaliṅgāni nirdiśannāha- todānvita ityādi| śyāvāruṇyaṃ doṣadūṣyarāśeḥ, na punaravarṇasya vāyoreva| kadāciditi na sarvakālam| yadṛcchayā ajñātahetuniyamena| kaphajaḥ savarṇaḥ prakṛtisamānavarṇaḥ| tālugalapralepaḥ praliptatvam| vivardhate hīyati cātra dehaḥ dehavṛddhihānibhyāṃ lakṣaṇābhyāṃ vivardhate hiyati ca| hīyatīti divāderākṛtigaṇatvāt hidhātuṃ parasmaipadeṣu paṭhanti; tena hīyatīti rūpam| anye tu “vṛddhikṣayāvṛcchati cātra dehaḥ” iti paṭhanti| galena śabdamanunādam||23-27||

lg.l: kṣīṇaṃ ca vaidyo galagaṇḍinaṃ tu bhinnasvaraṃ caiva vivarjayet tu ||28||

ab.seg: idānīṃ galagaṇḍasyāsādhyatāmāha- kṛcchrādityādi||28||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: idānīṃ galagaṇḍasyāsādhyatāṃ darśayannāha- kṛcchrācchvasantamityādi||28||

lg.l: nibaddhaḥ śvayathur yasya muṣkaval lambate gale |
mahān vā yadi vā hrasvo galagaṇḍaṃ taṃ gaṇḍamiti nirdiśet’ iti pā. tam ādiśet ||29||

ab.seg: na sarva eva galāśrayo gaṇḍo galagaṇḍaḥ, kiṃ tarhi kaścideva vakṣyamāṇasvarūpa iti darśayannāha- nibaddha ityādi| niyamena baddho nibaddhaḥ| muṣkavat aṇḍavat||29||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: na galāśrayo galagaṇḍaḥ, kiṃ tarhi kaścideva pāribhāṣika iti darśayannāha- nibaddha ityādi| niyamena baddho nibaddhaḥ| muṣkavadaṇḍavat| bhojapyuktaṃ- “mahāntaṃ śothamalpaṃ vā hanumanyāgalāśrayam| lambantaṃ muṣkavaddṛṣṭvā galagaṇḍaṃ vinirdiśet” iti||29||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne galagaṇḍagaṇḍamālāpacyarbudanidānaṃ nāmaikādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||11||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nidānasthāne ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ||11||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: iti sauśrute śalyatantre śrīgayadāsaviracitāyāṃ nyāyacandrikākhyāyāṃ pañjikāyāṃ nidānasthāne ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ||11||
athāto vṛddhyupadaṃśaślīpadānāṃ nidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi||1-2||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: muṣkapralambanasya pūrvaṃ prakrāntatvāt, śothasāmānyācca galagaṇḍānantaraṃ vṛddhinidānārambhaḥ||1-2||

vātapittaśleṣmaśoṇitamedomūtrāntranimittāḥ sapta vṛddhayo bhavanti | tāsāṃ ‘teṣāṃ’ ityādi tāḍapatrapustake tathā gayadāsena ca vṛddhiśabdaḥ sarvatra puṃlliṅga eva paṭhyate mūtrāntranimitte vṛddhī vātasamutthe, kevalam utpattihetur anyatamaḥ ||3||

vṛddhīnāṃ saṅkhyāmāha- vātetyādi| saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva saptasaṅkhyāsiddhau saptagrahaṇaṃ dvandvajādivṛddhiniṣedhārthaṃ; tāsāṃ punarasambhavo vyādhisvabhāvāt| dhātumalakṛtāyāmapi vṛddhau doṣasyaiva cikitsārthaṃ sambhavaṃ darśayannāha- tāsāmityādi| vātasamutthe vātāt samyaguttiṣṭhete vṛddhiṃ gacchata ityarthaḥ| jananahetuḥ punaranyatama iti taṃ pratipādayannāha- kevalamutpattiheturanyatama iti| kevalaṃ param, utpatterutpādakasya hetuḥ kāraṇamanyat mūtramantraṃ vā| anye tu anayorvṛddhyoryaṃ utpatterheturvāyuḥ so'nyatamo bhinno jñeyaḥ; etena mūtrasandhāraṇakupito vāyurmūtravṛddheḥ kāraṇaṃ, bhāraharaṇādibhiḥ kupitastvantravṛddherityarthaḥ||3||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: vṛddhistu vātādibhedena saptavidhaḥ; saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva saptasaṅkhyāsiddhau saptagrahaṇaṃ dvandvajādivṛddhiniṣedhārthaṃ; teṣāṃ punarasambhavo'pi vyādheḥ svabhāvāt| dhātumalakṛte'pi doṣasyaiva cikitsārthaṃ sambhavaṃ darśayannāha- teṣāṃ mūtrāntranimitte vātasamutthe iti; vātāt samyaguttiṣṭhete, paramutpatterutpādakasya kāraṇamanyat mūtramantraṃ vā| ata evāha- “vāyurapratikāriṇaḥ kālāntareṇa muṣkau samupaiti” iti| śoṇitaje pittadoṣaḥ, medoje kaphaḥ||3||
adhaḥ prakupito 'nyatamo hi doṣaḥ phalakośavāhinīr abhiprapadya dhamanīḥ phalakoṣayor vṛddhiṃ janayati, tāṃ vṛddhim ity ācakṣate ||4||
tāsāṃ samprāptimāha- adhaḥ prakupita ityādi| phalakośayorityanena dvivacanena muṣkadvaya eva vṛddhiriti na jñeyaṃ, kiṃ tarhi ekasminnapi pakṣe vṛddhiriti jñātavyam||4||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: teṣāṃ samprāptiṃ nirdiśannāha- adhaḥ prakupita ityādi| phalaṃ ca koṣaśca tayorvāhinīḥ dhamanīḥ; phalakoṣayoriti dvivacanamatantraṃ, tenaikasya ca phalakoṣasya vṛddhirbhavati| taṃ vṛddhimācakṣeta iti kecidvṛddhipadaṃ paṭhanti| tatra ca “kticktau ca sañjñāyām” (pā. a. 3/3/174) ityanena siddho vṛddhiśabdaḥ, sa ca puṃlliṅgaḥ||4||
tāsāṃ bhaviṣyatīnāṃ pūrvarūpāṇi- bastikaṭīmuṣkameḍhreṣu vedanā mārutanigrahaḥ phalakośaśophaś ceti ||5||
tāsāṃ pūrvarūpāṇyāha- tāsāmityādi||5||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: kecidvṛddhīnāṃ pūrvarūpāṇi paṭhanti- teṣāṃ bhaviṣyatāṃ pūrvarūpāṇītyādi||5||

tatrānilaparipūrṇāṃ bastim ivātatāṃ paruṣām animittānilarujāṃ vātavṛddhim ācakṣate; pakvodumbarasaṅkāśāṃ jvaradāhoṣmavatīṃ cāśusamutthānapākāṃ pittavṛddhiṃ; kaṭhinām alpavedanāṃ śītāṃ ‘kaṭhinaṃ snigdhamalpavedanaṃ śleṣmavṛddhiṃ’ iti tā. kaṇḍūmatīṃ śleṣmavṛddhiṃ; kṛṣṇasphoṭāvṛtāṃ pittavṛddhiliṅgāṃ raktavṛddhiṃ, mṛdusnigdhāṃ kaṇḍūmatīm alpavedanāṃ tālaphalaprakāśāṃ medovṛddhiṃ; mūtrasandhāraṇaśīlasya mūtravṛddhir bhavati, sā gacchato 'mbupūrṇā dṛtir iva kṣubhyati mūtrakṛcchravedanāṃ vṛṣaṇayoḥ śvayathuṃ kośayoś cāpādayati, tāṃ mūtravṛddhiṃ vidyāt; bhāraharaṇabalavadvigrahavṛkṣaprapata
nādibhir āyāsaviśeṣair vāyur abhipravṛddhaḥ ‘vāyuḥ prakupito'ntrasya sthūlasyetarasya vā’ iti tā. prakupitaś ca sthūlāntrasyetarasya ‘kṣudrāntrasyaikadeśaṃ’ iti pā. caikadeśaṃ viguṇam ādāyādho viguṇaṃ saṅkucitaṃ| ‘dviguṇaṃ’ iti pāṭhāntaram, tatra saṅkocena dviguṇīkṛtamityarthaḥ gatvā vaṅkṣaṇasandhim upetya granthirūpeṇa sthitvā 'pratikriyamāṇe ca kālāntareṇa phalakośaṃ praviśya muṣkaśopham āpādayati, ādhmāto bastir ivātataḥ pradīrghaḥ sa śopho bhavati, saśabdam avapīḍitaś cordhvam upaiti, vimuktaś ca punar ādhmāyate ‘punarādhamati’ iti, ‘punarādhmāti’ iti ca pā., tām antravṛddhim asādhyām ity ācakṣate ||6||

tāsāṃ vātādijānāṃ lakṣaṇamāha- tatrāniletyādi| ātatām ādhmātām| medovṛddhimiti kaphena saha| mūtretyādi śīlaṃ svabhāvaḥ| kṣubhyati sañcalati| ādhmāto bastiriva paripūrṇo mūtrāśaya iva| ātato vistīrṇaḥ| upaiti udgacchati, vimuktaśca saśabdamevādhmāyate||6||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: mūtrasandhāraṇaśīlasya mūtravṛddhirbhavati, paścādvegavighātena ca mūtrapravṛttena vāyunā āpyāyate| adhaḥpradeśe dviguṇamiti ādhārādheyakṛtamiti kecidvyācakṣate| anye viguṇaṃ duṣṭamādāyeti paṭhanti| vaṅkṣaṇasandhimāgamya unnatatvād granthyākāreṇa ca sthānaṃ kṛtvā, upekṣito muṣkakośamupaiti dīrghaḥ, avapīḍitaśca saśabdamūrdhvamuttiṣṭhate, muktaśca saśabdameva ādhmāyate| atraiva bhojaḥ- ativyavāyavyāyāmabhāraplavanalaṅghanaiḥ| vāyuḥ pravṛddhaḥ patanādruddhaścaṅkramaṇena ca|| antraṃ dviguṇamādāya jantornayati vaṅkṣaṇam| vaṅkṣaṇāttu rujāyuktaṃ phalakoṣaṃ prapadyate|| tatra sthitvā cirādvṛddhiṃ karoti na ca śāmyati| sa dīrghakālasaṃvṛddho dīrgho bastirivātataḥ|| cirāvanaddho bhavati pīḍitaśca vilīyate| muktaścādhmāyate bhūyo caryāṃ tāmantrajāṃ viduḥ”| iti vṛddhinidānaṃ samāptam||6||

tatrātimaithunād atibrahmacaryād vā ‘tatra brahmacāriṇīṃ dīrghakarkaśaromāṃ yonirogopasṛṣṭāmalpadvārāmapriyāmakāmāmacaukṣasalilaprakṣālitayoniṃ vā nārīṃ yo'bhigacchet tathā karajadaśanaviṣaśūkanipātanāddhastābhighātāccatuṣpadīgamanādacaukṣasalilaprakṣālanādvā prakupitāḥ’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ| gayadāsenāpyayameva vyākhyātaḥ tathā 'tibrahmacāriṇīṃ cirotsṛṣṭāṃ rajasvalāṃ dīrgharomāṃ karkaśaromāṃ saṅkīrṇaromāṃ nigūḍharomām alpadvārāṃ mahādvārām apriyām akāmām acaukṣasalilaprakṣālitayonim aprakṣālitayoniṃ yonirogopasṛṣṭāṃ svabhāvato vā duṣṭayoniṃ viyoniṃ vā nārīm atyartham upasevamānasya tathā karajadaśanaviṣaśūkanipātanād bandhanād dhastābhighātāc catuṣpadīgamanād acaukṣasalilaprakṣālanād avapīḍanāc chrukravegavidhāraṇān maithunānte vā 'prakṣālanādibhir meḍhram āgamya aprakṣālanādevaṃvidhādvā'nyasmāt’ iti pā. prakupitā doṣāḥ kṣate 'kṣate vā śvayathum upajanayanti, tam upadaṃśam ity ācakṣate ||7||

vṛddherantaramupadaṃśānāṃ hetvadyabhidhānamāha- tatrātimaithunetyādi| atibrahmacāriṇyā maithunātinivṛttyā saṅkucitakarkaśayonimukhatvāt| cirotsṛṣṭāṃ prabhūtakālatyaktāṃ, atrāpi sa eva hetuḥ| brahmacāriṇyā janmanaḥ prabhṛtyeva maithunābhāvaḥ, cirotsṛṣṭāyāstu kadācidevetyanayorbhedaḥ| rajasvalāyā duṣṭārtavaprasaṅgāt| dīrghakarkaśādiromābhigamane pīḍanābhighātaprasaṅgāt| saṅkīrṇaromā ghanaromā| nigūḍharomā abhyantararomā| alpadvārāyāmapi sa eva hetuḥ| mahādvārāyāṃ śophahetuścinttya eva, tasmāt kecinna paṭhanti| apriyāyāṃ liṅgānutthānenetaścetābhighātaprasaṅgāt| akāmāyāḥ sakthisaṅkocena dvārālpatvāt| acokṣasalilaprakṣālitayoneḥ saliladoṣāt, acokṣamapavitram| aprakṣālitayoneḥ svedamaladoṣāt| yonirogopasṛṣṭāyā rogadoṣānusāreṇa doṣodayāt| svabhāvato vā duṣṭayonervātādaya eva kāraṇam| viyoniṃ hastajaṅghāntaraṃ, tasya karkaśatvāt| karajā nakhāḥ, daśanā dantāḥ, śūkasya ‘saviṣaśūketi śūkaḥ sajanturjalamalaḥ, liṅgavṛddhikarayogo vā’ iti pā. saviṣajalajakīṭasya, nipātanālliṅgādiśarīre pātanādathavā teṣāṃ mardanāt pīḍanāt| catuṣpadyo'jādayo rāsabhyādayo vā, tāsāmapyalpāramyayonitvāt| acokṣasalilaprakṣālanādibhiriti acokṣasalilaprakṣālanamatra liṅgasya na tu yoneḥ||7||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: athāta upadaṃśanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| vṛddheranantaramupadaṃśārambhaḥ, sthānapratyāsannatvāt| tatrātimaithunādatibrahmacaryādvā tathā brahmacāriṇīmityādihetuviśeṣā yathāyogaṃ vyākhyeyāḥ| tatra brahmacāriṇyāṃ maithunanivṛtyā saṅkucitakarkaśayonimukhatvāt| dīrghakarkaśaromayonyāmapi dīrghakarkaśaromabhireva sukumārasya niṣpīḍanābhighātaiḥ śothaḥ| yonirogopasṛṣṭāyāṃ yathārogadoṣameva doṣodayāt| alpadvārāyāmapi niṣpīḍanābhighātāt| mahādvārāyāmapi vraṇairniṣpīḍanābhighātāditi kecit paṭhanti| śothahetūnāmapi vaimityaiva(?)| apriyāyāṃ litthānutthānenetaścetaścābhighātena śothaḥ| akāmāyāṃ sakthisaṅkocena dvārālpatvāt| acokṣasalilaprakṣālitayoneḥ maladoṣāt| aprakṣālanena vā svedamalādidoṣāt| rujādibhirabhighātataḥ| catuṣpadīnāṃ yoneralpāmanojñetvāt| taṃ śvayathumupadaṃśamityācakṣate ityanena śiśnagataśophaḥ daṃśanopādhimantareṇāpi saṅketamātreṇaiva ‘upadaṃśa’ ityucyate||7||
sa pañcavidhas tribhir doṣaiḥ pṛthak samastair asṛjā ceti ‘caikaḥ’ iti pā.||8||
teṣāṃ saṅkhyāmāha- sa pañcavidha ityādi| tribhirdoṣaiḥ pṛthagiti trayaḥ, samastairekaḥ, asṛjā caikaḥ, evaṃ pañca||8||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: doṣadūṣyāśrayasaṅkhyayā pañcavidhaḥ||8||

tatra vātike pāruṣyaṃ tvakparipuṭanaṃ stabdhameḍhratā paruṣaśophatā vividhāś ca ‘vividhavedanāprādurbhāvaśca’ iti tā. vātavedanāḥ; paittike jvaraḥ śvayathuḥ pakvoḍumbarasaṅkāśas tīvradāhaḥ kṣiprapākaḥ pittavedanāś ca; ślaiṣmike śvayathuḥ kaṇḍūmān kaṭhinaḥ snigdhaḥ śleṣmavedanāś ca; raktaje kṛṣṇasphoṭaprādurbhāvo 'tyartham asṛkpravṛttiḥ pittaliṅgāny atyarthaṃ jvaradāhau śoṣaś ca, yāpyaś caiva kadācit; sarvaje sarvaliṅgadarśanam avadaraṇaṃ ca śephasaḥ kṛmiprādurbhāvo maraṇaṃ ceti ||9||

teṣāṃ vātādijānāṃ pratyekaṃ lakṣaṇamāha- tatra vātike ityādi| “meḍhrasandhau vraṇāḥ kecit kecit sarvāśrayāḥ smṛtāḥ| kulatthākṛtayaḥ kecit kecinmudgadalopamāḥ|| rujādāhaparītāśca tṛṣṇāmohasamanvitāḥ| śīghraṃ kecidvisarpanti śanaiḥ kecittathā'pare|| strīṇāṃ puṃsāṃ ca jāyante upadaṃśāḥ sudāruṇāḥ”- iti tantrāntare||9||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: tatra vārtike vividhāśca vātavedanā iti nānāvidhatodādivedanāḥ| raktaje pittaliṅgāni jvaradāhacoṣādīni| sarvaje avadaraṇaṃ kṛmiprādurbhāvo maraṇaṃ ceti| raktaje'pi kaṭvamlādihetubhī raktakaphakopāt karṇikā jāyate| tathā ca bhojaḥ- “kaṭvamlalavaṇāñjantoḥ pittalasyātisevinaḥ| raktaṃ pradūṣayatyamlaṃ tadduṣṭamanileritam|| karoti mehanaṃ prāpya śvayathuṃ....| kathañcidatyupekṣātastato raktakaphātmikā| karṇikā jāyate tatra sakaṇḍūkā savedanā” iti| kecit suśrutādhyāyinaḥ paṭhanti ‘meḍhrasandhau vraṇāḥ kecit’ ityādikaṃ; tamanārṣamācakṣate, strīṇāṃ copadaṃśā bhavantīti sarvatantreṣvaprasiddheḥ| ityupadaṃśanidānaṃ samāptam||9||

kupitās tu doṣā vātapittaśleṣmāṇo 'dhaḥprapannā vaṅkṣaṇorujānujaṅghāsv avatiṣṭhamānāḥ kālāntareṇa pādam āśritya śanaiḥ śophaṃ janayanti, taṃ ślīpadam ity ācakṣate | tat trividhaṃ- vātapittakaphanimittam iti ||10||

ataḥ paraṃ ślīpadārambhaḥ, upadaṃśasthāne'pi ślīpadasambhavāt; ‘śiśnauṣṭhanāsāsvapi ca kecidicchanti tadvidaḥ’ iti vacanāt| teṣāṃ samprāptiṃ nirdiśannāha- prakupitāstvityādi| prakupitā ityanena sāmarthyādeva hetavo nirdiṣṭāḥ, ahatordoṣasyāduṣṭatvāt| sthānasaṃśrayalakṣaṇā samprāptirapi lakṣaṇameva| tatra pūrvo lakṣaṇodayo doṣadūṣyarāśereva; dūṣyān dūṣayanto doṣāḥ śophaṃ janayanti| taṃ ślīpadamityācakṣate iti pāribhāṣikī nirupādhireva ślīpadasañjñetītiśabdena prakāśayati||10||

tatra, vātajaṃ kharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ paruṣam animittānilarujaṃ parisphuṭati ca bahuśaḥ; pittajaṃ tu pītāvabhāsam īṣanmṛdu jvaradāhaprāyaṃ ca; śleṣmajaṃ tu śvetaṃ snigdhāvabhāsaṃ mandavedanaṃ bhārikaṃ mahāgranthikaṃ kaṇṭakair upacitaṃ ca ||11||
kaphaje bhārikaṃ gurvityarthaḥ||11||
tatra saṃvatsarātītam atimahad valmīkajātaṃ prasṛtam iti varjanīyāni ||12||
valmīkajātaṃ valmīkavajjātam, atibahutaraśikharairgranthibhirupacitatvāt; parapadārtheṣu hi pravṛttā śabdā vatimantareṇāpi vatyarthaṃ janayanti||12||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: tasyāsādhyāvasthāṃ nirdiśannāha- saṃvatsarātītamityādi| valmīkajātaṃ valmīkavajjātam, atibahutaraśikharairgranthibhirupacitatvāt; parapadārtheṣu hi pravṛttā śabdā vatimantareṇāpi vatyarthaṃ gamayanti||12||

bhavanti cātra-
trīṇy apy etāni jānīyāc chlīpadāni kaphocchrayāt |
gurutvaṃ ca mahattvaṃ ca yasmān nāsti vinā kaphāt ||13||
vātapittaślīpadānyapi kaphādhikānyeveti darśayannāha- trīṇītyādi||13||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: vātapittaślīpadānyapi kaphādhikānyeveti darśayannāha- trīṇyapyetānītyādi||13||

lg.l: ye deśās teṣu jāyante ślīpadāni viśeṣataḥ ||14||

ab.seg: deśaviśeṣa evāsyotpattiṃ darśayannāha- purāṇodakabhūyiṣṭhā ityādi| anūpadeśasya purāṇodakabhūyiṣṭhatā| jāṅgalasyonnatasamabhūtalatvāt salilaṃ patitaṃ na tiṣṭhati, sthitamapi rūkṣoṣṇaśuṣkatvāddeśasya śoṣamupaiti; tena jāṅgaladeśasya śīte'pyaśītatā||14||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: deśaviśeṣa evāsyotpattiṃ darśayannāha- purāṇodakabhūyiṣṭhā ityādi| anūpadeśasya purāṇodakabhūyiṣṭhatā; jāṅgalasya tūnnatasamabhūtalatvāt salilaṃ patitaṃ na tiṣṭhati, sthitamapi rūkṣoṣṇaśuṣkatvāddeśasya śoṣamupaitīti jāṅgaladeśasya śīte'pyaśītatā; taduktaṃ- “samāḥ sādhāraṇe” (sū. 35) ityādi; lakṣaṇadvandvametat pañcavidhasyānūpasyāvarodhakam(?) atraiva hi deśaviśeṣeṇa ślīpadānāmutpattiriti||14||

lg.l: pādavaddhas tayoś cāpi ślīpadaṃ jāyate nṛṇām |

ab.seg: ślīpadasya pādābhyāmanyasminnapyaṅge utpattiṃ darśayannāha- pādavaddhastayoścāpītyādi||15||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: ślīpadasya pādābhyāmanyasminnapyaṅge utpattiṃ darśayannāha- pādabaddhastayoścāpītyādi| iti ślīpadanidānaṃ samāptam||15||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne vṛddhyupadaṃśaślīpadanidānaṃ nāma dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||12||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nidānasthāne dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ||12||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: iti sauśrute śalyatantre śrīgayadāsaviracitāyāṃ nyāyacandrikākhyāyāṃ pañjikāyāṃ nidānasthāne dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ||12||

div.head: kṣudraroganidānam

ab.seg: athātaḥ kṣudrarogāṇāṃ nidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

athāta ityādi| yadyapi kṣudrarogeṣu rohiṇīvalmīkādayo mahāvyādhayaḥ santi, tathā'pi kṣudrarogāṇāṃ bahutvāttaireva vyapadeśaḥ; yathā bahuṣu chatriṣu gacchatsu acchatriṣvapi keṣucicchatriṇo yāntīti vyapadeśaḥ, tathā'trāpīti na doṣaḥ| anye tu kṣudrā laghavastilakādyapekṣayā, agnirohiṇīvalmīkādyapekṣayā kṣudrāstīkṣṇāḥ ‘sūkṣmāḥ’ iti pā.; athavā pūrvācāryaprasiddhā nirhetukeyaṃ sañjñā||1-2||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: vṛddhyādinidānānantaraṃ kṣudrarogāṇāmārambhaḥ| nidānasya hetulakṣaṇanirdeśasyārambhaḥ, vyādhivarganirdeśasyārambhaḥ, sādharmyāt kṣudrarogapāriśeṣyāt| prathamaṃ hyadhikānāṃ mahāvyādhīnāṃ nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ, tadanu madhyānāṃ mahāvyādhīnāṃ vidradhīnām, anantaraṃ svalpānāṃ kṣudrāṇāṃ nidānamavatiṣṭhati, tannirdiśannāha- athāta ityādi| kṣudratvaṃ punareṣāṃ hetulakṣaṇacikitsālpatvena; yadyevaṃ rohiṇīvalmīkādīnāṃ tridoṣajatvena hetubāhulyād rohiṇyāstāvadihāsādhyatvāt, tathaiva valmīkasya ca kṛcchratvādasādhyatvādvā mahāvyādhitvaprasaṅgaḥ| naitadasti, bāhulyenoktatvāt; tadyathā- chatribāhulyena chatriṇo yāntīti vyapadeśaḥ| advitīyatvena vā kṣudrāḥ, tathā hi- nahi kṣudraroganirdiṣṭeṣu rogeṣvajagallikāgudabhraṃśādiṣu doṣadhātumalasaṃsargād vyabhicarati saṅkhyā, alpatvenāpi kṣudratvaṃ, jejjaḍeneti punariha bahutaramasambaddhaṃ pralapitaṃ, tadvistarabhayādasmābhirdūṣayitumapi nānugaditam||1-2||

samāsena catuścatvāriṃśat ‘saptacatvāriṃśat’ iti tā. kṣudrarogā bhavanti | tad yathā,- ajagallikā, yavaprakhyā, andhālajī, vivṛtā, kacchapikā, valmīkaṃ, indravṛddhā ‘indraviddhā, gardabhikā’ iti tā., panasikā, pāṣāṇagardabhaḥ, jālagardabhaḥ, kakṣā ‘kakṣā, irivellikā, gandhanāmā’ iti tā., visphoṭakaḥ, agnirohiṇī, cippaṃ, kunakhaḥ, anuśayī, vidārikā śarkarārbudaṃ, pāmā, vicarcikā, rakasā, pādadārikā, kadaraṃ, alasendraluptau ‘alasaḥ, rujyā’ iti pā., dāruṇakaḥ, aruṃṣikā, palitaṃ, masūrikā, yauvanapiḍakā, padminīkaṇṭakaḥ, jatumaṇiḥ, maśakaḥ, carmakīlaḥ tāḍapatrapustake carmakīlasthāne nīlikā paṭhyate, tilakālakaḥ, nyacchaṃ, vyaṅgaḥ, parivartikā, avapāṭikā, niruddhaprakaśaḥ sanniruddhagudaḥ, ahipūtanaṃ, vṛṣaṇakacchraḥ, gudabhraṃśaś ceti ||3||

saṅkhyāmāha- samāsenetyādi| samāsena saṅkṣepeṇa, vistareṇa pramāṇaṃ tu nāstyeva| śrībrahmadevastu gardabhikerivellikāgandhapiḍikānīlikānāṃ saṅgrahaṇenāṣṭacatvāriṃśaditi paṭhati| śrījejjhaṭena tu gardabhikādayaścatvāro na paṭhitāḥ| pūrvavyākhyātāro'pi suvīranandivārāhādayaḥ samānatantrāpāṭhāt gardabhikādīnāṃ caturṇāṃ pāṭhaṃ garhitaṃ manyante| gayadāsācāyastu samānatantrādarśane'pi sarveṣveva pāṭheṣu pātād gardabhikādīn paṭhati, pāmādīṃśca kṣudratve'pi caturaḥ kuṣṭha eva paṭhati||3||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: prathamaṃ saṅkhyāmeva nirdiśannāha- samāsena catuścatvāriṃśat kṣudrarogāḥ| samāsena saṅkṣepeṇa, doṣavikārāṇāmānantyāt; yaduktaṃ- “anuktamapi doṣāṇāṃ liṅgairvyādhimupācaret” (sū. 35) ityādi||3||

lg.l: snigdhā savarṇā grathitā nīrujā mudgasannibhā ‘granthisannibhā’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: teṣāṃ pratyekaṃ lakṣaṇamāha- snigdhetyādi| “prāyograhaṇamatra luptanirdiṣṭaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ, tena kvacidabāleṣvapi” ityeke manyante||4||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: ajagallikā bālānāmeva “yadā kurvanti sa kālaḥ” (sū. 41) iti bālye eva tadrogadhārāṇasāmarthyaṃ, na punastāruṇyādiṣu vātapiḍikāvat| prāyograhaṇamatra luptanirdiṣṭaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ; tena kvacidabāleṣvapītyeke manyante| atra bhojaḥ- “mārutaḥ kaphamādāya piḍikāṃ māṣamudgayoḥ| tulyāṃ savarṇāṃ tvaṅmāṃse kurute sā'jagallikā” iti||4||
yavetyādi| yavākārā sthūlamadhyanimnāntatvena ‘antanimnamadhyonnatatvena’ iti pā.||5||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: yavaprakhyāḥ sthūlamadhyatvena yavākārāḥ||5||
ghanāmityādi| avaktrāmiti alpamukhīm| parimaṇḍalāṃ vartulāmityarthaḥ| andhālajīṃ snāyuprasṛtāntarmukhīm||6||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: andhālajī snāyuśritā'ntarmukhī| tathā ca bhojaḥ- “śleṣmānilau śritau snāyuṃ piḍikāṃ parimaṇḍalām| duṣṭau janayato'vaktrāmalpapūyāmakaṇḍurām| āmodumbarasaṅkāśāṃ vidyādandhālajīṃ tu tām” iti| etāsu doṣāḥ svayamācāryeṇa nirdiṣṭā eva; yatra punarācāryeṇa doṣāḥ svayaṃ na nirdiṣṭāstatra doṣāḥ paratantrapratyayena liṅgenaiva nirdiśyante||6||

lg.l: vivṛtām iti tāṃ vidyāt pittotthāṃ parimaṇḍalām ||7||

ab.seg: vivṛtāsyāmityādi| vivṛtāsyāmiti vyāttamukhīm||7||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: pittādhikatvenādhikapākādvivṛtāsyatvena vivṛtā||7||

lg.l: grathitāḥ pañca vā ṣaḍ vā dāruṇāḥ kacchaponnatāḥ |

ab.seg: dāruṇāḥ kaṭhināḥ||8||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: madhyonnatatvena paryanteṣvanatatvena kāṭhinyena ca kacchapikā| sā kaphavātotthā||8||

lg.l: granthir valmīkavad yas tu śanaiḥ samupacīyate ||9||
vyādhir valmīka ity eṣa kaphapittānilodbhavaḥ ‘vijñeyaḥ kaphapaittikaḥ’ iti tā.||10||

ab.seg: granthaya ityādi||9-10||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: valmīkavaditi bahutaraśikharatvenocchrāyeṇa ca, tathā dūrāvagāḍhadoṣadūṣitadūṣyatayā'ntarmūlatvenāpi valmīkasamatā; ata eva cikitsite avagāḍhamūlaśodhanārthamagnikṣārābhyāṃ prasādhanamuktam| taṃ ca kecit kaphapaittikamicchanti; tanna, todasya kledadāhayoḥ kaṇḍvādīnāṃ ca vātādiliṅgānāṃ darśanāt sānnipātika evāyaṃ; tathā hi bhojaḥ- “sannipātena piḍikā mukhairbahubhirāvṛtā| pāṇipādatale sandhau grīvāyāmūrdhvajatruṣu|| jāyate hi viśeṣeṇa vyādhiṃ valmīkamādiśet” iti| tathā'nyatrāpyuktaṃ- ‘grīvāṃsakakṣe karapādadeśe sandhau gale vā tribhireva doṣaiḥ| granthiḥ sa valmīkavadakriyāṇāṃ jātaḥ krameṇaiva gataḥ pravṛddhim|| mukhairanekaiḥ srutitodavadbhirvisarpavat sarpati connatāgraiḥ| valmīkamāhurbhiṣajo vikāraṃ niṣpratyanīkaṃ cirajaṃ viśeṣāt” iti||9-10||

lg.l: padmapuṣkaravan madhye ‘padmakarṇivanmadhye’ iti pā. piḍakābhiḥ samācitām |
indravṛddhāṃ tu tāṃ vidyād vātapittotthitāṃ bhiṣak ||11||

ab.seg: padmetyādi| padmapuṣkaraṃ padmakarṇikā| gayī tvatra gardabhikāṃ paṭhati; yathā- “maṇḍalāṃ vṛttamutsannāṃ ‘vipulotsannāṃ iti pā. saraktāṃ piḍakācitām| rujākarīṃ gardabhikāṃ tāṃ vidyādvātapittajām”||11||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: mahāpuṣkaravanmadhye iti puṣkaraṃ varāṭakam| indraviddhā vātapittajā, gardabhikā'pi; sā paṭhyate, sarveṣu samanatantreṣu dṛśyate iti||11||

lg.l: karṇau ‘karṇasyābhyantare jātāṃ piḍakāmugravedanām| sthirāṃ panasikāṃ tāṃ tu vidyādvātakaphotthitām’ iti tā. pari samantād vā pṛṣṭhe vā piḍakograruk |

ab.seg: karṇasyābhyantare deśe jātā vātakaphātmikā| samantata iti vacanāt karṇādbahirapīti vyācakṣate, tanna, sarveṣu pādeṣu bahiriti aprāpteḥ| na ca samānatantreṣu bahiriti labhyate| tathāhi bhojaḥ- “kaphavātau prakupitau māṃsamāśritya karṇayoḥ| samantataḥ paristabdhāṃ kurutaḥ piḍakāṃ sthirām|| viṣamāṃ dāhasaṃyuktāṃ vidyāt panasikāṃ tu tām” iti| bhoje'syāṃ vātakaphajāyāṃ dāhaḥ paṭhitaḥ, sa hi vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyārambhādadhiṣṭhānaprabhāvādvā'vagantavyaḥ||12||

lg.l: pāṣāṇagardabhaṃ ‘pāṣāṇagardabhamiti brūyāttat kaphapittataḥ’ iti tā. vidyād balāsapavanātmakam ||13||

ab.seg: hanusandhisamudbhūtamityādinā pāṣāṇagardabhaḥ| sthirakaṭhinapāṣāṇavat kāṭhinyena pāṣāṇagardabhaḥ||13||

lg.l: visarpavat sarpati yo ‘yaḥ śophastanurapākavān| dāhajvarakaraḥ pittāt’ iti tā. dāhajvarakaras tanuḥ |
apākaḥ śvayathuḥ pittāt sa jñeyo jālagardabhaḥ ||14||

ab.seg: visarpavat sarpati ya ityādinā jālagardabhaḥ| apākavān īṣatpākavān, īṣadarthe nañ; pittakṛtatvenātyarthaṃ pākābhāvasyāyuktatvādalpapāka ityaṅgīkriyate| pratanustokapākapiḍikājālābhatvāj jālagardabhaḥ| pittādityudbhūtapittāt, pittotkaṭaistribhireva doṣairanyatra paṭhyate| tathāhi bhojaḥ- “pittotkaṭāstrayo doṣā janayanti tvagāśritāḥ| śyāvaraktatanuśothaprapākaṃ bahuvedanam|| visarpiṇaṃ sadāhaṃ ca tṛṣṇājvarasamanvitam| visarpamāhustaṃ vyādhimapare jālagardabham” iti||14||

piḍakāmuttamāṅgasthāmityādinā irivellikā| sā ca sarvajā sarvadoṣārabdhetyarthaḥ| sarveṣāṃ vātādidoṣāṇāṃ svabhāvakāryāṇāṃ liṅgadarśanaṃ sannipātena prakṛtisamavāyārabdhatvānmanyante| iyaṃ sarveṣveva pāṭheṣu paṭhyate, na tu samānatantreṣviti pūrvavyākhyātāro manyante||15||
bāhupārśvāṃsakakṣetyādinā kakṣā||16||
ekāmetādṛśīṃ kakṣānirdiṣṭasphoṭasadṛśīṃ gandhanāmāṃ vadanti||17||

lg.l: kvacit sarvatra vā dehe smṛtā visphoṭakā iti ||18||

ab.seg: agnidagdhanibhāḥ| sphoṭā ityādinā visphoṭakāḥ| anyaiḥ punaramī visarpabhedatvādeṣāṃ na paṭhyante| ata evānyatantrīyairvisarpabhedatvādeṣāṃ doṣabhedena lakṣaṇaṃ paṭhyate| kṣudrarogapāṭhe tu doṣabhedo'tra na yujyate| atrārthe bhojaḥ “pittaṃ raktaṃ ca kupitaṃ vātenātugataṃ tvaci| agnidagdhanibhān sphoṭān kurute sarvadehagān|| sajvarān saparīdāhān vidyādvisphoṭakāṃstu tān” iti||18||

lg.l: saptāhād vā daśāhād vā pakṣād vā nghanti mānavam |

ab.seg: kakṣābhāgeṣvityādi| asādhyāmiti ata evāsyāścikitsiteṣu na cikitsābhidhānam| ‘māṃsadāraṇā” ityapi pāṭhaḥ| tathāhi tantrāntaram,- “pittotkaṭā nṛṇāṃ doṣāḥ pradīptāṅgārasannibhān| kakṣābhāgeṣu kurvanti tīvradāharujājvarān|| māṃsāvadāraṇān sphoṭān ye hanyuranupakramāt| pakṣāddaśāhādarvāgvā sā jñeyā vahnirohiṇī” iti| tatra vātādhikaiḥ saptāhāt, pittādhikairdaśāhāt, kaphādhikaiḥ pakṣāt||19-20||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: kakṣābhāgeṣu ye sphoṭā ityādinā agnirohaṇī| asādhyāmiti ata evāsyāścikitsiteṣu na cikitsābhidhānam||19-20||

lg.l: nakhamāṃsam adhiṣṭhāya pittaṃ vātaś ca vedanām ‘dehinām’ iti tā.|
karoti dāhapākau ca taṃ vyādhiṃ cippam ādiśet ||21||
tad evākṣatarogākhyaṃ tathopanakham ity api ‘tadevālpatarairdoṣaiḥ kunakhaṃ paruṣaṃ kharam’ iti tā.|
abhighātāt praduṣṭo yo nakho rūkṣo 'sitaḥ kharaḥ ||22||
bhavet taṃ kunakhaṃ vidyāt kulīnam iti sañjñitam |23|

ab.seg: nakhetyādi| cippamiti tantrāntare'ṅgulīveṣṭhakamiti prasiddham||20-22||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: nakhamāṃsamadhiṣṭhāyetyādinā cippaṃ; carake tu akṣatanāmnā'yaṃ vikāraḥ| tathāhi carakaḥ- “rogo'kṣataścarmanakhāntare syānmāṃsāsradūṣī bhṛśadāhapākaḥ” (ca. ci. 12) iti| anye tu “tadevākṣatarogākhyaṃ tathopanakhamityāpi” iti granthamadhīyate||21-22||

lg.l: kaphād antaḥprapākāṃ tāṃ vidyād anuśayīṃ bhiṣak ‘pādasyānuśayīṃ tāṃ tu vidyādantaḥprapākinīm’ iti tā.|24|

ab.seg: gambhīrāmityādi| antaḥpākena gambhīrām| alpasaṃrambhām alpaśothām| uparisthitāṃ mastake sthitām||23||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: gambhīrāmalpasaṃrambhāmityādinā anuśayī| upari mūrdhani| saṃrambhaḥ śothaḥ| antaḥpākena gambhīrā||23||

lg.l: raktāṃ vidārikāṃ vidyāt sarvajāṃ sarvalakṣaṇām ‘vidārikāmiti vadet sarujāṃ sarvalakṣaṇām’ iti tā.| ‘vidārīkandavadvṛttā kakṣāvaṅkṣaṇasandhiṣu| raktā vidārikā jñeyā sarvajā sarvalakṣaṇā’ iti gayadāsasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ|25|

ab.seg: vidārīkandavadityādi| vaṅkṣaṇasandhiḥ gaṇḍakaḥ| raktāṃ lohitām| sarvajāṃ sannipātajāṃ; paraṃ tathā'pi sādhyā, na hi sarva eva sannipātajā vyādhayo'sādhyāḥ| sarvalakṣaṇāṃ doṣasamudāyalakṣaṇāṃ, na tu pratyekadoṣalakṣaṇāṃ, doṣebhyo doṣasamudāyasyānyatvāt, cūrṇaharidrāsaṃyogasyeva| anye tu “sarvebhyo vātapittakaphebhyaḥ pṛthak dviśastriśo vā jāyata iti sarvajā ityasyāḥ sāptavidhyaṃ doṣaliṅgaiḥ sūkṣmamatinā'nuktamapyūhyam” ityācakṣate; tannecchati gayī “yena kṣudrarogasāmānyanyāyenāsyāḥ sāptavidhyaṃ na prapadyate, na hi kṣudrarogeṣu ko'pi vyādhiḥ paṭhito yaḥ pratyekādidoṣajaḥ, api ca yadyācāryasya sāptavidhyamabhipretaṃ syāttadā ‘doṣaiḥ saptavidhā tu sā’ iti pāṭhaṃ kuryāt; tantrāntare ceyaṃ vātakaphānvitā paṭhitā, tasmādvātakaphādhikyena hīnapittatayā asyā utpattirjñeyā” iti||24||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: vidārīkandavadvṛttāmityādinā vidārī| sarvajā sarvalakṣaṇeti atra vākyārthe pūrvavyākhyātāro vivadante| tatrāhureke- asarvajā asarvalakṣaṇetyubhayatrāpi nañaḥ praśleṣaḥ; anye tu punaḥ asarvajā sarvalakṣaṇeti pūrvapade nañamicchanti praśliṣṭaṃ na punaruttarapade; tathottarapade evāpare nañaḥ praśleṣaṃ prajānante na pūrvapade iti; atrāpyapakṣapātino hi no'yaṃ vākyārthaḥ- sarvajeti sarvaiḥ sannipatitairbhavati; asarvalakṣaṇetyatrāpi sannipātalakṣaṇarahitetyarthaḥ| tena pratyekadoṣadvandvajatvena ṣaḍvidhā, sānnipātikī na bhavatīti samudāyārthaḥ| atra pakṣe'sandehārthamācāryeṇa ‘ṣaḍvidhā dvyekadoṣajā’ iti paṭhitaṃ syāt| asarvajā sarvalakṣaṇetyatrāpi pakṣe sarvairdoṣairna jāyate atha sarvadoṣaliṅgānviteti vadatāṃ liṅginamantareṇāpi liṅgasadbhāvamaṅgīkurvatāṃ liṅgamaniścāyakaṃ syāt| tatra svadoṣādyapekṣiṇī cikitsaiva na syāt, doṣaliṅgasyaiva...| atha sarvāṇi ca tāni lakṣaṇāni tānyavidyamānāni yasyāmiti sannipātajā'pyasampūrṇalakṣaṇetyarthaḥ, tadā sarvatrāsya nyāyasya sāmānyāt asarvalakṣaṇeti na ca vaktavyaṃ bhavet, taduktaṃ “doṣe vibaddhe naṣṭe'gnau sarvasampūrṇalakṣaṇaḥ” (ca. ci. 3) iti| hetvanurūpakopabalena hi sarvatra sarvārdhālpasarvalakṣaṇodaya iti viśeṣaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| tadevaṃ sarvajā sarvalakṣaṇā iti ubhayatrāpyanañeva pakṣaḥ| atrāpi tridoṣajatvenāsādhyatvena vidāryāḥ kṣudrarogacikitsāpraṇayanamanarthakaṃ syāt| na sannipātamātrajā kiṃ tarhi vyastasamastadvandvajatvena saptavidhā sarvalakṣaṇetyatrāpīyameva vyākhyānapakṣaḥ| sa cārthaḥ kṣudrarogasya sāmānyanyāyena nopapadyate| na hi kṣudrarogeṣu ko'pi vyādhiḥ paṭhitaḥ pratyekādidoṣajaḥ| api ca yadyayamabhiprāya ācāryasya syāt tadā'sandehārthaṃ ‘doṣaiḥ saptavidhā tu sā’ iti paṭhitaṃ syāt| tasmāt sānnipātajaiveyaṃ, na cāsādhyā; na hi sarva eva sannipātajo vyādhirasādhyaḥ, yato na sarveṣāmeva doṣāṇāṃ tulyaṃ balaṃ, yathāhetubalameva hi doṣabalābalaṃ; yaduktaṃ- “hetubhirbahubhirjāto balibhirbahulakṣaṇaḥ” (ca. ci. 3) iti, tathā “santatajvara evānyaḥ svalpadurbalakāraṇaḥ” (ca. ci. 3) iti| sannipātajā sarvalakṣaṇopetetyapi viśeṣaṇamarthavat; yena na sarvatra sarvaje vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyārabdhaṃ pratyekadoṣajeṣvapaṭhitameva liṅgaṃ bhavati, kiṃ tarhi samudāyibhyo'nyatvāt samudāyasya cūrṇaharidrāsaṃyoga ivānyānyapi, ata eva vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyārabdhasya sannipātasyāvaśyameva lakṣaṇāni paṭhyante, pratyekadoṣaliṅgebhyo'nyatvādeva teṣāṃ sannipātaliṅgānām; evaṃ cikitsā'pi pṛthageva paṭhyate, tata eva hetoranyatvāddoṣadūṣyasvabhāvasya vyādheḥ| carake tu kaphavātajaiva vidārī paṭhitā; taduktaṃ- “jvarānvitāvaṅkṣaṇakakṣajā yā vartirnirartiḥ kaṭhināyatā ca| vidārikā syāt kaphamārutābhyām” (ca. ci. 12) iti| tatrāpi jvarānviteti vacanena pittamapyanumīyate| yaduktaṃ- “ūṣmā pittādṛte nāsti jvaro nāstyūṣmaṇā vinā” (vā. ci.1) iti| carake'pi pittavacanādvidārikā svalpapittādeva, svatantre paratantre'pi sarvajaivāvagamyate, vidārīcikitsite ca pittakaphaharavimlāpanādyukteḥ| ‘vidārīmiti tāṃ vidyāt sarvajāṃ sarvalakṣaṇām’ iti pāṭhāntare nāsti ko'pi vivādaḥ||24||

lg.l: sravaty āsrāvam atyarthaṃ ‘karoti’ tā. tatra vṛddhiṃ gato 'nilaḥ ‘gataḥ punaḥ’ iti tā.||26||
māṃsaṃ viśoṣya grathitāṃ śarkarāṃ janayet ‘janayatyataḥ’ iti tā. punaḥ |
durgandhaṃ klinnam atyarthaṃ nānāvarṇaṃ tataḥ sirāḥ ||27||
sravanti sahasā raktaṃ tad vidyāc charkarārbudam |28|

ab.seg: prāpyetyādi| iyaṃ śarkarāsamprāptiruktā, sā ca śarkarā hetuḥ śarkarārbudasya| kāṭhinyādeva śarkarāsādṛśyena śarkarā| atyagādhocchrāyābhyāmarbudam| nānāvarṇaṃ madhughṛtavasāsannibham| tata ityādi tataḥ śarkarāyāḥ sirā raktaṃ sravantītyarthaḥ| kecit śarkarā śarkarārbudaṃ ceti vyādhidvayaṃ vadanti; tannecchati gayī, saṅkhyātirekāccharkarāyāḥ pṛthaktvenokteradarśanācca||25-27||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: prāpya māṃsetyādinā śarkarārbudam| tatra śarkarrāyāṃ kaphānilau doṣau, māṃsasirāsnāyumedāṃsi tu dūṣyāṇi, madhughṛtavasāsadṛśaḥ srāvaḥ| dhātukṣayeṇa vṛddhiṅgato'nilo māṃsaṃ viśoṣya grathitāṃ kaṭhināṃ śarkarāṃ karoti; kāṭhinyādeva śarkarāsādṛśyena śarkarā, avagāḍhocchrāyābhyāmarbudam| tata iti śarkarāyāḥ sirā raktaṃ sravanti| nānāvarṇaṃ madhughṛtavasāsannibhameva, prakrāntatvāt; tatrāntare'pyevamevoktatvāt| tathāhi bhojaḥ- “vāyuḥ śleṣmāṇamādāya medaḥsnāyusirāgataḥ| karoti viṣamaṃ granthiṃ jvaradāhasamanvitam|| avagāḍhaṃ sukaṭhinamarbudaṃ taṃ vidurbudhāḥ| tadeva bhinnaṃ durgandhaṃ ghṛtamedopamaṃ sirāḥ|| sravanti srāvamaniśaṃ tadā taṃ śarkarārbudam” iti| kecit śarkarā arbudaṃ ceti vyādhidvayamācakṣate| tanna, saṅkhyātirekāt, śarkarāyāḥ pṛthaktvenānukteḥ, adarśanācca||25-27||
pāmetyādi| kuṣṭheṣviti kuṣṭhanidāne ityarthaḥ||28||
parītyādi| parikramaṇaśīlasya sarvato bhramaṇasvabhāvasya| dārīmiti vipādikāṃ; ‘viśrāvāku’ iti loke||29||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: paribhramaṇaśīlasyetyādinā pādadārī| paribhramaṇaśīlasya sarvato bhramaṇaśīlasya| anye tu vicarcikaiva sthānabhedena pādadārītyucyate vipādiketi ca| tasyāḥ kuṣṭhatvena sarvadoṣajatvaṃ sakrimitvaṃ ceti| pāmārakase tu kuṣṭhanirdiṣṭe kṣudraroge'pīti vākyaśeṣaḥ; tena punarnocyate, punaruktibhayādeva||29||

lg.l: medoraktānugaiś caiva ‘granthiḥ kī(ko)lavadutsanno jāyate kadaraṃ tataḥ’ iti tā. doṣair vā jāyate nṛṇām ||30||
kolamātraḥ saruk srāvī jāyate kadaras tu saḥ ||31||

ab.seg: śarkaretyādi| śarkarā ghaṭakarparakhaṇḍādayaḥ, tābhirunmathite pīḍite| kīlena sadṛśaṃ sakīlamityavyayībhāvaḥ, sakīlaṃ cāsau kaṭhinaśca sakīlakaṭhinaḥ| ‘hastayorapi’ iti bhojaḥ||30-31||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: śarkarābadarastu śarkaronmathite pāde ityādinā| kolavaditi badaravat| bhojābhiprāyeṇa hastayorapīcchanti| tathāhi bhojaḥ- “hastayoḥ pādayoścāpi gambhīrānugataṃ kharam| māṃsakīlaṃ janayataḥ kupitau kaphamārutau|| saśalyamapi taṃ deśaṃ manyate tena pīḍitaḥ| śarkarābadaraṃ kecinmanyante'nye ca kaṇṭakam” iti||30-31||
klinnetyādi| ayaṃ kaphena saśoṇitena||32||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: klinnāṅgulyantarau pādāvityādinā alasakaḥ| ayaṃ kaphena saśoṇitena; tatra kaṇḍūḥ kaphasya, śoṇitasya dāharuje||32||

lg.l: tad indraluptaṃ khālityaṃ rujyeti ca vibhāvyate ||34||

ab.seg: romakūpānugamityādi| khālityaṃ puṃsāmeva na tu yoṣitām| tathāca videhaḥ- “atyantasukumārāṅgyo rajo duṣṭaṃ sravanti ca| avyāyāmaratā yasmāttasmānna khalitiḥ striyāḥ” iti||33-34||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: romakūpānugaṃ pittamityādinā indraluptaṃ; khālityaṃ rujyeti ca tasyaiva sañjñāntaram| tatra khālityaṃ puṃsāmeva, na tu yoṣitāṃ; tathāhi videhaḥ- “atyantasukumārāṅgyo rajo duṣṭaṃ sravanti ca| avyāpāraratā yasmāttasmānna khalitiḥ striyāḥ” iti| asyāyamabhiprāyaḥ- avyāpāreṇa vātapitte na prakupyete, tato na lomapracyavaḥ; rajo vimuktyā ca srotovarodhābhāvāccyutānāmapi punarviroha iti| indralupte bhojaḥ- “pittaṃ sirasi sanduṣṭaṃ lomakūpānugaṃ yadā| tadā romāṇi śīryante tatra śleṣmānilau śritau|| …tadindraluptamityāhuḥ khallīṃ ruhyāṃ ca kecana” iti||33-34||

dāruṇenyādi| dāruṇā kaṭhinā| kaṇḍurā kaṇḍūyuktā| prapāṭyate prakarṣeṇa pāṭyate ‘prapuṭyate puṭapuṭāyate’ iti pā.| pittarudhirayorapyanubandho jñeyaḥ, videhavacanān| dāruṇakaṃ ‘pahā ‘aupahā’ iti pā. ’ iti loke||35||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: dāruṇā kaṇḍuretyādinā dāruṇakam| tasya kaphavātajasyāpi raktapittābhyāmanubandho videhavacanādeva jñeyaḥ| tathāhi videhaḥ- “yadabhrapaṭalābhāsamarajaskaṃ śirastvaci| pāruṣyaṃ jāyate jantostasya rūpaṃ viśeṣataḥ|| todaiḥ samanvitaṃ vātāt, sakaṇḍūgauravaṃ kaphāt| sapipāsaṃ sadāhārtirāgaṃ pittāttathā'sṛjaḥ” iti| tatrāpi sadāhaṃ pittāt, sārtirāgaṃ raktāt, ārtirhi śoṇitād bhavati| taduktaṃ carake- “raktaṃ hi vyamlatāṃ yāti tacca nāsti na cāsti ruk” (ca. ci. 5) iti| atra tu raktasya pittasya liṅgamanirdiṣṭamavasthāyāṃ draṣṭavyam||35||

lg.l: kaphāsṛkkṛmikopena ‘kaphāsṛkpittakopena’ iti tā. nṛṇāṃ vidyād aruṃṣikām ||36||

ab.seg: arūṃṣītyādi| arūṃṣi vraṇān||36||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: arūṃṣi bahuvaktrāṇītyādinā aruṃṣikā||36||

lg.l: pittaṃ ca keśān pacati palitaṃ tena jāyate ||37||

ab.seg: krodhetyādi| krodhādikṛtena śarīroṣmaṇā śirogatena vaikṛtaṃ, pittena punaḥ prākṛtaṃ palitam; anyathā pittoṣmaṇorabhedāt punaruktidoṣaḥ syāt; pañjikākārastu “śarīroṣmā pāvakaḥ, pittaṃ tadāśrayaḥ, etau pittapāvakāvekībhūya keśān pacataḥ; etena kevaloṣmakṛtasya vaikṛtasyādoṣajaprasaṅgo nirākṛtaḥ” iti manyate||37||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: krodhāyāsetyādinā palitam| atra śarīroṣmā pittaṃ ceti dvikartṛsamuccaya iti kecit; tadasamyak, bhedo hi- vaikṛtasya palitasya pācakapittoṣmakṛtatvāt, svābhāvikasya prākṛtapittakṛtatvāt; nanu tathā sati palitasyādoṣajaprasaṅgaḥ? na, ūṣmaṇaḥ pittadharmatvāt...tadyathā vaikṛtaḥ pittakṛtaḥ, samadoṣaprakṛtiṣu svābhāvikaḥ; tasmāt samuccitadvikartṛkatvaṃ nānenocyate| pittaprakṛtijaṃ svābhāvikameva, prakṛteralpadoṣatvenāvikāritvādityanekaśo vyākhyātameva||37||

lg.l: dāhajvararujāvantas tāmrāḥ sphoṭāḥ sapītakāḥ ‘savedanāḥ’ iti tā.|
gātreṣu vadane cāntar vijñeyās tā masūrikāḥ ||38||

ab.seg: dāhetyādi| tāmratvena śoṇitānubandho'pyeṣāṃ; tathāhi tantrāntaraṃ- “pittaṃ śoṇitasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ yadā dūṣayati tvacam| tadā karoti piḍakāḥ sarvagātreṣu dehinaḥ|| masūramudgamāṣāṇāṃ tulyāḥ kolopamā api| masūrikāstu vijñeyāḥ piḍakā raktapittajāḥ”- iti| etāsāṃ ‘śītalikā’ iti lokāśrayā sañjñā||38||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: dāhajvararujāvanta ityādinā masūrikāḥ| tāmratvasarujatvena śoṇitānubandho'pyeṣām|| tathāhi tantrāntare- “pittaṃ śoṇitasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ yadā dūṣayati tvacam| tadā karoti piḍikāṃ sarvagātreṣu dehinām|| masūramudgamāṣāṇāṃ tulyāḥ kolopamā api| masūrikāstu vijñeyāḥ piḍikāḥ pittaraktajāḥ” iti||38||

lg.l: jāyante piḍakā yūnāṃ vaktre yā ‘yuvānapiḍakā yūnāṃ vijñeyā’ iti tā. mukhadūṣikāḥ ||39||

ab.seg: śālmalītyādi| śālmalīkaṇṭakaprakhyāḥ śālmalīkaṇṭakasadṛśāḥ| yūnāṃ taruṇānām||39||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: śālmalīkaṇṭakākārā ityādinā yuvānapiḍikāḥ| yūnāmānanaṃ yūvānanaṃ, tasya piḍikā yuvānapiḍikāḥ| pṛṣodarāderākṛtigaṇatvādekasya nakārasya lopaḥ| mukhe pacante ata eva mukhadūṣikā iti||39||

lg.l: kaṇṭakair ācitaṃ vṛttaṃ ‘vidyānmaṇḍalaṃ pāṇḍu kaṇḍuram’ iti tā. kaṇḍūmat pāṇḍumaṇḍalam |

ab.seg: kaṇṭakairityādi| padminīkaṇṭakaprakhyaiḥ padminīkaṇṭakasadṛśaiḥ| ācitaṃ vyāptam| tadākhyaṃ padminīkaṇṭakākhyam||40||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: kaṇṭakairācitamityādinā padminīkaṇṭakam| padminīkaṇṭakavadākhyā yasya tat padminīkaṇṭakākhyam||40||

lg.l: sahajaṃ raktam īṣac ca ‘lakṣma caikeṣāṃ lakṣyo jatumaṇīti saḥ’ iti tā. ślakṣṇaṃ jatumaṇiṃ viduḥ ||41||

ab.seg: nīrujamityādi| samaṃ sūkṣmam| utsannamunnatam| sahajaṃ janmabalapravṛttam| ślakṣṇamakarkaśam| jatumaṇiḥ ‘jadula’ iti lokāśrayā tatsañjñā||41||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: samamutsannamarujamityādinā jatumaṇiḥ| tasya jaṭula iti lokāśrayā sañjñā| ekeṣāmācāryāṇāṃ matena tu lakṣaṇaṃ strīpuruṣayoraṅgabhedena suphalapradam| sahajaṃ janmabalapravṛttamityarthaḥ| samamutsannamapi ślakṣṇaṃ yato'vaiṣamyakarkaśamityarthaḥ| tathā hi bhojaḥ- “jaṭulaṃ sahajaṃ raktaṃ śleṣmaśoṇitasambhavam| ślakṣṇaṃ ca samudīrṇaṃ ca vidyājjatumaṇiṃ bhiṣak” iti| tathā vaitaraṇe'pi “kṛṣṇaḥ śuklo jatumaṇirjñeyo vātottaraistribhiḥ| arujaṃ tvaparaṃ raktaṃ lakṣmetyāhurbhiṣagvarāḥ” iti||41||

lg.l: avedanaṃ sthiraṃ caiva yasya gātreṣu dṛśyate |
māṣavat kṛṣṇam utsannam anilān maṣakaṃ vadet ||42||

ab.seg: avedanamityādi| sthiraṃ kaṭhinam||42||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: māṣaśabdāt “ive pratikṛtau” (pā. a. 5/3/96) iti kanpratyayaḥ| pṛṣodarāditvānmāṣaśabdākārasya hrasvatvam| sthiraṃ kaṭhinam| atrāpi kaphavātamedobhireva maṣakamārabhyate| taduktaṃ bhoje- “vāterite tvaci yadā pravṛddhe kaphamedasī| ślakṣṇaṃ mṛdu savarṇaṃ ca kuruto maṣakaṃ vadet” iti| atrāpi ślakṣṇatā vāyorlabhyata eva||42||

lg.l: vātapittakaphocchoṣāt tān ‘vātapittakaphodrekāt’ iti pā. vidyāt tilakālakān ||43||

ab.seg: kṛṣṇānītyādi| vātapittakaphocchoṣāditi vātapittābhyāṃ kaphasya śoṣādityarthaḥ| anye tu “vātapittāsṛgucchoṣāt” iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- vātapittābhyāṃ raktasya śoṣādityarthaḥ; ata eva tilakālake kārṣṇyam| ‘vātapittakaphodrekāt’ iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ, tasmin pāṭhe kaphodrekalakṣaṇaṃ tilakālake nāsti||43||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: kṛṣṇāni tilamātrāṇītyādinā tilakālakaḥ| ‘vātapittakaphocchoṣāt’ iti kecit paṭhanti; anye tu ‘vātapittāsṛgucchoṣāt’ iti paṭhanti| atra vātapittābhyāṃ raktaśoṣaḥ; tathāhi carakaḥ- “yasya pittaṃ prakupitaṃ śoṇitaṃ prāpya śuṣyati| tilakāḥ piplavo vyaṅgā nīlikā cāsya jāyate” (ca. sū. 18) iti| anye tu ‘vātapittakaphodrekāt’ iti paṭhanti| tathā hi tantrāntaraṃ- “mārutaḥ pittamādāya kapharaktasamāśritaḥ| karoti tilamātrāṇi tvaci te tilakālakāḥ” iti| anenāpi tantrāntarārthenāyameva pāṭhaḥ| vātapittakaphocchoṣāditi vātapittāśritayoḥ kaphapittayorucchoṣa eva yato bhavati; ata eva tilakālake pittotpatteḥ (?) tathāhi kaphodrekasya lakṣaṇaṃ kimatra bhaviṣyati||43||

lg.l: maṇḍalaṃ mahad alpaṃ vā śyāmaṃ vā yadi vā sitam |
sahajaṃ nīrujaṃ gātre nyaccham ity abhidhīyate ||44||

ab.seg: maṇḍalamityādi| sahajaṃ janmabalapravṛttam| nyacchaṃ lokā lāñchanamiti vadanti; pittaraktānvito vāyurasya kāraṇam||44||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: mahadvā yadi vā svalpamityādinā nyacchaḥ| ‘sahajaṃ maṇḍalaṃ’ iti kecidadhīyate| teṣāṃ mate janmabalapravṛttaṃ nyaccham, ata eva nyacchasya paryāye tairuktaṃlāñchanamiti| pittaraktānvito vāyurasya kāraṇaṃ, śyāvānvitatvrānnyacchasyeti||44||

div.ab: samutthānetyādi| samutthānaṃ samprāptiḥ, nidānaṃ hetulakṣaṇanirdeśaḥ| gayī tu samutthānanidānābhyāmityādi carmakīlapratipādakaṃ vākyameva na paṭhati|45|-

lg.l: sahasā mukham āgatya maṇḍalaṃ visṛjaty ataḥ |
nīrujaṃ tanukaṃ śyāvaṃ mukhe vyaṅgaṃ tam ādiśet ||46||
kṛṣṇam evaṅguṇaṃ gātre mukhe vā nīlikāṃ viduḥ |47|

ab.seg: krodhetyādi| “vyaṅgameva sthānāntareṇa varṇāntareṇa ca nīlikā” ityanye||45-46||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
