ab.seg: krodhāyāsaprakupito vāyurityādinā vyaṅgaḥ| asyaiva nīliketi loke khyātiḥ| tatra tantrāntare “mārutaḥ krodhaharṣābhyāmūrdhvago mukhamāśritaḥ| pittena saha saṃyuktaḥ karoti vadane tvaci|| nīrujaṃ tanukaṃ śyāvaṃ taṃ vyaṅgamiti nirdiśet| kṛṣṇāmevaṅguṇaṃ gātre nīlikāṃ tāṃ vinirdiśet” iti||45-46||

lg.l: meḍhracarma yadā vāyur bhajate sarvataś caraḥ ||47||
maṇer adhastāt kośaś ca granthirūpeṇa lambate ||48||
savedanaḥ sadāhaś ca pākaṃ ca vrajati kvacit |
mārutāgantusambhūtāṃ vidyāt tāṃ parivartikām ‘parivartiketi tāṃ vidyāt sarujāṃ vātasambhavām’ iti tā.||49||

ab.seg: mardanādityādi| atīti mardanapīḍanābhyāṃ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate; samyakkṛtau hi mardanapīḍanau vāyupraśāntikarāveva bhavataḥ| bhajate āśrayati| sarvataścaro vāyurvyānaḥ| carma pratinivartata iti maṇiṃ vihāya sarvato vyāghuṭatītyarthaḥ| kośaḥ carmakośaḥ| saiva parivartiketyarthaḥ||47-49||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: mardanādityādi| atyarthamardanāt pīḍanādvā tathā'bhighātādvā sarvataścaro vāyurvyāno meḍhracarma bhajate; atīti pīḍanamardanayorviśeṣaṇaṃ, tayorhi samyakkṛtayorvāyoreva praśamanatvāt; atyarthakaraṇāttayorabhighātāt kalāyāścarmaṇo dūṣakatvāt| carmavātopasṛṣṭatvāt parivartate| carma koṣacarma| parivartiketi paripūrvādvṛteḥ ṇvul| sakaṇḍūḥ kaṭhinā caiva saiva śleṣmānubandhataḥ| tathāhi bhoje- “maṇeradho meḍhracarma vyānastu parivartayet| saśūlatodadāhādyairvijñeyā parivartikā|| ślaiṣmikī kaṭhinā stabdhā kaṇḍūmatyalpavedanā” iti||47-49||

lg.l: alpīyaḥkhāṃ ‘alpīyasīṃ yadā harṣādbalādgacchet’ iti pā. yadā harṣād bālāṃ gacchet striyaṃ naraḥ ||50||

ab.seg: alpīyaḥkhāmityādi| alpīyaḥkhām alpatarayonidvārām| carmaṇyudvartite uttānībhūya vyāghuṭite| yasya carma mardanādibhiravapāṭyate vidīryate tasya tāmavapāṭikāṃ vidyādityarthaḥ| carma kartṛ| udvartate niścitamūrdhvaṃ pravartata ityanye||50-51||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: kanyā punaranārtavā'lpatarayonidvāratvādevālpīyaḥkhetyucyate| tatra pakṣāntaraṃ hastābhighātādathavā carmaṇyudvartite; udvartite ūrdhvaṃ pravartite| yasyāvapāṭyate ‘svayaṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ; tenāvadīryate| iyaṃ doṣaistribhirapyanuvartate| tathā hi bhojaḥ- “mardanādabhighātādvā kanyāyoniprapīḍanāt| lakṣyate yadi meḍhrasya carma darbhairiva kṣatam|| avapāṭiketi tāṃ vidyāt pṛthagdoṣaiḥ samanvitām| vātāt saparuṣā rūkṣā tathā nistodakārikā|| pittāt sapītā raktādvā dāhatṛṣṇāsamanvitā| ślaiṣmikī kaṭhinā snigdhā kaṇḍūmatyalpavedanā” iti||50-51||

lg.l: vātopasṛṣṭam evaṃ tu carma saṃśrayate maṇim ||52||
maṇiś carmopanaddhas tu ‘carmoparuddhastu’ iti tā. mūtrasroto ruṇaddhi ca |
niruddhaprakaśe tasmin mandadhāram avedanam ‘savedanam’ iti tā.||53||
mūtraṃ pravartate jantor maṇir na ‘maṇirvivriyate na ca’ iti pā. ca vidīryate |
niruddhaprakaśaṃ vidyād durūḍhāṃ ‘sarujaṃ vātasambhavam’ iti pā. cāvapāṭikām ||54||

ab.seg: vātopasṛṣṭamityādi| evamiti mardanapīḍanābhighātādinetyarthaḥ| saṃśrayate samagraṃ śrayate| durūḍhāṃ cāvapāṭikāmiti avapāṭikā'pi durūḍhā niruddhaprakāśākhyāṃ labhate||52-54||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: vātopasṛṣṭe meḍhre ityādinā niruddhaprakaśaḥ| evamityatipīḍanābhighātādinā pūrvavat| saṃśrayate samagraṃ śrayate| avapāṭikaiva ca durūḍhā saṅkucitatvāccarmaṇo niruddhaprakāśo bhavati| mandadhāramadenamantardoṣābādhāt tasmin mandadhārā pravartate, maṇiśca nātivivṛto bhavet| atraiva bhojaḥ- “meḍhrānte carmaṇi yadā mārutaḥ kupito bhṛśam| dvāraṃ ruṇaddhi ca śanaiḥ prakāśastu muhurbhavet|| mūtraṃ mūtrayate kṛcchrāt prakāśastu yadā bhavet| vātopasṛṣṭameḍhrastu maṇirna ca vidīryate|| niruṇaddhi prakāśaṃ taṃ vidyādvyādhiṃ sudāruṇam” iti||52-54||

lg.l: niruṇaddhi mahat srotaḥ sūkṣmadvāraṃ karoti ca ||55||
mārgasya saukṣmyāt kṛcchreṇa purīṣaṃ tasya gacchati |

ab.seg: vegasandhāraṇādityādi| vihato niruddhagatiḥ| mahatsroto gudam||55-56||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: gudaṃ meḍhrānantaraṃ nirdiśannāha- vegasandhāraṇādityādi| mahatsrotaḥ gudam| niruddhaprakāśavadatrāpi gudacarmasaṅkocāt sanniruddhagudatvam||55-56||

lg.l: kaṇḍūyanāt tataḥ kṣipraṃ sphoṭāḥ srāvaś ca jāyate |
ekībhūtaṃ vraṇair ghoraṃ taṃ vidyād ahipūtanam ||58||

ab.seg: śakṛdityādi| śakṛnmūtrasamāyukte'pāne gude, adhaute akriyamāṇaśauce, śiśo raktakaphodbhavā kaṇḍūrbhavediti sambandhaḥ| kathambhūtasya? svinnasya asnāpyamānasya ca| ekībhūtamapānaṃ vraṇaiḥ ‘saha’ ityadhyāhāryam| ahipūtanaṃ kapharaktajaṃ jñeyam||57-58||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: sakṛnmūtretyādinā'hipūtanā| apāne gude svinne śiśorasnāpyamāne akriyamāṇe śauce svedamalotkledena kaṇḍūyanaṃ kapharaktadoṣeṇa sphoṭāśca jāyante| jāyante iti vakṣyamāṇavacanavipariṇāmāt| ekībhūtaṃ vraṇaiḥ ‘saha’ ityādhyāhāryam| sanniruddhagudaviparīto'yaṃ, vraṇaiḥ sahaikībhāvena gudasyātivivṛtatvāt| atra bhojaḥ- “duṣṭastanyasya pānena malasyādhāvanena ca| kaṇḍūdāharujāvadbhiḥ piḍakābhiḥ samācitaḥ|| ahipūtanako nāma yathādoṣaṃ sudāruṇaḥ” iti||57-58||

lg.l: yadā praklidyate svedāt kaṇḍūṃ sañjanayet tadā ||59||
tatra kaṇḍūyanāt kṣipraṃ sphoṭāḥ srāvaś ca jāyate |

ab.seg: snānotsādanetyādi| utsādanam udvartanam||59-60||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: snānotsādanetyādinā vṛṣaṇakacchūḥ| ahipūtanavadvṛṣaṇakacchurapi kapharaktodbhavā||59-60||

lg.l: rūkṣadurbaladehasya taṃ gudabhraṃśam ādiśet asyāgre tāḍapatrapustake ‘ityevaṃ kṣudrarogāṇāṃ sthānaṃ samparikīrtitam| tadavekṣya bhiṣak prājño yathādoṣamupācaret’ ityadhikaḥ śloka upalabhyate||61||

ab.seg: pravāhaṇetyādi| pravāhaṇaṃ prakarṣeṇa nirvāhaṇam| ayaṃ vātakopajaḥ||61||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: pravāhaṇātisarābhyāmityādinā gudabhraṃśaḥ| pravāhaṇaṃ prakarṣeṇa nirvāhaṇaṃ; ‘vāha’ prayatne, ityasmāt pravāhaṇamiti rūpam| ativegodīraṇena vātakopaḥ punaratisaraṇena dhātukṣayāt| rūkṣadurbaladehasyeti ubhayatra yojanīyam| carake bhojādiṣu punaratīsāre eva gudabhraṃśaḥ paṭhitaḥ||61||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne kṣudraroganidānaṃ nāma trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||13||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nidānasthāne trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ||13||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: iti sauśrute śalyatantre śrīgayadāsaviracitāyāṃ nyāyacandrikākhyāyāṃ pañjikāyāṃ nidānasthāne kṣudrarogāṇāṃ nidānam||13||
athātaḥ śūkadoṣanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

athāta ityādi| śūkadoṣanidānamiti atrādiśabdo luptanirdiṣṭo draṣṭavyaḥ, tena śūkādidoṣanidānamityarthaḥ; ādiśabdācca duṣṭayonigūḍhāntarlomayonidurbhagāgamanamabhighātaścābhipretaḥ| tannecchati gayī, duṣṭayonyādīnāmupadaṃśahetutvāt| śūkaḥ sajantujalamalaḥ, liṅgavṛddhikaro yogo vā; doṣo'tra duṣṭiḥ, asamyakkaraṇādvaikṛtam; athavā doṣo vātādiḥ, vātādikṛto vā vikāraḥ; teṣāṃ lakṣaṇasyaiva nirdeśānnidānaṃ, na tu hetoḥ; hetuḥ punaratra śūka eva, sa ca pratijñāsūtreṇaivābhihitaḥ||1-2||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: kṣudrarogānantaraṃ kṣudratvasāmānyāt parivartikādimeḍhrarogapratyāsannatvena ca śūkadoṣanidānārambhaḥ| śūkojalaśūkaḥ, ādipadalopāt| sa tu sajantujalamalaḥ; liṅgavṛddhikarayogo vā, śūkapradhānatvāt| śūkavalliṅgavṛddhikaratvādanyo'pi śūkasamaḥ śūkaḥ, tena vā tasya vā doṣo'tra duṣṭirasamyakkaraṇādvaikṛtam; athavā doṣo vātādiḥ vātādikṛtavikāro vā; doṣaśabdo hi vātādiṣu tatkṛtavyādhiṣvapi vartate, “doṣā api vyādhiśabdaṃ labhante” iti vacanāt| teṣāṃ lakṣaṇasyaiva nirdeśānnidānaṃ, na tu hetoḥ; hetuḥ punaratra śūkadoṣa eva, tasyāpi ca pratipādanamātranirdeśānnidānam||1-2||

liṅgavṛddhim icchatām akramapravṛttānāṃ śūkadoṣanimittā daśa cāṣṭau ca vyādhayo jāyante | tad yathā sarṣapikā, aṣṭhīlikā, grathitaṃ, kumbhīkā, alajī, mṛditaṃ, sammūḍhapiḍakā, avamanthaḥ, puṣkarikā, sparśahāniḥ, uttamā, śataponakaḥ, tvakpākaḥ, śoṇitārbudaṃ, māṃsārbudaṃ, māṃsapākaḥ, vidradhiḥ, tilakālakaś ceti ||3||

teṣāṃ śūkadoṣajānāṃ vyādhīnāṃ sāmānyāṃ samprāptimāha- liṅgetyādi| liṅgavṛddhiḥ sthūlīkaraṇam; āyāmapariṇāhābhyāmityanye āyāmapariṇāhavṛddhirityanye’ iti pā.| vātsyāyanādyuktaliṅgavṛddhikarayogasya ‘… liṅgavṛddhivyatirikto’ iti pā. akramo'nācāraḥ; ‘uttarabastikarmaṇo'nācāra’ ityanye, tannecchati gayī| saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva saṅkhyāyāṃ labdhāyāmaṣṭādaśavacanaṃ saṅkhyeyanirdeśabhrāntinirāsārtham||3||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: teṣāṃ śūkadoṣajānāṃ sāmānyāṃ samprāptiṃ darśayannāha- liṅgavṛddhimicchatāmityādinā| vṛddhiḥ sthūlīkaraṇam; āyāmapariṇāhavṛddhirityanye| kramavirodho akramaḥ, nañatra virodhārthaḥ| śūkadoṣanimittāḥ śūkadoṣā eva nimittaṃ kāraṇaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| śūkadoṣa eva nimittamatrocyate, na tu yonidoṣādaya upadaṃśahetava iti| tena ādipadalopasya prayojanameva nāsti| teṣāṃ liṅgavṛddhividhīnāṃ vātsyāyanādau vistara aupaniṣadike draṣṭavyaḥ| tathāhi- “bhallātakāsthijalaśūkamathābjapatramantarvidahya matimān saha saindhavena| etadvirūḍhabṛhatīphalatoyapiṣṭamālepanaṃ mahiṣaviḍvimalīkṛte'ṅge| sthūlaṃ bṛhadvaraturaṅgamatulyamāśu śephaḥ karotyabhimataṃ nahi saṃśayo'sti”| evamādīnāṃ duravacāraṇaṃ śūkadoṣajānāṃ nidānam| anye tu manyante'trāpacārastrividhaḥ- praṇidhānāśrayaḥ, parikarmāśrayaḥ, puruṣāśrayaśca; tathā hi bhālukiḥ- “ekonaviṃśatiḥ śūkadoṣāḥ- praṇidhānadoṣāt, parikarmadoṣāt, puruṣadoṣācca”| tanna, tantreṣu sarveṣvadarśanāt| saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva saṅkhyāyāṃ labdhāyāmaṣṭādaśavacanaṃ sammūḍhapiḍakādīnāṃ samāsanirdeśabhrāntinirāsārtham||3||
śūkadurbhagnahetuketi duravacāritaśūkahetuketyarthaḥ| anye ‘śūkadurbhagahetukā’ iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- śūko duṣṭabhagaśca heturyasyāḥ sā tathā| tannecchati gayī||4||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: śūkadurbhagahetuketi kecit paṭhanti| tanna, teṣāmanupadaṃśatvāt||4||

lg.l: śūkais tu viṣasambhugnaiḥ ‘viṣasaṃyuktaiḥ’ iti pā. piḍakā 'ṣṭhīlikā bhavet ‘kaṭhinā viṣamā bha(bhu)gnairvoyunā'ṣṭhīlikā bhavet iti tā.||5||

ab.seg: kaṭhinetyādi| śūkairaṣṭhīlikā bhavediti sambandhaḥ| viṣamaiḥ apraśastaiḥ| antairiti ko'rthaḥ; patitaiḥ| anye tu “viṣamairantairupalakṣitā” iti vyācakṣate; etena viṣamāntasahitetyuktam| viṣasambhugnaiḥ viṣeṇa kṛtvā vakrairityarthaḥ||5||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: kaṭhinetyādinā aṣṭhīlikā| kaṭhinā viṣamairbhugnairiti parasparāsaktaiḥ; anye punaratraiva viṣamairlakṣyamāṇairityācakṣate| duḥkhacāritaśūkadoṣahetuḥ punaratra sarvatraivotsarganyāyenāsti| aṣṭhīlikā aṣṭhīlā nāma lohakārāṇāṃ lauhī dīrghavartulā bhāṇḍiḥ||5||

lg.l: śūkair yat pūritaṃ śaśvad grathitaṃ tat ‘nāma tat kaphāt’ iti tā. kaphotthitam |6|

ab.seg: śūkairityādi| śaśvat pratidinam, etenaikadināntarapūraṇaṃ praśastamicchanti kāmatantrācāryāḥ; nityapūraṇādgrathitanāmno rogasyotpattiḥ||6||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: śūkairyat pūritamityādinā grathitam||6||

kumbhīketyādi| kumbhīkā kumbhīphalamiva| aśubheti śubhā śuklā, tadvirodhenāśubhā kṛṣṇetyarthaḥ| iyamapi duravacāritaśūkajā| ‘āśujā’ iti kecit paṭhanti; tatra śūkapātānantaraṃ śīghraṃ jāyata ityarthaḥ||6||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: kumbhīkāḥ kumbhyāḥ phalaṃ kumbhī, phale luk (pā. a. 4/2/163) iti taddhitasya luk, ‘ive prakṛtau’ (pā. a. 5/3/96) iti kan| aśubheti śubhaṃ śuklaṃ, tadvirodhe nañ, tena kṛṣṇetyarthaḥ||6||

lg.l: alajīlakṣaṇair yuktām alajīṃ ‘tulyajāṃ tvalajīṃ vidyādyathāproktāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ’ iti tā. ca vitarkayet |
mṛditaṃ pīḍitaṃ yat tu saṃrabdhaṃ vāyukopataḥ ||7||

ab.seg: alajīlakṣaṇaiḥ pramehapiḍakālajīlakṣaṇairityarthaḥ| iyamapi duṣṭaśūkāvacāraṇājjñeyā| yat punarliṅgaṃ pātitaśūkaṃ sat hastābhyāṃ bhṛśapīḍitam, ata eva vātakopataḥ saṃrabdhaṃ saśophaṃ, tanmṛditākhyarogākrāntaṃ jñeyam||7||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: alajīlakṣaṇairityādinā alajī| alajīlakṣaṇairiti pramehapiḍikālakṣaṇairiti śeṣaḥ| sā ca raktā'sitā sphoṭāvṛtetyādinā tulyalakṣaṇā| tatra pramehe jāyamānā pramehadoṣādadhaḥkāye eva viśeṣeṇa, śūkadoṣajā tu raktapittadoṣajā liṅgajaiva| pātitaśūkaṃ liṅgaṃ pāṇibhyāṃ bhṛśaṃ pīḍitaṃ mṛditaṃ; vyādhināmedam||7||
bhṛśasammūḍhe atyarthapiccitāvanate, ‘pātitaśūke liṅge’ ityadhyāhāryam| sammūḍhapiḍakā mṛditaṃ ca vātaraktāt||8||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: pātitaśūke liṅge pāṇibhyāṃ bhṛśasammūḍhe piccitāvanate; sammūḍhapiḍakā mṛditaṃ ca vātaraktābhyām||8||

lg.l: dīrghā bahvyaś ca piḍakā dīryante madhyatas tu yāḥ ||8||

ab.seg: bahvyaḥ prabhūtāḥ| avamantho'pi sthūlīkaraṇaśūkakarmāpacāreṇa jñeyaḥ||8||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: dīrghā bahvya ityādinā'vamanthaḥ| atra bhālukiḥ- “avamanthakagrasto yo madhye dīrghavidāritaḥ| piḍakābhirbhaved vyāptaḥ śūkakarmāpacārataḥ” iti| sthūlīkaraṇaśūkakarmāpacāraja ityarthaḥ||8||

lg.l: padmapuṣkarasaṃsthānā ‘padmakarṇikasaṃsthānā’ iti tā. jñeyā puṣkariketi sā |10|

ab.seg: padmapuṣkaraṃ padmakarṇikā| eṣā'pi śūkakarmāpacārajā jñeyā||9||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: piḍaketyādinā puṣkarikā| padmapuṣkaravat puṣkarikā||9||
janayedityādi| sparśahāniṃ sparśahānināmānaṃ vyādhiviśeṣam| śūkadūṣitaṃ śūkena duṣṭiṃ nītam||10||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: śūkadoṣādityutsarganyāyena, sparśahāniḥ||10||

lg.l: uttamaiṣā ‘vyādhireṣottamo nāma śūkājīrṇanimittajaḥ’ iti tā. tu vijñeyā śūkājīrṇanimittajā ||11||

ab.seg: mudgetyādi| uttamā vyādhiviśeṣaḥ| śūkājīrṇanimittajeti śūkājīrṇaṃ punaḥ punarduravacāritaśūkavikṛtilakṣaṇa eva pariṇāmaḥ, tadeva nimittaṃ, tato jāteti; anye tu “śūkājīrṇaṃ śūkenājīrṇaṃ pratikṣaṇapātitaśūkanimittābhyāṃ raktapitābhyāṃ jāyate” ityāhuḥ||11||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: mudgamāṣopametyādinottamā| śūkājīrṇaṃ duravacāritaśūkasalakṣaṇa eva pariṇāmaḥ, tadena nimittaṃ, tato jātā||11||

lg.l: chidrair aṇumukhair vastu ‘chidrairaṇumukhairliṅgaṃ’ iti, ‘chidrairaṇumukhairyattu citaṃ meḍhraṃ’ iti ca pā. citaṃ yasya samantataḥ |

ab.seg: chidrairityādi| chidraiḥ duravacāritaśūkanimittavātaśoṇitajaiḥ| vastu adhiṣṭhānamityarthaḥ||12||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: chidrairaṇumukhairityādinā śataponakaḥ| chidraiḥ duravacāritaśūkanimittavātaśoṇitajaiḥ| citamupacitaṃ, cikitsite lekhanopadeśāt||12||

lg.l: pittaraktakṛto ‘vātapittakṛtaḥ’ iti pā. jñeyas tvakpāko jvaradāhavān |13|

ab.seg: pittaraktetyādi| pittaraktakṛta iti duravacāritaśūkajanitapittaśoṇitaja ityarthaḥ| gayī tu duravacāritaśūkadūṣitavātapittaja ityāhaḥ||13||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: vātapittaja ityādinā tvakpākaḥ| duravacaritaśūkadūṣitavātapittajaḥ||13||

lg.l: kṛṣṇaiḥ sphoṭaiḥ saraktaiś ca piḍakābhiś ca pīḍitam ‘dūṣitam’ iti pā.|
yasya vas tu rujaś cogrā jñeyaṃ tac choṇitārbudam ||13||

ab.seg: kṛṣṇairityādi| yasya vastu adhiṣṭhānaṃ sphoṭaiḥ piḍakābhiśca pīḍitaṃ bhavati tacchoṇitārbudaṃ jñeyamiti sambandhaḥ| ayamapi duravacāritaśūkebhyaḥ||13||
māṃsetyādi| māṃsadoṣeṇa māṃsavṛddhyā| idamapi duravacāritaśūke liṅge prahārādibhirjāyate||14||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: sphoṭairityādinā śoṇitārbudam| ya vastu vraṇavastu tadavagādhocchritamāṃsaśothatvādarbudam| duravacāritaśūke liṅge prahārādibhirmāṃsadoṣeṇetyarthaḥ|||14||

lg.l: śīryante yasya māṃsāni yatra sarvāś ca vedanāḥ ||14||
vidyāt taṃ māṃsapākaṃ tu sarvadoṣakṛtaṃ bhiṣak |15|

ab.seg: śīryante galanti| eṣo'pi duravacāritaśūkadūṣitadoṣajaḥ||14||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: śīryante yasyetyādinā māṃsapākaḥ| duravacāritaśūkadūṣitadoṣatrayakṛtasya māṃsapākasya śīryante māṃsāni galanti| sarvā vedanā todadāhakaṇḍvādikāḥ| duravavāritaśūkadūṣitadoṣatrayajaḥ||14||
vidradhimityādi| ayamapi duravacāritaśūkadūṣitadoṣatrayajaḥ||15||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: vidradhiḥ sānnipātikavidradhilakṣaṇānyevātra jānīyāt| sa tu ‘nānāvarṇarujāsrāva’ (ni. 9) ityādilakṣaṇena vidradhinā vijñeyaḥ||15||

lg.l: kṛṣṇāni citrāṇy athavā śūkāni saviṣāṇi ca |
kālāni bhūtvā māṃsāni śīryante yasya dehinaḥ |

ab.seg: kṛṣṇānītyādi| kṛṣṇāni kṛṣṇavarṇāni| citrāṇi śuklapītanīlādivarṇānītyarthaḥ| kālāni pariṇatatilaphalavarṇāni| śīryante galanti||16-17||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: kṛṣṇānītyādinā tilakālakaḥ| kṛṣṇāni kṛṣṇavarṇāni| citrāṇyathaveti śuklapītanīlādivarṇānītyarthaḥ| kṛṣṇāni pariṇatatilaphalavarṇāni| viśīryante galanti||16-17||

lg.l: tatra māṃsārbudaṃ yac ca māṃsapākaś ca yaḥ smṛtaḥ |
vidradhiś ca na sidhyanti ye ca syus tilakālakāḥ ||18||

ab.seg: śūkadoṣajānāmasādhyānnirdiśannāha- tatretyādi| ye ceti cakārāt kadācit sidhyantītyuktam||18||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: śūkadoṣajānāmasādhyānnirdiśannāha- tatra māṃsārbudaṃ yaccetyādi| yacceti cakāro bhinnakrame na siddhyanti cetyatra draṣṭavyaḥ, tena cikitsite tu pratyākhyāyopacaraṇam||18||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne śūkadoṣanidānaṃ nāma caturdaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||14||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nidānasthāne caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ||14||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: iti sauśrute śalyatantre nidānasthāne śrīgayadāsaviracitāyāṃ nyāyacandrikākhyāyāṃ pañjikāyāṃ śūkadoṣāṇāṃ nidānam||14||

div.head: bhagnanidānam

ab.seg: athāto bhagnānāṃ nidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi||1-2||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: atha śūkadoṣānantaraṃ bhagnanidānaṃ hetulakṣaṇanirdeśaḥ, āgantusādharmyādubhayoḥ||1-2||
patanapīḍanaprahārākṣepaṇavyālamṛgadaśanaprabhṛtibhir abhighātaviśeṣair anekavidham asthnāṃ bhaṅgam upadiśanti ‘bhagnamupadiśanti’ iti pā.||3||

bhagnānāṃ hetuṃ nirdiśannāha- patanapīḍanetyādi| prahāro muṣṭilaguḍakṛpāṇabāṇādīnām, ākṣepaṇamatiśayena cālanaṃ, vyālamṛgadaśanaṃ vyāghrādibhakṣaṇaṃ, prabhṛtigrahaṇādbalavadvigrahādīnāmavarodhaḥ| anekavidhaṃ bahuprakāram||3||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: tatra prathamaṃ bhagnānāṃ hetumeva darśayannāha- prapatanapīḍanetyādi| praharaṇaṃ prahāraḥ muṣṭilaguḍakṛpāṇabāṇādīnāṃ; prabhṛtigrahaṇāt balavadvigrahādīnāmavarodhaḥ||3||
tatra ‘tattu’ iti pā. bhaṅga(gna)jātam anekavidham anusāryamāṇaṃ dvividham evopapadyate sandhimuktaṃ, kāṇḍabhagnaṃ ca | tatra ṣaḍvidhaṃ sandhimuktaṃ, dvādaśavidhaṃ kāṇḍabhagnaṃ bhavati ||4||

teṣāṃ dvaividhyamāha- tatretyādi| bhagnajātamiti jātaṃ samūhaḥ| anusāryamāṇam anusartuṃ preryamāṇam| ‘anuśriyamāṇaṃ’ ityeke paṭhanti| sandhimuktakāṇḍabhagnayorlakṣaṇamāha- tatra parvaṇītyādi; ayaṃ pāṭho'bhāvānna likhito na ca vyākhyātaḥ||4||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: teṣāṃ bhagnānāṃ saṅkṣepeṇa lakṣaṇacikitsārthaṃ viśiṣṭavyādhidvayena dvaividhyameva darśayannāha- tattu bhagnajātamityādi| anekavidhaṃ bahuprakāraṃ bhagnānāṃ jātaṃ, patanādihetūnāmeva nānāvidhatvena tajjanitotpiṣṭādīnāmapi pratyekameva bahuprakāratvāt| ‘anuśriyamāṇaṃ’ ityeke paṭhanti, ‘anusāryamāṇaṃ’ ityanye| pūrvapakṣatvādinā prayojakena tu sarvatra yujyamānamiti(?)| tadeva dvaividhyaṃ darśayannāha- sandhimuktamityādi| tayoreva lakṣaṇamāviṣkurvannāha- tatra parvaṇītyādi| pūrvāparasañcchinno'sthyavayavaḥ kāṇḍaḥ, tayorevāsthikāṇḍayormadhyasandhānaṃ sandhiḥ, tayordvayorapi lakṣaṇacikitsārthamākṛtiviśeṣabhedāntaraṃ darśayannāha- tatra ṣaḍvidhamityādi||4||
tatra sandhimuktam- utpiṣṭaṃ, viśliṣṭaṃ, vivartitam, avakṣiptam, atikṣiptaṃ, tiryakkṣiptam iti ṣaḍvidham ||5||
sandhimuktasya ṣāḍvidhyamāha- tatretyādi| sandhimuktaṃ ṣaḍvidhamiti sambandhaḥ||5||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: atha ke sandhimuktasya ṣaḍbhedā ityuktāstān darśayannāha- tatra sandhimuktamityādi||5||
tatra prasāraṇākuñcanavivartanākṣepaṇāśaktir ugrarujatvaṃ sparśāsahatvaṃ ceti sāmānyaṃ sandhimuktalakṣaṇam uktam ||6||
tatra sandhimuktasya sāmānyalakṣaṇamāha- tatra prasāraṇetyādi| vivartanaṃ viparītavartanam, ākṣepaṇamatiśayena cālanam||6||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: nanu cāsthnāṃ bhaṅgo bhagnamityuktaṃ, tat kathamasthnāṃ sandhimukte bhagnatvamiti? ucyate- sandhānaṃ hi dvayorasthnorekībhāvaḥ; tābhyāṃ muktābhyāṃ punarapi dvaidhībhāva iti sandhimukte'pyasthnāmeva bhagnatvam| tasya lakṣaṇaṃ dvividhaṃ- sāmānyaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ ca; tatra sāmānyameva lakṣaṇaṃ prathamaṃ nirdiśannāha- prasāraṇākuñcanetyādi| sāmānyamiti bhinnāśrayeṣvabhinnākārabuddhividhānataḥ||6||

vaiśeṣikaṃ tūtpiṣṭe sandhāv ubhayataḥ śopho vedanāprādurbhāvo viśeṣataś ca nānāprakārā vedanā rātrau prādurbhavanti; viśliṣṭe 'lpaḥ śopho vedanāsātatyaṃ sandhivikriyā ca; vivartite tu sandhipārśvāpagamanād viṣamāṅgatā vedanā ca; avakṣipte sandhiviśleṣas tīvrarujatvaṃ ca; atikṣipte dvayoḥ sandhyasthnor atikrāntatā vedanā ca; tiryakkṣipte tv ekāsthipārśvāpagamanam atyarthaṃ vedanā ceti ||7||

utpiṣṭādilakṣaṇamāha- vaiśeṣikaṃ tūtpiṣṭe ityādi| utpiṣṭe cūrṇite| viśliṣṭe ghaṭṭite, ‘sandhau’ iti śeṣaḥ| vivartite viparītaṃ vartite, ‘sandhau’ iti śeṣaḥ| sandhivikriyā madhyanimnatvam| sandhisaṃśrayayorasthnorvyāvartanena pārśvāgamanādviṣamāṅgatā| vedanā ceti cakārādvedanā'pi viṣametyarthaḥ| avakṣipte sandhāvadhogate| atikṣipte dūraṃ gate sandhau| atikrāntatā dūragamanam| ativedanā ceti cakārārthaḥ| tiryakkṣipte ‘sandhau’ iti śeṣaḥ| atraikasyaivāsthnaḥ pārśvagamanaṃ, vivartite dvayorapīti viśeṣaḥ||7||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: viśeṣayati parasparato vyāvartayati buddhividhānamiti viśeṣaḥ, tena nirvṛttaṃ vaiśeṣikam| tadidaṃ lakṣaṇadvayam| sandhāvubhayata iti dvayorapi asthyantayoścūrṇitatvāt| viśeṣato rātrāviti utpiṣṭe hi cūrṇitatvenātiśayamārgāvaraṇakupitasya vāyorniśāyāmeva viśeṣeṇa kopāt| taduktaṃ vātanāḍīlakṣaṇeṣu- “phenānuviddhamadhikaṃ sravati kṣapāyām” (ni. 1) iti| viśliṣṭe ‘sandhau’ iti śeṣaḥ| alpaśophatāṃ sandheranabhighātāt| vedanāsātatyamutpiṣṭādahorātriṣu, viśliṣṭe viśeṣo'yam| sandhivikriyā sandhyasthnordvayorapi viśliṣṭatvānmadhyanimnatvam| vivartite ‘sandhau’ iti śeṣaḥ| vivartite viparītaṃ vartite pratyāvṛtte iti yāvat| dvayorapyasthnoḥ sandhisaṃśrayoḥ sahaiva vivṛtiṃ gatatvād viṣamāṅgatā viṣamavedanā ceti| avakṣipte sandhāvadhogate| sandhiviśleṣa iti viśleṣaṃ vinā sandheradhogamanābhāvāt| atikṣipte ‘sandhau’ iti śeṣaḥ| dvayorapi sandhyasthnoratikṣepeṇaivātikrāntatā| ativedanā ceti vedanā'pyatīti cakārārthaḥ, utpiṣṭādivedanābhyo'tivedaneti viśeṣaḥ| tiryakṣate ‘sandhau’ ityatrāpi śeṣaḥ| ekasyaivāsthnaḥ pārśvagamanaṃ, vivartite tu dvayorapīti viśeṣaḥ||7||
kāṇḍabhagnam ata ūrdhvaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ- karkaṭakam, aśvakarṇaṃ, cūrṇitaṃ, piccitam, asthicchallitaṃ, kāṇḍabhagnaṃ, majjānugatam, atipātitaṃ, vakraṃ, chinnaṃ, pāṭitaṃ, sphuṭitam iti dvādaśavidham ||8||
kāṇḍabhagnamityādi||8||

śvayathubāhulyaṃ ‘śvayathubāhulyamavapīḍyamāne vividhavedanāpravṛttiriti sāmānyataḥ’ iti tā. spandanavivartanasparśāsahiṣṇutvam avapīḍyamāne śabdaḥ srastāṅgatā vividhavedanāprādurbhāvaḥ sarvāsv avasthāsu na śarmalābha iti samāsena kāṇḍabhagnalakṣaṇam uktam ||9||
teṣāṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇamāha- śvayathubāhulyamityādi| śarma sukham||9||

viśeṣas tu sammūḍham ubhayato 'sthi madhye bha(la)gnaṃ granthir ivonnataṃ karkaṭakam, aśvakarṇavad udgatam aśvakarṇakaṃ, spṛśyamānaṃ ‘śabdasparśābhyāṃ cūrṇitamavagacchet’ iti tā. śabdavac cūrṇitam avagacchet, piccitaṃ pṛthutāṃ gatam analpaśophaṃ ‘alpaśothaṃ’ iti tā., pārśvayor asthi hīnodgatam asthicchalitaṃ, vellate prakampamānaṃ kāṇḍabhagnam, asthyavayavo 'sthimadhyam anupraviśya majjānam unnahyatīti majjānugatam, asthi niḥśeṣataś chinnam atipātitam, ābhugnam avimuktāsthi vakram, anyatarapārśvāvaśiṣṭaṃ chinnaṃ, pāṭitam aṇubahuvidāritaṃ vedanāvac ca, śūkapūrṇam ivādhmātaṃ vipulaṃ visphuṭitaṃ sphuṭitam iti ||10||

teṣāṃ pratyekaṃ viśiṣṭalakṣaṇamāha- viśeṣatastvityādi| viśeṣataḥ sammūḍhamiti atiśayena sparśaṃ jānātītyarthaḥ| gayadāsācāryastu ubhayataḥ sammūḍhamiti ubhayoḥ pārśvayornipīḍanenātatāvanataṃ madhye granthirivonna(dga)tamiti vyākhyānayati| karkaṭakaṃ karkaṭasadṛśam| aśvakarṇamaśvakarṇasadṛśamityarthaḥ| cūrṇitaṃ cūrṇīkṛtam| avagacchet jānīyāt| piccitamityādi piccitaṃ pīḍitasadṛśaṃ, pṛthutāṃ gataṃ vistīrṇatāṃ gatam| asthi challamiva vidyate yasmin tadasthicchallitam| asthicchallikamityanye| vellate ‘khalate’ iti pā. calati| yadyapi kāṇḍabhagnavyapadeśo dvādaśānāmapi, tathā'pi ‘tathā'pi kasyacitkāṇḍabhagnasya viśeṣakāṇḍabhagnatvaṃ’ iti pā. viśeṣataḥ kasyacidvyapadeśaḥ; yathā sarveṣāmeva mṛgapakṣiṇāṃ vidyamānajaṅghatve'pi viśiṣṭajaṅghāyogena eṇādīnāmeva jaṅghālatvam| ābhugnamīṣajjihmam| anyatarapārśveṇa ekapārśveṇetyarthaḥ| aṇūni bahūni vidāritāni yasya tattathā| gayī tu sphuṭitalakṣaṇametat paṭhati, agretanaṃ pāṭitalakṣaṇamiti| śūkapūrṇamiti śūko yavādīnāmagrabhāgaḥ, tatpūrṇamiva vedanāviśeṣaḥ| ādhmātaṃ śūnam| visphuṭitaṃ vipulasphuṭitaṃ, gayī tu ‘vipulaikadāri’ iti paṭhati||10||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: ataḥ paraṃ kāṇḍabhagnaṃ darśayannāha- kāṇḍabhagnamityādi| karkaṭādiṣu prāyeṇa nāmabhirevākṛtayo vyākhyātāstathā'pi vispaṣṭārthaṃ lakṣaṇamupadekṣyati| śvayathvādi sāmānyataḥ| viśeṣatastu sammūḍhamubhayata iti ubhayoḥ pārśvayorniṣpīḍanenātatāvanataṃ madhye granthirivonnatam| pārśvādayastu avayavaviśeṣā iti| asthicchallitam asthi cchallamiva; challaṃ valkalaṃ, tat sañjātaṃ yasya; ‘asthicchallikaṃ’ ityanye; tatra matvarthīyaṣṭikan| vallite “prasāraṇe kampamānaṃ kāṇḍabhagnam” iti vyākhyāmadhukoṣe śrīkaṇṭhadattaḥ prakampamānaṃ kāṇḍabhagnam| dvādaśānāmapi kāṇḍabhagnatvaṃ; kāṇḍena bhagnena kāṇḍabhagnatvaṃ jaṅghālavat; sarveṣāmeva hi mṛgapakṣiṇāṃ vidyamānajaṅghatvād viśiṣṭajaṅghāyā yogena eṇādīnāmeva jaṅghālatvam| asthi niḥśeṣataśchinnamatipātitaṃ, tat subodham| asthyavayavo'sthimadhyaṃ praviśya majjānamanugacchatīti majjānugatam| ābhugnamīṣajjihmam| avimuktāsthi aviśliṣṭāsthi vakram| anyatarapārśve avaśiṣṭaṃ chinnaikapārśvamityarthaḥ| sphuṭitaṃ bhinnaṃ, tasya lakṣaṇam- aṇubahuvidāritam; aṇūni bahūni vidaraṇāni yasya; bahuvrīhiprāptāvapi matvarthīyo bhavati| ekadeśeneti pāṇinīye(?)| evaṃ sphuṭitasyaiva lakṣaṇam| śūkapūrṇamiva vedanāvat| ādhmātaṃ śūnam| vipulaikadārīti sphuṭitalakṣaṇām; kāṇḍabahuvidāriṇo viparītam||8-10||

teṣu cūrṇitacchinnātipātitamajjānugatāni kṛcchrasādhyāni, kṛśavṛddhabālānāṃ ‘kṛśātivṛddhabālāsahānāṃ’ iti pā. kṣatakṣīṇakuṣṭhiśvāsināṃ sandhyupagataṃ ‘savraṇāni sandhyupagatāni ca’ iti tā. ceti ||11||
kṛcchrasādhyānnirdiśannāha- teṣvityādi| cakārāt kāṇḍopagatamiti||11||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: teṣu cūrṇitādīni kṛcchrasādhyāni, anyānyapi kṛśādīnām| sandhyupagatāni ceti cakāreṇa kāṇḍopagatānyapi||11||

bhavanti cātra-
bhinnaṃ kapālaṃ kaṭyāṃ tu sandhimuktaṃ tathā cyutam |
jaghanaṃ prati piṣṭaṃ ca varjayet tac cikitsakaḥ ||12||

lg.l: asaṃśliṣṭaṃ kapālaṃ tu lalāṭe cūrṇitaṃ ca yat |
bhagnaṃ stanāntare śaṅkhe pṛṣṭhe mūrdhni ca varjayet ||13||
ādito yac ca durjātam asthi sandhir athāpi vā |
samyag yamitam apy asthi ‘samyaksaṃhitamapyasthi’ iti pā. durnyāsād durnibandhanāt ‘durnikṣepanibandhanāt’ iti pā.||14||
saṅkṣobhād vā 'pi yad gacched vikriyāṃ tac ca varjayet |15|

ab.seg: asādhyānnirdiśannāha- bhinnamityādi| bhinnaṃ kapālaṃ kāṇḍabhagnaṃ, sandhimuktamasādhyaṃ ṣaḍvidhamapi, tathā cyutaṃ viśliṣṭaṃ lambitamasādhyaṃ; sandhimuktaśabdena cyutasyāpi sandhimuktabhedasyāsādhyatve labdhe tadupādānaṃ viśeṣārtham| jaghanaṃ pratīti jaghanasthāne piṣṭaṃ, sandhimuktabhedo'yam| asaṃśliṣṭaṃ vighaṭṭitasandhi| lalāṭe cūrṇitaṃ ca yaditi cūrṇitaṃ kāṇḍabhagnametat| bhagnaṃ sandhimuktaṃ kāṇḍabhagnaṃ dvayamapi boddhavyam| idānīṃ dvividhasyāpi sarvasthānagatasyāvasthāyāmasādhyatvaṃ darśayannāha- ādita ityādi| ādito yacca durjātamiti ādita utpattāveva duḥsandhānopapāditaṃ yat ‘asthibhagnam’ iti śeṣaḥ, tadasādhyam| asthisandhirathāpi veti sandhirasthnorantarālaṃ, so'pi durjāto'sādhyaḥ| samyagyamitamapyasthi samyak saṃhitamapyasthi, durnyāsāt duḥsthāpanāt, durnibandhanāt durbandhāt, saṅkṣobhāt vyavāyādinā calanāt; vikriyāṃ vikṛtim||12-14||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: asādhyānnirdiśannāha- bhinnaṃ kapālaṃ kaṭyāmityādi| bhinnaṃ kapālaṃ kaṭyāṃ bhagnaṃ sandhimuktaṃ nānāvidhaṃ, tathā cyutaṃ sandhimuktaśabdena cyutasyāpyasādhyatve labdhe tadgrahaṇaṃ viśeṣārtham| jaghanasthānalakṣaṇena piṣṭamapyasādhyaṃ; piṣṭamutpiṣṭaṃ sandhimuktaṃ, netarat| lalāṭe cūrṇitaṃ tadapyasādhyaṃ, kāṇḍabhagnametat| avidyamānakapālasaṃśleṣaṃ vighaṭitasandhi vicūrṇitamityarthaḥ| stanāntare ityurasi, pṛṣṭhe śaṅkhe mūrdhni ca bhagnamityaviśeṣeṇopadānād dvividhamapi| idānīṃ dvividhasyāpi sarvasthānagatasyāvasthāyāmasādhyatāṃ darśayannāha- samyaksaṃhitamityādi| yathāvadyamitamapi durnyāsāt, tathā samyaṅnyastamapi durbandhanāt, tathā samyagyamitanyastabaddhamapyabhighātena vyavāyādinā calanāt, vikriyāṃ vikṛtiṃ gacchettadapyasādhyam||12-14||

lg.l: tatra sthiro bhavej jantur upakrānto vijānatā ayaṃ ślokastāḍapatrapustake na paṭhyate| gayadāsenāvyākhyātaśca|16|

div.ab: madhyasyetyādi| tisro'vasthā iti ṣoḍaśavarṣādūrdhvaṃ catvāriṃśadyāvat pūryate||15||-

ab.seg: kapālāni vibhidyante ‘vibhajyante’ iti pā. sphuṭanti rucakāni ca ||17||

asthiviśeṣeṇāpi bhagnaviśeṣaṃ darśayannāha- taruṇāsthīnītyādi| ghrāṇakarṇakaṇṭhākṣikūṭeṣu taruṇāsthīni| namyante vakrībhavanti, etena vakralakṣaṇaṃ bhagnamuktam| nalakāni śākhāsthīni; bhajyante truṭanti| kapālāni mastakādikarparāṇi; vibhidyante ityanena kapāleṣu vidaraṇalakṣaṇo bhaṅga uktaḥ sphuṭitapāṭitādiḥ| rucakānīti rucakā dantāḥ, teṣu sphuṭitaṃ bhagnamuktam| cakāreṇa valayeṣvapi sphuṭitaṃ samuccīyate| etena pañcavidhānyasthīni taruṇanalakakapālavalayarucakānyuktāni||16||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: asthiviśeṣeṇāpi bhagnaviśeṣaṃ darśayannāha- taruṇāsthīnītyādi| taruṇāsthīni namyanti vakrībhavanti; taruṇāsthiṣu vakralakṣaṇaṃ bhagnaṃ; ghrāṇakarṇakaṇṭhākṣikūṭeṣu taruṇānyasthīni| nalakeṣu punardvādaśavidhamapi bhagnam| kapālāni vibhidyata iti kapāleṣu vidaraṇalakṣaṇo bhaṅgaḥ; tacca sphuṭitapāṭitādi| rucakāsthīni punardaśanāḥ; teṣu sphuṭitalakṣaṇaḥ| rucakāni ceti cakāreṇa valayādiṣvapi sphuṭitamapi samuccīyate| asthīni pañcavidhāni- taruṇa-nalaka-kapāla-valaya-rucakānīti||16||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne bhagnanidānaṃ nāma pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||15||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nidānasthāne pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ||15||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: iti sauśrute śalyatantre śrīgayadāsaviracitāyāṃ nyāyacandrikāyāṃ pañjikāyāṃ nidānasthāne bhagnānāṃ nidānam||15||

div.head: mukharoganidānam

ab.seg: athāto mukharogāṇāṃ nidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi||1-2||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: athāto mukharogāṇāṃ nidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| bhagnānantaraṃ vadanarogāṇāṃ hetulakṣaṇanirdeśārambhaḥ, ‘sphuṭanti rucakāni ca’ (ni. 15) ityatra mukhagatadaśananirdeśāt||1-2||

mukharogāḥ pañcaṣaṣṭir bhavanti saptasv āyataneṣu | tatrāyatanāni- oṣṭhau, dantamūlāni, dantāḥ, jihvā, tālu, kaṇṭhaḥ, sarvāṇi ceti | tatrāṣṭāv oṣṭhayoḥ, pañcadaśa dantamūleṣu, aṣṭau danteṣu, pañca jihvāyāṃ, nava tāluni, saptadaśa kaṇṭhe, trayaḥ sarveṣv āyataneṣu ||3||

teṣāṃ saṅkhyāmāha- mukharogā ityādi| anye saptaṣaṣṭirityāhuḥ, tannecchanti nibandhakārāḥ| atha te kiyatsu sthāneṣūtpadyanta ityāha- saptasvāyataneṣviti| āyataneṣu sthāneṣu| tānyeva sthānānyāha- tatrāyatanānītyādi||3||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: aparaiḥ saptaṣaṣṭimukharogāḥ procyante| tadasamyak, yataḥ samānatantreṣu bhojādiṣu pañcaṣaṣṭireva paṭhyante| tathā hi bhojaḥ- “danteṣvaṣṭāvoṣṭhayośca mūleṣu daśa pañca ca| nava tāluni jihvāyāṃ pañca saptadaśāmayāḥ|| kaṇṭhe trayaḥ sarvasarā ekaṣaṣṭiścatuḥparā” iti||3||
tatrauṣṭhaprakopā vātapittaśleṣmasannipātaraktamāṃsamedobhighātanimittāḥ ||4||
oṣṭhaprakopā oṣṭharogāḥ||4||

lg.l: karkaśau paruṣau stabdhau kṛṣṇau tīvraruganvitau ‘samāṃsānilavedanau’ iti tā.|
ācitau ‘cīyete pīḍakābhiśca sarujābhiḥ samantataḥ’ iti tā. piḍakābhis tu sarṣapākṛtibhir bhṛśam |
sadāhapākasaṃsrāvau ‘... pākapīḍakau pītābhāsau ca’ iti tā. nīlau pītau ca pittataḥ ||6||
kaṇḍūmantau ‘bhavatastu kaphādoṣṭhau’ iti tā. kaphācchūnau picchilau śītalau gurū ||7||
sakṛt kṛṣṇau sakṛt pītau sakṛcchvetau tathaiva ca |
jantavaś cātra mūrcchanti sṛkkasyobhayato ‘narasyobhayataḥ’ iti tā. mukhāt ||10||
medasā ‘sarpirmaṇḍapratīkāśau medasā kaṇḍurau gurū’ iti tā. ghṛtamaṇḍābhau kaṇḍūmantau sthirau mṛdū |
acchaṃ sphaṭikasaṅkāśam āsrāvaṃ sravato gurū ‘bhṛśam’ iti tā.||11||
kṣatajābhau ‘oṣṭhau paryavadīryete’ iti tā. vidīryete pāṭyete cābhighātataḥ |
grathitau ‘tato vraṇaḥ susaṃrūḍho mṛdutvamupagacchati’ iti pā. ca samākhyātāv oṣṭhau kaṇḍūsamanvitau ||12||

ab.seg: teṣāmoṣṭharogāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ lakṣaṇamāha- karkaśāvityādi| karkaśau śākapatrasadṛśau| paruṣau rūkṣau| stabdhau niścalau| dālyete dvividhā bhavata iva| paripāṭyete puṭapuṭāyete| ācitau vyāptau| cīyete vyāpyete| śūnau śophayuktau| sakṛt kiñcidityarthaḥ| anekapiḍakācitau anekavarṇapiḍakāvyāptāvityarthaḥ| ayamasādhyo jñeyaḥ| raktopasṛṣṭau raktajavyādhiyuktau| śoṇitaprabhau raktacchāyau| jantavaḥ krimayaḥ| atra asmin| mūrcchanti bhavanti| ubhayataḥ sṛkkabhāgayorityarthaḥ, sṛkka oṣṭhaprāntaḥ| medasā ‘dūṣitau’ iti śeṣaḥ| ghṛtamaṇḍo ghṛtasyoparyaccho bhāgaḥ| sthirāvacalau| kṣatajābhau raktacchāyau| vidīryete vidāraṇayuktau bhavataḥ| pāṭyete dvidhā bhavata iva| grathitau granthiyuktau| oṣṭhaprakope vātaje śuddho vātaḥ kāraṇam, abhighātaje tu kapharaktasahita iti parasparaṃ bhedaḥ||5-12||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: tatrauṣṭhajeṣu karkaśāvityādinā vātajaḥ, cīyete ityādinā pittajaḥ, savarṇābhirityādinā kaphajaḥ, sakṛtkṛṣṇāvityādinā tridoṣajaḥ, kharjūraphalavarṇābhirityādinā raktajaḥ, gurū sthūlau māṃsaduṣṭāvityādinā māṃsajaḥ| atra mukhe jantavo mūrcchitā bhavanti, ubhayataḥ sṛkkṛṇībhāgayorityarthaḥ| sarpirmaṇḍetyādinā medojaḥ| kṣatajābhau vidīryete ityādinā'bhighātajaḥ| atra kapharaktayorapyanubandhaḥ sthānaprabhāvādityanye, natu vāyoreva| tathā hi bhojaḥ- “kṣatāvabhihatau vā'pi raktāvoṣṭhau savedanau| bhavataḥ saparisrāvau kapharaktapradūṣitau”- iti| vāyuḥ punaratra samānābhighātanyāyenaivāsti| abhighātajatve'pyayamabhighātajaśothādbhinna eva, tena śalyatantre evāsya nirdeśaḥ kṛta iti||5-12||
dantamūlagatās tu- śītādo, dantapuppuṭako, dantaveṣṭakaḥ, śauṣiro, mahāśauṣiraḥ, paridara, upakuśo, dantavaidarbho, vardhanaḥ, adhimāṃso, nāḍyaḥ pañceti ||13||
dantamūlagatāstvityādi||13||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: dantamūlagatāstu śītādaprabhṛtayaḥ pañcadaśa||13||

lg.l: dantayos triṣu vā yasya śvayathuḥ sarujo ‘śvayathuḥ sparśanāsahaḥ’ iti tā. mahān |
sravanti pūyarudhiraṃ calā dantā bhavanti ca |
śvayathur dantamūleṣu rujāvān kapharaktajaḥ kaphasambhavaḥ’ iti tā|
lālāsrāvī sa vijñeyaḥ kaṇḍūmāñ ‘śauṣiro nāma nāmataḥ’ iti tā. śauṣiro gadaḥ ||18||
dantāś calanti veṣṭebhyas tālu cāpy avadīryate |
dantamāṃsāni śīryante yasmin ṣṭhīvati cāpy asṛk ‘cāsakṛt’ iti tā.||20||
pittāsṛkkaphajo vyādhir jñeyaḥ paridaro hi saḥ |
veṣṭeṣu dāhaḥ pākaś ca tebhyo dantāś calanti ca asyāgre tāḍapatrapustake ‘dāhena veṣṭāstaptāśca śuṣyante cāgninā yathā’ ityadhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate||21||
ādhmāyante srute rakte mukhaṃ pūti ca jāyate ||22||
yasminn upakuśaḥ sa syāt ‘yasmin sopakuśo nāma’ iti pā. pittaraktakṛto gadaḥ |
bhavanti ca calā dantāḥ sa vaidarbho 'bhighātajaḥ |
vardhanaḥ sa mato vyādhir jāte ‘khalivardhanasañjño'sau’ iti mādhavanidāne pā. ruk ca praśāmyati |
hānavye paścime dante mahāñ chotho mahārujaḥ ||25||

ab.seg: teṣāṃ pratyekaṃ lakṣaṇamāha- śoṇitamityādi| dantaveṣṭebhyo dantamāṃsebhyaḥ| śīryante galanti| dantayorityādi| dantayoriti dvivacanād dvayoḥ| tālu cāpyavadīryata iti cakāreṇa dantāścāvadīryante, oṣṭhāvapi ca| sarvajaḥ sarvadoṣebhyo jātaḥ| ayaṃ saptarātrānmārayati| ṣṭhīvati cāpyasṛgiti rogī lohitaṃ thūtkarotītyarthaḥ| veṣṭeṣu dantaveṣṭanamāṃseṣu| tebhyo dantaveṣṭebhyaḥ| āghaṭṭitā ācālitāḥ| ghṛṣṭeṣvityādi| saṃrambho'tra śvayathuḥ| mārutenetyādi| jāte ruk ca praśāmyatīti vyādhiprabhāvāt| hānavya ityādi| hānavye hanusambhave| dantamūlagatā ityādi| yatheritā iti yathākathitā nidāne| teṣāṃ madhye triliṅgā nāḍī asādhyā||14-26||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: śoṇitaṃ dantaveṣṭebhya ityādinā śītādaḥ| dantaveṣṭā dantaveṣṭanamāṃsāni| pacyante ‘svayaṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ| parasparamanyo'nyaṃ pacanti, pācakoṣmadūṣitaraktasañcaraṇenānyo'nyaṃ pākaḥ| dantayorityādinā dantapuppuṭakaḥ| dantayoriti dvivacanād dvayoḥ| sravanti pūyarudhiramityādinā dantaveṣṭaḥ| śvayathurdantaveṣṭeṣvityādinā śauṣirakaḥ| dantāścalantītyādinā mahāsauṣiraḥ| tālu cāpyavadīryate iti cakāreṇa dantāścāpyavadīryante oṣṭhāvapi ca| ayaṃ saptarātrānmārayati| tathā hi bhojaḥ- “sadāho dantamūleṣu śvayathurjāyate mahān| jātaḥ kaphaṃ kṣapayati kṣīṇe tasmiṃstu śoṇitam|| vivṛddhamaniśaṃ dantān tālvoṣṭhamapi dārayet| mahāśauṣira ityeṣaḥ saptarātrānnihantyasūn” iti| dantamāṃsamityādinā paridaraḥ| dantamāṃsaparidāraṇāt paridaraḥ| veṣṭeṣu dāhaḥ pākaścetyādinā upakuśaḥ| ghṛṣṭeṣvityādinā vaidarbhaḥ| saṃrambho'tra śvayathuḥ| mārutenādhiko danta ityādinā vardhanakaḥ| jāte ruk ca praśāmyatīti vyādhiprabhāvāt| hānavye ityādinā'dhimāṃsakaḥ; sañjñāyāṃ kan| hānavyaḥ iti “śarīrāvayavādyat” (pā. a. 5/1/6)| pañcāpi nāḍyo vātādināḍilakṣaṇena yathoditena jñeyāḥ||14-26||
dantagatās tu- dālanaḥ, krimidantako, dantaharṣo, bhañjanakaḥ, dantaśarkarā, kapālikā, śyāvadantako, hanumokṣaś ceti ||27||

lg.l: dālyante ‘dīryamāṇeṣviva rujā yasya danteṣu jāyate| dālano nāma sa vyādhiḥ’ iti tā. bahudhā dantā yasmiṃs tīvraruganvitāḥ |
kṛṣṇaś chidrī calaḥ srāvī sasaṃrambho mahārujaḥ |
śītam uṣṇaṃ ca daśanāḥ ‘śītarūkṣapravātāmlasparśānāmasahā dvijāḥ| pittamārutakopena dantaharṣaḥ sa nāmataḥ’ iti mādhavanidāne pāṭhaḥ sahante sparśanaṃ na ca |
yasya taṃ dantaharṣaṃ tu vyādhiṃ vidyāt samīraṇāt ||30||
vaktraṃ vakraṃ bhaved yasmin ‘bhavedyasya dantabhaṅgaśca jāyate’ iti tā. dantabhaṅgaś ca tīvraruk |
śarkareva ‘malo dantagato yastu pittamārutaśoṣitaḥ| śarkareva kharasparśā sā jñeyā dantaśarkarā’ iti mādhavanidāne sthirībhūto malo danteṣu yasya vai |
jñeyā kapālikā saiva daśanānāṃ vināśinī ‘kapāleṣviva dīryatsu dantānāṃ saiva śarkarā| kapāliketi vijñeyā sadā dantavināśinī’ iti tā.||33||
yo 'sṛṅmiśreṇa pittena dagdho dantas tv aśeṣataḥ |
śyāvatāṃ nīlatāṃ vā 'pi gataḥ sa śyāvadantakaḥ ||34||
vātena tais tair bhāvais tu hanusandhir visaṃhataḥ ‘visaṅgataḥ’ iti tā.|

ab.seg: teṣāṃ pratyekaṃ lakṣaṇamāha- dālyanta ityādi| dālyante vidāryante| sadāgatinimittajaḥ sadāgatirvātaḥ, tannimittajaḥ| asādhyo'yaṃ vyādhiḥ| kṛṣṇa ityādi| kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇadantakaḥ| chidrī sacchidradantakaḥ, krimikṛtacchidratvāt| calaḥ caladantaḥ| saṃrambhaḥ śvayathuḥ| vaktramityādi| asādhyo'yaṃ vyādhiḥ| śarkaretyādi| śarkarā karparasya sūkṣmakhaṇḍaḥ| guṇaharī śuklādiguṇaharaṇaśīlā| dalantītyādi| dalanti sphuṭanti| dantavalkāni dantatvacaḥ| ya ityādi| asādhyo'yaṃ vyādhiḥ| taistairuccairvyāharaṇakaṭhinabhakṣaṇajṛmbhaṇādibhiḥ| visaṃhato vighaṭṭitaḥ| hanumokṣavyādhirapi dantasthānasāmīpyāddantapīḍākaratvācca dantaroga iti vyapadiśyate||27-35||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: dantagatāstu dālanādayo'ṣṭau| dīryamāṇeṣvivetyādinā dālanaḥ| sadāgatirvātaḥ, sa nimittaṃ yasya sa tathā| kṛṣṇaśchidrītyādinā kṛmidantakaḥ| chidrī kṛmikṛtacchidraḥ| saṃrambhaḥ śvayathuḥ| sparśaṃ tu śītamuṣṇaṃ cetyādinā dantaharṣaḥ| vaktraṃ vakramityādinā bhañjanakaḥ| śarkaretyādinā dantaśarkarā; sā dantānāṃ guṇaharī śuklādiguṇaharaṇaśīlā| kapāle dīryamāṇe ityādinā kapālikā| dantānāṃ kapāle dīryamāṇe kapālikā| dantavināśanī sadeti bālyādeva sarvadā dantavināśanī utpannā bālye eva dantavināśaśīletyarthaḥ| ‘dalanti dantavalkāni yadā śarkarayā saha’ iti kecit paṭhanti, tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ| asṛṅmiśreṇetyādinā śyāvadantakaḥ| śyāvadantaka iti sañjñāyāṃ kan| vātena taistairityādinā hanumokṣaḥ| dantadoṣāṇāṃ sāmīpyāddantaroga ityeke; anye tu dantarogahetutvāddantarogatvamasya| arditalakṣaṇo'yaṃ hanumokṣo'rdite eva paṭhitaḥ “grīvācibukadantānāṃ tasmin pārśve tu vedanā| tamarditamiti prāhuḥ’ (ni. 1) ityādinā| tathā hi bhoje'pi- “bhārābhighātājjantorhi hanusandhirviyujyate| nirastajihvaḥ kṛcchreṇa bhāṣituṃ tatra gacchati|| saṃsaktamanilavyādhiṃ hanumokṣaṃ vinirdiśet” iti||27-35||
jihvāgatās tu- kaṇṭakās trividhās tribhir doṣaiḥ, alāsa, upajihvikā ceti ||36||

lg.l: jihvā 'nilena sphuṭitā prasuptā bhavec ca śākacchadanaprakāśā |
pittena ‘pittāt sadāhairanucīyate ca dīrghaiḥ’ iti tā. pītā paridahyate ca citā saraktair api kaṇṭakaiś ca |
kaphena gurvī bahalā citā ca māṃsodgamaiḥ śālmalikaṇṭakābhaiḥ ||37||
jihvātale ‘adhogato yaḥ’ iti tā. yaḥ śvayathuḥ pragāḍhaḥ so 'lāsasañjñaḥ kapharaktamūrtiḥ |
jihvāṃ sa tu stambhayati pravṛddho mūle tu jihvā bhṛśam eti pākam ||38||
jihvāgrarūpaḥ śvayathur hi jihvām unnamya jātaḥ kapharaktayoniḥ ‘kapharaktamūlaḥ| lālākaraḥ kaṇḍuyutaḥ sacoṣaḥ sa tūpajihvā kathitā bhiṣagbhiḥ’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: jihvāgatāstvityādi| teṣāṃ pratyekaṃ lakṣaṇamāha- jihvetyādi| śāko vṛkṣaviśeṣo mahākharapatralakṣaṇaḥ| chadanaṃ patram| citā vyāptā| bahalā sthūlā| māṃsodgamaiḥ māṃsāṅkuraiḥ; citā vyāptā bhavatīti sambandhaḥ| jihvātala ityādi| pragāḍhaḥ prakarṣeṇa dāruṇaḥ| kapharaktamūrtitvena kapharaktayoḥ prādhānyaṃ, jihvāstambhena tu vāyurapyasti, bhṛśaṃ pākena tu pittamapyasti; ata eva tridoṣajatvenāsādhyatvamapi, durapakramatvāt| jihvāgrarūpa ityādi| jihvāmunnamya ūrdhvīkṛtya, jāta utpannaḥ; etena jihvāyā adho bhavatītyuktam| kapharaktayoniḥ śleṣmaraktakāraṇaḥ||36-39||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: jihvāgatāstu kaṇṭakāstrayaḥ, alāsaḥ, upajihvikā ceti| tatra jihvā'nilenetyādinā vātakaṇṭakāḥ, pittātsadāhairityādinā pittakaṇṭakāḥ, kaphena gurvītyādinā kaphakaṇṭakāḥ, jihvātale yaḥ śvayathurityādinā alāsaḥ| praśabdo'tra prakarṣadyotī, tena prakarṣeṇa gāḍho dāruṇaḥ; “jihvātaleṣvalāsastu” (ci. 22) iti vacanenāsādhyatvāt; kapharaktamūlatvena kapharaktayoḥ prādhānyaṃ, jihvāstambhena vāyurapyasti, bhṛśaṃ pākena pittamapyasti, ata eva tridoṣajatvenāsādhyatvamapi durupakramatvāt| jihvāgrarūpaḥ śvayathurityādinā upajihvikā| coṣaścātra raktayoninā pittena||36-39||
tālugatās tu- galaśuṇḍikā, tuṇḍikerī, adhruṣaḥ, kacchapaḥ, arbudaṃ, māṃsasaṅghātaḥ, tālupuppuṭaḥ, tāluśoṣaḥ, tālupāka iti ||40||

lg.l: śleṣmāsṛgbhyāṃ tālumūlāt pravṛddho dīrghaḥ śopho dhmātabastiprakāśaḥ |
tṛṣṇākāsaśvāsakṛt sampradiṣṭo vyādhir vaidyaiḥ kaṇṭhaśuṇḍīti nāmnā ||41||
śophaḥ sthūlas todadāhaprapākī prāguktābhyāṃ tuṇḍikerī matā tu |
śophaḥ ‘mṛduḥ śotho lohitastāludeśe jñeyo'dhruṣaḥ sajvarastīvraruk ca’ iti tā. stabdho lohitas tāludeśe raktājjñeyaḥ so 'dhruṣo rugjvarāḍhyaḥ ||42||
kūrmotsanno 'vedano 'śīghrajanmā 'rakto ‘kūrmonnataḥ’ iti tā. jñeyaḥ kacchapaḥ śleṣmaṇā syāt |
padmākāraṃ tālumadhye tu śophaṃ vidyād raktād arbudaṃ proktaliṅgam ||43||
duṣṭaṃ māṃsaṃ śleṣmaṇā nīrujaṃ ca tālvantaḥsthaṃ māṃsasaṅghātam āhuḥ |

nīruk ‘aruk sthiraḥ kolamātraḥ kaphena samedasā’ iti tā. sthāyī kolamātraḥ kaphāt syā
n medoyuktāt ‘medoyuktaḥ’ iti pā. puppuṭas tāludeśe ||44||
śoṣo 'tyarthaṃ śuṣyatyatyarthaṃ’ iti tā. dīryate cāpi tāluḥ śvāso ‘śvāsaścaivograstāluśoṣo'nilāttu’ iti tā. vātāt tāluśoṣaḥ sapittāt |
pittaṃ kuryāt pākam atyarthaghoraṃ tāluny enaṃ tālupākaṃ vadanti ||45||

ab.seg: teṣāṃ pratyekaṃ lakṣaṇamāha- śleṣmāsṛgbhyāmityādi| kaṇṭhaśuṇḍī galaśuṇḍītyarthaḥ| śopha ityādi| todadāhaprapākīti todadāhaprapākayuktaḥ| prāguktābhyāṃ śleṣmāsṛgbhyām| tuṇḍikerī vanakārpāsikā, tatphalānukārī vyādhirayam| kūrmetyādi| kūrmotsannaḥ kūrmavadunnataḥ| araktaḥ pāṇḍuraḥ| aśīghrajanmā mandānusārī| padmākāraṃ padmakarṇikākāram| proktaliṅgaṃ yathoktaraktārbudaliṅgam ‘yathodita...’ iti pā.| asādhyo'yaṃ vyādhiḥ| duṣṭamityādi| sthāyī sthiraḥ| puppuṭa ityatra tāluśabdo lupto draṣṭavyaḥ, tena tālupuppuṭa ityarthaḥ| śoṣa ityādi| enamiti enaṃ pākam||40-45||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: tālugatāstu galaśuṇḍikādayaḥ| śleṣmāsṛgbhyāṃ tālumūlāgravṛddha ityādinā galaśuṇḍikā| śothaḥ sthūlastodadāhaprapākītyādinā tuṇḍikerī| sā tu prāguktābhyāṃ śleṣmāsṛgbhyāmityarthaḥ| tuṇḍikerī vanakārpāsī, tatphalānukārī śotho'yam| mṛduḥ śotha ityādinā adhruṣaḥ| kūrmotsanna ityādinā kacchapaḥ| aśīghrajanmā cirajaḥ| padmākāramityādinā'rbudam| proktaliṅgamiti yathoditaraktārbudaliṅgam| padmākāraṃ padmakarṇikākāralohitavarṇaṃ, raktajatvāt| tathā hi bhojaḥ- “uparyeva bhavennaddho yathā padmasya karṇikā| pārśvataścāṅkurairdīrghairnāśā cāpyavasīdati|| śleṣmaraktasamutthānaṃ tattālvarbudasañjñitam” iti| duṣṭaṃ māṃsamityādinā māṃsasaṅghātaḥ| aruk sthira ityādinā tālupuppuṭaḥ| tāluśabdo'tra luptanirdiṣṭo draṣṭavyaḥ| śuṣyatyatyarthamityādinā tāluśoṣaḥ| ‘anilāttu’ ityatra ‘sapittāt’ iti kecit paṭhanti| atra bhojaḥ- “tāluśoṣo bhavedvātāt” ityādi| pittaṃ kuryāt pākamityādinā tālupākaḥ||40-45||
kaṇṭhagatās tu- rohiṇyaḥ pañca, kaṇṭhaśālūkam, adhijihvo, balayo, balāsa ‘alāsaḥ’ iti tā., ekavṛndo, vṛndaḥ, śataghnī, gilāyuḥ, galavidradhiḥ, galaughaḥ, svaraghno, māṃsatāno, vidārī ceti ||46||

kaṇṭhagatāstvityādi| ekavṛndo vṛnda iti ekavṛnda eva doṣaviśeṣānugamenāvasthāntaraṃ prāpto vṛndatvaṃ pratipadyate, ato mūloktā saptadaśasaṅkhyā na virudhyata iti jejjaṭaḥ; gayī tu ‘vṛnda’ iti pāṭhaṃ kalpitameva manyate; anye tu ‘vṛndamudāharanti’ ityatra chandonurodhādekavṛnda eva vṛndaśabdenokta ityāhuḥ||46||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: kaṇṭhagatāsu rohiṇyādayaḥ saptadaśa| atra saptadaśa sūtritā aṣṭādaśa nirdiṣṭā ityatra pūrvavyākhyātāraḥ ekavṛndastulyākṛtisthānatvena vṛndato'bhinna ityavirodhaḥ; tathā hi bhojaḥ- “śleṣmaraktasamutthānamekavṛndaṃ vibhāvayet| tulyasthānākṛtirvṛndo vṛndajo raktapittajaḥ” iti, tasmānna saṅkhyātireka ityāhuḥ| tanna, bhedo hi bhedavatāṃ kāraṇabhedāt, tathā svadharmabhedācca; tathā hi- īṣatkaṇḍūpākakāṭhinyagauravāṇi kapharaktajasya, pittaraktajasya punardāho jvaraśca; tasmādutpannatvena kāraṇakāryayorabhedaḥ; syādevaṃ hi rasādidhātūnāmanyonyamabhedastatastata utpannatvāttasya tasya raktāderdhātoḥ, tasmādvṛndasya sūtre kalpita eva pāṭhaḥ| anye punarekavṛndasyaiva chandonurodhādādipadalopena nirdiṣṭasya kaphasya pittasya vāyorapi śoṇitānubandhe kṛte jvarāpādakatvamapyasti, tasmāt sūtre eva kalpitavṛndaśabdānupraveśena duruktivṛddhi(?)riti||46||

lg.l: gale 'nilaḥ pittakaphau ca mūrcchitau pṛthak samastāś ca tathaiva śoṇitam ‘pradūṣya māṃsaṃ ca tathaiva śoṇitam| galopasaṃrodhakaraistathā'ṅkurairhinastyasūn vyādhirayaṃ hi rohiṇī’ iti tā.|
pradūṣya māṃsaṃ galarodhino 'ṅkurān sṛjanti yān sā 'suharā hi rohiṇī ||47||
jihvāṃ samantād bhṛśavedanā ye māṃsāṅkurāḥ kaṇṭhanirodhinaḥ syuḥ |
tāṃ rohiṇīṃ vātakṛtāṃ vadanti vātātmakopadravagāḍhayuktām ‘tisraśca tāstvādita eva kṛcchrāḥ’ iti tā.||48||
srotonirodhiny api ‘srotovirodhinyacalonnatā ca sthirāṅkurā yā kaphasambhavā sā’ iti tā. mandapākā gurvī sthirā sā kaphasambhavā vai ||49||

ab.seg: teṣāṃ pratyekaṃ lakṣaṇamāha- gala ityādi| pṛthagiti tisraḥ, samastā iti ekā, śoṇitamityekā, evaṃ pañca| mūrcchitau vṛddhau| asuharā prāṇaharā| ‘gale'nilaḥ pittakaphau ca mūrcchitau pradūṣya māṃsaṃ ca tathaiva śoṇitam| galopasaṃrodhakaraistathā'ṅkurairnihantyasūn vyādhirayaṃ tu rohiṇī’ ityapi pāṭhāntaramicchanti nibandhakārāḥ| tridoṣajā raktajā cāsādhyā| uktaṃ ca,- “vātāt pittāt kaphāttribhyo raktādrohiṇya īritāḥ| antye sadyo mārayata ādyāstisraḥ kriyāṃ vinā”- iti| jihvāmityādi| jihvāṃ samantāditi jihvāṃ vyāpya sambhavatītyarthaḥ| aprativāravīryā durnivāraśaktirityarthaḥ||47-50||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: tatra pañcānāṃ rohiṇīnāṃ sāmānyasamprāptiṃ nirdiśannāha- gale'nilaḥ pittakaphau ca mūrcchitāvityādi| atra sāmānyena sarvāsāmevāsādhyatvamuktaṃ; tatra vātādidoṣajāyā anupakrameṇāsādhyatvam, evaṃ śoṇitajāyā api, sannipātajāyāḥ punarutpattāvevāsādhyatvaṃ, pittaraktajanyayoḥ punarupakramasāmānyatvaṃ; tathā hi bhojaḥ- “vātapittakaphā raktamekaśaḥ sarvaśo'pi vā| niviśanti yadā kaṇṭhe praduṣṭā mūrdhani gatāḥ|| aṅkurāñjanayantyāśu jihvāmūle samantataḥ| rohiṇīṃ tāṃ vijānīyādāhuḥ pañcavidhāṃ tu tām|| tāluḥ śuṣyati kaṇṭhaśca vātenāyamyate yadā| kaṇṭhe'syānnaṃ prasajyeta saptāhācca jahātyasūn|| tapyate cūṣyate pittāddhūmyate paridahyate| aṅgārairiva sā jahyāt prāṇānāśu caturdināt|| kaphādantarbahiḥ śothaḥ śvāsaḥ kaṇṭhaśca bādhyate| yasya so'sūn tyajedrogī tryahādrohiṇipīḍitaḥ| lakṣaṇaṃ pittarohiṇyāstulyaṃ śoṇitajanmanaḥ| rohiṇī kṛṣṇaraktābhairyuktā sphoṭairviśeṣataḥ|| sarvadoṣakṛtā yā tu sarvaliṅgasamanvitā| asādhyāṃ tāṃ vijānīyādrohiṇīṃ sannipātataḥ|| eṣā sadyo mārayati tisra ādyāḥ kriyāṃ vinā” iti||47-50||

lg.l: kolāsthimātraḥ kaphasambhavo yo granthir gale kaṇṭakaśūkabhūtaḥ |
kharaḥ sthiraḥ śastranipātasādhyas taṃ kaṇṭhaśālūkam iti bruvanti ||51||

ab.seg: koletyādi| kaṇṭakaśūkabhūtaḥ kaṇṭaka iva śūkaḥ kaṇṭakaśūkaḥ, tadvattvaṃ bhūtaḥ prāptaḥ| ata eva piśitāṅkurācitatvācchālūkākāratvamasya||51||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: kolāsthimātra ityādinā kaṇṭhaśālūkaḥ| kaṇṭaka iva śūkaḥ kaṇṭakaśūkaḥ| bhūtaḥ prāptaḥ| bhū ātmanepadī ityasmādayaṃ prayogaḥ| ata eva piśitāṅkurācitatvācchālūkasādṛśyācchālūkam| śālūkamutpalakandaḥ||51||

lg.l: jihvāgrarūpaḥ śvayathuḥ kaphāt tu jihvāprabandhopari jihvopariṣṭādapi’ iti tā. raktamiśrāt |
jñeyo 'dhijihvaḥ khalu roga eṣa vivarjayed āgatapākam enam ||52||

ab.seg: jihvetyādi| jihvāprabandhasyopari jihvāmūlasyopariṣṭādityarthaḥ| āgatapākatvena pittamapyatrāsti||52||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: jihvāgrarūpa ityādinā adhijihvā| iyaṃ jihvāmūlasyopariṣṭāt, upajihvā tu adhastājjihvāyāḥ, jihvāmunnamya jāta iti vacanāt| āgatapākitvena pittamapyatrāsti||52||

lg.l: balāsa evāyatam unnataṃ ca śophaṃ karoty annagatiṃ nivārya |

ab.seg: balāsa ityādi| balāsaḥ śleṣmā||53||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: balāsa evetyādinā valayaḥ| annagatiṃ nivāryeti annasya gatiryena srotasā so'nnagatiḥ annavahasrotaḥ| ayaṃ tu sthānaprabhāvādātmaprabhāvādvā'sādhyaḥ||53||

lg.l: gale tu śophaṃ kurutaḥ pravṛddhau śleṣmānilau śvāsarujopapannam |
marmacchidaṃ dustaram etad āhur balāsasañjñaṃ ‘...ralāsasañjñaṃ’ iti tā. nipuṇā vikāram ||54||

ab.seg: gala ityādi| upapannaṃ sahitam| nipuṇā dhīmantaḥ||54||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: gale tu śopha ityādinā balāsaḥ||54||

lg.l: vṛttonnato yaḥ śvayathuḥ sadāhaḥ kaṇḍvanvito 'pākyamṛdur guruś ca |
samunnataṃ vṛttam amandadāhaṃ tīvrajvaraṃ vṛndam udāharanti |
taṃ cāpi pittakṣatajaprakopād vidyāt satodaṃ pavanāsrajaṃ tu ‘pavanātmakaṃ’ iti pā.||56||

ab.seg: vṛttonnata ityādi| sadāho mandadāhaḥ| apākī īṣatpākī| balāsakṣatajaprasūtaḥ śleṣmaraktajātaḥ| bhedena vṛndatvaṃ pratipādyate| etena ekavṛndo vṛndaśca dvāvapyekātmakau matau| evaṃ caite kaṇṭharogāḥ saptadaśeti| pañjikāyāṃ punarādāveva ‘ekavṛnda’ iti pāṭhaḥ||55-56||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: vṛttonnata ityādinā ekavṛndaḥ| sadāha iti saśabdasyopasarjanātvarthena mandadāhaḥ| apākīti īṣatpākī| samunnatamityādinā'pyekavṛnda eva raktapittataḥ| samunnataḥ samyagunnato jñeyaḥ| satodamityādinā ekavṛndaṃ savātaśoṇitajaṃ; pavanāsrajamiti vātajaśoṇitajam||55-56||

lg.l: vartir ghanā kaṇṭhanirodhinī yā citā 'timātraṃ piśitaprarohaiḥ |
nānārujocchrāyakarī ‘anekaruk prāṇaharī trirātrājjñeyā śataghnī tu śataghnirūpā’ iti tā. tridoṣāj jñeyā śataghnīva śataghny asādhyā ||57||

ab.seg: vartirityādi| “ayaḥkaṇṭakasañcchannā śataghnī mahatī śilā”||57||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: vartirghanetyādinā śataghnī| anekarugiti vātādikṛtatodadāhakaṇḍvādivedanā| śataghnīva śataghnīrūpā| “ayaḥ kaṇṭakasañchannā śataghnī mahatī śilā” iti| atra bhojaḥ- “vātapittakaphā duṣṭā kuryurmāṃsāṅkurācitām| madhyekaṇṭhamatho vartiṃ janayanti hyupekṣitāḥ|| śaṅkuneva gale naddhā śataghnyeṣā na sidhyati” iti||57||

lg.l: granthir gale tv āmalakāsthimātraḥ sthiro 'lparuk syāt kapharaktamūrtiḥ ‘kaphapittamūrtiḥ| yo lakṣyate raktamivāsravaśca’ iti tā.|
saṃlakṣyate saktam ivāśanaṃ ca sa śastrasādhyas tu gilāyusañjñaḥ ||58||

ab.seg: granthirityādi| kapharaktamūrtiḥ kapharaktakāraṇaḥ| saktamiva lagnamiva| aśanaṃ bhojanam||58||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: granthirgala ityādinā gilāyuḥ||58||

lg.l: sarvaṃ galaṃ vyāpya samutthito yaḥ śopho rujo yatra ca santi sarvāḥ |
sa sarvadoṣo galavidradhis tu tasyaiva tulyaḥ khalu sarvajasya ||59||

ab.seg: sarvamityādi| tasyaiva tulyaḥ khalu sarvajasyeti tasyaiva sānnipātikavidradheḥ sadṛśa ityarthaḥ||59||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: sarvaṃ galaṃ vyāpyetyādinā galavidradhiḥ| sthānaprabhāveṇa sānnipātika eva| tasyaiva sānnipātikavidradherayaṃ sadṛśaḥ||59||

lg.l: śopho mahān annajalāvarodhī tīvrajvaro vātagater nihantā |
kaphena jāto rudhirānvitena gale galaughaḥ parikīrtyate 'sau ||60||
kaphopadigdheṣv anilāyaneṣu jñeyaḥ sa rogaḥ śvasanāt svaraghnaḥ ||61||

ab.seg: śopha ityādi| atipratāmyan atyarthaṃ prakarṣeṇa tāmyan tamaḥ prapaśyan| śvasiti niḥśvasitītyarthaḥ| prasaktaṃ nirantaram| kaphopadigdheṣu śleṣmaruddheṣu| anilāyaneṣu vāyumārgeṣu| śvasanāt vātāt||60-61||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: śotho mahānityādinā galaughaḥ| yo'tipratāmyannityādinā svaraghnaḥ| atipratāmyanniti atyarthaṃ prakarṣeṇa tāmyan tamaḥ praviśan| śvasiti niḥśvasiti| kaphena tu vāyumārgeṣu ruddheṣu satsu prasaktaṃ nirantaraṃ śvasanaṃ vātāt||60-61||

lg.l: pratānavān yaḥ śvayathuḥ sukaṣṭo galoparodhaṃ kurute krameṇa |
sa māṃsatānaḥ kathito 'valambī prāṇapraṇut sarvakṛto vikāraḥ ||62||

ab.seg: pratānavānityādi| pratānavān vistāravān| avalambī lambanaśīlaḥ| prāṇanut prāṇaprerakaḥ||62||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: pratānavānityādinā māṃsatānaḥ||62||

lg.l: pittena vidyād vadane vidārīṃ pārśve viśeṣāt sa tu yena śete ||63||

ab.seg: sadāhetyādi| pūtiviśīrṇamāṃsaṃ durgandhiśaṭitamāṃsam| pārśve viśeṣāt sa tu yena śete iti yenaiva pārśvena viśeṣācchete tenaiva pārśvena vidārī viśeṣeṇa bhavati| anyatrāpyasyāḥ sambhavanā sāmānyato na nivāryate||63||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: sadāhatoda ityādinā vidārī| yenaiva pārśvena viśeṣācchete tenaiva pārśvena vidārī viśeṣeṇa bhavati| anyatrāpyasyāḥ sambhavaḥ sāmānyato na nivāryate| todadāhaprapākapracuro vidārīdāhaḥ; prapākatvena galavidāraṇādvidārī||63||
sarvasarās tu vātapittakaphaśoṇitanimittāḥ ||64||
sarvasarāstvityādi| pittanimitto raktanimittaścaika eveti vātādinimittāstraya eva sarvasarāḥ| sarvasmin mukhe ye bhavanti te sarvasarāḥ||64||

lg.l: sphoṭaiḥ satodair vadanaṃ samantād yasyācitaṃ sarvasaraḥ sa vātāt |
raktaiḥ sadāhais tanubhiḥ sapītair yasyācitaṃ cāpi sa pittakopāt ||65||

ab.seg:
kaṇḍūyutair alparujaiḥ ‘avedanaiḥ kaṇḍuyutaiḥ sadāhaiḥ’ iti tā. savarṇair yasyācitaṃ cāpi sa vai kaphena |
raktena pittodita eka eva kaiś cit pradiṣṭo mukhapākasañjñaḥ asyāgre tāḍapatrapustake ‘sūtre pradiṣṭaṃ daśa ṣaṭ ca pūrvaṃ sthānaṃ nidānaṃ bhavatīti yacca| savistaraṃ tatkathitaṃ mayeha svayambhunā yat kathitaṃ hitāya’ ityadhikaḥ śloka upalabhyate||66||

sphoṭairityādi| raktaiḥ ‘sphoṭaiḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| kaṇḍūyutairityādi ‘sphoṭaiḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| raktenetyādi raktena kṛtvā yo'sau sarvasaraḥ kaiścidācāryaiḥ mukhapākasañjñaḥ pradiṣṭaḥ kathitaḥ, sa ca pittodita eka eva; na catvāraḥ sarvasarāḥ, kintu traya eva| evamete etena pañcaṣaṣṭirmukharogā na saptaṣaṣṭiriti’ iti pā. pañcaṣaṣṭirmukharogāḥ svaptasvāyataneṣviti||65-66||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: sarvasarāstrayastribhirvātādibhiḥ| sphoṭaiḥ satodairityādinā vātasarvasaraḥ| raktaiḥ sadāhairityādinā pittasarvasaraḥ| avedanairityādinā kaphasarvasaraḥ| śeṣāṇāṃ tu rogāṇāṃ nayanaghrāṇakarṇaśirogatānāṃ kumārajānāṃ ca tathā jvarātisāraśophādīnāmapi śālākyāditantreṣu yathā yathā hetunirdeśaḥ karaṇīya iti| bhavati cātra- doṣe vyāpi(dhau) kvacidapi gate tadvipakṣā'pi kiñcidyatra prākkarma (?) vihitaṃ kārakaṃ jñāpakaṃ ca| kārye meye dvitayamidanuvyāsanirdiṣṭamevaṃ sthānānyanyānyapi vivṛtayaḥ sūtritasyaiva sūtre”||65-66||

div.ab:
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne mukharoganidānaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||16||
iti bhagavatā śrīdhanvantariṇopadiṣṭāyāṃ tacchiṣyeṇa maharṣiṇā suśrutena viracitāyāṃ suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīyaṃ nidānasthānaṃ samāptam |

ab.seg: nibandhān bahuśo vīkṣya vaidyeśabharatātmajaḥ| nidānasthānamakarot suspaṣṭaṃ ḍalha(hla)ṇo bhiṣak| iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ samastanibandhārthajñāpikāyāṃ suśrutaṭīkāyāṃ nidānasthāne ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ||16||

ab.label: Nyā. Ca.
ab.seg: iti śrīsauśrute śalyatantre śrīgayadāsakṛtāyāṃ nyāyacandrikāyāṃ pañjikāyāṃ mukharoganidānam||16||

div.head: sarvabhūtacintāśārīram

ab.seg: athātaḥ sarvabhūtacintāśārīraṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

hetulakṣaṇapratipādakānnidānasthānādadhigatavyādhihetulakṣaṇasya vaidyasya cikitsāyā avasaraḥ, cikitsā cādhiṣṭhānaviśeṣajñānamantareṇa na sambhavatītyadhiṣṭhānajñāpanāya ‘…dhiṣṭhānajñānāya śārīrasthānaṃ pratipādyate’ iti pā. śārīrasthānamārabhyate| śārīrasthāne'pi pratipādye ādau sarvaśarīrakāraṇānāṃ bhūtānāmeva cintā kartuṃ yujyata ityāha- athāta ityādi| sarvāṇi bhūtāni sthāvarajaṅgamāni, mahābhūtāni pṛthivyādīni vā; teṣāṃ cintā hetusvalakṣaṇakāryaiścintanaṃ; kuta utpannāni? kāni caiṣāṃ svalakṣaṇāni? kāni kāryāṇīti cintanaṃ; saiva yasminnadhyāye'stīti matvarthe pūrvavacchapratyayamutpādya tallope prakṛtibhāvaṃ ca pratipādya sarvabhūtacinteti niṣpādyate, sarvabhūtacintā ca tacchārīraṃ ceti paścāt karmadhārayaḥ| gayī tu ‘sarvabhūtacintānāma śārīraṃ’ iti paṭhati||1-2||

sarvabhūtānāṃ kāraṇam akāraṇaṃ sattvarajastamolakṣaṇam aṣṭarūpam akhilasya ‘akhilasyāsya’ iti tā. jagataḥ sambhavahetur avyaktaṃ nāma | tad ekaṃ bahūnāṃ ‘anekeṣāṃ’ iti pā. kṣetrajñānām adhiṣṭhānaṃ samudra ivaudakānāṃ bhāvānām ||3||

tatrādau hetucintāmāha- sarvabhūtānāmityādi| evambhūtamavyaktaṃ mūlaprakṛtyaparaparyāyaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ kāraṇamiti piṇḍārthaḥ| kiṃviśiṣṭam? akāraṇaṃ; na vidyate kāraṇaṃ yasya tadakāraṇam, avikṛtirūpaṃ na kasyacit kāryamityarthaḥ| svarūpaviśeṣaṇamāha- sattvarajastamolakṣaṇaṃ; sattvarajastamaḥsvarūpam| punarapi kimbhūtamityāha- aṣṭarūpamiti| prakṛtibhāvenaivāvyaktaṃ mahānahaṅkāraḥ pañcatanmātrāṇītyaṣṭau rūpāṇi yasya tattathā; prakṛtitvaṃ cāṣṭānāmavyaktādīnāṃ sāṅkhye'pi pratipāditamasti| śilāputrakanyāyena rūpatvaṃ rupitvaṃ cāvyaktasya| avyaktaṃ mahānahaṅkāraḥ pañcabhūtānītyaṣṭau rūpāṇītyeke; anye tu dharmajñānavairāgyaiśvaryādharmājñānāvairāgyānaiśvaryāṇyaṣṭau rūpāṇyāhuḥ; apare tu manobuddhyahaṅkāramahābhūtānyāhuḥ| punarapi kimbhūtam? akhilasya jagataḥ sambhavahetuḥ abhivyaktikāraṇam| tatra sarvabhūtānāṃ kāraṇamityanena kāryakāraṇayostādātmyaṃ darśitam, akhilasya jagataḥ sambhavaheturityanena cābhivyaktihetutvamiti na paunaruktyam| gayī tvanyathā vyākhyāti, yathā- sarvabhūtānāṃ kāraṇamityasyaiva bhāṣyaṃ nirdiśannāha- akhilasya jagataḥ sambhavaheturiti; anenopādānakāraṇatvamavyaktasya jagadutpattau pratipāditam| na vyajyate smetyavyaktaṃ; prakṛtiḥ pradhānaṃ mūlaprakṛtiriti yāvadavyaktaparyāyāḥ| tat avyaktam; ekaṃ śilāpaṭṭavadavivecyāvayavaṃ, na punastridaṇḍavadvivecyāvayavam| kṣetrajñānāṃ karmapuruṣāṇām| adhiṣṭhānaṃ śarīrabhāvāya viṣayaḥ| atropamānamāha- samudra ivetyādi| udakabhavā audakā nadīnadasarastaḍāgādayaḥ; anye tvaudakā bhāvāścarācarā matsyapadmādaya ityāhuḥ||3||

tasmād avyaktān mahān utpadyate talliṅga eva | talliṅgāc ca mahatas tallakṣaṇa evāhaṅkāra utpadyate; sa ‘sa tu’ iti pā. trividho vaikārikas taijaso bhūtādir iti | tatra vaikārikād ahaṅkārāt taijasasahāyāt tallakṣaṇāny evaikādaśendriyāṇy utpadyante, tad yathā- śrotratvakcakṣurjihvāghrāṇavāgghastopasthapāyupādamanāṃsīti; tatra pūrvāṇi pañca buddhīndriyāṇi, itarāṇi pañca karmendriyāṇi, ubhayātmakaṃ manaḥ; bhūtāder api taijasasahāyāt tallakṣaṇāny eva pañcatanmātrāṇy utpadyante- śabdatanmātraṃ, sparśatanmātraṃ, rūpatanmātraṃ, rasatanmātraṃ, gandhatanmātram iti; teṣāṃ viśeṣāḥ- śabdasparśarūparasagandhāḥ; tebhyo bhūtāni- vyomānilānalajalorvyaḥ; evam eṣā tattvacaturviṃśatir vyākhyātā ||4||

nanu kathamekamavyaktamanekadharmaṇāṃ ‘kathamekamevānekadharmiṇāṃ’ iti pā. sarvabhūtānāṃ kāraṇamityāśaṅkyāvyaktāt sarvabhūtānāmutpattikramamāha- tasmādityādi| tasmāditi kṣetrajñādhiṣṭhitādavyaktāt| mahāniti buddhitattvaṃ, tattu sattvasamudrekānnirmalasphaṭikopalaprakhyaṃ cicchāyāsaṅkrāntiprāptacaitanyaṃ ‘ātmacchāyāsaṅkrāntiprāptacaitanyaṃ’ iti pā. puruṣavannānātmakamadhyavaseyaviṣayaṃ niścitārthakāraṇamityarthaḥ| utpadyate vyaktībhavati| talliṅga eveti sattvarajastamaḥsvabhāva eva| talliṅgat sattvarajastamaḥsvabhāvāt| mahata iti buddhitattvāt| tallakṣaṇa eveti sattvarajastamaḥsvabhāva evetyarthaḥ| ahaṅkāro'bhimānavyāpāralakṣaṇaḥ| talliṅgāditi viśeṣaṇena śuddhasattvasvarūpānmahattattvānnāhaṅkārasyotpattiriti sūcyate| tathā ca carake'pyabhihitaṃ- “śuddhasattvasya yā śuddhā satyā buddhiḥ pravartate| yayā bhinattyatibalaṃ mahāmohamayaṃ tamaḥ|| sarvabhāvasvabhāvajño yayā bhavati nispṛhaḥ| yayā nopaityahaṅkāraṃ nopāste kāraṇaṃ yayā”- (ca. śā. 1) ityādi| vaikārikādisañjñāstu pūrvācāryaiḥ saṃvyavahārāya kṛtāḥ| tatra vaikārikaḥ sāttvikaḥ, taijaso rājasaḥ, bhūtādistāmasaḥ| tasya trividhasyāpi kāryamāha- tatretyādi| tatra sāttvikādahaṅkārādrājasasahāyāttamomātrayā'nuviddhādekādaśendriyāṇi; tallakṣaṇāni prakāśalakṣaṇāni, sattvasya prakāśakatvāt| tānyahaṅkārādutpannānyāhaṅkārakārikāṇīti sāṅkhye, vaidyake tu bhautikāni| pūrvāṇi pañca śrotrādīni buddhīndriyāṇi, buddherāśrayatvāt; itarāṇi vākprabhṛtīni karmendriyāṇi, karmaṇa āśrayatvātteṣām; ubhayātmakaṃ buddhyātmakaṃ karmātmakaṃ ca manaḥ, buddhīndriyāṇāṃ karmendriyāṇāṃ ca mano'dhiṣṭhitānāmeva pravṛtteḥ| bhūtāderiti tāmasādahaṅkārādrājasasahāyāt sattvamātrayā'nuviddhāt| tallakṣaṇānyeva mohādilakṣaṇānyeva| tatrānudbhūtasvabhāvāni bāhyendriyāgrāhyāṇi śabdādīnyeva tanmātrāṇi, tāni ca yogibhireva grāhyāṇi| sā mātrā yasmin tattanmātram| teṣāmityādi teṣāṃ tanmātrāṇām| viśeṣā iti anubhavayogyaiḥ sukhaduḥkhamoharūpairdharmairviśiṣyanta iti viśeṣāḥ śabdādayaḥ; tanmātrāṇi tvaviśeṣāṇi, yatastānyanubhavayogyaiḥ sukhaduḥkhādibhirviśeṣṭuṃ na śakyante, sūkṣmatvāt| tebhyaḥ pañcabhyaḥ śabdatanmātrādibhya ekottaraparivṛddhyā vyomādaya utpadyante| tadyathā- śabdatanmātrācchabdaguṇaṃ vyoma, śabdatanmātrasahitāt sparśatanmātrācchabdasparśaguṇo vāyuḥ, śabdasparśatanmātrasahitādrūpatanmātrācchabdasparśarūpaguṇaṃ tejaḥ, śabdasparśarūpatanmātrasahitādrasatanmātrācchabdasparśarūparasaguṇā āpaḥ, śabdasparśarūparasatanmātrasahitādgandhatanmātrācchabdasparśarūparasagandhaguṇā pṛthivī| patañjalimatānusāriṇaśca śabdādibhya eva vyomādīnāmutpattimicchanti| śabdādīnāṃ vyomādimahābhūtaguṇānāṃ dharmiṇo'bhinnatvena pṛthaktvaṃ nirasyannaktasyopasaṃhāramāha- evamityādi||4||
tatra buddhīndriyāṇāṃ śabdādayo viṣayāḥ; karmendriyāṇāṃ yathāsaṅkhyaṃ vacanādānānandavisargaviharaṇāni ||5||

tatretyādi| viṣayā grāhyāḥ| vacanādānānandavisargaviharaṇānītyatra viṣayā iti sambadhyate; tenocyate yattadvacanaṃ vaktavyamucyate, evaṃ karmapratyayāntatvādādānamādātavyam, ānanda ānandanīyaṃ, visargo visarjitavyaṃ, viharaṇaṃ vihartavyaṃ sthānam||5||
avyaktaṃ mahān ahaṅkāraḥ pañca tanmātrāṇi cety aṣṭau prakṛtayaḥ; śeṣāḥ ṣoḍaśa vikārāḥ ||6||

uktāyāstattvacaturviṃśateruktameva dharmāntaraṃ kvacit kiñcinnidarśayannāha- avyaktamityādi| prakṛtaya iti apareṣāṃ kāraṇabhūtā; avyaktamiti vicchidya pāṭhaḥ ‘pāṭhāt’ iti pā. kevalahetubhāvenāvyaktaṃ prakṛtireveti bodhanārtham| tanmātrāṇi ceti cakāraḥ prakṛtayaścetyatra sambandhanīyaḥ| tena mahadādayaḥ sapta kāryatvena vikṛtayo'pi| śeṣā iti ekādaśendriyāṇi pañcamahābhūtānīti ṣoḍaśavikārāḥ kāryāṇītyarthaḥ ‘kāryamityarthaḥ’ iti pā.||6||

svaḥ svaś caiṣāṃ viṣayo 'dhibhūtaṃ; svayam adhyātmam; adhidaivatam- atha buddher brahmā, ahaṅkārasyeśvaraḥ, manasaś candramāḥ, diśaḥ śrotrasya, tvaco vāyuḥ, sūryaś cakṣuṣaḥ, rasanasyāpaḥ, pṛthivī ghrāṇasya, vāco 'gniḥ, ‘vacaso'gniḥ’ iti pā. hastayor indraḥ, pādayor viṣṇuḥ, pāyor mitraḥ, prajāpatir upasthasyeti ||7||

asmiṃścaturviṃśatike tattvarāśau prakāśakatvena buddhyādayaḥ pradhānabhūtāḥ, ataste yatrasthaṃ prakāśyaṃ yatra sthitā yadanugraheṇa ca prakāśayanti, tatprakāratrayamadhibhūtādibhedenāha- svaḥ sva ityādi| eṣāṃ buddhyahaṅkāraśrotrādibuddhīndriyāṇāṃ vāgādikarmendriyāṇāṃ manasaśca svaḥ sva ātmīya ātmīyo viṣayo'dhyavaseyo'bhimantavyaḥ svakalpanīyādilakṣaṇo'dhibhūtam; adhibhūtaṃ bhūteṣvadhi; bhūtāni mahābhūtāni prāṇino vā| etena buddhyāderadhyavasāyādivyāpārasādhyo'dhyavaseyādiviṣayo …‘vyāpārasyādhyavaseyādiviṣayaḥ’ iti pā. bhūteṣviti pratipāditam| kecit ‘svaḥ sva eṣāṃ viṣayo'dhibhūtasañjña’ iti vyākhyānayanti| svayamityādi etāni buddhyādīni trayodaśa svayamadhyātmam| ātmanyadhi adhyātmam; ātmaśabdo'tra svaśarīravacanaḥ, tena svaśarīre buddhyādikamātmanaḥ paramātmaparyāyasya vā yogyo viṣayo'dhyātmam| anye tu buddhyādikaṃ svayamadhyātmasañjñamiti vyākhyānayanti| adhidaivatamiti devatānāmadhikṛtatvamadhidaivatam| tadeva buddhyādiṣu prakaṭīkaroti- atha buddherbrahmetyādi| yā yā devatā viśvarūpasya viṣṇoravayavādutpannā sā sā tasyāvayavasyādhidaivatvamāpannā boddhavyā| ayaṃ cādhibhūtādibhāvo vedānte'pi varṇitaḥ| yathā- buddhiradhyātmaṃ, boddhavyamadhibhūtaṃ, brahmā'dhidaivatam; ahaṅkāro'dhyātmam, ahaṅkartavyamadhibhūtaṃ, rudro'dhidaivataṃ; mano'dhyātmaṃ, mantavyamadhibhūtaṃ, candro'dhidaivataṃ; śrotramadhyātmaṃ, śrotavyamadhibhūtaṃ, diśo'dhidaivataṃ; tvagadhyātmaṃ, sparśanīyamadhibhūtaṃ, vāyuradhidaivataṃ; cakṣuradhyātmaṃ, dṛśyamadhibhūtaṃ, sūryo'dhidaivataṃ; rasanā'dhyātmaṃ, rasanīyamadhibhūtaṃ, varuṇo'dhidaivataṃ; ghrāṇamadhyātmaṃ, ghrātavyamadhibhūtaṃ, bhūmiradhidaivataṃ; vāgadhyātmaṃ, vaktavyamadhibhūtam, agniradhidaivataṃ; hastāvadhyātmam, ādātavyamadhibhūtam, indro'dhidaivataṃ; pādāvadhyātmaṃ, gantavyamadhibhūtaṃ, viṣṇuradhidaivataṃ; pāyuradhyātmaṃ, visarjanīyamadhibhūtaṃ, mitro'dhidaivataṃ; upastho'dhyātmam, ānandanīyamadhibhūtaṃ, prajāpatiradhidaivatamityādi||7||

tatra ‘tatra’ iti kvacitpustake na paṭhyate sarva evācetana eṣa vargaḥ, puruṣaḥ pañcaviṃśatitamaḥ kāryakāraṇasaṃyuktaś cetayitā bhavati | saty apy acaitanye pradhānasya puruṣakaivalyārthaṃ ‘puruṣakaivalyārthaṃ’ iti pā. pravṛttim upadiśanti, kṣīrādīṃś cātra hetūn udāharanti ||8||

tatra sarva evetyādi| sarva evaiṣa vargo'vyaktādiko'cetanaḥ, kāraṇasyāvyaktasyācetanatvena tatkāryasya mahadāderapyacetanatvāt| puruṣaḥ pañcaviṃśatitamaḥ kāryakāraṇasaṃyukta iti kāryeṇa mahadādivikāragaṇena, kāraṇena mūlaprakṛtyā, saṃyuktaḥ saṃyogī| tasya kaivalyārthaṃ(rthāṃ) mokṣārthaṃ(rthāṃ), pradhānasya mūlaprakṛteḥ, pravṛttimupadiśantyācāryāḥ| kathamacetanaḥ pravartata ityāha- kṣīrādīnityādi| yathā kṣīramajñaṃ ‘kṣīramacetanaṃ’ iti pā. vatsavivṛddhyarthaṃ pravartate| ādiśabdācca yathaikānte kamanīyakāminīsuratamahotsave tatsukhātiśayotpādanārthamajñaṃ retaḥ pravartate, tadvadityarthaḥ||8||

ata ūrdhvaṃ prakṛtipuruṣayoḥ sādharmyavaidharmye vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | tad yathā- ubhāv apy anādī, ubhāv apy anantau, ubhāv apy aliṅgau, ubhāv api nityau, ubhāv apy anaparau ubhāvapyaparau’ iti pā., ubhau ca sarvagatāv iti; ekā tu prakṛtir acetanā triguṇā bījadharmiṇī prasavadharmiṇy amadhyasthadharmiṇī ceti, bahavas tu puruṣāś cetanāvanto 'guṇā abījadharmāṇo 'prasavadharmāṇo madhyasthadharmāṇaś ceti ||9||

div.ab: ata ityādi| prakṛtiravyaktaṃ, puruṣa ātmā| sādharmyaṃ samāno dharmaḥ, vaidharmyaṃ visadṛśo dharmaḥ, te vyākhyāsyāmaḥ kathayiṣyāmaḥ| ubhāvapyaliṅgāviti na vidyate liṅgaṃ yayostāvaliṅgau| nityāviti ubhāvapi layaṃ kvacidapi na gacchata ityarthaḥ| na vidyate'paro yābhyāṃ tāvanaparau ‘tāvaparau’ iti pā., yatastāveva prakṛtipuruṣau mahadādibhyaḥ parau| sarvagatau sarvaṃ vyāpya sthitau| sādharmyamukttvā vaidharmyamāha- eketyādi| tayormadhye ekā prakṛtiravyaktāparaparyāyā| sā ca triguṇā sattvarajastamoguṇā| sattvarajastamasāṃ guṇānāṃ sāmyāvasthāyāṃ sthitā sarveṣāṃ mahadādivikārāṇāṃ bījabhāvenāvasthitā bījadharmiṇītyucyate; gayī tu saṃhāre bhūtendriyatanmātrāhaṅkāramahadādīnāmādhārabhūteti bījadharmiṇī| saiva sisṛkṣuṇā vibhunā puruṣeṇa sārdhaṃ kṣobhamāgamya sāmyāvasthātaḥ pracyutā mahadahaṅkārādikrameṇa carācarasya jagataḥ prasavitrīti prasavadharmiṇītyucyate| amadhyasthadharmiṇīti sattvādiguṇarāśitayā sukhādirūpatvāt, sukhī hi sukhamabhilipsan duḥkhī duḥkhaṃ vidviṣan amadhyastho bhavati; prakṛtiśca sattvādirūpā, tato'madhyasthā| bahava iti yugapanmaraṇāsambhavādaneke puruṣāḥ, ‘pur’śabdena mahadādikṛtaṃ sūkṣmaṃ liṅgaśarīramucyate, tacca yogināmeva dṛśyaṃ, tatra puri śete iti puruṣaḥ| aguṇā iti avidyamānasattvādiguṇāḥ| abījadharmāṇa iti mahadādīnāṃ mahāpralaye prakṛtāviva teṣvanavasthānāt| madhyasthadharmāṇa iti prītyaprītiviṣādāyogenecchādveṣaśūnyatvāt| taduktaṃ sāṅkhye- “tasmāttu viparyāsāt siddhaṃ sākṣitvamasya puruṣasya| kaivalyaṃ mādhyasthyaṃ draṣṭṛtvamakartṛbhāvaśca”- (sāṃ. kā. 9) iti||9||-

ab.seg: tatra kāraṇānurūpaṃ kāryam iti kṛtvā sarva evaite viśeṣāḥ sattvarajastamomayā bhavanti; tadañjanatvāt tanmayatvāc ca tadguṇā eva puruṣā bhavantīty eke bhāṣante ||10||

idānīmuktameva tadupasaṃharannāha- tatretyādi| kāraṇasya prakṛteranurūpaṃ sadṛśaṃ kāryaṃ mahadādikam| viśeṣāḥ prakārā mahadādikāḥ| saṃyuktasya pañcaviṃśatitamasya puruṣasyāpi sattvādiguṇatvaṃ darśayannāha- tadañjanatvādityādi| teṣāṃ sattvarajastamasāmañjanaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vyaktirvā yeṣu te tadañjanāḥ puruṣāḥ; sattvādilakṣaṇā ityarthaḥ, teṣāṃ bhāvastattvaṃ, tasmāt| tadeva kuta ityāha- tanmayatvāditi|- sattvādimayatvāt| sattvādimayatvaṃ punaḥ puruṣāṇāṃ sattvādirūpe mahadādau pratibimbanāt; yathā- taḍāgodake pratibimbito vidhustaḍāgodakaprakampanena prakampātmakaḥ kathyate, evaṃ sattvādirūpe mahadādau pratibimbitāḥ puruṣāḥ sattvādimayā iva bhavanti, na tu vāstavaṃ sattvādimayatvaṃ; tādṛśācca tanmayatvāttallakṣaṇatvena tadguṇāḥ sukhino duḥkhino mūḍhāśca puruṣā bhavanti| gayī tu taiḥ sattvādibhirañjanaṃ vyaktiryasya mahadādestattadañjanaṃ, tadasyāstīti matvarthīyo'kārapratyaya iti; tatsambandhāt puruṣasya sattvādibhirevāñjanaṃ mahadādīnāṃ; kuta ityāha- tanmayatvāt; sattvādiprakṛtikāraṇatvāt| teṣāṃ tadañjanatvaṃ ca nirvikārasyāpi vikārivastusaṃyogāt ‘vikārivatsaṃyogāt’ iti pā.; yathā sandhyārāgiravikaranikarasaṃyogādaruṇagaganatalopalambha iti| pūrvoktasya sarvasyāpyekīyamatatvaṃ darśayannāha- ityeke ityādi||10||

lg.l: vaidyake tu- svabhāvam īśvaraṃ kālaṃ yadṛcchāṃ niyatiṃ tathā |

ab.seg: svamataṃ darśayannāha- vaidyake tvityādi| atraike svabhāvavādinaḥ svabhāvaṃ sarvasya prakṛtiṃ kāraṇamūcuḥ; tathāhi- “kaḥ kaṇṭakānāṃ prakaroti taikṣṇyaṃ, citraṃ vicitraṃ mṛgapakṣiṇāṃ ca| mādhuryamikṣau, kaṭutāṃ marīce, svabhāvataḥ sarvamidaṃ pravṛttam”- iti| īśvara evorvī parvatatarvāderjantūnāṃ svarganarakādeśca kāraṇamityanye| uktaṃ ca- “ajño janturanīśo'yamātmanaḥ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ| īśvaraprerito gacchet svargaṃ narakameva vā” iti| kāla eva jagataḥ sṛṣṭisthitipralayanimittamiti kālakāraṇikāḥ; uktaṃ ca jyotiḥśāstravidā śrīpatinā- “prabhavaviratimadhyajñānavandhyā nitāntaṃ viditaparamatattvā yatra te yogino'pi| tamahamiha nimittaṃ viśvajanmātyayānāmanumitamabhivande bhagrahaiḥ kālamīśam”- iti| yo yato bhavati tattannimittamiti yādṛcchikāḥ; yathā- tṛṇāraṇinimitto vahniriti| pūrvajanmārjitau dharmādharmau niyatiḥ, saiva sarvasya kāraṇamiti niyativādinaḥ| pradhānameva mahadahaṅkārādirūpatayā pariṇataṃ sarvasya nimittamiti pariṇāmavādinaḥ| etat sarvamatrānumataṃ, sarvavedapāriṣadatvādāyurvedasya| suśrutācāryeṇāpi svabhāvādibhedabhinnāyāḥ ṣaḍvidhāyā api prakṛterudāharaṇānyabhihitāni| tatra svabhāvasya tāvat kāraṇatvamāha- “aṅgapratyaṅganirvṛttiḥ svabhāvādeva jāyate” (śā.3); punaśca “sanniveśaḥ śarīrāṇāṃ dantānāṃ patanodbhavau| taleṣvasambhavo yaśca romṇāmetat svabhāvataḥ”- (śā.2) iti; punaścoktaṃ- “dhātuṣu kṣīyamāṇeṣu vardhete dvāvimau sadā| svabhāvaṃ prakṛtiṃ kṛtvā nakhakeśāviti sthitiḥ” (śā.4) iti; punarapyāha- “nidrāhetustamaḥ sattvaṃ bodhane heturucyate| svabhāva eva vā heturgarīyānapi kīrtyate”- (śā.4) iti; anyatrāpyuktaṃ- “svabhāvāllaghavo mudgāstathā lāvakapiñjalāḥ| svabhāvādguravo māṣā varāhamahiṣādayaḥ”- (ca.sū.27) iti| īśvaro'pi vahnirūpo jīvitādeḥ kāraṇatvenodāhṛtaḥ; tathāhi- “jāṭharo bhagavānagnirīśvaro'nnasya pācakaḥ| saukṣmyādrasānādadāno vivektuṃ naiva śakyate”|| (sū. 35); “agnimūlaṃ balaṃ puṃsāṃ balamūlaṃ hi jīvitam”- iti| kālastu śītoṣṇalakṣaṇaḥ; uktaṃ ca- “mahābhūtaviśeṣāṃstu śītoṣṇadvayabhedataḥ| kāla ityadhyavasyanti nyāyamārgānusāriṇaḥ- ” iti; ayaṃ ca ṛtucaryādhyāye doṣāṇāṃ sañcayaprakopopaśamadvāreṇa heturuktaḥ| yadṛcchā punaralakṣita ākasmikapadārthāvirbhāvaḥ, uktaṃ ca “yadṛcchayā copagatāni pākaṃ pākakrameṇopacaredvidhijñaḥ”- (ci.18) ityādi| niyatiratrāpi dharmādharmau, taddhetutvamāha- “brahmastrīsajjanavadhaparasvaharaṇādibhiḥ| karmabhiḥ pāparogasya prāhuḥ kuṣṭhasya sambhavam” ||(ni.5); “karmajā vyādhayaḥ kecit”- (u.40) iti coktam| pariṇāmasya hetutvamāha- “jāṭharāgnestu saṃyogādyadudeti rasāntaram| rasānāṃ pariṇāmānte sa vipāka iti smṛtaḥ” ||(vā. sū. 9) iti; “tā evauṣadhyaḥ kālapariṇāmāt pariṇatavīryā balavatyo hemante bhavantyāpaśca” (sū.6); “samyak pariṇatasyāhārasya sāro rasaḥ” (sū.14); “evaṃ bālānāmapi vayaḥpariṇāmācchukraprādurbhāvo bhavati”- (sū.14) iti| itthametāḥ ṣaṭprakṛtayo vaidyakānugatā darśitāḥ| nanu, svabhāvādayaḥ ṣaṭ padārthāḥ prakṛteraṣṭarūpāyāḥ paryāyāḥ syurathavā'nyārthābhidhāyitvena bhinnārthāḥ? tatra bhinnārthatve'pi vikalpadvayaṃ; kimetaiḥ svabhāvādibhirbhinnārthaiḥ kiñcit svabhāvena kiñcidīśvareṇetyevamprakāreṇa militvā jagadārabhyate? utaitte svabhāvādayaḥ pṛthak pṛthageva viśvajananasamarthāḥ? ityanekadhā vikalpamutpādya jejjhaṭācāryeṇaśvaraṃ vihāya svabhāvādayaḥ prakṛteraṣṭarūpāyāḥ paryāyatvenābhihitāḥ| yattu vaidyake “svabhāvamīśvaraṃ kālam”- ityādivākyena vipuladarśibhiḥ svabhāvādīnāṃ bhinnameva prakṛtitvaṃ pratipāditaṃ, tattathāsvarūpeṇa teṣāmavabhāsanāt| paramārthatastu guṇatrayātmikā prakṛtireva kāraṇam| yataḥ svabhāvādayaścatvāraḥ prakṛtipariṇāmasya dharmaviśeṣatayā prakṛtāvevāntarbhavanti| tathāhi- svabhāvastāvat sattvarajastamasāṃ tadvikārāṇāṃ pṛthivyādimahābhūtānāṃ ca pariṇāmasya tādṛśo viśeṣa iti prakṛtipariṇāmādanyo na bhavati; niyaterapi pūrvakṛtasadasatkarmarūpāyā rajoguṇapariṇāmalakṣaṇatvena na prakṛteranyatvaṃ; kālo'pi candrārkādigatikriyālakṣaṇaḥ, tatra ca mahābhūtānāṃ pariṇāmaviśeṣācchītoṣṇādayo bhavanti, taduktaṃ- “mahābhūtaviśeṣāṃstu śītoṣṇadvayabhedataḥ| kāla ityadhyavasyanti nyāyamārgānusāriṇaḥ”- iti, kriyātvena rajoguṇapariṇāmatvānmahābhūtapariṇāmaviśeṣatvācca na kālasya prakṛteranyatvam; īśvaraśca pañcaviṃśatitamaḥ puruṣaḥ prakṛteḥ kṣobhakatayā kāraṇatvenodāhṛta eva; yadṛcchā ca kādācitkatvādbhūtapariṇāmaviśeṣānnānyā| kiñcāsmiñ śāstre prakṛtipariṇāmātmakaṃ viśvaṃ paṭhyate| tathāhi- “sāttvikaṃ kāyalakṣaṇaṃ, rājasaṃ kāyalakṣaṇaṃ” (śā.4) tathā ‘sattvabahulamākāśaṃ’ ityādi| gayī tvanyathā vyākhyāti; yathāvaidyake tu vipuladarśinaḥ svabhāvādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ prakṛtitvaṃ pratipādayanti, te ca svabhāvādayaḥ samuccayena jagadutpattau kāraṇabhūtāḥ; tatrāpi prakṛtipariṇāmasyopādānakāraṇatvaṃ, svabhāvādīnāṃ ca pañcānāṃ nimittakāraṇatvamiti||11||

lg.l: tanmayāny eva ‘tato jātāni’ iti tā. bhūtāni tadguṇāny eva cādiśet |
taiś ca tallakṣaṇaḥ kṛtsno bhūtagrāmo vyajanyata ||12||
bhūtebhyo hi paraṃ yasmān nāsti cintā cikitsite ||13||

ab.seg: yato 'bhihitaṃ- “tatsambhavadravyasamūho bhūtādir uktaḥ” (sū.1); bhautikāni cendriyāṇy āyurvede varṇyante, tathendriyārthāḥ ||14||

ekīyamatena kāraṇānurūpaṃ kāryamityādivākyāt kāraṇamayatvaṃ kāryasya pratipādya svamate'pi kāraṇamayatvaṃ pratipādayannāha- tanmayānītyādi| tanmayānīti avakāśacaloṣṇadravakharasvabhāvādidharmaviśeṣākrāntaprakṛtipariṇāmamayāni; bhūtānyākāśādīni; tadguṇānyeveti sattvarajastamoguṇānyevetyarthaḥ, sattvabahulamākāśamityādyuktatvāt| gayī tu ‘tato jātāni bhūtāni’ iti paṭhitvā vyākhyāti- tataḥ svabhāvādeḥ, nimittakāraṇatvāt prakṛtipariṇāmāccopādānakāraṇāni bhūtānyākāśādīni tadguṇāni kāraṇaguṇāni| taiścetyādi| tairākāśādibhirbhūtaiḥ, tallakṣaṇo bhūtalakṣaṇaḥ, kṛtsnaḥ samastaḥ, bhūtagrāmaḥ sthāvarajaṅgamātmakaḥ, vyajanyata vividho janitaḥ| bhūtānāṃ pṛthivyādīnāṃ punarlakṣaṇaṃ sthiragurukaṭhinatvamityādi, tallakṣaṇaśca sthāvarajaṅgamātmako bhūtagrāmaḥ| tasya pañcamahābhūtārabdhasya bhūtagrāmasya parasparopakāryopakārakatvena vyavasthitasya, upayogaḥ prayojanam, abhihitaḥ kathitaḥ, cikitsāṃ prati rogāpanayanaṃ lakṣīkṛtya, sarvadā nityage āvasthike ca kāle| kutaḥ? yasmāttebhyaḥ pañcamahābhūtārabdhabhūtagrāmyebhyaḥ paraṃ cikitsite cintā nāsti| taduktamādye'dhyāye, “tatrāsmin pañcamahābhūtaśarīrisamavāyaḥ puruṣa ityucyate; tasmin kriyā, so'dhiṣṭānaṃ, kasmāt? lokadvaividhyāt, loko hi dvividhaḥ- sthāvaro jaṅgamaśca, tasmin puruṣaḥ pradhānaṃ, tasyopakaraṇamanyat”- (sū.1) iti| tena pañcamahābhūtārabdhasyaiva bhūtagrāmasya cikitsopakaraṇatvam| ato bhūtebhyaḥ paraṃ yadavyaktādi tatra cintā'pi nāsti| ayamevārtho'nyatrāpinirdiṣṭa iti darśayannāha- yata ityādi| etatsūtraṃ bījādhyāye vyākhyātam, atrāpi kiñcicchiṣyabodhārthaṃ vyākhyāyate- yatastasya puruṣasya sambhavadravyāṇi śukraśoṇitādīni teṣāṃ samūhaḥ saṃyogaviśeṣaḥ, kathambhūtaḥ? bhūtādiḥ bhūtaṃ pṛthivyādikamādirmūlakāraṇaṃ yasya sa tathā| na paraṃ puruṣasambhavadravyasya bhūtāditvābhidhānādbhūtebhyaḥ paraṃ cintā nāsti, kintvetasmādapītyāśaṅkyāha- bhautikāni cetyādi| indriyāṇi śravaṇasparśanarasanaghrāṇāni bhautikāni| tathā coktaṃ pañcabhūtātmakatve'pi- “khaṃ śrotre sparśane vāyurdarśane teja utkaṭam| salilaṃ rasane bhūmirghrāṇe tajjñairnirūpitam”- iti| indriyāṇāmarthāḥ śabdasparśarūparasagandhāḥ, te cāyurvedaśāstre tathā bhautikā ityarthaḥ| uktaṃ ca- “śabdo vaihāyasaḥ, sparśo vāyavīyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ| rūpamāgneyamāpyo'tra raso, gandhastu pārthivaḥ” iti||12-14||

bhavati cātra-
indriyeṇendriyārthaṃ tu svaṃ svaṃ gṛhṇāti mānavaḥ |
niyataṃ tulyayonitvān nānyenānyam iti sthitiḥ ||15||

indriyāṇāmindriyārthānāṃ ca pāñcabhautikatve'pi yasya bhūtasya yatra yatrendriye ādhikyaṃ tena tenendriyeṇa tasya tasyaiva guṇāḥ śabdādayo gṛhyanta iti darśayitumāha- indriyeṇetyādi| indriyeṇa cakṣurādinā rūpādikamātmīyamātmīyaṃ mānava upādatte; tadyathā- taijasaṃ cakṣustaijasameva rūpamādatte, pārthivaṃ ghrāṇendriyaṃ pārthivameva gandhamādatte, evaṃ śeṣeṣvapi boddhavyam| niyatamātmīyameva kuta ityāha- tulyayonitvāditi; ekabhūtahetutvāt, bhūtaṃ hi svayonimevābhidhāvati jalamiva jalam| tameva spaṣṭīkurvannāha- nānyenānyamiti||15||

na cāyurvedaśāstreṣūpadiśyante sarvagatāḥ kṣetrajñā nityāś ca; asarvagateṣu ca kṣetrajñeṣu nityapuruṣakhyāpakān hetūn udāharanti; āyurvedaśāstreṣv asarvagatāḥ ‘āyurvedaśāstrasiddhānteṣvasarvagatāḥ’ iti pā. kṣetrajñā nityāś ca, tiryagyonimānuṣadeveṣu sañcaranti dharmādharmanimittaṃ; ta ete 'numānagrāhyāḥ paramasūkṣmāś cetanāvantaḥ śāśvatā lohitaretasoḥ ‘śukrārtavayoḥ’ iti tā. sanni
pāteṣv abhivyajyante, yato 'bhihitaṃ- ‘pañcamahābhūtaśarīrisamavāyaḥ puruṣaḥ’ (sū.1) iti; sa eṣa karmapuruṣaś cikitsādhikṛtaḥ ||16||

aparamapi sāṅkhyādibhyo bhedamāyurvedasyātmani darśayannāha- na cetyādi| kiṃ tarhyāyurvedaśāstreṣvasarvagatāḥ puruṣā upadiśyante sattvopādhivaśāt; sāṅkhyādiṣu punaḥ sarvagatā eva kṣetrajñā upadiśyante| evamāyurvedapuruṣasya pradeśavartino'pi nityatvaṃ syādityāha- nityāśca; ‘upadiśyante’ iti śeṣaḥ| nityatvaṃ ca kathamityāha- asarvagateṣvityādi| hetūniti sadakāraṇavannityamityādīn| tathāhi- sannātmā, sukhādiliṅgopalambhāt; aviṣayo'kāraṇaśca, ato nityaḥ| tathāhi bhojaḥ- “śubhāśubhābhyāṃ karmabhyāṃ preraṇānmanaso gateḥ| dehāddehāntaraṃ yāti krimivacchāśvato'vyayaḥ|| nitya ityucyate sadbhiḥ sannakāraṇavān yataḥ”- iti| tadevopasaṃharannāha- āyurvedetyādi| asarvagatatve'pi sarvayonigamanaṃ nirdiśannāha- tiryagityādi| tatra bahuśaḥ saṃsaraṇe tiryagyonīnāṃ prakṛṣṭatvam, atasteṣāṃ prāgupādānaṃ; tato manuṣyanirdeśaḥ; devāstu kadācit kvacit sambhavantīti paścānnirdiṣṭāḥ| tatra prāyeṇādharmanimittaṃ tiryagyonayaḥ, dharmādharmanimittaṃ manuṣyāḥ, dharmanimittaṃ devāḥ| nanu, kathamapratyakṣā apyātmāno'bhyupagamyanta ityāha- ta ete'numānagrāhyā iti| sukhaduḥkhādyupalabdhirūpeṇa liṅgenāvyabhicāriṇaite ātmāna upalabdhāro'numātavyāḥ ‘anumantavyāḥ’ iti pā.| pratyakṣapramāṇenāpi kṣetrajñāḥ kathaṃ na gṛhyante? ityāha- paramasūkṣmā iti|- paramasūkṣmā hi paramāṇava iva santo'pi te pratyakṣeṇa naivopalabhyante| cetanāvanta iti nityaṃ cetanāyuktāḥ| śāśvatā iti nityāḥ| kathaṃ tarhi jāyanta ityucyata ityāha- lohitaretasorityādi| ātmānaḥ paramasūkṣmāḥ pañcabhūtātmakayoḥ śukraśoṇitayoḥ sannipāteṣu saṃyogeṣvabhivyajyante| eṣa eva ca sūkṣmapuruṣāṇāṃ pañcamahābhūtānāṃ ca saṃyogo vaidyake ṣaḍdhātukaḥ puruṣaḥ paribhāṣitaḥ| kutaḥ paribhāṣita ityāśaṅkyādyādhyāyoktaṃ vākyaṃ darśayati- yata ityādi| tasya cikitsopayogitāṃ nidarśayannāha- sa ityādi| karmapuruṣa iti karmaphalabhāgityarthaḥ karmaphalabhogītyarthaḥ’ iti pā.| tena cikitsitakarmaphalamapyavāpnotītyuktaṃ bhavati||16||
tasya sukhaduḥkhe icchādveṣau prayatnaḥ prāṇāpānāv unmeṣanimeṣau buddhir manaḥ saṅkalpo vicāraṇā smṛtir vijñānam adhyavasāyo viṣayopalabdhiś ca guṇāḥ ||17||

idānīṃ tasyaiva karmapuruṣasya śarīrātmanoḥ saṃyogakārakeṇa manasā saṃyoge ye guṇā utpadyante tānāha- tasyetyādi| tatra sukhaṃ svabhāvato'nukūlavedanīyaṃ; duḥkhaṃ svabhāvataḥ pratikūlavedanīyam; icchā abhilāṣaḥ; dveṣo'prītilakṣaṇaḥ; prayatnaḥ kāryārambhe utsāhaḥ; prāṇo vāyurvaktrasañcārī, apānaḥ pakvāśayasthitiradhogamanaśīlaḥ; unmeṣanimeṣau cakṣuṣorunmīlananimīlane; buddhirniścayātmikā; manaḥ saṃśayātmakaṃ, tasya saṅkalpo manasaḥ karma; vicāraṇā punarūhāpohābhyāṃ vastuvimarśaḥ; smṛtiḥ pūrvānubhūtasyārthasya smaraṇaṃ; vijñānaṃ śilpaśāstrādibodhaḥ; adhyavasāyo buddhervyāpāraḥ; viṣayāṇāṃ śabdādīnāmupalabdhiravagatirviṣayopalabdhiḥ| gayī tu sukhaṃ prītiḥ, duḥkhamaprītiḥ, icchā sukhaheturabhilāṣaḥ, dveṣo duḥkhaheturmanaḥpratīghātaḥ ‘duḥkhahetormanaḥpratyānayanam’ iti pā., prayatno manaḥ pravṛttikara utsāhaḥ, manaḥ saṅkalapātmakalakṣaṇaṃ, tasya saṅkalpo viṣayeṣu doṣaguṇakalpanaṃ; śeṣaṃ samam| ete karmapuruṣasya ṣoḍaśa guṇāḥ| ata ‘ete’ iti pā. eva ‘kalā’ ityucyante||17||

sāttvikās tu- ānṛśaṃsyaṃ saṃvibhāgarucitā titikṣā satyaṃ dharma āstikyaṃ jñānaṃ buddhir medhā smṛtir dhṛtir anabhiṣaṅgaś ca; rājasās tu- duḥkhabahulatā'ṭanaśīlatā'dhṛtir ahaṅkāra ānṛtikatvam akāruṇyaṃ dambho māno harṣaḥ kāmaḥ krodhaś ca; tāmasās tu- viṣāditvaṃ nāstikyam adharmaśīlatā buddher nirodho 'jñānaṃ durmedhastvam akarmaśīlatā nidrālutvaṃ ceti ||18||

puruṣaguṇānabhidhāya śeṣān sattvādiyuktasya manaso guṇānnirdiśannāha- sāttvikā ityādi| ānṛśaṃsyam akrūrakarmakāritvam| saṃvibhāgarucitā saṃvibhajya bhoktumabhilāṣukatā| titikṣā kṣamā| satyaṃ bhūtahitaṃ tathyaṃ vaco vā| dharmaḥ kāyavāṅmanobhiḥ sucaritam| asti dharmamokṣaparalokādikamiti buddhyā caratītyāstikaḥ, tadbhāva āstikyam| jñānam ātmajñānam| buddhiḥ tatkālaviṣayā| medhā granthāvadhāraṇaśaktiḥ| dhṛtirmanaso niyamātmikā buddhiḥ| pūrvānubhūtasyārthasya smaraṇaṃ smṛtiḥ| phalanirapekṣayā buddhyā śreyaḥkarmakaraṇamanabhiṣaṅgaḥ| rājasāstvityādi| adhṛtirmanaso'dhīratā| ānṛtikatvaṃ mithyāvacanaśīlatā; gayī tu ‘āvṛttikatvaṃ’ iti paṭhitvā manasaḥ śīlatetyāha ‘śītalatā’ ‘khalatā’ iti ca pā.| akāruṇyaṃ nirdayatvam| dambhaḥ kuhakavṛttitā| māna ātmanyutkarṣabuddhiḥ| ahaṅkārādayaḥ pūrvaṃ vyākhyātāḥ| gayī tu ‘aṭanaśīlatā’ ityatra ‘tāḍanaśīlatā’ iti paṭhati, ‘māna’ ityatra ‘mada’ iti paṭhati| tāmasāstvityādi| viṣādo'syāstīti viṣādī, tadbhāvo viṣāditvaṃ mūḍhatā| adharme ‘adharmaḥ’ iti pā. śīlaṃ svabhāvo yasya tadbhāvo'dharmaśīlatvam| durmedhastvaṃ duṣṭabuddhitvam| akarmaśīlatā karmaṇyanutsāhaḥ||18||

āntarikṣāḥ- śabdaḥ śabdendriyaṃ sarvacchidrasamūho viviktatā ca; vāyavyās tu- sparśaḥ sparśendriyaṃ sarvaceṣṭāsamūhaḥ sarvaśarīraspandanaṃ laghutā ca; taijasās tu- rūpaṃ rūpendriyaṃ varṇaḥ santāpo bhrājiṣṇutā paktir amarṣas taikṣṇyaṃ śauryaṃ ca; āpyās tu- raso rasanendriyaṃ sarvadravasamūho gurutā śaityaṃ sneho retaś ca; pārthivās tu- gandho gandhendriyaṃ sarvamūrtasamūho gurutā ceti ||19||
