ab.seg: idānīṃ janmabhūmimārabhya tuvarakarasāyanakalpaṃ prastauti- vṛkṣā ityādi| paścimārṇavabhūmiṣu paścimasamudrabhūmiṣu| vīcītaraṅgetyādi| ūrmiparamparāvikṣepapavanotkampitapallavāḥ samudrodakasyātyāsannā ityarthaḥ| teṣāṃ phalebhyo majjānamādāya; kusumbhavat kusumbhakusumavattailaṃ vā gālayet, tattailagālanaṃ salilāpacayaṃ yāvat| tattu karīṣarāśau pakṣaṃ nidhātuṃ prayojayet, viśiṣṭatamaśaktyutpādanārtham| hṛtaṃ malaṃ purīṣaṃ kaphādayo'pi yasya sa tathā; tatra kaphe vamanameva, vamanāt pakṣādeva virecanaṃ; yadāhuḥ- “pakṣādvireko vāntasya” (ci. 36) iti; virecanādapi pakṣādeva tauvarakaṃ tailaṃ, tasyāpi śodhanatvāt; etena peyādisaṃsarjanakrameṇa sañjātabalastuvarakasnehaṃ pibedityarthaḥ| caturthabhaktāntarita iti pakṣādūrdhvaṃ prathame'hni sāyamprātaḥ prakṛtibhojanadvayaṃ, dvitīye'hni prātarbhuktvā sāyaṃ bhojanaṃ na kāryaṃ, phalāmlamuṣṇodakaṃ vā pāyayet sāyaṃ bhojanasthāne, tatastṛtīye'hani laghukoṣṭhāya prātaḥ snehaṃ dadyāt, evaṃ caturthabhaktamantaritaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| tailasyāpi pibenmātrāṃ pāṇitalapramāṇāṃ, karṣapramāṇāmityarthaḥ| asnehalavaṇām alpasnehalavaṇāṃ, yato nañ īṣadarthe| pakṣaṃ pariharet, ‘krodhādīn’ iti śeṣaḥ| mahāvīryo mahāprabhāvaḥ| para utkṛṣṭatamaḥ||20-34||

lg.l: sāntardhūmas tasya majjā tu dagdhaḥ kṣiptas taile saindhavaṃ cāñjanaṃ ca |
paillyaṃ hanyād armanaktāndhyakācān nīlīrogaṃ taimiraṃ cāñjanena ||35||

ab.seg: sāntardhūma ityādi| taile tuvarakotthe| saindhavaṃ lavaṇam| añjanaṃ srotoñjanaṃ, tasyotpattisthānaṃ varṇasā sindhuśca mahānadaḥ; athavā varṇasodbhavāñjanaparihārāya saindhavamuktaṃ, tena sindhumahānadodbhavamevāñjanaṃ grāhyam| majjādikaṃ tritayamantardhūmena dagdham| etena tuvarakasya ṣaḍvidhaḥ prayoga uktaḥ; tadyathā- tailaṃ pañcāhikaprayogeṇa kuṣṭhahara ekaḥ, tathā tadeva khadirāmbusiddhaṃ viśiṣṭāvasthakuṣṭhe dvitīyaḥ, tathā tadeva sarpirmadhukhadirakaṣāyavidhinā tṛtīyaḥ, tathā paro'pi pañcāśadāhniko nasyaprayogo rāsāyanikaścaturthaḥ, majjaprayogaḥ pañcamaḥ, tathāhi ‘śodhayanti naraṃ pītāḥ’ ityādi, añjanaprayogaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ ‘sāntardhūma’ ityādi||35||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne madhumehacikitsitaṃ nāma trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||13||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ cikitsasthāne trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ||13||
athāta udarāṇāṃ cikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

aṣṭāv udarāṇi pūrvam uddiṣṭāni | teṣv asādhyaṃ baddhagudaṃ parisrāvi ca; avaśiṣṭāni kṛcchrasādhyāni;
sarvāṇy eva pratyākhyāyopakrameta | teṣv ādyaś caturvargo bheṣajasādhyaḥ, uttaraḥ śastrasādhyaḥ, kālaprakarṣāt sarvāṇy eva śastrasādhyāni varjayitavyāni vā ||3||

nidānasthāne kathite'pyaṣṭatve'tra punaraṣṭasaṅkhyākhyāpanaṃ plīhodarayakṛddālyudarayościkitsitaikatvaprakhyāpanāya ‘cikitsitaikatvapratyākhyāpanāya’ iti pā.| avaśiṣṭāni kṛcchrasādhyānīti teṣvapi yathottaraṃ kṛcchrataratvaṃ jñeyam| tathāca- “vātāt pittāt kaphāt plīhnaḥ sannipātāttathodakāt| paraṃ paraṃ kṛcchrataramudaraṃ bhiṣagādiśet” (ca. ci. 13) iti| sarvāṇyeveti ṣaḍiti kecit, ṣaṭsveva kṛcchratvapratipādanāt; baddhagudaparisrāvibhyāṃ sahāṣṭāvapītyanye, tayorapi cikitsitokteḥ, sarvagrahaṇācca| teṣvityādi| ādyaścaturvargaḥ vātapittakaphadūṣīviṣanimittāni catvāryudarāṇi; uttarastu plīhodarabaddhagudacchidrodakodarāṇi| kālaprakarṣāditi bheṣajasādhyakālātikramāt śastrasādhyakālātikramācca sarvāṇyevauṣadhasādhyānyapi śastrasādhyāni syuḥ, śastrasādhyāni varjayitavyānīti varjanārhāṇi vetyarthaḥ||1-3||
udarī tu gurvabhiṣyandirūkṣavidāhisnigdhapiśitapariṣekāvagāhān pariharet; śāliṣaṣṭikayavagodhūmanīvārān nityam aśnīyāt ||4||
udarītyādi| doṣadhātumalasrotasāṃ kledaprāptijananamabhiṣyandi| vidāhi kāñjikādi| snigdhaṃ piśitaṃ meduramāṃsam| nīvāra ulikādhānyam||4||

tatra vātodariṇaṃ vidārigandhādisiddhena sarpiṣā snehayitvā, tilvakavipakvenānulomya, citrāphalatailapragāḍhena vidārigandhādikaṣāyeṇāsthāpayed anuvāsayec ca, sālvaṇena copanāhayed udaraṃ, bhojayec cainaṃ vidārigandhādisiddhena kṣīreṇa jāṅgalarasena ca, svedayec cābhīkṣṇam ||5||

tatretyādi| tilvakaḥ paṭṭikārodhraḥ| anulomya virecya| citrāphalatailaṃ dantīphalatailam| āsthāpayet nirūhayet, anuvāsayecca citrāphalatailenaiva| sālvaṇenopanāhayet badhnīyāt| svedayeccābhīkṣṇamiti evamagretane kaphārabdhe'pi svedo vidheyaḥ, natu pittārabdhe; sa ca sveda ājalaprāpteḥ ‘ājalaprāptisarvarūpāvasthāprāpteḥ’ iti pā., ata ūrdhvaṃ sarveṣāmasvedyatvam| kathamatrodariṇaḥ snehasvedāsthāpanānuvāsanāni suśrutācāryaḥ prāha? agre ‘asnehyā asvedyā nānuvāsyā nāsthāpyā’ iti paṭhitatvāt; etanna, yataśchidrodakodariṇoreva tatra niṣedhaḥ, anyeṣu yathāvasthaṃ snehādayaḥ prayojyā iti||5||

pittodariṇaṃ tu madhuragaṇavipakvena sarpiṣā snehayitvā, śyāmātriphalātrivṛdvipakvenānulomya, śarkarāmadhughṛtapragāḍhena nyagrodhādikaṣāyeṇāsthāpayed anuvāsayec ca, pāyasenopanāhayed udaraṃ, bhojayec cainaṃ vidārigandhādisiddhena payasā ||6||
pittodariṇamityādi| madhuragaṇaḥ kākolyādīni| śyāmā vṛddhadārakaḥ| kṣīrasiddhāstaṇḍulāḥ pāyasaḥ||6||

śleṣmodariṇaṃ tu pippalyādikaṣāyasiddhena sarpiṣopasnehya, snuhīkṣīravipakvenānulomya, trikaṭukamūtrakṣāratailapragāḍhena muṣkakādikaṣāyeṇāsthāpayed anuvāsayec ca, śaṇātasīdhātakīkiṇvasarṣapamūlakabījakalkaiś copanāhayed udaraṃ, bhojayec cainaṃ trikaṭukapragāḍhena kulatthayūṣeṇa pāyasena vā, svedayec cābhīkṣṇam ||7||
śleṣmodariṇamityādi| muṣkakapalāśadhāvanyādirmuṣkakādiḥ| āsthāpanavargasiddhena tailenānuvāsanam| kiṇvaṃ surābījam||7||

dūṣyodariṇaṃ tu pratyākhyāya saptalāśaṅkhinīsvarasasiddhena sarpiṣā viracayen māsam ardhamāsaṃ vā, mahāvṛkṣakṣīrasurāgomūtrasiddhena vā; śuddhakoṣṭhaṃ tu madyenāśvamārakaguñjākākādanīmūlakalkaṃ pāyayet; ikṣukāṇḍāni vā kṛṣṇasarpeṇa daṃśayitvā bhakṣayed vallīphalāni vā, mūlajaṃ kandajaṃ vā viṣamā sevayet, tenāgado bhavaty anyaṃ vā bhāvam āpadyate ||8||

sānnipātikacikitsitamupadiśannāha- dūṣyodariṇamityādi| śaṅkhinī yavatiktābhedaḥ| sānnipātikodare snehādi yaduktaṃ tadvātādyudaroditabheṣajagaṇaiḥ sarvaṃ sādhanīyam| yadāha carakaḥ- “sannipātodare sarvā yathoktāḥ kārayet kriyāḥ” (ca. ci. 13) iti| laghuvāgbhaṭe'pi “sannipātodare kuryānnātikṣīṇabalānale| doṣodrekānurodhena pratyākhyāya kriyāmimām” (vā. ci. 15) iti| śaṅkhinī yavatiktābhedaḥ| mahāvṛkṣetyādi| virecayediti śeṣaḥ| mahāvṛkṣaḥ sehuṇḍaḥ| mahāvṛkṣakṣīramātrā kalkapramāṇā| śuddhetyādi| guñjā cirihiṇṭikā| kākādanī vāyasatindukā| ikṣukāṇḍānītyādi| yathā madātyaye madyapānam, agnidagdhe'gnisvedaḥ, atīsāre svinnapathyayā ‘svinnapathyādi’ iti pā. viṭpravartanaṃ, chardyāṃ vamanaṃ, sarpaviṣe viṣabhakṣaṇaṃ, tadvadviṣādyutpannodare'pi kṛṣṇasarpadaṣṭekṣukāṇḍabhakṣaṇaṃ viṣabhakṣaṇaṃ vā| vallīphalāni karkaṭīprabhṛtīni| anyaṃ vā bhāvamāpadyate maraṇaṃ prāpnoti| karmedaṃ dāruṇam, akriyāyāṃ dhruvaṃ maraṇaṃ, kriyāyāṃ saṃśaye satyevaṃ kuryāt, tatrāpīśvarānujñātenaiva kāryam||8||

bhavati cātra-
kupitānilamūlatvāt sañcitatvān malasya ‘sañcayitvāt’ iti pā. ca |
sarvodareṣu śaṃsanti bahuśas tv anulomanam ||9||
kupitetyādi| sarvodarāṇyeva malavṛddhyā vartante, tasmāt saṃśodhanaṃ śastaṃ, tacca bahuśo'nalpaśaḥ ‘alpaśaḥ’ iti pā.||9||

ata ūrdhvaṃ sāmānyayogān vakṣyāmaḥ | tad yathā- eraṇḍatailam ahar ahar māsaṃ dvau vā kevalaṃ mūtrayuktaṃ kṣīrayuktaṃ vā sevetodakavarjī, māhiṣaṃ vā mūtraṃ kṣīreṇa nirāhāraḥ saptarātram, uṣṭrīkṣīrāhāro vā 'nnavārivarjī pakṣaṃ, pippalīṃ vā māsaṃ pūrvoktena vidhānenāseveta, saindhavājamodāyuktaṃ vā nikumbhatailam, ārdraśṛṅgaverarasapātraśatasiddhaṃ vā vātaśūle 'vacāryaṃ, śṛṅgaverarasavipakvaṃ kṣīram āseveta, cavyaśṛṅgaverakalkaṃ vā payasā saraladevadārucitrakam eva vā, muraṅgīśālaparṇīśyāmāpunarnavākalkaṃ vā, jyotiṣkaphalatailaṃ vā kṣīreṇa svarjikāhiṅgumiśraṃ pibet, guḍadvitīyāṃ ‘guḍapragāḍhāṃ’ iti pā. vā harītakīṃ bhakṣayet, snuhīkṣīrabhāvitānāṃ vā pippalīnāṃ sahasraṃ kālena, pathyākṛṣṇācūrṇaṃ vā snuhīkṣīrabhāvitam utkārikāṃ pakvāṃ dāpayet; harītakīcūrṇaṃ prastham āḍhake ghṛtasyāvāpyāṅgāreṣv abhivilāpya khajenābhimathyānuguptaṃ kṛtvā 'rdhamāsaṃ yavapalle vāsayet, tataś coddhṛtya parisrāvya harītakīkvāthāmladadhīny āvāpya vipacet, tad yathā yogaṃ māsam ardhamāsaṃ vā pāyayet; gavye payasi mahāvṛkṣakṣīram āvāpya vipacet, vipakvaṃ cāvatārya śītībhūtaṃ manthānenābhimathya navanītam ādāya bhūyo mahāvṛkṣakṣīreṇaiva vipacet, tad yathā yogaṃ māsaṃ māsārdhaṃ vā pāyayet; cavyacitrakadantyativiṣākuṣṭhasārivātriphalājamodaharidrāśaṅkhinītrivṛttrikaṭukānām ardhakārṣikā bhāgā, rājavṛkṣaphalamajjñām aṣṭau karṣāḥ, mahāvṛkṣakṣīrapale dve, gavāṃ kṣīramūtrayor aṣṭāv aṣṭau palāni, etat sarvaṃ ghṛtaprasthe samāvāpya vipacet, tad yathā yogaṃ māsam ardhamāsaṃ vā pāyayet; etāni tilvakaghṛtacaturthāni sarpīṃṣy udaragulmavidradhyaṣṭhīlānāhakuṣṭhonmādāpasmāreṣūpayojyāni virecanārthaṃ; mūtrāsavāriṣṭasurāś cābhīkṣṇaṃ mahāvṛkṣakṣīrasambhṛtāḥ seveta; virecanadravyakaṣāyaṃ vā śṛṅgaveradevadārupragāḍham ||10||

ata ityādi| saptāhaṃ māhiṣaṃ mūtraṃ kṣīreṇa kṛtodakānnakāryaḥ, kecidatra māhiṣameva kṣīramāhuḥ, apare punarmāhiṣasyāgnimāndyādikaraṇādgavyamevāhuḥ| gūḍhapadabhaṅgaṭippaṇe īdṛśaṃ vyākhyātaṃ- māhiṣaṃ mūtraṃ kṣīreṇa gavyena pibet; pramādavyākhyānamidaṃ, yasmājjejjaṭācāryādīnāmanumataṃ na bhavati| uṣṭrītyādi| kecidatra kṣīraṃ trikaṭukasaṃyuktamāhuḥ, tantrāntaraprāmāṇyāt| pippalīmityādi| pūrvoktena vātaśoṇitoktena| saindhavājamodāprakṣepayuktaṃ vā dantītailaṃ; tadeva tailamārdraśṛṅgaverarasāḍhakaśatapakvaṃ vātaśūle vātarujyavacāryam; anye tu tilatailameva sādhayanti, tantrāntaraprāmāṇyāt; ārdraśṛṅgaveramārdrakaṃ, tadrasaṃ caturguṇam| vipakvaṃ kṣīrāvaśiṣṭaṃ pakvam| cavyetyādi| payasā caturguṇenaiva| saraladevadārucitrakameva payasetyarthaḥ; saralā trivṛt| muraṅgyādayo vā tathaiva ca; muraṅgī ‘suraṅgī’ iti pā. śobhāñjanakaḥ| śyāmā vṛddhadārukaḥ| jyotiṣkaḥ kākamardanikā| hiṅgumāṣakasvarjikākṣāramāṣakacatuṣṭayasaṃyuktaṃ ‘māsamardhamāsaṃ vā’ iti śeṣaḥ| snuhītyādi| atra triḥsaptakṛtvo bhāvanā| snuhī sehuṇḍaḥ, sa ca bahukaṇṭakaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ| kāleneti yāvatā kālena śaknuyādbhakṣayituṃ, pippalīsahasramekadvitricatuṣṭayatvena virekārtham| pathyetyādi| utkārikāṃ lapsikām| harītakītyādi| khajaḥ manthānam| harītakīkvāthakāñjikadadhīni pratyekaṃ ghṛtacaturguṇāni| gavya ityādi|- gavye payasīti āḍhakapramāṇe, mahāvṛkṣakṣīraṃ prasthaṃ, mahāvṛkṣaḥ sehuṇḍaḥ, tajjaṃ ca navanītaṃ mahāvṛkṣakṣīrapādaṃ, dravānuktau jalamatra caturguṇam| cavyetyādi| triphalātrikaṭukadravyāṇāṃ pratyekamardhakārṣikā bhāgāḥ, na hi triphalā trikaṭukaṃ vā dravyamekamiti| keciddravasyālpatvājjalamapi caturguṇamityāhuḥ| eṣāṃ viṣayamāha- etānītyādi| tilvakaghṛtaṃ vātavyādhyuktaṃ caturthaṃ yeṣāṃ tāni tilvakaghṛtacaturthāni| mūtretyādi|- mūtradraveṇāsavādayo'nukalpena mahāvṛkṣakṣīraprasthaprakṣepeṇa samyakkṛtāḥ| virecanadravyakaṣāyamityādi|- trivṛdādikaṣāyaṃ vā śuṇṭhīdevadārucūrṇakarṣaprakṣepāḍhyam||10||

vamanavirecanaśirovirecanadravyāṇāṃ pālikā bhāgāḥ pippalyādivacādiharidrādiparipaṭhitānāṃ ca dravyāṇāṃ ślakṣṇapiṣṭānāṃ yathoktānāṃ ca lavaṇānāṃ tat sarvaṃ mūtragaṇe prakṣipya mahāvṛkṣakṣīraprasthaṃ ca mṛdvagninā 'vaghaṭṭayan vipaced apradagdhakalkaṃ, tat sādhusiddham avatārya śītībhūtam akṣamātrā guṭikā vartayet, tāsām ekāṃ dve tisro vā guṭikā balāpekṣayā māsāṃs trīṃś caturo vā seveta, eṣā''nāhavartikriyā ‘eṣā khalvānāhamūtravartikriyā viśeṣeṇa’ iti pā. viśeṣeṇa mahāvyādhiṣūpayujyate (viśeṣeṇa) koṣṭhajāṃś ca kṛmīn apahanti kāsaśvāsakṛmikuṣṭhapratiśyāyārocakāvipākodāvartāṃś ca nāśayati ||11||

idānīmanaladīpanīṃ gupitānilasaṃvalitamalānulomanīmābhyantarīṃ ‘kupitānilasevitamalānulomanīṃ’ iti pā. mūtravartiṃ nirdiśannāha- vamanetyādi| saṃśodhanasaṃśamanīyādhyāyoditāni vamanavirecanaśirovirecanadravyāṇi madanaphalāditrivṛdādiviḍaṅgādīni, dravyasaṅgrahaṇīyādhyāye pippalyādivacādiharidrādayo nirdiṣṭāḥ, lavaṇānyannapānādhyāye paripaṭhitāni saindhavādīni, mūtragaṇo gomūtrādirdravadravyapaṭhitaḥ; teṣāṃ yathālābhaṃ pālikā bhāgāḥ| yathālābhameva gavādīnāṃ mūtreṇa vyastasamastena piṣṭvā caturguṇairaṣṭaguṇairvā vipācyam| aṅguṣṭhapramāṇā vartayaḥ kartavyāḥ| tāḥ punaradhamamadhyamottamapuruṣādibalāpekṣayā ekadvitrisaṅkhyopalakṣitā bhakṣayitavyāḥ| tatra ca gavādimūtramevānupānam| tāsāmabhyāse kālāvadhirmāsāstrayaścatvāro vā; phalaṃ tu mehādimahāvyādhiharaṇaṃ koṣṭhakṛmiharaṇaṃ ca||11||

madanaphalamajjakuṭajajīmūtakekṣvākudhāmārgavatrivṛttrikaṭukasarṣapalavaṇāni mahāvṛkṣakṣīramūtrayor anyatareṇa piṣṭvā 'ṅguṣṭhamātrāṃ vartiṃ kṛtvodariṇa ānāhe tailalavaṇābhyaktagudasyaikāṃ dve tisro vā pāyau nidadhyāt, eṣā''nāhavartikriyā vātamūtrapurīṣodāvartādhmānānāheṣu vidheyā ||12||

abhyantaravartiprasaṅgena phalavartiṃ nirdiśannāha- madanaphaletyādi| jīmūtako devadālī, ikṣvākuḥ kaṭutumbī, dhāmārgavo mahākośātakī| ‘vipācya’ ityanuvartanīyam| pāke tu mūtramevānuvartanīyam| pāyau gude| na kevalaṃ udarānāhe vātamūtrapurīṣodāvartādhmānānāheṣu vidheyeti| ‘kṣāramūtrayoranyatareṇa’ ityanye paṭhanti; tatra kṣāraḥ kṣārodakaṃ peṣaṇavacanāt ‘peṣaṇe vartanāt’ iti pā.||12||

plīhodariṇaḥ snigdhasvinnasya dadhnā bhuktavato vāmabāhau kūrparābhyantarataḥ sirāṃ vidhyet, vimardayec ca pāṇinā plīhānaṃ rudhirasyandanārthaṃ; tataḥ saṃśuddhadehaṃ samudraśuktikākṣāraṃ payasā pāyayeta, hiṅgusauvarcike vā kṣīreṇa, srutena palāśakṣāreṇa vā yavakṣāraṃ, kiṃśukakṣārodakena vā bahuśaḥ srutena yavakṣāraṃ, pārijātakekṣurakāpāmārgakṣāraṃ vā, tailasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ śobhāñjanakayūṣaṃ pippalīsaindhavacitrakayuktaṃ, pūtikarañjakṣāraṃ vā 'mlasrutaṃ viḍlavaṇapippalīpragāḍham ||13||

plīhetyādi| dadhibhojanaṃ raktotkleśāya tadahareva, kaphavyādhau vamane kartavye prāk kaphotkleśakaradravyopayogavat| kūrparaṃ bhujamadhyam| rudhirasyandanārthaṃ raktasrāvaṇārthaṃ; sirāvyadhavidhyukto'pi sirāvyadhaḥ punarihoktaḥ, prakaraṇavaśāt; ato na punaruktadoṣamāvahati| tata ityādi| saṃśuddhadehaṃ vamanavirecanābhyām| pārijātaḥ prasiddhaḥ| ikṣurakaḥ kokilākṣakaḥ| pāribhadrakekṣuraketi kecit paṭhanti| śobhāñjanetyādi| amlaṃ kāñjikam| pūtikarañjaścirabilvaḥ, kaṇṭakīkarañja ityanye| kalpanāmāha- kaṇṭakīkarañjakṣāramardhapalamātraṃ ṣaḍguṇāmlakāñjikena bahuśaḥ parisrutaṃ pippalīviḍlavaṇacūrṇākṣaprakṣepam| viḍasthāne saindhavamiti kecit paṭhanti||13||

pippalīpippalīmūlacavyacitrakaśṛṅgaverayavakṣārasaindhavānāṃ pālikā bhāgāḥ, ghṛtaprasthaṃ tattulyaṃ ca kṣīraṃ tad aikadhyaṃ vipācayet, etat ṣaṭpalakaṃ nāma sarpiḥ plīhāgnisaṅgagulmodarodāvartaśvayathupāṇḍurogakāsaśvāsapratiśyāyordhvavātaviṣamajvarān apahanti | mandāgnir vā hiṅgvādikaṃ cūrṇam upayuñjīta ||14||

pippalītyādi| kecidatra bhiṣajaścaturguṇaṃ pānīyamādadate; tanna, jejjaṭena niṣiddhatvāt| asmin yoge ‘kolakulatthapūtīkarohītakakvāthaṃ dviguṇamāvāpya’ iti kecit paṭhanti; tanna, so'pi jejjaṭena niṣiddhatvāt||14||
yakṛddālye 'py eṣa eva kriyāvibhāgaḥ | viśeṣatas tu dakṣiṇabāhau sirāvyadhaḥ ||15||

lg.l: dahet sirāṃ śareṇāśu plīhno vaidyaḥ praśāntaye ||16||

ab.seg: yakṛddālya ityādi| maṇibandhaḥ pāṇimūlaṃ, sakṛt kiñcinnāmayitvā vāmāṅguṣṭhaṃ prati samyagīritāṃ gatāṃ sirāṃ, śaraḥ prasiddhaḥ, tamagnivarṇaṃ kṛtvā dahet||15-16||

baddhagude parisrāviṇi ca snigdhasvinnasyābhyaktasyādho nābher vāmataś caturaṅgulam apahāya romarājyā udaraṃ pāṭayitvā caturaṅgulapramāṇam antrāṇi niṣkṛṣya nirīkṣya baddhagudasyāntrapratirodhakaram aśmānaṃ bālaṃ vā 'pohya malajātaṃ vā tato madhusarpirbhyām abhyajyāntrāṇi yathāsthānaṃ sthāpayitvā bāhyaṃ ‘baddhaṃ’ iti pā. vraṇam udarasya sīvyet | parisrāviṇy apy evam eva śalyam uddhṛtyāntrasrāvān saṃśodhya ‘anusrāvya’ iti pā., tac chidram āntraṃ samādhāya kālapipīlikābhir daṃśayet, daṣṭe ca tāsāṃ kāyān apaharen na śirāṃsi, tataḥ pūrvavat sīvyet, sandhānaṃ ca yathoktaṃ kārayet, yaṣṭīmadhukamiśrayā ca kṛṣṇamṛdā 'valipya bandhenopacaret, tato nivātam āgāraṃ praveśyācārikam upadiśet, vāsayec cainaṃ tailadroṇyāṃ sarpirdroṇyāṃ vā payovṛttim iti ||17||

tato baddhagudaparisrāviṇorupakramaprāptāṃ cikitsāmupadiśannāha- baddhaguda ityādi| svinnasyeti dravasvedena| nābhervāmata ityādi|- vāmabhāge nābheradhastāccaturaṅgulamapahāya romarājyāścaturaṅgulapramāṇastiryageva chedaḥ; tatra lomni tiryagavasthite'nulomagaṃ ca śastrapātanamuktam| antrapratirodhakaramaśmānaṃ bālaṃ vā'pohya malajātaṃ veti tatra malarodhakāraṇamābhyantaramaśmakeśatṛṇādi, bāhyaṃ tu viṣamavihārābhighātenāntrāvayavānāṃ parasparasammūrcchanaṃ, na tatrāntracchedanamiti parisrāvyudarādviśeṣaḥ| ata eva parisrāviṇyeva pṛthagantrasandhānaṃ viśeṣeṇa vakṣyati| tatrābhyantare'śmādāvatyantābādhakare śalyanimittamevāntracchedaṃ kṛtvā'śmādiśalyamapaharet| antracchidraṃ tu vakṣyamāṇanyāyenānusandhāya sarpirmadhvaktaṃ niṣkṛṣṭamantramaṅguṣṭhāṅguliśalākādibhiryathāsthānaṃ ‘aṅguṣṭhāṅgulisparśanādibhiḥ’ iti pā. sthāpayet| mūrcchitamantraṃ tu vīkṣya pāṇinā bandhāvamokṣeṇānulomayet| bāhyavraṇaṃ raktāsecanādividhimapekṣya samyak sīvyet| tailasarpirdroṇīvāsanamudarasya vraṇitvenādhmānakleśanivṛttyartham| payasā kevalena vṛttiriti yāvat| gudapicchāsranivṛttyā samyagantrasya sandhānadṛḍhībhāvaniścayaḥ, anyathā khalvāhāreṇa tatkiṭṭena vā pipīlikāmukhadaṃśasandhānaṃ mṛdu vighaṭeta samyak sandhāvapi, tasmādanukrameṇaiva payojāṅgalamāṃsarasabhojanena tribhāgārdhabhāgavāriṇā ca prākṛtabhojanaprāptiḥ ‘prabhūtabhojanaprāptiḥ’ iti pā.| sāṃśayikaṃ caitat karma, tasmādāpṛcchyeśvaraṃ pratyākhyāyācaret||17||

dakodariṇas tu ‘udakodariṇaḥ’ iti pā. vātaharatailābhyaktasyoṣṇodakasvinnasya sthitasyāptaiḥ suparigṛhītasyākakṣāt pariveṣṭitasyādho nābher vāmataś caturaṅgulam apahāya romarājyā vrīhimukhenāṅguṣṭhodarapramāṇam avagāḍhaṃ vidhyet, tatra trapvādīnām anyatamasya nāḍīṃ dvidvārāṃ pakṣanāḍīṃ vā saṃyojya doṣodakam avasiñcet, tato nāḍīm apahṛtya tailalavaṇenābhyajya vraṇaṃ bandhenopacaret, na caikasminn eva divase sarvaṃ doṣodakam apaharet, sahasā hy apahṛte tṛṣṇājvarāṅgamardātīsāraśvāsakāsapādadāhā utpadyerann āpūryate vā bhṛśataram udaram asañjātaprāṇasya, tasmāt tṛtīyacaturthapañcamaṣaṣṭhāṣṭamadaśamadvādaśaṣoḍaśarātrāṇām anyatamam antarīkṛtya doṣodakam alpālpam avasiñcet; niḥsṛte ca doṣe gāḍhataram āvikakauśeyacarmaṇām anyatamena pariveṣṭayed udaraṃ, tathā nādhmāpayati vāyuḥ; ṣaṇmāsāṃś ca payasā bhojayej jāṅgalarasena vā, tatas trīn māsān ardhodakena payasā phalāmlena jāṅgalarasena vā, avaśiṣṭaṃ māsatrayam annaṃ laghu hitaṃ vā seveta, evaṃ saṃvatsareṇāgado bhavati ||18||

ṣaṇmāsānityādi| māsān ṣaḍyāvallaghu hitamannaṃ payasā kṣīreṇa bhojayet| kṣīreṇaivodakakāryaṃ kārayet, kaphavātādhikatvaṃ ca vīkṣya jāṅgalarasena bhojayet, rasenaivodakakāryaṃ, tata ūrdhvaṃ trīnmāsān ardhodakena payasā doṣāpekṣayā jāṅgalarasena vā laghu hitamannaṃ bhojayet, tābhyāmevodakakāryaṃ kārayet| avaśiṣṭaṃ ca māsatrayaṃ laghu hitamannaṃ bhojayet| udakenaivodakakāryam| carakamatānusāriṇā vāgbhaṭena kṣīreṇaiva ṣaṇmāsān vṛttirabhihitā, nānnapānīyābhyāṃ; tathā ca- “syāt kṣīravṛttiḥ ṣaṇmāsāṃstrīn peyāṃ payasā pibet| trīṃścānyān payasaivādyāt phalāmlena rasena vā|| alpaśaḥ snehalavaṇaṃ jīrṇaśyāmākakodravam” (vā. ci. 15) iti||18||

bhavati cātra-
āsthāpane caiva virecane ca pāne tathā''hāravidhikriyāsu |
sarvodaribhyaḥ kuśalaiḥ prayojyaṃ kṣīraṃ śṛtaṃ jāṅgalajo raso vā ||19||
kṛtakarmaṇo jalaniṣedhaṃ ‘jalaniṣedhārthaṃ coktau dvāvetau nirdiśannāha’ iti pā. tadabhāve coktaṃ dravaṃ nirdiśannāha- bhavatītyādi| cakāradvayakaraṇenodarapāṭanādāvanukte'pīti samuccīyate||19||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne udaracikitsitaṃ nāma caturdaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||14||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ||14||

div.head: mūḍhagarbhacikitsitam

ab.seg: athāto mūḍhagarbhacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

nāto 'nyat kaṣṭatamam asti yathā mūḍhagarbhaśalyoddharaṇam; atra hi yoniyakṛtplīhāntravivaragarbhāśayānāṃ madhye karma kartavyaṃ sparśena, utkarṣaṇāpakarṣaṇasthānāpavartanotkartanabhedanacchedanapīḍanarjūkaraṇadāraṇāni caikahastena garbhaṃ garbhiṇīṃ cāhiṃsatā, tasmād adhipatim āpṛcchya paraṃ ca yatnam āsthāyopakrameta ||3||

utkarṣaṇam adhogatasyordhvīkaraṇam, apakarṣaṇam ūrdhvagatasyādhaḥ karṣaṇaṃ, sthānāpavartanaṃ sthāneṣu saktasya garbhaśayyāta uttānasyāvāṅmukhīkaraṇam, udvartanam avāṅmukhasyottānīkaraṇam; atra kecit ‘sthānavyāvartanaṃ’ iti paṭhanti; tatra sthānaṃ sthitiḥ; sthāne garbhaśayyāyāṃ tiryagādisthitasyottānasyādhovyāvṛttyā sthāpanam; ūrdhvasya kasyacidaṅgasya chedanamutkartanaṃ, chedanamiti mṛtasya tu teṣu teṣu sthāneṣu saktasya tasya tasyāṅgasya chedanaṃ dvaidhīkaraṇaṃ, garbhakukṣyāderādhmātasya vidāraṇaṃ bhedanaṃ, pīḍanaṃ campanaṃ (valanam), ṛjūkaraṇaṃ vakrasya prāñjalīkaraṇaṃ, dāraṇaṃ vidāraṇam||1-3||
tatra samāsenāṣṭavidhā mūḍhagarbhagatir uddiṣṭā; svabhāvagatā api trayaḥ saṅgā bhavanti- śiraso vaiguṇyād aṃsayor jaghanasya vā ||4||
tatretyādi| śiraso vaiguṇyāt vakratvāt, aṃsayorjaghanasya ca vaiguṇyādityanuvartate; vaiguṇyaṃ vakratā| aṃso bāhuśiraḥ, jaghanaṃ kaṭeragrabhāgaḥ||4||

lg.l: nirhartum aśakye cyāvanān mantrān upaśṛṇuyāt; tān vakṣyāmaḥ ||5||
‘ihāmṛtaṃ ca somaś ca citrabhānuś ca bhāmini |
uccaiḥśravāś ca turago mandire nivasantu te ||6||
idam amṛtam apāṃ samuddhṛtaṃ vai tava laghu garbham imaṃ pramuñcatu stri |
tad analapavanārkavāsavās te saha lavaṇāmbudharair diśantu śāntim ||7||
muktāḥ paśor vipāśāś ca ‘muktāḥ pāśā vipāśāśca muktāḥ sūryenduraśmayaḥ| muktaḥ sarvabhayādgarbha ehyehi māciraṃ svāhā’ iti pā. muktāḥ sūryeṇa raśmayaḥ |
muktaḥ sarvabhayād garbha ehy ehi viramāvitaḥ ||8||

ab.seg: jīvatītyādi| prayateta yatnaṃ kurvīta| kecidācāryā mantravyākhyānaṃ na kurvanti, kecit kurvanti tadāha- ihetyādi| amṛtaṃ samudramanthanodbhūtaṃ, citrabhānurādityaḥ, bhāmini he varastri, uccaiḥśravā amṛtamanthanotpannasturagaḥ śakravāhanaḥ, laghu śīghraṃ, diśantu prayacchantu||5-8||

auṣadhāni ca vidadhyād yathoktāni | mṛte cottānāyā ābhugnasakthyā vastrādhārakonnamitakaṭyā dhanvananagavṛttikāśālmalīmṛtsnaghṛtābhyāṃ ‘śālmalīṣu madhye marudeśīyaparvatasthā hi nitarāṃ picchilaniryāsā bhavanti, tadidamucyate-dhanveti| dhanvā marudeśaḥ, mṛtsnamatra picchilo bhāgaḥ| ‘viviktaṃ mṛtsnaṃ ca’ ityojolakṣaṇaṃ ca| tantrāntare'pyuktaṃ-‘hastamabhyajya yoniṃ ca sājyaśālmalipicchayā’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ| ‘dhanvanagavṛttikaśālmalīmṛtsnaghṛtābhyāṃ’ iti hārāṇacandrasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ mrakṣayitvā hastaṃ yonau praveśya garbham upaharet | tatra sakthibhyām āgatam anulomam evāñchet, ekasakthnā pratipannasyetarasakthi prasāryāpaharet, sphigdeśenāgatasya sphigdeśaṃ prapīḍyordhvam utkṣipya sakthinī prasāryāpaharet, tiryag āgatasya parighasyeva tiraścīnasya paścād ardham ūrdhvam utkṣipya pūrvārdham apatyapathaṃ pratyārjavam ānīyāpaharet, pārśvāpavṛttaśirasam aṃsaṃ prapīḍyordhvam utkṣipya śiro 'patyapatham ānīyāpaharet, bāhudvayapratipannasyordhvam utpīḍyāṃsau śiro 'nulomam ānīyāpaharet, dvāv antyāv asādhyau mūḍhagarbhau, evam aśakye śastram avacārayet ||9||

lg.l: sacetanaṃ ca śastreṇa na kathañcana dārayet |
dāryamāṇo hi jananīm ātmānaṃ caiva ghātayet ||10||
aviṣahye vikāre tu śreyo garbhasya pātanam |
na garbhiṇyā viparyāsas tasmāt prāptaṃ na hāpayet ||11||

ab.seg: mantrānnirdiśyauṣadhāni nirdiśannāha- auṣadhānītyādi| tāni punaḥ śārīre aparāpātanoditāni pāṇipādalepā yonidhūpanamāturapānādikaṃ ca| niṣphale mantre tantre ‘jalavyāpāre’ iti pā. ca vṛthābhūteṣu sūtījanavyāpāreṣu bhiṣajāṃ śalyāharaṇopāyaṃ nirdiśannāha- mṛte ceti| cakārādaphalībhūteṣu mantratantraprasūtījananavyāpāreṣu jīvatyapītyanuktaṃ samuccinoti| ābhugnasakthyā iti saṅkucitasakthyāḥ| dhanvano dhanurvṛkṣo badarīsadṛśapatraḥ, nagavṛttikā śallakī, yadyapi mṛtsnaśabdaḥpraśastāyāṃ mṛdi vartate tathā'pyatra dhanurvṛkṣaśallakīśālmalīnāṃ picchile cumpe mṛtsnaśabdo boddhavyaḥ| ghṛtaṃ gavyaṃ ghṛtaṃ, tābhyāṃ pāṇiṃ mrakṣayitvā vilipya, mūḍhagarbhamapaharediti sāmānyo vidhiḥ| mṛtaṃ ceti cakārādapaharaṇe viśeṣeṇa vidhimāha- tatretyādi| āñchet ākarṣet| ekasakthneti prathamamekasakthipratipannaṃ, dvitīyasakthi punarābhugnaṃ sthitvā''gatamityarthaḥ, tadapi prasārya praguṇībhūtasakthidvayamapaharaṇārthamāñchediti pūrvasmādviśeṣaḥ; sakthi jaṅghocyate, ayaṃ dvitīyaḥ| sphigityādi| ayaṃ tṛtīyaḥ| tiryagityādi| parigho'rgalādaṇḍaḥ| ārjavamānīya ṛjubhāvamānīyāpaharediti, ayaṃ caturthaḥ| pārśvetyādi| pārśvāpavṛttaṃ pārśvavalitaṃ śiro yasya, apatyapatho yoniḥ; ayaṃ pañcamaḥ| bāhudvayetyādi| ayaṃ ṣaṣṭhaḥ| tatra ādyaṃ mūḍhagarbhatritayaṃ pādābhyāmāharaṇīyaṃ, taditarattu tritayaṃ śirasā, dvāviti śeṣaṃ tu mūḍhagarbhadvayamasādhyam, evamaṣṭau mūḍhagarbhāḥ| dāryamāṇaḥ chidyamāno garbho mātaramātmānaṃ ca vyāpādayet| ghātayediti sarvathaivāśakyahastākarṣe dvayorapi garbhagarbhiṇyorvipattisiddheḥ| śastramantrādinopāyenāsiddhau garbhacyāvanaṃ garbhiṇīrakṣārthaṃ kāryamityāha- aviṣahya iti| soḍhumaśakye vikāre vyādhau sati kiṃ kartavyamityāha- śreyo garbhasyeti; śreyo bhavatītyarthaḥ| garbhapātanaphalamāha- na garbhiṇyā viparyāsa iti; viparyāso mṛtyurityarthaḥ| tasmāt prāptakālaṃ na hāpayet nollaṅghayedityarthaḥ||9-11||

tataḥ striyam āśvāsya maṇḍalāgreṇāṅgulīśastreṇa vā śiro vidārya, śiraḥkapālāny āhṛtya, śaṅkunā gṛhītvorasi kakṣāyāṃ vā 'paharet; abhinnaśirasam akṣikūṭe gaṇḍe vā, aṃsasaṃsaktasyāṃsadeśe bāhū chittvā, dṛtim ivātataṃ vātapūrṇodaraṃ vā vidārya nirasyāntrāṇi śithilībhūtam āharet, jaghanasaktasya vā jaghanakapālānīti ||12||

lg.l: kim bahunā- yad yad aṅgaṃ hi garbhasya tasya sajjati tad bhiṣak |
samyag vinirharec chittvā rakṣen nārīṃ ca yatnataḥ ||13||
nopekṣeta mṛtaṃ garbhaṃ muhūrtam api paṇḍitaḥ |
sa hy āśu jananīṃ hanti nirucchvāsaṃ paśuṃ yathā ||15||
vṛddhipatraṃ hi tīkṣṇāgraṃ nārīṃ hiṃsyāt kadācana ||16||
dhunuyāc ca muhur nārīṃ pīḍayed vā ṃ'sapiṇḍikām hārāṇacandrastu ‘svedayedvā sapiṇḍikāṃ’ iti paṭhati, ‘sapiṇḍikāmaparāsannihitamāṃsapiṇḍikāsahitāmaparāmityarthaḥ’ iti ca vyākhyāti|
tailāktayoner evaṃ tāṃ pātayen matimān bhiṣak ||18||
evaṃ nirhṛtaśalyāṃ tu siñced uṣṇena vāriṇā |
evaṃ mṛdvī bhaved yonis tac chūlaṃ copaśāmyati |20|

div.ab: mṛte tu garbhe śastrāvacaraṇaṃ nirdiśannāha- tata iti| maṇḍalāgreṇāṅgulīśastreṇeti antarmukhasañjñitena kṛśataraśaśadharakānukāriṇā'rdhadvayasaṃhitamadhyakīlitena madhyamāṅgulyaṅguṣṭhapraviṣṭalohakaṭakaniyamitena, anye punarekāvayavena madhyamāṅgulīpraviṣṭalohakaṇṭakenetyāhuḥ| taddhi śastramantadvāraṃ hastāntargataṃ yonau supradeśapraveśitamapi sukhacchedakaraṃ garbhiṇīṃ na hinasti| śaṅkunā ākuñcitākāreṇa baḍiśaviśeṣeṇa samyaggṛhītaṃ hṛdaye kakṣe vā'paharet| śirasaḥ punaravaiguṇyena nirgataśiraso vipulāṃsadeśasaktasya vidhimupadiśannāha- abhinnaśirasamiti; kūṭe gaṇḍe vā saṅgṛhya śaṅkunā'paharaṇam| mṛtasyādhmātodarasya kramāgatamudarasaṅgaṃ nirdiśannāha- dṛtimivetyādi|- dṛtiḥ pānīyapūrṇakhallī| jaghanasaktasyetyādi|- jaghanasaktaṃ jaghanakapālāni vidārya, apahṛtyāpaharet| evamuddiṣṭānāmāharaṇopāyaṃ nirdiśyānuktānāmapi nānāprakārāṇāṃ nirdiśati- garbhasyetyādi| mṛte tu doṣaṃ nirdiśannāha- nopekṣetetyādi| saḥ garbhaḥ, hi yasmādarthe| maṇḍalāgreṇeti maṇḍalāgrāvacāraṇamuktamapi vṛddhipatraniṣedhopadeśārthaṃ punarucyate| athāpatantīmityādi| aparāṃ garbhāvaraṇaṃ jarāyusañjñaṃ yaṃ lokā āvalamityācakṣate| pūrvavat śārīroktavidhinā||12-19||-

lg.l: vacām ativiṣāṃ rāsnāṃ cavyaṃ sañcūrṇya pāyayet |
kvāthaṃ caiṣāṃ tathā kalkaṃ cūrṇaṃ vā snehavarjitam |
tathā tejovatīṃ cāpi pāyayet pūrvavad bhiṣak |
trirātraṃ pañcasaptāhaṃ ‘trirātramevaṃ saptāhaṃ’ iti pā. tataḥ snehaṃ punaḥ pibet ||23||
pāyayet āsavaṃ naktam ariṣṭaṃ vā susaṃskṛtam |
upadravāś ca ye 'nye syus tān yathāsvam upācaret |
payo vātaharaiḥ siddhaṃ daśāhaṃ bhojane hitam ||26||
rasaṃ daśāhaṃ śeṣe tu yathāyogam upācaret |
vyupadravāṃ viśuddhāṃ ca jñātvā ca varavarṇinīm ||27||

div.ab: vyavasthitavikalpā hyete deśaprakṛtisātmyāpekṣayā| kṛṣṇā pippalī, tanmūlaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ, dīpyakaḥ ajamodā| prasavakāla eva jātamūḍhagarbhāyāḥ kṛtakarmaṇā'pahṛtāparāyāḥ pārśvayoniśūlakāṭhinyaśāntyarthaṃ raktakledādidoṣaprasekārthaṃ ca tailāktayonestailena kṛṣṇādipānam; akālamūḍhagarbhāyāstu laṅghitāyāḥ punarannakāle uddālakādīnāmannānāmasnehalavaṇābhiryavāgūbhirupacāro yāvanto māsā garbhasya tāvantyevāhāni; anantaramāse tu snehādividhānamakālamūḍhagarbhāyā api pūrvavat| śākaḥ karkaśapatravṛkṣaḥ, ‘sāgavana’ iti loke| trirātramityādi|- evaṃ trirātraṃ kṛṣṇādicūrṇapānena śākatvagādicūrṇapānena vā''hṛtakoṣṭharaktakledādidoṣāyāḥ saptāhaṃ hrasvamātrayā snehapānam| tena viśuddhavātāśayāyā daśāhādūrdhvaṃ snigdhapathyālpabhojanam| tatra nityaṃ bāhyāvapi svedābhyaṅgāvavaśyaṃ kāryau, tatra dvitīyadaśāhe vātaharasiddhaṃ payo vakṣyamāṇaṃ, tṛtīye māṃsarasaḥ| kakubhaḥ sugandhimūlo viṭapaḥ| ācamanasnānādau ṣaḍaṅgakalpanākalpitaśirīṣakakubhasalilam| upadravā iti upadravā vātarogajvarādyāḥ| vātaharaiḥ śatapuṣpādibhiḥ| yathāyogamiti sātmyādyapakṣayeti bhāvaḥ||20-27||-

lg.l: aṣṭāv aṣṭau śubhā bhāgās tailād ekas tad ekataḥ ||30||
māṃsīṃ śaileyakaṃ patraṃ tagaraṃ sārivāṃ vacām ||32||
tat sādhusiddhaṃ sauvarṇe rājate mṛnmaye 'pi vā ||33||
yā ca garbhārthinī nārī kṣīṇaśukraś ca yaḥ pumān ||35||
hikkāṃ kāsam adhīmanthaṃ gulmaṃ śvāsaṃ ca dustaram ||37||
rājñām etad dhi kartavyaṃ rājamātrāś ca ye narāḥ |
sukhinaḥ sukumārāś ca dhaninaś cāpi ye narāḥ ||39||

ab.seg: balāmūlakvāthasya tathā daśamūlakvāthasya yavakolakulatthānāṃ kvāthasya payasaśca pratyekamaṣṭāvaṣṭau bhāgāḥ, ekaḥ snehāt; evaṃ snehāddvātriṃśadguṇo dravaḥ, snehacaturthāṃśo bheṣajakalkaḥ| madhuraḥ kākolyādigaṇaḥ| kālānusārivā kṛṣṇasārivā, ‘kālānusāri vā’ ityatra kecidācāryā asmin taile kṣīraśuklakaṃ paṭhanti, kṣīraśuklakaṃ kṣīravidārī| svanugupte nirupadravasthāne| adhīmanthaḥ akṣirogo'bhiṣyandapūrvakaḥ| ṣaṇmāsopayogāt kośamaprāptāmantravṛddhiṃ hanti, kośaprāptāṃ punarantravṛddhimasādhyāmāhuḥ||28-39||

lg.l: tailam utpādya tat kvāthaśatapākaṃ ‘tatkvāthaśatapātaṃ śṛtaṃ’ iti pā. kṛtaṃ śubham ||40||
śataṃ śataṃ tathotkarṣo droṇe droṇe prakīrtitaḥ ||43||

ab.seg: balātailānantaraṃ balāsaṃskāreṇa śatapākavidhānamāha- baletyādi| pītebhyo bhāvitebhyaḥ saptakṛtvaḥ| tilatulyabalāmūlāṣṭaguṇasalilāṣṭāṃśaśeṣitakaṣāyabhāvitānāṃ tilānāṃ tailamādāya tatkvāthaṃ balākvāthaṃ sāmānyakvāthaparibhāṣārthakṛtakvāthena caturguṇena śataśaḥ pacet; tat kvathaṃ tatkalkameva vetyeke; pūrvabalātailasamuddiṣṭairmadhurādikalkairevetyanye||40-43||

lg.l: tailāni madhuke kuryāt prasāriṇyāṃ ca buddhimān |45|

div.ab: uktabalātailadvayakalpena saṅkṣepārthaṃ dravyāntareṣvatideśamuddiśannāha- baletyādi| ādityaparṇī sūryāvartaḥ| vīrataruḥ svanāmaprasiddhaḥ, arjuna ityeke, kokilākṣa ityapare| atibalāditaileṣu ca balātailoktakalkaprakṣepaḥ; athavā'tibalādīnāmeva kvāthakalkābhyāṃ tailāni paktavyānīti||44||-

lg.l: śatapākaṃ tatas tena tilatailaṃ paced bhiṣak |
balātailasya kalkāṃs tu supiṣṭāṃs tatra dāpayet ||46||

ab.seg: nīlotpalamityādi| varī śatāvarī||45-47||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne mūḍhagarbhacikitsitaṃ nāma pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||15||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ||15||

div.head: vidradhicikitsitam

ab.seg: athāto vidradhīnāṃ cikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

lg.l: uktā vidradhayaḥ ṣaḍ ye teṣv asādhyas tu sarvajaḥ |
śeṣeṣv āmeṣu kartavyā tvaritaṃ śophavat kriyā ||3||

ab.seg: ṣaḍgrahaṇaṃ dvandvajavidradhiniṣedhārtham| punarasādhyakīrtanaṃ cikitsāprakramatvāttadupakramaniṣedhārtham| śeṣeṣu pañcasu śophavat kriyeti sā punarapatarpaṇādyā virecanāntaikādaśavidhā||1-3||

lg.l: svedayet satataṃ cāpi nirharec cāpi śoṇitam ||6||
sa ced evam upakrāntaḥ pākāyābhimukho yadi |
taṃ pācayitvā śastreṇa bhindyād bhinnaṃ ca śodhayet ‘buddhimān’ iti pā.||7||

ab.seg: vātaghnetyādi| vātaghnāni bhadradārvādīni, anye tu vātaghnaḥ śobhāñjanakaḥ| ‘muraṅgīmūlakalkaiḥ’ ityanye paṭhanti; muraṅgī śobhāñjanakaḥ| sānūpetyādi ayaṃ sālvaṇaprakāraḥ| ānūpā mahiṣādayaḥ, audakāḥ kośasthādayaḥ, tarpayatīti tarpaṇaṃ, vātapittaharā vidārigandhādayaḥ, snehāḥ sarva eva, amlāni ca| lavaṇaiḥ saṃskṛto lavaṇaḥ| veśavārairityādi| veśavāraḥ saṃskṛtamāṃsaviśeṣaḥ| kṛśarā tilataṇḍulamāṣakṛtā yavāgūḥ| kṣīrasiddhāstaṇḍulāḥ pāyasaḥ| lavaṇottarairiti lavaṇapramukhaistailairityarthaḥ| bhadrādi bhadradārvādi| vairecaniketyādi| vairecanikayukteneti cūrṇīkṛtatrivṛdādimiśreṇa; gayī tu vairecanikayuktena siddheneti vyākhyānayati| traivṛtena snehena| tailaghṛtasnehāni pṛthakparṇyādīni ropaṇaghṛtasādhane miśrakoktāni||4-9||

lg.l: pākyaiḥ śītakaṣāyair vā kṣīrair ikṣurasais tathā |
jalaukobhir harec cāsṛk pakvaṃ cāpāṭya buddhimān ||12||

div.ab: paittikamityādi| pradihyāt limpet| payasyā kṣīrakākolī, jejjaṭācāryastvarkapuṣpīmāha| pākyaiḥ kvathitakaṣāyaiḥ| śītakaṣāyalakṣaṇamāha “dravyamāpothitaṃ samyagatyuṣṇodakasaṃsthitam| rātriparyuṣitaṃ śītakaṣāyaṃ phāṇitaṃ (?) viduḥ” iti| jīvanīyaiḥ kākolyādibhiḥ siddhāni jīvanīyaghṛtāni| secayet pariṣecayet| dāhavedanopaśamārthaṃ virecanamāha- trivṛdityādi| kṣīravṛkṣetyādi kṣīravṛkṣā nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaplakṣagardabhāṇḍāḥ| audakāni kamalakumudakalhāraprabhṛtīni| kṛtaṃ sarpiḥ saṃskṛtaṃ sarpiḥ| kṣīretyādi kṣīraśuklā kṣīravidārī| samaṅgā mañjiṣṭhā ‘añjalikārikā’ iti pā., varāhakrāntetyapare| nyagrodhādirdravyasaṅgrahaṇīye paṭhitaḥ; pravālāḥ pallavāḥ||10-15||-

lg.l: priyaṅguḥ kuśamūlaṃ ca niculasya tvag eva ca |
sadyaś chinnavraṇānāṃ ca karañjādyam idaṃ śubham |
duṣṭavraṇāś ca ye kecid ye cotsṛṣṭakriyā vraṇāḥ ||20||
nāḍyo gambhīrikā yāś ca sadyaś chinnās tathaiva ca |
agnikṣārakṛtāś caiva ye vraṇā dāruṇā api ||21||
karañjādyena haviṣā praśāmyanti ‘praṇaśyanti’ iti pā. na saṃśayaḥ |22|

div.ab: naktamālasyetyādi| taruṇāni tatkālotpannāni, āmānītyarthaḥ| sumanā jātī| niculo vetasaḥ| kecidenamanārṣaṃ vadanti, tannecchati gayī, tasmānmayā'pyaṅgīkṛtaḥ||16-21||-

lg.l: mūtrair uṣṇaiś ca satataṃ svedayec chleṣmavidradhim |
hared doṣān abhīkṣṇaṃ cāpy alābvā 'sṛk tathaiva ca |
pūrayitvā vraṇaṃ samyag badhnīyāt kīrtitaṃ yathā ||25||
kuryāt tailaṃ sagomūtraṃ hitaṃ tatra sasaindhavam ||26||
anayor vargayoḥ siddhaṃ sarpir vairecanena ca |
acirād vidradhiṃ hanti prātaḥ prātar niṣevitam ||29||
ebhir eva gaṇaiś cāpi saṃsiddhaṃ snehasaṃyutam |
pradhānaṃ guggulaṃ cāpi śuṇṭhīṃ ca suradāru ca |
snehopanāhau kuryāc ca sadā cāpy anulomanam ||33||

ab.seg: iṣṭaketyādi| pāṃśurdhūliḥ| gomūtreṇa dravasvedaḥ| kaṣāyetyādi| badhnīyāt kīrtitaṃ yatheti “ghanena vāsasā ślaiṣmikaṃ gāḍhasthāne gāḍhataram” (sū. 18) iti| kulatthikā cakṣuṣyā| idānīṃ raktāgantunimittayoravasaraḥ; anayoruttarayorvaruṇāderūṣakādeśca (?); tatra varuṇādeḥ kaṣāyaḥ, ūṣakādeḥ kalkaḥ, teṣāṃ lavaṇatvena kaṣāyakalpanāyā duḥśakatvāt| trivṛdādīnāmapi kṛtena kaṣāyeṇa tadeva sarpiriti cakārāt| prātaḥ prātariti vīpsayedaṃ jñāpayati- abhyāsena niṣevitaṃ sarpirvidradhiṃ hantīti| varuṇādigaṇakvāthamityādyupacāro'bhyantare, bāhye tu vidradhāvamarmajāte pācanapāṭanaśodhanādyupacāraḥ karaṇīya iti| ebhirityādi|- ebhireva gaṇairvaruṇādivairecanikaiḥ; atrāpi varuṇādivairecanikau kaṣāyatayā prayojyau, ūṣakādiśca kalkatayā| pānetyādi| svabhāvata evāmavidradhipratyanīko madhuśigruḥ, kaṣāyapānādiṣu tasya tu doṣasya pratyanīkatvārthaṃ doṣānatikrameṇa vraṇahitavātapittakaphaharadravyaprakṣepaḥ| toyetyādi|- toyādibhiḥ surāntairyathādoṣaṃ sa eva madhuśigruriti; tatra toyena pittavidradhau, dhānyāmlena vātavidradhau, mūtreṇa kaphavidradhau, avidagdhe punā rakte surādibhirnānyatra| yathetyādi|- yathādoṣagaṇakvāthairiti vātādipratyanīkairityarthaḥ| pradhānaṃ guggulaṃ mahiṣākhyamityarthaḥ, pradhānaṃ medoharatvādvidradhau śreṣṭhamityanye| tatra guggulukalpena vātike devadāru, ślaiṣmike śuṇṭhīti| snehopanāhānulomanādīni bāhyavātapittakaphavidradhiviṣayāṇi prāguktānyabhyantare'pi vidradhau yathādauṣaṃ vibhajya yojyāni||22-33||

lg.l: yathoddiṣṭāṃ sirāṃ vidhyet kaphaje vidradhau bhiṣak |

ab.seg: antarvidradhau dūṣyaśoṇitasya gambhīrānugatatvāttatra sirāvyadhamuddiśannāha- yathetyādi|- yathoddiṣṭāmiti “vāmapārśva kakṣāstanayorantare'ntarvidradhau pārśvaśūle ca’ (śā. 8) iti| tena kakṣāntarāśrayadeśasyādhaḥ stanayorupariṣṭāt pārśvaviśeṣe kaphavidradhau| raktapittānilottheṣu bāhau kecidāhuḥ; bāhau bāhumadhye kūrpare, tena sthānāntarāśrayamekīyamatam||34||

lg.l: pakvaṃ vā bahir unnaddhaṃ bhittvā vraṇavad ācaret |
prātaḥ prātaś ca seveta mātrayā tailvakaṃ ghṛtam ||37||

div.ab: pakvamityādi| surāsavayoḥ pratyekaṃ niṣpāditayorekīkṛtya punaḥ sandhānaṃ maireyaḥ, amlaṃ kāñjikaṃ, surā piṣṭamayī, dravapradhāna āsavaḥ| śigrvityādi| atra saṃskārya eva siddhārthaprakṣepaḥ| mātrayā alpaśa ityarthaḥ| tailvakaṃ ghṛtaṃ vātavyādhau paṭhitam| trivṛtetyādi siddhaṃ sarpirityanuvartate||35-37||-

lg.l: paryāgate vidradhau tu siddhir naikāntikī smṛtā |39|

div.ab: prayateta prayatnaṃ kurvīta| paryāgate paripākamāgate na siddhiḥ||38||-

lg.l: pratyākhyāya tu kurvīta majjajāte tu vidradhau ||39||
vidradhyuktāṃ kriyāṃ kuryāt pakve vā 'sthi tu bhedayet ||40||
dhāvet tiktakaṣāyeṇa tiktaṃ sarpis tathā hitam ||41||

ab.seg: paraṃ majjavidradhau pratyākhyāya tu kurvīteti ‘cikitsām’ ityadhyāhāraḥ| kāṃ cikitsāṃ kurvītetyāśaṅkyāha- snehasvedopapannānāmityādi| tiniḥ tinisaḥ, ekadeśenāpi samudāyo budhyate; yathā- satyā satyabhāmā, bhīmo bhīmasena iti||39-43||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne vidradhicikitsitaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||16||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ||16||

div.head: visarpanāḍīstanarogacikitsitam

ab.seg: athāto visarpanāḍīstanarogacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

lg.l: sādhyā visarpās traya ādito ye na sannipātakṣatajau hi sādhyau |3|

div.ab: sādhyā ityādi| sādhyāsādhyavibhāgakaraṇaṃ punaścikitsitaprakramāt||1-2||-

lg.l: sādhyeṣu tatpathyagaṇair vidadhyād ghṛtāni sekāṃś ca tathopadehān ||3||

ab.seg: teṣāṃ sarveṣāmeva sāmānyacikitsitasūtraṃ nirdiśannāha- sādhyeṣvityādi| tatpathyagaṇairyathākramaṃ vātapittakaphajeṣu vātādidoṣaharagaṇaiḥ||3||

lg.l: vātātmake coṣṇagaṇāḥ prayojyāḥ sekeṣu lepeṣu tathā śṛteṣu ‘ghṛteṣu’ iti pā.||4||
yat pañcamūlaṃ khalu kaṇṭakākhyam alpaṃ mahac cāpy atha vallijaṃ ca |
tac copayojyaṃ bhiṣajā pradehe seke ghṛte cāpi tathaiva taile ||5||

ab.seg: mustetyādi| kṛṣṇagandhā śobhāñjanakaḥ, śamītyapare| uṣṇagaṇā bhadradārvādayaḥ pippalyādayaśca| yadityādi tṛṇākhyaṃ pañcamūlamapahāya śeṣāṇi catvāri pañcamūlāni grāhyāṇi||4-5||

lg.l: vastrāntarāḥ pittakṛte visarpe lepā vidheyāḥ saghṛtāḥ suśītāḥ ||6||
kṣīreṇa piṣṭāḥ saghṛtāḥ suśītā lepāḥ prayojyās tanavaḥ sukhāya ||7||
prapauṇḍarīkaṃ madhukaṃ payasyā mañjiṣṭhikā padmakacandane ca |
sugandhikā ceti sukhāya lepaḥ paitte visarpe bhiṣajā prayojyaḥ ||8||
nyagrodhavargaiḥ pariṣecanaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ ca kuryāt svarasena tasya |
śītaiḥ payobhiś ca madhūdakaiś ca saśarkarair ikṣurasaiś ca sekān ||9||

ab.seg: pittavisarpacikitsitamāha- kaservityādi| śṛṅgāṭakaṃ jalamadhye trikaṇṭakam| gundrā paharakabhedaḥ| saśaivalāḥ śaivālayuktā ityarthaḥ| kardamaḥ paṅka ityarthaḥ| vastrāntarā vastreṇāntarīkṛtāḥ, te hi sukhenāpanetuṃ śakyante| hrīveretyādi hrīveraḥ vālakam| lāmajjaka uśīramūlam ‘uśīrabhedaḥ’ iti pā.| srotojaṃ sauvīrāñjanam| tanavaḥ acchāḥ| sukhāyeti tanutvānnoṣmāṇamantaḥ praveśayatītyarthaḥ| śrīvāgbhaṭa āha- “ślakṣṇaśuṣkaghano ‘ślakṣṇapiṣṭo ghano’ iti pā. lepaścandanasyāpi dāhakṛt| tvaggatasyoṣmaṇo rodhācchītakṛccānyathā'guroḥ”- iti| prapauṇḍarīkamityādi payasyā kṣīravidārī ‘kṣīra kākolī’ iti pā.; jejjaṭācāryastu arkapuṣpīmāha| sugandhikā utpalasārivā| nyagrodhetyādi| madhūdakaṃ madhumiśramudakam||6-9||

lg.l: kalkīkṛtāsūdakam atra dattvā nyagrodhavargasya tathā sthirādeḥ ||11||
gaṇasya bilvādikapañcamūlyāś caturguṇaṃ kṣīram athāpi tadvat |
prasthaṃ vipakvaṃ pariṣecanena paittīr nihanyāt tu visarpanāḍīḥ ||12||
grahārdite śoṣiṇi cāpi bāle ghṛtaṃ hi gauryādikam etad iṣṭam ||13||

ab.seg: gauryādighṛtamāha- ghṛtasyetyādi| gaurī haridrā, gorocanetyanye| aravindaṃ padmam| ambu vālakam| rājādanaṃ kṣīrikā| ṛṣabhaḥ kūrcaśīrṣakaḥ svanāmaprasiddhaḥ| madhunaḥ śarkarā madhuśarkarā| sthirā śālaparṇī| gauryādiśatāhvāntānāṃ kalkīkṛtānāṃ catvāri palāni, nyagrodhādervidārigandhādermahato'pi pañcamūlasya trayāṇāmudakaṃ kvāthaṃ caturguṇaṃ ghṛtasya, kṣīramapi gavyaṃ caturguṇamiti; prasthaṃ ghṛtasyeti dvātriṃśatpalāni dravadravyatvāt; anye punaḥ kalkamānamaṣṭapalamāhuḥ||10-13||

lg.l: ajā 'śvagandhā saralā sakālā saikaiṣikā cāpy athavā 'jaśṛṅgī |
gomūtrapiṣṭo vihitaḥ pradeho hanyād visarpaṃ kaphajaṃ sa śīghram ||14||

ab.seg: kaphavisarpacikitsāmāha- ajetyādi| ajā ajagandhā ‘bobaī’ iti loke| saralā trivṛt| kālā kāsamardaḥ ‘kaṭuhiṃsrā’ iti pā.| ekaiṣikā śatāvarī ‘ambuṣakī ‘sākuraṇḍa’ iti loke’ iti pā., anye trivṛdbhedamāhuḥ| ajaśṛṅgī chāgalaviṣāṇikā, ‘uttamāraṇī’ iti loke; gayadāsācāryeṇa karkaṭaśṛṅgī vyākhyātā| kālānusāryetyādi- kālānusāryā tagaraṃ, cocaḥ tvak, guñjā cirahiṇṭikā, śītaśivaṃ śatapuṣpābhedaḥ, indraparṇī indravāruṇī, atra gayadāsācāryeṇa indrapuṣpī paṭhitā vyākhyātā ca; indrapuṣpī lāṅgalakī| pālindiḥ kālavallī, muñjāta uttarāpathajaḥ svalpakandaḥ, mahīkadambo'lambuṣā muṇḍitiketi loke, jejjaṭācāryo bhūkadambamāha||14-15||

lg.l: gaṇas tu yojyo varuṇapravṛttaḥ kriyāsu sarvāsu vicakṣaṇena |
saṃśodhanaṃ śoṇitamokṣaṇaṃ ca śreṣṭhaṃ visarpeṣu cikitsitaṃ hi ||16||
sarvāṃś ca pakvān pariśodhya dhīmān vraṇakrameṇopacared yathoktam |17|

div.ab: gaṇa ityādi| varuṇapravṛtto gaṇo varuṇādiḥ| kriyāsu sarvāsu pānādikāsu| ārambhe sarveṣāṃ sāmānyacikitsite saṃśamanamabhidhāya samprāptau saṃśodhanamuddiśannāha- saṃśodhanamityādi| raktāvasecanaṃ jalaukābhiḥ, sarveṣāmeva raktapittapradhānatvādalābuśṛṅgayostatra duravacāratvāt||16||-

lg.l: nāḍī tridoṣaprabhavā na sidhyec cheṣāś catasraḥ khalu ‘pratiyatnasādhyāḥ’ iti pā. yatnasādhyāḥ ||17||
tatrānilotthām upanāhya pūrvam aśeṣataḥ pūyagatiṃ vidārya |
tilair apāmārgaphalaiś ca piṣṭvā sasaindhavair bandhanam atra kuryāt ||18||
prakṣālane cāpi sadā vraṇasya yojyaṃ mahad yat khalu pañcamūlam |
hiṃsrāṃ haridrāṃ kaṭukāṃ balāṃ ca gojihvikāṃ cāpi sabilvamūlām ||19||
saṃhṛtya tailaṃ vipaced vraṇasya saṃśodhanaṃ pūraṇaropaṇaṃ ca |20|

div.ab: nāḍīnāmavasaraḥ- nāḍītyādi| tatretyādi| upanāhya pācanadravyairavabaddhvā; tannecchati gayī, kasmāt? nāḍīvacanāt, nahyapakve vraṇe nāḍīti; tasmādvātaharadravyairevopanāhaḥ| prakṣālana ityādi| saṃhṛtya ekīkṛtya| snehacaturthāṃśo bheṣajakalkaḥ, snehāccaturguṇo dravaḥ, anena nyāyena paktavyam| dravo'tra jalam, “anukte dravakārye tu sarvatra salilaṃ smṛtam” (ci. 31) iti vacanāt||17-19||-

lg.l: pittātmikāṃ prāg upanāhya dhīmān utkārikābhiḥ sapayoghṛtābhiḥ ||20||
prakṣālane cāpi sasomanimbā niśā prayojyā kuśalena nityam ||21||

ab.seg: pittetyādi| utkārikābhiḥ lapsikābhiḥ| nāgadantī dantī| somaḥ somasañjñaḥ ‘trisañjñakā’ iti pā., somalatetyanye; kaṭphala iti jejjaṭācāryaḥ; tannecchati gayī, tasya tīkṣṇoṣṇatvāt||20-21||

lg.l: ghṛtaṃ sadugdhaṃ vraṇatarpaṇena hanyād gatiṃ koṣṭhagatā 'pi yā syāt ||22||

ab.seg: śyāmetyādi|- śyāmā vṛddhadārukaḥ| tribhaṇḍī trivṛt| vṛkṣakaḥ kuṭajaḥ||22||

lg.l: mṛdūkṛtām eṣya gatiṃ viditvā nipātayec chastram aśeṣakārī ||23||
dadyād vraṇe nimbatilān sadantīn ‘supiṣṭān’ iti pā. surāṣṭrajāsaindhavasamprayuktān |
phaleṣv apāmārgabhaveṣu caiva kuryāt samūtreṣu hitāya tailam ||25||

ab.seg: nāḍīmityādi| kiṇvaḥ surābījam| aśeṣakārī vaidyaḥ| dadyādityādi| surāṣṭrajā tuvaramṛttikā| prakṣālane ityādi| nikumbho dantī| tālītalaṃ muśalīmūlaṃ ‘bhūmyāmalakamūlaṃ’ iti pā.; nalamityanye paṭhanti, tatra nalaḥ śuṣiraparvā svanāmaprasiddhaḥ| rūpikā śvetārkaḥ| ‘nīlīphalarūpikābhiḥ’ iti kecit paṭhanti; nīlīphalaṃ śāradaṃ phalaṃ, śrīphaliketi loke||23-25||

lg.l: nāḍīṃ tu śalyaprabhavāṃ vidārya nirhṛtya śalyaṃ praviśodhya mārgam |
saṃśodhayet kṣaudraghṛtapragāḍhais tilais tato ropaṇam āśu kuryāt ||26||
kṛtvā kaṣāyaṃ vipacet tu tailam āvāpya mustāsaralāpriyaṅgūḥ ||27||
sugandhikāmocarasāhipuṣpaṃ rodhraṃ vidadhyād api dhātakīṃ ca |
etena śalyaprabhavā tu nāḍī rohed vraṇo vā sukhamāśu caiva ||28||

ab.seg: nāḍīmityādi| kumbhīkaḥ sthalakumbhikā, vanaspatayo vaṭādyāḥ, kumbhikādīnāṃ śalāṭūni komalaphalāni grāhyāṇi| saralā trivṛt| sugandhikā utpalasārivā| mocarasaḥ śālmalīcumpaḥ| ahipuṣpaṃ nāgakeśaram||26-28||

lg.l: kṣārasūtreṇa tāṃ cchindyān na tu śastreṇa buddhimān ||29||
tataḥ kṣārabalaṃ vīkṣya sūtram anyat praveśayet ||31||
kṣārāktaṃ matimān vaidyo yāvan na chidyate ‘klidyate’ iti pā. gatiḥ |
bhagandare 'py eṣa vidhiḥ kāryo vaidyena jānatā ||32||
mūle sūtreṇa badhnīyāc chinne copacared vraṇam ||33||

ab.seg: kṛśetyādi| kṣārasūtreṇa kṣārāktasūtreṇa| tatra kṣārasūtrāvacāraṇāprakāraṃ nirdiśannāha- eṣaṇyetyādi| arbudādiṣviti ādiśabdādgranthyādīnāṃ grahaṇam| tanumūleṣu arbudādiṣu, utkṣipya mūle kṣārasūtraṃ nidhāpayet; viśālamūlāṃścārbudādīn kṣārasūtrapratiṣṭhāpanārthe sarvataḥ sūcībhirāvidhya ‘sūcībhirācitān’ iti pā., mūle kṣārasūtreṇa badhnīyāt||29-33||

lg.l: yā dvivraṇīye 'bhihitās tu vartyas tāḥ sarvanāḍīṣu bhiṣag vidadhyāt |
snuhyarkadugdhena tu kalka eṣa vartīkṛto hanty acireṇa nāḍīḥ |
vārāhikandaś ca tathā pradeyo nāḍīṣu tailena ca miśrayitvā ||36||
dhattūrajaṃ madanakodravajaṃ ca bījaṃ kośātakī śukanasā mṛgabhojinī ca |
aṅkoṭabījakusumaṃ gatiṣu prayojyaṃ lākṣodakāhṛtamalāsu vikṛtya ‘cūrṇamiti kriyāviśeṣaṇāt cūrṇaṃ vikṛtya cūrṇīkṛtvetyarthaḥ’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ cūrṇam ||37||
tathā ca gomāṃsamasīṃ hitāya koṣṭhāśritasyādarato diśanti |
duṣṭavraṇe yad vihitaṃ ca tailaṃ tat sarvanāḍīṣu bhiṣag vidadhyāt |
cūrṇīkṛtair atha vimiśritam ebhir eva tailaṃ prayuktam acireṇa gatiṃ nihanti ||39||
eṣv eva mūtrasahiteṣu vidhāya tailaṃ tat sādhitaṃ gatim apohati saptarātrāt |
piṇḍītakasya tu varāhavibhāvitasya mūleṣu kandaśakaleṣu ca sauvaheṣu ||40||
tailaṃ kṛtaṃ gatim apohati śīghram etat kandeṣu cāmaravarāyudhasāhvayeṣu |
syān mārkavasya ca rasena nihanti tailaṃ nāḍīṃ kaphānilakṛtām apacīṃ vraṇāṃś ca |42|

div.ab: tataḥ paraṃ sarvanāḍīnāṃ sāmānyavidhimāha- yā ityādi| miśrakoktātītāvekṣaṇena dvivraṇīye'bhihitā ‘antaḥśalyānaṇumukhān’ (ci. 1) ityādivākye vartyaḥ śodhanāḥ prayojyāḥ| ihāpi vartiṃ nirdiśannāha- ghoṇṭetyādi| ghoṇṭāphalaṃ badarīphalaṃ, tasya tvak valkalam| lavaṇāni saindhavādīni| alavaṇā kākamardanikā ‘kaṅkumardanikā’ iti pā., tasyā idaṃ patramālavaṇam| bibhītaketyādi śaṅkhinī yavatiktā| bibhītakāmrāsthyādīnāṃ dāhena masyaḥ kṣārā ityarthaḥ| vārāhikando gṛṣṭikākandaḥ| tathetyādi tenaiva prakāreṇa gomāṃsasyāpi masīṃ ‘kṣāraṃ’ iti pā. koṣṭhāśritāsu nāḍīṣu hitāya ādareṇa pratipādayanti| vartīkṛtamityādi pakvamadhusaindhavavartirapi nāḍīharā| duṣṭetyādi|- duṣṭavraṇe yadvihitaṃ ca tailamiti sarvavraṇe “dravantī cirabilvaṃ” ityādinā vargeṇa “yathopapatti kartavyaṃ tailameteṣu śodhanam” (ci. 2) ityabhihitam| dhattūrajamityādi dhattūrajaṃ bījam| madotpādakāḥ kodravā madanakodravāḥ; anye tu vyākhyānayanti- madanaṃ kodravajaṃ bījaṃ ceti| kośātakī devadālī| śukanasā carmakāravaṭaḥ| mṛgabhojinī indravāruṇī| aṅkoṭabījapuṣpayuktaiḥ kṛtaṃ cūrṇaṃ gatiṣu deyam| lākṣodakāhṛtamalāsu lākṣādigaṇakvāthaprakṣālanena āsamantāt hṛtamalāsu, doṣāpanayanācchuddhāsvityarthaḥ; anye tu lākṣodakaprakṣālanena bhedanapīḍanābhyāṃ ca hṛtamalāsu gatiṣu, dhattūramadanakodravādicūrṇaṃ vikṛtyāloḍya lākṣodakenaiva prayojyamiti sambandhaṃ kathayanti| cūrṇīkṛtairityādi| ebhireva dhattūrakādibhiścūrṇīkṛtairmiśrīkṛtya tailaṃ prayuktamacireṇa gatiṃ nihantīti jejjaṭaḥ; gayī tu, ‘tailaṃ kṛtaṃ gatimapohati śīghrameva’ iti paṭhitvā kṛtagrahaṇāttailaṃ sāmānyapākaparibhāṣayā kṛtaṃ sādhitaṃ gatimapohatīti vyākhyāti| eṣvityādi|- eṣveva dhattūrakādibījādiṣvityarthaḥ| piṇḍītakasyetyādi| varāhapiṇḍītakamūlasuvahakādiśakaleṣu vajrakandeṣu ca snehapākasāmānyaparibhāṣayā siddhaṃ tailaṃ nāḍīharam| vistaramāha- piṇḍītakastrividhaḥ kṛṣṇapuṣpaḥ, śvetapuṣpaḥ, pītapuṣpaśca; teṣvatra varāhavarṇapuṣpairvibhāvyata iti varāhavibhāvitaḥ kṛṣṇapuṣpo grāhyaḥ; suvahā gandhanākulī nāpiṇīti loke, godhāpadītyapare, kandālītyanye, tasyāḥ kandaśakaleṣu kandakhaṇḍeṣu; kṛtaṃ saṃskṛtam| ‘kandeṣu cāmaravarāyudhasāhvayeṣu’ ityatra amaravara indrastasyāyudhaṃ vajraṃ tena samāna āhvayaḥ sañjñā yeṣāṃ te amaravarāyudhasāhvayā vajrakandāsteṣu| cakārāt ‘tailaṃ kṛtam’ ityanuvartate| bhallātaketyādi mārkavarasena bhṛṅgarājarasena||34-41||-

lg.l: stanye gate vikṛtim āśu bhiṣak tu dhātrīṃ pītāṃ ghṛtaṃ pariṇate 'hani vāmayet tu ||42||
nimbodakena madhumāgadhikāyutena vāntāgate 'hani ca mudgarasāśanā syāt |
evaṃ tryahaṃ caturahaṃ ṣaḍahaṃ vamed vā sarpiḥ pibet triphalayā saha saṃyutaṃ vā ||43||
bhārgīṃ vacām ativiṣāṃ suradāru pāṭhāṃ mustādikaṃ madhurasāṃ kaṭurohiṇīṃ ca |
dhātrī pibet tu payasaḥ pariśodhanārtham āragvadhādiṣu varaṃ madhunā kaṣāyam ||44||
sāmānyam etad upadiṣṭam ato viśeṣād doṣān payonipatitān śamayed yathāsvam |45|

div.ab: stanya ityādi| stanye doṣaurvikṛtiṃ gate parigate| pariṇate'hani sāyaṅkāla ‘niśāyāṃ’ iti pā., pītāṃ ghṛtaṃ saṃśamanameva ghṛtaṃ pītavatīṃ, etacca prataptakanakanikarapītalohite savitari snehapānakalpasyāpavādaḥ| sāmānyoktamapi kaphaghnadravyasaṃskṛtaṃ ghṛtam| jejjaṭādayastu pariṇate niṣpanne snehaphale sati snigdhāmityarthaḥ, ahani tasminneva divase| tannecchati gayī, sāmānyavākyenaiva snigdhāya vamanasya vihitatvāt| svedasya pūrvakarmatvāt svinnāṃ, nimbodakena nimbakvāthena vāmayet| vāntāgate'hani ca mudgarasāśanā syāt natu vamanadivase bhojayedityarthaḥ| tatra prathamavamanena kaphasya niḥśeṣamanapahṛtatvādaśuddhadehāṃ snehasvedāvantarā'ntarā sevayitvā ṣaḍahaṃ vā caturahaṃ tryahaṃ vā yāvadviśuddhiriti, śuddhadehāyāstu punarvamanaṃ tyājyam, anyathā glāniḥ stanyakṣayaśca| tasmācchuddhadehā vātapittānubandhe snehapākaparibhāṣayā triphalāsiddhaṃ sarpiḥ pibedeveti vāśabdādvyavasthitārthāllabhyate| saṃśodhanamabhidhāya saṃśamanamāha- bhārgīmityādi| mustādikaṃ dravyasaṅgrahaṇīyoktam| madhurasā mūrvā ‘corasnāyuḥ’ iti loke| bhārgyādibhiḥ saha mustādergaṇasya kaṣāyapānaṃ varaṃ śreṣṭham| payonipatitān stanyanipatitān| śamayedyathāsvamiti yasya yadātmakaṃ pratyanīkaṃ tena śamayediti||42-44||-

lg.l: rogaṃ stanotthitam avekṣya bhiṣag vidadhyād yad vidradhāv abhihitaṃ bahuśo vidhānam ||45||
sampacyamānam api taṃ tu vinopanāhaiḥ sambhojanena khalu pācayituṃ yateta |
śīghraṃ stano hi mṛdumāṃsatayopanaddhaḥ sarvaṃ prakotham upayāty avadīryate ca ||46||
pakve tu dugdhahariṇīḥ parihṛtya nāḍīḥ kṛṣṇaṃ ca cūcukayugaṃ vidadhīta śastram |
āme vidāhini tathaiva gate ca pākaṃ dhātryāḥ stanau satatam eva ca nirduhīta ||47||

ab.seg: sambhojaneneti yatheṣṭabhojanenetyarthaḥ| upanāho hyatyarthaṃ pākakāri, tasmādupanāhaniṣedhamāha- śīghramityādi| hi sphuṭaṃ, prakothaṃ pūtimāṃsatām| āmetyādi āme vidagdhatāparihārāya, vidāhini vipākaparihārāya, pakve nāḍīvraṇaparihārāya, stanau nirduhīta||45-47||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne visarpanāḍīstanarogacikitsitaṃ nāma saptadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||17||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ||17||

div.head: granthyapacyarbudagalagaṇḍacikitsitam

ab.seg: athāto granthyapacyarbudagalagaṇḍacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

lg.l: granthiṣv athāmeṣu bhiṣag vidadhyāc chophakriyāṃ vistaraśo ‘śophakriyāyāṃ vihitaṃ’ iti pā. vidhijñaḥ |
rakṣed balaṃ cāpi narasya nityaṃ tad rakṣitaṃ vyādhibalaṃ nihanti ||3||

ab.seg: granthiṣvityādi| śophakriyāmapatarpaṇādikāṃ virecanāntām| vistaraśo bhūyiṣṭham||1-3||

lg.l: tailaṃ pibet sarpir atho dvayaṃ vā dattvā vasāṃ vā trivṛtaṃ vidadhyāt |
apehivātādaśamūlasiddhaṃ vaidyaś catuḥsneham atho dvayaṃ vā ||4||

ab.seg: idānīmāme granthau visrāvaṇaśodhanayoḥ snehanāṅgasnehaṃ nirdiśannāha- tailamityādi| tailaṃ pibet, sarpirvā pibet, athavā dvayaṃ tailasarpiṣī pibet| vasātailasarpiṣā ca sādhyatvāt trivṛtaṃ vidadhyāt; tribhistailasarpirvasābhirvṛto vyāptaḥ snehasaṃyogastrivṛtasañjñaḥ syāt, taṃ vidadhyāt kuryāt; ‘vaidyo granthirogiṇaḥ pānāya’ iti śeṣaḥ; athavā catuḥsnehaṃ ghṛtatailavasāmajjāsaṃyogajaṃ; dvayaṃ vā pibet, dvayamiti tailasarpiṣī, tailavase, tailamajjānau, ghṛtavase, ghṛtamajjānau, vasāmajjānau ceti evamprakāraṃ dvayaṃ, catuḥsnehaṃ vā ekībhūtaṃ pibet| kimbhūtaṃ pibet? apehivātādaśamūlasiddhamiti apehivātā prasāriṇī| tatrādyaṃ tailaṃ sarpirdvayaṃ vā yat proktaṃ tadasaṃskṛtameva, uttarārdhoktaṃ ca catuḥsnehaṃ dvayaṃ vā prasāriṇīdaśamūlakalkakvāthasaṃskṛtam, anyathā vāśabdena “dvayaśabdena” iti pā. punaruktidoṣaḥ syāt| yadyapi pṛthaṅnirdiṣṭarasavīryavipākaprabhāvāṇāṃ tailasarpirvasāmajjānāṃ saṃskṛtānāṃ granthirogiṇaḥ sāmānyenātra prayogo'bhihitaḥ, tathā'pi vātapittaśleṣmasaṃsṛṣṭasannipātārabdhagranthiṣu hetuprakṛtideśakālasātmyānubandhānavekṣya yathāvacca pānārthamupayojyā iti jñeyam| gayī tu ‘apehivātā- ’ tyatra ‘āme vidadhyāddaśamūlasiddhaṃ’ iti paṭhati vyākhyānayati ca- tailaṃ pibedityādi; tatra granthau vātabhave āme tailaṃ vātaharakvāthakalkasiddhaṃ, pittabhave ghṛtaṃ pittaharakvāthakalkasiddhaṃ, tailameva kaphaharakvāthasiddhaṃ kaphaje, saṃsargasannipāte ca dvitricatuḥsnehādisiddhaṃ vikalpyaṃ; tadeva vātaharaṃ nirdiśannāha- āme vidadhyāddaśamūlasiddhamityādi||4||

lg.l: gojī ca piṣṭā saha tālapatryā granthau vidheyo 'nilaje pralepaḥ ||5||
svedopanāhān vividhāṃś ca kuryāt tathā prasiddhān aparāṃś ca lepān |
vidārya vā pakvam apohya pūyaṃ prakṣālya bilvārkanarendratoyaiḥ ||6||
śuddhaṃ vraṇaṃ vā 'py uparopayet tu tailena rāsnāsaralānvitena ||7||

div.ab: idānīṃ vātādijanitagranthiviśeṣeṇa pralepādīnāha- hiṃsretyādi| rohiṇī kaṭukā| amṛtā guḍūcī| kṛṣṇagandhā śobhāñjanakaḥ, śamītyapare| gojī gojihvikā, śākhoṭaka ityanye| tālapatrī musalī| svedetyādi| prasiddhā lepā miśrakoktā mātuluṅgyādayaḥ| vidāryetyādi| narendraḥ kiramālakaḥ| toyaśabdo'tra kvāthe vartate| pañcāṅgula eraṇḍaḥ| anye ‘bilvārkagaṇāditoyaiḥ’ iti paṭhanti; tatra bilvādigaṇaḥ, arkādigaṇaśca, tayoḥ kvāthairityarthaḥ| śuddhamityādi| saralā trivṛt, kecit saralaṃ śālatarumāhuḥ, tayoścūrṇānvitena tailena ropayet, tathā caturguṇagokṣīrasamanvitena tailena viḍaṅgādibhiḥ kalkīkṛtaiḥ siddhena vā ropayet||5-7||-

lg.l: jalaukasaḥ pittakṛte hitās tu kṣīrodakābhyāṃ pariṣecanaṃ ca ||8||
kākolivargasya ca śītalāni pibet kaṣāyāṇi saśarkarāṇi |
drākṣārasenekṣurasena vā 'pi cūrṇaṃ pibec cāpi harītakīnām ||9||
saśarkarair vā tṛṇaśūnyakandair dihyād abhīkṣṇaṃ muculundajair vā ||10||
vidārya vā pakvam apohya pūyaṃ dhāvet kaṣāyeṇa vanaspatīnām |
tilaiḥ sayaṣṭīmadhukair viśodhya sarpiḥ prayojyaṃ madhurair vipakvam ||11||

ab.seg: jalaukasa ityādi| tṛṇaśūnyakandaiḥ ketakīmūlaiḥ| dihyāt limpet| abhīkṣṇaṃ satatam| muculundaḥ kaṇṭakīmadanaḥ, anye mucukundamāhuḥ| vidāryetyādi| vanaspatīnāṃ vaṭaplakṣapippalodumbarāṇām| tilairityādi| madhuraiḥ kākolyādibhirdravyaiḥ||8-11||

lg.l: hṛteṣu doṣeṣu yathānupūrvyā granthau bhiṣak śleṣmasamutthite tu |

ab.seg: hṛteṣvityādi| yathānupūrvyā snehasvedādikrameṇa| vamanavirecanāsthāpanaśirovirecanaśoṇitasrāvaṇairdoṣeṣu kaphapittavāteṣu hṛteṣu tathā śoṇite ca hṛte svinnasya vimlāpanaṃ kāryamityāha- aṅguṣṭhalohopalaveṇudaṇḍaiḥ; vimlāpanamaṅguṣṭhādibhirmardanena śvayathuvimlāpanaṃ kuryāt| vikaṅkatetyādi| vikaṅkatavṛkṣaḥ kaṭāyikā| āragvadhaḥ kiramālakaḥ| kākaṇantī guñjā| kākādanī vāyasatindukā, ahiṃsretyanye| tāpasavṛkṣa iṅgudaḥ| piṇḍaphalā tiktālābuḥ| kālā kaṭuhiṃsrā||12-13||

lg.l: amarmajātaṃ śamam aprayāntam apakvam evāpahared vidārya |
dahet sthite cāsṛji siddhakarmā sadyaḥkṣatoktaṃ ca vidhiṃ vidadhyāt ||14||

ab.seg: amarmetyādi| śleṣmasamutthameva granthimarmaṇyutpannaṃ śamamaprayāntaṃ pūrvoktakramaiḥ śāntimagacchantamapakvameva vidārya apaharet| sadyaḥkṣatoktavidhirmadhughṛtādiprayogaḥ| kecit ‘amarmajaṃ caivamapacyamānaṃ’ iti paṭhanti||14||

lg.l: yā māṃsakandyaḥ kaṭhinā bṛhatyas tāsv eṣa yojyaś ca vidhir vidhijñaiḥ |
śastreṇa vā''pāṭya supakvam āśu prakṣālayet pathyatamaiḥ kaṣāyaiḥ ||15||
saṃśodhanais taṃ ca viśodhayet tu kṣārottaraiḥ kṣaudraguḍapragāḍhaiḥ |
śuddhe ca tailaṃ tv avacāraṇīyaṃ viḍaṅgapāṭhārajanīvipakvam ||16||

ab.seg: yā ityādi| yāśca mahatyo māṃsakandyo māṃsaprarohāḥ, tāsviyameva kriyā| śastreṇetyādi śastreṇa pāṭanaṃ amarmaje, marmaje tu bheṣajaiḥ| pathyatamairiti kaphotthavraṇaharaiḥ| saṃśodhanairityādi| kṣārottarairyavakṣārapradhānaiḥ| ‘kṣaudraghṛtapragāḍhaiḥ’ iti pāṭhāntaram||15-16||

lg.l: hutāśataptena muhuḥ pramṛjyāl lohena dhīmān adahan hitāya ||17||
pralipya dārvīm atha lākṣayā vā prataptayā svedanam asya kāryam |
nipātya vā śastram apohya medo dahet supakvaṃ tv athavā vidārya ||18||
prakṣālya mūtreṇa tilaiḥ supiṣṭaiḥ suvarcikādyair haritālamiśraiḥ |

div.ab: ato medogranthicikitsitamāha- meda ityādi| dārvī dāruhastakaḥ| apakvamedoje śastraṃ nipātya medo'pakṛṣya dahet, pakvaṃ vā medogranthiṃ vidārya gavādimūtraiḥ prakṣālya tilaiḥ suvarcikāyavakṣārasaindhavaharitālakṣaudraghṛtapradhānairabhipraśodhya vakṣyamāṇatailāvacāraṇam| tailamityādi dvikarañjādikalkasiddhena caturguṇagomūtradraveṇa tailena ropayet| vaṃśāvalekho vaṃśatvak||17-19||-

lg.l: sarpiḥ kṛtaṃ hanty apacīṃ pravṛddhāṃ dvidhā pravṛttaṃ tad udāravīryam |
śākhoṭakasya svarasena siddhaṃ tailaṃ hitaṃ nasyavirecaneṣu |
madhūkasāraś ca hito 'vapīḍe phalāni śigroḥ kharamañjarer vā ||23||

ab.seg: idānīmapacīcikitsāmāha- jīmūtakairityādi| jīmūtako devadālī| kośavatī kaṭukośātakī| dvidhāpravṛttam ubhayatobhāgadoṣaharam| udāravīryam utkaṭavīryam| jīmūtakakośavatyoḥ phalakalkaṃ dantyādīnāṃ tisṝṇāṃ mūlasya ca snehacaturthāṃśena kṛtvā, jalaṃ caturguṇaṃ dattvā, vipacet; kalkakvāthābhyāmityapare| nirguṇḍītyādi| barihiṣṭhaṃ vālakam| jīmūtako devadālī| nirguṇḍījātībarihiṣṭhānāmañjaliṃ salilāḍhakena niḥkvāthya pādaśeṣaṃ vidhāya tataḥ puruṣāpekṣayā jalamuṣṇamādāya, tacca jīmūtakaphalakalpena pratyekaṃ mākṣikasaindhavāḍhyaṃ kṛtvā, yuktaṃ vamanavidhinā, duṣṭāsvapacīṣūttamamādiśanti vamanadravyamuttamamādiśanti| kaiḍaryetyādi kaiḍaryaḥ parvatanimbaḥ| kaiḍaryādikalkacaturthāṃśaṃ jalacaturguṇaṃ tailaṃ sādhyam| anye tu kaiḍaryetyatra nirguṇḍīti paṭhanti| nirguṇḍīsvarase caturguṇe bimbīkaravīrakalkaṃ tailaṃ sādhyam| śākhoṭakasyetyādi| śākhoṭakavalkalānāṃ caturguṇe svarase tailaṃ siddhaṃ; nasye tu akalkamityeke, tatkalkakaṣāyamevetyanye| madhūketyādi| avapīḍya dīyate ityavapīḍaḥ, nasyabheda ityarthaḥ| kharamañjariḥ apāmārgaḥ| madhūkasāraśigruphalāpāmārgataṇḍulā uṣṇodakena piṣṭvā avapīḍo'rūkṣalakṣaṇa ‘rūkṣa eva’ iti pā. eva||20-23||

lg.l: granthīn amarmaprabhavān apakvān uddhṛtya cāgniṃ vidadhīta paścāt |
kṣāreṇa vā 'pi pratisārayet tu saṃlikhya śastreṇa yathopadeśam ||24||

ab.seg: granthīnityādi| uddhṛtya ca śastreṇa paraṃ yadā auṣadhenāsādhyatvam||24||

lg.l: pārṣṇiṃ prati dve daśa cāṅgulāni mitvendrabastiṃ parivarjya dhīmān |
vidārya matsyāṇḍanibhāni vaidyo niṣkṛṣya jālāny analaṃ vidadhyāt ||25||
ā gulphakarṇāt sumitasya jantos tasyāṣṭabhāgaṃ khuḍakād vibhajya |
ghoṇarjuvedhaḥ surarājabaster hitvā 'kṣimātraṃ tv apare vadanti ||26||

ab.seg: sthānakarmābhidhāya sthānāntarakarmāṇi nirdiśannāha- pārṣṇimityādi| pārṣṇiḥ gulphasya paścādbhāgaḥ| dvādaśāṅgulāni mitvordhvamindrabastiṃ parityajya, chittvā, medojālāni matsyāṇḍena nibhāni ākṛṣya agnimavacārayet| jaṅghāmadhye dvyaṅgulamindrabastiḥ, jejjaṭācāryastu ardhāṅgulamāha| anye tu pārṣṇiṃ pratītyatra pratiśabdaṃ viparītārthakamāhuḥ, tena viparītāyāṃ pārṣṇyāmityarthaḥ; tena dakṣiṇabhāgagatāyāmapacyāṃ vāmajaṅghāyāṃ, vāmabhāgagatāyāmapacyāṃ dakṣiṇajaṅghāyām, abhayatobhāgagatāyāmubhayataḥ karma kartavyamiti jñeyam| ‘bhāge ca paripratī’ ityuktatvādbhāgārtho'pi pratiśabdo vyākhyātavyaḥ; tena pārṣṇibhāge jaṅghāyāḥ pāścātyabhāge vyadhaḥ kāryaḥ| dve daśa cāṅgulānīti mitvetyatra pṛthagvibhaktinirdeśāt pārṣṇito daśāṅgulāni vihāyāṅguladvayamātro vyadhaḥ kārya iti jñeyam| indrabastiṃ trayodaśe'ṅgule sthitamardhāṅgulapramāṇaṃ parityajya hitvā, dhīmān buddhimān ūhāpohayogyo dṛṣṭakarmetyarthaḥ, vaidyaḥ yaḥ samyagāyurvedavidyāṃ vetti, jālāni medojālāni, analaṃ vidadhyāt apunarbhavāyāgnitaptayā śalākayā dahedityarthaḥ; evaṃ hi mūlocchedādapacyupaśama iti vadanti| amumevārthaṃ kecidanyena pāṭhena paṭhanti- ā gulphetyādi| ā khula(ḍa)kāt ‘khulukāt’ iti pā. gulphakarṇāt gulphau karṇāviva yasya sa tathā; khulako ‘khulukaḥ’ iti pā. jaṅghāpādayoḥ sandhiḥ| surarājabasterindrabasteraṣṭabhāgaṃ jaṅghāyāścaraṇahīnāyā viṃśatyaṅgulāyā aṣṭamo bhāgaḥ sārdhamaṅguladvayaṃ hitvā, yadyapi dvyaṅgula indrabastistathā'pi tadupaghātaparihārārthaṃ sārdhamevāṅguladvayaṃ jñe(he)yam| anye tu akṣimātrameva dvyaṅgulaṃ netrapramāṇaṃ hitveti vadanti| ghoṇarjuvedha iti gulphakarṇasya, khulakasya ‘khulukasya’ iti pā., ghoṇā nāsā iva ghoṇā, yathottarīyakaṇḍarā tasyāḥ ṛjuravakro vedho vyadhaḥ, ‘kuryāt’ ityatrāpi pāṭhe sa evārthaḥ| apacyāstu jaṅghākaṇḍarāgatamedomūlatāyāṃ bhojavacanaṃ- “vātapittakaphā vṛddhā medaścāpi samācitam| jaṅghayoḥ kaṇḍarāṃ prāpya matsyāṇḍasadṛśān bahūn”- ityādīti gayī; jejjaṭasyāpyayamabhiprāyaḥ| gūḍhapadabhaṅgaṭippane'nyathā vyākhyātam- ā gulphakarṇāditi gulphakarṇāvabhivyāpya, āṅatrābhividhau na maryādāyāṃ, sumitasya suniścitaṃ mitasya tasya pramāṇasya ṣaṭsaptatyaṅgulamitasyāṣṭamabhāgaḥ sārdhanavāṅgulamātraṃ, khulakāt pārṣṇibhāgād dvyaṅgulapramāṇāt ‘tryaṅgulapramāṇāt’ iti pā., vibhajya pṛthakkṛtya, ghoṇā nāsā tasyā ṛju yathā bhavati tathā'vakro vedhaḥ kartavyaḥ| tacca vidha vidhāne iti dhāto rūpam, tathā'pi vedhaśabdo'tra vyadhane vartate, dhātūnāmanekārthatvāt| sa ca khulakasyāṅgulatritayamaṣṭamabhāgasya ca sārdhanavāṅgulakamevaṃ sārdhadvādaśāṅgulaparimāṇenendrabastirmarmāpi parihṛtaṃ bhavatyevamuktamindrabastiṃ hitveti| tathā coktaṃ- “trayodaśāṅgule pārṣṇiṃ prati kālāntarāsuhṛt| indrabastirasṛksrāvī māṃsago'rdhāṅgulo bhavet”- iti| akṣimātramaṅguladvayapramāṇamapare bhiṣaja iti vadanti| evaṃ prathamaślokenādhastāddvitīyaślokenendrabasterupariṣṭājjaṅghāyāḥ pāścātyabhāgagatakaṇḍarāyā dvyaṅgulamātro vyadhaḥ kārya iti sthitam; evamanupaśame vāmapārśvajāyāṃ dakṣiṇajaṅghāpṛṣṭhamadhyādindrabasteradhastādūrdhvaṃ vā śastreṇākṣimātraṃ vraṇaṃ kṛtvā, matsyāṇḍajālanibhaṃ medo'panīyagninā dahet, anenetarapārśvajā vyākhyātā, evamubhayapārśvajātāyāmubhayata iti| bhojā'trāha- “vātapittakaphā vṛddhā medaścāpi samācitam| jaṅghayoḥ kaṇḍarāṃ prāpya matsyāṇḍasadṛśān bahūn|| kurvanti granthīn yastebhyaḥ punaḥ prakupito'nilaḥ| doṣastairūrdhvago vakṣaḥkakṣāmanyāgalāśritaḥ|| nānāprakārān kurute granthīn sā tvapacī matā| vyāmiśradoṣotpannāṃ tu kṛcchrasādhyāṃ vinirdiśet|| tāsāṃ vātottarā kṛṣṇā vātikīvedanāyutā|| kṣiprapākasamutthānā dāhayuktā ca paittikī|| gūḍhā'vipākā kaṭhinā kaphāt snigdhā rujākarī|| medodhikā ślaiṣmikī ca viśeṣāt sā samārdavā|| tāṃ tu mālākṛtiṃ manyākaṇṭhahṛddhanusandhiṣu|| galamālāṃ vijānīyādapacītulyalakṣaṇām”- iti| “tasmājjaṅghāyāmeva karmaṇā mūlocchedaḥ kāryaḥ” iti gūḍhapadabhaṅgāt| vāgbhaṭena cobhayatrāpi vyadho darśitaḥ| yathā- “ityaśāntau gadasyānyapārśvajaṅghāsamāśritam| basterūrdhvamadhastādvā medo hṛtvā'gninā ‘hitvā’ iti pā. dahet”- (vā. u. 30) iti||25-26||

hanvasthisandhimanyāgalasthitāpacyāṃ jaṅghāgataṃ karmābhidhāya kakṣākūrparasandhigatāsvapacīṣu bāhugatameva karma vinirdiśannāha- maṇibandhetyādi| atrāpi pūrvavat, “etenetarasakthi bāhū ca vyākhyātau” (śā. 8) iti vacanādindrabasteraṣṭabhāgamakṣimātraṃ vā vihāyāgre rekhātrayaṃ kuryāt| tatrāpi viṃśatyaṅgulajaṅghāyā dvādaśāṅgulāni kiñcidadhiko bhāgena, evaṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulakūrparamaṇibandhamadhye kiñcidadhikāni navāṅgulāni mitvā reṣātrayamaṅgulāntaramiti||27||

lg.l: dadyāc ca tailena saheṅgudīnāṃ yad vakṣyate ślīpadināṃ ca tailam ||28||
virecanaṃ dhūmam upādadīta bhavec ca nityaṃ yavamudgabhojī |29|

div.ab: vamanavirecanaśirovirecanaistathā sthānāntaragataśastrakṣārānalairantarbahiḥpramārjanābhyāmantarbahiḥśuddhīrnirdiśya saṃśamanaṃ nirdiśannāha- cūrṇasyetyādi|- cūrṇasya kāle ropaṇakāle, pracalākādīnāṃ masīrdadyāt kṣāramityarthaḥ| pracalāko mayūraḥ, kṛkalāsamanye prāhuḥ| iṅgudīnāṃ tailena kṣārameva ‘masīmeva’ iti pā. dadyāt| yāni ca tailāni ślīpade tāni ca dadyāt||28||-

lg.l: vātārbudaṃ kṣīraghṛtāmbusiddhair uṣṇaiḥ satailair upanāhayet tu |
kuryāc ca mukhyāny upanāhanāni siddhaiś ca māṃsair atha vesavāraiḥ ||30||
svedaṃ vidadhyāt kuśalas tu nāḍyā śṛṅgeṇa raktaṃ bahuśo harec ca |
vātaghnaniryūhapayomlabhāgaiḥ siddhaṃ śatākhyaṃ trivṛtaṃ pibed vā ||31||

ab.seg: karkārukairityādi| karkārukaṃ kūṣmāṇḍaṃ, ervāruḥ grīṣmakarkaṭī, priyālaścāraḥ, pañcāṅgula eraṇḍaḥ| kṣīraghṛtasiddhai raktapittānubandhe| upanāhayet badhnīyāt| vātaghnetyādi| vātaghnā devadārvādayaḥ| tatkvāthakṣīrasauvīrabhāgaistribhiḥ snehacaturguṇairakalkaistailapākaḥ, evameva śatadhā pakvaṃ śatapākam, evaṃ trivṛtaṃ vā majjavarjaṃ ghṛtatailavasābhirvṛtaṃ pūrvakalkavātaharakvāthapayomlaiḥ siddham; evameva śatadhā'patānakavidhānena vā siddhaṃ trivṛtaṃ, tatrāpyayameva sādhanavidhiḥ||29-31||

lg.l: svedopanāhā mṛdavas tu kāryāḥ ‘pathyāḥ’ iti pā. pittārbude kāyavirecanaṃ ca |
visrāvya cāragvadhagojisomāḥ śyāmā ca yojyā kuśalena lepe ||33||
ghṛtaṃ pibet klītakasamprasiddhaṃ pittārbudī tajjaṭharī ca jantuḥ ||34||

ab.seg: svedopanāhā ityādi| mṛduḥ svedo dravasvedaḥ, upanāho bandhaḥ kākolyādimṛdudravyakṛtaḥ kṣīrāmlapiṣṭaśca nātyuṣṇaḥ| mṛdukāyavirecanaṃ na śirovirecanamiti vyavacchedaviṣayaḥ| bhṛśaṃ vighṛṣya udumbarādipatraiḥ| tatra śākaḥ kharamasṛṇapatro mahātaruḥ; gojī dārvīpatrikā, śākhoṭaka ityanye| visrāvyetyādi| somaḥ somalatā, kaṭphalamityapare| śyāmetyādi| śyāmā trivṛt, girihvā śvetasyandaḥ, añjanakī nīlāñjanikā śāradaṃ phalaṃ, śrīphaliketi loke| saptalikā yavatiktā| klītaketyādi| yaṣṭīmadhukalkena sāmānyasnehaparibhāṣayā siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ śodhanaṃ pittārbudī pittodarī ca pibet||32-34||

lg.l: śuddhasya jantoḥ kaphaje 'rbude tu rakte 'vasikte tu tato 'rbudaṃ tat |
dravyāṇi yāny ūrdhvam adhaś ca doṣān haranti taiḥ kalkakṛtaiḥ pradihyāt ||35||
mūtrais tu kākādanimūlamiśraiḥ kṣārapradigdhair athavā pradihyāt ||36||

ab.seg: śuddhasyeti vamanena| alābvā rakte'vasikte'pacyā doṣānūrdhvamadhaśca yāni dravyāṇi jīmūtakīghoṣavatīphaladantīdravantītrivṛdādīni haranti teṣāṃ kalkairlimpet| kāṃsyanīlaḥ kāṃsyamasī| śukaḥ granthiparṇaḥ ‘carmakāravaṭaḥ’ iti pā., lāṅgalākhyā kalikārikā| kākādanī vāyasatindukā| kapotādiviḍvimiśraiḥ kāṃsyanīlādisahitairvāyasatindukāyā mūlayuktairmūtrairvilimpet; athavā kṣārapradigdhaiḥ kṣārasaṃyuktairmūtraiḥ pralimpet; ‘kṣārapraghṛṣṭairathavā’ ityanye; tatra kṣārodakena praghṛṣṭairvā kapotaviḍādibhiḥ pradihyādityarthaḥ||35-36||

lg.l: lepaṃ vidadhyāt kṛmayo yathā 'tra mūrcchanti muñcanty atha makṣikāś ca ||37||
alpāvaśiṣṭe kṛmibhakṣite ‘kṛmibhiḥ kṛte ca’ iti pā. ca likhet tato 'gniṃ vidadhīta paścāt |
yad alpamūlaṃ traputāmrasīsapaṭṭaiḥ samāveṣṭya tad āyasair vā ||38||
kṣārāgniśastrāṇy asakṛd vidadhyāt prāṇān ahiṃsan bhiṣagapramattaḥ |

ab.seg: niṣpāvetyādi|- niṣpāvaḥ śimbaḥ| vidadhyāt kuryāt| mūrcchanti patanti| muñcantyatha makṣikāśceti ‘kṛmīn’ iti śeṣaḥ| śikharāṇāṃ ca kṛmibhirbhakṣitatvādalpāvaśiṣṭatvam| asakṛt anekavāram| apramattaḥ sāvadhānaḥ| āsphotā sārivā| śuddha ityādi| śuddhe ca ropaṇārthaṃ bhārgyāditailaṃ tailapākakalpena| yadṛcchayetyādi| yadṛcchayā punarākasmikotpāde abhighātādinimitte'buddhipūrvake vā||37-40||

lg.l: medorbudaṃ svinnam atho vidārya viśodhya sīvyed gataraktam āśu |
vraṇaṃ pratigrāhya madhupragāḍhaiḥ karañjatailaṃ vidadhīta śuddhe |
saśeṣadoṣāṇi hi yo 'rbudāni karoti tasyāśu punar bhavanti ||42||
tasmād aśeṣāṇi samuddharet tu hanyuḥ saśeṣāṇi yathā hi vahniḥ |43|

div.ab: meda ityādi| pataṅgo raktakāṣṭham ‘raktacandanam’ iti pā.| ālaṃ haritālam| karañjatailaṃ vidradhyuktaṃ, tatphalatailamevetyanye||41-42||-

lg.l: amlaiḥ samūtrair vividhaiḥ payobhir uṣṇaiḥ satailaiḥ piśitaiś ca vidvān |
visrāvayet svinnam atandritaś ca śuddhaṃ vraṇaṃ cāpy upanāhayet tu ||44||
siddhaṃ balābhyāṃ ca sadevadāru hitāya nityaṃ galagaṇḍaroge ||47||

ab.seg: saṃsvedyetyādi| patrabhaṅgaiḥ pallavaiḥ| anilaghnaṃ vātaharam| eraṇḍādipallavayutaṃ tu śuddhavāte, amlaiḥ kāñjikādibhiḥ pittāvṛte vāyau, kaphāvṛte mūtrakvathitaiḥ; raktāvṛte payobhiḥ kṣīraiḥ, piśitaiśceti piśitarasaiḥ kvathitaiḥ, athavā piśitairmāṃsaiḥ pallavaiḥ saha kvathitairdhātukṣayaje vāyau| visrāvayet jalaukādibhiḥ, ūrumūlasaṃśritasirāvyadhena vā| raktādiharaṇaśuddhaṃ ‘raktāharaṇaśuddhyā śuddhaṃ’ iti pā. galagaṇḍaṃ nirantaraṃ śaṇādibījairupanāhayet| śuddhamiti vacanāt sauśrute'pi raktāharaṇasya śuddhisañjñā; tena “catuṣprakārā saṃśuddhiḥ” (ca. sū. 22) iti carakavacanaṃ tu prāyikaṃ ‘anulomitam’ iti pā. smṛtam| kiṇvaṃ surābījam| kāletyādi| kālā hiṃsrā, gajādināmā hastipippalī, karahāṭaṃ madanaphalam| ekaiṣikā ambaṣṭhā, trivṛdityeke; vṛkṣakaḥ kuṭajaḥ| asakṛt anekavāram| pradihyāt limpet| tailamityādi| haṃsāhvayā haṃsapadī| tailaṃ pibet siddhamiti sambandhaḥ||43-47||

lg.l: svedopanāhaiḥ kaphasambhavaṃ tu saṃsvedya visrāvaṇam eva kuryāt |
daśārdhasaṅkhyair lavaṇaiś ca yuktaṃ tailaṃ piben māgadhikādisiddham ||49||
pracchardanaṃ mūrdhavirecanaṃ ca dhūmaś ca vairecaniko hitas tu |
pākakramo vā 'pi sadā vidheyo vaidyena pākaṅgatayoḥ kathañcit ||50||

ab.seg: pittagalagaṇḍābhāvādanantaraṃ kaphajasya cikitsitaṃ darśayannāha- svedetyādi| svedo'tra rūkṣaḥ, upanāhaśca sakṣāramūtraḥ| ajagandhā bovayikā, viśalyā agniśikhavṛkṣaḥ ‘kāṣṭhapāṭalā’ iti pā., viṣāṇikā āvartanikā, śukāhvayaḥ carmakāravaṭaḥ| daśetyādi daśārdhasaṅkhyairlavaṇairiti pañcalavaṇaiḥ| māgadhikādisiddhaṃ pippalyādikvāthakalkābhyāṃ siddham| pākaṅgatayoḥ pākaṃ prāptayorvātakaphajayoḥ||48-50||

lg.l: kaṭutrikakṣaudrayutāḥ samūtrā bhakṣyā yavānnāni rasāś ca maudgāḥ |

ab.seg: sarvagalagaṇḍaviṣaye yogaṃ nirdiśannāha- kaṭutriketyādi| bhakṣyā dhānollumbādayaḥ| yavānnāni gṛñjanādīni| samūtrā iti mūtrasvinnaśuṣkāṇāṃ bhakṣyayavāṇāmiti boddhavyam| kaṭutrikamadhubhyāṃ yojanā| rasāśca maudgā mudgayūṣāḥ| saśṛṅgaverāḥ sārdrakā deyāḥ||51||

lg.l: medaḥsamutthe tu yathopadiṣṭāṃ vidhyet sirāṃ snigdhatanor narasya |
mūtreṇa vā''loḍya hitāya sāraṃ prātaḥ pibet sālamahīruhāṇām |
śastreṇa vā''pāṭya vidārya cainaṃ medaḥ samuddhṛtya hitāya sīvyet ||53||
majjājyamedomadhubhir dahed vā dagdhe ca sarpirmadhu cāvacāryam |
kāsīsatutthe ca tato 'tra deye cūrṇīkṛte rocanayā samete ||54||
tailena cābhyajya hitāya dadyāt sārodbhavaṃ gomayajaṃ ca bhasma |
hitaś ca nityaṃ triphalākaṣāyo gāḍhaś ca bandho yavabhojanaṃ ca ||55||

ab.seg: medaḥsamuttha ityādi| yathopadiṣṭāmiti ūrusandhinirdiṣṭām| śyāmetyādi|- śyāmā trivṛt, sudhā sehuṇḍaḥ, lohapurīṣaṃ lohamalam; anye tu lohamagaruṃ vadanti, tathā purīṣaṃ kapotapārāvataviṭ| mūtreṇetyādi| sālasārāditarūṇāṃ sārakalkaṃ karṣamātraṃ gomūtreṇa pibet| jejjaṭastu sārodbhavaṃ bhasma mūtreṇāloḍya pibediti vadati| śastreṇetyādi| dāhe ca madhughṛtāvacāraṇaṃ paścātkarma| kāsīsetyādi| tato'nantaraṃ kāsīsatutthagorocanācūrṇāvacāraṇaṃ vraṇe| sārodbhavaṃ sālasārādisārodbhavam| prakṣālane triphalākaṣāyaśca||52-55||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne granthyapacyarbudagalagaṇḍacikitsitaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||18||

div.ab: iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutaṭīkāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne'ṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|

div.head: vṛddhyupadaṃśaślīpadacikitsitam

ab.seg: athāto vṛddhyupadaṃśaślīpadacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

lg.l: antravṛddhyā vinā ṣaḍ yā vṛddhayas tāsu varjayet |

div.ab: antravṛddhyetyādi| caṅkramaṇaṃ bhramaṇam||1-3||-

lg.l: sakṣīraṃ vā piben māsaṃ tailam eraṇḍasambhavam |
tataḥ kāle 'nilaghnānāṃ kvāthaiḥ kalkaiś ca buddhimān ||6||
bhindyāt tataḥ prabhinnāyāṃ yathoktaṃ kramam ācaret |9|

div.ab: tatretyādi| traivṛtamapatānakaharaṃ vātavyādhyuktaṃ, naraṃ pāyayeteti sambandhaḥ| kāle āvasthike| nirūḍhaṃ ca yaṣṭīmadhukasiddhatailena yojayedanuvāsanakalpavidhinā| yathoktāmityādi| yathā yena prakāreṇokto dvivraṇīyakramastamācaret||4-8||-

lg.l: pakvāṃ vā bhedayed bhinnāṃ śodhayet kṣaudrasarpiṣā |
śuddhāyāṃ ca bhiṣag dadyāt tailaṃ kalkaṃ ca ropaṇam ||10||
raktajāyāṃ jalaukobhiḥ śoṇitaṃ nirhared bhiṣak ‘abhīkṣṇaṃ nirharedasṛk’ iti pā.|
pittagranthikramaṃ kuryād āme pakve ca sarvadā |12|

div.ab: pittajāyāmityādi| kalkaṃ ca ropaṇaṃ dvivraṇīyoktakalkaṃ; gayī tu miśrakādhyāyoktamiti kathayati||9-11||-

lg.l: pakvāyāṃ ca vibhinnāyāṃ tailaṃ śodhanam iṣyate |

ab.seg: vṛddhimityādi| uṣṇairuṣṇavīryairvacādipippalyādimuṣkakādigaṇaiḥ; anye tu, uṣṇavīryairajagandhādibhirmiśrakoktaiḥ| pītetyādi| gomūtrakvathitasyaiva dāruharidrākaṣāyasya vā pānaṃ, pītadārusthāne keciddevadāruṃ paṭhanti| vimlāpanādityādi| sumanāruṣkarādikalkakaṣāyasiddhaṃ tailam||12-14||

lg.l: svinnāṃ cāveṣṭya paṭṭena samāśvāsya tu mānavam |
rakṣan phale sevanīṃ ca vṛddhipatreṇa dārayet ||16||
badhnīyāc ca yathoddiṣṭaṃ śuddhe tailaṃ ca dāpayet ||17||

div.ab: meda ityādi| surasādinā mūtrapiṣṭena lepaḥ| śirovirecanadravyāṇi pippalīviḍaṅgāpāmārgaśigruśirīṣasiddhārthakādīni saṃśodhanasaṃśamanīyoktāni| tairapi gomūtrapiṣṭaiḥ sukhoṣṇairlepaḥ| svinnāmityādi| yathoddiṣṭaṃ ca badhnīyāt gophaṇayā sthagikābandhena vā||15-17||-

lg.l: athātra dvimukhāṃ nāḍīṃ dattvā visrāvayed bhiṣak ||19||
tatra yā vaṅkṣaṇasthā tāṃ ‘taptayā vaṅkṣaṇasthānaṃ’ iti pā. dahed ardhenduvaktrayā ||21||
pradahet prayataḥ kin tu snāyucchedo 'dhikas tayoḥ ||23||
śaṅkhopari ca karṇānte tyaktvā yatnena sevanīm |

ab.seg: mūtrajāmityādi| varjayedantrahaitukīṃ ‘kośaprāptām’ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ| vātavṛddhikramo hita iti snehapānādiranuvāsanāntaḥ| tatretyādi| ardhenduvaktrayā śalākayā| tvaca bhittveti tvaṅmātraṃ chittvā| aṅgaviparyayāditi vāmāntravṛddhau ‘vāmāṇḍapravṛddhau’ iti pā. dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhamadhye, dakṣiṇāntravṛddhau ‘dakṣiṇāṇḍapravṛddhau’ iti pā. vāmāṅguṣṭhamadhye| śaṅkhabhruvorantopari karṇalalāṭayormadhye antravṛddhernivṛttaye ‘vaṅkṣaṇasthāyā’ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ, sirāṃ vidhyet||18-24||

lg.l: sirāṃ vidhyen meḍhramadhye pātayed vā jalaukasaḥ ||25||
hared ubhayataś cāpi doṣān atyartham ucchritān |
yadi vā durbalo jantur na vā prāptaṃ virecanam |
nirūheṇa haret tasya doṣān atyartham ucchritān ||27||

ab.seg: upadaṃśeṣvityādi| tatra sirāṃ vidhyedbahudoṣe, alpadoṣe tu jalaukāpātaḥ; pittaraktajayormṛdutvājjalaukasetyanye; jejjaṭastu anavagāḍhe jalaukasā, avagāḍhe sirāvyadha iti| haredityādi| balavato virecyasya vamanavirecanābhyāṃ doṣaharaṇam| yadi vetyādi| durbalāvirecyayoḥ punaratyarthocchritadoṣayordoṣaharaṇānukūlyena nirūheṇa haraṇam| na vā prāptaṃ na yuktamityarthaḥ||25-27||

lg.l: etaiś ca vātajaṃ snigdhaiḥ sukhoṣṇaiḥ sampralepayet ||29||

div.ab: prapauṇḍarīketyādi| saralā trivṛt| niculetyādi| niculo vetasaḥ| prapauṇḍarīkapūrvaiḥ prapauṇḍarīkādibhiḥ, pūrvauktairvātopadaṃśoktaiḥ| sekaḥ pariṣekaḥ||28-29||-
gairiketyādi| añjanaṃ rasāñjanam| mṛṇālaṃ padmanālam| secayet pariṣecayedityarthaḥ||30-32||-

ab.seg: śālaḥ śaṅkuḥ, aśvakarṇaḥ pūrvadeśaprasiddho'śvatthasadṛśaḥ, ajakarṇaḥ ‘piyāsāl’ iti loke| pattūraḥ sirivālikā||33-35||

lg.l: na yāti ca yathā pākaṃ prayateta tathā bhiṣak |
śastreṇopacarec cāpi pākam āgatam āśu vai |

ab.seg: evaṃ pūrvoktaprakāreṇa pratikuryāt, ‘āmopadaṃśam’ ‘vātopadaṃśaṃ’ iti pā. iti śeṣaḥ| prāksthānaṃ sūtrasthānaṃ, tatra miśrakoktaiḥ; apiśabdād dvivraṇīyoktaiḥ| ‘tasmāt saṃśodhanālepasekaśoṇitamokṣaṇaiḥ| pratikuryāt kriyāyogaiḥ prāksthānoktairhitairapi’ iti kecit paṭhanti| tadā'pohya pūyamupahṛtya| prakṣālane vraṇasya karavīrapatrāṇi, teṣāṃ kaṣāya ityarthaḥ; tathaivāparayorvaijayantyarkayoḥ patrāṇāṃ kaṣāyaḥ; vaijayantī agnimanthavṛkṣaḥ ‘araṇikā’ iti pā.||36-39||
saurāṣṭrī tuvaramṛttikā| puṣpaṃ puṣpāñjanam||40-41||

lg.l: kṣīriṇāṃ ca tvaco yojyāḥ kvāthe triphalayā saha |
tena kvāthena niyataṃ vraṇaṃ prakṣālayed bhiṣak ||43||
asminn eva kaṣāye tu tailaṃ dhīro vipācayet |

div.ab: jambvāmretyādi| śvetaḥ śvetasyandaḥ; kāmbojikā kūvikā, gayī tu māṣaparṇīmāha| tiniśaḥ syandanaḥ| kṣīriṇo vaṭādayaḥ| asminnityādi| gojī gojihvā| sarvagandhairelādiparipaṭhitaiḥ| sāmānyakaṣāyapākakalpitena caturguṇena kaṣāyeṇa siddhaṃ tilatailamakalkameva, kaṣāyopādānāt, kalkamapyanantaroktauṣadhagaṇāt kartavyamityanye, kaṣāyaśabdasya kalke'pi vṛtteḥ||42-44||-

lg.l: gundrāṃ dagdhvā kṛtaṃ bhasma haritālaṃ manaḥśilā ||46||
upadaṃśaṃ nihanty eṣa vṛkṣam indrāśanir yathā |48|

div.ab: mārkavo bhṛṅgarājaḥ||45-47||-

lg.l: tayor eva ca yā yogyā vīkṣya doṣabalābalam |49|

div.ab: upadaṃśayordvayorapi raktasannipātajayostulyakāraṇatvāttulyaiva cikitsā| sannipātaprabhave tu vātādicikitsitamekīkṛtya dadyāt||48||-

lg.l: samyag dagdhaṃ ca vijñāya madhusarpiḥ prayojayet |
śuddhe ca ropaṇaṃ dadyāt kalkaṃ tailaṃ hitaṃ ca yat ||51||

ab.seg: upadaṃśe ityādi| kuthitaṃ mehanaṃ tyajediti yāvanmātraṃ mehanaṃ kuthitaṃ bhavettāvanmātraṃ chindyādityarthaḥ| jambvauṣṭhaḥ jambūphalasadṛśamukhāgrā kṛṣṇapāṣāṇaracitā vartiḥ||49-51||

lg.l: kṛtvā gulphopari sirāṃ vidhyet tu caturaṅgule ||52||
māsam eraṇḍajaṃ tailaṃ piben mūtreṇa saṃyutam ||53||

ab.seg: snehetyādi| sneho'tra śodhanārtha eva, ślīpadānāṃ rūkṣaṇīyatvāt, gayī tu snehasvedopanāhāṃśceti paṭhati| samāpyāyitadehamiti raktāpakarṣeṇa sthāpanāddehasyānukramādāpyāyitasya| bastiratra nirūho'bhipretaḥ| māsamityādi śuṇṭhīkarṣapakvenāṣṭaguṇitena taccaturguṇāvaśiṣṭena payasā bhojanaṃ kuryāt| traivṛtamityādi traivṛtamutpāditaṃ vātavyādhau, taccopayuñjīta snehaprayogakāle||52-54||
gulphasyetyādi| pittaje ślīpade sirāṃ vidhyet, gulphasyopari caturaṅgulam; anye tu gulphasyādha iti sirāvyadha eva sambadhnanti||55||

lg.l: sirāṃ suviditāṃ vidhyed aṅguṣṭhe ślaiṣmike bhiṣak |
kaṭukām amṛtāṃ śuṇṭhīṃ viḍaṅgaṃ dāru citrakam ||57||
hitaṃ vā lepane nityaṃ bhadradāru sacitrakam |
tailaṃ pakvaṃ pibed vā 'pi yavānnaṃ ca hitaṃ sadā ||59||
rasaṃ dattvā 'tha pūrvoktaṃ peyam etad bhiṣagjitam ||62||

ab.seg: sirāmityādi| sirāṃ suviditāmiti kṣipramarmaṇa upari caturaṅgule| madhvityādi| abhīkṣṇaṃ punaḥ punarityarthaḥ| pibedityādi| atra mūtreṇānyatamena ceti aṣṭamūtreṣvekenāpi harītakīṃ seveta| kaṭukāmityādi| anyatamena mūtreṇa pibedityatrāpi sambadhyate| hitamityādi| elukākhyam elavālukam| pibedityādi| kaṇṭakikarañjapatrasvarasaṃ yathābalaṃ analapuruṣādibalānatikrameṇa palamardhapalaṃ paladvayaṃ vā kaṭutailākṣaprakṣepaṃ pibet; kaṇṭakikarañjaḥ pūtīkarañjaḥ, cirabilva ityanye| anenaivetyādi| putrañjīvako'nenaiva nāmnā prasiddhaḥ| kevuketyādi| pākimaṃ lavaṇaṃ viḍalavaṇam| bhiṣagjitam auṣadham||56-62||

lg.l: dagdhvā mūtreṇa tad bhasma srāvayet kṣārakalpavat |
madanāc ca phalāt kvāthaṃ śukākhyasvarasaṃ tathā |
eṣa kṣāras tu pānīyaḥ ślīpadaṃ hanti sevitaḥ ||65||
apacīṃ galagaṇḍaṃ ca grahaṇīdoṣam eva ca |

ab.seg: kākādanīmityādi| kākādanī kālāhiṃsretyarthaḥ| kākajaṅghā etannāmnā prasiddhaiva| kadambapuṣpī alambuṣā muṇḍatiketi loke prasiddhā| mandārī ālī, lambā kaṭukālābuḥ| śukanasā carmakāravaṭaḥ| dagdhvā kṣāraṃ ṣaṅguṇena mūtreṇaikaviṃśativārān srāvayet, kākodumbarikārasaṃ ‘goṣṭhodumbarikārasaṃ’ iti pā. madanaphalakvāthaṃ śukanasāsvarasaṃ ca pratyekaṃ gomūtreṇa samaṃ, pādikamapareṣāṃ matena prakṣipya, kṣārapākakalpakrameṇa vipakvaḥ siddhaḥ, ślīpadaharadraveṇa śāṇādimātrayā pānārhaḥ||63-66||

lg.l: eṣv eva tailaṃ saṃsiddhaṃ nasyābhyaṅgeṣu pūjitam etān evāmayān hanti ye ca duṣṭavraṇā nṛṇām ||67||

ab.seg: kākādanyādīnāṃ kvāthena tathā kākodumbarikārasamadanaphalakvāthaśukanāsāsvaraseṣu pratyekaṃ sameṣu tailaṃ sādhyam||67||

lg.l: dravantīṃ trivṛtāṃ dantīṃ nīlīṃ śyāmāṃ tathaiva ca |
saptalāṃ śaṅkhinīṃ caiva dagdhvā mūtreṇa gālayet ||68||
dadyāc ca triphalākvātham eṣa kṣāras tu sādhitaḥ |
adho gacchati pītas tu pūrvaiś cāpy āśiṣaḥ samāḥ ||69||

ab.seg: dravantīmityādi| dravantī śambarī| trivṛtā trivṛt| dantī dantinī| nīlī śāradaṃ phalaṃ, śrīphaliketi loke| śyāmā vṛddhadārukaḥ| śaṅkhinī yavatiktābhedaḥ| pūrvaiścāpyāśiṣaḥ samā iti pūrvaiḥ pūrvakṣārayogaiḥ saha samāstulyā bhavanti, āśiṣa āśaṃsanāni arthavādāḥ| idamuktaṃ bhavati- ye kecidguṇāḥ pūrvakṣāreṣvabhihitāste'trāpi tulyā jñeyā ityarthaḥ||68-69||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne vṛddhyupadaṃśaślīpada cikitsitaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||19||

div.ab: iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne ekonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||

div.head: kṣudrarogacikitsitam

ab.seg: athātaḥ kṣudrarogacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

tatretyādi| śuktiḥ jalaśuktiḥ| śrughnī svarjikā| yavaḥ prasiddhaḥ| kṣāraśabdaḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| gayī tu ajagallikāmapakvāṃ yavakṣāraśuktisaurāṣṭrīkalkenālepayet, tato jalaukobhiḥ srāvayet ‘apakvāṃ grāhayet’ iti pā., ālepaścādya upakramaḥ sarvaśophānāmityukteḥ||1-4||
andhetyādi||5-6||
madhurauṣadhāni kākolyādīni||7-8||

lg.l: cipya(ppa)m uṣṇāmbunā siktam utkṛtya srāvayed bhiṣak |
kunakhe vidhir apy eṣa kāryo hi bhiṣajā bhavet |

ab.seg: cippamityādi| utkṛtya duṣṭamāṃsaṃ pakvam| cakratailaṃ cakrapīḍitaṃ, hastādipīḍitavyudāsārthaṃ cakragrahaṇam| “cippaṃ śoṇitasekena śodhanaiścāpyupācaret| gatoṣmāṇaṃ tathā cainamuṣṇāmbupariṣecitam|| śastreṇa tu yathāyogamutkṛtya srāvayedvraṇam| śilā tejovatī caiva rocanā ca rasāñjanam|| kalkairetaiśca ‘kalkairetairamlapiṣṭaiḥ’ iti pā. sampiṣṭaiḥ śodhayitvā vraṇaṃ tataḥ| haridrāgurukālīyakalkaiśca sarasāñjanaiḥ|| siddhena tilatailena tatra kurvīta ropaṇam”- iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ| eṣa vidhiḥ cippakramaḥ||9-11||

lg.l: vraṇabhāvagatāyāṃ vā kṛtvā saṃśodhanakriyām ‘saṃśodhanīṃ kriyām’ iti pā.|
baddhvā ca kṣīravṛkṣasya kaṣāyaiḥ khadirasya ca |
vraṇaṃ prakṣālayec chuddhāṃ tatas tāṃ ropayet punaḥ ||16||

ab.seg: vidārikāmityādi| vimlāpyeti aṅguṣṭhādibhiḥ| nagavṛttikaḥ jiṅginī guḍamajjaniketi loke, vṛścikālītyanye| vraṇabhāvetyādi| kaṣāyaiḥ nyagrodhādipaṭhitaiḥ, madhuraiḥ kākolyādibhiḥ| ajakarṇaḥ sarjaḥ| pālāśaḥ śaṭī| pakvāmityādi| picumardo nimbaḥ| kṣīravṛkṣā vaṭodumbaraplakṣapippalagardabhāṇḍāḥ||12-16||

div.ab: medo'rbudetyādi| naktamālajatailenāpakvenaiva, ‘kaṭukauṣadhasiddhena’ ityanye| sāratailena śiṃśapāgurusaraladevadārvāditailena| kaṭukauṣadhāni pippalyādīni| ‘sāratailamathābhyaṅge’ ityatra ‘sāralaṃ tailamabhyaṅge’ iti kecit paṭhanti; tatra saralasārasnehaḥ sāmānyasnehaparibhāṣayā paktavyaḥ||17-18||-

ab.seg: pādetyādi| pūrvamādau snehatvedau kṛtvā paścāt sirāṃ vidhyet| yavāhvo yavakṣāraḥ||19-20||

lg.l: pādau siktvā''ranālena lepanaṃ hy alase hitam |
siddhaṃ rase kaṇṭakāryās tailaṃ vā sārṣapaṃ hitam ||22||

div.ab: pādāvityādi| śilā manaḥśilā| pratisāraṇaṃ gharṣaṇam||21-22||-

lg.l: utkṛtya ‘uddhṛtya’ iti pā. dagdhvā snehena jayet kadarasañjñakam ||23||

ab.seg: utkṛtyetyādi| kadaraṃ tu śastreṇotkṛtya agnitaptena tailenaiva dahet, sūkṣmamārgānusāritvāttailasya; anye tu vahnisantaptāḥ sarve'pi snehāḥ sūkṣmamārgānusāriṇo bhavanti, ataḥ sarve'pi snehā grāhyāḥ||23||
