div.ab: indralupta ityādi| kuṭannaṭetyādi kuṭannaṭaḥ tagaraḥ| rasāyanavidhānopadeśaṃ kurvannetajjñāpayati- duḥsādhyo'yaṃ vyādhirna śakyate rasāyanamantareṇāpanetuṃ; rasāyanamaṣṭādaśa divyauṣadhayaḥ somaścauṣadharājā| mālatītyādi snehapākakalpaparibhāṣayā jātyādikalkasiddhena kaṭutailena gomūtracaturguṇena śiro'bhyañjyāt||24-26||-

arūṃṣikāmityādi| arūṃṣikāṃ tu punarjalaukobhiḥ raktamavasicya nimbakvāthena paritaḥ siktvā, aśvapurīṣarasena bahusaindhavacūrṇena lepayet| mārkavo bhṛṅgarājaḥ| haritālādibhirvā madhukādibhirvā lepayet| indraluptoktasya jātyāditailasyābhyaṅgakaraṇamarūṃṣikāyāḥ śodhanaropaṇam||27-28||-

ab.seg: sirāmityādi| avapīḍya nasye dīyata ityavapīḍaḥ||29-30||

div.ab: palitacikitsitamāha- upariṣṭādityādi| upariṣṭānmiśrakokte cikitsite|31|-
masūrikāyāmityādi| ādiśabdenodvartanaghṛtādi||31||-

lg.l: kṣāreṇa pradahed yuktyā vahninā vā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ‘carmakīlaṃ jatumaṇiṃ maśakaṃ tilakālakam| uddhṛtya śastreṇa dahet kṣārāgnibhyāmaśeṣataḥ||’ iti pā.|33|

div.ab: jatumaṇimityādi| kṣāreṇa kṣāraviṣayeṣu, āgninā akṣārakṛtyeṣu||32||-

lg.l: nyacche vyaṅge sirāmokṣo nīlikāyāṃ ca śasyate ||33||
ghṛṣṭvā dihyāt tvacaṃ piṣṭvā kṣīriṇāṃ kṣīrasaṃyutām ||34||

ab.seg: nyacche ityādi| ghṛṣṭvā samudraphenādinā| kṣīriṇo vaṭādayo vṛkṣāḥ pañca, teṣāṃ tvacaṃ piṣṭvā| payasyā arkapuṣpī| kālīyaṃ kṛṣṇacandanam||33-36||

lg.l: yauvane piḍakāsv eṣa viśeṣāc chardanaṃ hitam |

div.ab: yauvane ityādi| eṣa anantaroktaḥ||37||-

ab.seg: padminītyādi| nimbāragvadhayoḥ kalkaḥ kaṣāya utsādane udvartane hito bhavedityarthaḥ| kalke kaṣāyaśabdo vartate, “pañcavidhaṃ kaṣāyakalpanam” (ca. sū. 4) iti vacanāt||38-39||

lg.l: tato 'bhyajya śanaiś carma cānayet pīḍayen maṇim ||40||
praviṣṭe ca maṇau carma svedayed upanāhanaiḥ |
dadyād vātaharān bastīn snigdhāny annāni bhojayet |

ab.seg: parivṛttimityādi| upanāhayet badhnīyāt| abhyajya sarpiṣā| hīnamadhyamottamadoṣabalāpekṣayā ekarātratripañcarātravikalpaḥ||40-42||

lg.l: tryahāt tryahāt sthūlatarāṃ samyaṅ nāḍīṃ praveśayet |
sroto vivardhayed evaṃ snigdham annaṃ ca bhojayet ||45||
bhittvā vā sevanīṃ muktvā sadyaḥkṣatavad ācaret |

div.ab: niruddhetyādi| dāravīṃ kāṣṭhamayīm| jatukṛtāṃ lākṣāmayīm| śiśumāraḥ pādī jalacaraḥ svanāmakhyātaḥ| cakratailaṃ yantrapīḍitaṃ tailaṃ; sevanīṃ bhittvā muktvā vā śastreṇa mūtrasrotaḥsaṅkocakāraṇaṃ carmāvadārayet; tasyāpi dvārasyāvipāke maṇidvāramathaivaṃ dārayet||43-47||-

lg.l: valmīkaṃ tu bhaved yasya nātivṛddham amarmajam ||49||
tatra saṃśodhanaṃ kṛtvā śoṇitaṃ mokṣayed bhiṣak |
kulatthikāyā mūlaiś ca guḍūcyā lavaṇena ca ||50||
ārevatasya mūlaiś ca dantīmūlais tathaiva ca |
susnigdhaiś ca sukhoṣṇaiś ca bhiṣak tam upanāhayet |
pakvaṃ vā ‘yadā vijānīyāt’ iti pā. tad vijānīyād gatīḥ sarvā yathākramam ||52||
abhijñāya tataś chittvā pradahen matimān bhiṣak |
vraṇaṃ viśuddhaṃ vijñāya ropayen matimān bhiṣak |
etaiḥ siddhaṃ nimbatailaṃ valmīke ropaṇaṃ hitam ||55||
valmīkaṃ yat saśophaṃ syād varjyaṃ tat tu vijānatā ||56||

ab.seg: asādhyeṣvapi valmīkāgnirohiṇīprabhṛtiṣu cikitsitaṃ kāryaṃ, “yāvaducchvasiti prāṇī tāvat kāryā pratikriyā| kadā'pi daivayogena dṛṣṭāriṣṭo'pi jīvati” ityuktatvāt| valmīkamityādi| tatra saṃśodhanaṃ kṛtvā ‘auṣadhena’ iti śeṣaḥ| ārevataḥ kiramālakaḥ| śyāmā trivṛdviśeṣaḥ| palalaṃ tilapiṣṭiḥ| upanāhaḥ pācanam| kālānusārī kṛṣṇasārivā||48-56||

lg.l: pītaṃ ghṛtaṃ nāśayati kṛcchrām apy ahipūtanām |

ab.seg: dhātryā ityādi| kāsīsādibhiramlakāñjikādipiṣṭaiḥ pralepanaṃ, badarītvaksaindhavairvā pralepanam| kapālaṃ pakvamṛdbhāṇḍakhaṇḍaḥ| ahipūtanoktaśca dhātrīśodhanavarjaṃ ghṛtapānādiḥ||57-60||

lg.l: vinirgamārthaṃ vāyoś ca svedayec ca muhur muhuḥ |

ab.seg: gudetyādi| mūṣikāṃ nirgatāntrāṃ kṛtvā mahatpañcamūlasya prasthaṃ kṣīraprasthe triguṇitajale vipacet, kṣīraprasthe'vaśiṣṭai tailakuḍavaṃ dattvā, bhadradārvādikalkapādaṃ kṛtvā, pacet; tadyathābalaṃ pānābhyaṅgābhyāṃ gudabhraṃśaṃ sādhayet||61-63||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne kṣudrarogacikitsitaṃ nāma viṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||20||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne viṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||20||

div.head: śūkarogacikitsitam

ab.seg: athātaḥ śūkadoṣacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
śūkādidoṣacikitsitamiti jñeyam, ādiśabdasya luptatvāt; tatrādiśabdena nidānoktā abhighātanimittā durbhaganimittāścātra jñātavyāḥ||1-2||

lg.l: kaṣāyeṣv eva tailaṃ ca kurvīta vraṇaropaṇam ||3||

ab.seg: saṃlikhyetyādi| kaṣāyairiti kaṣāyavṛkṣacūrṇairavacūrṇayet, kaṣāyavṛkṣairmiśrakoktaśodhanakaṣāyasādhanadravyaiścūrṇīkṛtairavacūrṇayedityarthaḥ| teṣu ropaṇakaṣāyasādhanadravyeṣu pādikeṣu jalaṃ caturguṇaṃ dattvā ropaṇaṃ tailaṃ kuryāt||3||

lg.l: aṣṭhīlikāṃ jalaukobhir grāhayec ca ‘grāhayet kuśalo bhiṣak’ iti pā. punaḥ punaḥ |

ab.seg: aṣṭhīlikāmityādi| kaphagrantheriva śastreṇoddharaṇam||4||

lg.l: kumbhīkāṃ pākamāpannāṃ bhindyāc chuddhāṃ tu ropayet |

ab.seg: svedayedityādi| śaśvat pratidinam| susnigdhairityupanāhaviśeṣaṇam| tailena triphalādikalkapādena jalacaturguṇasiddhena ropayet||5-6||

lg.l: kaṣāyais teṣu siddhaṃ ca tailaṃ ropaṇam iṣyate ||7||

ab.seg: grāhayitvetyādi| kaṣāyaiḥ kaṣāyavṛkṣakaṣāyaiḥ, kaṣāyavṛkṣāḥ plakṣādayaḥ||7||
baletyādi| madhurāṇi kākolyādīni||8||
sammūḍhetyādi| paryāgatā pakvā||9||

lg.l: avamanthe gate pākaṃ bhinne tailaṃ vidhīyate |
kriyāṃ puṣkarikāyāṃ tu śītāṃ sarvāṃ prayojayet |
sparśahānyāṃ hared raktaṃ pradihyān madhurair api |

ab.seg: avamanthetyādi| aśvakarṇaḥ pūrvadeśe ‘gandhamuṇḍa’ iti khyāto'śvatthasadṛśaḥ| pattaṅgaṃ raktacandanam||10-12||
piḍakāmityādi| kaṣāyaiḥ cūrṇairityarthaḥ| śodhanakāle tu śodhanadravyaiścūrṇīkṛtairavacūrṇayet, ropaṇakāle tu ropaṇaireva||13||

lg.l: pṛthak parṇyādisiddhaṃ ca deyaṃ tailam anantaram ||14||
kriyāṃ kuryād bhiṣak prājñas tvakpākasya visarpavat |15|

div.ab: rasakriyetyādi| rasakriyā phāṇitākṛtiḥ, śodhanakāle śodhanadravyakaṣāyakṛtā, ropaṇakāle ropaṇadravyakaṣāyakṛtā| pṛthakparṇyādisiddhaṃ tailaṃ sāmānyasnehaparibhāṣākalpena; pṛthakparṇyādīni miśrake ropaṇaghṛtapaṭhitāni kākolyādivarjitāni| visarpavat pittavisarpavadityarthaḥ||14||-

lg.l: hitaṃ ca sarpiṣaḥ pānaṃ pathyaṃ cāpi virecanam |
hitaḥ śoṇitamokṣaś ca yac cāpi laghu bhojanam ||17||

ab.seg: raktetyādi| śoṇitaje arbude liṅgaje raktārbude| vīkṣya vīkṣyeti dvivraṇīyoktāmavasthāṃ samyak nirūpyetyarthaḥ| avacārayet kaṣāyādīnītyarthaḥ||15-18||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne śūkarogacikitsitaṃ nāmaikaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||21||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne ekaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||21||

div.head: mukharogacikitsitam

ab.seg: athāto mukharogacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

lg.l: vātaje 'bhyañjanaṃ kuryān nāḍīsvedaṃ ‘kṛtvā nāḍīsvedaṃ’ iti pā. ca buddhimān ||3||
mastiṣke caiva nasye ca tailaṃ vātaharaṃ hitam ||4||
śirovirecanaṃ dhūmaḥ svedaḥ kavala eva ca |
medoje svedite bhinne śodhite jvalano hitaḥ |

div.ab: caturvidhena catuṣprakāreṇa| snehena doṣādyapekṣayā samastavyastena snehapākaparibhāṣayā vātaharakaṣāyamadhūcchiṣṭakalkaśṛtenābhyaṅgaḥ| tataḥ snigdhaṃ nāḍīsvedena yathoktena svedayet| mastiṣkaḥ śirobastiprakāraḥ; badhyata ūrdhvaṃ śirobastiḥ, anavabaddho mastiṣka iti| anye tu paṭhanti ‘mastiṣkye ‘mastakye’ iti pā. caiva nasye ca’ ityādi; atra mastiṣkyaṃ ‘mastakyaṃ’ iti pā. mastiṣke ‘mastake’ iti pā. hitamabhyaṅgatailapicudhāraṇaśirobastyādi| śrīveṣṭakaḥ saralaniryāsaḥ| pratisāraṇaṃ gharṣaṇam| kriyāṃ kuryādaśeṣata iti saṃśodhanasaṃśamanarūpāṃ bāhyāmābhyantarīṃ ca| medoje punarasnehapūrvaṃ svedite bhittvā medaso'pakarṣaṇaṃ, śodhite cāgneravacāraṇaṃ pathyam||1-9||-

lg.l: dantamūlagatānāṃ tu rogāṇāṃ ‘sādhyānāṃ’ iti pā. karma vakṣyate ||10||
priyaṅgavaś ca mustaṃ ca triphalā ca pralepanam |
hitaḥ śirovirekaś ca nasyaṃ snigdhaṃ ca bhojanam |14|

div.ab: dantetyādi| nasyamityādi| śoṇitāvasekaśodhanagaṇḍūṣakupitavātānubandhe snehanaṃ nasyam| tatra kaphānugate madhukādibhiḥ saha triphalāsiddhaṃ tailaṃ nasye prayojyaṃ, śoṇitānugame ca triphalādisaṃsiddhaṃ ghṛtamiti| taruṇe tatkālotpanne| nasyamiti ‘śītādoktasnehena’ iti śeṣaḥ, doṣadūṣyasthānānāmaikyāt||10-13||-

lg.l: sakṣaudraiḥ śasyate lepo gaṇḍūṣe kṣīriṇo hitāḥ |
kṣīre daśaguṇe siddhaṃ sarpir nasye ca pūjitam |

ab.seg: visrāvite ityādi| pattaṅgaṃ raktacandanaṃ, madhūttaraiḥ madhupradhānaiḥ| kṣīriṇo vaṭādayaḥ| daśakṣīrasiddhaṃ daśaguṇena gavyakṣīreṇa ghṛtaṃ sādhanīyam||14-18||

lg.l: pippalīḥ sarṣapāñ śvetān nāgaraṃ naiculaṃ phalam ||20||
śastreṇa ‘vastreṇa’ iti pā. dantavaidarbhe dantamūlāni śodhayet |
tataḥ kṣāraṃ prayuñjīta kriyāḥ sarvāś ca śītalāḥ ||22||

ab.seg: saṃśodhyobhayata iti vamanavirecanābhyāmūrdhvamadhaśca kāyaṃ śodhayitvā, śirovirecanena śiraśca saṃśodhayedityarthaḥ| raktapittotthite'pyupakuśe sthāninaḥ kaphasya pratīkārārthaṃ vamanaṃ yuktam| kākodumbarikā kāṣṭhodumbarikā, gojī gojihvā| niculo vetasaḥ| madhurakaiḥ kākolyādibhiḥ||19-23||

lg.l: hitaḥ śirovirekaś ca dhūmo vairecanaś ca yaḥ ||25||

ab.seg: chittvetyādi| tejovatī kākamardanikā| sakṣaudraśca sapippalīkaḥ sukhodake kavalaḥ||24-25||

lg.l: sāmānyaṃ karma nāḍīnāṃ viśeṣaṃ cātra me śṛṇu |
yaṃ dantam abhijāyeta ‘dantamadhijāyeta’ iti pā. nāḍī taṃ dantam uddharet |
chittvā māṃsāni śastreṇa yadi noparijo bhavet ||27||
śodhayitvā dahec cāpi kṣāreṇa jvalanena vā |
bhinatty upekṣite dante hanukāsthi gatir dhruvam ||28||
samūlaṃ daśanaṃ tasmād uddhared bhagnam asthiram |
uddhṛte tūttare dante samūle ‘saśūle’ iti pā. sthirabandhane ||29||
raktātiyogāt pūrvoktā rogā ghorā bhavanti hi |
kāṇaḥ sañjāyate jantur arditaṃ cāsya jāyate ||30||
calam apy uttaraṃ dantam ato nāpahared bhiṣak |
tailaṃ saṃśodhanaṃ tad dhi hanyād dantagatāṃ gatim |
kīrtitā dantamūle tu kriyā danteṣu vakṣyate ||33||

ab.seg: sāmānyamityādi| sāmānyaṃ tulyam| yadeva vātādināḍīnāṃ karmoktaṃ tadeva dantanāḍīnāṃ sāmānyamekamityarthaḥ| yaṃ dantamabhijāyetetyādi yaṃ dantamabhi samīpe nāḍī syāttaṃ dantamuddharet| yadi noparijo bhavediti ūrdhvagatadantapaṅktigataścenna bhavati| sthirabandhane dṛḍhataradantaveṣṭane| ‘samūle sthirabandhane’ ityatra ‘śoṇitaṃ samprasicyate’ iti paṭhanti| dhāvane prakṣālane, jātimadanakaṭukasvādukaṇṭakakhādiraṃ kaṣāyamiti; anye tu kaṣāyamāmapūgaphalamiti manyante| svādukaṇṭako gokṣuraḥ, kaṇṭakārivṛkṣamanye||26-33||

lg.l: snehānāṃ kavalāḥ koṣṇāḥ sarpiṣas traivṛtasya vā |
snaihikaś ca hito dhūmo nasyaṃ snigdhaṃ ca bhojanam |
raso rasayavāgvaś ca kṣīraṃ santānikā ghṛtam ||35||
śirobastir hitaś cāpi kramo yaś cānilāpahaḥ |
kapālikā kṛcchratamā tatrāpy eṣā kriyā hitā |
calam uddhṛtya ‘kṛmidantakamityunneyam’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ ca sthānaṃ vidahet suṣirasya ca |
tailaṃ daśaguṇe kṣīre siddhaṃ nasye hitaṃ bhavet |41|

div.ab: sarpiṣastraivṛtasya veti vātavyādhipaṭhitasya ‘vātavyādhipratipāditasya’ iti pā.| niryūhāḥ kvāthāḥ| raso māṃsarasaḥ| rasayavāgvo māṃsarasayavāgvaḥ| kṣīraṃ dugdham| santānikā ‘sara’ iti bhāṣā, kṣīrasānnidhyāt santānikāghṛte kṣīrotthe eva| pratisārayet gharṣayedityarthaḥ| uddhṛtadaśanasya sthānaṃ dahecchuddhyarthaṃ śoṇitasrāvaniṣedhārthaṃ ca; suṣirasya ca pūyakṛtacchidrasya ‘sthānaṃ dahet’ iti śeṣaḥ||34-40||-

arditavatsamuddiṣṭāmiti ardita iva samuddiṣṭāṃ kriyāṃ kuryāt| samuddiṣṭagrahaṇenaitajjñāpayati- arditoktāmātideśikīṃ “vātavyādhividhinopacaret” (ci.a.5) ityevaṃrūpāṃ vaiśeṣikīṃ vātārditoktāṃ mastiṣkaśirobastinasyadhūmopanāhādikāṃ dvividhāmapi kriyāṃ kuryāditi| sādhyānāṃ dantarogāṇāṃ cikitsitamuktaṃ, śyāvadantadālanabhañjanānāmasādhyatvānnodāhṛtam||41-42||-

lg.l: kaṇṭakeṣv anilottheṣu tat kāryaṃ bhiṣajā bhavet ||44||

div.ab: jihvetyādi| vighṛṣṭeṣu gojīśephālikādipatraghṛṣṭeṣu, pratisāraṇaṃ madhuraireva kākolyādibhiḥ; gaṇḍūṣo'pi taireva kvathitaiḥ; nasyamapi daśaguṇakṣīraṃ tatkalkasadhitaṃ hitam| likhiteṣu maṇḍalāgrādinā| asṛjaḥ kṣaye asṛjo'vasāne, virāme ityarthaḥ| kṣāro yavakṣāraḥ, tatpradhānaiḥ yuṣaiḥ kṣārayūṣaiḥ| upajihvāmityādi| gaṇḍūṣaḥ kaphavraṇaharadravyeṇa kaphakaṇṭakaharadravyeṇa vā| dhūmaiśca vairecanikadhūmaiḥ| alāsaḥ punaratra kapharaktakṛta āśukāritvāt pratyākhyāyaiva virecanakṣoṇitamokṣaṇakavalaśirovirecanadhūmavamanādibhirupacaryaḥ||43-48||-

lg.l: notkṛṣṭaṃ caiva hīnaṃ ca tribhāgaṃ chedayed bhiṣak ||50||
atyādānāt sraved raktaṃ tannimittaṃ mriyeta ca |
hīnacchedād bhavec chopho lālā nidrā bhramas tamaḥ ||51||
galaśuṇḍīṃ tu sañchidya kuryāt prāptam imaṃ kramam ||52||
niṣkvāthya picumandaṃ ca kavalaṃ tatra yojayet ||54||
pañcāṅgīṃ kārayet piṣṭair vartiṃ gandhottarāṃ śubhām ||55||
tato dhūmaṃ pibej jantur dvir ahnaḥ kaphanāśanam |
kṣārasiddheṣu mudgeṣu yūṣaś cāpy aśane hitaḥ ||56||
eṣa eva vidhiḥ kāryo viśeṣaḥ śastrakarmaṇi ||57||

div.ab: aṅguṣṭhetyādi| chedayenmaṇḍalāgreṇeti bhāgadvayamardhaṃ ‘bhāgadvayaṃ sārdhaṃ vā’ iti pā. vā parityajya bhāgenaikenārdhena vā chedayet| bhramaścakrārūḍhasyeva bhramaṇam| tamaḥ andhakāradarśanam| prāptaṃ yuktam| kuṭannaṭaḥ śyonākaḥ| kiṇihī kaṭabhī, saralā trivṛt| pañcāṅgīmiti pañcabhiraṅgabhūtairdravyaiḥ kṛtā pañcāṅgī, tām| gandhottarāṃ gandhapradhānām| dvirahnaḥ ahni vāradvayamiti| kṣārasiddheṣu mudgeṣviti kṛto yūṣo yavakṣāreṇa lavaṇīkṛto bhojane hitaḥ pathyaḥ| tuṇḍikerītyādi| viśeṣaḥ śastrakarmaṇīti śastrakarmaṇi viśeṣo ‘niḥśeṣacchede'pi’ iti pā. bhedaḥ| tatra tuṇḍikerī medyā tālupuppuṭako'pi, adhruṣamāṃsasaṅghātau chedyau, māṃsocchrāyatvāllekhyaḥ kurmastato'nurūpāyāmavasthāyāṃ chedyo'pi| tālvityādi| cakāreṇātra tāluśoṣe pittaharo vidhiḥ samuccīyate, pittenāpi tāluśoṣajananāt| kīrtitaṃ tālujānāmiti atra raktārbudasyāsādhyatvāt karma nodāhṛtam||49-58||-

lg.l: chardanaṃ dhūmapānaṃ ca gaṇḍūṣo nasyakarma ca |
vātikīṃ tu hṛte rakte lavaṇaiḥ pratisārayet ||60||
ekakālaṃ yavānnaṃ ca bhuñjīta snigdham alpaśaḥ |
ekavṛndaṃ tu visrāvya vidhiṃ śodhanam ācaret |
gilāyuś cāpi yo vyādhis taṃ ca śastreṇa sādhayet ||66||

div.ab: śoṇitamokṣaṇādikarmapaccakaṃ sāmānyaṃ sādhyānām| abhīkṣṇaśaḥ vāraṃvāram| pataṅgaṃ raktacandanam| śvetā śvetasyandā| visrāvyetyādi| sādhayettuṇḍikerivaditi tuṇḍikeryāmapi galaśuṇḍīvidhyatideśāt sādhayedgalaśuṇḍīvaditi vācye tuṇḍikerīvidhyatideśo niḥśeṣacchedanārthaḥ, galaśuṇḍīvadatra tribhāgacchedo na kārya iti bodhayati, aśeṣacchedo na punastribhāgādibhiriti| visrāvya jalaukābhiḥ| śirovirecanadhūmalepanakṣārādibhiḥ śodhanam||59-66||-

lg.l: tato 'smai snaihikaṃ dhūmam imaṃ dadyād vicakṣaṇaḥ ||68||
tat sarvaṃ sukṛtaṃ cūrṇaṃ snehenāloḍya yuktitaḥ |
eṣa sarvasare dhūmaḥ praśastaḥ snaihiko mataḥ |
pibed ativiṣāṃ pāṭhāṃ mustaṃ ca suradāru ca |
rohiṇīṃ kaṭukākhyāṃ ca kuṭajasya phalāni ca ||74||

ab.seg: mukhāvayavagatānnirdiśya sakalavadanagatānnirdiśannāha- vātādityādi| lavaṇaiścūrṇaiḥ pañcalavaṇakṛtaiḥ| tailaṃ vātaharaiḥ siddhaṃ hitaṃ kavalanasyayoḥ vātaharabhadradārvādikalkakaṣāyasiddhaṃ tailaṃ kavale nasye ca hitamityarthaḥ| śālarājādanetyādi śālaphalādimajjānaḥ; śālaḥ śaṅkuḥ, rājādanaḥ kṣīrikā, sāraḥ sāravṛkṣaḥ khadirādiḥ| dhyāmaṃ gandhatṛṇaṃ ‘kattṛṇaṃ’ iti pā., kālānusārivā kālavallī| śrīḥ navanītakhoṭiḥ saralaniryāsaḥ, sarjarasaḥ rālā| snehenāloḍya yuktita iti yāvatā snehena nātighanatvaṃ nātitanutvaṃ lepayogyatā ca bhavati tāvatī snehamātretyarthaḥ| ṭiṇṭukaḥ śyonākaḥ| śuddhakāyasya vamanādibhiḥ| ativiṣādicūrṇadharaṇabhāgaṃ pratidivasaṃ ṣāṇmāsikaṃ gomūtreṇa peyam| dharaṇamānamapi kecit sauśrutīyāḥ paṭhanti; “madhyamā ekonaviṃśatirniṣpāvā dharaṇaṃ tānyardhatṛtīyāni karṣaḥ” (ci.a.31) iti||67-75||

lg.l: vidadhyāt kavalān vīkṣya doṣaṃ tailaghṛtair api ||76||

ab.seg: sarveṣveva mukharogeṣvatra doṣādivibhāgena kavalānnirdiśannāha- kṣīrekṣurasetyādi| vīkṣya doṣaṃ doṣakāryamapi ‘rogakāraṇaṃ’ iti pā. rogamityarthaḥ||76||

lg.l: asādhyā api vakṣyante rogā ye tatra kīrtitāḥ ||77||
jihvāgateṣv alāsas tu tālavyeṣv arbudaṃ tathā ||79||
svaraghno valayo vṛndo vidāryalasa eva ca |
galauṣṭho māṃsatānaś ca śataghnī rohiṇī ca yā ||80||
asādhyāḥ kīrtitā hy ete rogā nava daśaiva ca |
teṣāṃ cāpi kriyāṃ vaidyaḥ pratyākhyāya samācaret ||81||

ab.seg: oṣṭhajāstrayaḥ, dantamūleṣu dvau, dantabhaveṣu trayaḥ, triliṅgagatiḥ tridoṣaliṅgākṛtirnāḍī, jihvāgateṣvekaḥ, tālunyapyeka eva, svaraghnādayo nava gale, samudāyasaṅkhyā nava daśaiveti||77-81||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne mukharogacikitsitaṃ nāma dvāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||22||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne dvāviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||22||

div.head: śophacikitsitam

ab.seg: athātaḥ śophānāṃ cikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
ṣaḍvidho 'vayavasamutthaḥ śopho 'bhihito lakṣaṇataḥ pratīkārataś ca; sarvasaras tu pañcavidhaḥ, tad yathā- vātapittaśleṣmasannipātaviṣanimittaḥ ||3||

avayave samuttiṣṭhatīti avayavasamutthaḥ, sthā gatinivṛttau, sthiratvādityarthaḥ ‘sthira ityarthāt’ iti pā.| abhihita uktaḥ| kena? atītena śāstreṇa| cakāro'nuktahetvādisamuccayārthaḥ ‘cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena kārakahetorapīti bodhyam’ iti pā., anye tu lakṣaṇaśabdenaiva hetvādiṃ ‘kārakaheturapyavaruddha ityāhuḥ’ iti pā. nirdiśanti, apare tu asādhyānāmapratīkārasamuccayārthaṃ varṇayanti| sarvaṃ saratīti sarvasaraḥ; gatimattvāt sarvasaraṇayogyaḥ||1-3||

tatrāpatarpitasyādhvagamanād atimātram abhyavaharato vā piṣṭānnaharitakaśākalavaṇāni kṣīṇasya vā 'timātram amlam upasevamānasya mṛtpakvaloṣṭakaṭaśarkarānūpaudakamāṃsasevanād ajīrṇino vā grāmyadharmasevanād viruddhāhārasevanāt vā hastyaśvoṣṭrarathapadātisaṅkṣobhaṇādayo sitasya doṣā dhātūn pradūṣya śvayathum āpādayanty akhile śarīre ||4||

pañcavidhasyaiva sarvasarasyāhāravihārābhyāṃ sarvāṅgagatadoṣakopahetuṃ nirdiśannāha- tatretyādi| apatarpitaḥ laṅghanavyāyāmavamanādirūkṣādibhirāhāravihāraiḥ karśitaḥ, tasyātyarthamadhvagamanalakṣaṇādvihārāt| piṣṭānnādimatimātramabhyavaharataḥ ityevaṃvidhādāhārāt| haritakaḥ kuṭheraśigrusurasāsumukhāsuribhūtṛṇādiḥ| piṣṭānnagrahaṇena sarvavidhagurvāhārāvarodhaḥ| kṣīṇasya veti svayameva kṛśasyātyarthamamlamupasevamānasya| mṛdādyāhāraratasya; mṛt mṛttikā, pakvaloṣṭaḥ agnipakvaloṣṭaḥ, kaṭaśarkarā agnidagdhaśarkarā, ānūpā mahiṣādayaḥ, audakā matsyādayaḥ| ajīrṇino vetyādi| grāmyadharmo maithunaṃ, sājīrṇasya maithunasevanāt| viruddhaṃ hitāhitīyādhyāye proktam| saṅkṣobhaṇāt calanādityarthaḥ ‘yānajanyādityarthaḥ’ iti pā.| akhile śarīre sakale kāye||4||

tatra vātaśvayathur aruṇaḥ kṛṣṇo vā mṛdur anavasthitās todādayaś cātra vedanāviśeṣāḥ; pittaśvayathuḥ pītaḥ sarakto vā mṛduḥ śīghrānusāry ūṣādayaś cātra vedanāviśeṣāḥ; śleṣmaśvayathuḥ pāṇḍuḥ śuklo vā snigdhaḥ kaṭhinaḥ śīto mandānusārī, kaṇḍvādayaś cātra vedanāviśeṣāḥ; sannipātaśvayathuḥ sarvavarṇavedanaḥ; viṣanimittas tu garopayogād duṣṭatoyasevanāt prakuthitodakāvagāhanāt saviṣasattvadigdhacūrṇenāvacūrṇanād vā saviṣamūtrapurīṣaśukraspṛṣṭānāṃ vā tṛṇakāṣṭhādīnāṃ saṃsparśanāt, sa tu mṛduḥ kṣiprotthāno 'valambī calo 'calo vā dāhapākarāgaprāyaś ca bhavati ||5||

bhavanti cātra-
doṣāḥ śvayathum ūrdhvaṃ hi kurvanty āmāśayasthitāḥ |
pakvāśayasthā madhye ca varcaḥsthānagatās tv adhaḥ ||6||

lg.l: kṛtsnaṃ deham anuprāptāḥ kuryuḥ sarvasaraṃ tathā |7|

div.ab: tatretyādi| aruṇa īṣadraktaḥ| ūṣādayaḥ ūṣacoṣaparitāpādayaḥ| kaṇḍvādayaḥ kaṇḍūrgurutvamityādayaḥ| garopayogo bahirantaśca| prakothaḥ pūtibhāvaḥ, saviṣakīṭādikothaprakuthitodakāvagāhanāt, ayaṃ punarbahireva| saviṣasattvalālāsparśādiviṣāt taddigdhacūrṇenāvacūrṇanādveti saviṣasattvādimiśracūrṇairavadhūlanāt; saviṣasattvacūrṇaṃ vṛścikālīnāmakaṃ ‘vṛścikālīnāmakakṣupabhedacūrṇamiti himavatyatyarthaṃ lokā vadanti’ iti pā. kṣupabhedaṃ kecit kathayanti||5-6||-

lg.l: śvayathur madhyadeśe yaḥ sa kaṣṭaḥ sarvagaś ca yaḥ ||7||
śvāsaḥ pipāsā daurbalyaṃ jvaraś cchardir arocakaḥ ||8||
sāmānyato viśeṣāc ca teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi bheṣajam ||9||

ab.seg: tasya dehadeśajanmasvabhāvena kṛcchratvādi nirdiśannāha- śvayathurityādi| madhyadeśe yaḥ śvayathuḥ sa sannipātajvaravadviruddhopakramatvāt kaṣṭaḥ| ardhāṅga iti ardhanāsārdhahṛdayārdhanābhiḥ śophāvacchinnaikapakṣaḥ ardhāṅgaḥ, tiryagvā nābhyavacchinnapūrvārdhe'pārārdhe vā| ariṣṭabhūtaḥ ariṣṭavat, bhūtaśabdo'tra upamānārthaḥ, riṣṭābhāsa ityarthaḥ| yaścordhvaṃ parisarpatīti yaḥ śophaḥ pādābhinivṛtta ūrdhvamuparitanakāye parisarpati sa puruṣaviṣaye'riṣṭabhūtaḥ; cakāro bhinnakrame, tena yaścādhaḥ parisarpati uttamāṅgāt sa strīviṣaye'riṣṭabhūtaḥ| uktaṃ ca- “ūrdhvagāmī naraṃ pabhdyāmadhogāmī mukhāt striyam”- iti| ūrdhvamadhyādhaḥsthitaśophe'pi sarvasarābhidhānamekadeśe'pi dagdhe paṭo dagdha itivat| upadraveṇāsādhyatvaṃ nirdiśannāha- śvāsa ityādi| sāmānyata ityādi sāmānyaṃ viśeṣaṃ ca||7-9||
śophinaḥ sarva eva parihareyur amlalavaṇadadhiguḍavasāpayastailaghṛtapiṣṭamayagurūṇi ||10||

tatra vātaśvayathau traivṛtam eraṇḍatailaṃ vā māsam ardhamāsaṃ vā pāyayet, nyagrodhādikakaṣāyasiddhaṃ sarpiḥ pittaśvayathau, āragvadhādisiddhaṃ sarpiḥ śleṣmaśvayathau, sannipātaśvayathau snuhīkṣīrapātraṃ dvādaśabhir amlapātraiḥ pratisaṃsṛjya dantīdravantīpratīvāpaṃ sarpiḥ pācayitvā pāyayet, viṣanimitteṣu kalpeṣu pratīkāraḥ ||11||

prathamaṃ viśeṣacikitsāmāha- tatretyādi| traivṛtamiti majjavarjaṃ ghṛtādibhistribhirvṛtaṃ trivṛtaṃ, trivṛtameva traivṛtaṃ, svārthiko'ṇ| jejjaṭācāryastu catuḥsnehamāha| māsamardhamāsaṃ vā puruṣabalāpekṣayā doṣabalāpekṣayā vā vikalpaḥ| pātram āḍhakam| amlaṃ kāñjikam| dantīdravantīpratīvāpamiti dravantī cīritapatrā dantībhedaḥ; dantīdravantīkalkaḥ, sa ca snehacaturthāṃśena| sarpiḥ āḍhakapramāṇam||10-11||

ata ūrdhvaṃ sāmānyacikitsitam upadekṣyāmaḥ- tilvakaghṛtacaturthāni yāny uktāny udareṣu tato 'nyatamam upayujyamānaṃ śvayathum apahanti, mūtravartikriyāṃ vā seveta, navāyasaṃ vā 'har ahar madhunā, viḍaṅgātiviṣākuṭajaphalabhadradārunāgaramaricacūrṇaṃ vā dharaṇam uṣṇāmbunā, trikaṭukṣārāyaś cūrṇāni vā triphalākaṣāyeṇa, mūtraṃ vā tulyakṣīraṃ, harītakīṃ vā tulyaguḍām upayuñjīta, devadāruśuṇṭhīṃ vā, gugguluṃ vā mūtreṇa varṣābhūkaṣāyānupānaṃ vā, tulyaguḍaṃ śṛṅgaveraṃ vā, varṣābhūkaṣāyaṃ mūlakalkaṃ vā saśṛṅgaveraṃ payo 'nupānam ahar ahar māsaṃ, vyoṣavarṣābhūkaṣāyasiddhena vā sarpiṣā mudgolumbān bhakṣayet, pippalīpippalīmūlacavyacitrakamayūrakavarṣābhūsiddhaṃ vā kṣīraṃ pibet, sahauṣadhamuraṅgīmūlasiddhaṃ vā, trikaṭukair aṇḍaśyāmāmūlasiddhaṃ vā, varṣābhūśṛṅgaverasahādevadārusiddhaṃ vā, tathā 'lābūbibhītakaphalakalkaṃ vā taṇḍulāmbunā; kṣārapippalīmaricaśṛṅgaverānusiddhena ca mudgayūṣeṇālavaṇenālpasnehena bhojayed yavānnaṃ godhūmānnaṃ vā; vṛkṣakārkanaktamālanimbavarṣābhūkvāthaiś ca pariṣekaḥ; sarṣapasuvarcalāsaindhavaśārṅgeṣṭābhiś ca pradehaḥ kāryaḥ; yathādoṣaṃ ca vamanavirecanāsthāpanāni tīkṣṇāny ajasram upaseveta, snehasvedopanāhāṃś ca; sirābhiś cābhīkṣṇaṃ śoṇitam avasecayed anyatropadravaśophād iti ||12||

harītakīcūrṇaprasthādīni trīṇi ghṛtāni tilvakaghṛtaṃ caturṇāṃ pūraṇaṃ yeṣāṃ tāni tilvakacaturthāni; harītakīcūrṇaprasthetyādinā ekaṃ, gavye payasi mahāvṛkṣakṣīretyādi dvitīyaṃ, cavyacitraketyādi tṛtīyaṃ, tilvakaṃ vātavyādhyuktaṃ caturtham| vamanavirecanetyādinā udaroktā eva mūtravartikriyā| navāyasaṃ pramehapiḍakācikitsite paṭhitam| dharaṇaṃ karṣam| kṣāro yavakṣāraḥ| ayo loham| tulyakṣīramiti gomūtraṃ paladvayaṃ, gokṣīramapi dvipalam| tulyaguḍāmiti śophaharadravānupānām| devadāruśuṇṭhīkalkaṃ kṛtvā sukhāmbunā, sāmānyaśophaharadraveṇa sukhoṣṇena vā| saguḍamārdrakaṃ vā karṣamānam| varṣābhūkaṣāyaḥ paladvayamanupānaṃ; varṣābhūḥ raktapunarnavā| vyoṣādikalkasiddhena jalacaturguṇena sarpiṣā mudgolumbān, svinnāḥ kiñcidbhṛṣṭā mudgā mudgolumbāḥ| mayūrakaḥ apāmārgaḥ| sahā māṣaparṇī, muraṅgī śobhāñjanakaḥ| kṣāro yavakṣāraḥ| anuviddhena anugatena, ‘anusiddhena’ iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ| yavānnaṃ godhūmānnaṃ veti sātmyāpekṣo vikalpaḥ| vṛkṣakaḥ kuṭajaḥ, naktamālaḥ mahākarañjaḥ| suvarcalā sūryāvartaḥ| śārṅgeṣṭā kākajaṅghā| pradehaḥ pralepaḥ| ajasraṃ punaḥ punaḥ, upaseveta ‘balavān’ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ| upadravaśophādityatra sarvāṅgaśophāditi kecit| śītoṣṇasnigdharūkṣādyairapraśāmyati śophe sirābhirabhīkṣṇaṃ śoṇitamavasecayedityarthaḥ| avisrāvyaśca sarvāṅgaśophīti kecidamuṃ pāṭhamanārṣamācakṣate; anye'vayavagataṃ sarvasaraṃ śītoṣṇasnigdharūkṣādibhirapraśāmyantaṃ śoṇitāvasecanena sādhayediti viṣayabhedena vidhiniṣedhau caritārthau kurvanti||12||

bhavati cātra-
piṣṭānnam amlaṃ lavaṇāni madyaṃ mṛdaṃ divāsvapnam ajāṅgalaṃ ca |
striyo ghṛtaṃ tailapayogurūṇi śophaṃ jighāṃsuḥ parivarjayet tu ||13||
piṣṭānnamityādi| ‘striyo guḍaṃ’ iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ||13||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne śothacikitsitaṃ nāma trayoviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||23||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne trayoviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||23||

div.head: anāgatabādhāpratiṣedhaḥ

ab.seg: athāto 'nāgatābādhāpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

anāgata īṣadāgataḥ, nañ atra īṣadarthe; ābādhā duḥkhaṃ vyādhirityarthaḥ; tasya pratiṣedhaścikitsitam| taccikitsitaṃ svasthavṛttamahorātrikācārakrama ityarthaḥ, yato'horātre'pi ṣaṇṇāmṛtūnāmantarbhāvaḥ||1-2||

lg.l: dhīmatā yad anuṣṭheyaṃ tat sarvaṃ sampravakṣyate ||3||

ab.seg: utthāyotthāyeti vīpsāyāṃ, pratyahamitikartavyatākhyāpanāyetyeke; anye tu utthāyeti abhiyojyetyarthaḥ, abhito yogamabhisaṃyogaṃ kṛtvā; abhiyoga udyamaḥ, utpūrvasya sthādhātorabhiyogārthatvāt| satatam aharaharityarthaḥ; yadā tu utthāyotthāyetyasyāharaha iti vyākhyānaṃ tadā satatamiti vyarthaṃ syāt| ‘yadanuṣṭheyamaskannaṃ’ iti kecit paṭhanti, askannam avaśyamityarthaḥ||3||

lg.l: tatrādau dantapavanaṃ ‘tatrādito dantakāṣṭhaṃ’ iti pā. dvādaśāṅgulam āyatam |
avekṣyartuṃ ca doṣaṃ ca rasaṃ vīryaṃ ca yojayet ||5||
kaṣāyaṃ madhuraṃ tiktaṃ kaṭukaṃ prātar utthitaḥ |
nimbaś ca tiktake śreṣṭhaḥ kaṣāye khadiras tathā ||6||
madhūko madhure śreṣṭhaḥ karañjaḥ kaṭuke tathā |
cūrṇena tejovatyāś ca dantān nityaṃ viśodhayet |
ekaikaṃ gharṣayed dantaṃ mṛdunā kūrcakena ca ||8||

vaiśadyam annābhiruciṃ ‘rucimanneṣu vaiśadyaṃ dantajihvauṣṭhatāluṣu|| pāṭavaṃ saumanasyaṃ ca lāghavaṃ copapādayet|| na ca syādgalatālvoṣṭhajihvārogasamudbhavaḥ| sugandhi vadanaṃ ca syāllālāstambhanameva ca| mukhaprasekaśamanaṃ dharmapuṣṭikaraṃ nṛṇām| lāghavaṃ cendriyāṇāṃ syānnityaṃ khādettato naraḥ| pāṭavaṃ ‘vakrasya’ ityadhyāhāraḥ| prasekaḥ thūtkaraṇam’| iti pā. saumanasyaṃ karoti ca |
athāsyapāke ‘mukhapākaśvāsakāsaśoṣahikkāvamīṣu ca’ iti pā. śvāse ca kāsahikkāvamīṣu ca |
arditī karṇaśūlī ca dantarogī ca mānavaḥ ||12||

ab.seg: śirasa uttamāṅgatvāttatpūrvameva vivṛṇvannāha- tatretyādi| avraṇaṃ koṭarādirahitam| pratthagraṃ navam| trivargāktaṃ trisugandhinā''ktaṃ liptaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ kṛtvā, tenetyadhyāhāraḥ| daurgandhyādyapakarṣaṇaṃ tatphalam; upadehaḥ upalepaḥ| vaiśadyaṃ nirmalatā| madaḥ pūgaphaleneva||4-12||

lg.l: jihvānirlekhanaṃ raupyaṃ sauvarṇaṃ vārkṣam eva ca |
tan malāpaharaṃ śastaṃ mṛdu ślakṣṇaṃ daśāṅgulam ||13||

ab.seg: jihvetyādi| mṛdu komalam| ślakṣṇaṃ masṛṇam| jāḍyaṃ jaḍatā stabdhatetyarthaḥ||13-14||

lg.l: prakṣālayen mukhaṃ netre svasthaḥ śītodakena vā |
nīlikāṃ mukhaśoṣaṃ ca piḍakāṃ vyaṅgam eva ca ||16||

div.ab: kṣīravṛkṣā nyagrodhādayaḥ| kṣīravṛkṣakaṣāyagaṇḍūṣeṇa raktaduṣṭirapi nivartate| bahirmukhaprakṣālanamāha- bhilletyādi| bhilloṭako hi parvate kedārabhūmau prasiddhaḥ| gayī tu bhilloṭakakaṣāyamantarmukhaprakṣālanamāha| āmalakasya kaṣāyeṇa netre prakṣālayet, ubhayaṃ śītodakena vā||15-16||-

lg.l: sukhaṃ laghu nirīkṣeta dṛḍhaṃ paśyati cakṣuṣā ||17||
na netrarogā jāyante tasmād añjanam ācaret ||19||
rātrau jāgaritaś cāpi nāñjyāj jvarita eva ca ||20||

ab.seg: tato'ñjanāvasaraḥ| sindhuratra nado'bhipretaḥ, tatsambhavaṃ srotoñjanam| viśuddhaṃ malarahitaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mataṃ; kutaḥ? yasmāddṛṣṭerdāhādiharaṃ kledādyapaharaṃ tathā tejorūpakaraṃ; tasmādañjanena dṛḍhaṃ cakṣuṣā paśyati, mārutātapau sahate, netrarogāśca na jāyanta iti yogatantrayuktyā yojanīyam| chardanavāhanairiti bahuvacanena pariśrāntihetavo gṛhyante||17-20||

lg.l: sacūrṇapūgaiḥ sahitaṃ patraṃ tāmbūlajaṃ śubham ‘hitam’ iti pā.||21||
pathyaṃ suptotthite bhukte snāte vānte ca mānave ||23||

ab.seg: karpūretyādi| jātīśabdena jātīphalaṃ kathyate||21-24||

lg.l: karoti śirasas tṛptiṃ sutvakkam api cānanam |

ab.seg: śirasaḥ pratipūraṇamiti śūnyabhūtasya śirasaḥ punaḥ pūraṇamityarthaḥ| ‘śirogatāṃstathā rogān’ ityatra ‘keśabhūmigatān rogān’ ityeke paṭhanti; ‘śirasaḥ pratipūraṇaṃ’ ityatra ‘dattaṃ mastakatailakam’ ityapare paṭhanti||25-26||

lg.l: madhukaṃ kṣīraśuklā ca saralaṃ devadāru ca |
sadaiva śītalaṃ jantor mūrdhni tailaṃ pradāpayet ||28||

ab.seg: śirobhyaṅgarthaṃ tailamāha- madhukamityādi| kṣīraśuklā kṣīravidārikā| kṣudrakaṃ pañcanāmānamiti alpā pañcamūlī| cakratailaṃ yantrapīḍitatailam| madhukādidravyāṇāṃ kvāthārthaṃ palaśatam, udakasya dvādaśādhikapañcaśatapalāni, tāvat vipacedyāvadviṃśatyadhikaṃ śataṃ bhavati, tato vastrapūtaṃ grāhyaṃ, tena kvāthena tathā taddravyāṇāmeva kalkairaṣṭabhiḥ palaiścakratailasya dvātriṃśatpalāni vipacet, yāvattailapākalakṣaṇāni bhavanti, evamānumānikaṃ kalpanīyam ‘pacanīyam’ iti pā.||27-28||

div.ab: keśaprasādhanī kaṅkatikā ‘kākuṃi’ iti loke| rajo dhūliḥ| jantuḥ yūkā|29|-

ab.seg: hanvityādi| karṇapūraṇakālasya saṅkhyāṃ śrīvāgbhaṭaḥ prāha- “dhārayet pūraṇaṃ karṇe karṇamūlaṃ vimardayan| rujaḥ syānmārdavaṃ yāvanmātrāśatamavedane” (vā.sū.a.22)- iti||29||

abhyaṅga ityādi| abhyaṅgo'tra sakaladehasya ‘sakalaśarīrakarṇādigataḥ’ iti pā. snehābhyaṅgaḥ| mṛjā śuddhaprabhā, varṇo gaurādiḥ| snehasya sirāmukhādibhiḥ śarīrasantarpaṇakālaṃ kecidatra paṭhanti- “romānteṣvanu dehasya sthitvā mātrāśatatrayam| tataḥ praviśati snehaścaturbhirgacchati tvacam||raktaṃ gacchati mātrāṇāṃ śataiḥ pañcabhireva tu| ṣaḍbhirmāṃsaṃ prapadyeta medaḥ saptabhireva ca||śatairaṣṭābhirasthīni majjānaṃ navabhirvrajet| tatrasthāñchamayedrogān vātapittakaphātmakān” iti||30||
sekaḥ sarvāṅgapariṣekaḥ||31-32||
yuktaḥ prayuktaḥ| avagāhanaṃ majjanam||33||

lg.l: tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā matimān yuñjyād abhyaṅgasekayoḥ ||34||

ab.seg: teṣāṃ yogyatāmāha- tatretyādi||34||

lg.l: kevalaṃ sāmadoṣeṣu na kathañ cana yojayet |
tathā virikto vāntaś ca nirūḍho yaś ca mānavaḥ |
pūrvayoḥ kṛcchratā vyādher asādhyatvam athāpi vā ||36||

ab.seg: abhyaṅgasya niṣedhamāha- kevalamityādi| āmajvare tatkṛtakampādīnāmapi sambhava ityarthaḥ| pūrvayostaruṇajvaryajīrṇinoḥ; śeṣāṇāṃ viriktānāṃ tadahaḥkriyamāṇe'bhyaṅge'gnimāndyādayo bhavanti||35-37||

lg.l: tat kṛtvā ‘kṛtvā'nu’ iti pā. tu sukhaṃ dehaṃ vimṛdgīyāt samantataḥ ||38||
na cāsti sadṛśaṃ tena kiñcit sthaulyāpakarṣaṇam |
na ca vyāyāminaṃ martyam ardayanty arayo balāt ‘bhayāt’||41||
vyāyāmasvinnagātrasya ‘vyāyāmakṣuṇṇagātrasya’ iti pā. padbhyām udvartitasya ‘padbhyāmudvartitasya pādāvamarditasya’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ ca |
vyāyāmaṃ kurvato nityaṃ viruddham api bhojanam ||44||
vyāyāmo hi sadā pathyo balināṃ snigdhabhojinām ||45||
sa ca śīte vasante ca teṣāṃ pathyatamaḥ smṛtaḥ |
sarveṣv ṛtuṣv ahar ahaḥ pumbhir ātmahitaiṣibhiḥ ||46||
hṛdi sthānasthito vāyur yadā vaktraṃ prapadyate ||47||
vyāyāmaṃ kurvato jantos tad balārdhasya lakṣaṇam |
samīkṣya kuryād vyāyāmam anyathā rogam āpnuyāt |
bhuktavān strīṣu ca kṣīṇas tṛḍbhramārtaś ca varjayet |51|

div.ab: śarīretyādi| śarīrasyopacayaḥ samyakpuṣṭiḥ| gātrāṇāṃ suvibhaktatā gātrāṇāmiti sarveṣāmaṅgānāṃ, suvibhaktatā susannibiṣṭatā sughaṭitaśarīratetyarthaḥ| mṛjā śuddhiḥ ‘śuddhaprabhā’ iti pā.| śatravo yathā ca vyāyāminaṃ balāddhetorna mardayanti udvartanakāriṇaṃ janaṃ tathā vyādhayo nopasarpanti nābhibhavantītyarthaḥ| sthirībhavati māṃsaṃ ceti upacayalakṣaṇasyāpi balasya heturityarthaḥ| vyāyāmasvinnagātrasyeti gātre svedāgame sati vyāyāmāduparamaḥ kārya ityarthaḥ, anye tu ‘vyāyāmasvinnagātrasya’ ityatra ‘vyāyāmakṣuṇṇagātrasya’ iti paṭhanti| padbhyāmudvartitasya pādābhyāṃ bahukṛtamardanasyetyarthaḥ| viruddhaṃ hitāhitīyādhyāyoktam| vidagdham amlapākam, avidagdhaṃ vidagdhādanyat, tenāmaṃ vidagdhaṃ ca gṛhyate| pariḥ sarvato'rthe| vasante ceti cakāraḥ pathyatamatve hemantādvasantasyāpakarṣaṃ sūcayati| balārdhalakṣaṇaṃ kecidanyathā paṭhanti,- “kakṣālalāṭanāsāsu hastapādādisandhiṣu| prasvedānmukhaśoṣācca balārdhaṃ taddhi nirdiśet”- iti| vayobaletyādi vayo yauvanaṃ, balaṃ śaktyupacayalakṣaṇaṃ, śarīraṃ madhyaṃ sthūlaṃ ca, deśamānūpaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ ca; kālaṃ nityagamāvasthikaṃ ca dvividhamapi, tatra nityage śīte vasante ca, āvasthike yauvane bale sati; aśanāni snigdhabhojanāni; samīkṣya dṛṣṭvā upacayaprabhṛtau vyāyāmaṃ kuryāt| vyāyāmādagnipradīptau satyāṃ sarvarogopaśama iti||38-50||-

ab.seg: vyāyāme padbhyāmudvartitasyetyuktasyodvartanasya guṇaṃ nirdiśannāha- udvartanamityādi| udvartanaṃ gātramardanam| vilāpanaṃ dravīkaraṇam||51||

lg.l: utsādanād bhavet strīṇāṃ viśeṣāt kāntimad vapuḥ ||53||

ab.seg: siretyādi| tejanaṃ tvaggatasyāgneḥ, sirāmukhavivardhanam| uddharṣaṇam asnehauṣadhacūrṇādibhirgharṣaṇam, anye tu phenakeṣṭakādigharṣaṇam| uddharṣaṇotsādanābhyāṃ jāyeyātāmiti sirāmukhaviviktatvāgnidīpane uddharṣaṇotsādanābhyāmutpadyeyātāṃ;| kecidatra yathāsaṅkhyamāhuḥ- sirāmukhaviviktatvamuddharṣaṇena, tvaksthasyāgnestejanamutsādanena; sasnehakalkenoddharṣaṇamutsādanam| mṛjā śuddhaprabhā| ūrvorūrdhvamadhaśca ‘ūrudvayasyādhaḥ’ iti pā. phenakaḥ, ūruḥ ‘jāṅgha’ iti loke| kaṇḍūkoṭhavināśanamiti iyamiṣṭikoddharṣaṇaguṇoktiḥ||52-56||

lg.l: hṛdyaṃ malaharaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvendriyavibodhanam ‘sarvendriyaviśodhanam’ iti pā.||57||
raktaprasādanaṃ cāpi snānam agneś ca dīpanam ||58||
uṣṇena śirasaḥ snānam ahitaṃ cakṣuṣaḥ sadā |
śītena śirasaḥ snānaṃ cakṣuṣyam iti nirdiśet ||59||
kāmam uṣṇaṃ śiraḥsnānaṃ bhaiṣajyārthaṃ ‘bhaiṣajyamiti nirdiśet’ iti pā. samācaret ||60||
snānaṃ yeṣāṃ niṣiddhaṃ tu teṣām apy anulepanam |64|

div.ab: nidretyādi| kāmaṃ yatheṣṭam| snānasya niṣedhamāha- tadityādi| yeṣāṃ snānaṃ neṣyate teṣāmanulepanamapi niṣidhyate||57-63||-
rakṣoghnamityādi| ratnāni māṇikyamarakatādīni| asyāgre ādarśaguṇaṃ gorocanādhāraṇaguṇaṃ ca kecidadhīyate; sa cābhāvānna likhitaḥ||64||-
mukhetyādi| kāntaṃ kamanīyaṃ manoharamityarthaḥ||65||-
sāmānyamañjanaguṇamāha- pakṣmalamityādi| pakṣmalaṃ ghanaromānvitam viśadaṃ cippaurahitam| amalojjvalamaṇḍalamiti nirmalojjvalacakṣurbahirbhāgam ‘nirmalamapākaṃ ca tvābahirbhāgam’ iti pā.||66-67||-
āhāra ityādi| tejo bhrājiṣṇutā, samutsāhaḥ samyakcittavyavasāyaḥ, ojo hṛdisthaṃ prāṇāyatanam||68||-
cakṣuḥprasādanaṃ dṛṣṭiprasādanaṃ, dṛṣṭisaṃyuktapādanibandhananāḍīprasādanatvāt ‘dṛṣṭigata’ iti pā.; prabhāvādityapare| vṛṣyaṃ śukravṛddhikaraṃ, prabhāvāt||69||-
nidretyādi| pādābhyaṅgo'trāpi dṛṣṭipradaḥ pūrvavat||70||-

lg.l: pādarogaharaṃ vṛṣyaṃ ‘vṛṣyamāyuṣyaṃ cakṣuṣe hitam’ iti pā. rakṣoghnaṃ prītivardhanam ||71||

ab.seg: pādetyādi| pādatraṃ pādahitaṃ pādukādi| anupānadbhyāṃ pādatrāṇarahitābhyām| bāṇavāraṃ ‘vārabāṇaṃ kañcukaṃ ‘ḍantimpitāṅga’ iti loke’ iti pā. varma||71-74||

div.ab: pavitramityādi| uṣṇīṣaṃ śiroveṣṭanam|75|-
varṣetyādi| śaṅkaraṃ sukhakaram||75||-

lg.l: avaṣṭambhakaraṃ cāpi bhayaghnaṃ ‘rakṣoghnaṃ’ iti pā. daṇḍadhāraṇam |78|

div.ab: śuna ityādi| sarīsṛpāḥ kṛṣṇasarpādayaḥ| vyālā vyāghrādayaḥ| viṣāṇibhyaḥ śṛṅgibhyaḥ| sattvaṃ sattvaguṇaḥ, utsāho balaṃ, balam ojaḥ, sthairyaṃ acalatvaṃ, dhairyaṃ dhīratvaṃ, vīryaṃ śaktiḥ| avaṣṭambhaḥ avalambanam| bhayaghnaṃ ‘rakṣoghnaṃ rākṣasaghnam’ iti pā. bhayanāśakam||76-77||-

ab.seg: āsyetyādi| āsyā sthitiḥ||78||
adhvetyādi| atyadhvā atiśayena mārgagamanam| caṅkramaṇaṃ kuṭilagatyā paribhramaṇam||79-80||

śrametyādi| sukhaṃ śayyāsanaṃ vistṛtamāstīrṇaṃ mṛdugaṇḍopadhānādiyuktam| duḥkhaṃ saṅkocyāsanaṃ ‘duḥkhaśayyāsanaṃ’ iti pā., duḥkhaṃ viparītaguṇam| bālavyajanaṃ cāmarākhyavyajanam| vyajanānilaḥ tālavṛntavāyuḥ||81-82||
prītītyādi| saṃvāhanaṃ sukhakarasparśaḥ, mardanaṃ tu gāḍhaṃ pādābhyāmārabhya ‘pādābhyāṃ ca’ iti pā. kaṭiparyantaṃ, amitaprabhaṭīkākārastu hastābhyāṃ śanaiḥ śanairāhananamiti vadati||83||

lg.l: sukhaṃ vātaṃ praseveta grīṣme śaradi mānavaḥ |
nivātaṃ hy āyuṣe sevyam ārogyāya ca sarvadā ||85||
karoti dhātusāmyaṃ ca nidrā kāle niṣevitā ||88||

ab.seg: sukhamityādi| “sukhaṃ pravātaṃ seveta grīṣme śaradi vā'ntarā” ityanye paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- grīṣmaśaradau pravātasevanakālaḥ, paraṃ tayorapi pravātasevanaṃ sāntaram| jyotsnātamasorguṇāḥ punaśchāyānivātaguṇaiḥ sadṛśā jñeyā itīha noktāḥ| adravyatve'pi ātapādīnāṃ prabhāvajaṃ karma; anye punarātapaṃ tejaḥparamāṇupuñjaṃ, chāyāmapi tamaḥparamāṇujāmāhuḥ||84-88||

tatrādita eva nīcanakharomṇā śucinā śuklavāsasā laghūṣṇīṣacchatropānatkena daṇḍapāṇinā kāle hitamitamadhurapūrvābhibhāṣiṇā bandhubhūtena bhūtānāṃ guruvṛddhānumatena susahāyenānanyamanasā khalūpacaritavyaṃ, tad api na rātrau, na keśāsthikaṇṭakāśmatuṣabhasmotkarakapālāṅgārāmedhyasnānabalibhūmiṣu, na viṣamendrakīlacatuṣpathaśvabhrāṇām upariṣṭāt ||89||

prātarutthitasya dantakāṣṭhakhādanādīndriyaśarīramanasāmupakārakamantaraṅgamabhidhāya bahiraṅgopacaraṇe saddhṛttamuddiśannāha- tatretyādi| laghūṣṇīṣam alpatanukṛtaṃ śiroveṣṭanaṃ; kecillaghupadaṃ chatreṇopānadā'pi sambandhayanti| upacaritavyam upagamanaṃ kartavyam| utkaraḥ tṛṇādisamūhaḥ; ācchāditakhanitamṛttikādirityapare| yāgārthaṃ nikhāto yūpopalakṣitaḥ pradeśa indrakīlaḥ, indrārthaṃ kīlā nyasyante yasmin deśe sa pradeśa indrakīlaḥ| catuṣpatho mārgacatuṣṭayasaṅgamaḥ| śvabhraṃ gartaḥ||89||
na rājadviṣṭaparuṣapaiśunyānṛtāni vadet, na devabrāhmaṇapitṛparivādāṃś ca; na narendradviṣṭonmattapatitakṣudranīcān upāsīta ||90||

paiśunyaṃ sūcakatā, daurjanyamiti yāvat| parivādo doṣakathanam| unmatto vātūlaḥ, patitaḥ svakīyadharmādbhraṣṭaḥ ‘svakīyācārabhraṣṭaḥ’ iti pā., kṣudro laghuḥ, nīcā mlecchādayaḥ| nopāsīta nopaseveta||90||

vṛkṣaparvataprapātaviṣamavalmīkaduṣṭavājikuñjarādyadhirohaṇāni pariharet, pūrṇanadīsamudrāviditapalvalaśvabhrakūpāvataraṇāni, bhinnaśūnyāgāraśmaśānavijanāraṇyavāsāgnisambhramavyālabhujaṅgakīṭasevāś ca, grāmāghātakalahaśastrasannipātavyālasarīsṛpaśṛṅgisannikarṣāṃś ca ||91||

prapāto ‘prapātaḥ patanasthānaṃ’ iti pā. nirjharapatanam| kūpāntāvataraṇāni pariharediti sambandhaḥ; avidito'jñātasvarūpaḥ; palvalaṃ khātagartaḥ, avataraṇaṃ praveśaḥ; atrāpi pariharediti sambandhaḥ| bhinnaśūnyāgāraṃ patitagṛhaṃ janarahitagṛhaṃ ’patitavijanagṛhaṃ’ iti pā. ca, vijanaṃ nirjanam, araṇyaṃ aṭavī, agnisambhrama ‘agnisambhramo'tyantapradīptatvam’ iti pā. utpātapradīptaḥ, vyālā vyāghrādayaḥ, kīṭā vṛścikādayaḥ, grāmāghāto mārībhayajanyagrāmahananaṃ, sarīsṛpaḥ kṛṣṇasarpaḥ, sannikarṣaṃ naikaṭyaṃ pariharediti sambandhaḥ| pūrvamagnerhemantādāvatiśaityādabhipretasyāpi sevā atyantopāsanaṃ niṣiddham, atra tu grīṣmādau tasya sānnidhyamapi niṣiddhamiti budhyate| tathā pūrvaṃ vyālabhujaṅgayorapi sevā punaḥ punarnikaṭopāsanaṃ niṣiddham, atra tu viśvastayoḥ sānnidhyamapi niṣidhyata iti na paunaruktyam||91||

nāgnigogurubrāhmaṇapreṅkhādampatyantareṇa yāyāt | na śavam anuyāyāt | devagobrāhmaṇacaityadhvajarogipatitapāpakāriṇāṃ ca chāyāṃ nākrameta | nāstaṃ gacchantam udyantaṃ vā''dityaṃ vīkṣeta | gāṃ dhāpayantīṃ dhayantīṃ paraśasyaṃ vā carantīṃ na kasmaicid ācakṣīta, na colkāpātotpātendradhanūṃṣi | nāgniṃ mukhenopadhamet | nāpo bhūmiṃ vā pāṇipādenābhihanyāt ||92||

agnyorgurvorbrāhmaṇayoḥ preṅkhayordampatyoścāntareṇa na gacchet; preṅkhā dolā, dampatī jāyāpatī| śavaṃ mṛtaprāṇiśarīram| anugamanaṃ paścādgamanam; skandhadānādyadhikāraṃ vineti śeṣaḥ| caityaḥ śmaśānavṛkṣaḥ| nākrameta na laṅghayet| gāṃ surabhīm| dhāpayantīṃ pāyayantīṃ, vatsamiti gamyate, dheṭ pāne| dhayantīṃ svayaṃ pibantīṃ kuṇḍādinikṣiptapānīyaprabhṛtīnīti gamyate| paraśasyaṃ ‘paraśasyaṃ parānnaṃ vā carantīm’ iti pā. parakṣetram| nācakṣīta na kathayet| ulkāpāta ākāśājjvaladagnipātaḥ; utpātā divyabhaumāntarīkṣāstrayaḥ; tatra divyāḥ pratimārodanagandharvanagaradarśanādikāḥ, bhaumā bhūkampaprabhṛtayaḥ, āntarikṣāstārāpatanaravipariveṣādayaḥ; etāni kasmaicinnācakṣītetyarthaḥ| upadhamet nāgniṃ mukhena jvālayedityarthaḥ| abhihanyāditi kāraṇaṃ vineti śeṣaḥ||92||
na vegān dhārayed vātamūtrapurīṣādīnām | na bahirvegān grāmanagaradevatāyatanaśmaśānacatuṣpathasalilāśayapathisannikṛṣṭān utsṛjen na prakāśaṃ na vāyvagnisalilasomārkagogurupratimukham ||93||
bahirvegā vātamūtrapurīṣādīnām| na prakāśamiti prakāśo yathā bhavatyevaṃ notsṛjet||93||
na bhūmiṃ vilikhet, nāsaṃvṛtamukhaḥ sadasi jṛmbhodgārakāsaśvāsakṣavathūn utsṛjet, na paryaṅkikāvaṣṭambhapādaprasāraṇāni gurusannidhau kuryāt ||94||

vilikhet nakhādibhiḥ| na sabhāyāmasaṃvṛtamukho jṛmbhādīn visṛjet| kṣavathuḥ chikkā| paryaṅkikā paryastikā| avaṣṭambho'grapṛṣṭhapārśvasthitastambhādiṣvavalambanaṃ; paramārthatastu avaṣṭambho'valambo na paryāyaśabdaḥ||94||

na bālakarṇanāsāsrotodaśanākṣivivarāṇy abhikuṣṇīyāt ‘…ṇyabhinikuṣṇīyāt’ iti pā., na vījayet keśamukhanakhavastragātrāṇi, na gātranakhavaktravāditraṃ kuryāt, na kāṣṭhaloṣṭatṛṇādīn abhihanyāc chindyād bhindyād vā ||95||

srotāṃsi pāyūpasthādīni, eteṣāṃ vivarāṇi chidrāṇi; nābhikuṣṇīyāt ‘nābhinikuṣṇīyāt na niṣkarṣet’ iti pā. nābhikarṣet, na malaṃ spṛśedityarthaḥ| na vījayet na kampayet| na gātravāditraṃ na gātraṃ vādyabhāṇḍaṃ kuryāt||95||

na prativātātapaṃ seveta, na bhuktamātro 'gnim upāsīta, notkaṭakālpakāṣṭhāsanam adhyāsīta, na grīvāṃ viṣamaṃ dhārayet, na viṣamakāyaḥ kriyāṃ bhajeta bhuñjīta vā, na pratatam īkṣeta viśeṣāj jyotirbhāskarasūkṣmacalabhrāntāni, na bhāraṃ śirasā vahet, na svapnajāgaraṇaśayanāsanasthānacaṅkramaṇayānavāhanapradhāvanalaṅghanaplavanaprataraṇahāsyabhāṣyavyavāyavyāyāmādīn ucitān apy atiseveta ||96||

na prativātātapamiti abhimukhaṃ vātamātapaṃ vā na seveta| nādhyāsīta nopaviśedityarthaḥ| āsanaśabda utkaṭakādibhistribhiḥ saha pratyekamabhisambadhyate| pratataṃ visphāritākṣaṃ nekṣeta; jyotiragniśikhā, tāraketyanye| divā svapnajāgaraṇādīni svabhyastānyapyetāni hitāhitāni nātikrāntapramāṇaṃ bhajet| sthānam ūrdhvasthitiṃ, caṅkramaṇaṃ gatāgataṃ, yānaṃ rathādi, vāhanaṃ hastyaśvādi, laṅghanaṃ kheyagartādyutkramaṇaṃ, plavanam utplutyotplutya gamanaṃ, prataraṇaṃ nadyādīnāṃ bāhubhyāṃ taraṇam||96||
ucitād apy ahitāt kramaśo viramet, hitam anucitam apy āseveta kramaśaḥ, na caikāntataḥ pādahīnāt ||97||

svabhyastādapi yavakādeḥ krameṇaiva nivartayedityarthaḥ; sahasā parivartane rogo maraṇaṃ vā| kramaśo hitaṃ raktaśālyādi| anucitam anabhyastaṃ, kramaśa iti tatrābhyastādahitādvirāme yathākramaṃ pādasyāpacayaḥ, tathā tasyābhyasanīyasya yathākramamabhyāse pādasyaiva prakṣepaḥ; evaṃ hitāhitayoścaturthāṃśasya ṣoḍaśāṃśasya vā''vāpoddhārābhyāṃ ṣoḍaśāhobhirahitasya sarvasya tyāgo hitasya sarvasya prāptiriti||97||

nāvākśirāḥ śayīta, na bhinnapātre bhuñjīta, na vinā pātreṇa, nāñjalipuṭenāpaḥ pibet, kāle hitamitasnigdhamadhuraprāyam āhāraṃ vaidyapratyavekṣitam aśnīyāt, grāmagaṇagaṇikāpaṇikaśatrusatraśaṭhapatitabhojanāni pariharet, śeṣāṇy api cāniṣṭarūparasagandhasparśaśabdamānasāni, anyāny evaṅ guṇāny api sambhramadattāni, (tāny api) makṣikābālopahatāni ‘makṣikāvyālopahatāni’ iti pā., nāprakṣālitapādo bhuñjīta na mūtroccārapīḍito na sandhyayor nānupāśrito nātītakālaṃ hīnam atimātraṃ (noddhṛtasnehaṃ) ceti ||98||

avākśirā adhaḥśirā ityarthaḥ| bhinnapātre vidīrṇapātre| pratyavekṣitaṃ vilokitam| grāmasthāḥ sarve militvā kvacit kiñcid ‘kiñcidduḥkhaṃ samāhṛtya yadbhojanaṃ’ iti pā. yadbhojanaṃ sampādayanti tadgrāmabhojanam| gaṇā kathakacāraṇādayaḥ, gaṇikā veśyā, paṇika itaravaṇik, śatruḥ vipakṣaḥ, satraṃ yajñaḥ, patitaḥ svakīyācārabhraṣṭaḥ| aniṣṭaśabdo rūpādibhiḥ saha pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| aniṣṭaśabdaḥ kutsitadhvaniḥ; aniṣṭamānasaṃ cittānabhipretam| anyānīti aniṣṭarūpādibhyo'nyāni iṣṭarūparasādīni vā, evaṅguṇānyapīti grāmādibhyaḥ śeṣāṇyapītyarthaḥ| sambhramadattānīti militvā ‘tvarayā’ iti pā. dattāni, bhojanāni pariharediti śeṣaḥ| (sarvāṇyeva ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate kiṃ tvarayā dattāni pariharedityāha- tānyapītyādi|) uccāro viṣṭhā| nānupāśrita āśritānvito na bhuñjīta| nātītakālaṃ nātikrāntakālamityarthaḥ, (sasnehavastuni ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate pīḍanena snehādbhinnaṃ yattaduddhṛtasneham|)||98||

lg.l: na naktaṃ dadhi bhuñjīta na cāpy aghṛtaśarkaram ||99||
nātmānam udake paśyen na nagnaḥ praviśej jalam ||100||

ab.seg: uddhṛtasnehaṃ ca sumanthanenaiva snehādbhinnam, atra sneho ghṛtam| na naktaṃ dadhītyādi| na cāpyalavaṇaṃ na vā'pyudakavarjitaṃ dadhi bhuñjīta||99-100||
dyūtamadyātisevāpratibhūtvasākṣitvasamāhvānagoṣṭhīvāditrāṇi na seveta, srajaṃ chatropānahau kanakam atītavāsāṃsi na cānyair dhṛtāni dhārayet, brāhmaṇam agniṃ gāṃ ca nocchiṣṭaḥ spṛśet ||101||

pratibhūḥ lagnakaḥ, niṣkāraṇamāhūya svecchālāpakathanaṃ samāhvānam| vāditrāṇi mṛdaṅgādīni| atītavāsāṃsi jīrṇavastrāṇi, anyairvidhṛtāni na ‘nūtanāni punaḥ prakṣālya dhārayet’ iti pā. prakṣālya dhārayet||101||

bhavanti cātra-
yasmin yasminn ṛtau ye ye doṣāḥ kupyanti dehinām |
teṣu teṣu pradātavyā rasās te te vijānatā ||102||

lg.l: varṣāsu na pibet toyaṃ pibec charadi mātrayā |
varṣāsu caturo māsān mātrāvad udakaṃ pibet ||103||
uṣṇaṃ haime vasante ca kāmaṃ grīṣme tu śītalam |
hemante ca vasante ca sīdhvariṣṭau piben naraḥ ||104||
śṛtaśītaṃ payo grīṣme prāvṛṭkāle rasaṃ pibet |
pibed agnivivṛddhyarthaṃ na ca vegān vidhārayet |107|

div.ab: annaṃ niyamya kālena varṣādiṛtulakṣaṇenāpi pānaṃ niyamayannāha- varṣāsvityādi| na pibet īṣat pibedityarthaḥ| pibeccharadi mātrayeti mātrāśabdo'lpavacanaḥ| etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati- kāmamabhilāṣapūrṇaṃ, na tvatiśayena| sīdhvariṣṭau madyāriṣṭayorudakaṃ pibedityarthaḥ| sīdhuḥ sasyakaḥ, ariṣṭaḥ abhayāriṣṭādikaḥ, payo'tra kṣīram| tasyānte varṣānte| ato'nya iti asvasthaḥ| doṣāhāragatānugo bhavet doṣā vātādayaḥ; tatra vāte snigdhamuṣṇaṃ, pitte śītaṃ, kaphe rūkṣoṣṇam; āhāragatānuga iti ‘uṣṇodakānupānaṃ tu snehānāmatha śasyate’ ityādi| vegavidhāraṇaṃ hi agnināśanam||102-106||-

lg.l: kaphe pracchardanaṃ pitte vireko bastir īraṇe ||108||
śasyate triṣv api sadā vyāyāmo doṣanāśanaḥ |
bhuktaṃ viruddham apy annaṃ vyāyāmān na praduṣyati ||109||

ab.seg: svasthāturayorubhayorapi vakṣyamāṇaṃ ‘vakṣyamāṇakaraṇīyaśodhanaphalaṃ nirdiśannāha’ iti pā. śodhanaṃ nirdiśannāha- kapha ityādi| īraṇe vāte| apiśabdo vyāyāmakriyāphalānāṃ prāguktānāmapīhānuvartanaṃ samuccinoti| na praduṣyati na doṣakaraṃ bhavati||107-109||

lg.l: necched doṣacayāt ‘necchedrogabhayāt’ iti pā. prājñaḥ pīḍāṃ vā kāyamānasīm ||110||
tribhis tribhir ahobhir vā samīyāt pramadāṃ naraḥ ||113||
sarveṣv ṛtuṣu, gharmeṣu pakṣāt pakṣād vrajed budhaḥ |
rajasvalām akāmāṃ ca malinām apriyāṃ tathā ||114||
sagotrāṃ gurupatnīṃ ca tathā pravrajitām api |
sandhyāparvasv agamyāṃ ca nopeyāt pramadāṃ naraḥ ||116||
gosarge cārdharātre ca tathā madhyandineṣu ca |
kṣudhito vyādhitaś caiva kṣubdhacittaś ca mānavaḥ |
duṣṭayonau visargaṃ tu balavān api varjayet ||119||
retasaś cātimātraṃ tu mūrdhāvaraṇam eva ca |
dṛṣṭyāyustejasāṃ hānir adharmaś ca tato bhavet |
liṅginīṃ gurupatnīṃ ca sagotrām atha parvasu ||122||
vṛddhāṃ ca sandhyayoś cāpi gacchato jīvitakṣayaḥ |
hīnāṅgīṃ malināṃ dveṣyāṃ kāmaṃ vandhyām asaṃvṛte |
deśe 'śuddhe ca śukrasya manasaś ca kṣayo bhavet ||124||
sthitaś ca hāniṃ śukrasya vāyoḥ kopaṃ ca vindati ||125||
vyādhitasya rujā plīhni mṛtyur mūrcchā ca jāyate ||126||
tiryagyonāv ayonau ca duṣṭayonau tathaiva ca ||127||
upadaṃśas tathā vāyoḥ kopaḥ śukrasya ca kṣayaḥ |
uccārite mūtrite ca retasaś ca ‘retasyapi vidhārite’ iti pā. vidhāraṇe ||128||
uttāne ca bhavec chīghraṃ śukrāśmaryās tu sambhavaḥ |
śukraṃ copasthitaṃ mohān na sandhāryaṃ kathañcana |130|

div.ab: śodhane vamanavirecane| tanmanā utsargādimanā nānyacitta ityarthaḥ| doṣacayādiśaṅkāmaprāptaḥ prājñaḥ śodhanādinā kāyamānasīṃ pīḍāṃ necchedityarthaḥ| atra ātmā śarīram| ātmavān buddhivān| sthiropacitamāṃsā iti kaṭhinasthiramāṃsā ityarthaḥ| samīyāt gacchet| akāmāṃ maithunānabhilāṣiṇīm| varṇavṛddhāṃ varṇaśreṣṭhāmityarthaḥ, yathā śūdro na vaiśyāṃ, vaiśyo na kṣatriyāṃ, kṣatriyo na brāhmaṇīmiti| dveṣyāṃ śatrubhūtām| pravrajitāṃ gṛhītavratām| sandhyāparvasu pakṣāntare nānvaṣṭakādiṣu| agamyā svasṛduhitṛprabhṛtayaḥ| nopeyāt na gacchet| gosarge prabhāte| vivṛte anācchādite deśe ityarthaḥ| aśuddhe manaso'priye kaluṣitadeśe ityarthaḥ| kṣubdhacittaḥ bhītacittaḥ ‘calitacittaḥ’ iti pā.| tiryagyoniḥ ajādiḥ| ayoni mukhādimaithunaṃ, yathā dākṣiṇātyāḥ striyo mukhe maithunaṃ kārayanti| prāptaśukravidhāraṇamiti eṣu śukrapāto na kārya ityarthaḥ, calitaśukravidhāraṇaṃ na kāryamiti vā'rthaḥ| duṣṭayonau svabhāvaduṣṭayonau| retasaścātimātraṃ tu visargaṃ vivarjayediti sambandhaḥ| mūrdhāvaraṇaṃ liṅgamaṇerāvaraṇaṃ, yathā dākṣiṇātyāḥ kṛttrimamaṇiṃ kārayantīti jejjaṭaḥ; kvacit pustake ‘mūrdhāhananameva ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ, tatra rahasi harṣeṇa śirastāḍanaṃ parityajet| yathā''ha vṛddhavāgbhaṭaḥ “mūrdhābhighātaṃ pariharet”, (a.saṃ.sū.a.9) laghuvāgbhaṭo'pi,- “parvāṇyanaṅgaṃ divasaṃ śirohṛdayatāḍanam” (vā.sū.a.7) iti ‘asyāgre ‘yeṣāṃ mūrcchā maraṇameva ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ, te tu retaso'tivisargasya dūṣaṇaṃ varjanaprakāra eva mūrcchetyādinā paṭhanti| sa cāprākaraṇikatvādasaṅgata iti pūrva eva pāṭho nyāyyaḥ| atraivāvarjane doṣamāha-mūrcchetyādi| anyadapi doṣakathanaprastāvanāyāmagre kathayiṣyati’ ityadhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate| sthitāviti sthānaṃ sthitirūrdhvībhāvaḥ, tatra retaso visargaṃ varjayet| uttānaśayane'pi retaso visargaṃ parivarjayet| etayoḥ krīḍāyāmapi retovisargaṃ parivarjayet| aniyatātmanaḥ ajitendriyasya| vṛddhāṃ varṇavayobhyāṃ vṛddhām| asaṃvṛte deśe anācchāditadeśe ‘vivṛte deśe’ iti pā. ityarthaḥ| aśuddhe kaluṣe ityarthaḥ| manasaḥ kṣayo'prakarṣatā, vandhyāmiti yadyapi uddeśaśāstre vandhyāpadaṃ nāsti tathā'pi yonidoṣasamanvitāmityanena padenopagṛhītam hārāṇacandrastu ‘kāmavandhyāṃ’ iti paṭhitvā ‘akāmāṃ’ iti vyākhyānayati| uccārite purīṣavegavati| mūtrite mūtravegayukte| adhaḥsthitaḥ pumānuttānaḥ, taduparisthā nārī, yadyapi apriyā'gamyāmūrdhābhighātānāṃ sevane dūṣaṇaṃ nābhihitaṃ, tathā'pyapriyāyāṃ dveṣyāmiva śukrasya manasaśca kṣayo bhavati, agamyāsu ca varṇavṛddhāyāmiva jīvitakṣayaḥ, mūrdhābhighāte ca tantrāntarāddūṣaṇaṃ jñeyaṃ, tathā ca vṛddhavāgbhaṭaḥ,- “timirādigadotpattirmūrdhābhihananād dhruvam” (a.saṃ.sū.a.9)- iti||110-129||-

lg.l: bhakṣyāḥ saśarkarāḥ kṣīraṃ sasitaṃ rasa eva ca |
snānaṃ savyajanaṃ svapno vyavāyānte hitāni tu ‘snānaṃ saśarkaraṃ kṣīraṃ raso bhakṣyāśca gauḍikāḥ| vyajanaṃ svapnasevā ca vyavāyānte hitāni tu’ iti pā.||132||

ab.seg: guṇo dākṣiṇyādiḥ| tulyaśīlāṃ samānasvabhāvām| abhikāmaḥ sābhilāṣaḥ| abhikāmāṃ vṛṣasyantīṃ sakāmāmityarthaḥ| raso māṃsarasaḥ| vyajanaṃ vyajanānilaḥ| nanu cāsya vidherasambhava eva, tathāhi- rātrāvevābhigamanamuktaṃ, rātrau ca snānabhojanādibhirajīrṇādidoṣaḥ syāt, tat kathaṃ maithunānte snānādividhiḥ? satyam, adhikaśukrāṇāṃ narāṇāṃ divā maithunagāmināmayaṃ snānavidhirvyavasthāpita iti bhāvaḥ; athavā grīṣme sāyaṃ snānaṃ bhojanaṃ ca sambhāvyate eveti na doṣaḥ||130-132||

lg.l: ārogyam āyur artho vā nāsadbhiḥ prāpyate nṛbhiḥ ‘hārāṇacandreṇa tvayaṃ śloko 101 aṅkasyānantaraṃ paṭhitaḥ||133||

ab.seg: idānīmativistṛtatvāt pradhānamātramevaitadīritaṃ na punaratrāpradhānamapītyāha- mukhamātramityādi| mukhamātraṃ pradhānamātraṃ, samāsena saṅkṣepeṇa| nāsadbhiḥ anācāraiḥ| nṛbhiḥ puruṣaiḥ| (kecidasminnadhyāye ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate ‘yasmin yasminnṛtau’ ityādikaṃ tathā strīprayogakramaṃ cādhīyante; tadasamyak, pañjikāyāṃ dūṣitatvāt)||133||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne 'nāgatābādhacikitsitaṃ nāma caturviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||24||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne caturviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||24||

div.head: miśrakacikitsitam

ab.seg: athāto miśrakacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

lg.l: pālyāmayās tu visrāvyā ity uktaṃ prāṅnibodha tān |
pañcamaḥ parilehī ca karṇapālyāṃ gadāḥ smṛtāḥ |
rakto vā raktapittābhyām utpātaḥ sa gado mataḥ |
balād vardhayataḥ karṇaṃ pālyāṃ vāyuḥ prakupyati ||7||
gṛhītvā sakaphaṃ kuryāc chophaṃ tadvarṇavedanam ‘stabdhamavedanam’ iti pā.|
śopho bhavati pākaś ca tvakstho 'sau duḥkhavardhanaḥ ||9||
lihyāt saśaṣkulīṃ pālīṃ parilehīti sa smṛtaḥ ||11||

ab.seg: cirotsṛṣṭo bahukālaṃ yāvat parityaktaḥ, saukumāryahetutvāt| śaṣkulī bāhyapālyadhiṣṭhānaṃ||1-12||

lg.l: tasmād āśu bhiṣak teṣu snehādikramam ācaret |
sāmānyato viśeṣāc ca vakṣyāmy abhyañjanaṃ prati |
sakṣīrāṇy atha taiḥ pāliṃ pradihyāt paripoṭake |
sarvair vā sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ siddhaṃ maricasaṃyutam |
puṣṭyarthaṃ mārdavārthaṃ ca kuryād abhyañjanaṃ tv idam ||24||
paced daśaguṇaṃ kṣīram āvāpya madhuraṃ gaṇam ||25||
mṛdvyaḥ puṣṭāḥ samāḥ snigdhā jāyante bhūṣaṇakṣamāḥ |28|

div.ab: tasmādityādi| sneha ādiryasya vamanādeḥ sa tathā| tatra vātike'bhyaṅgānuvāsanapradehādi, paittike virecanaṃ, ślaiṣmike vamanaṃ, raktapaittike raktāpakarṣaṇavirekapariṣekādikā kriyā, kṛmije kṛmighnaśca vidhiriti| kharamañjariḥ apāmārgaḥ| avalgujā bākucikā| paripoṭake pāliṃ catuḥsnehena sakiṭṭenaiva pradihyāt| tālapatrī muśalī| kulīragodhābhyāmiti kulīraḥ karkaṭaḥ, godhā ‘gosāp’ iti bhāṣā| saralā dhūpakāṣṭhaḥ| aśmantakādipatrakvāthapariṣiktāṃ lākṣāviḍaṅgakalkasiddhena tailenābhyaktāṃ prapauṇḍarīkādicūrṇairavacūrṇayet| trivṛdādisaṃyutairviḍaṅgairgomūtrapiṣṭaiḥ pradihyāt| gayī tu parilehike pippalīkṛmighnavacākalkena gomūtrapiṣṭena ca pradihyāditi vyākhyānayati; tadanugataśca pāṭho na labhyate| sarvairanantaroktaiḥ; gomūtrapiṣṭaireva karañjādibhiścaturbhiḥ| atrāpi gomūtraṃ caturguṇam| anye tvevaṃ paṭhanti- “nimbapatrairmūtrasikte hyaṅge cābhyañjanaṃ hitam” iti| lopākaḥ lāṅgaṭakaḥ| ānūpā mahiṣādayaḥ| vasā punasteṣāmeva| madhuragaṇaḥ kākolyādiḥ||13-27||-

lg.l: bījodbhavaṃ sāhacaraṃ ca puṣpaṃ pathyākṣadhātrīsahitaṃ vicūrṇya ||28||
ekīkṛtaṃ sarvam idaṃ pramāya paṅkena tulyaṃ nalinībhavena |
saṃyojya pakṣaṃ kalaśe nidhāya lauhe ghaṭe ‘dṛḍhe’ iti pā. sadmani sāpidhāne ||29||
anena tailaṃ vipaced vimiśraṃ rasena bhṛṅgatriphalābha ‘vipacedvidhijñaḥ’ iti pā. vena |
āsannapāke ca parīkṣaṇārthaṃ patraṃ balākābhavam ākṣipec ca ||30||
bhaved yadā tad bhramarāṅganīlaṃ tadā vipakvaṃ vinidhāya pātre |
kṛṣṇāyase māsam avasthitaṃ tad abhyaṅgayogāt palitāni hanyāt ||31||

ab.seg: palite nīlītailamāha- nīlīdalamityādi| nīlī nīlāñjanikā śāradaphalā, ‘śrīphalī’ ‘śaradvalā’ iti pā. iti loke| bhṛṅgarājo mārkavaḥ| piṇḍītakaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ, kṛṣṇapuṣpo madanaḥ| bījodbhavaṃ sāhacaraṃ ca puṣpaṃ bījakasahacarayoḥ puṣpam; anye tu bījodbhavamityāhuḥ, asmin yoge kecit sāhacaraṃ śyāmāpuṣpaṃ iti vadanti| ekīkṛtaṃ sarvamidaṃ pramāyeti adaḥ etat, pramāya tolayitvā, nalinībhavena paṅkena tulyaṃ padmatalakardamena sahetyarthaḥ| saṃyojya melayitvā| sadmani gṛhe| sāpidhāne suṣṭhu āvṛte sajhampane kalaśe iti jñeyam| anenetyādi| pakṣāduddhṛtyānena tailaṃ vipacet| snehacaturthāṃśo bheṣajakalkaḥ, snehāccaturguṇo drava iti nyāyaḥ svayamevohyaḥ| āsannapāke cetyādi| tāvat kālaṃ pācayed ‘na gālayet’ iti pā. yāvadeva balākāpakṣaṃ nīlaṃ bhavatīti; etena punaḥ punardravaṃ nikṣipya pacedityuktaṃ bhavati||28-31||

lg.l: phalatrayaṃ loharajo 'ñjanaṃ ca yaṣṭyāhvayaṃ nīrajasārive ca |
piṣṭvā 'tha sarvaṃ saha modayantyā sārāmbhasā bījakasambhavena ||33||
sārāmbhasaḥ saptabhir eva paścāt prasthaiḥ samāloḍya daśāhaguptam |
lauhe supātre vinidhāya tailam akṣodbhavaṃ tac ca pacet prayatnāt ||34||
pakvaṃ ca lauhe 'bhinave nidhāya nasyaṃ vidadhyāt pariśuddhakāyaḥ |
abhyaṅgayogaiś ca niyujyamānaṃ bhuñjīta māṣān kṛśarām atho vā ||35||
keśās tathā 'nye khalatau bhaveyur jarā na cainaṃ sahasā 'bhyupaiti ||36||
balaṃ paraṃ sambhavatīndriyāṇāṃ bhavec ca vaktraṃ valibhir vimuktam |
nākāmine 'narthini nākṛtāya naivāraye tailam idaṃ pradeyam ||37||

ab.seg: sairīyakādīnāṃ puṣpāṇi| sairīyakaḥ kaṇṭaselīyākaḥ, mārkavacūtayorbīje, mārkavo bhṛṅgarājaḥ| cūta āmraḥ| punarnave dve śuklalohite| kardamaḥ padminīmūlapaṅkaḥ| piṇḍītako madanakaḥ, tasya yatphalaṃ pāṇḍuravarṇaṃ bhavati tadiha grāhyam| bījasāraṃ asanasāram| añjanaṃ nīlavarṇaṃ rasāñjanaṃ, anye sroto'ñjanamāhuḥ| nīrajaṃ nīlotpalam| piṣṭvā sarvaṃ karṣapramāṇamityarthaḥ| modayantī malliketi loke khyātā| sārāmbhasā bījakasambhavena bījakasārodakena| tailamakṣodbhavaṃ bibhītakatailaṃ, tadāḍhakapramāṇaṃ pacediti| lauhapātre nidhāya sthāpayet, ‘māsamātram’ iti śeṣaḥ| eṣa palite khalatau ca yogaḥ; valiḥ tvaksaṅkocaḥ, anarthini atātparyārthapare, akṛtāya kṛtaghnāya||32-37||

lg.l: lākṣā lākṣāmanohvagajarodhratālaṃ pattaṅgaraktākanakābhidhānāḥ| saurāṣṭrikā pāṇḍu vaṭasya patraṃ kālīyakaṃ padmakapadmamadhyam||38|| gorocanākuṅkumagairikāni niśādvayaṃ pāradacandane ca| kṣaudrotthamajjājyavasāpayāṃsi sasvāduvargāmayavarṇakāni||39|| kṣīradgumāṇāṃ kvathanena piṣṭvā sampācitaṃ tāmramaye kaṭāhe| abhyaṅgayogena niṣevyamāṇaṃ vyaṅgaṃ samastān piḍakāṃśca sarpiḥ| vakre pravṛddhāmati nīlikāṃ ca tūrṇaṃ nihanyāttilakālakāṃśca| valīvimuktaṃ dṛḍhapīnagaṇḍaṃ kuryācca vakraṃ kamalānukāri||41|| ṭī. manovhā manaḥśilā, gajaṃ nāgakesaraṃ, tālaṃ haritālaṃ pattaṅgaṃ raktacandanabhedaḥ, raktā mañjiṣṭhā, kanakābhidhānā suvarṇakṣīriketi prasiddhā, saurāṣṭikā tuvaramṛttikā, kālīyakaṃ pītacandanaṃ, padmakaṃ padmakāṣṭhaṃ, padmamadhyaṃ padmavarāṭakaṃ, pāradaḥ śambhuretaḥ, candane ca ekaṃ sitamaparaṃ raktaṃ, kṣaudrotthaṃ madhūcchiṣṭaṃ, vasāmajjāsarpiṣkāni kalkabhāgenaiva, payo dugdhaṃ tacca ghṛtasamaṃ deyaṃ, svāduvargaḥ kākolyādiḥ, āmayaḥ kuṣṭhaṃ| varṇakaḥ kampillakaḥ, kaṅkuṣṭhakamapare, anye suvarṇamāhuḥ, āragvadhakalkamapare| kṣīradrumāṇāṃ kvathaneneti vaṭādīnāṃ triguṇena kvāthena athavā caturguṇenetyarthaḥ| ayaṃ pāṭho'sauśruto'pi jejjaṭenoktatvādasmadvṛddhaiḥ paṭhitatvānmayā'pi paṭhitāḥ’ iti pā. rodhraṃ dve haridre śilāle kuṣṭhaṃ nāgaṃ gairikā varṇakāś ca |
mañjiṣṭhogrā syāt surāṣṭrodbhavā ca pattaṅgaṃ vai rocanā cāñjanaṃ ca ||38||
hemāṅgatvak pāṇḍupatraṃ vaṭasya kālīyaṃ syāt padmakaṃ padmamadhyam |
raktaṃ śvetaṃ candanaṃ pāradaṃ ca kākolyādiḥ kṣīrapiṣṭaś ca vargaḥ ||39||
medo majjā sikthakaṃ goghṛtaṃ ca dugdhaṃ kvāthaḥ kṣīriṇāṃ ca drumāṇām |
etat sarvaṃ pakvam aikadhyatas tu vaktrābhyaṅge sarpir uktaṃ pradhānam ||40||
hanyād vyaṅgaṃ nīlikāṃ cātivṛddhāṃ vaktre jātāḥ sphoṭikāś cāpi kāś cit |
padmākāraṃ nirvalīkaṃ ca vaktraṃ kuryād etat pīnagaṇḍaṃ manojñam ||41||
rājñām etad yoṣitāṃ cāpi nityaṃ kuryād vaidyas tat samānāṃ nṛṇāṃ ca |
kuṣṭhaghnaṃ vai sarpir etat pradhānaṃ yeṣāṃ pāde santi vaipādikāś ca ||42||

ab.seg: lākṣāmityādi| valiḥ tvaksaṅkocaḥ||38-42||

lg.l: patraṃ ca dadyān madayantikāyā lepo 'ṅgarāgo naradevayogyaḥ ||43||

ab.seg: harītakītyādi| ariṣṭapatraṃ nimbapatraṃ, phenilavṛkṣapatraṃ vā| cūtatvak āmratvak| madayantikā ‘mendī’ iti loke, yasyāḥ piṣṭaiḥ patrairnakhānāṃ rāgaṃ striya utpādayanti||43||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne miśrakacikitsitaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||25||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne pañcaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||25||

div.head: kṣīṇabalīyavājīkaraṇam

ab.seg: athātaḥ kṣīṇabalīyaṃ vājīkaraṇacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
kṣīṇatā hīnaśaktitvam||1-2||

lg.l: sarveṣv ṛtuṣv ahar ahar vyavāyo na nivāritaḥ ||3||
nṛṇāṃ ca bahubhāryāṇāṃ yogā vājīkarā hitāḥ ||5||

ab.seg: kalyasya rogarahitasya| udagravayasaḥ taruṇasya||3-5||

lg.l: gandhā manojñā rūpāṇi citrāṇy upavanāni ca |

ab.seg: atha kiṃ tadvājīkaraṇamityucyata ityāha- sevamāna ityādi| tathā'nyatrāpi “vājīvātibalo yena yātyapratihataḥ striyaḥ” ityādilakṣaṇaṃ vājīkaraṇam| tat trividham- janakaṃ, pravartakaṃ, janakapravartakaṃ ceti| tatra janakaṃ māṃsaghṛtādikaṃ, yatastadrasādidhātukrameṇa pariṇataṃ sat pradhānadhātupuṣṭiṃ karoti; pravartakamuccaṭācūrṇādikaṃ śukravairecanikaṃ, na ca tasya vairecanikoktayā śukrakṣayakāritvaṃ syāt, ato virecanaṃ śukrasya patanāyābhimukhībhāvamātrakaraṇaṃ; janakapravartakaṃ tu gavyaghṛtagodhūmamāṣakākāṇḍaphalādikam| kevalaṃ dehabalakaraṃ janakaṃ godhūmādikaṃ, kevalamanobalakaraṃ saṅkalpādi tu pravartakaṃ, ghṛtakṣīrādi dehamanobalakaraṃ sadubhayakaramiti| vṛṣyādidravyāṇāṃ sadyaḥ śukrādikaraṇe prabhāvo'yam| tathā ca śrīvāgbhaṭaḥ,- “kecidāhurahorātrāt ṣaḍahādapare, pare| māsāt prayāti śukratvamannaṃ pākakramāditi|| vṛṣyādīni prabhāveṇa sadyaḥ śukrādi kurvate|| prāyaḥ karotyahorātrāt karmānyadapi bheṣajam” (vā. śā. 3)- iti| riraṃsuḥ rantumicchuḥ| pravartanādikāraṇānyuddiśannāha- bhojanānītyādi||6-8||

lg.l: tais tair bhāvair ahṛdyais tu riraṃsor manasi kṣate ||9||
dveṣyastrīsamprayogāc ca klaibyaṃ tan mānasaṃ smṛtam |
saumyadhātukṣayo dṛṣṭaḥ klaibyaṃ tad aparaṃ smṛtam |
klaibyam etac caturthaṃ syān nṝṇāṃ puṃstvopaghātajam |
janmaprabhṛti yaḥ klībaḥ klaibyaṃ tat sahajaṃ smṛtam ||13||
ṣaṣṭhaṃ klaibyaṃ mataṃ tat tu kharaśukranimittajam ‘sthiraśukranimittajam’ iti pā.||14||
asādhyaṃ sahajaṃ klaibyaṃ marmacchedāc ca yad bhavet |

ab.seg: pravartanākāraṇānyuddiśannāha- taistairityādi| taistairbhāvairiti bhayāviśrambhastrīdoṣadarśanādibhiḥ| āhārajaṃ klaibyamāha- kaṭuketyādi| riraṃsuḥ rantumicchuḥ| dhātukṣayajanyaṃ ‘viśiṣṭavihārajaṃ’ iti pā. klaibyamāha- ativyavāyetyādi| dhvajo mehanam| marmacchedeneti śukravahanāḍīnāṃ chedanāt| balinaḥ atisthūlasya| kṣubdhamanasaḥ calacittasya| nirodhāt vātamūtrādīnām| kharaṃ ‘sthiraṃ’ iti pā. kaṭhinam, anye paruṣamāhuḥ||9-15||

lg.l: vidhir vājīkaro yas tu taṃ pravakṣyāmy ataḥ param |
tāṃ bhakṣayitvā puruṣo ‘gacchettu puruṣaḥ ṣaṣṭimaṅganāḥ’ iti pā. gacchet tu pramadāśatam |18|

div.ab: rasaiḥ māṃsarasairikṣurasaiśca| utkārikāṃ lapsikām||16-17||-

lg.l: yaḥ khādet sa pumān gacchet strīṇāṃ śatam apūrvavat ||19||

ab.seg: sāmānyaparibhāṣākalpena siddhe payasi saptāhaṃ bhāvitān tilān khādet, tatrānupānaṃ kṣīramevetyeko yogaḥ| paribhāṣāmāha- “dravyādaṣṭaguṇaṃ kṣīraṃ kṣīrāttoyaṃ caturguṇam| kṣīrāvaśiṣṭaṃ kartavyaṃ kṣīrapāke tvayaṃ vidhiḥ”- iti| bastāṇḍasiddhapayobhāvitatilaiḥ kṛtāḥ śaṣkulyaḥ śiśumāravasayā bhṛṣṭā bhakṣitā yathoktaphaladāḥ, tatrāpyanupāne kṣīramiti dvitīyo yogaḥ, etena yogadvayamuktam| apūrvavat prathamasuratavat||18-19||

lg.l: sādhite bhakṣayed yas tu sa gacchet pramadāśatam ||20||

ab.seg: pippalītyādi| bastāṇḍe kṣīrasarpiṣā kṣīrotthitanavanītasarpiṣā pakve pippalyā kiñcitkaṭuke saindhavena kiñcillavaṇe bhakṣite yathoktaphalade, anupānaṃ śītalajalam||20||

lg.l: cūrṇabhāgaiḥ samais tais tu ghṛte pūpalikāṃ pacet ||21||
tāṃ bhakṣayitvā pītvā tu śarkarāmadhuraṃ payaḥ |

ab.seg: pippalītyādi| śṛtaṃ śarkarāmadhuraṃ kṣīramanupānam||21-22||

lg.l: sarpirmadhuyutaṃ līḍhvā daśa strīr adhigacchati ‘strīradhirohati’ iti pā.||23||

div.ab: svarasenaiva vidāryā eva, śarkarāsarpiḥkṣaudrayutaṃ līḍhvā'nantaramanupānaṃ payaḥ pibet||23-24||-

lg.l: śiśumārasya vā khādet te tu vājīkare bhṛśam |

div.ab: pippalītyādi| bastāṇḍe ajamuṣkau| śiśumārasya ‘aṇḍe’ iti śeṣaḥ| kulīraḥ karkaṭakaḥ, ‘gṛhacaṭaka ‘grāmacaṭakaḥ’ iti pā. ’ ityanye, ‘kulīro matsyaviśeṣa’ ityapare| kūrmaḥ kacchapaḥ| nakro matsyabhedaḥ, ‘ghaḍiyāla’ iti loke| aṇḍamatra prāṇādhāro vartulaḥ, natu muṣkaḥ| ṛṣabho vṛṣabhaḥ| bastaḥ chāgaḥ| teṣāṃ śukrāṇi gurūpadeśāt tadādhārabhūtānyevāṇḍāni ‘śukrāṇāṃ durupādeyatvāttadādhārabhūtānyaṇḍāni grāhyāṇi’ iti pā.||25-26||-

lg.l: vidārimūlakalkaṃ tu śṛtena ‘ghṛtena’ iti pā. payasā naraḥ ||28||
māṣāṇāṃ palam ekaṃ tu saṃyuktaṃ kṣaudrasarpiṣā ||29||
avalihya payaḥ pītvā tena vājī bhaven naraḥ |
śītān ghṛtayutān khādet tataḥ paścāt payaḥ pibet |
pādābhyaṅgena kurute balaṃ bhūmiṃ tu na spṛśet |
yāvat spṛśati no bhūmiṃ tāvad gacchen nirantaram ||32||
dhāroṣṇena naraḥ pītvā payasā na kṣayaṃ vrajet ||33||
svayaṅguptāphalair yuktaṃ māṣasūpaṃ ‘māṣayūṣaṃ iti pā. piben naraḥ ||34||
guptāphalaṃ gokṣurakāc ca bījaṃ tathoccaṭāṃ gopayasā vipācya |
khajāhataṃ śarkarayā ca yuktaṃ pītvā naro hṛṣyati sarvarātram ||35||
māṣān vidārīm api soccaṭāṃ ca kṣīre gavāṃ kṣaudraghṛtopapannām |
pītvā naraḥ śarkarayā suyuktāṃ kuliṅgavad dhṛṣyati sarvarātram ||36||

ab.seg: aśvatthetyādi| śuṅgā agrapallavāḥ| hṛṣyati sakāmo bhavati| uḍumbarasamam udumbaraphalapramāṇam| svayaṅguptā kapikacchūḥ| ikṣurakaḥ kokilākṣaḥ ‘tālamakhānā’ iti loke| uccaṭā śaṇaghaṇṭākāraḥ svalpaviṭapaḥ prāyaśo himavati sarayūnadītīre dṛśyate| evamiti saśarkaradhāroṣṇakṣīreṇa; khajāhataṃ manthānahatam||27-36||

lg.l: yat kṣīraṃ tat praśaṃsanti balakāmeṣu jantuṣu ||37||
vājīkaraṇahetor hi tasmāt tat tu prayojayet ||38||

ab.seg: gṛṣṭīnāṃ prathamaprasūtānāṃ, vṛddhavatsānāmekavarṣavatsānāmityarthaḥ| māṣaparṇabhṛtāṃ māṣaparṇena poṣitānāṃ, māṣaparṇagrahaṇaṃ phalavyudāsārthaṃ, te ca māṣaparṇā ‘māṣāḥ parṇavantaḥ’ iti pā. haritā abhipretā na śuṣkāḥ||37-38||

prītiḥ manaḥsukham, apatyaṃ santatiḥ, balaṃ dehasyopacayalakṣaṇaṃ śaktilakṣaṇaṃ vā| viśiṣṭaśodhanaviśuddhaśarīrāṇāṃ kṛtasaṃsarjanānāmeva yathoktaṃ phalaṃ bhavati nānyatheti darśayannāha- sevyā viśuddhopacitadehairiti; pūrvaṃ viśuddhāḥ kṛtasaṃsarjanatvāt paścādupacitāḥ||39||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ kṣīṇabalīyavājīkaraṇacikitsitaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||26||

div.ab: iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne ṣaḍviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||26|

ab.seg: athātaḥ sarvopaghātaśamanīyaṃ ‘sarvabādhāśamanīyaṃ’ iti pā. rasāyanaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

rasādidhātūnāmayanamāpyāyanam, athavā bheṣajāśritānāṃ rasavīryavipākaprabhāvāṇāmāyurbalavīryadārḍhyāṇāṃ ‘…prabhāvaparamāyurbalavīryāṇāṃ’ iti pā. vayaḥsthairyakarāṇāmayanaṃ lābhopāyo rasāyanam; vardhakaṃ sthāpakamaprāptaprāpakaṃ vetyarthaḥ| dvividhaṃ rasāyanaṃ- kuṭīprāveśikaṃ, vātātapikaṃ ca; punaśca trividhaṃ- kāmyaṃ, naimittikam, ājasrikaṃ ca; ‘prāṇamedhākāmaḥ śrīkāma’ ityādikaṃ kāmyaṃ, naimittikaṃ vyādhinimittaṃ śilājatubhallātakatuvarakādyam, ājasrikaṃ kṣīraghṛtābhyāsādikam; punaśca dvividhaṃ- saṃśodhanasaṃśamanabhedena; doṣasya ‘doṣasya pāpasya ca’ iti pā. saṃśodhanāt saṃśodhanaṃ sasyādirasāyanaṃ (?), saṃśamanaṃ nāgabalāprayogādikamiti||1-2||

lg.l: pūrve vayasi madhye vā manuṣyasya rasāyanam |
na bhāti vāsasi kliṣṭe raṅgayoga ivāhitaḥ ||4||

ab.seg: na bhāti na dīpyate| āhitaḥ prayuktaḥ| śarīradoṣā vātādayaḥ; mānasau tu rajastamasī||3-5||

lg.l: śītodakaṃ payaḥ kṣaudraṃ sarpir ity ekaśo dviśaḥ |
triśaḥ samastam athavā prāk pītaṃ sthāpayed vayaḥ ||6||

ab.seg: śarīrasya prakṛtibhedena caturvidhaṃ vayaḥsthāpanamupadiśannāha- śītodakamityādi| śītodakapayaḥkṣaudrasarpiṣāmekaśaścatvāraḥ prayogāḥ, dviśaḥ ṣaṭ, triśaścatvāraḥ, caturbhirekaḥ, evaṃ pañcadaśa prayogāḥ| udakaṃ payaḥ kṣaudraṃ sarpirityekaśaścatvāraḥ; udakapayasī, udakakṣaudre, udakasarpiṣī, payaḥkṣaudre, payaḥsarpiṣī, kṣaudrasarpiṣītyevaṃ dviśaḥ ṣaṭ; udakapayaḥsarpīṃṣi, udakakṣaudrasarpīṃṣi, payaḥkṣaudrasarpīṃṣi, udakapayaḥkṣaudrāṇītyevaṃ catvāraḥ; udakapayaḥkṣaudrasarpirbhireka eva ca prayogaḥ| mānāviruddhānāmeṣāṃ viṣamāṇāmupayogaḥ kārya iti jñeyam| śītodakaṃ samapittavātakaphaprakṛtau, payaḥ punaradhikapittaprakṛtāveva, kṣaudraṃ kaphaprakṛtau, sarpiḥ punaradhikavātaprakṛtau; atraivaikadvitricaturdravyasaṃyogo hitāhitavātādidoṣabhedaprakṛtiṣu svabuddhyā vibhajanīyaḥ||6||

tatra viḍaṅgataṇḍulacūrṇam āhṛtya yaṣṭīmadhukamadhuyuktaṃ yathābalaṃ śītatoyenopayuñjīta śītatoyaṃ cānupibed evam ahar ahar māsaṃ, tad eva madhuyuktaṃ bhallātakakvāthena vā, madhudrākṣākvāthayuktaṃ vā, madhvāmalakarasābhyāṃ vā, guḍūcīkvāthena vā, evam ete pañca prayogā bhavanti; jīrṇe mudgāmalakayūṣeṇālavaṇenālpasnehena ghṛtavantam odanam aśnīyāt; ete khalv arśāṃsi kṣapayanti, kṛmīn upaghnanti, grahaṇadhāraṇaśaktiṃ janayanti, māse māse ca prayoge varṣaśataṃ varṣaśatam āyuṣo 'bhivṛddhir bhavati ||7||

ataścordhvamāyurvardhanamupadiśannāha- tatretyādi| yaṣṭīmadhu madhu ca viḍaṅgataṇḍulamānena grāhyam; etat pittaraktārśassu tatprakṛtau vā| tadeva viḍaṅgataṇḍulacūrṇaṃ madhuprakṣepaṃ bhallātakakvāthena peyaṃ, yathābalamatrāpi sambadhyate; etadvātajeṣu śuṣkārśaḥsu tatprakṛtāvapi| madhudrākṣākvāthayuktaṃ vā ‘viḍaṅgataṇḍulacūrṇam’ iti śeṣaḥ| madhvityādi atrāpi viḍaṅgataṇḍulacūrṇam| guḍūcītyādi atrāpi viḍaṅgataṇḍulacūrṇam| ghṛtavantaṃ bahughṛtamityarthaḥ| teṣāṃ phalamāha- ete ityādi| tasya bhallātakavidhānavadāhāraḥ parihāraśca||7||

viḍaṅgataṇḍulānāṃ droṇaṃ piṣṭapacane piṣṭavad upasvedya ‘piṣṭavadutsvedya’ iti pā. vigatakaṣāyaṃ svinnam avatārya dṛṣadi piṣṭam āyase dṛḍhe kumbhe madhūdakottaraṃ prāvṛṣi bhasmarāśāv antargṛhe caturo māsān nidadhyāt, varṣāvigame coddhṛtyopasaṃskṛtaśarīraḥ sahasrasampātābhihutaṃ kṛtvā prātaḥ- prātar yathābalam upayuñjīta, jīrṇe mudgāmalakayūṣeṇālavaṇena ‘alavaṇenālpasnehena’ iti pā. ghṛtavantam odanam aśnīyāt, pāṃśuśayyāyāṃ śayīta, tasya māsād ūrdhvaṃ sarvāṅgebhyaḥ kṛmayo niṣkrāmanti, tān aṇutailenābhyaktasya vaṃśavidalenāpaharet, dvitīye pipīlikās tṛtīye yūkās tathaivāpaharet, caturthe dantanakharomāṇy avaśīryante; pañcame praśastaguṇalakṣaṇāni jāyante, amānuṣaṃ cādityaprakāśaṃ vapur adhigacchati, dūrāc chravaṇāni darśanāni cāsya bhavanti, rajastamasī cāpohya sattvam adhitiṣṭhati, śrutanigādy apūrvotpādī gajabalo 'śvajavaḥ punar yuvā 'ṣṭau varṣaśatāny āyur avāpnoti; tasyāṇutailam abhyaṅgārthe, ajakarṇakaṣāyam utsādanārthe, sośīraṃ kūpodakaṃ snānārthe, candanam upalepanārthe, bhallātakavidhānavad āhāraḥ parihāraś ca ||8||
kāśmaryāṇāṃ niṣkulīkṛtānām eṣa eva kalpaḥ pāṃśuśayyābhojanavarjaṃ; atra hi payasā śṛtena bhoktavyaṃ, samānam anyat pūrveṇāśiṣaś ca | śoṇitapittanimitteṣu vikāreṣv eteṣām upayogaḥ ||9||

yathoktam āgāraṃ praviśya balāmūlārdhapalaṃ palaṃ vā payasā''loḍya pibet, jīrṇe payaḥ sarpirodana ity āhāraḥ, evaṃ dvādaśarātram upayujya dvādaśa varṣāṇi vayas tiṣṭhati; evaṃ divasaśatam upayujya varṣaśataṃ vayas tiṣṭhati | evam evātibalānāgabalāvidārīśatāvarīṇām upayogaḥ | viśeṣatas tv atibalām udakena, nāgabalācūrṇaṃ madhunā, vidārīcūrṇaṃ kṣīreṇa, śatāvarīm apy evaṃ, pūrveṇānyat samānam āśiṣaś ca samāḥ | etās tv auṣadhayo balakāmānāṃ śoṣiṇāṃ raktapittopasṛṣṭānāṃ śoṇitaṃ chardayatāṃ viricyamānānāṃ copadiśyante ||10||

piṣṭapacane tṛṇādikṛtāstāre kaṭāhe| dṛṣadi śilāyām| madhūdakottaraṃ madhūdakapradhānam; udakamatra viḍaṅgakaṣāya eva, śītodakamityanye| nidadhyāt sthāpayet| upasaṃskṛtaśarīro viśuddhadehaḥ| sahasrasampātābhihutaṃ kṛtvā sahasrasampātādhyāyo ṛgvede paṭhyate, tairmantraiḥ sahasraṃ hutvopayuñjītetyarthaḥ| jejjaṭastu sampātaśabdena yājñikānāṃ sravaṇaṃ, tathā hyāhārya saṃskṛtya dravyāṇi hūyante, hutvā hutvā ca pānīyādipūrṇapātre saṃsrāvyante| etaduktaṃ bhavati- sahasrasampatanaṃ yasminnabhihute tattathā; tat kṛtvopayuñjītetyarthaḥ| gayī tu atharvavidbhiḥ sampātakrameṇauṣadhādhikāriṇā mantreṇa tripadā gāyatryā vā prāktanakarmakṣayārthaṃ vighnaśāntyarthamabhimatāśīḥprāptyarthaṃ vā sahasrābhihutaṃ kṛtvā prayujyante| pāṃśuḥ dhūliḥ| vaṃśavidalena vaṃśakambikayā| dvitīye iti māse| avaśīryante patantītyarthaḥ| caturthe'tīte ityarthaḥ| apūrvotpādīti apūrvaślokādikaṃ karotītyarthaḥ| ajakarṇo mahāsarjaḥ, ‘gandhamuṇḍa’ iti loke| kaṣāyo'tra kalkaḥ| sasnehakalkenoddharṣaṇamutsādanam| candanaṃ raktacandanaṃ, sitacandanamityapare| bhallātakavidhānavaditi vivṛtāgārapraveśādibhirityarthaḥ; samānamanyat| āśiṣa iti guṇā ityarthaḥ||8-10||

vārāhīmūlatulācūrṇaṃ kṛtvā tato mātrāṃ madhuyuktāṃ payasā''loḍya pibet, jīrṇe payaḥ sarpirodana ity āhāraḥ, pratiṣedho 'tra pūrvavat ‘cūrṇakṣayāt’ iti pā.; prayogam imam upasevamāno varṣaśatam āyur avāpnoti strīṣu cākṣayatām, etenaiva cūrṇena payo 'vacūrṇya śṛtaśītam abhimathyājyam utpādya madhuyutam upayuñjīta sāyamprātar ekakālaṃ vā, jīrṇe payaḥ sarpirodana ity āhāraḥ, evaṃ māsam upayujya varṣaśatāyur bhavati ‘triṇi varṣaśatānyarogo jīvati iti pā.||11||

vārāhītyādi| pratiṣedho nivṛttiḥ| etenaiva cūrṇena vārāhīcūrṇena kṣīrapākavidhinā śṛtaṃ kṣīramavacūrṇya, tacca śītamabhimathya, ājyamutpādayet, vārāhīśatapākaṃ vā sarpirdroṇamupayujya varṣaśatāyurbhavati| jīrṇe payaḥ sarpirodana ityāhāraḥ| kalpanāmāha- vārāhīkandakalkaṃ kṣīracaturguṇaṃ ghṛtadroṇaṃ pacet; anena krameṇa śatapākaṃ ghṛtaṃ droṇamupayujya varṣaśatāyurbhavati| anye punaranuktaṃ jalameva caturguṇamāhuḥ| yadyapi snehapānānantaraṃ snehabhojanaṃ niṣiddhaṃ, tathā'pyatra vārāhyā śatapākasaṃskṛtasya svabhāvaśamanīyarūpasya sarpiṣaḥ pānānantaraṃ rasāyanavidhinā sarpiṣā bhojanaṃ yujyate iti na doṣaḥ||11||

cakṣuḥkāmaḥ prāṇakāmo vā bījakasārāgnimanthamūlaṃ niṣkvāthya māṣaprasthaṃ sādhayet, tasmin sidhyati citrakamūlānām akṣamātraṃ kalkaṃ dadyād āmalakarasacaturthabhāgaṃ, tataḥ svinnam avatārya sahasrasampātābhihutaṃ kṛtvā śītībhūtaṃ madhusarpirbhyāṃ saṃsṛjyopayuñjīta yathābalaṃ, yathāsātmyaṃ ca lavaṇaṃ pariharan bhakṣayet | jīrṇe mudgāmalakayūṣeṇālavaṇena ghṛtavantam odanam aśnīyāt payasā vā māsatrayam; evam ābhyāṃ prayogābhyāṃ cakṣuḥ sauparṇaṃ sauparṇavat’ iti pā. bhavaty analpabalaḥ strīṣu cākṣayo varṣaśatāyur bhavatīti ||12||

bhavati cātra-
payasā saha siddhāni naraḥ śaṇaphalāni yaḥ |
bhakṣayet payasā sārdhaṃ vayas tasya na śīryate ||13||

bījakasārāgnimanthamūlaṃ palaṃ salilāḍhake niṣkvāthya, ardhāvaśiṣṭe tatra pūte ṣoḍaśapalāni māṣāṇi sādhyāni, tasmiṃśca sidhyati citramūlakalkākṣaṃ prakṣipet, āmalakarasasya māṣaprasthāpekṣayā caturthabhāgaṃ kuḍavamaṣṭau palāni| payasā veti yogadvayametat, yojanāviśeṣatvāt| sauparṇaṃ garuḍacakṣuṣā tulyaṃ cakṣurbhavati| gayī tu ‘sahasrasampātābhihutaṃ kṛtvā’ iti na paṭhati| anye tu suśrutādhyāyino'tra vakṣyamāṇaṃ yogaṃ paṭhanti; yathā- payasā saha siddhānītyādi| ayaṃ yogo'nārṣaḥ, jejjaṭenāpyanuktatvāt; tasmānna paṭhanīyaḥ||12-13||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne sarvopaghātaśamanīyaṃ rasāyanacikitsitaṃ nāma saptaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||27||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne saptaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ|||27||
athāto medhāyuṣkāmīyaṃ ‘medhāyuṣkāmīyamadhyāyaṃ’ iti pā. rasāyanacikitsitaṃ ‘rasāyanaṃ’ iti pā. vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
medhā sarvato'vyāhatā sūkṣmatamā pragāḍhā buddhiḥ śrutadhāriṇī||1-2||

medhāyuḥkāmaḥ śvetāvalgujaphalāny ātapapariśuṣkāṇy ādāya sūkṣmacūrṇāni kṛtvā guḍena sahāloḍya snehakumbhe saptarātraṃ dhānyarāśau nidadhyāt, saptarātrād uddhṛtya hṛtadoṣasya yathābalaṃ piṇḍaṃ prayacched anudite sūrye, uṣṇodakaṃ cānupibet; bhallātakavidhānavac cāgārapraveśaḥ, jīrṇauṣadhaś cāparāhṇe himābhir adbhiḥ pariṣiktagātraḥ śālīnāṃ ṣaṣṭikānāṃ ca payasā śarkarāmadhureṇaudanam aśnīyāt; evaṃ ṣaṇmāsān upayujya vigatapāpmā balavarṇopetaḥ śrutanigādī smṛtimān arogo varṣaśatāyur bhavati | kuṣṭhinaṃ pāṇḍurogiṇam udariṇaṃ vā kṛṣṇāyā gomūtreṇāloḍyārdhapalikaṃ piṇḍaṃ vigatalauhitye savitari pāyayet, parāhṇe cālavaṇenāmalakayūṣeṇa sarpiṣmantam odanam aśnīyāt, evaṃ māsam upayujya smṛtimān arogo varṣaśatāyur bhavati | eṣa evopayogaś citrakamūlānāṃ rajanyāś ca; citrakamūle viśeṣo dvipalikaṃ piṇḍaṃ paraṃ pramāṇaṃ, śeṣaṃ pūrvavat ||3||

hṛtadoṣa eva pratisaṃsṛṣṭabhakto yathākramam āgāraṃ praviśya maṇḍūkaparṇīsvarasam ādāya sahasrasampātābhihutaṃ kṛtvā yathābalaṃ payasā''loḍya pibet payo 'nupānaṃ vā, tasyāṃ jīrṇāyāṃ yavānnaṃ payasopayuñjīta; tilair vā saha bhakṣayet trīn māsān payo 'nupānaṃ, jīrṇe payaḥ sarpirodana ity āhāraḥ; evam upayuñjāno brahmavarcasī śrutanigādī bhavati varṣaśatam āyur avāpnoti | trirātropoṣitaś ca trirātram enāṃ bhakṣayet, trirātrād ūrdhvaṃ payaḥ sarpir iti copayuñjīta | bilvamātraṃ piṇḍaṃ vā payasā''loḍya pibet, evaṃ dvādaśarātram upayujya medhāvī varṣaśatāyur bhavati ||4||

avalgujā bākucī, sā'pi śvetā ‘śvetaphalā’ iti pā. gṛhyate| kṛṣṇāyā bākucyāḥ, tena kṛṣṇāvalgujaphalānāṃ piṇḍaṃ gomūtreṇa pāyayet| ‘kṛṣṇāyāḥ pippalyā’ iti jejjaṭaḥ, tannecchati gayī| citrakasya dvipalaprayogaḥ paraṃ pramāṇaṃ, citrakasya dvipalaprayoga iti etena rajanyā mānasyānuktatvāt pūrvavat palikaṃ piṇḍaṃ pāyayediti gamyate| citrako'tra kṛṣṇapuṣpo grāhyaḥ| maṇḍūkaparṇyāḥ samūlapuṣpāyāstilaiḥ saha bhakṣaṇaṃ, bhakṣaṇakāla eva payo'nupānamupayuñjīteti sambandhaḥ| brahmavarcasī tejasvītyarthaḥ| enāṃ brāhmīṃ, bilvamātraṃ piṇḍamiti tatkalkapiṇḍo vā payasā peyaḥ||3-4||

hṛtadoṣa evāgāraṃ praviśya pratisaṃsṛṣṭabhakto brāhmīsvarasam ādāya sahasrasampātābhihutaṃ kṛtvā yathābalamupayuñjīta, jīrṇauṣadhaś cāparāhṇe yavāgūm alavaṇāṃ pibet, kṣīrasātmyo vā payasā bhuñjīta, evaṃ saptarātram upayujya brahmavarcasī medhāvī bhavati, dvitīyaṃ saptarātram upayujya grantham īpsitam utpādayati naṣṭaṃ cāsya prādur bhavati, tṛtīyaṃ saptarātram upayujya dvir uccāritaṃ śatam apy avadhārayati, evam ekaviṃśatirātram upayujyālakṣmīr apakrāmati; mūrtimatī cainaṃ vāgdevy anupraviśati, sarvāś cainaṃ śrutaya upatiṣṭhanti, śrutadharaḥ pañcavarṣaśatāyur bhavati ||5||

brāhmīsvarasaprasthadvaye ghṛtaprasthaṃ viḍaṅgataṇḍulānāṃ kuḍavaṃ dve dve pale vacāmṛtayor dvādaśa harītakyāmalakabibhītakāni ślakṣṇapiṣṭāny āvāpyaikadhyaṃ sādhayitvā svanuguptaṃ nidadhyāt, tataḥ pūrvavidhānena mātrāṃ yathābalam upayuñjīta, jīrṇe payaḥ sarpirodana ity āhāraḥ, pūrvavac cātra parīhāraḥ, etenordhvam adhas tiryak kṛmayo niṣkrāmanti, alakṣmīr apakrāmati, puṣkaravarṇaḥ sthiravayāḥ śrutanigādī trivarṣaśatāyur bhavati; etad eva kuṣṭhaviṣamajvarāpasmāronmādaviṣabhūtagraheṣv anyeṣu ca mahāvyādhiṣu saṃśodhanam ādiśanti ||6||

pūrvavidhāneneti ‘maṇḍūkabrāhmīprayogānabhidhāya lavaṇabrāhmīprayogānāha- hṛtetyādi’ iti pā. tena hṛtadoṣādiḥ ‘snehasvedādiḥ’ iti pā. sarvarasāyanāṅgo vidhiratidiṣṭaḥ| pūrvavaccātra parīhāra iti sāmānyarasāyanokto'pi, brāhmīrasāyane varjyasyānuktatvāt| puṣkaravarṇa iti puṣkaraṃ padmavarāṭakam| śrutanigādī śrutagrahaṇaśaktimān bhavatītyarthaḥ||5-6||

hṛtadoṣa evāgāraṃ praviśya haimavatyā vacāyāḥ piṇḍam āmalakamātram abhihutaṃ payasā''loḍya pibet, jīrṇe payaḥ sarpirodana ity āhāraḥ, evaṃ dvādaśarātram upayuñjīta, tato 'sya śrotraṃ vivriyate, dvirabhyāsāt smṛtimān bhavati, trirabhyāsāc chrutam ādatte, caturdvādaśarātram upayujya sarvaṃ tarati kilbiṣaṃ, tārkṣyadarśanam utpadyate, śatāyuś ca bhavati | dve dve pale itarasyā vacāyā niṣkvāthya pibet payasā, samānaṃ bhojanaṃ, samāḥ pūrveṇāśiṣaś ca ||7||
vacāśatapākaṃ vā sarpirdroṇam upayujya pañcavarṣaśatāyur bhavati, galagaṇḍāpacīślīpadasvarabhedāṃś cāpahantīti ||8||

haimavatyā vacāyāḥ śvetavacāyā ityarthaḥ| abhihutamityatra kṛtvetyadhyāhārāt homaṃ kṛtvetyarthaḥ| gayī tu ‘payasā''loḍya pibet’ ityatra ‘sarpiṣā''loḍya pibet’ iti paṭhati| tacca sarpirbrāhmīsvarasasādhitaṃ pūrvoktameveti vyākhyāti| itarasyā vacāyā iti aruṇāyāṃ ityarthaḥ| payasā niṣkvāthyeti kṣīrapākavidhinā||7-8||

lg.l: bilvasya cūrṇaṃ puṣye tu hutaṃ vārān sahasraśaḥ |
śrīsūktena naraḥ kalye sasuvarṇaṃ dine dine ||10||
tvacaṃ vihāya bilvasya mūlakvāthaṃ dine dine ||11||
prāśnīyāt payasā sārdhaṃ snātvā hutvā samāhitaḥ |
hutvā bisānāṃ kvāthaṃ tu madhulājaiś ca saṃyutam |

ab.seg: śrīsūktamatharvavedoktaṃ “hiraṇyavarṇāṃ hariṇīṃ suvarṇarajatasrajāṃ” ityādikam| kalye prabhāte| daśasahasrāṇi hūyante yatra taddaśasāhasram| āyuṣyam āyurvṛddhikaram| yuktarathaṃ nāma rasāyanaṃ smṛtaṃ bhavet| bisakvāthaṃ tu madhvādidvitīyaṃ yuktarathaṃ rasāyanaṃ smṛtam||9-13||

lg.l: gavyaṃ payaḥ suvarṇaṃ ca madhūcchiṣṭaṃ ca mākṣikam |

ab.seg: madhūcchiṣṭaṃ ca mākṣikamiti mākṣikaṃ madhu bhrāmaram| vacāditrayacūrṇaṃ ghṛtena sahāvalihyāt||14-16||

lg.l: hutvā sahasram aśnīyān medhyam āyuṣyam ucyate ||18||
yāvakāṃs tāvakān khāded abhibhūya yavāṃs tathā |

ab.seg: tulā palaśatam| yavānāmete yāvakāḥ yavān tāvakān tavakabhavān abhibhūya kuṭṭayitvā tatkṛtān yāvakān bhakṣyān madhupippalīsaṃyuktān khādet| śikṣā caraṇavadbhavediti ‘abhrababhra’- iti gaṇapāṭhāccaradhāturgatyarthaḥ| tataścaraṇavat śikṣā paropadeśāpekṣā śāstrābhyāsaḥ sukhenaiva bhavati; yathā kila bālyānantaraṃ pādagamanaṃ śikṣāṃ vinaiva bhavati, tathaivaitena yogenābhyavahṛtena medhāvṛddheḥ śāstrābhyāsaḥ sukhenaiva bhavatīti tātparyārthaḥ||17-19||

lg.l: sakṣaudraṃ sasuvarṇaṃ ca narendraṃ sthāpayed vaśe ||21||
suvarṇam iti saṃyogaḥ peyaḥ saubhāgyam icchatā ||22||
sarpir āsāditaṃ gavyaṃ sasuvarṇaṃ sadā pibet ||23||
payaś cānupibet siddhaṃ teṣām eva samudbhave |
yatra nodīrito mantro yogeṣv eteṣu sādhane |
śabditā tatra sarvatra gāyatrī tripadā bhavet ||25||
pāpmānaṃ nāśayanty etā dadyuś cauṣadhayaḥ śriyam |

ab.seg: ariṣṭaṃ maraṇalakṣaṇam| narendraṃ sthāpayedvaśe iti yo hi idaṃ ghṛtaṃ seveta tasya vaśago bhavennarendraḥ| gocandanā priyaṅguḥ| mohanikā putrañjīvī, ‘avākpuṣpī’ iti apare| āsāditaṃ sādhitam| teṣāmeva padmanīlotpalānāmeva ‘padminīphalānāmeva’ iti pā. samudbhave kvāthe| sarveṣāmidānīṃ phalaśrutimāha- pāpmānamityādi||20-26||

lg.l: brahmacaryam ahiṃsā ca sāhasānāṃ ca varjanam ||28||

ab.seg: na kevalaṃ rasāyanayogādeva medhāyuṣī bhavataḥ, kiṃ tarhi satatādhyayanādapi buddhimedhākaro gu(ga)ṇo bhavati| svapakṣasādhanaṃ parapakṣabādhanaṃ vādaḥ| paratantrāṇi nyāyavaiśeṣikahastiśikṣāvyākaraṇādīni, tathaivetarāṇyāyuṣyāṇi| brahmacaryam indriyasaṃyamo vedādhyayanaṃ vā| sāhasam ayathābalamārambhaḥ||27-28||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne medhāyuṣkāmīyaṃ rasāyanaṃ nāmāṣṭāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||28||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne'ṣṭāviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||28||
athātaḥ svabhāvavyādhipratiṣedhanīyaṃ rasāyanaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

svabhāvapravṛttānāṃ kṣutpipāsājarāmṛtyunidrāprabhṛtīnāṃ vyādhīnāṃ pratiṣedhanaṃ svabhāvavyādhipratiṣedhanaṃ, tadadhikṛtya kṛtaṃ rasāyanaṃ svabhāvavyādhipratiṣedhanīyam| yadyapi svabhāvo niṣpratiṣedhanīyastathā'pi rasāyanaprabhāvāttapojñānādiyuktairmaharṣibhiraniyatāyuṣāṃ svabhāvavyādhyādiḥ pratiṣidhyate; niyatāyuṣāḥ ‘na kalikalitāyuṣāṃ kalikaluṣitacetasāṃ, lolupānāṃ teṣāṃ rasāyanāyogyatvāt’ iti pā. punaḥ kalikaluṣairakṣīṇā rasāyanāyogyā eva||1-2||
eka eva khalu bhagavān somaḥ sthānanāmākṛtivīryaviśeṣaiś caturviṃśatidhā bhidyate ||4||

lg.l: tad yathā- aṃśumān muñjavāṃś caiva candramā rajataprabhaḥ |
gāyatras traiṣṭubhaḥ pāṅkto jāgataḥ śākvaras tathā |
agniṣṭomo raivataś ca yathokta iti sañjñitaḥ ||7||
gāyatryā tripadā yukto yaś coḍupatir ucyate |
ete somāḥ samākhyātā vedoktair nāmabhiḥ śubhaiḥ ||8||
sarveṣām eva caiteṣām eko vidhir upāsane |
sarve tulyaguṇāś caiva vidhānaṃ teṣu vakṣyate ||9||

ab.seg: gāyatryā tripadā yukta iti sarveṣāmeva somānāṃ viśeṣaṇam| tatra gāyatryā varṇasvarātmikāyāḥ somasya sākṣādyogo nāstīti gāyatrīpratipāditalokavedatrayayukta ityarthaḥ; tena pītasomaprabhāveṇa lokavedatrayamasya vaśībhavati| etāni ca nāmāni sāmānyalokāprasiddhānyapi pramāṇānīti darśayannāha- ete somā ityādi| tulyaguṇāḥ tulyaphalā ityarthaḥ||3-9||
