div.ab: āvasthikīṃ kriyāṃ nirdiśannāha- viṣopasarga ityādi| upadravān vīkṣya cikitsitaṃ vidadhītetyāha- mahāsugandhimityādi| mahāsugandhistu `candanāgaruṇī kuṣṭhaṃ’ ityādi yāvat `mahāsugandhināmaiṣa pañcāśītyaṅgasambhavaḥ’ iti| vidadhītāñjaneṣu ceti bahuvacanādguḍikācūrṇarasakriyārūpeṣu; cakāreṇa pariṣekakavalādiṣvapi| āśayānurodhena cikitsāṃ nirdiśannāha- virecanānītyādi| prāptaṃ yuktam| idānīṃ prabhāvakṛtaṃ cikitsitaṃ nirdiśannāha- mūṣiketyādi| ajaruhālakṣaṇamuśanasā proktam- “kandaḥ śvetaḥ sapiḍako bhede cāñjanasannibhaḥ| gandhalepanapānaistu viṣaṃ jarayate nṛṇām|| daṣṭānāṃ viṣapītānāṃ ye cānye viṣamohitāḥ| viṣaṃ jarayate teṣāṃ tasmādajaruhā smṛtā|| mūṣikā lomaśā kṛṣṇā bhavet sā'pi ca tadguṇā”- iti||75-78||-

lg.l: pibed ghṛtam ajeyākhyam amṛtākhyaṃ ca buddhimān |
sarpir dadhi payaḥ kṣaudraṃ pibed vā śītalaṃ jalam ||80||
mayūrān nakulān godhāḥ pṛṣatān hariṇān api |
satataṃ bhakṣayec cāpi rasāṃs teṣāṃ pibed api ||81||

ab.seg: śarīre viṣavyāptipratiṣedhamabhidhāyedānīṃ cite viṣavyāptipratiṣedhamāha- hṛdayāvaraṇamityādi| hṛdayāvaraṇaṃ hṛdayapracchādanaṃ hṛdayarakṣākāribhirmūṣikājaruhāmṛtājeyapurāṇaghṛtadūṣīviṣārimahāsugandhiśimbīyūṣatīkṣṇaviṣaghnadhāraṇādibhiḥ| madhukaṃ kuṣṭhamityādikamajeyākhyaṃ, apāmārgasya bījāni pippalīrityādyamṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ, sarpirādīni pratyekaṃ catvāri pañca vā hṛdayāvaraṇāni pibediti||79-81||

lg.l: dadyāt supiṣṭāṃ pālindīṃ madhukaṃ śarkarāṃ tathā ||82||
pārṣate cāpi deyāḥ syuḥ pippalyaḥ samahauṣadhāḥ ||83||
sakṣaudraḥ saghṛtaś caiva śimbīyūṣo hitaḥ sadā |

ab.seg: godhādimāṃsānāṃ saṃskārayaugikaṃ viśeṣaṃ nirdiśannāha- godhetyādi| madhukamakṣamātraṃ dadyāt| pālindī trivṛt| śarkaretyādi| mayūrasya māṃse tasya rase ca supiṣṭe śarkarātiviṣe saśuṇṭhyau deye| pārṣata ityādi| pṛṣatasya māṃse rase ca pippalyaḥ sanāgarāḥ supiṣṭā deyāḥ| sakṣaudra ityādi| anuktāni coddiśannāha- viṣaghnānītyādi| viṣaghnāni viṣaghnairdravyaiḥ saha siddhāni||82-84||

lg.l: chardayed guptahṛdayo bhakṣitaṃ yadi vai viṣam ||85||

ab.seg: āvṛtaguptahṛdayasya pītaviṣasya śeṣaṃ nirdiśannāha- pippalītyādi| śarkarekṣurasāmbūni trīṇi dravāṇi, pippalīmadhukaṃ kalkaṃ, kṣaudramiti prakṣepaḥ| guptahṛdayo viṣaghnaiḥ pracchāditahṛdayaḥ||85||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ kalpasthāne 'nnapānarakṣākalpo nāma prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||1||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne prathamo'dhyāyaḥ||1||

div.head: sthāvaraviṣavijñānīyakalpaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ sthāvaraviṣavijñānīyam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
anne pāne ca prāyeṇa sthāvaraviṣāvacāraṇāttadvijñānīyārambho yujyata ityāha- athāta ityādi||1-2||

lg.l: sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva dvividhaṃ viṣam ucyate |

ab.seg: tatra viṣasya cikitsāviśeṣārthaṃ svarūpabhedenāśrayabhedena ca dvaividhyaṃ pratipādayati- sthāvaramityādi| ādyaṃ prathamam; ‘adanīyam ādyaṃ’ ityanye, tannecchati gayī||3||

lg.l: mūlaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ tvak kṣīraṃ sāra eva ca |
niryāso dhātavaś caiva kandaś ca daśamaḥ smṛtaḥ ||4||

ab.seg: tānyeva sthāvarasya daśādhiṣṭhānāni nirdiśannāha- mūlamityādi||4||

tatra, klītakāśvamāraguñjāsugandhagargarakakaraghāṭavidyucchikhāvijayānīty aṣṭau mūlaviṣāṇi; viṣapatrikālambāvaradārukarambhamahākarambhāṇi pañca patraviṣāṇi; kumudvatīveṇukākarambhamahākarambhakarkoṭakareṇukakhadyotakacarmarībhagandhāsarpaghātinandanasārapākānīti dvādaśa phalaviṣāṇi; vetrakādambavallījakarambhamahākarambhāṇi pañca puṣpaviṣāṇi; antrapācakakartarīyasaurīyakakaraghāṭakarambhanandananārācakāni sapta tvaksāraniryāsaviṣāṇi; kumudaghnīsnuhījālakṣīrīṇi trīṇi kṣīraviṣāṇi; phenāśma(bhasma) haritālaṃ ca dve dhātuviṣe; kālakūṭavatsanābhasarṣapapālakakardamakavairāṭakamustakaśṛṅgīviṣaprapuṇḍarīkamūlakahālāhalamahāviṣakarkaṭakānīti trayodaśa kandaviṣāṇi; ity evaṃ pañcapañcāśat sthāvaraviṣāṇi bhavanti ||5||

gayī tu gargarakasthāne `anantā’ iti paṭhati| viṣapatriketyādi| gayī tu nārācasthāne vallījaṃ paṭhati| kumudvatītyādi| gayī tu pālakasthāne balāhamiti paṭhati| mūlādiviṣāṇāṃ yatnaparairapi jñātumaśakyatvāttāni himavatpradeśe kirātaśabarādibhyo jñeyāni||5||

lg.l: ṣaṭ caiva sarṣapāṇy āhuḥ śeṣāṇy ekaikam eva tu ||6||

ab.seg: teṣāṃ kandaviṣāṇāmavāntarabhedān darśayannāha- catvārītyādi||6||

lg.l: udveṣṭanaṃ mūlaviṣaiḥ pralāpo moha eva ca |
bhavet puṣpaviṣaiś chardir ādhmānaṃ moha eva ca ||8||
hṛtpīḍanaṃ dhātuviṣair mūrcchā dāhaś ca tāluni ||10||

div.ab: tatra navānāṃ mūlādyadhiṣṭhānānāṃ samāsena cikitsārthaṃ sāmānyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ nirdiśannāha- udveṣṭanamityādi| udveṣṭanam aṅgamoṭanam| jṛmbhāṅgodveṣṭanetyādi| udveṣṭanaṃ pūrvaṃ vyākhyātam| muṣkaśopha ityādi| eṣāṃ navānāṃ sāmānyaṃ dharmamuddiśannāha- prāyeṇetyādi| upayogadivasādanyo divasapakṣamāsādiḥ kālaḥ, teṣu ghnantītyevaṃśīlāni kālaghātīni||7-10||-

lg.l: kandajāni tu tīkṣṇāni teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi vistaram ||11||
sparśājñānaṃ kālakūṭe vepathuḥ stambha eva ca |
gātrastambho vepathuś ca jāyate mustakena tu |
karkaṭenotpataty ūrdhvaṃ hasan dantān daśaty api |18|

div.ab: kandajānītyādi| tīkṣṇāni tīkṣṇaviṣāṇi, ataḥ sadyaḥprāṇaharāṇi| vistaramiti pratyekaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kathayāmīti tātparyārthaḥ| sparśājñānamityādi| aṅgasādaḥ aṅgaglāniḥ| puṇḍarīkeṇetyādi| pramūḍhatā prakarṣeṇācaitanyam| cireṇocchvasitītyādi| hāsaṃ kurvan puruṣo dantān khādati||11-17||-

lg.l: sarvāṇi kuśalair jñeyāny etāni daśabhir guṇaiḥ |19|

div.ab: mūlādiviṣebhyaḥ kandajānāṃ dharmāntareṇa viśeṣaṃ nirdiśannāha- kandajānītyādi| ugravīryāṇi utkaṭaśaktīni; gayī tu agravīryāṇīti paṭhati, vyākhyānayati ca- agrāṇi urūṇi `bhūrīṇi’ iti pā. vīryāṇi guṇaviśeṣā yeṣāṃ tāni tathāvidhāni| pratyuktāni pratyekamuktāni||18||-

lg.l: rūkṣam uṣṇaṃ tathā tīkṣṇaṃ sūkṣmam āśu vyavāyi ca ||19||
vikāśi viśadaṃ caiva laghv apāki ca tat smṛtam |
tad raukṣyāt kopayed vāyum auṣṇyāt pittaṃ saśoṇitam ||20||
matiṃ ca mohayet taikṣṇyān marmabandhān chinatti ca |
āśutvād āśu tad dhanti vyavāyāt prakṛtiṃ bhajet |
kṣapayec ca vikāśitvād doṣān dhātūn malān api ||22||

ab.seg: tānyeva daśaguṇāni nirdiśannāha- rūkṣamityādi| tīkṣṇaṃ rājikāmaricādivat| sūkṣmaṃ sūkṣmamārgānupraveśi| āśu śīghraṃ prahaṇanakāri| vyavāyī sakalaṃ dehaṃ vyāpya paścāt pākayāyi| vikāśi prasarpadapasarpaddhātubandhaśaithilyakāri| viśadam apicchilam| laghu laghuguṇayuktam| apākīti āhāravadudarānalena paktumaśakyam| teṣvapi daśasu guṇeṣu madhye kuto guṇāt kiṃ karotītyāha- tadraukṣyādityādi| vikaroti śarīrāvayavān vikārākāraṃ nayatītyarthaḥ| vyavāyāt prakṛtiṃ bhajediti vyavāyāt akhiladehavyāptilakṣaṇāt, prakṛtiṃ svabhāvam akhiladehavyāptirūpaṃ bhajet| vikāśitvāditi hiṃsanaśīlatvāt; kṣapayed vināśayet| kasadhāturgatyartho'pi vipūrvo hiṃsārthaḥ| vaiśadyādatiricyeta na sajjeta kvacidapi saktaṃ na bhavedityarthaḥ| `asaktagati vaiśadyāt’ iti kecit paṭhanti, tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ| duścikitsyaṃ ca lāghavāditi idaṃ hi laghutvādutplutya mano dhāvati asthiraṃ ca bhavati, tasmāt saṃśamanabheṣajāprāptyā duścikitsyaṃ bhavati| saṃśamanenāsādhyatāṃ viṣasya nirdiśya saṃśodhanenāpyāha- durharaṃ ceti|- cakāro bhinnakrame, na paraṃ lāghavāt durharamapākitvācca; tasmādevāpākitvācciraṃ kleśayati paraṃ yadviṣaṃ dvitriguṇamadaśaguṇaṃ vā; pūrvadaśaguṇaṃ sadyo vyāpādakameva||19-23||

lg.l: sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ yac ca kṛtrimaṃ cāpi yad viṣam |
sadyo vyāpādayet tat tu jñeyaṃ daśaguṇānvitam ||24||
yat sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamakṛtrimaṃ vā dehād aśeṣaṃ yad anirgataṃ tat |25|

div.ab: kandajameva daśaguṇānvitaṃ na bhavati kintvanyadapīti darśayannāha- sthāvaramityādi| sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ kṛtrimaṃ vā dehādaśeṣaṃ yadanirhṛtaṃ sadyo vyāpādayet taddaśaguṇānvitaṃ jñeyam| yadyapi kandajāni parityajyānyeṣāṃ guṇasāmastyābhāvena kālaghātitvamuktaṃ, tathā'pyamīṣāṃ madhye yeṣāṃ daśaguṇatvaṃ tānyāśughātīni bhavanti||24||-

lg.l: jīrṇaṃ viṣaghnauṣadhibhir hataṃ vā dāvāgnivātātapaśoṣitaṃ vā ||25||
svabhāvato vā guṇaviprahīnaṃ viṣaṃ hi dūṣīviṣatām upaiti |
vīryālpabhāvān na nipātayet tat kaphāvṛtaṃ varṣagaṇānubandhi ||26||

ab.seg: sthāvaramapi daśaguṇametaiḥ kāraṇairhatavīryaṃ sat sañjñāntaraṃ labhate ityāha- jīrṇamityādi| jīrṇādibhirhetubhirguṇaviprahīnaṃ guṇairdvitryādibhirhīnaṃ daśaguṇamevaṃ vā mandaśaktikaṃ dūṣīviṣatāṃ prāpnoti| tāmeva guṇahīnatāṃ kāryeṇa darśayannāha- vīryālpetyādi| na nipātayet na mārayet sadyaścireṇa vā; mandībhūtoṣṇādiguṇaviśeṣeṇa vilīnaśleṣmaṇā''vṛtatvānna mārayedityarthaḥ| varṣagaṇānubandhi cirakālānubandhītyarthaḥ||25-26||

lg.l: mūrcchan vaman gadgadavāgviṣaṇṇo bhavec ca duṣyodaraliṅgajuṣṭaḥ ||27||
bhaven naro dhvastaśiroruhāṅgo vilūnapakṣas tu yathā vihaṅgaḥ ||28||
sthitaṃ rasādiṣv athavā yathoktān karoti dhātuprabhavān vikārān |

div.ab: tena gareṇa ye doṣā bhavanti tān darśayannāha- tenārdita ityādi| kecit `vaman’ ityatra `bhraman’ iti paṭhanti| gadgadavākyaḥ aspaṣṭavacanaḥ| etat sarvasthānagatasya sāmānyaṃ lakṣaṇam| sthānaviśeṣeṇa viśiṣṭaṃ nirdiśannāha- āmāśayastha ityādi| vyastaśiroruhāṅgo vyastakeśaśarīraḥ| `bhavet samuddhvastaśiroruhāṅga’ iti kecit; tatra samyak uddhvastaśiroruhāṇyaṅgāni yasya sa tathā| yathoktān vyādhisamuddeśīyoktān| dhātuprabhavān vikārān annāśraddhārocakādīn karoti||27-28||-

lg.l: nidrā gurutvaṃ ca vijṛmbhaṇaṃ ca viśleṣaharṣāv athavā'ṅgamardaḥ |30|

div.ab: nidretyādi| viśleṣaḥ sandhīnāṃ prasāraṇādāvapravṛttiḥ| harṣo romaharṣaḥ| aṅgamardo vedanāviśeṣaḥ||29||-

lg.l: vaivarṇyamūrcchāviṣamajvarān vā kuryāt pravṛddhāṃ prabalāṃ tṛṣāṃ vā ||31||
unmādam anyaj janayet tathā'nyad ānāham anyat kṣapayec ca śukram |
gādgadyam anyaj janayec ca kuṣṭhaṃ tāṃs tān vikārāścaṃ bahuprakārān ||32||

ab.seg: tata ityādi| tataḥ pūrvarūpāt parataḥ| annamadāvipākāviti annena bhuktena mado harṣakṣayo'nnamadaḥ, avipākaḥ pākābhāvaḥ| tāṃstān vikārān pūrvoktān āmāśaye kaphavātajān, pakvāśaye pittānilajān, rasādidhātugatāṃśca vikārān janayet||30-32||

lg.l: yasmād dūṣayate dhātūn tasmād dūṣīviṣaṃ smṛtam ||33||

ab.seg: dūṣīviṣaniruktimuddiśannāha- dūṣitamityādi| deśa ānūpaḥ prabhūtānilaśītavarṣaḥ, kālaḥ śītāniladurdinādiḥ, annaṃ surātilakulatthādi, annasyopalakṣaṇatvād vyavāyavyāyāmakrodhādibhirapītyarthaḥ| abhīkṣṇaśaḥ punaḥ punaḥ||33||

lg.l: śyāvā jihvā bhavet stabdhā mūrcchā śvāsaś ca jāyate ||34||
dvitīye vepathuḥ sādo dāhaḥ kaṇṭharujas tathā |
tāluśoṣaṃ tṛtīye tu śūlaṃ cāmāśaye bhṛśam |
durvarṇe harite śūne jāyete cāsya locane ||36||
ṣaṣṭhe prajñāpraṇāśaś ca bhṛśaṃ cāpy atisāryate |

ab.seg: sthāvarasya prathamādivegalakṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha- sthāvarasyopayuktasyetyādi| sannirodhaḥ samyaṅnirodhaḥ, `ucchvāsasya’ iti śeṣaḥ||34-39||

lg.l: dvitīye pūrvavad vāntaṃ pāyayet tu virecanam |
mūrdhni kākapadaṃ kṛtvā sāsṛg vā piśitaṃ kṣipet ||43||

ab.seg: teṣāmeva yathākramaṃ cikitsitamuddiśannāha- prathama ityādi| agadaṃ madhusarpirbhyāmityatrānyatra cāviśeṣeṇāgadaśrutyā dūṣīviṣārireva prayoktavyaḥ| dvitīya ityādi| tacca virecanaṃ ghṛtamadhuśītaviṣaghnauṣadhisampṛktaṃ; gayī tu vāntaṃ naraṃ virecanaṃ pāyayet pūrvavat, tena madhuyuktameveti vyākhyānayati| tṛtīya ityādi| agado'tra dūṣīviṣārirmadhusarpiryukto dātavyaḥ| nasyaṃ viṣaghnaṃ sañjñāprabodhanaṃ ca| añjanamapi viṣaghnaṃ cakṣuṣyaṃ sañjñāprabodhanaṃ tathā atīkṣṇaṃ `abhīkṣṇaṃ’ iti pā. ca| caturtha ityādi| agado'trāpi dūṣīviṣāriḥ| sneho'tra gavyaṃ ghṛtaṃ, viṣaghnatvāttasya; snehagrahaṇena pūrvaprastutaṃ madhu nivartate| pañcama ityādi| agadamiha dūṣīviṣārināmādhyāharaṇīyam| ṣaṣṭha ityādi| saptame vege'sādhyarūpe'pi pratyākhyāya pratikriyāṃ kuryāt| cakāro'yaṃ bhinnakrame, tena saptame ceti yojanāt ṣaṣṭhe'pyavapīḍaḥ| vāśabdaścānuktasamuccaye, tenānuktaṃ saśoṇitacarmadānaṃ śākhālalāṭasirātāḍanādijaṅgamaviṣoktaṃ ca samuccīyate||40-43||

lg.l: vegāntare tv anyatame kṛte karmaṇi śītalām |
punarnave hareṇuś ca trikaṭuḥ sārive balā |
eṣāṃ yavāgūr niṣkvāthe kṛtā hanti viṣadvayam ||46||

ab.seg: idānīṃ vegāntareṣu kālaghātinaḥ pratīkāravidhimāha- vegāntara ityādi| prakṛtādvegādanyo vego vegāntaram| anyatame ekatame| kṛte karmaṇi prathamādivegeṣūkte ityarthaḥ| kośātakya ityādi| kośātakī ghoṣakaḥ; agnikaḥ ajamodaḥ, `moraṭa’ ityanye; sūryavallī paṭolasadṛśapatrā, yasyāḥ patrarasenāktaṃ māṃsaṃ svinnamiva bhavati, anye sūryāvartamāhuḥ; kiṇihī kaṭabhī, śeluḥ śleṣmātakaḥ, giryāhvā śvetasyandaḥ, punarnave sitapītapuṣpe, kośātakyādīnāṃ kvāthena ṣaḍaṅgakalpanākalpitena yavāgūḥ kalpanīyā| `sārive balā’ ityatra `sārivotpale’ ityanye paṭhanti||44-46||

lg.l: viḍaṅgaṃ candanaṃ patraṃ priyaṅgur dhyāmakaṃ tathā |
haridre dve bṛhatyau ca sārive ca sthirā sahā ||48||
kalkair eṣāṃ ghṛtaṃ siddham ajeyam iti viśrutam |
viṣāṇi hanti sarvāṇi śīghram evājitaṃ kvacit ||49||

ab.seg: madhukamityādi| punnāgaḥ tuṅgaḥ pūrvadeśe prasiddhaḥ; elavālukaṃ svanāmaprasiddhaṃ; nāgapuṣpaṃ nāgakeśaraṃ; dhyāmakaṃ kattṛṇaṃ; sthirā śālaparṇī| madhukādīnāṃ kalkaṃ pādikaṃ, caturguṇaṃ jalaṃ dattvā ghṛtaṃ sādhayet, tasyājeyamiti sañjñā| sarvāṇi sthāvarajaṅgamakṛtrimāṇi| ajitaṃ kvacinna jitamajitaṃ; kvacit kasminnapi sthāvarādāvityarthaḥ||47-49||

lg.l: dūṣīviṣārtaṃ susvinnam ūrdhvaṃ cādhaś ca śodhitam |
nāmnā dūṣīviṣāris tu na cānyatrāpi vāryate ||52||

ab.seg: dhātudūṣakasya dūṣīviṣasya cikitsāṃ vaktumāha- dūṣīviṣārtamityādi| dūṣīviṣasya viṣatve'pi svedo na niṣidhyate; yena mandavīryatayā kaphāvaraṇādviṣavegenānubandhitvamasya `kaphāvaraṇādvarṣagaṇānubandhitvamasya’ iti pā., ataḥ svedena kaphasyāvarakasyopaśāntāvapahāryaṃ `pittadūṣitadhātūnāṃ vā prasādanārthaṃ’ iti pā. viṣaṃ koṣṭhagataṃ śodhanena sakalameva hriyate| anye `dūṣīviṣārtaṃ susnigdhaṃ’ iti paṭhanti; teṣāmapi snigdhaśrutyā svedo'pyākṣiptaḥ| kathañcidevānirhṛtasya viṣāvaśeṣasya saṃśamanārthamanyatrāpi sthāvarajaṅgamaviṣadūṣitadhātūnāṃ vā prasādanārthaṃ saṃśamanamuddiśannāha- pāyayetetyādi| dhyāmakaṃ kattṛṇaṃ; śāvaro rodhraḥ; paripelavaṃ vanyakaḥ, kaivartamustakamanye; toyaṃ bālakaṃ; suvarṇagairikaṃ dakṣiṇāpathe prasiddham| anyatrāpi sthāvarajaṅgamayostīkṣṇayorapītyarthaḥ; anyeṣu vakṣyamāṇeṣu jvarādiṣvapītyanye||50-52||

lg.l: jvare dāhe ca hikkāyām ānāhe śukrasaṅkṣaye |
unmāde vepathau caiva ye cānye syur upadravāḥ |
yathāsvaṃ teṣu kurvīta viṣaghnair auṣadhaiḥ kriyām ||54||

ab.seg: dūṣīviṣeṇa ye upadravāḥ syustaccikitsitamāha- jvara ityādi| ye cānye upadravāstajjāḥ| yathāsvaṃ yadyasya vihitaṃ tadityarthaḥ| tacca viṣaghnairoṣadhairyuktaṃ kartavyam||53-54||
idānīṃ sādhyayāpyapratyākhyeyatvaṃ darśayannāha- sādhyamityādi||55||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ kalpasthāne sthāvaraviṣavijñānīyo nāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ ||2||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ kalpasthāne dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ||2||

div.head: jaṅgamaviṣavijñānīyakalpaḥ

ab.seg: athāto jaṅgamaviṣavijñānīyaṃ `jaṅgamaviṣavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ’ iti pā. kalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi||1-2||

lg.l: samāsena mayā yāni vistaras teṣu vakṣyate ||3||

ab.seg: tatra, dṛṣṭiniḥśvāsadaṃṣṭrānakhamūtrapurīṣaśukralālārtavamukhasandaṃśa- viśardhitatuṇḍāsthipittaśūkaśavānīti `...gudāsthi...’ iti pā.||4||

tānyevādhiṣṭhānāni nirdiśannāha- tatra dṛṣṭiniḥśvāsetyādi| niḥśvāsaḥ phūtkāraḥ, viśardhitaṃ pāyukṛtaḥ kutsitaśabdaḥ, śūkaṃ kīṭaloma, kīṭānāṃ sarpāṇāṃ ca vigataprāṇānāṃ dehaḥ śavaḥ| vṛddhavāgbhaṭastu `jaṅgamasya tvāśrayāḥ ṣoḍaśadṛṣṭiniḥśvāsasparśadaṃṣṭrāmukhanakhāsthimūtrapurīṣaśukrārtavalālāśūkapittaśoṇitaśavāni’ iti| (vṛ. vā. u. a. 40) tuṇḍaviśardhitasthāne ala(āra)śoṇite paṭhati||3-4||

tatra, dṛṣṭiniḥśvāsaviṣā divyāḥ sarpāḥ, bhaumās tu daṃṣṭrāviṣāḥ, mārjāraśvavānaramakaramaṇḍūkapākamatsyagodhāśambūkapracalākagṛhagodhikācatuṣpādakīṭās tathā 'nye daṃṣṭrānakhaviṣāḥ, cipiṭapicciṭakakaṣāyavāsikasarṣapakatoṭakavarcaḥkīṭakauṇḍinyakāḥ śakṛnmūtraviṣāḥ, mūṣikāḥ śukraviṣāḥ, lūtā lālāmūtrapurīṣamukhasandaṃśanakhaśukrārtavaviṣāḥ `lālānakhaśukramūtrapurīṣārtavamukhasandaṃśaviṣāḥ’ iti pā., vṛścikaviśvambharavaraṭīrājīvamatsyocciṭiṅgāḥ samudravṛścikāś cāla(ra)viṣāḥ, citraśiraḥsarāvakurdiśatadārukārimedakasārikāmukhā mukhasandaṃśaviśardhitamūtrapurīṣaviṣāḥ, makṣikākaṇabhajalāyukā mukhasandaṃśaviṣāḥ, viṣahatāsthi sarpakaṇṭakavaraṭīmatsyāsthi cety asthiviṣāṇi, śakulīmatsyaraktarājivarakī(ṭī)matsyāś ca pittaviṣāḥ, sūkṣmatuṇḍocciṭiṅgavaraṭīśatapadīśūkavalabhikāśṛṅgibhramarāḥ śūkatuṇḍaviṣāḥ, kīṭasarpadehā gatāsavaḥ śavaviṣāḥ; śeṣās tv anuktā mukhasandaṃśaviṣeṣv eva gaṇayitavyāḥ ||5||

tatretyādi| divi bhavā divyāḥ, bhūmau bhavā bhaumāḥ; etacca prāyikaṃ, sarve'pi sarpā daṃśāyatanaviṣāḥ; tathā hi sāvitre,- “sarva eva sarpā daṃśaviṣā bhavanti, maladaśanadaṃṣṭrācakṣurlālāniḥśvāsendriyamūtrapurīṣapucchaiḥ `manodaśana...’ iti `malo daśana...’ iti ca pā. ”(?) iti| mārjāretyādi| atra mārjāroktyaiva vyālā vyāghrādayo'bhipretāḥ| makaro jalajanturityeke, anye āgneyakīṭapaṭhitaṃ makarākāratvena makaraṃ, karkaṭavṛścikaṃ makaramanye| pākamatsyo'pi āgneyeṣveva paṭhitaḥ kīṭaviśeṣaḥ| godhā pañcanakhī pavitrā saumyakīṭapaṭhitā; kṛṣṇaśabdasya lopāt kṛṣṇagodhāṃ viduranye| pracalākaṃ saumyakīṭapaṭhitaṃ kīṭaviśeṣamāhuḥ| gṛhagodhikā koṣṭhāgārī koṣṭhagṛhakārikā| catuṣpadakīṭāḥ pratisūryakādayaḥ| tathā'nye maśakamakṣikādayaśca kīṭāḥ| cipiṭapicciṭaketyādi ete kīṭaviśeṣā deśāntare lokato jñeyāḥ| vṛściketyādi| āraśabdenātra `alaśabdenātra’ iti pā. vṛścikalāṅgūlādisthitaḥ kaṇṭako bhaṇyate, tasya ca sthūlaśūkarūpatvācchūkagrahaṇenaiva grahaṇaṃ, ata eva dṛṣṭiniḥśvāsetyādisūtre pṛthaṅnodāhṛtamāragrahaṇam ‘... mālagrahaṇam’ iti pā.| gayadāsaścātra `ālālaviṣā’ iti paṭhati, vyākhyānayati ca- ālālaṃ lālā| citraśira ityādi| varakīmatsyayoḥ sthāne kecidekameva varaṭī(kī)matsyaṃ paṭhanti| gatāsavo gataprāṇāḥ||5||

bhavanti cātra-
rājño 'rideśe ripavas tṛṇāmbu mārgānnadhūmaśvasanān viṣeṇa |
sandūṣayanty ebhir atipraduṣṭān vijñāya liṅgair abhiśodhayet tān ||6||
rājña ityādi| arideśe praviṣṭasya rājño'pi ripavaḥ śatravaḥ tṛṇādīn sandūṣayanti| annam annarakṣāyāmuktamapi deśādiprasaṅgeṇātra punaruktam| śvasano vāyuḥ| ebhirliṅgaiḥ vakṣyamāṇairityarthaḥ||6||

lg.l: duṣṭaṃ jalaṃ picchilam ugragandhi phenānvitaṃ rājibhir āvṛtaṃ ca |
maṇḍūkamatsyaṃ mriyate vihaṅgā mattāś ca sānūpacarā bhramanti ||7||
majjanti ye cātra narāśvanāgās te chardimohajvaradāhaśophān |
ṛ(ga)cchanti teṣām apahṛtya doṣān `rogān’ iti pā. duṣṭaṃ jalaṃ śodhayituṃ yateta ||8||

ab.seg: duṣṭamityādi| rājibhiḥ kṛṣṇābhiḥ| vihaṅgā ityādi sānūpacarā anūpacarasahitā vihaṅgāḥ pakṣiṇo viṣavegena mattāḥ santo bhramanti| ṛcchanti prāpnuvanti| yateta yatnaṃ kurvīta||7-8||

lg.l: dagdhvā sarājadrumasomavalkāṃs tad bhasma śītaṃ vitaret saraḥsu ||9||
bhasmāñjaliṃ cāpi ghaṭe nidhāya viśodhayed īpsitam evam ambhaḥ |10|

div.ab: tadeva duṣṭavāripraśodhanauṣadhaṃ darśayannāha- dhavāśvetyādi| aśvakarṇaḥ pūrvadeśe prasiddho gandhamuṇḍaḥ aśvatthasadṛśaḥ, asano bījakaḥ, pāribhadraḥ phalabhadro raktakusumaḥ kaṇṭakī rohiṇīsadṛśapatraḥ pūrvadeśe prasiddhaḥ, rājadrumaḥ kiramālakaḥ, somavalkaḥ kaṭvalaḥ| vitaret niḥkṣipet| saraḥsviti bahuvacanamavahajjalopalakṣaṇaṃ; vahajjalānāṃ dūṣaṇameva duṣkaraṇam| sāmānyajanārthaṃ sarasāṃ saṃśodhanamabhidhāya viśiṣṭajanārthamuddhṛtajalasya śodhanaṃ darśayannāha- bhasmāñjalimityādi| añjaliṃ catuḥpalaṃ, taṃ ca ghaṭe droṇapramite jale, nidhāya niḥkṣipya, īpsitaṃ vāñchitaṃ śodhayet| jejjaṭācāryastu ghaṭaṃ gargarīmāha||9||-

lg.l: kṣitipradeśaṃ viṣadūṣitaṃ tu śilātalaṃ `śilāsthalī’ iti pā. tīrtham atheriṇaṃ vā ||10||
spṛśanti gātreṇa tu yena yena govājināgoṣṭrakharā narā vā |
tac chūnatāṃ yāty atha dahyate ca viśīryate romanakhaṃ tathaiva ||11||
tatrāpy anantāṃ saha sarvagandhaiḥ piṣṭvā surābhir viniyojya mārgam |
siñcet payobhiḥ sumṛdanvitais taṃ viḍaṅgapāṭhākaṭabhījalair vā ||12||

ab.seg: kṣitipradeśamityādi| tīrthaṃ nadyādighaṭṭam| īriṇam ūṣaram| anantāṃ sarvagandhaiḥ saha saṃyojya surābhiḥ piṣṭvā mārgaṃ siñcediti sambandhaḥ| surābhiriti bahuvacanānmadhuguḍapiṣṭakṛtābhiḥ| anantā utpalasārivā| sarvagandhaiḥ elādiparipaṭhitaiḥ| payobhiḥ kṣīraiḥ| mṛdanvitaistaṃ mārgaṃ siñcet, viḍaṅgādijalairvā mārgaṃ siñcet| mṛdiha kṛṣṇā prādhānyakalpanayā| anye tvevaṃ paṭhanti- “tatrāpyanantāṃ saha sarvagandhairvacāṃ tu piṣṭvā surayā'numārgam| siñcettathā mṛtsahitābhiradbhirmārgo'sti nānyo yadi tena gacchet” iti| `payobhistu mṛdanvitaiḥ’ ityatra `valmīkamṛdanvitābhiḥ’ iti kecit paṭhanti, viṣaghnatvādvalmīkasya||10-12||

lg.l: tṛṇeṣu bhakteṣu ca dūṣiteṣu sīdanti mūrcchanti vamanti cānye |
viḍbhedam ṛcchanty athavā mriyante teṣāṃ cikitsāṃ praṇayed yathoktām ||13||
viṣāpahair vā 'py agadair vilipya vādyāni citrāṇy api vādayeta |
tāraḥ sutāraḥ sasurendragopaḥ sarvaiś ca tulyaḥ kuruvindabhāgaḥ ||14||
pittena yuktaḥ kapilānvayena vādyapralepo vihitaḥ praśastaḥ |
vādyasya śabdena hi yānti nāśaṃ viṣāṇi ghorāṇy api yāni santi `tatra’ iti pā.||15||

ab.seg: tṛṇeṣvityādi| sīdanti aṅgaglāniyuktā bhavanti| praṇayedityādi| aṅgasādādiṣu yathoktāṃ cikitsāṃ viṣāpahairdravyairyuktāṃ vitaret| agadairvā dundubhisvanīyoktaiḥ, vādyāni bherīpaṭahādīni vilipya vādayet| aparamapi vādyalepamāha- tāra ityādi| tāro rūpyaṃ, sutāraḥ pāradaḥ; surendraṃ suvarṇaṃ, kuṭajamanye; gopā sārivā; kuruvindo mustā, niśānapāṣāṇa ityanye, uttamalohitaratnaṃ kuruvinda ityeke||13-15||

lg.l: dhūme 'nile vā viṣasamprayukte khagāḥ śramārtāḥ prapatanti bhūmau |
kāsapratiśyāyaśirorujaś ca bhavanti tīvrā nayanāmayāś ca ||16||
priyaṅgukāṃ cāpy anale nidhāya dhūmānilau cāpi viśodhayeta ||17||

ab.seg: lākṣetyādi| lākṣādidravyaṃ vahnau nidhāya dhūmaṃ viśodhayeta, cūrṇamanile vikīrya punaranilamiti| priyaṅgukāmityatra `madhūlikāṃ’ kecit paṭhanti, guḍūcikāmiti ca vivṛṇvanti||16-17||

lg.l: prajām imām ātmayoner brahmaṇaḥ sṛjataḥ kila |
akarod asuro vighnaṃ kaiṭabho nāma darpitaḥ ||18||
tasya kruddhasya vai vaktrād brahmaṇas tejaso nidheḥ |
sa taṃ dadāha garjantam antakābhaṃ mahābalam |
tato viṣādo devānām abhavat taṃ nirīkṣya vai |
tataḥ sṛṣṭvā prajāḥ śeṣaṃ tadā taṃ krodham īśvaraḥ |
vinyastavān sa bhūteṣu sthāvareṣu careṣu ca ||22||

ab.seg: cikitsopayogi etatpūrva `samādhimantrabhedena’ ityadhikaṃ paṭhyate hastalikhitapustake viṣasya mūrtisvarūpamāha- prajāmityādi| ātmayoneḥ ātmā paramapuruṣo yoniḥ kāraṇaṃ yasya sa tathā tasya; eteneśvarādikāraṇaṃ nirasya svayambhūtvamuktam| kiletyāgamasaṃvāde| tata ityādi| vigrahavān śarīravān| niḥpapāta niḥsṛtaḥ| sa tamityādi|- sa krodhaḥ puruṣarūpaḥ, taṃ kaiṭabhaṃ, dadāha bhasmīkṛtavān| kiṃviśiṣṭaṃ kaiṭabhaṃ? garjantamityādiviśeṣaṇayuktam| tattejaḥ tasya mūrtimataḥ krodhasya teja ityarthaḥ| tata ityādi| vākkāyacittāvasādo viṣādaḥ| tata ityādi| vinyastavān viniḥkṣiptavān||18-22||

lg.l: teṣu teṣu pradeśeṣu rasaṃ taṃ taṃ niyacchati ||23||
evam eva viṣaṃ yad yad dravyaṃ vyāpyāvatiṣṭhate |
svabhāvād eva taṃ tasya rasaṃ samanuvartate ||24||

ab.seg: viṣasya nānāvīryahetubhūtamuddiśannāha- yathā'vyaktarasamityādi| yathā jalamekarasamapyantarīkṣāt patitaṃ bhūmigataṃ teṣu teṣu pradeśeṣvākāśaguṇabhūyiṣṭhādiṣu rasaṃ taṃ taṃ niyacchati niścayena dadāti, evameva viṣaṃ yadyaddravyaṃ vyāpyāvatiṣṭhate svabhāvādeva tasya tasya rasaṃ samanuvartate||23-24||

lg.l: viṣe yasmād guṇāḥ sarve tīkṣṇāḥ prāyeṇa santi hi |
te tu vṛttiṃ prakupitā jahati svāṃ viṣārditāḥ |
nopayāti viṣaṃ pākam ataḥ prāṇān ruṇaddhi ca ||26||
visañjñaḥ sati jīve 'pi tasmāt tiṣṭhati mānavaḥ ||27||

ab.seg: viṣe yasmādityādi| yasmādviṣe ye guṇāḥ santi te sarve svabhāvataḥ sarvadehadhātuvirodhena tīkṣṇā āśukāriṇaḥ, prāyeṇa tejorūpakrodhātmakatvādviṣasya; ataḥ sarvameva viṣaṃ sarvadoṣaprakopaṇam| te tu vṛttimityādi| te prakupitā vātādayo viṣārditā viṣapīḍitāḥ santaḥ, svāṃ vṛttiṃ vātaḥ praspandanādikāṃ, rāgapaktyādikāṃ pittaṃ, sandhisaṃśleṣādikāṃ kaphaḥ, tyajanti; tena ca pittasya paktyabhāvādviṣaṃ pākaṃ na yāti, ato'pakvaṃ viṣaṃ prāṇān ruṇaddhi, viṣavilīnena śleṣmaṇā niruddhocchvāsatvājjīve'pi prāṇe'pi sati visañjño vigatasamyagjñāno mānavastiṣṭhati||25-27||

lg.l: kruddhānām eti cāṅgebhyaḥ śukraṃ nirmanthanād iva ||28||
teṣāṃ baḍiśavad daṃṣṭrās tāsu sajjati cāgatam |
anudvṛttā viṣaṃ tasmān na muñcanti ca bhoginaḥ ||29||

ab.seg: śukravadityādi| sarvasarpāṇāṃ viṣaṃ sarvaśarīragam| kruddhānāmityādi kruddhānāṃ sarpāṇāmaṅgebhyo'vayavebhyo viṣamāgacchati; kimiva? śukraṃ nirmanthanādiva, nirmanthanaṃ viśiṣṭastrīvarāṅgaviloḍanahetureva harṣa ucyate| teṣāmityādi| baḍiśaṃ matsyabandhanayantram| sajjati saṅgaṃ yāti, sambaddhaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| anudvṛttā ananuyojitā, anucchalitā `ananumoditā’ iti pā. iti yāvat; karṣaṇakṛtaparāvṛttyā hi daṃṣṭrāṇāmadhomukhateti| bhoginaḥ sarpāḥ||28-29||

lg.l: yasmād atyartham uṣṇaṃ ca tīkṣṇaṃ ca paṭhitaṃ viṣam |
ataḥ kīṭaviṣe cāpi svedo na pratiṣidhyate ||31||

div.ab: yasmādityādi| kīṭeṣu viṣaṃ mandaṃ nātyuṣṇaṃ bahuvātakaphaṃ bhavati; apiśabdāt kīṭeṣvapi keṣucidugraviṣeṣu na svedaḥ, api tu śītalameva cikitsitam| tathā ca vakṣyati,- `kīṭairdaṣṭānugraviṣaiḥ sarpavatsamupācaret’- iti||30-31||-

lg.l: svabhāvād eva tiṣṭhet tu prahārādaṃśayor viṣam ||32||
laulyād viṣānvitaṃ māṃsaṃ yaḥ khāden mṛtamātrayoḥ ||33||
yathāviṣaṃ sa rogeṇa kliśyate mriyate 'pi vā |
ataś cāpy anayor māṃsam abhakṣyaṃ mṛtamātrayoḥ ||34||

div.ab: idānīṃ digdhaviddhāhidaṣṭayoḥ prahāradaṃśadeśamāṃsamabhakṣyaṃ muhūrtācca tadupādeyamuddiśannāha- svabhāvādityādi| digdhaviddhāhidaṣṭayoḥ `prāṇinoḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| atra digdhaviddho viṣaliptakāṇḍādihataḥ, ahidaṣṭaḥ sarpadaṣṭaḥ| yathāviṣaṃ viṣānusāreṇetyarthaḥ||32-34||-

lg.l: udvamaty atha phenaṃ ca viṣapītaṃ tam ādiśet ||36||
na cāsya hṛdayaṃ vahnir viṣajuṣṭaṃ dahaty api |
tad dhi sthānaṃ cetanāyāḥ svabhāvād vyāpya tiṣṭhati ||37||

ab.seg: idānīṃ viṣapītasya prāṇaiḥ parityajyamānasya mṛtasya ca lakṣaṇamāha- savātamityādi| asraṃ nayanajalam| vivarṇaḥ atyarthaṃ kṛṣṇaśyāmapītavarṇaḥ| sādaḥ aṅgaglāniḥ| vivarṇa iti mṛtasya lakṣaṇaṃ, śeṣaṃ sarvaṃ mriyamāṇasya lakṣaṇam| asya viṣapānamṛtasya viṣajuṣṭaṃ hṛdayaṃ vahnirapi na dahati; kuto hṛdayameva viṣajuṣṭaṃ? hi yasmāttadviṣaṃ cetanāsthānaṃ hṛdayaṃ svabhāvādvyāpya tiṣṭhati; ata eva ca viṣapānamṛtasya hṛdayamadāhyaṃ viṣavyāptatvāt||35-37||

lg.l: yāmye sapitrye parivarjanīyā ṛkṣe narā marmasu ye ca daṣṭāḥ ||38||

ab.seg: idānīṃ varjyaprahārādaṃśahṛdayaprasaṅgena viśiṣṭadeśādidvāreṇa varjanīyān daṣṭānāha- aśvatthetyādi| yāmye bharaṇyāṃ, pitrye maghāyāṃ, ṛkṣe nakṣatre||38||

lg.l: darvīkarāṇāṃ viṣam āśughāti sarvāṇi coṣṇe dviguṇībhavanti |

div.ab: darvīkarāṇāmityādi| darvīkarāṇāṃ phaṇināṃ, sarvāṇi aśeṣaviṣāṇi, uṣṇe uṣṇakāle, dviguṇībhavanti dviguṇaśaktīni bhavanti; `sarvāṇi cordhvaṃ dviguṇībhavanti’ iti kecit paṭhanti, ūrdhvam ūrdhvadeśe ityarthaḥ| ajīrṇapittādiṣvapi dviguṇatvamāha- ajīrṇetyādi||39||-

lg.l: śastrakṣate yasya na raktam eti rājyo latābhiś ca na sambhavanti ||40||
śītābhir adbhiś ca na romaharṣo viṣābhibhūtaṃ parivarjayet tam |
jihvā sitā yasya ca keśaśāto nāsāvabhaṅgaś ca sakaṇṭhabhaṅgaḥ ||41||
kṛṣṇaḥ saraktaḥ śvayathuś ca daṃśe hanvoḥ sthiratvaṃ ca sa varjanīyaḥ |
vartir ghanā yasya nireti vaktrād raktaṃ sraved ūrdhvam adhaś ca yasya ||42||
daṃṣṭrānipātāḥ sakalāś ca yasya taṃ cāpi vaidyaḥ parivarjayet tu |
unmattam atyartham upadrutaṃ vā hīnasvaraṃ vā 'py athavā vivarṇam ||43||
sāriṣṭam atyartham aveginaṃ ca jahyān naraṃ tatra na karma kuryāt ||44||

ab.seg: śastretyādi| latābhirabhihate'ṅge rājyo rekhā nocchalanti| jihvetyādi| sitā śvetā, asitā kṛṣṇā vā bhavatītyarthaḥ| keśaśātaḥ keśacyavanam| nāsāvabhaṅgo nāsāsrotovaiguṇyaṃ, taccānunāsikavākyatvena jñeyam| kaṇṭhabhaṅgaḥ svarasādaḥ| daṃśo bhakṣitasthānam| hanvoḥ mukhasandhyoḥ| sthiratvam acalanam| vartirityādi vartiḥ kaphavartiḥ| unmattetyādi| unmattaṃ vātulam| atyarthamupadrutam upadravabahulam| sāriṣṭaṃ maraṇalakṣaṇasahitam| aveginaṃ laharīvarjitam| jahyāt tyajet||40-44||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ kalpasthāne jaṅgamaviṣavijñānīyo nāma tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ ||3||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ kalpasthāne tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ||3||

div.head: sarpadaṣṭaviṣavijñānīyakalpaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ sarpadaṣṭaviṣavijñānīyaṃ kalpaṃ `adhyāyaṃ’ iti pā. vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
jaṅgamaviṣāśrayeṣu mahāviṣatvena sarpasyaivātra prādhānyāttaddaṣṭavijñānaṃ pratipādayitukāmaḥ prāha- athāta ityādi||1-2||
pādayorupasaṅgṛhya pādapatanaṃ kṛtvetyarthaḥ||3||

lg.l: sarpasaṅkhyāṃ vibhāgaṃ ca daṣṭalakṣaṇam eva ca |
jñānaṃ ca viṣavegānāṃ bhagavan ! vaktum arhasi ||4||

ab.seg: kiṃ paripṛcchatītyāha- sarpasaṅkhyāmityādi| saṅkhyā gaṇanā, vibhāgo viśeṣabhāgaḥ pṛthakkaraṇam| arhasi yogyo bhavasi||4||

lg.l: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā prābravīd bhiṣajāṃ varaḥ |
asaṅkhyā vāsukiśreṣṭhā `vāsukimukhā’ iti pā. vikhyātās takṣakādayaḥ ||5||
ye cāpy ajasraṃ garjanti varṣanti ca tapanti ca ||6||
kruddhā niḥśvāsadṛṣṭibhyāṃ ye hanyur akhilaṃ jagat ||7||
namas tebhyo 'sti no teṣāṃ kāryaṃ kiñcic cikitsayā |
ye tu daṃṣṭrāviṣā bhaumā ye daśanti ca mānuṣān ||8||

div.ab: tasya tadvacanamityādi| vāsukiśreṣṭhā vāsukiḥ śreṣṭho yeṣāṃ te tathā| asti no teṣāṃ kāryaṃ kiñciccikitsayeti teṣāṃ takṣakādīnāṃ cikitsayā kiñcit kāryaṃ nāsti| ye tu daṃṣṭretyādi| anupūrvaśaḥ anukrameṇa||5-8||-

lg.l: aśītis tv eva sarpāṇāṃ bhidyate pañcadhā tu sā ||9||
nirviṣā vaikarañjāś ca trividhās te punaḥ smṛtāḥ ||10||
teṣu darvīkarā jñeyā viṃśatiḥ ṣaṭ ca pannagāḥ `rājimantastathaiva ca’ iti pā.||11||
nirviṣā dvādaśa jñeyā vaikarañjās trayas tathā ||12||
vaikarañjodbhavāḥ sapta citrā `citramaṇḍalirājilāḥ’ iti pā. maṇḍalirājilāḥ |13|

div.ab: aśītirityādi| sā aśītiḥ| darvīkarāḥ phaṇāvantaḥ, maṇḍalinaḥ phaṇāvarjitā vividhamaṇḍalaiścitritāḥ, rājimanto rekhāyuktāḥ phaṇāvarjitā īṣadviṣā gamālādayaḥ, nirviṣā viṣarahitāḥ dundubhigaurāhikādayaḥ; kecit `nir’ śabdamīṣadarthe vyākhyānayanti, tena nirviṣā īṣadviṣāḥ; yathā- anudarā kanyeti| vaikarañjāḥ saṅkīrṇajātāḥ, pṛthagjātīyasarpiṇīpṛthagjātīyasarpābhyāṃ jātā vaikarañjāḥ `vyatikarajāḥ’ iti pā.| eṣveva nirviṣavaikarañjayorantarbhāvāt kathamaśītiḥ pūryata ityāha- teṣvityādi| citrā maṇḍalirājilā vaikarañjodbhavāḥ sapta bhavanti; tatra maṇḍalinaścatvāraḥ, rājilāstrayaḥ| atrāyameva pāṭho nyāyyaḥ, jejjaṭagayadāsaprabhṛtibhiraṅgīkṛtatvāt||9-12||-

lg.l: pādābhimṛṣṭā duṣṭā vā kruddhā grāsārthino 'pi vā ||13||
te daśanti mahākrodhās trividhaṃ `taddhi trividhamucyate’ iti pā. bhīmadarśanāḥ |14|

div.ab: saṅkṣepeṇa vibhāgaṃ pratipādya daṣṭasya daṃśanapūrvakatvāddaṃśanalakṣaṇaṃ pratipādayitukāmo daṃśasya kāraṇāni nirdiśannāha- pādābhimṛṣṭā ityādi| abhimṛṣṭā marditāḥ, duṣṭāḥ svabhāvaduṣṭāḥ, kruddhāḥ kupitāḥ, apiśabdo'trānuktasamuccaye, tenātyāsannabhītaśaṅkitakrāntādayo grāhyāḥ| te daśanti mahākrodhāstrividhaṃ bhīmadarśanā iti sarpā mahākrodhāḥ pracaṇḍakopāḥ, ata eva bhīmadarśanāḥ; trividhaṃ yathā bhavatyevaṃ daśanti bhakṣayanti||13||-

lg.l: sarpitaṃ raditaṃ cāpi tṛtīyam atha nirviṣam |
padāni yatra dantānām ekaṃ dve vā bahūni vā |
nimagnāny alparaktāni yāny udvṛtya karoti hi ||15||
saṅkṣiptāni saśophāni vidyāt tat sarpitaṃ bhiṣak ||16||
rājyaḥ salohitā yatra nīlāḥ pītāḥ sitās tathā |
vijñeyaṃ raditaṃ tat tu `tvakṣu’ iti pā. jñeyam alpaviṣaṃ ca tat ||17||
padaṃ padāni vā vidyād aviṣaṃ tac cikitsakaḥ ||18||
kasyacit kurute śophaṃ sarpāṅgābhihataṃ tu tat ||19||

ab.seg: etadeva daṃśatraividhyamuddiṣṭaṃ nirdiśannāha- sarpitamityādi| teṣāṃ lakṣaṇamāha- padānītyādi| padāni kṣatāni| ekamityādi| padeṣu yathottaraṃ viṣabāhulyam| nimagnāni anudgatāni| yānyudvṛtya karoti hi yāni padānyudvṛtya unmoṭhya sarpaḥ karoti| cañcumālakayuktānīti upari piḍakāsadṛśairācitānītyarthaḥ; gayī tu cañcumālikāḥ sarpadaṣṭasthānasya pārśve vaṭaprarohāgratulyā viṣotpannā aṅkurā bhavantīti vyākhyānayati| vaikṛtyakaraṇāni vikārabhāvavidhāyakāni| saṅkṣiptānītyādi| saṅkṣiptāni sūkṣmāṇi| sarpitam atyavagāḍham| rājya ityādi| rājyo rekhāḥ, raditaṃ vilikhitamanavagāḍham, ata evālpaviṣam| aśophamityādi| prakṛtisthasyeti kāyavākcitteṣu svena bhāvenāvasthitasya| padaṃ padāni veti ekaṃ padaṃ bahūni vā padānītyarthaḥ| sarpaspṛṣṭasyetyādi| tuśabdaścārthe, tena kaṇṭakādividdhe'pi śaṅkāviṣaṃ bhavati||14-19||

lg.l: viṣaghnauṣadhiyukte ca deśe na kramate viṣam ||21||

ab.seg: sarpāvasthāviśeṣato'lpaviṣatvamuddiśannāha- vyādhitetyādi| daṣṭāni bhakṣyasthānāni| viśiṣṭadevasevite viśiṣṭauṣadhisevite ca deśe'viṣatvamuddiśannāha- suparṇetyādi| suparṇo garuḍaḥ| bhūtāḥ svanāmaprasiddhāḥ||20-21||

lg.l: jñeyā maṇḍalinaḥ sarpā jvalanārkasamaprabhāḥ `jvalanārkasamā viṣe’ iti pā.||23||
snigdhā vividhavarṇābhis tiryag ūrdhvaṃ ca rājibhiḥ |
citritā iva ye bhānti rājimantas tu te smṛtāḥ ||24||

ab.seg: idānīṃ cikitsopayogidarvīkarādiliṅgamuddiśannāha- rathāṅgetyādi| rathāṅgaṃ cakraṃ, lāṅgalaṃ halaṃ, dhāriṇa iti yato rathāṅgādīnāmākṛtiṃ dhārayanti| maṇḍalairityādi| pṛthavo vistīrṇāḥ||22-24||

lg.l: muktārūpyaprabhā ye ca kapilā ye ca pannagāḥ |
sugandhayaḥ suvarṇābhās te jātyā brāhmaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ ||25||
kṛṣṇā vajranibhā `vajraprabhā’ iti pā. ye ca lohitā varṇatas tathā |
dhūmrāḥ pārāvatābhāś ca vaiśyās te pannagāḥ smṛtāḥ ||27||
bhinnavarṇāś ca ye kecic chūdrās te parikīrtitāḥ ||28||

ab.seg: idānīṃ brāhmaṇādijātiparijñānāyāha- muktārūpyetyādi| sūryādivatteṣāṃ lakṣma cihnaṃ, tathā ambujaḥ śaṅkhaḥ| tathā ca vṛddhavāgbhaṭaḥ- “bhoge'rdhacandraśrīvatsaśaṅkhacakrahalāṅkitāḥ”- iti| dvīpī citrakaḥ||25-28||

lg.l: kopayanty anilaṃ jantoḥ phaṇinaḥ sarva eva tu |

div.ab: apatyamityādi| asamānavarṇābhyāṃ sarpasarpiṇībhyāṃ yat apatyaṃ vaikarañjākhyaṃ, taddvidoṣakaralakṣaṇaṃ jñeyaṃ; dvidoṣakarāṇi lakṣaṇāni yatra taddvidoṣakaralakṣaṇaṃ; etena vaikarañjasya dvidoṣakartṛtvamuktam| apatye yau dvidoṣau tau kayorityāha- jñeyāviti|- jñeyau jñātavyau| dampatyoḥ pitṛmātrorityarthaḥ||29||-

lg.l: rajanyāḥ paścime yāme sarpāś citrāś caranti hi |

ab.seg: eṣāṃ madhye ke kasmin kāle vicarantītyāha- viśeṣa ityādi| paścime yāme caturthe prahara ityarthaḥ| citrā atra rājimantaḥ| śeṣeṣu prahareṣu `rajanyā eva’ iti śeṣaḥ||30-31||

lg.l: darvīkarās tu taruṇā vṛddhā maṇḍalinas tathā |

ab.seg: teṣāṃ darvīkarādīnāmugraviṣatve vayo'vasthāmuddiśannāha- darvīkarā ityādi| darvīkarādayo mṛtyuhetavo jāyante bhavantītyarthaḥ||32||

lg.l: vṛddhā muktatvaco bhītāḥ sarpās tv alpaviṣāḥ smṛtāḥ ||33||

ab.seg: teṣāmevālpaviṣatve hetumāha- nakulākulitā ityādi| nakulena ākulitāḥ kadarthitāḥ; vāriviprahatā vāriṇā jalena viśeṣeṇa prahatā abhibhūtāḥ; muktatvaco muktakañcukāḥ, tathā bhītāḥ sarpā alpaviṣā bhavanti||33||

div.ab: tatra, darvīkarāḥ- kṛṣṇasarpo, mahākṛṣṇaḥ, kṛṣṇodaraḥ śvetakapoto, mahākapoto, balāhako, mahāsarpaḥ, śaṅkhakapālo `śaṅkhakāmalo’ iti pā., lohitākṣo, gavedhukaḥ, parisarpaḥ, khaṇḍaphaṇaḥ, kakudaḥ, padmo, mahāpadmo, darbhapuṣpo, dadhimukhaḥ, puṇḍarīko, bhrūkuṭīmukho, viṣkiraḥ, puṣpābhikīrṇo, girisarpaḥ, ṛjusarpaḥ, śvetodaro, mahāśirā, alagarda, āśīviṣa iti (1); maṇḍalinas tu- ādarśamaṇḍalaḥ, śvetamaṇḍalo, raktamaṇḍalaḥ, citramaṇḍalaḥ, pṛṣato, rodhrapuṣpo, milindako, gonaso, vṛddhagonasaḥ, panaso, mahāpanaso, veṇupatrakaḥ, śiśuko madanaḥ, pālindiraḥ, piṅgalaḥ `piṅgalatantukaḥ’ iti pā., tantukaḥ puṣpapāṇḍuḥ, ṣaḍaṅgo, agniko babhruḥ, kaṣāyaḥ, kaluṣaḥ pārāvato, hastābharaṇaḥ, citrakaḥ, eṇīpada iti (2); rājimantas tu- puṇḍarīko rājicitro, aṅgularājiḥ, bindurājiḥ, kardamakaḥ, tṛṇaśoṣakaḥ, sarṣapakaḥ śvetahanuḥ, darbhapuṣpaś cakrako, godhūmakaḥ, kikkisāda iti (3); nirviṣās tu- galagolī, śūkapatro, ajagaro, divyako, varṣāhikaḥ, puṣpaśakalī, jyotīrathaḥ, kṣīrikāpuṣpako, ahipatāko, andhāhiko, gaurāhiko, vṛkṣeśaya iti (4); vaikarañjās tu trayāṇāṃ darvīkarādīnāṃ vyatikarāj jātāḥ, tad yathā- mākuliḥ, poṭagalaḥ, snigdharājir iti | tatra, kṛṣṇasarpeṇa gonasyāṃ vaiparītyena vā jāto mākuliḥ; rājilena gonasyāṃ vaiparītyena vā jātaḥ poṭagalaḥ; kṛṣṇasarpeṇa rājimatyāṃ vaiparītyena vā jātaḥ snigdharājir iti | teṣām ādyasya pitṛvad viṣotkarṣo, dvayor mātṛvad ity eke (5) |34|

tajjātameva vyatikaraṃ vivṛṇvannāha- tatra kṛṣṇasarpeṇetyādi| vaiparītyena veti gonasena puṃsā kṛṣṇasarpiṇyāṃ striyāmityarthaḥ| rājilenetyādi| vaiparityaṃ pūrvavyākhyāvajjñeyam| kṛṣṇasarpeṇetyādi| eṣāṃ madhye ye'prasiddhāḥ sarpabhedāste sarve nānādeśavāsibhyaḥ sarpahelikādibhyo jñeyāḥ| teṣāṃ vyatikarajānāṃ samatayā dvividhatve prāpte dampatyorekasya viṣamutkarṣaṃ `viṣamutkarṣādbhavati’ iti pā. bhavatīti darśayannāha- teṣāmityādi| ādyasya mākuleḥ, pitṛvat kṛṣṇasarpavat| dvayoḥ poṭagalasnigdharājikayoḥ; tatra poṭagalasya mātā gonasī, snigdharājikasya mātā rājimatī|(1-5)|34|

ab.seg: trayāṇāṃ vaikarañjānāṃ punar divyelakarodhrapuṣpakarājicitrakapoṭagalapuṣpābhikīrṇadarbhapuṣpavellitakāḥ sapta; teṣām ādyās trayo rājilavat, śeṣā maṇḍalivat, evam eteṣāṃ sarpāṇām aśītir vyākhyātā ||34||
vaikarañjebhyastribhyo jātānāṃ divyelakaprabhṛtīnāṃ viṣaṃ keṣāmanuyāyi bhavatīti darśayannāha- trayāṇāmityādi||34||
tatra mahānetrajihvāsyaśirasaḥ pumāṃsaḥ, sūkṣmanetrajihvāsyaśirasaḥ striyaḥ, ubhayalakṣaṇā mandaviṣā akrodhā napuṃsakā iti ||35||
sarpāṇāṃ puruṣādilakṣaṇamuddiśannāha- tatretyādi||35||

tatra sarveṣāṃ sarpāṇāṃ sāmānyata eva daṣṭalakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ? viṣaṃ hi niśitanistriṃśāśanihutavahadeśyam āśukāri muhūrtam apy upekṣitam āturam atipātayati, na cāvakāśo 'sti vāksamūha
m upasartuṃ pratyekam api daṣṭalakṣaṇe 'bhihite sarvatra `sarvatraividhyaṃ’ iti pā. traividhyaṃ bhavati, tasmāt traividhyam eva vakṣyāmaḥ; etad dhy āturahitam asammohakaraṃ ca, api cātraiva sarvasarpavyañjanāvarodhaḥ ||36||

niśitanistriṃśaḥ tīkṣṇaḥ khaṅgaḥ, aśaniḥ vajraṃ, hutavaho vahniḥ, deśyaṃ tulyaṃ; āśukāri śīghravyāpakam| atipātayati śīghraṃ mārayatītyarthaḥ| na cāvakāśa ityādi avakāśaḥ kālavilambaḥ| upasartum anusartum| pratyekamapītyādi| tasmāt pratisarpadaṣṭalakṣaṇaṃ na kṛtamiti bhāvaḥ| etattraividhyamasammohakaraṃ ceti abhrāntijanakaṃ, `vaidyasya’ iti śeṣaḥ;| taduktaṃ,- “muhyanti vistare mandāḥ” iti||36||

tatra, darvīkaraviṣeṇa tvaṅnayananakhadaśanavadanamūtrapurīṣadaṃśakṛṣṇatvaṃ raukṣyaṃ śiraso gauravaṃ sandhivedanā kaṭīpṛṣṭhagrīvādaurbalyaṃ jṛmbhaṇaṃ vepathuḥ svarāvasādo ghurghurako jaḍatā śuṣkodgāraḥ kāsaśvāsau hikkā vāyor ūrdhvagamanaṃ śūlodveṣṭanaṃ tṛṣṇā lālāsrāvaḥ phenāgamanaṃ sroto 'varodhas tās tāś ca vātavedanā bhavanti; maṇḍaliviṣeṇa tvagādīnāṃ pītatvaṃ śītābhilāṣaḥ paridhūpanaṃ dāhas tṛṣṇā mado mūrcchā jvaraḥ śoṇitāgamanam ūrdhvam adhaś ca māṃsānām avaśātanaṃ śvayathur daṃśakothaḥ pītarūpadarśanam āśukopas tās tāś ca pittavedanā bhavanti; rājimadviṣeṇa śuklatvaṃ tvagādīnāṃ śītajvaro romaharṣaḥ stabdhatvaṃ gātrāṇām ādaṃśaśophaḥ sāndrakaphaprasekaś chardir abhīkṣṇam akṣṇoḥ kaṇḍūḥ kaṇṭhe śvayathur ghurghuraka ucchvāsanirodhas tamaḥ praveśas tās tāś ca kaphavedanā bhavanti ||37||

darvīkarādisarpagaṇabhedānāṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇopadeśena viśiṣṭalakṣaṇamavabudhyate, tatsāmānyaṃ trividhalakṣaṇamuddiśannāha- tatra darvīkaretyādi| darvīkaraviṣeṇa tvaṅnakhādikṛṣṇatvādilakṣaṇāni bhavantīti sambandhaḥ| svarāvasādaḥ svarabhaṅgaḥ, ghurghurako mārjāraśabdānukārī avyakto dhvaniviśeṣaḥ, jaḍatā niḥspandatā, śūlodveṣṭanaṃ śūlena kṛtvā'ṅgamoṭanaṃ tāstā vātavedanāḥ todanabhedanādikāḥ| maṇḍalītyādi| paridhūpanaṃ sarvāṅgasantāpaḥ, madaḥ pūgaphalakhādaneneva mattatvaṃ, māṃsānāmavaśātanaṃ śaṭitatvādgalanaṃ, daṃśakothaḥ daṃśasya pūtibhāvaḥ, pītarūpadarśanaṃ sarvaṃ vastu pītābhaṃ paśyati, tāstāśca pittavedanā ūṣacoṣādikāḥ| rājimadviṣeṇetyādi| ādaṃśaśopha āsamantato daṃśasya śophā ityarthaḥ, prasekaḥ kṣaraṇaṃ, ghurghurakaḥ avyaktaḥ śabdaviśeṣaḥ, tama andhakāraḥ; tāstāḥ kaṇḍvādyāḥ||37||

puruṣābhidaṣṭa ūrdhvaṃ prekṣate, adhastāt striyā sirāś cottiṣṭhanti lalāṭe, napuṃsakābhidaṣṭas tiryakprekṣī bhavati, garbhiṇyā pāṇḍumukho dhmātaś ca, sūti
kayā kukṣiśūlārtaḥ sarudhiraṃ mehaty upajihvikā cāsya bhavati, grāsārthinā 'nnaṃ kāṅkṣati, vṛddhena cirān mandāś ca vegāḥ, bālenāśu mṛdavaś ca, nirviṣeṇāviṣaliṅgaṃ, andhāhikenāndhatvam ity eke, grasanāt ajagaraḥ śarīraprāṇaharo na viṣāt | tatra sadyaḥ prāṇaharāhidaṣṭaḥ patati śāstrāśanihata iva bhūmau, srastāṅgaḥ svapiti ||38||

adhunā puruṣādyabhidaṣṭalakṣaṇamāha- puruṣābhidaṣṭa ityādi| prekṣate iti pūrvasmādadhastādityanena ca sambandhanīyam| napuṃsakābhidaṣṭa ityādi| sūtikā prasūtā| mehati mūtrayati| vṛddhena daṣṭasya cirakālena vegāste ca mandā bhavanti| bālenetyādi| andhena ahinā daṣṭasyāndhatvaṃ ca dṛśyate ityeke, anye punaraviṣaprakaraṇādaviṣa evāyamityāhuḥ| andhāhiḥ jalabilaśāyīti `jaladhiśāyi’ iti pā. prasiddhaḥ, apare punaraparamevāndhāhimāhuḥ| grasanādityādi| grasanāt gilanāt; śarīraprāṇaharaḥ śarīraharaḥ prāṇaharaśca bhavati, na viṣāt||38||

tatra sarveṣāṃ sarpāṇāṃ viṣasya sapta vegā bhavanti | tatra, darvīkarāṇāṃ prathame vege viṣaṃ śoṇitaṃ dūṣayati, tat praduṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇatām upaiti, tena kārṣṇyaṃ pipīlikāparisarpaṇam iva cāṅge bhavati; dvitīye māṃsaṃ dūṣayati, tenātyarthaṃ kṛṣṇatā śopho granthayaś cāṅge bhavanti; tṛtīye medo dūṣayati, tena daṃśakledaḥ śirogauravaṃ `śirograhaṇaṃ’ iti pā. svedaś cakṣurgrahaṇaṃ ca; caturthe koṣṭham anupraviśya kaphapradhānān doṣān dūṣayati, tena tandrāprasekasandhiviśleṣā bhavanti; pañcame 'sthīny anupraviśati prāṇam agniṃ ca dūṣayati, tena parvabhedo hikkā dāhaś ca bhavati; ṣaṣṭhe majjānam anupraviśati grahaṇīṃ cātyarthaṃ dūṣayati, tena gātrāṇāṃ gauravam atīsāro hṛtpīḍā mūrcchā ca bhavati; saptame śukram anupraviśati vyānaṃ cātyarthaṃ kopayati kaphaṃ ca sūkṣmasrotobhyaḥ pracyāvayati, tena śleṣmavartiprādurbhāvaḥ kaṭīpṛṣṭhabhaṅgaḥ sarvaceṣṭāvighāto lālāsvedayor atipravṛttir ucchvāsanirodhaś ca bhavati | maṇḍalināṃ prathame vege viṣaṃ śoṇitaṃ dūṣayati, tat praduṣṭaṃ pītatām upaiti, tatra paridāhaḥ pītāvabhāsatā cāṅgānāṃ bhavati; dvitīye māṃsaṃ dūṣayati, tenātyarthaṃ pītatā paridāho daṃśe śvayathuś ca bhavati; tṛtīye medo dūṣayati, tena pūrvavac cakṣurgrahaṇaṃ tṛṣṇā daṃśakledaḥ svedaś ca; caturthe koṣṭham anupraviśya jvaram āpādayati; pañcame paridāhaṃ sarvagātreṣu karoti, ṣaṣṭhasaptamayoḥ pūrvavat | rājimatāṃ prathame vege viṣaṃ śoṇitaṃ dūṣayati tat praduṣṭaṃ pāṇḍutām upaiti, tena romaharṣaḥ śuklāvabhāsaś ca puruṣo
bhavati; dvitīye māṃsaṃ dūṣayati, tena pāṇḍutā 'tyarthaṃ jāḍyaṃ śiraḥśophaś ca bhavati; tṛtīye medo dūṣayati, tena cakṣurgrahaṇaṃ daṃśakledaḥ svedo ghrāṇākṣisrāvaś ca bhavati; caturthe koṣṭham anupraviśya manyāstambhaṃ śirogauravaṃ cāpādayati; pañcame vāksaṅgaṃ śītajvaraṃ ca karoti; ṣaṣṭhasaptamayoḥ pūrvavad iti ||39||

vego viṣavego viṣagatiḥ| tatra darvīkarāṇāmityādi| cakṣurgrahaṇaṃ dṛṣṭyavarodhaḥ| pañcame ityādi| grahaṇī pittadharā kalā| pūrvavaditi darvīkāraviṣasya ṣaṣṭhasaptamayorvegayoryāni lakṣaṇāni tāni bhavantītyarthaḥ asyāgre `phaṇimaṇḍalīviṣajñānaṃ ca pṛthaguktaṃ tvagādikṛṣṇatvapītatvādisāmānyalakṣaṇadvāreṇa’ ityadhikaṃ paṭhyate hastalikhitapustake| evaṃ rājimatāmapi ṣaṣṭhasaptamavegayoratideśārtho boddhavyaḥ||39||

bhavanti cātra-
dhātvantareṣu yāḥ sapta kalāḥ samparikīrtitāḥ |
tāsv ekaikām atikramya vegaṃ prakurute viṣam ||40||

kutaḥ punaḥ saptaiva vegā ityāha- bhavantītyādi| dhātvantareṣu dhātumadhyeṣu, dhātugrahaṇamāśayopalakṣaṇaṃ; tenāyamarthaḥ- dhātvāśayāntaramaryādā yāḥ kalāḥ sapta prāguktā garbhavyākaraṇe tāsvekaikāmatikramya saptasu dhātuṣu sapta vegā bhavanti| tadyathā- rasaraktayorantarasthāṃ kalāmatikramya rakte prathamavegaḥ, raktamāṃsayorantarasthāṃ kalāmatikramya dvitīyaḥ, māṃsamedasorantarasthāṃ kalāmatikramya tṛtīyaḥ, medaḥkaphayorantarasthāṃ kalāmatikramya caturthaḥ, kaphapurīṣayorantarasthāṃ kalāmatikramya pañcamaḥ, purīṣapittayorantarasthāṃ kalāmatikramya ṣaṣṭhaḥ, pittaśukrayorantarasthāṃ kalāmatikramya saptama iti| yaiva kalā purīṣadharā saivāsthidhareti pañcame asthanyanupraviśatītyaviruddhaṃ; evaṃ yaiva pittadharā saiva majjadhareti ṣaṣṭhe majjānamanupraviśatītyaviruddham||40||

lg.l: yenāntareṇa tu kalāṃ kālakalpaṃ bhinatti hi |

ab.seg: vegamabhidhāya vegāntaramāha- yenāntareṇetyādi| yenāntareṇa yena kālena, kalām uktalakṣaṇāṃ, kālakalpaṃ mṛtyusadṛśaṃ viṣaṃ, bhinatti vidārayati, samīraṇenohyamānaṃ vāyunā preryamāṇaṃ tattu vegāntaraṃ bhūtasya bhaviṣyataśca vegasya madhyabhūtaḥ kālastāvatpramāṇa ityarthaḥ||41||

lg.l: śūnāṅgaḥ prathame vege paśur dhyāyati duḥkhitaḥ |
lālāsrāvo dvitīye tu kṛṣṇāṅgaḥ `hṛṣṭāṅgaḥ’ iti pā. pīḍyate hṛdi ||42||
tṛtīye ca śiroduḥkhaṃ kaṇṭhagrīvaṃ ca bhajyate |
caturthe vepate mūḍhaḥ khādan dantān jahāty asūn ||43||
kecid vegatrayaṃ prāhur antaṃ caiteṣu tadvidaḥ |
dhyāyati prathame vege pakṣī muhyaty ataḥ param ||44||
dvitīye vihvalaḥ proktas tṛtīye `pakṣī kūjan maraṇamṛcchati’ iti pā. mṛtyum ṛcchati |
kecid ekaṃ vihaṅgeṣu viṣavegam uśanti hi |

ab.seg: manuṣyasya saptaviṣavegaprasaṅgena paśupakṣiṣvapi vegaprasaṅkhyāmuddiśannāha- śūnāṅga ityādi| hṛṣṭāṅga uddharṣitaśarīraḥ, kecidvegatrayamityāhuḥ| kecidācāryā `dhyāyati prathame’ ityādipāṭhaṃ na paṭhanti||42-45||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ kalpasthāne sarpadaṣṭaviṣavijñānīyaṃ nāma caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ ||4||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ kalpasthāne caturtho'dhyāyaḥ||4||

div.head: sarpadaṣṭaviṣacikitsitakalpaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ sarpadaṣṭaviṣacikitsitaṃ kalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi||1-2||

lg.l: na gacchati viṣaṃ deham ariṣṭābhir nivāritam ||4||

ab.seg: sarpadaṣṭacikitsitaṃ dvividhaṃ sāmānyaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ ca; tatra sāmānyameva prathamaṃ nirdiśannāha- sarvairityādi| śākhā hastapādakam| ariṣṭā vastrādibhirmantrapuraskṛtairbandhaḥ| plotetyādi| plotaṃ vastraṃ, carmāntaṃ carmaikadeśaḥ, valkaṃ vṛkṣāditvak, mṛdunā komalena, anyatamena ekatamena, plotena carmāntena valkalena vetyarthaḥ||3-4||

lg.l: dahed daṃśam athotkṛtya yatra bandho na jāyate |

ab.seg: ariṣṭāmabhidhāya dāhamuddiśannāha- dahedityādi| utkṛtya chittvā| dahediti atra `maṇḍalidaṃśaṃ varjayitvā’ iti śeṣaḥ| na jāyate na sambhavati| sarvatraiva sarvasmin dehe| pūjitāḥ ślāghitāḥ| dāhasya punarupādānamutkartanamantareṇāpi dāhavidhānārtham||5||

lg.l: pratipūrya mukhaṃ vastrair hitam ācūṣaṇaṃ bhavet |
sa daṣṭavyo 'thavā `sandaṣṭavya’ iti pā. sarpo loṣṭo vā 'pi hi tat kṣaṇam ||6||

ab.seg: pratipūryetyādi| vastrairityupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena kṛṣṇavalmīkamṛtpāṃśunā'pi pratipūryācūṣaṇaṃ hitaṃ, viṣaharatvādvalmīkasya| sa daṣṭavya ityādi| daṣṭena puruṣeṇa hastābhyāmupasaṅgṛhya pucche vaktre ca sarpaḥ samyag daṣṭavyaḥ, tadabhāve loṣṭo vā daṣṭavyaḥ| tadbhakṣaṇaṃ tu tatraiva saṅkramaṇaheturityarthaḥ||6||

lg.l: atha maṇḍalinā daṣṭaṃ na kathañ cana dāhayet |

ab.seg: kenaciddaṣṭe dāhaniṣedhamāha- atha maṇḍalinā daṣṭamityādi||7||

lg.l: ariṣṭām api mantraiś ca badhnīyān mantrakovidaḥ |
sā tu rajjvādibhir baddhā viṣapratikarī matā ||8||

ab.seg: na kevalaṃ plotādibhiḥ paramariṣṭetyāha- ariṣṭāmityādi| mantrakovido mantrajñaḥ puruṣaḥ| kevalairapi mantrairariṣṭāṃ badhnīyāt| na paraṃ mantrairevāriṣṭetyāha- sā tvityādi| sā punarariṣṭā mantrarahitairapi rajjvādibhirbaddhā viṣapratikarī viṣapratīkārahetuḥ `viṣapratibandhahetuḥ’ iti pā.| etena mantratantrābhyāṃ tu viṣapratīkāraḥ||8||

lg.l: bhavanti nānyathā kṣipraṃ viṣaṃ hanyuḥ sudustaram ||9||
yathā nivāryate kṣipraṃ prayuktair na tathauṣadhaiḥ ||10||

ab.seg: mantrasya śaktiṃ darśayannāha- devabrahmarṣibhirityādi| devarṣivihitatvena satyamayāḥ, brahmarṣivihitatvena tapomayāḥ| proktāḥ kathitā na tu kṛtāḥ, mantrāṇāṃ nityatvāt| anye tu `satyabrahmatapomayā’ iti paṭhitvā vyākhyānayanti- devā indrādayaḥ, brahmā svanāmaprasiddhaḥ, ṛṣayaḥ devarṣi-brahmarṣi-rājarṣayaḥ| tatra devakṛtatvena satyapratyayāḥ, brahmakṛtatvena brahmamayāḥ, trividharṣikṛtatvena tapomayāḥ; mantrāḥ kurukullābheruṇḍādayaḥ paratantrābhihitā iha nopadiṣṭāḥ||9-10||

div.ab: mantragrahaṇavidhānamāha- mantrāṇāmityādi| atra madhu madyaṃ kṣaudraṃ cobhayamapi varjanīyam| yatāhāreṇa saṃyatāhāreṇa haviṣyaikāhāreṇetyarthaḥ| śucinā bāhyābhyantarapavitreṇa| mālyaṃ mālā, upahāro dhūpadīpādikaṃ pūjopakaraṇaṃ, baliḥ sapaśunaivaidyam| homaśceti cakāreṇa dhyānenāpītyanuktaṃ samuccīyate||11||12||

lg.l: mantrās tv avidhinā proktā hīnā vā svaravarṇataḥ |
yasmān na siddhim āyānti tasmād yojyo 'gadakramaḥ ||13||

ab.seg: vidhihīnagṛhītasya hīnasvarādervā mantrasyāsiddhāvagadakramo yojya ityāha- mantrāstvityādi| avidhinā strīmāṃsamadhuvarjanādividhiṃ vinā; proktā `guruṇā’ iti śeṣaḥ||13||

lg.l: samantataḥ sirā daṃśād vidhyet tu kuśalo bhiṣak |
śākhāgre vā lalāṭe vā vyadhyās tā visṛte viṣe ||14||
rakte nirhriyamāṇe tu kṛtsnaṃ nirhriyate viṣam |
tasmād visrāvayed raktaṃ sā hy asya paramā kriyā ||15||

ab.seg: yato raktameva prāpya viṣaṃ vikārakāryatastadapakarṣaṇāyāha- samantata ityādi| samantataḥ sarvatra| vāśabdo'tra samuccayārthe| visṛte prasṛte| pralepayed raktasecanāvaśiṣṭavipraśamāya mahāgadādibhiḥ| candanetyādi| candanośīrakvāthenetyarthaḥ, anye tu candanośīrakalkamiśritajalenetyāhuḥ||14-16||

lg.l: tadalābhe hitā vā syāt kṛṣṇā valmīkamṛttikā ||17||

div.ab: pāyayetetyādi| raktāvasecanapūrvaṃ hṛdayāvaraṇārthaṃ tāṃstān mahāgadādīnakṣamātrāparimitān kṣīrādibhiryathādoṣaṃ pātuṃ prayojayet| ādiśabdāddadhitakrayorgrahaṇam| kovidāraḥ kāñcanāraḥ| kaṭabhī śvetasyandaḥ||17||-

lg.l: dravam anyat tu yat kiñcit pītvā pītvā tad udvamet |
prāyo hi vamanenaiva sukhaṃ nirhriyate viṣam ||19||

ab.seg: viṣe kānapi dravān nirasyannāha- na pibettailakaulatthetyādi| kulatthānāmayaṃ kaulattho yūṣaḥ, sauvīrakaṃ kāñjikam||18-19||

lg.l: phaṇināṃ viṣavege tu prathame śoṇitaṃ haret |
vāntaṃ caturthe pūrvoktāṃ yavāgūm atha dāpayet ||21||
pāyayec chodhanaṃ `dāpayet’ iti pā. tīkṣṇaṃ yavāgūṃ cāpi kīrtitām ||22||
saptame tv avapīḍena śiras tīkṣṇena śodhayet |
tīkṣṇam evāñjanaṃ dadyāt, tīkṣṇaśastreṇa mūrdhni ca ||23||
kṛtvā kākapadaṃ carma sāsṛg vā piśitaṃ `māṃsakaṃ’ iti pā. kṣipet |24|

div.ab: ata ūrdhvaṃ darvīkarādivegaviśeṣeṇa vaiśeṣikaṃ cikitsitamāha- phaṇināmityādi| śoṇitaṃ harediti sirayā pracchannena śṛṅgeṇa vā| agadaṃ darvīkaraviṣoditam| vāntaṃ caturtha ityādi| vamana miha sārvakārmikādibhiragadaiḥ| pūrvoktāṃ yavāgūmiti sthāvaraviṣaviṣaye kṛtavamanādikarmaṇāṃ kośātakyādidravyaiḥ kṛtāmannasaṃsarjanārtham| evaṃ pañcamaṣaṣṭhayoḥ śodhane kṛte'nnasaṃsarjanārthaṃ kīrtitāṃ yavāgūm| saptame tu pratyākhyāyāvapīḍanādikam||20-23||-

lg.l: vāmayitvā yavāgūṃ ca pūrvoktām atha dāpayet ||25||
tṛtīye śodhitaṃ tīkṣṇair yavāgūṃ pāyayed dhitām |
kākolyādir hitaḥ ṣaṣṭhe peyaś ca madhuro 'gadaḥ `madhuro gaṇaḥ’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: pūrve maṇḍalināmityādi| pūrve maṇḍalināṃ vege darvīkaravadityanenātidiṣṭaṃ śoṇitamokṣaṇaṃ jalaukābhiḥ| agadaṃ maṇḍaliviṣoditameva| dvitīye vāmayitveti vamanadravyakvāthena| śodhitaṃ viriktaṃ, tīkṣṇaiḥ virecanadravyaiḥ| peyaścetyatra cakāreṇa śodhanaṃ tīkṣṇamapi samuccīyate| madhuro'gada iti mahāgadādiṣu yo'tīkṣṇaḥ sa peyaḥ| saptame vege pratyākhyāya viṣapratyanīkāgadāvapīḍenopacaret||24-27||

lg.l: pūrve rājimatāṃ vege 'lābubhiḥ śoṇitaṃ haret `atha rājimatāṃ vege prathame śoṇitaṃ haret’ iti pā.|
vāntaṃ dvitīye tv agadaṃ pāyayed viṣanāśanam |
tṛtīyādiṣu triṣv evaṃ vidhir dārvīkaro hitaḥ ||29||

div.ab: pūrve rājimatāmityādi| avapīḍo'tra sārvakārmikāgadena| avapīḍaśceti cakāreṇa naṣṭasañjñavidhānaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ sūcyate|||28-29||-
cikitsitasya kvacideva kañcidviśeṣamuddiśannāha- garbhiṇītyādi||30||-

lg.l: triguṇaṃ mahiṣe soṣṭre gavāśve dviguṇaṃ tu tat `gavāśvayośca dviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ mahiṣoṣṭrayoḥ’ iti pā.|

div.ab: saptavegaprasaṅgena paśuvegaviśeṣasyoktatvāccikitsite mātrāyāṃ viśeṣamuddiśannāha- raktetyādi| raktāvasekasya mahatī mātrā prasthapramāṇā; prasthaścātra sārdhatrayodaśapalapramāṇaḥ||31||-

lg.l: māṣakaṃ tv añjanasyeṣṭaṃ dviguṇaṃ nasyato hitam |

ab.seg: pakṣiṇāṃ cikitsitamuddiśannāha- kevalamityādi| pariṣekapradehau kevalaṃ naraviṣaharadravyeṇa kāryau, natu raktāvasekāñjanānītyarthaḥ| añjanādīnāṃ pramāṇamāha- māṣakamityādi| idamañjanādipramāṇaṃ gayadāsajejjaṭābhyāmaṅgīkṛtam| vayaṃ tu vṛddhavāgbhaṭoktasuśrutoktavākyadarśanādañjanādiṣu viṣaviṣaye mahatīṃ mātrāṃ manyāmahe| tathā ca tayorvākyam,- “gulmodāvartavīsarpasarpadaṃśābhipīḍitaiḥ| unmattaiḥ kṛcchramūtraiśca mahatī śīghrameva sā”- iti; suśrute ca,- “ahorātrādasanduṣṭā yā mātrā parijīryati| sā ca kuṣṭhaviṣonmādagrahāpasmāranāśinī”- iti; tantrāntare'pi- “viṣajuṣṭahatā ye ca kāsaśvāsahatāśca ye| taruṇā balavantaśca vāmayeduttamena tān”- iti| etaduddeśena kalkādīnāṃ mahatyā mātrayā'tra yuktiravasīyate| mahatyā mātrayā ca kalkamodakacūrṇānāṃ palaṃ mātrāpramāṇam| tathā ca,- kalkamodakacūrṇānāṃ karṣa(pala)madyācca lehataḥ| karṣadvayaṃ palaṃ vā'pi vayorogāgnyapekṣayā”- iti| kvāthasya palacatuṣṭayaṃ pramāṇaṃ; tathā ca- “kvāthadravyapale vāri dviraṣṭaguṇamiṣyate| caturbhāgāvaśeṣaṃ tu peyaṃ palacatuṣṭayam”- iti| vamanaviṣaye kvāthasya nava prasthāḥ pramāṇaṃ; tathā ca, “nava prasthā tu jyeṣṭhā syānmadhyamā ṣaṭ prakīrtitā| niṣkvāthasya trayaḥ prasthā māgadhāstu kanīyasī”- iti| vamanaviṣaye kalkasya palatrayaṃ pramāṇam| tathā ca,- “tripalaṃ jyeṣṭhamākhyātaṃ kanīyastu palaṃ bhavet| madhyamaṃ dve pale vidyāditi me niścitā matiḥ”- iti| nasyāñjanayośca mātrā nasyāñjanavidhāveva yā mahatī pratipāditeti||32-33||

lg.l: pradhārya nipuṇaṃ buddhyā tataḥ karma samācaret ||34||

ab.seg: deśetyādi| deśo bhūmiḥ āturaśca; tatra bhūdeśaḥ aśvatthadevatāyatanaśmaśānādikaḥ, āturaśarīre ca marmadeśaḥ; prakṛtiḥ kāyikī mānasī ca; tatra kāyikī vātādikṛtā, mānasī ca sattvadijā| pradhārya ālocya, buddhyā nipuṇaṃ yathā bhavatyevaṃ karma samācaret||34||

lg.l: vegānupūrvyā karmoktam idaṃ viṣavināśanam `vegānupūrvamityetat karmoktaṃ viṣanāśanam’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: vegānupūrvyetyādi| vegānupūrvyā vegānāmanukrameṇetyarthaḥ| ubhayoḥ sthāvarajaṅgamayoḥ||35||

lg.l: vivarṇe kaṭhine śūne saruje 'ṅge viṣānvite `viṣārdite’ iti pā.|
tūrṇaṃ visravaṇaṃ kāryam uktena vidhinā tataḥ ||36||

ab.seg: vivarṇe ityādi| tūrṇaṃ tvaritam| visrāvaṇaṃ raktamokṣaṇam||36||

lg.l: kṣudhārtam anilaprāyaṃ tad viṣārtaṃ `tadviṣātiṃsamanvitam’ iti pā. samāhitaḥ |
pāyayeta rasaṃ sarpiḥ śuktaṃ `takraṃ’ iti pā.| `pāyayeddadhi takraṃ vā sarpiḥ kṣaudraṃ tathā rasam’ iti pā. kṣaudraṃ tathā dadhi ||37||

ab.seg: kṣudhārtamityādi| tadviṣārtamiti `tadviṣārtiriti vātādhikaviṣavedanā’ iti pā. vātādhikaviṣavedanārtam| atra māṃsarasādipānaṃ viṣavegaprāptau satyāṃ sukhena vamanārtham||37||

lg.l: tṛḍdāhagharmasammohe paittaṃ paittaviṣāturam `paitte viṣāturam’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: tṛḍdāhetyādi| gharma ityuṣṇakāle, sammohe mūrcchāyām| paittaṃ pittaprakṛtim| paittaṃ pittajanakaṃ viṣam| saṃvāhanaṃ sukhakaraḥ sparśaḥ| pradehaḥ pralepaḥ||38||
kaphaviṣāturasya cikitsāmāha- śīte ityādi| śīte śītakāle| ślaiṣmikaṃ puruṣam||39||
āmāśayagatasya kaphasya vamanamuddiśya pacyamānapakvāśayagatayoḥ pittavātayorvirecanaśabdena virekabastī nirdiśannāha- koṣṭhetyādi| koṣṭhadāhādau tu virecanaśabdo virecana eva vartate||40||

lg.l: vivarṇaṃ cāpi paśyan tam añjanaiḥ samupācaret ||41||

ab.seg: śūnākṣikūṭamityādi| akṣikūṭo bhruvoradhobhāgaḥ| āvilaṃ dūṣikāsrābhyāṃ malinaṃ, vivarṇaṃ vividhavarṇam||41||

lg.l: śiro virecayet kṣipraṃ manyāstambhe ca dāruṇe ||42||
tāḍayec ca sirāḥ kṣipraṃ tasya śākhālalāṭajāḥ |
kuryāt kākapadākāraṃ vraṇam evaṃ sravanti tāḥ |
saraktaṃ carma māṃsaṃ vā nikṣipec cāsya mūrdhani ||45||
carmavṛkṣakaṣāyaṃ vā kalkaṃ `cūrṇaṃ’ iti pā. vā kuśalo bhiṣak |
vādayec cāgadair liptvā dundubhīṃs tasya pārśvayoḥ ||46||
labdhasañjñaṃ punaś cainam ūrdhvaṃ cādhaś ca śodhayet |
alpam apy avaśiṣṭaṃ hi bhūyo vegāya kalpate |

div.ab: naṣṭasañjñamityādi| vivṛtākṣaṃ vyāvartitanetram| saraktamiti| saraktaṃ hi māṃsādikaṃ śirasi nikṣiptaṃ viṣasaṅkrāmaṇaṃ bhavati| carmavṛkṣaḥ pūrvadeśe nauvṛkṣaḥ| kaṣāyo'tra niryāsaḥ| asāvapi prayogo viṣasaṅkramaṇahetuḥ| dundubhīn niḥsvānān| evaṃ ca paramadurjayaṃ viṣaṃ nirharet; kuta ityāha- alpamityādi| bhūyaḥ punarapi vegāya kalpate vegārthaṃ bhavati| sādaḥ aṅgaglāniḥ| pratiśyāyasthāne jejjaṭācāryaḥ staimityaṃ paṭhati, atra staimityaṃ niścalatā||42-49||-

lg.l: athāriṣṭāṃ vimucyāśu `vimucyāpsu’ iti pā. pracchayitvā'ṅkitaṃ tayā `tathā’ iti pā.||50||
dahyāt tatra viṣaṃ skannaṃ bhūyo vegāya kalpate |51|

div.ab: ariṣṭāsthāpanabandhanaviṣadūṣitaśoṇitasya cikitsāṃ dūṣyaviṣapratyanīkāmuddiśannāha- athāriṣṭāmityādi| atha anantaram| tayā aṅkitaṃ deśaṃ pracchayitvā dihyāt `agadaiḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ; anyathā tatra viṣaṃ skannaṃ styānībhūtaṃ bhūyo vegāya kalpate punarvegārthaṃ prādurbhavatītyarthaḥ||50||-

lg.l: evam auṣadhibhir mantraiḥ kriyāyogaiś ca yatnataḥ ||51||
viṣe hṛtaguṇe dehād yadā doṣaḥ prakupyati |
śleṣmaghnair agadaiś caiva tiktai rūkṣaiś ca bhojanaiḥ ||54||

ab.seg: evamityādi| auṣadhibhiḥ mahāgadādinirdiṣṭābhiḥ, mantraiḥ kurukullādinirdiṣṭaiḥ, kriyāyogaiḥ dūṣyabhūtaśoṇitaharabahiḥparimārjanasecanālepanādibhiḥ; tathaivāntaḥparimārjanairvamanavirecanāsthāpanaśirovirecanākhyaiḥ| viṣe hṛtaguṇe apahṛtaviṣādajananatīkṣṇādiguṇe| doṣaḥ anilādiḥ| udvṛttam uccalitaṃ parasthānamiti yāvat| snehādyairiti ādyaśabdānmṛdusaṃśodhanasvādubhojanāṅgavimardanādibhiḥ| pittajvaraharairityādi samupācaredityanuvartate| kaphamāragvadhādyenetyādi||51-54||

lg.l: udbaddhaṃ ca mṛtaṃ sadyaś cikitsen naṣṭasañjñavat ||55||

ab.seg: vṛkṣetyādi| prapāto nadītaṭādiḥ, viṣamo nimnonnatapradeśaḥ, vṛkṣādipatitaṃ prāṇinaṃ; mṛtamambhasi ambhasi mṛtaṃ, udbaddhamullambitaṃ ca mṛtaṃ, sadyo jhaṭiti, naṣṭasañjñavaccikitset| tatra mṛtaśabdo mṛtyusamīpe vartamāno gṛhyate; na punarmṛta eva, tasya niṣphalacikitsitatvāt| kecidācāryā amuṃ pāṭhaṃ na manyante, ye tu manyante tanmatānusāreṇa likhito'yamityadoṣaḥ||55||

lg.l: gāḍhaṃ baddhe 'riṣṭayā pracchite vā tīkṣṇair lepais tadvidhair vā'vaśiṣṭaiḥ `viśeṣaiḥ’ iti pā.|
śūne gātre klinnam atyarthapūti jñeyaṃ māṃsaṃ tadviṣāt pūti kaṣṭam ||56||

ab.seg: gāḍhamityādi| gāḍhamariṣṭayā baddhe, athavā pracchite, tīkṣṇairlepaistadvidhaiḥ śarīravartibhiḥ, avaśiṣṭaiḥ anuddhṛtaiḥ, jñeyaṃ jñātavyaṃ, tanmāṃsaṃ `tanmāṃsaṃ viṣapūtisañjñakaṃ’ iti pā., viṣāt pūti pūtisañjñakaṃ, kaṣṭaṃ kṛcchrasādhyam||56||

lg.l: sadyo viddhaṃ nisravet kṛṣṇaraktaṃ pākaṃ yāyād dahyate cāpy abhīkṣṇam |
kṛṣṇībhūtaṃ klinnam atyarthapūti śīrṇaṃ māṃsaṃ yāty ajasraṃ kṣatāc ca ||57||
tṛṣṇā mūrcchā bhrāntidāhau jvaraś ca yasya syus taṃ digdhaviddhaṃ vyavasyet |58|

div.ab: sadyo viddhamityādi| abhīkṣṇaṃ punaḥ punaḥ, klinnam ārdrībhūtaṃ, atyarthaṃ pūti atiśayena durgandhaṃ, śīrṇaṃ śaṭitam, ajasram anavarataṃ, bhrāntiḥ vastūnāmanyathā pratītiḥ, syuḥ bhaveyuḥ, digdhaviddhaṃ viṣaliptabāṇatāḍitaṃ, vyavasyet jānīyāt||57||-

lg.l: pūrvoddiṣṭaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sarvam etaj juṣṭaṃ yasyālaṃ viṣeṇa vraṇāḥ syuḥ ||58||
lūtādaṣṭā digdhaviddhā viṣair vā juṣṭā prāyas te vraṇāḥ pūtimāṃsāḥ `juṣṭā ye syurye vraṇāḥ pūtimāṃsāḥ’ iti pā.|59|

div.ab: pūrvoddiṣṭamityādi| yasya prāṇino'lamatyarthaṃ śatrūṇāmavacāritena viṣeṇa juṣṭā vraṇāḥ syurbhaveyuḥ, tasya etat sarvaṃ pūrvoddiṣṭaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ bhavati; kuta ityāha- lūtādaṣṭā ityādi| ye vraṇā lūtādaṣṭadigdhaviddhādayaste prāyaḥ pūtimāṃsā bhavantītyarthaḥ||58||-

lg.l: teṣāṃ yuktyā pūtimāṃsāny apohya vāryokobhiḥ śoṇitaṃ cāpahṛtya ||59||
hṛtvā doṣān kṣipram ūrdhvaṃ tv adhaś ca samyak siñcet kṣīriṇāṃ tvakkaṣāyaiḥ |
antarvastraṃ dāpayec ca pradehān śītair dravyair ājyayuktair viṣaghnaiḥ ||60||

ab.seg: eṣāṃ pūrvoktānāṃ cikitsāmāha- teṣāmityādi| vāryokobhiḥ jalaukobhirityarthaḥ| kṣīriṇāṃ nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaplakṣagardabhāṇḍānām| śītairityādi| śītavīryasparśairviṣaghnaiḥ pittavisarpoktairityarthaḥ| ājyamiśraiḥ śatadhautaghṛtayuktaiḥ||59-60||

lg.l: bhinne tv asthnā duṣṭajātena kāryaḥ pūrvo mārgaḥ paittike yo viṣe ca |61|

div.ab: bhinne ityādi| duṣṭajātena duṣṭajīvasambhūtena asthiviṣāṇāmasthnetyarthaḥ| asthnā duṣṭajātenetyupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena tatsadṛśaśakṛnmūtraśukrasparśapardanagudāsthiśūkaśavaiḥ saviṣakaṇṭakairvṛścikakaṇṭakaiśca kṛte vraṇe| pūrvo mārgaḥ anantaroktaḥ `teṣāṃ yuktyā pūtimāṃsānyapohya’ ityādikaḥ; na paraṃ duṣṭāsthyādibhirbhinne vraṇe pūrvo mārgaḥ anantarokto'pi yo vraṇastasminnapi pūrvo mārgaḥ kāryaḥ|61|-

lg.l: trivṛdviśalye madhukaṃ haridre raktā narendro lavaṇaś ca vargaḥ ||61||
kaṭutrikaṃ caiva sucūrṇitāni śṛṅge nidadhyān madhusaṃyutāni |
avāryavīryo viṣavegahantā `viṣavegahārī’ iti pā. mahāgado nāma mahāprabhāvaḥ |63|

div.ab: idānīmagadakośamāha- trivṛdviśalyetyādi| viśalyā kāṣṭhapāṭalā, raktā mañjiṣṭhā, narendraḥ kiramālakaḥ| avāryavīryaḥ apratihatavīryaḥ||61-62||-

lg.l: sarvaś ca vargo lavaṇaḥ susūkṣmaḥ sacitrakaḥ kṣaudrayuto nidheyaḥ |
śṛṅge gavāṃ śṛṅgamayena caiva pracchāditaḥ pakṣam upekṣitaś ca ||64||
eṣo 'gadaḥ sthāvarajaṅgamānāṃ jetā `hantā’ iti pā. viṣāṇām ajito hi nāmnā |65|

div.ab: viḍaṅgapāṭhetyādi| vakraṃ tagaram||63-64||-

lg.l: prapauṇḍarīkaṃ suradāru mustā kālānusāryā kaṭurohiṇī ca ||65||
rodhraṃ jalaṃ kāñcanagairikaṃ ca samāgadhaṃ candanasaindhavaṃ ca |
sūkṣmāṇi cūrṇāni samāni kṛtvā śṛṅge nidadhyān madhusaṃyutāni ||67||
eṣo 'gadas tārkṣya iti pradiṣṭo viṣaṃ nihanyād api takṣakasya |68|

div.ab: prapauṇḍarīkamityādi| kālānusāryā kālānusārivā| dhyāmakaṃ kattṛṇaṃ, kuṭannaṭaḥ śyonākaḥ, sitasindhuvāraḥ śvetanirguṇḍī||65-67||-

lg.l: bhārgī paṭolaṃ kiṇihī sapāṭhā mṛgādanī karkaṭikā puraś ca ||69||
pālindyaśokau kramukaṃ surasyāḥ prasūnam āruṣkarajaṃ ca puṣpam |
sūkṣmāni cūrṇāni samāni śṛṅge nyaset sapittāni samākṣikāṇi `cūrṇānyathaiṣāṃ nihitāni śṛṅge nyasecca pittāni samākṣikāṇi’ iti pā.||70||
varāhagodhāśikhiśallakīnāṃ `varāhagodhāśikhiśalyakānāṃ’ iti pā. mārjārajaṃ pārṣatanākule ca |
yasyāgado 'yaṃ sukṛto gṛhe syān nāmnarṣabho nāma nararṣabhasya ||71||
na tatra sarpāḥ kuta eva kīṭās tyajanti vīryāṇi viṣāṇi caiva |
etena bheryaḥ paṭahāś ca digdhā nānadyamānā viṣam āśu hanyuḥ ||72||
digdhāḥ patākāś ca nirīkṣya sadyo viṣābhibhūtā hy aviṣā bhavanti |73|

div.ab: māṃsītyādi| muraṅgī śobhāñjanakaḥ, raktā latā mañjiṣṭhā, sugandhikā sarpagandhikā, kiṇihī kaṭabhī, mṛgādanī karkaṭikā, indravāruṇīphalamityanye, puraḥ gugguluḥ, pālindī trivṛt, kālavallītyapare, kramukaṃ pūgaphalaṃ, rubukamityanye paṭhanti sa cairaṇḍaḥ, surasyāḥ prasūnaṃ tulasīpuṣpaṃ, śikhī mayūraḥ, kukkuṭa ityanye, pṛṣatānāmidaṃ pārṣataṃ, pṛṣataḥ cittalaḥ| yasya nararṣabhasya narādhipasya, gṛhe'yamagado nāmnā sañjñayā, ṛṣabho nāma ṛṣabha iti prasiddhaḥ, sukṛtaḥ syāt śobhano niṣpādito bhavet||68-72||-

lg.l: lākṣā hareṇur naladaṃ priyaṅguḥ śigrudvayaṃ yaṣṭikapṛthvikāś ca ||73||
cūrṇīkṛto 'yaṃ rajanīvimiśro sarpirmadhubhyāṃ `vargo vidheyo madhusarpiṣā''ktaḥ’ iti pā. sahito nidheyaḥ |
śṛṅge gavāṃ pūrvavad ā pidhānas tataḥ prayojyo 'ñjananasyapānaiḥ ||74||
sañjīvano nāma gatāsukalpān eṣo 'gado jīvayatīha martyān |75|

div.ab: lākṣetyādi| pṛthvikā elā, hiṅgupatriketyanye| pūrvavadāpidhānaḥ gośṛṅgikāpidhānaḥ||73-74||-

lg.l: śleṣmātakīkaṭphalamātuluṅgyaḥ śvetā girihvā kiṇihī sitā ca ||75||

div.ab: śleṣmātakītyādi| śleṣmātakī `bahuvāraḥ’ iti loke, kaṭphalaṃ kāśmarī, mātuluṅgo bījapūrakaḥ, śvetā girihvā śvetasyandā, kiṇihī nīlasyandā, sitā śarkarā| ayaṃ darvīkararājilaviṣadaṣṭāgadaḥ||75||-

lg.l: drākṣā sugandhā nagavṛttikā ca śvetā samaṅgā `śvetā ca piṣṭā palikaiśca bhāgaiḥ’ iti pā. samabhāgayuktā ||76||
deyo dvibhāgaḥ surasācchadasya kapitthabilvād api dāḍimāc ca |
tathā'rdhabhāgaḥ `tathā'rdhabhāgo'sitasindhuvārāt’ iti pā. sitasindhuvārād aṅkoṭhamūlād api gairikāc ca ||77||
eṣo 'gadaḥ kṣaudrayuto nihanti viśeṣato maṇḍalināṃ viṣāṇi |78|

div.ab: drākṣetyādi| sugandhā sarpasugandhā nākulīti yāvat, nagavṛttikā śallakī, śvetā śvetasyandaḥ| deyo dvibhāga ityādi| ardhabhāgaḥ ardhapalaṃ sindhuvārādibhyaḥ| kecittu sugandhā nagamṛttiketi paṭhanti, tatrāyamarthaḥ- śobhanagandhavatī parvatasya mṛttikā, parvatamṛttikāyāḥ sāmānyato viṣaharatvāt| sāmānyena sarvatra viṣaharo'yamagadaḥ, viśeṣato maṇḍaliviṣaharo bhavati| ayaṃ tu maṇḍaliviṣaharo nāmāgadaḥ||76-77||-

lg.l: karañjabījaṃ tagaraṃ śirīṣapuṣpaṃ ca gopittayutaṃ nihanti |
kācārmakothān paṭalāṃś ca ghorān puṣpaṃ ca hanty añjananasyayogaiḥ ||80||

ab.seg: vaṃśatvagārdretyādi| vaṃśatvagārdrā ārdravaṃśasya tvak, haimavatī vacā| kothaḥ pūtibhāvaḥ klinnavartmādiṣu| ayaṃ tu sārvakārmiko'gadaḥ||78-80||

lg.l: salāvaṇaḥ kṣaudrayuto 'tha pīto viśeṣataḥ kīṭaviṣaṃ nihanti ||81||

ab.seg: samūlapuṣpāṅkuretyādi| aṅkuro navapatrāṅkuraḥ, pravāla ityarthaḥ| saha lāvaṇena lavaṇasamūhena vartate iti salāvaṇaḥ| kecidīdṛśaṃ paṭhanti- `tvakpatrapuṣpāṇi phalaṃ samūlaṃ piṣṭvā śirīṣasya kaṭutrikaṃ ca| salāvaṇaṃ kṣaudrayutaṃ vilīḍhaṃ viśeṣataḥ kīṭaviṣaṃ nihanti’| ayamagadaḥ pañcaśirīṣanāmā||81||

lg.l: mālatī nāgapuṣpaṃ ca sarvāṇi madhurāṇi ca ||82||
viṣaṃ hanty agadaḥ sarvaṃ mūṣikāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||83||

ab.seg: kuṣṭhaṃ trikaṭukamityādi| lavaṇadvayaṃ saindhavaṃ sauvarcalaṃ ca| mālatī jātī, nāgapuṣpaṃ nāgakeśaraṃ, sarvāṇi madhurāṇi kākolyādīni| ayamapi sārvakāmikanāmā'gadaḥ||82-83||

lg.l: somarājīphalaṃ `somarājīphalaṃ mukhyaṃ kadalī sindhuvārakaḥ’ iti pā. puṣpaṃ kaṭabhī sindhuvārakaḥ |
bhūmī kurabakaś caiva gaṇa ekasaraḥ smṛtaḥ |

ab.seg: somarājīphalamityādi| somarājī bākucī, sindhuvāraḥ śvetapuṣpā nirguṇḍī, corako granthiparṇānukārī, sarpagandhā nākulī, saptalā yavatiktābhedaḥ, śyāmā śyāmalatā, priyaṅgurityanye, ambaṣṭhā pāṭhā, aśmantako vṛkṣo'mloṭakānusārī, bhūmiḥ kṛṣṇamṛttikā, kurabakaḥ snigdhapatraḥ sitakusumaḥ svanāmaprasiddhaḥ| gaṇa ekasaraḥ smṛta iti ayamauṣadhagaṇa ekasaraḥ ekasarasañjñakaḥ smṛtaḥ| ekaśo dvitriśo vā'pi prayoktavyo viṣāpaha iti sa cauṣadhagaṇa ekaikaśaḥ ekamekaṃ dvau dvau trīn trīn vā prayoktavyaḥ, prayuktaśca viṣāpaho bhavati||84-86||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ kalpasthāne sarpadaṣṭaviṣacikitsitaṃ nāma pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||5||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ kalpasthāne pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ||5||
athāto dundubhisvanīyaṃ kalpaṃ `adhyāyaṃ’ iti pā. vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi| dundubhisvano'sminnadhyāye'stīti dundubhisvanīyastaṃ; dundubhiratra nisvānaḥ||1-2||

dhavāśvakarṇaśirīṣatiniśapalāśapicumardapāṭalipāribhadrakāmrodumbarakarahāṭakārjunakakubhasarja- kapītanaśleṣmātakāṅkoṭhāmalakapragrahakuṭajaśamīkapitthāśmantakārkacirabilvamahāvṛkṣāruṣkarāralu- madhukamadhuśigruśākagojīmūrvābhūrjatilvakekṣurakagopaghoṇṭārimedānāṃ bhasmāny āhṛtya gavāṃ mūtreṇa kṣārakalpena parisrāvya vipacet, dadyāc cātra pippalīmūlataṇḍulīyakavarāṅgacocamañjiṣṭhākarañjikāhastipippalīmaricaviḍaṅgagṛhadhūmānantā- somasaralābāhlīkaguhākośāmraśvetasarṣapavaruṇalavaṇaplakṣaniculakavañjulavakrālavardhamānaputraśreṇī- saptaparṇaṭuṇṭukailavālukanāgadantyativiṣābhayābhadradārukuṣṭhaharidrāvacācūrṇāni lohānāṃ ca samabhāgāni, tataḥ kṣāravad āgatapākam avatārya lohakumbhe nidadhyāt ||3||

lg.l: anena dundubhiṃ limpet patākāṃ toraṇāni ca |
śravaṇād darśanāt sparśāt viṣāt `viṣaṃ teṣāṃ praśāmyati’ iti pā. sampratimucyate ||4||
eṣa kṣārāgado nāma śarkarāsv aśmarīṣu ca |
arśaḥsu vātagulmeṣu `arśaḥsu vātaśūle ca śūlagulmodareṣu ca’ iti pā. kāsaśūlodareṣu ca ||5||
ajīrṇe grahaṇīdoṣe bhaktadveṣe `śophe sarvasare tathā’ iti pā. ca dāruṇe |
śophe `aruciśvāsakāseṣu hikkāpāṇḍugadeṣu ca’ iti pā. sarvasare cāpi deyaḥ śvāse ca dāruṇe ||6||

ab.seg: dhavāśvakarṇatiniśetyādi| aśvakarṇaḥ pūrvadeśe prasiddhaḥ, tiniśaḥ syandanaḥ, palāśaḥ kiṃśukaḥ, picumardo nimbaḥ, pāribhadrako raktakusumaḥ kaṇṭakī phalabhadrākhyaḥ, arjunaḥ svanāmaprasiddho vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, kakubhaḥ sugandhamūlo viṭapaviśeṣaḥ, sarjakaḥ svanāmaprasiddho vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, kapītano gardabhāṇḍaḥ, śleṣmātako bahuvāraḥ, pragrahaḥ kiramālakaḥ, mahāvṛkṣaḥ sehuṇḍaḥ, aruṣkaro bhallātakaḥ, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu, madhuśigruḥ śākaviṭapaḥ, raktaśobhāñjanaka ityapare, śāko mahāpatraḥ `śrīparṇa’ iti loke, gojī gojihvā, ikṣurakaḥ kokilākṣakaḥ, gopaghoṇṭā karkoṭī, arimedo rāmakaḥ; eṣāṃ dhavādīnāmarimedāntānāṃ samūladalakāṇḍaśākhānāṃ samena bhāgena gṛhītānāṃ bhasmānyāhṛtya gavāṃ mūtreṇa kṣāraṣaḍguṇena kṣārakalpena parisrāvya ekaviṃśativārān gālayitvetyarthaḥ, vipacet sādhayet, tāvadyāvadaccho raktaḥ picchilaśca bhavati| dadyāccātretyādi| mūlaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ, varāṅgaṃ vanavāsikātvak, cocaṃ dvitīyā sthūlā tvak yāṃ śālmalakamityācakṣate, karañjikā naktamālaḥ, anantā utpalasārivā, somaḥ somavalkaḥ kaṭphalākhyaḥ, bāhlīkaṃ kuṅkumaṃ, guhā śālaparṇī, plakṣaḥ parkaṭī, niculako jalavetasaḥ, vakraṃ tagaraṃ, ālaṃ haritālaṃ, vardhamāna eraṇḍaḥ, putraśreṇī dravantī, ṭuṇṭukaḥ śyonākaḥ, elavālukaḥ svanāmaprasiddhaḥ, nāgadantī indravāruṇībhedaḥ, jejjaṭācāryamate tu dantī; eṣāṃ pippalyādīnāṃ cūrṇāni lohānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ yathālābhaṃ kṣārodakāt triṃśattamabhāgena, atra asmin kṣārodake, dadyāt nikṣipedityarthaḥ| tadanu punarvipaced yāvannātidravaṃ nātisāndraṃ ca bhavati| gayadāsastu śirīṣapicumardakakubhāruṣkaramadhukekṣurakān parityajya triṃśadeva paṭhati; pippalyādiṣvāvāpeṣu ca maricasomaguhālavaṇavakrālān parityajya triṃśaddravyāṇi paṭhati||3-7||
viḍaṅgatriphaletyādi| idaṃ kalyāṇakaṃ ghṛtaṃ bhūtavidyāyāṃ paṭhitatvāt kecinna paṭhanti||8-11||

lg.l: śvete dve kākamācīṃ ca gavāṃ mūtreṇa peṣayet ||12||
sarpir etais tu saṃsiddhaṃ viṣasaṃśamanaṃ param |
amṛtaṃ nāma vikhyātam api sañjīvayen mṛtam ||13||

ab.seg: apāmārgasyetyādi| śirīṣasya ca māṣakāniti māṣakā iva māṣakāḥ tān, bījānītyarthaḥ| śvete dve iti śvetā mahāśvetā ca kaṭabhīdvayamityarthaḥ; anye tu śvete dve śvetasyandaḥ śvetavaceti bhāṣante| atra śrutatvād ghṛtād gomūtraṃ caturguṇaṃ deyam||12-13||

lg.l: prapauṇḍarīkaṃ `prapauṇḍarīkaṃ yaṣṭayāhvaṃ naladaṃ devadāru ca’ iti pā. naladaṃ saralaṃ devadāru ca ||14||
kāleyakaṃ padmakaṃ ca madhukaṃ nāgaraṃ `saralaṃ’ iti pā. jaṭām ||15||
kaṭutrikaṃ `śrīparṇikāṃ śītaśivaṃ trikaṭuṃ kaṭurohiṇīm’ iti pā. śītaśivaṃ kāśmaryaṃ kaṭurohiṇīm |
somarājīm ativiṣāṃ pṛthvikām indravāruṇīm `indrajān yavān’ iti pā.||18||
uśīraṃ varuṇaṃ mustaṃ kustumburu nakhaṃ tathā |
śvete haridre sthauṇeyaṃ lākṣāṃ ca lavaṇāni ca ||19||
kusumaṃ tṛṇamūlyāś ca surabhīsindhuvārajam `surasyāstṛṇaśūnyāśca sindhuvārasya yāni ca’ iti pā.||21||
etat sambhṛtya sambhāraṃ sūkṣmacūrṇāni `vidhivatsūkṣmacūrṇitam’ iti pā. kārayet |
anenāgadamukhyena manuṣyaṃ `cikitseddhi viṣāturam’ iti pā. punar āharet ||24||
viṣaṃ nāgapater hanyāt prasabhaṃ vāsuker api ||25||
rājā 'gadānāṃ sarveṣāṃ rājño haste bhavet sadā ||26||
snātānuliptas tu `tenānuliptastu’ iti pā. nṛpo bhavet sarvajanapriyaḥ |
bhrājiṣṇutāṃ ca labhate `tejasvitāṃ samāpnoti’ iti pā. śatrumadhyagato 'pi san ||27||

ab.seg: candanāguruṇītyādi| tilaparṇikaṃ `hulahula’ iti loke, gayī tu tailaparṇikaḥ saralarasaḥ navanītakhoṭiriti prasiddhaḥ, naladam uśīrabhedaḥ lāmajjakaṃ, bhadraśriyaṃ śvetacandanaṃ, yavaphalā dugdhikā, nīlī nīlāñjanikā śāradaṃ phalaṃ, sugandhikā sarpasugandhā, kāleyakaṃ pītacandanaṃ, jaṭā dvitīyā māṃsī, punnāgaḥ svanāmaprasiddhaḥ, elā sthūlailā, elavālukaṃ svanāmaprasiddhaṃ, dhyāmakaṃ kattṛṇaṃ, toyaṃ bālakaṃ, hareṇuḥ reṇukā, kṣudrailā sūkṣmailā, kuṭannaṭaḥ vanyakaḥ, `phañjīmadanaka’ iti loke, śilāpuṣpaṃ śilā manaḥśilā, puṣpaṃ puṣpakāsīsaṃ, kālānusārivā tagarabhedaḥ, kāśmarī śrīparṇī, śītaśīvaṃ karpūraṃ, śamītyapare, somarājī bākucī, pṛthvikā śyāmavarṇaḥ sthūlajīrakaḥ, hiṅgupatriketyapare, śvete iti kaṭabhīdvayaṃ, śvetāmiti kecit paṭhanti tatra śvetā vacā, sthauṇeyaṃ granthiparṇakaṃ, lavaṇāni pañcaiva, prasavaśabdenātra kusumāni phalāni ca grāhyāṇi prasavasyobhayavācitvāt, tṛṇaśūnyāḥ ketakyāḥ, mallikāyā ityapare, surasīsindhuvārābhyāṃ jātaṃ kusumamityarthaḥ, sindhuvāro nirguṇḍībhedaḥ, aśvakarṇaḥ sarjabhedaḥ, tiniśaḥ syandanaḥ, bimbī kundurikā, sarpākṣī raktapuṣpā pūrvadeśe prasiddhā, gandhanākulī sugandhamūlā rāsnā, śilāpuṣpamityatra tilapuṣpamiti kecit paṭhanti tacca prasiddhaṃ, tanmate śṛṅgeṇādhāreṇa pañcāśītiḥ pūryate| aṣṭau lavaṇānīti jejjaṭācāryaḥ, tannecchati gayī, yataḥ pañcāśīteraṅgānāmādhikyaṃ syāt| `kumudotpalapadmāni puṣpaṃ vā'pi tathā'rkajaṃ’ ityatra sthāne `pāṭalākāśmarīśeluśirīṣaprasavāni ca’ iti gayadāsācāryaḥ paṭhati| eṣo'gnikalpamityādi| eṣaḥ agadaḥ, agnikalpaṃ durvāraṃ viṣaṃ vāsukerapi kruddhasya amitatejaso nāgapateḥ prasabhaṃ haṭhena hanyāditi sambandhaḥ| rājā'gadānāṃ sarveṣāṃ rājño haste bhavet sadeti yato'yaṃ sarvāgadānāṃ rājā ata eva rājño haste sadā nityaṃ bhavitumarhati; tena hastasthitāgadena pāṇinā spṛṣṭamannapānaṃ nirviṣaṃ bhavati; hastasthāpanaprayojanamidam| snātānulipta ityādi| snānānulepanābhyāṃ vaśīkaraṇam||14-27||
viṣārtānāṃ śodhanāṅgatvenāpi svedo na kriyata ityarthamāha- uṣṇavarjya ityādi||28||

lg.l: śubhaṃ deyaṃ viṣārtebhyo viruddhebhyaś ca vārayet ||29||
divāsvapnaṃ vyavāyaṃ ca vyāyāmaṃ krodham ātapam |

ab.seg: upadhārya jñātvetyarthaḥ, śubhāśubhaṃ hitāhitaṃ, vārayedviṣārtāneva| phāṇitamityādi| kulatthāṃścetyatra cakāreṇa piṇyākamūlakalasunakalāyakusumbhātasīśiśumārakūrmaniṣpāvajambvāmrātakacūtādikāni ca varjayet||29-31||

lg.l: prasannadoṣaṃ prakṛtisthadhātum annābhikāṅkṣaṃ `annābhikāmaṃ’ iti pā. samasūtrajihvam |
prasannavarṇendriyacittaceṣṭaṃ `prasannakāyendriyavarṇaceṣṭaṃ vaidyastu vidyādaviṣaṃ manuṣyam’ iti pā. vaidyo 'vagacched aviṣaṃ manuṣyam ||32||

ab.seg: aviṣaśca kīdṛśa ityāha- prasannadoṣamityādi| prasannadoṣaṃ svabhāvāvasthitavātādikaṃ, prakṛtisthadhātuṃ dadhatīti dhātavo rasādayo malāśca| annābhikāṅkṣaṃ bhojanābhilāṣiṇaṃ, etena samāgnitvamuktam| samasūtrajihvamiti samasūtrā jihvā yasya sa tathā tam| etaduktaṃ bhavati- nirviṣasya hi puruṣasya cittena saha samasūtratayā `samastaceṣṭāyāṃ’ iti pā. jihvā rasavedinī bhavati, saviṣasya viṣaprabhāveṇa dūṣitacittatvājjihvā rasavedinī na bhavatītyarthaḥ| anena ślokena `samadoṣaḥ samāgniśca’ ityādiślokasya sarva evārtho nibaddhaḥ| vaidyo'vagacchedaviṣaṃ manuṣyamiti uktalakṣaṇaḥ puruṣo'viṣo bhavati, viparītalakṣaṇastu viṣāturaḥ| tathā hi,- “pravṛddhadoṣaṃ vikṛtisthadhātumanannakāṅkṣaṃ kṣatasūtrajihvam| viruddhavarṇendriyacittaceṣṭaṃ vaidyo'vagacchet saviṣaṃ manuṣyam”- iti| `samamūtraviṭkaṃ’ iti kecit paṭhanti, tacca subodham| idaṃ saviṣāviṣalakṣaṇaṃ tīkṣṇatame sthāvaraviṣe sarpadaṣṭe ca draṣṭavyaṃ, natu mandaviṣe cireṇa dhātudūṣaṇakare mūṣikaviṣe kīṭaviṣeṣu ca; ata evottaratra mūṣikakīṭavikalpāviti| jejjaṭastu mūṣikakalpānantaraṃ dundubhisvanīyaṃ kalpaṃ paṭhati||32||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ kalpasthāne dundubhisvanīyakalpo nāma ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ ||6||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ kalpasthāne ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ||6||

div.head: mūṣikakalpaḥ

ab.seg: athāto mūṣikakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi||1-2||

lg.l: pūrvaṃ śukraviṣā uktā mūṣikā ye samāsataḥ |
nāmalakṣaṇabhaiṣajyair aṣṭādaśa nibodha me `tān’ iti pā.||3||
lālanaḥ putrakaḥ kṛṣṇo haṃsiraś cikvi(kki)ras tathā |
kuliṅgaś cājitaś caiva capalaḥ kapilas tathā kokilo 'ruṇasañjñaś ca mahākṛṣṇas tathonduraḥ ||5||

ab.seg: tānevāṣṭādaśabhedān nirdiśannāha- lālana ityādi||3-6||

lg.l: śukraṃ patati yatraiṣāṃ śukraspṛṣṭaiḥ `śukraghṛṣṭaiḥ’ iti pā. spṛśanti vā |

ab.seg: nanu `daṣṭarūpaṃ samāsoktaṃ’ iti vakṣyati tatkathaṃ śukraviṣatvamevetyāha- śukramityādi| nakhadantādibhirityādiśabdāt purīṣamūtrābhyāṃ ca; tathā cālambāyane,- “śukreṇātha purīṣeṇa mūtreṇāpi nakhaistathā| daṃṣṭrābhirvā kṣipantīha `vamantīha’ iti pā. mūṣikāḥ pañcadhā viṣam”- iti| kasmiṃścittantrāntare viśeṣo'sti, tathā ca,- “garbhiṇyā mūṣikayā daṣṭe amlādidohadaḥ, ṛtumatyā daṣṭe raktamehanamādhmānaṃ ratiśīlatā ca” ityādi||7||

lg.l: jāyante granthayaḥ śophāḥ karṇikā maṇḍalāni ca |
parvabhedo rujas tīvrā mūrcchā 'ṅgasadanaṃ `jvaro mūrcchā ca dāruṇā’ iti pā. jvaraḥ |
daṣṭarūpaṃ samāsoktam etad vyāsam ataḥ ‘... metacca vyāsataḥ śṛṇu’ iti pā. śṛṇu |10|

div.ab: sāmānyaṃ mūṣikadaṣṭalakṣaṇamabhidhātumāha- jāyante granthaya ityādi| karṇikā kamalamadhyabījakośākṛtiḥ| parvabhedaḥ sandheḥ sphoṭaḥ| aṅgasadanam aṅgaglāniḥ||8-9||-

lg.l: lālāsrāvo lālanena hikkā chardiś ca jāyate `chardayate’ iti pā.||10||

div.ab: teṣāṃ viśiṣṭaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ cikitsitaṃ ca nirdiśannāha- lālāsrāva ityādi| lālāsrāvacchardihikkā vātakopajā bhavanti| taṇḍulīyakakalkādikaṃ vyādhipratyanīkaṃ cikitsitaṃ, doṣapratyanīkaṃ tu sāmānyacikitsitoktaṃ `taptaghṛtena dagdhvā visrāvayeddaṃśaṃ’ ityādikam; evamanyatrāpi vyādhidoṣapratyanīkaṃ cikitsitaṃ svayamūhanīyaṃ; pratimūṣikoktaṃ tu cikitsitaṃ prāyo vyādhipratyanīkameva||10||-

ab.seg: putrakeṇāṅgetyādi| ākhuśāvakasannibhairmūṣikaputrakatulyairgranthibhiraṅgaṃ cīyate vyāpyata ityarthaḥ| ākhuśāvakanibhā granthayaḥ sarvamūṣikadaṃśeṣu jāyante viśeṣeṇa putrakadaṣṭe| nāgārjuno'trāha,- “tena darśayate daṣṭo vyaktaṃ mūṣikaputrakān| etat putrakadaṣṭasya vyaktaṃ bhavati lakṣaṇam”- iti| `śirīṣeṅgudacūrṇaṃ tu’ iti paṭhitvā gayadāsaḥ anayoḥ patracūrṇamiti vyākhyānayati; jejjaṭācāryastu `śirīṣaphalakalkaṃ tu’ iti paṭhati||11-12||

lg.l: kṛṣṇena `kṛṣṇenāsṛk chardayati durdineṣu viśeṣataḥ’ iti pā. daṃśe śopho 'sṛkchardiḥ prāyaś ca durdine |

ab.seg: kṛṣṇenetyādi| granthyādīnyatrāpi sāmānyamūṣikalakṣaṇāni vijñeyāni; evaṃ sarvatronneyam| prāyaśceti vacanādanyatrāpyasṛkcchardiḥ| kiṃśukabhasmanā kiṃśukakusumabhasmodakenetyarthaḥ||13||

lg.l: pibed āragvadhādiṃ tu suvāntas tatra mānavaḥ ||14||

ab.seg: haṃsireṇetyādi| suvāntaḥ suṣṭhu vāntaḥ||14||

lg.l: cikvi(kki)reṇa śiroduḥkhaṃ śopho hikkā vamis tathā |

div.ab: cikvireṇetyādi| jālinī kośātakī, ṛṣabhī kapikacchuḥ, bṛhatyośceti cakāreṇa kṣāramityatrāpi sambandhanīyam| kṣāraścātra kṣārodakam| gayadāsastu `jālinīmadanāṅkoṭha’ ityādisthāne `suvānto jālinīkvāthaiḥ sāramaṅkoṭhajaṃ pibet’ iti paṭhati na yavanālādi||15||-

lg.l: chucchundareṇa `chucchundareṇa viḍbhaṅgo grīvāstambho vijṛmbhaṇam| yavanālarṣabhakṣāraṃ bṛhatyoścātra dāpayet’ iti pā. tṛṭ chardir jvaro daurbalyam eva ca ||16||
cavyaṃ harītakī śuṇṭhī viḍaṅgaṃ pippalī madhu ||17||
aṅkoṭhabījaṃ ca tathā pibed atra viṣāpaham |18|

div.ab: chucchundareṇetyādi| chucchundaradaṣṭalakṣaṇaṃ taccikitsitaṃ ca gayadāso'nyathā paṭhati; yathā- “bhramaśchucchundareṇogro grīvāstambho visūcikā| yavanālarṣabhīkṣāraṃ bṛhatyoścātra dāpayet” iti||16-17||-

lg.l: nidrā kaṣāyadantena hṛcchoṣaḥ kārśyam eva ca ||19||
kuliṅgena rujaḥ `rujā srāvo’ iti pā. śopho rājyaś ca daṃśamaṇḍale ||20||
sahe sasindhuvāre ca lihyāt tatra samākṣike |21|

div.ab: grīvāstambha ityādi| sahe mudgaparṇīmāṣaparṇyau||18-20||-

lg.l: ajitenāṅgakṛṣṇatvaṃ `ajitena vamirmūrcchā hṛdgrahaḥ kṛṣṇanetratā’ iti pā. chardir mūrcchā ca hṛdgrahaḥ ||21||

div.ab: ajitenetyādi| pālindī trivṛt||21||-

lg.l: capalena bhavec chardir mūrcchā ca saha tṛṣṇayā ||22||
kṣaudreṇa kṣaudreṇalihyāttriphalāṃ’ iti pā. triphalāṃ lihyād bhadrakāṣṭhajaṭānvitām |23|

div.ab: capalenetyādi| bhadrakāṣṭhaṃ devadāru, jaṭā jaṭāmāṃsī| `jaṭānvitāṃ’ ityatra `ghanānvitām’ iti kecit||22||-

lg.l: kapilena vraṇe kotho jvaro granthy udgamaḥ satṛṭ ||23||
lihyān madhuyutāṃ `kṣaudreṇa lihyāntriphalāṃ’ iti pā. śvetāṃ śvetāṃ cāpi punarnavām |
granthayaḥ kokilenogrā jvaro dāhaś ca dāruṇaḥ `jāyate’ iti pā.||24||

ab.seg: kapilenetyādi| kothaḥ pūtiprādurbhāvaḥ| śvetāṃ śvetasyandāṃ, `śvetāṃ’ ityatra gayadāsaḥ `śreṣṭhāṃ’ iti paṭhati||23-24||

lg.l: mahākṛṣṇena pittaṃ ca śvetena kapha eva ca |
mahatā kapilenāsṛk kapotena `kapotenaiva tu trayam’ iti pā. catuṣṭayam ||26||
niṣkvāthya caiṣāṃ kvāthasya caturtho ṃ'śaḥ punar bhavet |
kapitthadāḍimatvak ca ślakṣṇapiṣṭāḥ `supiṣṭāni prayojayet’ iti pā. pradāpayet |
tat sarvam ekataḥ kṛtvā śanair mṛdv agninā pacet ||30||
sirāś ca srāvayet `mokṣayet’ iti pā. prāptāḥ kuryāt saṃśodhanāni ca |32|

div.ab: dadhyādīni prasthamātrāṇi, karañjādidravyāṇāṃ dvipalikaṃ bhāgaṃ, salilāḍhakena niṣkvāthya, kvathitaṃ prasthaśeṣaṃ, taistribhiḥ prasthaiḥ saha saṃyojya, trivṛnmūlādikalkapādaṃ ca vipacet; pakvaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ virecanaṃ bhavati| aṃśumatī śālaparṇī, gojī gojihvā, amṛtā guḍūcī, vakraṃ tagaraṃ, sarpagandhā sarpacchatrikā| samṛttikāḥ sakṛṣṇamṛttikāḥ, `ahimṛttikā’ iti kecit paṭhanti, atrāhimṛttikā valmīkamṛttikā; `agavṛttikā’ iti jejjaṭācāryaḥ paṭhati, tatrāgavṛttikā śallakī| dvitīyaṃ ghṛtamāha- kākādanītyādi| kākādanī kṛṣṇaśrīphalikā, kṛtaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ, ghṛtamiti śeṣaḥ| sirā ityādi| prāptā yuktā marmānāśritāḥ| saṃśodhanāni vamanādīni nasyaparyantāni, tānyapi prāptāni; tenāvamyāvirecyayoravarodhaḥ| anye tu viṣāturā avamyā api vamyā eva, `ete'pyajīrṇavyathitā vāmyā ye ca viṣāturā’ iti||25-31||-

lg.l: sarveṣāṃ ca vidhiḥ kāryo mūṣikāṇāṃ viṣeṣv ayam ||32||

ab.seg: aruṇādyāśritaṃ sirāvyadhādikaṃ sāmānyataḥ sarvatrātidiśannāha- sarveṣāmityādi| ayaṃ vidhiḥ sirāvyadhādikaḥ kartavya ityarthaḥ||32||

lg.l: dagdhvā visrāvayed daṃśaṃ pracchitaṃ ca pralepayet |

ab.seg: dagdhvetyādi| dagdhvā `ghṛtenāgnitaptena’ iti śeṣaḥ| visrāvayet pracchannena pracchitaṃ daṃśam| śirīṣādibhiḥ kalkairālepayet| tathaiva kecit pracchitaṃ daṃśaṃ visrāvayecchoṇitaṃ śirīṣādikalkairālepayeccetyāhuḥ||33||

div.ab: śodhanaṃ sūtritaṃ dravyairvivṛṇvannāha- chardanamityādi| śukākhyaḥ carmakāravaṭaḥ||34||-

lg.l: śukākhyākoṣavatyoś ca mūlaṃ madana eva ca |
devadālīphalaṃ caiva dadhnā pītvā viṣaṃ vamet |
pūrvakalpena yojyāḥ `yojyaṃ syātsarvonduraviṣacchidi iti pā. syuḥ sarvonduruviṣacchidaḥ ||36||

ab.seg: aparāvapi vamanayogāvāha- śukākhyetyādi| koṣavatī ghoṣakaḥ| mūlamityatra phalamityanye| phalamityādi| pūrvakalpena dadhnā lehamityarthaḥ||34-36||

div.ab: virecanamāha- virecane ityādi| dantīsthāne kecinnīlīṃ paṭhanti|37|
śirovirecane ityādi| sāraḥ śirīṣasya, gayadāsastu śālatamālamadhūkānāmāha| phalāni ceti śirīṣasyeti sambandhaḥ| trikaṭukāḍhyaḥ trikaṭukotkaṭa ityarthaḥ| etacca yogāntaram||37||-

lg.l: kapitthagomayarasau `kapitthagomayarasaḥ sakṣaudro leha iṣyate’ iti pā. lihyān mākṣikasaṃyutau ||38||

ab.seg: saṃśamanayogānāha- kapitthetyādi| pratyekaṃ kapittharaso gomayarasaśca samadhurlehaḥ| rasāñjanetyādi| kaṭvī kaṭurohiṇī| taṇḍulīyaketyādi| kapitthaphalamūlapuṣpatvakpatrakalkakaṣāyasiddhaṃ pañcakāpitthaṃ ghṛtaṃ sarvamūṣikaviṣaharam||38-40||

lg.l: mūṣikāṇāṃ viṣaṃ prāyaḥ kupyaty abhreṣv anirhṛtam `abhreṣu nirhṛtaṃ’iti pā.|
tatrāpy eṣa vidhiḥ kāryo yaś ca dūṣīviṣāpahaḥ ||41||

ab.seg: praśāntakopasyāpyavaśyaṃ vamanādiśodhanaṃ karaṇīyamiti darśayannāha- mūṣikāṇāmityādi| eṣa vidhiḥ vamanavirecanaśirovirecananayanāñjanādiḥ| yaśca dūṣīviṣāpaho vidhiḥ so'pyatra kāryaḥ; etena dūṣīviṣatulyatā mūṣikaviṣasyoktā||41||

lg.l: sthirāṇāṃ rujatāṃ vā 'pi vraṇānāṃ karṇikāṃ bhiṣak |

ab.seg: idānīmākhuviṣavraṇe karṇikā bhavanti tathā'nyaviṣaduṣṭavraṇe'pi, taccikitsāmuddiśannāha- sthirāṇāmityādi| sthairyeṇa kaphātmakatā, rujatāmityanena vātātmakatā vraṇānāmuktā| karṇikāṃ māṃsakarṇīkam| pāṭayitvā vidārya, pāṭayitvetyatra pācayitveti kecit, pātayitvetyapare| lālanaputrakādimūṣikajātiviśeṣajñānaṃ nānādeśīyalokebhyo'vagantavyam||42||

lg.l: atyarthabadhiro 'ndhaś ca `avyaktabadhirāndhaśca’ iti pā. so 'nyonyam abhidhāvati ||44||
suptatā jāyate daṃśe kṛṣṇaṃ cātisravaty asṛk ||45||
