div.ab: idānīṃ mūṣakasya `mūṣakatva...’ iti pā. catuṣpadajarāyujahiṃsratvasāmānyācchvādīnāṃ viṣaṃ lakṣaṇacikitsitairuddiśannāha- śvaśṛgālatarakṣvṛkṣetyādi| śvā kukkuraḥ, śṛgālaḥ prasiddhaḥ, tarakṣuḥ mṛgaśatrurvyāghraviśeṣaḥ `jarakha’ iti loke, ṛkṣo bhallūko'tilomaśaḥ `rīccha’ iti prasiddhaḥ; ādiśabdādvṛkacitrakādayo hiṃsrāḥ paśavo grāhyāḥ| śvādīnāṃ yadā'nilo vāyuḥ śleṣmapraduṣṭaḥ san, sañjñāvahāśrito sañjñāvahasrotogataḥ, sañjñāṃ samyagjñānaṃ, muṣṇāti harati| samyagjñānaharaṇācca kīdṛśo bhavatītyāha- tadetyādi| prasrastaṃ sthānacyutaṃ lāṅgūlaṃ bāladhirmehanaṃ vā hanuḥ skandhaśca yasya saḥ; prasrastaśabdo lāṅgūlādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambandhanīyaḥ| atilālavān atiśayena lālāsrāvayuktaḥ| atyarthabadhiro'ndhaśca `avyaktabadhirāndhaśca na vyakto badhiro'ndho vetyarthaḥ’ iti pā. atiśayena badhiro'ndho vetyarthaḥ| anyonyamabhidhāvati parasparaṃ daṣṭumabhidhāvati| hanuskandhasthāne `galaskandha `stanaskandha’ iti pā. ’ iti kecit paṭhanti| `pramūḍho'nyatamasteṣāṃ khādan viparidhāvati’ iti atra uttarārdhaṃ kecit paṭhanti| eṣāṃ madhye'nyatama ekatamaḥ pramūḍhaḥ san khādan viśeṣeṇa paridhāvati| tenonmattena daṣṭasyetyādi| tena daṃṣṭriṇā saviṣeṇonmattena daṣṭasya puruṣasya daṃśe suptatā bādhirya jāyate| upalakṣito yukta ityarthaḥ||43-45||-

lg.l: yena cāpi bhaved daṣṭas tasya ceṣṭāṃ rutaṃ naraḥ ||46||

div.ab: atraivāriṣṭamuddiśannāha- yena cāpi bhavedityādi| ceṣṭā kriyā, rutaṃ śabdaḥ, bahuśaḥ anekavāraṃ, pratikurvāṇaḥ anukurvan, kriyāhīnaḥ svakīyakāyādivyāpārarahitaḥ||46||-

lg.l: daṃṣṭriṇā yena daṣṭaś ca tad rūpaṃ yas tu paśyati ||47||
apsu `apsu vā''darśabimbe vā tasya tadriṣṭamādiśet’ iti pā. vā yadi vā''darśe 'riṣṭaṃ tasya vinirdiśet |48|

div.ab: idānīmaparamapyariṣṭaṃ nirdiśannāha- daṃṣṭriṇā yenetyādi| taddaṃṣṭrirūpadarśanamariṣṭaṃ maraṇalakṣaṇam||47||-

lg.l: trasyaty akasmād yo 'bhīkṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā `śrutvā dṛṣṭvā'pi’ iti pā. spṛṣṭvā 'pi vā jalam ||48||
jalatrāsaṃ tu vidyāt taṃ riṣṭaṃ tad api `tamapi kīrtayet’ iti pā. kīrtitam |49|

div.ab: punaraparamapyariṣṭaṃ nirdiśannāha- trasyatītyādi| akasmāt jalatrāsahetuṃ vinā| apiśabdācchrutvā'pi| jalatrāsaṃ jalatrāsarogaṃ jānīyāttasyeti sambandhaḥ| riṣṭamityādi| tadapi jalatrasanamariṣṭaṃ maraṇalakṣaṇaṃ kīrtitaṃ; etaccāriṣṭaṃ daṣṭasya, adaṣṭe jalatrasanāriṣṭasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt| atrārthe tantrāntaram,- “vyādhitena śvādinā daṣṭasya śleṣmā prakupitaścetovāhinīrdhamanīranupraviśya sañjñānāśamāpādayati sadyaḥ kālāntarādvā”; avabhṛte viśeṣataḥ- “tato naraḥ spṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā śrutvā vā jalaṃ trasyati, tasyāpi tadariṣṭaṃ jānīyāt” iti| gayadāsastu `yadi trasyatyadaṣṭo'pi’ ityādi paṭhati||48||-

lg.l: adaṣṭo vā jalatrāsī na kathañcana sidhyati ||49||
prasupto 'thotthito vā 'pi svasthas trasto na sidhyati |50|

div.ab: evamadaṣṭasyāpi jalatrāso'riṣṭameveti darśayannāha- adaṣṭa ityādi| asminnarthe tantrāntaram,- “adaṣṭasyāpi jantorhi jalatrāso bhavedyadi| tasya riṣṭaṃ hi bhiṣajo bruvate viṣacintakāḥ” iti| jalaṃ vinā'pi jalatrāso jāyate śleṣmasañcayāt| tathā coktaṃ,- “buddhisthānaṃ yadā śleṣmā kevalaṃ `kevalaḥ’ iti pā. pratipadyate| tadā buddhau niruddhāyāṃ śleṣmaṇā'dhiṣṭhito naraḥ|jāgrat supto'thavā''tmānaṃ majjantamiva manyate| salile trasyati tadā jalatrāsaṃ tu taṃ viduḥ|| śleṣmaghnaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ śodhanaṃ śamanāni ca| āhārasya vidhānena yāvat sa prakṛtiṃ vrajet”- iti| ayaṃ jalatrāsaḥ kupitakaphasya bhavatīti riṣṭaṃ na bhavati, ata evātra cikitsopadeśaḥ, daṣṭasya tu riṣṭameva| tathā svasthasya suptasya jāgrato vā jalamantareṇa trāso'riṣṭameveti darśayannāha- prasupto'thotthito vā'pītyādi||49||-

lg.l: daṃśaṃ visrāvya tair daṣṭe sarpiṣā paridāhitam ||50||
pradihyād agadaiḥ, sarpiḥ purāṇaṃ pāyayeta ca |
arkakṣīrayutaṃ hy asya `vā'pi dadyādāśu’ iti pā. dadyāc cāpi viśodhanam ||51||
palalaṃ tilatailaṃ ca rūpikāyāḥ payo guḍaḥ ||52||

div.ab: idānīṃ cikitsāvasaraḥ- daṃśaṃ visrāvyetyādi| visrāvya niṣpīḍanena srāvayitvā bījabhūtasya viṣasya nāśanārthaṃ, sarpiṣā dāhastu taccheṣanāśanārtham| agadaiḥ mahāgadādibhiḥ, pradihyāt limpet| visrāvitaśoṇitasya vātaśamanārthaṃ bāhyamauṣadhamuddiśyābhyantaramuddiśannāha- sarpirityādi| viśodhanaṃ viśodhanadravyaṃ, tatra kaphādhikye vamanadravyayutaṃ pittādhikye virecanadravyayutamarkakṣīraṃ dadyāt| jejjaṭastu `arkakṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ vā'sya’ iti paṭhati| anye `dadyācchīrṣavirecanaṃ’ iti paṭhanti| śvetāmityādi|- śvetāmiti punarnavāviśeṣaṇam; anye śvetāṃ kaṭabhīmāhuḥ| dhattūrakāyutāṃ dhattūramūlānvitām| gayī tu `dhattūrārdhasamāyutām’ iti paṭhitvā, dhattūramūlasyārdhena yutāmiti vyākhyānayati| anye tu dhattūraphalasaṃyutāmityāhuḥ||50-52||-

lg.l: karoti śvavikārāṃs tu `karotyanyān vikārāṃstu’ iti pā. tasmiñ jīryati cauṣadhe ||55||
kupyet svayaṃ viṣaṃ yasya na sa jīvati mānavaḥ ||58||
tasmāt prakopayed āśu svayaṃ yāvat `yāvanna kupyati’ iti pā. prakupyati |59|

div.ab: mūlamityādi| dhattūrakārdhikamiti dhattūrakajaṭāyāḥ karṣārdhaṃ deyam| unmattakasya patraistvityādi| dhattūrakasya sapta parṇāni grāhyāṇi, tantrāntaradarśanāt| tasya bhakṣitasya jaraṇakāle yogaprabhavādāturaḥ kukkuraceṣṭā eva karoti| auṣadhapariṇatikāle yāṃśca vikārānāturaḥ karoti teṣu pratīkāramāha- vikārā ityādi| vikārā unmattaśvādidaṣṭotpannāḥ| śiśire śītale vārivivarjite gṛhe yāpyāḥ śamanīyāḥ `gamanīyāḥ’ iti pā.| tata ityādi| kṣīreṇoṣṇena bhojayediti annaṃ gavyenājye(je)na vā bhojayediti gayadāsācāryaḥ| eṣa vidhiḥ śvetāṃ punarnavāmityādikaḥ| ardhamātrayā prāguktamātrātaḥ| kasmādeṣa vidhiḥ kāryo dinatraye pañcame vetyāha- kupyedityādi||53-58||-

lg.l: snāpayet taṃ nadītīre samantrair vā catuṣpathe |
baliṃ nivedya tatrāpi piṇyākaṃ palalaṃ dadhi ||60||
mālyāni ca vicitrāṇi māṃsaṃ pakvāmakaṃ tathā |
alarkajuṣṭam etan me nirviṣaṃ kuru mā cirāt |62|

div.ab: idānīmalarkaviṣe bhūtānubandho bhavatīti taccikitsārthaṃ savidhivaidikaṃ mantramuddiśannāha- bījaratnauṣadhītyādi| tamalarkajuṣṭam alarkaviṣajuṣṭam| piṇyākaḥ tilakhalī, palalaḥ sasnehastilakalkaḥ| alakāyā nagaryā adhipatiḥ dhanadaḥ, yakṣo devayoniḥ, sārameyagaṇādhipaḥ kukkurasamūhapatiḥ, tasya sambodhane| alakādhipatiryakṣa eva sārameyagaṇādhipatiḥ| alarkaṃ unmattakukkuraḥ||59-61||-

lg.l: dadyāt saṃśodhanaṃ tīkṣṇam evaṃ snātasya `tīkṣṇamajasraṃ tasya’ iti pā. dehinaḥ ||62||
aśuddhasya surūḍhe 'pi vraṇe kupyati tad viṣam |63|

div.ab: dadyādityādi||62||-

lg.l: śvādayo 'bhihitā vyālā ye 'tra `vātapittaprakopaṇāḥ’ iti pā. daṃṣṭrāviṣā mayā ||63||
ataḥ karoti daṣṭas tu teṣāṃ ceṣṭāṃ rutaṃ naraḥ |
bahuśaḥ pratikurvāṇo na cirān mriyate ca saḥ ||64||

ab.seg: idānīmunmattaśvādiviṣaṃ pratipādayitumunmattavyālānāmunmattatāsūcakaśvaprakāreṇābhihitatvamāha- śvādayo'bhihitā vyālā ityādi| ye'tra daṃṣṭrāviṣā vyālāḥ te śvādayaḥ śvaprakārā unmattaśvasadṛśā mayā pratipāditāḥ, te tu vātapittaprakopaṇadaṃśāsṛkkṛṣṇatvena `daṃśadeśakṛṣṇatvena’ iti pā. purāṇasarpiḥpānena cānumitāḥ||63-64||

lg.l: nakhadantakṣataṃ vyālair yat kṛtaṃ tad vimardayet |
siñcet tailena koṣṇena te hi vātaprakopakāḥ ||65||

ab.seg: unmattaśvādicikitsitaṃ sahetukaṃ darśayannāha- nakhadantakṣatamityādi||65||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ kalpasthāne mūṣikakalpo nāma saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||7||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne saptamo'dhyāyaḥ||7||

div.head: kīṭakalpaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ kīṭakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

lg.l: vāyvagnyambuprakṛtayaḥ kīṭās tu vividhāḥ `trividhāḥ’ iti pā. smṛtāḥ ||3||
kīṭatve 'pi sughorāḥ `sughorāste’ iti pā. syuḥ, sarva eva caturvidhāḥ ||4||

ab.seg: tatra kīṭān hetulakṣaṇasaṅkhyākarmacikitsitairnirdiśannāha- sarpāṇāmityādi| sarpāṇāṃ darvīkaramaṇḍalirājimatāṃ śukrādipañcasambhavā yathāsaṅkhyaṃ vāyvagnyambuprakṛtayaḥ kīṭāḥ| śavo mṛtasarpaśarīraṃ, tasya pūtiḥ śaṭanam| trīn kīṭān darvīkaramaṇḍalirājilasambandhena vāyvādiprakṛtikramānnirdiśya `viṇmūtrādikramānnirdiśannāha’ iti pā. caturthaṃ svabhāvena karmaṇā ca nirdiśannāha- sarvadoṣetyādi| sarvadoṣasvabhāvairyuktāḥ; pariṇāmataḥ pariṇāmo nāma bhinnajātīyairanekairekībhāvena `bhinnajātaiḥ’ iti pā. kāryasyārambhaḥ, sa cātra darvīkarādibhinnajātīyairvaikarañjākhyāpatyotpādanalakṣaṇaḥ, tasmāt| sughorāḥ tridoṣakopanāḥ, vaikarañjasarpajātiśukrādisambhavatvena| ekīkṛtya saṅkhyāmāha- sarva evetyādi||1-4||

lg.l: śatabāhuś ca yaś cāpi raktarājiś ca kīrtitaḥ |
aṣṭādaśeti vāyavyāḥ `aṣṭādaśaiva jñātavyāḥ’ iti pā. kīṭāḥ pavanakopanāḥ ||7||

div.ab: tāneva catuḥprakārān vātādisvabhāvairnirdiśannāha `vātādisvabhāvān’ iti pā. - kumbhīnasa ityādi| ete kīṭakabhedā nānādeśīyalokādavagantavyāḥ, yataḥ suvīranandivarāhajejjaṭagayadāsādibhiḥ ṭīkākārairna vyākhyātāḥ| vātanimittajā rogāstodādayo jvarādayaśca| vātaprakopaṇānāṃ kumbhīnasādīnāṃ madhye śṛṅgyucciṭiṅgaśarāvakurdacitraśīrṣakān varjayitvā śeṣāścaturdaśa mukhasandaṃśaviṣāḥ||5-7||-

lg.l: pañcālakaḥ pākamatsyaḥ kṛṣṇatuṇḍo 'tha `sūkṣmatuṇḍo'tha’ iti pā. gardabhī ||10||
klītaḥ kṛmisarārī ca yaś cāpy utkleśakas tathā |
ete hy agniprakṛtayaś caturviṃśatir eva ca ||11||

div.ab: kauṇḍinyaka ityādi| bindulasthāne `viluṭa’ iti kecit| pittanimittajā dāhādayo jvarādayaśca| pittaprakopaṇānāṃ madhye kauṇḍinyakavaraṭībhramarapicciṭavarcaḥkīṭamakaraśatapadapañcālakapākamatsyakṛṣṇatuṇḍān `sūkṣmatuṇḍān’ iti pā. vihāya śeṣāścaturdaśa mukhasandaṃśaviṣāḥ||8-11||-

lg.l: viśvambharaḥ pañcaśuklaḥ pañcakṛṣṇo 'tha `valabhī kapilastathā| sairīyakaḥ pañcakṛṣṇaḥ pracalāko'tha koṭikaḥ’ iti pā. kokilaḥ ||12||
kīṭo gardabhakaś caiva `koṭīgardabhakaścaiva’ iti pā. tathā troṭaka eva ca |

div.ab: viśvambhara ityādi| śleṣmanimittajā rogāḥ kaṇḍvādayo jvarādayaśca| śleṣmaprakopiṇāṃ madhye viśvambharapracalākakṛṣṇagodhākāṣāyavāsikāṃścaturo varjayitvā navānye mukhasandaṃśaviṣāḥ||12-14||-

lg.l: tās tāś ca vedanās tīvrā rogā vai sānnipātikāḥ |

ab.seg: sarvadoṣaprakṛtikānāha- tuṅgīnāsa ityādi| taiḥ sarvadoṣaprakṛtikaiḥ prāṇanāśanaiḥ kīṭaiḥ| tāstāḥ todadāhakaṇḍvādikā vedanāḥ, rogā jvarādayaḥ| daṃśa ityādi| raktapītaḥ pittena, sitaḥ kaphena, aruṇo vātena| sarvadoṣaprakṛtikānāṃ madhye vāhakasarṣapaśambūkān varjayitvā nava mukhasandaṃśaviṣāḥ||15-18||

lg.l: vepathuśvāsahikkāś ca dāhaḥ śītaṃ ca dāruṇam |
dadravaḥ karṇikāś caiva visarpāḥ kiṭibhāni ca |
tair bhavantīha daṣṭānāṃ yathāsvaṃ cāpy upadravāḥ ||21||
ye 'nye teṣāṃ viśeṣās tu tūrṇaṃ teṣāṃ samādiśet |

ab.seg: idānīṃ caturvidhānapi tāṃstīkṣṇamandaviṣabhedena nirdiśannāha- jvarāṅgetyādi| śītaṃ ca dāruṇamityatra cakārāddāho'pi dāruṇa eva| yathāsvaṃ yathākīṭadoṣamityarthaḥ| ye'nye ityādi| teṣāṃ tīkṣṇaviṣāṇāṃ kīṭānāmatroktebhyo ye'nye viśeṣā upadravāsteṣāṃ bhedāṃstūrṇaṃ samādiśediti| teṣāmiti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī, tena tān kṣipraṃ kathayet, kathaṃ? dūṣīviṣaprakopāt dūṣīviṣaprakopaṃ vīkṣya| yapi lupte pañcamīyam| tathaiva viṣalepanāditi lepanamatrāhārastena viṣālepanaṃ viṣāhāraṃ vīkṣyetyarthaḥ||19-22||

div.ab: śṛṇu mandaviṣeṣvityādi| śītako alpaṃ śītaṃ, koṭhādīnāṃ janma yathā kīṭadoṣavibhāgena||23||-

lg.l: yogair nānāvidhair eṣāṃ cūrṇāni garam ādiśet ||24||

dūṣīviṣaprakārāṇāṃ `dūṣīviṣaprakopācca’ iti, `dūṣīviṣaprakārāṇāṃ tathaivāpyanulepanāt’ iti ca pā.| asyāgre hārāṇacandrastu `tena pāṇḍuḥ kṛśo'lpāgniḥ kāsaśvāsajvarārditaḥ| jaṭharagrahaṇīrogayakṣmagulmakṣayaiśca saḥ| nipīḍito marmasu ca śūnapādakaro'lasaḥ| svapne mārjaragomāyuvyālān sa nakulān kapīna|| prāyaḥ paśyati nadyādīn śuṣkāṃśca sa vanaspatīn|’ ityadhikaṃ pāṭhaṃ paṭhati tathā cāpy anulepanāt |25|

div.ab: idānīṃ kīṭadehacūrṇānāṃ nānauṣadhayogāttathā'nulepanato'pi garatvamāha- yogairityādi| athālambāyanoktaḥ kīṭānāṃ sāmānyajñānopāyo likhyate,- “kṛṣṇābhirbindulekhābhiḥ pakṣaiḥ pādairmukhairnakhaiḥ| śūkaiḥ kaṇṭakalāṅgūlaiḥ saṃśliṣṭaiḥ `sannimnaiḥ| iti pā. pakṣaromabhiḥ| svanaiḥ pramāṇaiḥ saṃsthānairliṅgaiścāpi śarīragaiḥ| viṣavīryaiśca kīṭānāṃ rūpajñānaṃ vibhāvyate”- iti| tathā katicit kīṭā viśiṣṭākṛtivarṇādibhistaduktā eva likhyante,- “ajāpratimarūpo yaḥ śūkahīnastvaromaśaḥ| sitaḥ śarakulīrastu kṣveḍacūrṇaviṣaḥ smṛtaḥ|| gairikābho mahākīṭaḥ sapakṣo mārjitodaraḥ| khecaro gudaśūkaśca kauṇḍinya iti sa smṛtaḥ|| kuraṇṭapuṣpavarṇābhaḥ sapakṣo mārjitodaraḥ| tuṇḍaśūkaviṣaḥ kīṭaḥ koṣṭhāgārīti sañjñitaḥ|| lākṣārudhiravarṇābhaḥ śvetabinduvicitritaḥ| kṣudrako hyagnisaṅkāśo bhrājate niśi cāgnivat|| kīṭaḥ khadyota ityukto daṣṭastenāpi dahyate| daṃṣṭrāviṣaḥ śvetabinduḥ sapakṣaḥ ṣaṭpadaḥ khagaḥ|| sa tu vai śambūko nāma kālakaḥ saptamaṇḍalaḥ| catuṣpādo dīrghapatra ullalāṭo bahuprajaḥ|| vṛkṣālayo dantaviṣaḥ kṛkalāsa iti smṛtaḥ| candrābhaḥ kṛkalāso'nyastadbhedastu trikaṇṭakaḥ”- iti| teṣāṃ na kevalaṃ niyamena śūkādidaṃśena viṣaprādurbhāvaḥ, kiṃ tarhi abhyavahāracūrṇānulepanaiśca dūṣīviṣaliṅgaprādurbhāva ityāha- “yaścaitānatti cūrṇairvā cūrṇyate lipyate'thavā| mūtrādibhistasya dūṣīviṣaliṅgaṃ samādiśet”- iti| jejjaṭagayadāsāvatra āpātanikāpūrvakaṃ pāṭhaṃ paṭhataḥ, sa ca vartamānapustakeṣu na dṛśyate||24||-

lg.l: ekajātīn atas tūrdhvaṃ kīṭān vakṣyāmi bhedataḥ ||25||
trikaṇṭaḥ `trikaṇṭakaḥ kuṇī cāpi’ iti pā. kariṇī cāpi hastikakṣo 'parājitaḥ |

ab.seg: tair daṣṭasya śvayathur aṅgamardo gurutā gātrāṇāṃ daṃśaḥ kṛṣṇaś ca bhavati ||27||

idānīṃ vātapittakaphasannipātaprakṛtīn kīṭān nirdiśya, ekajātīyānapyekalakṣaṇacikitsārthaṃ nirdiśannāha- ekajātīnatastūrdhvamityādi| bhedata iti bhedaṃ vīkṣya| trikaṇṭakādayaścatvāraḥ kaṇabhāḥ; kaṇabhatvamekajātitvaṃ, trikaṇṭakādistu bhedaḥ, `kṛkaṇṭaka’ iti kecit| sarva eva kaṇabhāścatuṣpadāḥ kīṭāḥ sādhyāśca||25-27||

pratisūryakaḥ `catuṣpadāḥ kīṭāḥ pratisūryakaḥ’ iti pā., piṅgābhāso, bahuvarṇo, nirūpamo `virūpakaḥ’ iti pā. godhereka iti pañca godherakāḥ `iti pañca’ iti pā.; tair daṣṭasya śopho dāharujau ca bhavataḥ, godherakeṇaitad eva granthiprādurbhāvo jvaraś ca ||28||

pratisūryaka ityādi| kecittu pratisūryaka `catuṣpadāḥ’ iti pā. ityādisthāne evaṃ paṭhanti- “pratisūryaḥ piṅganāso bahulomā mahāśirāḥ| tathā nirūpamaśceti pañca gaudherakāḥ smṛtāḥ|| tairbhavantīha dṛṣṭānāṃ vegajñānāni sarpavat| rujaśca vividhākārā granthayaśca sudāruṇāḥ” iti| gaudherakalakṣaṇaṃ tantrāntare,- “kṛṣṇasarpeṇa godhāyāṃ bhavedyastu catuṣpadaḥ| sarpo gaudherako nāma tena daṣṭo na jīvati”- iti||28||

galagolikā `gogatiḥ’ iti, galagolī, śvetakṛṣṇā iti ca pā. - śvetā, kṛṣṇā, raktarājī, raktamaṇḍalā, sarvaśvetā, sarṣapikety evaṃ ṣaṭ; tābhir daṣṭe sarṣapikāvarjaṃ dāhaśophakledā bhavanti, sarṣapikayā hṛdayapiḍā 'tisāraś ca, tāsu madhye sarṣapikā prāṇaharī ||29||

śatapadyas tu- paruṣā, kṛṣṇā, citrā, kapilā, pītikā, raktā, śvetā, agniprabhā, ity aṣṭau; tābhir daṣṭe śopho vedanā dāhaś ca hṛdaye, śvetāgniprabhābhyām etad eva dāho mūrcchā cātimātraṃ śvetapiḍakotpattiś ca ||30||

maṇḍūkāḥ- kṛṣṇaḥ, sāraḥ, kuhako, harito, rakto, yavavarṇābho, bhṛkuṭī, koṭikaś cety aṣṭau; tair daṣṭasya daṃśe kaṇḍūr bhavati pītaphenāgamaś ca vaktrāt, bhṛkuṭīkoṭikābhyām etad eva dāhaś chardir mūrcchā cātimātram ||31||

maṇḍūkā ityādi| atra bhṛkuṭīkoṭikāvasādhyau| atha maṇḍūkotpattiḥ bhṛkuṭīlakṣaṇaṃ ca tantrāntaroktaṃ paṭhyate,- “varṣamāṇe sṛjecchukraṃ prāvṛṭkāle mahoragaḥ| tataḥ śaratprataptāyāṃ bhūmau maṇḍo jalasya hi| tasmin maṇḍodake jātā maṇḍūkāstena sañjñitāḥ|| maṇḍūko gogatistajjñaiḥ koṭikaḥ parikīrtitaḥ| tena daṣṭasya maraṇaṃ, nāsti tasya pratikriyā”- iti||29-31||
viśvambharābhir daṣṭe daṃśaḥ sarṣapākārābhiḥ piḍakābhiḥ sarujābhiś cīyate, śītajvarārtaś ca puruṣo bhavati ||32||
viśvambharābhirdaṣṭa ityādi| viśvambharāśca trayaḥ||32||

ahiṇḍukābhir daṣṭe todadāhakaṇḍuśvayathavo bhavanti mohaś ca; kaṇḍūmakābhir daṣṭe pītāṅgaś chardyatīsārajvarādibhir abhihanyate; śūkavṛntābhir daṣṭe kaṇḍūkoṭhāḥ pravardhante śūkaṃ cātra lakṣyate ||33||

ahiṇḍukābhirdaṣṭa ityādi| ahiṇḍukākaṇḍūmakaśūkavṛntānāṃ daṣṭalakṣaṇaṃ kecinna paṭhanti, viśvambharābhedatvena viśvambharāgraheṇa grahaṇāt; anye tu ahiṇḍukādīnāṃ pṛthagdaṣṭalakṣaṇaṃ paṭhanti, pṛthakcikitsitopādānāt||33||

pipīlikāḥ- sthūlaśīrṣā, saṃvāhikā, brāhmaṇikā, aṅgulikā; kapilikā, citravarṇeti ṣaṭ; tābhir daṣṭe `daṣṭasya koṭhaḥ sparśo'gnidagdhavacca| sarvā eva sādhyāḥ’ iti pā. daṃśe śvayathur agnisparśavad dāhaśophau bhavataḥ ||34||

makṣikāḥ- kāntārikā, kṛṣṇā, piṅgalā, madhūlikā, kāṣāyī, sthālikety evaṃ ṣaṭ; tābhir daṣṭasya kaṇḍuśophadāharujo bhavanti, sthālikākāṣāyībhyām etad eva śyāvapiḍakotpattir upadravāś ca jvarādayo bhavanti, kāṣāyī sthālikā ca prāṇahare `tābhirdaṣṭasya dāhaśophau bhavataḥ, sthālikākāṣāyībhyāmetadeva piḍakāśca sopadravā bhavanti’ iti hāraṇacandrasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ||35||
maśakāḥ- sāmudraḥ, parimaṇḍalo, hastimaśakaḥ, kṛṣṇaḥ, pārvatīya iti pañca; tair daṣṭasya tīvrā kaṇḍūr daṃśaśophaś ca, pārvatīyas tu kīṭaiḥ prāṇaharais tulyalakṣaṇaḥ ||36||

bhavanti cātra-
godherakaḥ sthālikā ca ye ca śvetāgnisaprabhe |
bhṛkuṭī koṭikaś caiva na sidhyanty ekajātiṣu ||38||

idānīmihaikajātyeṣu pañcasvasādhyān nirdiśannāha- godheraka ityādi| sthālikā ceti cakāreṇa kāṣāyī samuccīyate| ye ceti cakāreṇa galagolikeṣu sarṣapikā'pyanuktā samuccīyate| bhṛkuṭī koṭikaścaiveti cakāreṇānuktā jalaukaḥsvindrāyudhā samuccīyate||34-38||

lg.l: prakledavāṃs tathā srāvo bhṛśaṃ sampācayet tvacam |

ab.seg: eṣāṃ bahiścūrṇāvacūrṇanādau liṅgamuddiśya cikitsāmuddiśannāha- śavamūtrapurīṣairityādi| prakledavāniti saviṣacūrṇāvamṛṣṭapradeśe ityarthaḥ||39-40||

idānīṃ kīṭadaṣṭasya daṃśalakṣaṇena kṛcchratāmuddiśannāha- nāvasannamityādi| nāvasannaṃ nātibhinnaṃ, na cotsannaṃ nātyunnatam, itthambhūtamapi yadatisaṃrambhavedanam atiśayavyathaṃ, daṃśādau viparītārti anugraviṣadaṣṭe tīvrārtirbhavati, ugraviṣadaṣṭe tu mandārtiriti viparītārtiḥ| subādhakaṃ kṛcchrasādhyam||41||

lg.l: trividhānāṃ tu pūrveṣāṃ `sarpāṇāṃ’ iti pā. traividhyena kriyā hitāḥ ||42||

ab.seg: idānīmugraviṣakīṭānāṃ cikitsāmuddiśannāha- kīṭairdaṣṭānugretyādi| ugraviṣaiḥ prāṇaharaistridoṣaprakṛtibhiḥ| sarpavat sarpadaṣṭāniva, sarpadaṣṭasya sarpavegoktābhiḥ kriyābhirityarthaḥ| trividhānāmiti darvīkaramaṇḍalirājilaśukrādiyonibhedāttriprakārāṇām| pūrveṣām ādyuktānām| traividhyeneti vātādibhedenetyarthaḥ||42||

lg.l: viṣaghnaṃ ca vidhiṃ sarvaṃ bahuśaḥ `kuryāt saṃśodhanāni ca’ iti pā. śodhanāni ca |44|

div.ab: idānīṃ sāmānyaṃ cikitsitamāha- svedamālepanamityādi| anyatra mūrcchitāditi mūrcchitaṃ varjayitvā, mūrcchite na kuryādityarthaḥ| viṣaghnaṃ ca vidhiṃ sarvamityādi| saṃśamanavidhiṃ pānanasyābhyaṅgālepanapariṣekāñjanādikaṃ vātādiviṣaharadravyakalpitam| saṃśodhanāni ceti vamanavirekāsthāpanāni, `yathādoṣam’ ityadhyāhāraḥ||43||-

lg.l: utkārikā sthirādau vā sukṛtā svedane hitā ||45||

ab.seg: idānīṃ vātādidoṣaviṣaharasvedadravyasūtramuddiśannāha- śirīṣetyādi| utkārikā lapsikā| sthirādau śālaparṇyādau| sukṛtā śobhanā kṛtā| etena kṣīrādidravaiḥ śirīṣādidravyāṇāṃ ślakṣṇapeṣitānāṃ mātrākrameṇa nātidravo nālpadravaḥ pāka iti sarvaṃ bodhyate||44-45||

lg.l: na svedayeta cādaṃśaṃ dhūmaṃ vakṣyāmi vṛścike |46|

div.ab: muktvā kīṭaviṣamityanena hetunā sarveṣveva kīṭeṣu svedaṃ prasaktaṃ kvacinnirasyannāha- na svedayetetyādi| vṛścikaviṣe daṃśaṃ na svedayeta, āṅo vyavahitasyāpi kriyāpadena sambandhāt| tatrāpi kiñcidūṣmasvedamāha- dhūmamityādi| dhūmaśca `śikhikukkuṭabarhāṇi’ ityādinā'gre vaktavyaḥ| na svedayeta cādaṃśamityatra cakāro bhinnakrame dhūmaṃ cetyatra draṣṭavyaḥ; tena mandaviṣavṛścikadaṣṭasyotkārikāsveda ukto na virudhyate|46|-

lg.l: kuṣṭhaṃ vakraṃ vacā pāṭhā bilvamūlaṃ suvarcikā |

ab.seg: idānīṃ vātādibhedena caturvidhaprakṛtīnāṃ saptaṣaṣṭisaṅkhyopetānāṃ cikitsitamabhidhāya vṛścikalūtāvarjaṃ catuḥpañcāśatāmekajātīnāṃ cikitsitaṃ nirdiśannāha- agadānekajātīṣvityādi| vakraṃ tagaraṃ, suvarcikā svarjikākṣāraḥ| trikaṇṭakagrahaṇamaparasajātīyānāṃ kaṇabhaprabhṛtīnāṃ prādhānyādupalakṣaṇam| hita iti agada iti śeṣaḥ||46-47||
pratisūryakādicikitsāyā vakṣyamāṇatvādgalagolikopakramamāha- rajanītyādi| palāśajaṃ `bījam’ ityadhyāhāryam||48||

lg.l: meṣaśṛṅgī vacā pāṭhā niculo rohiṇī jalam |

ab.seg: niculo vetasaḥ, jalaṃ vālakam||49-50||
dhavāśvetyādi| viśvambharābhiḥ tisṛbhiḥ| atibalā kaṅkatikā, atiguhā śāliparṇī, guhā pṛśniparṇī||51||

lg.l: śirīṣaṃ tagaraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śāliparṇī sahā niśe |

ab.seg: śirīṣamityādi| sahā mudgaparṇī| niśe piṇḍaharidrādāruharidre||52||

lg.l: kaṇḍūmakābhir daṣṭānāṃ rātrau śītāḥ kriyā hitāḥ |
nakhāvaghṛṣṭasañjāte śophe bhṛṅgaraso hitaḥ `nakhāvakṛṣṭe syāllepe mārkavasvaraso hitaḥ’ iti pā.|56|

div.ab: kaṇḍūmakābhirityādi| kaṇḍūmakābhirdaṣṭāḥ puruṣāḥ| sūryaraśmibhirbalaṃ yeṣāṃ te sūryaraśmibalāḥ kaṇḍūmakāḥ, tairarditāḥ pīḍitāḥ| pipīlikādibhistribhirdaṣṭe gomūtrayuktā kṛṣṇavalmīkamṛttikā| nakhetyādi nakhāvakṛṣṭe nakhodghṛṣṭe sati sañjātaśophe mārkavasya bhṛṅgarājasya raso lepe hitaḥ syāt| gayadāsastu bhṛṅgasvarasapiṣṭā syādityādi paṭhitvā pipīlikāditraye daṣṭe bhṛṅgarājapiṣṭakṛṣṇavalmīkamṛttikālepaṃ pratipādayati; gomūtrayutakṛṣṇavalmīkamṛttikālepanaṃ tu nakhāvakṛṣṭe tathā mārkavasvarasālepanaṃ ca||53-55||-
pratisūryaketyādi| ācaret `cikitsitaṃ’ ityadhyāhāraḥ|56|-

ab.seg: evamekajātīyān kīṭānabhidhāya vṛścikānnirdeṣṭumāha- trividhā vṛścikā ityādi| nanvekajātibhyaḥ pṛthagbhūtā vṛścikā lūtāśca kasmānnirdiśyante iti? ucyate-viṣacikistitaviśeṣāpekṣaḥ pṛthagārambhaḥ||56||

tāneva trīnapi kāraṇadharmacikitsitabhedairbhinnān prathamaṃ kāraṇādevāha- gośakṛdityādi| gośakṛdityatra gośabdasyāparapaśūpalakṣaṇatvācchakṛcchabdasyāparamalopalakṣaṇatvādgomahiṣyādiśakṛnmūtrakothajā mandāḥ| ye cānye ityādi| anye'pi ye viṣasambhavāste'pi tīvrāḥ| anye tvevaṃ paṭhanti,- “sarpakothodbhavāstīvrā digdhaviddhaviṣairhate| kothe madhyā gavādīnāṃ śakṛtkothe'varāḥ smṛtāḥ”- iti||57||

lg.l: mandā dvādaśa madhyās tu trayaḥ pañcadaśottamāḥ |
daśa viṃśatir ity ete saṅkhyayā parikīrtitāḥ ||58||

ab.seg: idānīṃ teṣāṃ pṛthak saṅkhyāmāha- mandā dvādaśetyādi| gayadāsastu- “trayodaśa prāṇaharāstrayo madhyāstathā'pare| mandavīryā daśaikaśca vṛścikā viṣavedibhiḥ|| saptaviṃśatirityete saṅkhyayā parikīrtitāḥ”- iti paṭhati||58||

lg.l: kṛṣṇaḥ śyāvaḥ karburaḥ pāṇḍuvarṇo `kāṇḍavarṇo’ iti pā. gomūtrābhaḥ karkaśo `mecako rūkṣavarṇaḥ’ iti pā. mecakaś ca |
pīto `śveto rakto’ iti pā. dhūmro romaśaḥ śāḍvalābho raktaḥ śvetenodareṇeti mandāḥ `raktaścaite mandavīryā matāstu’ iti pā.||59||
yuktāś caite vṛścikāḥ pucchadeśe syur bhūyobhiḥ parvabhiś cetarebhyaḥ |
ebhir daṣṭe vedanā vepathuś ca gātrastambhaḥ kṛṣṇaraktāgamaś ca ||60||
śākhādaṣṭe vedanā cordhvam eti dāhasvedau daṃśaśopho jvaraś ca |61|

div.ab: idānīṃ mandaviṣāṇāṃ lakṣaṇakarmāṇyāha- kṛṣṇa ityādi| kṛṣṇādayo dvādaśāpi śvetenodareṇopalakṣitāḥ| vedanā cordhvametīti trividhānāmapi vṛścikānāṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇamatra prāyovṛttyā'bhihitam| syurbhūyobhiḥ parvabhiścetarebhya iti itarebhyo vṛścikebhyo mandaviṣā vṛścikā bhūyobhirbahutaraiḥ parvabhirupalakṣitā bhaveyuḥ||59-60||-

lg.l: raktaḥ pītaḥ kāpilenodareṇa sarve dhūmrāḥ parvabhiś ca tribhiḥ syuḥ ||61||
yasyaiteṣām anvayād yaḥ prasūto doṣotpattiṃ tat svarūpāṃ sa kuryāt ||62||
jihvāśopho bhojanasyāvarodho `rasanasyopaghāto’ iti pā. mūrcchā cogrā madhyavīryābhidaṣṭe `vṛścikairmadhyamaistu’ iti pā.|63|

div.ab: madhyaviṣāṇāṃ lakṣaṇakarmāṇyāha- rakta ityādi| kapilena saha raktaḥ pītaśceti trayaḥ| ete ca trayo'pyudareṇa dhūmrāḥ| pūrvatra kāṣṭheṣṭikodbhavatvamiha tu sarpamūtroccārādisambhavatvamityubhayahetūpādānād vyastasamastobhayahetūdbhavatvaṃ madhyānāṃ boddhavyam| digdhaviddhasarpadaṣṭānāṃ ca śarīrakothe madhyānāṃ janma matāntareṇa pratipāditameva| triprakāroragāṇāmityādi darvīkarādibhedena triprakārāṇāmeteṣāṃ yasyānvayādyo yādṛk prasūtaḥ sa tatsvarūpāṃ doṣotpattiṃ kuryāt||61-62||-

lg.l: śvetaś citraḥ śyāmalo lohitābho `lohitaśca kṛṣṇaḥ pītaḥ śuklanīlodarau ca’ iti pā. raktaḥ śveto raktanīlodarau ca ||63||

pīto 'rakto `agnyābhāsaḥ kāpilo raktakoṣṭho yo vā yuktaḥ kāpilenodareṇa’ iti, `kṛṣṇaḥ śvetaḥ śvetakṛṣṇau pavitrau raktāgnyābhaścāpyathānyonyacitrau’ iti ca pā. nīlapīto 'paras tu rakto nīlo nīlaśuklas tathā ca |
rakto babhruḥ pūrvavac caikaparvā yaś cāparvā parvaṇī dve ca yasya ||64||
nānārūpā varṇataś cāpi ghorā jñeyāś caite vṛścikāḥ prāṇacaurāḥ `mṛtyurūpāḥ’ iti pā.|
janmaiteṣāṃ sarpakothāt pradiṣṭaṃ dehebhyo vā ghātitānāṃ viṣeṇa ||65||
ebhir daṣṭe sarpavegapravṛttiḥ sphoṭotpattir bhrāntidāhau jvaraś ca |
khebhyaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ śoṇitaṃ yāti tīvraṃ tasmāt `paścāt prāṇān muñcati kṣiprameva’ iti pā. prāṇais tyajyate śīghram eva ||66||

ab.seg: tīkṣṇaviṣāṇāṃ lakṣaṇakarmāṇyāha- śvetaścitra ityādi| pūrvavacceti pūrve madhyaviṣā yathā jihvāśophādikārakāstathaivaite'pi jihvāśophādi kurvantītyarthaḥ| ekaparveti dvayorasthnoḥ saṅghātaḥ parva, ekaṃ parva yasya sa tathā| parvaṇī dve ca yasyeti cakāreṇa bahuparvāṇo'pi bhavantīti samuccīyate| khebhya iti khebhyaḥ srotobhyaḥ| ariṣṭamidam||63-66||

div.ab: idānīṃ cikitsā prastūyate- ugramadhyetyādi| mūrcchā cogrā cetyanena sarpadaṣṭaṣaṣṭhasaptamavegalakṣaṇasya vacanānmadhyaviṣe'pi sarpadaṣṭacikitsā kāryā| ihāparāmapi cikitsāmāha- ādaṃśamityādi| pratisāraṇaṃ gharṣaṇaṃ, tacca duṣṭaraktapravartanārtham| mātuluṅgāmletyādi| mātuluṅgāmlaṃ bījapūrakarasaḥ| surasāgrajaṃ tulasīpallavaṃ, mallikākusumamiti kecit| svede ityādi vātakaphāvajayāya| pāne sarpirityādi| bahuvātasya sarpiḥpānaṃ madhuyutaṃ, bahupittasya kṣīraṃ bahuśarkaraṃ ceti yogadvayam||67||-

lg.l: lepe, svede sukhoṣṇaṃ ca gomayaṃ hitam iṣyate |
pāne kṣaudrayutaṃ sarpiḥ `sarpiśca sakṣaudraṃ’ iti pā. kṣīraṃ vā bahuśarkaram ||69||
kuryāc cotkārikāsvedaṃ viṣaghnair upanāhayet `viṣaghnairupanāhanaiḥ’ iti pā.|
pānam asmai pradātavyaṃ kṣīraṃ vā saguḍaṃ himam |
dhūmo hanti prayuktas tu śīghraṃ vṛścikajaṃ viṣam |
kusumbhapuṣpaṃ rajanī niśā vā kodravaṃ tṛṇam ||73||
ebhir ghṛtāktair dhūpas tu pāyudeśe prayojitaḥ |
nāśayed āśu kīṭotthaṃ vṛścikasya ca yad viṣam ||74||

ab.seg: idānīṃ mandaviṣāṇāṃ cikitsāmāha- daṃśamityādi| cakratailaṃ cakrapīḍitaṃ tilatailaṃ, atra cakraśabdopādānaṃ hastādiyantrapīḍananiṣedhārtham| vidārigaṇasiddhenetyādiśabdasya lopādvidāryādigaṇasiddhena, `tailena’ iti śeṣaḥ| kuryāccotkāriketyādi| utkārikā lapsikā| utkārikā tu śirīṣādiviṣaharadravyaiḥ pūrvoktā pūrvakalpitā ca| upanāhayed viṣaghnadravyairupanāhasvedaṃ kuryāt| guḍodakamityādi| barhāṇi picchāni||68-74||

lg.l: duścikitsyatamaṃ ayaṃ pāṭho hastalikhitapustake nopalabhyate cāpi bhiṣagbhir mandabuddhibhiḥ ||75||
saviṣaṃ nirviṣaṃ caitad ity evaṃ pariśaṅkite |
viṣaghnam eva kartavyam avirodhi yad auṣadham ||76||

ab.seg: lūtāviṣamādikāraṇalakṣaṇacikitsitairnirdiśannāha- lūtetyādi| ghoratamaṃ kaṣṭasādhyaṃ, durvijñeyatamam atiduḥkhena vijñātuṃ śakyam| tasya durvijñeyatvādeva saṃśaye sati viṣaharameva karaṇīyamityāha- saviṣamityādi| avirodhi dhātubhiḥ saha yanna virudhyate'nnapānaṃ tat; na punaragadakaraṇaṃ, dhātuvirodhāt||75-76||

lg.l: tasmāt sarvaprayatnena `tasmādyatnena bhiṣajā’ iti. jñātavyo viṣaniścayaḥ |

ab.seg: tameva dhātuvirodhaṃ darśayannāha- agadānāmityādi| asukhaṃ kaṣṭam||77-78||

lg.l: prodbhidyamānas tu yathā'ṅkureṇa na vyaktajātiḥ pravibhāti vṛkṣaḥ |
tadvad durālakṣyatamaṃ hi tāsāṃ viṣaṃ śarīre pravikīrṇamātram ||79||

ab.seg: lūtāviṣadurvijñeyatāyāmupamānapramāṇaṃ nirdiśannāha- prodbhidyamāna ityādi| pravikīrṇamātraṃ prathamaṃ vikṣiptamātram, alpavistṛtamityarthaḥ||79||

lg.l: īṣatsakaṇḍu pracalaṃ sakoṭham avyaktavarṇaṃ prathame 'hani syāt |
anteṣu śūnaṃ parinimnamadhyaṃ pravyaktarūpaṃ ca dine dvitīye ||80||
tryaheṇa tad darśayatīha rūpaṃ viṣaṃ caturthe 'hani kopam eti |
ṣaṣṭhe dine viprasṛtaṃ tu sarvān marmapradeśān bhṛśam āvṛṇoti |

ab.seg: īṣatsakaṇḍu pracalamityādi| īṣatsakaṇḍu kiñcitkaṇḍūyuktaṃ, pracalaṃ pracalanaśīlam| gayadāsastu prabalamiti paṭhitvā vyākhyānayati- prabalam īṣat prathamadine, dvitīyādiṣu dineṣu tu prabalataraṃ krameṇa prabalatamaṃ ca; yadāha,- “ṣaṣṭhe dine viprasṛtaṃ tu sarvān marmapradeśān bhṛśamāvṛṇoti”- iti| sakoṭhaṃ kiñcit koṭhayuktaṃ, koṭhaśca varaṭīdaṃśasthānaḥ| darśayatīha rūpamiti rūpaṃ cātra tantrāntaroktaṃ jvararomaharṣaraktamaṇḍalādikam| tathā ca vṛddhavāgbhaṭaḥ- “tṛtīye sajvaro romaharṣakṛdraktamaṇḍalaḥ| śarāvarūpastodāḍhyo romakūpeṣu sāsravaḥ”- iti| kopameti unmārgapravṛttaṃ bhavati, tato'dhike pañcamadine unmārgapravṛttaṃ sat viṣakopaprabhavān vikārān karoti| `tṛḍdāhakaṇḍūprabalaṃ’ iti kecit||80-82||

lg.l: yās tīkṣṇacaṇḍograviṣā hi lūtās tāḥ saptarātreṇa naraṃ nihanyuḥ |
ato 'dhikenāpi nihanyur anyā yāsāṃ viṣaṃ madhyamavīryam uktam ||83||
yāsāṃ kanīyo viṣavīryam uktaṃ tāḥ pakṣamātreṇa vināśayanti |
tasmāt prayatnaṃ bhiṣag atra kuryād ā daṃśapātād viṣaghātiyogaiḥ ||84||

ab.seg: tāsāṃ tīkṣṇamadhyamandaviṣāṇāṃ kālāvadhimāha- yāstīkṣṇacaṇḍogretyādi| tīkṣṇaṃ dāhapākasrāvakaraṃ, caṇḍam atikopāṭopakaraṃ; tīkṣṇacaṇḍatvenogramasahyaṃ viṣaṃ yāsāṃ tāstathā| ato'nenaikādaśāhāt parata iti sāmarthyād grāhyam| tathā cālambāyanaḥ,- “lūtāstīkṣṇaviṣā hanyuḥ saptāṣṭanavabhirdinaiḥ| ekādaśāhāt parato viṣaṃ yāsāṃ tu madhyamam”- iti||83-84||

lg.l: viṣaṃ tu lālānakhamūtradaṃṣṭrā rajaḥpurīṣair atha cendriyeṇa |
sakaṇḍukoṭhaṃ sthiram alpamūlaṃ lālākṛtaṃ mandarujaṃ vadanti |
śophaś ca kaṇḍūś ca pulālikā `pulānikā’ iti pā. ca dhūmāyanaṃ caiva nakhāgradaṃśe ||86||
daṃśaṃ tu mūtreṇa sakṛṣṇamadhyaṃ saraktaparyantam avehi dīrṇam |
daṃṣṭrābhir ugraṃ kaṭhinaṃ vivarṇaṃ jānīhi daṃśaṃ sthiramaṇḍalaṃ ca ||87||

ab.seg: adhiṣṭhānaviśeṣādapi tāsāṃ viṣaṃ viṣe ca liṅgaṃ darśayannāha- viṣaṃ tu lāletyādi| raja ārtavam, indriyaṃ śukram| sakaṇḍukoṭhamityādi| koṭhaḥ koṭhapiḍakāḥ| śopha ityādi| pulālikā romāñcaḥ| dhūmāyanaṃ dhūmodvamanamivāṅgānām| daṃśaṃ tu mūtreṇetyādi| rajaḥprabhṛtije `daṃśe’ ityadhyāhāraḥ| viddhi jānīhi||85-87||

lg.l: etāvad etat samudāhṛtaṃ tu vakṣyāmi lūtāprabhavaṃ purāṇam ||88||
sāmānyato daṣṭam asādhyasādhyaṃ cikitsitaṃ cāpi yathāviśeṣam ||89||

ab.seg: idānīmatītānāgatoktaiḥ samānatāṃ viśiṣṭatāṃ ca vibhajannāha- etāvadetadityādi| iyatpramāṇametat prathamādidivasāśrayaṃ lālādyadhiṣṭhānāśrayaṃ ca sarvalūtāviṣayaṃ samudāhṛtamāgamaprasiddhamuktamityarthaḥ| vakṣyāmītyādi| lūtāprabhavaṃ lūtānāmādyutpattikāraṇaṃ, purāṇaṃ purābhavaṃ, sāmānyato vakṣyāmīti sambandhaḥ; tathā daṣṭaṃ daṃśamapyasādhyaṃ sādhyaṃ ca sāmānyato vakṣyāmīti| cikitsitaṃ cetyādi| cikitsitaṃ yathāviśeṣaṃ viśeṣānatikrameṇa; cakārāllakṣaṇamapi viśeṣānatikrameṇa vakṣyāmīti sambandhaḥ||88-89||

lg.l: apatan darśanād eva raves tatsamatejasaḥ `hyadhastāttīkṣṇavarcasaḥ’ iti pā.||91||
tṛṇe maharṣiṇā lūne dhenvarthaṃ sambhṛte 'pi ca |
tato jātās tv imā ghorā nānārūpā mahāviṣāḥ |
yasmāl lūnaṃ tṛṇaṃ prāptā muneḥ prasvedabindavaḥ |
tasmāl lūteti bhāṣyante saṅkhyayā tāś ca ṣoḍaśa ||93||

ab.seg: tatprabhavamuddiśannāha- viśvāmitra ityādi| kiletyāgamasaṃvāde| tatsamatejaso ravisamānatejaso vaśiṣṭhasya svedabindavaḥ apatan patitāḥ| dhenvarthaṃ sambhṛte gavādicaraṇārthaṃ sañcite| matāntareṇotpattiranyathā varṇyate,- “anye vadanti bhuktasya duṣṭasyānnasya mūrcchanāt| sambhavanti viṣasphoṭā ye lūtākīṭalakṣaṇam| yathāsvaṃ dhārayantaste lūtākīṭāśca kīrtitāḥ”- ityādi||90-93||

lg.l: kṛcchrasādhyās tathā'sādhyā lūtās tu dvividhāḥ smṛtāḥ |
tāsām aṣṭau kṛcchrasādhyā varjyās tāvatya eva tu ||94||
trimaṇḍalā tathā śvetā kapilā pītikā tathā |
tābhir daṣṭe śiroduḥkhaṃ kaṇḍūr daṃśe ca vedanā |
tābhir daṣṭe daṃśakothaḥ pravṛttiḥ kṣatajasya ca |
jvaro dāho 'tisāraś ca gadāḥ syuś ca tridoṣajāḥ ||98||
mahānto mṛdavaḥ śophā raktāḥ śyāvāś calās tathā ||99||

ab.seg: ālāviṣā mūtraviṣā ceti dve||94-99||

lg.l: bādhiryaṃ kaluṣā dṛṣṭis tathā dāhaś ca netrayoḥ ||101||
śvetāyāḥ piḍakā daṃśe śvetā kaṇḍūmatī bhavet |
kuṣṭhaṃ lāmajjakaṃ vakraṃ naladaṃ cāgado hitaḥ ||104||
ādaṃśe piḍakā tāmrā kapilāyāḥ sthirā bhavet |
śiraso gauravaṃ dāhas timiraṃ bhrama eva ca ||105||
ādaṃśe pītikāyās tu piḍakā pītikā sthirā |
bhavec chardir jvaraḥ śūlaṃ mūrdhni rakte tathā 'kṣiṇī ||107||

ab.seg: sāmānyalakṣaṇamabhidhāya tāsāṃ viśeṣalakṣaṇaṃ cikitsite ca bhedaṃ darśayannāha- viśeṣalakṣaṇamityādi| cakārāt pariṣeke'pi| śvetāyā ityādi| rāsnā gandhanākulī| ādaṃśe ityādi| tuṅgaṃ padmakeśaraṃ, punnāga ityapare| vañjulo jalavetasaḥ; jejjaṭastu kambuketi paṭhitvā kiṇihīti vyākhyānayati| raktamaṇḍanime ityādi| `raktapādyā’ iti kvacit, tatrāpi raktāyā eva grahaṇam| picchilamityādi| raktalūtācikitsitaṃ toyacandanādikam||100-115||

lg.l: purīṣagandhir alpāsṛk kṛṣṇāyā daṃśa eva tu |
coṣakaṇḍūromaharṣā `coṣakaṇḍūromaharṣā vidāhaḥ sphoṭajanma ca’ iti pā. dāhavisphoṭasaṃyutaḥ ||118||

ab.seg: idānīṃ sauvarṇikādiṣvasādhyeṣu dvayoḥ kṛṣṇāgnivakrayoḥ kadācitkṛcchrasādhyatvāt kṛcchrasādhyānantaraṃ lakṣaṇaṃ pratyākhyānapūrvakaṃ cikitsitaṃ cāha- purīṣagandhirityādi| sarpākṣī lohitapuṣpā śaṅkhapuṣpībhedaḥ| mahāsugandhiḥ dundubhisvanīyokto'gadaḥ| daṃśe ityādi| coṣasthāne tṛṣṇeti kvacit, saṃyuta ityatra daṃśa iti vibhaktivipariṇāmena yojanīyam| gayadāsastu kṛṣṇāgnivakrayorniyatāsādhyatvamaṅgīkurvan sauvarṇikādikrameṇāgre lakṣaṇamātrameva paṭhati||116-119||

tāsāmuktānāṃ daśānāmapi lūtānāṃ viśiṣṭaṃ cikitsitamabhidhāya sāmānyamapyāha sarvāsāmityādi| sarvaprakāreṇa pānābhyañjanādayaḥ| akṣīvapippalamiti akṣīvāt mahānimbājjātaḥ pippala akṣīvapippalaḥ, anye śobhāñjanājjāta iti manyante| anyatrāpyuktaṃ- “akṣīvājjātasya pippalasya maṇiḥ sarvaviṣāpahaḥ| śelutvaco vā” iti| ālambāyano'pyatrāha,- “lūtāviṣeṣu sarveṣu pānanasyāñjanādinā| prayojyaḥ pippalo'kṣīvajjātaḥ śelutvaco'thavā” iti||120||

lg.l: kṛcchrasādhyaviṣā hy aṣṭau proktā dve ca yadṛcchayā |
śvāsaḥ kāso jvaras tṛṣṇā mūrcchā cātra sudāruṇā ||122||
ādaṃśe lājavarṇāyā dhyāmaṃ pūti sraved asṛk |
dāho mūrcchā 'tisāraś ca śiroduḥkhaṃ `mūrghni cātyarthavedanā’ iti pā. ca jāyate ||123||
ghoro daṃśas tu jālinyā rājimān avadīryate |
stambhaḥ śvāsas tamovṛddhis tāluśoṣaś ca jāyate ||124||
tṛṣṇā mūrcchā jvaracchardikāsaśvāsasamanvitaḥ `tṛṣṇāmūrcchājvaraśvāsadāhakṛt prāṇanāśanaḥ’ iti pā.||125||

ab.seg: idānīmasādhyānāmapi parihārārthaṃ lakṣaṇamāha- kucchrasādhyetyādi| dve yadṛcchayeti avāryaviṣavīryāṇāṃ madhye dve ca yadṛcchayā sidhyataḥ| śeṣāṇāmavāryaviṣavīryāṇāṃ ṣaṭsaṅkhyakānāṃ, nibodha jānīhi| dhyāma ityādi| dhyāmo dagdheṣṭakādivarṇaḥ| ghoro daṃśa ityādi| tamovṛddhiḥ punaḥ punastamodarśanam| eṇīpadyā ityādi| viśīryeta śaṭatītyarthaḥ||121-127||
kecidasādhyānāmapi cikitsitaṃ paṭhanti- asādhyāsvityādi||128||

lg.l: sādhyābhir ābhir lūtābhir daṣṭamātrasya `sādhyābhirapi lūtābhiḥ’ iti pā. dehinaḥ |

ab.seg: idānīṃ kṛcchrasādhyānāṃ tātkālikaṃ cikitsitamāha- sādhyābhirābhirityādi| asyāgre kecidamuṃ pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti- `jāmbvauṣṭhenāgnitaptena dahedākaravāraṇāt `dahedākaraṇāditi’ iti pā. ’- iti||129||

kīdṛśasya daṃśasya chedaṃ kuryādityāha- amarmaṇi vidhānajña ityādi| jvarādibhiḥ asādhyalūtoktaiḥ, `asādhyānāṃ bhiṣak prājño na yuñjīta cikitsitam’ iti| madhusaindhavetyādi| agadaiḥ mahāsugandhyādibhiḥ| tat iti chedādanantaram| samaṅgā varāhakrāntā| tatheti priyaṅgvādibhirapi lepayedityarthaḥ| sārivāmityādi| sārivā utpalasārivā, payasyā arkapuṣpī, kṣīramoraṭaṃ moraṭa eva| ekatra yoge madhukadvayaṃ sthalajajalajabhedena| kṣīriṇāmityādi||130-133||

lg.l: saṃśodhanaṃ cobhayataḥ pragāḍhaṃ kuryāt sirāmokṣaṇam eva cātra ||134||

ab.seg: lūtāsu daśavidhamupakramamāha- nasyāñjanābhyañjanetyādi| abhyañjanasthāne ālepanamiti kecit| saṃśodhanamubhayato vamanavirecanākhyaṃ kuryāt| sirāmokṣaṇamityatra `raktaṃ hareccāpi jalāyukābhiḥ’ iti kecit| etacca sarvaṃ viṣaharaireva daśavidhamapi||134||

lg.l: ādāhapākāt tān `ādaṃśapākaṃ yatnena cikitset sarpadaṣṭavat’ iti pā. sarvāñ cikitsed duṣṭavad bhiṣag ||135||

ab.seg: lūtānāmapi kīṭatvāt sāmānyenaiva kīṭaviṣotthavraṇānāṃ tathā tādṛśānāmahidaṣṭavraṇānāmapi duṣṭavraṇavaccikitsāmāha- kīṭadaṣṭavraṇānityādi| ādāhapākāditi yāvaddāhapākau tiṣṭhataḥ; vinivṛttayośca dāhapākayorvakṣyamāṇo vidhirbhaviṣyati| kvacit `sadāhapākān’ iti pāṭhaḥ| duṣṭavat duṣṭavraṇavat; duṣṭavraṇoktaṃ ca `duṣṭavraṇeṣu kartavyamūrdhvaṃ cādhaśca śodhanam’ ityādi| tatra śodhanaṃ viṣaharadravyaiḥ, tathā lepādikamapi viṣaharameva duṣṭavraṇacikitsitena||135||

lg.l: gugguluḥ saindhavaṃ kiṇvaṃ varcaḥ pārāvatasya ca |

ab.seg: nivṛttadāhādau vraṇe yā viṣotpannā karṇikā tasyāścikitsāmāha- vinivṛtte ityādi| karṇikā māṃsakandī, padmakarṇikākāratvāt karṇikā bhaṇyate| tasyāśca śoṇitapittotthāyā mṛdurujāyāḥ pracchanamantareṇaiva pātanaṃ sukaram| tānyeva pātanadravyāṇyāha- nimbapatramityādi| kiṇvaṃ surābījam| etannimbapatrādikaṃ dravyaṃ lepanena karṇikāpātane hitaṃ, tathā viṣavṛddhikaraṃ tilakulatthādyannaṃ varjayitvā yadanyat pātanam sambhojanaṃ tat karṇikāyāḥ pātane hitam| gayadāsastu nimbapatramityasya sthāne `śikhīvaṃśa’ iti paṭhitvā vyākhyānayati- śikhī lāṅgalakī, vaṃśo vaṃśatvak| kiṇvasthāne dantaṃ paṭhati, danto godanto gavāṃ dantaḥ||136-137||

lg.l: viṣebhyaḥ khalu sarvebhyaḥ karṇikām arujāṃ sthirām |

ab.seg: kaphavātotthāyāḥ karṇikāyāścikitsāmāha- viṣebhya ityādi| arujām avidyamānarujāṃ, sthirāṃ kaṭhināṃ| śodhanīyaiḥ nimbapatratrivṛtādibhiḥ, dantīmūlamadanaphalakalkādibhirvā||138||

idānīṃ paratantroditasaṅkhyāvipratipattinirāsārthaṃ svatantre vyāsoktasaṅkhyāḥ sukhabodhārthaṃ ca kīṭeṣu daṣṭalakṣaṇacikitsitopadeśena parimāṇamuddiśannāha- saptaṣaṣṭhasyetyādi| saptaṣaṣṭhaśatasya kīṭānāṃ daṣṭalakṣaṇamākhyātaṃ kathitaṃ, vibhāgaśaḥ pratyekaṃ daṣṭalakṣaṇādanantaraṃ cikitsitamapi samākhyātam||139||

div.ab: idānīṃ pūrvatantrasyādhyāyasaṅkhyāyāḥ parimāṇaṃ yaduddiṣṭaṃ tannirdiṣṭamiti darśayannāha- saviṃśamityādi| etat saviṃśamadhyāyaśataṃ, vibhāgaśaḥ sūtrasthānādivibhāgenoktam|140|-

ab.seg: śālākyakaumārakāyacikitsābhūtavidyānāṃ nāmamātreṇehoddiṣṭānāṃ nirdeśābhāvāt kathaṃ jñānamityāha- ihoddiṣṭānityādi| iha viṃśatyadhikādhyāyaśate ye'rthāḥ śālākyādayo nāmamātreṇoddiṣṭā natu prapañcena nirdiṣṭāḥ, tānatha anantaramuttare vakṣyāmi||140||

lg.l: tathā dṛṣṭaphalatvāc ca hitatvād api dehinām ||141||
cikitsitāt puṇyatamaṃ na kiñcid api śuśrumaḥ ||142||

ab.seg: cikitsitasyopādeyatāmāgamapratyakṣaphalatvābhyāmeva nirdiśannāha- sanātanatvādityādi| cikitsitādanyat puṇyatamaṃ na kimapi śuśrumaḥ na kimapi anu gurupāramparyeṇa śrutavantaḥ| kuta ityāha- sanātanatvādvedānāmiti|- āyurvedāṅgānāṃ śalyādīnāṃ sanātanatvānnityabhavatvādakṛtakatvādityarthaḥ| etenākṛtakatvākhyahetukena doṣābhāveṇa tatproktasya cikitsitasya puṇyatamatvam| tathā akṣaratvādāyurvedāṅgānāṃ śalyādīnāṃ na kṣaratītyakṣaramavicalanātmakamucyate, etāni cāyurvedāṅgānyakṣarāṇi avicalanātmakāni yāthātathyādityarthaḥ, etasmādapi cikitsitaṃ puṇyatamam| āgamapramāṇamabhidhāya pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇamāha- tathā dṛṣṭaphalatvācceti| dṛṣṭaphalamapi kiñcidapuṇyatamaṃ `kiñcit puṇyatamaṃ yathā- asteyādītyāha’ iti pā. yathā steyādītyāha- hitatvādapi dehināmiti| cikitsitādityasya svarūpaviśeṣaṇamāha- vāksamūhārthavistārāditi|- vāksamūhe'rthavistāro yasmin; ata eva pūjitatvācca dehibhiriti dehinaḥ vyādhiparimokṣaṃ svastharakṣaṇamicchanta āyurvedaṃ viśiṣṭapadapadārtharūpaṃ svasukhakāmāḥ pūjayanti| yataścikitsitamuktairhetubhiḥ pavitratamaṃ; tasmādindraprabhāvasya munestaṃ vedamavidyamānapāpalakṣaṇamamalaṃ, paramāṇāṃ mahatāṃ samyaḍyataṃ pūjitaṃ hṛdaye dhāraṇāt| uktāhārasamācāra uktavyādhiparimokṣasvastharakṣaṇāhārācāraḥ| iha ihaloke, pretya paraloke'pi, modate hṛṣyati| gayadāsastu `sanātanatvādvedānāmakṣaratvāttathaiva ca’ itīdṛśaṃ vyākhyānayati- sanātanatvāt nityabhavatvādāyuṣaḥ santānasyopakāryasya nityasadbhāvāttadupahitakārako'pyāyurvedo nityaḥ| tatrāyuṣaḥ santānasyaiva santatinityatāmuddiśannāha akṣaratvāditi|- na kṣarantīti akṣarāṇi akārādayaḥ svarāḥ kādīni ca vyañjanāni; tadghaṭitatvādāyurvedasyāpi nityatvaṃ kāraṇānurūpaṃ kāryamiti kṛtvā||141-143||

div.ab: iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ kalpasthāne kīṭakalpo nāmāṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||8|| iti bhagavatā śrīdhanvantariṇopadiṣṭāyāṃ tacchiṣyeṇa maharṣiṇā suśrutena viracitāyāṃ suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ pañcamaṃ kalpasthānaṃ samāptam |

ab.seg: iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ kalpasthāne'ṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ||8||

div.head: aupadravikādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāta aupadravikam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

kalpasthānānantaramuttaratantramārabhyate, yena kalpasthāne viṣajasyāgantuvraṇasya viṣamupadravakāri ‘viṣavadupadravakāritvaṃ’ iti pā. nijavraṇasyāpi ripubhiravacāritaviṣamupadravabhūtamiti ‘ripubhiravacāritaviṣasya viṣavadupadravakāritvam’ iti pā. taccikitsitabhihitam, ata upadravacikitsādhikārasāmānyāt sarvopadravacikitsārthamuttaratantrārambhaḥ; athavā saviṃśamadhyāyaśataṃ parisamāpya pariśiṣṭatvāduttaratantraṃ ‘pariśiṣṭabhūtamuttaratantraṃ’ iti pā. pratipādyaṃ bhavati| tasya ca tantrasyopadravānadhikṛtya pravṛttatvānniruktyā aupadravikatvaṃ prāptamapyadhyāye vyavasthitam| taduktaṃ sūtre- ‘adhikṛtya kṛtaṃ’ ityādi| sa ca niruktisampanno'dhyāyaḥ prāk pratipādyo bhavatītyata āha- athāta ityādi| upadravān rogānadhikṛtya kṛto'dhyāya aupadravikaḥ||1-2||

lg.l: adhyāyānāṃ śate viṃśe yad uktam asakṛn mayā |
vakṣyāmi bahudhā samyag uttare 'rthān imān iti ||3||
idānīṃ tat pravakṣyāmi tantram uttaram uttamam |4|

div.ab: idānīmārabhyamāṇasyottaratantrasya sambandhaṃ darśayannāha- adhyāyānāmityādi| yadyasmāt kāraṇādviṃśatyadhike'dhyāyaśate punaḥ punaruktaṃ mayā; kiṃ tadityāha- ‘imānarthān bahudhottare vakṣyāmi’ iti; tattasmāt kāraṇādadhunottaratantraṃ pravakṣyāmīti sambandhaḥ| kecit ‘yadviṃśatyadhike proktamadhyāyānāṃ śate mayā’ iti paṭhanti; apare tu ‘śate saviṃśe'dhyāyānāṃ’ iti paṭhanti||3||-

lg.l: nikhilenopadiśyante yatra ‘tatra’ iti pā. rogāḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ ||4||
upasargādayo rogā ye cāpy āgantavaḥ smṛtāḥ ||6||
yuktārthā yuktayaś caiva doṣabhedās tathaiva ca ||7||

div.ab: idānīmuttaratantrasya nikhilavyādhiniścayacikitsālakṣaṇāṃ stutiṃ nirdiśannāha- nikhilenetyādi| nikhilena sāmastyena| yatra yasminnuttaratantre| pṛthagvidhā nānāprakārāḥ| ke te nānāprakārā rogā nikhilenottare'bhidhāsyante? ityāha- śālākyaśāstrābhihitā ityādi| videhādhipakīrtitā iti nimipraṇītāḥ ṣaṭsaptatirnetrarogāḥ, na karālabhadraśaunakādipraṇītāḥ| ye ca vistarato haṣṭā iti pārvatakajīvakabandhakaprabhṛtibhiḥ; ‘yācaka’ iti pā. kumārābādhahetavaḥ skandagrahaprabhṛtayaḥ| ṣaṭsu kāyacikitsāsu agniveśabheḍajātūkarṇaparāśarahārītakṣārapāṇīproktāsu| upasargādayo jvarādayaḥ| āgantavaḥ atra unmādādayaḥ| nanu bhūtanimittatvādunmādādīnāṃ kathamāgantukatvaṃ? yataḥ prahārādikṛtā āgantavaḥ; satyaṃ, bāhyanimittatvādunmādādīnāmāgantukatvam| gayī tu, upasargādayaḥ amānuṣopasargādayaḥ, te cāpasmāronmādā bhūtavidyābhihitāḥ, ta evāgantava iti vyākhyānayati| uttaratantre nikhilena rogā eva proktā utānye'pi proktā? iti pṛṣṭa āha- triṣaṣṭī rasasaṃsargā ityādi| yuktārthāḥ pramāṇopapannārthāḥ| yuktayaḥ tantrayuktayaḥ| asyāgre kecit ‘videhādhipatiḥ śrīmān janako nāma viśrutaḥ| ālambhayajñapravaṇaḥ so'yajadbrāhmaṇairvṛtaḥ|| tasya yāgapravṛttasya kupito bhagavān raviḥ|| dṛṣṭiṃ praṇāśayāmāsa so'nutepe mahattapaḥ|| dīptāṃśustapasā tena toṣitaḥ pradadau punaḥ|| cakṣurvedaṃ prasannātmā sarvabhūtānukampayā||’ iti pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca| taṃ ca bṛhatpañjikākāro na paṭhati, tasmānmayā'pi na paṭhito na vyākhyātaśca||4-7||-

ab.seg: idānīṃ sarvendriyādhiṣṭhānatvena prāṇādhiṣṭhānatvena ca śiraḥ pradhānamataḥ prathamaṃ śiraḥsthān vyādhīn kathayāmīti nirdiśannāha- mahata ityādi| tasya uttaratantrasyādau uttamāṅgasthān rogānabhidadhāmīti sambandhaḥ| ambudheriva samudrasyeva, mahataḥ ativistīrṇasya, durgādhasya agādhasya| saṅkhyayā ṣaṭsaptatyā videhādhipaproktayā, lakṣaṇaiḥ vyañjanaiḥ, cakāreṇa hetucikitsābhyāṃ; sādhyāsādhyakrameṇa ceti sādhyāsādhyaparipāṭyā| athavā lakṣaṇaiḥ hetupūrvarūpopaśayasamprāptibhiḥ; cakāreṇa cikitsitamevānuktaṃ samuccīyate, kecicca kramaśabdenaiva cikitsitaṃ gṛhṇanti||8-9||

div.ab: tatra sarveṣūttamāṅgastheṣu saṅkhyādibhirvācyeṣu nayanagatarogābhidhānaṃ, sarvendriyāṇāṃ madhye nayanasya pradhānatvāt; tatrāpi nayanasya paṭalavyadhanimittamantaḥpraveśāyāmavistārairmānamākāraṃ ‘mānaṃ kāraṇaṃ ca’ iti pā. ca darśayannāha- vidyādityādi| dvyaṅgulabāhulyamidamantaḥpraveśapramāṇaṃ, dvyaṅgulamānamāha ‘aṅgulamānamāha-’ iti pā. - svāṅguṣṭhodarasammitaṃ; etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati- svāṅguṣṭhodarasammitaṃ yadaṅgulaṃ tadaṅguladvayapramāṇaṃ netrabudbudasyāntaḥpraveśaṃ vidyāt| dvyaṅgulaṃ sārdhamiti ardhatṛtīyāṅgulamityarthaḥ| sarvata iti āyāmato vistaraścetyarthaḥ| nayanabudbudam akṣigolakaḥ| sarvabhūtaguṇodbhavaṃ sarvabhūtebhyastadguṇebhyaścodbhavo yasya tattathāvidhaṃ; sarvabhūtebhyastāvannetrabudbudaṃ sirāsnāyvasthisahitaṃ sāśrumārgaṃ cotpannaṃ, tadguṇebhyaśca raktasitakṛṣṇaguṇā utpannāḥ; etena guṇavadbhūtotpannamityarthaḥ| kecidguṇaśabdena bhūtaprasādaṃ kathayanti; tacca vyākhyānaṃ jejjaṭāya ‘jejjaṭasya’ iti pā. na rocate||10||-

lg.l: palaṃ bhuvo 'gnito raktaṃ vātāt kṛṣṇaṃ sitaṃ jalāt ||11||

div.ab: yena bhūtena netrabudbudamārabhyate yena ca raktādaya iti darśayannāha- palamityādi| palaṃ māṃsaṃ, bhuvaḥ pṛthivyāḥ; agnito raktamiti agniguṇādraktaṃ pittarūpaṃ; evaṃ sitaṃ jalādityatrāpi vyākhyeyaṃ; aśrumārgā aśrusrotāṃsi||11||-

lg.l: dṛṣṭiṃ cātra tathā vakṣye yathā brūyād viśāradaḥ ||12||

ab.seg: idānīṃ tasminnetrabudbude yaddṛṣṭimaṇḍalaṃ tasya pramāṇaṃ pūrvācāryapratipāditapramāṇānurūpaṃ pratipādayitumāha- dṛṣṭiṃ cetyādi| viśārado videhaḥ| kṛṣṇāt saptamamiti kṛṣṇamaṇḍalāt saptamaṃ bhāgaṃ dṛṣṭimicchanti| dṛṣṭiviśāradāḥ śālākinaḥ| etat pramāṇaṃ paramatamapyapratiṣiddhatvādanumatameva| tasya saptamāṃśasya kiṃ pramāṇaṃ syāditi kathanāya masūradalamātrāmityagre nirdeśaḥ; athavā śālākināṃ paramatamabhidhāya masūradalamātrāmiti svamatamabhidhāsyatyācāryaḥ| yadyevaṃ tarhyāturopakramaṇīye ‘navamastārakāṃśo dṛṣṭiḥ’ iti kathamuktavān? satyaṃ, mahāpuruṣāṇāṃ pūrṇāyuṣāṃ bhinnaviṣayamabhidhānamiti na doṣaḥ, ato'nyānyapi samādhānāni pañjikoktāni santi, tāni vistarabhayānna likhitāni| kecidimaṃ pāṭhamanyathā kṛtvā''pātanikāpūrvakaṃ paṭhanti, sa cābhāvānna likhitaḥ||12-13||

lg.l: maṇḍalāni ca sandhīṃś ca paṭalāni ca locane |
yathākramaṃ vijānīyāt pañca ṣaṭ ca ṣaḍ eva ca ||14||

ab.seg: idānīṃ nayanasya rogādhiṣṭhānakathanāya maṇḍalādisaṅkhyāmāha- maṇḍalānītyādi| kecidevaṃ paṭhanti- ‘locane maṇḍalānyantān sandhīṃśca paṭalāni ca| jānīyāt kramaśaḥ pañca caturaḥ ṣaṭ ṣaḍeva ca’- iti| eṣa pāṭho nibandhakārairdūṣitaḥ||14||

lg.l: anupūrvaṃ tu te madhyāś catvāro 'ntyā yathottaram ||15||

ab.seg: tānyeva pañcamaṇḍalānyāha- pakṣmavartmetyādi| pakṣmādīnāṃ pañca maṇḍalāni| te tu maṇḍalā anupūrvaṃ madhyāḥ, yathottaraṃ cāntyāḥ||15||
sandhīnāha- pakṣmetyādi| kanīnakagato nāsāsamīpe'vasthitaḥ ‘nāsāsamīpavyavasthitaḥ’ iti pā., apāṅgago bhrūpucchāntaḥsthitaḥ||16||

lg.l: dve vartmapaṭale vidyāc catvāry anyāni cākṣiṇi |

div.ab: paṭalānyāha- dve ityādi| catvāryanyāni cākṣiṇi aparāṇyapi catvāri paṭalānyakṣiṇi vidyāt| yeṣu caturṣu paṭaleṣu||17||-

lg.l: tejo jalāśritaṃ bāhyaṃ teṣv anyat piśitāśritam |
medas tṛtīyaṃ paṭalam āśritaṃ tv asthi cāparam ||18||

div.ab: idānīṃ tānyeva timirasyāśrayabhūtāni catvāri paṭalāni cikitsārthaṃ vibhajannāha- teja ityādi| atra tejaḥśabdenālocakatejaḥsamāśrayaṃ ‘samāśritaṃ’ iti pā. sirāgataṃ raktaṃ boddhavyam| jalaṃ tvaggato rasadhātuḥ, bāhyam akṣigolakasya prathamaṃ paṭalaṃ; anyat dvitīyaṃ, bāhulyaṃ sthūlatā||18||-

lg.l: sirāṇāṃ kaṇḍarāṇāṃ ca medasaḥ kālakasya ca ||19||
guṇāḥ kālāt paraḥ śleṣmā bandhane 'kṣṇoḥ sirāyutaḥ |20|

div.ab: teṣāmeva dhātūnāṃ paṭalāśrayāṇāmupadhātūnāṃ ca karmato ‘kāryatvena’ iti pā. nayane'stivaṃ darśayannāha- sirāṇāmityādi| sirādīnāṃ kālakāsthiparyantānāṃ parā guṇā yathottaramutkṛṣṭāḥ prasādā, akṣṇorbandhane'nyonyasaṃhanane'dhikṛtāḥ|| tathā kālakāt paraḥ kālakāsthnaḥ sakāśācchleṣmā sirāyuto'kṣṇorbandhane para utkṛṣṭo'dhikṛta iti piṇḍārthaḥ| sirāṇāmityatra bahuvacanasyādyarthavācitvāddhamanīnāmapi grahaṇam| kaṇḍarāṇāmityatra kaṇḍarāśabdaḥ snāyuvācakaḥ| anye tu sirādīnāṃ medaḥparyantānāṃ guṇāḥ prasādāḥ kālakasyākṣṇoḥ kṛṣṇabhāgasya bandhane'dhikṛtāḥ| tathā kālāt paraḥ kṛṣṇabhāgādyaḥ paraḥ śuklo bhāgastasya bandhane sirāyutaḥ śleṣmā| kecidetadarthānukūlenaivātra pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti,- ‘sirāṇāṃ kaṇḍarāṇāṃ ca medasaḥ kṛṣṇabandhane| guṇāḥ kālāt paraḥ śleṣmā bandhane'kṣṇoḥ sirāyutaḥ’- iti||19||-

idānīṃ netrarogāṇāṃ sāmānyāṃ samprāptimāha- sirānusāribhirityādi| sirā atra netragatāḥ| viguṇaiḥ prakupitaiḥ| netrabhāgeṣu netrāvayaveṣu| netrarājiṣviti kecit paṭhanti; tatra netrāṇyeva rājayo netrarājayaḥ| etena sarvanetrāśrayā api labdhā bhavanti||20||-

lg.l: tatrāvilaṃ sasaṃrambham aśrukaṇḍūpadehavat ‘... maśrupūrṇopadehavat’ iti pā.||21||
vihanyamānaṃ rūpe vā kriyāsv akṣi yathā purā |
dṛṣṭvaiva dhīmān budhyeta doṣeṇādhiṣṭhitaṃ tu tat ||23||

ab.seg: pūrvarūpamāha- tatretyādi| āvilam ākulamaśrupūrṇamityarthaḥ ‘maṇḍapūrṇamivetyarthaḥ’ iti pā.| sasaṃrambham īṣacchophayuktam| upadeho malavṛddhiḥ| gurūṣātodarāgādyairjuṣṭamiti atrādiśabdaḥ pratyekaṃ yojyaḥ; tena gurutvādibhiḥ śleṣmaliṅgaiḥ, ūṣādibhiḥ pittaliṅgaiḥ, todādibhiḥ vātāliṅgaiḥ, rāgādibhiḥ śoṇitaliṅgaiḥ, juṣṭaṃ sevitam| nanu yadi gurutvādīni doṣaliṅgāni santi tat kathaṃ pūrvarūpaṃ? yato doṣaviśeṣeṇāvyaktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ pūrvarūpaṃ; ata āha- avyaktalakṣaṇairiti|- gurutvādīnāmapi tatra vyaktatā nāstyevetyarthaḥ| saśūlam īṣacchūlamityarthaḥ| vihanyamānamityādi| rūpe nīlapītādau yena prakāreṇa pūrvamāsīttataḥ svayameva vihanyamānaṃ kriyamāṇavighātam| kriyāsu nimeṣonmeṣādiṣu ceti| anye tu ‘kriyāsvakṣi yathā purā’ ityatra ‘kriyāsvakṣyāgataklamam’ iti paṭhanti| tatrāgataklamam āptaklamaṃ, nirvyāpāramityarthaḥ||21-23||

lg.l: vidadhyān netrajā rogā balavantaḥ syur anyathā ||24||

ab.seg: pūrvarūpe kriyāṃ nirdiśannāha- tatretyādi| tatra nayane, sambhavaṃ rogāṇāṃ prāgutpattiṃ, āsādya jñātvā, bhiṣagjitam auṣadhaṃ, vidadhyāt| ‘tatra sañcayamāsādya’ iti kecit paṭhanti; tatra sañcayaśabdaścayaprakopaprasarādiṣu vartate||24||

kiṃ tadbhiṣagjitaṃ pūrvarūpe kuryādityāśaṅkya saṅkṣepavistarābhyāṃ tatra bhiṣagjitamāha- saṅkṣepata ityādi| kriyāṇāṃ saṃśamanasaṃśodhanādīnāmayameva samyagyogaḥ| kiṃ tadityāha- nidānaparivarjanamiti|- nidānānāṃ doṣakārakahetūnāṃ rogakārakahetūnāṃ ca sarvato varjanam| vistareṇa punarvātādīnāṃ pratīghātaḥ kriyāyogaḥ proktaḥ| yenauṣadhaprayogeṇa vātādīnāṃ kopaḥ pratihanyate sa upakrama ukta ityarthaḥ||25||

lg.l: svedād atho dhūmaniṣevaṇāc ca charder vighātād vamanātiyogāt |
bāṣpagrahāt sūkṣmanirīkṣaṇāc ca netre vikārān janayanti doṣāḥ ||27||

ab.seg: kāni tāni nidānāni yāni parihartavyānītyāha- uṣṇetyādi| atra kecit ‘evaṃ vidāhyāpratikāriṇo'nnaṃ’ ityādi yāvat ‘avākśirotyucchritaśāyitasya jvaropatāpādṛtuparyayācca’ ityantaṃ paṭhanti ‘vidāhyasātmyātiviruddhaśītakṣārāmlatīkṣṇoṣṇagurudravānnaiḥ’ ityādi yāvat ‘evaṃ vidāhyapratikāriṇo'nnaṃ vidagdhamapyudgirato narasya| bāṣpagrahātsūkṣmanirīkṣaṇācca netre vikārān janayanti doṣāḥ iti paṭhanti’ iti pā., sa ca pāṭhaḥ punaruktidūṣaṇabhayānnāṅgīkṛtaḥ||26-27||

lg.l: vātād daśa tathā pittāt kaphāc caiva trayodaśa |
tathā bāhyau punar dvau ca rogāḥ ṣaṭsaptatiḥ smṛtāḥ |29|

div.ab: idānīṃ tāneva vikārān vātādisaṅkhyayā nirdiśannāha- vātādityādi| tathā pittāt pittādapi daśaiva ca| bāhyau bahirnimittabhavau| tau kau? eko'bhighātotpannaḥ sanimittaḥ, anyaḥ surarṣigandharvādidarśanābhihataśaktiranimittaḥ||28||-

lg.l: hatādhimantho nimiṣo dṛṣṭir gambhīrikā ca yā ||29||
yac ca vātahataṃ vartma na te sidhyanti vātajāḥ |
yāpyo 'tha tanmayaḥ kācaḥ sādhyāḥ syuḥ sānyamārutāḥ ||30||

div.ab: idānīṃ teṣāmeva vikārāṇāṃ vātādibhedena sādhyāsādhyayāpyatvaṃ darśayannāha- hatetyādi| tanmayaḥ vātamayaḥ| sādhyāḥ syuḥ sānyamārutā iti hatādhimanthādayaścatvāro vātajā asādhyāḥ, ekaśca yāpyaḥ, śuṣkākṣipākādayo rogāḥ sānyamārutā anyatovātarogeṇa sahitāḥ pañca sādhyāḥ||29-30||-

lg.l: asādhyo hrasvajāḍyo yo jalasrāvaś ca paittikaḥ ||31||
parimlāyī ca nīlaś ca yāpyaḥ kāco 'tha tanmayaḥ |
dṛṣṭiḥ pittavidagdhā ca dhūmadarśī ca sidhyati |33|

div.ab: asādhya ityādi| pittasambhavau dvau hrasvajāḍyajalasrāvau sādhayitumaśakyau, tathā paittikau parimlāyīnīlākhyau kācau yāpanārhau, abhiṣyandādayaḥ ṣaṭ sādhyāḥ||31-32||-

lg.l: asādhyaḥ kaphajaḥ srāvo yāpyaḥ kācaś ca tanmayaḥ ||33||
dṛṣṭiḥ śleṣmavidagdhā ca pothakyo lagaṇaś ca yaḥ ||34||
śleṣmopanāhaḥ sādhyās tu kathitāḥ śleṣmajeṣu tu ||35||

ab.seg: asādhya ityādi| tanmayaḥ śleṣmaja ityarthaḥ| kaphajeṣveka evāsādhyaḥ, yāpyo'pyeka eva, abhiṣyandādayaścaikādaśa sādhyāḥ||33-35||

lg.l: śukraṃ na sādhyaṃ kācaś ca yāpyas tajjaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||36||
manthasyandau kliṣṭavartma ‘klinnavartma’ iti pā. harṣotpātau tathaiva ca |
sirājātā'ñjanākhyā ca sirājālaṃ ca yat smṛtam ||37||
parvaṇy athāvraṇaṃ śukraṃ śoṇitārmārjunaś ca yaḥ |
ete sādhyā vikāreṣu raktajeṣu bhavanti hi ||38||

ab.seg: raktasrāva ityādi| raktasrāvastathā'jakā śoṇitārśaḥ kṣataśukrakaṃ ca raktājjātaṃ catuṣṭayamapyasādhyaṃ, tajjo raktajaḥ kāco yāpyaḥ, manthasyandādaya ekādaśa sādhyāḥ||36-38||

lg.l: asādhyāḥ sarvajā yāpyaḥ kācaḥ kopaś ca pakṣmaṇaḥ ||39||
vartmāvabandho yo vyādhiḥ sirāsu piḍakā ca yā |
tathā'rśovartma śuṣkārśaḥ śarkarāvartma yac ca vai ||41||
saśophaś cāpy aśophaś ca pāko bahalavartma ca |

ab.seg: pūyetyādi| pūyāsrāvādayaścatvāro'sādhyāḥ, kācapakṣmakopau yāpyau, vartmāvabandhādaya ekonaviṃśatiḥ sādhyāḥ| kecittu ‘kācaḥ kopaśca pakṣmaṇa’ ityatra ‘yāpyo vartmāvabandhaśca kācaḥ kopaśca pakṣmaṇaḥ| pillākhyaścāpi yo vyādhiḥ sirāsu piḍakā ca yā’ iti paṭhanti| sa ca pāṭhaḥ pañjikayā nirastaḥ, tasmādasmābhirapi parityaktaḥ||39-42||

lg.l: sanimitto 'nimittaś ca dvāv asādhyau tu bāhyajau |43|

div.ab: sanimitta ityādi| tau dvāvapi sannipātanimittau vivṛtau|43|-

lg.l: ṣaṭsaptatir vikārāṇām eṣā saṅgrahakīrtitā ‘saṅgrahakīrtanā’ iti pā.||43||

ab.seg: ṣaḍityādi| saṅkṣepeṇa kathitā, athavā saṅgraheṇa samyak doṣagraheṇa kathitā||43||

lg.l: nava sandhyāśrayās teṣu vartmajās tv ekaviṃśatiḥ |

ab.seg: idānīṃ teṣāṃ doṣaviśeṣeṇa saṅgrahaṃ pratipādya sandhyādyāśrayamedenāpi saṅgrahaṃ pratipādayannāha- navetyādi| dvau bāhyajau ‘tau’ iti pā. sarvāśrayatve'pi dṛṣṭyāśritau mantavyau, dṛṣṭeḥ pradhānatamatvāt||44-45||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre aupadraviko nāma prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||1||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre prathamo'dhyāyaḥ||1||

div.head: saṃdhigatarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ sandhigatarogavijñānīyam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
pūrvasminnadhyāye sandhyādikrameṇa nayanagatarogā abhihitāḥ, ata aupadravikānantaraṃ prāk sandhigatā rogāḥ pratipādyā bhavantītyata āha- athāta ityādi| gataśabda āśrayavacanaḥ||1-2||

lg.l: krimigranthiś ca vijñeyā rogāḥ sandhigatā nava ||3||

ab.seg: srāvāḥ catvāraḥ pūyāsrāva ityādayaḥ||3||

lg.l: pakvaḥ śophaḥ sandhijaḥ saṃsraved yaḥ sāndraṃ pūyaṃ pūti pūyālasaḥ saḥ |4|

div.ab: idānīṃ teṣāṃ navānāmapi pratyekaṃ lakṣaṇamāha- pakva ityādi| sandhijaḥ kanīnasandhijaḥ| pūti durgandham| ayaṃ sannipātajaḥ sādhyaśca|4|-

lg.l: granthir nālpo dṛṣṭisandhāv apākaḥ kaṇḍūprāyo nīrujas tūpanāhaḥ ||4||

ab.seg: granthirityādi| nālpo mahānityarthaḥ| apāka īṣatpākaḥ| upanāhaḥ śleṣmopanāhaḥ| kaphajo'yaṃ sādhyaśca||4||

lg.l: gatvā sandhīn aśrumārgeṇa doṣāḥ kuryuḥ srāvān rugvihīnān kanīnāt |
tān vai srāvān netranāḍīm athaike tasyā liṅgaṃ kīrtayiṣye caturdhā ||5||
pākaḥ sandhau saṃsraved yaś ca pūyaṃ pūyāsrāvo naikarūpaḥ pradiṣṭaḥ |
śvetaṃ sāndraṃ picchilaṃ saṃsraved yaḥ śleṣmāsrāvo nīrujaḥ sa pradiṣṭaḥ ||6||
raktāsrāvaḥ śoṇitotthaḥ saraktam uṣṇaṃ nālpaṃ saṃsraven nātisāndram |
pītābhāsaṃ nīlam uṣṇaṃ jalābhaṃ pittāsrāvaḥ saṃsravet sandhimadhyāt ||7||

ab.seg: sandhayo netrāntargatāścatvāraḥ| aśrumārgaśabdenātra sirā abhipretāḥ| tathāca videhaḥ,- “aśrusrāvaḥ sirā gatvā netrasandhiṣu tiṣṭhati| tataḥ kanīnakaṃ gatvā cāśru kṛtvā kanīnake|| tataḥ sravatyathāsrāvaṃ yathādoṣamavedanam”- iti| aśrusrāvaśabdenātra tatsahito doṣo'bhidhīyate| kathaṃ caturdhetyāha- pāka ityādi|- naikarūpa iti asya ‘tasya’ iti pā. sannipātajatvādbahurūpatvam| sandhiratra kanīnakasandhiḥ| asādhyo'yam| śveta ityādi|- ayamapyasādhyaḥ| raktetyādi|- asāvapyasādhyaḥ| pītetyādi|- kanīnakasandhimadhyādityarthaḥ| vyādhisvabhāvato vātāsrāvo nāsti, pittajagalagaṇḍacāturthikavat| eṣo'pyasādhyaḥ||5-7||

lg.l: tāmrā tanvī dāhaśūlopapannā raktāj jñeyā parvaṇī vṛttaśophā |
jātā sandhau kṛṣṇaśukle 'lajī syāt tasminn eva khyāpitā pūrvaliṅgaiḥ ||8||

ab.seg: tāmretyādi| asādhyo'yam| alajītyādi| tasminneva kṛṣṇaśuklasandhāveva| pūrvaliṅgaiḥ parvaṇīliṅgairityarthaḥ| parvaṇyalajyoḥ sthānasya lakṣaṇasya caikye'pi tanutvasthūlatvābhyāṃ bhedaḥ| tanvī parvaṇī, tataḥ sthūlā punaralajī| iyaṃ sannipātajā asādhyā ca||8||
krimigranthir vartmanaḥ pakṣmaṇaś ca kaṇḍūṃ kuryuḥ krimayaḥ sandhijātāḥ | nānārūpā vartmaśuklasya sandhau ‘vartmaśuklāntasandhau’ iti pā. caranto 'ntarnayanaṃ dūṣayanti ||9||

krimītyādi| krimīgranthirvartmaśuklayoḥ sandhau bhavati| tatraiva nānārūpāḥ krimayo vartmanaḥ pakṣmaṇaśca sandhiṃ prāptāḥ kaṇḍūṃ janayanti, antaścaranto bhakṣayanto nayanaṃ dūṣayanti| asau kaphajaḥ sādhyaśca||9||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantre sandhigatarogavijñānīyo nāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ ||2||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ||2||

div.head: vartmagatarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto vartmagatarogavijñānīyam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
sandhigatarogānantaraṃ ‘vartmaśuklasya sandhau caranto'ntarnayanaṃ dūṣayanti’ iti vartmano'nantaranirdiṣṭatvādvartmagatarogavijñānīyārambho yukta ityata āha- athāta ityādi||1-2||

lg.l: vivardhya ‘vibadhya’ iti pā. māṃsaṃ raktaṃ ca tadā vartmavyapāśrayān |
vikārāñ janayanty āśu nāmatas tān nibodhata ||4||

ab.seg: samprāptimāha- pṛthagityādi| yadā pṛthak samastā vā adhikamūrcchitā atiśayaprakupitā doṣā vartmavyapāśrayāḥ apaśabdasyopasargasya madhyavacanatvādvartmamadhyagatāḥ sirā vyāpya vartmasvavatiṣṭhante, tadā vartmavyapāśrayān vikārān śīghraṃ janayantīti sambandhaḥ| amuṃ pāṭhaṃ pañjikākāro na paṭhati, jejjaṭapaṭhitatvādasmābhirapi paṭhitaḥ||3-4||

lg.l: bahalaṃ vartma yac cāpi vyādhir vartmāvabandhakaḥ |
praklinnam apariklinnaṃ vartma vātahataṃ tu yat |
arbudaṃ nimiṣaś cāpi śoṇitārśaś ca yat smṛtam ||7||
lagaṇo biśanāmā ca pakṣmakopas tathaiva ca |

div.ab: te ca vartmāśrayā rogā ekaviṃśatirabhihitāḥ, atastāneva nāmnā nirdiśannāha- utsaṅginītyādi||5-8||-

lg.l: abhyantaramukhī bāhyotsaṅge 'dho vartmanaś ca yā ‘piḍakā'bhyantaramukhī bāhyā'dhovartmasaṃśrayā’ iti pā.||9||

div.ab: nāmatastān samuddiśya lakṣaṇairāha- lakṣaṇairityādi| abhyantaramukhī vartmābhyantaramukhī| bāhyeti bahirbhavā iva pratibhāsate, vāstūtsedhena ‘bāhyotsedhena\\’ iti pā. bahirapyunnatatvāt| utsaṅge'dho vartmanaśca yeti adhobhāge yadvartma tasyotsaṅge kroḍe jātā yā, tasyā iva rūpaṃ yāsāṃ, tadrūpābhirvyāptā; iyaṃ sannipātajā sādhyā ca| videhoktamihānuktaṃ kāṭhinyādi cohyam| tathā hi taduktaṃ vacaḥ, - “vartmotsaṅge'pyadho ‘'dhare’ iti pā. jantoḥ sannipātāt prajāyate| abhyantaramukhī sthūlā bāhyataścāpi dṛśyate|| piḍakā piḍakābhiśca citā'nyābhiḥ samantataḥ| utsaṅgapiḍakā nāma kaṭhinā mandavedanā|| sā prabhinnā sravet srāvaṃ kukkuṭāṇḍarasopamam”- iti||9||-

lg.l: kumbhīkabījapratimāḥ piḍakā yās tu ‘piḍakāḥ pakṣmavartmanoḥ’ iti pā. vartmajāḥ ||10||
ādhmāpayanti bhinnā yāḥ ‘ādhmāyante tu bhinnāśca’ iti pā. kumbhīkapiḍakās tu tāḥ |11|

div.ab: kumbhīkā dāḍimākāraphalā sthalakumbhī| vartmajā iti bahuvacanād bāhyā eva bhavanti| etāḥ sannipātajā api sādhyāḥ||10||-

lg.l: srāviṇyaḥ kaṇḍurā ‘kaṇḍūsrāvānvitā’ iti pā. gurvyo raktasarṣapasannibhāḥ |
piḍakāś ca rujāvatyaḥ pothakya iti sañjñitāḥ ||11||

ab.seg: srāviṇya ityādi| srāviṇyo bahusrāvāḥ| kaṇḍurā iti kaṇḍuyuktāḥ| rujāvatya iti kaphajā api vedanāyuktā ityarthaḥ| imāḥ sādhyāḥ||11||

lg.l: piḍakā yā kharā sthūlā sā jñeyā vartmaśarkarā ||12||

ab.seg: piḍakābhirityādi| iyaṃ sannipātajā sādhyā ca||12||

lg.l: ervārubījapratimāḥ `ervārubījapratimā pīḍakā mandavedanā| sūkṣmā kharā ca vartmasthā tadarśoṃvartma kīrtyate’ iti pā. piḍakā mandavedanāḥ |
sūkṣmāḥ kharāś ca vartmasthās tad arśovartma kīrtyate ||13||

ab.seg: ervārvityādi| ervāruḥ grīṣmakarkaṭī| vartmasthā vartmanāmantarbāhyato'pi tiṣṭhāti| idaṃ sannipātajamapi sādhyam||13||

lg.l: vyādhir eṣa samākhyātaḥ śuṣkārśa iti sañjñitaḥ ||14||

ab.seg: dīrgha ityādi| dāruṇaḥ atikaṣṭataraḥ| vartmasambhavo vartmanāmantareva bhavati| ayaṃ vyādhiḥ sannipātajo'pi sādhyaḥ||14||
dāhetyādi| raktajeyaṃ sādhyā ca||15||

lg.l: savarṇābhiḥ samābhiś ca vidyād bahalavartma tat ||16||

ab.seg: vartmetyādi| etadapi sannipātajaṃ sādhyaṃ ca||16||

lg.l: na samaṃ chādayed akṣi bhaved bandhaḥ sa vartmanaḥ ||17||

ab.seg: kaṇḍūmatetyādi| eṣa sannipātajo'pi sādhyaḥ||17||

lg.l: mṛdvalpavedanaṃ tāmraṃ yad vartma samam eva ca |
akasmāc ca bhaved raktaṃ kliṣṭavartma tad ādiśet ||18||

ab.seg: mṛdvityādi| ‘akasmācca sravedraktaṃ’ iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ, taṃ ca pañjikākāro na manyate| akasmācca kāraṇaṃ vinā dvayamapi vartma raktaṃ bhavet| tathā ca videhaḥ,- “śleṣmaduṣṭena raktena kliṣṭamāṃsamivobhayam| bandhujīvanibhaṃ vartma kliṣṭavartma taducyate”- iti| etadraktajaṃ sādhyaṃ ca||18||

lg.l: kliṣṭaṃ punaḥ pittayutaṃ vidahec choṇitaṃ yadā |

ab.seg: kliṣṭamityādi| yadā kliṣṭārambhakaṃ śleṣmaduṣṭaṃ śoṇitaṃ pittayuktaṃ vidahet vidāhaṃ gacchettadā klinnatvamāpannaṃ kliṣṭameva vartmakardama ucyate, klinnatvamāpannamārdratāṃ prāptam| etat kaphapittaraktārabdhatvāt sannipātajaṃ sādhyaṃ ca| ‘kṛṣṇatvamāpannam’ iti kecit paṭhanti, taṃ pāṭhaṃ pañjikākāro nāṅgīkaroti||19||

lg.l: yad vartma bāhyato 'ntaś ca śyāvaṃ śūnaṃ savedanam |
dāhakaṇḍūparikledi `sakaṇḍūṣāparikledaṃ’ iti pā. śyāvavartmeti tan matam ||20||

ab.seg: yadvartmetyādi| etadapi sannipātajaṃ sādhyaṃ ca||20||

lg.l: arujaṃ bāhyataḥ śūnam antaḥ klinnaṃ sravaty api |

ab.seg: arujamityādi| arujamalparujaṃ śūnaṃ ca bāhye, klinnaṃ sravatyapyantareva, kaṇḍūnistodabahulaṃ punarantareva| ayaṃ rogaḥ pillākhyaḥ kenacit kathitaḥ, tat pañjikākāro na manyate| ayaṃ vyādhiḥ kaphajaḥ sādhyaśca||21||

lg.l: yasya dhautāni dhautāni sambadhyante punaḥ punaḥ |

ab.seg: yasyetyādi| yasya rogasya sthānabhūtāni vartmānyasakṛtprakṣālitāni punaḥ sambaddhāni bhavanti pillopadehenāntarbahiśca pākarahitānyapi pākarahitatvāt’ iti pā., tadaklinnavartma jānīyāt| etat sannipātajamapi sādhyaṃ pillākhyaṃ ca| tathā ca videhaḥ- “prakṣālite tathā `'thavā’ iti pā. mṛṣṭe ānahyete punaḥ punaḥ| apariklinnavartmānaṃ pillākhyamiti nirdeśet”- iti| amuṃ dvayamapi dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikapāṭhaṃ sūtre jejjaṭācāryaḥ paṭhati, tannecchati gayadāsaḥ||22||

lg.l: vimuktasandhi niśceṣṭaṃ vartma yasya na mīlyate |
etad vātahataṃ vidyāt sarujaṃ yadi vā'rujam ||23||

ab.seg: vimuktetyādi| niśceṣṭaṃ niṣkriyam| ata eva na nimīlyate na saṅkucatītyarthaḥ| arujam alparujam| idaṃ vātajamasādhyaṃ ca||23||

vartmetyādi| vartmāntarastham abhyantarasthamityarthaḥ| viṣamaṃ kaṣṭakāri| granthibhūtaṃ granthiriva `granthirivāsaktaṃ’ iti pā.| saraktamavalambitamiti kiñcidraktatā pittena, avalambitatvamarbudatvena| ‘avalambi ca’ iti kecit paṭhanti| sannipātajamapīdaṃ sādhyam||24||

lg.l: cālayaty ati `cālayedakṣivartmāni’ iti, `cālayedativartmāni’ iti ca pā. vartmāni nimeṣaḥ sa gado mataḥ ||25||

ab.seg: nimeṣaṇīrityādi| vartmasaṃśrayāḥ nimeṣiṇīḥ sirā vāyuḥ praviṣṭaḥ san vartmāni cālayatīti sambandhaḥ| yadbalena nimeṣonmeṣau syātāṃ tā nimeṣiṇyaḥ sirāḥ| ‘so'gado mata’ iti kecit paṭhanti, tatrāgada avyatha ityarthaḥ| asau vātajo'sādhyaśca||25||

chinnā ityādi| ye śoṇitasambhavā mṛdavo vartmasthā aṅkurāśchinnāśchinnāḥ santo vivardhante te'ṅkurā arśaḥ `śoṇitārśaḥ iti sambandhaḥ’ iti pā. śoṇitārśa iti sambandhaḥ| idaṃ śoṇitārśo raktajamasādhyaṃ ca||26||

lg.l: sakaṇḍūḥ picchilaḥ kolapramāṇo lagaṇas tu saḥ ||27||

ab.seg: apāka ityādi| śleṣmajo'yaṃ sādhyaśca||27||

lg.l: śūnaṃ yad vartma bahubhiḥ sūkṣmaiś chidraiḥ samanvitam |
bisam antarjala iva bisavartmeti tan matam ||28||

ab.seg: śūnamityādi| yathā'ntarjale bisaṃ bisāṇḍaṃ tadvadityarthaḥ| etat sarvajamapi sādhyam||28||

lg.l: nirvartayanti pakṣmāṇi tair ghuṣṭaṃ `tairjuṣṭaṃ’ iti pā. cākṣi dūyate ||29||
uddhṛtair uddhṛtaiḥ `utpāṭitaiḥ punaḥ’ iti pā. śāntiḥ pakṣmabhiś copajāyate |

ab.seg: doṣā ityādi| nirvartayanti niṣpādayanti| pakṣmāṇi pratibālān| taiḥ pakṣmabhiḥ, akṣi locanaṃ, dūyate upatapyate| uddhṛtairuddhṛtairiti unmūlitairunmūlitairityarthaḥ; atra vīpsayā teṣāṃ punaḥ punarudbhavaḥ khyāpyate| asya pakṣmakopasya ‘upapakṣmamālā’ iti anuktā dvitīyā sañjñā; loke ‘parivāla’ iti vadanti| eṣa rogaḥ sarvajo yāpyaśca||29-30||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantre vartmagatarogavijñānīyo nāma tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ ||3||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ||3||

div.head: śuklagatarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ śuklagatarogavijñānīyam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
vartmagatarogavijñānīyānantaraṃ vartmamaṇḍalācchuklamaṇḍalasyānantaryāttadgatarogavijñānīyārambho yukta ityata āha- athāta ityādi||1-2||

lg.l: syuḥ śuktikā cārjunapiṣṭakau ca jālaṃ sirāṇāṃ piḍakāś ca yāḥ syuḥ ||3||
rogā balāsagrathitena sārdham ekādaśākṣṇoḥ khalu śuklabhāge |4|

div.ab: tāneva rogānnāmabhirāha- prastārītyādi| armaśabdaḥ prastāryādibhiḥ pañcabhiḥ saha sambadhyate| jālaṃ sirāṇāmiti sirāśabdo jālapiḍakābhyāṃ sambadhyate; tena sirājālaṃ, sirāpiḍakāścetyarthaḥ||3||-

lg.l: prastāri prathitam ihārma śuklabhāge vistīrṇaṃ tanu rudhiraprabhaṃ sanīlam ||4||

ab.seg: prastārītyādi| prathitaṃ prakhyātaṃ, vistīrṇaṃ vitataṃ, tanu viralaṃ, rudhiraprabhaṃ raktanibhaṃ, sanīlam īṣannīlam, eteneṣannīlalohitamityarthaḥ| jejjaṭācāryastu videhoktaṃ prastāryarmalakṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā sanīlamityatra vāśabdo lupto draṣṭavyaḥ, tena raktamīṣannīlaṃ vetyartha iti pratipādayati| tathā ca videhavākyaṃ- “samantādvistṛtaḥ śyāvo rakto vā māṃsasañcayaḥ| sannipātena doṣāṇāṃ prastāryarma taducyate”- iti| tridoṣajamidaṃ sādhyaṃ ca||4||

lg.l: śuklākhyaṃ mṛdu kathayanti śuklabhāge saśvetaṃ samam iha vardhate ’samamabhivardhate’ iti pā. cireṇa |5|

div.ab: śuklākhyamityādi| śuklākhyaṃ śuklanāmārma| mṛdu komalaṃ, saśvetaṃ kiñcicchvetaṃ; śleṣmajamidaṃ sādhyaṃ ca|5|-

lg.l: yan māṃsaṃ pracayam upaiti śuklabhāge padmābhaṃ tad upadiśanti lohitārma ||5||

ab.seg: yadityādi| pracayaṃ vṛddhim, upaiti gacchati, padmābham aruṇapadmaprabhaṃ, lohitārma śoṇitārmetyārthaḥ| etadraktajaṃ `sādhyeyaṃ raktajā ca’ iti pā. sādhyaṃ ca||5||

lg.l: vistīrṇaṃ mṛdu bahalaṃ yakṛtprakāśaṃ śyāvaṃ vā tad adhikamāṃsajārma vidyāt |6|

div.ab: vistīrṇamiti| bahalaṃ sthūlam| etat sannipātajaṃ sādhyaṃ ca|6|-

lg.l: śukle yat piśitam upaiti vṛddhim etat snāyvarmety abhipaṭhitaṃ kharaṃ prapāṇḍu ||6||

ab.seg: śukle ityādi| etattridoṣajamapi sādhyam| kharaṃ kharasparśam| ‘snāyvābhaṃ piśitāṃśamupaiti yattu snāyvarma’ ityapi pāṭhaḥ| ‘kharaṃ ca śuklaṃ’ iti kecit paṭhanti||6||

lg.l: śyāvāḥ syuḥ piśitanibhāś ca bindavo ye śuktyābhāḥ sitanayane sa śuktisañjñaḥ |7|

div.ab: śyāvā ityādi| śuktyābhā iti jalaśuktiriva kiñjiddīrghāḥ śuklamaṇḍale ye bindavaḥ sa śuktikāvikāra iti sambandhaḥ| sādhyo'yaṃ pittajaśca|7|-

lg.l: eko yaḥ śaśarudhiropamas tu binduḥ śuklastho bhavati tam arjunaṃ vadanti ||7||

ab.seg: eka ityādi| raktajo'yaṃ sādhyaśca||7||

lg.l: utsannaḥ salilanibho 'tha piṣṭaśuklo bindur yo bhavati sa piṣṭakaḥ suvṛttaḥ |8|

div.ab: utsanna ityādi| piṣṭaśuklaḥ taṇḍulapiṣṭavacchuklaḥ, śuklatve'pyacchatvāt salilanibhaḥ, piṣṭakaḥ piṣṭakanāmā| ayaṃ ślaiṣmikaḥ sādhyaśca|8|-

lg.l: jālābhaḥ kaṭhinasiro mahān saraktaḥ santānaḥ smṛta iha jālasañjñitas tu ||8||

ab.seg: jālābha ityādi| anulomavilomavistṛtasirānicayaviracitatvājjālasyeva ābhā yasya sa tathā| rakto lohito lohitajanitaśca, santānaḥ sirāsantānaḥ| eṣa sirājālasañjñito raktajaḥ sādhyaśca||8||

lg.l: śuklasthāḥ sitapiḍakāḥ sirāvṛtā yās tā vidyād asitasamīpajāḥ sirājāḥ |9|

div.ab: śuklasthā ityādi| sirājāḥ ‘piḍakā’ iti śeṣaḥ| vāstusthitasirāvṛttatvāt sirājāḥ, na tu sākṣāt sirājāḥ| eṣa sannipātajaḥ sādhyaśca|9|-

lg.l: kāṃsyābho `kāṃsyābho bhavati sirāvṛtaḥ site yo bindurvā sa tu nirujo balāsakākhyaḥ’ iti pā. bhavati site 'mbubindutulyaḥ sa jñeyo 'mṛdur arujo balāsakākhyaḥ ||9||

ab.seg: kāṃsyābha ityādi| kāṃsyasyeva ābhā yasya sa tathā, sita ityarthaḥ| ambubindutulyaḥ vāribindurivodgatvāt| amṛduḥ kaṭhinaḥ| arujaḥ avyathaḥ| etaddvayamapi kaphajanitatvāt `kaphānilajanitatvāt’ iti pā. nāmānvayena balāsanāmā vikāro balāsaja eva| atraiva videhaḥ,- “mārutotpīḍitaḥ śleṣmā śuklabhāge vyavasthitaḥ| jalabindurivocchūno mṛduḥ kaphasamudbhavaḥ”- iti| pustakāntare cānyathā pāṭhaḥ, yathā- ‘santāno bhavati sirāvṛtaḥ site yo bindurvā sa tu nirujo balāsakākhyaḥ’- iti| īdṛśasya pāṭhasya ṭīkākārā vyākhyāṃ na kurvanti| sādhyo'yaṃ śleṣmajaśca||9||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantre śuklagatarogavijñānīyo nāma caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ ||4||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre caturtho'dhyāyaḥ||4||

div.head: kṛṣṇagatarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ kṛṣṇagatarogavijñānīyam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
śuklagatarogavijñānīyānantaraṃ pratyāsattyā kṛṣṇamaṇḍalagatā rogāḥ pratipādyā ityāta āha- athāta ityādi||1-2||

lg.l: yat savraṇaṃ śukra(kla)m athāvraṇaṃ vā pākātyayaś cāpy ajakā tathaiva |
catvāra ete 'bhihitā vikārāḥ kṛṣṇāśrayāḥ saṅgrahataḥ purastāt ||3||

ab.seg: tāneva kṛṣṇagatarogānnāmabhiḥ prāha- yadityādi| saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva catuḥsaṅkhyāyāṃ labdhāyāṃ catuḥsaṅkhyākaraṇaṃ tantrāntaroddiṣṭātiriktasaṅkhyānirāsārtham| saṅgrahataḥ samyagupādānataḥ||3||

lg.l:
nimagnarūpaṃ hi bhavet tu kṛṣṇe sūcyeva viddhaṃ pratibhā
ti yad vai `yacca’ iti pā.|
srāvaṃ sraved uṣṇam atīva ruk ca tat savraṇaṃ śukra(kla)m udāharanti ||4||

ab.seg: tāneva lakṣaṇairnirdiśannāha- nimagnetyādi| nimagnarūpam antaḥpraviṣṭarūpam, īṣaddṛśyarūpamityarthaḥ| sūcyeva viddhamityanena vartulatvaṃ darśitaṃ, raktasyāgneyatvāduṣṇāśrutā atyarthaṃ ca pīḍā bhavati| avraṇaśukle mandarugaśrutā vakṣyate, tasmādasmin sakṣate śukre kṣatayogānnetrasya sukumāratvāccātīva vedanā yuktā| atra videhaḥ- “raktarājīnibhaṃ kṛṣṇe vidrumābhaṃ pralakṣyate| sūcyagreṇaiva tacchukramuṣṇāśrusrāvi savraṇam”- iti| savraṇaṃ sakṣatamityarthaḥ| raktajamidamasādhyaṃ ca||4||

lg.l: dṛṣṭeḥ samīpe na bhavet tu yac ca na cāvagāḍhaṃ na ca saṃsraved dhi |
avedanāvan na ca yugmaśukraṃ tat siddhim āpnoti kadācid eva ||5||

ab.seg: idānīṃ tasyaivāvasthādvāreṇa kādāciktaṃ sādhyatvaṃ darśayannāha- dṛṣṭerityādi| saṃsraveddhītyatra saṃśabdo'tiśayārthaḥ| avedanāvat mandavedanam||5||

lg.l: vicchinnamadhyaṃ piśitāvṛtaṃ vā calaṃ sirāsaktam adṛṣṭikṛc ca ‘sirāsūkṣmaṃ’ iti pā.|
dvitvaggataṃ lohitam antataś ca cirotthitaṃ cāpi vivarjanīyam ||6||
uṣṇāśrupātaḥ piḍakā ca kṛṣṇe yasmin bhaven mudganibhaṃ ca śukram |
tad apy asādhyaṃ pravadanti kecid anyac ca yat tittiripakṣatulyam ||7||

ab.seg: tasyaiva kadācitsādhyasya lakṣaṇaṃ pratipādyāsādhyasya lakṣaṇaṃ pratipādayannāha- vicchinnetyādi| vicchinnamadhyamiti vidīrṇamāṃsatvānmadhye sacchidramiva| pakṣāntaramāha- piśitāvṛtaṃ veti, ācchinnamadhyamevonnatamāṃsena veṣṭitaṃ vā| calaṃ sirāsaktamiti yataḥ sirāsaktamata eva calaṃ, sirā hi svabhāvata eva calāḥ; tadāśritaṃ śukramapi calameva; anye tu calaṃ caladiva na tu sākṣāccalameva| adṛṣṭikṛt darśanarodhakṛt| dvitvāggataṃ dvipaṭalāśritam| lohitamantataśceti prānteṣu lohitamityarthaḥ| idānīṃ dvipaṭalāśritasya lakṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha- uṣṇetyādi| kasmiṃścit pustake ‘piḍakā ca pītā’ iti pāṭhaḥ, sa na saṅgacchate ‘tacca saṅgacchate’ iti pā.| tathā ca videhaḥ- “coṣoṣṇasrāvadāhāstu kṛṣṇe ca piḍikodgamaḥ| vyaktamudgaphalākāraṃ śukraṃ dvitvaggataṃ bhavet” iti| ekīyamatamāha- tadityādi| yaccānyacchukraṃ tittiripakṣatulyaṃ tadapyasādhyaṃ kecidvadantīti sambandhaḥ| etat paramatamapyapratiṣiddhatvādanumatameva||6-7||

lg.l: sitaṃ yadā bhāty asitapradeśe syandātmakaṃ nātirugaśruyuktam |
vihāyasīvāc chaghanānukāri ‘abhradalānukāri’iti pā. tad avraṇaṃ sādhyatamaṃ vadanti ||8||

ab.seg: idānīṃ savraṇaṃ śukraṃ pratipādyāvraṇaṃ pratipādayannāha- sitamityādi| syandātmakam abhiṣyandakāraṇaṃ vihāyasīva ākāśa iva, acchaghanānukāri pratanumeghakhaṇḍānukārītyarthaḥ| raktajamidaṃ sādhyaṃ ca||8||

lg.l: gambhīrajātaṃ bahalaṃ ca śukraṃ cirotthitaṃ cāpi vadanti kṛcchram |9|

div.ab: asyaivāvraṇasya śukrasyāvasthābhedena kṛcchratāṃ darśayannāha- gambhīretyādi| evambhūtamavraṇamapi śukraṃ kṛcchraṃ vadantīti sambandhaḥ| gambhīrajātaṃ dvipaṭalāśritamityarthaḥ| jejjaṭācāryastu savraṇāvraṇaśukrasya lakṣaṇaṃ sādhyāsādhyatvaṃ ca viparītakrameṇa paṭhati, mayā tu pañjikākārābhiprāyeṇānenaiva krameṇa paṭhitam|9|-

lg.l: sañcchādyate `śvetaḥ samākrāmati sarvato hi’ iti pā. śvetanibhena sarvaṃ doṣeṇa yasyāsitamaṇḍalaṃ tu ||9||
tam akṣipākātyayam akṣikopasamutthitaṃ `... makṣirogaṃ sarvātmakaṃ varjayitavyamāhuḥ’ iti pā. tīvrarujaṃ vadanti |10|

div.ab: idānīṃ pākātyayamāha- sañcchādyata ityādi| akṣikopāt samutthitaṃ syandādutpannamityarthaḥ| eṣa tridoṣajo'sādhyaśca||9||-

lg.l: vidārya kṛṣṇaṃ pracayo 'bhyupaiti taṃ cājakājātam iti vyavasyet ||10||

ab.seg: ajetyādi| ajāpurīṣapratima iti viśuṣkacchagalīpurīṣatulyaḥ| salohita īṣallohitaḥ| lohitapicchilāśruriti lohitaṃ picchilaṃ cāśru yasya saḥ| pracayaḥ sāmarthyānmedasaḥ| eṣa śleṣmajo'sādhyaśca||10||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantre kṛṣṇagatarogavijñānīyo nāma pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||5||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ||5||

div.head: sarvagatarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ sarvagatarogavijñānīyam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

athāta ityādi| sarvagatarogavijñānīyaḥ sarvāśrayarogavijñānīya ityarthaḥ| kṛṣṇamaṇḍalapratyāsattyā dṛṣṭigatarogavijñānīyo yujyate, yaśca dṛṣṭigatarogavijñānīyāt pūrvaṃ sarvagatarogavijñānīyārambhaḥ sa dṛṣṭigatānāṃ timirādīnāmabhiṣyandanimittatvaṃ na syāditi bodhayati, sandhyādigatānāṃ ca syandakāraṇatvaṃ bodhayati||1-2||

lg.l: syandās tu catvāra ihopadiṣṭās tāvanta eveha tathā'dhimanthāḥ |
śophānvito 'śophayutaś ca pākāv ity evam ete daśa sampradiṣṭāḥ ||3||

ab.seg: sarvākṣigatarogāṇāṃ saṅkhyāmāha- syandā ityādi| tāvanta eva catvāra eva| prathamaślokena daśa, dvitīyaślokena sapta, evaṃ saptadaśa sarvāśrayāḥ kathitāḥ||3-4||

lg.l: prāyeṇa sarve nayanāmayās tu bhavanty abhiṣyandanimittamūlāḥ |
tasmād abhiṣyandam udīryamāṇam upācared āśu hitāya dhīmān ||5||

ab.seg: sarveṣāṃ netrarogāṇāmabhiṣyandabhavatvāt tatpratīkārasyāśeṣanayanāmayapratīkārabhūtatvādyatnataḥ pūrvarūpa evāsau pratikaraṇīya ityāha- prāyeṇetyādi| abhiṣyandanimittamūlā iti abhiṣyandāśca tannimittāni ca tānyeva mūlaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathā| nimittaśabdādduṣṭā doṣā doṣakopanāni ca saṅgṛhyante| udīryamāṇam utpadyamānam| ‘abhiṣyandanimittamūlā’ ityatra ‘abhiṣyandasamudbhavā hi’ iti kecit paṭhanti||5||

lg.l: viśuṣkabhāvaḥ śiśirāśrutā ca vātābhipanne nayane bhavanti ||6||

ab.seg: idānīṃ vātābhiṣyandalakṣaṇamāha- nistodanamityādi| nistodanaṃ sūcyeva vyadhanam| stambhanaṃ stabdhatā| saṅgharṣaḥ karakarimā| śirobhitāpaḥ śirovyathā| ‘viśuṣkabhāvaḥ śiśirāśrutā ca’ ityatra ‘śuṣkālpadūṣikahimāśrutā ca’ iti kecit paṭhanti| tatra dūṣikā netramalam| sādhyo'yam||6||

lg.l: uṣṇāśrutā pītakanetratā ca pittābhipanne nayane bhavanti ||7||

ab.seg: pittābhiṣyandalakṣaṇamāha- dāhetyādi| śiśirābhinandā śītābhilāṣaḥ| dhūmāyanaṃ dhūmasyevodvamanaṃ, bāṣpasamucchrayaḥ aśrubāhulyam| ayamapi sādhyaḥ||7||

lg.l: srāvo muhuḥ picchila eva cāpi kaphābhipanne nayane bhavanti ||8||

ab.seg: śleṣmābhiṣyandalakṣaṇamāha- uṣṇetyādi| upadeho malopaliptatā, sitatā śuklatā; eṣo'pi sādhyaḥ||8||

lg.l: tāmrāśrutā lohitanetratā ca rājyaḥ samantād atilohitāś ca |
pittasya liṅgāni ca yāni tāni raktābhipanne nayane bhavanti ||9||

ab.seg: raktābhiṣyandamāha- tāmretyādi| asāvapi sādhyaḥ||9||

lg.l: tāvantas tv adhimanthāḥ syur nayane tīvravedanāḥ ||10||

ab.seg: adhimanthānāmabhiṣyandarogakṛtatvaṃ darśayannāha- vṛddhairityādi| tāvantaḥ catvāra eva| tīvravedanā ityatra vedanāśabdaḥ sāmānyapīḍāvacanaḥ| tena yathāsvaṃ vātādidoṣavedanāyuktā ityarthaḥ; etenedamuktaṃ bhavati- vātikādabhiṣyandādvātika evādhimanthastīvravātikanistodādisakalavedano bhavati; evaṃ paittikaḥ, ślaiṣmiko, raktotthitaśceti||10||

lg.l: śiraso 'rdhaṃ ca taṃ vidyād adhimanthaṃ svalakṣaṇaiḥ ||11||

ab.seg: adhimanthānāṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇamāha- utpāṭyata ityādi| netraṃ nirmathyate tatheti na kevalaṃ netrameva nirmathyate śiraso'rdhaṃ ca tathā nirmathyata iti, ardhaśiraso vedanā ca vyādhisvabhāvāt| svalakṣaṇairvātādīnāṃ svakīyairlakṣaṇaiḥ| kecidatrādhimanthānāṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ na paṭhanti, pañjikāyāṃ paṭhitatvādasmābhiḥ paṭhitam||11||

lg.l: netram utpāṭyata iva mathyate 'raṇivac ca yat |
śiraso 'rdhaṃ ca yena syād adhimanthaḥ sa mārutāt ||13||

ab.seg: adhimanthānāṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇamuktvā vistareṇa viśeṣalakṣaṇamāha- netramityādi| saṅgharṣaḥ karakarimā| anye tu ‘saṃharṣa’ iti paṭhanti, tatra saṃharṣo romāñcaprāyo vedanāviśeṣaḥ| todaḥ sūcīvyadhanamiva vedanā| nirbhedaḥ śastreṇa vidāraṇamiva| māṃsasaṃrabdhaṃ māṃsopacitamityarthaḥ| āvilaṃ samalam| eṣa sādhyaḥ||12-13||
pittādhimanthalakṣaṇamāha- raktarājītyādi| dāhi kṣāreṇāktamiva kṣatamiti kṣāraliptakṣatamiva dahanaśīlam| eṣa vyādhiḥ sādhyaḥ||14-15||
śleṣmādhimanthalakṣaṇamāha- śophavadityādi| dūṣikā netramalam| ayamapi rogaḥ sādhyaḥ||16-17||
raktādhimanthalakṣaṇamāha- bandhujīvetyādi| bandhujīvo madhyāhnapuṣpakaḥ, ariṣṭakaṃ kṛṣṇaphalaṃ ‘arīṭhā’ iti loke| asāvapi sādhyaḥ||18-19||

lg.l: ṣaḍrātrādvai mārutottho nihanyān mithyācārāt paittikaḥ sadya eva ||20||

ab.seg: idānīṃ vātādyadhimanthānāṃ samyagupacārasādhyānāṃ vaidyāturayoryatnādhānārthaṃ mithyācārāddṛṣṭivināśāvadhiṃ yathādoṣaṃ nirdiśannāha- hanyādityādi| mithyācārāditi padaṃ śleṣmodbhavādyadhimantheṣu sarveṣvapi sambadhyate| dṛṣṭināśakālāvadhirapyatra vyādhisvabhāvāt||20||

lg.l: juṣṭo muhuḥ sravec cāsram uṣṇaśītāmbu picchilam |
saṃrambhī pacyate yaś ca netrapākaḥ saśophajaḥ ||22||

ab.seg: saśophapākamāha- kaṇḍvityādi| saṃrambhī śophayuktaḥ||21-22||

div.ab: aśophapākamāha- śophetyādi| liṅgāni saśophapākaliṅgānītyarthaḥ| ubhāvapi pākau tridoṣajau sādhyau ca|23|-

lg.l: upekṣaṇād akṣi yadā'dhimantho vātātmakaḥ sādayati prasahya |
rujābhir ugrābhir asādhya eṣa hatādhimanthaḥ khalu nāma rogaḥ ||23||

ab.seg: sakalanayanaśoṣalakṣaṇaṃ hatādhimanthaṃ darśayannāha- upekṣaṇādityādi| sādayati avasādayati, śoṣayatītyarthaḥ||23||

lg.l: hatādhimanthaṃ janayet tam asādhyaṃ vidur budhāḥ ||24||

ab.seg: dṛṣṭinirgamalakṣaṇaṃ hatādhimanthaṃ darśayannāha- antaḥsirāṇāmityādi| pratikṣipan niṣkāsayannityarthaḥ| yadyapi hatādhimanthalakṣaṇadvitvaṃ jñāyate tathā'pyeka eva, ato na saṅkhyātirekaḥ| jejjaṭācāryastu nayanaśoṣalakṣaṇahatādhimanthasya pāṭhaṃ na paṭhati, dṛṣṭinirgamalakṣaṇasya hatādhimanthasya pāṭhaṃ paṭhati, pañjikākāreṇa ca videhoktaṃ prakāradvayena hatādhimanthalakṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā nyūnatādoṣabhayāt pāṭhadvayamapi paṭhitam| tathā ca videhaḥ- “antargataḥ sirāṇāṃ tu yadā tiṣṭhati mārutaḥ| sa tadā nayanaṃ prāpya śīghraṃ dṛṣṭiṃ nirasyati|| tasyāṃ nirasyamānāyāṃ nirmathnanniva mārutaḥ| nayanaṃ nirvamatyāśu śūlatodādhimanthanaiḥ|| athavā śoṣayedakṣi kṣīṇatejobalānalam| utpadmamiva saṃśuṣkamavasīdati locanam|| hatādhimanthaṃ taṃ vidyādasādhyaṃ vātakopataḥ”- iti||24||

lg.l: pakṣmadvayākṣibhruvam āśritas tu yatrānilaḥ sañcarati praduṣṭaḥ |
paryāyaśaś cāpi rujaḥ karoti taṃ vātaparyāyam udāharanti ||25||

ab.seg: vātaparyāyamāha- pakṣmetyādi| akṣi locanaṃ, bhrūḥ prasiddhā| paryāyaśaścāpi rujaḥ karoti kadācit pakṣmadvaye, kadācidakṣiṇi, kadācidbhruvīti paryāyaśabdārthaḥ| sādhyo'yam||25||

lg.l: yat kūṇitaṃ dāruṇarūkṣavartma vilokane cāviladarśanaṃ yat |
sudāruṇaṃ yat pratibodhane ca śuṣkākṣipākopahataṃ tad akṣi ||26||

ab.seg: śuṣkākṣipākamāha- yadityādi| kūṇitaṃ nimīlitaṃ, dāruṇaṃ kaṭhinaṃ rūkṣaṃ vartma yasya tattathā| vilokane cāviladarśanamiti yadatidarśane ākuladarśanamityarthaḥ| sudāruṇaṃ yat pratibodhane ceti pratibodhane unmeṣe ca yadatiśayena kaṭhinaṃ; anye sudāruṇaṃ kṛcchronmīlanam| vātiko'yaṃ sādhyaśca||26||

lg.l: kuryād rujo 'ti bhruvi locane vā tam anyatovātam udāharanti ||27||

ab.seg: anyatovātamāha- yasyetyādi| avaṭuḥ grīvāyāḥ paścimo bhāgaḥ| manyā grīvāyāḥ pārśvayoḥ sirāviśeṣaḥ| anyato veti pṛṣṭhato vetyarthaḥ| anyatovāta iti yathārtheyaṃ sañjñā, yato'nyataḥ sthito vāyuranyato vedanāṃ karoti| vātiko'yaṃ sādhyaśca||27||

lg.l: amlena bhuktena vidāhinā ca sañchādyate sarvata eva netram |
śophānvitaṃ lohitakaiḥ sanīlair etādṛg amlādhyuṣitaṃ vadanti ||28||

ab.seg: amlādhyuṣitamāha- amlenetyādi| vidāhinā veti kaṭukena lavaṇena vetyarthaḥ| lohitakai rāgairityarthaḥ| sanīlaiḥ īṣannīlaiḥ| etādṛk īdṛśamityarthaḥ| amlādhyuṣitam amlajanitapittādhyuṣitam| eṣa rogaḥ paittikaḥ sādhyaśca||28||

lg.l: avedanā vā'pi savedanā vā yasyākṣirājyo hi bhavanti tāmrāḥ |
muhur virajyanti ca tāḥ samantād vyādhiḥ sirotpāta iti pradiṣṭaḥ ||29||

ab.seg: sirotpātamāha- avedanetyādi| virajyanti viraktā bhavanti prakṛtavarṇā bhavantītyarthaḥ `viśeṣaraktavarṇā bhavantītyarthaḥ’ iti śrīkaṇṭhadattaḥ| raktajo'yaṃ sādhyaśca||29||

lg.l: mohāt sirotpāta upekṣitas tu jāyeta rogas tu sirāpraharṣaḥ |
tāmrāccham asraṃ `tāmrābhamasraṃ’ iti pā. sravati pragāḍhaṃ tathā na śaknoty abhivīkṣituṃ ca ||30||

ab.seg: sirāharṣamāha- mohādityādi| ayamapi raktajaḥ sādhyaśca||30||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantre sarvagatarogavijñānīyo nāma ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ ||6||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargataśālākyatantre ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ||6||

div.head: dṛṣṭigatarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto dṛṣṭigatarogavijñānīyam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
sarvagatarogavijñānīyānantaraṃ dṛṣṭigatarogāṇāṃ pāriśeṣyādārambho yukta ityata āha- athāta ityādi||1-2||

lg.l: khadyotavisphuliṅgābhām iddhāṃ `siddhāṃ iti pā. tejobhir avyayaiḥ ||3||
