ab.seg: tāṃ ca dṛṣṭiṃ cikitsārthaṃ pramāṇākārasvalakṣaṇairnirdiśannāha- masūretyādi| masūradalamātrāmiti masūradalapramāṇāmityarthaḥ| pañcabhūtaprasādajāmiti pañcabhūtānāṃ dhāmabhūtāt sārājjātāmityarthaḥ| pañcabhūtamadhye ekasya prādhānyamāha- iddhāṃ tejobhiravyayairiti; etena tejomayī dṛṣṭirityuktam| khadyotavisphuliṅgābhāmiti khadyoto jyotiriṅgaṇaḥ, visphuliṅgaḥ sukṣmo'gnikaṇaḥ; khadyotavisphuliṅgau taijasāvapi yathā na dahatastathā dṛṣṭirapi na dahati| yadi sā khadyotādisadṛśī tarhi divākaraprakāśādrūpagrahaṇena na bhavitavyamityāha- avyayairiti|- avyayaiḥ upacayāpacayarahitaistejobhirviśiṣṭā| tasya dṛṣṭeḥ kuto bhāsvaratā na dṛśyata ityāha- āvṛtāṃ paṭalenākṣṇorbāhyeneti; āvṛtām ācchāditāṃ, bāhyena tejo jalāśritena| yadyapi bāhyapaṭalāvṛtatvāddṛṣṭe `duṣṭigatabāhyapaṭalāvṛtatvāt’ iti pā. rūpagrahaṇasāmarthyopaghātaḥ prāptaḥ, tathā'pi paṭalasyātyantācchatvāddromakūpavivarāntaratvācca `romakūpavivarāntargatatvācca’ iti pā. tejaḥparamāṇūnāṃ bahiścaratve `bahiḥśarārutve’ iti pā. rūpagrahaṇasāmarthyaṃ dṛṣṭernopahanyata ityāha- vivarākṛtimiti|- vivaraṃ chidraṃ tasyevākṛtiryasyāḥ sā tathā tāṃ, na tu sākṣāttatra chidramasti| vivarākāravacanena punarmṛdutaivoktā, na punaḥ sarvathā śuṣiratvaṃ; tathā ca sati `tadā hi’ iti pā. paṭalānāṃ pratipāditānāmapyanupapattiḥ syāt| dṛṣṭeḥ paṭalacatuṣṭaye'pi rūpagrahaṇasāmarthyamanumātavyaṃ, kālakāsthyāśritābhyantarapaṭalamapi gate doṣe rūpagrahaṇavikṛtilakṣaṇasya timirasyokteḥ| śītasātmyāmiti| nanu śītena tejo'bhihanyate tat kathaṃ śītena sātmyaṃ? ucyate- pṛthagvyavasthitayorjalāgnyorvirodho, na punaḥ sahotpannayorekakāryayoḥ; prabhāvādvā jalāntargatamapyetattejo nopahanyate||3-4||

lg.l: rogāṃs tadāśrayān ghorān ṣaṭ ca ṣaṭ ca pracakṣmahe |

ab.seg: pramāṇādibhiścikitsopayogibhirdṛṣṭimabhidhāya tadāśrayarogopavarṇanārthaṃ paṭalacatuṣṭayapraviṣṭatimiralakṣaṇopadeśārthaṃ ca pratipādayannāha- rogānityādi| tadāśrayān dṛṣṭyāśrayānityarthaḥ| ṣaṭ ca ṣaṭ ceti dvādaśetyarthaḥ||5||

lg.l: prathame paṭale doṣo yasya dṛṣṭau vyavasthitaḥ ||6||
avyaktāni sa rūpāṇi sarvāṇy eva prapaśyati |7|

div.ab: prathamapaṭalagatasya timirārambhakadoṣasya samprāptileśapūrvakaṃ lakṣaṇamāha- sirābhirityādi| abhisamprāpya samyaggatvā| viguṇo duṣṭaḥ| abhyantare sarvābhyantare kālakāsthyāśrite prathamapaṭale| sa puruṣaḥ| ‘sarvāṇyeva prapaśyati’ ityatra ‘kadācidatha paśyati’ iti pañjikākāraḥ paṭhati vyākhyānayati ca- kadācinna sarvakālam| etena sthānaviśeṣāddoṣasyālpabalavattoktā, taduttareṣu kramāt balavattvamiti| tānyavyaktarūpāṇyapi vakṣyamāṇarūpabhramaṇāruṇavarṇādiyuktāni vātena, tathā pittenādityakhadyotādīni nīlapītavarṇāni, evaṃ kaphena sitavarṇāni, raktena raktavarṇāni, sannipātena vicitrāṇi| evaṃ dvitīyādipaṭaleṣvapi vyākhyeyam||6||-

lg.l: dṛṣṭir bhṛśaṃ vihvalati dvitīyaṃ paṭalaṃ gate ||7||
makṣikā maśakān keśāñ jālakāni ca paśyati |
maṇḍalāni patākāṃś ca marīcīḥ kuṇḍalāni ca ||8||
pariplavāṃś ca `paripūrvāśca’ iti pā. vividhān varṣam abhraṃ tamāṃsi ca |
dūrasthāny api rūpāṇi manyate ca samīpataḥ ||9||
yatnavān api cātyarthaṃ sūcīpāśaṃ na paśyati ||10||

ab.seg: dvitīyapaṭalagatadoṣalakṣaṇamāha- dṛṣṭirityādi| dvitīyaṃ paṭalaṃ medaḥśritam| bhṛśamiti yādṛśī prathame paṭale tato'dhikaṃ vihvalībhavati| vihvalatvamāha- makṣikā maśakānityādi| makṣikādīnāmabhāve'pi timirārambhakadvitīyapaṭalāśritadoṣaprabhāveṇa makṣikādīni yathādoṣavarṇāni paśyati| jālakāni jantulālāviracitajālakākārāṇi, maṇḍalāni vartularūpāṇi| patākāḥ dhvajān| marīcīḥ mṛgatṛṣṇāḥ| kuṇḍalāni karṇakuṇḍalāni| pariplavāṃśceti nakṣatrādīnāṃ gatīḥ| vividhān ūrdhvādhastiryaggamanena kṛṣṇapītaśuklavarṇadarśanena vā nānāprakārān| varṣaṃ vṛṣṭim| asadrūpagrahaṇe vihvalatvaṃ pratipādya sadrūpagrahaṇe'pi deśāparijñāne dṛśorvihvalatvaṃ pratipādayannāha- dūrasthānītyādi| gocaravibhramāt indriyārthavibhramāt||7-10||

lg.l: ūrdhvaṃ paśyati nādhastāt tṛtīyaṃ paṭalaṃ gate |
mahānty api ca rūpāṇi cchāditānīva vāsasā ||11||
yathādoṣaṃ ca rajyeta dṛṣṭir doṣe balīyasi ||12||
pārśvasthite tathā doṣe pārśvasthāni na paśyati ||13||
samantataḥ sthite doṣe saṅkulānīva `saṅkulāni ca’ iti pā. paśyati |
dṛṣṭimadhyagate doṣe sa ekaṃ manyate dvidhā ||14||

div.ab: tṛtīyapaṭalagatadoṣalakṣaṇamāha- ūrdhvamityādi| tṛtīyaṃ paṭalaṃ māṃsāśritam| ūrdhvaṃ paśyatīti ālokasahāyatvena dṛśa ūrdhvamupalambho nādhastāt| viparītāni karṇādihīnāni| yathādoṣaṃ ceti sāmarthyānmāṃsasthitaśoṇitasahāyena `māṃsasthitaśoṇitasahāyabalavattare doṣe’ iti pā. balavattaradoṣeṇa dṛṣṭau rāga utpadyata ityarthaḥ| ata eva prathamadvitīyapaṭalayoḥ śoṇitābhāvādrāgābhāvaḥ| adhaḥsthite dṛṣṭimaṇḍalādhobhāgasthite doṣe ityarthaḥ| saṅkulānīveti miśrībhūtānīva vasturūpāṇi paśyati| dvidhā sthite ‘doṣe’ iti śeṣaḥ| anavasthite cañcale doṣe| timirākhyaḥ timirasañjñaḥ, rāgaprāptasya ca timirasya ‘kāca’ iti sañjñā||11-14||-

lg.l: ruṇaddhi sarvato dṛṣṭiṃ liṅganāśaḥ sa ucyate |
nirmalāni ca tejāṃsi bhrājiṣṇūni `bhrājiṣṇūnīva paśyati’ iti pā. ca paśyati ||17||

ab.seg: caturthapaṭalagatadoṣalakṣaṇamāha- sa ityādi| sa eva timirākhyaḥ, caturthaṃ paṭalaṃ tejojalāśritaṃ prāpto yadā sarvato dṛṣṭiṃ ruṇaddhi tadā liṅganāśa ucyata iti sambandhaḥ| liṅganāśa iti liṅgaṃ cakṣurindriyaśaktiḥ, tasya nāśo yasmin sa liṅganāśo doṣaḥ| tatrāpyalpeṣu doṣeṣu keṣāñcidvastuviśeṣāṇāmupalambho bhavatīti darśayannāha- tasminniti| tasmin liṅganāśe| tamobhūte iti atra bhūtaśabda upamāne| nātiruḍhe nātivṛddhe| mahāgade pradhānendriyatirobhāvakatvāt| nirmalāni ca tejāṃsi agnyādīni, bhrājiṣṇūni anyānyapi dīptimanti yāni vastūni tāni paśyatītyarthaḥ||15-17||

div.ab: tasyaiva liṅganāśasyāparaṃ sañjñādvayaṃ pratipādayannāha- sa evetyādi| nīlikāviśeṣitā kācasañjñā sañjātā yasya sa tathā| kācasañjñā ca tṛtīye'pi paṭale rāgitimirasya rāgotpattidvāreṇa sūcitā| etena kācatvāt paṭaladvayagatayorapi doṣayoḥ ṣaṭtvaṃ na tu dvādaśatvam| asyāgre kicit ‘yanmayastanmayāni’ ityādipāṭhamāpātanikāpūrvakaṃ paṭhanti, sa cābhāvānna likhitaḥ|18|-

lg.l: tatra vātena rūpāṇi bhramantīva sa paśyati ||18||

div.ab: idānīṃ teṣu paṭaleṣu krameṇa vātādideṣārabdhasya timirasya liṅgāni darśayannāha- vātenetyādi| āvilāni samalāni, aruṇābhāni īṣadraktāni| vyāviddhāni vakrāṇi||18||-
pittajatimiralakṣaṇamāha- pittenetyādi| khadyoto jyotiriṅgaṇaḥ| śakracāpam indradhanuḥ, taḍidguṇo vidyullatā, śikhibarhaḥ mayūrapicchaḥ||19||-

lg.l: kaphena paśyed rūpāṇi snigdhāni ca sitāni ca ||20||

div.ab: śleṣmajatimiralakṣaṇamāha- kaphenetyādi| gauracāmaragaurāṇīti śvetacāmaravacchuklāni| sitāni ceti sudhautaśuklavastrasadṛśāni| asūkṣmāṇi sthūlāni| vyabhre vigataghane `megharahite’ iti pā.| abhrasamplavaṃ meghānāṃ sarvato gamanam| salilaplāvitānīva parijāḍyānīti sarvataḥ salilaplavaneneva śuklāni stimitāni ca rūpāṇi paśyati||20-21||-

lg.l: tathā raktena raktāni tamāṃsi vividhāni ca ||22||

div.ab: raktajatimiralakṣaṇamāha- tathetyādi| dhūmadhūmrāṇi dhūmaveṣṭitānīva| yadyapi timirasya raktāntargatadoṣajanyatvādraktajasañjñā na syāt, tathā'pi raktabāhulyādupacārādvā raktajavyapadeśaḥ||22||-

lg.l: bahudhā vā dvidhā vā'pi sarvāṇy eva samantataḥ |
hīnādhikāṅgāny athavā jyotīṃṣy api ca paśyati `mānavaḥ’ iti pā.||24||

ab.seg: sannipātajatimiralakṣaṇamāha- sannipātenetyādi| citrāṇi nānāvarṇāni viplutāni sarvato'vakīrṇāni| bahudhā bahutvaṃ gatāni, dvidhā dvitvaṃ gatāni, sarvāṇyeva yāvaddraṣṭavyāni rūpāṇi| hīnādhikāṅgānīti na kevalaṃ tṛtīye paṭale hīnādhikāṅgāni paśyati sannipātena punaḥ paṭalāntare'pi hīnādhikāṅgāni paśyati| jyotīṃṣi tārakāṇi||23-24||

lg.l: pītā diśas tathodyantam ādityam iva paśyati ||25||
vikīryamāṇān khadyotair vṛkṣāṃs tejobhir eva ca |26|

div.ab: nanu vātapittakaphaśoṇitasannipātaiḥ pañcabhiḥ pañcatimirāṇāṃ cottarāvasthāsu kācaliṅganāśasañjñe kṛte, kācāśca ṣaṭ vyākhyeyā iti teṣāṃ ṣaṭtvopapattihetubhūtaṣaṣṭhaparimlāyitimirakathanāya, tathā parimlāyitimirākrāntasya puṃso yādṛśaṃ rūpagrahaṇaṃ bhavati tādṛgrūpakathanāya ca prāha- pittamityādi| mūrcchitaṃ saṃyuktaṃ, raktatejasā raktaprasādena; anye tu raktārthaṃ tejo raktatejaḥ, tena mūrcchitaṃ; etena raktārthaṃ pariṇamyamānarasena saṃyuktamityarthaḥ| īdṛśe ca vyākhyāne nāmānvayaḥ `nāmadvayaṃ’ iti pā. saṅgacchate| yathā parimlāyī kṣayī kathyate tathā ca vakṣyati,- ‘doṣakṣayāt kadācit syāt svayaṃ tatra ca darśanam’ iti, tacca kṣayitvaṃ laṅghanādibhirupabṛṃhakarasakṣayāt `upabṛṃhaṇakarabalakṣayāt pittakṣayāccopapadyate’ iti pā. pittakṣayāccopapadyate| raktajapakṣe raktakṣayopapattirnāsti| kecit ‘raktatejasā’ ityatra ‘bhaktatejasā’ iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- bhaktatejasā āhāraprasādena rasākhyenetyarthaḥ| atra sātyakiprabhṛtīnāṃ matānulomena raktamūrcchitaṃ pittaṃ hyapītyavagantavyam| tathā ca rāgakathanaprastāve sātyakiḥ- “pittaraktotthitā pītāścitritāḥ sannipātajāḥ”- iti| eka evāsau parimlāyī rogo'rāgaprāptaḥ san timirākhyaḥ, rāgaprāptastu kācākhyaḥ, sa eva kiñciddarśananāśakārī liṅganāśaḥ| sarvāṇyeva timirāṇi prathamadvitīyapaṭalagatāni sādhyāni; tṛtīyapaṭalagatāni rāgaprāptyā kācākhyāni bhavanti, tadā yāpyāni||25||-

lg.l: vakṣyāmi ṣaḍvidhaṃ `ṣaḍvidhaiḥ’ iti pā. rāgair liṅganāśam ataḥ param ||26||

ab.seg: tṛtīyarāgitimirasya kācākhyāṃ prāptasya liṅganāśasya ca rāgeṇaiva saṅkhyāṣaṭtvaṃ nirdiśannāha- vakṣyāmītyādi| ṣaḍvidhaṃ ṣaḍbhedabhinnam| tṛtīyapaṭalagataṃ kācākhyāṃ prāptaṃ timiramiti śeṣaḥ| rāgaiḥ vakṣyamaṇaiḥ aruṇādibhiḥ| liṅganāśamataḥ paramiti kācākhyatimirakathanānantaraṃ liṅganāśamapi ṣaḍvidhaṃ vakṣyāmi||26||

lg.l: rāgo 'ruṇo mārutajaḥ pradiṣṭaḥ pittāt parimlāyy athavā'pi nīlaḥ |
kaphāt sitaḥ śoṇitajas tu raktaḥ samastadoṣo 'tha vicitrarūpaḥ `samastadoṣe'tha vicitravarṇaḥ’ iti pā.||27||

ab.seg: tānevāruṇādikān rāgānāha- rāga ityādi| parimlāyī pīta ityarthaḥ| aruṇādirāgaiḥ pañcabhistāvat pañca kācā jñeyāḥ, ṣaṣṭhaḥ kācaśca parimlāyī rogaḥ paraṃ rāgaprāptaḥ| asya ca pītavarṇatā sātyakivacanādavagantavyā| evaṃ ṣaṭ kācāḥ kathitāḥ||27||

lg.l: raktajaṃ maṇḍalaṃ dṛṣṭau sthūlakācānalaprabham `sthūlakācāruṇaprabham’ iti pā.|
parimlāyini roge syān mlāyy ānīlaṃ ca maṇḍalam ||28||
doṣakṣayāt kadācit syāt svayaṃ tatra ca darśanam |29|

div.ab: atra pittāt parimlāyītyuktaṃ tasya ca lakṣaṇamanuktaṃ vaktumāha- raktajamityādi| raktajaṃ raktaprasādājjātaṃ raktatejasā jātaṃ vā| sthūlakācānalaprabhamiti bāhulyena sthūlakācābhaṃ, varṇenānalaprabham| anye tu ‘aruṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ dṛṣṭau sthūlakācāruṇaprabhaṃ’ iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca- aruṇam aruṇavarṇaṃ| kīdṛśamaruṇamityāha- sthūlakācāruṇaprabhamiti|- sthūlakācasyevāruṇā prabhā yasya tattathā| eṣa pāṭhaḥ pañjikayā dūṣitaḥ| mlāyi kṣayi| ānīlamiti īṣannīlam| analaprabhatvena ca pītatvamuktameva, tasmāt kiñcinnīlapītamityarthaḥ| anye tu ‘mlāyīnīlam’ iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- mlāyīnīlaṃ pītanīlamityarthaḥ| tatra pītaṃ rasamūrcchitapittajanitaṃ, nīlaṃ punaḥ raktamūrcchitapittajam| atra tṛtīyapaṭalasthe rāge doṣavyādhi(pti)vaśādrāgasya maṇḍalākārataiva, na tu le(re)khādiprakāratvamiti niyamārthaṃ punarmaṇḍalagrahaṇamiti| doṣakṣayādityādi karmakṣayāddoṣakṣaye sañjāte kadācidākasmikaṃ tatra parimlāyini roge darśanaṃ syādityeke; anye tu pittasammūrcchākararasasaṅkṣayāt kṣīṇe doṣe tatra kadāciddarśanaṃ syāditi vyākhyāṃ kurvantīti| ayaṃ yāpyaḥ||28||-

lg.l: aruṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ vātāc cañcalaṃ paruṣaṃ tathā ||29||
pittān maṇḍalam ānīlaṃ kāṃsyābhaṃ pītam eva vā |
mṛdyamāne ca nayane maṇḍalaṃ tad visarpati |
yathāsvaṃ doṣaliṅgāni sarveṣv eva bhavanti hi ||33||

ab.seg: idānīṃ kācākhyāṃ prāptasya timirasya rāgeṇa ṣaṭtvaṃ pratipādya, ṣaḍvidhaṃ liṅganāśamataḥ paraṃ vakṣyāmīti yaduktaṃ tadeva ṣaḍvidhatvaṃ maṇḍalarāgabhedena vivṛṇvannāha- aruṇamityādi| paruṣaṃ kharasparśam| ānīlam īṣannīlaṃ, kāṃsyābham āpāṇḍupītam| bahalaṃ sthūlam| śuklo bindurivāmbhasa ityasyāgre kecit ‘saṅkucatyātape'tyarthaṃ chāyāyāṃ vistṛto bhavet’ iti paṭhanti| liṅganāśe'pi pūrvoktavātādirūpabhramaṇāruṇavarṇādidoṣaliṅgaṃ jñeyamiti darśayitumāha- yathāsvamityādi| yathāsvaṃ doṣaliṅgānīti pūrvoktavātāditimirāṇāṃ rūpabhraṇādilakṣaṇānītyarthaḥ| eṣu liṅganāśeṣu kevalaśleṣmajaliṅganāśaṃ vihāyānye liṅganāśā asādhyāḥ| atra kiñciddarśanāvasthāṃ `darśanānāśāvasthāṃ’ iti pā. prāptaḥ parimlāyyeva rogaḥ ṣaṣṭho liṅganāśo jñeyaḥ| evaṃ ṣaḍ liṅganāśā uktāḥ||29-33||

lg.l: ṣaḍ liṅganāśāḥ ṣaḍ ime ca rogā dṛṣṭyāśrayāḥ ṣaṭ ca ṣaḍ eva ca syuḥ |
tathā naraḥ pittavidagdhadṛṣṭiḥ kaphena cānyas tv atha dhūmadarśī ||34||
yo hrasvajāḍyo(tyo) `yo hasvajātyo’ iti pā. nakulāndhatā ca gambhīrasañjñā ca tathaiva dṛṣṭiḥ |35|

div.ab: rāgairaruṇādikaiḥ ṣaḍvidhaṃ liṅganāśamabhidhāyāparān pittavidagdhadṛṣṭyādikān ṣaḍeva nirdiśannāha- ṣaḍityādi| ṣaḍliṅganāśā iti ‘vakṣyāmi ṣaḍvidhaṃ rāgairliṅganāśamataḥ paraṃ’ ityanaineva liṅganāśānāṃ ṣaṭtve prāpte punaḥ ṣaḍiti yatsaṅkhyākaraṇaṃ tanniyamārthaṃ, tena timirakācaliṅganāśānāṃ pṛthak saṅkhyākaraṇaṃ na gaṇanīyaṃ; etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati- ṣaḍ liṅganāśāḥ, ṣaḍime ca rogā vakṣyamāṇāḥ pittavidagdhadṛṣṭyādayaḥ, evaṃ dṛṣṭyāśrayā dvādaśa| ṣaḍime ca rogā iti vakṣyamāṇāḥ pittavidagdhadṛṣṭyādayaḥ| dṛṣṭyāśrayāḥ ṣaṭ ca ṣaḍeva syuriti atrāpi pūrvaśaṅkayā ṣaḍeveti parasmānniyamayati; dvādaśaiva dṛṣṭyāśrayā rogā bhaveyurityarthaḥ| ke te pittavidagdhadṛṣṭyādayaḥ ṣaḍityāha- tathetyādi| tathāśabdo bhinnakrame, kaphena cānya ityatra sambadhyate; tena kaphenāpi vidagdhadṛṣṭiranya ityarthaḥ||34||-

lg.l: pittena duṣṭena gatena dṛṣṭiṃ pītā bhaved yasya narasya dṛṣṭiḥ ||35||
pītāni rūpāṇi ca manyate yaḥ sa mānavaḥ pittavidagdhadṛṣṭiḥ |
prāpte tṛtīyaṃ paṭalaṃ tu doṣe divā na paśyen niśi vīkṣate ca ||36||
(rātrau ‘ayamardhaśloko hastalikhitapustake na paṭhyate’ sa śītānugṛhītadṛṣṭiḥ pittālpabhāvād api tāni paśyet) |37|

div.ab: pittavidagdhadṛṣṭerlakṣaṇamāha- pittenetyādi| dṛṣṭena vṛddhena| `baddhena’ iti pā. niśi vīkṣate ceti rātrau śītopakṛtadṛṣṭitvāt pittābhāvaḥ, ato rātrau rūpadarśanam| sādhyo'yam||35-36||-

lg.l: tathā naraḥ śleṣmavidagdhadṛṣṭis tāny eva śuklāni hi manyate tu ||37||
triṣu sthitolpaḥ paṭaleṣu doṣo naktāndhyam āpādayati prasahya |
divā sa sūryānugṛhītacakṣur īkṣeta `sūryānugṛhītacakṣurīkṣeta’ iti pā. rūpāṇi kaphālpabhāvāt ||38||

ab.seg: kaphavidagdhadṛṣṭerlakṣaṇamāha- nara ityādi| kaphena duṣṭena gatena dṛṣṭiṃ sitā bhavedyasya narasya dṛṣṭiriti tathāśabdārthaḥ| tānyeva rūpāṇi| ayamapi sādhyaḥ||38||

lg.l: sadhūmakān paśyati sarvabhāvāṃs taṃ dhūmadarśīti vadanti rogam ||39||

ab.seg: dhūmadarśino lakṣaṇamāha- śoketyādi| śirobhitāpaḥ śirovyathā| ayaṃ pittajaḥ sādhyaśca||39||

lg.l: sa hrasvajāḍyo `hrasvajātyo’ iti pā. divaseṣu kṛcchrād dhrasvāni rūpāṇi ca yena paśyet |40|

div.ab: hrasvajāḍyalakṣaṇamāha `hrasvajātyalakṣaṇamāha’ iti pā. - sa ityādi| sa puruṣaḥ| yena vikāreṇa| atra divaseṣu paśyediti vacanādrātrau na paśyatītyavagamyate| kecittu ‘rātrau ca śītānugṛhītadṛṣṭiḥ pittālpabhāvādapi tāni paśyet’ iti paṭhanti; taccāsaṅgataṃ, asya naktāndhatājanakatvāt| tathā ca videhaḥ,- “naktamandhāstu catvāro ye purastāt prakīrtitāḥ| teṣāmasādhyo nakulo hrasvajāḍya(tya)stathaiva ca”- iti| atra ca dṛṣṭimadhyagataḥ pīto rāgo jñeyaḥ| asya paṭalacatuṣṭayāśritapittaprabhavatvādasādhyatvam|40|-

lg.l: vidyotate yena narasya dṛṣṭir doṣābhipannā nakulasya yadvat ||40||
citrāṇi rūpāṇi divā sa paśyet sa vai vikāro nakulāndhyasañjñaḥ |41|

div.ab: nakulāndhyalakṣaṇamāha- vidyotata ityādi| doṣābhipannā doṣairvyāptā| citrāṇi sarvadoṣavarṇāni| divā sa paśyediti vacanādrātrau na paśyatītyavagamyate| sarvajo'sādhyaśca||40||-

lg.l: dṛṣṭir virūpā śvasanopasṛṣṭā saṅkucyate 'bhyantarataś ca yāti ||41||
rujāvagāḍhā ca tam akṣirogaṃ gambhīriketi pravadanti tajjñāḥ |42|

div.ab: gambhīrikāyā lakṣaṇamāha- dṛṣṭirityādi| virūpā vikṛtarūpā| śvasanopasṛṣṭā vātopadrutā| rujāvagāḍhā tīvravedanā| iyamapyasādhyā||41||-

lg.l: bāhyau punar dvāv iha sampradiṣṭau nimittataś cāpy animittataś ca ||42||
nimittatas tatra śirobhitāpāj jñeyas tv abhiṣyandanidarśanaiś ca `abhiṣyandanidarśanaśca’ iti pā.|43|

div.ab: hetubhedena bāhyau nirdiśannāha- bāhyāvityādi| bahirbhavau bāhyau; yadyapi prāksūtre saṅkṣepeṇopadiṣṭau tathā'pi punariha nimittānimittabhedadvayena samyak prakarṣānnirdiṣṭāvityarthaḥ| tatra sanimittaṃ darśayannāha- nimittata ityādi| tatra tayormadhye, śirobhitāpād viṣapuṣpagandhaspṛṣṭapavanasamparkajātāt, abhiṣyandanidarśanairiti abhiṣyandalakṣaṇairityarthaḥ| ayamasādhyaḥ||42||-

lg.l: hanyeta dṛṣṭir manujasya yasya sa liṅganāśas tv animittasañjñaḥ |
tatrākṣi vispaṣṭam ivāvabhāti vaidūryavarṇā vimalā ca dṛṣṭiḥ ||44||

ab.seg: animittaṃ darśayannāha- surarṣītyādi| animitta iti anupalabhyamānaviśiṣṭasurādidarśananimittaḥ| dṛṣṭiḥ darśanam| liṅganāśa iti darśananāśa ityarthaḥ| ayamapyasādhyaḥ| tasyaivānimittasya lakṣaṇamāha- tatretyādi| tatra animittasañjñake| vispaṣṭamiva viśeṣeṇa prasannamiva| vaidūryavarṇā prakṛtivarṇetyarthaḥ| vimaleti vigatāstimirakācādayo malā yasyāṃ sā tathā| etau sanimittānimittau sarvagatāvapi darśananāśakaratvādanuktāvapi dṛṣṭyāśritau kathitau, ato na saṅkhyātirekaḥ||43-44||

lg.l: vidīryate sīdati hīyate vā nṛṇām abhīghātahatā tu dṛṣṭiḥ ||45||

ab.seg: āgantuprastāvādaparamabhighātajamāha- vidīryata ityādi| sīdati avasādaṃ yāti| eṣa bāhyanimittatvāt sannipātāntarbhūtaḥ||45||

lg.l: ity ete nayanagatā mayā vikārāḥ saṅkhyātāḥ pṛthag iha ṣaṭ ca saptatiś ca |
eteṣāṃ pṛthag iha vistareṇa sarvaṃ vakṣye 'haṃ tadanu cikitsitaṃ yathāvat ||46||

ab.seg: samudāyasaṅkhyāmāha- ityeta ityādi| saṅkhyātāḥ samyagākhyātāḥ, samyaggaṇitā vā| iha śālākye| punaḥ ṣaṭsaptatisaṅkhyākāraṇaṃ niyamārthaṃ; tena ṣaṭsaptatireva| etena karālādiproktā saṅkhyā nirākṛtā||46||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre dṛṣṭigatarogavijñānīyo nāma saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||7||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre saptamo'dhyāyaḥ||7||

div.head: cikitsitapravibhāgavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaś cikitsitapravibhāgavijñānīyam adhyāyaṃ `cikitsitapravibhāgīyaṃ’ iti pā. vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ (suśrutāya) ||2||

dṛṣṭigatarogavijñānīyānantaraṃ sarvathā pratipannasakalanayanāmayasya bhiṣajaścikitsā nyāyyeti cikitsāpravibhāgīyārambhaḥ- athāta ityādi| pravibhāgaḥ prakarṣeṇa vibhajanaṃ pṛthakkaraṇamityarthaḥ||1-2||

lg.l: cikitsitam idaṃ teṣāṃ samāsavyāsataḥ `samāsādvyāsataḥ\\’ iti pā. śṛṇu ||3||

ab.seg: cikitsā tu dvividhā samāsād vyāsācca; tatra samāsenehādhyāye vibhāgaṃ darśayannāha- ṣaḍityādi| lakṣaṇaiḥ hetupūrvarūparupopaśayasamprāptibhiḥ| samāsāt saṅkṣepādihaivādhyāye; vistarāt punarvātābhiṣyandādiṣu||3||

lg.l: chedyās teṣu daśaikaś ca nava lekhyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
bhedyāḥ pañca vikārāḥ syur vyadhyāḥ pañcadaśaiva tu ||4||
dvādaśā'śastrakṛtyāś ca yāpyāḥ sapta bhavanti hi |
rogā varjayitavyāḥ syur daśa pañca ca jānatā |
asādhyau vā bhavetāṃ tu yāpyau cāgantusañjñitau ||5||

ab.seg: tatrāṣṭavidhaśastrakarmaṇāṃ madhye netrāmayeṣu caturvidhaṃ karma prayojyam, ataścaturvidhaśastrakarmārhān vyādhīn samāsārthaṃ vargīkṛtya prāha- chedyā ityādi| dvādaśā'śastrakṛtyāśceti cakārād dvau bāhyajāvaśastrakṛtyau| yāpyā iti snehādikriyayā yāpyatvaṃ, na tu chedyādikriyayā| yāpyasādhyatve ca dvayoravasthāvaśāt| varjayitavyā asādhyā ityarthaḥ||4-5||

lg.l: arśo 'nvitaṃ bhavati vartma tu yat tathā'rśaḥ śuṣkaṃ tathā'rbudam atho piḍakāḥ sirājāḥ |
jālaṃ sirājam api pañcavidhaṃ tathā'rma chedyā bhavanti saha parvaṇikāmayena ||6||

ab.seg: tāneva chedyān rogānnāmabhiḥ prāha- arśo'nvitamityādi| pañcavidhamarmeti prastāryarma, śuṣkārma, raktārma, adhimāṃsārma, snāyvarmetyevaṃ pañcavidham||6||

lg.l: utsaṅginī bahalakardamavartmanī ca śyāvaṃ ca yac ca paṭhitaṃ tv iha baddhavartma |
kliṣṭaṃ ca pothakiyutaṃ khalu yac ca vartma kumbhīkinī ca saha śarkarayā ca lekhyāḥ ||7||

ab.seg: lekhyānnāmabhiḥ prāha- utsaṅginītyādi| bahalakardamavartmanītyatra vartmeti padaṃ bahalakardamābhyāṃ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate||7||

lg.l: śleṣmopanāhalagaṇau ca bisaṃ ca bhedyā granthiś ca yaḥ kṛmikṛto 'ñjananāmikā ca |8|

div.ab: bhedyānnāmabhiḥ prāha- śleṣmetyādi| bisaṃ bisavartma|8|-

lg.l: ādau sirā nigaditās tu yayoḥ prayoge pākau ca yau nayanayoḥ pavano 'nyataś ca ||8||
pūyālasānilaviparyayamanthasañjñāḥ syandās tu yānty upaśamaṃ hi sirāvyadhena |9|

div.ab: vyadhyānnāmabhiḥ prāha- ādāvityādi| ādau sirā nigaditāḥ ityādi yayorvikārayoḥ prayoge ādau sirā nigaditāstau vyadhyau, kau tau? sirotpātasirāharṣau| pavano'nyataḥ anyatovātaḥ| manthasañjñā adhimanthāścatvāraḥ; syandā abhiṣyandāstāvanta eva||8||-

lg.l: āgantunā''mayayugena ca dūṣitāyāṃ dṛṣṭau na śastrapatanaṃ pravadanti tajjñāḥ ||10||

ab.seg: aśastrakṛtyānāha- śuṣketyādi| hutabhuk dhvajadarśī, dhūmadarśītyarthaḥ||9-10||

lg.l: sampaśyataḥ ṣaḍ api ye 'bhihitās tu kācās te pakṣmakopasahitās tu bhavanti yāpyāḥ |11|

div.ab: yāpyānāha- sampaśyata ityādi| ṣaḍapi ye kācā abhihitāste sampaśyataḥ puruṣasya yāpyā bhavantīti sambandhaḥ|11|-

lg.l: catvāra eva pavanaprabhavās tv asādhyā dvau pittajau kaphanimittaja eka eva |
aṣṭārdhakā rudhirajāś ca gadās tridoṣās tāvanta eva gaditāv api bāhyajau dvau ||11||

ab.seg: asādhyānāha- catvāra ityādi| catvāra eveti hatādhimanthanimiṣagambhīradṛṣṭivātahatavartmākhyāścatvāraḥ| dvāviti hrasvajāḍya(tya)jaladhisrāvākhyau| eka eva kaphasrāvākhyaḥ| aṣṭārdhakā iti catvāra ityarthaḥ| ke te catvāraḥ? raktasrāvājakājātaśoṇitārśovraṇānvitaśukrākhyāḥ| tāvanta eveti catvāra evetyarthaḥ| ke te catvāraḥ? pūyāsrāvanakulāndhyākṣipākātyālajyākhyāḥ| bāhyajau āgantujau||11||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre cikitsitapravibhāgavijñānīyo nāmāṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||8||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre'ṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ||8||

div.head: vātābhiṣyandapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto vātābhiṣyandapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

cikitsitapravibhāgīyānantaraṃ sarveṣāṃ nayanāmayānāmabhiṣyandamūlatvāt, tatrāpi pittādīnāṃ vātasyaivāvaraṇatvena nidānabhūtatvādādau vātābhiṣyandapratiṣedho yukta ityata āha- athāta ityādi| atrādiśabdo lupto draṣṭavyaḥ, tena vātābhiṣyandādipratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāma ityarthaḥ; pratiṣedhaḥ cikitsitaṃ; evaṃ pittābhiṣyandapratiṣedhādiṣvādiśabdo draṣṭavyaḥ||1-2||

lg.l: tarpaṇaiḥ puṭapākaiś ca dhūmair āścyotanais tathā ||4||

div.ab: tatra sirāvyadhasādhyeṣu pañcadaśasvabhiṣyandādhimanthau paṭhitau, sirāvyadhasādhyānāṃ cākṣirogāṇāṃ śoṇitamūlatvānmūlocchedārthaṃ pūrvaṃ dūṣyanirharaṇaṃ darśayannāha- purāṇetyādi| purāṇaṃ sarpiḥ saṃvatsaroṣitaṃ ghṛtam; anye daśavarṣasthitaṃ ghṛtaṃ purāṇaṃ kathayanti| yathānyāyaṃ yathāśāstramityarthaḥ| tena dṛṣṭeḥ samīpamuttamāṅgamalpaṃ svedayet, dṛṣṭirasvedyā| yathānyāyamiti padaṃ snehapānasirāmokṣābhyāṃ saha yojayet| tena snehopayaugikokto vidhiḥ ‘prāk pācitāmadoṣāya’ ityādiko'vadhāraṇīyaḥ| tenātrāpi doṣavyādhinirāmatāyāmeva sarpiḥpānādayo vidheyāḥ| tathā ca tantrāntaraṃ,- “svedaḥ pralepastiktānnaṃ dhūmo dinacatuṣṭayam| laṅghanaṃ cākṣirogāṇāmāmānāṃ pācanāni ṣaṭ|| añjanaṃ sarpiṣaḥ pānaṃ kaṣāyaṃ gurubhojanam| netrarogeṣu sāmeṣu snānaṃ ca parivarjayet”- iti| videhe'pi,- “prāgevākṣyāmaye bhaktaṃ trirātramaguru smṛtam| upavāsastryahaṃ vā syānnaktaṃ vā'pyaśanaṃ hitam|| tataścaturthe divase vyādhau sañjātalakṣaṇe| yathoktāstu kriyāḥ kāryā nasyasekāñjanādikāḥ”- iti| sirāmokṣeṇetyatra sirā upanāsikā lālāṭyā vā āpāṅgyā vā| dūṣyaharaṇaṃ pratipādya doṣacikitsitamāha- sampādayedityādi| sampādayet yojayet| bastibhiḥ snehabastibhirnirūhairvā| samyagiti hīnamithyātiyogarahitaiḥ| snehavirecitāviti snehavirecanaṃ tu pittasyānugate pittāsṛganugate vā vāyau balavato bahudoṣasya ceti| durbalasyālpadoṣasya ca puruṣasya svasthānagato malāvṛtaḥ svatantro vā bastibhirevāvajetavyaḥ| bastirapi malāvṛte vāte nairūhikaḥ, dhātukṣayaje snaihikaḥ| samyakśabdo bastyādiṣu śirobastyanteṣu sambadhyate| tarpaṇādividhānaṃ kriyākalpe bhaviṣyati| tatra sekaḥ sukhoṣṇaḥ, āścyotanaṃ ca śītameva||3-4||-

lg.l: payobhir vesavāraiś ca sālvaṇaiḥ pāyasais tathā ||6||
bhiṣak sampādayed etāv upanāhaiś ca pūjitaiḥ |7|

div.ab: pūrvaṃ svedayitvetyuktaṃ, tatra dravādisvedānupapādayannāha- vātaghnetyādi| vātaghnāni bhadradārvādīni| uṣṇaiḥ sukhoṣṇaiḥ| uṣṇairiti padaṃ vātaghnādibhiḥ sambadhyate| tatpītāmbaradhāraṇairiti catuḥsnehamitavastradhāraṇairityarthaḥ| sālvaṇairiti sālvaṇasyaikatvāt kathaṃ bahuvacanaṃ? satyaṃ, yaugikairanyairapi dravyaiḥ svedaḥ kārya iti bodhanārthaṃ bahuvacanaṃ, svedayitvā sirāmokṣeṇa yojayedityuktam||5-6||-

lg.l: susaṃskṛtaiḥ payobhiś ca tayor āhāra iṣyate |8|

div.ab: na cābhuktavataḥ śastrakarma kuryādityāśaṅkyāhāramāha- grāmyetyādi| phalarasānvitairiti dāḍimāmalakarasasaṃyuktaiḥ| susaṃskṛtaiḥ payobhiriti śatāvarīśṛṅgaveraprabhṛtidravyasaṃskṛtairityarthaḥ| tayoḥ syandādhimanthayoḥ||7||-

lg.l: tathā copari bhaktasya sarpiḥpānaṃ(ne) praśasyate `bhaktasyopari sarpistau pibetāṃ cāpi mānavau’ iti pā.||8||
siddhaṃ vātaharaiḥ kṣīraṃ prathamena gaṇena vā ||9||
snehās tailād vinā siddhā vātaghnais tarpaṇe hitāḥ |10|

div.ab: purāṇasarpiṣā snigdhāvityuktaṃ tasya ca ghṛtasyāvacāraṇakālaṃ niyamayannāha- tathetyādi| kevalam asaṃskṛtam| vātaharaiḥ bhadradārvādibhiḥ| jejjaṭācāryastu kākolyādibhirvātaharairityāha| upari pānaṃ pibediti śeṣaḥ| prathamena gaṇena vidārigandhādinā| gayadāsācāryastu sarvatrāpi ghṛtaṃ manyate| tathā ca tadvyākhyānam- “triphalāghṛtaṃ vyādhipratyanīkaṃ, vātaharadevadārvādisiddhaṃ tu doṣapratyanīkaṃ, vātasyaiva pittānubandhe sati vidārigandhādisiddhaṃ”; īdṛśe ca vyākhyāne ‘siddhaṃ vātaharairvā'pi prathamena gaṇena vā’ iti pāṭhaḥ||8-9||-

lg.l: snaihikaḥ puṭapākaś ca dhūmo nasyaṃ ca tadvidham ||10||

div.ab: pūrvaṃ tarpaṇairityuktaṃ, tatra tarpaṇadravyāṇyāha- snaihika ityādi| snaihikaḥ puṭapākaḥ kriyākalpe vakṣyamāṇaḥ| tadvidhaṃ snaihikamityarthaḥ||10||-

lg.l: eraṇḍapallave mūle tvaci vā''jaṃ payaḥ śṛtam ||11||
kaṇṭakāryāś ca mūleṣu sukhoṣṇaṃ secane hitam |12|

div.ab: āntaramupakramamabhidhāya bāhyamāha- eraṇḍetyādi| secane ityatra cakāro lupto draṣṭavyaḥ; tena na kevalaṃ seke āścyotane cetyarthaḥ| tatra seke sukhoṣṇaṃ, āścyotane ca śītamevetyarthaḥ||11||-

lg.l: hitam ardhodakaṃ seke tathā''ścyotanam eva ca |13|

div.ab: saindhavetyādi| ardhodakamiti ardhamudakaṃ yasmin kṣīre tat kṣīraṃ seke hitaṃ tathā āścyotane ca; na punaḥ pānādau| saindhavādipramāṇaṃ tu kṣīrādaṣṭamāṃśameva||12||-

lg.l: sāmbhaś chāgaṃ payo vā'pi śūlāścyotanam uttamam |14|

div.ab: hrīberetyādi| hrīberaṃ vālakam| vakraṃ tagaram| sāmbha iti caturguṇodakaṃ, ardhodakamiti kecit| āścyotanam akṣipūraṇam||13||-

lg.l: madhukaṃ rajanīṃ pathyāṃ devadāruṃ ca peṣayet ||14||
ājena payasā śreṣṭham abhiṣyande tad añjanam |15|

div.ab: madhukamityādi| kecidamuṃ pāṭhaṃ na paṭhanti||14||-

lg.l: gairikaṃ saindhavaṃ kṛṣṇāṃ nāgaraṃ ca yathottaram ||15||
dviguṇaṃ piṣṭam adbhis tu guṭikāñjanam iṣyate |16|

div.ab: gairikamityādi| yathottaraṃ dviguṇamiti gairikāddviguṇaṃ saindhavaṃ, saindhavāddviguṇā kṛṣṇā, tato'pi dviguṇaṃ nāgaram| guṭikāñjanamiṣyate iti snaihikapuṭapākādijanitakaphānubandhasya guṭikāñjanam| kecidatrāpyājena payaseti sambadhnanti; tenājapayasā piṣṭamadbhirvā| ‘nāgaraṃ ca yathottaraṃ’ ityatra ‘godantaṃ ca yathottaraṃ’ iti paṭhanti; sa ca pāṭho jejjaṭācāryeṇa dūṣitaḥ||15||-

lg.l: snehāñjanaṃ hitaṃ cātra vakṣyate tad yathāvidhi ||16||

ab.seg: snehetyādi| yathāvidhīti vidhimanatikramya `vidheranatikramāt’ iti pā., etenāpatarpaṇasirāvyadhakupitavāte'bhiṣyande snehāñjanaṃ hitamityarthaḥ| atraike ‘tāmrapātrasthitaṃ māsaṃ sarpiḥsaindhavasaṃyutaṃ’ `māṃsaṃ sarpiḥ saindhavasaṃyutam’ iti pā. iti snehāñjanamāhuḥ| anye tu ‘vasā cānūpajalajā saindhavena samāyutā’ ityādinā vakṣyamāṇaṃ snehāñjanaṃ kathayanti||16||

lg.l: rogo yaś cānyatovāto yaś ca mārutaparyayaḥ |
anenaiva vidhānena bhiṣak tāv api sādhayet ||17||

ab.seg: vātābhiṣyandakriyāmanyasminnapi vātaje'kṣiroge'tidiśannāha- roga ityādi||17||

lg.l: pūrvabhaktaṃ hitaṃ sarpiḥ kṣīraṃ vā'py atha bhojane |
vṛkṣādanyāṃ kapitthe ca pañcamūle mahaty api ||18||
sakṣīraṃ karkaṭarase siddhaṃ cātra ghṛtaṃ pibet |
sakṣīraṃ meṣaśṛṅgyā vā sarpir vīratareṇa vā |20|

div.ab: anyatovātamārutaparyayayoḥ sāmānyāṃ cikitsāmabhidhāya viśeṣacikitsāmāha- pūrvabhaktamityādi| tadeva ghṛtamāha- vṛkṣādanyāmityādi| vṛkṣādanī bandākaḥ, vṛkṣakalambuketyanye| vṛkṣādanyādīnāṃ saptadravyāṇāmatra kaṣāyaḥ| agarbhaṃ ghṛtamidam| siddhamityādi| pattūraḥ sitivāraḥ, ‘sirivālī’ iti loke prasiddhā| ārtagalaḥ kaṇṭakaphalo jalamuktadeśajaḥ, ‘kakubha’ ityanye| agnikaḥ ajamodā| pattūrādīnāṃ kaṣāye kṣīre ca sādhitaṃ sarpiḥ meṣaśṛṅgīkvāthe vā sakṣīre sādhitam| vīrataraḥ śaraḥ vellantaro vā, tasya kvāthe vā sakṣīre sādhitaṃ sarpiranyatovātamārutaparyayayorhitam| idamapi ghṛtatrayamagarbham||18-19||-

lg.l: saindhavaṃ dāru śuṇṭhī ca mātuluṅgaraso ghṛtam ||20||
pūjitaṃ sarpiṣaś cātra pānam akṣṇoś ca tarpaṇam ||21||
pariṣeke hitaṃ cātra payaḥ śītaṃ sasaindhavam ||22||

ab.seg: saindhavamityādi| saindhavādidravyatrayāṇāṃ kalkena mātuluṅgādidravyacatuṣkeṇa rasakriyāṃ niṣpādya śuṣkapāke'ñjanaṃ kāryaṃ; yato rasakriyāñjanamidam| pūjitamityādi| sarpiṣo ‘jīvanīyasiddhasya’ iti śeṣaḥ| atra śuṣkapāke nasyaṃ jīvanīyena ghṛtenaiva; aṇunā tailena vā nasyaṃ pūjitam| aṇutailaṃ tu śālākyatantroktaṃ, na punarvātavyādhyuditam| pariṣeke ityādi| śītamiti śṛtaśītamityarthaḥ| sasaindhavamiti saśabda īṣadarthaḥ| rajanīdārusiddhaṃ vetyatra kṣīramiti sambadhyate| saindhavena samāyutam alpasaindhavayuktamityarthaḥ| sarpirityādi|- mahauṣadhaṃ vā ghṛtastrīstanyayuktaṃ pāṣāṇaghṛṣṭamityarthaḥ, añjanaṃ vā| vasetyādi|- ānūpajalajā vā vasā stokasaindhavayuktā kiñcicchuṇṭhīyuktā pāṣāṇaghṛṣṭā satī śuṣkapāke'ñjanamiti sambandhaḥ||20-24||
idānīṃ vātajeṣu timirakācādiṣveṣaiva kriyā kartavyeti darśayannāha- pavanetyādi| dṛṣṭināśanāḥ timirakācādayaḥ| bījena bījabhūtena| anena vātābhiṣyandoktakarmaṇā| matimān ūhāpohavit||25||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre vātābhiṣyandapratiṣedho nāma navamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||9||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre navamo'dhyāyaḥ||9||

div.head: pittābhiṣyandapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ pittābhiṣyandapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
vātābhiṣyandapratiṣedhānantaraṃ ‘vātāddaśa tathā pittāt’ iti vacanāt pittābhiṣyandapratiṣedhārambhaḥ- athāta ityādi||1-2||

lg.l: pittasyande paittike cādhimanthe raktāsrāvaḥ sraṃsanaṃ cāpi kāryam |
akṣṇoḥ sekālepanasyāñjanāni paitte ca syād yad visarpe vidhānam ||3||

ab.seg: pittetyādi| sraṃsanaṃ virekaḥ| pittavisarpavidhānaṃ ‘uśīralāmajjakacandanāni’ ityādipralepāḥ| pūrvavadatrāpyapatarpaṇādibhiḥ kṛtāmapācanasya snehapūrvakaḥ sirāmokṣaḥ||3||

lg.l: gundrāṃ śāliṃ śaivalaṃ śailabhedaṃ dārvīm elām utpalaṃ rodhram abhram |
padmāt patraṃ śarkarā darbham ikṣuṃ tālaṃ rodhraṃ vetasaṃ padmakaṃ ca ||4||
drākṣāṃ kṣaudraṃ candanaṃ yaṣṭikāhvaṃ yoṣitkṣīraṃ rātry anante ca piṣṭvā |
sarpiḥsiddhaṃ tarpaṇe sekanasye ‘nāvane ca’ iti pā. śastaṃ kṣīraṃ siddham eteṣu cājam ||5||
yojyo vargo vyasta eṣo 'nyathā vā samyaṅ nasye 'ṣṭārdhasaṅkhye 'pi nityam |6|

div.ab: idānīṃ pittasyābhiṣyandayaugikadravyāṇyāha- gundrāmityādi| gundrā erakābhedaḥ, gavedhuketyanye, śaivalaṃ dūrvā, śailabhedaḥ pāṣāṇabhedaḥ, candanaṃ raktacandanaṃ, rātriḥ haridrā, anantā utpalasārivā, yoṣitkṣīraṃ strīstanyaṃ, śarkarādeḥ sāhacaryāt kalkadravye ikṣuriti ikṣurasena dravakāryam| vyastaḥ asamastaḥ, anyathā vā samasta ityarthaḥ| yadyapi vargatvāt ‘samastaṃ vargamardhaṃ vā yathālābhamathāpi vā’ iti śalyatantroktaparibhāṣayaiva samastavyastatā prāptā, tathā'pi śālākyatantratvādatra punaruktā| nasye aṣṭārdhasaṅkhye catuḥsaṅkhye pratimarṣāvapīḍanasyaśirovirecanākhye||4-5||-

lg.l: kriyāḥ sarvāḥ pittaharyaḥ praśastās tryahāc cordhvaṃ kṣīrasarpiś ca nasyam ‘śastā'śeṣā pittahantrī kriyā ca tryahādūrdhvaṃ kṣīrasarpiśca nasyam’ iti pā.||6||

ab.seg: kriyā ityādi| kṣīrasarpiśceti ‘bhojane’ iti śeṣaḥ| nasyamityupalakṣaṇaṃ, tenāścyotanasekāñjanādi gṛhyate| yadyapi ‘paitte ca syādyadvisarpe vidhānaṃ’ ityanenaiva pittaharī kriyā kathitā, tathā'pi tatra vyādhipratyanīkatayoktā, atra tu doṣapratyanīkatveneti na doṣaḥ||6||

lg.l: pālāśaṃ syāc choṇitaṃ cāñjanārthe śallakyā vā śarkarākṣaudrayuktam |7|

div.ab: raktapittaprasādakāñjanānāṃ rasakriyā prathamā, atastāmāha- pālāśamityādi| pālāśaṃ śoṇitaṃ kiṃśukarasaḥ; anye palāśakhapuramāhuḥ|7|-

lg.l: rasakriyāṃ śarkarākṣaudrayuktāṃ pālindyāṃ vā madhuke vā'pi kuryāt ||7||

ab.seg: aparāmapi rasakriyāmāha- rasakriyāmityādi| rasakriyāphāṇitākṛtiḥ| tathā coktam- “gṛhītvā kvāthakalpena kvāthaṃ pūtaṃ punaḥ punaḥ| kvāthayet phāṇitākārameṣā proktā rasakriyā” iti| pālindī śyāmā trivṛt, sārivāmanye||7||

lg.l: mustā phenaḥ sāgarasyotpalaṃ ca kṛmighnailādhātribījād rasaś ca |8|

div.ab: aparamapi rasakriyāñjanamāha- mustetyādi| kṛmighnā viḍaṅgāḥ, dhātrī āmalakaṃ, bījaḥ pītasāraḥ ‘bījaka’ iti yāvat, mustādīnāṃ rase rasakriyā kāryā|8|-

ab.seg: vartyañjanamāha- tālīśetyādi| kāśīśaileti kecit paṭhanti||8||

lg.l: cūrṇaṃ kuryād añjanārthe raso vā stanyopeto dhātakīsyandanābhyām |9|

div.ab: cūrṇāñjanamāha- cūrṇamityādi| raso veti rasakriyā vetyarthaḥ| syandano'nenaiva nāmnā prasiddhaḥ| kecit candanābhyāmiti paṭhanti|9|-

lg.l: yoṣitstanyaṃ śātakumbhaṃ vighṛṣṭaṃ kṣaudropetaṃ kaiṃśukaṃ cāpi puṣpam ||9||

ab.seg: yoṣidityādi| śātakumbhaṃ suvarṇaṃ, tacca yoṣitstanyena ghṛṣṭamañjanam| kṣaudrayuktaṃ vā kiṃśukapuṣpaṃ ghṛṣṭaṃ tāmrapātrādāvañjanam||9||

lg.l: rodhraṃ drākṣāṃ śarkarām utpalaṃ ca nāryāḥ kṣīre yaṣṭikāhvaṃ vacāṃ ca |
piṣṭvā kṣīre varṇakasya tvacaṃ ca toyonmiśre candanodumbare ca ||10||

ab.seg: rodhramityādi| rodhrādivacāntaṃ nārīkṣīre piṣṭamekamañjanam| varṇako rocanikā; tasyāstvak nārīkṣīreṇa piṣṭā dvitīyamañjanam| anye varṇakatvakśabdena karṇikāravṛkṣasya valkalaṃ kathayanti, tannecchati gayī| toyonmiśre candanodumbare ceti tṛtīyāñjanaṃ, toyonmiśre bālakayukte, candanaṃ kucandanaṃ; pañjikākārastu candanodumbaraṃ bhṛśataraṃ cūrṇitaṃ vastrabaddhaṃ toyaplutamāścyotanāñjanamāha||10||

lg.l: kāryaḥ phenaḥ sāgarasyāñjanārthe nārīstanye mākṣike cāpi ghṛṣṭaḥ |
yoṣitstanye sthāpitaṃ yaṣṭikāhvaṃ rodhraṃ drākṣāṃ śarkarām utpalaṃ ca ||11||
kṣaumābaddhaṃ pathyam āścyotane vā sarpirghṛṣṭaṃ ‘sarpirbhṛṣṭaṃ’ iti pā. yaṣṭikāhvaṃ sarodhram |
toyonmiśrāḥ kāśmarīdhātripathyās tadvac cāhuḥ kaṭphalaṃ cāmbunaiva ||12||

ab.seg: kārya ityādi| aparamāścyotanamāha- nārītyādi| yaṣṭimadhukādidravyamatīva cūrṇitaṃ strīstanyasthāpitaṃ kṣaumavastrāvabaddhamāścyotane hitamityarthaḥ| yaṣṭikāhvaṃ sarodhramiti yaṣṭimadhukarodhre vā ghṛtaghṛṣṭe ‘ghṛtabhṛṣṭe’ iti pā. pūrvavadāścyotanam||11-12||

lg.l: eṣo 'mlākhye 'nukramaś cāpi śuktau kāryaḥ sarvaḥ syāt sirāmokṣavarjyaḥ ||13||

ab.seg: idānīmamlādhyuṣitaśuktyoḥ sāmānyacikitsāmāha- eṣa ityādi| kecidamlādhyuṣitaśuktyoraśastrakṛtyatvādeva sirāmokṣavarjanaṃ siddham, ataḥ ‘śirāmokṣavarjya’ iti pāṭhaṃ na paṭhanti||13||

lg.l: sarpiḥ peyaṃ traiphalaṃ tailvakaṃ vā peyaṃ vā syāt kevalaṃ yat purāṇam |14|

div.ab: amlādhyuṣite viśeṣacikitsitamāha- sarpirityādi| ādyaṃ ghṛtadvayaṃ saṃśodhanaṃ, purāṇaghṛtaṃ tu saṃśamanam|14|-

lg.l: doṣe 'dhastāc chuktikāyām apāste śītair dravyair añjanaṃ kāryam āśu ||14||

ab.seg: śuktikāyāṃ viśeṣacikitsitamāha- doṣe ityādi| adhastādapāste doṣe ‘virecanena’ iti śeṣaḥ||14||

lg.l: vaidūryaṃ yat sphāṭikaṃ vaidrumaṃ ca mauktaṃ śāṅkhaṃ rājataṃ śātakumbham |
cūrṇaṃ sūkṣmaṃ śarkarākṣaudrayuktaṃ śuktiṃ hanyād añjanaṃ caitad āśu ||15||

ab.seg: tānyeva śītadravyāṇyāha- vaidūryamityādi||15||

lg.l: yuñjyāt sarpir dhūmadarśī naras tu śeṣaṃ kuryād raktapitte vidhānam |
yac caivānyat pittahṛc cāpi sarvaṃ yad vīsarpe paittike vai vidhānam ||16||

ab.seg: dhūmadarśinaścikitsitamāha- yuñjyādityādi| raktapitte vidhānamiti raktābhiṣyande pittābhiṣyande ca cikitsitaṃ yaduktaṃ tadityarthaḥ| anyat pittahṛditi pittavidagdhadṛṣṭeryadvidhānaṃ tadatra yojayet| yadvīsarpe paittike vai vidhānamiti pittavisarpoktaṃ vidhānaṃ yojayediti sambandhaḥ||16||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre pittābhiṣyandapratiṣedho nāma daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||10||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre daśamo'dhyāyaḥ||10||

div.head: śleṣmābhiṣyandapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ śleṣmābhiṣyandapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
pittābhiṣyandānantaraṃ doṣakrameṇa kaphābhiṣyandapratiṣedhārambhaḥ- athāta ityādi||1-2||

lg.l: syandādhimanthau kaphajau pravṛddhau jayet sirāṇām atha mokṣaṇena |
tryahāt tryahāc cāpy apatarpaṇānte prātas tayos tiktaghṛtaṃ praśastam ||4||
tad annapānaṃ ca samācared dhi yac chleṣmaṇo naiva karoti vṛddhim |5|

div.ab: sirāṇāmatha mokṣaṇenetyatrāthaśabdādayamabhiprāyaḥ- kṛtasnehādipūrvakramasya pravṛddhāvasthāyāṃ sirāmokṣaḥ| pūrvakramamāha- svedāvapīḍetyādi| tryahāt tryahāditi atarpaṇapreritadinacatuṣṭayasya tiktadravyasādhitaṃ prātaḥ praśastaṃ ghṛtaṃ, tena snigdhasya tryahāt ‘paścāt’ iti pā. sirāmokṣaḥ| ‘prātastayostiktaghṛtaṃ praśastaṃ’ ityatra ‘tau prātarevānu ghṛtaṃ pibetāṃ’ iti kecit paṭhanti| ‘tadannapānaṃ ca samācareddhi’ ityatra ‘tat prātarannaṃ ca samācareddhi’ iti kecit paṭhanti; prātargrahaṇaṃ dvirannakālaniṣedhārthamiti vyākhyānayanti||3-4||-

svedadravyāṇyāha- kuṭannaṭetyādi| kuṭannaṭaṃ tagaraṃ; phaṇijjhakaḥ tīkṣṇagandhaḥ svanāmnaiva prasiddhaḥ, anye nirguṇḍīmāhuḥ; pattūraḥ śarabālikaḥ, bhaṅgaiḥ patrabhaṅgaiḥ, anye bhaṅgaśabdena pallavānāhuḥ||5||-
anulepadravyāṇyāha- athavetyādi| barhiṣṭhaṃ bālakam|6|-

lg.l: trīṇy ūṣaṇāni triphalā haridrā viḍaṅgasāraś ca samāni ca syuḥ ||7||
phalaṃ prakīryād athavā'pi śigroḥ puṣpaṃ ca tulyaṃ ‘tutthaṃ’ iti pā. bṛhatīdvayasya |
rasāñjanaṃ saindhavacandanaṃ ca manaḥśilāle laśunaṃ ca tulyam ||9||

piṣṭvā'ñjanārthe kaphajeṣu dhīmān vartīr vidadhyān nayanāmayeṣ
u |10|

div.ab: vartyañjanadravyāṇyāha- sindhūtthetyādi| trīṇyūṣaṇānīti trikaṭukamityarthaḥ| barhiṣṭhaṃ vālakam| amarakāṣṭhaṃ devadāru| prakīryaḥ kaṇṭakikarañjaḥ| kecit puṣpamapi prakīryādeveti kathayanti| tathā bṛhatīdvayasya puṣpaṃ phalaṃ ca| ālaṃ haritālam| etā vartyo'rdhaślokasamāpanāḥ pañca tryūṣaṇādidravyairjñeyāḥ| pañjikāyāṃ tu ‘vyoṣamanaḥśilāśca’ ityanantaraṃ ‘mūrvā ca jātīmukulāni cāpi piṣṭvā'mbunaitān vitarettathaiva’ iti paṭhyate; vyākhyānaṃ ca- tryūṣaṇādyaṣṭāṅgamañjanaṃ, barhiṣṭhādi dvādaśāṅgaṃ, athavetyanena vikalpavācinā kaṇṭakikarañjaphalatulyāṃśairvakṣyamāṇairauṣadhairekamañjanaṃ, śigruphalatulyāṃśairvakṣyamāṇairdvitīyamañjanam| ‘sindhūtthahiṅgu’ ityatra kecit ‘sindhuprasūtaṃ’ iti paṭhanti||6-9||-

lg.l: roge balāsagrathite 'ñjanaṃ jñaiḥ kartavyam etat suviśuddhakāye ||10||
nīlān yavān gavyapayo 'nupītān śalākinaḥ śuṣkatanūn vidahya |
etad balāsagrathite 'ñjanaṃ syād eṣo 'nukalpas tu phaṇijjhakādau ||12||

ab.seg: roge ityādi| jñairiti kuśalairvaidyairityarthaḥ| etad vakṣyamāṇaṃ kṣārāñjanam| suviśuddhakāye iti sirāvyadhavirekaśirovirekairityarthaḥ| tadeva kṣārañjanaṃ vyutpādayannāha- nīlānityādi| nīlān apakvān ‘nīlān pakvān’ iti pā.| gavyapayo'nupītān kṛṣṇagodugdhabhāvitān, pītāniti vaktavye anupītāniti yat kṛtaṃ tat saptāhaṃ saptāhadvayaṃ vā bhāvanā kāryeti bodhayati| śalākinaḥ śūkayuktān| taditi bhasmetyarthaḥ| nīlayavādibhasmaprasthaṃ, uṣṇodakāḍhakena saha melayitvā punaḥ punarāsrāvayet, yāvat kṣārodakaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ picchilaṃ raktaṃ ca syāt, tadā bhasma vihāya tatra kṣārodake saindhavatuttharocanamāvāpaṃ kṣārodakāddvātriṃśadbhāgaṃ dattvā pacet| kecit saindhavādidravyāṇi bhasmārthaṃ na tu āvāpārthamiti vadanti, tanmate'prativāpameva paktavyam| phaṇijjhakādāvityatrādiśabdāt kusumādayo gṛhyante||11-12||

lg.l: mahauṣadhaṃ māgadhikāṃ ca mustāṃ ‘mukhyāṃ’ iti pā. sasaindhavaṃ yan maricaṃ ca śuklam |
tan mātuluṅgasvarasena piṣṭaṃ netrāñjanaṃ piṣṭakam āśu hanyāt ||13||

ab.seg: piṣṭakaroge'ñjanamāha- mahauṣadhamityādi| maricaṃ śuklaṃ śobhāñjanabījam||13||

lg.l: phale ‘phalaṃ bṛhatyā magadhodbhavānāmādāya’ iti pā. bṛhatyā magadhodbhavānāṃ nidhāya kalkaṃ phalapākakāle |
srotojayuktaṃ ‘srotojayuktaṃ khalu saptarātrāttaduddhṛtaṃ syāttu tathaiva pathyam’ iti pā. ca tad uddhṛtaṃ syāt tadvat tu piṣṭe ... |14|

div.ab: aparamapyañjanamāha- phale ityādi| phalapākakāle kaṇṭakāriphalamuddhṛtabījaṃ sauvīrāñjanasamabhāgena pippalīkalkena pūrayet, tatkalkaṃ saptarātrādanantaramuddhṛtaṃ mahauṣadhādyañjanavat piṣṭakaroge hitaṃ pathyamityarthaḥ|14|-
kaṇṭakāriphalavidhimanyatrāpi phale'tidiśannāha- vidhirityādi| indrasurā indravāruṇī||14||-

lg.l: praklinnavartmany upadiśyate tu yogāñjanaṃ tan madhunā'vaghṛṣṭam |16|

ab.seg: praklinnavartmani roge yogāñjanamāha- kāsīsetyādi| jātyāḥ korakaṃ jātīkalikā||15||

lg.l: nādeyam agryaṃ maricaṃ ca śuklaṃ nepālajātā ca samapramāṇā ||16||
samātuluṅgadrava eṣa yogaḥ kaṇḍūṃ nihanyāt sakṛd añjanena |17|

div.ab: sarveṣāṃ kaphajākṣirogāṇāmupadravabhūtāyāḥ kaṇḍvāścikitsāmāha- nādeyamityādi| nādeyamiti saindhavamityarthaḥ| maricaṃ ca śuklamiti śobhāñjanabījamityarthaḥ; anye śuklameva maricaṃ kathayanti| nepālajātā manaḥśilā||16||-

lg.l: saśṛṅgaveraṃ suradāru mustaṃ sindhuprabhū(sū)taṃ mukulāni jātyāḥ ||17||
surāprapiṣṭaṃ tv idam añjanaṃ hi kaṇḍvāṃ ca śophe ca hitaṃ vadanti |18|

div.ab: kaṇḍvāmaparamapyañjanamāha- setyādi||17||-

lg.l: syandādhimanthakramam ācarec ca sarveṣu caiteṣu sadā'pramattaḥ ||18||
(viśeṣato nāvanam eva kāryaṃ saṃsarjanaṃ cāpi yathopadiṣṭam ayaṃ pāṭho hastalikhitapustake nopalabhyate ) ||19||

ab.seg: idānīṃ balāsagrathitapiṣṭakapraklinnavartmasu viśeṣacikitsāmabhidhāya sāmānyacikitsāmāha- syandetyādi| eteṣu balasagrathitapiṣṭakapraklinnavartmasu| cakārādanyeṣvapi kaphajākṣirogeṣu| apramattaḥ sāvadhānaḥ||18||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre kaphābhiṣyandapratiṣedho nāmaikādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||11||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ||11||

div.head: raktābhiṣyandapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto raktābhiṣyandapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
vātapittakaphakṛtānabhiṣyandān pratipādya pariśiṣṭaṃ raktābhiṣyandapratiṣedhamāha- athāta ityādi||1-2||

lg.l: manthaṃ syandaṃ sirotpātaṃ sirāharṣaṃ ca raktajam |

ab.seg: manthamityādi| atra manthasya prāgupādānaṃ syandādgarīyastvakhyāpanārtham||3||

lg.l: vyādhyārtāṃś caturo 'py etān snigdhān kaumbhena sarpiṣā |

ab.seg: tadeva vidhānamāha- vyādhyārtānityādi| vyādhibhirārtāḥ pīḍitā vyādhyārtāḥ| kaumbhena śatavarṣasthitenetyarthaḥ| rasairudārairathaveti māṃsarasairadhikasnehairvā snigdhānityarthaḥ| dūṣyaharaṇaṃ pratipādayannāha- siretyādi||4||

lg.l: viriktānāṃ prakāmaṃ ca śirāṃsy eṣāṃ viśodhayet |

ab.seg: dūṣyaharaṇaṃ pratipādya doṣaharaṇaṃ pratipādayannāha- viriktānāmityādi| śirāṃsīti bahuvacanaṃ pratirogāpekṣayā dūṣye'pahṛte virecanena doṣaharaṇaṃ, tataḥ śirovirecanaṃ; tadapi sarpiṣā natu tailena, ghṛtasya cakṣuṣyatvāt, raktāviruddhatvācca| tasya saṃskāramāha- vairecanikasiddheneti; śirovirecanadravyasiddhena, kecit trivṛtādidravyasiddhenetyāhuḥ| kecidatra ‘majjñā vā tadvipakvena’ ityādipāṭhaṃ paṭhanti, sa cānārṣaḥ||5||

lg.l: tataḥ pradehāḥ pariṣecanāni nasyāni dhūmāś ca yathāsvam eva |

ab.seg: antaḥśuddhikaraṃ kriyākramamuktvā bahiḥśuddhikaraṃ kriyākramasaṅgrahamuddiśannāha- tata ityādi| dhūmāśca yathāsvamātmīyānatikrameṇa, raktasya dūṣyasya kaphānubandhe kaphaharadravyavartikṛtāḥ, vātānubandhe tu snaihikāḥ; evamanyatrāpi yathāsvamiti sambandhanīyam| abhyañjanam añjanaṃ; tacca prasādanaṃ raktapitte, savraṇaśukrādau tu ropaṇaṃ; anye punarabhyañjanameva śatadhautaghṛtādinecchanti||6||

lg.l: sapadmakair dhautaghṛtapradigdhair akṣṇoḥ pralepaṃ paritaḥ prakuryāt ||7||

ab.seg: idānīṃ pralepadravyāṇyāha- nīlotpaletyādi| kaṭaṅkaṭerī dāruharidrā| kālīyakaṃ dāruharidrānukāri prasiddham| dhautaghṛtapradigdhaiḥ miśrairityarthaḥ||7||

lg.l: rujāyāṃ cāpy atibhṛśaṃ svedāś ca mṛdavo hitāḥ |
akṣṇoḥ samantataḥ kāryaṃ pātanaṃ ca jalaukasām ||8||
ghṛtasya mahatī mātrā pītā cārtiṃ niyacchati |

ab.seg: pariṣecanādyuddiṣṭaṃ yadanirdiṣṭaṃ tatpittābhiṣyandanirdiṣṭadravyairatidiśan kriyākrame'nirdiṣṭaṃ ca nirdiśannāha- rujāyāmityādi| rujo hi bhavanti sirāvyadhādikṛtavātānubandhāt, vātāvṛtādraktādvā; tatra vātajāyāṃ tīvrarujāyāṃ mṛdavaḥ svedāḥ, dūṣyaraktāvarodhādbahuśoṇitajāyāṃ jalaukaḥpātanaṃ; vātajāyāmevāntaramauṣadhaṃ ghṛtasya mahatyā mātrayā pānam; alpaśoṇitajāyāṃ pittābhiṣyandaśamano vidhiḥ| niyacchati nivārayati||8-9||

lg.l: nyastam apsv āntarikṣāsu hitam āścyotanaṃ bhavet ||10||

ab.seg: āścyotanamāha- kaśervityādi| ambarasaṃvṛtaṃ vastraveṣṭitaṃ, nyastaṃ kṣiptaṃ, āntarikṣodakālābhe ākāśaguṇabhūyiṣṭhaṃ bhūmisthamudakaṃ gṛhyate| kecit pariṣekamapyanenaivecchanti||10||

lg.l: puṣpāṇy atha bṛhatyoś ca bimbīloṭāc ca tulyaśaḥ ||11||

ab.seg: raktābhiṣyande'ñjanamāha- pāṭalītyādi| śrīparṇī kāśmarī| dhātrī āmalakī, bimbīloṭo bhilloṭo himādrijo vṛkṣaḥ| virecanādibhirviśuddhadoṣasya puruṣasya śeṣadoṣopaśāntyarthamañjanaṃ yojyaṃ, na punaraśuddhadoṣasyeti||11-12||

lg.l: trapu kāṃsyamalaṃ cāpi piṣṭvā puṣparasena tu |
vipulā yāḥ kṛtā vartyaḥ pūjitāś cāñjane sadā ||14||

ab.seg: candanamityādi| patraṃ patrakam| añjanaṃ rasāñjanam| puṣparaseneti madhunetyarthaḥ| vipulā yāstā eva manthādiṣu caturṣu lekhanādikarmaṇi sāmarthyāt pūjitā vartayaḥ| taduktaṃ,- “hareṇumātrā vartiḥ syāllekhanasya pramāṇataḥ| prasādanasya cādhyardhā dviguṇā ropaṇasya tu”- iti||13-14||

lg.l: syād añjanaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ sirotpātasya bheṣajam |
yuktaṃ tu madhunā vā'pi gairikaṃ hitam añjane |17|

div.ab: manthādīnāṃ caturṇāṃ sāmānyacikitsitamuktvā sirotpāte viśeṣacikitsitamāha- syādañjanamityādi| añjanaṃ rasāñjanaṃ ‘sauvīrāñjanaṃ’ iti pā., ghṛtaṃ gavyaghṛtam| nepālī manaḥśilā| maricaṃ prasiddhaṃ, kecit maricaśabdena sitamaricaṃ śobhāñjanaphalāparaparyāyaṃ vadanti| gairikaṃ svarṇagairikam| etānyañjanānyardhaślaukikānyapyuktāni||15-16||-

lg.l: madhunā tārkṣyajaṃ vā'pi kāsīsaṃ vā sasaindhavam |

ab.seg: sirāharṣa ityādi| phāṇitaṃ madhuyuktamekamañjanamiti; madhuyuktaṃ tārkṣyajaṃ dvitīyamañjanaṃ, tatra tārkṣyajaṃ rasāñjanaṃ; kāsīsaṃ sasaindhavaṃ madhuyuktaṃ tṛtīyamañjanaṃ; vetrāmlastanyasaṃyuktaṃ phāṇitaṃ caturthamañjanaṃ; tatra vetrāmlam amlavetasaṃ, anye tu vetraṃ vetrakarīraṃ, amlam amlavetasam, amlīkā veti vyākhyānayanti; yattu jejjaṭācāryeṇa dūṣitam||17-18||

lg.l: sekāñjanaṃ cātra hitam amlair āścyotanaṃ tathā |
ekaśo vā dviśo vā'pi yojitaṃ vā tribhis tribhiḥ ||21||
sphaṭikaṃ vidrumaṃ śaṅkho madhukaṃ madhu caiva hi |
kāsīsaṃ madhunā vā'pi yojyam atrāñjane sadā |24|

div.ab: raktārjunacikitsāmāha- paittamityādi| paittaṃ pittābhiṣyandoditam| atra arjune| amlaiḥ dhānyāmlādibhiḥ| tatra ikṣukṣaudrādibhiḥ sekāñjane kartavye, amlaiḥ punarāścyotanameva kartavyam| arjune'paramapyāścyotanamāha- sitetyādi| etaiḥ sitādibhirdāḍimāmlaparyantairvyastaiḥ samastairvā yuktito doṣabalāpekṣayā''ścyotanaṃ kāryamiti piṇḍārthaḥ| arjune'ñjanamāha- sphaṭikamityādi| vidṛmaḥ pravālaḥ| arjune'paramapyañjanamāha- saindhavetyādi| saindhavakṣaudrakatakā ityekamañjanaṃ, sakṣaudraṃ vā rasāñjanamityaparaṃ, kāsīsaṃ madhunā vā'pīti tṛtīyamañjanam| atra arjune||19-23||-

lg.l: ratnāni dantāḥ śṛṅgāṇi gaṇaś cāpy avasādanaḥ |

div.ab: lekhyāñjanamāha- lohetyādi| sarvāṇi suvarṇatrapusīsatāmrarajatakṛṣṇalohādijātāni| dhātavo manaḥśilāgairikādayaḥ| lavaṇāni saindhavādīni pañca| ratnāni vaidūryamarakataprabhṛtīni| dantā gavādīnāmaśvādīnāṃ ca| śṛṅgāṇi gavādīnāmeva| avasādano miśrakoktaḥ kāsīsādiḥ| etadanirdiṣṭānāmapi lekhyāñjanasañjñakaṃ jñeyam| aparamapi lekhyāñjanamāha- kukkuṭāṇḍetyādi| lekhyāñjanaṃ kīdṛgvidhasyāturasya prayojyamityāha- puṭapākāvasānenetyādi| raktavisrāvaṇādinā puṭapākāvasānena, syandaghātinā abhiṣyandahananaśīlena, kṛtsnena sakalena vidhinā, sampāditasya samyagyojitasya; sa punarvidhiḥ sirāvyadhavirecanaśirovirecanānyantaḥparimārjanāni; tathā hi,- “tataḥ pradehān pariṣecanāni nasyāni dhūmāśca yathāsvameva| āścyotanābhyañjanatarpaṇāni tathaiva ‘śītāṃśca kuryātpuṭapākayogān’ iti pā. kāryāḥ puṭapākayogāḥ”- iti; lekhyāñjanaṃ prayojanīyamiti piṇḍārthaḥ| ‘puṭapākāvasādena’ iti kecit paṭhanti, puṭapāka evāvasādo'vadhiryasya sa tathā teneti khyānayanti||24-26||-

ab.seg: imāṃ cikitsāmavraṇe śukre'pyatidiśannāha- anenetyādi| anena lekhyāñjanena pūrvoktena raktavisrāvaṇādyupakrameṇa sampāditasyāturasyāvraṇaṃ śukramapaharediti vākyārthaḥ||27||

lg.l: uttānam avagāḍhaṃ vā karkaśaṃ vā'pi savraṇam |
śukrasya gharṣaṇaṃ kāryam athavā saindhavena tu |
kuryād añjanayogau vā samyak ślokārdhikāv imau ||30||
dvitvaggate saśūle vā vātaghnaṃ tarpaṇaṃ hitam ||34||

div.ab: idānīmavraṇaśukracikitsitamabhidhāya savraṇe'pi pūrvaṃ cikitsitamuddiśannāha- uttānamityādi| savraṇamapi śukramuttānamekapaṭalagatam, avagāḍhaṃ vā dvitryādipaṭalagataṃ, raktasrāvaṇetyādinā pūrvoktena vidhinopapādya, lekhayediti samudāyārthaḥ| nanu savraṇasya santarpaṇasādhyatvāt kathaṃ savraṇe lekhanamupayujyate? satyaṃ, karkaśāvasthāyāṃ pūrvaṃ lekhanaṃ prayujyate paścāt santarpaṇamiti na doṣaḥ| ‘karkaśaṃ vāpi savraṇaṃ’ ityatra ‘karṣayeccāpi savraṇaṃ’ iti kecit paṭhanti| etadavasthe eva śukre gharṣaṇamāha ‘etadavasthāyāmeva śukragharṣaṇamāha’ iti pā. - śirīṣabījetyādi| śilā manaḥśilā| kuryādityādi| kau tau ślokārdhikau dvau yogāvityāha- śaṅkhakolāsthītyādi| kolāsthi badarāsthi, katakaṃ śaśapurīṣānukāryambuprasādanaṃ phalaṃ, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu, danto godantaḥ, arṇavamalaṃ samudraphenam| kṣārāñjanamityādi| kṣārāñjanaṃ ‘nīlān yavān gavyapayo'nupītān’ ityādinā śleṣmābhiṣyandoktam| mudgānityādi| mudgān śaṅkhakṣaudrasitāyutānityeko yogaḥ, madhūkasāraṃ madhuneti dvitīyo yogaḥ| bibhītaketyādi| bibhītakāsthimajjā madhunetyeko yogaḥ; śaṅkhādikatakaparyantaṃ madhuneti dvitīyo yogaḥ, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu| kecit śaṅkhaśuktītyatra śaṅkhāśmanteti paṭhanti| dvitvaggata ityādi| dvitvaggate dvipaṭalāśrite śukra ityarthaḥ| kecidamuṃ pāṭhaṃ na paṭhanti, jejjaṭena paṭhitatvādasmābhiḥ paṭhitaḥ| vaṃśajetyādi| vaṃśajo vaṃśakarīraḥ, vaṃśāṅkura iti yāvat| aruṣkarādīnāṃ paripakvāsthi, anye jaṭāmāhuḥ| eteṣāṃ vaṃśajādīnāṃ tilanāladīpitānāṃ bhasma, tacca karabhāsthicūrṇasamaṃ pratyahamākṛṣya, ṣaḍguṇodakenāṣṭaguṇodakena vā niṣkvāthya, pādaśeṣaṃ bahuśo visrāvya, svasthena tena saptāhaṃ karabhāsthicūrṇaṃ bhāvayitvā''tape śoṣayet, taccūrṇaṃ punaśca cūrṇitaṃ kṛtvā, madhvāktenāṅgulyagreṇa śalākayā vā saṅgṛhya śukradeśamātraṃ gharṣayet, tatastriphalodakenākṣi prakṣālayet| śukravaivarṇyanāśanamiti śukrasya vaivarṇyaṃ vināśayati na tu śukraṃ, etena śukrasya kṛṣṇatāmutpādayatītyarthaḥ||28-35||-

lg.l: ajakāṃ pārśvato viddhvā sūcyā visrāvya codakam ||36||

ab.seg: asādhyaśukravaivarṇyanāśanaprasaṅgenāsādhyājakājātasya vaikṛtanāśanārthaṃ cikitsāmāha- ajakāmityādi| kecidamuṃ pāṭhaṃ na paṭhanti, jejjaṭapaṭhitatvādasmābhiḥ paṭhitaḥ| atrājakāyāmavasthāyāṃ lekhanamapi karmātidiśannāha- bahuśo'valikhedityādi| asya ajakājātasya, vartma tuṇḍaṃ ‘oṣṭhaḥ’ iti pā., upagataṃ yadyuccatāṃ prāptaṃ, tadā taṃ bahuśo'valikhet||36-37||

lg.l: saśophaś cāpy aśophaś ca dvau pākau yau prakīrtitau |

div.ab: idānīṃ vātapittakaphaśoṇitānāṃ pṛthagabhiṣyandapratiṣedhamabhidhāya sānnipātikānāmapyupadeṣṭumāha- saśopha ityādi| tatreti tayoḥ pākayoḥ| sirāścātra āpāṅgyā aupanāsikā lālāṭhyā vā| āścyotanam akṣipūraṇam||38||-

lg.l: sarvataś cāpi śuddhasya kartavyam idam añjanam ||39||
tāmrapātrasthitaṃ māsaṃ ‘māṃsaṃ sarpiḥsaindhavasaṃyutam’ iti pā. sarpiḥ saindhavasaṃyutam |
maireyaṃ vā'pi dadhy evaṃ dadhyuttarakam eva vā ||40||

div.ab: tayorañjanāvasthāmuddiśannāha- sarvata ityādi| sarvataścāpi śuddhasyeti antaḥparimārjanabahiḥparimārjanābhyāṃ śuddhasyetyarthaḥ| idaṃ vakṣyamāṇam| tadevāñjanamāha- tāmrapātrasthitamityādi| maireyaṃ surāsavayorekatra sandhānaṃ, dadhi prasiddhaṃ, evamiti pūrvavat tāmrapātrasthitaṃ saindhavacūrṇayuktamityarthaḥ, dadhyuttarakaṃ dadhnaḥ saraḥ| snehāñjanaṃ raktāpakarṣaṇādinā virūkṣitākṣasya yojyaṃ; vātolbaṇapākasya vā maireyaṃ dadhi ca tāmrapātrasthitaṃ saindhavayuktaṃ, pittolbaṇe nātivirūkṣite dadhyuttarakaṃ ca, saśophasya ca raktāsrāvādisampāditasya ghṛtaṃ kāṃsyamalayuktañjanaṃ stanyaṃ vā saindhavayuktamañjanaṃ, madhūkasāraṃ vā gairikeṇa tulyāṃśaṃ madhunā'ñjanaṃ, ghṛtādīni trīṇi stanyenāñjanaṃ, etāni sāvaśeṣaraktayoḥ pākayoryojyāni||39-41||-

ab.seg: rasakriyāmāha- dāḍimetyādi| ārevataḥ kṛtamālakaḥ; ‘airāvata’ iti kecit paṭhanti, tatra airāvato nāraṅgam| sasaindhavām alpasaindhavāṃ, na samasaindhavāmityarthaḥ| rasakriyā phāṇitākṛtiḥ, tasyāśca kalpanā pittābhiṣyandapratiṣedhe vyākhyātā| ‘kolāmlaiśca sasaindhavām’ ityatra ‘kolāmlamadhusaindhavaiḥ’ iti kecit paṭhanti||42||

lg.l: māsaṃ ‘māṃsaṃ’ iti pā. saindhavasaṃyuktaṃ sthitaṃ sarpiṣi nāgaram |

ab.seg: āścyotanamāha- māsamityādi| abalākṣīraṃ strīstanyaṃ, tacca peṣaṇe boddhavyam| etaccāścyotanaṃ saśophe pāke kapholbaṇe||43||

lg.l: jātyāḥ puṣpaṃ saindhavaṃ śṛṅgaveraṃ kṛṣṇābījaṃ kīṭaśatroś ca sāram |
etat piṣṭaṃ netrapāke 'ñjanārthaṃ kṣaudropetaṃ nirviśaṅkaṃ ‘nirviśaṅkaiḥ’ iti pā. prayojyam ||44||

ab.seg: jātyā ityādi| kṛṣṇābījaṃ pippalītaṇḍulaḥ| kīṭaśatruḥ viḍaṅgaḥ| nirviśaṅkaṃ prayojyamiti pākayorañjanāvasthāyāṃ deyaṃ tadañjanamiti tātparyārthaḥ||44||

lg.l: pūyālase śoṇitamokṣaṇaṃ ca hitaṃ tathaivāpy upanāhanaṃ ca |
kṛtsno vidhiś cekṣaṇapākaghātī yathāvidhānaṃ bhiṣajā prayojyaḥ ||45||

ab.seg: pūyālase sannipātaje kriyāmāha- pūyālase ityādi| śoṇitamokṣaṇaṃ ca snehasvedapūrvakameva| upanāhanamiti yathādoṣaharavraṇaśodhanacakṣuṣyadravyakṛtaḥ pralepo bandhanaṃ vā| kṛtsno vidhiriti antaḥśuddhikaro bahiḥśuddhikaraścetyarthaḥ| yathāvidhānamiti hitānatikrameṇetyarthaḥ||45||

lg.l: kāsīsasindhuprabhavārdrakais tu hitaṃ bhaved añjanam eva cātra |
kṣaudrānvitair ebhir athopayuñjyād anyat tu tāmrāyasacūrṇayuktaiḥ ||46||

ab.seg: kāsīsādirasakriyāñjanamāha- kāsīsetyādi| cakārāt pākayoruktamañjanaṃ samuccīyate| atra pūyālase| kṣaudrānvitairityādi| ebhireva kāsīsādibhirmadhunā piṣṭaistāmrāyasacūrṇayuktairanyadañjanamiti piṇḍārthaḥ| ‘kṣaudrānvitairebhirathopayuñjyāt’ ityatra ‘kṣaudrānvitairebhiravāntaroktaiḥ’ iti kecit paṭhanti||46||

lg.l: snehādibhiḥ samyag apāsya doṣāṃs tṛptiṃ vidhāyātha yathāsvam eva |

ab.seg: idānīṃ praklinnavartmanaḥ pillākhyasya cikitsāmuddiśannāha- snehādibhirityādi| snehādibhiriti snehasirāvyadhavirecanaśirovirecanāsthāpanaiḥ| apāsya nirhṛtya| tṛptiḥ tarpaṇam| yathāsvaṃ yathātmīyam||47||

lg.l: kṣuṇṇābhir āścyotanam eva kāryam atrāñjanaṃ cāñjanamākṣikaṃ syāt ||48||

ab.seg: sekāścyotanayordravyāṇyāha- mustetyādi| kṣuṇṇābhiriti antarīkṣodake tadguṇe vā'nyasmin nyastābhirityarthaḥ ‘piṣṭābhiḥ’ iti pā.| āścyotanameva kāryamiti atrānukto'pi sekaḥ kāryaḥ| anye etairāścyotanamekamevecchanti| atrāñjanamityādi| atrāklinnavartmani rasāñjanamākṣikamañjanaṃ syāt| ‘rodhrotpalasārivābhiḥ’ ityatra kecit ‘lodhrāsitasārivābhiḥ’ iti paṭhanti, asitasārivā śyāmālatā; asitaṃ rasāñjanamityanye vyākhyānayanti||48||

lg.l: patraṃ phalaṃ cāmalakasya paktvā kriyāṃ vidadhyād athavā'ñjanārthe |
vaṃśasya mūlena rasakriyāṃ vā vartīkṛtāṃ tāmrakapālapakvām ||49||
rasakriyāṃ vā triphalāvipakvāṃ palāśapuṣpaiḥ kharamañjarer vā |50|

div.ab: rasakriyāñjanamāha- patramityādi| paktveti kaṣāyakalpena vipācyetyarthaḥ| kriyāṃ rasākriyāṃ, vaṃśasya mūlarasena vā rasakriyāṃ, tāmeva vā rasakriyāmatiśoṣaṇena vartīkṛtām| tāmrakapālaṃ tāmrakaṭāhaḥ| triphalāyā anyā rasakriyā, palāśapuṣpairanyā, kharamañjarerapāmārgasyānyā rasakriyeti||49||-

lg.l: piṣṭvā chagalyāḥ payasā malaṃ vā kāṃsasya dagdhvā saha tāntavena ||50||
pratyañjanaṃ tan maricair upetaṃ cūrṇena tāmrasya sahopayojyam |51|

div.ab: idānīṃ tīkṣṇāñjanadurbalasya nayanasya pratyāśvāsanārthaṃ pratyañjanamāha- piṣṭvetyādi| kāṃsyasya malaṃ kārpāsavastreṇa saha dagdhvā sitamaricatāmrajoyuktaṃ chagalīdugdhena piṣṭvā pratyañjanaṃ yojyamiti piṇḍārthaḥ| paścāt praśāntadoṣe yadañjanaṃ kriyate tat pratyañjanaśabdavācyam||50||-

lg.l: samudraphenaṃ lavaṇottamaṃ ca śaṅkho 'tha mudgo maricaṃ ca śuklam ||51||
cūrṇāñjanaṃ jāḍyam athāpi ‘yojyamathāpi’ iti pā. kaṇḍūm aklinnavartmāny upahanti śīghram |52|

ab.seg: cūrṇāñjanamāha- samudraphenamityādi| lavaṇottamaṃ saindhavam||51||

lg.l: praklinnavartmany api caita eva yogāḥ prayojyāś ca samīkṣya doṣam ||52||

ab.seg: sarvānapyaklinnartmoktān praklinnavartmanyatidiśannāha- praklinnetyādi| eta eveti pūrvoktāḥ| samīkṣya doṣamiti praklinnavartmanaḥ kaphajatvādeṣu madhye ye kaphaharā yogāste prayojyā ityarthaḥ||52||

lg.l: sakajjalaṃ tāmraghaṭe ca ghṛṣṭaṃ sarpiryutaṃ tutthakam añjanaṃ ca ||53||

ab.seg: praklinnavartmanaḥ sāmānyacikitsāmuktvā viśeṣacikitsāmāha- sakajjalamityādi| tutthakaṃ kajjalatulyabhāgaṃ tāmrapātre ghṛṣṭaṃ sarpiryutamañjanamiti||53||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre raktābhiṣyandapratiṣedho nāma dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||12||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ||12||

div.head: lekhyarogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto lekhyarogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

raktābhiṣyandānantaramauṣadhasādhyān gadāñcaturṣvabhiṣyandeṣvabhidhāya śastrasādhyān pratipādayitukāmo lekhyāñjanaprasaṅgena prathamaṃ lekhyarogapratiṣedhamāha- athāta ityādi| yadyapi cikitsāpravibhāgīyoddiṣṭāt ‘chedyāsteṣu daśaikaśca’ ityādivacanāt pūrvaṃ chedyarogāṇāmupādānaṃ prapnoti, tathā'pi lekhyāñjanaprasaṅgācchedyādiṣvalpāvasthāyāṃ ‘lekhanaprasaṅgāt’ iti pā. lekhanopayogācca likhyānāṃ prāgupādānam||1-2||

lg.l: nava ye 'bhihitā lekhyāḥ sāmānyas teṣv ayaṃ vidhiḥ |
plotāntarābhyāṃ ‘plotāntarīkṛtaṃ naiva’ iti pā. na yathā calati sraṃsate 'pi vā ||5||
likhec chastreṇa patrair vā, tato rakte sthite punaḥ ||6||

div.ab: tān sarvān saṅkhyayā'bhidhāya saṅkṣepārthaṃ teṣvabhinnavidhimupadiśannāha- navetyādi| tameva sāmānyavidhimāha- snigdhetyādi|- snigdhavāntaviriktasyetyatrānukto'pi snehānantaraṃ svedaḥ kāryaḥ| susamāhita ityanena yathā dṛśoḥ pīḍā na syāttathā svedayeditī dyotyate| nirbhujya parivartya, uttānīkṛtyetyarthaḥ| nirbhugnam uttānīkṛtam| plotāntarābhyāṃ vastraveṣṭitābhyāmaṅgulyaṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ yathā na calati na kampate, na vā sraṃsate nādhaḥ patati, tathā vartma nirbhujyetyarthaḥ| śastrapadāṅkitamiti pracchayitavye pracchitaṃ, bhedayitavye ca bhinnaṃ, chedanīye ca chinnamityarthaḥ| vātakaphavyādhikaṭhinaṃ dāruṇaṃ vartma śastreṇa likhet, pittaraktagadakrāntaṃ mṛduvartma punaḥ śephālikādīnāṃ patrairlikhet| paścātkarmāha- tata ityādi| svinnaṃ sveditam| manohvā manaḥśilā| ārdrāñjanaṃ rasāñjanam| mākṣīkaṃ suvarṇamākṣīkam| pratisārya avaghṛṣya| haviṣā ghṛtena| vraṇavat sadyovraṇavat saptāhaṃ yāvat, tadūrdhvaṃ śārīravraṇavat; tacca parṇabandhādinā krameṇa| svedāvapīḍetyādi| tryahādūrdhvaṃ punarvraṇavadeva svedāpīḍāprabhṛtīn prayojayediti tātparyārthaḥ| svedāvapīḍādikaṃ samāsenābhidhāya vistareṇātidiśannāhā- vyāsata ityādi| vidhānaṃ svedāvapīḍādikam| lekhyakarmaṇīti sakalalekhanārhagadakarmaṇītyartthaḥ||3-8||-

lg.l: samaṃ nakhanibhaṃ vartma likhitaṃ samyag iṣyate |10|

div.ab: idānīṃ samyaglikhitasya vartmano lakṣaṇamāha- asṛgāsrāvarahitamityādi| samaṃ nimnonnatatvarahitam| nakhanibhaṃ nakhasyeva nibhā yasya tattathā| tadeva vraṇavadupacaraṇīyam||9||-

lg.l: raktam akṣi sravet skannaṃ kṣatāc chastrakṛtād dhruvam ||10||
etad durlikhitaṃ jñeyaṃ snehayitvā punar likhet ||12||

ab.seg: durlikhitasya vartmano lakṣaṇamāha- raktamityādi| skannaṃ styānam| vyādhyanirjaya iti lekhanasādhyasya vyādheranupaśamaḥ| apratikāriṇa iti tasya pratikriyāmakurvata ityarthaḥ| tatra cikitsāmāha- snehatvetyādi| kecit ‘svedayitvā’ iti paṭhanti||10-12||

lg.l: vyāvartate yadā vartma pakṣma cāpi vimuhyati ‘vimuñcati’ iti pā.|
syāt saruk srāvabahulaṃ tad atisrāvitaṃ viduḥ ||13||

div.ab: atilikhitavartmano lakṣaṇamāha- vyāvartata ityādi| taccikitsitamāha- snehasvedādirityādi| anilāpahaḥ kramo'nyo'pi pariṣekādirbāhya ābhyantaro vā''hārādikaḥ| anilāpahena vāyuṃ jitvā paścādvraṇavadupacaraṇīyam||13||-

lg.l: vartmāvabandhaṃ kliṣṭaṃ ca bahalaṃ yac ca kīrtitam ||14||

div.ab: idānīṃ rogaviśeṣe kvacideva pracchannena raktaharaṇamṛdukaraṇapūrvakaṃ lekhanamatidiśannāha- vartmetyādi| avalikhet śastreṇa, na tu patrādibhiḥ||14||-

ab.seg: kvacit punarlekhanamātrameva kartavyaṃ na punaśchedabhedapracchannānīti darśayannāha- samamityādi| samam ekakālamityarthaḥ; anye tu nātyavagāḍhaṃ nātyuttānamiti samamāhuḥ||15||

lg.l: kalpayitvā ‘kartayitvā’ iti pā. tu śastreṇa likhet paścād atandritaḥ ||16||

ab.seg: kutracicchedapūrvakaṃ lekhanamāha- kumbhīkinīmityādi| kalpayitvā chittvetyarthaḥ| atandritaḥ analasaḥ||16||

lg.l: bhaveyur vartmasu ca yāḥ piḍakāḥ kaṭhinā bhṛśam |
hrasvās tāmrāś ca tāḥ pakvā bhindyād bhinnā likhed api ||17||

ab.seg: kasmiṃścidbhedapūrvakaṃ lekhanamāha- bhaveyurityādi||17||
kutrāpi vartmaroge na pūrvaṃ chedabhedapracchannāni, na cottarakālaṃ lekhanamiti darśayannāha- taruṇīścālpetyādi||18||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre lekhyarogapratiṣedho nāma trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||13||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahakhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ||13||

div.head: bhedyarogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto bhedyarogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
lekhyapratiṣedhānantaraṃ bhittvā likhediti vacanādbhedyarogapratiṣedhārambhaḥ- athāta ityādi||1-2||

lg.l: svedayitvā bisagranthiṃ chidrāṇy asya nirāśayam ‘nirāśrayaṃ’ iti pā.|
tataḥ kṣaudraghṛtaṃ dattvā samyag bandham athācaret ||4||

ab.seg: svedayitvetyādi| bisagranthiṃ pakvaṃ svedayitvā, anantaramasya pakvasya bisagrantheḥ svinnasya chidrāṇi nirāśayaṃ bhittvā, saindhavena kāsīsādiyuktenāvacūrṇayet| nirāśayamiti āśayasya utsaṅgasyābhāvo yathā syāttathā bhittvetyarthaḥ| puṣpaṃ puṣpāñjanaṃ, nepālī manaḥśilā| tataḥ pratisāraṇādanantaraṃ sandhānārthaṃ kṣaudraghṛtadānam| kecit ‘samyagbandhamathācaret’ ityatra ‘bandhenoktena yojayet’ iti paṭhanti| samyakśabdena śithilatā bandhasya khyāpyate||3-4||

lg.l: mahaty api ca yuñjīta kṣārāgnī vidhikovidaḥ |6|

div.ab: lagaṇasya cikitsāmāha- rocanetyādi| rocanā gorocanā, kṣāro yavakṣāraḥ| etāni pratisāraṇānyalpe lagaṇe bhinne sati yojyāni| ekaikamiti vacanena gorocanādibhirekaikaśaḥ pratisāraṇaṃ vidheyamityarthaḥ| alpalagaṇacikitsāmabhidhāya mahālagaṇacikitsāmāha- mahatyapi ca yuñjītetyādi| mahati gurutare iti| yuñjīteti bhinne sati lagaṇe kṣārāgnī prayuñjīta; tadanantaraṃ tatkālameva kṣārāgnidagdhavraṇavaccikitsā, paścāt sāmānyavraṇavat| kovidaḥ paṇḍitaḥ||5||-

svayaṃ bhinnāyā añjananāmikāyāścikitsāmāha- svinnāmityādi| bhinnāṃ svayambhinnām| viniṣpīḍyeti snehasvedapūrvakaṃ niṣpīḍanaṃ kṛtvā, śilā manaḥśilā, elā sūkṣmailā, nataṃ tagaraṃ, sindhūtthaṃ saindhavam| pratisārayet gharṣayet||6||-

abhinnāñjananāmikācikitsāmāha- rasāñjanetyādi| svayamabhinnāmañjananāmikāṃ pūrvaṃ ‘pūrvavat’ iti pā. svinnāṃ śastrakarmavidbhittvā rasāñjanamadhubhyāṃ pratisārya taduttarakālaṃ dīpaśikhodbhavaiḥ kajjalākhyairañjanairyojayediti piṇḍārthaḥ||7||-

lg.l: samyak svinne kṛmigranthau bhinne syāt pratisāraṇam ||8||

div.ab: krimigranthicikitsāmāha- samyagityādi| samyaksvinne iti locanocitasvedasvinne, anantaraṃ bhedite pratisāraṇamiti; anuktamapyañjananāmikoddiṣṭamañjanamadhubhyāṃ pratisāraṇaṃ, tadanantaraṃ triphalākvāthena tutthakāsīsasaindhavāvāpena rasakriyā||8||-

śleṣmopanāhacikitsāmāha- bhittvetyādi| śleṣmopanāho bhedyaḥ, mahānnīrujaśca lekhyaḥ, raktānubandhaśca pracchanīyaḥ; śleṣmopanāhe bhinne likhite pracchite'pi ca pippalyādibhirekameva pratisāraṇam||9||-

ab.seg: eṣāṃ pañcānāmapi medyānāṃ bisagranthyādīnāmāmānāmādau saṃśamanaṃ nirdiśannāha- saṃsnehyetyādi| patrabhaṅgaiḥ patrakhaṇḍaiḥ; anye patrabhaṅgaśabdena pallavamāhuḥ| vidhinā apatarpaṇādinā sāmānyaśothapratīkāreṇa| snehapūrvakaṃ vidhānamiti snehasvedaraktāsrāvavirecanādi, nayanabudbudajānyatra vamanaṃ ca||10-11||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre bhedyarogapratiṣedho nāma caturdaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||14||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ||14||

div.head: chedyarogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaś chedyarogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
bhedyarogapratiṣedhānantaraṃ pāriśeṣyācchedyarogapratiṣedhārambho yujyata ityāha- athāta ityādi||1-2||

lg.l: snigdhaṃ bhuktavato hy annam upaviṣṭasya yatnataḥ |
saṃroṣayet tu nayanaṃ bhiṣak cūrṇais tu lāvaṇaiḥ ||3||

ab.seg: tatraikādaśasu chedyeṣu prathamaṃ pañcānāmarmaṇāmekameva prakāramupadarśayiṣyan prathamaṃ tatprākkarmaiva nirdiśannāha- snigdhamityādi| snigdhaṃ bhuktavata iti saṃśuddhadehasya kṛtasaṃsarjanasya vicāraṇāprakāreṇa vā snigdhaṃ bhuktavataḥ| yatnata iti yathā nātipīḍā syāt| saṃroṣayet armaśithilīkaraṇāya saṅkṣobhayet| lāvaṇaiḥ saindhavotthaiḥ||3||

lg.l: arma yatra valījātaṃ tatraital lagayed bhiṣak ||4||
mucuṇḍy ā''dāya medhāvī sūcīsūtreṇa vā punaḥ ||5||
na cotthāpayatā kṣipraṃ kāryam abhyunnataṃ ‘kāryamatyunnataṃ’ iti pā. tu tat |
śastrābādhabhayāc cāsya ‘śasrapātabhayāccāsya’ iti pā. vartmanī grāhayed dṛḍham ||6||
vimuktaṃ sarvataś cāpi kṛṣṇācchuklāc ca maṇḍalāt |

div.ab: idānīṃ yādṛśamarma baḍiśena grāhyaṃ tādṛśaṃ nirdiśannāha- tata ityādi| parighaṭṭitaṃ cālitam| arma yatra valījātamityādi| yatra yasmin pradeśe arma jātavalīkaṃ syāttatra pradeśe etadarma baḍiśena lagayet saṃyojayet, grāhayedityarthaḥ| mucuṇḍyetyādi|- tadanantaraṃ baḍiśaṃ mucuṇḍyā tarjanyaṅguṣṭhasandaṃśenādāya mucuṇḍī sandaṃśayantraviśeṣaḥ| tallakṣaṇaṃ vāgbhaṭe proktaṃ, yathā- ‘mucuṇḍī sūkṣmadantarjurmūle rucakabhūṣaṇā| gambhīravraṇamāṃsānāmarmaṇaḥ śeṣitasya ca’ iti gṛhītvā samyagyogenotkṣepayet| sūcīsūtreṇa vā punariti mucuṇḍyā baḍiśotkṣepādanantaraṃ praṇihitaṃ sasūtrasūcīsūtreṇa tadarma utkṣipet| na cotthāpayatetyādi|- utthāpayatā vaidyena kṣipraṃ sahasā tadarmātyunnataṃ na kāryaṃ, truṭanabhayāt| vartmanī grāhayediti ūrdhvaṃ sthitaṃ vartma ūrdhvamākṛṣya grāhayet, adhaḥ sthitamadha evākṛṣya grāhayedityarthaḥ| tataḥ praśithilībhūtamityādi|- praśithilībhūtaṃ vimuktanayanagolakāśleṣam ‘nayanagolakaśleṣmāṇaṃ’ iti pā.| tribhiḥ baḍiśādibhiḥ, na tvekena, truṭanabhayāt; vilambitaṃ viśeṣeṇa lambitaṃ dhṛtamityarthaḥ| ullikhannityādi- ullikhan ūrdhvamevādhaḥsthitaṃ kurvan| pariśodhayet sarvata unmūlayet, ‘armasantānaṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ| kanīnakopāntaṃ kanīnakasamīpaṃ, kanīnakaśca nāsāsamīpastho'kṣisandhiḥ| chindyāditi kriyāsaukaryārthaṃ baḍiśamapakṛṣya praṇihitasūcīsūtreṇāvalambyārma chindyādityarthaḥ| nātikanīnakamiti atikrāntakanīnakaṃ yathā na syāttathā chindyādityarthaḥ| caturbhāgasthite iti akṣigolakasyoparitane māṃse caturbhāgena sthite ityarthaḥ, nāntike ‘nāntike’ iti hastalikhitapustake nopalabhyate| vyāpattiṃ vyāpadam, ṛcchati prāpnotītyarthaḥ| kanīnakavadhādityādi aticchedāt kanīnakavadhaḥ| asraṃ raktam| nāḍīti nāḍīvraṇaḥ| apiśabdādvedanā ca| hīnacchedāt kiṃ syādityāha- vṛddhimadhigacchati; ‘arma’ iti śeṣaḥ||4-9||-

lg.l: arma yaj jālavad vyāpi tad apy unmārjya ‘tadeṣyonmārjya’ iti pā. lambitam ||10||

div.ab: yatra punaḥ prastāryarmaṇi vistaratvādarmaṇo vartmadvayasamīpaśuklāvayavavyāpino valībhāvo nāsti tatra kiṃ karaṇīyamiti darśayannāha- armetyādi| yadarma jālavanmatsyabandhanajālasadṛśaṃ vyāpi vyāpanaśīlaṃ tadapi saindhavacūrṇena sahordhvaghṛṣṭaṃ śithilībhūtaṃ vakraśastreṇa baḍiśena lambitaṃ maṇḍalāgreṇa chindyādityarthaḥ| vartmaśuklāntamāśritamiti atra vartmano'nta śabdaḥ samīpavācī, śukle punaravayavavācī| kecit ‘armavajjālakaṃ ‘armaivaṃ jālakaṃ vyāpi’ iti pā. vyāpi’ iti paṭhanti; jālakaṃ snāyvarma, tacca vakreṇa śastreṇa lambitamarmavacchindyāt, vartmaśuklāntamāśritaṃ punararma ullekhaprakāreṇa chindyāditi ca vyākhyānayanti||10||-

lg.l: pratisāraṇam akṣṇos tu tataḥ kāryam anantaram ||11||
svedayitvā tataḥ paścād badhnīyāt kuśalo bhiṣak ||12||
vraṇavat saṃvidhānaṃ tu tasya kuryād ataḥ param ||13||
tryahān muktvā karasvedaṃ dattvā śodhanam ācaret |14|

div.ab: chedānantaraṃ pratisāraṇaṃ nirdiśannāha- pratisāraṇamityādi| tata iti karmaṇaḥ| yāvanālasya yavakṣārasya, lavaṇasya saindhavasya| svedayitvetyādi| svedayitvā ‘kareṇa’ iti śeṣaḥ| kuśalo bandhādivettā| ‘doṣartubalakālajña’ iti doṣāṇāṃ cayādimukhena balakālajñaḥ, ṛtūnāmādimadhyāvasānena; athavā doṣā vātādayaḥ, ṛtavo hemantādayaḥ, balaṃ kriyāsu sāmarthyaṃ, kālaścāvasthikaḥ, tān jānāti yaḥ sa tādṛśaḥ| snehaṃ dattvā yathāhitamiti sandhānārthaṃ ghṛtādīnāṃ madhye yo yasmai hitastaṃ dattvetyarthaḥ| tathā'nuktamapi cakṣuṣyaṃ sadyovraṇahitaṃ triphalālodhracandanādikaṣāyadravakalkapiṇḍaṃ dattvā badhnīyāt, tenaiva ca prakṣālanam| vraṇavadityādi vraṇavat saṃvidhānaṃ śodhanaropaṇādikam| tadeva śodhanavidhānaṃ darśayannāha- tryahādityādi||11-13||-

lg.l: hitam āścyotanaṃ śūle dvir ahnaḥ kṣaudrasaṃyutam |

div.ab: idānīmāvasthikaśūlasya cikitsāmāha- karañjabījetyādi| āścyotanam akṣipūraṇam| dvirahna iti divasasya kāladvayam| tasminneva śūle śirolepaṃ darśayannāha- madhukotpalakiñjalketyādi| utpalaṃ nīlotpalaṃ, kiñjalkaḥ padmakeśaram||14-15||-

ab.seg: śastrakarmāvaśiṣṭasyārmaṇo lekhyāñjanairevāpaharaṇaṃ nirdiśannāha- lekhyāñjanairityādi| lekhyāñjanairiti ‘lohacūrṇāni sarvāṇi dhātavo lavaṇāni ca’ ityādinā śukranirdiṣṭaiḥ||16||

lg.l: arma cālpaṃ dadhinibhaṃ nīlaṃ raktam athāpi vā |
dhūsaraṃ tanu yac cāpi śukravat tad upācaret ||17||

ab.seg: idānīṃ lekhyāñjanaprasaṅgena yādṛśaṃ lekhanasādhyamarma tādṛśaṃ darśayannāha- arma cālpamityādi| alpaṃ vistāreṇa, dadhinibhaṃ śuklārma, nīlaṃ prastāri, raktaṃ lohitārma, dhūsaraṃ pāṇḍuraṃ, tanu snāyvarma, tanu yaccāpītyatra cakārāpiśabdābhyāṃ māṃsārmāpi yakṛtprakāśaṃ śyāvaṃ vā; etat pañcavidhamapyarma vistīrṇaṃ tanu vā śukravadeva lekhyāñjanairevopacaraṇīyam||17||

lg.l: chedyam eva tad arma syāt kṛṣṇamaṇḍalagaṃ ca yat ||18||

ab.seg: idānīṃ yādṛśaṃ chedyamarma tādṛśaṃ darśayannāha- carmābhamityādi| carmavadābhāsate yattattathā carmakhaṇḍavadityarthaḥ| bahalaṃ sthūlam| snāyumāṃsaghanaṃ snāyumāṃsābhyāṃ ghanaṃ yathā syādevamāvṛtaṃ; ‘snāyumāṃsasirāvṛtaṃ’ iti kecit paṭhanti| kṛṣṇamaṇḍalagamiti dṛṣṭimārgāvaraṇakārītyarthaḥ||18||

samyakchinnasyārmaṇo lakṣaṇamāha- viśuddhavarṇamityādi| viśuddhavarṇamarmāpanayanāt prakṛtivarṇamakṣi bhavet| akliṣṭaṃ kriyāsviti nimeṣonmeṣādiṣu na kleśavat| gataklamam anāyāsakleśarahitam| kecidakliṣṭaṃ nirdoṣaṃ, kriyāsvakṣi gataklamaṃ kriyāsūnmeṣādiṣvapi nirābādhaṃ syāditi vyākhyānayanti| yathāsvamanupadravamiti hīnāticchedayorye pratyekamupadravāste na vidyamānā yasya tattathetyarthaḥ||19||

lg.l: sirājāle sirā yās tu kaṭhinās tāś ca buddhimān |

ab.seg: armacchedaṃ pratipādya sirājālacchedaṃ pratipādayannāha- sirājāle ityādi| pūrvavadeva snigdhasvinnasaṃroṣitanayanasya baḍiśenāvalambitāḥ kaṭhinasirā maṇḍalāgreṇordhvaṃ likhet ūrdhvaṃ chindyāditi piṇḍārthaḥ| kaṭhinasirāgrahaṇānmṛdūnāṃ sirāṇāṃ lekhyāñjanaṃ yojyamiti jñeyam||20||

lg.l: sirāsu piḍakā jātā yā na sidhyanti bheṣajaiḥ |

ab.seg: sirājapiḍakāsu bheṣajairasidhyamānāsu chedaṃ darśayannāha- sirāsvityādi| armavacchedanamiti armoktaṃ pūrvakarmādikaṃ kṛtvā chedaḥ kāryaḥ||21||

rogayorityādi| etayoḥ sirājālasirāpiḍakayoḥ| armoktaṃ pratisāraṇamiti ‘yāvanālasya cūrṇena’ ityādyuktam| yathādoṣaṃ yo vidhirvātābhiṣyandanādiṣu nirdiṣṭaḥ sa ca kāryo lekhanairdravyaiḥ sampādita ityarthaḥ||22||

lg.l: chindyāt tato 'rdham agre, syād aśrunāḍī hy ato 'nyathā |

div.ab: parvaṇikāpiḍakācchedanamāha- sandhāvityādi| sandhau kṛṣṇaśuklasandhau, saṃsvedya samyak svedayitvā, paraṃ yathā dṛśoḥ pīḍā na syāt, uttare tribhāge baḍiśenāvalambitāṃ viddhā ‘viddhagṛhītāṃ’ iti pā. gṛhītāṃ, chindyāttato'rdhamagre iti tadanantaramagre'rdhaṃ chindyāt mūlāgrayormitvā ‘mūlāgrayorbhittvā’ iti pā. madhye tāṃ chindyādityarthaḥ| tasyāṃ chinnāyāṃ pratisāraṇamāha- pratisāraṇamityādi| śastrakarmāvaśiṣṭasya parvaṇīśeṣasya cikitsāmāha- lekhanīyānītyādi||13-14||-

lg.l: śaṅkhaṃ samudraphenaṃ ca maṇḍūkīṃ ca samudrajām ||25||
vaidūryaṃ ‘vaidūryopalakaṃ’ iti pā. pulakaṃ muktāmayas tāmrarajāṃsi ca ||26||
armāṇi piḍakāṃ hanyāt sirājālāni tena vai ||28||

ab.seg: tānyeva lekhanīyacūrṇānyāha- śaṅkhamityādi| maṇḍūkīṃ ca samudrajāmiti samudrajā maṇḍūkī muktānāṃ śuktiḥ| kuruvindaḥ padmarāgaḥ, ‘niśānopala’ ityanye, aśmantakaṃ salaupamaṃ(?) maṇiviśeṣaḥ| vaidūryamiti vidūragirisambhavam atyacchamānīlaṃ, pulakaṃ sphaṭikameva pākādvarṇāntaramāpannaṃ; kecit ‘vaidūryopalakaṃ’ iti paṭhanti, tatra vaidūryopalakaṃ veruḍiketi vyākhyānayanti| meṣaśṛṅga iṅgudībhedaḥ; kecit meṣaviṣāṇaracitabhājanaṃ manyante||25-28||

lg.l: arśas tathā yac ca nāmnā śuṣkārśo 'rbudam eva ca |

ab.seg: arśa ityādi| abhyantaraṃ vartmaśayā iti vartmābhyantarāśrayā ityarthaḥ||29||

lg.l: sthite ca rudhire vartma dahet samyak śalākayā ||31||

div.ab: tadeva vidhānamāha- vartmetyādi| nirbhujya parivartya, uttānaṃ kṛtvetyarthaḥ| kecidamumeva pāṭhamanyathā kṛtvā paṭhanti, sa ca vartamānapustakeṣu na dṛśyate, ato na likhitaḥ| teṣāṃ karmaṇi kṛte pratisāraṇamāha- tata ityādi| pratisārayed gharṣayet| śastrakarmāvaśiṣṭānāmarśaādīnāṃ cikitsāmāha- sthita ityādi| samyag yogena, śalākayeti vastrācchāditāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ kṛtvā agnitaptaśalākayā vyādhiśeṣaṃ dahet, kṣāreṇāvalikhecca| sarveṣvevokteṣu chedyarogeṣvanirdiṣṭaṃ bheṣajaṃ nirdiśannāha- tīkṣṇairityādi| ubhayatobhāgaiḥ vāmanīyavirecanadravyaiḥ| doṣaṃ vraṇagatāṃ doṣaduṣṭiṃ; etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati- vāmanīyavirecanīyadravyāṇāṃ kalkakaṣāyādinā vraṇaśuddhiḥ kartavyetyarthaḥ| kecidvamanavirecanaireva kaphādikaṃ doṣaṃ nirharediti manyante; etacca pañjikākāreṇa dūṣitam||30-32||-

lg.l: śastrakarmaṇy uparate māsaṃ ca syāt suyantritaḥ ||33||

ab.seg: idānīṃ chedyādiṣu parihāryaparihārāvadhiṃ darśayannāha- śastrakarmaṇītyādi||33||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre chedyarogapratiṣedho nāma pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||15||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ||15||
athātaḥ pakṣmakopapratiṣedhaṃ ‘pakṣmagatarogapratiṣedhaṃ’ iti pā. vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

chedyarogapratiṣedhānantaraṃ pakṣmakope cchedyakarmasamavāyāt pakṣmagatarogapratiṣedhārambho yukto'ta āha- athāta ityādi| pakṣma vartmagataromamālikā; kecit pakṣmaśabdena pakṣmāśrayaṃ vartma kathayanti||1-2||

lg.l: yāpyas tu yo vartmabhavo vikāraḥ pakṣmaprakopo 'bhihitaḥ purastāt |
tatropaviṣṭasya narasya carma vartmopariṣṭād anutiryag eva ||3||
bhruvor adhastāt parimucya bhāgau pakṣmāśritaṃ caikam ato 'vakṛntet |
utkṛtya śastreṇa yavapramāṇaṃ bālena sīvyed bhiṣag apramattaḥ |
dattvā ca sarpirmadhunā'vaśeṣaṃ kuryād vidhānaṃ ‘kuryādvidhiṃ yo'bhihito vraṇe tam’ iti pā. vihitaṃ vraṇe yat ||5||
lalāṭadeśe ca nibaddhapaṭṭaṃ ‘nibadhya paṭṭaṃ’ iti pā. prāk syūtam atrāpy aparaṃ ca baddhvā |
sthairyaṃ gate cāpy atha śastramārge bālān vimuñcet kuśalo 'bhivīkṣya ||6||

ab.seg: pakṣmakope śastramagniḥ kṣāro bheṣajamiti caturvidhaṃ karma; tatrādau śastrakarma nirdiśannāha- yāpya ityādi| purastāt vartmarogavijñānīye| tatra pakṣmaprakope| snigdhadehasyopaviṣṭasya narasya, bhruvoradhastāddvau bhāgau, tatra pakṣmāśritamekaṃ bhāgaṃ vimucya kanīnakāpāṅgayoḥ samaṃ pradeśamanulakṣīkṛtya, samantāt sarvataḥ na tu kvacideva, etenopapakṣmamālāpramāṇena vartmopariṣṭādyavākṛti carma tiryak śastreṇa nikṛntet, carma nikṛtya tadaśvādīnāṃ bālena sīvyet| tataḥ sandhānārthaṃ madhu ghṛtaṃ ca dattvā, prāksyūtaṃ yattat aparaṃ yat syūtvoddhṛtaṃ tat etadbālāñcaladvayena lalāṭe paṭṭaṃ baddhvā vraṇoktaṃ vidhiṃ kuryāditi piṇḍārthaḥ| sthairyaṃ gate kaṭhinībhūte saṃrūḍhe ityarthaḥ| śastramārge ‘śastramārgavraṇādbālān vimuñcet’ iti pā. vraṇe, bālān sevanabālān, vimuñcet syūtarandhrāt krameṇāpakarṣedityarthaḥ| kecit ‘vimuñcet’ ityatra ‘prakalpayet’ iti paṭhanti, prakalpayet kartaryā cchindyāditi ca vyākhyānayanti||3-6||

lg.l: evaṃ na cec chāmyati tasya vartma nirbhujya doṣopahatāṃ valiṃ ca |
tato 'gninā vā pratisārayet tāṃ kṣāreṇa vā samyag avekṣya dhīraḥ ||7||

ab.seg: evamapyaśāmyati pakṣmakope upapakṣmamālāparaparyāye karmāntaramāha- evamityādi| nirbhujya uttānīkṛtvetyarthaḥ| avekṣya ‘śāstram’ iti śeṣaḥ||7||

lg.l: chittvā samaṃ vā'py upapakṣmamālāṃ samyag gṛhītvā baḍiśais tribhis tu |
pathyāphalena pratisārayet tu ghṛṣṭena vā tauvarakeṇa samyak ||8||

ab.seg: kṣārāgnibhyāmapyapraśāmyantyāmupapakṣmamālāyāṃ vidhyantaramāha- chittvā samamityādi| chittvā dvidhā bhāvaṃ nītvā, utpāṭyetyarthaḥ| samam ekakālam| upapakṣmamālāṃ ‘doṣāḥ pakṣmāśayagatāstīkṣṇāgrāṇi kharāṇi ca’ ityādyuktalakṣaṇām| pathyāphalena jalaghṛṣṭena pratisārayet| kecit ‘piṣṭena’ iti paṭhanti||8||

lg.l: catvāra ete vidhayo vihantuṃ pakṣmoparodhaṃ pṛthag eva śastāḥ |

ab.seg: uktamevopasaṃharannāha- catvāra ityādi| catvāra eta iti śastrāgnikṣārabheṣajāni| pakṣmoparodhaṃ pakṣmaprakopam| vihantuṃ vighaṭṭayituṃ na punaḥ sarvathā śamayituṃ, tasya yāpyatvāt| tathā'bhiṣyandoktā virecanādayo yathāvasthamupayuktāḥ pṛthageva pakṣmoparodhaṃ vihantuṃ samarthāḥ| rasakriyāścetyatra cakārādupapakṣmotpāṭanam||9||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre pakṣmagatarogapratiṣedho nāma ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||16||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ||16||

div.head: dṛṣṭigatarogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto dṛṣṭigatarogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
pakṣmakopapratiṣedhānantaraṃ dṛṣṭigatānāmeva rogāṇāmavaśiṣṭatvāttatpratiṣedho yukta ityāha- athāta ityādi| dṛṣṭigatarogetyatra dṛṣṭiśabdena dṛṣṭyāśrayaṃ maṇḍalamabhipretam||1-2||

lg.l: trayaḥ sādhyās trayo 'sādhyā yāpyāḥ ṣaṭ ca bhavanti hi |3|

div.ab: dṛṣṭigatadvādaśarogāṇāṃ madhye sādhyānāṃ sādhanārthaṃ, yāpyānāṃ yāpanārthamasādhyānāṃ parihārarthamāha- traya ityādi| dhūmadarśipittavidagdhadṛṣṭiśleṣmavidagdhadṛṣṭayastrayaḥ sādhyāḥ| trayo'sādhyā iti hrasvajāḍya(tya)nākulāndhyagambhīrikākhyāḥ| yāpyāḥ ṣaṭ ceti aruṇādayo ‘aruṇādivicitrā varṇataḥ’ iti pā. vicitravarṇāntāḥ ṣaṭ kācāḥ| cakāro'tra bhinnakrame; tena yāpyaśabdānantaramupāttena caśabdena sādhyāsādhyatvaṃ samuccīyate; tena ṣaṇṇāṃ rogāṇāmavasthāviśeṣeṇa sādhyatvayāpyatvāsādhyatvāni; tathā ca te prāgavasthāyāṃ sādhyāḥ, uttarāvasthāyāmasādhyāḥ, paraṃ ślaiṣmikaṃ liṅganāśaṃ vihāya|3|-

ab.seg: tatra sādhyeṣu triṣu madhye dhūmadarśinaḥ prāguktameva pratīkāraṃ nirdiśannāha- tatretyādi| pratīkāraḥ hetuvyādhiviparītā kriyā| kīrtitaḥ pittābhiṣyandapratiṣedhe||3||

lg.l: ādye tu traiphalaṃ peyaṃ sarpis traivṛtam uttare ||5||
tailvakaṃ cobhayoḥ pathyaṃ kevalaṃ jīrṇam eva vā |6|

div.ab: idānīṃ pittakaphavidagdhadṛśorapi hetuvyādhiviparītaṃ cikitsitamāha- dṛṣṭau pittavidagdhāyāmityādi| pittaśleṣmaharaṃ pittaśleṣmābhiṣyandaharaṃ; tena pittavidagdhadṛṣṭau pittābhiṣyandaharovidhiḥ, kaphavidagdhadṛṣṭau tu kaphābhiṣyandaharo vidhiḥ| śastrakṣatādṛte sirāvyadhaṃ varjayitvā| tameva pittaśleṣmābhiṣyandaharaṃ vidhimāha- nasyaseketyādi| tatra kaphavidagdhadṛṣṭyāṃ kaphābhiṣyandaharaṃ nasyādi, pittavidagdhadṛṣṭyāṃ tu pittābhiṣyandaharaṃ nasyādi| pittakaphavidagdhadṛṣṭyāṃ vaiśeṣikaṃ sāmānyaṃ ca snehopakramamāha- ādye tu traiphalamityādi| ādye pittavidagdhadṛṣṭyākhye, traiphalaṃ triphalākvāthakalkābhyāṃ saṃskṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ; kecit ‘triphalāyā rasaprasthaṃ’ ityādikaṃ videhoktaṃ traiphalamāmananti; tannecchati gayī| traivṛtaṃ trivṛtāsaṃskṛtaṃ, na punarapatānakoktam| uttare śleṣmavidagdhadṛṣṭyākhye iti| tilvakaḥ paṭṭikārodhrastena saṃskṛtaṃ tailvakam| kevalam asaṃskṛtam| jīrṇaṃ purāṇam| anuktamapi snehādanantaraṃ vamanādi kartavyaṃ, tantrāntaradarśanāt||4-5||-

lg.l: gairikaṃ saindhavaṃ kṛṣṇā godantasya maṣī tathā ||6||
catvāra ete yogāḥ syur ubhayor añjane hitāḥ |8|

div.ab: idānīṃ bahiḥparimārjanārthamañjanayogāṃścaturo nirdiśannāha- gairikamityādi| tatra gairikamādau kṛtvā godantamaṣīṃ yāvadeko yogaḥ, gomāṃsādiko manaḥśilāṃ yāvaddvitīyo yogaḥ, vṛntaṃ kapitthānmadhuneti tṛtīyo yogaḥ, svayaṅguptāphalāni madhuneti caturtho yogaḥ, iti yogacatuṣṭayaṃ prabhāvāt pittakaphavidagdhadṛṣṭyorhitamityarthaḥ| kecidatra pittavidagdhadṛṣṭau rātrāvañjanaṃ, kaphavidagdhadṛṣṭau diveti kālavibhāgaṃ ‘kālavibhāgau’ iti pā. manyante||6-7||-

adhunā dvayorapi puṣpāñjanamāha- kubjakāśoketyādi| kubjakāśokau svanāmaprasiddhau, śālaḥ sarjabhedaḥ, nalinam īṣadraktaṃ padmaṃ, utpalaṃ nīlotpalaṃ, hareṇuḥ reṇukā, kṛṣṇāhvā pippalī, veṇunāḍyāmavasthānaṃ śaktyutkarṣārtham| pittaśleṣmavibhāvitāviti pittaśleṣmavidagdhadṛṣṭī ityarthaḥ||8-9||-

idānīṃ dinarātryandhāñjanadvayamāha- āmretyādi| āmrajambūdbhavaṃ yat puṣpaṃ tadrasena rasacaturthāṃśaṃ hareṇukācūrṇaṃ piṣṭvā rasakriyāpākena vipācya madhughṛtayuktaṃ dinarātryandhayoḥ pittakaphavidagdhadṛṣṭyaparaparyāyayordravāñjanaṃ yojyam| tathā nalinādibhirgośakṛdrasapiṣṭairguṭikāñjanaṃ hitaṃ; nalinam īṣadraktaṃ padmaṃ, utpalaṃ nīlotpalaṃ, kiñjalkaḥ keśaraḥ, sa ca nalinotpalayoreva| kecit ‘goyakṛdrasaiḥ’ iti paṭhanti; gośabdasya paśuvācitvādajādayo gṛhyante; yakṛdrasaḥ kālakhaṇḍarasa iti vyākhyānayanti||10-11||-

adhunā divāndhye vaiśeṣikaṃ cūrṇāñjanamāha- rasāñjanetyādi| rasa iti jātīpatrarasa ityarthaḥ, āmalakīpatrarasa ityanye| atra dravadravyaiḥ kaṭhinadravyabhāvanāṃ vidhāya cūrṇāñjanaṃ kartavyam| pittopahatadṛṣṭaye pittavidagdhadṛṣṭaye||12||-

ab.seg: aparamapi cūrṇāñjanamāha- śītetyādi| śītaṃ rasañjanaṃ, karpūramanye| sauvīrakaṃ sauvīrāñjanam| rasabhāvitamiti catuṣpadamṛgapakṣimāṃsarasabhāvitamityarthaḥ| kecidrasa iti sāmānyoktyā rasāñjanasauvīrāñjanayoreva rasaṃ saṅgṛhṇanti, tadabhāve ca tayoreva cūrṇāḍhakamudakāḍhake prakṣipya ahorātraparyuṣitaṃ prātarmarditaṃ ‘pītamṛditaṃ’ iti pā. pūtaṃ svarasavat prayojyamityarthaḥ| kecicca prastutatvādrasaśabdena gośakṛdrasaṃ gṛhṇanti||13-14||

lg.l: sakṣaudram añjanaṃ tadvad dhitam atrāmaye sadā ||15||

ab.seg: divāndhye kalkāñjanamāha- kāśmarīpuṣpetyādi| atreti pittavidagdhadṛṣṭau| kecit kāśmīrapuṣpādirasakriyāñjanametadityāhuḥ||15||

lg.l: srotojaṃ saindhavaṃ kṛṣṇāṃ reṇukāṃ cāpi peṣayet |

ab.seg: rātryāndhye kaphavidagdhadṛṣṭyaparaparyāye vartyañjanamāha- srotojamityādi||16||

lg.l: kṛtās tā vartayaḥ piṣṭāś chāyāśuṣkāḥ sukhāvahāḥ |18|
