div.ab: aparamapi naktandhye vartyañjanamāha- kālānusārivāmityādi| kālānusārivā tagaraṃ, kṣaṇade dve haridre, gāṅgeyaṃ mustā| yakṛdrase chāgalyādikālakhaṇḍarase; anye ‘śakṛdrase’ iti paṭhanti, śakṛdrase gomayarase iti vyākhyānayanti||17||-
anyadapi rātryāndhye vartyañjanamāha- manaḥśiletyādi||18||-

lg.l: saindhavopahitaṃ yuñjyān nihitaṃ veṇugahvare ‘veṇubhājane’ iti pā.|21|

div.ab: idānīṃ rasakriyāñjanatritayamāha- gomūtretyādi| atra mūtrapittayakṛntyajādīnāmeva| madirā piṣṭasurā| gomūtrādirasena kṣudrāñjanaṃ vipacedityeko yogaḥ, kṣudrāñjanaṃ rasakriyāñjanamityarthaḥ; rasena yakṛta iti dvitīyo yogaḥ; traiphale'pi veti tṛtīyo yogaḥ| gomūtrājyārṇavamaletyādi| etadrasakriyāñjanatritayamapyekaikaṃ gomūtrājyādibhiḥ saṃyuktaṃ veṇugahvare vaṃśanalikābhyantare vyavasthitamañjanaṃ rātryandhe yuñjyādityarthaḥ||19-20||-

lg.l: medo yakṛd ghṛtaṃ cājaṃ pippalyaḥ saindhavaṃ madhu ||21||
rasam āmalakāc cāpi pakvaṃ samyaṅ nidhāpayet |

ab.seg: śleṣmavidagdhadṛṣṭyāmaparamapi rasakriyāñjanamāha- medo yakṛddhṛtaṃ cājamityādi| medo yakṛddhṛtaṃ ceti trayametacchagalīnām| medoyakṛti sarvamekīkṛtya rasakriyāpākena pakvaṃ khadiratarusāranirmitabhājane sūkṣmamukhe bṛhanmadhyakuhare nikṣiptaṃ kṣudrāñjanaṃ rasakriyāñjanāparaparyāyaṃ hitamityarthaḥ||21-22||

anyadapi kaphavidagdhadṛṣṭāvañjanamāha- hareṇvityādi| hareṇuḥ hareṇukā, magadhājāsthimajjeti pippalīvituṣabījāni| etad hareṇvādi yakṛdraveṇa piṣṭamañjanaṃ śleṣmopahatadṛṣṭaye naktāndhāya hitamityarthaḥ| idamañjanamekīyamatābhiprāyeṇa gayadāsācāryeṇa paṭhitaṃ vyākhyātaṃ ca||23||

lg.l: niṣevitaṃ tad yakṛd añjanena nihanti naktāndhyam asaṃśayaṃ khalu ||24||

ab.seg: idānīṃ naktāndhye kaphavidagdhadṛṣṭyaparaparyāye prayogamāha- vipācyetyādi| godhāyakṛdardhapāṭitaṃ kṛtvā pippalībhiḥ pūritaṃ śucimṛdā liptamagninā vipācya tryahaṃ bhakṣitaṃ sat, tathā tadantaḥsvinnā pippalī madhunā'ñjanena niḥsandehaṃ naktāndhyaṃ nihantītyarthaḥ||24||

lg.l: tathā yakṛcchāgabhavaṃ hutāśane vipācya samyaṅ magadhāsamanvitam |
prayojitaṃ pūrvavad āśv asaṃśayaṃ jayet kṣapāndhyaṃ sakṛd añjanān nṛṇām ||25||

ab.seg: naktāndhye'paramapi prayogamāha- tathā yakṛcchāgabhavamityādi| prayojitaṃ pūrvavaditi yakṛdbhakṣaṇavidhinā prayojitaṃ, pippalī punarañjanavidhinetyarthaḥ||25||

lg.l: plīhā yakṛc cāpy upabhakṣite ‘upalakṣite’ iti pā. ubhe prakalpya śūlye ghṛtatailasaṃyute |
te sārṣapasnehasamāyute 'ñjanaṃ naktāndhyam āśveva hataḥ prayojite ||26||

ab.seg: aparamapi naktāndhyayogamāha- plīhetyādi| plīhā udaravāmapārśvasthaṃ māṃsakhaṇḍaṃ, yakṛt dakṣiṇapārśvasthaṃ kālakhaṇḍāparaparyāyaṃ, te ubhe api prastutatvād godhācchāgayoreva grāhye| prakalpya khaṇḍaśaḥ kalpayitvā| śūlye śūlapākapakve||26||

lg.l: nadījaśimbītrikaṭūny athāñjanaṃ manaḥśilā dve ca niśe ya(śa)kṛd gavām |
sacandaneyaṃ guṭikā'thavā'ñjanaṃ praśasyate vai divaseṣv apaśyatām ||27||

ab.seg: idānīṃ divāndhye pittavidagdhadṛṣṭyaparaparyāye'ñjanamāha- nadījetyādi| nadījaṃ saindhavaṃ; śimbīśabdenātra haritamudgāḥ, cakṣuṣyatvāt; anye śimbīsthāne śimbeti paṭhanti, tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ; añjanaṃ sauvīrāñjanam| gavāṃ chāgādīnām| candanaṃ raktacandanam| guṭikā vaṭīkṛtyāñjanaṃ; athavā'ñjanamiti cūrṇāñjanamathavetyarthaḥ| vipācya godhāyakṛdardhapāṭitamityādikaṃ sacandaneyaṃ guṭikā'thavāñjanamiti paryantaṃ yogacatuṣṭayaṃ nibandhakārairanārṣīkṛtaṃ, teraiva subhāṣitatvādupayogārhatvācca vyākhyātaṃ; tasmānmayā'pi paṭhitaṃ vyākhyātaṃ ca||27||

lg.l: bhavanti yāpyāḥ khalu ye ṣaḍ āmayā hared asṛk teṣu sirāvimokṣaṇaiḥ |

ab.seg: idānīṃ sādhyānāṃ cikitsitamabhidhāya yāpyānāṃ cikitsitamāha- bhavantītyādi| bhavanti yāpyā iti atra ‘upekṣyamāṇā’ iti śeṣaḥ, etena teṣāṃ pragavasthāyāṃ sādhyatvam| yāpyāḥ ṣaḍāmayā iti| nanu ślaiṣmikakācasya sādhyatvāt kathaṃ ṣaḍ yāpyāḥ? satyaṃ, yāpyabāhulyādetadvyapadeśaḥ| teṣviti prathamadvitīyapaṭalaprāpteṣu timirāvastheṣu kāceṣvityarthaḥ, na tu rāgaprāpteṣu, yatastatra sirāvyadhaniṣedhaḥ; tathā coktaṃ- ‘timire rāgiṇi bhiṣak sirāmokṣaṃ vivarjayet’- iti| sirāvimokṣaṇairityanenaiva snehasvedau pūrvakarmasañjñakāvākṣiptau mantavyau| virecanāṅgopahiteneti virecanadravyasaṃskṛtenetyarthaḥ||28||

lg.l: payovimiśraṃ pavanodbhave hitaṃ vadanti pañcāṅgulatailam eva tu |
bhaved ghṛtaṃ traiphalam eva śodhanaṃ viśeṣataḥ śoṇitapittarogayoḥ ||29||
trivṛdvirekaḥ kaphaje praśasyate tridoṣaje tailam uśanti tatkṛtam |30|

div.ab: sarvatimirāṇāṃ sāmānyaṃ śodhanamabhidhāya viśeṣaśodhanamāha- payovimiśramityādi| pañcāṅgulatailam eraṇḍatailam| viśeṣataḥ śoṇitapittarogayoriti traiphalaṃ ghṛtaṃ sarvatimireṣu hitaṃ, anayorviśeṣata ityarthaḥ| trivṛddhireka iti trivṛtā siddhaghṛtena vireka ityarthaḥ| tatkṛtamiti trivṛtā saṃskṛtamityarthaḥ; anye tu tairvātapittakaphaghnairdravyaiḥ saṃskṛtaṃ tatkṛtaṃ vadanti| dvandvajeṣu timireṣu tvanuktamapi saṃśodhanaṃ vyāmiśraṃ kartavyam||29||-

lg.l: purāṇasarpis timireṣu sarvaśo hitaṃ bhaved āyasabhājanasthitam ||30||
hitaṃ ca vidyāt triphalāghṛtaṃ sadā kṛtaṃ ca yan meṣaviṣāṇanāmabhiḥ |31|

div.ab: saṃśodhanamabhidhāya sāmānyaṃ saṃśamanamāha- purāṇasarpirityādi| sarvata iti pānābhyañjananasyādiṣu, sarveṣveva vātādijanyanayanavikāreṣvityanye| triphalāghṛtaṃ triphalākvāthakalkapakvaṃ ghṛtam| kṛtaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ ‘ghṛtaṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ| meṣaviṣāṇanāmabhiḥ meṣaśṛṅgīphalairityarthaḥ||30||-

lg.l: sadā'valihyāt triphalāṃ sucūrṇitāṃ ghṛtapragāḍhāṃ timire 'tha pittaje ||31||
samīraje tailayutāṃ kaphātmake madhupragāḍhāṃ vidadhīta yuktitaḥ |32|

div.ab: sāmānyaṃ saṃśamanamabhidhāya viśeṣasaṃśamanamāha- sadetyādi| sadeti nityage āvasthike ca kāle ityarthaḥ| pittaje ityatrānuktamapi raktajaṃ timiraṃ boddhavyaṃ, tatrāpi ghṛtena triphalāprayogaḥ| kecit “sadā'valihyāttriphalāṃ sucūrṇitaṃ ghṛtapragāḍhāṃ timirāturo naraḥ| kaphābhibhūtaḥ khalu tailasaṃyutāṃ madhupragāḍhāmapi vā prayojayet” īdṛśaṃ pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti; sa ca jejjaṭācāryeṇa dūṣitaḥ; tasmāt pūrvapāṭha eva nyāyyaḥ||31||-

lg.l: gavāṃ śakṛtkvāthavipakvam uttamaṃ hitaṃ tu tailaṃ timireṣu nāvanam ||32||

ab.seg: idānīṃ śleṣmatimire nasyamāha- gavāṃ śakṛdityādi| sāmānyasnehapākaparibhāṣayā gośakṛtkvāthena tailamakalkaṃ paktavyaṃ, etattailaṃ tantrāntaradarśanāt kaphaje timire boddhavyaṃ; anye tu timireṣviti bahuvacanāt sarvatimireṣu boddhavyamiti vadanti||32||

lg.l: hitaṃ ghṛtaṃ kevala eva paittike hy ajāvikaṃ yan madhurair vipācitam |33|

div.ab: pittaje timire nasyamāha- hitamityādi| kevala eva paittike nānyadoṣasampṛkte timire ityarthaḥ| madhurairvipācitamiti kākolyādikvāthakalkavipakvamityarthaḥ| ‘kevala eva’ ityatra ‘kevalameva’ iti kecit paṭhanti, tatra kevalamasaṃskṛtamityarthaḥ, ajāvikaṃ ghṛtamiti ca vyākhyānayanti|33|-

lg.l: tailaṃ sthirādau madhure ca yad gaṇe tathā'ṇutailaṃ pavanāsṛgutthayoḥ ||33||

ab.seg: vātaraktajayostimirayornasyamāha- tailamityādi| sthirādau vidārigandhādau, siddhamiti śeṣaḥ| tathā madhure gaṇe kākolyādike yat siddhaṃ, tathā'ṇutailaṃ vātavyādhicikitsitoktam||33||

lg.l: sahāśvagandhātibalāvarīśṛtaṃ hitaṃ ca nasye trivṛtaṃ yadīritam |
jalodbhavānūpajamāṃsasaṃskṛtād ghṛtaṃ vidheyaṃ payaso yad utthitam ||34||

ab.seg: kevalavātaje timire nasyamāha- sahetyādi| sahā mudgaparṇī, māṣaparṇītyanye| varī śatāvarī| etairvipakvaṃ tailaṃ vātārabdhe timire nasye hitam| trivṛtaṃ yadīritamiti mahāvātavyādhicikitsite tribhiḥ sarpirvasāmajjabhirvṛtaṃ trivṛtaṃ tailaṃ yadīritaṃ tadatra hitaṃ; kecidetaireva mudgaparṇyādibhirdravyaistrivṛtaṃ tailaṃ siddhaṃ vātārabdhatimire nasye hitamiti vadanti| vātārabdhatimire dvitīyaṃ nasyamāha ‘tailamāha’- iti pā. - jalodbhavetyādi| jalodbhavā matsādayaḥ, ānūpāḥ kūlacarāḥ, teṣāṃ māṃsena kṣīrapākakalpena saṃskṛtāddugdhānmathyamānād yaddhṛtamuddhṛtaṃ tat sahāśvagandhādibhiranantaroktairvipakvaṃ vātārabdhatimire nasyaṃ vidheyam| kecijjalodbhavaśabdena padmādīni gṛhṇanti, tannecchanti nibandhakārāḥ||34||

lg.l: sasaindhavaḥ kravyabhugeṇamāṃsayor hitaḥ sasarpiḥ samadhuḥ puṭāhvayaḥ |35|

div.ab: nasyamabhidhāya puṭapākamāha- sasaindhava ityādi| kravyabhujo gṛdhrādayaḥ, eṇaḥ kṛṣṇasāraḥ| puṭāhvayaḥ puṭapākaḥ| tasya vidhānaṃ kriyākalpe vakṣyati|35|-

ab.seg: vātajatimire puṭapākamabhidhāyāñjanamrāha- vasetyādi| uragaḥ kṛṣṇasarpaḥ, tāmracūḍaḥ kukkuṭaḥ, madhukānvitā yaṣṭīmadhukasaṃyutā; etā gṛdhrādijāstisro vasā yaṣṭīmadhukacūrṇānvitā ekaśo dviśaḥ samastā vā'ñjane hitāḥ||35||

lg.l: pratyañjanaṃ srotasi yat samutthitaṃ kramād rasakṣīraghṛteṣu bhāvitam |36|

div.ab: idānīṃ vātajatimire snehāñjanena jaḍībhūtasya cakṣuṣa upakārārthaṃ pratyañjanamāha- pratyañjanamityādi| yat añjanasyānu prayujyate tat pratyañjanam| tatra tīkṣṇāñjanasya mṛdvañjanamanu prayujyate, mṛdvañjanasya tīkṣṇāñjanam| srotasi yat samutthitaṃ sindhusrotasi varṇasārpaṇasayoḥ srotasi vā yat samutthitaṃ srotoñjanaṃ, sauvīrāñjanamityanye| rasaśca cakṣuṣyamṛgapakṣimāṃsarasaḥ| pṛthak pṛthak saptāhaṃ rasakṣīraghṛteṣu bhāvitaṃ cūrṇāñjanaṃ prayojyam|36|-

lg.l: sthitaṃ daśāhatrayam etad añjanaṃ kṛṣṇoragāsye kuśasampraveṣṭite ||36||
tan mālatīkorakasaindhavāyutaṃ sadā'ñjanaṃ syāt timire 'tha rāgiṇi |
subhāvitaṃ vā payasā dinatrayaṃ kācāpahaṃ śāstravidaḥ pracakṣate ||37||

ab.seg: arāgitimiracikitsitaṃ pratipādya vātajarāgitimirācikitsitaṃ pratipādayannāha- sthitamityādi| daśāhatrayaṃ māsamekamityarthaḥ| etadañjanaṃ srotoñjanaṃ, sauvīrañjanamityanye| tataḥ srotoñjanaṃ kṛṣṇasarpamukhe yathoditaprakāreṇa nivāsitaṃ paścānmālatīkorakasaindhavena samudāyasamabhāgena yutamañjanaṃ kāryaṃ; mālatīkorakāḥ jātīkusumāni| timire'tha rāgiṇi vātakāce ityarthaḥ| vātakāce'paramapyañjanamāha- subhāvitamityādi| anye tu jātīkorakayuktatvāt ‘sātyakyktutvāt’ iti pā. vātapittakācāpahaṃ vadanti, tannecchati gayī||36-37||

lg.l: havir hitaṃ kṣīrabhavaṃ tu paittike vadanti nasye madhurauṣadhaiḥ kṛtam |
tat tarpaṇe caiva hitaṃ prayojitaṃ sajāṅgalas teṣu ca yaḥ puṭāhvayaḥ ||38||

ab.seg: pittatimirarogacikitsitamāha- havirityādi| haviḥ ghṛtaṃ, kṣīrabhavaṃ kṣīramathanodbhūtaṃ, paittike ‘timire’ iti śeṣaḥ| madhurauṣadhaiḥ kākolyādibhiḥ, kṛtaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ; anye tu kṣīramapi kākolyadibhiḥ sādhitaṃ manyante, tena kākolyādisādhitāt kṣīrānmathyamānādutthitaṃ ghṛtaṃ kākolyādibhireva sādhitaṃ pittajatimire hitamiti vadanti| kecidiha kṛtamityasya sthāne śṛtamiti paṭhanti, tatra śṛtaṃ pakvam| tattarpaṇa ityādi| na kevalaṃ tadghṛtaṃ nasye hitaṃ, kiṃ tarhi tarpaṇe'kṣipūraṇaparyāye prayojitaṃ hitam| tathā teṣu madhurauṣadheṣu yo jāṅgalamāṃsayuktaḥ puṭapākaḥ sa pittatimire snehārthaṃ hitaḥ||38||

div.ab: pittatimire rasakriyāñjanamāha- rasāñjanamityādi| rasāñjanādikṛtaṃ kṣudrāñjanaṃ phāṇitākṛti pittatimire hitam| kṣudrāñjanamityatra kecidrasāñjanamiti paṭhanti, tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ|39|-

lg.l: samāñjanaṃ vā kanakākarodbhavaṃ sucūrṇitaṃ śreṣṭham uśanti tadvidaḥ ||39||

ab.seg: idānīṃ pittatimire pratyañjanamāha- samāñjanamityādi| samāñjanaṃ tulyasauvīrāñjanaṃ, kanakākarodbhavaṃ tutthakaṃ, śreṣṭham uttamaṃ, uśanti icchanti, pratyañjanamityadhyāhāryam| tadvidaḥ śālākinaḥ| kecit samāñjanamityatra rasāñjanamitipaṭhanti||39||

lg.l: bhilloṭagandhodakasekasecitaṃ pratyañjane cātra hitaṃ tu tutthakam |40|

div.ab: pittamire'paramapi pratyañjanamāha- bhilloṭetyādi bhilloṭako himavadāsannabhūmijaḥ kakubhānukāriphalo vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, gandhā elādigaṇoktāḥ, udakamatra kaṣāyaḥ, tatsekasecitaṃ tutthakaṃ pratyañjane hitam| anye bhilloṭakasvābhāvikagandhodakasekasecitamāhuḥ| kecidamuṃ pratyañjanaṃ na paṭhanti|40|-

ab.seg: pittaje timire rāgaprāpte cikitsāmāha- sameṣetyādi| meṣaśṛṅgaḥ putrajīvānukārī vṛkṣaḥ, añjanaṃ sauvīrāñjanaṃ, etayorbhāgena aṃśena sammitaṃ tulyabhāgaṃ jalodbhavaṃ srotoñjanaṃ, añjanena kācamalaṃ pittakācaṃ vyapohati| anye jalodbhavaṃ śaṅkhaṃ vadanti||40||

lg.l: palāśarohītamadhūkajā rasāḥ kṣaudreṇa yuktā madirāgramiśritāḥ ‘madirāgrapeṣitāḥ’ iti pā.|41|

div.ab: paittike kāce rasakriyāñjanamāha- palāśarohītetyādi| palāśaḥ kiṃśukaḥ, rohito dāḍimapuṣpatulyapuṣpaḥ, madhūkaḥ svanāmaprasiddho vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, eteṣāṃ rasāḥ; madirāgraṃ madirāyā uparyaccho bhāgaḥ| kiṃśukādirasakṣaudramadirāgrāṇi samabhāgāni āhṛtya rasakriyā kāryā, sā cāñjanātpittakācamalaṃ vyapohati|41|-

ab.seg: idānīṃ kaphatimire nasyamāha- uśīralodhretyādi| uśīrādibhirdravyaiḥ kalkīkṛtaiḥ sāmānyasnehapākaparibhāṣayā'nuktamapi tilatailaṃ pācanīyaṃ, videhadarśanāt||41||

div.ab: kaphatimire dhūmamāha- viḍaṅgetyādi| kiṇihī apāmārgaḥ| nanu timire dhūmo niṣiddhaḥ, kathamatrocyate? satyaṃ, pittatimire eva dhūmo niṣiddho na kaphaje, ato na doṣaḥ|42|-

lg.l: vanaspatikvāthavipācitaṃ ghṛtaṃ hitaṃ haridrānalade ca tarpaṇam ||42||

ab.seg: kaphatimire tarpaṇamāha- vanaspatikvāthetyādi| vanaspatayaḥ kṣīravṛkṣāḥ, tatkṛtakvāthe caturguṇe haridrānaladakalkacaturthāṃśaṃ ghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ kaphatimire tarpaṇe akṣipūraṇāparaparyāye hitam| naladam uśīram||42||

lg.l: samāgadho mākṣikasaindhavāḍhyaḥ sajāṅgalaḥ syāt puṭapāka eva ca |43|

div.ab: kaphatimire puṭapākamāha- samāgadha ityādi| māgadhī pippalī| āḍhya utkaṭaḥ| sajāṅgalaḥ jāṅgalamṛgapakṣimāṃsakṛtaḥ| kecit ‘āḍhyaḥ’ ityatra ‘ājya’ iti paṭhanti| tatrājyaṃ ghṛtam| kecidamuṃ puṭapākaṃ rāgiṇi kaphatimire vadanti, tannecchati gayī|43|-

ab.seg: kaphatimire rasakriyāñjanamāha- manaḥśiletyādi| manaḥśilādibhiḥ kāsīsarasāñjanāntaiścūrṇīkṛtaiḥ salilacaturthāṃśanikṣiptairagnipākāt phāṇitākṛtīkṛtai rasakriyā| mākṣikaṃ madhu||43||

lg.l: hite ca kāsīsarasāñjane tathā vadanti pathye guḍanāgarair yute |44|

div.ab: kaphatimire'paramapi rasakriyāñjanamāha- hite ityādi| tatheti rasakriyāñjanaprakāreṇetyarthaḥ| pathye iti patho'napete ityarthaḥ| kaphakācasya śalākākarmasādhyatvāttatrāñjanādikaṃ na nirdiṣṭam|44|-

lg.l: yad añjanaṃ vā bahuśo niṣecitaṃ samūtravarge triphalodake śṛte ||44||
niśācarāsthisthitam etad añjanaṃ kṣipec ca māsaṃ salile 'sthire punaḥ |
meṣasya puṣpair madhukena saṃyutaṃ tad añjanaṃ sarvakṛte prayojayet ||45||

ab.seg: sarvajakācacikitsāmāha- yadañjanamityādi| añjanaṃ srotoñjanam| bahuśo bahūna vārān niṣecitamityatra ‘dhmātaṃ sat’ ityadhyāhāryam| mūtravarge aṣṭasvapi mūtreṣu| śṛte kvāthīkṛte| niśācarāsthisthitamityādi| niśācarāṇāṃ gṛdhrādīnāṃ nalake vigatamajjani mūtravargādisecitaṃ tadañjanaṃ nikṣipya paścānnalakamukhaṃ pidhāya vahati sarijjale nikhātakīlakopari sūtreṇa baddhvā māsaṃ yāvat sthāpayet, tatastaduddhṛtya śoṣayitvā meṣaśṛṅgapuṣpayaṣṭīmadhukacūrṇasamāṃśaṃ tadañjanaṃ sarvakṛte rāgitimire prayojayet| ‘meṣasya puṣpairmadhukena saṃyutaṃ’ ityatra kecid ‘yutaṃ tu puṣpairmadhuśigrukodbhavaiḥ’ iti paṭhanti| tatra madhurmadhūkaḥ tasya sāraḥ, śigruḥ śobhāñjanakastasya puṣpāṇi||44-45||

lg.l: kriyāś ca sarvāḥ, kṣatajodbhave hitaḥ kramaḥ parimlāyini cāpi pittahṛt |46|

div.ab: sānnipātikarāgitimirasya cikitsāmāha- kriyāścetyādi| kriyā atra tarpaṇapuṭapākādikāḥ, sarvā vātapittakaphamiroktāḥ, anye tu kriyāśca sarvā vātapittakaphatimiroktā rasakriyā ityāhuḥ| raktatimire tathā parimlāyini timire ca kaḥ krama ityāha- kṣatajodbhava ityādi| pittahṛt kramaḥ pittatimirāpahanasyatarpaṇādikrama ityarthaḥ| eṣa eva kramo'rāgiṇi raktatimire, rāgiṇi punaḥ pittakācāpaho vidhiḥ|46|-

lg.l: kramo hitaḥ syandaharaḥ prayojitaḥ samīkṣya doṣeṣu ‘roge ca’ iti pā. yathāsvam eva ca ||46||

ab.seg: idānīṃ vātādijeṣu timireṣu rāgārāgaprāpteṣu vātādijanitābhiṣyandacikitsitamatidiśannāha- krama ityādi| yathāsvamiti yo yasyātmīya ityarthaḥ| tena vātatimire vātābhiṣyandakramaḥ, pittatimire pittābhiṣyandoktaḥ, evaṃ śeṣeṣu||46||

lg.l: doṣodaye naiva ca viplutiṅ gate dravyāṇi nasyādiṣu yojayed budhaḥ |47|

div.ab: sa eva vātābhiṣyandādikramo vātāditimireṣu kadā kartavya iti darśayannāha- doṣodaya ityādi| doṣodaya iti doṣodayamātre tāvadvātasyandādyuktakramo na kartavyaḥ| tathā viplutiṅgate; ko'rthaḥ? samastanayanavyāptipare syandoktakramo na kartavyaḥ| etena laṅghanavirecananiṃrūhānuvāsanaśirovirecanādinā tryahamatikramya paścādvātasyandādyuktanasyādidravyāṇi vātādijanitatimireṣu (nasyatarpaṇādiṣu) yojayedityarthaḥ| anye ‘viplutiṅgate’ ityatra ‘viplute gade’ iti paṭhanti; tatra viśabdo vividhārthaḥ, tena vividhatāṃ gate gada ityarthaḥ|47|-

lg.l: punaś ca kalpe 'ñjanavistaraḥ śubhaḥ pravakṣyate 'nyas tam apīha yojayet ||47||

ab.seg: idānīṃ kriyākalpe vakṣyamāṇamañjanavistaramatropadiśannāha- punaścetyādi| kalpe kriyākalpe ityarthaḥ| anyaḥ aparaḥ| tamiti añjanavistaramityarthaḥ||47||

lg.l: ghṛtaṃ purāṇaṃ triphalāṃ śatāvarīṃ paṭolamudgāmalakaṃ yavān api |
niṣevamāṇasya narasya yatnato bhayaṃ sughorāt timirān na vidyate ||48||

ab.seg: idānīṃ bahirāśrayaṃ cikitsitaṃ pratipādyāntarāśrayaṃ pratipādayannāha- ghṛtamityādi||48||

lg.l: śatāvarīpāyasa eva kevalas tathā kṛto vā''malakeṣu pāyasaḥ |

ab.seg: āhāraviśeṣamāha- śatāvarītyādi| śatāvarīpāyasa iti śatāvarīmūlaśṛtena payasā kṛtaḥ śatāvarīpāyasaḥ, āmalakeṣu pāyasa iti āmalakaśṛtapayasā kṛtaḥ pāyasa ityarthaḥ| anye tu śatāvarīsvarasasiddhā yavāgūḥ śatāvarīpāyasaḥ, āmalakasvarasasiddhā yavāgūścāmalakapāyasaḥ| prabhūtasarpirityādi pracuraghṛto yavaudano vāṭyasañjñakaḥ ‘vāḍhīsañjñakaḥ’ iti pā. gṛñjāsañjñako vā, triphalodake pracure sādhita ityarthaḥ||49||

lg.l: jīvantiśākaṃ suniṣaṇṇakaṃ ca sataṇḍulīyaṃ varavāstukaṃ ca |
cillī tathā mūlakapotikā ca dṛṣṭer hitaṃ śākunajāṅgalaṃ ca ||50||
śākāni śigrvārtagalāni caiva hitāni dṛṣṭer ghṛtasādhitāni ||51||

ab.seg: āhāropayogicakṣuṣyaśākānāha- jīvantiśākamityādi| jīvantī ḍoḍikā, suniṣaṇṇakaṃ catuṣpatrī, anye śiravālikāmāhuḥ, varavāstukaṃ, ṭaṅkavāstukaṃ, cillī kṣetravāstukaḥ, mūlakapotikā bālamūlakaṃ, śākunaṃ lāvādikaṃ, jāṅgalam eṇādijātaṃ, tarkārī araṇikā, karīro gūḍhapatraḥ, śigruḥ śobhāñjanakaḥ, ārtagalo nīlasahacaraḥ||50-51||
sevyamuddiśya parihāryamāha- vivarjayedityādi||52||

lg.l: arāgi timiraṃ sādhyam ādyaṃ paṭalam āśritam |
kṛcchraṃ dvitīye rāgi syāt tṛtīye yāpyam ucyate ||53||

ab.seg: idānīṃ mandadhiyāṃ sukhasmaraṇāya sādhyādibhedamāha- arāgītyādi||53||

lg.l: rāgaprāpteṣv api hitās timireṣu tathā kriyāḥ |

ab.seg: rāgaprāpteṣu vidhyantaraṃ yāpanārthaṃ pūrvamuktamapyanuvadannāha- rāgaprāpteṣvityādi| tṛtīyapaṭalaprāptarāgitimireṣu yāpanārthaṃ tathā kriyā hitā yathoddiṣṭā ityarthaḥ| tatra sirāmokṣasya niṣiddhatvādavaśyākarṣaṇīyaśoṇite upāyāntaramāha- sevyā ityādi||54||

lg.l: ślaiṣmike liṅganāśe tu karma vakṣyāmi siddhaye |
viṣamo vā tanur madhye rājimān vā bahuprabhaḥ |
dṛṣṭistho lakṣyate doṣaḥ sarujo vā salohitaḥ ||56||

ab.seg: anauṣadhasādhye ślaiṣmike liṅganāśe'rdhendvādyākṛtiviśiṣṭo dṛṣṭistho doṣo na cellakṣyate tadā sādhanārthaṃ śastrakarma vakṣyāmīti nirdiśannāha- ślaiṣmika ityādi| liṅganāśo dṛṣṭināśaḥ| karma śastrakarma| gharmāmbubinduḥ prasvedabinduḥ| ākṛtiśabdo'rdhendvādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambandhanīyaḥ| sthiraḥ kaṭhinaḥ| viṣamo vā tanurmadhye iti yato madhye tanurata eva viṣamo nimnonnata ityarthaḥ||55-56||

lg.l: matimān śuklabhāgau dvau kṛṣṇān muktvā hy apāṅgataḥ |
nādho nordhvaṃ na pārśvābhyāṃ chidre daivakṛte tataḥ |
dakṣiṇena bhiṣak savyaṃ vidhyet savyena cetarat ||60||
vāribindvāgamaḥ samyag bhavec chabdas tathā vyadhe |61|

div.ab: tadeva śastrakarma nirdiśannāha- snigdhasvinnasyetyādi| nātyuṣṇaśīte sādhāraṇe mārgaśīrṣe caitre vā| śuklabhāgau dvāvapi dvau śuklatārakāṃśāvityarthaḥ| kṛṣṇāt kṛṣṇatārakāntāt, muktvā parityajya, apāṅgataḥ apāṅgasamīpe, vidhyedityarthaḥ| samyagiti nātiprasāritaṃ nātisaṅkucitaṃ yathā syādityarthaḥ| daivakṛte chidre iti chidramiva chidraṃ na paramārthataśchidramasti| viśvastaṃ asantrastaṃ yathā syāt| savyaṃ vāmanetraṃ, savyena vāmahastena, itarat dakṣiṇanayanam| samyagviddhalakṣaṇamāha- vāribindvāgama ityādi| samyagiti padaṃ vyadha ityatra sambadhyate| asamyagvyadhe ca raktanirgamanamaśabdatā ca||57-60||-

lg.l: sthire doṣe cale vā'pi svedayed akṣi bāhyataḥ |

div.ab: samyagviddhe netre sati kiṃ kāryamityāha- saṃsicyetyādi| yoṣitstanyena nārīkṣīreṇa| kovido dhīmān vaidyaḥ| sthire acale| śalākāṃ saṃsthāpya niścalīkṛtya| bhaṅgaiḥ pallavaiḥ| svedānantaraṃ kiṃ kartavyamityāha- śalākāgreṇetyādi| tataḥ svedānantaraṃ; dṛṣṭimaṇḍalaṃ nirlikhet śleṣmasaṃhativiśleṣārtham| śalākāgravinirlekhanādviśliṣṭakaphasya nirharaṇopāyamāha- vidhyata ityādi| vidhyato'kṣṇo'nyapārśve yo nāsāpuṭastaṃ nāsāpuṭaṃ ruddhvā dṛṣṭimaṇḍalagaḥ kapha ucchiṅghanena hartavya iti piṇḍārthaḥ||61-63||-

lg.l: nirabhra iva gharmāṃśur yadā dṛṣṭiḥ prakāśate ||64||
tadā'sau likhitā samyag jñeyā yā cāpi nirvyathā |
(evaṃ tv aśakye nirhartuṃ doṣe pratyāgate 'pi vā ||65||
snehād yair upapannasya vyadho bhūyo vidhīyate) |
tato dṛṣṭeṣu rūpeṣu śalākām āharec chanaiḥ ||66||
tato gṛhe nirābādhe śayītottāna eva ca ||67||

ab.seg: samyaglikhitalakṣaṇamāha- nirabhra ityādi| nirabhro nirmeghaḥ, gharmāṃśuḥ ādityaḥ| tato dṛṣṭeṣvityādi| śalākāmāhṛtya kiṃ kuryādityāha- ghṛtenābhyajyetyādi| nirābādhe dhūlidhūmavātātapādirahite| uttānaśayanamṛjūkaraṇārthaṃ| udgāretyādi| kṣavathuḥ chikkā| tatkālamiti yāvacchalākā netre tiṣṭhati| tata ūrdhvaṃ yantraṇā āhārādīnāṃ niyamaḥ, snehapītavat snehapānoktaḥ kāryaḥ||64-68||

lg.l: tryahāt tryahāc ca dhāveta kaṣāyair anilāpahaiḥ |
vāyor bhayāt tryahād ūrdhvaṃ svedayed akṣi pūrvavat ||69||

ab.seg: tryahādityādi| dhāveta prakṣālayet| anilāpahaiḥ eraṇḍamūlādivātāpahacakṣuṣyadravyaiḥ kṣīrāmbusādhitaiḥ| prakṣālanānantaraṃ kiṃ kartavyamityāha- vāyorbhayādityādi| pūrvavaditi bāhyato mṛdu svedayedityarthaḥ||69||

lg.l: paścāt karma ca seveta laghvannaṃ cāpi mātrayā ||70||

ab.seg: daśāhamevamityādi| evamuttānaśayanādinā daśāhaṃ niyamya tadanantaraṃ paścātkarma nasyatarpaṇaśirobastyādikaṃ yaddṛṣṭiprasādanaṃ dṛṣṭernairmalyajananaṃ tat seveteti piṇḍārthaḥ||70||

lg.l: sirāvyadhavidhau pūrvaṃ narā ye ca vivārjitāḥ |
na teṣāṃ nīlikāṃ vidhyed anyatrābhihitād bhiṣak ||71||

ab.seg: idānīṃ ślaiṣmike'pi liṅganāśe keṣāñcit puruṣāṇāṃ śastraniṣedhaṃ darśayannāha- sirāvyadhavidhau pūrvamityādi| narā ye ca vivarjitā iti sirāvyadhavidhau ye narā bālasthavirādayo vivarjitāsteṣāṃ nīlikāṃ liṅganāśāparaparyāyāṃ na vidhyet| anyatrābhihitāditi tathā'bhihitāt kathitāddaivakṛtācchidrādanyatra na vidhyet| cakārastu sirāviddhaiḥ puruṣairye krodhādayo vivarjanīyāste'pi nīlikāyāṃ varjanīyā iti jñāpayati||71||

daivakṛtacchidrādanyatra kasmānna nīlikāṃ vidhyedityāha- pūryata ityādi| visarpatā śoṇitenākṣi pūryata ityarthaḥ| pramādāddaivakṛtacchidrādanyatrāpi viddhe sati vyāpadupaśamanārthaṃ cikitsitamāha- tatretyādi||72||

lg.l: athāpy upari viddhe tu kaṣṭā ruk sampravartate |
śūlāśrurāgās tv atyartham adhovedhena ‘adhoviddhe bhavanti hi’ iti pā. picchilaḥ |
śalākām anu cāsrāvas tatra ‘vidadhīta bhiṣak tatra’ iti pā. pūrvacikitsitam ||76||
snehasvedau hitau tatra hitaṃ cāpy anuvāsanam ||77||
doṣas tv adho 'pakṛṣṭo 'pi taruṇaḥ punar ūrdhvagaḥ |
śirobastiṃ ca tenaiva dadyān māṃsaiś ca bhojanam ||79||

ab.seg: idānīmasthānavedhāt saṅkṣepeṇa vyāpadamabhidhāya vistareṇāpi vyāpado nirdiśannāha- apāṅgetyādi| tatra cikitsāmāha- tatropanāhamityādi| cikitsāmāha- tatrādha ityādi| adhaḥśodhanaṃ virekaḥ, raktamokṣaṇamatra jalaukobhiḥ| athetyādi| kaṣṭā tīvrā| cikitsāmāha- tatra koṣṇenetyādi| śūletyādi| anu śalākāṃ śalākāyā anantaramevetyarthaḥ| cikitsāmāha- tatretyādi| pūrvacikitsitaṃ strīstanyayaṣṭyāhvetyādikam| harṣo romāñcaprāyo vedanāviśeṣaḥ, ativighaṭṭite aticālite| cikitsāmāha- snehasvedāvityādi| taruṇo liṅganāśamaprāptaḥ| cikitsāmāha- madhurairityādi| madhuraiḥ yaṣṭīmadhukādibhiḥ tenaiva yaṣṭīmadhukādisiddhenaiva||73-79||

lg.l: prāpya naśyec chalākāgraṃ tanv abhram iva mārutam ||80||

ab.seg: doṣastu sañjātetyādi||80||

lg.l: doṣaḥ pratyeti kopāc ca viddho 'titaruṇaś ca ‘vṛddhaḥ’ iti pā. yaḥ ||81||

ab.seg: nirlikhitasyāpi doṣasya punarāvṛttikāraṇānyāha- mūrdhābhighātetyādi| pratyeti āgacchati| taruṇo liṅganāśamaprāptaḥ||81||

lg.l: vraṇaṃ viśālaṃ sthūlāgrā, tīkṣṇā hiṃsyād anekadhā ||82||

div.ab: duṣṭaśalākājanitavyāpadamāha- śalāketyādi| doṣapariplutiḥ doṣasya samantādāgamanam| hiṃsyādanekadheti anekaprakāraṃ kṣataṃ karotītyarthaḥ| viṣamā kṛśasthūlā| asthirā vṛddhā mugdhā ‘mṛdvī’ iti pā.| ‘karoti’ iti padamante nirdiṣṭatvāt sarvatra sambadhyate||82||-

lg.l: ... varjitā doṣais tasmād ebhir hitā bhavet ||83||

div.ab: varjitetyādi| ebhirdoṣairanantaroktaiḥ karkaśādibhirvirahitā| hitā kāryakāriṇī| śātakumbhī suvarṇamayī||83-84||-

ab.seg: idānīṃ duṣṭavyadhāhārācārajān rogānāha- rāga ityādi| coṣa ācūṣyata iva vedanāviśeṣaḥ| budbudaṃ budbudākāro māṃsanirgamaḥ| śūkarākṣitā adhodṛṣṭitvam| tatra cikitsitamāha- yathāsvamityādi| yathāsvaṃ yathātmīyaṃ, yathādoṣamityarthaḥ||85-86||

lg.l: rujāyām akṣirāge vā yogān bhūyo nibodha me |
gairikaṃ sārivā dūrvā yavapiṣṭaṃ ghṛtaṃ payaḥ ||87||

ab.seg: idānīṃ karkaśaśalākājanite śūle tathā duṣṭavyadhaje ca roge cikitsāmuddiśannāha- rujāyāmityādi| nibodha jānīhi| sārivā utpalasārivā| mṛdubhṛṣṭairityādi| siddhārthakaḥ sarṣapaḥ| tadarthakṛt vedanārāganāśakṛt| payasyetyādi| payasyā arkapuṣpī, kṣīrakākolītyanye| patraṃ patrakam| dārupadmaketyādi| evameveti ajākṣīrānvitaiḥ dārupadmakādibhiḥ lepaḥ kāryaḥ; tadvaddrākṣādibhirapi| rodhrasaindhavetyādi| vātaghnāni bhadradārvādīni| sarvakarmasu nasyālepanādiṣu||87-94||

lg.l: śāmyaty evaṃ na cec chūlaṃ snigdhasvinnasya mokṣayet |
tataḥ sirāṃ dahed vā'pi matimān kīrtitaṃ yathā ||95||

ab.seg: evamapyaśāmyati śūle kiṃ kuryādityāha- śāmyatyevamityādi| sirā'tra aupanāsikā āpāṅgyā lālāṭyā vā| na kevalaṃ sirāṃ mokṣayet dahedvā| kīrtitaṃ yatheti ‘bhrūlalāṭaśaṅkhapradeśeṣu dahet’ ityādivākyena||95||

lg.l: dṛṣṭer ataḥ prasādārtham añjane śṛṇu me śubhe |
sumanāyāś ca puṣpāṇi ‘tulyāni’ iti pā. muktā vaidūryam eva ca |
pravidhāya ca tad vartīr yojayec cāñjane bhiṣak |
maricāni ca tad vartīḥ kārayec cāpi pūrvavat |
dṛṣṭisthairyārtham etat tu vidadhyād añjane hitam ||99||

ab.seg: sirāvyadhenāpyavaśiṣṭadoṣakaluṣitāyā dṛṣṭeḥ prasādanārthamañjane āha- dṛṣṭerata ityādi| sumanā jātī| āvapet pratikṣipet| srotojaṃ sauvīrāñjanaṃ vidrumaṃ pravālam| meṣaśṛṅgasyetyādyekaṃ, srotojamityādi dvitīyam||96-99||
bhūya ityādi| kalpe kriyākalpe||100||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre dṛṣṭigatarogavijñānīyo nāma saptadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||17||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ||17||

div.head: kriyākalpādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ kriyākalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

prāguktādhyāyeṣu cikitsitānyabhihitāni, teṣu cikitsiteṣu sarvatra tarpaṇādeḥ kriyāyā abhihitatvāt saṅkṣepārthamekatra tarpaṇādikalpanavistarāya kriyākalpaḥ pratipādyo bhavatītyāha- athāta ityādi| kriyāṇāṃ tarpaṇapuṭapākādīnāṃ kalpanaṃ karaṇaṃ kriyākalpaḥ||1-2||

kriyākalpaviṣaye'pi prāṅnirdiṣṭaṃ yat tarpaṇādi tatpūrvakarmapradhānakarmahīnayogātiyogottarakarmabhirnirdidikṣurāha- sarvaśāstrārthetyādi| sarvaśāstrārthatattvajñādiguṇayuktaḥ kāśipatirmunirvaiśvāmitraṃ śiṣyaṃ śaśāseti piṇḍārthaḥ| tapasā dṛṣṭirdarśanaṃ viśeṣajñānodayo yasyāsau tapodṛṣṭiḥ| udārā mahatī dhīryasya sa udāradhīḥ| viśvāmitrasyāpatyaṃ vaiśvāmitraḥ suśrutastam| śaśāsa śikṣitavānityarthaḥ| athaśabdo maṅgalārthaḥ| kāśipatirmuniriti rājarṣiḥ dhanvantarirityarthaḥ||3||

lg.l: tatra tatropadiṣṭāni teṣāṃ vyāsaṃ nibodha me ||4||

ab.seg: kāstāḥ kriyā yāsāṃ kalpanamityāha- tarpaṇamityādi| yāni tarpaṇapuṭapākādīni tatra tatra vātābhiṣyandādāvupadiṣṭāni saṅkṣepataḥ kathitāni teṣāṃ vistaraṃ matsakāśānnibodha jānīhīti piṇḍārthaḥ| śirobastiḥ sarvendriyatarpaṇāt tarpaṇokterevokto mantavyaḥ, puṭapākasekāścyotanānyapi snehayuktāni ‘sekayuktāni’ iti pā. tarpaṇarūpatvāt tarpaṇa evāntarbhavanti, yat punarupādānaṃ puṭapākādīnāṃ tadrūkṣāṇāṃ puṭapākādīnāṃ grahaṇāya kṛtamityarthaḥ||4||

lg.l: pūrvāhṇe vā'parāhṇe vā kāryam akṣṇos tu tarpaṇam ||5||
āpakṣmāgrāt tataḥ sthāpyaṃ pañca tad vākśatāni tu |
svasthe, kaphe ṣaṭ, pitte 'ṣṭau, daśa vāte tad uttamam ||8||
yathākramopadiṣṭeṣu trīṇy ekaṃ pañca sapta ca ||9||
daśa dṛṣṭyām athāṣṭau ca vākśatāni vibhāvayet |

ab.seg: tarpaṇaṃ kathaṃ kāryamityāha- saṃśuddhetyādi| saṃśuddhadehaśirasa iti sirāmokṣaṇavirecananirūhaśirovirecanaiḥ samyakśuddhakāyamastakasyetyarthaḥ| veśmani gṛhe| ādhārau pālī ityarthaḥ| klinnena pānīyāloḍitena| parimaṇḍalau vartulau, dvāvapi netrakośau parivārya sthitāvityarthaḥ| etena tiryakpūraṇe ghṛtasya mātroktā| samau animnonnatau, dṛḍhau acchidrau, asambādhau asaṅkaṭau| netrakośayorityatra ‘paritaḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| ghṛtamaṇḍo ghṛtasyoparyaccho bhāgaḥ| sukhodake uṣṇodake| āpakṣmāgrādityatra pūrayediti sambandhanīyam| āpakṣmāgrāt vartmalomaparyantamityarthaḥ| etenordhvaṃ pūraṇe ghṛtasya mātroktā bhavati| tarpaṇaṃ kiyatkālaṃ sthāpyamiti darśayannāha- tata ityādi| tacca pramāṇamuttamaṃ, doṣabalāpekṣayā punarhrāso'pi kartavyaḥ| idānīṃ svamataṃ pradarśya paramatamapi darśayannāha- rogetyādi| rogasthānaviśeṣeṇeti sandhivartmaśuklādibhedenetyarthaḥ| kathaṃ rogasthānaviśeṣeṇa kālaṃ pracakṣate ityāha- yathākramopadiṣṭeṣvityādi| yathākramakathiteṣu sandhyādirogasthāneṣvityarthaḥ| tatra trīṇi vākśatāni sandhau, vartmanyekaṃ, śukle pañca, kṛṣṇe sapta, sarvatra daśa, dṛṣṭāvapi daśa aṣṭau vā| tata ityādi| apāṅgataḥ apāṅgāt, bhrūpucchāntapradeśādityarthaḥ| snehaṃ srāvayitvā śalākākṛtadvāreṇa| snehavīryeritamityādi| snehavīryeritaṃ snehaśaktyā preritam| tataḥ snehāpanayanāntaram| yathāsvaṃ dhūmapāneneti kaphapratyanīkena śirovirecanadhūmapānenetyarthaḥ||5-11||

lg.l: ekāhaṃ vā tryahaṃ vā'pi pañcāhaṃ ceṣyate param |12|

div.ab: kati dināni tarpaṇaprayogastadāha- ekāhamityādi| ekāhaṃ vāte, tryahaṃ pitte, pañcāhaṃ kaphe iti gayī; ekāhaṃ nyūnadoṣe, tryahaṃ madhyadoṣe, pañcāhamadhikadoṣe iti jejjaṭācāryaḥ| paramityutkṛṣṭapramāṇaṃ yathā syāt; etenātaḥ paraṃ tarpaṇaṃ na yojyam| tacca tarpaṇaṃ videhānumatena nirantaraṃ dināntaraṃ dvyantaraṃ tryantaraṃ vā yojyam| tathā ca videhaḥ,- “svasvavṛtte vidhātavyaṃ dvyantaraṃ tarpaṇaṃ bhavet| ahanyahani vātotthe, raktapitte dināntaram|| tarpaṇaṃ sannipātotthe dvyantaraṃ, tryantaraṃ kaphe” iti|12|-

ab.seg: tarpaṇe ityādi| vaiśadyaṃ malābhāvaḥ| varṇapāṭavaṃ śvetatvādervarṇasya yathārthagrahaṇaṃ; anye tu netragatasyaiva śuklakṛṣṇādervarṇasya vaimalyamāhuḥ| nirvṛtiḥ tātkālikaṃ sukhamutpannam| kriyālāghavamiti kriyāṇāṃ nimeṣonmeṣādīnāṃ śīghratā; anye tu kriyā nimeṣonmeṣaṇādikāḥ, lāghavaṃ netrayoreva laghutetyāhuḥ||12-13||
atitarpitasya netrasya lakṣaṇamāha- gurvāvilamityādi| āvilam ākulaṃ, doṣasamutkliṣṭaṃ doṣavyāptam||14||

lg.l: vyādhivṛddhiś ca taj jñeyaṃ hīnatarpitam akṣi ca ||15||

ab.seg: hīnatarpitasya nayanasya lakṣaṇamāha- rūkṣamityādi| asrāḍhyam aśrubahulam||15||

lg.l: dhūmanasyāñjanaiḥ sekai rūkṣaiḥ snigdhaiś ca yogavit ||16||

ab.seg: idānīmatitṛptātṛptayościkitsāmuddiśannāha- anayorityādi| etairdhūmanasyāñjanasekai rūkṣaiḥ pittaśleṣmabhūyiṣṭhe, vātabhūyiṣṭhe tu snigdhairiti| yogavit śāstravidvaidyaḥ||16||

lg.l: tāmyaty ativiśuṣkaṃ yad rūkṣaṃ yac cātidāruṇam |
śīrṇapakṣmāvilaṃ jihmaṃ rogakliṣṭaṃ ca yad bhṛśam ||17||
tad akṣi tarpaṇād eva labhetorjām asaṃśayam |18|

div.ab: tarpaṇaviṣayaṃ nirdiśannāha- tāmyatītyādi| tāmyati andhakāramiva paśyati| ativiśuṣkam aśrurahitam| rūkṣam asnigdhacchavi| dāruṇaṃ kaṭhinavartma| jihmaṃ rūpakriyāsu jaḍam| ūrjāṃ balam||17||-
tarpaṇaviṣayamāha- durdinetyādi| aśāntopadrave ceti aśāntā asvalpībhūtā ‘āmatābhūtā’ udīrṇavedanādaya upadravā yatra tasmin||18||-

lg.l: puṭapākas tathaiteṣu, nasyaṃ yeṣu ca garhitam ||19||
tarpaṇārhā na ye proktāḥ snehapānākṣamāś ca ye |20|

div.ab: idānīṃ puṭapākasya viṣayāviṣayamāha- puṭapāka ityādi| puṭapākastathaiteṣviti eteṣu pūrvokteṣu tarpaṇārheṣu puṭapākastathā'rhatītyarthaḥ| ayaṃ puṭapākasya viṣayaḥ, aviṣayastu nasyaṃ yeṣu ca garhitamityādikaḥ| nasyaṃ yeṣu ca garhitamiti yeṣu nasyaṃ garhitaṃ teṣu puṭapāko'pi garhitaḥ| tarpaṇārhā na ye proktā iti ye cintābhramagṛhītādayastarpaṇaṃ nārhanti te puṭapākamapi nārhanti| snehapānākṣamāśca ye durbalārocakiprabhṛtayaḥ snehapānaṃ na kṣamante te puṭapākamapi na kṣamante ityarthaḥ||19||-

lg.l: snehano lekhanīyaś ca ropaṇīyaś ca sa tridhā ||21||

ab.seg: idānīṃ puṭapākasyāvasthikaṃ kālamuddiśannāha- tata ityādi| evambhūteṣu netreṣu bhiṣajā puṭapākaḥ prayoktavyo bhavediti piṇḍārthaḥ| praśāntadoṣeṣviti praśabdo'yamādikarmaṇi, tena prathamakarmaśāntāvasthadoṣeṣvityarthaḥ| puṭapākakṣameṣu ceti tarpaṇanasyasnehapānārheṣvityarthaḥ; tarpaṇādyanarhāṇi punaḥ puṭapākaṃ na kṣamante| snehana ityādi||20-21||

teṣāṃ trividhānāmapi viṣayamāha- hita ityādi| apara iti ropaṇīyaḥ puṭapāka ityarthaḥ| ‘hitaḥ snigdho'tirūkṣasya’ ityatra ‘trividhaḥ sa hito rūkṣe’ iti kecit paṭhanti| ‘pittāsṛgvraṇavātanut’ ityatra ‘pittāsṛgvraṇanāśana’ iti paṭhanti||22||

lg.l: snehanaḥ puṭapākas tu dhāryo dve vākśate tu saḥ ||23||

ab.seg: snehanapuṭapākamāha- snehetyādi| snehamāṃsamiti snehapradhānaṃ māṃsam, ānūpamityarthaḥ, ‘sarpirmāṃsa’ iti kecit paṭhanti| svādvauṣadhaiḥ kākolyādibhiḥ, kṛtaḥ saṃskṛtaḥ||23||

lg.l: lekhano vākśataṃ tasya paraṃ dhāraṇam ucyate ||25||

ab.seg: lekhanapuṭapākamāha- jāṅgalānāmityādi| jāṅgalā eṇādayaḥ| yakṛt kālakhaṇḍāni, māṃsāni ca kālakhaṇḍāsannānyeva| vidrumaḥ pravālaḥ, sindhujaṃ saindhavam||24-25||

lg.l: lekhanāt triguṇaṃ dhāryaḥ puṭapākas tu ropaṇaḥ ||26||

ab.seg: ropaṇapuṭapākamāha- stanyajāṅgaletyādi| stanyaṃ strīstanyaṃ, jāṅgaletyatra māṃsamiti śeṣaḥ; ‘madhvājya’ ityatra ‘medhyājya’ iti kecit paṭhanti, medhyājyaṃ gavyaṃ ghṛtamiti vyākhyānayanti||26||

lg.l: vitaret tarpaṇoktaṃ tu dhūmaṃ hitvā tu ropaṇam |
snehasvedau dvayoḥ kāryau, kāryo naiva ca ropaṇe ||27||

ab.seg: idānīṃ snehanalekhanayoḥ pūrvakarmāha- vitaredityādi| ropaṇaṃ puṭapākaṃ parityajya tarpaṇoktaṃ dhūmaṃ dvayorvitaret kuryāt, tathā snehasvedau dvayoreva kāryāviti piṇḍārthaḥ||27||

lg.l: ekāhaṃ vā dvyahaṃ vā'pi tryahaṃ vā'py avacāraṇam |28|

div.ab: ekāhamityādi| ekāhaṃ ślaiṣmike netraroge puṭapākasyāvacāraṇaṃ, dvyahaṃ paittike, tryahaṃ vātike; anye tu ekāhaṃ lekhanīyasyāvacāraṇaṃ, dvyahaṃ snehanasya, tryahaṃ ropaṇīyasyeti|28|-

lg.l: yantraṇā tu kriyākālād dviguṇaṃ kālam iṣyate ||28||

ab.seg: tarpaṇapuṭapākayorekatra parihāryakālamuddiśannāha- yantraṇā tu kriyākālāddviguṇamityādi| kriyākālāt snehapānāderārabhya yaḥ kālastasmād dviguṇaḥ kālaḥ; na punastarpaṇakālāt, tasyālpatvāt||28||

lg.l: tejāṃsy anilam ākāśam ādarśaṃ bhāsvarāṇi ca |

ab.seg: parihāryāṇyāha- tejāṃsyanilamityādi| tejāṃsi dīpajvālāprabhṛtīni, anilaṃ sammukhavāyuṃ, bhāsvarāṇi ādityādīni||29||
adhunā tayorvyāpaccikitsābījamuddiśannāha- mithyopacārādityādi| anayoḥ tarpaṇapuṭapākayoḥ||30||
puṭapākasya samyagyogamāha- prasannavarṇamityādi||31||

div.ab: puṭapākasyātiyogamāha- atiyogādruja ityādi|32|-

lg.l: pāko 'śru harṣaṇaṃ cāpi hīne doṣodgamas tathā ||32||

ab.seg: puṭapākasya hīnayogamāha- pāka ityādi| harṣo vedanāviśeṣo'ntaḥśītakaraḥ||32||

lg.l: dvau bilvamātrau ślakṣṇasya piṇḍau māṃsasya peṣitau ||33||
dravyāṇāṃ bilvamātraṃ tu dravāṇāṃ kuḍavo mataḥ |
svinnam uddhṛtya niṣpīḍya rasam ādāya taṃ nṛṇām |
rakte pitte ca tau śītau koṣṇau vātakaphāpahau ||38||

ab.seg: ata ūrdhvamityādi| ślakṣṇasya māṃsasya dvau piṇḍau bilvamātrau pratyekaṃ palapramāṇau kāryavityarthaḥ| dravyāṇāṃ bilvamātramiti snehanalekhanaropaṇeṣu puṭapākeṣu yathākramaṃ madhurauṣadhalekhanadravyatiktadravyāṇāṃ palapramāṇamityarthaḥ| dravāṇāṃ kuḍava iti aṣṭau palāni; keciccatvāri palāni, kasmāt? kuḍavādūrdhvaṃ dviguṇaparibhāṣā| tatra snehanapuṭapākasya peṣaṇāloḍanārthaṃ māṃsarasamadhurauṣadhakaṣāyakṣīrāṇi, lekhanasya madhumastutriphalodakāni, ropaṇasya tiktakaṣāya iti| avakūlayet vipacet| kṣīradrumā vaṭādayaḥ| yuktita iti padamavakūlayedityatra sambandhanīyam| yuktistu ‘puṭapākasya pāko'yaṃ bahirāraktavarṇatā’ iti| idānīṃ tarpaṇapuṭapākayordoṣopayogidharmantaraṃ nirdiśannāha- rakte ityādi||33-38||
tarpaṇapuṭapākayorviruddhaguṇamātrayorvyāpado nirdiśannāha- atyuṣṇetyādi| aplutau mandaplatau||39-40||

lg.l: tasmāt pariharan doṣān vidadhyāt tau sukhāvahau |42|

div.ab: yuktau kṛtāvityādi| dūṣīkā netramalaḥ, doṣān atyuṣṇatīkṣṇādikān||41||-

ab.seg: idānīṃ vyāpaccikitsāmāha- vyāpadaśca yathādoṣamityādi| vyāpado dāhapākādikāḥ, yathādoṣaṃ doṣānatikrameṇa||42||

idānīṃ tarpaṇapuṭapākayoḥ pūrvakarma paścātkarma cāha- ādyantayoścāpyanayorityādi| anayoḥ tarpaṇapuṭapākayoḥ| sveda uṣṇāmbucailika iti uṣṇāmbusiktena karpaṭena sveda ityarthaḥ| ‘tathā hito'vasāne ca dhūmaḥ śleṣmasamutthitau’ iti kecit paṭhanti||43||

lg.l: rogam āścyotanaṃ hanti sekas tu balavattaram ||44||

ab.seg: idānīmāścyotanasekāvāha- yathādoṣopayuktamityādi| yathādoṣopayuktamiti vātādije netraroge vātādiharadravyasiddhamāścyotanamityarthaḥ| nātiprabalaṃ nātyutkaṭaṃ rogam| ojasā śaktyā| sekastu balavattaramiti yathādoṣopayuktaḥ pariṣekaḥ punarbalavattaramiti prabalaṃ rogaṃ hanti| tau cāścyotanasekau caturthe'hanyāgatarogalakṣaṇe ‘caturthe'hani gatavege'kṣṇi’ iti pā. prayoktavyau| tathā ca videhaḥ- “prāgevākṣyāmaye kāryaṃ trirātraṃ laghubhojanam| upavāsastryahaṃ vā syānnaktaṃ vā'pyaśanaṃ tryaham|| tataścaturthe divase vyādhiṃ sañjātalakṣaṇam| samīkṣyāścyotanaiḥ sekairyathāsvamupapādayet”- iti||44||

div.ab: tāvityādi| tau āścyotanasekau| tridhaiveti snehanalekhanaropaṇabhedena puṭapākavattriprakārāvityarthaḥ| tayośca peṣaṇāloḍanārthaṃ dravāṇi ‘dravyāṇi’ iti pā. puṭapākoktānyeva| tayoreva samyagyogo hīnayogo mithyāyogaśca puṭapākavat| āścyotanasya dhāraṇakālaḥ puṭapākavat| pariṣekasya punarihaivāgre dhāraṇakālaṃ kathayiṣyāmaḥ| kecidāścyotanasekayoḥ puṭapākād dviguṇaṃ ‘triguṇaṃ’ iti pā. kālaṃ manyante| tanna, ‘sekasya dviguṇaḥ kālaḥ puṭapākāt paro mata’ ityatroktena saha virodhāpatteḥ|45|-

lg.l: lekhane sapta cāṣṭau vā bindavaḥ snaihike daśa ||45||

div.ab: lekhanādīnāmāścyotanānāṃ bindusaṅkhyāmāha- lekhane sapta cāṣṭau vetyādi| lekhane lekhanāścyotane saptāṣṭau vā bindavaḥ||45||-

lg.l: sekasya dviguṇaḥ kālaḥ puṭapākāt paro mataḥ ||46||

ab.seg: idānīṃ pariṣekasya dhāraṇakālamāha- sekasyetyādi| tatra lekhanapariṣekasya vākśatadvayaṃ dhāraṇakālaḥ, snehanasya vākśatacatuṣṭayaṃ, ropaṇasya ṣaḍvākśatāni||46||

div.ab: pakṣāntaramāha- athavetyādi| kāryanirvṛttiḥ vyādherupaśamaḥ prakṛtivarṇopapattiḥ kriyāpāṭavaṃ vedanopaśamaśca kāryaṃ, tasya niṣpattiḥ kāryanirvṛttiḥ| yathākramaṃ śanaiḥ śanairityarthaḥ| ayaṃ kāryanirvṛttilakṣaṇo dhāraṇakāla āścyotanasekayoḥ| anye tu sarveṣāṃ tarpaṇādīnāmayaṃ dhāraṇakāla iti vadanti| apare tu puṭapākasekayorayaṃ kālaḥ; tatra puṭapākasekayordravyabhedato bhedaḥ|47|-

ab.seg: idānīmāścyotanasekayoryathādoṣaṃ prayogakālamāha- pūrvāparāhṇa ityādi| kaphaje vyādhau pūrvāhṇe lekhanāvāścyotanasekau prayojyau, vātaje'parāhṇe snehanau, raktapittaje madhyāhne ropaṇau| rujākāleṣu cetyāvasthikaḥ kālaḥ, tena yadaiva rugutpadyate tadaiva sekāścyotanau prayojyau| ubhayoḥ āścyotanasekayoḥ| kecit pariṣekasyaivāyaṃ prayogakāla iti kathayanti||47||

div.ab: idānīṃ pariṣekasya dravyaviśeṣakṛtasya saṅkṣepārthaṃ yogāyogalakṣaṇamāha- yogāyogānityādi| yogaḥ samyagyogaḥ, ayogaḥ samyagyogābhāvaḥ| tenāyogaśabdena hīnamithyātiyogāḥ prāpyante, ataḥ pṛthaṅnehoktāḥ| anye tu, ayoge ityatra naśabdenaiva hīnayogamithyāyogāvākṣiptau, atiyogasya tu mātrākālābhyāmeva paryudāsaḥ kṛta iti| snaihike kevalaghṛtapariṣeke| tarpaṇoktān sukhasvapnāvabodhitvamityādīn| idaṃ yogāyogalakṣaṇaṃ kevalaṃ snehapariṣekasyaiva boddhavyaṃ, kṣīrekṣurasādikṛtasya snehanīyākhyapariṣekasya yogāyogalakṣaṇaṃ puṭapākavat kathitam|48|-

lg.l: karoti śiraso bastir uktā ye mūrdhatailikāḥ |

ab.seg: śirobastimāha- rogānityādi| atiprabalān śirasi sambhūtān rogān śirobhitāpādīn hatvā śirobastirye mūrdhatailikā guṇā uktāstān karotīti sambandhaḥ| śiro'tra grīvāparyantaṃ grāhyaṃ, natu ṣaḍaṅgulotsedham| mūrdhatailikā guṇā śirogatāṃstathā rogānityādayaḥ śirasaḥ pratipūraṇaparyantā anāgatābādhapratiṣedhoktāḥ| śuddhadehasya vamanādibhirnirmalaśarīrasya; athavā śuddhadehasya nasyādibhirviśuddhamastakasya, dehāvayave'pi dehopacārāt; athavā śiraḥśuddhāvapi dehasya śuddhiriti| sāyāhne dināvasāne| yathāvyādhyaśitasyeti vyādhipratyanīkaṃ bhuktavata ityarthaḥ| ṛjviti ṛju yathā syādevaṃ bastikośaṃ badhnīyāt, ‘keśānta’ iti śeṣaḥ| athavā ṛjviti āsīnasya viśeṣaṇam| bastikośamityuktenaiva paṭṭacelikāmāṣacūrṇādikamākṣiptam| yathāvyādhiśṛtasnehapūrṇaṃ yathāvyādhidoṣadūṣyahitadravyasiddhasnehapūrṇam| saṃyamya dhārayet yāvat keśabhūmerupari dvyaṅgulaṃ baddhvā dhārayet| kiyatkālaṃ śirobastiṃ dhārayedityāha- tarpaṇoktamityādi| tarpaṇoktamakṣitarpaṇakathitakālaṃ daśaguṇaṃ śirobastiravacāryaḥ| yathādoṣamiti tatra ṣaṇmātrāsahasrāṇi śleṣmaṇi, aṣṭau sahasrāṇi pitte, daśasahasrāṇi vāte iti; aparaṃ ca vātarogacikitsite śirogatavātaprastāve vyākhyātam| kecidamuṃ pāṭhamanyathā paṭhanti, sa cābhāvānna likhitaḥ||47-50||

lg.l: netra eva sthite doṣe prāptam añjanam ācaret |
lekhanaṃ ropaṇaṃ cāpi prasādanam athāpi vā ||52||

ab.seg: idānīmañjanasyāvasthikaṃ kālamuddiśannāha- vyaktarūpeṣvityādi| vyaktarūpeṣu sāmatāpagamena vyaktātmarūpaprāpteṣu| śuddhakāyasya sirāvyadhivirecananirūhaśirovirecanairhṛtamaladehasya| kevale anyadoṣāsaṃsṛṣṭe| netre eva sthite akṣigolakatvaṅmātrasthite, na punaḥ pakṣmādyāśrite| prāptaṃ yuktam| kecit ‘doṣeṣu’ ityatra ‘rogeṣu’ iti paṭhanti, rogaśabdo doṣeṣvapi vartate iti vyākhyānayanti| idānīmañjanabhedaṃ nirdiśannāha- lekhanamityādi||51-52||

lekhanamāha- tatretyādi| pañcarasān pañcarasadravyāṇītyarthaḥ| ādyaikarasavarjitān madhurarasavarjitān| pañcadheti vātapittaśleṣmaraktasannipātabhedena| yathādoṣaṃ doṣānatikrameṇa| tatra vāte amlalavaṇau, pitte tiktakaṣāyau, śleṣmaṇi kaṭutiktakaṣāyāḥ, rakte pittavat, sannipāte rasadvayaṃ trayaṃ vā| sannipātenaiva saṃsargo'varuddhaḥ, ato'tra pṛthaṅnoktaḥ| lekhanaṃ doṣasrāvaṇānnayanasya riktīkaraṇam||53||

lg.l: mukhanāsākṣibhir doṣam ojasā srāvayet tu tat ||54||

ab.seg: lekhanaṃ yathā doṣasya srāvaṇaṃ kurute tathā darśayannāha- netretyādi| netravartmanoryāḥ sirā yaśca kośo yāni ca srotāṃsi tatra sthitaṃ doṣaṃ, tathā śṛṅgāṭakamarmāśritaṃ ca doṣaṃ tallekhanāñjanaṃ mukhādibhirojasā prabhāveṇa srāvayediti piṇḍārthaḥ||54||

lg.l: kaṣāyaṃ tiktakaṃ vā'pi sasnehaṃ ropaṇaṃ matam |
tatsnehaśaityād varṇyaṃ ‘tatsnehaśaityādvraṇyaṃ’ iti pā. syād dṛṣṭeś ca balavardhanam ||55||

ab.seg: ropaṇamāha- kaṣāyetyādi| sasneham īṣadghṛtayuktam||55||
prasādanamāha- madhuramityādi| dṛṣṭidoṣaprasādārthaṃ dṛṣṭisthadoṣaprasādārthamityarthaḥ||56||

yathetyādi| tāni yathoktāni lekhanādīnyañjanāni rogaviśāradairvaidyairyathādoṣaṃ prāhṇasāyāhnarātriṣu prayojyānīti piṇḍārthaḥ| tatra pūrvāhṇe śleṣmaroge lekhanāñjanaṃ, sāyāhne vātaje, rātrau pittaje| anye tu ādau śodhanāñjanaṃ, tato ropaṇaṃ; apare tu prasādanamiti vadanti| aparamapi ṛtubhedādarthāntaramasti, tacca vistarabhayānna likhitam||57||

lg.l: yathāpūrvaṃ balaṃ teṣāṃ śreṣṭham āhur manīṣiṇaḥ ||58||

ab.seg: idānīmapyekaikamañjanaṃ guṭikādibhedāttriprakāramiti darśayannāha- guṭikārasetyādi| raso'tra ghanaraso rasakriyetyarthaḥ| yathāpūrvaṃ balaṃ teṣāmiti etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati- mahābalānāṃ rogāṇāṃ guṭikāñjanaṃ, madhyānāṃ rasakriyāñjanaṃ, hīnānāṃ cūrṇāñjanam||58||
idānīṃ pramāṇāvasaraḥ- hareṇumātrā vartirityādi| hareṇuḥ vartulakalāyaḥ, adhyardhā sārdhakalāyapramāṇetyarthaḥ, dviguṇā dvikalāyapramāṇetyarthaḥ||59||

lg.l: rasāñjanasya mātrā tu yathāvartimitā ‘piṣṭā vartimitā’ iti pā. matā |60|

div.ab: guṭikāñjanapramāṇamabhidhāya rasakriyāñjanapramāṇamāha- rasāñjanasyetyādi| rasāñjanasya rasakriyāñjanasya, ‘rasāñjanadravyasya’ ityeke, tanmate rasakriyāñjanapramāṇamanyatrānveṣaṇīyam| yathāvartimitā matā iti yathāsvavartipramāṇamātretyarthaḥ| tatra lekhanarasakriyāñjanasya lekhanavartivat pramāṇaṃ, ropaṇasya ropaṇavartivat, prasādanasya prasādanavartivat|60|-

ab.seg: cūrṇāñjanapramāṇamāha- dvitricaturityādi| anupūrvaśo lekhanādīnāmañjanānāmānupūrvyeṇetyarthaḥ| tatra śalākādvayaṃ lekhanacūrṇasya, tisro ropaṇasya, catasraḥ prasādanasya||60||

lg.l: teṣāṃ tulyaguṇāny eva vidadhyād bhājanāny api |
āyasāni ca yojyāni śalākāś ca yathākramam |62|

div.ab: idānīmañjanāni kiṅguṇe kimmaye pātre sthāpayitavyāni, tathā kiṅguṇāni kimmayaśalākānītyāha- teṣāmityādi| tulyaguṇānīti sauvarṇe madhuraṃ, rājate amlaṃ, śārṅge meṣaśṛṅgamaye lavaṇaṃ, tāmre lohamaye vā kaṣāyaṃ, vaidūrye kaṭukaṃ, kāṃsye tiktaṃ, śītāñjanaṃ tu nalādimaye, evaṃ samānaguṇāni bhājanāni vidadhyāt kuryāt| śalākāścaiṣāṃ bhājanadravyaguṇena yathākramameva vyākhyātāḥ||61||-

tāsāṃ śalākānāmākāramuddiśannāha- vaktrayormukulākāretyādi| mukulākārā mallikādimukulasyeva nirgacchato yadvanmukhaṃ tadākārā; kalāyaparimaṇḍalatvena tīkṣṇāgratvaniṣedhaḥ; sukṛtā karkaśādidoṣarahitā; sādhunigrahā sukhagrahetyarthaḥ||62||-

lg.l: audumbary aśmajā vā'pi śārīrī vā hitā bhavet ||63||

ab.seg: idānīṃ tāmrādijānāṃ śalākānāṃ hitatvaṃ pratipādayannāha- audumbarītyādi| audumbarī tāmramayī, aśmajā vaidūryādipāṣāṇajā, śārīrī śṛṅgādijā, apiśabdāt suvarṇādijā'pi hitetyarthaḥ| tathā ca tantrāntare,- “āyasī ropaṇe, tāmrā lekhye, haimī prasādane| śeṣā api yathādoṣaṃ prayojyā rasakovidaiḥ”- iti| kecit śārīrīśabdena aṅgulimācakṣate, tannecchati gayī||63||

lg.l: āpāṅgyaṃ vā yathāyogaṃ kuryāc cāpi gatāgatam |
vartmopalepi vā yat tad aṅgulyaiva prayojayet ||65||

ab.seg: vāmenetyādi| nirbhujya vakrīkṛtya| kanīnyāṃ nāsāsamīpe netrāvayave añjanaṃ kānīnaṃ, taccāñjanaṃ kanīnakapradeśādapāṅgaṃ nayet, āpāṅgyaṃ ceti apāṅge netrānte bhavam āpāṅgyaṃ, taccāpāṅgapradeśāt kanīnakapradeśaṃ nayet| paraṃ yathāyogaṃ yathā'tiyogahīnayogau na bhavata ityarthaḥ| evaṃ gatāgatamapi kuryāt| etacchalākayā antarnayanamañjanapraṇidhānaṃ boddhavyam| antarnayanapraṇidhānamabhidhāya bahirañjanapraṇidhānamāha- vartmetyādi| vartmopalepi vartmopalepanayogyam||64-65||

lg.l: akṣi nātyantayor añjyād bādhamāno 'pi vā bhiṣak |66|

div.ab: akṣītyādi| antayoḥ kanīnakāpāṅgayoḥ| nātyañjyāt īṣadañjyāt, kṣatabhayāt| bādhamāno'pi veti bādhāṃ kurvan vaidyo vā nāñjyādityarthaḥ| ‘akṣi nātyantayorañjyāt’ ityatra ‘nātyantamañjayedakṣi’ iti kecit paṭhanti; tatra ca pāṭhe sarvatrāpyatyantāñjananiṣedhaḥ kṛto bhavati|66|-

lg.l: doṣaḥ pratinivṛttaḥ san hanyād dṛṣṭer balaṃ tathā |67|

div.ab: idānīmakāle prakṣālananiṣedhamāha- na cetyādi| na cānirvāntadoṣe iti niścayena samyagyogena na vānto'śrudūṣikādirūpo doṣo yena tasminnityarthaḥ| dhāvanaṃ na samprayojayet prakṣālanaṃ na prayojayet, doṣapratyāvṛttihetutvāt| akālaprakṣālanāt kiṃ syādityāha- doṣa ityādi| pratinivṛttaḥ punarāvṛttaḥ| tathetyakālaprakṣālanaprakāreṇetyarthaḥ||66||-

lg.l: gatadoṣam apetāśru paśyed yat samyag ambhasā ||67||

div.ab: kīdṛśaṃ punaścakṣuḥ prakṣālyamityāha- gatadoṣamityādi| pratyañjanaṃ tīkṣṇāñjanena kaṭubhūtanayanasya yadañjanaṃ śītaṃ, tathā śītena jaḍībhūtanayanasya yattīkṣṇamañjanamityarthaḥ| kecidamuṃ pāṭhaṃ na paṭhanti, tannecchati gayī||67||-

ab.seg: idānīmañjanasya pūrvāhṇādikān kālān sāmānyena svasthāturayoḥ pratipādya, āvasthikeṣu kāleṣvañjananiṣedhamāha- śramodāvartetyādi| śramādibhirārtānāṃ puruṣāṇāmañjanaṃ neṣyata iti sambandhaḥ| kecidatra ‘śānte bhīte prarudite madyapīte navajvare| uṣṇe vegābhighāte ca nāñjanaṃ sampraśasyate’ iti paṭhanti, tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ| kasmācchramādibhirārtānāmañjanaṃ neṣyata ityāha- rāgarugityādi| saṃrambhaḥ śvayathuḥ||68-69||

lg.l: doṣasthairyād apārthaṃ syād doṣotkleśaṃ karoti ca |
doṣavegodaye dattaṃ kuryāt tāṃs tān upadravān |
tasmāt pariharan doṣān añjanaṃ sādhu yojayet ||73||

ab.seg: idānīṃ sāmānyenāñjanavaiguṇyena vyāpadaḥ pradarśya prativaiguṇyaṃ vyāpada āha- nidrākṣaye ityādi| kriyāśaktiṃ nimeṣonmeṣaṇādīnāmaśaktim ‘añjanaṃ karoti’ ityadhyāhāryam| kecit kriyāsaṅgamiti paṭhanti| pravāte ityādi| dṛgbalaṃ dṛṣṭerbalamityarthaḥ| saṃrambhaḥ śvayathuḥ| apārtham akiñcitkaram| etaduktaṃ bhavati- etaiḥ snānādibhiḥ sthirīkṛtasya doṣasya nirharaṇaṃ kartumañjanaṃ na śankotītyarthaḥ| evamevetyapārthakamañjanaṃ syāt doṣotkleśaṃ ca karotītyarthaḥ| upadravān rāgaśophādikān| sādhu yojayediti deśakālāvasthāpekṣamityarthaḥ||70-73||

div.ab: lekhanasyetyādi| lekhanasya lekhanāñjanasyaiṣa pūrvoktaḥ pratiṣedhakālaḥ|74|-
akālāñjanakṛtānāṃ vyāpadāṃ cikitsitamāha- vyāpada ityādi| etā rāgarujādyāḥ samutthitā vyāpado yathāsvaṃ sekādibhirjayediti sambandhaḥ||74||-
idānīṃ lekhanāñjanasya samyagyogalakṣaṇamāha- viśadamityādi||75||-

lg.l: jihmaṃ dāruṇadurvarṇaṃ srastaṃ rūkṣam atīva ca ||76||

div.ab: lekhanāñjanasyātiyogalakṣaṇamāha- jihmamityādi| jihmaṃ vakraṃ, dāruṇaṃ kaṭhinaṃ, syandate sravati||76||-

ab.seg: lekhanāñjanātiyogapratīkāramāha- tatretyādi| tatreti lekhanāñjanātiyoge ityarthaḥ||77||

div.ab: lekhanāñjanasya hīnayogamāha- akṣi mandaviriktamityādi| udagrataradoṣavat utkaṭataradoṣayuktam|78|-

ab.seg: hīnayogapratīkāramāha- dhūmanasyāñjanairityādi| kecidatra ‘nasyadhūmāñjanālepairjayecchleṣmāṇamīritam’ iti pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti; tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ||78||
prasādanāñjanasya samyagyogamāha- snehetyādi| nirvṛtaṃ sarvakriyākṣamam, upaśāntopadravamiti yāvat||79||

lg.l: kiñcid dhīnavikāraṃ syāt tarpaṇād dhi kṛtādati |80|

div.ab: prasādanāñjanātiyogamāha- kiñcidityādi| tarpaṇādatikṛtāt sakṛdatikṛte prasādanāñjane kiñciddhīnavikāraṃ cakṣuḥ syāditi tātparyārthaḥ|80|-

lg.l: tatra doṣaharaṃ rūkṣaṃ bheṣajaṃ śasyate mṛdu ||80||

ab.seg: prasādanāñjanātiyogacikitsāmāha- tatretyādi| doṣaharaṃ kaphaharamityarthaḥ| mṛdu mṛduvīryaṃ śītavīryamityarthaḥ; uṣṇena hi nayanaṃ duṣyati na tu prasādyate||80||

idānīṃ ropaṇāñjanasya samyagyogamatiyogaṃ cātideśenāha- sādhāraṇamityādi| evaṃ ropaṇalakṣaṇamiti prasādanāñjanasya samyagyogātiyogaprakāreṇa ropaṇāñjanasya samyagyogātiyogalakṣaṇaṃ jñeyam| paraṃ sādhāraṇaṃ nātisnigdharūkṣamiti yāvat| anye tu ropaṇalakṣaṇamevaṃ prasādanāñjanavyañjanena sādhāraṇaṃ samānaṃ jñeyamiti vyākhyānayanti| ropaṇāñjanātiyoge cikitsāmāha- prasādanavadityādi| tasmin ropaṇāñjane'tiprayukte prasādanavat prasādanāñjanātiyogavadbheṣajamācaṣṭe brūyāditi piṇḍārthaḥ||81||

div.ab: idānīṃ prasādanaropaṇayorhīnayogamāha- snehanamityādi| snehanaṃ prasādanāñjanam| apārthakam akiñcitkaram|82|-

lg.l: kartavyaṃ mātrayā tasmād añjanaṃ siddhim icchatā ||82||

ab.seg: kartavyamityādi| mātrayeti yathā hīnātiyogau na bhavataḥ| siddhiṃ vikāranivṛttim| asyāgre vidyamānapustakeṣu ‘dhūmairnasyāñjanairvā'pi doṣaśeṣaṃ śamaṃ nayet’ iti pāṭho vidyate, sa jejjaṭādibhirna paṭhitaḥ, tasmānna paṭhitavyaḥ||82||

idānīmañjanoktena madhurarasavarjapañcarasena lekhanāñjanakalpanābījena, tathā tiktakaṣāyeṇa sasnehena ropaṇāñjanakalpanābījena, tathā madhurarasena snehasampannena prasādanāñjanakalpanābījena, puṭapākādyāsu kriyāsvañjaneṣvapi lekhanaropaṇaprasādanakalpanāḥ sahasraprakārāḥ kalpanīyā ityāha- puṭapāketyādi| añjaneṣūktena lekhanaropaṇaprasādanākhyena bījena puṭapākakriyādyāsu kriyāsu tathā'nukteṣvañjaneṣvapyauṣadhakalpanāḥ lekhanaropaṇaprasādanākhyāḥ sahasraśaḥ pūjitā iti piṇḍārthaḥ| puṭapākakriyādyāsvityatra ādiśabdāt sekāścyotanādayo gṛhyante| anye tvañjanoktena hīnayogātiyogacikitsābījena puṭapākādihīnātiyogacikitsitaṃ vyācakṣate, tannecchati gayī||83||

idānīṃ rogāpaharaṇaprayogāṇyañjanānyabhidhāya svasthāturahitānyañjanānyāha- dṛṣṭerbalavivṛddhyarthamityādi| dṛṣṭirmasuradalamātrā tacchaktibalādhānārthaṃ svasthena prasādāñjanaṃ kāryam, ātureṇa yāpyarogaprasādanāñjanaṃ kāryaṃ; yāpyarogāśca ‘sampaśyataḥ ṣaḍapi ye'bhihitāstu kācā’ ityādiproktāḥ| kecitpāpmarogakṣayāya ceti paṭhanti, pāpmaśabdena ca srāvaṇaṃ kathayanti||84||

lg.l: ekādaśaitān bhāgāṃs tu yojayet kuśalo bhiṣak |
gavāṃ śakṛdrase mūtre dadhni sarpiṣi mākṣike ||87||
niṣecayet pṛthak cainaṃ dhmātaṃ dhmātaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||89||
viśoṣya cūrṇayen muktāṃ sphaṭikaṃ vidrumaṃ tathā ||90||
etac cūrṇāñjanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ nihitaṃ bhājane śubhe ||91||
śātakumbhe 'tha śārṅge vā rājate vā susaṃskṛte |

ab.seg: tānyañjanāni darśayannāha- aṣṭāvityādi| añjanasya sauvīrāñjanasya, srotojarasāñjanasyetyanye; nīlotpalasamatviṣaḥ nīlotpalavarṇasyetyarthaḥ; ‘nīlotpalasugandhinaḥ’ iti kecit paṭhanti| audumbaraṃ tāmrabhāgaṃ, śātakumbhaṃ suvarṇabhāgaṃ, rājataṃ rūpyabhāgam, etena tāmrādīnāṃ pratyekamekaikaṃ bhāgaṃ, evamekādaśa bhāgāḥ pūryante| mūṣā mṛtkalpitā; sā tu dhātuvādināṃ gṛhe prasiddhā| āvṛtaṃ vilīnaṃ, jātavedasi agnau, aṅgāraiḥ dagdhanirvāpitakṛṣṇavarṇakāṣṭhakhaṇḍaiḥ, gośakṛdbhiḥ śuṣkairgopurīṣaiḥ, gavāmiti padaṃ śakṛdrasādiṣu sarpiḥparyanteṣu sambadhyate| mākṣike madhuni, vasā śuddhamāṃsasnehaḥ| antarīkṣe tathā jale pānīye| plotabaddhaṃ karpaṭabaddham| kecicchikyāropitaṃ pānīyamāntarīkṣaṃ kathayanti| viśoṣya saptarātrādanantaraṃ tadañjanaṃ śoṣayitvetyarthaḥ| muktā mauktikaṃ, vidrumaṃ pravālaṃ, kālānusārivā tagaramūlaṃ, jejjaṭastu dvitīyasārivāmāha| śuciriti vaidyaviśeṣaṇam| āvāpya prakṣipya, yogataḥ alpamātrayā| anye tu sauvīrāñjanādīnāṃ caturthāṃśena muktādicūrṇaṃ prakṣipyeti vyākhyānayanti| nihitaṃ nikṣiptam| asano bījakaḥ, śātakumbhe suvarṇamaye, śārṅge meṣaśṛṅgamaye| kecidatra sphaṭikavaidūryādibhājanapāṭhaṃ na paṭhanti; te cātra pātrāṇāṃ tāmrarajatasuvarṇānāṃ śubhabhājanaṃ gṛhṇanti| sahasrapākavat śaṅkhadundubhinirghoṣādinā, pūjyaṃ pūjanīyam| kṛtveti padaṃ nihitamityatra sambandhanīyam| kecit sahasrapākavat pūjāṃ kṛtveti paṭhanti| adhṛṣyaḥ agamyaḥ| sarvabhūtānāṃ devāsuragandharvayakṣarakṣaḥpitṛpiśācanāgānāmaṣṭānām| ‘dṛṣṭirāgavivarjitaṃ’ iti kecit paṭhanti, rāgaśabdena ‘sampaśyataḥ ṣaḍapi ye'bhihitāstu kācā’ iti vyākhyānayanti||85-93||

lg.l: kuṣṭhaṃ candanamelāś ca patraṃ madhukam añjanam |
meṣaśṛṅgasya puṣpāṇi vakraṃ ratnāni sapta ca ||94||
utpalasya bṛhatyoś ca padmasyāpi ca keśaram |
kṛtvā sūkṣmaṃ tataś cūrṇaṃ nyased abhyarcya pūrvavat |

ab.seg: kuṣṭhamityādi| vakraṃ tagaraṃ, ratnāni sapta padmarāgamarakatanīlavavaidūryamuktāpravālahemāni| utpalasya nīlotpalasya, puṣpāṇi kusumāni, bṛhatyoḥ kaṇṭakārīdvayasyāpi kusumāni, tutthamuttamaṃ mayūragrīvākhyaṃ, kecit tutthaṃ kharparikātutthaṃ, uttamaṃ mayūragrīvākhyatutthamiti vyākhyānayanti, gṛhagopikā gṛhagodhikā, gṛhakāriketyanye| nyaset śubhe bhājane prakṣipet| abhyarcya śaṅkhadundubhinirghoṣādinā pūjāṃ kṛtvā| pūrvavat yādṛgguṇaṃ pūrvāñjanaṃ tādṛgguṇametadapi syādityarthaḥ| anye tu pūrvavat śaṅkhadundubhinirghoṣādinā'bhyarcyetyāhuḥ| bhadrodayaṃ bhadrasya kalyāṇasya udayo lābho yasmāttattathā; anye tu bhadra udayo yasyetyāhuḥ||94-97||

lg.l: vakraṃ samaricaṃ caiva māṃsīṃ śaileyam eva ca |
tulyāṃśāni samānais taiḥ samagraiś ca manaḥśilā ||98||
tāvac ca yaṣṭīmadhukaṃ pūrvavac caitad añjanam ||99||

ab.seg: vakramityādi| samānaistaiḥ samagraiśca manaḥśileti samabhāgaiḥ sarvadravyaiḥ samā manaḥśiletyarthaḥ| patrasya bhāgāścatvāra iti ādyadravyāt patrakasya catvāro bhāgāḥ| dviguṇaṃ sarvato'ñjanaṃ sarvasmādeva samuditāñjanacūrṇāddviguṇaṃ sauvīrāñjanam; anye tu añjanaśabdena srotojarasāñjanamāhuḥ| tāvacca yaṣṭīmadhukaṃ sauvīrāñjanapramāṇaṃ yaṣṭīmadhukamityarthaḥ| anye tu sarvadravyasamaṃ yaṣṭīmadhukamicchanti| pūrvavat pūrvamaṣṭau bhāgānañjanasyeti yaduktamañjanaṃ tattulyametadapyañjanaṃ phalaśrutyā śaṅkhādidhvanipūjanena bhājanasthāpanena ca| asyāgre keciduśīrādyañjanaṃ paṭhanti, taccābhāvānna likhitam||98-99||

lg.l: rodhraṃ sāvarakaṃ cūrṇam āyasaṃ tāmram eva ca |
tulyāni payasā piṣṭvā guṭikāṃ kārayed budhaḥ |

ab.seg: manaḥśiletyādi| ūṣaṇaṃ maricam||100-102||

lg.l: saptakṛtvas tu tā vartyaś chāyāśuṣkā rujāpahāḥ ||104||

ab.seg: kāṃsyāpamārjanamasītyādi| kāṃsyāpamārjanamasī kāṃsyāpamārjanasyollekhananīlikā, nataṃ tagaramūlaṃ, bṛhatyaṃśadvayānvitaṃ bṛhatīphalayorbṛhatīmūlayorvā ādyadravyādyadaṃśadvayaṃ tena samanvitam||103-104||
pathyātutthaketyādi| maricasya ṣoḍaśabhāgo yasyāḥ sā maricaṣoḍaśā vartiḥ| pathyā hitā||105||

sā punaḥ śuṣkā vartirañjane'vacāryamāṇā nayane kṣatādijananītyāśaṅkya tasyāḥ prayogamāha- rasakriyāvidhānenetyādi| rasakriyāvidhānena rasakriyāyā yadvidhānaṃ nātitanu nātighanaṃ śalākopalepakṣamamaṅgulyupalepakṣamaṃ vā tenetyarthaḥ| piṇḍāñjanāni vartyañjanāni śilāpaṭṭakaghṛṣṭāni piṣṭāni vā| etenaitaduktaṃ- na kadācidapi śuṣkavartyā nayanamañjyāditi tātparyārthaḥ| yathāyogamiti yathā nayane kṣatādayo na bhaveyurityarthaḥ| atandritaḥ analasaḥ| kecidamuṃ ślokamanyathā vyākhyānayanti, tacca vistarabhayānna likhitam||106||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre kriyākalpo nāmāṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||18||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālakyatantre'ṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ||18||

div.head: nayanābhighātapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto nayanābhighātapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

kriyākalpānantaraṃ śārīradoṣanimittānāṃ nayanāmayānāmuktatvādbāhyanimittasyāvaśiṣṭatvāccikitsārthaṃ nayanābhighātapratiṣedhādhyāyārambho yukta ityata āha- athāta ityādi| abhighātaśabdenātrābhighātajanitā vedanādayaḥ, teṣāṃ pratiṣedhaścikitsitam| sa cābhighāto mūrtena daṇḍādinā amūrtena bhayaśokādinā vā||1-2||

lg.l: abhyāhate tu nayane bahudhā narāṇāṃ saṃrambharāgatumulāsu rujāsu dhīmān |
dṛṣṭiprasādajananaṃ vidhim āśu kuryāt snigdhair himaiś ca madhuraiś ca tathā prayogaiḥ |4|

div.ab: tamevābhighātaṃ mūrtadaṇḍādijaṃ cikitsābhedayoginaṃ darśayannāha- abhyāhate ityādi| narāṇāṃ bahudhā abhyāhate nayane sati saṃrambharāgatumulāsu rujāsu nasyāsyalepādyaṃ karma kṣatajapittajaśūlapathyaṃ yaduktaṃ tathā snigdhādibhirdṛṣṭiprasādajananaṃ vidhiṃ dhīmānāśu kuryāditi piṇḍārthaḥ| bahudhā bahuprakāram| tathā ca videhaḥ,- “tīkṣṇāñjanātiparikliṣṭeṣu netreṣu vātātapadhūmarajavyāpārakīṭamakṣikāmaśakasparśādibhirabhihateṣu salilakrīḍājāgaraṇalaṅghanāplutābhidruteṣu śrāntaklānteṣu bhayārditeṣu divākarāgnicandragrahanakṣatrakramaṇakarmavividharūpaprekṣaṇādyabhihateṣu durbaleṣu netreṣu rāgadāhatodaśophapākagharṣādivedanāsu”- iti| saṃrambharāgābhyāṃ tumulāḥ saṅkulāḥ saṃrambharāgatumulāstāsu| anye tu saṃrambhaśca rāgaśca tumulaśca saṃrambharāgatumulāstāsu; tumulāḥ pracaṇḍāḥ, saṃrambhaḥ śvayathuḥ, ityarthaṃ vadanti| kṣatajapittajaśūlapathyamiti raktābhiṣyandahitaṃ pittābhiṣyandahitaṃ cetyarthaḥ| anye tu abhighātajo hi vāyuḥ śoṇitapittaṃ dūṣayan tābhyāmevāvṛtaḥ śūlaṃ karotīti taddhitamiti vyākhyānayanti| dṛṣṭiprasādanaṃ nayanagolakaprasādanam||3||-

lg.l: svedāgnidhūmabhayaśokarujābhighātair abhyāhatām api tathaiva bhiṣak cikitset ||4||

ab.seg: ‘abhyāhate tu nayane bahudhā narāṇām’ ityatra mūrtānāṃ daṇḍādīnāmabhighāte yaccikitsitamabhihitaṃ tadeva cikitsitamamūrtānāmapi svedādīnāmabhighāte'tidiśannāha- svedāgnidhūmabhayetyādi| tathaiva cikitset pūrvoktaprakāreṇa cikitset| evaṃ saptāhādarvāgeva| ‘abhyāhate tu nayane’ ityatra pūrvavākye bahudhātvaṃ mūrtadaṇḍādyabhighātasya bodhyam, ihāmūrtābhighātacikitsitamabhidhīyate||4||

lg.l: sadyohate nayana eṣa vidhis tad ūrdhvaṃ syanderito bhavati doṣam avekṣya kāryaḥ |5|

div.ab: idānīṃ pūrvokto vidhiḥ saptāhādarvāgeva kāryastadūrdhvamanyo vidhirityāha- sadyohata ityādi| sadyohate saptāhādarvāgevetyarthaḥ| eṣa vidhiḥ pūrvokto vidhiḥ| tadūrdhvaṃ saptāhādūrdhvam| syanderito vātābhiṣyandokto vidhiḥ|5|-

lg.l: abhyāhataṃ nayanam īṣad athāsyabāṣpasaṃsveditaṃ bhavati tan nirujaṃ kṣaṇena ||5||

ab.seg: idānīṃ kiñcidabhyāhatanayane viśeṣacikitsitamāha- abhyāhatamityādi| āsyabāṣpaṃ mukhaphūtkārajanitoṣmā||5||

lg.l: sādhyaṃ kṣataṃ paṭalam ekam ubhe tu kṛcchre trīṇi kṣatāni paṭalāni vivarjayet tu |
syāt piccitaṃ ca nayanaṃ hy ati cāvasannaṃ srastaṃ cyutaṃ ca hatadṛk ca bhavet tu yāpyam ||6||
vistīrṇadṛṣṭitanurāgam asatpradarśi, sādhyaṃ yathāsthitam anāviladarśanaṃ ca |7|

div.ab: idānīṃ paṭalāvagāhanaviśeṣeṇābhighātasya sādhyakṛcchrasādhyāsādhyaviśeṣamāha- sādhyaṃ kṣatamityādi| kecidamuṃ pāṭhaṃ na paṭhanti| yādṛṅnayanaṃ yāpyaṃ tādṛgāha- syāt piccitamityādi| avasannam antaḥpraviṣṭaṃ, srastaṃ śithilaṃ, cyutam avalambitaṃ, vistīrṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tathā tanurāgaṃ ca yadasatpradarśi syāt tadapi yāpyam| sādhyamāha- sādhyamityādi||6||-

lg.l: prāṇoparodhavamanakṣutakaṇṭharodhair unnamyam āśu nayanaṃ yad atipraviṣṭam ||7||

ab.seg: atipraviṣṭanetre cikitsitamāha- prāṇoparodhetyādi| prāṇāyāmena vamanena chikkāpravartanena tathā kaṇṭhanirodhanena vā unnamyamunnamanīyam||7||

lg.l: netre vilambini vidhir vihitaḥ purastād ucchiṅghanaṃ śirasi vāryavasecanaṃ ca |8|

div.ab: atinirgatanayanasya cikitsitamāha- netra ityādi| vilambini atinirgate, vidhirvihitaḥ purastāditi ‘bhinnaṃ netrakarmaṇyamabhinnaṃ lambate tu yat’ ityādinā proktaḥ| ucchiṅghanaṃ nāsikayā vāyorantaḥpraveśanam| vāryavasecanaṃ śītodakapariṣekaḥ|8|-

lg.l: ṣaṭsaptatir nayanajā ya ime pradiṣṭā rogā bhavanty amahatāṃ mahatāṃ ca tebhyaḥ ||8||

div.ab: idānīṃ vakṣyamāṇakukūṇakena ṣaṭsaptateḥ saṅkhyādhikyamityāśaṅkyamānamāha- ṣaṭsaptatirityādi| ya ime nayanajā rogāḥ ṣaṭsaptatiḥ pradiṣṭāste'mahatāṃ bālānāṃ tathā mahatāṃ ca bhavanti| tebhyaḥ ṣaṭsaptativikārebhyaḥ stanyaprakopādibhirbālākṣivartmabhava eva anyaḥ kukūṇaka iti samudāyārthaḥ| bālākṣivartmabhava eva na mahatāmakṣivartmani, anyaḥ aparaḥ| yo'sau kukūṇako bālānāmeva bhavati, sa kaphābhiṣyande avaruddho'to na saṅkhyātirekaḥ| ‘stanyaprakopakaphamārutapittaraktaiḥ’ ityatra ‘stanyaprakopajanitaiḥ piśitodayādvā’ ityanye paṭhanti; apare tu ‘piśitocchrayāt’ iti paṭhanti; tau ca necchati jejjaṭaḥ||8||-

lg.l: mṛdnāti netram atikaṇḍum athākṣikūṭaṃ nāsālalāṭam api tena śiśuḥ sa nityam ||9||
sūryaprabhāṃ na sahate sravati prabaddhaṃ, tasyāhared rudhiram āśu vinirlikhec ca |
kṣaudrāyutaiś ca kaṭubhiḥ pratisārayet tu mātuḥ śiśor abhihitaṃ ca vidhiṃ vidadhyāt ||10||

ab.seg: idānīṃ tasya kukūṇakasya lakṣaṇamāha- mṛdgātītyādi| nāsālalāṭamapi mṛdgāti| prabaddhaṃ nirantaram| kukūṇakasya sādhanamāha- tasyāharedrudhiramityādi| āharedrudhiraṃ jalaukobhiḥ, vinirlikhet śephālikāpatraiḥ| kaṭubhiḥ trikaṭukādibhiḥ| idānīṃ bālasyauṣadhākṣamatvānmāturevauṣadhamāha- māturityādi| yaḥ stanyarogacikitsite ‘stanye gate vikṛtimāśu bhiṣak’ ityādividhirabhihitaḥ, taṃ śiśoryā jananī tasyā vidadhyāditi piṇḍārthaḥ| anye tu dvayorevābhihitaṃ vidhimicchanti||9-10||

lg.l: taṃ vāmayet tu madhusaindhavasamprayuktaiḥ pītaṃ payaḥ khalu phalaiḥ kharamañjarīṇām ||11||

div.ab: idānīṃ kṣīrapasya bālasya stanyasātmyatvāt stanyayuktameva vamanaṃ nirdiśannāha- taṃ vāmayedityādi| madhusaindhavasaṃyutaiḥ kharamañjarīṇāṃ phalaiḥ saha payaḥ stanyaṃ pītaṃ taṃ bālaṃ vāmayediti sambandhaḥ| kharamañjarīṇāṃ phalaiḥ apāmārgaphalacūrṇaiḥ| syādityādi| pippalīsaindhavādiyutairvā kharamañjarīṇāṃ phalacūrṇaiḥ saha stanyaṃ pītaṃ vamanakṛdbhavedityarthaḥ||11||-

idānīmutkṛṣṭadoṣatvāt svayaṃ vamantaṃ bālakaṃ vamanayogaṃ dattvā na vāmayedityāha- nainamityādi| enamutkliṣṭadoṣatvātsvayameva vamantaṃ vāmayitumanyaprakāreṇa vāmayituṃ na yateta yatnaṃ na kurvīta, vamanātiyogabhayāt|12|-

lg.l: dattvā vacām aśanadugdhabhuje prayojyam ūrdhvaṃ tataḥ phalayutaṃ vamanaṃ vidhijñaiḥ ||12||

ab.seg: kṣīrānnādasya tathā'nnādasya ca vamanamāha- dattvā vacāmityādi| aśanadugdhabhuje kṣīrānnādāya pūrvoktameva vamanaṃ vacāṃ dattvā prayojyam| ata ūrdhvaṃ kṣīrānnāvasthāto'nantaramannādasya madanaphalayutaṃ pūrvoktameva vamanaṃ sakṣīramakṣīraṃ vā yojyam||12||

lg.l: jambvāmradhātryaṇudalaiḥ paridhāvanārthaṃ kāryaṃ kaṣāyam avasecanam eva cāpi |13|

div.ab: idānīṃ kukūṇake vartmanaḥ prakṣālanapariṣekārthaṃ kaṣāyamāha- jambvāmradhātryaṇudalairityādi| dhātrī āmalakī, aṇuḥ aśmantakaḥ, paridhāvanārthaṃ prakṣālanārthaṃ, pariṣecanaṃ pariṣeka ityarthaḥ|13|-

lg.l: āścyotane ca hitam atra ghṛtaṃ guḍūcīsiddhaṃ tathā''hur api ca triphalāvipakvam ||13||

ab.seg: prakṣālanapariṣekāvabhidhāya pūraṇārthamakalkaghṛtadvayamāha- āścyotane ityādi| āścyotane akṣipūraṇe| atra kukūṇake guḍūcīsvarasena ghṛtacaturguṇena pakvaṃ, idamekamañjanaṃ; triphalākvāthena pakvaṃ, etacca dvitīyam||13||

div.ab: adhunā kukūṇake'ñjanamāha- nepālajetyādi| nepālajā manaḥśilā| sindhuprasūtaṃ saindhavam| aparamañjanamāha- syādañjanamityādi| madhurasā mūrvā| etairmūrvādibhistribhirvā'ñjanaṃ syāt|14|-

ab.seg: cūrṇāñjanamāha- kṛṣṇāyasamityādi| kṛṣṇāyasaṃ kṛṣṇalohacūrṇam| etat kṛṣṇalohādikaṃ cāntardhūmadagdhaṃ cūrṇāñjanaṃ bhavet| tathā ca videhaḥ,- “lauhacūrṇaṃ ca sarpiśca madhu kṣīraṃ ca dāhayet|| etaccūrṇāñjanaṃ piṣṭaṃ kumārāṇāṃ kukūṇake”- iti||14||

lg.l: vyoṣaṃ palāṇḍu madhukaṃ lavaṇottamaṃ ca lākṣāṃ ca gairikayutāṃ guṭikāñjanaṃ vā |
nimbacchadaṃ madhukadārvi satāmralodhram icchanti cātra bhiṣajo 'ñjanam aṃśatulyam ||15||

ab.seg: guṭikāñjanamāha- vyoṣamityādi| palāṇḍuḥ laśunabhedaḥ, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu, lavaṇottamaṃ saindhavam| guṭikāñjanaṃ vartyañjanam| aparamapi vartyañjanamāha- nimbacchadamityādi| dārvī haridrādvayaṃ; videhadarśanāt| atra kukūṇake añjanamityatra guṭikāśabdo lupto draṣṭavyaḥ; tena guṭikāñjanamityarthaḥ| aṃśatulyaṃ nimbacchadādikaṃ samabhāgamityarthaḥ||15||

lg.l: srotojaśaṅkhadadhisaindhavam ardhapakṣaṃ śukraṃ śiśor nudati bhāvitam añjanena |
syande kaphād abhihitaṃ kramam ācarec ca bālasya rogakuśalo 'kṣigadaṃ jighāṃsuḥ ||16||

ab.seg: idānīṃ kukūṇakaprasaṅgena bālānāṃ śukralekhanārthamañjanamāha- srotojetyādi| asyāñjanasya kalpanāṃ videhadarśanena vṛddhavaidyā āhuḥ| tadyathā- gavyena dadhnā piṣṭābhyāṃ śaṅkhasaindhavābhyāṃ srotojaṃ rasāñjanamardhapakṣaṃ sārdhasaptarātramasakṛllepayet; tato'nantaraṃ tatsrotojaṃ rasāñjanaṃ piṣṭvā vartiḥ kāryā, sā añjanena śiśoḥ śukraṃ nudati sphoṭayatītyarthaḥ| kecit srotoñjanaśabdena sauvīrāñjanamāhuḥ| kecit ‘śukraṃ śiśornudati bhāvitamañjanena’ ityatra ‘ābhāvitaṃ śiśukaroganudañjanena’ iti paṭhanti| anye tu ‘brāhmīrasena paribhāvitamañjanārthaṃ’ iti paṭhanti, tannecchati gayī| pūrvoktamevauṣadhaṃ śukre'tidiśannāha- syande kaphādabhihitamityādi| kaphādyaḥ syandastatra syande yaḥ kramo'bhihitastaṃ kramaṃ bālasyākṣigadaṃ jighāṃsuryogakuśalo vaidya ācaret kuryāditi sambandhaḥ; jighāṃsuḥ hantumicchuḥ| kecit ‘syande kaphādabhihitaṃ kramaṃ’ ityatra ‘syandakramaṃ kaphavināśanamācarecca’ iti paṭhanti| bālasya kaphādhikyāt kaphasyandakramaṃ vidadhyāt| ācarecceti cakāro bhinnakrame, sa ‘tena’ iti pā. ca kaphavināśanamityatra draṣṭavyaḥ; tato'nyamapyavasthākupitaṃ vātaṃ pittaṃ raktaṃ cānubandhabhūtamihoktamavekṣya vātapittasyandānukramaṃ raktābhiṣyandakramaṃ cāvekṣya yathādoṣaṃ yogamupayojayediti vyākhyānayanti||16||

lg.l: samudra iva gambhīraṃ naiva śakyaṃ cikitsitam |
sahasrair api vā, proktam artham alpamatir naraḥ |

ab.seg: kutaḥ punaḥ sa kramo'vasthāviśeṣeṇa svagranthe ācāryeṇa na nibaddha ityāha- samudra iva gambhīramityādi| samudra iva gambhīraṃ cikitsitaṃ ślokānāṃ sahasrairapyayutairniravaśeṣeṇa vaktuṃ naiva śakyamityarthaḥ; ślokānāṃ sahastairapyayutaiḥ ślokakoṭyā'pītyarthaḥ| yadi ślokakoṭyā vaktuṃ na śakyate tarhi kiṃ granthakarturaśaktirityāśaṅkamānamāha- proktamityādi| alpamatirapaṇḍito naro yatastarkagranthārtharahito'taḥ ślokakoṭyoktamapyarthaṃ naiva gṛhṇātīti sambandhaḥ; tarkagranthārtharahitastarkeṇohena yo granthārthaḥ śāstrārthastena rahita ityarthaḥ||17-18||

tadidamityādi| yasmānniravaśeṣeṇa rogāvasthānantyāccikitsitasya vaktumaśakyatvaṃ, śakyatve vā nirūpaṇasya niṣphalatā, tasmāt kāraṇādidaṃ bahugūḍhārthaṃ cikitsāyā bījamīritamiti samudāyārthaḥ| tadeva cikitsābījaṃ kuśalena jñātamanekadhā prarohatītyāha- kuśalenetyādi| kuśalenāvasthāvidā vaidyenābhipannamadhigataṃ tadbahudhā'bhiprarohati| cikitsābījamiti bījamiva bījaṃ, yathaikaṃ bījaṃ subhūmau nikṣiptaṃ mūlakāṇḍaśākhāpallavādinā'nekadhā prarohati tathedamapīti cikitsābījamityarthaḥ| yasmāt kuśalenādhigataṃ cikitsābījamanekadhā prarohati tasmāt kāraṇānmatimatā nityaṃ nānāśāstrārthadarśinā āgamabuddhinā vaidyena sarvamagādhārthaṃ śāstraṃ nityamūhyamiti sambandhaḥ| nānāśāstrāṇi śālākyāni| āgamaḥ āptānāṃ śāstraṃ; tathā coktaṃ,- “siddhaṃ siddhaiḥ pramāṇaistu hitaṃ cātra paratra ca| āgamaḥ śāstramāptānāmāptāstattvārthadarśinaḥ”- iti||19-20||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre nayanābhighātacikitsitaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||19||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre ekonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||19||

div.head: karṇagatarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ karṇagatarogavijñānīyam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
indriyagatarogasāmānyācchravaṇagatarogavijñānīyārambho yukta ityata āha- athāta ityādi| gataśabda āśritaparyāyaḥ||1-2||

lg.l: karṇaśūlaṃ praṇādaś ca bādhiryaṃ kṣveḍa eva ca |

ab.seg: tāneva karṇagatarogānnāmabhiḥ saṅkhyayā cāha- karṇaśūlamityādi| karṇaśūlasya kaṣṭasādhyatvāt prāgeva nirdeśaḥ| vidradhirdvividhaḥ- doṣavidradhiḥ kṣatavidradhiśca; arśaścaturvidhaṃ- vātapittakaphasannipātaiḥ; arbudaṃ saptavidhaṃ- vātena pittena kaphena cāpi raktena māṃsena ca medasā ca, saptamaṃ śālākyatantre; śophaścaturvidhaḥ- vātapittakaphasannipātaiḥ| saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva saṅkhyāyāṃ labdhāyāmaṣṭāviṃśatiriti bhūyaḥ saṅkhyākaraṇaṃ niyamārthaṃ, tena ca videhasaṅkhyayā adhikatvaṃ mā bhūdityarthaḥ||3-5||

lg.l: samīraṇaḥ śrotragato 'nyathācaraḥ samantataḥ śūlam atīva karṇayoḥ |
karoti doṣaiś ca yathāsvam āvṛtaḥ sa karṇaśūlaḥ kathito durācaraḥ ||6||

ab.seg: karṇaśūlamāha- samīraṇa ityādi| anyathācara iti vimārgagaḥ| samantataḥ śūlamatīva karṇayoḥ karotīti sambandhanīyam| doṣaiḥ kaphapittaraktaiḥ, anye tu vāyoreva vāyvantarāvaraṇādbahuvacanaṃ samarthayanti| svasya svasya doṣasya anatikrameṇa yathāsvam| durācaro duḥkhenopacaryata ityarthaḥ| anye ‘durāsada’ iti paṭhanti, durvāra iti vyākhyānayanti| yadyapi śūlabādhiryavidradhyarśorbudaśophāḥ prāṅnirdiṣṭāstathā'pi karṇarogasaṅgrahārthaṃ sādhyāsādhyavibhāgārthaṃ ca punarnirdiṣṭāḥ; śūlastu vātavyādhinidāne kevalavātaja uktaḥ atra punardoṣairāvṛta iti na paunaruktyam||6||

lg.l: yadā tu nāḍīṣu vimārgam āgataḥ sa eva śabdābhivahāsu tiṣṭhati |
śṛṇoti śabdān vividhāṃs tadā naraḥ praṇādam enaṃ kathayanti cāmayam ||7||

ab.seg: karṇanādamāha- yadā tu nāḍīṣvityādi| vimārgamāgataḥ viruddhamārgaṃ prāptaḥ, vimārgo'tra śira eva, vimārgagaḥ tiryaggo yadā tiṣṭhati, (sa evetyevaśabdena kaphādyāvaraṇāvṛtaḥ| anye tu śabdavahāsu nāḍīṣu sa eva vāyurvimārgago yadā niruddhyati) ayaṃ pāṭho hastalikhitapustake nopalabhyate tadā vividhān śabdān naraḥ śṛṇotīti vyākhyānayanti| asya rogasyāpīḍākaratvādarogatvaṃ mā bhūditi dyotanārthamāmayavacanam||7||

lg.l: sa eva śabdānuvahā yadā sirāḥ kaphānuyāto vyanusṛtya tiṣṭhati |
tadā narasyāpratikārasevino bhavet tu bādhiryam asaṃśayaṃ khalu ||8||

ab.seg: bādhiryamāha- sa eva śabdānuvahā ityādi| sa eva śuddho vāyuḥ kaphānuyātaḥ kaphānugataḥ| sa evetyatrāpiśabdo lupto draṣṭavyaḥ, tena na kevalaṃ śuddho vāyuḥ śleṣmānvito'pi vetyarthaḥ| vyanusṛtya vividhamārgamāvṛtya| apratikārasevinaḥ cikitsāmakurvataḥ||8||

lg.l: śramāt kṣayād rūkṣakaṣāyabhojanāt samīraṇaḥ śabdapathe pratiṣṭhitaḥ |
viriktaśīrṣasya ca śītasevinaḥ karoti hi kṣveḍam atīva karṇayoḥ ||9||

ab.seg: karṇakṣveḍamāha- śramādityādi| kṣayo dhātukṣayaḥ| kṣveḍaḥ śabdaḥ| karṇanādaḥ kevalavātārabdho nānāvidhaśabdānvitaḥ, karṇakṣveḍastu doṣasaṃsṛṣṭavātārabdho vaṃśaghoṣānukāriśabdānvitaḥ| tathā ca videhaḥ,- “mārutaḥ kaphavātābhyāṃ saṃsṛṣṭaḥ śoṇitena ca| karṇakṣveḍanaṃ sañjanayet kṣveḍanaṃ veṇughoṣavat”- iti; eṣa karṇanādakṣveḍayorbhedaḥ||9||

lg.l: śirobhighātād athavā nimajjato jale prapākād athavā'pi vidradheḥ |
sravet tu pūyaṃ śravaṇo 'nilāvṛtaḥ sa karṇasaṃsrāva iti prakīrtitaḥ ||10||

ab.seg: karṇasrāvamāha- śirobhighātādityādi| vidradheḥ karṇavidradheḥ||10||

lg.l: kaphena kaṇḍūḥ pracitena karṇayor bhṛśaṃ bhavet srotasi karṇasañjñite |11|

div.ab: karṇakaṇḍūmāha- kaphenetyādi| karṇayoḥ pracitena sañcitena śleṣmaṇā karṇasrotasi bhṛśamatyarthaṃ kaṇḍūrbhavediti sambandhaḥ|11|-

lg.l: viśoṣite śleṣmaṇi pittatejasā nṛṇāṃ bhavet srotasi karṇagūthakaḥ ||11||

ab.seg: karṇagūthakamāha- viśoṣita ityādi| srotasi sañcite śleṣmaṇi pittatejasā viśoṣite sati karṇagūthako bhavediti sambandhaḥ||11||

lg.l: sa karṇaviṭko dravatāṃ yadā gato vilāyito ghrāṇamukhaṃ prapadyate |
tadā sa karṇapratināhasañjñito bhaved vikāraḥ śiraso 'bhitāpanaḥ ||12||

ab.seg: karṇapratināhamāha- sa karṇetyādi| vilayanaṃ punaḥ snehasvedābhyām| kaphamārutābhyāṃ sannipātena vā videhoktatvāt| śiraso'bhitāpanaḥ sakalaśirovikārakārītyarthaḥ||12||

lg.l: yadā tu mūrcchanty athavā'pi jantavaḥ sṛjanty apatyāny athavā'pi makṣikāḥ |
tadañjanatvāc chravaṇo nirucyate bhiṣagbhir ādyaiḥ kṛmikarṇako gadaḥ ||13||

ab.seg: kṛmikarṇamāha- yadetyādi| mūrcchanti patanti| jantavo māṃsakothajāḥ kṛmayaḥ| apatyāni sūkṣmakṛmīn| makṣikā mambhaṇākhyā nīlamakṣikāḥ| tadañjanatvādityādi| ādyairbhiṣagbhistadañjanatvācchravaṇaḥ kṛmikarṇako nirukta iti sambandhaḥ| tadañjanatvāt kṛmilakṣaṇatvāt| ādyairbhiṣagbhiḥ videhādibhiḥ| ayaṃ rogaḥ sānnipātikaḥ, videhaproktatvāt||13||

lg.l: kṣatābhighātaprabhavas tu vidradhir bhavet tathā doṣakṛto 'paraḥ punaḥ |

ab.seg: karṇavidradhimāha- kṣatābhighātaprabhava ityādi| kṣatābhighātaprabhavastu vidradhirbhavediti chedaḥ| etena kṣatavidradhirdarśitaḥ| doṣakṛto'paraḥ doṣajanito dvitīyo vidradhiḥ| etena doṣajo darśitaḥ| sa caturvidhaḥ| kṣatavidradherlakṣaṇamāha- saraktapītāruṇamityādi| asraṃ raktam| dhūmāyanaṃ dhūmodvamanamiva vedanāviśeṣaḥ| coṣavān ācūṣyata iva| doṣavidradherlakṣaṇaṃ doṣaliṅgaireva jñātavyam| saraktapittāruṇetyādinā karṇapākalakṣaṇamuktamiti kecit kathayanti; tacca mahyaṃ na rocate, yato jejjaṭādīnāmīdṛśo'bhiprāyo nāsti||14||

lg.l: bhavet prapākaḥ khalu pittakopato vikothavikledakaraś ca karṇayoḥ |15|

div.ab: karṇapākalakṣaṇamāha- bhavet prapāka ityādi|15|-

lg.l: sthite kaphe srotasi pittatejasā vilāyyamāne bhṛśasampratāpavān ||15||
avedano vā'py athavā savedano ghanaṃ sravet pūti ca pūtikarṇakaḥ |16|

div.ab: pūtikarṇamāha- sthita ityādi| ghanaṃ nirantaraṃ vāraṃvāramityarthaḥ| anye ghanamiti pūyasya viśeṣaṇamāhuḥ| pūti pūyam||15||-

lg.l: pradiṣṭaliṅgāny araśāṃsi tattvatas tathaiva śophārbudaliṅgam īritam |
mayā purastāt prasamīkṣya yojayed ihaiva tāvat prayato bhiṣagvaraḥ ||16||

ab.seg: arśaḥśophārbudānyāha- pradiṣṭetyādi| śophārbudaliṅgaṃ śophasya arbudasya ca lakṣaṇamityarthaḥ| tattvataḥ paramārthataḥ| prasamīkṣya jñātvā| prayogajño vaidyaḥ||16||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre karṇagatarogavijñānīyo nāma viṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||20||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||20||

div.head: karṇagatarogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ karṇagatarogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi| pratiṣedhaḥ cikitsitam||1-2||

karṇarogāṇāṃ sāmānyaṃ cikitsitamāha- sāmānyamityādi| ghṛtapānamatra ūrdhvabhaktikam| aśiraḥsnānaṃ na śiraḥsnānamityarthaḥ| akatthanam abhāṣaṇam| rasāyanamityatra ‘rasāśanam’ iti kecit paṭhanti, māṃsarasena saha bhojanamiti vyākhyānayanti||3||

lg.l: caturṇām api rogāṇāṃ sāmānyaṃ bheṣajaṃ viduḥ ||4||

ab.seg: vātajānāṃ caturṇāṃ karṇaśūlādīnāmekahetutvādekāmeva cikitsāmāha- karṇaśūla ityādi||4||

kiṃ tat sāmānyaṃ cikitsitamityāha- snigdhamityādi| snigdhaṃ snehapānenābhyaṅgena ca| snehavirecitam eraṇḍatailādibhiḥ| svedādhyāye vyāmārdhamātretyādinā nāḍīsvedaḥ proktaḥ; piṇḍasvedaḥ kṛśarāpāyasādibhiḥ||5||

nāḍīsvedopayogidravyāṇyāha- bilvetyādi| varṣābhūḥ śvetapunarnavā, dadhitthaḥ kapitthaḥ, unmatto dhattūrakaḥ, śigruḥ śobhāñjanakaḥ, viṭapaśākamanye| bastagandhā bobayikā| tarkārī araṇikā, yavaveṇubhiriti veṇuyavaḥ annajātiḥ| bilvairaṇḍādibhiḥ āranālasiddhaiḥ kevalavātārabdhe kaphāvṛtavātārabdhe ca karṇaśūle svedaḥ prayojyaḥ; paraṃ kevalavātaje śūle snehapūrvaḥ svedaḥ, kaphāvṛte punaḥ rūkṣaḥ sveda iti||6-7||
piṇḍasvedopayogidravyāṇyāha- mīnakukkuṭalāvānāmityādi| payasā'pi veti ghanībhūtakṣīrapiṇḍenetyarthaḥ| etairmīnādibhirmāṃsapiṇḍaiḥ pṛthak samastairvā svedaḥ kāryaḥ||8||

lg.l: yat tailaṃ cyavate tasmāt khallād aṅgāratāpitāt |
tat prāptaṃ śravaṇasrotaḥ sadyo gṛhṇāti vedanām ||10||

ab.seg: śuddhavātaje śūle snehaviśeṣasvedamuddiśannāha- aśvatthapatretyādi| khallamiti dvikarṇikākāramityarthaḥ| abhyajya tailena ghṛtena vā, sātyakividehaproktatvāt||9-10||

lg.l: bhaktopari hitaṃ sarpir bastikarma ca pūjitam ||11||

ab.seg: karṇasvedasya paścātkarmāha- kṣaumetyādi| kṣaumam atasīvastraṃ, bastiratra śirobastiḥ||11||

lg.l: niranno niśi tat sarpiḥ pītvopari pibet payaḥ |

div.ab: idānīṃ nirannasya sāyameva asyāgre ‘koṣṇaṃ payonupānaṃ ca tailamapyādiśanti hi- pūrvaṃ śirobastikarma ca pūjitamityuktaṃ’ ityadhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate hastalikhitapustake koṣṇaṃ payo nirdiśannāha- niranna ityādi| nirannaḥ puruṣaḥ| niśi koṣṇaṃ payo'nupānaṃ ca sarpiḥ pibet| mūrdhetyādi| mastiṣkaḥ śirobastiviśeṣaḥ, sa ca snehapicuplotādinā'vacāryate| śatapākaṃ vātavyādhipaṭhitam| balātailaṃ mūḍhagarbhoktaṃ, anye tu balātailameva śatapākaṃ kṛtvopayujyata iti vyākhyānayanti||12||-

lg.l: kaṇṭakārīm ajākṣīre paktvā kṣīreṇa tena ca ||13||

div.ab: kaṇṭakārīmityādi| kaṇṭakārī catuṣpalapramāṇā, tadaṣṭaguṇaṃ kṣīraṃ, kṣīrāccaturguṇamudakaṃ dattvā vipacet, tena kṣīreṇa kukkuṭavasāṃ kuḍavāpramāṇāṃ pacet, tatkarṇayoḥ prapūraṇam||13||-

lg.l: kalkair eṣāṃ tathā'mlaiś ca pacet snehaṃ caturvidham |

ab.seg: aparamapi pūraṇamāha- taṇḍulīyaketyādi| vaṃśāvalekhanaṃ vaṃśāccholanam| kalko dṛṣadi peṣitaḥ, sa cādravaḥ, sa cāṣṭapalapramāṇaḥ, amlaiḥ dadhitakrasurācukramātuluṅgarasaiḥ pratyekamaṣṭāviṃśatyadhikaśatapramāṇaiḥ, snehaścaturvidhaḥ sarpistailavasāmajjasañjño dvātriṃśatpalapramāṇaḥ||14-16||

lg.l: śṛṅgaverarasaḥ kṣaudraṃ saindhavaṃ tailam eva ca |
kaduṣṇaṃ karṇayor deyam etad vā vedanāpaham ||18||

ab.seg: laśunārdraketyādi| śigruḥ madhuśigruḥ, muraṅgī dvitīyaḥ śobhāñjanakaḥ, kaduṣṇa īṣaduṣṇaḥ| eteṣāṃ laśunādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ svarasā vyastāḥ samastā vā karṇapūraṇe deyāḥ||17-18||

lg.l: sarpiḥ pacet tena karṇaṃ pūrayet karṇaśūlinaḥ ||19||

ab.seg: vaṃśetyādi| ‘mūtre cājāvike bhiṣak’ ityatra tantrāntaradarśanādviparyayeṇa sarpiḥpākaḥ kartavyaḥ; tena pūrvamāvike mūtre sarpiḥ paktavyaṃ, paścādāja iti| anye tu pūrvamāvikamūtrapakvena sarpiṣā karṇapūraṇaṃ, paścādājena mūtreṇeti viparyayaṃ vyākhyānayanti| kecit sarpiḥ pacedityatra tailaṃ pacediti paṭhanti; tanna, sarvanibandhaiḥ parihṛtatvāt||19||

lg.l: yat tailaṃ cyavate tebhyo dhṛtebhyo bhājanopari |
jñeyaṃ tad dīpikātailaṃ sadyo gṛhṇāti vedanām ||21||

ab.seg: dīpikātailamāha- mahata ityādi| kāṇḍaṃ khaṇḍaṃ, kṣaumeṇa atasīvastreṇa, āveṣṭya ‘tribhāgam’ iti śeṣaḥ| ghṛtebhyo ‘adhomukham’ iti śeṣaḥ| gṛhṇāti apaharati||20-21||

lg.l: kuryād evaṃ bhadrakāṣṭhe kuṣṭhe kāṣṭhe ca sārale |

ab.seg: kuryādevamityādi| cakārādagurvairaṇḍāgnimanthakāṣṭhāni gṛhyante||22||
arkāṅkurānityādi| ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ sarvanibandhakārairanārṣīkṛtastasmānna vyākhyātaḥ||23-26||
aṣṭānāmityādi| aṣṭānāṃ mūtrāṇāmanyatamenaikatamena||27||

lg.l: mūtreṣv amleṣu vātaghne gaṇe ca kvathite bhiṣak |
pacec caturvidhaṃ snehaṃ pūraṇaṃ tac ca karṇayoḥ ||28||

ab.seg: mūtreṣvityādi| mūtrāṇi gavādīnāmaṣṭānām| amlāni surāmastvāranālabījapūracukrāṇi| vātaghno gaṇo vidārigandhādiḥ||28||

lg.l: etā eva kriyāḥ kuryāt pittaghnaiḥ pittasaṃyute |29|

div.ab: vātajakarṇaroge kriyāmabhidhāya pittajakarṇaśūlacikitsāmāha- etā ityādi| etā eva dīpikādayaḥ kriyāḥ| tatra dīpikā aśvatthapatrakhallasnehasarpiṣā karṇapūraṇaṃ; kāñjikenāpi, tasya sparśane pittaharatvāt| pittasaṃyute karṇaśūle ityarthaḥ|29|-

lg.l: kākolyādau daśakṣīraṃ tiktaṃ cātra hitaṃ haviḥ ||29||

ab.seg: pittajakarṇaśule sāmānyacikitsāmabhidhāya viśeṣacikitsāmāha- kākolyādāvityādi| kākolyādikalkena daśaguṇakṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ hitaṃ, tathā tiktaṃ tiktadravyasaṃskṛtam; anye tu tiktaṃ kuṣṭhacikitsitoktaṃ ghṛtaṃ kathayanti| kṣīravṛkṣā nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaplakṣagardabhāṇḍāḥ, teṣāṃ pallavakvāthena kākolyādikalkena siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ hitam| madhuke candane tatheti pratyekaṃ yaṣṭīmadhukacandanakvāthakalkābhyāṃ siddham| śarkarāmadhukairityatra yaṣṭīmadhukadvitayaṃ, ata eva bahutvam| saraiḥ virecanadravyairityarthaḥ| jejjaṭācāryastu kṣīravṛkṣapravāleṣvityekaṃ yogaṃ kathayati, bimbīkvātha iti dvitīyaṃ; tau ca yogāvanārṣau kathayanti||29-30||

lg.l: tiktauṣadhānāṃ yūṣāś ca svedāś ca kaphanāśanāḥ ||31||

ab.seg: śleṣmaśūlasya cikitsāmāha- iṅgudīsarṣapetyādi| sakaphe ‘karṇaśūle’ ityadhyāhāraḥ| tiktetyādi| svedāśca kaphanāśanā iti tāpoṣmasvedā rūkṣāḥ||31||

lg.l: surasādau kṛtaṃ tailaṃ pañcamūle mahaty api |
ekaikaḥ pūraṇe pathyas tailaṃ teṣv api vā kṛtam |
tīkṣṇā mūrdhavirekāś ca kavalāś cātra pūjitāḥ ||33||

ab.seg: surasādau kṛtamityādi| tailadvitayametat| mātuluṅgarasa ityādi| mātuluṅgarasādinā ekaikenaiva siddhaṃ tailaṃ pūraṇe pathyamityarthaḥ| tīkṣṇā ityādi| tīkṣṇā mūrdhavirekā iti apāmārgabījādibhiḥ| tīkṣṇāḥ kavalāḥ pippalyādibhiḥ||32-33||

div.ab: śoṇitaśūlasya cikitsāmāha- karṇetyādi| kecidamuṃ pāṭhaṃ na paṭhanti|34|-

lg.l: sāmānyato, viśeṣeṇa ‘viśeṣastu’ iti pā. bādhirye pūraṇaṃ śṛṇu |
gavāṃ mūtreṇa bilvāni piṣṭvā tailaṃ vipācayet ||35||
sajalaṃ ca sadugdhaṃ ca bādhirye karṇapūraṇam |36|

div.ab: śūletyādi| pañjikākārastu ‘sajalaṃ ca sadugdhaṃ ca’ ityatra pādikaṃ jaladugdhābhyāṃ iti paṭhati||34-35||-

sitāmadhuketyādi| sitāmadhukabimbībhiḥ kalkitābhiśchāgīkṣīre caturguṇe pakvaṃ tilatailamuṣṇameva bimbīkvāthe mathitvā śītībhūtaṃ pāṇinā''dāya punarapi bilvaphalakvāthe viloḍitaṃ sitaśarkarāyaṣṭīmadhuraktacandanaiḥ kalkīkṛtairdaśaguṇe kṣīre vipacet| kecid ‘bilvāmbugāḍhaṃ’ ityatra ‘bimbyambugāḍhaṃ’ iti paṭhanti||36-37||-

lg.l: vakṣyate yaḥ pratiśyāye vidhiḥ so 'py atra pūjitaḥ ||38||

ab.seg: idānīṃ bādhirye kaphānubandho'pyastītyanāgatāvekṣaṇena saṅkṣepārthamatideśena cikitsāmāha- vakṣyate ya ityādi| so'pyatra pūjita iti ‘navaṃ pratiśyāyamapāsya sarvamupācaret sarpiṣa eva pānaiḥ’ ityādinoktaḥ||38||

lg.l: vātavyādhiṣu yaś cokto vidhiḥ sa ca hito bhavet |39|

div.ab: śuddhavātakṛte punaratītāvekṣaṇena saṅkṣepārthamatideśena nirdiśannāha- vātavyādhiṣvityādi| vātavyādhyukto vidhiḥ nivātabrahmacaryādikaḥ|39|-

lg.l: samānaṃ karma kurvīta yogān vaiśeṣikān api |40|

div.ab: karma cikitsām||39||-

ab.seg: kiṃ tat samānaṃ karmetyāha- śirovirecanamityādi| pramārjanaṃ picukūrcikayā karṇaproñchanaṃ, dhāvanaṃ prakṣālanam| vīkṣya vīkṣyeti pratyekaṃ karṇaprasrāvādiṣu doṣadūṣyādimalaviśeṣaṃ ‘doṣadūṣyādibalaviśeṣaṃ’ iti pā. dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvetyarthaḥ| rājavṛkṣāditoyenetyādi| rājavṛkṣādiḥ āragvadhādiḥ||40-41||

lg.l: karṇaprakṣālanaṃ kāryaṃ cūrṇair eṣāṃ ca pūraṇam |
