ab.seg: samānaṃ karmābhidhāya vaiśeṣikān yogānāha- karṇetyādi| pañcakaṣāyamasminnevādhyāye ‘tindukānyabhayā rodhraṃ samaṅgā''malakaṃ’ ityādinā paṭhiṣyati, anye tu āragvadhaśirīṣajambusarjāśvakarṇajaṃ pañcakaṣāyacūrṇaṃ kathayanti, tacca ṭīkāpañjikābhyāṃ nāṅgīkṛtam| sarjatvagityādi| kārpāsī vanakārpāsī| śaivalaṃ dūrvā, haṭhamityanye| mahāvṛkṣaḥ sehuṇḍaḥ, prasavāḥ pallavāḥ| kulīraḥ karkaṭaśṛṅgī, maṇḍūkī brāhmībhedaḥ| śaivalādikaṃ prasavaparyantaṃ kaṣāyadravyaṃ, kulīrādikaṃ ca kalkadravyam| pūjitaṃ ‘karṇasrāve karṇapūraṇam’ ityadhyāhāryam||42-45||

lg.l: pūraṇaṃ cātra ‘cātipathyaṃ syāt’ iti pā. pathyaṃ syāt kapittharasayojitam ||46||

ab.seg: tindukānyabhayā rodhramityādi| samaṅgā añjalikārikā, ‘varāhakrāntā’ ityapare| idaṃ pañcakaṣāyacūrṇam||46||

lg.l: pūraṇārthaṃ praśaṃsanti tailaṃ vā tair vipācitam ||47||
pacet tailaṃ tad āsrāvam avagṛhṇāti pūraṇāt |49|

div.ab: rasamāmretyādi| āmrādipallavānāṃ rasaḥ svarasa eva ekaikaḥ samasto vā karṇapūraṇam, tairvipakvaṃ vā tilatailaṃ pūyasrāve pūraṇam| priyaṅgumadhukāmbaṣṭhetyādi| priyaṅgvādikalkaiḥ kapitthapallavarasena caturguṇena tilatailaṃ siddhaṃ karṇasrāvāpaham| ambaṣṭhā sāṅkuraḍā, śilā manaḥśilā, parṇī śālaparṇī||47-48||-
idānīṃ pūtikarṇasya viśeṣacikitsāṃ yogadvayenāha- ghṛṣṭamityādi||49-50||-

ab.seg: kṛmikarṇe vaiśeṣikamāha- kṛmikarṇakanāśārthamityādi| kṛmighno vidhiḥ krimipratiṣedhe ‘karṇapratiṣedhe’ iti pā. vakṣyamāṇaḥ||51||

lg.l: vārtākudhūmaś ca hitaḥ sārṣapasneha eva ca |52|

div.ab: aparamapi viśeṣacikitsitamāha- vārtākudhūma ityādi| pariṇataśuṣkavārtākudhūmasya pānaṃ karṇadhūpanaṃ ca, sārṣapasnehena karṇapūraṇaṃ, tantrāntaroktatvāt|52|-

lg.l: chardanaṃ dhūmapānaṃ ca kavalasya ca dhāraṇam ||53||

ab.seg: kṛmikṛtadaurgandhyacikitsāmāha- kṛmighnamityādi| kṛmighnaṃ viḍaṅgasāracūrṇaṃ, tacca haritālacūrṇena yutaṃ gomūtreṇa pūraṇaṃ, guggulunā dhūpanam| chardanamityādi| kecicchardanādikaṃ kriyātritayaṃ trayāṇāmāsrāvādīnāṃ hitamāhuḥ; tanna, yataḥ kṛmikṛtadaurgandhyasānnidhyādvidehādiṣvasya ‘videhādiṣvapyadarśanāt’ iti pā. darśanād daurgandhya eva chardanāditritayaṃ hitam||52-53||

lg.l: karṇakṣveḍe hitaṃ tailaṃ sārṣapaṃ caiva pūraṇam |

ab.seg: karṇakṣveḍe hitamityādi| karṇakṣveḍe yat sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ pūraṇe uktaṃ tadvidradhāvapi kurvīta; na kevalaṃ tadeva kurvīta vidradhyuktaṃ cikitsitamapi kurvītetyarthaḥ| vātaje āme savedane vidradhau tilatailena sekaḥ, kaphaje punaḥ sārṣapataileneti||54||

lg.l: prakledya dhīmāṃs tailena svedena pravilāyya ca |
śodhayet karṇaviṭkaṃ tu bhiṣak samyak śalākayā ||55||

ab.seg: karṇagūthacikitsāmāha- prakledyetyādi||55||

lg.l: vidhiś ca kaphahṛt sarvaḥ karṇakaṇḍūm apohati ||56||

ab.seg: karṇakaṇḍūcikitsāmāha- nāḍīsveda ityādi| vamanaṃ sasvedavamanaṃ, dhūmo'tra vairecanikaḥ||56||
karṇapratīnāhe cikitsāmāha- athetyādi| kriyāṃ snehasvedanasyādikāṃ, prāptāṃ yuktām||57||

div.ab: karṇapāke cikitsāmāha- karṇapākasyetyādi| śītālepanapariṣekādīṃśca taccikitsitoktān kuryāt|58|-
śārīradoṣabhavakarṇagūthapratyākarṣaṇacikitsāprasaṅgenāgantukīṭamalādīnāmākarṣaṇacikitsāmāha- karṇacchidra ityādi| śṛṅgeṇāpaharet ‘ācūṣya’ iti śeṣaḥ||58||-

lg.l: śeṣāṇāṃ tu vikārāṇāṃ prāk cikitsitam īritam ||59||

ab.seg: idānīṃ śālakyasiddhāntena caturvidhānāmarśasāṃ saptavidhānāmarbudānāṃ caturvidhānāṃ śophānāṃ kiṃ cikitsitamiti pṛṣṭhaḥ śālākyatantrasya nyūnatādoṣaṃ parijihīrṣurāha- śeṣāṇāmityādi| śeṣāṇāṃ caturvidhānāmarśasāṃ, saptavidhānām arbudānāṃ, caturvidhānāṃ śophānāṃ cetyarthaḥ| prāgiti arśaādicikitsite| īritaṃ pratidoṣaṃ pratyavasthaṃ sarvamuktamityarthaḥ||59||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre karṇagatarogapratiṣedho nāmaikaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||21||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre ekaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||21||

div.head: nāsāgatarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto nāsāgatarogavijñānīyam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi| gataśabda āśrayavacanaḥ, tena nāsāśritarogavijñānamadhikṛtya kṛto'dhyāyo nāsāgatarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ||1-2||

lg.l: apīnasaḥ pūtinasyaṃ ‘pūtināsaḥ’ iti pā. nāsāpākas tathaiva ca |
tathā śoṇitapittaṃ ca pūyaśoṇitam eva ca ||3||
catvāry arśāṃsi catvāraḥ śophāḥ saptārbudāni ca |
pratiśyāyāś ca ye pañca vakṣyante sacikitsitāḥ |
ekatriṃśanmitās te ‘ekatriṃśatsahitaistaistu’ iti pā. tu nāsārogāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||5||

ab.seg: nāsārogān nāmabhiḥ saṅkhyayā cāha- apīnasa ityādi| saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva saṅkhyāyāṃ labdhāyāṃ bhūyaḥ saṅkhyākaraṇaṃ niyamārthaṃ; tena videhoktasaṅkhyayā adhikatvaṃ mā bhūt| ‘apīnasaḥ pūtipākau pittāsṛk pūyaśoṇitam’ iti kecit paṭhanti||3-5||

lg.l: ānahyate yasya vidhūpyate ca praklidyate śuṣyati ‘pāpacyate klidyati’ iti pā. cāpi nāsā |
na vetti yo gandharasāṃś ca jantur juṣṭaṃ vyavasyet tam apīnasena ||6||

div.ab: apīnasalakṣaṇamāha- ānahyata ityādi| ānahyate kaphena pittaśoṣitena ānahyata iva| vidhūpyate dhūmāyata iva, pittāt; praklidyate ārdrībhavati kaphāt; śuṣyati pittāt| gandharasān gandhān rasāṃścetyarthaḥ; anye tu gandhasya rasā gandharasāḥ, rasatergatyarthatvāt; yāthātathyena gandhaṃ jānātītyarthaḥ| vyavasyet jānīyāt| kecidamuṃ pāṭhamanyathā paṭhanti, sa cādarśanānna likhitaḥ||6||-

lg.l: doṣair vidagdhair galatālumūle saṃvāsito yasya samīraṇas tu ||7||
nireti pūtir mukhanāsikābhyāṃ taṃ pūtināsaṃ pravadanti rogam |8|

div.ab: pūtināsasya lakṣaṇamāha- doṣairityādi| raktamapi doṣatvena vivakṣitaṃ, tena doṣairiti bahuvacanam| vidagdhaiḥ mūrcchitaiḥ svarūpapracyutairvā| saṃvāsitaḥ pittaśleṣmaraktairātmavikṛtigandhena miśrīkṛtaḥ| nireti nirgacchati, pūtiḥ śaṭitagandho vāyuḥ||7||-

lg.l: ghrāṇāśritaṃ pittam arūṃṣi kuryād yasmin vikāre balavāṃś ca pākaḥ ||8||
taṃ nāsikāpākam iti vyavasyed vikledakothāv api yatra dṛṣṭau |9|

div.ab: nāsāpākasya lakṣaṇamāha- ghrāṇāśritamityādi| arūṃṣi vraṇān| vikleda ārdrabhāvaḥ, kothaḥ pūtibhāvaḥ, etau yatra yasmin vikāre, dṛṣṭau darśanaṃ gatau||8||-

lg.l: caturvidhaṃ dviprabhavaṃ dvimārgaṃ vakṣyāmi bhūyaḥ khalu raktapittam ||9||

ab.seg: raktapittalakṣaṇamanāgatāvekṣaṇena nirdiśannāha- caturvidhamityādi| caturvidhaṃ vātapittakaphasannipātātmakam| dviprabhavaṃ dvau prabhavau yakṛtplīhānau yasya taṃ tathā; anye tu snigdharūkṣoṣṇabhedena dvirutpattikāraṇaṃ manyante; apare tu dviprabhavamāmāśayapakvāśayaprabhavamāhuḥ| dvimārgam adharottaramārgadvayam||9||

lg.l: doṣair vidagdhair atha vā'pi jantor lalāṭadeśe 'bhihatasya tais tu |
nāsā sravet pūyam asṛgvimiśraṃ taṃ pūyaraktaṃ pravadanti rogam ||10||

ab.seg: pūyaraktaṃ doṣāgantunimittaṃ darśayannāha- doṣairityādi| vidagdhaiḥ pittaraktādhikyādviruddhāṃ pariṇatiṃ prāptaiḥ| lalāṭābhighāto'pi viruddhapākaṃ prāpto mantavyaḥ||10||

lg.l: ghrāṇāśrite marmaṇi sampraduṣṭe ‘sampraduṣṭaḥ’ iti pā. yasyānilo nāsikayā nireti ||11||
kaphānuyāto bahuśaḥ saśabdas taṃ rogam āhuḥ kṣavathuṃ vidhijñāḥ |12|

div.ab: kṣavathurapi doṣajaścāgantujaśca, tatra pūrvaṃ doṣajameva nirdiśannāha- ghrāṇetyādi| ghrāṇāśrite marmaṇi śṛṅgāṭakākhye; ‘ghrāṇāśrite marmaṇi’ ityatra ‘ghrāṇāśrite śleṣmaṇi’ iti kecit paṭhanti||11||-

lg.l: tīkṣṇopayogād atijighrato vā bhāvān kaṭūn arkanirīkṣaṇād vā ||12||
sūtrādibhir vā taruṇāsthimarmaṇy udghāṭite 'nyaḥ kṣavathur nireti |13|

div.ab: āgantujaṃ kṣavathumāha- tīkṣṇopayogādityādi| atijighrataḥ āghrāyataḥ| bhāvān dravyāṇi| taruṇāsthimarma nāsāvaṃśāsthimarma śṛṅgāṭakasañjñam| udghāṭite ūrdhvaṃ cālite||12||-

lg.l: prabhraśyate nāsikayaiva yaś ca ‘yasya’ iti pā. sāndro vidagdho lavaṇaḥ kaphas tu ||13||
prāk sañcito mūrdhani pittataptas taṃ bhraṃśathuṃ vyādhim udāharanti |14|

div.ab: bhraṃśathorlakṣaṇamāha- prabhraśyata ityādi| prabhraśyate atyarthamadhaḥ patati nāsikayaiva, na mukhena||13||-

lg.l: ghrāṇe bhṛśaṃ dāhasamanvite tu viniḥsared dhūma iveha vāyuḥ ||14||
nāsā pradīpteva ca yasya jantor vyādhiṃ tu taṃ dīptam udāharanti |15|

div.ab: dīptalakṣaṇamāha- ghrāṇe bhṛśamityādi| viniḥsaret niryāti| vāyuḥ niśvāsaḥ| pradīpteva jvaliteva nāsā syāt||14||-

lg.l: kaphāvṛto vāyur udānasañjño yadā svamārge viguṇaḥ sthitaḥ syāt ||15||
ghrāṇaṃ vṛṇotīva tadā sa rogo nāsāpratīnāha iti pradiṣṭaḥ |16|

div.ab: nāsāpratīnāhalakṣaṇamāha- kaphāvṛta ityādi| nāsā pratinahyate badhyata iva vāteneti nāsāpratīnāhaḥ||15||-

lg.l: ajasram acchaṃ salilaprakāśaṃ yasyāvivarṇaṃ sravatīha nāsā ||16||
rātrau viśeṣeṇa hi taṃ vikāraṃ nāsāparisrāvam iti vyavasyet |17|

div.ab: nāsāparisrāvamāha- ajasramacchamityādi| ajasram anavaratam| avivarṇam aviśiṣṭavarṇam| atra roge srāvaḥ śṛṅgāṭakākhyasrotasi pravilāyitāt kaphāt| vyavasyet jānīyāt||16||-

lg.l: ghrāṇāśrite śleṣmaṇi mārutena pittena gāḍhaṃ pariśoṣite ca ||17||
samucchvasity ūrdhvam adhaś ca kṛcchrād yas tasya nāsāpariśoṣa uktaḥ |18|

div.ab: nāsāśoṣalakṣaṇamāha- ghrāṇāśrite ityādi| gāḍham atiśayena||17||-

lg.l: doṣais tribhis taiḥ pṛthag ekaśaś ca brūyāt tathā'rśāṃsi tathaiva śophān ||18||
śālākyasiddhāntam avekṣya cāpi sarvātmakaṃ saptamam arbudaṃ tu |19|

div.ab: idānīmuktānāmarśaādīnāṃ sāmānyena lakṣaṇamāha- doṣairityādi| pṛthagdoṣaiḥ trīṇyarśāṃsi, sannipātenaikaṃ, evaṃ catvāryarśāṃsi| tathaiva śophāniti śophā api catvāra ityarthaḥ| śālākyasiddhāntamavekṣyeti ‘vātena pittena kaphena cāpi’ ityādinā nidānasthāne ṣaḍarbudāni nirdiṣṭāni, saptamaṃ sarvātmakaṃ śālākyatantre||18||-

lg.l: rogaḥ pratiśyāya ihopadiṣṭaḥ sa vakṣyate pañcavidhaḥ purastāt ||19||

ab.seg: pratiśyāyasyānāgatāvekṣaṇena saṅkṣepārthaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ nirdiśannāha- roga ityādi||19||

div.ab: nanu, sarvāṅgagatānāṃ kuṣṭhādīnāmapyatra nāsāyāṃ sambhavo'stīti nāsārogāṇaṃ saṅkhyātirekamāśaṅkyāha- nāsāsrotogatā rogā ityādi| nāsāsrotasi gatā eva ye rogāsta eva mayaikatriṃśaduktāḥ, na punaratra nāsāyāṃ ye bhavanti|20|-

lg.l: srotaḥpathe yad vipulaṃ kośavac cārbudaṃ bhavet ayaṃ śloko hārāṇacandreṇa na paṭhitaḥ ) ||20||

ab.seg: nāsāgataśophān nāsārbudalakṣaṇena pṛthakkurvannāha- srota ityādi| kośaḥ antaḥpūraṇavastu, yādṛśamasyāntaḥpūraṇavastu tādṛśamantaḥpūraṇakaraṃ vastu śothasya nāstītyarthaḥ||20||

śophāḥ punaḥ kīdṛśā ityāha- śophā ityādi| śopho vijñānaṃ yeṣāṃ te śophavijñānāḥ; athavā prāguktaśophānāmiva vijñānaṃ yeṣāmiti| nidāne'rśāṃsītyādi| eṣa pāṭho dviruktibhayānnibandhakārairna paṭhitaḥ||21||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre nāsāgatarogavijñānīyo nāma dvāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||22||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||22||

div.head: nāsāgatarogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto nāsāgatarogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi||1-2||

lg.l: pūrvoddiṣṭe pūtinasye ca jantoḥ snehasvedau chardanaṃ sraṃsanaṃ ca |
yuktaṃ bhaktaṃ tīkṣṇam alpaṃ laghu syād uṣṇaṃ toyaṃ dhūmapānaṃ ca kāle ||3||

ab.seg: apīnasapūtinasyayościkitsāmāha- pūrvoddiṣṭe ityādi| pūrvoddiṣṭe apīnase ityarthaḥ| chardanaṃ vamanaṃ, sraṃsanaṃ virekaḥ| kṛtaśuddherantaḥsaṃsargaṃ niyamayannāha- yuktamityādi| toyasya pānaṃ niyamayannāha- uṣṇaṃ toyamityādi| kāle dhūmapānakāle||3||

lg.l: hiṅgu vyoṣaṃ vatsakākhyaṃ śivāṭī lākṣā bījaṃ saurabhaṃ kaṭphalaṃ ca |
ugrā kuṣṭhaṃ tīkṣṇagandhā viḍaṅgaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ nityaṃ cāvapīḍe karañjam ||4||

ab.seg: tayorevāvapīḍamuddiśannāha- hiṅgu vyoṣamityādi| vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukam| śivāṭī śvetapunarnavā, śephāliketyanye| ugrā vacā, tīkṣṇagandhā śobhāñjanakaḥ| avapīḍya dīyata ityāvapīḍaḥ| kecidamumeva pāṭhamanyathā paṭhanti, sa cādarśanānna likhitaḥ||4||

lg.l: etair dravyaiḥ sārṣapaṃ mūtrayuktaṃ tailaṃ dhīmān nasyahetoḥ paceta |5|

div.ab: apīnasapūtinasyayoretairevāvapīḍanadravyairnasyārthaṃ tailasādhanamāha- etairdravyairityādi| kecit ‘asmin taile yuktitaḥ sampaceta mañjiṣṭhāṃ vai srotasi mrakṣaṇārthaṃ, iti paṭhanti, sa cācāryairanārṣīkṛtaḥ|5|-

lg.l: nāsāpāke pittahṛtsaṃvidhānaṃ kāryaṃ sarvaṃ bāhyam ābhyantaraṃ ca ||5||
hṛtvā raktaṃ kṣīravṛkṣatvacaś ca sājyāḥ sekā yojanīyāś ca lepāḥ |6|

div.ab: nāsāpāke bheṣajamāha- nāsāpāke ityādi| bāhmaṃ lepābhyaṅgapariṣekādi, ābhyantaraṃ punarāhārasnehapānavirecanādi| sājyāḥ saghṛtāḥ||5||-

raktapittasyānāgatāvekṣaṇena saṅkṣepārthaṃ cikitsitamāha- vakṣyāmyūrdhvamityādi| ūrdhvaṃ raktapittapratiṣedhe| upaśāntiṃ cikitsitaṃ ‘nāsāpravṛtte jalamāśu deyaṃ saśarkaraṃ nāsikayā payo vā’ ityādikam|6|-

ab.seg: pūyaraktasya vidhānamāha- nāḍīvadityādi| pūyarakte nāḍīvat nāḍītulyā cikitsā, yā visarpanāḍīstanarogacikitsite vyākhyātā||6||

lg.l: vānte samyak cāvapīḍaṃ vadanti tīkṣṇaṃ dhūmaṃ śodhanaṃ cātra nasyam |7|

div.ab: pūyarakte sāmānyāṃ cikitsāmabhidhāya viśeṣacikitsāmāha- vānte ityādi| atra pūyarakte; anye tu ‘atreti nāsāpāke’ iti vyākhyānayanti| kecit ‘vānte samyak’ ityādikaṃ kṣavathau bhraṃśathau ca yojayanti|7|-

lg.l: kṣepyaṃ nasyaṃ mūrdhavairecanīyair nāḍyā cūrṇaṃ kṣavathau bhraṃśathau ca ||7||
kuryāt svedān mūrdhni vātāmayaghnān snigdhān dhūmān yadyadanyadvitaṃ ca |8|

div.ab: kṣavathau bhraṃśathau ca cikitsāmāha- kṣepyamityādi| nasyamiti pradhamanamityarthaḥ, pañcavidhatvānnasyasya| mūrdhavairecanīyaiḥ śirovirecanadravyaiḥ| pradhamanena kṣīṇe kaphe vāte ca vṛddhe sati anilaghnān snigdhānityarthaḥ| anyaditi śirobastimastiṣkādikam||7||-

lg.l: dīpte roge paittikaṃ saṃvidhānaṃ kuryāt sarvaṃ svādu yac chītalaṃ ca ||8||

ab.seg: dīptarogasya cikitsāmāha- dīpte ityādi| saṃvidhānaṃ karmetyarthaḥ, sarvaṃ bāhmābhyantaram||8||

lg.l: nāsānāhe snehapānaṃ pradhānaṃ snigdhā dhūmā mūrdhabastiś ca nityam |
balātailaṃ sarvathaivopayojyaṃ vātavyādhāv anyad uktaṃ ca yad yat ||9||

ab.seg: nāsānāhacikitsāmāha- nāsānāhe snehapānamityādi| snehapānam uttarabhaktakam| mūrdhabastiśceti cakārāt sālvaṇopanāhādayo gṛhyante| sarvathaiveti pānābhyaṅgānuvāsanaśirobastimastiṣkādibhiḥ sarvaireva prakāraiḥ| anyat aṇutailādikam||9||

lg.l: nāsāsrāve ghrāṇataś cūrṇam uktaṃ nāḍyā deyaṃ yo 'vapīḍaś ca tīkṣṇaḥ |
tīkṣṇaṃ dhūmaṃ devadārvagnikābhyāṃ māṃsaṃ vā''jaṃ yuktam atrādiśanti ||10||

ab.seg: nāsāsrāvacikitsāmāha- nāsasrāve ityādi| uktaṃ cūrṇaṃ śirovirecanadravyakṛtam| tīkṣṇo'vapīḍo ‘hiṅgu vyoṣaṃ vatsakākhyaṃ’ ityādinā ihaivādhyāye proktaḥ| agnikaḥ citrakaḥ, ajamodāmanye| ājaṃ māṃsaṃ ‘bhojane’ iti śeṣaḥ||10||

lg.l: nāsāśoṣe kṣīrasarpiḥ pradhānaṃ siddhaṃ tailaṃ cāṇukalpena nasyam |
sarpiḥpānaṃ bhojanaṃ jāṅgalaiś ca snehaḥ svedaḥ snaihikaś cāpi dhūmaḥ ||11||

ab.seg: nāsāśoṣe cikitsāmāha- nāsāśoṣe kṣīrasarpirityādi| kṣīrasarpiḥ ādita uktam| pradhānaṃ śreṣṭham| nasye nasyaviṣaye| aṇukalpena aṇutailavidhānena vātavyādhyuktena| sarpiḥpānam antarbhaktakam| jāṅgalaiḥ eṇādimāṃsaiḥ, snehaḥ sveda ityarthaḥ| snaihiko dhūmo madhūcchiṣṭādibhiḥ||11||

lg.l: śeṣān rogān ghrāṇajān sanniyacched uktaṃ teṣāṃ yad yathā saṃvidhānam ||12||

ab.seg: arśaḥprabhṛtīnāṃ cikitsāmāha- śeṣānityādi| śeṣān rogānarśaḥśophādīn, sanniyacchet cikitset| uktaṃ saṃvidhānaṃ sve sve cikitsite||12||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre nāsāgatarogapratiṣedho nāma trayoviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||23||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||23||

div.head: pratiśyāyapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ pratiśyāyapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi| vātaṃ prati abhimukhaṃ śyāyo gamanaṃ kaphādīnāṃ yatra sa pratiśyāyaḥ| pratiṣedhaḥ cikitsitam||1-2||

lg.l: nārīprasaṅgaḥ śiraso 'bhitāpo dhūmo rajaḥ śītam atipratāpaḥ |
sandhāraṇaṃ mūtrapurīṣayoś ca sadyaḥ pratiśyāyanidānam uktam ||3||

ab.seg: tacca cikitsitamalakṣitānāṃ vyādhīnāṃ na sambhavati, ataḥ pratiśyāyalakṣaṇārthaṃ pūrvaṃ sadyojanakameva nidānaṃ nirdiśannāha- nārīprasaṅga ityādi| nārīprasaṅgo nārīṣvatiśayena pravṛttiḥ| śiraḥ abhitapyate yena sa śirobhitāpaḥ| (śirobhitāpo ayaṃ pāṭho hastalikhitapustake nopalabhyate dhūmādiḥ, rajodhūmacayāśca nāsāpraviṣṭā hetavaḥ)| kecidamuṃ pāṭhaṃ na paṭhanti; tanna, yataḥ sarvanibandhakārairaṅgīkṛto'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ||3||

lg.l: cayaṃ gatā mūrdhani mārutādayaḥ pṛthak samastāś ca tathaiva śoṇitam |
prakopyamāṇā vividhaiḥ prakopaṇair nṛṇāṃ pratiśyāyakarā bhavanti hi ||4||

ab.seg: sadyojanakaṃ nidānamabhidhāya cayādikrameṇa| kālāntarajanakamapi nidānamāha- cayamityādi| cayaṃ gatāḥ arthāt sve sve sthāne sañcayaṃ prāptāḥ| mūrdhanīti mūrdhani pratiśyāyakarā bhavantīti yojanīyam| yadi sve sve sthāne citāstat kathaṃ mūrdhani pratiśyāyakarā ityāha- prakopyamāṇā ityādi| vividhaiḥ prakopaṇaiḥ balavadvigrahādibhiḥ krodhādibhirdivāsvapnādibhiśca| anye tu mūrdhani sañcayaṃ prāptā doṣā iti vyākhyānayanti| nanu svasthānavṛddhiḥ sañcayaḥ, vātapittakapharaktānāṃ śirasi sthānaṃ nāsti, tatkathaṃ mūrdhani vātādīnāṃ sañcayaḥ? satyaṃ, ‘yo vāyurvaktrasañcārī’ ityādinā vāyoḥ śirasi sthānamuktaṃ, pittasya tvagdṛṣṭiśceti śirasi sthānadvayaṃ, śleṣmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ śirasi prasiddhameva, sirāṇāṃ sarvagatvādraktasyāpi ‘sarvasaratvāt’ iti pā. śirasi sthānaṃ, tasmāt śirasi sañcayaṃ gatā iti yuktam||4||

lg.l: upadravāś cāpy apare pṛthagvidhā nṛṇāṃ pratiśyāyapuraḥsarāḥ smṛtāḥ ||5||

ab.seg: pratiśyāyasya pūrvarūpamāha- śirogurutvamityādi| kṣavathoḥ pravartanaṃ chikkāyāḥ pravṛttiḥ| aṅgamardo vedanāviśeṣaḥ| parihṛṣṭaromatā ucchūnaromatā, uddharṣitaromāñca iti yāvat| pṛthagvidhā upadravā jvarārocakādayaḥ| puraḥsarā agragāminaḥ, pūrvarūpāṇītyarthaḥ||5||

div.ab: vātajapratiśyāyasya lakṣaṇamāha- ānaddhā pihitetyādi| ānaddhā ādhmātā pūriteva| pihitā rajaḥśūkapūrṇeva||6||-

lg.l: uṣṇaḥ sapītakaḥ srāvo ghrāṇāt sravati paittike ||7||
sadhūmaṃ sahasā vahniṃ vamatīva ca mānavaḥ ||8||

ab.seg: pittapratiśyāyasya lakṣaṇamāha- uṣṇa ityādi| sapītaka īṣatpīta ityarthaḥ| sadhūmamiti sadhūmamiva vahniṃ nāsayā vamatītyarthaḥ| sahasā akasmāt||7-8||

lg.l: kaphaḥ kaphakṛte ghrāṇāc chuklaḥ śītaḥ sraven muhuḥ |

div.ab: kaphakṛtapratiśyāyaliṅgamāha- kapha ityādi| kaphakṛte pratiśyāye kaphaḥ sravediti sambandhanīyam||9||-

lg.l: sampakvo vā'py apakvo vā sa sarvaprabhavaḥ smṛtaḥ |
liṅgāni caiva sarveṣāṃ pīnasānāṃ ca sarvaje ||11||

ab.seg: sānnipātikasya liṅgaṃ nirdiśannāha- bhūtvetyādi| akasmāt kāraṇaṃ vinā| sarvaje pratiśyāye sarveṣāṃ vātādijānāṃ pratiśyāyānāṃ pīnasānāṃ liṅgāni bhavantīti yojyam| sānnipātikapratiśyāyo'sādhyaḥ, videhoktatvāt||10-11||

lg.l: durgandhocchvāsavadanas tathā gandhān na vetti ca |
mūrcchanti cātra kṛmayaḥ śvetāḥ snigdhās tathā'ṇavaḥ ‘kṛṣṇāḥ’ iti pā.||13||

div.ab: raktajapratiśyāyasya lakṣaṇamāha- raktaje ityādi| uroghātastantrāntaroktalakṣaṇaḥ tena prakarṣeṇa pīḍitaḥ| tadeva tantrāntaroktalakṣaṇaṃ darśayati,- “uraḥkṣataṃ guru stabdhaṃ pūtipūrṇakapho rasaḥ| sakāsaḥ sajvaro jñeya uroghātaḥ sapīnasaḥ”- iti| mūrcchanti patanti| atra raktajapratiśyāye| kṛmayaḥ sūkṣmāḥ| kṛmimūrdhavikāreṇetyādi| kṛmijasya śirorogasya yallakṣaṇaṃ tena samānamasya lakṣaṇamityarthaḥ| kecit ‘mūrcchanti cātra kṛmayaḥ śvetāḥ snigdhāstathā'ṇavaḥ’ iti pāṭhaṃ raktajapratiśyāyalakṣaṇabhinnaṃ paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- atreti eṣu sarveṣveva pratiśyāyeṣu||12-13||-

lg.l: praklidyati punar nāsā punaś ca pariśuṣyati ||14||
muhur ānahyate cāpi muhur vivriyate tathā |
niḥśvāsocchvāsadaurgandhyaṃ tathā gandhān na vetti ca ||15||

div.ab: idānīmekadoṣaje'pi pratiśyāye durupacārato doṣāntaraprakopādduṣṭiṃ gatasya liṅgamāha- praklidyatītyādi||14-15||-

lg.l: bādhiryam āndhyam aghrāṇaṃ ghorāṃś ca nayanāmayān |

ab.seg: idānīṃ sarveṣāmeva pratiśyāyānāmupekṣayā mithyāhārācāriṇo narasya kālāntareṇa rogāntarārambhakatvaṃ nirdiśannāha- sarva ityādi| sarve eva pratiśyāyāḥ kālena rogajananā bhavanti, tathā ta eva pratiśyāyāḥ krameṇa duṣṭapīnasā jāyante| ke te rogā ityāha- bādhiryamityādi| vṛddhāḥ pratiśyāyā bādhiryādīn kurvantīti piṇḍārthaḥ| pratiśyāyānāṃ pakvatā ‘pakvaṃ ghanaṃ cāpyavalambamānaṃ’ ityādinā jñeyā; etadviparyayeṇa cāmatā| kecidvṛddhasuśrutoktam,- “arucirvirasaṃ vaktraṃ nāsāsrāvo rujā'ratiḥ| śirogurutvaṃ kṣavathurjvaraścāmasya lakṣaṇam|| tanutvamāmaliṅgānāṃ śironāsāsyalāghavam| ghanapītakaphatvaṃ ca pakvapīnasalakṣaṇam”- iti pratiśyāyānāmāmapakvalakṣaṇaṃ paṭhanti||16-17||

lg.l: navaṃ pratiśyāyam apāsya sarvam upācaret sarpiṣa eva pānaiḥ |
svedair vicitrair vamanaiś ca yuktaiḥ kālopapannair avapīḍanaiś ca ||18||

ab.seg: idānīṃ pratiśyāyānāṃ sāmānyaṃ cikitsitamāha- navaṃ pratiśyāyamityādi| apāsya parityajya| sarveṣāṃ pratiśyāyānāṃ vātātmakatvāt sarveṣāmeva sarpiḥpānam| kālopapannaiḥ āvasthikakālayogyaiḥ| avapīḍanaiḥ nasyabhedaiḥ| kecidatra, ‘pīnasānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ heturyasmāt samīraṇaḥ| kaphapittādhike'pyasmāt mārutaṃ samupakramet|| tasmādabhiṣyandamudīryamāṇamupācaredādita eva dhīmān| ghṛtaiḥ sahiṅgvamlakaṭūṣṇasiddhaiḥ svedairvicitrairvamanaiśca tīkṣṇaiḥ|| kaṭutrikaṃ citrakatintiḍīkaṃ tālīśapatraṃ cavikāmlasañjñam| vicūrṇitaṃ jīrakacūrṇayuktamelācchadatvaksurabhīkṛtaṃ ca|| miśraṃ purāṇena guḍena dadyāttat pīnasānāṃ paripācanārtham| pakvaṃ guḍaṃ cāpi kaṭutrikeṇa ghṛtapragāḍhaṃ pralihet sukhoṣṇam| sarpirguḍābhyāṃ kaṭukaiśca pakvān khādecca śaktūnapi nātiśītān| guḍādhikaṃ cārdrakamādiśanti yuktoṣitaṃ ‘śuktoṣitaṃ’ iti pā. tat paripācanārtham| śirovirekaṃ vamanaṃ ca kecidāme na dātavyamiti bruvanti”- iti paṭhanti| sa ca pāṭho jejjaṭācāryeṇa nāṅgīkṛtaḥ||18||

lg.l: apacyamānasya hi pācanārthaṃ svedo hito 'mlair ahimaṃ ca bhojyam |

ab.seg: navapratiśyāyasya pākārthaṃ cikitsāmāha- apacyamānasyetyādi| ahimam uṣṇaṃ, bhojyaṃ bhojanam| aparamapi pākārthaṃ yogamāha- niṣevyamāṇamityādi| ārdrakaṃ payasā pāyayem ikṣuvikārayogairvā| ikṣuvikārā guḍādayaḥ| kecit ‘niṣevyamāṇaṃ payasā''rdrakaṃ vā sampācayet tat kaṭukopayogaiḥ’- iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- dugdhena sahārdrakarasaḥ peyaḥ, anye tu dugdhena saha nāgaracūrṇaṃ peyamiti manyante; kaṭukopayogaiḥ kaṭudravyopayogaiḥ| asyāgre kecit ‘grāmyāṇi māṃsāni dadhīni madyaṃ māṣān kulatthān lavaṇaṃ kaṭūni| amlaṃ tathā cāmakamūlakaṃ ca tathā dhanatvaṃ ‘tathā(')tanutvaṃ’ iti pā. taruṇaḥ prayāti’- iti paṭhanti; sa ca na paṭhanīyaḥ, sarvanibandhakāraiḥ parihṛtatvāt||19||

lg.l: pakvaṃ ghanaṃ cāpy avalambamānaṃ śirovirekair apakarṣayet tam |

ab.seg: pakvapratiśyāyasya nibarhaṇamāha- pakvamityādi||20||

lg.l: nivātaśayyāsanaceṣṭanāni mūrdhno gurūṣṇaṃ ca tathaiva vāsaḥ |
tīkṣṇā virekāḥ śirasaḥ sadhūmā rūkṣaṃ yavānnaṃ ‘palānnaṃ’ iti pā. vijayā ca sevyā ||21||

ab.seg: pakvapratiśyāye sevyamāha- nivātetyādi| āsanam upaveśanaṃ, ceṣṭanaṃ krīḍanam| mūrdhno mastakasya| vāso vastram| vijayā harītakī||21||

lg.l: śokaṃ ca madyāni navāni caiva vivarjayet pīnasarogajuṣṭaḥ ||22||

ab.seg: sevyamuddiśya parihāryamāha- śītetyādi||22||
idānīṃ sopadravasya pakvapratiśyāyasyāvasthikaṃ cikitsāsūtramāha- chardītyādi| aratiḥ na kvacidavasthitiścetasaḥ||23||

lg.l: upadravāṃś cāpi yathopadeśaṃ svair bheṣajair bhojanasaṃvidhānaiḥ |
jayed viditvā mṛdutāṃ gateṣu prāglakṣaṇeṣūktam athādiśec ca ||24||

ab.seg: pakvapratiśyāye vamanāvasthāṃ nirdiśannāha- bahudravairityādi| vātakaphopasṛṣṭaṃ pīnasinaṃ bahudravairvāmayediti piṇḍārthaḥ| vayaḥsthaṃ taruṇam| vānte sati kiṃ kuryādityāha- upadravānityādi| yathopadeśaṃ yathākathitam| vakṣyamāṇacikitsāyāḥ kālamuddiśannāha- mṛdutāmityādi| mṛdutāṃ gateṣu alpībhūteṣu, prāglakṣaṇeṣu āmapratiśyāyalakṣaṇeṣu, uktaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ ‘vātike tu pratiśyāye pibet’ ityādikaṃ vidhānamityarthaḥ| kecit ‘viditvā mṛdutāṃ tu teṣāṃ prāglakṣaṇānāṃ vidhimādiśecca’ iti paṭhanti||24||

lg.l: vātike tu pratiśyāye pibet sarpir yathākramam |
pañcabhir lavaṇaiḥ siddhaṃ prathamena gaṇena ca ||25||

div.ab: vātikapratiśyāyasya cikitsāmāha- vātika ityādi| yathākramaṃ snehapānakrameṇetyarthaḥ| prathamo gaṇo vidārigandhādiḥ| kṛtsnaṃ samastam| arditeritaṃ arditacikitsitoktam||25||-

lg.l: pariṣekān pradehāṃś ca kuryād api ca śītalān |
yujyante kavalāś cātra vireko madhurair api ||28||

ab.seg: pittaraktakṛtayoḥ pratiśyāyościkitsāmāha- pittaraktotthayorityādi| madhurakaiḥ kākolyādibhiḥ| kecit ‘pittaraktotthayostiktaiḥ kaṣāyamadhurairghṛtam’ iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- tiktāni paṭolādīni| pariṣekānityādi| pradehāḥ pralepāḥ| śrīriti śrīveṣṭakaḥ navanītadhūpaḥ, ‘guggulī’ iti loke, sarjaraso rālā, pattaṅgaṃ raktacandanaṃ; madhulikā guḍūcī, markaṭatṛṇamapare, gojī gojihvikā, śrīparṇī kāśmīrī| kavalā gaṇḍūṣabhedāḥ| atreti pittaraktotthayoḥ pratiśyāyayorityarthaḥ| madhuraiḥ drākṣāragvadhamadhuśarkarādibhiḥ||26-28||

lg.l: tailaṃ kālopapannaṃ tan nasyaṃ syād anayor hitam |30|

div.ab: pittaraktakṛtayoḥ pratiśyāyayornasyārthaṃ tailamāha- dhavetyādi| dhavatvagādikalkaistailacaturthāṃśairdaśaguṇe kṣīre tailaṃ pacanīyam| śyāmā trivṛt, tilvakaḥ paṭṭikārodhraḥ| kālopapannaṃ nirāmatākālayogyam| anayoḥ pittaraktotthayoḥ pratiśyāyayoḥ||29||-

lg.l: yavāgvā vāmayed vāntaḥ kaphaghnaṃ kramam ācaret |
ubhe bale bṛhatyau ca viḍaṅgaṃ satrikaṇṭakam ||31||
śvetāmūlaṃ sadābhadrāṃ ‘sahāṃ bhadrāṃ’ iti pā. varṣābhūṃ cātra saṃharet |
tailam ebhir vipakvaṃ tu nasyam asyopakalpayet ||32||

ab.seg: kaphajapratiśyāyacikitsāmāha- kaphaje ityādi| tilamāṣavipakvayā yavāgvā kṛsarayā vāmanīyadravyasiddhayā vāmayet| vāntaśca kaphaghnaṃ kramamannasaṃsarjanākhyamācaret| ubhe ityādi| dvibalādibhiḥ kalkīkṛtaistailaṃ siddhaṃ nasye hitam| trikaṇṭakogokṣurakaḥ| śvetā śvetasyandaḥ| sadābhadrā kāśmarī| saraletyādi| saralā trivṛt, kiṇihī kaṭabhī, dāru devadāru, nikumbhā dantī||30-33||

lg.l: tailaṃ vipakvaṃ nasyārthe vidadhyāc cātra buddhimān ||35||

ab.seg: sānnipātikapratiśyāyacikitsāmāha- sarpiṃṣītyādi| sarpīṣi ghṛtāni| kaṭutiktāni kaṭutiktadravyasiddhānītyarthaḥ| kaṭūni ceti cakāreṇa pratyekavātādiyuktā kriyā'pyanuktā samuccīyate| rasāñjane ityādi| atreti sānnipātikapratiśyāye ityarthaḥ||34-35||

lg.l: mustā tejovatī pāṭhā kaṭphalaṃ kaṭukā vacā |
tutthaṃ karañjabījaṃ ca lavaṇaṃ bhadradāru ca |
etaiḥ kṛtaṃ kaṣāyaṃ tu kavale samprayojayet ||37||
hitaṃ mūrdhavireke ca tailam ebhir vipācitam |38|

div.ab: mustetyādi| tejovatī kākamardanikā, agnikaḥ ajamodā| mustādibhiḥ kṛtaḥ kaṣāyaḥ sānnipātike pratiśyāye hitaḥ; sarveṣu pratiśyāyeṣu hita ityanye||36-37||-

lg.l: puṣpair vimiśraṃ jalajair vātaghnair auṣadhair api |
sarvagandhasitānantāmadhukaṃ ‘sarvagandhāḥ sitā'nantāmadhukaṃ’ iti pā. candanaṃ tathā |
āvāpya vipaced bhūyo daśakṣīraṃ tu tad ghṛtam ||40||
yathāsvaṃ doṣaśamanais tailaṃ kuryāc ca yatnataḥ ||41||

ab.seg: kṣīramityādi| kṣīraṃ jāṅgalamāṃsādibhyo'ṣṭaguṇaṃ, ardhajale kṣīrādardhaṃ jalaṃ, jāṅgalaiḥ mṛgapakṣibhiḥ eṇādibhirlāvādibhiśca, jalajaiḥ puṣpaiḥ nīlotpalādibhiḥ, vātaghnaiḥ vidārīgandhādibhiḥ, ghṛtamutpādya ‘taddugdhaṃ mathitvā’ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ| sarvagandhā elādiparipaṭhitāḥ| sitā śarkarā, anantā utpalasārivā, candanaṃ raktacandanaṃ, āvāpya prakṣipya| tadghṛtaṃ kṣīramathanādyadutpannaṃ ghṛtaṃ, pratiśyāyān sarvān apohati sphoṭayati| doṣaśamanaiḥ vātapittaśleṣmaharadravyagaṇaiḥ| yathāsvaṃ yathātmīyam| idameva tailaṃ sarveṣāmeva pratiśyāyānām||38-41||

raktapratiśyāye kṛmisambhavo darśitaḥ, atasteṣāmeva kṛmīṇāṃ yāpanārthaṃ cikitsāmāha- samūtretyādi| kṛmighnā yāḥ kriyā uddiṣṭāstā gomūtrapittayuktā yāpanārthaṃ kartavyāḥ; tathā kṛmighnāni bheṣajāni surasādīni ca kartavyāni| buddhimān ūhāpohavān vaidyaḥ| ye tu sarveṣāmeva pratiśyāyānāṃ kṛmisambhavatvaṃ manyante te'muṃ ślokamīdṛśaṃ vyākhyānayanti- pratyekaṃ vātādipratiśyāye yāḥ kriyā uddiṣṭāstā eva gomūtrapittayuktā yathāsvaṃ kṛmiṣu yojayet||42||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre pratiśyāyapratiṣedho nāma caturviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||24||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre caturviṃśodhyāyaḥ||24||

div.head: śirorogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ śirorogavijñānīyam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

lg.l: ekādaśaprakārasya ‘sūryovartāvabhedābhyāṃ śaṅkhakena tathaiva ca| daśaprakārasyāpyasya’ iti pā.| ḍalhaṇavyākhyānamapyetatpāṭhāntarānusāreṇaiva jñayam lakṣaṇaṃ sampravakṣyate ||4||

ab.seg: tāneva śirorogān saṅkhyayā āha- śiro rujatītyādi| tribhiriti pṛthagarthadyotanārtham| ‘śiro rujati martyānām’ ityatra kecit ‘śirorogā manuṣyāṇām’ iti paṭhanti| rogaśabdo yadyapi sāmānyavyādhivācakastathā'pi ye pīḍākarā vyādhayaste'tra gṛhyante, tena khālityādīnāmatrānupādānamiti vyākhyānayanti| ekādaśaprakārasyetyādi| ekādaśaivātra śirorogāḥ| anyatovātaśabdena anantavātasya sarvagatanayanarogavijñānīye proktatvāt| brahmadevastu videhādiṣu anantavātasya pṛthak pāṭhāt pṛthagevātra paṭhanīyaḥ, tena caikādaśa śirorogā iti brūte| atra kecidvidehadarśanāt sūryāvartakaviparyayamapi paṭhanti| tathā ca tadvacaḥ- “tatra vātānugaṃ pittaṃ citaṃ śirasi tiṣṭhati| madhyāhne tejasā'rkasya tadvivṛddhaṃ śirorujam|| karoti paittikīṃ ghorāṃ saṃśāmyati dinakṣaye| astaṃ gate prabhāhīne sūrye vāyurvivardhate|| pittaṃ śāntimavāpnoti tataḥ śāmyati vedanā| eṣa pittānilakṛtaḥ sūryāvartaviparyayaḥ”- iti| kecitsuśrutādhyāyino'nena pāṭhena sūryāvartakaviparyayaṃ paṭhanti,- “vātapittāt purojātā rujā'paityaparāhṇataḥ| sūryāvartaḥ sa tu prokto viparīte viparyayaḥ”- iti| asau sūryāvartaviparyayaścāturthikaviparyayavadasūtrito'pi gṛhyate| atra kecit “āluñcayate kampati cāpi mūrdhā sarpanti madhye ca pipīlikā vā| skandhaḥ śiraścāpyavaghūrṇate ca mūrcchā pralāpaśca tathaiva nidrā|| sañjñāpraṇāśaṃ janayedvinidrāṃ prātastataḥ paśyati cāticitram| gṛhṇāti manye hṛdayaṃ ca rūpaiḥ sarvairamībhiḥ samabhidrutastu|| tisro hi rātrīrna sa jātu jīvettaṃ śīrṣakaṃ sampravadanti rogam”- iti paṭhanti| sa ca nibandhakārairnāṅgīkṛtaḥ||1-4||

lg.l: yasyānimittaṃ śiraso rujaś ca bhavanti tīvrā niśi cātimātram |
bandhopatāpaiś ca bhaved viśeṣaḥ śirobhitāpaḥ sa samīraṇena ||5||

ab.seg: idānīṃ vātikaśirorogalakṣaṇamāha- yasyetyādi| animittam īṣatkāraṇam| tīvravacanāt pitte madhyāḥ rujo, madhyaḥ kaphe iti budhyate| viśeṣa upaśamaḥ| śirobhitāpaḥ śirorogaḥ||5||

lg.l: yasyoṣṇam aṅgāracitaṃ yathaiva dahyeta ‘bhavecchiro dhūmavatī ca nāsā’ iti pā. dhūpyeta śirokṣināsam |
śītena rātrau ca bhaved viśeṣaḥ śirobhitāpaḥ sa tu pittakopāt ||6||

ab.seg: paittikaśirorogalakṣaṇamāha- yasyetyādi||6||

lg.l: śirogalaṃ yasya kaphopadigdhaṃ guru pratiṣṭabdham atho himaṃ ca |
śūnākṣikūṭaṃ vadanaṃ ca yasya śirobhitāpaḥ sa kaphaprakopāt ||7||

ab.seg: kaphajaśirorogalakṣaṇamāha- śirogalamityādi| upadigdham upaliptaṃ, guru bhārikaṃ, pratiṣṭabdham apracalitarūpamiva, himaṃ śītapūrṇamiva| śirobhitāpaḥ śirorogaḥ| atrānukto'pi viparyaya sevayopaśamo gṛhyate| ‘śirogalaṃ’ ityatra ‘śirobhavaṃ’ iti kecit paṭhanti||7||

lg.l: śirobhitāpe tritayapravṛtte sarvāṇi liṅgāni samudbhavanti ‘muhurbhavanti’ iti pā.|8|

div.ab: sānnipātikaśirorogalakṣaṇamāha- śirobhitāpe ityādi|8|-

lg.l: raktātmakaḥ pittasamānaliṅgaḥ sparśāsahatvaṃ śiraso bhavec ca ||8||

ab.seg: raktajaśirorogalakṣaṇamāha- raktātmaka ityādi| pittajaśirorogadraktaje sparśāsahatvamadhikam||8||

div.ab: kṣayajaśirorogasya liṅgamāha- vasetyādi| vasāśabda upalakṣaṇārthaḥ; tena dehasnehamastiṣkamedomajjāśukrāṇi gṛhyante| ‘vasābalāsakṣatasambhavānāṃ’ ityatra kecit ‘asṛgvasāśleṣmasamīraṇānāṃ’ iti paṭhanti; tannecchati gayī||9||-

lg.l: nistudyate yasya śiro 'timātraṃ sambhakṣyamāṇaṃ sphuṭatīva ‘sphuratīva cantaḥ’ iti pā. cāntaḥ ||10||
ghrāṇāc ca gacchet salilaṃ saraktaṃ śirobhitāpaḥ kṛmibhiḥ sa ghoraḥ |11|

div.ab: kṛmikṛtaśirorogalakṣaṇamāha- nistudyate ityādi| nistudyate śūlyate vyathyata ityarthaḥ| sphuṭatīva śīryata iva||10||-

lg.l: sūryodayaṃ yā prati mandamandam akṣibhruvaṃ ruk samupaiti gāḍham ||11||
vivardhate cāṃśumatā sahaiva sūryāpavṛttau vinivartate ca |
śītena śāntiṃ labhate kadācid uṣṇena jantuḥ sukham āpnuyāc ca ||12||
taṃ bhāskarāvartam udāharanti sarvātmakaṃ kaṣṭatamaṃ vikāram |13|

div.ab: suryāvartamāha- sūryodayamityādi| sūryāpavṛttau sūryāstasamaye| kasmātpravṛttinivṛttī bhavata iti pratipādayan nimirāha,- “svabhāvaśītā tamaso'bhimūlā rātristayodbhūtakaphena mārge| ruddhe marutkopamiyāt prabhāte rujaṃ karotyatra śirobhitāpe|| madhyāhnasūryātapatāpayogāt kaphe vilīne maruti prapanne| svamārgamāyāti tadā dinānte praśāntimāvarta ihārkapūrve” iti| sūryātapavilīnamastuluṅgakāraṇotpannasūryāvarta iti dṛḍhabalācāryaḥ| ‘uṣṇena jantuḥ sukhamāpnuyācca’ iti pāṭhātsūryāvartaviparyayaḥ kathito boddhavyaḥ| kecidatra ‘āvartasañjñaḥ sa ca sūryapūrvovyādhirmataḥ pittasamīraṇābhyām’ iti paṭhanti||11-12||-

lg.l: doṣās tu duṣṭās traya eva manyāṃ sampīḍya ghāṭāsu rujāṃ sutīvrām ||13||
kurvanti sākṣibhruvi śaṅkhadeśe sthitiṃ karoty āśu viśeṣatas tu |
gaṇḍasya pārśve tu karoti kampaṃ hanugrahaṃ locanajāṃś ca rogān ||14||
anantavātaṃ tam udāharanti doṣatrayotthaṃ śiraso vikāram |15|

div.ab: anantavātamāha- doṣāstu duṣṭāstraya ityādi| sātyakiprabhṛtibhistu śiraḥkamparogo'sādhyaḥ paṭhitaḥ; asmiṃstu śāstre sānnipātikaśirorogo'nantavāta evāntarbhavati||13-14||-

lg.l: pakṣād daśāhād athavā'py akasmāt tasyārdhabhedaṃ tritayād vyavasyet |16|

div.ab: ardhāvabhedamāha- yasyottametyādi| ‘tasyārdhabhedaṃ pavanāt sapittāt’ iti kecit ‘tritayādvyavasyet’ ityatra ‘dvitayāt’ iti vā pāṭhaḥ||15||-

lg.l: rujaḥ sutīvrāḥ pratanoti mūrdhni viśeṣataś cāpi hi śaṅkhayos tu |
sukaṣṭamenaṃ khalu śaṅkhakākhyaṃ maharṣayo vedavidaḥ purāṇāḥ ||17||
vyādhiṃ vadanty udgatamṛtyukalpaṃ bhiṣaksahasrair api durnivāram ||18||

ab.seg: śaṅkhakalakṣaṇamāha- śaṅkhāśrita ityādi| kṛtānuyātraḥ kṛtānugamaḥ| udgatamṛtyukalpaḥ upastitamṛtyusamaḥ| eṣa vyādhistu tryahānmārayati, tryahādanantaraṃ kuśalenopakrāntaḥ sidhyati||16-18||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre śirorogavijñānīyo nāma pañcaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||25||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||25||

div.head: śirorogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ śirorogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

lg.l: payo nupānaṃ seveta ghṛtaṃ tailam athāpi vā ||3||

ab.seg: vātavyādhividhiriti samasto vātavyādhividhirbāhya ābhyantaro'pi kartavyaḥ; tatra bāhyaḥ snehasvedābhyaṅgapariṣekopanāhaśirobastinasyādiḥ, ābhyantarastu snehapānānuvāsananirūhādiḥ| payonupānamiti vātasya pittānubandhasya ghṛtaṃ, kaphānubandhasya tailam| yadyapi vātavyādhicikitsitātideśenaiva ghṛtatailayoḥ pānaṃ prāptaṃ, tathā'pi niyamārthametadvacanaṃ; athavā payonupānaprāptyarthaṃ; athavā snehādiprayogaparisamāptau prāyogikametadvidhānam||1-3||

lg.l: mudgān kulatthān māṣāṃś ca khādec ca niśi kevalān |
kaṭūṣṇāṃś ca ‘kaṭūṣṇān samasarpiṣkān’ iti pā. sasarpiṣkān uṣṇaṃ cānu payaḥ pibet ||4||
pibed vā payasā tailaṃ tatkalkaṃ vā'pi mānavaḥ |5|

div.ab: mudgānityādi| mudgānāṃ vātakaratve'pi māṣāṇāṃ śleṣmakaratve'pi vyādhipratyanīkatvādyogaśakteracintyatvāccopayogaḥ| kaṭūṣṇāniti kaṭūṣṇadravyasaṃskṛtān, sasarpiṣkān saghṛtān| tailaṃ tilatailam| tatkalkaṃ mudgādikalkaṃ; anye tilakalkamāhuḥ, tannecchati gayī jejjaṭaśca||4||-

lg.l: vātaghnasiddhaiḥ kṣīraiś ca sukhoṣṇaiḥ sekam ācaret ||5||
tatsiddhaiḥ pāyasair vā'pi sukhoṣṇair lepayec chiraḥ |
svinnair vā ‘snigdhaiḥ’ iti pā. matsyapiśitaiḥ kṛśarair vā sasaindhavaiḥ ||6||
varuṇādau gaṇe kṣuṇṇe kṣīram ardhodakaṃ pacet |
kṣīraśeṣaṃ ca tan mathyaṃ śītaṃ sāram upāharet ||8||
tato madhurakaiḥ siddhaṃ nasye tat pūjitaṃ haviḥ |
tasmin vipakve kṣīre tu peyaṃ sarpiḥ saśarkaram ||9||
dhūmaṃ cāsya yathākālaṃ snaihikaṃ yojayed bhiṣak |10|

div.ab: ābhyantaravidhiṃ pratipādya bāhyavidhimāha- vātaghnasiddhairityādi| vātaghnāni bhadradārvādīni| seko dhārāsekaḥ| tatsiddhaiḥ pāyasaiḥ vātaharadravyasiddhagokṣīrapāyasairityarthaḥ| lepayet upanāhayet| svinnairvā ‘snigdhaiḥ’ iti pā. matsyapiśitairiti matsyamāṃsaiḥ svinnairvā ‘snigdhaiḥ’ iti pā. śirasyupanāhaḥ| kṛśarairveti tilataṇḍulamāṣakṛtayavāgvopanāhaḥ; kṛśaraśabdo'kārānto'pyasti| candanādibhirvā ślakṣṇapiṣṭairupanāhaḥ| snigdhasyetyādi| snigdhasya kulīrarasacaturguṇe sādhitaṃ tailaṃ nasyaṃ syāditi piṇḍārthaḥ| varuṇādāvityādi| kṣuṇṇe jarjarīkṛte| tasmin vipakve kṣīre tviti varuṇādigaṇasiddhe kṣīre caturguṇe sādhitaṃ kākolyādiprativāpaṃ yat sarpistaccharkarāprakṣepaṃ peyamiti tātparyārthaḥ| anye tu ‘tasmin vipakvaṃ kṣīre ca’ iti paṭhanti; tasmin varuṇādikvāthe kṣīre ca sādhitaṃ sarpiḥ saśarkaraṃ pibediti ca vyākhyānayanti| dhūmaṃ cāsyetyādi| yathākālaṃ yathāvasthaṃ madhūcchiṣṭaprabhṛtibhiḥ snehamiśraiḥ kṛto dhūmaḥ snaihikaḥ||5-9||-

lg.l: vidadhyāt traivṛtaṃ dhīmān balātailam athāpi vā |11|

div.ab: pānābhyañjanetyādi| traivṛtam apatānakacikitsitoktaṃ, balātailaṃ mūḍhagarbhacikitsitoktam||10||-

lg.l: bhojayec ca rasaiḥ snigdhaiḥ payobhir vā susaṃskṛtaiḥ ||11||

ab.seg: bhojayedityādi| rasaiḥ māṃsarasaiḥ| susaṃskṛtaiḥ vātaharadravyasādhitaiḥ||11||

div.ab: idānīṃ pittajaraktajayostulyacikitsitatvāt saṅkṣepārthamubhayorekaṃ cikitsitamāha- pittaraktetyādi| śirolepaiḥ madhurakādidravyakṛtaiḥ pariṣekaiśca śītalaiḥ kṣīrekṣurasādikṛtaiḥ| tānyeva pariṣekadravyāṇyāha- kṣīrakṣvityādi| sitājalaṃ śarkarodakam||12||-

lg.l: madhuraiś ca mukhālaipair nasyakarmabhir eva ca |15|

div.ab: śirolepadravyāṇyāha- naletyādi| nalaḥ śuṣiraparvā svanāmakhyātaḥ, vañjulo vetasaḥ kahlāraṃ raktotpalaṃ, candanaṃ raktacandanam, utpalaṃ nīlotpalaṃ, śaivalaṃ dūrvā, ambhoruhaṃ padmam| vaisarpaiśca tathāvidhairiti visarpacikitsitoktaiḥ pralepaiḥ (ci. 17); tāni tu uśīralāmajjakacandanasrotojamuktāmaṇigairikāṇi| tathāvidhairiti vacanādraktapittavisarpapralepaprakārairna tu kaphavātavisarpalepadravyaprakārairityarthaḥ| madhuraiḥ kākolyādibhiḥ| nasyamatra madhuradravyasaṃskṛtena snehena kṛtam| pittaraktasamutthānau śirorogau nivārayedityatrāpi sambandhanīyam||13-14||-

lg.l: āsthāpanair virekaiś ca pathyaiś ca snehabastibhiḥ ||15||
kṣīrasarpir hitaṃ nasyaṃ vasā vā jāṅgalā śubhā |16|

div.ab: idānīṃ raktaje pittaje ca śiroroge vamanaṃ vihāya karmacatuṣṭayaṃ nirdiśannāha- āsthāpanairityādi| āsthāpanādibhiḥ pittaraktasamutthitau śirorogau nivārayediti sambandhaḥ| pathyaśabda āsthāpanādibhistribhiḥ sambandhanīyaḥ| pathyaiḥ hitaiḥ| tena vakṣyamāṇotpalādinā''sthāpanaṃ virecanaṃ ca madhuradravyakṛtaṃ, snehabastayastu madhurakandakṣīraghṛtādikṛtāḥ| kṣīrasarpiratra mathyamānakṣīrotpannanavanītajātam||15||-

lg.l: madhuraiḥ kṣīrasarpis tu snehane ca saśarkaram ||17||

ab.seg: āsthāpanopayogidravyāṇyāha- utpaletyādi| sarpiṣā cānuvāsanamityuktaṃ tadeva nirdiśannāha- madhurairityādi| madhuraiḥ kākolyādibhiḥ, pakvamiti śeṣaḥ| kṣīrasarpiḥ kṣīramathanādutthitaṃ, snehane snehabastau, saśarkaraṃ sitaśarkarācūrṇaprakṣepam| anye tu ‘madhuraiḥ kṣīrasarpistu pakvaṃ pāne saśarkaram’ iti paṭhanti, tannecchati gayī||16-17||

lg.l: pittaraktaghnam uddiṣṭaṃ yac cānyad api tad dhitam |18|

div.ab: idānīṃ saṅkṣepārthamatideśenāparamapi cikitsitamāha- pittaraktaghnamityādi| anyadapi pānālepanasyādi raktapittaghnaṃ yaduddiṣṭaṃ tadatrāpi hitamiti piṇḍārthaḥ|18|-

lg.l: acchaṃ ca pāyayet sarpiḥ svedayec cāpy abhīkṣṇaśaḥ ||19||
iṅgudasya tvacā vā'pi meṣaśṛṅgasya ‘meṣaśṛṅgyā ca’ iti pā. vā bhiṣak ||20||

ab.seg: idānīṃ kaphajaśirorogacikitsāmāha- kaphotthitamityādi| kaphotthitaṃ śirorogaṃ kaphanivāraṇairjayediti sambandhaḥ; tāni ca kaphanivāraṇāni śirovirecanādīni| acchaṃ ceti acchaṃ kevalaṃ, vamananirjitakaphasya prakupitavātavijayārthaṃ sarpiḥpānaṃ athavā sarpiḥpānaṃ vamanasya prākkarma| abhīkṣṇaśaḥ punaḥ punaḥ||18-20||

lg.l: ābhyām eva kṛtāṃ vartiṃ dhūmapāne prayojayet |
ghreyaṃ kaṭphalacūrṇaṃ ca kavalāś ca kaphāpahāḥ ||21||

ab.seg: śirovirecanāvaśeṣitakaphasyopaśamanārthaṃ dhūmamāha- ābhyāmityādi| ābhyām iṅgudīmeṣaśṛṅgītvagbhyām| kaṭphalacūrṇaṃ ghreyaṃ ghrātavyaṃ, pradhamanaviśeṣo'yam| kaphāpahāḥ kaphaharadravyakṛtāḥ| saraletyādi| kṣārapiṣṭaiḥ kṣārodakapiṣṭaiḥ ‘atra kṣāraḥ pānīyaḥ’ iti pā., salavaṇaiḥ īṣallavaṇaiḥ||21-22||
āhāramāha- yavetyādi| vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukaṃ, kṣāro yavakṣāraḥ, yavaṣaṣṭikayoścānnaṃ trikaṭukena kaṭūkṛtaṃ, yavakṣāreṇa lavaṇitaṃ, paṭolādīnāṃ yūṣaiḥ saha mātrāvadbhojayediti sambandhaḥ||23||

div.ab: adhunā tridoṣajaśirorogasya sāmānyāṃ cikitsāmāha- śiroroge ityādi| tridoṣaghno vidhiranantaroktavātādijaśirorogaghno vidhiḥ|24|-

lg.l: sarpiḥpānaṃ viśeṣeṇa purāṇaṃ vā diśanti hi ||24||

ab.seg: sāmānyacikitsitamabhidhāya viśeṣacikitsitamāha- sarpiḥpānamiti| atra nibandhakārairbahūktaṃ, tacca vistarabhayānna likhitam||24||

lg.l: pāne nasye ca sarpiḥ syād vātaghnamadhuraiḥ śṛtam ||25||

div.ab: kṣayajacikitsāmāha- kṣayaja ityādi| kṣayamāsādya raktādikṣayeṣvanyatamaṃ kṣayamavadhārya, śoṇitādikriyānatikrameṇa cikitsitamityarthaḥ; anye tu kṣayārthaṃ śoṣapratiṣedhamadhyāyamāsādya, yo bṛṃhaṇo vidhirāhārauṣadhākhyaḥ sa kāryaḥ| pāne nasye cetyatra cakāro bhinnakrame sarpiścetyatra draṣṭavyaḥ, tena tailamapi madhuradravyasaṃskṛtaṃ samuccīyate| kṣayakāsāpahaṃ sarpiḥ “kulīraśukticaṭakaiṇalāvān niṣkvāthya vargaṃ madhuraṃ ca kṛtsnam” ityādinā proktam||25||-

lg.l: nasye hi śoṇitaṃ dadyāt tena mūrcchanti jantavaḥ |

ab.seg: idānīṃ krimijaśirorogāvasare sudūravistṛtabahukrimīṇāmutkleśanenāharaṇopāyamuddiśannāha- kṛmibhirityādi| krimibhirbhakṣyamāṇasyeva, bhakṣitasya duḥśakyatvāt; śirasaḥ kriyā vakṣyate iti sambandhaḥ| śoṇitanasyaṃ kṛmīṇāmutkleśanārthaṃ, srotomukhagamanārthaṃ ca| mūrcchanti mūrcchitā bhavanti madayuktā bhavanti| samāyānti samāgacchanti| yatastato nāsāsrotaḥprabhṛtibhiḥ tatra cāgatānāṃ kṛmīṇāṃ kūrcakādibhirnirharaṇaṃ kartavyam||26-27||

idānīṃ kūrcakādibhiragamyānāṃ krimīṇāṃ nirharaṇārthaṃ cikitsitamāha- teṣāmityādi| mūrdhavirecanaiḥ viḍaṅgamaricāpāmārgaśigrubījādibhiḥ; gayī tu vakṣyamāṇāni hrasvaśigrukabījāni śirovirecanadravyāṇi manyante| hrasvaśigrukabījairityādi| kṛmighnaiḥ viḍaṅgādibhiḥ||28-29||

div.ab: āhāramāha- bhojanānītyādi| kṛmighnāni kṛmipratiṣedha paṭhitāni dhānyāmlaprabhṛtīni surasādisaṃskṛtāni|30|-

ab.seg: sūryāvartakacikitsāmāha- sūryāvarte ityādi| nasyakarmādītyādiśabdāllepapariṣekakavalagrahaśirobastyādayaḥ| anye tu nasyakarma ādau yasya tannasyakarmādi, tacca vamanaṃ vihāya virekādikarmacatuṣṭayam| ye tu sūryāvartaviparyayaṃ paṭhanti tatrāpīdameva cikitsitam||30||

div.ab: āhāraṃ niyamayannāha- bhojanetyādi|31|-

lg.l: tathā'rdhabhedake vyādhau prāptam anyac ca yad bhavet ||31||

ab.seg: śirīṣamūlakaphalair avapīḍo 'nayor hitaḥ | vaṃśamūlakakarpūrair avapīḍaṃ prayojayet ||32||

div.ab: ardhāvabhedakacikitsitamāha- tathā'rdhabhedake ityādi| na kevalaṃ sūryāvarte nasyakarmādibheṣajaṃ jāṅgalaprāyaṃ bhojanaṃ kṣīrānnavikṛtirghṛtaṃ prayojayet tathā'rdhāvabhedake'pi| prāptamanyacca yadbhavediti anyadapi snehasirāvyadhāvapīḍakarṇaśūloktadīpikātailādi yat prāptaṃ yuktaṃ bhavet tat kartavyam| gayī tu anyacchabdena vakṣyamāṇaṃ śirīṣamūlakaphalairityādikamicchati| śirīṣetyādi| anayoḥ sūryāvartārdhabhedakayoḥ| avapīḍya dīyata ityavapīḍo nasyabheda ityarthaḥ| vaṃśetyādi| atreti anayoḥ sūryāvartārdhabhedakayoḥ| madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhukaṃ, manaḥśilāvapīḍo madhunetyeko yogaḥ, candanena ceti dvitīyaḥ| kecidatra candanaśabdena madhūkasāraṃ vyākhyānayanti||31-33||-

lg.l: teṣām ante hitaṃ nasyaṃ sarpir madhurasānvitam ||34||

ab.seg: avapīḍairnirjitakaphasya paścātkarmāha- teṣāmityādi| teṣām avapīḍānām, ante avasāne, madhurakānvitaṃ kākolyādigaṇakalkaśṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ nasye prayojyam| anye madhurasāṃ mūrvāṃ manyante| kecitteṣāmityatra tayoriti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- ante'vapīḍānāmavasāne madhurasānvitasarpistayoḥ sūryāvartārdhabhedakayornasye hitaṃ, vātapittottarāvasthāyāṃ ghṛtanasyam||34||

div.ab: idānīṃ śirolepamāha- sārivetyādi| sārivā prasiddhā, utpalaṃ nīlotpalam| amlapeṣitaṃ kāñjikapeṣitam| dvayoḥ sūryāvartārdhāvabhedakayoḥ| ayamapi śirolepo vātapittottarāvasthāyāṃ prayoktavyaḥ| eṣa ityādi| eṣa eveti śirīṣaphalādyavapīḍaḥ kaphanimitte śiroroge prayoktavyaḥ| yadyapi kaphaśirorogasya cikitsoktā tathā'pyavasaraprāptatvāt punaruktā| anye ‘śiroroge kaphātmake’ ityatra ‘kṣayātmake’ iti paṭhanti| tannecchati jejjaṭācāryaḥ| apare tu ‘ebhireva prayoktavyaḥ śiroroge'nilātmake’ iti paṭhanti| ebhireveti anantaroktasārivotpalakuṣṭhādibhiḥ||35||-

lg.l: anantavāte kartavyaḥ sūryāvartaharo ‘sūryāvarteritaḥ’ iti pā. vidhiḥ ||36||

div.ab: kecidatrānantavātacikitsitaṃ paṭhanti; tadāha- anantavāte ityādi| madhumastakāḥ ravajukāḥ, saṃyāvaḥ kaṇḍakaghṛtaiścāturjātakakarpūrasugandhaḥ lapsiketi loke, ghṛtapūraḥ ‘ghevara’ iti prasiddhaḥ||36-37||-

lg.l: kṣīrasarpiḥ praśaṃsanti nasye pāne ca śaṅkhake ||38||
jāṅgalānāṃ rasaiḥ snigdhair āhāraś cātra śasyate |39|

div.ab: śaṅkhakacikitsāmāha- kṣīretyādi| kṣīrasarpiriti arditacikitsite'kṣitarpaṇārthaṃ yaduktam| jāṅgalānāmityatra kecidaudakānāmiti paṭhanti, tannecchati gayī||38||-

lg.l: śatāvarīṃ tilān kṛṣṇān madhukaṃ nīlam utpalam ||39||
dūrvāṃ punarnavāṃ caiva lepe sādhv avacārayet |

ab.seg: śirolepamāha- śatāvarīmityādi| śatāvaryādibhiḥ kṣīrapiṣṭaiḥ śirolepaḥ| mahāsugandhāmityādi| mahāsugandhā utpalasārivā, sarpasugandhāmapare| pālindī kālavallī| amlaṃ kāñjikam||39-40||

lg.l: śītāṃś cātra parīṣekān pradehāṃś ca prayojayet |41|

div.ab: anuktānapyatra pariṣekapradehānnirdiśannāha- śītānityādi| śītapariṣekān śītavīryavidārigandhādikākolyādyutpalādikaṣāyakṛtān, śītapradehāneteṣāmeva kalkairamlapiṣṭaiḥ kṛtān|41|-

ab.seg: avapīḍaścetyādi| sūryāvartanivāraṇo'vapīḍaḥ ‘śirīṣamūlakaphalairavapīḍo'nayorhita’ ityādyuktaḥ||41||

div.ab: idānīṃ śirorogāṇāṃ sāmānyacikitsāmāha- kṛmītyādi| kṛmikṣayakṛtau śirorogau parityajyānyeṣu śirorogeṣu madhutailasamāyuktaiḥ śirovirecanadravyairbuddhimān vaidyaḥ śirāṃsi ativirecayet, nasyaṃ dadyādityarthaḥ| mūlānilonmūlanatvāt styānabhūtakaphavināśanatvācca sarṣapatailena nasyam| anye tu ‘paścāt sarpiḥ sukhoṣṇaṃ tu nasyatastu praśasyate’ iti paṭhanti; teṣāmayamabhiprāyaḥśirovirecanena kaphe vijite sati vātapittajayārthaṃ sarpirnasyam||42||-

lg.l: na cec chāntiṃ vrajanty evaṃ snigdhasvinnāṃs tato bhiṣak ||43||
paścād upācaret samyak sirāṇām atha mokṣaṇaiḥ |44|

div.ab: idānīmetairapyupāyairyadā śāntiṃ śirorogā na yānti tadā kiṃ kartavyamityāha- na cecchāntimityādi||43||-

ab.seg: idānīṃ śālākyatantrasyārthapiṇḍamuktamupasaṃharannāha- ṣaṭsaptatirityādi| daśāṣṭādaśa aṣṭāviṃśatirityarthaḥ| iti śabda uktasmaraṇe| ye vistarato dṛ(di)ṣṭāḥ vistareṇa videhādau bhāṣitāḥ| yathāsthūlaṃ sthūlānatikrameṇa, aṇuśo bhidyamānāḥ punarasaṅkhyeyāḥ| asminniti śālākyaśāstre||44-46||

div.ab: iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre śirorogapratiṣedho nāma ṣaḍviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||26|| iti śrībhagavatā dhanvantariṇopadiṣṭāyāṃ maharṣiṇā suśrutācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargataṃ śālākyatantraṃ samāptam |

ab.seg: sadbuddheḥ prasavaḥ padaṃ suyaśasaḥ sadvaidyavandyaḥ śriyāmāvāsaḥ sukṛtī kriyāsu nipuṇaḥ śrīḍalhaṇākhyo bhiṣak| śrībhādānakanāthasāhalanṛpasyātīva yo vallabhaḥ śāstraṃ tasya nibandhasaṅgraha iti khyātaṃ dharitrītale| iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ||26||

div.head: navagrahākṛtivijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto navagrahākṛtivijñānīyam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

śālākyatantrānantaraṃ kaumāratantraṃ prārabhyate- athāta ityādi| bālaśabdo'tra luptanirdiṣṭo draṣṭavyaḥ| tatra grahā bālānāṃ nava, aṣṭau punarabālānāṃ bhūtavidyāyāṃ nirdeṣṭavyāḥ| ākṛtiḥ ākāro liṅgaṃ kāryabhūtaṃ, natu svabhāvākhyam||1-2||
tatra prathamaṃ kumāratantrasyārthapiṇḍamuddiśannāha- bālagrahāṇāmityādi| vijñānaṃ viśiṣṭajñānam| sādhanaṃ cikitsitam| utpattiḥ prabhavaḥ| kāraṇaṃ hetuḥ||3||

lg.l: skandagrahas tu prathamaḥ skandāpasmāra eva ca |

ab.seg: idānīṃ teṣāṃ navagrahāṇāṃ nāmānyāha- skandagraha ityādi| prathamaḥ pradhānamādirvā| navamo naigameṣa iti saṅkhyānirdeśādeva saṅkhyāyāṃ labdhāyāṃ bhūyo navama iti saṅkhyākaraṇaṃ kāśyapāditantrāntaroktādhikasaṅkhyānirākaraṇārtham| pitṛgrahasañjñita iti bālasyānyagrahebhyo rakṣakatvātpiteva grahaḥ saiva sañjñā sañjātā yasya sa tathā| (natu ayaṃ pāṭho hastalikhitapustake nopalabhyate bhūtavidyāvat pitṛlokābhihitagraha iti)||4-5||

lg.l: trastān hṛṣṭāṃstarjitān tāḍitān vā pūjāhetor hiṃsyur ete kumārān ||6||

ab.seg: kasmādgrahā bālān viśantītyāha- dhātrītyādi| dhātrī stanapāyinī poṣayitrītyarthaḥ, mātā prasavitrī| prākpradiṣṭāpacārāditi prāk śārīrasthāne pradiṣṭo'pacāraḥ akṛtyavidhiḥ māṃsasurādīnāṃ laulyādācaraṇaṃ vā| śaucaṃ mūtrapurīṣādiprakṣālanaṃ, maṅgalaṃ svastikasragdāmadūrvāvacāsarṣapādisparśanam, ācāraḥ pāpavirodhī, trastān udvignān, hṛṣṭān muditān, tarjitān anyena ‘yena kenacit’ iti pā. kenacidvibhīṣitān| tāḍitān abhihatān| kathaṃ pūjā jāyate? kusumādinā bhojanādinā ca| ato hetoḥ dhātrīmātrorapacārāddūṣaṇādyanvitān bālān| pūjā cātropalakṣaṇaṃ; tena ratihetorapi hiṃsyuriti| nanu, dhātrīmātropacārādbālānāmanaparādhitvāt kathaṃ grahahiṃsanaṃ? atrocyate- bālānāṃ prāktanakarmayogata evāpacāraṃ kurutaḥ| kumārānityupalakṣaṇaṃ; tena kumārikā api hiṃsyuḥ| ete grahā ityarthaḥ||6||

lg.l: aiśvaryasthās te na śakyā viśanto dehaṃ draṣṭuṃ mānuṣair viśvarūpāḥ |
āptaṃ vākyaṃ tat samīkṣyābhidhāsye liṅgāny eṣāṃ yāni dehe bhavanti ||7||

ab.seg: kasmātte grahā dehaṃ viśanto nopalabhyante ityāha ‘nanu pratyakṣāviṣayatvāt kṛtāveśānāṃ grahāṇāṃ kena jñānaṃ bhaviṣyatītyāha-’ iti pā. - aiśvaryetyādi| eṣāṃ grahāṇāṃ yāni liṅgāni bhavanti tāni āptaṃ vākyaṃ samīkṣyābhidhāsye kathayiṣye iti piṇḍārthaḥ| āptaṃ vākyam āptairuktaṃ vākyam; āptāśca yathārthavādinaḥ ‘tattvārthavedinaḥ’ iti pā.||7||

lg.l: śūnākṣaḥ ‘stabdhākṣaḥ’ iti pā. kṣatajasagandhikaḥ stanadviḍ vakrāsyo hatacalitaikapakṣmanetraḥ |
udvignaḥ sululitacakṣur alparodī skandārto bhavati ca gāḍhamuṣṭivarcāḥ ||8||

ab.seg: skandagrahārtalakṣaṇamāha- śūnākṣa ityādi| kṣatajasagandhikaḥ rudhirasamānagandhikaḥ, visragandha ityarthaḥ; anye tu kṣatajaṃ raktaṃ tatsagandhika īṣadrudhiragandhika ityarthaḥ| stanadviṭ stanadveṣī| vakrāsyaḥ vakramukhaḥ| hatacalitaikapakṣmanetra iti hataṃ calitaṃ caikapakṣma netre yasya sa tathā| udvignaḥ udvignacittaḥ| sululitacakṣuḥ kiñcinmilitalocanaḥ| skandārta iti skandavinodanārthaṃ rudreṇa sṛṣṭo grahaḥ tenārtaḥ, skando'tra na punarbhagavān kārtikeyaḥ| gāḍhe muṣṭivarcasī yasya sa tathā| gayadāsastu ‘stabdhāṅgaḥ’ kṣatajasagandhikaḥ stanadviṭ vakrāsyo hatacaraṇaikapakṣmanetraḥ’ iti paṭhitvā ‘stabdhamaṅgaṃ yasya sa tathā, hatāni ekapādaikapakṣmārdhanayanāni yasya sa tathā’ iti vyākhyānayati||8||

lg.l: niḥsañjño bhavati punar bhavet sasañjñaḥ saṃrabdhaḥ karacaraṇaiś ca nṛtyatīva |
viṇmūtre sṛjati vinadya jṛmbhamāṇaḥ phenaṃ ca prasṛjati tat sakhābhipannaḥ ||9||

ab.seg: skandāpasmārārtalakṣaṇamāha- niḥsañjña ityādi| saṃrabdhaḥ samyak kalitaḥ san, karacaraṇabhyāṃ hastapādābhyāṃ, nṛtyatīva nartanamiva karoti| vinadya śabdaṃ kṛtvā; kvacit ‘vinamya’ iti pāṭhaḥ, tatra gātravinamanaṃ kṛtvā; viṇmūtre muñcatīti vyākhyānam| tatsakhābhipannaḥ tacchabdena skandaḥ kathyate, tasya sakhā skandāpasmāraḥ, tenākrāntaḥ||9||

lg.l: sphoṭaiś ca pracitatanuḥ sadāhapākair vijñeyo bhavati śiśuḥ kṣataḥ śakunyā ||10||

ab.seg: śakunigrahārtalakṣaṇamāha- srastāṅga ityādi| srastāṅgaḥ śithilāṅgaḥ| bhayacakito bhītaḥ| vihaṅgā atra māṃsādā jalacarāśca| saṃsrāvivraṇaparipīḍitaḥ pūyāsrāvivraṇaparipīḍitaḥ| samantāt sarvataḥ| atroktavraṇasphoṭayorvidīrṇāvidīrṇatvena bhedaḥ| kṣataḥ abhibhūtaḥ||10||

lg.l: revatyā vyathitatanuś ca karṇanāsaṃ mṛdnāti dhruvam abhipīḍitaḥ kumāraḥ ||11||

ab.seg: revatīgrahārtasya lakṣaṇamāha- raktāsya ityādi| haritamala iti malo'tra viṣṭhā mūtraṃ ca| jvaramukhapākavedanārtaḥ jvarārto mukhapākavedanārtaśca| vyathitatanuriti sarujaśarīraḥ| abhipīḍito revatyā iti sambandhaḥ||11||

lg.l: srastāṅgaḥ svapiti sukhaṃ divā na rātrau viḍ bhinnaṃ sṛjati ca kākatulyagandhiḥ |
chardyā''rto hṛṣitatanūruhaḥ kumāras tṛṣṇālur bhavati ca pūtanāgṛhītaḥ ||12||

ab.seg: pūtanāgrahārtalakṣaṇamāha- srastāṅga ityādi| na divā sukhaṃ svapiti na ca rātrau sukhaṃ svapiti| sṛjati muñcati| ‘srastāṅga’ ityatra kecit ‘svasthāṅga’ iti paṭhanti, svasthāṅgo'pi na divā na rātrau svapitīti vyākhyānayanti||12||

lg.l: yo dveṣṭi stanam atisārakāsahikkācchardībhir jvarasahitābhir ardyamānaḥ |
durvarṇaḥ satatam adhaḥśayo 'mlagandhis taṃ brūyur bhiṣaja ihāndhapūtanārtam ||13||

ab.seg: andhapūtanārtalakṣaṇamāha- ya ityādi| adhaḥśayaḥ adhomukhaśāyī| amlagandhiḥ kāñjikādyamladravyagandhiḥ||13||

lg.l: udvigno bhṛśam ativepate prarudyāt saṃlīnaḥ svapiti ca yasya cāntrakūjaḥ |
visrāṅgo bhṛśam atisāryate ca yas taṃ jānīyād bhiṣag iha śītapūtanārtam ||14||

ab.seg: śītapūtanārtalakṣaṇamāha- udvigna ityādi| saṃlīnaḥ samyaglīnaḥ, śayyaikadeśe lagna ityarthaḥ| visrāṅgo visragandhāṅgaḥ| ‘udvigno bhṛśamati’ ityatra kecit ‘ākrandatyaticakitaḥ’ iti paṭhanti||14||

lg.l: mlānāṅgaḥ surucir apāṇipādavaktro bahvāśī kaluṣasirāvṛtodaro yaḥ |
sodvego bhavati ca mūtratulyagandhiḥ sa jñeyaḥ śiśur iha vaktramaṇḍikārtaḥ ||15||

ab.seg: mukhamaṇḍikāgrahārtalakṣaṇamāha- mlānāṅga ityādi| mlānāṅgo durbalamadhyaśarīraḥ| surucirapāṇipādavaktra iti suṣṭhu ruciraṃ śobhanaṃ hastapādavaktraṃ yasya saḥ| vaktramaṇḍikarto mukhamaṇḍikārta ityarthaḥ||15||

lg.l: yaḥ phenaṃ vamati vinamyate ca madhye sodvegam vilapati cordhvamīkṣamāṇaḥ |
jvaryeta pratatam atho vasāsagandhir niḥsañjño bhavati hi naigameṣajuṣṭaḥ ||16||

ab.seg: naigameṣagrahārtalakṣaṇamāha- ya ityādi| madhye madhyāṅge| sodvegaṃ satrāsaṃ, vilapati atiśayena śabdaṃ karoti, ūrdhvamīkṣamāṇaḥ ūrdhvaṃ paśyan| ‘vilapati’ ityatra kecit ‘vihasati’ iti paṭhanti| jvaryeta pratataṃ satatam| vasāsagandhiḥ vasayā tulyagandhiḥ| niḥsañjñaḥ nirgatasamyagjñānaḥ||16||

lg.l: prastabdho yaḥ stanadveṣī muhyate cāviśan muhuḥ |
taṃ bālam acirād dhanti grahaḥ sampūrṇalakṣaṇaḥ ||17||

ab.seg: sāmpratamasādhyagrahārtalakṣaṇamāha- prastabdha ityādi| prastabdho'tyarthaṃ stabdhāṅgaḥ| muhyate mohaṃ yāti| āviśan āveśaṃ kurvan| muhuḥ vāraṃvāram||17||

div.ab: sādhyagrahārtalakṣaṇamāha- viparītamityādi| viparītaṃ prastabdha stanadveṣādilakṣaṇairanupahatam| acirārditam alpakālapīḍitam|18|-

lg.l: sarṣapān prakiret teṣāṃ tailair dīpaṃ ‘taile dīpaṃ’ iti pā. ca kārayet |
agnaye kṛttikābhyaś ca svāhā svāheti santatam ||20||

ab.seg: sādhyasya cikitsāmāha- gṛhe ityādi| purāṇahaviṣā jīrṇaghṛtena, abhyajya bālaṃ cupāṭitvā| śucau pavitradeśe, śuciḥ ‘bhiṣag’ iti śeṣaḥ| teṣāṃ tailaiḥ sarṣapāṇāṃ tailaiḥ, dīpaṃ kārayet dīpaṃ prajvālayedityarthaḥ| sadetyādi| juhuyāt homaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ| havyavāhanam agnim| kairjuhuyāt? sarvagandhauṣadhībījairiti; sarvagandhā elādiparipaṭhitāḥ, oṣadhībījani yavadhānyatilādīni, tairjuhuyāt| gandhamālyairalaṅkṛtamagniṃ bālaṃ vā, satataṃ vāraṃvāraṃ na sakṛt| ayaṃ vidhiḥ sarvagrahāṇāṃ sāmānyaḥ| agnaya ityādi| agniṃ hutvā tato madhyāhne baliṃ dadyāt||18-20||

lg.l: nīrujo nirvikāraś ca śiśur me jāyatāṃ drutam ||21||

ab.seg: tatra yaṃ mantramuccarettamāha- nama ityādi||21||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre navagrahākṛtivijñānīyo nāma (prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) saptaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||27||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kaumārabhṛtyatantre navagrahākṛtivijānīyo nāma saptaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||27||
athātaḥ skandhagrahapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
navagrahākṛtivijñānīyānantaraṃ vijñātanavagrahākṛteścikitsitamucitaṃ; tatrāpi skandagrahasya prathamatvāttapratiṣedhādhyāya ārabhyate- athāta ityādi||1-2||

skandetyādi| upasṛṣṭānāṃ gṛhītānām| drumagrahaṇaṃ viṭapaniṣedhārtham| skandagrahaprabhāveṇa tenāviṣṭe bāle vāyuḥ kupyatīti vātaharaiḥ sekādayaḥ kāryoḥ; athavā vātaghnadrumāḥ svaprabhāveṇa grahāveśamapi nivartayanti, acintyaśaktitvāt||3||

lg.l: teṣāṃ mūleṣu siddhaṃ ca tailam abhyañjane hitam |

ab.seg: teṣāmityādi| teṣāṃ vātaghnadrumāṇāṃ bilvādīnām| sarvagandhā elādipaṭhitāḥ, surāmaṇḍaḥ surāyā uparyaccho bhāgaḥ, kaiḍaryo mahānimbaḥ| etena bilvādimūlakvāthena elādīnāṃ kalkena siddhaṃ tailamabhyañjane hitamiṣyata iti siddham||4||

lg.l: siddhaṃ sarpiś ca sakṣīraṃ pānam asmai prayojayet ||5||

ab.seg: devadāruṇītyādi| madhuradrumā madhuravṛkṣāḥ, madhu(dhū)karājādanādayaḥ| pānam annādasya bālasya||5||
kākādanī kākajaṅghā||6||

lg.l: mṛgādanyāś ca mūlāni grathitāny eva dhārayet ||7||

ab.seg: somavallītyādi| somavallī guḍūcī, indravallī matsāṇḍakaḥ ‘matsyāṇḍakaḥ’ iti pā. gaṇḍadūrveti loke, mṛgādanī indravāruṇī||7||

lg.l: raktāni mālyāni tathā patākā raktāś ca gandhā vividhāś ca bhakṣyāḥ |
ghaṇṭā ca devāya balir nivedyaḥ sukukkuṭaḥ skandagrahe hitāya ||8||

ab.seg: baliṃ nirdiśannāha- raktānītyādi| tathā patākā raktetyarthaḥ| raktāśca gandhāḥ kuṅkumādikāḥ| bhakṣyāḥ svastikamodakādayaḥ| devāya skandanāmne, skandagrahe vakṣyamāṇe catvārākhye| hitāya hitārthaṃ bālakasya| baliśca śucinā vaidyena kṛtasnānena śastrahastena rātrau dātavyaḥ||8||

lg.l: snānaṃ trirātraṃ niśi catvareṣu kuryāt puraṃ śāliyavair navais tu |
adbhiś ca gāyatryabhimantritābhiḥ prajvālanaṃ vyāhṛtibhiś ca vahneḥ ||9||

ab.seg: snānamityādi| catvareṣu catuṣpatheṣu, apare catvaraśabdena tripathaṃ kathāsthānaṃ cetyāhuḥ| puraṃ maṇḍalam| adbhiśca gāyatryabhimantritābhiḥ snānamiti sambandhanīyam| vyāhṛtibhistisṛbhiḥ saptabhirdaśabhirvā svāhāntābhiḥ| skandagrahe catvarākhye śāliyavairviracitamaṇḍalābhyantarasadmani purābhidhāne, trirātraṃ rātrau balisnānahomāḥ kāryāḥ||9||

lg.l: ahany ahani kartavyā yā bhiṣagbhir atandritaiḥ ||10||
tapasāṃ tejasāṃ caiva yaśasāṃ vapuṣāṃ tathā |
nidhānaṃ yo 'vyayo devaḥ sa te skandaḥ prasīdatu ||11||
devadevasya mahataḥ pāvakasya ca yaḥ sutaḥ |
gaṅgomākṛttikānāṃ ca sa te śarma prayacchatu ||13||

ab.seg: rakṣamityādi| rakṣā svastyayanaṃ; mantrāṇāmacintyaśaktitvānmantramayī rakṣā pāpanāśinī| tapasāmityādi| vapuṣāmiti vapuṣāṃ nidhānaṃ sthānamityanena kāmarūpatvamuktam| avyayo nityaḥ| grahāḥ skandagrahādikāḥ, teṣāṃ senā tasyāḥ patiḥ devasenāpatiḥ| devasenāripavo daityāḥ| devadevasya rudrasya, umā pārvatī, kṛttikāḥ ṣaṭsaṅkhyopetāḥ saptarṣibhāryāḥ| śarma sukham| krauñcanāmā parvataḥ taṃ sūdayati nihantīti krauñcasūdanaḥ||10-14||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre skandapratiṣedho nāmā (dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ, ādito')ṣṭāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||28||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kaumārabhṛtyatantre skandagrahapratiṣedho nāmā'ṣṭāviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||28||

div.head: skandāpasmārapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ skandāpasmārapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

lg.l: bilvaḥ śirīṣo golomī surasādiś ca yo gaṇaḥ |

ab.seg: skandapratiṣedhānantaraṃ pratyāsattyā skandāpasmārapratiṣedhārambho yujyata ityāha- bilva ityādi| golomī dūrvā||1-3||

lg.l: vipaktavyaṃ ghṛtaṃ cāpi pānīyaṃ payasā saha |5|

div.ab: sarvetyādi| sarvagandhā elādikāḥ, yathālābhamelādikatvena bilvaśirīṣādīnāṃ kvāthena tailaṃ paktavyam| anye tu ‘gandhamūtravipakvam’ iti paṭhanti; gandhāḥ sarvagandhāḥ pūrvoktāḥ, mūtraṃ gomūtram| kṣīretyādi| kṣīravṛkṣakaṣāye caturguṇe, payasā dugdhena caturguṇena, kākolyādau gaṇe kalkīkṛte snehacaturthāṃśe ghṛtaṃ vipaktavyam| tadghṛtaṃ kiṃ kāryamityāha,- pānīyaṃ pātavyam, ‘annādena’ iti śeṣaḥ| anye tu pānīyaṃ caturguṇaṃ dattvā ghṛtaṃ paktavyamiti manyante, śeṣaṃ pūrvavat||4||-

lg.l: vṛṣabhasya ca romāṇi yojyāny uddhūpane 'pi ca ||6||

ab.seg: utsādanamityādi| utsādanam udvartanam| skandagrahe hitamityatra cakāro lupto jñeyaḥ, tena skandagrahe skandāpasmāre ca hitam| (‘etadudvartanaṃ hitam’ ityatrānye ‘etadudvartaneritam’ iti paṭhanti; tanna, utsādanasyānuktatvāt)||5-6||

lg.l: anantāṃ kukkuṭīṃ bimbīṃ markaṭīṃ cāpi dhārayet |7|

div.ab: anantetyādi| anantā utpalasārivā, kukkuṭī kukkuṭīśarīravat kusumacitrā vallī sphaṭikaracitakukkuṭāṇḍatulyakandā, markaṭī kapikacchuḥ| dhārayet śarīre iti boddhavyam|7|-
pakvetyādi| prasannā surā, rudhiraṃ chāgalasya, payo dugdham| bhūtaudanaḥ bhūtānāmodanaḥ sopahāro baliḥ, utsvinnā māṣavikṛtirbalirityanye| avaṭe gartāyām||7||-

lg.l: catuṣpathe ca kartavyaṃ snānam asya yatātmanā ||8||

ab.seg: catuṣpathe ityādi| asya bālakasya| yatātmanā upavāsādiyutena| ‘yatātmanā’ ityatra kecit ‘yathāvidhi’ iti paṭhanti; skandapratiṣedhoktasnānavidhāneneti ca vyākhyānayanti||8||

rakṣāmantramāha- skandetyādi| skandasya kārtikeyasya, dayitaḥ abhīṣṭaḥ, sakhā mitraṃ, viśākhasañjña iti skandāpasmārasya dvitīyaṃ nāma| śiśoḥ bālakasya, śivo'stu kalyāṇakṛdbhavatu, vikṛtānano vikṛtamukhaḥ| ‘viśākhasañjñasya’ iti kecit paṭhanti, tatra skandasya viśeṣaṇam||9||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre skandāpasmārapratiṣedho nāma (tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) ekonatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||29||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kaumārabhṛtyatantre skandāpasmārapratiṣedho nāmaikonatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||29||

div.head: śakunīpratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ śakunīpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
skandāpasmārapratiṣedhānantaraṃ śakunīpratiṣedhārambhaḥ, skandādigrahapratipādakasūtre'syā evānantaroktatvādityāha- athāta ityādi||1-2||
śakunītyādi| abhiparītasya vyāptasya, ‘bālasya’ iti śeṣaḥ| jānatā buddhimatā| niṣkvāthaḥ pariṣecane kārya iti sambandhaḥ||3||

div.ab: kaṣāyetyādi| kaṣāyā vaṭādayaḥ, madhurāṇi kākolyādīni; tatra vaṭādīnāṃ kaṣāyaḥ, kākolyādīnāṃ ca kalkaḥ, tābhyāṃ tailaṃ sādhyaṃ; pratyekaṃ vaṭādīnāṃ kākolyādīnāṃ ca kalkakaṣāyau kalpanīyāvityanye|4|-
madhuketyādi| utpalaṃ nīlotpalam| pradihet limpet||4||-

ab.seg: vraṇeṣvityādi| vraṇeṣu śakunījuṣṭabālakavraṇeṣu| uktāni cūrṇāni dvivraṇīyādhyāye kīrtitāni miśrakoktāni ca śodhanaropaṇāni| pathyāni vraṇitopāsanīyoktāni śālimudgadāḍimasaindhavayavapaṭolādīni; anye tu pathyānīti cūrṇānītyasya viśeṣaṇaṃ kurvanti, tatra śakunījuṣṭabālakavraṇānāṃ sadāhapākaraktasrāvaharāṇi cūrṇāni prayoktavyānīti sambandhanīyam||5||

div.ab: skandetyādi| dhūpanāni sarṣapā ityādīni skandagrahoktāni, tānīhāpi śakunyamapi prayojayet|6|-

lg.l: lakṣmaṇāṃ sahadevāṃ ca bṛhatīṃ cāpi dhārayet |7|

div.ab: śatāvarītyādi| mṛgairvāruḥ indravāruṇī, nāgadantī dantinī, sahadevā pītapuṣpā balā, bṛhatī sthūlaphalā||6||-
tiletyādi| eṣa tilataṇḍulakamityādiko baliḥ| karañjeṣu naktamāleṣu| niyatātmanā saṃyatendriyeṇa ‘karañjeṣu’ ityatrānye ‘nikuñjeṣu’ iti paṭhanti, nikuñjeṣu vaneṣu||7||-

lg.l: niṣkuṭe ca prayoktavyaṃ snānam asya yathāvidhi ||8||

ab.seg: niṣkuṭe ityādi| niṣkuṭe gṛhopavane, anye niṣkuṭaṃ vanagahanamāhuḥ| yathāvidhīti skandagrahokto vidhiḥ; tena śāliyavaracitamaṇḍale gāyatryabhimantratena jalena snānamiti labhyate||8||

div.ab: skandetyādi| ghṛtaṃ devadāruṇi rāsnāyāmityādikaṃ, cakāro'tra somavallayādīnāmapi dhāraṇaṃ samuccinoti| jejjaṭastu skandagrahe dhūpanānītyādikadhūpanapāṭhānte idaṃ ghṛtaṃ paṭhati|9|-

lg.l: kuryāc ca vividhāṃ pūjāṃ śakunyāḥ kusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||9||

ab.seg: kuryādityādi| kusumaiḥ śubhairiti jātīpuṣpanīlotpalādibhiḥ||9||

lg.l: lambodarī śaṅkukarṇī ‘śaṅkhavarṇā’ iti pā. śakunī te prasīdatu ||11||

ab.seg: bālakarakṣāmāha- antarīkṣetyādi||10-11||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre śakunīpratiṣedho nāma (caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) triṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||30||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kaumārabhṛtyatantre śakunīpratiṣedho nāma triṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||30||

div.head: revatīpratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto revatīpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
śakunīpratiṣedhānantaraṃ revatyāmapi mukhapākavacanāt savraṇatvenaikadharmatvācca revatīpratiṣedhādhyāyo yujyata ityāha- athāta ityādi||1-2||

lg.l: aśvagandhā ca śṛṅgī ca sārivā sapunarnavā |
sahe tathā vidārī ca kaṣāyāḥ secane hitāḥ ||3||

ab.seg: aśvagandhetyādi| ajaśṛṅgī karkaṭaśṛṅgī, uttamāraṇītyanye| sahe mudgamāṣaparṇyau| secane hitāḥ pratyekaṃ samuditāśca||3||

lg.l: tailam abhyañjane kāryaṃ kuṣṭhe sarjarase 'pi ca |

ab.seg: tailamityādi| sarjaraso rālaḥ, palaṅkaṣā gugguluḥ, naladaṃ jaṭāmāṃsī, giriḥ girikarṇikā; anye girikadambo mahākadambaḥ svanāmakhyātaḥ; etaiḥ kuṣṭhādibhiḥ kalkīkṛtaistailaṃ kāryam||4||

dhavetyādi| aśvakarṇo gardabhāṇḍaḥ, kakubhaḥ arjunaḥ| tatra dhavādikaṣāye kākolyādikalke ca pānīyaṃ sarpiḥ pātavyaṃ ghṛtamiṣyate| anye tu kākolyādigaṇenaiva pānīyaṃ ghṛtamicchanti, dhavāśvakarṇādīni paścāttaile ‘saṅkṣudya taile saṃyacchanti' iti pā. sambandhanti||5||

lg.l: sandhyayor ubhayoḥ kāryam etad uddhūpanaṃ śiśoḥ |
satataṃ dhārayec cāpi kṛtaṃ vā pautrajīvikam |
śuklāḥ sumanaso lājāḥ payaḥ śālyodanaṃ tathā ||8||

div.ab: kulatthā ityādi| śaṅkhacūrṇaṃ sudagdhaśaṅkhacūrṇam| sarvagandhā elādikāḥ, taiḥ kṛto lepaḥ sārvagandhikaḥ| gṛdhretyādi| yavāḥ prasiddhāḥ, yavaphalo vaṃśaḥ, anye yavaphalā dugdhiketyāhuḥ| varuṇāriṣṭakamayaṃ varuṇanimbakāṣṭhaghaṭitaṃ, rucakaṃ grīvābharaṇaṃ maṇikasañjñaṃ dhārayet| brahmadevastvariṣṭaṃ phenilamāha| saindukamiti sinduko nirguṇḍī, tatkāṣṭhakṛtaṃ rucakaṃ; tatphalakṛtamityanye| putrañjīvo madhyavartulatīkṣṇāgraphalo jambīrapatro vṛkṣastatkāṣṭhakṛtaṃ rucakaṃ, tatphalakṛtamityanye| kecidatrāragvadhaṃ paṭhanti| śukletyādi śuklāḥ sumanasaḥ śvetakusumāni| nivedyo dātavyaḥ| gotīrthe salilagopathe| prayatātmanā upavāsādipavitreṇa| taduktaṃ,- “sopavāsaḥ śucirnaktaṃ saśastro nirharedbalim” iti||6-8||-

lg.l: saṅgame ca bhiṣak snānaṃ kuryād dhātrīkumārayoḥ ||9||
revatī śuṣkanāmā yā sā te devī prasīdatu ||11||

ab.seg: saṅgama ityādi| saṅgame nadīdvayamelake| rakṣāmantramāha- nānetyādi| aparā devyo vividhabhūṣaṇā yāṃ revatīmupāsate sevante sā devī bho bālaka te tava prasādaṃ karotu loke prasādakarā bhavatu| revatī śuṣkanāmā śuṣkarevatītyarthaḥ||9-11||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre revatīpratiṣedho nāma (pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) ekatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||31||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kaumārabhṛtyatantre revatīpratiṣedho nāmaikatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||31||
athātaḥ pūtanāpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
revatīpratiṣedhānantaraṃ strīgrahasāmānyāt pūtanāpratiṣedhārambho yujyata ityāha- athāta ityādi||1-2||

lg.l: āsphotā caiva yojyāḥ syur bālānāṃ pariṣecane ||3||
kuṣṭhaṃ sarjarasaś caiva tailārthe varga iṣyate ||4||

ab.seg: kapotavaṅketyādi| kapotavaṅkā kabaḍavaṅketi loke prasiddhā brahmasuvarcalāparaparyāyā| āsphotā sārivā| vayasthā brāhmī, anye guḍūcīmāhuḥ| golomī dūrvā| varga iṣyate iti vargagrahaṇaṃ yathālābhaṃ prakṣepārtham| vacādīnāṃ kalkakaṣāyābhyāṃ tailasādhyam||3-4||

lg.l: hitaṃ ghṛtaṃ tugākṣīryāṃ siddhaṃ madhurakeṣu ca |
elā hareṇavaś cāpi yojyā uddhūpane sadā ||6||
karkaṭāsthi ghṛtaṃ cāpi dhūpanaṃ sarṣapaiḥ saha ||7||

ab.seg: hitamityādi| tugākṣīrī vaṃśalocanā, madhurakeṣu kākolyādiṣu; kākolyādipāṭhāttugākṣīrī prāptā, pṛthakpāṭho bhāgadvayārthaṃ kuṣṭhatālīśādīnāṃ yathālābhaniṣedhārtho vā, ye tugākṣīrīṃ vaṃśarocanānukāripārthivadravyaṃ manyante tanmate dviruktirnāsti| kalkakaṣāyābhyāṃ siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ hitamiti sambandhaḥ| girikadambako mahākadambaḥ| gandhanākulī sugandhā rāsnā| kumbhikā jalajā| jejjaṭācāryastu na paṭhatyetaddevadārvādiyogadvayamapi, gayī tu paṭhati||5-7||

lg.l: kākādanīṃ citraphalāṃ bimbīṃ guñjāṃ ca dhārayet |
matsyaudanaṃ ca kurvīta kṛśarāṃ palalaṃ tathā |

ab.seg: kākādanīmityādi| kākādanī kākatindukaḥ, ‘kālā’ ityanye; citraphalā indravāruṇī, citrāṇḍiketyanye| matsyaudanaṃ matsyabhaktaṃ; palalaṃ tilapiṣṭam| ‘śūnyagṛhe haret’ ityatra ‘śūnyagṛhetare’ ityanye, tatretare khaṇḍagṛhe| kecidatredṛśaṃ paṭhanti ‘haredbaliṃ cotkuraṭe’ ityādi; tatrotkuraṭaḥ śūnyāgāraḥ, śūnyārāma ityanye||8||

lg.l: pūjyā ca pūtanā devī balibhiḥ sopahārakaiḥ ||9||
śūnyāgārāśritā `śūnyārāmāśritā' iti pā. devī dārakaṃ pātu pūtanā ||10||

ab.seg: ucchiṣṭenetyādi| ucchiṣṭenābhiṣekeṇa ācamanodakenetyarthaḥ| pūrvakalpena snānam| rakṣāmantraḥ- malinetyādi||9-11||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre (ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) dvātriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||32||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kaumārabhṛtyatantre pūtanāpratiṣedho nāma dvātriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||32||

div.head: andhapūtanāpratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto 'ndhapūtanāpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
pūtanāpratiṣedhānantaraṃ pūtanāsāmānyādandhapūtanāpratiṣedhārambho yujyata ityāha- athāta ityādi||1-2||

div.ab: tiktaketyādi| tiktakadrumā nimbādayaḥ, tatpatrakvāthena pariṣekaḥ kāryaḥ|3|-

suretyādi| sauvīrakaṃ virecanādhyāyopadiṣṭakāñjikaprakāraḥ| atra taile surāsauvīrake tailāt pratyekaṃ caturguṇe, kuṣṭhādīni kalkadravyāṇi caturthāṃśāni| pippalya ityādi| vargo madhurakaḥ kākolyādiḥ, vargagrahaṇaṃ yathālābhaniṣedhārthaṃ, pippalyādīnāṃ kalkakvāthābhyāṃ ghṛtaṃ vipācya śītībhūte ghṛte madhu kṣipet| idaṃ ghṛtaṃ pānāya||3-4||-

lg.l: sarvagandhaiḥ pradehaś ca gātreṣv akṣṇoś ca śītalaiḥ ||5||

ab.seg: sarvetyādi| pradeho lepaḥ| śītalairanyairapi dravyaiḥ||5||

lg.l: purīṣaṃ kaukkuṭaṃ keśāṃś carma sarpatvacaṃ tathā |

ab.seg: purīṣaṃ kaukkuṭamiti kukkuṭapurīṣaṃ, keśāṃścarma ca kukkuṭasya, keśāścarma ca mānuṣasyetyeke; kecit carmeti sarpasya vadanti, tena carma tvak kañculikā sarpasya| jīrṇāṃ ca bhikṣusaṅghāṭīmiti bhikṣuratra śākyabhikṣurbauddhākhyaḥ parivrājakaśca, tayorjīrṇasaṅghāṭī jīrṇavastraṃ; tadekadeśo gṛhyate, ekadeśe'pi samudāyapravṛtteḥ; bhikṣuratra śākyabhikṣureveti jejjaṭaḥ||6||

lg.l: kukkuṭīṃ markaṭīṃ śimbīm anantāṃ cāpi dhārayet |
māṃsam āmaṃ tathā pakvaṃ śoṇitaṃ ca catuṣpathe ||7||
nivedyam antaś ca gṛhe śiśo rakṣānimittataḥ |
śiśoś ca snapanaṃ kuryāt sarvagandhodakaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||8||
devī bālam imaṃ prītā saṃrakṣatv andhapūtanā ||9||

ab.seg: kukkuṭīmityādi| kukkuṭī sphaṭikaracitakukkuṭāṇḍasadṛśakandā kukkuṭīśarīravat kusumacitrā vallī| markaṭī kapikacchuḥ, markaṭamūlītyanye, śukaśimbītyapare| anantā sārivā| antaśca khaṇḍagṛhābhyantare| śiśośceti cakārāt dhātryāśca snapanam| sarvagandhā elādikāḥ| devī prītā satī imaṃ bālaṃ rakṣatviti sambandhaḥ||7-9||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre 'ndhapūtanāpratiṣedho nāma (saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) trayastriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||33||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kaumārabhṛtyatantre'ndhapūtanāpratiṣedho nāma trayastriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||33||

div.head: śītapūtanāpratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ śītapūtanāpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
andhapūtanāpratiṣedhānantaraṃ pūtanāsāmānyācchītapūtanāpratiṣedhārambho yujyata ityāha- athāta ityādi||1-2||

lg.l: kapitthaṃ suvahāṃ bimbīṃ tathā bilvaṃ pracībalam |
bastamūtraṃ gavāṃ mūtraṃ mustaṃ ca suradāru ca |
kuṣṭhaṃ ca sarvagandhāṃś ca tailārtham avacārayet ||4||
niṣkvāthya tasmin niṣkvāthe sakṣīraṃ vipaced ghṛtam ||5||
dhārayed api lambāṃ ca guñjāṃ kākādanīṃ tathā |7|

div.ab: kapitthamityādi| suvahā godhāpadī| pracībalo matsyākṣakaḥ, kākajaṅghetyanye| nadībhallātakaṃ nadīpippalikā gaṇḍopalīti paryāyā| sarvagandhā elādikāḥ| atra taile kuṣṭhadvayasya pāṭho bhāgadvayārthaḥ| rohiṇī kaṭphalaḥ| rohiṇyādikvāthe triguṇe kṣīraikabhāge ghṛtaṃ pacet| bastagandhā bothayikā| ahestvacaḥ sarpasya kañcukāḥ| lambā tiktālābūḥ| kākādanī kākatindukā||3-6||-

lg.l: devyai deyaś copahāro vāruṇī rudhiraṃ tathā |

ab.seg: nadyāmityādi| mudgakṛtairannaiḥ mudgakṛtairbhakṣyaiḥ, mudgodaneneti gayī| upahāro baliḥ| jalāśayānte nadyāḥ samīpe||7-8||
rakṣāmāha- mudgetyādi||9||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre śītapūtanāpratiṣedho nāma (aṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) catustriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||34||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kaumārabhṛtyatantre śītapūtanāpratiṣedhādhyāyaścatustriṃśattamaḥ||34||
athāto mukhamaṇḍikāpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
śītapūtanāpratiṣedhānantaraṃ strīgrahasāmānyānmukhamaṇḍikāpratiṣedhārambho yujyata ityāha- athāta ityādi||1-2||

lg.l: kuberākṣī ca yojyāḥ syur bālānāṃ pariṣecane ||3||

ab.seg: kapitthetyādi| tarkārī araṇikā, vāṃśī vaṃśalocanā, kuberākṣī kāṣṭhapāṭalā, peṭiketyanye||3||

lg.l: svarasair bhṛṅgavṛkṣāṇāṃ `bhṛṅgavṛkṣo bhṛṅgarāja' iti hārāṇacandraḥ tathā'jaharigandhayoḥ |
tailaṃ vasāṃ ca saṃyojya paced abhyañjane śiśoḥ ||4||

ab.seg: bhṛṅgavṛkṣāṇāmiti vātaharabilvādikānāṃ bhṛṅgāḥ patrabhaṅgāḥ, tadupayogikā vṛkṣāḥ| ajaharigandhayoriti bastagandhāśvagandhayoḥ, ajāśvagandhācaturguṇarasena tailaṃ vasāṃ ca saṃyojya yamakaṃ pacediti manyante; ‘ajaharigandhayoḥ’ ityatra ca ‘tathaiva harigandhayā’ iti paṭhanti||4||

lg.l: madhure pañcamūle ca kanīyasi ghṛtaṃ pacet ||5||

ab.seg: madhūlikāyāmityādi| madhūlikā markaṭahastatṛṇam| payasi gokṣīre| atra gayī payaḥsvinīti paṭhati; tatra kṣīravidārīgaṇe; tathā madhure kākolyādike, pañcamūle kanīyasi śālaparṇyādike| madhūlikādikalkakvāthābhyāṃ ghṛtaṃ pacet||5||

lg.l: vacā sarjarasaḥ kuṣṭhaṃ sarpiś coddhūpanaṃ hitam |
varṇakaṃ cūrṇakaṃ mālyam añjanaṃ pāradaṃ tathā |
mantrapūtābhir adbhiś ca tatraiva snapanaṃ hitam ||8||

ab.seg: vacetyādi| cāṣaḥ karṇāyasaḥ, cīralliḥ ‘cilla’ iti loke, cāṣādijihvāṃ dhārayet| varṇako rocanikā kampillaka ityarthaḥ, kaṅkuṣṭhamityanye| mālyaṃ puṣpam| añjanaṃ rasāñjanaṃ, sauvīrāñjanamityanye| pāradaṃ śambhuretaḥ| pūrvakalpena śālyādikṛtamaṇḍale goṣṭhamadhye varṇakādibalimupaharet, anye tu varṇakādidravyāṇi maṇḍalārthaṃ manyante| pāyasaṃ kṣīrasaṃsiddhāstaṇḍulāḥ, puroḍāśaḥ aṣṭākapālaḥ piṣṭamayaḥ kapālopari pakvastṛṇāgninā| mantretyādi mantrapūtābhiḥ gāyatryā abhimantritābhiḥ| tatraiva goṣṭhamadhye||6-8||
rakṣāmāha- alaṅkṛtetyādi||9||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre mukhamaṇḍikāpratiṣedho nāma (navamo 'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) pañcatriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||35||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kaumārabhṛtyatantre mukhamaṇḍikāpratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ pañcatriṃśattamaḥ||35||
athāto naigameṣapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
mukhamaṇḍikāpratiṣedhānantaraṃ pariśiṣṭhatvānnaigameṣapratiṣedhārambho yukta ityāha- athāto naigameṣapratiṣedhamityādi||1-2||

lg.l: surā sabījaṃ dhānyāmlaṃ pariṣeke ca śasyate ||3||

ab.seg: bilvāgnimanthetyādi| pūtīkaḥ cirabilvaḥ| ‘surā sabījaṃ dhānyāmlaṃ’ ityatrānye ‘surāsabījadhānyāmlaiḥ’ iti paṭhanti; tathāpāṭhe sabījaṃ dhānyāmlaṃ bījena saha kāñjikamiti| anye tu surāsthāne tatheti paṭhanti| sabījamapyatra sauvīramiti kecit| priyaṅgusaraletyādi| saralā śuklā trivṛt, anantā utpalasārivā, kuṭannaṭaṃ tagaraṃ; tatra priyaṅgvādikalkaṃ caturthāṃśaṃ, dadhyādidravyaiścaturbhiḥ pratyekaṃ samaṃ tailaṃ pacediti kramaḥ||3-4||

lg.l: paced ghṛtaṃ ca medhāvī kharjūrīmastake 'pi vā ||5||

ab.seg: pañcamūladvayakvāthe iti pañcamūladvayakvāthe daśamūlakvāthe triguṇe, kṣīre ghṛtasame, kākolyādikalkacaturthāṃśaṃ, kharjūrīmajjacaturthāṃśaṃ vā ghṛtaṃ pānārthaṃ pacedityarthaḥ||5||

lg.l: vacāṃ vayaḥsthāṃ golomīṃ jaṭilāṃ cāpi dhārayet |

ab.seg: vacāmityādi| vayaḥsthā guḍūcī, brāhmītyanye, golomī dūrvā, jaṭilā māṃsī| utsādanam udvartanam||6||
siddhārthaketyādi| akṣatā yavāḥ||7||

lg.l: dhūpaḥ supte jane kāryo bālasya hitam icchatā ||8||

ab.seg: markaṭetyādi| markaṭādipurīṣeṇa rātrau supte loke bālasya dhūpanam||8||

lg.l: tilataṇḍulakaṃ mālyaṃ bhakṣyāṃś ca vividhān api |

ab.seg: tiletyādi| vividhān svastikamodakādīn| kumārapitṛmeṣāyeti kumārāṇāṃ pitā rakṣaṇātmakatvāt, meṣo naigameṣaḥ, tasmai naigameṣāya| vṛkṣamūle kṣīravṛkṣamūle| nivedayettilādikaṃ balim||9||
rakṣāmāha- adhastādityādi| snapanaṃ gāyatryabhimantritābhiradbhiḥ| balimapi tilataṇḍulamityādikaṃ vaṭamūle ṣaṣṭhyāṃ nivedayet||10-11||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre naigameṣapratiṣedho nāma (daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) ṣaṭtriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||36||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kaumārabhṛtyatantre naigameṣapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśattamaḥ||36||

div.head: grahotpattyadhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto grahotpattim adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

navagrahākṛtivijñānaṃ cikitsitaṃ cābhidhāya bālagrahāṇāmutpattiṃ kāraṇaṃ cābhidhātuṃ grahotpattyadhyāyārambho yujyata ityāha- athāta ityādi| grahāṇāṃ skandādīnām, utpattiḥ āgatiḥ prāptiḥ; etena krīḍanārthaṃ niyojanamatrotpattiḥ, nābhūtaprādurbhāvaḥ; kutaḥ? teṣāṃ nityatvāt||1-2||

lg.l: nava skandādayaḥ proktā bālānāṃ ya ime grahāḥ |

ab.seg: navetyādi| vigrahaḥ śarīraṃ; tatra ca skandaskandāpasmāranaigameṣāḥ puruṣaśarīrāḥ, śeṣāḥ strīśarīrāḥ||3||

ete ityādi| śaravaṇasthasya ātmatejasā rakṣitasyāpi rakṣārthaṃ kṛttikādibhirete skandādayo grahāḥ sṛṣṭā niyojitā ityarthaḥ; guhasya kārtikeyasya, ātmatejasā svaśaktyā| nanu svabhāvarakṣitasya guhasya rakṣakaiḥ kiṃ? ucyate- yathā svaśaktyā anabhibhavanīyasyāpi indrasya anye devā rakṣakāḥ, prabhudharmatvāt; tadvadguhasyāpi anye grahā rakṣakāḥ, prabhudharmatvāt||4||

lg.l: strīvigrahā grahā ye tu nānārūpā mayeritāḥ |

ab.seg: strītyādi| strīvigrahā nārīśarīrāḥ, nānārūpā meṣādimukhāḥ, mayā dhanvantariṇā, īritāḥ kathitāḥ| te strīvigrahāḥ| bhāgā aṃśāḥ, rājasatāmasā matā rajastamomayāḥ smṛtāḥ| yadyapi sarvagrahāṇāṃ rajastamomayatvaṃ, tathā'pi strīvigrahāṇāmevātyarthaṃ rajastamoguṇabhūyiṣṭhatvaṃ; tadbhūyiṣṭhatvāccātiśayena hiṃsātmakatvamiti tebhyo bālako rakṣitavyaḥ||5||

lg.l: naigameṣas tu pārvatyā sṛṣṭo meṣānano grahāḥ |

ab.seg: naigameṣa ityādi| naigameṣaḥ puṅgrahaḥ, meṣānana eḍakamukhaḥ, bālakautukāya sṛṣṭaḥ| kumāradhārī kumārapālayitā; ‘kumārahārī’ ityanye paṭhanti, tatra kumārān haratītyarthaḥ| ātmasama ātmatulyaḥ, sakhā mitram| ‘ātmasama’ ityatrānye ‘ātmodbhava’ iti paṭhanti, tatrātmodbhavaḥ putraḥ||6||

lg.l: sa ca skandasakhā nāma viśākha iti cocyate ||7||

ab.seg: skandetyādi| apasmāravikāraliṅgaliṅgatavikāritvena skandāpasmāra ityucyate| so'gninā sṛṣṭa iti sambadhyate| viśākha iti skandāpasmārasyāparaṃ nāma||7||

lg.l: bibharti cāparāṃ sañjñāṃ kumāra iti sa grahaḥ ||8||

ab.seg: skanda ityādi| tripurāriṇā rudreṇa sṛṣṭaḥ||8||

lg.l: mithyācāreṣu `mithyā bāleṣu' iti pā. bhagavān svayaṃ naiṣa pravartate ||9||

ab.seg: guhasya skandādibhyo bhedamāha- bālalīlādhara ityādi| līlā ceṣṭā, rudrāgnisambhava iti rudrasambhavo'gnisambhavaśca| mithyācāreṣu bāleṣvityarthaḥ| svayaṃ na pravartate tadanucarāstu pravartante, kutaḥ? yato'sya devatvādyāgādibhireva tṛptiḥ| ‘bālalīlādhara’ ityatra ‘bālalīlāṭana’ ityanye paṭhanti||9||
kumāra ityādi| kumāraḥ kārtikeyaḥ, skandasāmānyāt skandagrahanāmatulyatvādbālaṃ gṛhṇātīti ye kecidapaṇḍitā dehacintakā vaidyā bruvate te'lpavijñānā apaṇḍitāḥ||10||

lg.l: ūcuḥ prāñjalayaś cainaṃ vṛttiṃ naḥ saṃvidhatsva vai |
teṣām arthe tataḥ skandaḥ śivaṃ devam acodayat ||12||
tato grahāṃs tān uvāca bhagavān bhaganetrahṛt |
tiryagyoniṃ mānuṣaṃ ca daivaṃ ca tritayaṃ jagat ||13||
devā manuṣyān prīṇanti tairyagyonīṃs tathaiva ca ||14||
narāḥ samyak prayuktaiś ca prīṇanti tridiveśvarān |
bhāgadheyaṃ vibhaktaṃ ca śeṣaṃ kiñcin na vidyate ||16||
tad yuṣmākaṃ śubhā vṛttir bāleṣv eva bhaviṣyati |
kuleṣu yeṣu nejyante devāḥ pitara eva ca ||17||
gṛheṣu teṣu ye bālās tān gṛhṇīdhvam aśaṅkitāḥ ||19||
tatra vo vipulā vṛttiḥ pūjā caiva bhaviṣyati |
evaṃ grahāḥ samutpannā bālān gṛhṇanti cāpy ataḥ ||20||

div.ab: ke tarhi bālān gṛhṇantīti pṛṣṭa āha- tata ityādi| tato guharakṣārthaṃ navagraheṣu sṛṣṭeṣu satsu, anantaraṃ surā devāsteṣāṃ senā tasyāḥ patau svāmini guhe kṛte sati, upatasthuḥ āgatāḥ| śaktiḥ āyudhaviśeṣaḥ| ūcuḥ uktavantaḥ| prāñjalayaḥ saṃyojitahastāḥ| enaṃ guhaṃ prati; enamityatra anye deveti guhasambodhanaṃ paṭhanti| kimūcuḥ? vṛttiṃ `vṛttirjīvanaṃ' iti pā. vartanaṃ, naḥ asmākaṃ, saṃvidhatsva kuru, vai sphuṭam| ātmavṛttyarthamupasthitānāṃ grahāṇāṃ kārtikeyena kiṃ kṛtamityāha- teṣāmityādi| tataḥ skandaḥ śivaṃ devamacodayatteṣāṃ grahaṇāmarthe, tato grahavṛttiprārthanādanantaraṃ, skandaḥ kārtikeyaḥ, acodayat prārthitavān| evaṃ grahārthe prārthitaḥ śaṅkaraḥ kiṃ kṛtavānityāha- tata ityādi| tataḥ prārthanānantaraṃ tān grahān prati bhagavān bhaganetrahṛt bhagalocanahārī rudra uktavān| kimuktavānityāha- tiryagityādi| tiryagyonimānuṣadevānāṃ tritayaṃ jagacchabdavācyaṃ, etattritayaṃ parasparamanyonyopakāreṇa vartate, dhāryate'pi ceti cakārāt kriyate ca| tatra tiryagyonayo gavādayaḥ, te manuṣyānupakurvanti vahanādinā; mānuṣāśca māṣādidānena tiryagyonīnupakurvanti| devamānuṣayoḥ parasparopakāramāha- devā ityādi| yathākālaṃ śītoṣṇavarṣādīn `śītoṣṇavarṣādibhiḥ' iti pā. kṛtvā mānuṣān tiryagyonīṃśca prīṇayantīti sambandhaḥ| deveṣu mānuṣopakāramāha- ijyetyādi| ijyā yāgaḥ, añjaliḥ karadvayayojanaṃ, namaskāraḥ praṇāmaḥ, japa oṅkārapūrvakaṃ gāyatryādyāvartanaṃ, homo lakṣādisaṅkhyāhutibhirvahnau havanaṃ, vrataṃ prasiddhaṃ, samyakprayuktaiḥ vedoktavidhānena prayuktaiḥ; ijyāñjaliprabhṛtibhiḥ samyakprayuktairnarāstridiveśvarān devān prīṇayantīti sambandhaḥ| bhāgadheyamityādi| bhāgadheyam aṃśasamūhaḥ, vibhaktaṃ devāditritayena sarvameva vibhajya gṛhītaṃ, śeṣam avaśiṣṭaṃ, kiñcinnāsti yatastattasmādbālagraharakṣārthaṃ sṛṣṭatvādyuṣmākaṃ vṛttirapi bho grahā bāleṣveva bhaviṣyatīti| anaparādheṣu bāleṣu vṛttiṃ kalpayan śambhurapi doṣabhāk syādataḥ sāparādheṣu vṛttimāha- kuleṣvityādi| nejyante na pūjyante, utsanne `utsannabalibhikṣeṣu naṣṭapūjābhikṣeṣu' iti pā. naṣṭe balibhikṣe yeṣu tāni tathā, teṣu vṛttiriti| atra hiṃsanameva vṛttiḥ| pūjā caiveti puṣpādinā bhojanādinā cetyarthaḥ||11-20||-

lg.l: vaikalyaṃ maraṇaṃ cāpi dhruvaṃ skandagrahe matam ||21||
anyo vā sarvarūpas tu na sādhyo graha ucyate ||22||

ab.seg: evamityādi| vaikalyaṃ vikalāṅgatā| dhruvaṃ niścitam| skandetyādi| sarveṣveva graheṣu madhye skandagraho yato'tyugratamaḥ, ata eva tadgṛhītasya dhruvaṃ maraṇaṃ, atha kathañcijjīvati tadā vaikalyamiti| anya ityādi| anyo vā skandāpasmārādikaḥ||21-22||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre grahotpattyadhyāyo nāma (ekādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) saptatriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||37||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kaumārabhṛtyatantre grahetpattyadhyāyaḥ saptatriṃśattamaḥ||37||

div.head: yonivyāpatpratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto yonivyāpatpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
