ab.seg: kaiḥ praduṣyatītyāha- ekaśa ityādi| atyarthamucchritaiḥ atyantavṛddhaiḥ, ekaśo vātādibhiḥ, sarvaśaḥ sarvairdoṣaiḥ, sā grahaṇī duṣṭā satī bhuktamannaṃ, bahuśo bahūn vārān, āmamapakvameva vimuñcati| kiṃ sā duṣṭā satī āmameva paraṃ vimuñcatītyāha- pakvaṃ vetyādi| āyurvedavidaḥ aṣṭāṅgajñāḥ||171-172||

ato grahaṇīrogasya pūrvarūpamāha- tasyotpattāvityādi| tasya grahaṇīrogasya| vidāho'nne annaṃ bhuktaṃ vidahyatītyarthaḥ| sadanam aṅgasādaḥ, ālasyam anutsāhaḥ, tṛṭ pipāsā, klamo vinā'pi vyāyāmaṃ śramaḥ| karṇakṣveḍaḥ anekavidhahuṅkārādiśabdaśravaṇam| ‘vidāho'nne’ ityatrānye ‘vidāho'ntaḥ’ iti paṭhanti, antaḥkoṣṭhe'nnaṃ vidāhamāpādayatīti vyākhyānayanti ca||173||

lg.l: atha jāte bhavej jantuḥ śūnapādakaraḥ kṛśaḥ |

ab.seg: pūrvarūpānantaraṃ rūpamāha- athetyādi| parvaruk sandhipīḍā, laulyaṃ sarvaraseṣu lolupatvam| udgiret vamet| śuktaṃ cukram| gandhaśabdo lohādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| praseko lālāsrāvaḥ| tamakaḥ śvāsaviśeṣaḥ, anye tu tamakaṃ mohamācakṣate| pīḍitaśabdaḥ prasekādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| atra pāṭhe ‘nirmāso vā kṛśaḥ’ ityanye paṭhanti, tatra nirmāṃsaḥatyantakṣīṇamāṃsaḥ, kṛśaḥ alpamāṃsaḥ| atrārocakaśabdopādānādevāruciḥ prāptā, punararucyabhidhānamasmin roge'ruceravaśyambhāvasūcanārtham||174-175||

lg.l: pittāt sadāhair gurubhiḥ kaphāt tribhyas trilakṣaṇaiḥ ||176||

ab.seg: ata ūrdhvaṃ vātādibhedena grahaṇīlakṣaṇānyāha- vātādityādi| pāyuḥ gudaḥ, hṛt hṛdayaṃ, pārśve dve; pāyvādimastakāntaiḥ śūlādhikairvātādgrahaṇīrogo jñātavya iti; evaṃ sarvatra sambandhanīyam| ebhireva pāyvādibhiḥ sadāhaiḥ pittādgrahaṇī, gurubhiḥ pāyvādibhiḥ kaphāt, trilakṣaṇairiti śūlādhikaiḥ sadāhairgurubhiḥ pāyvādibhiḥ; tribhyo doṣebhyaḥ, ‘grahaṇī’ iti śeṣaḥ||176||

kimetaireva lakṣaṇairgrahaṇīrogo jñeyo'thavā'nyairapītyāha- doṣavarṇairityādi| doṣavarṇairiti kṛṣṇāruṇanīlapītaraktāsitapāṇḍubhirnakhaiḥ, tadvaditi kṛṣṇādivarṇairviḍādibhiśca ‘grahaṇīrogo jñeya’ iti śeṣaḥ| hṛtpāṇḍūdarādirogāśaṅkī ca mānavo bhavati, ‘pravardhamāne grahaṇīroge’ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ||177||

lg.l: takreṇa vā'tha takraṃ vā kevalaṃ hitam ucyate |
cūrṇaṃ hiṅgvādikaṃ cātra ghṛtaṃ vā plīhanāśanam |181|

div.ab: ata ūrdhvaṃ grahaṇīrogacikitsitamāha- yathetyādi| doṣocchrayo doṣodrekaḥ| tasyeti grahaṇīrogiṇaḥ| tatra yathādoṣocchrayaṃ viśuddhasyeti vātodreke nirūheṇa, pittodreke virekeṇa, kaphodreke vamanena| yathākramamiti yathāsvaṃ śuddhiprakaraṇoktakrameṇetyarthaḥ| peyādimityādiśabdāt vilepīyūṣamṛdvodanādikam| vitaret dadyāt| samyak yathoktam| dīpanīyopasambhṛtamiti pañcakolādyagnidīpanadravyayuktam| ‘yathādoṣocchrayaṃ’ ityatrānye ‘yathādoṣabalaṃ’ iti paṭhanti, tatra doṣabalānatikrameṇa viśuddhasyetyarthaḥ| tata ityādi| tata iti peyādikramānantaram| pācanasaṅgrāhidīpanīyagaṇatrayamiti gaṇaśabdaḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate; tena pācanadravyagaṇo haridrādiḥ, saṅgrāhīgaṇaḥ ambaṣṭhādiḥ, dīpanīyagaṇaḥ pippalyādiḥ; etadgaṇatrayaṃ doṣakālasātmyādyapekṣayā surāriṣṭādibhistakrāntaiḥ prātaḥ pibedityarthaḥ| takraṃ vetyādi saṅgrāhidīpanīyalaghutvāt “ekā śāntiranekasya” iti vacanāt| krimyādighnī kriyā'trāpi karaṇīyetyāha- krimītyādi| atreti grahaṇīroge| avacārayet prayojayet| nanu, grahaṇīrogo vātādibhedena caturvidhaḥ proktaḥ, tatkathaṃ cikitsitaṃ tathā noktaṃ? ucyate- yathādoṣocchrayamityatrāpyanuvartanīyam; tena krimyādighnī kriyā yathādoṣocchrayamavacārayediti na doṣaḥ| hiṅgvādicūrṇādikaṃ grahaṇyāmapyatidiśannāha- cūrṇamityādi| hiṅgvādicūrṇaṃ mahāvātavyādhyuktaṃ, ghṛtaṃ vā plīhanāśanamiti ṣaṭpalādikaṃ, avacārayedityatrāpi sambadhyate||178-180||-

lg.l: caturguṇena dadhnā ca ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ hitaṃ bhavet |182|

ab.seg: cāṅgerīghṛtamāha- kalkenetyādi| magadhādeḥ pippalyādeḥ| cāṅgerī amlapatrikā, tasyāḥ svarasena snehacaturguṇena, pippalyādikalkena snehacaturthāṃśena, dadhnā ca caturguṇena, siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ hitaṃ bhavedityarthaḥ||181||
idānīṃ grahaṇīroge'śeṣasaṅgrahārthamāha- sarvathetyādi| sarvathā sarvaprakāreṇa| dīpanam agnidīpanam; yat agnidīpanaṃ tatsarvaṃ grahaṇīrogiṇāṃ sarvathā hitamiti sambandhaḥ||182||

lg.l: jvarādīn avirodhāc ca sādhayet svaiś cikitsitaiḥ ||183||

ab.seg: ato'nantaraṃ grahaṇīrogopadravāṇāṃ jvarārocakādīnāṃ pratikāramāha- jvarādīnityādi| jvarādīnityādiśabdādarocakaśūlakarapādaśophādīnāṃ grahaṇam| avirodhācceti ‘mūlavyādheḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| yadyapi nibandhakārairayamadhyāyo vyastapāṭhena paṭhitastathā'pi mayā madguruṇā yena krameṇopadiṣṭastathā'yaṃ paṭhito vyākhyātaśca||183||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre 'tisārapratiṣedho nāma (dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) catvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||40||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargatakāyacikitsāyāmatisārapratiṣedhādhyāyaścatvāriṃśattamaḥ||40||

div.head: śoṣapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ śoṣapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

atīsārapratiṣedhānantaraṃ śoṣe'pyatīsārasambhūterathavā jvarātīsārābhyāṃ śoṣasyotpatteḥ śoṣapratiṣedhārambho yukta ityata āha- athāta ityādi| athetyādikaṃ pūrvavadvyākhyeyam| śoṣapratiṣedhaṃ śoṣacikitsitam||1-2||

nanu, śoṣacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti pratijñāṃ kṛtvā nidānābhidhāne ko hetuḥ? ucyate- ajñātarogasya vaidyasya cikitsāyāṃ pragalbhyaṃ na syādato nidānārambha iti; tathā coktaṃ- “rogamādau parīkṣeta tato'nantaramauṣadham”- iti| prāgeva vikārasvabhāvābhidhānāya vākyamāha- anekarogānugata ityādi| anekarogā upadravasañjñakāḥ, tairanugata āśritaḥ| bahavo rogāḥ śvāsakāsāṅgasādakaphasaṃsravādayaḥ, purogamāḥ pūrvarūpatvenopasthitā yasya sa tathā| durvijñeya iti tridoṣaliṅgatvādaṃśāṃśabalavikalpanābhiḥ prakupitadoṣāṇāṃ liṅgadarśanāt| durnivāra iti doṣāṇāṃ parasparaviruddhopakramatvāt; durnivāratvācca kṛcchro'yaṃ mahābalaḥ||3||

lg.l: kriyākṣayakaratvāc ca kṣaya ity ucyate punaḥ ||4||
rājñaś candramaso yasmād abhūd eṣa kilāmayaḥ |
tasmāt taṃ rājayakṣmeti kecid āhuḥ `kecidāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ' iti pā. punar janāḥ ||5||

ab.seg: idānīmasya vyādheryathā śoṣakṣayarājayakṣmeti nāmāni tathā''ha- saṃśoṣaṇādrasādīnāmityādi| kriyā cikitsā, kāyavāṅmānasaṃ vā karma, tasya kṣayakaratvāt| rājña iti ‘dvijānāṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ| candramasaḥ candrasya, āmayo yakṣmā rogaḥ, keciditi ātreyaprabhṛtayaḥ; yasmādeṣa āmayo dvijānāṃ rājñaścandramasaścandrasyābhūttasmāt taṃ rogaṃ kecit punarjanā rājayakṣmeti bruvate; yato'yaṃ yakṣmā rogo rogāṇāṃ rājā ato rājayakṣmeti vāgbhaṭo vyākhyānayati| kileti vārtāyām| evaṃ khalu yathā `yathā' iti mudritapustake na paṭhyate śrūyate- pūrvaṃ dakṣanāmā prajāpatirabhūt, tasya bahvayo duhitaro babhūvuḥ, tena ca saptādhikā viṃśatiḥ kanyakāścandrāya vivoḍhe `vivoḍhuṃ' iti pā. dattāḥ, sa candramāstāsu madhye rohiṇyāmevānurakto babhūva, tataśca saśokābhiraśvinyādibhirduhitṛbhirātmapitari dakṣasañjñake candrasya rohiṇyāmāsaktivṛttānto `candravṛttāntaḥ' iti pā. niveditaḥ, tato duhitṝṇāṃ vārtāmākarṇya, candramāhūya, sarvāsvapi nijaputrīṣu samatayā vartanāya candro'bhihitaḥ, sa ca tatheti `tathetyupakramyāpi' iti pā. svīkṛtyāpi svagurorvacanamanādṛtya na tāsu samavartata, tato dakṣaprajāpateḥ krodho niśvāsarūpeṇa mūrtimān bhūtvā niḥsṛtya yakṣmarūpeṇa rohiṇyāmatiprasaṅgenāvilaṃ candramāviśat, tato'sau tena rogeṇābhibhūtaḥ san gataprabho gatotsāhaśca sañjātaḥ, guruvacanātikrameṇa doṣaṃ matvā tameva dakṣanāmānaṃ guruṃ śaraṇaṃ gatavān, tato'nantaraṃ devavaidyābhyāmaśvibhyāṃ sa cikitsitaḥ, tataḥ prāptabalaścandro (rarājātīva suprabhaḥ) laghvaguruprasādo'śvibhyāṃ cikitsito'bhūt `api yāpyo'bhūt' iti pā.| evaṃ ca sati karmadoṣajo vyādhiriti darśitam||4-5||

lg.l: sa vyastair jāyate doṣair iti kecid vadanti hi |6|

div.ab: ekīyamatenāsya vyādheḥ pṛthagdoṣajatvamāha- sa vyastairityādi| sa vyādhiḥ| vyastaiḥ pṛthagbhūtaiḥ|6|-

lg.l: eka eva mataḥ śoṣaḥ sannipātātmako hy ataḥ ||7||

ab.seg: paramatanirākaraṇāya svamatamāha- ekādaśānāmityādi| ekādaśānāmiti svarabhedaśūlādīnām| ekasminniti rājayakṣmaroge; anye tu rājayakṣmātura iti vyākhyānayanti, sānnidhyāditi vidyamānatvāt| tantrayuktitaḥ arthayuktitaḥ `tantrayuktita ityarthāpatteḥ' iti pā.; anye tantretyatra tatreti paṭhanti; tatra tasmin, yuktito yuktivaśāditi vyākhyānayanti| kā sā yuktiḥ? yadvaśenaika eva śoṣa ityāha- kriyāṇāmavibhāgeneti|- cikitsānāmapṛthaktvena darśitatvādityarthaḥ| ekatve tṛtīyaṃ hetumāha- prāgekotpādanena ceti|- yasmāt pūrvaṃ dakṣeṇa kruddhenaikasyotpādanaṃ kṛtam| hiḥ yasmādarthe; yasmāt śoṣasyaikatve hetutritayamatroktam, ata eka eva śoṣaḥ sannipātātmako mata iti sambandhaḥ||6-7||

lg.l: udrekāt tatra liṅgāni doṣāṇāṃ nipatanti hi |8|

div.ab: nanu, yadi sannipātātmaka eka evāyaṃ tat kathamatra ekaikadoṣapṛthagliṅgajñānamityāha `anekadoṣapṛthagliṅgajñānaṃ' iti pā. - udrekādityādi| udrekāt ādhikyāt| tatra śoṣe| hiśabdo hetau, sa ca heturbahuprakāro'pi caturvidhatvaṃ na tyajati|8|-

tameva caturvidhaṃ hetumāha- kṣayādvegapratīghātādityādi| kṣayāt rasādiśukrāntānāṃ dhātūnāṃ kṣayāt| vegapratīghātāt vātamūtrapurīṣādīnāṃ pravṛttyunmukhānāmavarodhāt| āghātāt patanāditaḥ, ayathābalamārambhāditi boddhavyam| viṣamāśanāditi aprāptātītakālabahvalpabhojanāt| kṣayādityādihetubhiḥ kupitairdoṣairvyāptadehasya śoṣo jāyate iti sambandhaḥ| anye tvevaṃ paṭhanti- ‘vegāghātāt pūraṇādvā saṅghātāt saṅkṣayādapi’ iti; vyākhyānayanti ca- pūraṇaṃ viṣamāśanamabhipretaṃ, saṅghāto'tra sāhasaḥ, śeṣaṃ pūrvavadvyākhyeyam||8||-

ab.seg: kaphapradhānairityādi| kaphapradhānaiḥ utkaṭakaphaiḥ| hiśabdo hetau| rasavartmasvityatrādiśabdo lupto jñeyaḥ; vartma mārgaḥ, tena rasādivāhinīṣu dhamanīṣvityarthaḥ||9||

lg.l: kṣīyante dhātavaḥ sarve tataḥ śuṣyati mānavaḥ ||10||

ab.seg: aparaprakāreṇa dhātukṣayādrājayakṣmasambhavaṃ darśayannāha- atītyādi| ativyavāyinaḥ atyarthaṃ grāmyadharmasevinaḥ| kṣīṇe retasi śukre, śukrakṣayaśca meḍhravṛṣaṇavedanetyādinā jñeyaḥ| anantaraṃ retasaḥ kṣayādityarthaḥ| kṣīyante dhātavaḥ sarve iti paraṃ yadi strībhyo na nivartate| nanu, rasavartmarodhādrasena raktasyābṛṃhaṇāttadapacayaḥ raktāpacayācca māṃsasyāpacaya ityādipūrvapūrvadhātukṣīṇatayā kṛtvā śukrasya yuktaḥ kṣayaḥ, śukrakṣaye tu pūrvadhātūnāṃ kathaṃ kṣayaḥ? ucyate- yathā mahājalādhāraparikṣaye tatra praviśatāṃ jalaprāyāṇāṃ (jantūnāṃ) kṣayastadvadatrāpīti| svamārgāvarodhādraso'sañcaran kiṃ karoti? hṛdaye vidahyate, kāsavegena mukhamārgāt picchilabahalavisraharitapītaśvetaḥ pravartate||10||
idānīṃ madhyabaladoṣārabdhasya śoṣasya ṣaḍrūpāṇi darśayannāha- bhaktadveṣo jvara ityādi| svarabhedaḥ ghargharādisvaraḥ||11||

lg.l: jvaro dāho 'tisāraś ca pittād raktasya cāgamaḥ ||12||

ab.seg: ṣaḍrūpāṇi nirdiśya doṣabhedenaikādaśarūpāṇi balavatsamadoṣārabdhasya śoṣasya darśayannāha- svarabheda ityādi| saṃloco luñcanamiva, aṃsayoḥ pārśvayoḥ; ‘saṃloca’ ityatrānye ‘saṅkoca’ iti paṭhanti, tatra saṅkocanamivetyarthaḥ| śirasaḥ paripūrṇatvaṃ ‘kaphena’ iti śeṣaḥ| abhaktacchando bhaktāruciḥ| kaṇṭhasya coddhvaṃsaḥ kaṇṭhabhaṅgaḥ; anye uddhvaṃsa utkāsiketi vyākhyānayanti| svarabhedādiliṅgatrayaṃ rājayakṣmaṇi vātena, jvarādīni catvāri pittena, śirasaḥ paripūrṇatvādīni catvāri kaphena; evaṃ ṣaḍrūpāṇyapi vātādibhedena jñeyāni||12-13||

lg.l: ekādaśabhir ebhir vā ṣaḍbhir vā'pi samanvitam |
jahyāc choṣārditaṃ jantum icchan suvipulaṃ yaśaḥ ||15||

ab.seg: idānīṃ `bahurūpo rājayakṣmā asādhyastamāha' iti pā. rūpaprastāvādbahurūpānvitasyāsādhyatvamāha- ekādaśabhirityādi| etairebhiḥ svarabhedo'nilācchūlamityādikaiḥ, ṣaḍbhirvā'pīti bhaktadveṣo jvara ityādibhiḥ, apiśabdāttribhirvā śvāsakāsāsṛgāmayaistantrāntaroktaiḥ, samanvitamiti samuccīyate| jahyāditi tyajet, paraṃ vahnau mande balamāṃsakṣaye satīti boddhavyam| nanu, sarvarūpādardhatrirūpau laghutarau, tatkathaṃ tāvapyasādhyau? ucyate- balavahnayapacaye kālaprakarṣāttayorapi mahattvāt; etena sarvarūpopapanna evāsādhyaḥ, itarau tu kālaprakarṣeṇeti| ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ pustakāntareṣvanyathā paṭhyate, sa ca nibandhakārairna paṭhitaḥ||14-15||

ekīyamatena śoṣabhedānnirdiśannāha- vyavāyaśoketyādi| vyavāyaḥ strīsevā, śokaḥ putrādiviyogena cittodvegaḥ, sthāviryaṃ vṛddhatvaṃ; anye vārdhakyamiti paṭhanti, tatrāpyeko'rthaḥ; vyāyāmaḥ śarīrāyāsajanakaṃ karma; adhvā dīrghamārgāṭanaṃ; vyavāyādyupavāsāntairhetubhistathā vraṇapīḍayā uraḥkṣatapīḍayā cānye śoṣān vadantīti sambandhaḥ||16||

vyavāyaśoṣiṇo lakṣaṇānyāha- vyavāyetyādi| śukrasya kṣayaliṅgairiti ‘śukrakṣaye meḍhravṛṣaṇavedanā’ ityādibhiḥ| yathāpūrvamiti yathāpūrvaṃ tatra śukrasya pūrvaṃ majjā, majjño'sthi, asthno medaḥ, medaso māṃsaṃ, māṃsasya raktamityevaṃ kṣīyante dhātavaḥ prāgvadeva darśitanyāyāt, paraṃ yadi strībhyo na nivartate||17||
śokaśoṣiṇamāha- pradhyānaśīla ityādi| pradhyānaśīlaḥ cintāparaḥ, srastāṅgaḥ avasannagātraḥ| tādṛśa iti vyavāyaśoṣitavadabhilakṣitaḥ, paraṃ śukrakṣayakṛtairliṅgairvinā; etena pāṇḍudeha ityarthaḥ||18||

lg.l: ṣṭhīvati śleṣmaṇā hīnaṃ gauravārucipīḍitaḥ `tathaivārucipīḍitaḥ' iti `tathaivāratipīḍitaḥ' iti ca pā.|

ab.seg: jarāśoṣiṇamāha- jarāśoṣī kṛśo mandetyādi| mandaśabdo vīryādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate, vīryaṃ śaktiḥ, balam ojo hṛdi sthitaṃ saptadhātudhāmabhūtam| punararucikathanamatyantārocakakhyāpanārtham `punararucikaraṇaṃ' iti pā.| samprasrutetyādi samprasrutaśabda āsyādibhistribhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| āsyaṃ mukhakuharam, akṣi locanam| suptarūkṣatvaṃ prabhāyāḥ, rūkṣatvaṃ ca malasya; yadyapi satparūkṣatvaṃ tvaci bhavati na prabhāyāṃ, tathā'pi ‘mañcāḥ krośanti’ itivadupacārāt prabhāyāṃ boddhavyam| jejjaṭācāryastu jarāśoṣiṇo lakṣaṇamatra na paṭhati, saptatestūrdhvaṃ kṣīyamāṇetyādinā āturopakramaṇīye uktatvāt||19-20||

adhvaśoṣiṇamāha- adhvapraśoṣītyādi| srastāṅgaḥ śithilagātrāvayavaḥ| prasuptamātrāvayava ityanena akarmaṇyaśarīrapradeśa uktaḥ| śuṣkaśabdaḥ klomādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate; kloma tilakam, ānanaṃ mukhakuharam| sambhṛṣṭaparuṣacchaviriti dagdhasyeva paruṣā chaviryasyetyarthaḥ; kecit ‘sambhṛṣṭaparuṣacchaviḥ’ ityatra ‘saṃsṛṣṭaparuṣacchaviḥ’ iti paṭhitvā saṃsṛṣṭā paruṣā chaviḥ yasya sa iti vyākhyānayanti| yadyapi jarāśoṣyanantaraṃ vyāyāmaśoṣī vācyo nādhvaśoṣī, tathā'pyadhvaśoṣilakṣaṇānāṃ vyāyāmaśoṣiṇyatideśāt pūrvamatrādhvaśoṣi nirdiṣṭaḥ| yadyevaṃ tarhi vyāyāmaśoṣilakṣaṇānyeva kuto'dhvaśoṣiṇi nātidiśyante? satyam, uraḥkṣataliṅgānāmadhikānāṃ vyāyāmaśoṣiṇi sadbhāvāt| kecidatra ‘tṛḍaṅgamardadaurbalyapāruṣyairardito'dhvanā’ iti pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti, tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ||21||

lg.l: uraḥkṣatakṛtair liṅgaiḥ saṃyuktaś ca kṣatād vinā ||22||

ab.seg: vyāyāmaśoṣiṇamāha- vyāyāmaśoṣī bhūyiṣṭhamityādi| ebhireveti anantaroktaiḥ adhvaśoṣilakṣaṇairityarthaḥ| upavāsaśoṣilakṣaṇaṃ doṣadhātumalakṣayavṛddhivijñānīyoktaṃ ‘tatra vātalāhārasevina’ ityādikaṃ jñātavyam||22||

lg.l: vraṇitasya `vraṇitasya bhavecchoṣo doṣaiḥ sādhyatamaḥ sa ca' iti hastalikhitapustake pāṭha upalabhyate bhavec choṣaḥ sa cāsādhyatamaḥ smṛtaḥ ||23||

ab.seg: vraṇaśoṣilakṣaṇamāha- raktakṣayādityādi| vraṇaśoṣiṇo vaiśeṣikalakṣaṇānupadeśāt sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ jñeyam| yadyevaṃ kuto'sya pṛthagabhidhānamiti cet, viśiṣṭakāraṇatayā asādhyatamatvakhyāteḥ `sādhyatamatvakhyāteḥ' iti pā.||23||

lg.l: karmaṇā cāpy urasyena `karmabhiścāpyanaurasyairvakṣo' iti pā. vakṣo yasya vidāritam |
tasyorasi kṣate raktaṃ pūyaḥ śleṣmā ca gacchati ||24||

div.ab: uraḥkṣataśoṣiṇamāha- vyāyāmetyādi| karmaṇā cāpyurasyeneti dhanurākarṣaṇādinetyarthaḥ| kṣate atidārite| asitam īṣatkṛṣṇam, aruṇam īṣadraktam| dūyanāt ativedanāt, paritāmyati mohaṃ yāti| durgandhaśabdo vadanocchvāsābhyāṃ sambadhyate||24-25||-

lg.l: keṣāñcid evaṃ śoṣo hi kāraṇair bhedam āgataḥ ||26||

div.ab: ekīyamatamāha- keṣāñcidityādi| keṣāñcidācāryāṇāṃ mate evaṃ vyavāyādibhiranekaiḥ kāraṇaiḥ kṛtvā hi yasmāt śoṣo bhedamāgataḥ; ata eka eva svamate śoṣo netare vyavāyādijāḥ| kuto vyavāyādijāḥ śoṣā na bhavantītyāha- na tatretyādi| tatra teṣu vyavāyādijeṣu||26||-

lg.l: kṣayā eva hi te jñeyāḥ pratyekaṃ dhātusañjñitāḥ ||27||

ab.seg: yadi te vyavāyādijāḥ śoṣāḥ na bhavanti tarhi kinnāmadheyā bhavantītyāha- kṣayā evetyādi| te vyavāyādijāḥ kṣayā eva, kiṃviśiṣṭāḥ? pratyekaṃ dhātusañjñitāḥ dhātukṣayasañjñakā ityarthaḥ| yataḥ śukramārabhya vilomena vyavāyādibhirdhātūnāṃ yathāpūrvaṃ saṅkṣayāt||27||

lg.l: cikitsitaṃ tu teṣāṃ hi prāg uktaṃ dhātusaṅkṣaye ||28||

ab.seg: teṣāṃ kiñciccikitsitamāha- cikitsitaṃ tu teṣāmityādi| dhātusaṅkṣaye doṣadhātumalakṣayavṛddhivijñānīyādhyāye||28||

lg.l: śoṣe bhaviṣyati bhavanti sa cāpi jantuḥ śuklekṣaṇo bhavati māṃsaparo riraṃsuḥ ||29||
svapneṣu kākaśukaśallakinīlakaṇṭhagṛdhrās tathaiva kapayaḥ kṛkalāsakāś ca |
taṃ vāhayanti sa nadīr vijalāś ca paśyec chuṣkāṃs tarūn pavanadhūmadavārditāṃś ca ||30||

ab.seg: idānīmekīyamataṃ pradarśya samprāptyanantaraṃ rājayakṣmaṇaḥ pūrvarūpāṇyāha- śvāsāṅgasādakaphasaṃsravetyādi| aṅgasādaḥ aṅgānāmanutsāhaḥ, agnisādaḥ agnimāndyam| madaḥ pūgaphaleneva mattatā| māṃsaparo māṃsābhilāṣī| riraṃsuḥ rantumicchuḥ| śallakī godhānukārī vajraśakalaḥ, ‘śallaka’ iti loke prasiddhaḥ, nīlakaṇṭho mayūraḥ, gṛdhraḥ āmiṣāśī yojanadṛṣṭiḥ| kapayo vānarāḥ| kṛkalāsaḥ kṛkaṇṭakaḥ ‘giragiṭa’ iti pūrvadeśīyā bhāṣante| taṃ śoṣiṇaṃ, vāhayanti prāpayanti sa śoṣī| nanu, samprāptyanantaraṃ pūrvarūpeṣu vaktavyeṣu kathaṃ rūpāṇyabhidhāya pūrvarūpopādānaṃ kṛtam? ucyate- rūpāṇyavyaktāni pūrvarūpāṇyasyeti pratipādanārtham||29-30||
varjyamāha- mahāśanamityādi| muṣko vṛṣaṇam| ‘yakṣmiṇam’ ityatrānye ‘śoṣiṇam’ iti paṭhanti||31||

lg.l: upācared ātmavantaṃ dīptāgnim akṛśaṃ navam `naraṃ' iti pā.|32|

div.ab: upakramyamāha- upācaredātmavantamityādi| ātmavantaṃ jitendriyam|32|-

lg.l: snigdhasya mṛdu kartavyam ūrdhvaṃ cādhaś ca śodhanam |
āsthāpanaṃ tathā kāryaṃ śirasaś ca virecanam ||33||

ab.seg: tadeva cikitsitamāha- sthirādivargasiddhenetyādi| sthirādiḥ vidārigandhādiḥ| mṛdu yat karśanaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ| āsthāpanaṃ nirūhaḥ| tatheti mṛdvityarthaḥ| śiraso virecanaṃ nasyam||32-33||

div.ab: śodhitasya paścātkarma āha- yavagodhūmetyādi| rasaiḥ jāṅgalamāṃsarasaiḥ|34|-

ab.seg: bṛṃhaṇaviṣayamāha- dṛḍhe'gnāvityādi| nivṛttopadravamiti praśāntasvarabhedādikamityarthaḥ||34||
idānīṃ vyavāyaśoṣiṇo viśiṣṭaṃ cikitsitamāha- vyavāyetyādi| ‘vyavāyaśoṣiṇam’ ityādivākyaṃ kecinnecchanti, ‘kriyāṇāṃ cāvibhāgena’ ityuktasya vyāghātāt||35||

lg.l: kākān ulūkān nakulān biḍālān gaṇḍūpadān vyālabileśayākhūn |
gṛdhrāṃś ca dadyād vividhaiḥ pravādaiḥ `prakāraiḥ' iti pā. sasaindhavān sarṣapatailabhṛṣṭān ||36||
deyāni māṃsāni ca jāṅgalāni mudgāḍhakīsūparasāś ca `mudgāḍhakīyūṣarasāśca' iti pā. hṛdyāḥ |
māṃsopadaṃśāṃś ca pibed ariṣṭān mārdvīkayuktān madirāś ca sevyāḥ |
arkāmṛtākṣārajaloṣitebhyaḥ kṛtvā yavebhyo vividhāṃś ca bhakṣyān ||38||
khādet, pibet sarpir ajāvikaṃ vā kṛśo yavāgvā saha bhaktakāle |

ab.seg: śoṣiṇāṃ yāni māṃsānyādeyāni tānyāha- kākānulūkānnakulānityādi| biḍālā grāmyādibhedena ṣaṭprakārā mārjārāḥ; tathā ca- “grāmyo vanyastoyajātaḥ pakṣimārjāravijjakau| sugandhavṛṣaṇaśceti mārjārāḥ ṣaṭ prakīrtitāḥ”- iti| vyālā vyāghrādayaḥ, bileśayāḥ śvāvicchallakīprabhṛtayaḥ ākhuratra vṛkṣamūṣikaḥ| vividhaiḥ pravādairiti “kākāṃstittiriśabdena matsyaśabdena coragān| bhṛṣṭamatsyāntraśabdena dadyādgaṇḍūpadānapi” ityādibhirnānāprakārairvacanaiḥ| evaṃ prakāreṇa dāne `evamprakāradānaiḥ' iti pā. kiṃ prayojanamiti cet? ajugupsayā bhakṣaṇaṃ bhakṣitasya cānullekhanam| tathā coktaṃ- “jānan jugupsurnaivādyādbhuktaṃ vā punarullikhet| tasmācchadmopasiddhāni māṃsānyetāni dāpayet”- iti| jāṅgalāni jaṅghālaviṣkirapratudajāni, śeṣajāṅgalavargāṇāmatra viśeṣeṇābhidhānat| yadyapi jāṅgalaśabdenaiva gṛdhrādayo'pi labdhāḥ, tathā'pyatyantabṛṃhaṇatvādgṛdhrādīnāṃ pṛthagupādānam| mudgāḍhakīsūparasāḥ srotaḥśuddhikatvāddeyāḥ| nāgo hastī, aśvataro veśaraḥ| sukalpitāni veśavārīkṛtāni nānāprakāraprakalpitāni `nānyaprakārakalpitāni' iti| tathā ca vṛddhabhojaḥ- “kharoṣṭrāśvataraṃ nāgaṃ māṃsaṃ māṃsābhivṛddhaye| dadyānmāhiṣaśabdena vesavārīkṛtaṃ bhiṣak”- iti| māṃsopadaṃśānariṣṭān abhayāriṣṭaprabhṛtīn, mārdvīkayuktān drākṣāsavayuktān, madirā madyam| bhakṣyānnirdeṣṭumāha- arkāmṛtakṣārajaloṣitebhya ityādi| arkaguḍūcīkṣārapānīyoṣitebhyo yavebhyo bhakṣyān kṛtvā khādediti sambandhaḥ| uṣitebhyo rātrau sthitebhyaḥ| arkādibhasma caturguṇena jalena gālayitvā pacedyāvadardhāvaśiṣṭaṃ bhavati| tathā coktaṃ- “pānāya bhojanāyātha bhasma srāvyaṃ caturguṇe| jale'rdhamavaśiṣṭe(ṣṭaṃ) tu kṣārāmbho grāhyamiṣyate”- iti| pibedityādi| ajāvikaṃ veti ājaṃ vā āvikaṃ vetyarthaḥ| ajetyatra hrasvatvaṃ chando'nurodhāt| bhaktakāle bhojanakāle| sarpirmadhubhyāmityādi| upahitaṃ saṃyuktam||36-39||

lg.l: māṃsādamāṃseṣu ghṛtaṃ ca siddhaṃ śoṣāpahaṃ kṣaudrakaṇāsametam |40|

div.ab: māṃsādamāṃseṣvityādi| māṃsādā gṛdhrādayaḥ, tanmāṃsarase caturguṇe siddhaṃ sarpiḥ kṣaudrapippalīyuktaṃ śoṣāpahaṃ bhavati| kṣaudrakaṇetyatra dantikaṇeti kecit paṭhanti|40|-
drākṣetyādi| avaleho'yam|41|-

lg.l: sitāśvagandhāmagadhodbhavānāṃ cūrṇaṃ `kalkaṃ' iti pā. ghṛtakṣaudrayutaṃ pralihyāt ||41||

ab.seg: sitāśvagandhetyādi| sitā śarkarā, magadhodbhavā pippalī||41||

lg.l: kṣīraṃ pibed vā'py atha vājigandhāvipakvam evaṃ labhate 'ṅgapuṣṭim |42|

div.ab: kṣīramityādi| vājigandhāvipakvaṃ sāmānyakṣīrapākaparibhāṣayā| vājigandhā aśvagandhā|42|-

lg.l: tad utthitaṃ kṣīraghṛtaṃ sitāḍhyaṃ prātaḥ pibed vā'pi payonupānam ||42||

ab.seg: tadutthitaṃ kṣīraghṛtamityādi| tadutthitam aśvagandhāvipakvakṣīrotthaṃ, kṣīraghṛtaṃ kṣīradviloḍitādudbhūtaṃ ghṛtam||42||

lg.l: utsādane cāpi turaṅgagandhā yojyā yavāś caiva punarnave ca |43|

div.ab: udvartanamupacaryārthamāha- utsādane ityādi| utsādanam udvartanam| turaṅgagandhā aśvagandhā| punarnave śvetarakte dve| nanu, śoṣe bṛṃhaṇamupayujyate, etāśca vilekhanāḥ, tataḥ kathaṃ tadupayogaḥ? satyaṃ, bāhyopayogena teṣāṃ bṛṃhaṇatvenopayogāt|43|-

lg.l: kṛtsne vṛṣe tatkusumaiś ca siddhaṃ sarpiḥ pibet kṣaudrayutaṃ hitāśī ||43||
yakṣmāṇam etat prabalaṃ ca kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ ca hanyād api pāṇḍutāṃ ca |44|

div.ab: kṛtsne ityādi| kṛtsne vṛṣe iti samūlapatraśākhāṅkure| vāsakāṅgebhyaḥ kvāthe, tatkusumaiḥ vāsakapuṣpaiḥ, ‘kalkīkṛtaiḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| siddhaṃ sarpiriti caturguṇakvāthena puṣpakalkenāṣṭamabhāgena ca| tathā coktaṃ,- “śaṇasya kovidārasya vṛṣasya ca pṛthak pṛthak| kalkāḍhyatvānna śaṃsanti puṣpakalpaṃ catuṣpalam”- iti||43||-

lg.l: śakṛdrasā gośvagajāvyajānāṃ kvāthā mitāś cāpi tathaiva bhāgaiḥ ||44||
mūrvāharidrākhadiradrumāṇāṃ kṣīrasya bhāgas tv aparo ghṛtasya |
bhāgān daśaitān vipaced vidhijño dattvā trivargaṃ madhuraṃ ca kṛtsnam ||45||

div.ab: śakṛdrasā ityādi| gośvagajāvicchagalīnāṃ pratyekaṃ śakṛdrasāḥ, tathaiva mūrvāharidrākhadiradrumāṇāṃ kvāthabhāgairmitāḥ svalpā bhāgāḥ, tathā kṣīrasyāparo navamo bhāgaḥ, ghṛtasya daśama iti , etān daśabhāgān trivargādikena kalkena vipacediti sambandhaḥ| mūrvā corasnāyuḥ| khadiradrumāṇāmiti drumagrahaṇaṃ madhyamavayasaḥ khadirasya grahaṇārtham| trivargaḥ triphalā| madhuraṃ ca kṛtsnaṃ kākolyādikam; apare'ṣṭavargamāhuḥ||44-45||-

lg.l: dve pañcamūlyau varuṇaṃ karañjaṃ bhallātakaṃ bilvapunarnave ca ||46||
yavān kulatthān badarāṇi bhārgīṃ pāṭhāṃ hutāśaṃ samahīkadambam |
kṛtvā kaṣāyaṃ vipaced dhi tasya ṣaḍbhir hi pātrair ghṛtapātram ekam ||47||
vyoṣaṃ mahāvṛkṣapayo 'bhayāṃ ca cavyaṃ surākhyaṃ lavaṇottamaṃ ca |
etad dhi śoṣaṃ jaṭharāṇi caiva hanyāt pramehāṃś ca sahānilena ||48||

ab.seg: dve pañcamūlyāvityādi| dve pañcamūlyau daśamūlamityarthaḥ| bilvasya pṛthakpāṭhādatra phalaṃ grāhyam| hutāśaḥ citrakaḥ, mahīkadambo muṇḍitikā| kṛtvā kaṣāyamiti daśamūlādīnāmaṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikāni saptaśatapalāni caturguṇenāmbhasā niṣkvāthya caturbhāgāvaśiṣṭaḥ kvātho grāhyaḥ| tasya kvāthasya, pātraiḥ āḍhakaiḥ| kalkadravyāṇyāha- vyoṣamityādi| vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukaṃ, mahāvṛkṣapayaḥ sehuṇḍakṣīraṃ, surākhyaṃ devadāru, lavaṇottamaṃ saindhavam; kecit ‘lavaṇottamam’ ityatra ‘magadhodbhavāṃ’ iti paṭhitvā pippalīmiti vyākhyānayanti| pramehāṃśca sahānileneti vātikānapipramehān hantītyarthaḥ; etacca stutiparaṃ `stutivacaḥ' iti pā., vātikamehānāmasādhyatvāt||46-48||

gośvāvyajebhaiṇetyādi| gośvādīnāṃ śakṛdrasakṣīramāṃsarasarudhiraiḥ drākṣādīnāṃ kalkena siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ yakṣmavikārān hantīti sambandhaḥ| ibhā hastinī, eṇaḥ kṛṣṇasāraḥ| kṣīraṃ yathāsambhavaṃ grāhyaṃ, na tu sarveṣām||49||

lg.l: paktvā jale tena paced dhi sarpis tasmin susiddhe tv avatārite ca |
triṃśatpalāny atra sitopalāyā dattvā tugākṣīripalāni ṣaṭ ca ||51||
prasthe ghṛtasya dviguṇaṃ ca dadyāt kṣaudraṃ tato manthahataṃ vidadhyāt |
palaṃ palaṃ prātar ataḥ pralihya paścāt pibet kṣīram atandritaś ca ||52||
etad dhi medhyaṃ paramaṃ pavitraṃ cakṣuṣyam āyuṣyam atho yaśasyam |
yakṣmāṇam āśu vyapahanti caitat pāṇḍvāmayaṃ caiva bhagandaraṃ ca ||53||
na cātra kiñcit parivarjanīyaṃ rasāyanaṃ caitad upāsyamānam ||54||

ab.seg: elājamodetyādi| elādikān surāṣṭrajāntān kaṣāyakalpena vipācya, tena kvāthena sarpirvipacediti sambandhaḥ| tasmin kvāthe siddhe pūte śarkarāyāstriṃśatpalāni dadyāt, tugākṣīryāśca ṣaṭpalāni, tathā ghṛtasya prasthe dviguṇaṃ dviprasthamitaṃ kṣaudraṃ dadyāt| akṣaṃ bibhītakaṃ, gāyatrī khadiraḥ, ariṣṭo nimbaḥ, asano bījakaḥ, śālaḥ prasiddhaḥ, sāraśabdaḥ khadirādibhiḥ sambadhyate| ugrā vacā, ambhodo mustaṃ, surāṣṭrajā tuvaramṛttikā| tugākṣīrī vaṃśalocanam; anye vaṃśalocanānukāripārthivadravyamāhuḥ| manthahataṃ khajaviloḍitam| ato asmādrasāyanāt| atandritaḥ analasaḥ| medhyaṃ medhājanakam||50-54||

lg.l: plīhodaroktaṃ vihitaṃ ca sarpis trīṇy eva cānyāni hitāni cātra |55|

div.ab: atra rasāyane'parāṇyapi ghṛtānyatideśenāha- plīhodaroktaṃ vihitamityādi| plīhodaroktaṃ ṣaṭpalakaṃ, trīṇyeva cānyāni udaroktānyeva; tadyathā- ekaṃ ‘harītakīcūrṇaprasthaṃ’ ityādikaṃ, dvitīyaṃ ‘gavye payasi mahāvṛkṣakṣīram’ ityādi, tṛtīyaṃ ‘cavyacitrakadantyativiṣā’ ityādikam| atra śoṣe| etāni srotovarodhaśāntyarthaṃ recanatvena hitāni|55|-

lg.l: upadravāṃś ca svaravaikṛtādīn jayed yathāsvaṃ prasamīkṣya śāstram ||55||

ab.seg: svarabhedādīnāṃ cikitsitamatideśenāha- upadravāṃśca svaravaikṛtādīnityādi| yathāsvaṃ yasya yadātmīyaṃ svarabhedādiśāstraṃ, tat prasamīkṣyetyarthaḥ||55||

lg.l: snānādinānāvidhinā jahāti māsād aśeṣaṃ niyamena śoṣam ||56||

ab.seg: idānīmajāyāḥ sarvaprakāreṇopayogamāha- ajāśakṛnmūtretyādi| ajāśakṛdādikaṃ yathāsambhavaṃ snānādividhinā puruṣaḥ sevamāno'śeṣaṃ śoṣaṃ māsājjahātīti sambandhaḥ| ajāśabdaḥ śakṛdādibhirālayāntaiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| ālayaṃ gṛham, ajānāmeva||56||

lg.l: rasonayogaṃ vidhivat kṣayārtaḥ kṣīreṇa vā nāgabalāprayogam |

ab.seg: rasonayogamityādi| vidhivat yathāśāstram| kṣīreṇeti nāgabalāprayogamāgadhikāvidhānābhyāṃ sambadhyate| tatheti kṣīreṇetyarthaḥ| jatunaḥ aśmajasya śilājatunaḥ||57||

lg.l: śokaṃ striyaṃ krodham asūyanaṃ ca tyaje... |58|

div.ab: idānīṃ parihāryamāha- śokaṃ striyamityādi| krodhaḥ parābhidrohalakṣaṇaḥ; asūyanaṃ paraguṇeṣu doṣāropaṇam|58|-

lg.l: vaidyān dvijātīṃs tridaśān gurūṃś ca vācaś ca puṇyāḥ śṛṇuyād dvijebhyaḥ ||58||

ab.seg: idānīṃ daivavyapāśrayāṃ cikitsāmāha- udārānityādi| udārā viṣayā dharmāviruddhā manonukūlāśca śabdādayaḥ| bhajeta seveta| dvijātīn viprān, tridaśān devān, gurūn pitṛmātṛprabhṛtīn| puṇyā vāco vedoktā rudrastutiprabhṛtayaḥ||58||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre (tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ, ādita) ekacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||41||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre śoṣapratiṣedhanāmaikacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||41||

div.head: gulmapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto gulmapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
śoṣapratiṣedhānantaraṃ riṣṭoktakramānukrameṇa gulmapratiṣedhārambho yujyata ityāha- athāto gulmapratiṣedhamityādi||1-2||

lg.l: yathoktaiḥ kopanair doṣāḥ kupitāḥ koṣṭham āgatāḥ |
janayanti nṛṇāṃ gulmaṃ sa pañcavidha ucyate ||3||

ab.seg: tatra nidānānantarayīkatvāt pratiṣedhasyādau gulmānāṃ hetusamprāptisaṅkhyā āha- yathoktairityādi| yathoktaiḥ kopanaiḥ vraṇapraśnoktairbalavadvigrahādikrodhādidivāsvapnādibhiḥ| āmapakvāgniraktamūtrāśayahṛdayoṇḍukaphupphusāśca koṣṭhaśabdavācyāḥ, tathā coktam- ‘sthānānyāmāgnipakvānāṃ mūtrasya rudhirasya ca| hṛduṇḍukaḥ phupphusaśca koṣṭha ityabhidhīyate’ iti| gulmaḥ pañcavidhaḥ pṛthagdoṣaiḥ trayaḥ, samastaiḥ ekaḥ, raktena aparaḥ, evaṃ pañcavidhaḥ| etacca prāyovacanaṃ, dvandvajagulmānāṃ sadbhāvāt| tathā coktam- “vyāmiśraliṅgānaparāṃstu gulmāṃstrīnādiśedbheṣajakalpanārtham”- iti, tathā vraṇapraśnoktaprasaratayā pañcadaśaprakāragulmasambhavāt| yathoktaiḥ kopanairityādirhetuḥ, doṣāḥ kupitā ityādiḥ samprāptiḥ, sa pañcavidha ityeṣā saṅkhyā||3||

lg.l: hṛdbastyor antare granthiḥ sañcārī yadi vā'calaḥ |
cayāpacayavān vṛttaḥ sa gulma iti kīrtitaḥ ||4||

ab.seg: gulmasya rūpamāha- hṛdbastyorantare granthirityādi| hṛdbastyoḥ hṛdaye ca bastau ca, vā tayorevāntare; tena sarvamudaramākṣiptam| sañcārī calanaśīlaḥ, vātādhikyāt| acala ekasthānaśāyī, vāyoralpatvāt| cayāpacayavān kadācidupacitaḥ kadācidapacita iti, vicitrakriyatvādvāyoḥ| vṛtto vartulaḥ| kecit ‘hṛnnābhyorantare’ iti paṭhanti; te ca nābhigrahaṇenaiva sāmīpyādbastiṃ gṛhṇanti| ‘cayāpacayavān’ ityatra ‘sthiropacayavān’ iti kecit paṭhanti, sthira upacayo vṛddhiryasya sa iti ca vyākhyānayanti||4||

div.ab: idānīṃ tatrāpyudare pañcagulmāśrayānāha- pañca gulmāśrayā ityādi| subodhametat| kārtikakuṇḍastvenaṃ pāṭhaṃ ‘sa vyastairjāyate doṣaiḥ’ ityādivākyādanantaraṃ paṭhati|5|-

lg.l: gulmavad vā viśālatvād gulma ity abhidhīyate |6|

div.ab: atha gulmaniruktimāha- gupitānilamūlatvādityādi `kupitānilamūlatvāt' iti pā.| gupitānilamūlatvāt `kupitānilamūlatvāt' iti pā. ākulīkṛtavāyumūlatvāt, etena sarvagulmānāṃ vāyuḥ kāraṇam| gūḍhamūlodayāditi gūḍhamūlāḥ kandādayaḥ, teṣāmivodayādutpatteḥ; anye tu gūḍhamūlo guptakāraṇa udayo yasya sa tathā tasmāt, mūlasya vāyorgūḍhatvamāvṛtatvamucyate tatprakopadvaividhyāt; tathā ca- “vāyordhātukṣayāt kopo mārgasyāvaraṇena ca”- iti| gulmavat manuṣyādisaṃhativat `vanaspatyādisaṃhativat' iti pā.| viśālatvāt vistīrṇatvāt| etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati- yathā saṃhativiśeṣeṇāvasthitā manuṣyavṛkṣādayo gulmavyapadeśaṃ bhajante- manuṣyagulmo vṛkṣagulma iti, evamatrāpi dṛṣṭāntatrayaṃ gulmasya doṣatrayodbhavatvapradarśanārtham| ‘gupitānilamūlatvāt’ ityatra ‘kupitānilamūlatvāt’ iti kecit paṭhanti| tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ| ‘gūḍhamūlodayāt’ ityatrāpare ‘gūḍhagūlmodayāt’ iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- gūḍhasya latādivṛtasya `latādicchannasya' iti pā. gulmasyeva vartulaviṭapasyeva udayādutpattergulma ityarthaḥ||5||-

lg.l: sa yasmād ātmani cayaṃ gacchaty apsv iva budbudaḥ ||6||
antaḥ sarati yasmāc ca na pākam upayāty ataḥ |7|

div.ab: idānīṃ yathā na pacyate gulmastathā''ha- sa yasmādityādi| sa gulmo yasmāt kāraṇādātmani svāvayave cayaṃ nicayaṃ gacchati yāti; apsviva budbuda udgacchati udgatiṃ yāti, tathā gulmarūpo'pi doṣaḥ svāvayave udgacchati udgatiṃ yāti; antaḥ abhyantare, sarati bhrāmyati| evambhūtaḥ prāyeṇa vātiko bhavati, sa ca na pacyate; itare ca gulmā yadā raktādidūṣyamadhiṣṭhāya avatiṣṭhante tadā kadācit pacyante| tathā coktam- “raktapittātivṛddhatvāt kriyāmanupalabhya vā| yadi gulmo vidahyeta śastraṃ tatra bhiṣagjitam”- iti| athaivamantarvidradhergulmasya ca śīghramandapākitvena bhedaḥ||6||-

lg.l: sa vyastair jāyate doṣaiḥ samastair api cocchritaiḥ ||7||
puruṣāṇāṃ tathā strīṇāṃ jñeyo raktena cāparaḥ |8|

div.ab: idānīṃ ‘sa pañcavidha ucyate’ ityasyaiva vivaraṇamāha- sa vyastairjāyate doṣairityādi| sa gulmaḥ, vyastaiḥ ekaikaiḥ; ucchritaiḥ prakupitaiḥ, raktena ārtavaraktena; cakārāt dhāturaktenāpi gulmo jāyate, sa ca puṃsāṃ strīṇāṃ ca bhavati; tasya ca pṛthagupādānaṃ na kṛtaṃ, paittikagulmasamānalakṣaṇatayā tatraivāvarodhāt||7||-

lg.l: dveṣo 'nne vāyur ūrdhvaṃ ca pūrvarūpeṣu gulminām ||9||

ab.seg: gulmapūrvarūpāṇyāha- sadanamityādi| āṭopa udarāpūraḥ| saṅgo nirodhaḥ| sauhityāsahatā tṛptyakṣamatvam| vāyuḥ ūrdhvaṃ santatodgāra ityarthaḥ||8-9||

lg.l: hṛtkukṣiśūlaṃ mukhakaṇṭhaśoṣo vāyor nirodho viṣamāgnitā ca |
te te vikārāḥ pavanātmakāś ca bhavanti gulme 'nilasambhave tu ||10||

ab.seg: vātagulmalakṣaṇamāha- hṛtkukṣiśūlamityādi| viṣamāgnitā ceti cakārānmukhavairasyaṃ grāhyam| te te vikārāḥ stambhakampādayaḥ| kecidvātagulmalakṣaṇaṃ ‘ādhmānaśūle bhavato'timātraṃ’ ityādinā pāṭhena paṭhanti; sa `so'pyabhāvānna likhitaḥ' iti pā. cābhāvānna likhitaḥ||10||

lg.l: pittasya liṅgāny akhilāni yāni pittātmake tāni bhavanti gulme ||11||

ab.seg: pittagulmalakṣaṇamāha- svedetyādi| āhāravidāhaḥ bhuktamātrasyāhārasyāmlikādisadbhāvaḥ| pittasya liṅgāni bhramamadamūrcchādīni| pittagulmalakṣaṇamapi kecidanyapāṭhena paṭhanti| yathā- ‘amlībhavatyannamatho jvaraśca dāhaḥ pipāsā kaṭuvaktratā ca| pittasya liṅgāni ca kīrtitāni bhavanti pittaprabhave tu gulme’ iti||11||

lg.l: staimityam anne 'rucir aṅgasādaś chardiḥ praseko madhurāsyatā ca |
kaphasya liṅgāni ca yāni tāni bhavanti gulme kaphasambhave tu ||12||

ab.seg: kaphagulmalakṣaṇamāha- staimityamityādi| staimityaṃ stimitatā| anne aruciḥ annānabhilāṣaḥ| praseko lālāsrāvaḥ| kaphasya liṅgāni gauravaśaityādīni| kaphagulmamapi kecit “anne na lipsā gurugātratā ca chardiḥ praseko madhurāsyatā ca” ityādipāṭhena paṭhanti, so'pyabhāvānna darśitaḥ||12||

div.ab: sannipātagulmalakṣaṇamāha- sarvātmaka ityādi| sarvavikārayuktaḥ pratyekavātādigulmoktalakṣaṇasahitaḥ| ‘sarvātmake sarvarujopapattiḥ’ iti kecit paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- sarvaliṅgopapattiriti vaktavye sarvarujopapattiriti yatkṛtaṃ tanmahārujatvapratipādanārtham `tanmahārujāsūcanārtham' iti pā.| kecidatra nicayagulmaṃ purīṣalasikāraktajanyaṃ dakṣiṇapārśvāśritaṃ paṭhanti| tasya viśeṣa ucyate,- “sirājālaparicchanno dāharāgajvarānvitaḥ| kūrmavadraktaparyantastridoṣaḥ sa na sidhyati”- iti| kecicca gulmāvasthāviśeṣamupastambhanāmāntaraṃ `gulmāvasthāviśeṣaprāptyā nāmāntaraṃ' iti pā. paṭhanti- “payo hyamlasamāyuktaṃ dadhibhāvaṃ vrajedyathā| yatnahīnasya gulmo'pi tathopastambhatāṃ vrajet|| ambhovahe stambhayitvā srotasī koṣṭhasaṃśritaḥ| udare prati santiṣṭhedupastambhaṃ tu taṃ viduḥ”- iti|13|-

lg.l: navaprasūtā'hitabhojanā yā yā cāmagarbhaṃ visṛjed ṛtau `prasavedathartau' iti pā. vā ||13||
vāyur hi tasyāḥ parigṛhya raktaṃ karoti gulmaṃ sarujaṃ sadāham |
paittasya liṅgena samānaliṅgaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ cāpy aparaṃ nibodha ||14||
na spandate nodaram eti vṛddhiṃ bhavanti liṅgāni ca garbhiṇīnām |
taṃ garbhakālātigame cikitsyam asṛgbhavaṃ gulmam uśanti tajjñāḥ ||15||

ab.seg: ārtavaraktajagulmaṃ hetvādibhirāha- kṣatajamityādi| kṣatajaśabdenārtavaraktamucyate `kṣatajaśabdenātra raktamucyate' iti pā., kāraṇe kāryopacārāt| āmagarbha; ṣaṇmāsaṃ yāvat| ṛtāvityatrāpi ahitabhojaneti sambadhyate| paittasya pittajagulmasya| viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣam| nibodha jānīhi| na spandate na calati, ‘aṅgaiḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| anye tu parato niṣedhasyobhayatra sambandhāt spandate ityeva varṇayanti; tena piṇḍitaḥ spandata evetyarthaḥ; tathā coktam- ‘yaḥ spandate piṇḍita eva nāṅgaiḥ’ (ca. ci. a.5)- iti| garbhiṇīnāṃ liṅgāni śramādīni sadanāntānyatra vyādhisvabhāvādbhavanti| taṃ raktagulmam| garbhakālātigame prasūtikāle'tikrānte; prasūtikālādanantaraṃ piṇḍībhūte raktagulme snehādinopaskṛtadehāyāḥ sukhasādhyatvam| uktaṃ ca- “jvare tulyartudoṣatvaṃ pramehe tulyadūṣyatā| raktagulme purāṇatvaṃ sukhasādhyasya lakṣaṇam `hetavaḥ' iti pā. ” iti| kecidevaṃ vyākhyānayanti- ‘māse vyatīte daśame cikitsyaḥ’ iti vaktavye ‘taṃ garbhakālātigame cikitsyam’ iti yatkṛtaṃ tadraktagulme samyagupacite `samyak jñāte' iti pā. prasūtikālādarvāgapi cikitsā karaṇīyeti bodhayati||13-15||

ataḥ paraṃ cikitsāmāha- vātagulmārditamityādi| snigdhamavasthāpekṣayā caturbhirapi snehaiḥ| yathākālamiti ‘pakṣādvireko vāntasya’ ityādinoktasya kālasyānatikrameṇetyarthaḥ; ‘yathākālaṃ’ ityatra ‘yathāyogaṃ’ iti paṭhitvā yathāvasthamiti vyākhyā nayanti||16||
pittagulmārditamityādi| madhurairyogaiḥ āragvadhādibhiḥ kṣīraśarkarādibhiśca; anye tu ‘bhittvā dvidhekṣum’ ityādyuktairmadhurairyogairiti vyākhyānayanti| nirūhaiḥ samupācarenmadhuraireva||17||

lg.l: tīkṣṇair viriktaṃ tad rūpair nirūhaiḥ samupācaret ||18||

ab.seg: śleṣmagulmārditamityādi| tīkṣṇaiḥ dantīdravantīprabhṛtībhiḥ| tadrūpairnirūhaistīkṣṇaiḥ ‘āragvadhādibhiḥ kvāthaḥ’ ityādibhirityarthaḥ| sarvagulmeṣu snehasvedau prayojyau, vātārabdhatvāt `vātasadbhāvāt' iti pā.||18||

div.ab: sannipātotthite gulme ityādi| nanu, pūrvaṃ sānnipātiko gulmo'sādhya uktaḥ, tat kathaṃ tridoṣaghno vidhirhita ityucyate? satyaṃ, yathā `yasmāt' iti pā. viṣamasannipātajo gulmo'sādhyastathā samasannipātajo'bhinavo balavati puruṣe kṛcchrasādhyaḥ, ato'tra cikitsitamuktam| tathā coktaṃ- “sannipātotthito gulmaścirottho'samadoṣajaḥ| varjanīyo'nyathā kṛcchrasādhyo balavato mataḥ”- iti|19|-

lg.l: palāśakṣāratoyena `palāśabhasmatoyena' iti pā. siddhaṃ sarpiḥ prayojayet ||20||
uṣṇair vā bhedayed bhinne vidhir āsṛgdaro hitaḥ ||21||

ab.seg: pittavadraktagulminyā ityādi| pittavat pittagulmavat| pittagulmacikitsayā pratikṛtasya `mṛdukṛtasya' iti pā. raktagulmasya viśeṣacikitsāmāha- viśeṣamaparaṃ cāsyā ityādi| palāśakṣāratoyena palāśabhasmagālitena jalena| kecittoyaśabdaṃ kvāthe varṇayanti `vartayanti' iti pā.| sa ca kṣārakvāthaḥ snehopayogoktavidhinā kāryaḥ| pippalyādigaṇakalkakvāthābhyāṃ sādhitaghṛtena| uṣṇairiti pippalyādiprabhṛtibhiḥ| vidhirāsṛgdara iti raktapittokto vidhiḥ; kuta etat? asṛgdare raktapittavidhyatideśāt; asṛgdaravidhyatideśena raktapittavidhyatideśaṃ kurvannetajjñāpayati- adhogataraktapittacikitsitamatra kāryamiti||19-21||

vātagulme'nuvāsanamuddiśannāha- ānūpaudakamajjāna ityādi| ānūpā gajagavayādayaḥ, audakā matsyādayaḥ| vasā'pi ānūpādīnāmeva| vipakvamekata iti etacca snehamekīkṛtya vipakvam, arthādvātaharairdravyairiti boddhavyam||22||

lg.l: jāṅgalaikaśaphānāṃ tu vasā sarpiś ca paittike |23|

div.ab: paittike gulme'nuvāsanamāha- jāṅgalaikaśaphānāmityādi| atra jāṅgalaśabdena jaṅghālaviṣkirau pradhānatayā gṛhyete| ekaśaphā aśvaveśarādayaḥ| vasā sarpiśceti atrāpi vipakvamiti sambadhyate| tenaitaddvayaṃ pittaharairdravyairvipakvaṃ paittike gulme'nuvāsanaṃ yojyamiti|23|-

ab.seg: kaphagulme'nuvāsanamāha- tailaṃ jāṅgalamajjāna ityādi| evamiti kaphaharadravyairvipakvamanuvāsanaṃ śastamityarthaḥ||23||

vātādijagulmeṣvanuvāsanamabhidhāya vātāpahaghṛtānyāha `aparāṇi ghṛtānyāha' iti pā. - dhātrīphalānāmityādi| dhātrīphalānāṃ svarase caturguṇe; ṣaḍaṅgamiti ṣaṭpalakaṃ; tenātra pañcakolayavakṣārakalkamiti labhyate| śarkarāsaindhavopetamiti śarkarāsaindhavaprakṣepayuktaṃ tadghṛtaṃ vātagulmine hitamityarthaḥ||24||

citrakādighṛtamāha- citrakavyoṣetyādi| pṛthvīkā hiṅgupatrikā, ‘kṛṣṇajīraka’ ityanye; dīpyakaḥ ajamodā, granthikaṃ pippalīmūlam| samairiti ‘kalkīkṛtaiḥ’ ityadhyāhāryam| dadhyādīni mūlakasvarasāntāni pratyekaṃ ghṛtāccaturguṇāni||25-26||

hiṅgvādyaṃ ghṛtamāha- hiṅgusauvarcaletyādi| dhānyaṃ dhānyakam| ajagandhā bovayikā| surasaḥ tulasī| hiṅgvādīnāṃ surasāntānāṃ kalke dadhnā caturguṇena vipācitaṃ sarpiḥ śūlādiharamiti sambandhaḥ||27-28||
dādhikasañjñaṃ ghṛtamāha- viḍadāḍimasindhūtthetyādi| hutabhuk citrakaḥ| kṣāro yavakṣāraḥ, ruk kuṣṭhaṃ, vṛkṣāmlaṃ tintiḍīkam| bījapūrakaraso'tra caturguṇaḥ, dravadravyatvāt||29-30||

rasonādighṛtamāha- rasonasvaraso ityādi| pañcamūlarasānvitamiti bilvādipañcamūlakvāthānvitam| āranālaṃ kāñjikaṃ, dadhyamlaṃ dadhimastu| dīpyakaḥ ajamodā| rasonasvarasādimūlakasvarasāntaiḥ ṣaḍbhirdravairghṛtasamaiḥ, vyoṣādidravyaiḥ kalkitaiḥ sarpiścaturthāṃśaiḥ, siddhaṃ sarpirgulmādīn jayediti sambandhaḥ||31-33||

lg.l: sauvarcalaṃ sarjikāṃ ca devadārv atha saindhavam |
vātagulmāpahaṃ sarpir etad dīpanam eva ca ||35||

ab.seg: dadhi sauvīrakamityādi| dadhyādīni catvāri pṛthagāḍhakapramāṇāni, sauvarcalādīni dvipalānyāvāpya sarpirāḍhakaṃ vipacet, ayamatra siddhaḥ pāṭhaḥ, pāramparyāvicchedasmaraṇāt| vartamānapustakeṣu cāyaṃ paṭhyate- kulatthamūlakakvāthetyādi||34-35||

div.ab: pittajaraktajagulmayorghṛtānyāha- tṛṇamūlakaṣāye ityādi| atra tṛṇamūlaśabdāttṛṇapañcamūlakaṣāye iti boddhavyam| jīvanīyairiti kākolyādibhiḥ kalkīkṛtairityarthaḥ| nyagrodhādigaṇe kvāthīkṛte iti jñeyam| vā'pītvapiśabdo jīvanīyaiḥ pacedghṛtamiti samuccinoti| etamutpalādāvapi grāhyam| raktapittotthitaṃ ‘gulmaṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ||36||-

lg.l: ghnanti gulmaṃ kaphodbhūtaṃ ghṛtāny etāny asaṃśayam ||38||

ab.seg: kaphagulme ghṛtānyāha- āragvadhādau vipacedityādi| āragvadhādāviti kvāthīkṛte| dīpanīyayutamiti pippalyādikalkayutam| ekaṃ ghṛtam| kṣāravarge iti muṣkakādārabhya yāvaccatasraḥ kośātakīriti kṣāravarge, muṣkakādigaṇe ityanye vyākhyānayanti| atrāpi dīpanīyayutamiti sambadhyate, tena kṣāravargadrave `kṣāravargadvaye' iti pā. pippalyādikalkayutaṃ ghṛtaṃ pacedityarthaḥ; dvitīyaṃ ghṛtamityarthaḥ| pacenmūtragaṇe'paramiti mūtragaṇe gomūtrādike'ṣṭasaṅkhyāke'paraṃ tṛtīyaṃ ghṛtam| atrāpi dīpanīyayutamiti sambadhyate| ‘mūtragaṇe'param’ ityatrānye ‘dīpanīyagaṇe'param’ iti paṭhanti, tacca ṭīkākārā anārṣaṃ varṇayanti| kecididaṃ kaphagulmacikitsitaṃ vātagulmacikitsānantaraṃ paṭhitvā vātāvarakaṃ kaphaśāntaye kaphahantṝṇyapi ghṛtāni vātagulme śastānīti vyākhyānayanti||37-38||

div.ab: evaṃ ghṛtānyabhidhāyādhunā sānnipātike doṣodrekeṇa ghṛtacūrṇādibhiścikitsitamāha- yathetyādi| yathādoṣocchrayaṃ yo yo doṣa ucchrita utkaṭastaccikitsayā cikitsedityarthaḥ| ‘yathādoṣocchrayaṃ’ ityatrānye ‘yathādoṣabalaṃ’ iti paṭhanti; tatrāpyeko'rthaḥ|39|-

lg.l: cūrṇaṃ hiṅgvādikaṃ vā'pi ghṛtaṃ vā plīhanāśanam ||39||
pibed gulmāpahaṃ kāle sarpis tailvakam eva vā |40|

div.ab: tacca yathādoṣocchrayaṃ cikitsitaṃ vāte jite sati kāryamiti vātaharavidhimāha- cūrṇamityādi| cūrṇaṃ hiṅgvādikamiti hiṅgutrikaṭuketyādinā vātavyādhyuktam| ghṛtaṃ vā plīhanāśanamiti ṣaṭpalakamityarthaḥ| yadyapi ṣaṭpalaṃ ghṛtaṃ tantrāntare kaphagulmaharatvena darśitaṃ, tathā'pyatra vilakṣaṇaikadravyatvādvātagulmaharatvam| kāle utpannamātra eva ṣaṭpalakaṃ ghṛtaṃ hitaṃ, kāle avasthāyāmityanye| sarpistailvakamiti tilvakaḥ paṭṭikārodhraḥ, tena saṃskṛtaṃ tailvakaṃ, vātavyādhyuktaṃ vā||39||-

lg.l: sājamodaiś ca daśabhiḥ sāmudrāc ca palair yutam ||42||
tasya mātrāṃ pibed dadhnā surayā sarpiṣā'pi vā ||43||
gulmān vātavikārāṃś ca kṣāro 'yaṃ hanty asaṃśayam ||44||

ab.seg: pānīyaṃ kṣāramāha- tiletyādi| ikṣurakaḥ kokilākṣakaḥ| nāgarakasthāne kecittryūṣaṇaṃ paṭhanti| kṛmighāti viḍaṅgam| tilādīnāṃ mūlakāntānāṃ bhasma gavādimūtragaṇena caturguṇena kṣārakalpena parisrāvya kuṣṭādibhirajamodāntaiḥ pālikeḥ sāmudrāt samudralavaṇāddaśabhiḥ palaiścūrṇitairyutaṃ lauhapātre mṛdunā cāgninā lehyaṃ `āloḍya' iti pā. paktvā uddharediti sambandhaḥ| anye tu vyākhyānayanti- tilādibhasmapalaśataṃ gavādimūtreṇa caturguṇena niṣkvāthya pādabhāgikamavaśeṣya, taccaturthāṃśaṃ kuṣṭhādicūrṇamāvāpya tāvat pacedyāvallehyaṃ bhavati| dadhnetyādyanekāvaloḍanadravyopadeśo doṣakālāgnyapekṣayā| vātavikārān tūnīprabhṛtīn||40-44||

ślokena yogadvayamāha- svarjiketyādi| kṣāro yavakṣāraḥ| tatra svarjikākuṣṭhasahito yavakṣārastailenetyeko yogaḥ; ketakijo'pi vetyatrāpi kṣāra iti sambadhyate, tena ketakijo'pi vā kṣārastaileneti dvitīyo yogaḥ| gauḍāstu ketakikṣāraḥ svarjikākuṣṭhasahitastailenetyekameva yogaṃ manyante||45||

div.ab: kṣārāvalehamabhidhāya cūrṇamāha- pītamityādi| sukhāmbunā īṣaduṣṇodakena| gulmaṃ hantītyatrāpi sambadhyate|46|-

lg.l: vṛścīva(ra)murubūkaṃ `pṛthvīkāmurubūkaṃ ca' iti pā. ca varṣābhūr bṛhatīdvayam ||46||
busoṣitaṃ `tuṣoṣikaṃ iti pā. daśāhaṃ tu jīrṇabhaktaḥ piben naraḥ ||48||

div.ab: vṛścīvādyariṣṭamāha- vṛścīvetyādi vṛścīvaḥ śuklapunarnavā| urubūkaḥ śuklairaṇḍaḥ| varṣābhūḥ raktapunarnavā| bṛhatīdvayamiti ekā aṇuphalā `caṇakaphalā' iti pā., dvitīyā kaṇṭakinī sthūlaphalā| vṛścīvādīnāṃ citrakāntānāmāḍhakam; anye palaśataṃ manyante, droṇe'mbhasi palaśatamityādiparibhāṣitatvāt| pādāvaśeṣitaṃ caturthāṃśāvaśiṣṭaṃ kvāthaṃ, magadhādipramāṇaṃ yāvanmātreṇa kumbhasya samyaglepanaṃ bhavati, pathyācūrṇārdhasaṃyuktaṃ harītakīcūrṇāṣṭapalasaṃyutam| busoṣitaṃ busamadhye sthitam| jīrṇabhaktaḥ pariṇatāhāraḥ laghukoṣṭha iti yāvat| pibet prātareva||46-48||-

lg.l: lavaṇaṃ vṛkṣabījaṃ ca tulyaṃ syād anavo guḍaḥ |
pathyābhir vā yutaṃ `pathyābhiḥ sahitaṃ cūrṇaṃ' iti pā. cūrṇaṃ gavāṃ mūtrayutaṃ pacet ||50||
guṭikās tad ghanībhūtaṃ kṛtvā khāded abhuktavān |

div.ab: pāṭhetyādi| nikumbhā dantī| agnikaḥ citrakaḥ, ‘agnimantha’ ityanye, ‘moraṭa’ ityapare| vṛkṣabījam indrayavaḥ| anavaṃ guḍaṃ purāṇaṃ guḍam| pāṭhādicūrṇaṃ samapurāṇaguḍayutaṃ svādet, athavā tadeva cūrṇaṃ harītakībhiḥ saha gomūtreṇa pacet, taṃ ca ghanībhūtaṃ guṭikāḥ kṛtvā prātareva khādet| harītakīpramāṇaṃ cūrṇāccaturthāṃśaṃ, gomūtraṃ tu caturguṇam||49-51||-

lg.l: gulme raktaṃ jalaukobhiḥ sirāmokṣeṇa vā haret |53|

div.ab: idānīmavasthāyāṃ gulme raktamokṣaṇamāha- saśūle ityādi| aspande acale| pākaruganvite pākavedanāyukte, jalaukobhī raktaṃ haret gulmasthāne eva, sirāmokṣeṇa tu bāhvoḥ, tantrāntaroktatvāt| kecit ‘alābupātanaṃ cāpi gulme śastaṃ kaphātmake’ iti paṭhanti||52||-
gulmināṃ jāṅgalarasya pānamāha- sukhoṣṇā ityādi| sukhoṣṇā īṣaduṣṇāḥ| jāṅgalarasā jāṅghālaviṣkiramāṃsarasāḥ saṃskṛtāḥ| susnigdhāḥ samyak snehasaṃskṛtāḥ| hitā iti ‘yathādoṣaṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ||53||-

lg.l: peyā vātaharaiḥ siddhāḥ kaulatthā saṃskṛtā rasāḥ ||54||
khalāḥ sapañcamūlāś ca gulmināṃ bhojane hitāḥ |55|

div.ab: bhojanārthamāha- peyetyādi| vātaharaiḥ bhadradārvādibhiḥ| saṃskṛtāḥ snehādibhiḥ| khalāḥ kapitthadāḍimatakraśākādisaṃskṛtāḥ ‘kacilā’ iti prasiddhāḥ| sapañcamūlāḥ pañcamūlasahitāḥ, etena pañcamūlasahitaiḥ kapitthādibhiḥ kṛtā ityarthaḥ| bhojane hitā yathādoṣamityupaskāraḥ||54||-

ab.seg: avasthāvaśena gulme bhojanaviśeṣamāha- baddhetyādi| baddhavarconilānāṃ niruddhapurīṣavāyūnām| sārdrakam ārdrakasahitam| iṣyate ‘bhojane’ iti śeṣaḥ||55||

div.ab: āntaropacāramabhidhāyāvasthāyāṃ bāhyopacāraṃ svedamāha- kumbhīpiṇḍeṣṭakāsvedānityādi| kumbhīprabhṛtisvedāḥ svedādhyāye abhihitāḥ| nipuṇatayā svedān kārayet|56|-
vātaśleṣmātmake saśūle kaṭhine ca gulme gulmino virekamāha- gulmina ityādi| sukhinnāniti sneho hi svedenaivākṣiptaḥ, tena samyak snigdhasvinnān| sraṃsanena virekeṇa| upapādayet yojayet||56||-

lg.l: vimlāpanābhyañjanāni `vilepanābhyañjanāni' iti pā. tathaiva dahanāni ca ||57||
udaroktāni sarpīṃṣi mūtravartikriyās tathā `cūrṇavartikriyāstathā' iti pā.||58||
lavaṇāni ca yojyāni yāny uktāny anilāmaye |59|

div.ab: kiṃ gulme vireka eva kāryaṃ utānyadapītyāha- vimlāpanābhyañjanānītyādi| vimlāpanam aṅgulyādinā gulmasya mardanaṃ, dahanaṃ jāmbavauṣṭhādinā| sālvaṇādaya ityatra ādiśabdaḥ prakāre; tena sālvaṇaprakārā anye'pyupanāhasvedāḥ pacyamānābhimukhe gulme kāryāḥ| udaroktāni sarpīṃṣi ‘harītakīcūrṇaprasthaṃ’ ityādikāni| mūtravartikriyāstatheti udaroktā ‘vamanaśirovirecanadravyāṇāṃ’ ityādikāḥ| lavaṇāni patralavaṇasnehalavaṇakalyāṇalavaṇāni| anilāmaye vātavyādhau| kecit ‘sarpīṃṣi’ ityasyāgre ‘cūrṇāni’ iti paṭhitvā nārācakādaya iti vyākhyānayanti||57-58||-
idānīṃ mūtravartiprayogāvasthāmaparavartiṃ cāha- vātetyādi| sāmudraṃ samudralavaṇaṃ, samudraphenamapare| maricottarā maricapradhānāḥ||59||-

lg.l: kuryād ariṣṭān sarvāṃś ca ślokasthāne yatheritān |61|

div.ab: dantīcitrakamūleṣvityādi| vātahareṣu vidārigandhāprabhṛtiṣu| ślokasthāne yatheritāniti yathā sūtrasthāne virecanakalpe āsavakaraṇamuktaṃ, tenaiva prakāreṇātrāpi dantyādikvāthe'riṣṭānāsavān kuryāt| anye tu ‘ślokasthāne’ ityatra dvitīyaṃ sthānaśabdaṃ luptaṃ varṇayanti, luptasthānaśabdena gulmapratiṣedhaṃ gṛhṇanti| tenātroktavṛścīvādyariṣṭavaddantyādikvāthe madhupathyācūrṇaprakṣepeṇāriṣṭakaraṇaṃ, sūtrasthānoktaprakāreṇa vā''savakaraṇam||60||-

ab.seg: svādedityādi| aṅkurān komalapallavān| bhṛṣṭāniti ‘snehena’ iti śeṣaḥ; anye agninā bhṛṣṭānityāhuḥ, tanmate vātakāriṇo'pyaṅkurā vyādhipratyanīkatvādgulme hitāḥ| pūtīkaḥ cirabilvaḥ, nṛpavṛkṣo girimālakaḥ||61||

lg.l: ūrdhvavātaṃ manuṣyaṃ ca gulminaṃ na nirūhayet |62|

div.ab: idānīṃ gulme hitasyāpi nirūhasyāvasthāyāṃ niṣedhamāha- ūrdhvavātamityādi| ūrdhvavātam ūrdhvavātayuktaṃ gulminaṃ manuṣyaṃ na nirūhayediti sambandhaḥ| kecidimaṃ pāṭhaṃ na paṭhanti|62|-

lg.l: pibet trivṛnnāgaraṃ vā saguḍāṃ vā harītakīm ||62||
gugguluṃ trivṛtāṃ dantīṃ dravantīṃ saindhavaṃ vacām |

ab.seg: pibedityādi| pibediti vakṣyamāṇena mūtramadyādidraveṇa; anye pānīyena pibedityāhuḥ| trivṛnnāgaramityeko yogaḥ, saguḍāṃ vā harītakīmiti dvitīyaḥ| guggulumityādi| dravantī cīritapatrā dantībhedaḥ| payaḥ dugdhaṃ, drakṣārasaḥ drākṣāsvarasaḥ| vīkṣya balābalamiti ‘doṣādīnāṃ’ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ| atrāpi pibediti sambandhanīyam||62-63||

lg.l: evaṃ pīlūni bhṛṣṭāni `piṣṭāni' iti pā. pibet salavaṇāni tu |64|

div.ab: evamityādi| evamiti mūtrādibhirityarthaḥ| (bhṛṣṭāni snehena ayaṃ pāṭho hastalikhitapustake nopalabhyate )|64|-

lg.l: yuktā hanti surā gulmaṃ śīghraṃ kāle prayojitā |65|

div.ab: pippalītyādi| surā paiṣṭī| hantītyatra śīghramiti sambadhyate| kāle ādhmānādikāyāmavasthāyām||64||-
baddhaviṇmāruto gulmī bhuñjīta payasā yavān ||65|| kulmāṣān vā bahusnehān bhakṣayel lavaṇottarān |66|
baddhetyādi| payasā dugdhena| yavān vāṭyādikṛtān| kulmāṣān yavapiṣṭamayān bhakṣyān| lavaṇottarān saindhavapradhānān||65||-

lg.l: athāsyopadravaḥ śūlaḥ `śūlaṃ' iti pā. kathañcid upajāyate ||66||
śūlaṃ `śūlaṃ nikhānitamiva sukhaṃ yena na vettyasau' iti pā. nikhānitam ivāsukhaṃ yena tu vetty asau |67|

div.ab: idānīṃ gulmopadravamāha- athetyādi| asya gulmasya, upadravaḥ paścātkālabhāvī kathañcit svahetubhirityarthaḥ| śūla upajāyate| śūlaṃ nikhānitamiva kīlakaṃ nikhānitamivetyarthaḥ||66||-

tasyaivopadravasya doṣaviśeṣeṇa liṅgaṃ saṅkhyāṃ cāha- tatretyādi| tatretyupadrave śūle| sthirāṅgatā kaṭhināṅgatā| annasya vidagdhaparivṛddhitā annasya vidāhe śūlasya parivṛddhirbhavatītyarthaḥ| bhuktavṛddhiriti bhuktasya vṛddhiḥ bhuktamātre śūlasya vṛddhirbhavatītyarthaḥ| jaḍāṅgatā aṅgānāṃ jaḍatā| miśrairiti dvandvaiḥ sānnipātikaiścetyarthaḥ| viṇmūtrasaṃrodha ityādikaṃ vātajaśūlalakṣaṇaṃ, tṛṣṇādāha ityādikaṃ pittajaśūlalakṣaṇaṃ, romaharṣo'rucirityādikaṃ śleṣmajaśūlalakṣaṇaṃ, dvidoṣaliṅgaṃ dvandvaiḥ, sarvaliṅgaṃ samastaiḥ||67-68||-

lg.l: yavānīṃ ca haridrāṃ ca viḍaṅgāny amlavetasam |
yathākramaṃ vimiśrāṃś ca dvandve sarvāṃś ca sarvaje |73|

div.ab: ataḥ paramupadravaśūlasya `upadravaliṅgasya' iti pā. cikitsitamāha- vīkṣyetyādi| vīkṣyeti vātādibhedena śūlamityarthaḥ| trilavaṇaṃ saindhavasauvarcalabiḍāni| kṣāro yavakṣāraḥ| abhīruḥ śatāvarī, śṛṅgāṭī jalajaṃ dravyaṃ trikaṇṭakaphalaṃ| guḍaśarkarā gāṅgeṭīphalam `gāṅgeṭī balā' iti pā.| himaṃ candanam| ṣaḍgranthā vacā| vṛkṣaja indrayavaḥ| mūlakaṃ pippalīmūlam| uṣṇaśabdo'mlakāñjikādibhiḥ sambadhyate| ślokasamāpanān ‘yogān’ iti śeṣaḥ| yathākramamiti pathyādyamlavetasāntamuṣṇāmlakāñjikena vātike, vidāryādihimāntumuṣṇakṣīreṇa paittike, ṣaḍgranthādicitrakāntamuṣṇatoyena ślaiṣmike; vimiśraṃ dvandve iti pathyādividāryādī vātapaittike, pathyādiṣaḍgranthādī vātaślaiṣmike, vidāryādiṣaḍgranthādī pittaślaiṣmike, sarvāṃśca pathyādīn trīn sannipāte||69-72||-

tathaiva sekāvagāhapradehābhyaṅgabhojanam ||73||
śiśirodakapūrṇānāṃ bhājanānāṃ ca dhāraṇam |
vamanonmardanasvedalaṅghanakṣapaṇakriyāḥ ||74|| snehādiś ca kramaḥ sarvo viśeṣeṇopadiśyate |75|

kimetadevopadravaśūle kāryamutānyadapītyāha- tathaivetyādi| tathaiveti yathāsaṅkhyamityarthaḥ| tena sekādikaṃ vātike, śiśirodakādikaṃ paittike, vamanādikaṃ ślaiṣmike| snehādikramaśca yathādoṣaṃ yathāvasthaṃ sarveṣāmeva, dvandvaje dvayaṃ, sānnipātike samastam| kṣapaṇakriyā anyā api kaphakṣayakarī||73-74||-

lg.l: na khāded ālukaṃ gulmī madhurāṇi phalāni ca |76|

div.ab: gulmopadravamabhidhāya gulme varjyamāha- vallūraṃ mūlakamityādi| vallūraṃ śuṣkamāṃsam| vaidalaṃ mudgavanamudgādikam| ālukaṃ piṇḍālukādibhedenānekaprakāram| madhurāṇi phalāni kṣīravṛkṣaphalāni cocamocādīni ca| cakārādevaṃvidhānyanyānyapi varjyāni| asyāgre kecit ‘laghvannaṃ dīpanaṃ snigdhamuṣṇaṃ vātānulomanam| bṛṃhaṇaṃ ca bhavedyacca taddhitaṃ sarvagulminām|| sthāne'vaseko raktasya bāhumadhye sirāvyadhaḥ| svedo'nulomanaṃ caiva praśastaṃ sarvagulminām’ ityādikaṃ paṭhanti; sa cābhāvānna likhitaḥ| (iti ayaṃ pāṭho mudritapustake nopalabhyate ḍahlaṇenānyagranthadarśanāduktam)||75||-

lg.l: vinā gulmena yac chūlaṃ gulmasthāneṣu jāyate ||76||
nidānaṃ tasya vakṣyāmi rūpaṃ ca sacikitsitam |77|

div.ab: gulmopadravaṃ śūlamabhidhāyedānīṃ kevalaṃ śūlamāha- vinetyādi| gulmasthāneṣu gulmapratiṣedhokteṣu| anye ‘vinā gulmena’ ityādiślokaṃ parityajya ‘athātaḥ śūlapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ’ iti pratijñāṃ paṭhitvā vātamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ nigrahādityādinā pṛthageva śūlādhyāyaṃ paṭhanti; te ca pūrvaparipāṭīṃ tyajanti| apare vinā gulmenetyādikaṃ samastamapi asau śrutaṃ bhaṇitvā parityajanti| asmābhistu sarvamatānusāribhirjejjaṭābhiprāyeṇa paṭhitaḥ||76||-

lg.l: vāyuḥ prakupitaḥ koṣṭhe śūlaṃ sañjanayed bhṛśam |

ab.seg: śūlasya hetuṃ samprāptiṃ cāha- vātamūtrapurīṣāṇāmityādi| nigrahāt vegakāle'varodhāt| ajīrṇam āmavidagdhādibhedabhinnam| adhyaśanaṃ sājīrṇabhojanam| āyāsaḥ śarīrāyāsajanakaṃ karma| viruddhānnaṃ hitāhitīyoktam| virūḍhānāṃ vigatarohāṇāmaṅkuritānāṃ vā| evaṃvidhānāṃ doṣaprakopaṇānām| koṣṭhe sarvasminnudare| nirucchvāsaḥ niruddhocchvāsaḥ| tena śūlena| vātamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ nigrahādityādiranyeṣāṃ copasevanādityanto hetuḥ, vāyuḥ prakupita ityādiśca samprāptiḥ||77-80||

lg.l: śaṅkusphoṭanavat tasya `śaṅkvāsphoṭanavat' iti pā. yasmāt tīvrāś ca vedanāḥ |

ab.seg: tat kasmācchūlamucyata ityāha- śaṅkvityādi| śaṅkusphoṭanavat kīlakāhananavattīvrā vedanāḥ, tasya vyādhitasya, śūlāsaktasya śūlinaḥ; etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati- yathā kasyacit kīlakāhananena `kaṇṭakahananeneva' iti pā. tīvrā vedanā lakṣyate tadvattasya yasmādvedanā lakṣyate tasmācchūlamihocyate||81||
vātaśūlalakṣaṇamāha- nirāhārasyetyādi||82-83||

lg.l: tṛṣṇā dāho mado mūrcchā tīvraṃ śūlaṃ tathaiva ca |

div.ab: pittaśūlalakṣaṇamāha- tṛṣṇetyādi| śītābhikāmaḥ śītābhilāṣaḥ| praśāmyati ‘śūlaṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ||84||-

ab.seg: kaphaśūlalakṣaṇamāha- śūlenetyādi| hṛllāsaḥ thūtkaraṇam| nidarśanaṃ lakṣaṇam||85-86||

div.ab: sānnipātikaśūlalakṣaṇamāha- sarvāṇītyādi| nanu, kaiścit pūrvācāryairdoṣabhedena niyataṃ sthānaṃ śūlasyoktam| tathāhi- “vātātmakaṃ bastigataṃ vadanti, pittātmakaṃ cāpi vadanti nābhyām| hṛtpārśvakukṣau kaphasanniviṣṭaṃ, sarveṣu deśeṣu ca sannipātāt”- iti; tat kathamatra tathā noktam| satyaṃ, kupitadoṣāṇāṃ svāśaye parāśaye ca vyādhyutpādakatvānna niyataṃ sthānamasti, atastathā noktam||87||-

lg.l: āśukārī hi pavanas tasmāt taṃ tvarayā jayet ||88||

div.ab: cikitsāmityādi| nibodha jānīhi| me matsakāśāt| āśukārītyādi| āśukārī śīghramatyayakāritvāt| hi yasmāt| taṃ vātam| tasyetyādi|- tasya puruṣasya, śūlābhipannasya vātikaśūlakrāntasya; anye tu tasya vātasya yacchūlaṃ tena ākrāntasyetyāhuḥ||88||-

lg.l: pāyasaiḥ kṛśarāpiṇḍaiḥ snigdhair vā piśitair hitaḥ ||89||

ab.seg: sa ca svedaḥ kairdravyaiḥ kārya ityāha- pāyasairityādi| pāyaso dugdhasiddhāstaṇḍulāḥ| kṛśarāpiṇḍaiḥ tilataṇḍulamāṣakṛtayavāgūpiṇḍaiḥ| hita iti ‘sveda’ iti śeṣaḥ||89||

lg.l: trivṛcchākena vā snigdham uṣṇaṃ bhuñjīta bhojanam |
vaihaṅgāṃś ca rasān snigdhān jāṅgalān śūlapīḍitaḥ |

ab.seg: bhojanamāha- trivṛcchākenetyādi| snigdhādiguṇaṃ bhojanaṃ trivṛcchākena saha bhuñjīteti piṇḍārthaḥ| cirabilvāṅkurānityādi| aṅkurāḥ śuṅgāḥ| vaihaṅgāṃścetyādi| jāṅgalān vaihaṅgān, lāvādikṛtānityarthaḥ| bileśayāḥ śvāvicchallakādayaḥ||90-91||

lg.l: surā sauvīrakaṃ cukraṃ mastūdaśvit tathā dadhi |

ab.seg: surā sauvīrakamityādi| surā piṣṭabhavā| sauvīrakaṃ kāñjikabhedaḥ| cukraṃ śuktam| mastu dadhimastu| udaśvit ardhodakaṃ takram| tatheti yathālābhamityarthaḥ| kālalavaṇaśabdena yadyapi nirgandhasauvarcalamucyate, tathā'pyatra gandhavatsauvarcalaṃ grāhyaṃ, tantrāntaroktatvāt||92||
kulatthayūṣa ityādi| yuktaṃ mātrayopahitamamlaṃ dāḍimādikaṃ yatra sa yuktāmlaḥ| lāvakīyūṣasaṃskṛta iti lāvakena kṛto yūṣo lāvakīyūṣaḥ, tena saṃskṛtaḥ||93||

lg.l: surasām aśvamūtrīṃ `surasāmaśvakarṇaṃ ca' iti pā. ca sauvarcalayutān pibet ||94||
madyena vātajaṃ śūlaṃ kṣipram eva praśāmyati |95|

div.ab: viḍaṅgetyādi| śigruḥ viṭapaśākaṃ, śobhāñjanamapare| śyāmā aruṇamūlā trivṛt| surasā tulasī| aśvamūtrī śallakī||94||-

lg.l: tāni cūrṇāni payasā pibet kāmbalikena vā ||96||
sā vartir vātikaṃ śūlaṃ kṣipram eva vyapohati ||99||
guḍatailena vā līḍhā pītā madyena vā punaḥ |100|

div.ab: pṛthvīketyādi| pṛthvīkā hiṅgupatrikā| ajājī uttarāpathe jīrakaviśeṣaḥ| kāmbalikena dadhimastvamlasiddhayūṣeṇa| cukraṃ śuktam| sauvīrakaṃ virecanadravyavikalpakathitam| pakṣāntaramāha- athavetyādi| etāni pūrvoktāni cūrṇāni, bījapūrakarasena badarayūṣeṇa vā punaḥ punarbhāvitāni hiṅgūtkaṭāni śarkarayā saha mātuluṅgarasenaiva pibediti piṇḍārthaḥ| saha dāḍimasāreṇetyādi|- taireva cūrṇairdāḍimasāreṇa saha bhiṣagjitā vaidyena vartirvā kāryā| sā ca vartirguḍatailena līḍhā madyena vā pītā satī vātikaṃ śūlaṃ kṣiprameva hantītyarthaḥ||95-99||-

lg.l: uṣṇaiḥ kṣīrair yavāgūbhiḥ snigdhair māṃsarasais tathā |101|

div.ab: bubhukṣāprabhave ityādi| laghviti mātrayā svabhāvena ca| santarpaṇaṃ bhojanam| uṣṇairiti kṣīrādibhiḥ sambadhyate||100||-

lg.l: vāruṇīṃ ca pibej jantus tathā sampadyate sukhī ||102||

div.ab: vātetyādi| susaṃskṛtāḥ śuṇṭhīmaricādibhiḥ| pradeyā dātavyāḥ| ghṛtapūrā ghṛtapūpā ityarthaḥ| vāruṇī surā| tathā tena prakāreṇa| sukhī sampadyate sukhī bhavatītyarthaḥ| upasaṃhāramāha- etadvātasamutthasyetyādi||101-102||-

lg.l: atha pittasamutthasya kriyāṃ vakṣyāmy ataḥ param ||103||
sa sukhaṃ chardayitvā tu pītvā śītodakaṃ naraḥ |
śītalāni ca seveta sarvāṇy uṣṇāni varjayet ||104||

ab.seg: vātaśūlopakramamabhidhāyedānīṃ pittaśūlacikitsāmāha- athetyādi| atheti vākyālaṅkāre, vākyopakrame ityanye| tadeṣa cikitsitamāha- sa ityādi| sa pittaśūlī naraḥ, śītodakaṃ pītvā, sukhaṃ yathā bhavati tathā chardayitvā, śītalāni bhajeta, uṣṇāni sarvāṇi varjayediti piṇḍārthaḥ||103-104||
maṇirājatatāmrāṇītyādi| rājataṃ rūpyamayam| sarvaśa āmukhāt| asya pittaśūlinaḥ||105||

lg.l: guḍaḥ śālir yavāḥ kṣīraṃ sarpiḥpānaṃ virecanam |
pālāśaṃ dhānvanaṃ vā'pi pibed yūṣaṃ saśarkaram ||107||

ab.seg: guḍetyādi| pittaghnān rasān jāṅgalavarge yāni nirdiṣṭāni pittaharāṇi māṃsāni tatkṛtān rasānityarthaḥ| pittalānītyādi| pittalāni annapānādīni| pālāśaṃ yūṣaṃ māṃsādamāṃsarasamityarthaḥ| dhānvanaṃ jāṅgalamāṃsarasam||106-107||
parūṣakāṇītyādi| parūṣakāṇi parūṣakaphalāni| udakajāni padmāni||108||

lg.l: aśane bhuktamātre tu prakopaḥ ślaiṣmikasya ca |

ab.seg: ślaiṣmikaśūlacikitsāmāha- aśane ityādi| aśane bhojane| ślaiṣmikasya śleṣmaśūlasya| tatra śleṣmaśūle| pippalīvāriṇā pippalīyuktapānīyena, anye vāriśabdaṃ kvāthe vartayanti, apare pippalīśabdena madanaphalabījāni kathayanti||109||

lg.l: rūkṣaḥ svedaḥ prayojyaḥ syād anyāś coṣṇāḥ kriyā hitāḥ |

ab.seg: rūkṣaḥ svedaḥ prayojya ityādi|- rūkṣaḥ svedaḥ snigdharahitaḥ karīṣādikṛtaḥ| pippalīśṛṅgaveraprayogaścūrṇakalkakvāthādividhinā||110||

lg.l: citrakasya ca niryūhe `niryūhaṃ' iti pā. pibed yūṣaṃ sahārjakam ||111||

ab.seg: pāṭhāmityādi| pāṭhādīni dravyāṇi cūrṇitāni kalkitāni vā citrakasya niryūhe kvāthe pibedityeko yogaḥ| yūṣaṃ sahārjakamiti dvitīyo yogaḥ| yūṣaṃ śūlaharaśimbidhānyayūṣam| arjakaḥ kuṭherakaḥ||111||

lg.l: śālaparṇīṃ pṛśniparṇīṃ `śāliparṇī pṛṣṭhaparṇī' iti pā. bṛhatīṃ kaṇṭakārikām ||112||
dadyāc chṛgālavinnāṃ ca sahadevāṃ tathaiva ca |
prasahya nāśayec chūlaṃ chinnābhram iva mārutaḥ ||115||

ab.seg: eraṇḍadvādaśakamāha- eraṇḍetyādi| śṛgālavinnā pṛśniparṇībhedaḥ| mahāsahā māṣaparṇī| kṣudrasahā mudgaparṇī| ikṣurakaḥ kokilākṣakaḥ| sambhṛtya ekīkṛtya| eraṇḍādidravyasambhāraḥ catuḥṣaṣṭipalapramitaḥ; tulāpramita ityanye| prasahya balātkāreṇa| pibedityanenābhyavahāreṇātra sūcyate; tena tṛṣṇāyāṃ pānamācamanaṃ vā tena kāryam, anyathā droṇacaturthāṃśasya sādhitasya jalasyāparakvāthavat paladvayapāne vaiyarthyaṃ syāt| yadyapyayaṃ yogaḥ sarvaśūlaharastathāpyatyantakaphaśūlaharatvādatroktaḥ| kecit ‘mūlaṃ cekṣurakasya’ ityatra ‘dadyāccaivekṣuvālikām’ iti paṭhitvā khaggalīmiti vyākhyānayanti||112-115||

lg.l: pippalī svarjikākṣāro yavāś citraka eva ca |
sevyaṃ caitat samānīya bhasma kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ ||116||

div.ab: pippalītyādi| sevyam uśīraṃ, tat bhasma||116||-

lg.l: sa saṃruddhaḥ karoty āśu sādhmānaṃ `dhmānaṃ guḍaguḍāyanam' iti pā. guḍguḍāyanam |
sūcībhir iva nistodaṃ kṛcchrocchvāsī tadā naraḥ ||118||
nānnaṃ vāñchati no nidrām upaity artinipīḍitaḥ |

ab.seg: yadyapi catvāraḥ śūlāḥ, tathāpi doṣadhātumalasaṃsargādāyatanaviśeṣānnimittataścaiṣāṃ vikalpa iti kṛtvā pārśvādiśūlamāha- ruṇaddhītyādi| sa vāyuḥ| ādhmānam udarāpūraḥ| guḍguḍāyanamatra avyaktaśabdaḥ| no nidrāmupaiti na nidrāṃ prāpnotītyarthaḥ||117-119||

lg.l: saindhavaṃ tumburuṃ pathyāṃ cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā tu pāyayet ||120||
sarpiḥ plīhodaroktaṃ vā ghṛtaṃ vā hiṅgusaṃyutam ||121||
bhojayec cāpi payasā jāṅgalena rasena vā |123|

div.ab: pārśvaśūle cikitsitamāha- tatretyādi| puṣkaramūlādīni dravyāṇi cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā pārśvādiśūleṣu yavakvāthena saṃyutaṃ pāyayediti piṇḍārthaḥ| yadyapyayaṃ yogo'patantrake'pi paṭhitaḥ, tathā'pyatrāmlavetasābhāvāt punaḥ paṭhitaḥ| sarpiḥ plīhodaroktamityādi plīhodaroktaṃ sarpiḥ ṣaṭpalaṃ, hiṅgusaṃyutaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā asiddhameva| payasā kṣīreṇa, sādhitaṃ kvāthitaṃ, bījapūrakasāraṃ bījapūrakaphalabījam, atrāpi pāyayediti sambadhyate| kecit ‘bījapūrakasāraṃ ca’ ityatra ‘pibedbījakasāraṃ ca’ iti paṭhanti| eraṇḍatailamityādi|- eraṇḍatailaṃ vā madyādibhiryathāsātmyaṃ yathādoṣaṃ ca prātareva pibet, jīrṇe ca kṣīreṇa jāṅgalarasena vā bhojayet||120-122||-

lg.l: prakupyati yadā kukṣau vahnim ākramya mārutaḥ ||123||
tadā'sya bhojanaṃ bhuktaṃ sopastambhaṃ na pacyate |
naivāsane na śayane tiṣṭhan `tiṣṭhan sa' iti `tiṣṭhanna' iti ca pā. vā labhate sukham |

ab.seg: kukṣiśūlamāha- prakupyatītyādi| ākramya mandīkṛtya| sopastambhaṃ stabdhatānvitam| ucchvasiti ucchvāsaṃ karoti ‘puruṣa’ iti śeṣaḥ| āmaśakṛtā apakvapurīṣeṇa| tiṣṭhan ūrdhvībhavan||123-125||

lg.l: vamanaṃ kārayet tatra laṅghayed vā yathābalam |

ab.seg: kukṣiśūle cikitsāmāha- vamanaṃ kārayettatretyādi| tatra kukṣiśūle| yathābalaṃ balasyānatikrameṇa| saṃsargapācanaṃ peyādikramapācanam| amlaiḥ dāḍimatakrādibhiḥ| dīpanasaṃyutairiti pañcakolayutaiḥ||126||

lg.l: nāgaraṃ dīpyakaṃ cavyaṃ hiṅgu sauvarcalaṃ viḍam |
bṛhatyāḥ kaṇṭakāryāś ca kvāthaṃ śūlaharaṃ pibet |128|

div.ab: kvāthamāha- nāgaraṃ dīpyakamityādi| nāgarādikvāthaṃ hiṅgusaurvacalaviḍaprakṣepaṃ pibediti piṇḍārthaḥ| bījānītiśabdo mātuluṅgādibhiḥ kaṇṭakārīparyantaiḥ saha sambadhyate| śyāmā vṛddhadārakaḥ| urubūkaḥ raktairaṇḍaḥ, śuklairaṇḍamapare| bṛhatī aṇuphalā sthūlaphalā vā||127||-

lg.l: virecane `virecanaṃ' iti pā. prayuñjīta jñātvā doṣabalābalam ||129||

ab.seg: kukṣiśūle virecanamāha- vacetyādi| vacādīni kuṭajabījāntāni sadyaḥśūlaharāṇi virecane doṣabalābalaṃ jñātvā prayuñjīteti piṇḍārthaḥ| doṣabalābalamityatrādiśabdo lupto draṣṭavyaḥ, tena prakṛtyādīnapi jñātvetyarthaḥ||128-129||

div.ab: kiṃ kukṣiśūle virecanameva yujyate utānyadapītyāha- snehabastīnityādi|130|-

lg.l: avagāhāś ca śasyante yac cānyad api tad dhitam |131|

ab.seg: kukṣiśūle upanāhādisvedasya praśastatvamāha- upanāhā ityādi| upanāhāḥ sālvaṇāprakārāḥ| dhānyāmlaṃ kāñjikam| avagāho vātaharadravapūrṇadroṇyādinimajjanam| yaccānyadapītyādi| taddhitaṃ kukṣiśūlahitaṃ yadanyadapi bhavati tadasya śasyate ityarthaḥ||130||

lg.l: hṛdisthaḥ kurute śūlam ucchvāsārodhakaṃ `ucchvāsarodhakaṃ' iti pā. param |

ab.seg: hṛcchūlamāha- kaphetyādi| avaruddho ruddhaḥ| rasamūrcchito rasasaṃyutaḥ| ucchvāsārodhakaṃ ucchvāsasya āsamantādrodhakamityarthaḥ| etaddhṛcchūlaṃ yasmāddhṛdrogavilakṣaṇaṃ tasmāddhṛdrogādbhinnaṃ, tathā samprāptibhedācca||131-132||

div.ab: hṛcchūle hṛdrogoktāṃ kriyāmatidiśannāha- tatrāpi karmābhihitamityādi| yaddhṛdvikāriṇāṃ hṛdrogiṇāṃ karmoktaṃ tadatrāpi hṛcchūle'bhihitamiti piṇḍārthaḥ|133|-

lg.l: saṃrodhāt kupito vāyur bastim āvṛtya tiṣṭhati ||133||
viṇmūtravātasaṃrodhī bastiśūlaḥ sa mārutāt `sañjñitaḥ' iti pā.||134||

ab.seg: bastiśūlamāha- saṃrodhādityādi| saṃrodhāt mūtrapurīṣādīnāmityarthaḥ| bastiḥ mūtrādhāraḥ, vaṅkṣaṇaḥ gaṇḍakaḥ||133-134||

lg.l: mūtram āvṛtya gṛhṇāti mūtraśūlaḥ sa mārutāt `sañjñitaḥ' iti pā.||135||

ab.seg: mūtraśūlamāha- nābhyāmityādi| yadā meḍhrāntramardako vāyurāvṛtya avarudhya mūtraṃ gṛhṇāti ‘yadā meḍhrāntramardaka iti meḍhre mūtrāntraṃ meḍhrāntraṃ, tadgṛhṇāti yaḥ sarvathā evaṃvidho vāyurāvṛtya' iti pā., tadā nābhyādiṣu śūlo jāyate| sa ca mārutāt mūtraśūlo jñeyaḥ||135||

lg.l: malaṃ ruṇaddhi koṣṭhasthaṃ mandīkṛtya tu pāvakam ||136||
śūlaṃ sañjanayaṃs tīvraṃ srotāṃsy āvṛtya tasya hi |
dakṣiṇaṃ yadi vā vāmaṃ kukṣim ādāya jāyate ||137||
sarvatra vardhate kṣipraṃ bhramann atha `śūlaṃ tatra saghoṣavat' iti pā. saghoṣavān |
pipāsā vardhate tīvrā bhramo mūrcchā ca jāyate ||138||
uccārito mūtritaś ca na śāntim adhigacchati |

ab.seg: purīṣaśūlamāha- vāyurityādi| evambhūtasya dehino vahniṃ mandīkṛtya srotāṃsi cāvṛtya prakupito vāyustīvraṃ śūlaṃ sañjanayan koṣṭhasthaṃ malaṃ ruṇaddhi, tasya ca dakṣiṇaṃ vāmaṃ vā kukṣiṃ gṛhītvā śūlāya `śūlo jāyate' iti pā. jāyate, sa ca sarvatra bhraman ghoṣavān śabdayukto vardhate iti piṇḍārthaḥ| uccāritaḥ sañjātapurīṣavegaḥ| nādhigacchati na prāpnoti| paramadāruṇam atiśayakaṣṭakāri||136-139||

lg.l: kṣipraṃ doṣaharaṃ kāryaṃ bhiṣajā sādhu jānatā |

ab.seg: idānīṃ bastiśūladīnāṃ sāmānyacikitsāmāha- kṣipramityādi| doṣaharaṃ śodhanam| sādhu śobhanam| śamanaṃ saṃśamanam||140-141||

lg.l: atimātraṃ yadā bhuktaṃ pāvake mṛdutāṃ gate |
sthirībhūtaṃ tu tat koṣṭhe vāyur āvṛtya tiṣṭhati ||142||
avipākagataṃ hy annaṃ śūlaṃ tīvraṃ karoty ati |

ab.seg: atimātramityādi| avipākagatam avipākaṃ prāptam||142-144||

lg.l: kṣārāś cūrṇāni `kṣāracūrṇāni' iti pā. guṭikāḥ śasyante śūlanāśanāḥ ||145||

ab.seg: tasya cikitsitamāha- vamanamityādi||145||
idanīmupasaṃhāramāha- gulmāvasthā ityādi| yathāvat yathāvastham||146||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre gulmapratiṣedho nāma (caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) dvicatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||42||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāmuttaratantre kāyacikitsāyāṃ gulmapratiṣedho nāma dvicatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||42||

div.head: hṛdrogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto hṛdrogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
gulmapratiṣedhānantaraṃ sthānasāmīpyānnāmasaṅkīrtanādvā hṛdrogapratiṣedho yukta ityata āha- athāta ityādi||1-2||

lg.l: dūṣayitvā rasaṃ doṣā viguṇā hṛdayaṃ gatāḥ |
kurvanti hṛdaye bādhāṃ hṛdrogaṃ taṃ pracakṣate ||4||

ab.seg: idānīṃ pratijñānantaraṃ pūrvavaddhṛdrogasya hetusamprāptī āha- vegetyādi| etairvegāghātādihetubhirviguṇāḥ kupitā doṣā hṛdayaṃ gatvā rasaṃ dūṣayitvā hṛdaye bādhāṃ kurvanti, taṃ hṛdrogaṃ pracakṣate ācāryā iti sambandhaḥ| vegāghāta ityatra āghātaśabdo dvirāvartayitavyaḥ, tena vegāghāta āghātaśca; tatra vegāghāto vegāvarodhaḥ, āghāto laguḍādiprahāraḥ| viruddhaṃ hitāhitīyoktam, adhyaśanaṃ sājīrṇabhojanam, ajīrṇam āmavidagdhādikam| bādhāgrahaṇaṃ bādhāvaicitryajñāpanārtham| vegāghātādirasātmyabhojanānto hetuḥ, dūṣayitvetyādikā samprāptiḥ| hṛdroge pūrvarūpānabhidhānamavyaktalakṣaṇānāmeva pūrvarūpatvenābhimatatvāt; anye jātimātraparicchedāt pūrvarūpāvagamaḥ||3-4||

lg.l: caturvidhaḥ sa doṣaiḥ syāt kṛmibhiś ca `pañcamaḥ krimibhistathā| pṛthagliṅgaṃ pravakṣyāmi' iti pā. pṛthak pṛthak |

ab.seg: tasya saṅkhyāmāha- caturvidha ityādi| sa hṛdrogaḥ| doṣaiḥ ekaikaiḥ sannipatitaiśca, kṛmibhiriti kṛmibhiḥ sahetyarthaḥ| nanu, tantrāntare pañca hṛdrogāḥ paṭhitāḥ, tat kathamatra catvāraḥ? satyaṃ, tridoṣahṛdrogottarāvasthaiva kṛmihṛdrogaḥ, tena na pañca hṛdrogāḥ| pṛthak pṛthagityādi| anantaraṃ lakṣaṇānantaramityarthaḥ||5||

lg.l: āyamyate mārutaje hṛdayaṃ tudyate pīḍyate' iti pā. tathā |
nirmathyate dīryate ca sphoṭyate pāṭyate 'pi ca ||6||

ab.seg: vātikahṛdrogalakṣaṇamāha- āyamyata ityādi| āyamyate dīrghīkriyata iva, mārutaje hṛdroge, tudyate pratodena vyathyata iva, nirmathyate viloḍyata iva, dīryate ārayeva, pāṭyate dvidhā kriyata iva||6||

lg.l: dhūmāyanaṃ mūrcchā ca svedaḥ śoṣo mukhasya ca ||7||

ab.seg: paittikahṛdrogalakṣaṇamāha- tṛṣṇetyādi| ūṣā prādeśiko dāhaḥ| coṣaḥ cūṣyata iva vedanāviśeṣaḥ| paittike pittaje hṛdroge| dhūmāyanaṃ dhūmodvamanamiva||7||
ślaiṣmikahṛdrogalakṣaṇamāha- gauravamityādi| stambho jaḍimā| balāsāvatate śleṣmacchanne||8||

lg.l: utkleśaḥ ṣṭhīvanaṃ todaḥ śūlo hṛllāsakas tamaḥ |
aruciḥ śyāvanetratvaṃ śoṣaś ca kṛmije bhavet ||9||

ab.seg: tridoṣajahṛdrogalakṣaṇamāha- utkleśa ityādi| ṣṭhīvanaṃ thūtkaraṇam| hṛllāso lālāsrutiḥ| tamaḥ andhakāradarśanaṃ śvāso vā| tama ityatra ‘sānnipātike bhavet’ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ| tatra todaśūlau vātena, utkleśahṛllāsaṣṭhīvanāni śleṣmaṇā, tamaḥ pitteneti| kecit ‘aruciḥ śyāvanetratvaṃ śoṣaśca kṛmije bhavet’ ityantaṃ sānnipātikahṛdrogalakṣaṇaṃ manyante| tridoṣajahṛdrogasyaivāpacārāt krimīn prāptasya lakṣaṇamāha- arucirityādi| kṛmije iti tridoṣajahṛdroga evāpacāreṇottarāvasthāyāṃ kṛminipātāt kṛmija ityucyate| tathā ca tantrāntaram- “tridoṣaje tu hṛdroge yo durātmā niṣevate| tilakṣīraguḍādīni granthistasyopajāyate|| marmaikadeśe saṅkledaṃ rasaścāpyupagacchati| saṅkledāt kṛmayaścāsya bhavantyupahatātmanaḥ”- iti, ato na saṅkhyātirekaḥ| kecit sānnipātiko hṛdrogo vyādhisvabhāvānna bhavatyevetyāhuḥ; tanna, samānatantre tridoṣajadarśanāt||9||

div.ab: vātādijānāṃ kṛmihīnānāṃ hṛdrogiṇāmupadravānāha- bhrametyādi| bhramaḥ cakrārūḍhasyeva bhramaṇaṃ, klamaḥ anāyāsaḥ śramaḥ| sādaḥ aṅgasādaḥ| śoṣo mukhasya dhātūnāṃ ca| yadyapi bhramādayo vātapittātmakāstathā'pi vyādhisvabhāvācchlaiṣmike'pi bhavanti|10|-

lg.l: kṛmije kṛmijātīnāṃ ślaiṣmikāṇāṃ ca ye matāḥ ||10||

ab.seg: kṛmijasyopadravānāha- kṛmije kṛmijātīnāmityādi| ślaiṣmikāṇāmiti kṛmijātīnāmityasya viśeṣaṇam| tena ślaiṣmikāṇāṃ kṛmijātīnāṃ ya eva upadravāsta eva kṛmije hṛdroge matā ityarthaḥ||10||

lg.l: sauvarcalam atho śuṇṭhīm ajamodāṃ ca cūrṇitam ||12||

ab.seg: idānīṃ vātahṛdrogacikitsāmāha- vātopasṛṣṭe ityādi| vātopasṛṣṭe hṛdaye vātahṛdroge ityarthaḥ| yadyapi vāte vamanaṃ na śastaṃ, tathā'pi vātasya kaphasthānagaṇatvādatra vamanaṃ śastameva, tathā pittaje'pi| vamanānantaraṃ yat kāryaṃ tadāha- pippalītyādi| yavabhasma yavakṣāraḥ| phalāni mātuluṅgādiphalāni, teṣāṃ raso'bhipretaḥ| madyāsavau madyavargoktau| snehenānyatamena vā catuḥsnehamadhye ekena snehenetyarthaḥ||11-13||

lg.l: vātaghnasiddhaṃ tailaṃ ca dadyād bastiṃ pramāṇataḥ ||14||

ab.seg: vātahṛdroge pathyamāha- bhojayedityādi| kiṃ vātahṛdroge etadeva kāryamutānyadapītyāha- vātaghnasiddhamityādi| vātaghnasiddhaṃ bhadradārvādipakvam| pramāṇataḥ yathāpramāṇam||14||

div.ab: pittahṛdroge vamanamāha- śrīparṇītyādi| śrīparṇī kāśmarī, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu, sitā śarkarā, utpalaṃ kuṣṭham| atra jalaśabdo na kvāthatvena sarvatra sambandhanīyaḥ, kṣaudrādīnāṃ kvāthe'nupayogāt| seveta madhurairityādi| madhuraiḥ śṛtaṃ kākolyādibhiḥ pakvam| pittajvaravināśanān kaṣāyān ‘candanośīraśrīparṇī’- ityādinoktān||15||-

lg.l: tṛptasya ca rasair mukhyair madhuraiḥ `jāṅgalaiḥ' iti pā. saghṛtair bhiṣak ||16||
sakṣaudraṃ vitared bastau `vitaredbasti' iti pā. tailaṃ madhukasādhitam |17|

div.ab: pittahṛdroge snehabastimāha- tṛptasyetyādi| rasairmukhyaiḥ eṇādimāṃsarasaiḥ| madhuraiḥ amlādisaṃskṛtaiḥ| madhukasādhitamekenaiva yaṣṭīmadhukena pakvaṃ; anye jīvanīyasādhitamāhuḥ||16||-

lg.l: cūrṇaṃ tu pāyayetoktaṃ vātaje bhojayec ca bhojayeddhṛtam' iti pā. tam |
phalādim atha mustādiṃ triphalāṃ vā piben naraḥ ||18||
balātailair vidadhyāc ca `balatailaṃ vidadhyāt' iti pā. bastiṃ bastiviśāradaḥ ||19||

ab.seg: ślaiṣmikahṛdroge cikitsāmāha- vacetyādi| śleṣmahṛdroge vacānimbakaṣāyābhyāṃ vāntaṃ vātaje hṛdroge uktaṃ ‘cūrṇaṃ pippalyelā’- ityādikaṃ pāyayediti piṇḍārthaḥ| na kevalaṃ taccūrṇaṃ pāyayet bhojayecca tamiti taṃ vātaje hṛdroge uktaṃ cūrṇaṃ bhojayecca bhaktena saha khādedityarthaḥ| phalādimatha mustādimityādi|- phalādiḥ madanaphalādiḥ saṃśodhanasaṃśamanīyoktaḥ| mustādiḥ dravyasaṅgrahaṇīyoktaḥ| śyāmātrivṛtkalkayutamityādi|- śyāmā vṛddhadārakaḥ| atra pibediti sambadhyate| balātailairityādi| vātādicikitsitaṃ sarvamevānuktamapi tridoṣaje kāryam||17-19||

lg.l: dadhnā ca palalopetaṃ tryahaṃ, paścād virecayet ||20||
hṛdayasthāḥ patanty evam adhastāt krimayo nṛṇām |
yavānnaṃ vitarec cāsya saviḍaṅgam ataḥ param ||22||

ab.seg: kṛmihṛdrogacikitsāmāha- kṛmihṛdrogiṇamityādi| piśitaudanaṃ sapalalaṃ dadhnā saha krimihṛdrogiṇaṃ tryahaṃ bhojayet kṛmīṇāmutkleśanārthaṃ; piśitaṃ māṃsaṃ, palalopetaṃ bhṛṣṭatilacūrṇayuktam| krimyutkleśānantaraṃ kiṃ kuryādityāha- paścādityādi| sugandhibhiryogaiḥ virecanakalpoktaiḥ ‘śarkarākṣaudrasaṃyuktaṃ’ ityādibhiḥ| salavaṇairyogairiti ‘samāstrivṛnnāgarakābhayāḥ syuḥ’ ityādibhiḥ| sājājiśarkarairiti sugandhiyogasalavaṇayogaviśeṣaṇaṃ, sājājikānāṃ vairecanikānāmanirdeśāt; tena, ajājiśarkarāsahitaiḥ sugandhibhiryogairathavā salavaṇairapyajādiyuktairvirecayet| pītavirekasyānupānamāha- viḍaṅgagāḍhamityādi| viḍaṅgagāḍhaṃ viḍaṅgotkaṭam| dhānyāmlaṃ kāñjikam| evaṃ pūrvoktena vidhānena| kecit ‘salavaṇaiḥ’ ityatra ‘sapalalaiḥ’ iti paṭhitvā sabhṛṣṭatilakalkaiḥ sugandhibhiryogairvirecayediti vyākhyānayanti| kṛmihṛdroge vamanaṃ na yojyaṃ, kṛmijarjarahṛdayatvāt; ata eva sugandhiyogairvirecanamuktaṃ, vamanaśaṅkābhayāt| dhānyāmlapānādanantaraṃ `virecanādanantaraṃ' iti pā. kiṃ kuryādityāha- yavānnaṃ vitaredityādi| vitaret dadyāt| ata iti virekāt||20-22||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre hṛdrogapratiṣedho nāma (pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) tricatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||43||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre hṛdrogapratiṣedho nāma tricatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||43||

div.head: pāṇḍurogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ pāṇḍurogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

hṛdrogapratiṣedhānantaraṃ saṅkhyāsāmyāt tīkṣṇāmlakaṭukādihṛdrogacikitsitasya hetutvāt pāṇḍurogapratiṣedhārambho yukta ityāha- athāta ityādi| atrādiśabdadvayaṃ luptaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ, tena pāṇḍvādirogādipratiṣedhamiti| tatra prathamenādiśabdena kṛṣṇapītamiśrā varṇā grāhyāḥ, kāmalādayo dvitīyena; apare tu pāṇḍuvarṇādhikyāt sarve eva pāṇḍurogāḥ procyanta iti matvā ekamevādiśabdaṃ luptaṃ varṇayanti; te ca ādiśabdāt kāmalādīn gṛhṇanti| apare tvādiśabdaṃ vinā'pi kāmalādīn gṛhṇanti, pāṇḍurogāntarbhāvātteṣāmiti||1-2||

lg.l: vyavāyam amlaṃ lavaṇāni madyaṃ mṛdaṃ divāsvapnam atīva tīkṣṇam |
niṣevamāṇasya vidūṣya raktaṃ kurvanti doṣās tvaci pāṇḍubhāvam ||3||

ab.seg: pāṇḍurogasya hetusamprāptī āha- vyavāyamamlamityādi| vyavāyādīni niṣevamāṇasya puruṣasya duṣṭā doṣā raktaṃ vidūṣya tvaci pāṇḍubhāvaṃ kurvantīti piṇḍārthaḥ| vyavāyaḥ strīsevā, sa ca sarvadoṣaprakopakaḥ, anye tu vātapittaprakopakatvaṃ vyavāyasya manyante bhāraharaṇādau krodhādau ca tatpāṭhāt| amlalavaṇayoḥ pittakaphakaratvam| mṛttikā sarvadoṣaprakopaṇī, nānāvidhatvāt; tathā coktam,- “kaṣāyā mārutaṃ, pittamūṣarā, madhurā kapham| kopayenmṛdrasādīṃśca raukṣyādbhuktaṃ virūkṣayet”- iti| divāsvapnaḥ tridoṣaprakopakaḥ| tīkṣṇaṃ pittakopi| evaṃ yathāsvaṃ yathāsambhavaṃ heturuktaḥ| vidūṣya raktamityādikā samprāptiḥ| atīva tīkṣṇamityatra ādiśabdo lupto draṣṭavyaḥ; tena piṣṭapayomāṣatilādīnāṃ grahaṇam| kecit ‘mṛnmadyamatsyāmiṣatīkṣṇapiṣṭapayodivāsvapnatilekṣumāṣān| niṣevamāṇasya’- iti paṭhanti, śeṣaṃ samam| te'pi luptādiśabdāt vyavāyādīni gṛhṇanti| apare ‘atīva tīkṣṇam’ ityatra ‘atīvarūkṣam’ iti paṭhanti||3||

lg.l: pāṇḍvāmayo 'ṣṭārdhavidhaḥ pradiṣṭaḥ pṛthak samastair yugapac ca doṣaiḥ |4|

div.ab: saṅkhyāmāha- pāṇḍvityādi| aṣṭārdhavidhiḥ caturvidhaḥ; kathaṃ caturvidha ityāha- pṛthagityādi| pṛthagdoṣaiḥ trayaḥ, samastaiḥ ekaḥ| yugapaditi padaṃ doṣatrayasyaikakālaprakopasūcanārtham| yadyapi tantrāntare mṛjjaḥ pāṇḍurogaḥ pañcamaḥ kathitaḥ, tathā'pyatra mṛjjastridoṣaja evāntarbhūtaḥ, vakṣyamāṇāśca kāmalādayaḥ pāṇḍurogasyaiva paryāyāḥ; ato'tra catvāra eva| kecit pāṇḍvāmayastvaṣṭavidha iti paṭhanti| tanmate pṛthagdoṣaiḥ trayaḥ, samastaiḥ ekaḥ, mṛdbhakṣaṇāt ekaḥ, dve kāmale ca, eko halīmakaḥ, evaṃ pāṇḍurogo'ṣṭavidhaḥ| tathā ca tantrāntaram- “vātena pittena kaphena cāpi tridoṣamṛdbhakṣaṇasambhavaḥ syāt| dve kāmale caikahalīmakaśca sa cāṣṭadhaivaṃ tviha pāṇḍurogaḥ”- iti|4|-

lg.l: sarveṣu caiteṣv iha pāṇḍubhāvo yato 'dhiko 'taḥ khalu pāṇḍurogaḥ ||4||

ab.seg: yadyapi vātādibhedena kṛṣṇādivarṇatvamabhidhāsyati, tathā'pyasya vikārasya pāṇḍuvarṇādhikyāt pāṇḍurogavyapadeśa iti darśayannāha- sarveṣu caiteṣviha pāṇḍubhāva ityādi||4||

idānīṃ pāṇḍurogapūrvarūpāṇyāha- tvagityādi| tvaksphoṭaḥ tvacāṃ sphuṭanam| ṣṭhīvanaṃ thūtkaraṇam| yadyapyatra mṛdbhakṣaṇaṃ kathitaṃ, tathā'pi mṛdbhakṣaṇe icchā gamyate| prekṣaṇam akṣi| avipāka āhārasya| puraḥsarāṇi agresarāṇi||5||

lg.l: vibhāṣyate lakṣaṇam asya kṛtsnaṃ nibodha vakṣyāmy anupūrvaśas tat `tam' iti pā.| `atra kāmaleti kāmaśabdo'yaṃ sādhāraṇaśabdaviśeṣātsvalpe bhaktādyabhilāṣe pravartate, taṃ lātīti kāmalā| duṣṭatvena kutsito'pāno'pānakaḥ, so'syāstīti apānakī, kāmalakākhyo'pānakipāṇḍurogaḥ kāmalāpānakipāṇḍurogaḥ| kumbhakāmalakākhyo'pānakipāṇḍurogastvatra kumbhāhvaya ucyate, bhīmo bhīmasena itivat| rogasyāsya kumbhakāmaleti sañjñā tantrāntare upadiśyate| sa eva punarjvarādibhirlāghavaṃ karoti, satyapi sāmarthyo karmasvanutsāhaṃ ca janayatītyalasākhyo'pānakipāṇḍurogastu lāghavaka ucyate’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ||6||

ab.seg: tasyaiva pāṇḍurogasya paryāyānāha- sa ityādi| sa rogaḥ kāmalādikābhiḥ sañjñābhirvibhāṣyate vividhaṃ bhāṣyate| asyeti kāmalādiparyāyairnirdiṣṭasya rogasya| anupūrvaśaḥ pūrvaṃ pūrvamanupūrveṇetyarthaḥ| taṃ pāṇḍurogam||6||

lg.l: vātena pāṇḍuṃ manujaṃ vyavasyed yuktaṃ tathā'nyais tadupadravaiś ca ||7||

ab.seg: vātikapāṇḍurogalakṣaṇamāha- kṛṣṇekṣaṇamityādi| kṛṣṇekṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇākṣikam| tadvarṇaviṇmūtranakhānanaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaviṇmūtranakhamityarthaḥ| tadupadravaiḥ vātopadravaiḥ||7||

lg.l: pittena pāṇḍuṃ manujaṃ vyavasyed yuktaṃ tathā'nyais tadupadravaiś ca ||8||

ab.seg: paittikapāṇḍurogalakṣaṇamāha- pītetyādi| tadvarṇaṃ pītavarṇam| tadupadravaiḥ pittopadravairityarthaḥ||8||

lg.l: kaphena pāṇḍuṃ manujaṃ vyavasyed yuktaṃ tathā'nyais tadupadravaiś ca ||9||

ab.seg: ślaiṣmikapāṇḍurogalakṣaṇamāha- śukletyādi| tadvarṇaṃ śuklavarṇaṃ, tadupadravaiḥ kaphopadravaiḥ||9||

div.ab: sānnipātikapāṇḍurogalakṣaṇamāha- sarvātmake sarvamidamityādi| sarvātmake sānnipātike pāṇḍuroge, sarvaṃ samastam, idaṃ vātādija pāṇḍurogalakṣaṇaṃ, vyavasyet jānīyāt|10|-

lg.l: yo hy āmayānte sahasā'nnam amlam adyād apathyāni ca tasya pittam ||10||
karoti pāṇḍuṃ vadanaṃ viśeṣāt pūrveritau `tandrāvilatvaṃ prathamoditāṃśca' iti pā. tandribalakṣayau ca |11|

div.ab: idānīṃ pāṇḍurogaparyāyabhūtāyā api kāmalāyā lakṣaṇamāha- vakṣyāmītyādi| nanu, yadi pāṇḍurogasya paryāyaḥ kāmalā, tat kathaṃ tasya lakṣaṇānyuktāni? satyaṃ, yathā pāṇḍurogāṇāṃ vātādijānāṃ pratisvaṃ bhedo vidyate tathā'syāpīti na doṣaḥ; etena kāmalādīnāṃ sañjñānāṃ viśiṣṭāvasthāviṣayatvādviśiṣṭatvaṃ, paryāyatvaṃ pāṇḍurogatvāparityāgāt| tānyeva liṅgānyāha- ya ityādi| ‘vakṣyāmi liṅgānyatha kāmalāyā’ ityabhidhāya kāmalākāraṇavacanaṃ bhaviṣyantyā api tasyāḥ parijñānārtham| āmayānte pāṇḍurogānte anyarogānte ca| sahasā śīghram| annamamlam amlabhojanam| pāṇḍumityatra dehamiti śeṣaḥ| ‘pūrveritau tandribalakṣayau ca’ iti śārīrasthāne garbhavyākaraṇādhyāye tandrā kathitā, sūtrasthāne doṣādikṣayavṛddhyadhyāye balakṣaya ityarthaḥ| nanu, tandrāśabdasya vyutpāditatvāt kathaṃ tandribalakṣayāviti? satyaṃ, kṛṣyāderākṛtigaṇatvenekpratyayāntatvena sādhu| anye ‘tandrā'balatvaṃ prathamoditaṃ ca’ iti paṭhanti; tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ| apare 'prathamoditāṃśca' iti paṭhanti; te ca pāṇḍurogoktaliṅgaviśeṣān gṛhṇanti| ‘pāṇḍuvadanam’ ityatra ‘pītavadanam’ iti kecit paṭhanti, taṃ cānārṣaṃ ṭīkākārā bhāṣante||10||-

lg.l: bhedas tu tasyāḥ khalu kumbhasāhvaḥ śopho mahāṃs tatra ca parvabhedaḥ ||11||

ab.seg: idānīṃ kāmalābhedamāha- bheda ityādi| tatreti kumbhasāhve| parvabhedaḥ sandhipīḍā| kumbhasāhvaḥ tantrāntare kumbhakāmaleti kathyate||11||

div.ab: tasyaiva kumbhasāhvasyāvasthāyāṃ sañjñāntaramāha- jvarāṅgamardetyādi| sa eva kumbhasāhvo jvarādiyukto lāgharako'lasākhyaḥ syāditi piṇḍārthaḥ| lāgharakaḥ kathyate alasakaśca kathyata ityarthaḥ| aṅgamardo vedanāviśeṣaḥ, sphuṭaniketyapare| anye pāṇḍuroga eva jvarādiyuktaḥ kumbhasāhvaḥ kathyata iti manyante| asyaiva avasthābhedaṃ `avasthāviśeṣaḥ pānakīti' iti pā. pānakīti tantrāntarīyāḥ paṭhanti| tadyathā- “santāpo bhinnavarcastvaṃ bahirantaśca pītatā| pāṇḍutā netrarogaśca pānakīlakṣaṇaṃ vadet”- iti|12|-

lg.l: taṃ vātapittād dharipītanīlaṃ `vāta pittābhiparītaliṅga' iti pā. halīmakaṃ nāma vadanti tajjñāḥ ||12||

ab.seg: idānīṃ halīmakalakṣaṇamāha- tamityādi| taṃ pāṇḍurogam| kumbhasāhvo yadā haritapītanīlaḥ syāt, tadā tajjñāḥ kāyacikitsāvido halīmakaṃ nāma vadanti| hari haritaṃ, nīlaṃ śyāvam| kecittu ‘taṃ vātapittābhiparītaliṅgaṃ’ iti paṭhitvā vātapittābhyāmabhiparītaṃ sambaddhaṃ liṅgaṃ yasya tatheti vyākhyānayanti||12||

lg.l: upadravās teṣv aruciḥ pipāsā chardir jvaro mūrdharujā'gnisādaḥ |
śophas tathā kaṇṭhagato 'balatvaṃ mūrcchā klamo hṛdyavapīḍanaṃ ca ||13||

ab.seg: idānīṃ pāṇḍurogopadravānāha- upadravā ityādi| teṣu pāṇḍurogeṣu| mūrdharujā śirovyathā| abalatvaṃ nirbalatvam| sopadravasya pāṇḍurogasya kṛcchrasādhyatvamasādhyatvaṃ ca yathāvasthaṃ boddhavyam||13||

lg.l: sādhyaṃ tu pāṇḍvāmayinaṃ samīkṣya snigdhaṃ ghṛtenordhvam adhaś ca śuddham |
pibed ghṛtaṃ vā rajanīvipakvaṃ yattraiphalaṃ tailvakam eva vā'pi |
virecanadravyakṛtaṃ pibed vā yogāṃś ca vairecanikān ghṛtena ||15||
