ab.seg: idānīṃ cikitsitamāha- sādhyamityādi| sādhyapāṇḍurogajñānaṃ vakṣyamāṇāsādhyalakṣaṇaviparyayādariṣṭalakṣaṇavaiparītyācca| ghṛteneti kaṭvarakalyāṇakadādhikamahātiktapañcagavyādinā, anye kevalenaiva gavyaghṛtenetyāhuḥ| yadatra pāṇḍurogeṣu ghṛtenaiva snehanamuktaṃ tatteṣāṃ pittabhūyiṣṭhatvādraktadūṣyatvācca| yadyapi pāṇḍuroge ūrdhvaśodhanaṃ niṣiddhaṃ, tathā'pi ṛtudeśaprakṛtikālaśarīrāpekṣayā mṛdu vamanaṃ deyam| tathā ca tantrāntaram,- “kālaṃ ca deśaprakṛtī śarīraṃ samīkṣya dadyādvamanaṃ vidhijñaḥ| vāntasya tīkṣṇānyanulomanāni kalpopadiṣṭāni bhiṣagvidadhyāt”- iti| vamanānantaraṃ vakṣyamāṇaiḥ śāliprabhṛtibhiḥ kṛtasaṃsarjanakramasya doṣaśamanārthamāha- sampādayedityādi| śuddhaṃ pāṇḍurogiṇamevambhūtaiḥ prayogairvakṣyamāṇayogaiḥ śeṣadoṣaśamanārthaṃ sampādayet samyak yojayedityarthaḥ| nanu, sarpirmadhuharītakīyuktamekamevāyorajoyogamabhidhāsyati, tat kathaṃ prayogairiti bahuvacanaṃ? satyaṃ, pradeśāntaroktānāṃ navāyasaprabhṛtīnāmatra śastatvāt| pibedghṛtaṃ vetyādi| rajanīvipakvaṃ haridrākalkasādhitam|traiphalaṃ triphalāsādhitam| tailvakamiti tilvakaḥ paṭṭikārodhraḥ, tena sādhitamityarthaḥ; anye tailvakaṃ vātavyādhyuktamāhuḥ| virecanadravyakṛtamityādi|- trivṛdādisaṃskṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ; vairecanikān yogān virecanadravyavikalpoktān, tāṃśca ghṛtena pibet||14-15||

lg.l: mūtre nikumbhārdhapalaṃ vipācya pibed abhīkṣṇaṃ kuḍavārdhamātram |
khāded guḍaṃ vā'py abhayāvipakvam āragvadhādikvathitaṃ `abhayāvimiśraṃ' iti pā. pibed vā ||16||

ab.seg: idānīṃ pāṇḍuroge'parāṇyapi virecanānyāha- mūtre ityādi| nikumbhā dantī, tasyā ardhapalaṃ mahiṣīmūtre ṣoḍaśaguṇe vipācya, caturbhāgāvaśiṣṭaṃ kuḍavārdhamātraṃ paladvayamātraṃ, virekāya pibedityarthaḥ| guḍa ikṣuvikṛtiḥ| abhayāvipakvaṃ harītakīkvāthavipakvaṃ, anye abhayāvipakvaṃ guḍakaṃ saharītakīprabhṛtikamāhuḥ| apare ‘abhayāvimiśram’ iti paṭhanti| muhurvairecanikayoganirdeśāt `bahuvirekayoganirdeśāt' iti pā. pāṇḍuroge virecanasyātyantahitatvaṃ jñeyam||16||

lg.l: sarpir madhubhyāṃ vidadhīta vā'pi śāstrapradeśābhihitāṃś ca yogān ||17||

ab.seg: kiṃ pāṇḍuroge pūrvoktameva kāryamutānyadapītyāha- aya ityādi| ayorajovyoṣaviḍaṅgacūrṇamityeko yogaḥ| haridrāṃ triphalānvitāmiti dvitīyo yogaḥ| ayorajo lohacūrṇam| vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukam| ‘lihyāt’ ityātra ‘madhusarpirbhyām’ iti sambandhanīyam| haridrāṃ piṇḍaharidrām| kecit haridrāśabdena ādau dāruśabdalopāt dāruharidrāṃ gṛhṇanti| vidadhīta vā'pītyādi| vidadhīta kurvīta| śāstrapradeśābhihitāṃśca yogān śāstre'nyapradeśoktān navāyasādīn||17||

lg.l: harec ca doṣān bahuśo 'lpamātrān śvayed dhi doṣeṣv atinirhṛteṣu |18|

div.ab: idānīṃ pāṇḍuroge yat śodhanamuktaṃ tadalpamātrayā kartavyamityāha- harecca doṣānityādi| bahuśo bahūn vārān| alpamātrān stokastokān| kasmāt stokān stokān haredityāha- śvayeddhi doṣeṣvityādi| śvayet śvayathuṃ prāpnuyāt| hi yasmādarthe| atra pāṭhāntaraṃ- ‘harecca doṣān bahuśo'lpamātrān śuddheṣu doṣeṣvabhinirhṛteṣu’ iti| śuddheṣu duṣṭirahiteṣu; abhinirhṛteṣvityabhiśabdaḥ samyagarthaḥ, atiyogasyāniṣṭatvāt|18|-

lg.l: dhātrīphalānāṃ rasamikṣujaṃ ca manthaṃ pibet kṣaudrayutaṃ hitāśī ||18||

ab.seg: dhātrīphalānāmityādi| dhātrīphalānāmāmalakaphalānāṃ svarasaṃ kṣaudrayutaṃ pibedityeko yogaḥ| ikṣujaṃ rasaṃ kṣaudrayutamiti dvitīyaḥ| manthamiti “śaktavaḥ sarpiṣā'bhyaktāḥ śītavāripariplutāḥ”- ityādyuktalakṣaṇaṃ kṣaudrayutamiti tṛtīyaḥ| tathā ca tantrāntaram- “pibet suśītalān manthān ghṛtāktān madhusaṃyutān| sakṣaudraṃ vā rasaṃ dhātryā ikṣorvā'pi hitāśanaḥ”- iti| tantrāntare pāṇḍuroge manthaśabdena viśiṣṭo mantha ucyate| tadyathā- “dhātrīphalarase śaktūnikṣūṇāṃ ca rase tathā| pāṇḍurmadhusamāyuktaṃ pibenmanthaṃ suśītalam”- iti||18||

lg.l: ubhe bṛhatyau rajanīṃ śukākhyāṃ kākādanīṃ cāpi sakākamācīm |
ādāribimbīṃ sakadambapuṣpīṃ vipācya sarpir vipacet kaṣāye ||19||
tat pāṇḍutāṃ hanty upayujyamānaṃ kṣīreṇa vā māgadhikā yathāgni |20|

div.ab: ume ityādi| śukākhyā carmakāravaṭaḥ, anye śukaśimbāmāhuḥ| kākādanī kākatindukaḥ| ādāribimbīṃ sakadambapuṣpīmityādi|- ādārī vellantarasadṛśapuṣpā āliriti loke, bimbī rāsnānukāriviṭapā lohitaphalā ca; kārtikakuṇḍastu ādāriśimbī āuliriti prasiddheti vyākhyānayati| kadambapuṣpī bhūmikadambaḥ, alambuṣāmapare| etāni kaṣāyakalpena vipācya, tasmin kaṣāye sarpirghṛtaṃ vipacet| kṣīreṇa vetyādi| māgadhikā vā kṣīreṇa saha yathāgni upayujyamānā paṇḍutāṃ hantītyarthaḥ||19||-

lg.l: hitaṃ ca yaṣṭīmadhujaṃ `yaṣṭīmadhukaṃ' iti pā. kaṣāyaṃ cūrṇaṃ samaṃ vā madhunā'valihyāt ||20||

ab.seg: hitaṃ cetyādi| yaṣṭīmadhukakaṣāyaṃ madhunā samamityeko yogaḥ| cūrṇaṃ vā yaṣṭīmadhukasya madhunā samaṃ madhunā saha lihyāditi dvitīyaḥ| anye ‘cūrṇaṃ samaṃ vā madhunā'valihyāt’ ityatra ‘cūrṇaṃ lihedvā madhunā dvitīyam’ iti paṭhanti; tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ||20||

gomūtrayūktamityādi| triphalādalānāṃ cūrṇamāyasaṃ cūrṇaṃ dattvā gomūtrayuktamanalpakālaṃ cirakālaṃ lihyāt| triphalādalānāmiti dalaśabdaḥ aṣṭhīlāparihārārtham| anye ‘gomūtrayuktaṃ triphalādalānāṃ’ ityatra ‘gomūtrapītatriphalādalānāṃ’ iti paṭhanti, gomūtrabhāvitatriphalādalānāmiti vyākhyānayanti| pravāletyādi| pravālo vidrumaḥ, muktā mauktikam, añjanaṃ rasāñjanam| tatheti gomūtrayuktamanalpakālaṃ lihyādityarthaḥ| kāñcanagairikotthamityatrāpi tatheti sambadhyate; tena suvarṇagairikacūrṇaṃ gomūtrayutaṃ cirakālaṃ lihyādityarthaḥ| ‘gomūtrapītāṃ triphalāṃ sapiṣṭāṃ’ iti kecit paṭhanti, gomūtrapītāṃ gomūtrabhāvitāṃ madhunā avalihyāditi vyākhyānayanti||21||

lg.l: ājaṃ śakṛt syāt `śakṛddhara' iti pā. kuḍavapramāṇaṃ viḍaṃ haridrā lavaṇottamaṃ ca |
pṛthak palāṃśāni samagram etac cūrṇaṃ hitāśī madhunā'valihyāt ||22||

ab.seg: ājamityādi| ājaṃ śakṛt chāgalīpurīṣam| kuḍavapramāṇaṃ catuṣpalamātram| viḍaṃ lavaṇam| lavaṇottamaṃ saindhavam| pṛthakpalāṃśāni viḍādīni pṛthakpalamātrāṇītyarthaḥ| samagraṃ samastam||22||

lg.l: mūtrāsuto 'yaṃ `mūtrāyuto'yaṃ' iti pā. madhunā'valehaḥ pāṇḍvāmayaṃ hanty acireṇa ghoram ||23||

ab.seg: idānīṃ pāṇḍuroge siddhatamaṃ yogamāha- maṇḍūretyādi| maṇḍūraṃ lohakiṭṭānukāri dravyam| agniḥ citrakaḥ| vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukam| maṇḍūrādīnāṃ vyoṣaparyantānāmaṃśaḥ samo bhāgo yasmin sa tathetyarthaḥ| tāpyo mākṣikadhātuḥ| mūtrāsutaḥ mūtre uṣitaḥ mūtrasandhita ityarthaḥ||23||

lg.l: bibhītakāyomalanāgarāṇāṃ cūrṇaṃ tilānāṃ ca guḍaś ca mukhyaḥ |
takrānupāno `takrānupānaṃ vaṭakāprayuktaṃ' iti pā. vaṭakaḥ prayuktaḥ kṣiṇoti ghorān api pāṇḍurogān ||24||

ab.seg: aparamapi siddhatamaṃ yogamāha- bibhītaketyādi| ayomalaṃ lohasiṅghāṇakam| tilānāṃ kṛṣṇatilānāmapi cūrṇam| guḍaśca mukhya iti sarvasamo guḍo nārdhaguḍa ityarthaḥ| kṣiṇoti hanti| yadyapyetadyogadvayamanārṣaṃ tathā'pi siddhatamatvenāsmadgurusammatatvādasmābhiḥ paṭhitam||24||

lg.l: sauvarcalaṃ hiṅgu kirātatiktaṃ kalāyamātrāṇi sukhāmbunā vā |
mūrvāharidrāmalakaṃ ca lihyāt sthitaṃ gavāṃ saptadināni mūtre ||25||
mūlaṃ balācitrakayoḥ pibed vā pāṇḍvāmayārto 'kṣasamaṃ hitāśī |
sukhāmbunā vā lavaṇena tulyaṃ śigroḥ phalaṃ kṣīrabhujopayojyam ||26||

ab.seg: sauvarcalamityādi| sauvarcalādīnāmekatvena nirdiṣṭānāṃ bahuvacanāntaṃ kalāyamātrāṇīti viśeṣaṇaṃ sauvarcalādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ kalāyamātreti pramāṇabodhanārtham| sukhāmbunā vā īṣaduṣṇāmbunā, ‘lihet’ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ| vāśabdo'tra yogāpekṣayā| mūrvetyādi| mūrvādikaṃ saptadināni gavāṃ mūtre sthitaṃ lihyāt| mūrvā corasnāyuḥ| balācitrakayoḥ samuditayormūlakalkaṃ vā karṣasamaṃ hitāśī pāṇḍurogārto mūtreṇa sukhāmbunā vā pibedityarthaḥ| kārtikakuṇḍastu ‘mūrvāharidrāmalakaṃ pibedvā sthitaṃ gavāṃ saptadināni mūtre’ iti paṭhati; tatra tantrayuktivaśāt ‘yatra tat’ iti padaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ, tena yatra mūrvādikaṃ sthitaṃ tat pibedityarthaḥ| tathā ca tantrāntaram- “niśāmalakamūrvābhirbhāvitaṃ sapta vāsarān| gomūtraṃ pibataḥ pāṇḍuḥ kāmalā ca praṇaśyati”- iti| sukhāmbunā uṣṇodakena| lavaṇena saindhavena| tulyaṃ samam| śigroḥ phalaṃ śobhāñjanakaphalam| kalāyamātramityanuvartanīyaṃ, saindhavasyāpi hiṅguvadadhikamātrasyānabhimatatvāt| kṣīrabhujā dugdhāśanena| upayojyaṃ pānādividhinā||25-26||

lg.l: nyagrodhavargasya pibet kaṣāyaṃ śītaṃ sitākṣaudrayutaṃ hitāśī |
śālādikaṃ cāpy atha sāracūrṇaṃ dhātrīphalaṃ vā madhunā'valihyāt ||27||

ab.seg: nyagrodhavargasyetyādi| nyagrodhavargasya nyagrodhādigaṇasya| kaṣāyaṃ kvāthapākaparibhāṣayā kvathitam| śālādikaṃ cā'pyatha sāracūrṇamityādi| śālasārādicūrṇaṃ madhunā avalihyāt, āmalakacūrṇaṃ vetyarthaḥ||27||

lg.l: cūrṇāni kṛtvā guḍaśarkare ca tathaiva sarpirmadhunī śubhe ca ||28||
sambhāram etad vipacen nidhāya sārodake sāravato gaṇasya |
jātaṃ ca lehyaṃ matimān viditvā nidhāpayen mokṣakaje samudge ||29||
hanty eṣa lehaḥ khalu pāṇḍurogaṃ saśotham ugrām api kāmalāṃ ca |30|

div.ab: viḍaṅgamustatriphaletyādi| etāni viḍaṅgādidravyāṇi cūrṇīkṛtāni `cūrṇāni kṛtvā' iti pā., sāravato gaṇasya sārodake śālāsārādigaṇasārakvāthe, nidhāya nikṣipya, tathā śubhe nirmale kṛtvā guḍaśarkare sarpirmadhunī ca nikṣipya, aikadhyaṃ tāvat pacet yāvallehyaṃ syāt, tataśca sañjātalehyaṃ viditvā matimān vaidyo mokṣakaje samudge mokṣakamaye sampuṭe nidhāpayet nikṣipediti piṇḍārthaḥ| vinirdahanī citrakaḥ| guḍaśarkarāviḍaṅgādidravyacūrṇapramāṇaṃ sārodakacaturthāṃśena, madhusarpiḥpramāṇamapi tathaiva| nanu, uṣṇayogena madhu virudhyate, tat kathaṃ madhunā sahāvalehapākaḥ? satyam, uṣṇena saha madhuno'bhyavahāre virodho na pāke; tathā ca tantrāntaraṃ- ‘sakṣaudrāṃ śarkarāṃ paktvā’ ityādi| yadyapyatra pāṇḍurogacikitsitaṃ sāmānyenoktaṃ, tathā'pyetadeva cikitsitaṃ dravyasvarūpeṇa vikalpya yathādoṣaṃ yojyam| tathā ca tantrāntaram- “pāṇḍurogapraśāntyarthamidamuktaṃ cikitsitam| vikalpyaivaṃ ca bhiṣajā yathādoṣabalaṃ prati|| snehaprāyaṃ pavanaje, tiktaśītaṃ tu paittike| ślaiṣmike kaṭurūkṣoṣṇaṃ, miśraṃ syāt sānnipātike” (ca. ci. 16) iti||28-29||-

lg.l: saśarkarā kāmalināṃ tribhaṇḍī hitā gavākṣī saguḍā ca śuṇṭhī ||30||

ab.seg: ataḥ paraṃ kāmalācikitsitamāha- saśarkaretyādi| tribhaṇḍī trivṛt, saśarkarā kāmalināṃ hitā| gavākṣī indravāruṇī, sā saguḍā hitā, śuṇṭhyapi saguḍā||30||

lg.l: kāleyake cāpi ghṛtaṃ vipakvaṃ hitaṃ ca tat syād rajanīvimiśram |31|

div.ab: kāleyake ityādi| kāleyakaṃ dāruharidrānukāri dravyaṃ, tatkalkasādhitaṃ ghṛtaṃ, rajanīvimiśraṃ haridrācūrṇaprakṣepayutam|31|-

lg.l: dhātuṃ nadījaṃ jatu śailajaṃ vā kumbhāhvaye mūtrayutaṃ `kṣaudrayutam' iti pā. pibed vā ||31||

ab.seg: kumbhāhvayacikitsāmāha- dhātumityādi| nadījaṃ dhātuṃ suvarṇamākṣikam| tacca mūtrayutaṃ pibet| jatu śailajaṃ veti śilājatu vā mūtrayutaṃ pibet||31||

lg.l: mūtre sthitaṃ saindhavasamprayuktaṃ māsaṃ pibed vā'pi hi lohakiṭṭam |32|

div.ab: mūtre sthitamityādi| gomūtre māsamuṣitaṃ lohakiṭṭaṃ lohamalaṃ tenaiva mūtreṇa cūrṇitaṃ saindhavayuktaṃ kumbhāhvaye pibet| lohakiṭṭamityatra hiraṇyakiṭṭamiti kecit paṭhanti; tannecchanti nibandhakārāḥ, hiraṇyasyāmalatvāt|32|-

lg.l: dagdhvā'kṣakāṣṭhair malam āyasaṃ vā gomūtranirvāpitam aṣṭavārān ||32||
vicūrṇya līḍhaṃ madhunā'cireṇa kumbhāhvayaṃ pāṇḍugadaṃ nihanyāt |
sindhūdbhavaṃ vā'gnisamaṃ ca kṛtvā kṣiptvā ca mūtre sakṛd eva taptam ||33||
lauhaṃ ca kiṭṭaṃ bahuśaś ca taptvā nirvāpya mūtre bahuśas tathaiva |
ekīkṛtaṃ gojalapiṣṭam etad aikadhyam āvāpya paced ukhāyām ||34||
yathā na dahyeta tathā viśuṣkaṃ cūrṇīkṛtaṃ peyam udaśvitā tat |
takraudanāśī vijayeta rogaṃ pāṇḍuṃ tathā dīpayate 'nalaṃ ca ||35||

ab.seg: kumbhāhvaye siddhatamaṃ yogamāha- dagdhvetyādi| sindhūdbhavaṃ saindhavam| agnisamaṃ kṛtvā bibhītakāgninā agnivarṇaṃ kṛtvetyarthaḥ| sakṛt ekavāram| lauhaṃ ca kiṭṭamiti lohasiṃhāṇakamityarthaḥ| nirvāpya nirvāpittaṃ kṛtvā| ekīkṛtaṃ samabhāgena miśrīkṛtaṃ, gojalapiṣṭaṃ nirvāpaṇāvaśiṣṭapañcaguṇe gomūtre piṣṭam, ukhāyāṃ sthālyāṃ nikṣipya, mukhaṃ pidhāya, yathā bāṣpo bahirna niḥsarati yathā na dahyeta tathā vipacet| tataśca viśuṣkaṃ cūrṇīkṛtamudaśvitā mathitena saha peyam| jīrṇe ca takraudanaṃ bhojayedityarthaḥ| ayamasauśruto'pi pūrvoktahetutvādasmābhiḥ paṭhitaḥ| asya yogasya tantrāntare bibhītakalavaṇamiti sañjñā||32-35||

lg.l: drākṣāguḍūcyāmalakīrasaiś ca siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ lāghara(va)ke hitaṃ ca |36|

div.ab: idānīṃ lāgharacikitsāmāha- drākṣetyādi|36|-

lg.l: gauḍānariṣṭān madhuśarkarāś ca mūtrāsavān kṣārakṛtāṃs tathaiva ||36||
snigdhān rasānāmalakair upetān kolānvitān vā'pi hi jāṅgalānām |
seveta śophābhihitāṃś ca yogān pāṇḍvāmayī śāliyavāṃś ca nityam ||37||

ab.seg: idānīṃ tantrāntaroktān sarvānevābhayāriṣṭādīn bhojanaṃ ca saṅgṛhṇannāha- gauḍānityādi| gauḍānariṣṭān abhayāriṣṭādīn| madhuśarkarāśceti madhuśabdena madhvāsavaḥ, sa ca lohāriṣṭaprabhṛtikaḥ; śarkarāśabdena śarkarāsavaḥ| mūtrāsavān kuṣṭhacikitsitoktān| kṣārakṛtānāsavān ślīpadapaṭhitān| snigdhān rasān snehabhṛṣṭān jāṅgalānāṃ māṃsarasān; āmalakairupetān āmalakaphalasaṃskṛtān, kolānvitān veti badarasaṃskṛtān; vikalpābhidhānaṃ sātmyāpekṣayā| śophābhihitān yogān devadāruśuṇṭhīrasādikān| śālayo raktaśālyādayaḥ||36-37||

pāṇḍurogopadravacikitsāmāha- śvāsetyādi| etān śvāsādīnupadravān, yathāsvaṃ śāstraṃ yathātmīyaṃ cikitsāśāstraṃ prasamīkṣya jayet| kecidamuṃ pāṭhamanyathā paṭhanti,- ‘tṛṣṇāṃ jvaraṃ chardimathātisāraṃ mūrcchāṃ kṣayaṃ śvāsamanannalipsām `śvāsamanalpaśotham' iti pā.| tathā'vipākasvarabhedasādān jayedyathāvat prasamīkṣya śāstram’- iti| nanu, jvarātisārānvitasya tasyāsādhyatvena vakṣyamāṇatvāt kuto jvarātisārayościkitsātideśaḥ? ucyate, acirotthitayostayoḥ satoḥ pāṇḍurogiṇaḥ pratikāryatvāt||38||

lg.l: anteṣu śūnaṃ parihīnamadhyaṃ mlānaṃ tathā'nteṣu ca madhyaśūnam |
gude ca śephasy atha muṣkaśūnaṃ `muṣkayośca śūnaṃ, pratāmyantamasañjñakalpam' iti pā. pratāmyamānaṃ ca visañjñakalpam ||39||

ab.seg: idānīmanupakramyasya pāṇḍurogiṇo lakṣaṇamāha- anteṣu śūnamityādi| anteṣu hastapādamukheṣu| parihīnamadhyaṃ kṛśamadhyakāyam| mlānaṃ kṛśam| gude ca śephasītyatrāpi śūnamiti sambandhanīyaṃ, śepho yoniliṅgam| muṣkaśūnam aṇḍakoṣaśūnam| yadyapi madhyaśūnamityanenaiva gudādiśophaḥ prāptaḥ, tathā'pyante mlānatāṃ vinā'pi gudādiśophī tyājya iti darśanārthaṃ gudādiśophakathanam| pratāmyamānaṃ mūrcchantam| visañjñakalpaṃ vecetanaprāyam| yadyapi mūrcchāyena visañjñakalpamiti prāptaṃ, tathā'pyabhidhānaṃ visañjñakalpasya viśeṣeṇāsādhyatāpratipādanārtham| atisārajvarapīḍitam atisārajvarābhyāṃ pīḍitamityarthaḥ| yadyapi pānakīhalīmakacikitsitaṃ noktaṃ, tathā'pi pāṇḍurogacikitsitaṃ tayorapi kartavyam||39-40||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre pāṇḍurogapratiṣedho nāma (ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) catuś catvāriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||44||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre pāṇḍurogapratiṣedho nāma catuścatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||44||

div.head: raktapittapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto raktapittapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
pāṇḍurogapratiṣedhānantaraṃ dūṣyasāmyādraktapittapratiṣedhārambho yukta ityata āha- athāta ityādi||1-2||

lg.l: nityam abhyasato duṣṭo rasaḥ pittaṃ prakopayet |
vidagdhaṃ svaguṇaiḥ pittaṃ vidahaty āśu śoṇitam ||4||
tataḥ pravartate raktam ūrdhvaṃ cādho dvidhā'pi vā |5|

div.ab: nidānānantarīyakatvāt pratiṣedhasyādau raktapittanidānabhūte hetusamprāptī āha- krodhaśokabhayāyāsetyādi| krodhādīni nityamabhyasyato niṣevamāṇasya puruṣasya duṣṭiṃ gato rasaḥ pittaṃ prakopayet, tataśca vidagdhaṃ duṣṭaṃ pittaṃ svaguṇaiḥ tīkṣṇoṣṇādibhiḥ śoṇitaṃ vidahati pradūṣayati, tata ūrdhvamadho vā raktaṃ pravartata iti piṇḍārthaḥ| tīkṣṇamuṣṇakaṭvamlalavaṇakṣāravyatiriktaṃ jyotiṣmatyapāmārgaphalādikam| āyāsaḥ śramaḥ| viruddhānnaṃ hitāhitīyoktam| krodhaśoketyādiḥ hetuḥ, nityamabhyasyata ityādiḥ samprāptiḥ| ‘kaṭvamlalavaṇa’- ityatra kecit ‘tīkṣṇamuṣṇāmlalavaṇaṃ divāsvapnaṃ vidāhi yat’ iti paṭhanti||3-4||-

lg.l: āmāśayād vrajed ūrdhvam adhaḥ pakvāśayād vrajet ||5||
vidagdhayor dvayoś cāpi `vidagdhayoścāpyubhayoḥ' iti pā. dvidhā bhāgaṃ `dvidhāmārga' iti pā. pravartate |
kecit sayakṛtaḥ plīhnaḥ pravadanty asṛjo gatim ||6||

ab.seg: tadraktaṃ yathordhvamadho vā dvidhā'pi vā pravartate tathā darśayannāha- āmāśayādityādi| yadyapi raktasya yakṛtplīhasthānatvādāmāśayapakvāśayābhyāṃ pravartanaṃ na sambhavati, tathā'pi prakupitaraktasya tatrāpi gamanāt pravartanaṃ tābhyāṃ sambhavatyeva| vidagdhayoścāpyubhayoriti duṣṭayorāmapakvāśayayorityarthaḥ| tayośca duṣṭiḥ duṣṭarudhirasaṃyogāt| ekīyamatamāha- kecidityādi| sayakṛtaḥ kālakhaṇḍasahitāt| etadapyanumatam, apratiṣedhāt| asmin pāṭhe aṅgīkṛte'pi pūrvavākyena saha na virodhaḥ, yato yakṛtplīhābhyāmeva raktaṃ pravartate paramāmapakvāśayamadhiṣṭhāya||5-6||

lg.l: ūrdhvaṃ sādhyam adho yāpyam asādhyaṃ yugapadgatam `yugapadgatiḥ' iti pā.|7|

div.ab: triprakārasya raktapittasya sādhyayāpyāsādhyatvamāha- ūrdhvamityādi| ūrdhvaṃ sādhyamiti yadā daurbalyādyupadravahīnaṃ māṃsaprakṣālanābhamityādyasādhyalakṣaṇarahitamekadoṣānugaṃ bhavati tadā sādhyaṃ, yadā tu tadeva śāntiṃ gatvā punarbhavati mārgāntaraṃ vā yāti alpopadravam alpāsādhyalakṣaṇayuktaṃ dvidoṣānugaṃ ca bhavati tadā yāpyaṃ, yadā ca bahūpadravayuktaṃ bahvasādhyalakṣaṇayuktaṃ tridoṣānugataṃ ca bhavati tadā asādhyam| adho yāpyamiti alpopadravamasādhyalakṣaṇahīnaṃ dvidoṣānugaṃ ca bhavati tadā adhogaṃ yāpyaṃ; yadā ca tridoṣānugamasādhyalakṣaṇayuktaṃ tadā varjyaṃ, yadā caikadoṣānugaṃ nirupadravaṃ varjyalakṣaṇāsaṃyuktaṃ tadā sādhyam| asādhyaṃ yugapadgatamiti yadā tridoṣānugaṃ bahūpadravamasādhyalakṣaṇayuktaṃ bhavati tadā asādhyaṃ, yadā cānyathā tadā yāpyamityarthaḥ| yugapadgatam ubhayamārgapravṛttamityarthaḥ|7|-

lg.l: lohagandhiś ca niḥśvāso bhavaty asmin bhaviṣyati |8|

div.ab: atha pūrvarūpamāha- sadanamityādi| sadanam aṅgamlāniḥ| kaṇṭhadhūmāyanaṃ kaṇṭhe dhūmodvamanamiva vedanetyarthaḥ| asmin raktapitte||7||-

ab.seg: raktapittasya saṅkhyāṃ doṣocchrayaṃ cātideśenāha- bāhyāsṛglakṣaṇaistasyetyādi| bāhyāsṛglakṣaṇairiti śoṇitavarṇanīyoktaiḥ ‘phenilamaruṇam’ ityādibhiḥ, tasya raktapittasya, saṅkhyā saptavidhā| nanu, pittena vi dagdhena vidagdhaṃ raktaṃ raktapittamucyate, tat kathaṃ pittādapi pṛthaguddiśyate? ucyate, tadraktāntareṇa saṃsargāt| doṣocchritiḥ doṣādhikyam||8||

lg.l: daurbalyaśvāsakāsajvaravamathumadāstandritādāhamūrcchā bhukte cānne vidāhas tv adhṛtir api sadā hṛdyatulyā ca pīḍā |
tṛṣṇā kaṇṭhasya bhedaḥ śirasi ca davanaṃ `tapanaṃ' iti pā. pūtiniṣṭhīvanaṃ ca dveṣo bhakte 'vipāko viratir api rate raktapittopasargāḥ ||9||

ab.seg: idānīṃ raktapittopadravānāha- daurbalyaśvāsakāsetyādi| vamathuḥ chardiḥ| madaḥ pūgaphaleneva mattatā| adhṛtiḥ asantoṣaḥ| atulyā asādhāraṇā| kaṇṭhasya bhedaḥ kaṇṭhakṣaṇanam| śirasi ca davanaṃ santāpaḥ| viratirapi rateḥ sukhasyāpi vināśo bhavatītyarthaḥ| upasargā upadravāḥ| ‘bhukte cānne vidāha’ ityatra ‘bhukte ghoro vidāha’ ityanye paṭhanti| tatra saptamī ṣaṣṭhyarthe, tena bhuktasya āhārasya ghoro mahān vidāha ityarthaḥ| ‘kaṇṭhasya bheda’ ityatra ‘koṣṭhasya bheda’ ityapare paṭhanti; koṣṭhaśabdena koṣṭhastho malastasya bheda iti ca vyākhyānayanti| tadetat pāṭhadvayamūrdhvādhaḥpravṛttirūpaṃ yathāsambhavaṃ boddhavyaṃ, ekatra dvayorapyanaupayikatvāt| śirasi ca davanamityatra ‘pravitatasiratā’ iti kecit paṭhanti, sirātatagātrateti vyākhyānayanti| ‘viratirapi rateḥ’ ityatra apare ‘vinatirapi bhavet’ iti paṭhanti; vinatiḥ śarīrasya vinamanam| apare ‘vikṛtirapi bhavet’ iti paṭhanti, tatrāpi kāyasyākuñcanātmikā vikṛtirityarthaḥ||9||

lg.l: māṃsaprakṣālanābhaṃ kvathitam iva ca yat kardamāmbhonibhaṃ vā medaḥpūyāsrakalpaṃ `medaḥpūyāsthikalpaṃ' iti pā. yakṛd iva yadi vā pakvajambūphalābham |
yat kṛṣṇaṃ yac ca nīlaṃ bhṛśam atikuṇapaṃ yatra coktā vikārās tad varjyaṃ raktapittaṃ surapatidhanuṣā yac ca tulyaṃ vibhāti ||10||

ab.seg: asādhyaraktapittalakṣaṇamāha- māṃsaprakṣālanābhamityādi| māṃsaprakṣālanābhaṃ māṃsadhāvanatoyābham| kardamāmbhonibhaṃ kardamena miśritaṃ yadambhastoyaṃ tannibham| medaḥpūyāsrakalpaṃ medaḥpūyaraktasadṛśamityarthaḥ| atikuṇapaṃ śaṭitaśavagandhi| uktā vikārā daurbalyaśvāsādayaḥ, ‘prabhūtā’ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ| tadvarjyamiti ūrdhvadhomārgatvena sādhyaṃ yāpyaṃ ca yaduktaṃ bhavati tadapyevaṃvidham asādhyam| surapatidhanuḥ indradhanuḥ| ‘kvathitamiva ca yat’ ityatra ‘kvathitamiva yakṛt’ iti paṭhitvā pakvakālakhaṇḍatulyamiti vyākhyānayanti||10||

ādau balavati raktapitte saṅgrahaṇaniṣedhamāha- nādau saṅgrāhyamudriktamityādi| yat raktapittam, udriktam atiśayena vṛddhiṃ gataṃ, tadbalayuktasyāśnataśca puruṣasyādau na saṅgrāhyaṃ; yasmāttadādau saṅgṛhītaṃ sat pāṇḍvādirogāvahaṃ bhavati||11||

lg.l: jayed anyatarad vā'pi kṣīṇasya śamanair asṛk ||12||

ab.seg: tarhi tatra kiṃ kuryādityāha- adhaḥpravṛttaṃ vamanairityādi| saṃśodhanārhasya balavato narasyādhogaṃ raktapittaṃ bahudoṣaṃ vamanairjayet, evaṃvidhasyordhvagaṃ virecanairityarthaḥ| nanu, adhogaṃ vātānugaṃ bhavati, ūrdhvagaṃ ca kaphānugaṃ, tat kathaṃ tayorvamanavirecane yujyete? satyaṃ, vyādhipratyanīkatvādyujyete eva; tathā ca tantrāntaraṃ- “adhogaṃ vamanairdhīmānūrdhvagaṃ recanairjayet”- iti| anyataradveti ūrdhvagamadhogaṃ vā kṣīṇasya puruṣasya śamanairjayediti na vamanavirekaiḥ; tathā ca tantrāntaram- “ūrdhvagaṃ vā'pyadhogaṃ vā kṣīṇasya śamanairjayet”- iti||12||
idānīṃ saṃśodhanārhasya laṅghanamapi hitamiti darśayannāha- atipravṛddhadoṣasyetyādi| apatarpaṇaṃ laṅghanam||13||

lg.l: tarpaṇaṃ pācanaṃ lehān sarpīṃṣi vividhāni ca ||14||

ab.seg: laṅghanādanantaraṃ kiṃ kuryādityāha- laṅghitasyetyādi vidadhyāt kuryāt| kiṃ raktapitte peyāmeva vidadhyādutānyadapītyāha- tarpaṇamityādi| tarpaṇamiti mṛdvīkāmadhukādisādhitajalena saśarkareṇāloḍitāḥ saghṛtakṣaudrā lājaśaktavaḥ| pācanaṃ hrīberacandanośīraparpaṭamustasādhitajalapānam| lehāniti vakṣyamāṇān madhukaśobhāñjanakādipuṣpaiḥ kṛtān saghṛtakṣaudrān| vividhāni sarpīṃṣi vāsāghṛtādīni| tatrādhoge peyā hitā yadi māruto balī na syāt, mārutaścedbalī bhavati tadā māṃsarasa eva; ūrdhvage ca tarpaṇaṃ hitam| tathā ca tantrāntaram- “adhovahe yavāgvādi na cet syānmāruto balī| ūrdhvage tarpaṇaṃ śastaṃ yathādoṣamathāpi vā”- iti| kecit ‘laṅghitasya tato yuktyā laghvannamavacārayet’ iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- yuktyā mātrayā pratyanīkaṃ cetyarthaḥ||14||

pūrvamuddiṣṭaṃ yadvamanavirecanaṃ tayordravyāṇyāha- drākṣāmadhukakāśmaryetyādi| drākṣādiyuktaṃ virecanadravyakalpoktaṃ mṛdu virecanaṃ, yaṣṭīmadhukakṣaudrayuktaṃ vamanadravyavikalpoktaṃ mṛdu vamanaṃ hitam||15||

lg.l: payāṃsi śītāni rasāś ca jāṅgalāḥ satīnayūṣāś ca saśāliṣaṣṭikāḥ |
hitaṃ ca śākaṃ ghṛtasaṃskṛtaṃ sadā tathaiva dhātrīphaladāḍimānvitam |
rasāś ca pārāvataśaṅkhakūrmajās tathā yavāgvo vihitā ghṛtottarāḥ ||17||
himāḥ pradehā madhurā gaṇāś ca ye ghṛtāni pathyāni raktapittinām ||18||

ab.seg: vamanavirecanadravyāṇyabhidhāya bhojanadravyāṇi pratipādayati- payāṃsītyādi| śītāni utpalādidravyakvathitaśītāni, tāni tu pittaprāye| jāṅgalarasā eṇādilāvādikṛtāḥ, te ca vātānubandhe| satīnayūṣā vartulakalāyayūṣāḥ, te ca kaphānuge raktapitte hitāḥ| paṭoletyādi| śelūḥ dakṣiṇāpathajaṃ śākaṃ, śleṣmāntakamapare| suniṣaṇṇakaḥ śiravālikā, catuṣparṇītyapare| atimukta āvantakaḥ| aṅkurāḥ komalapallavāḥ paṭolādīnām| sinduvāraḥ nirguṇḍī| etānyapi śākāni kaphānuge śastānīti| paṭoletyatra kecit jīvantīti paṭhanti| rasāścetyādi| jāṅgalarasābhidhānenaiva pārāvatarasasyāpi parigrahe tadabhidhānaṃ viśeṣeṇa raktapitte hitatvāpādanārtham| dhātrīdāḍime saṃskārārtham| yavāgvaḥ abhihitāḥ| santānikā ghṛtasyoparitanaḥ styāno bhāgaḥ| ghṛtottarā ghṛtapradhānāḥ| himāḥ pradehā ityādi| himāḥ pradehāḥ śītā lepāḥ; te ca nyagrodhādiprabhṛtiśītalagaṇakṛtāḥ| madhurā gaṇāḥ kākolyādayaḥ| te ca pānādinā yojyāḥ| ghṛtāni madhuragaṇasādhitāni tantrāntarasaṃvādāt| pathyāni hitāni||16-18||

lg.l: bhiṣag vidadhyāc caturaḥ samākṣikān hitāya lehān asṛjaḥ praśāntaye ||19||
lihyāc ca dūrvāvaṭajāṃś ca pallavān madhudvitīyān sitakarṇikasya 'śṛtasya' iti pā. ca |
hitaṃ ca kharjūraphalaṃ samākṣikaṃ phalāni cānyāny api tadguṇāny atha ||20||

ab.seg: madhūketyādi| madhūkādipuṣpairekaikaiścūrṇitaistrayo `madhūkaśobhāñjanakovidārajaiḥ kusumaistrayo lehāḥ' iti pā. lehāḥ, priyaṅgukāyāḥ kusumaiścaturtho lehaḥ| aparānapi lehānāha- lihyādityādi| dūrvāvaṭapallavān madhudvitīyān lihyādityeko yogaḥ| sitakarṇikaḥ śvetakarṇikāraḥ, tasyāpi pallavān madhudvitīyān lihyāditi dvitīyo yogaḥ| kecit samuditamekaṃ yogaṃ manyante; tannecchanti nibandhakārāḥ, samānatantrasaṃvādāt| ‘dūrvāvaṭajāṃśca pallavān’ ityatrāpare ‘dugdhadrumapallavān’ iti paṭhitvā vaṭādipallavāniti vyācakṣate| kiṃ raktapitte etadeva hitamutānyadapītyāha- hitamityādi| samākṣikaṃ samadhu| anuktasaṅgrahāyāha- phalāni cānyānyapītyādi| anyāni phalāni kāśmaryādīni| tadguṇāni kharjūraphalatulyaguṇāni||19-20||

div.ab: idānīṃ raktapitte'tideśena cikitsāmāha- raktātīsāraproktāṃścetyādi| raktātīsāraproktān yogān ‘priyālamallikā’ ityādīn| asyāgre kārtikakuṇḍaḥ ‘nīlotpalānāṃ madhunā bhasma vā'pi parisrutam’ ityādiyogaṃ paṭhati, sa ca jejjaṭācāryeṇa ‘sakṣaudramindīvarabhasma’ ityādinā agre paṭhitaḥ|21|-

lg.l: yojayitvā kṣiped rātrāv ākāśe sotpalaṃ tu tat |

ab.seg: śuddhekṣukāṇḍamāpothyetyādi| śuddhekṣukāṇḍāni nirvalkalekṣukāṇḍāni, āpothya avakṣudya| himāmbhasā yojayitvetyādi śītalajalena yojayitvā nave ghaṭe rātrāvākāśe nirāvaraṇasthāne kṣipet dhārayet, tataśca prātaḥkāle srutaṃ gālitaṃ nīlotpalacūrṇamadhubhyāṃ yutaṃ śoṇitapittavān naraḥ pibet||21-22||

lg.l: udumbaraphalaṃ piṣṭvā pibet tad rasam eva vā ||23||

ab.seg: pibedityādi| pibedityatra madhuyutamityanuktamapi sambadhyate, samānatantrasaṃvādāt| udumbaraphalamityādi| udumbaraphalaṃ piṣṭvā tadrasaṃ gṛhītvā madhuyutaṃ pibet||23||

lg.l: pibed akṣasamaṃ kalkaṃ yaṣṭīmadhukam eva vā ||24||
candanaṃ madhukaṃ rodhram evam eva samaṃ pibet |

ab.seg: idānīṃ raktapitte siddhatamān ṣaḍyogānāha- trapusīmūlakalkamityādi| sakṣaudraṃ karṣonmitamadhusahitaṃ, taṇḍulāmbunā kalkāccaturguṇenetyarthaḥ| akṣasamaṃ karṣapramāṇaṃ, evameveti sakṣaudraṃ taṇḍulāmbunetyarthaḥ| karañjabījādiyogadvayaṃ kaphānubandhe ūrdhvage śastam| majjānamiṅgudasyetyādi sitāmadhuyutameva(ka)meva pibedityarthaḥ||24-27||

div.ab: anantaroktāḥ ṣaḍyogā ghrāṇage rakte'vapīḍane'pi yojyā ityāha- pathyā ityādi| pathyā hitāḥ, anantaroktāḥ trapusīmūlakalkamityādi ṣaḍyogāḥ iti śeṣaḥ|28|-

lg.l: yakṛd vā bhakṣayed ājam āmaṃ pittasamāyutam ||28||

ab.seg: asṛgiti śarīradhātusāmānyāt eṇādīnāmityarthaḥ| yakṛt kālakhaṇḍam||28||

lg.l: palāśavṛkṣasvarase vipakvaṃ sarpiḥ pibet kṣaudrayutaṃ suśītam |
vanaspatīnāṃ svarasaiḥ kṛtaṃ vā saśarkaraṃ kṣīraghṛtaṃ pibed vā ||29||
drākṣāmuśīrāṇy atha padmakaṃ sitā pṛthak palāṃśāny udake samāvapet |
sthitaṃ niśāṃ tad rudhir āmayaṃ jayet pītaṃ payo vā'mbusamaṃ hitāśinaḥ ||30||
turaṅgavarcaḥsvarasaṃ samākṣikaṃ pibet sitākṣaudrayutaṃ vṛṣasya vā |
lihet tathā vāstukabījacūrṇaṃ kṣaudrānvitaṃ taṇḍulasāhvayaṃ vā ||31||
lihyāc ca lājāñjanacūrṇam ekam evaṃ sitākṣaudrayutāṃ tugākhyām |
drākṣāṃ sitāṃ tiktakarohiṇīṃ ca himāmbunā vā madhukena yuktām ||32||
pathyām ahiṃsrāṃ rajanīṃ ghṛtaṃ ca lihyāt tathā śoṇitapittarogī |33|

div.ab: vanaspatīnāṃ vaṭādīnām| kṣīraghṛtaṃ kṣīrotthaṃ ghṛtam| payo vā'mbusamamiti dugdhaṃ jalaṃ ca tulyamityarthaḥ| kecidevaṃ paṭhanti- ‘vāsākaṣāyaṃ sasitaṃ pibedvā turaṅgavarcaḥsvarasaṃ samākṣikam’ iti| lihettathā vāstukabījacūrṇamityādi|- vāstukabījacūrṇaṃ ṭaṅkavāstukabījacūrṇaṃ kṣaudrānvitaṃ lihet| taṇḍulasāhvayaṃ veti taṇḍulīyaṃ kṣaudrānvitaṃ vā lihyādityarthaḥ| kecidevaṃ paṭhanti- ‘sataṇḍulīyaṃ madhunā'valehayet sitāyutaṃ vāstukamūlameva vā’ iti| lihyāccetyādi| lājā bhṛṣṭadhānyāni| añjanaṃ rasāñjanam| ekaṃ pradhānaṃ, evaṃ kṣādreṇetyarthaḥ| ‘lājāñjanacūrṇam’ ityatra ‘kālāñjanacūrṇam’ iti kecit paṭhanti; tatra kālāñjanaṃ sauvīrāñjanam| sitākṣaudrayutamityādi| tugākhyā vaṃśarocanānukāri pārthivaṃ dravyaṃ, anye vaṃśarocanāmāhuḥ; tāṃ ca śarkarākṣaudrayutāṃ lihyāt| drākṣāṃ sitāmityādi| drākṣādīni trīṇi dravyāṇi yaṣṭīmadhukena yutāni śītodakena vā lihyāt| pathyāmityādi| pathyā harītakī, rajanī haridrā, etāni harītakīprabhṛtīni dravyāṇi ghṛtena saha lihyāt| ayaṃ yogaḥ kaṇṭhage prasṛte ca raktapitte yojyaḥ| kecit ‘rajanīṃ ghṛtaṃ ca’ ityatra ‘rajanīdvayaṃ ca’ iti paṭhanti, te ca śītodakenaiva lehyamicchanti; ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ samānatantravirodhādanyāyyaḥ||29-32||-

lg.l: pītvā sitākṣaudrayutāni jahyāt pittāsṛjo vegam udīrṇam āśu |34|

div.ab: idānīṃ vegavati raktapitte siddhatamaṃ yogamāha- vāsākaṣāyotpaletyādi| utpalaṃ nīlotpalaṃ mṛt kedāramṛttikā, ambhoruhakeśaraṃ padmakeśaram| kalpanāmāha- pītvā sitākṣaudrayutāni jahyādityādi| vāsākaṣāyamutpalamṛdādicūrṇaprakṣepaṃ sitākṣaudrayutaṃ pītvā naro raktapittasyodīrṇamudriktaṃ vegamāśu jahyāt śīghraṃ parityajet||33||-

lg.l: puṣpāṇi śigroś ca vicūrṇya leho madhvanvitaḥ śoṇitapittaroge |35|

div.ab: gāyatrijambvarjunakovidāretyādi| gāyatrī khadiraḥ, arjunaḥ kakubhaḥ, kovidāraḥ kāñcanāraḥ, aśano bījakaḥ| śigruḥ śobhāñjanakaḥ||34||-

lg.l: sakṣaudram indīvarabhasmavāri karañjabījaṃ madhusarpiṣī `madhu śarkarā ca' iti pā. ca ||35||
jambvarjunāmrakvathitaṃ ca toyaṃ ghnanti trayaḥ pittam asṛk ca yogāḥ |36|

div.ab: idānīṃ raktapitte trīn yogānāha- sakṣaudramindīvarabhasmetyādi| indīvarabhasmavāri indīvarakṣārodakaṃ sakṣaudraṃ pibedityeko yogaḥ| karañjabījaṃ madhusarpiṣā ceti karañjabījaṃ madhusarpiṣā vā lihyāditi dvitīyo yogaḥ| jambvarjunāmrakvathitaṃ toyamityādi|- jambvādikvathitaṃ toyaṃ sakṣaudraṃ pibediti tṛtīyo yogaḥ| eṣu madhye antyau `ādyau yogau kaṇṭhanetrasthite' iti pā. yogau kaṇṭhāntaḥsthite raktapitte yojyau||35||-

lg.l: mūlāni puṣpāṇi ca mātuluṅgyāḥ piṣṭvā pibet taṇḍuladhāvanena ||36||
ghrāṇapravṛtte jalam āśu deyaṃ saśarkaraṃ nāsikayā payo vā |37|

div.ab: mūlānītyādi| mātuluṅgo bījapūrakaḥ, ‘madhukarkaṭī’ iti anye| ghrāṇapravṛtte jalamāśu deyamityādi| ghrāṇapravṛtte raktapitte saśarkaraṃ pānīyaṃ dugdhaṃ vā saśarkaraṃ nāsikayā deyam| kecit ‘nāsikayā’ ityatra ‘nāsikayoḥ’ iti paṭhanti||36||-

lg.l: drākṣārasaṃ kṣīraghṛtaṃ pibed vā saśarkaraṃ cekṣurasaṃ himaṃ vā ||37||

ab.seg: ghrāṇapravṛtte'paramapi nasyayogamāha- drākṣārasamityādi| drākṣārasaṃ saśarkaraṃ nāsikayā pibet, kṣīraghṛtaṃ kṣīramathanodbhūtaṃ tadvā saśarkaraṃ nāsikayā pibet, ikṣurasaṃ himaṃ vā tathaiva pibet, itthaṃ trayo yogāḥ kalpanīyāḥ| tathā ca tantrāntaraṃ- “drākṣārasasya nasyaṃ nasyaṃ vā kṣīrasarpiṣaḥ sapadi| ikṣo rasasya nasyaṃ saśarkaraṃ raktanudbhavati”- iti||37||

lg.l: śītopacāraṃ madhuraṃ ca kuryād viśeṣataḥ śoṇitapittaroge |38|

div.ab: sarvatantroktacikitsāsaṅgrahārthamāha- śītopacāramityādi| śītopacāraṃ dāhādiṣu bāhye'pi kuryāditi|38|-

lg.l: kṣīreṇa cāsthāpanam agryam uktaṃ hitaṃ ghṛtaṃ cāpy anuvāsanārtham |39|

div.ab: raktapitte āsthāpanārthaṃ kṣīramanuvāsanārthaṃ ca ghṛtamāha- drākṣetyādi| vidārigandhādigaṇasādhitena kṣīreṇa ghṛtakṣaudrasitāyutenāsthāpanaṃ raktapitte'gryamuktaṃ, tathā cānuvāsanārthaṃ ghṛtaṃ hitam| tacca ghṛtaṃ yaṣṭīmadhukasādhitaṃ, apakvasya snehasya vyāpatkaratvāt| anye vidārigandhādisādhitakṣīreṇa ghṛtapākamicchanti||38||-

lg.l: nirūhya cainaṃ payasā samākṣikair ghṛtaplutaiḥ śītajalāvasecitam ||40||
kṣīraudanaṃ bhuktam athānuvāsayed ghṛtena yaṣṭīmadhusādhitena ca |
adhovahaṃ śoṇitam eṣa nāśayet tathā'tisāraṃ rudhirasya dustaram ||41||

div.ab: apare'pi raktapitte āsthāpanānuvāsane āha- priyaṅgurodhrāñjanagairikotpalairityādi| añjanaṃ sauvīrāñjanam| gairikaṃ sāmānyagairikam| utpalaṃ nīlotpalaṃ; nāgakeśaramapare| suvarṇaṃ suvarṇagairikam, antalopāt| kālīyakaṃ dāruharidrānukāri dravyam| ambudo mustā| yaṣṭikāhvayo madhuyaṣṭikā| mṛṇālaṃ padmakeśaram| saugandhikaṃ kumudabhedaḥ| priyaṅgvādibhiḥ saugandhikāntaistulyaiḥ peṣitaiḥ kalkīkṛtaiḥ samaghṛtaiḥ payasā sahainaṃ raktapittinaṃ nirūhayet| tataśca śītalajalāvasecitaṃ kṣīraudanaṃ bhuktaṃ puruṣaṃ yaṣṭīmadhukasādhitena ghṛtenānuvāsayet| adhovahaṃ śoṇitamadhogaṃ raktapittam| eṣa āsthāpanānuvāsanaprayogaḥ| atisāraṃ rudhirasyeti raktātisāramityarthaḥ| virekayoge tvatīti virekātiyoge||39-41||-

ab.seg: vāmyaśca rakte ityādi| nirūhanānuvāsanābhyāṃ vijite raktapitte sati balānvitaḥ puruṣo vāmyo vāmanīyaḥ, adhomārgapravṛttinivāraṇārtham| atra kārtikakuṇḍena bahūktaṃ, tacca granthagauravabhayāt parihṛtam||42||

lg.l: evaṃvidhā uttarabastayaś ca mūtrāśayasthe rudhire vidheyāḥ |43|

div.ab: viśiṣṭasthānage raktapitte viśiṣṭacikitsāmāha- evaṃvidhā uttaratabastayaścetyādi| evaṃvidhā anantaroktāsthāpanānuvāsanatulyāḥ| mūtrāśayasthe bastisthe mūtrasrotaḥpravṛtte ca|43|-

lg.l: pravṛttarakteṣu ca pāyujeṣu kuryād vidhānaṃ khalu raktapaittam ||43||

ab.seg: arśasaḥ atipravṛttau ca raktapittacikitsitamatidiśannāha- pravṛttarakteṣvityādi| pāyujeṣu arśaḥsu||43||

lg.l: vidhiś cāsṛgdare 'py eṣa strīṇāṃ kāryo vijānatā |

ab.seg: vidhiścāsṛgdare'pyeṣa ityādi| eṣa vidhiḥ adhogaraktapittaghno vidhiḥ| vijānatā vaidyena asṛgdare kāryaḥ| na kevalamasṛgdare eva eṣa vidhiḥ kāryaḥ kintu yasya śastrakarmaṇi kṛte atiraktaṃ pravartate tasyāpyeṣa eva vidhiḥ kāryaḥ| kecidatraivāsṛgdaralakṣaṇaṃ paṭhanti| tadyathā- ‘dahedadho vaṅkṣaṇadeśamasyāḥ śroṇīṃ ca pṛṣṭhaṃ ca tathaiva vṛkkau `kukṣiṃ' iti pā.| asṛgdaraṃ cāpi karoti nāryā garbhāśayārtiṃ tvacireṇa ghorām’- iti| ye tvatra paṭhanti te śukraśoṇitaśuddhāvasṛgdaralakṣaṇaṃ na paṭhanti||44||

lg.l: trayāṇām api doṣāṇāṃ śoṇite 'pi ca sarvaśaḥ |

ab.seg: kiṃ raktapittaghno vidhiḥ raktapittākhye roge'sṛgdare śastrakarmaṇyatiraktapravṛttau cāviśeṣeṇaiva kārya uta kiñcidapekṣyetyāha- trayāṇāmapi doṣāṇāmityādi| trayāṇāmapi doṣāṇāṃ pṛthagdvandvasamastānāṃ liṅgāni śoṇitavarṇanīyoktāni śoṇite sarvaśa ālokyānantaraṃ cikitsitaṃ kartavyaṃ, asṛgdare vā śastrakarmaṇi raktātipravṛttau raktapittaghno vidhiḥ kārya ityarthaḥ| atrādhovahasya nāśanaṃ yāpanaṃ vā'bhipretaṃ, tena sānnipātikasyākṣīṇamāṃsāgneryāpyatvamabhipretam| atra kārtikakuṇḍa āpātanikāpūrvaṃ garbhiṇītyādipāṭhaṃ paṭhati, sa cābhāvānna likhitaḥ||45||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre raktapittapratiṣedho nāma (saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) pañcacatvāriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||45||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantre kāyacikitsāyāṃ pañcacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||45||

div.head: mūrcchāpratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto mūrcchāpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
athāta ityādi||1-2||

lg.l: niviśante yadā doṣās tadā mūrcchanti mānavāḥ ||4||
hṛtpīḍā jṛmbhaṇaṃ glāniḥ sañjñānāśo balasya ca |
sarvāsāṃ pūrvarūpāṇi, yathāsvaṃ `yathāsvamupalakṣayet' iti pā. tā vibhāvayet ||5||

ab.seg: idānīṃ doṣajamūrcchāyā hetusamprāptī āha- kṣīṇasyetyādi| evambhūtasya puruṣasya vegāghātādibhirhetubhirugrā doṣā yadā bāhyābhyantareṣu karaṇāyataneṣu niviśante tadā mānavā mūrcchantīti piṇḍārthaḥ| hīnasattvasya alpasattvasya| karaṇāyataneṣu buddhīndriyakarmendriyamanobuddhyahaṅkārasthāneṣu| ugrā atipravṛddhāḥ prasṛtāśca| bāhyeṣvābhyantareṣu ceti bāhyakaraṇāyatanāni karmendriyāṇi, ābhyantarakaraṇāyatanāni manobuddhyahaṅkārasthānāni| ābhyantarakaraṇāyatanasya hṛdayasyaikatvāt kathaṃ bahuvacanaṃ? satyaṃ, antaḥsañjñāvahanāḍīnāmapyantaḥkaraṇāyatanatvenābhimatatvāt| niviśante avatiṣṭhante| apare karaṇāyatanaśabdenaiva karaṇāni kathayanti, upacārāt| tena bāhyābhyantareṣu karaṇeṣu yadā doṣā niviśante tadā mānavā mūrcchantītyarthaḥ| anye tvanyathā vyākhyānayanti- karaṇāyataneṣu yadā doṣā niviśante tathā bāhyābhyanareṣu karaṇeṣu niviśante tadā mānavā mūrcchantīti||3-5||

div.ab: yayā prakriyayā mānavo mūrcchati tāmāha- sañjñetyādi| sukhaduḥkhavyapohakṛt sukhaduḥkhanāśakṛt, sukhaduḥkhanāśaśca sañjñānāśāt; sañjñānāśastu sañjñāvahanāḍīpidhānāt| anye sukhaduḥkhe sattvarajasī, tayorvyapoho nāśastaṃ karotīti vyākhyānayanti||6||-

lg.l: vātādibhiḥ śoṇitena madyena ca viṣeṇa ca |
ṣaṭsv apy etāsu 'tāsu ṣaṭsvapi' iti pā. pittaṃ hi prabhutvenāvatiṣṭhate ||8||

ab.seg: saṅkhyāmāha- ṣaḍvidhetyādi| ye tantrāntarīyā vātādibhiḥ śoṇitena ca caturvidhāṃ mūrcchāmicchanti teṣāmayamāśayaḥ- madyaviṣayostvanantaroktapāṇḍurogavat pṛthagupādānaṃ, tena svamate ṣaḍvidhaiva mūrcchā| sarvāsvapi murcchāsu pittaṃ kartṛtvena pradhānamityāha- ṣaṭsvityādi| prabhutvenāvatiṣṭhate itaradoṣāvākramya vartata ityarthaḥ| vegāghātādiḥ hetuḥ; karaṇāyataneṣvityādiḥ sampraptiḥ||7-8||

div.ab: vātādijānāṃ tisṛṇāṃ liṅgamapasmāroktaliṅgātideśenāha- apasmāretyādi| apasmāroktaliṅgāni yathāsvaṃ tāsāṃ jānīyādityarthaḥ| kecit ‘apasmāroktaliṅgāni’ ityatra ‘apasmāreṇa liṅgāni’ iti paṭhitvā vyākhyānayanti- dantanakhakhādanākṣivaikṛtalālāsrāvādirahitānyapasmāreṇa tulyāni lakṣaṇāni yathāsvamupalakṣayedityarthaḥ| tathā ca tantrāntaraṃ,- “sarvākṛtiḥ sannipātādapasmāra ivāgataḥ| sa jantuṃ pātayatyāśu vinā bībhatsaceṣṭitaiḥ”- iti|9|-

lg.l: pṛthivyambhastamorūpaṃ raktagandhaś ca `raktagandhastadanvayaḥ' iti pā. tanmayaḥ ||9||
tasmād raktasya gandhena mūrcchanti bhuvi mānavāḥ |10|

div.ab: vātajādīnāṃ tisṛṇāṃ liṅgānyatidiśya raktajāyāḥ samprāptiṃ lakṣaṇaṃ cāha- pṛthivītyādi| pṛthvī ambhaśca dvayamapi tamorūpaṃ `tamorūpamiti tamaḥsvarūpam' iti pā. tamobahulaṃ; tathā coktaṃ purā- ‘tamobahulā pṛthivī, sattvatamobahulā āpaḥ’ iti, raktagandhaśca `raktagandhastadanvayaḥ' iti pā. tanmaya iti pṛthivyambhaḥsamudbhavaḥ; pāñcabhautike'pi rakte pṛthivyambhasoḥ prādhānyāt| mūrcchanti bhuvi mānavā ityetena gandhasya tamobahulatvamuktam| nanu, gandhaḥ pārthivastatkathaṃ pṛthivyambhaḥsamudbhava ityucyate? satyaṃ, parasparopakāryatvāt `athākāśapavanetyādau apāṃ caturguṇatvena darśitatvāt kathaṃ tadanvayenāpi gandho vyapadiśyata iti cet? na, parasparopakārādityukteḥ| evamapi bhūtāntare pṛthivīnimittatvādgandhasyeti vyākhyānaṃ' `kārtikakuṇḍāt' iti pā.| mūrcchanti bhuvi mānavā iti ye mānavā pṛthivīguṇabahulāstāmasā ityarthaḥ| nanu, yadi raktagandho mūrcchājanakaḥ, tarhi kimiti sarveṣāmeva na mūrcchāmutpādayati? satyaṃ, ye hīnasattvāsteṣāṃ mūrcchāmutpādayati na sarveṣām| apare ‘raktagandhaśca tanmaya’ ityanyathā vyācakṣate, tadyathā- tanmayaḥ pṛthivyambhomayaḥ; atra yathāsambhavaṃ vyākhyānaṃ; tena raktamambhomayaṃ, dravatvāt; gandhaśca pṛthivīmayaḥ, pārthivatvādgandhasya; tena tamobhūyiṣṭhāyāḥ pṛthivyāḥ sakāśādgandhasya jātatvādgandho'pi tamobahula eva, kāraṇānurūpatvāt kāryasya; śeṣaṃ samam| anye tu ‘pṛthivyambhastamorūpaṃ raktaṃ gandhaśca tanmaya’ iti paṭhanti; pṛthivī cāmbhaśca pṛthivyambhasī, tayoḥ sambandhi yattamaḥ, tadrūpaṃ tadbahulaṃ tallakṣaṇaṃ vā raktaṃ, gandhaśca tanmaya iti tamomaya ityarthaḥ; tamobahulapṛthivyutpannatvādgandhasya| etena tamobhūyiṣṭhapṛthivyambhautpannaraktasya dhātujanitatvādgandhasya svayaṃ tamobhūyiṣṭhatvācca raktagandho mānavairāghrātaḥ san hṛdyavasthitaṃ tamo vardhayan mūrcchāmāpādayati, ‘sarvabhāvānāṃ sāmānyaṃ vṛddhikāraṇam’ ityuktatvāt| nanu, tamobahulatvādraktaṃ mūrcchājanakaṃ tarhi tamobhūyiṣṭhe ete pṛthivyambhasī kuto mūrcchāṃ notpādayataḥ? satyaṃ, pṛthivyambhasī sātmyatayā svarūpataśca mūrcchāṃ notpādayataḥ| anye tu paṭhanti- pṛthivyambhastamorūpaṃ raktagandhena tu trayam’ iti; vyākhyānayanti ca- pṛthivyambhastamasāṃ rūpaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ yasya raktasya tatpṛthivyambhastamorūpaṃ; raktagandhena kṛtvā tu punastrayaṃ sattvarajastamasāṃ guṇānāṃ tritayaṃ ‘rakte jñāyate’ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ| nanu, gandhena kṛtvā kathaṃ guṇānāṃ tritayaṃ rakte jñāyate iti cet? satyaṃ, rakte gandho visro vartate, gandhaśca guṇaviśeṣaḥ, uktaṃ ca,- “teṣāṃ viśeṣāḥ śabdasparśarūparasagandhāḥ”- iti, te ca viśeṣāstriguṇāḥ; uktaṃ ca,- “sarva evaite viśeṣāḥ sattvarajastamomayā bhavanti” iti| kintvatra tamoguṇasyādhikyaṃ jñeyam| etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati- pṛthivyambhastamaḥsvalakṣaṇasya raktasya gandhena triguṇena tamoguṇaviśiṣṭena mānavā mūrcchanti||9||-

lg.l: dravyasvabhāva ity eke dṛṣṭvā yad abhimuhyati ||10||

ab.seg: svamataṃ pradarśya paramatamāha- dravyasvabhāva ityeke ityādi||10||

lg.l: guṇās tīvrataratvena `tīvratamatvena' iti pā. sthitās tu viṣamadyayoḥ |
ta eva tasmāj jāyeta mohas tābhyāṃ yatheritaḥ ||11||

ab.seg: viṣamadyotthe āha- guṇā ityādi| ta eva guṇā rūkṣādayaḥ| moho mūrcchā| tābhyāṃ viṣamadyābhyām| yatherito `yatherita iti svaiḥ svairvikārairviṣakalpapānātyayayoryathākathitairityarthaḥ' iti pā. yathākathita ityarthaḥ| atha viṣamadyavikārayoḥ `viṣamadyādhikārayoḥ' iti pā. sāmānyenaiva mūrcchāpraṇayanāt kathamatra viśiṣṭamabhidhānam? ucyate- tatra itaralakṣaṇaiḥ saha tadgrahaṇārtham| nanu, yadi viṣamadyayostulyā guṇāḥ sthitāḥ, tat kimiti viṣavanmadyaṃ māraṇātmakaṃ na syāt? satyaṃ, madye teṣāṃ guṇānāmanatitīvratvenāvasthānāt| yadyevaṃ tarhi ‘guṇāstīvrataratvena sthitāstu viṣamadyayoḥ’ iti kathaṃ na vyāhanyate? satyaṃ, tīvrataraśabdādagre tīvraśabdo madhye lupto draṣṭavyaḥ| tena viṣe tīvrataratvena te guṇāḥ sthitāḥ, madye tīvratvenetyarthaḥ| tathā ca tantrāntaram,- “viṣasya ye guṇā dṛṣṭāḥ sannipātaprakopaṇāḥ| ta eva madye dṛśyante viṣe tu balavattarāḥ|| ta eva tasmāttābhyāṃ `tasya tābhyāṃ' iti pā. tu mohau syātāṃ yatheritau” (ca. ci. 24)- iti||11||

lg.l: stabdhāṅgadṛṣṭis tv asṛjā gūḍhocchvāsaś ca mūrcchitaḥ |12|

div.ab: rudhirajamūrcchālakṣaṇamāha- stabdhāṅgadṛṣṭistvasṛjetyādi| stabdhaśabdo'ṅgadṛṣṭibhyāṃ sambadhyate| gūḍhocchvāsaḥ aspaṣṭaśvāsaḥ|12|-

lg.l: gātrāṇi vikṣipan bhūmau jarāṃ yāvan na yāti tat ||12||

ab.seg: madyajamūrcchālakṣaṇamāha- madyenetyādi| vilapanniti vilāpaṃ kurvan| naṣṭavibhrāntamānasa iti naṣṭamānasaḥ apasmaraṇaḥ `apasmaraṇayuktaḥ' iti pā. vibhrāntamānaso vikṣiptacetāḥ| jarāṃ pākam||12||

viṣajamūrcchālakṣaṇamāha- vepathusvapnatṛṣṇāḥ syurityādi| vepathuḥ kampaḥ| stambhaḥ stabdhatā| veditavyamityādi| mūlādikandāntasya viṣasya yathāsvaṃ yāni lakṣaṇāni taiḥ kṛtvā viṣamūrcchitasya puṃso yathāsvaṃ yathātmīyaṃ viṣaṃ jñeyam||13||

lg.l: sekāvagāhau maṇayaḥ sahārāḥ śītāḥ pradehā vyajanānilāś ca |
śītāni pānāni ca gandhavanti sarvāsu mūrcchāsv anivāritāni ||14||

ab.seg: ataḥ paraṃ cikitsitamāha- sekāvagāhāvityādi| maṇayaḥ sahārā iti maṇayo muktāsphaṭikaprabhṛtayaḥ| te ca sahārā hārāropitā hitā ityarthaḥ| vyajanānilā vyajanānāṃ vāyavaḥ| śītāḥ pradehāḥ candanotpalaprabhṛtikṛtāḥ pralepāḥ| śītāni pānāni ca gandhavantīti yāni śītāni gandhavanti ca pānāni tānītyarthaḥ| anivāritāni praśastāni||14||

lg.l: kharjūrakāśmaryarasaiḥ śṛtāni pānāni sarpīṃṣi ca jīvanāni ||15||

ab.seg: tānyeva śītāni gandhavanti ca pānānyāha- sitāpriyālekṣurasaplutānītyādi| kharjūrakāśmaryarasaiḥ śṛtāni sitāpriyālādiyutāni pānāni pānakāni sarvāsvanivāritāni| na kevalaṃ pānānyevānivāritāni sarpīṃṣi ca jīvanānīti kākolyādisiddhānītyarthaḥ| kecit pānānītyatra siddhānīti paṭhanti, te ca ghṛtaviśeṣaṇaṃ manyante||15||

lg.l: siddhāni varge madhure payāṃsi sadāḍimā jāṅgalajā rasāś ca |
tathā yavā lohitaśālayaś ca mūrcchāsu pathyāś ca sadā satīnāḥ ||16||

ab.seg: kimetānyeva sarvamūrcchāsu hitānyutānyānyapītyāha- siddhānītyādi| madhure varge kākolyādau| payāṃsi sarvāṇyapi dugdhāni, sarveṣāṃ kṣīrāṇāṃ mūrcchāharatvāt| sadāḍimā dāḍimena saṃskṛtāḥ, jāṅgalajā rasāḥ| mūrcchāsu ye bhojane hitāstānāha- tathetyādi| pathyā hitāḥ, ‘bhojane’ iti śeṣaḥ| satīno vartulakalāyaḥ||16||

lg.l: bhujaṅgapuṣpaṃ maricāny uśīraṃ kolasya madhyaṃ ca pibet samāni |
śītena toyena `satīnatoyena' iti pā. bisaṃ mṛṇālaṃ kṣaudreṇa kṛṣṇāṃ sitayā ca pathyām ||17||

ab.seg: bhujaṅgapuṣpamityādi| bhujaṅgapuṣpaṃ nāgakeśaram| kolasya madhyaṃ badaramajjā| etāni bhujaṅgapuṣpādīni samāni tulyāni śītatoyena saha pibet| na kevalametānyeva śītatoyena saha pibet bisaṃ mṛṇālaṃ cāpi śītatoyena pibet; bisaṃ bisendrakaṃ, mṛṇālaṃ padmanālam| kṣaudreṇa kṛṣṇāmiti madhunā saha pippalīṃ pibedityarthaḥ; anye lihediti manyante| sitayā ca pathyāmiti harītakīṃ śarkarayā saha pibedityarthaḥ||17||

lg.l: kuryāc ca nāsāvadanāvarodhaṃ kṣīraṃ pibed vā'py atha mānuṣīṇām |
mūrcchāṃ prasaktāṃ tu śirovirekair jayed abhīkṣṇaṃ vamanaiś ca tīkṣṇaiḥ ||18||

ab.seg: ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ kuryādityāha- kuryādityādi| nāsāvaktrayoravarodhena vyāghuṭyāntaḥ `agtaḥ pravṛddho' iti pā. praviṣṭo māruto ruddhāni srotāṃsi vivṛṇvan mūrcchāmapahanti; nārīkṣīraṃ cātiśītalatvāt| mūrcchāmityādi| prasaktāṃ bhūyo bhūyo'nusaṅginīm| śirovirekaiḥ nasyaiḥ| abhīkṣṇaṃ punaḥ punaḥ| yadyapi sarvamūrcchāyāṃ pittaṃ pradhānaṃ, tīkṣṇe nasyavamane na yukte'sya, tathā'pi sañjñāvahasrotonirodhaśāntikaratvād vyādhipratyanīkatvācca hite eva| kecit ‘tīkṣṇaiḥ’ ityatra ‘pathyaiḥ’ iti paṭhanti; tatra pittaśleṣmaharairityarthaḥ||18||

lg.l: harītakīkvāthaśṛtaṃ `harītakīkvāthaghṛtaṃ pibedvā' iti pā. ghṛtaṃ vā dhātrīphalānāṃ svarasaiḥ kṛtaṃ vā |
pibet kaṣāyāṇi ca gandhavanti pittajvaraṃ yāni śamaṃ nayanti |20|

div.ab: harītakīkvāthaśṛtamityādi| harītakīkvāthena śṛtaṃ siddhaṃ harītakīkvāthaśṛtam| dhātrīphalānām āmalakaphalānāṃ svarasaiḥ| drākṣāsitetyādi| yāni kaṣāyāṇi śrīparṇyādikṛtāni pittajvaraṃ śamaṃ nayanti tāni drākṣāsitādāḍimalājavanti tatpradhānāni pibet| nīlotpalapadmavanti nīlotpalapadmapradhānāni| gandhavanti gandhadravyāḍhyāni| nīlotpalapadmavantītyādikaṃ pittajvaraharakaṣāyaviśeṣaṇam||19||-

lg.l: prabhūtadoṣas tamaso 'tirekāt sammūrcchito naiva vibudhyate yaḥ ||20||
sannyastasañjño bhṛśaduścikitsyo jñeyas tadā buddhimatā manuṣyaḥ |21|

div.ab: idānīṃ mūrcchāyā avasthāyāṃ sañjñāntaramāha- prabhūtadoṣa ityādi| yaḥ prabhūtadoṣo manuṣyaḥ sammūrcchitaḥ san tamaso'tirekānnāvabudhyate nāvabodhaṃ prāpnoti sa duścikitsyo matimatā vaidyena sannyastasañjño jñeya iti piṇḍārthaḥ| sannyastasañjña iti mṛtyumukhe vartamānatvāt sannyasta iva sannyastaḥ||20||-

lg.l: yathā ''maloṣṭaṃ salile niṣiktaṃ samuddhared āśv avilīnam eva ||21||
tadvac cikitset tvarayā bhiṣak tam asvedanaṃ mṛtyuvaśaṃ prayātam |22|

div.ab: idānīṃ sannyastasya śīghraṃ pratīkārāya dṛṣṭāntamāha- yathā''maloṣṭamityādi| āmaloṣṭam āmamṛtpiṇḍam| taṃ sannyastasañjñam| asvedanaṃ prasvedarahitam||21||-

kaiścikitsedityāha- tīkṣṇāñjanābhyañjanetyādi| tīkṣṇaśabdo'ñjanādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| totrāṇi sūciprakārāṇi| vāditraṃ vīṇādi| anunayaḥ sāntvanāpūrvakaṃ `śāntipūrvakaṃ' iti pā. vacanādi| vighaṭṭanaiḥ vividhaprakāreṇa cālanaiḥ| guptaphalāvagharṣaiḥ kapikacchūphalāvagharṣaṇaiḥ| anye guptaphalaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ, tasyāvagharṣaṇaiḥ pīḍanairityarthaḥ| kecidvighaṭṭanairityatra ‘vismāpanaiḥ’ iti paṭhanti; tatra āścaryakārakairityarthaḥ| etairupacāraiḥ upācaret āsañjñāprāpteḥ||22||-

lg.l: ābhiḥ kriyābhiś ca na labdhasañjñaḥ sānāhalālāśvasanaś ca varjyaḥ ||23||

ab.seg: ābhiḥ kriyābhirityādi| ābhiḥ kriyābhiḥ anantaroktābhistīkṣṇāñjanādibhiḥ| sānāhalālāśvasanaśca ānāhādiyuktaḥ; śvasanaḥ śvāsa ityarthaḥ||23||

lg.l: saśarkarair māsam upakrameta viśeṣato jīrṇaghṛtaṃ sa pāyyaḥ ||24||

ab.seg: tīkṣṇāñjanādibhirlabdhasañjñe sannyāsini paścātkarmāha- prabuddhetyādi| tīkṣṇāñjanādibhiḥ prabuddhasañjñaṃ sannyāsinaṃ tīkṣṇairvamanānulomyairvamanavirecanairviśuddhaṃ, annasaṃsarjanakrameṇa ca laghupathyabhuktaṃ, triphalācitrakaśuṇṭhībhāvitaiḥ saśarkaraiḥ śilājatuprayogaiḥ vajrakavaṭakakalpanayā kalpitairmāsaṃ yāvadupakrameta, śeṣadoṣopaśamanārtham| jīrṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ daśābdikaṃ pāyyaḥ pāyayitavyaḥ||24||

yathāsvaṃ ca jvaraghnānīti yathāsvaṃ yathādoṣaṃ jvareṣu yāni kaṣāyāṇyuktāni tāni taddoṣajamūrcchāsvapi `sarvadoṣajamūrcchāsvapi' iti pā. yojyāni| viṣāpahamiti kalpasthānoktaṃ viṣamohaśamanaṃ nasyāñjanādikam||25||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre mūrcchāpratiṣedho nāma (aṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) ṣaṭcatvāriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||46||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantre ṣaṭcatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||46||

div.head: pānātyayapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ pānātyayapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

mūrcchāpratiṣedhānantaraṃ pittapradhānasāmyāt asaṃvittijanakasāmyācca pānātyayapratiṣedhārambho yukta ityata āha- athāta ityādi| pānātyaya ityatra ādiśabdo lupto jñeyaḥ, tena paramadādīnāṃ grahaṇam||1-2||

lg.l: madyam uṣṇaṃ tathā tīkṣṇaṃ sūkṣmaṃ viśadam eva ca |
rūkṣam āśukaraṃ caiva vyavāyi ca vikāśi ca ||3||

ab.seg: tatrādau madyaguṇapraṇayanaṃ `idānīṃ pūrva madyaguṇānāha'- iti pā., evaṅguṇamapi madyaṃ mithyopayuktaṃ pānātyayādikaṃ karotīti pratipādanārtham madyaguṇapratipādanaṃ' iti pā.| madyamityādi| āśukaraṃ śīghrakāri| vyavāyi sarvaṃ dehaṃ vyāpya paścāt pākaṃ yāti| vikāśi sandhibandhavimocakam| yadyapi sūtrasthāne madyaguṇā uktāstathā'pyadhikakhyāpanārthamatrāpyuktāḥ||3||

lg.l: auṣṇyāc chītopacāraṃ tat taikṣṇyād dhanti manogatim |
mārutaṃ kopayed raukṣyād āśutvāc cāśukarmakṛt `āśukāri tat' iti pā.|

ab.seg: madyaguṇānabhidhāya karmāṇyāha- auṣṇyādityādi| ‘auṣṇyācchītopacāram’ ityanena pittakopitvaṃ sūcitam| manogatiṃ bāhyādhyātmikāṃ karaṇaprāptim| avayavān hṛdayaujaḥprabhṛtīn| harṣadaṃ manoharṣakaraṃ; na tu puṃstvadaṃ, śukraharatvāt||4-5||

lg.l: tad amlaṃ rasataḥ proktaṃ laghu rocanadīpanam |
kecil lavaṇavarjyāṃs tu rasān atrādiśanti hi ||6||

ab.seg: madyasya karmābhidhāya rasamāha- tadamlaṃ rasata ityādi| tat madyam| amlam amlarasotkaṭaṃ, tena itare'pi pañcarasā anurasatvena madye boddhavyāḥ| tathā coktam,- “madyasya ṣaḍrasatve'pi vyakto'mlo rasa ucyate”- iti| ekīyamatamāha- kecillavaṇavarjyānityādi||6||

lg.l: snigdhais tadannair māṃsaiś ca bhakṣyaiś ca saha sevitam |

ab.seg: evaṅguṇamapi madyaṃ yathā sevyamānaṃ guṇāya bhavati tathā''ha snigdhaistadannairityādi| snigdhairityupalakṣaṇaṃ; tena itare'pi madyaviparītaguṇāḥ śītādayo jñeyāḥ| tat madyam| balāya ojase, upacayāya ca māṃsopacayāya||7||

lg.l: vidhivat sevyamāne tu madye sannihitā guṇāḥ ||8||

ab.seg: anantaroktavidhinā sevyamānena madyena kāmyatādayo'pi guṇā bhavantīti darśayannāha- kāmyatetyādi| kāmyatā kamanīyatvam| tejaḥ prabhā| sannihitāḥ samyagavasthitāḥ||8||

lg.l: kāyāgninā hy agnisamaṃ sametya kurute madam ||9||

ab.seg: vidhirahitaṃ sevyamānaṃ madyaṃ yat karoti tadāha- tadevānannamityādi| tadeva madyam, agnisamaṃ vahnitulyam, ajñena uktamadyapānavidhānānabhijñena, anannam annarahitam atimātrayā ca sevyamānaṃ, kāyāgninā jaṭharānalena, sametya militvā, madaṃ kurute iti piṇḍārthaḥ||9||

lg.l: madena karaṇānāṃ tu bhāvānyatve kṛte sati |

ab.seg: madenāvaśaḥ puruṣo yat karoti tadāha- madenetyādi| karaṇānāṃ manobuddhīndriyāṇāṃ, bhāvānyatve svarūpānyathātve kṛte sati, nigūḍhamapi saṃvṛtamapi, bhāvam abhiprāyaṃ, svam ātmīyaṃ prakāśīkurute prakaṭīkurute, avaśo madaparavaśa iti piṇḍārthaḥ||10||

lg.l: tryavasthaś ca mado jñeyaḥ pūrvo madhyo 'tha paścimaḥ |11|

div.ab: atha katiprakāro mada ityāha- tryavasthaścetyādi| tryavasthaḥ triprakāraḥ| te ca trayaḥ prakārāḥ pūrvādayaḥ|11|-

ab.seg: pūrvamadalakṣaṇamāha- pūrve ityādi| pūrve prathame made, vīryam utsāhalakṣaṇaṃ, ratiḥ harṣaḥ, prītiḥ tṛptiḥ, harṣaḥ tuṣṭiḥ; ādiśabdāt hāsyādayaḥ||11||

lg.l: pralāpo madhyame moho `harṣaḥ' iti pā. yuktāyuktakriyās tathā |12|

div.ab: madhyamadalakṣaṇamāha- pralāpa ityādi| yuktāyuktakriyā iti kadācidayuktāḥ kadācidyuktāḥ kriyā ityarthaḥ|12|-

ab.seg: paścimamadalakṣaṇamāha- visañjña ityādi| paścime paścimamade| naṣṭakarmakriyāguṇa iti naṣṭāni karmāṇi kriyāguṇāḥ kriyāphalāni ca yasya sa tathā; atra guṇaśabdaḥ phale vartate| kecit, ‘buddhismṛtiprītikaraḥ sukhaśca pānānnanidrārucivṛddhihetuḥ| sampāṭhagītasvaravardhanaśca prokto'tiramyaḥ prathamo mado hi|| avyaktabuddhismṛtivāgviceṣṭaḥ sonmattalīlākrutirapraśāntaḥ| ālasyanidrābhihato muhuśca madhyena mattaḥ puruṣo madena|| gacchedagamyāṃ na gurūṃśca manyet khādedabhakṣyāṇi ca naṣṭasañjñaḥ| brūyācca guhyāni hṛdisthitāni matto madena pravareṇa martyaḥ’ iti paṭhanti; vyākhyānayanti ca- avyaktabuddhismṛtivāgiti aspaṣṭabuddhismaraṇavacanaḥ; viceṣṭo vigatakāyaparispandaḥ, sonmattalīlākṛtiriti saha unmattalīlākṛtibhyāṃ vartate iti tathā unmattakrīḍākāra ityarthaḥ| ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ pūrvo vā paṭhanīyaḥ, na tu pāṭhadvayaṃ paṭhanīyam||12||

lg.l: ślaiṣmikān alpapittāṃś ca snigdhān mātropasevinaḥ `māṃsopasevinaḥ' iti pā.|
pānaṃ na bādhate 'tyarthaṃ viparītāṃs tu bādhate ||13||

ab.seg: idānīṃ puruṣaviśeṣeṇa sevyamānaṃ madyaṃ nātibādhāṃ kurute ityāha- ślaiṣmikānalpapittāṃścetyādi| viparītān pittādhikarūkṣātimātrasevinaḥ||13||

lg.l: nirbhaktam ekāntata eva madyaṃ niṣevyamāṇaṃ manujena nityam |
utpādayet kaṣṭatamān vikārān āpādayec cāpi śarīrabhedam ||14||

ab.seg: nirbhaktamekāntata eva madyamityādi| nirbhaktam āhārarahitam| śarīrabhedaṃ dehanāśam| yadyapyayamarthastadevānannamityādinaivoktaḥ tathā'pi nirbhaktamiti yadatra punaruktaṃ tannirbhaktapānasyātigarhitatvakhyāpanārtham||14||

lg.l: uṣṇābhitaptena ca sevyamānaṃ karoti madyaṃ vividhān vikārān ||26||

ab.seg: idānīṃ kruddhādibhiḥ sevyamānaṃ madyaṃ vikārān janayatīti pratipādayitumāha- kruddhenetyādi| vyāyāmabhārādhvaparikṣateneti vyāyāmādibhiḥ parikhinnenetyarthaḥ| abhihatena pīḍitena| atyamlabhakṣyāvatatodareṇa atyamlabhakṣaṇāvṛtajaṭhareṇa||15-16||

lg.l: pānavibhramam ugraṃ ca teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam ||17||

ab.seg: ke te vividhā vikārāstānāha- pānātyayamityādi||17||

div.ab: idānīṃ pānātyayasya vātādibhedena lakṣaṇamāha- stambhetyādi| stambhaḥ stabdhatā|18|-

lg.l: ūṣmāṇam aṅgagurutāṃ virasānanatvaṃ śleṣmādhikatvam aruciṃ malamūtrasaṅgam ||19||
liṅgaṃ parasya tu madasya vadanti tajjñās tṛṣṇāṃ rujāṃ śirasi sandhiṣu cāpi bhedam |20|

div.ab: paramadalakṣaṇamāha- ūṣmāṇamityādi| virasānanatvaṃ virasamukhatvam| śleṣmādhikatvaṃ kaphotkarṣatvam `kaphautkaṭyaṃ' iti pā.| parasya tu madasya paramadasyetyarthaḥ| bhedamiti bheda iva bhedaḥ| paramadādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ doṣatrayajanitatvāt pṛthagdoṣaliṅgaṃ noktam||19||-

lg.l: ādhmānam udgiraṇam amlaraso vidāho 'jīrṇasya pānajanitasya vadanti liṅgam ||20||
jñeyāni tatra bhiṣajā suviniścitāni pittaprakopajanitāni ca kāraṇāni |21|

div.ab: pānājīrṇalakṣaṇamāha- ādhmānamityādi| udgiraṇaṃ chardiḥ| ajīrṇasya pānajanitasya pānājīrṇasya| kāraṇāni lakṣaṇāni, kāraṇasyāpi vyādhilakṣaṇatvāt||20||-

lg.l: dveṣaḥ surān navikṛteṣu ca teṣu teṣu taṃ pānavibhramam uśanty akhilena dhīrāḥ |22|

div.ab: pānavibhramalakṣaṇamāha- hṛdityādi| vamathuḥ chardiḥ, kaṇṭhadhūmaḥ kaṇṭhe dhūmodvamanamiva `dhūmodvahanamiva' iti ‘dhūmodgamanamiva’ iti ca pā., mūrdharujā śiraḥpīḍā||21||-

lg.l: hīnottarauṣṭham atiśītam amandadāhaṃ tailaprabhāsyam ati(pi)pānahataṃ vijahyāt ||22||
jihvauṣṭhadantam asitaṃ tv athavā'pi nīlaṃ pīte ca yasya nayane rudhiraprabhe ca |23|

div.ab: idānīmasādhyalakṣaṇamāha- hīnottarauṣṭhamityādi| hīnottarauṣṭhaḥ svabhāvauṣṭhādalpauṣṭhaḥ| amandadāhaṃ tīvradāham| kadācidatiśītaṃ kadācittīvradāham| pānahataṃ pānapīḍitam| vijahyāt tyajet| asitaṃ kṛṣṇam| pīte pītavarṇe||22||-

lg.l: hikkājvarau vamathuvepathupārśvaśūlāḥ kāsabhramāv api ca pānahataṃ bhajante ||23||

ab.seg: idānīmupadravānāha- hikkājvarāvityādi| vamathuḥ chardiḥ, vepathuḥ kampaḥ||23||

lg.l: teṣāṃ nivāraṇam idaṃ hi mayocyamānaṃ vyaktābhidhānam akhilena vidhiṃ nibodha |24|

div.ab: teṣāṃ nivāraṇamityādi| teṣāṃ pānātyayādīnām|24|-

lg.l: madyaṃ tu cukramaricārdrakadīpyakuṣṭhasauvarcalāyutam alaṃ `dīpyakāḍhyaṃ' iti pā. pavanasya śāntyai ||24||
pṛthvīkadīpyakamahauṣadhahiṅgubhir vā sauvarcalena ca yutaṃ vitaret sukhāya |25|

div.ab: tameva vidhimāha- madyamityādi| dīpyakaḥ ajamodā, yavānītyapare| sauvarcalāyutam īṣatsauvarcalayuktam| alaṃ samartham| pavanasya vātajamadātyayasya| vitaret dadyāt||24||-

lg.l: āmrātakāmraphaladāḍimamātuluṅgaiḥ kuryāc chubhāny api ca ṣāḍavapānakāni ||25||
seveta vā phalarasopahitān rasādīn ānūpavargapiśitāny api gandhavanti |26|

div.ab: kiṃ madātyaye madyameva sevyamutānyadapītyāha- āmrātakāmretyādi| dāḍimamatra amlameva| ṣāḍavo yūṣaviśeṣaḥ| āmrātakādibhiḥ kvathitairikṣuvikārayutaiḥ ṣāḍavaḥ kāryaḥ| tathā ca tantrāntare ṣāḍavakalpanā,- “yutamikṣuvikāreṇa kvathitaṃ cūtajaṃ phalam| ghṛtaśuṇṭhītilayutaṃ vijñeyo ghanaṣāḍavaḥ”- iti| phalarasopahitān mātuluṅgarasayuktān| rasādīn māṃsarasayūṣādīn| ānūpavargapiśitāni kūlacarādivargamāṃsāni| gandhavantīti prabhūtahiṅgujīrakādiyutāni||25||-

lg.l: pittātmake madhuravargakaṣāyamiśraṃ madyaṃ hitaṃ samadhuśarkaram iṣṭagandham ||26||

ab.seg: pittajamadātyayacikitsāmāha- pittātmake madhuravargakaṣāyamiśramityādi| madhuravargo guḍūcīvarjitaḥ kākolyādiḥ, tantrāntarasaṃvādāt| iṣṭagandham elātvakpatrakādyaiḥ surabhīkṛtam||26||

lg.l: pītvā ca madyam api cekṣurasapragāḍhaṃ niḥśeṣataḥ kṣaṇam avasthitam ullikhec ca |
lāvaiṇatittirirasāṃś ca pibed anamlān maudgān sukhāya saghṛtān sasitāṃś ca yūṣān ||27||

ab.seg: pittātmake madātyaye vamanamāha- pītvetyādi| ullikhet vamet| yadyapi pitte vamanaṃ na kāryaṃ tathā'pi pittasya kaphasthānagatatvādvamanaṃ hitameva, vyādhipratyanīkatvādvā| kiṃ pittātmake etadeva kāryamutānyadapītyāha- lāvaiṇatittirirasānityādi| kecit ‘maudgān sukhāya saghṛtān sasitāṃśca yūṣān’ ityatra ‘maudgān saśarkaraghṛtān sa hitāya yūṣān’ iti paṭhanti; sa iti pittapānātyayīti ca vyākhyānayanti||27||

lg.l: pānātyaye kaphakṛte kapham ullikhec ca madyena bimbividulodakasaṃyutena |
seveta tiktakaṭukāṃś ca rasān udārān yūṣāṃś ca tiktakaṭukopahitān hitāya ||28||

ab.seg: kaphajamadātyayacikitsāmāha- pānātyaye kaphakṛte ityādi| bimbī oṣṭhopamaphalā vidulo vetasaḥ| kaphamadātyaye'paramapyauṣadhamāha- sevetetyādi| tiktakaṭukān tiktakaṭukadravyasaṃskṛtān| rasān māṃsarasān; udārān jāṅgalajān, medaskānityarthaḥ| yūṣān mudgādiyūṣān| tiktāni durālabhādīni, kaṭukāni pippalyādīni, upahitān saṃskṛtān||28||

lg.l: pathyaṃ yavānnavikṛtāni ca jāṅgalāni śleṣmaghnam anyad api yac ca niratyayaṃ syāt |29|

div.ab: śleṣmajapānātyaye'paramapi yaddhitaṃ tadāha- pathyamityādi| pathyaṃ hitam| yavānnavikṛtāni yavānnāni vividhaprakāraiḥ kṛtānītyarthaḥ| atra annaśabdaḥ peyalehyavyavacchedakaḥ| jāṅgalāni jāṅgalamāṃsāni| niratyayaṃ nirdoṣam|29|-

lg.l: kuryāc ca sarvam atha sarvabhave vidhānaṃ dvandvodbhave dvayam avekṣya yathāpradhānam ||29||

ab.seg: sannipātajadvandvajamadātyayacikitsāmāha- kuryādityādi| sarvaṃ pratyekadoṣajapānātyayacikitsitam| sarvabhave sannipātodbhave| dvandvabhave dvandvaje| yathāpradhānaṃ yogapradhānamityarthaḥ; etena samasannipāte sarvapradhānaṃ kāryam, ekatamādhike ca tatpradhānamityarthaḥ; evaṃ dvandvaje'pi||29||

lg.l: sāmānyam anyad api yac ca samagram agryaṃ vakṣyāmi yac ca manaso madakṛt sukhaṃ ca |30|

div.ab: sāmānyamanyadapītyādi| anyadapi yat sāmānyaṃ manaso harṣakṛt vakṣyāmi tat samagramapi sarveṣāmagryaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sukhaṃ ca, sukhahetutvādityarthaḥ|30|-

lg.l: tvaṅgāgapuṣpamagadhailamadhūkadhānyaiḥ ślakṣṇair ajājimaricaiś ca kṛtaṃ samāṃśaiḥ ||30||
pānaṃ kapittharasavāriparūṣakāḍhyaṃ pānātyayeṣu vidhivat srutam ambarānte |
piṣṭaiḥ sapadmakayutair api sārivādyaiḥ sekaṃ jalaiś ca vitared amalaiḥ suśītaiḥ |
drākṣāyutaṃ hṛtamalaṃ madirāmayārtais tat pānakaṃ śuci sugandhi narair niṣevyam |
piṣṭvā pibec ca madhukaṃ kaṭurohiṇīṃ ca drākṣāṃ ca mūlam asakṛt trapuṣībhavaṃ yat ||33||
kārpāsinīm atha `kārpāsamūlamatha' iti pā. ca nāgabalāṃ ca tulyāṃ pītvā sukhī bhavati sādhu suvarcalāṃ ca |34|

div.ab: pānātyayacikitsāmāha- tvagityādi| nāgapuṣpaṃ nāgakeśaram, elā sūkṣmailā, ajājī uttarāpathe prasiddho jīrakaviśeṣaḥ| samāṃśaiḥ tulyabhāgaiḥ| pānaṃ pānakam| kapittharasaḥ kapitthasvarasaḥ| srutaṃ gālitam| ambarānte vastrānte| hrīveretyādi| hrīverādiyuktaiḥ karavīrajalodbhavaiḥ puṣpaiḥ piṣṭairvilipya padmakayutaiḥ sārivādibhiśca pralipya, amalaiḥ suśītaiśca jalaiḥ sekaṃ vitaret dadyāditi piṇḍārthaḥ| hrīveraḥ vālakam| padmakaṃ padmakāṣṭhaṃ, jalodbhavapuṣpatvena padmasya parigrahāt| kārtikakuṇḍastu ‘sapadmakayutaiḥ’ ityanena padmakasahitapriyaṅgvādyabhidhāya tena yuktaiḥ karavīrādipuṣpairhrīberādiyuktairiti vyākhyānayati, padmakaṃ jalajaṃ manyate| paripelavo vanyakaḥ| jalodbhavaiḥ nīlotpalaprabhṛtibhiḥ| sapadmakayutairapi sārivādyairiti sapadmakaḥ padmakasahitaḥ priyaṅgvādiḥ, tena yutaiḥ sārivādibhirityarthaḥ| tvagityādi|- tvak vanavāsikātvak| śleṣmātakaprasavaṃ bahuvārapuṣpam| hṛtamalaṃ vastragālitam| madirāmayārtaiḥ pānātyayapīḍitaiḥ| sugandhiśobhanagandhi| kecit tvakpatraśabdena tvakpatrikāmāhuḥ| piṣṭvetyādi| asakṛditi sādhviti ca padaṃ piṣṭvetyatra sambandhanīyam| madhukādistrapusīmūlānta eko yogaḥ| kārpāsinīmityādiḥ sādhusuvarcalāṃ cetyanto dvitīyaḥ| kārpāsinī vanakārpāsinī| suvarcalā sūryabhaktā| kārpāsinīmatha cetyatra kārpāsamevamatheti kecit paṭhanti, kārpāsaṃ kārpāsīmūlaṃ, evamasakṛt piṣṭveti ca vyākhyānayanti||30-33||-

lg.l: kāśmaryadāruviḍadāḍimapippalīṣu drākṣānvitāsu kṛtam ambuni pānakaṃ yat ||34||
tad bījapūrakarasāyutam āśu pītaṃ śāntiṃ parāṃ paramade tv acirāt karoti |35|

div.ab: paramade cikitsāmāha- kāśmaryetyādi| kāśmaryaṃ gambhārīphalaṃ, kṛtaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ, ambuni pānīye||34||-

lg.l: drākṣāsitāmadhukajīrakadhānyakṛṣṇāsv evaṃ kṛtaṃ trivṛtayā ca pibet tathaiva ||35||
sauvarcalāyutam udārarasaṃ phalāmlaṃ bhārgīśṛtena ca jalena hito 'vasekaḥ ||36||

ab.seg: paramade pānakāntaramāha- drākṣetyādi| drākṣādiṣu dravyeṣu evaṃ bījapūrakarasasaṃskāreṇa kṛtaṃ pānakaṃ trivṛtayā trijaṭayā ca kṛtaṃ pānakaṃ pibet| tathaiva sauvarcalāyutamityādi|- udārarasaṃ jāṅgalamāṃsarasaṃ, sauvarcalāyutam īṣatsauvarcalāyutaṃ, dāḍimādyamlaphalenāmlaṃ tathaiva pibedityarthaḥ| avasekaḥ pariṣekaḥ||35-36||

lg.l: vipācya tasyāñjalinā vamed dhi madyaṃ pibec cāhni gate tv ajīrṇe ||37||

ab.seg: pānājīrṇacikitsāmāha- ikṣvākvityādi| ikṣvākvādīni dravyāṇi kṣīrapākavidhānena dugdhe vipācya tasya kuḍavenājīrṇe pānājīrṇe vameta, tataśca ahni divase gate atīte sati madyaṃ pibet agnidīpanārtham| ikṣākuḥ tiktālābūḥ| dhāmārgavaḥ pītaghoṣaḥ| vṛkṣakaḥ kuṭajaphalam| kākāhvayā udumbarikāgo(kā)ṣṭhodumbarikā| anye gate tvajīrṇe apagate pānājīrṇe iti vyākhyānayanti||37||

lg.l: hṛdyaiḥ khaḍair api ca bhojanam atra śastaṃ... |39|

div.ab: kimmayaṃ madyaṃ pānājīrṇe pibedityāha- tvagityādi| tvakpippalīprabhṛtiyutaṃ madyaṃ seveta, tathā hiṅgumaricādiyutaṃ madyaṃ seveta| bhujagapuṣpaṃ nāgapuṣpam| phalāmlaṃ dāḍimabījapūrakādibhiramlīkṛtaṃ madyam| uṣṇāmbusaindhavayutā ityādi| atrāpi seveteti sambadhyate| magadhāphalamūlamiti pippalyāḥ phalamūlamityarthaḥ| bhojanamāha- hṛdyairityādi| khaḍā yūṣaviśeṣāḥ| atra pānājīrṇe| ‘hṛdyaiḥ’ ityatra ‘madyaiḥ’ ityanye paṭhanti| apare ‘khaḍaiḥ’ ityatra ‘phalaiḥ’ iti paṭhanti| ‘viḍatvak’ ityatra ‘yathoktaṃ’ iti kecit paṭhanti||38||-

lg.l: tat pānavibhramaharaṃ madhuśarkarāḍhyam āmrātakolarasapānakam eva cāpi ||39||
kharjūravetrakakarīraparūṣakeṣu `kharjūravetrakaravīraparūṣakeṣu' iti pā. drākṣātrivṛtsu ca kṛtaṃ sasitaṃ himaṃ vā |
śrīparṇiyuktam athavā tu pibed imāni yaṣṭyāhvayotpalahimāmbuvimiśritāni ||40||

ab.seg: pānavibhramacikitsāmāha- drākṣākapitthetyādi| atra phalaśabdena viśiṣṭāni mātuluṅgādiphalāni gṛhyante| na kevalaṃ drākṣādipānakaṃ madhuśarkarāḍhyaṃ pānavibhrame śastam, āmrātakolarasapānakamapi| athavā kharjūrādiṣu kṛtaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ saśarkaraṃ śrīparṇīyuktaṃ himaṃ pānakaṃ pānavibhrame śastam| karīro marudeśajaḥ, tasya phalam| śrīparṇīyuktaṃ kāśmarīphalayuktam| athavetyādi|- athavā imāni kṣīripravālādīni dāḍimāntāni yaṣṭyāhvayotpalahimāmbuvimiśritāni atra pānavibhrame pibet| yaṣṭyāhvayotpalahimāmbuvimiśritānīti yaṣṭīmadhunīlotpalayuktaṃ yat himāmbu tena vimiśritānītyarthaḥ| kṣīripravālā vaṭādipallavāḥ| bhavyaṃ tālaphalapramāṇam uttarāpathajam, anye karmaraṅgamāhuḥ||39-41||

lg.l: sūkṣmāmbarasrutahimāṃśca sugandhigandhān pānodbhavān nudati saptagadān aśeṣān ||42||

ab.seg: idānīṃ pānātyayādīnāṃ cikitsāmāha- sevetetyādi| rasān māṃsarasān| samagrān sampūrṇān; sampūrṇatvaṃ caiṣāṃ maricādibhiḥ sarvairevānvitatvam| sūkṣmāmbarasrutahimān sūkṣmavastragālitaśītānityarthaḥ| sugandhigandhān atyarthamagurvādidhūpitān| nudati sphoṭayati| pānodbhavān saptagadān catvāro madātyayāḥ, trayaśca paramadapānājīrṇapānavibhramāḥ, pānātyayaprabhavatvātteṣāṃ; evaṃ sapta||42||

lg.l: pañcendriyārthaviṣayā mṛdupānayogā hṛdyāḥ sukhāś ca manasaḥ satataṃ niṣevyāḥ `niyojyāḥ' iti pā.|

ab.seg: evaṃ pānātyayādīnāṃ cikitsitamabhidhāyādhunā pānātyayacikitsāmevāha- pañcendriyārthaviṣayā ityādi| pañcendriyārthaviṣayā iti pañcendriyārthāḥ śabdasparśarūparasagandhāḥ, teṣāṃ viṣayāḥ karaṇāni| mṛdupānayogāḥ mṛdumadyayogāḥ; te ca paiṣṭikagauḍikamādhvīkādayaḥ| hṛdyā hṛdayahitā hṛdayapriyāśca| sukhāḥ sukhakarāḥ| vikaṭorunitambavatyaḥ vikaṭau śreṣṭhau vistīrṇau vā ūrūyāsāṃ tā vikaṭoravaḥ, nitambavatyaḥ śreṣṭhanitambāḥ; yasmādatra praśaṃsāyāṃ vatuppratyayaḥ| pīnonnatastanabharānatamadhyadeśāḥ pīnonnatastanabhareṇa ānata īṣannamro madhyadeśo yāsāṃ tāstathā| prauḍhāḥ kāmakṣamāḥ| pañcaviṣayāḥ śabdādyatiśayāḥ, ta eva svabhāvo yāsāṃ tāstathā| śrībrahmadevastu pañcānāṃ viṣayāṇāmatiśayena sva ātmīyo bhāvo'bhiprāyo `bhāvaḥ sattā' iti pā. yāsāṃ tāstathā| ‘pañcendriyārthaviṣayātiśayasvabhāvā `...svabhāvāt' iti pā. ’ ityanye paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- pañcendriyārthaviṣayāṇāṃ śabdādīnāmatiśayo yāsāṃ tāstathetyarthaḥ||43-44||

lg.l: sañcūrṇya saṃyojya ca nāgapuṣpair ajājikṛṣṇāmaricaiś ca tulyaiḥ ||45||

ab.seg: aparaṃ pānātyaye kiṃ kāryamityāha- pibedrasaṃ puṣpaphalodbhavamityādi| puṣpaphalodbhavaṃ kūṣmāṇḍodbhavam| madhūko guḍapuṣpaḥ| trisugandhi trijātakam||45||

lg.l: drākṣāṃ ca kṛṣṇām atha keśaraṃ ca kṣīre samāloḍya pibet sukhepsuḥ `sukhoṣṇam' iti pā.||46||

ab.seg: varṣābhūyaṣṭyāhvetyādi| varṣābhūprabhṛtīni keśarāntāni kṣīre samāloḍya sukhepsuḥ puruṣaḥ pibediti piṇḍārthaḥ| varṣābhūḥ śvetapunarnavā, tvak cocaṃ, karbudārāṅkurāḥ kāñcanārāṅkurāḥ||46||

lg.l: bhavec ca madyena tu yena pātitaḥ prakāmapītena surāsavādinā |
tad eva tasmai vidhivat pradāpayed viparyaye bhraṃśam avaśyam ṛcchati `bhraṃśamasau ca gacchati' iti pā.||47||

ab.seg: madātyayeṣu sāmānyamadyapāne ukte'pi viśeṣavidhimāha- bhavedityādi| yena surāsavādinā madyena prakāmapītena puruṣaḥ pātito bhavet, tadeva surāsavādikaṃ madyaṃ tasmai puruṣāya vidhivat sauvarcalādiyuktaṃ pradāpayet| kasmāttadeva tasmai pradāpayedityāha- viparyaya ityādi| yasmādviparyaye kṛte asau puruṣo, bhraṃśaṃ kleśaṃ, ṛcchati prāpnoti, tasmāttadeva madyaṃ tasmai pradāpayedityarthaḥ||47||

lg.l: yathā narendropahatasya kasyacid bhavet prasādas tata eva nānyataḥ |
dhruvaṃ tathā madyahatasya dehino bhavet prasādas tata eva nānyataḥ ||48||

ab.seg: madyapīḍitasya puṃso yathā madyādeva svāsthyaṃ syāttathā dṛṣṭāntamāha- yathetyādi| tata iti narendrādityarthaḥ| dvitīyatataḥśabdena madyaṃ parāmṛśyate||48||

idānīmanuktasaṅgrahāyāha- vicchinnamadya ityādi| vicchinnamadyaḥ tyaktamadyaḥ| sahasā avimṛśyaiva| pānātyayoddiṣṭā dhvaṃsakādayaḥ| tathā ca tantrāntaram,- “vicchinnamadyaḥ sahasā yo'timadyaṃ niṣevate| bhavetāṃ mārutāt kaṣṭau tasya dhvaṃsakavikṣayau”- ityādi||49||

madyapānādyathā tṛṣṇotpattistathā''ha- madyasyetyādi| āgneyavāyavyau guṇau taikṣṇyarūkṣau| ambuvahāni srotāṃsītyatrāmbuvahasrotaḥśabdenāmbu kathyate, upacārāt| anye tu vyākhyānayanti- yaiḥ srotobhirudakaṃ vahanti tānyeva srotāṃsi tau tīkṣṇarūkṣau guṇau śoṣayitvā tata ādhārasrotaḥśoṣāttadāśrayasyāmbuno'pi śoṣaḥ, tena hetunā madyenāpi tṛṣopajāyate| ‘madyasya’ ityādipāṭhasthāne kecit ‘madyamāgneyabhāvāt’ ityādi pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti, sa cābhāvānna likhitaḥ||50||

madyajatṛṣṇācikitsāmāha- pāṭaletyādi| pāṭalā sugandhipuṣpavṛkṣaḥ, utpalavyaktibahutvāt kandeṣviti bahutvamuktam| tatreti tṛṣṇāyām| himaḥ tuṣāraḥ, tadvacchītalaṃ himaśītalam| pāṭalādisādhitamambho himaśītalaṃ pippalīcūrṇamiśraṃ tṛṣṇāyāṃ pibediti piṇḍārthaḥ||51||

div.ab: tṛṣṇāyāṃ kvāthamabhidhāyopacārārthaṃ snehamāha- sarpistailavasāmajjetyādi| bhṛṅgaraso bhṛṅgarājarasaḥ| bilvaṃ bilvaphalam| yavāḥ prasiddhāḥ| sarvagandhā elādipaṭhitāḥ| peṣitāḥ kalkīkṛtāḥ| dadhibhṛṅgarasairiti dvibhedabhinnabhṛṅgāpekṣayā rasasyāpi dvividhatvaṃ, tato bahuvacanam| dadhnā bhṛṅgarasena bilvayavayoḥ kvāthena pratyekaṃ caturguṇena sarvagandhaiḥ kalkīkṛtaiḥ snehacaturthāṃśaiḥ sarpistailaṃ vasā majjeti catuḥsnehaṃ pakvamabhyañjane śastamiti sambandhaḥ| anye'tra majjāsthāne dugdhaṃ paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- tailavaseti yadyapi dravadravyamadhye tailavase paṭhite tathā'pi snehasya snehāntareṇāsaṃskārāt sarpistailavaseti snehasya trayaṃ dugdhādicaturdravaiḥ pakvamabhyañjane śastamiti||52||-

abhyañjanasnehamabhidhāya sekamāha- seke kvātha ityādi| seke pariṣeke| kvāthaśca śītala iti madhuraśītadravyakṛto himasannibhaḥ| etāvabhyaṅgasekau satṛṣi madātyaye kāryau; anye madyajatṛṣṇāyāmevābhyaṅgasekāvicchanti|53|

satṛṣi madātyaye bhojyāni nirdiśannāha- rasavantītyādi| rasavanti pracuramadhurarasāni| bhojyāni bhaktāni| yathāsvaṃ yathādoṣapratyanīkamiti; etena yadbhojyaṃ yasya doṣasya pratyanīkaṃ taddoṣaje satṛṣi madātyaye tadbhojyamavacārayedityarthaḥ| pānakāni drākṣādāḍimādikṛtāni| hṛdyāni manaḥpriyāṇi| surabhīṇi karpūrādyadhivāsitāni||53||-

lg.l: dāhaṃ prakurute ghoraṃ pittavat tatra bheṣajam ||54||

ab.seg: idānīṃ madyoṣmaṇo dāhakāritvamatideśena tajjanyadāhasya cikitsitaṃ ca ślokenāha- tvacamityādi| pānoṣmā madyapānoṣmā| pittaraktābhimūrcchitaḥ pittaraktasampṛktaḥ| ghoraṃ bhayāvaham| pittavattatra bheṣajaṃ madhuraśītādi| ‘pānoṣmā’ ityatra ‘madyoṣmā’ iti kecit paṭhanti||54||

lg.l: śītaṃ vidhānam ata ūrdhvam ahaṃ pravakṣye dāhapraśāntikaram ṛddhimatāṃ narāṇām |
śītāmbuśītalataraiś ca śayānam enaṃ `śayānamevaṃ' iti pā. hārair mṛṇālavalayair abalāḥ spṛśeyuḥ |
bhinnotpalojjvalahime śayane śayīta patreṣu vā sajalabinduṣu padminīnām ||56||

ab.seg: dāhapratīkāramatideśenābhidhāyeśvarāṇāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ viśiṣṭaṃ pratīkāramāha- śītamityādi| tatreti dāhe| ādita iti ādau| malayajeneti surabhicandanena `śvetacandanena' iti pā.| pradehaḥ pratanurlepaḥ| malayajaviśeṣaṇamāha- candrāṃśuhāratuhinodakaśītaleneti|- hāro muktāhāraḥ, tuhinodakaṃ himapānīyaṃ, tadvacchītalenetyarthaḥ| anye ‘cadrāṃśuhārahimanirmalaśītalena’ iti, apare ‘candrāṃśuhārakarakāhimaśītalena’ iti paṭhanti| karakāḥ sphaṭikaguṭikākārā vṛṣṭijalajāḥ pāṣāṇāḥ, himaṃ tuṣāraḥ, śeṣaṃ samam| śītāmbuśītalataraiḥ śītodakavadatiśayaśītalaiḥ| etadviśeṣaṇaṃ hārairmṛṇālavalayairityanayoḥ| ‘śītāmbuśītalakaraiḥ’ ityanye; śītāmbuvat śītalahastaiḥ| śayānaṃ viśrāntaṃ na tu svapantaṃ, tādṛgdāhārtasya nidrāyā asambhavāt| anye ‘mṛṇālavalayaiḥ’ ityatra ‘tuṣāravimalaiḥ’ iti paṭhitvā hārairityasya viśeṣaṇaṃ manyante| abalāḥ prauḍhastriyaḥ| spṛśeyuḥ sparśanaṃ kuryuḥ| dāhārtasya sukhotpādanāya śayanamāha- bhinnotpalojjvalahime iti|- praphullanīlotpalojjvalaśītale evaṃvidhe śayane śayīta| pakṣāntaramāha- patreṣu vetyādi| sajalabinduṣu padminīnāṃ patreṣu vā śayīteti sambandhaḥ||55-56||

lg.l: āsādayan pavanam āhṛtam aṅganābhiḥ `pavanamāhṛtamiṣṭagandhaṃ' iti pā. kahlārapadmadalaśaivalasañcayeṣu |
kāntair vanāntapavanaiḥ `śītairvanāntapavanaiḥ' iti pā. parimṛśyamānaḥ śaktaś cared bhavanakānanadīrghikāsu `prītaḥ' iti pā.||57||

ab.seg: kiṃ kurvan śayītetyāha- āsādayannityādi| āsādayan prāpnuvan| kaṃ? pavanaṃ| kimbhūtam? āhṛtam ānītam| aṅganābhiḥ strībhiḥ; vyañjanādibhiḥ `vyañjanādinimittatvenetyūhyam' iti pā. kṛtvetyūhyam| kahlārapadmadalaśaivalasañcayeṣu śayīteti sambadhyate| kahlāraṃ saugandhikotpalam| anye ‘sañcayeṣu’ ityatra ‘sañcayebhyaḥ’ iti paṭhitvā kahlārapadmadalaśaivalasañcayebhyo'balābhirāhṛtamiti sambadhnanti| evaṃvidhaiḥ śayanairāhlāditaḥ san kiṃ kuryādityāha- kāntairityādi| kāntaiḥ kamanīyairmṛduśītasugandhibhiḥ, vanāntapavanaiḥ āmrādivāṭikāsamīpavātaiḥ, parimṛśyamānaḥ spṛśyamānaḥ, śaktaḥ samarthaḥ san, caret bhramet| kāsu bhavanakānanadīrghikāsu gṛhodyānasasopānapuṣkariṇīṣu| anye ‘kāntaiḥ’ ityatra ‘śītaiḥ’ iti, ‘vanāntapavanaiḥ’ ityatra ‘jalāntapavanaiḥ’, ‘parimṛśyamāna’ ityatra ‘parimṛjyamānaḥ,’ ‘śaktaḥ’ ityatra ‘prītaḥ’ iti paṭhanti||57||

lg.l: dāhābhibhūtamathavā pariṣecayet tu `pariṣecayettaṃ' iti pā. lāmajjakāmburuhacandanatoyatoyaiḥ `lāmajjakāmburuhacandanatoyatoyraiḥ' iti, `śītairuśīrajalacandanavāribhistam' iti ca pā.|
visrāvitāṃ hṛtamalāṃ navavāripūrṇāṃ padmotpalākulajalām adhivāsitāmbum `adhivāsitāṃ ca' iti pā.||58||

div.ab: dāhābhibhūtamityādi| athavā tamāturaṃ dāhapīḍitaṃ pariṣecayet| kaiḥ? lāmajjaketyādibhiḥ; lāmajjakaṃ parvatodbhūtamūlaṃ, anye uśīramāhuḥ; amburuhaṃ padmotpalādikaṃ; candanamatra śvetaṃ, tasyaiva dāhaharatvāt; toyaṃ vālakaṃ; eṣāṃ toyaiḥ kvāthaiḥ| visrāvitāmiti niḥsāritapūrvapānīyām| hṛtamalām ākṛṣṭapaṅkādikām, navavāripūrṇām aparanirmalajalabhṛtāṃ; padmotpalākulajalāṃ padmam īṣacchuklaṃ, utpalāni nīlotpalāni, tairvyāptajalām| adhivāsitāmbuṃ pracuracandanādiprakṣepeṇa sugandhitajalām| evaṃvidhāṃ vāpīṃ bhajeta seveta, ‘dāhārta ātura’ iti śeṣaḥ| kimbhūtaḥ san? candanabhūṣitāṅgaḥ śvetacandanānuliptagātraḥ| punaḥ kimbhūtaḥ? kāntetyādiviśeṣaṇayuktaḥ||58||-

lg.l: tatrainam amburuhapatrasamaiḥ spṛśantyaḥ śītaiḥ karoruvadanaiḥ kaṭhinaiḥ stanaiś ca ||59||
toyāvagāhakuśalā madhurasvabhāvāḥ saṃharṣayeyur abalāḥ sukalaiḥ `madhuraiḥ' iti `kuśalaiḥ' iti ca pā. pralāpaiḥ |60|

div.ab: tatra tasyāṃ vāpyam| enaṃ dāhārtam| amburuhaṃ kamalaṃ, tasya patrasamaiḥ patratulyaiḥ; etacca śītaiḥ karoruvadanairityasya viśeṣaṇam| ‘vadanaiḥ’ ityatra ‘jaghanaiḥ’ ityanye| madhurasvabhāvā mṛdupracārāḥ| sukalaiḥ pralāpaiḥ śobhanakalāyuktaiḥ prakṛṣṭavacanaiḥ| tatra vāpyamevaṃvidhaiḥ karoruvadanaiḥ stanaiśca kaṭhinaiḥ spṛśantyo'balāḥ prauḍhastriyastoyāvagāhakuśalā mṛdupracārāḥ sukalaiḥ pralāpairenaṃ dāhārtaṃ saṃharṣayeyuḥ tuṣṭimutpādayeyuriti sambandhaḥ||59||-

dhārāgṛhe ityādi| pragalitaṃ galituṃ pravṛttaṃ yadudakaṃ tena durdinasyeva ābhā yasya tattathā| klānto glāniyuktaḥ, ‘ātura’ iti śeṣaḥ| salilena miśrito'nilaḥ salilānilastena śītaḥ kukṣirabhyantaraṃ yasya tat tatra| ‘sajalāmbudaśītakukṣau’ ityanye paṭhanti; tatra sajalameghavacchītābhyantarapradeśe| gandhodakaiḥ elādigandhadravyakaṣāyaiḥ| sakusumaiḥ jātīkusumādiyutaiḥ| anye ‘sakusumairupasiktabhūmau’ ityatra ‘paṭubhirukṣitabhūmibhāge’ iti paṭhanti; tatra elādikaṣāyaiḥ paṭubhirvyaktagandhaiḥ sikto bhūmipradeśo yatra| patraṃ patrakam, ambu vālakaṃ, candanaṃ śvetacandanaṃ; raso'tra kvāthaḥ| kuḍyaṃ bhittiḥ| eteṣāmeva kalkakvāthābhyāmupaliptabhittike| ‘upadigdhakuḍye’ ityanye; tatrāpyeka evārthaḥ| jātī prasiddhā, utpalaṃ nīlotpalaṃ, priyako bījakaḥ, keśaro bakulaḥ, puṇḍarīkaṃ śvetapadmaṃ, punnāgo devavallabhaḥ svanāmaprasiddhaḥ, nāgaṃ nāgakeśaraṃ, karavīro'tra raktakaravīraḥ, atraiteṣāṃ puṣpāṇi grāhyāṇi; taiḥ kṛtopacāre kṛtaracanāviśeṣe dhāragṛhe| anye tvevaṃ paṭhanti- ‘māṃsītamālatṛṇakuṅkumapadmapatrajātyutpalāgrakaravīrakṛtopakāre’ iti| tamālaṃ patrakaṃ, tṛṇaṃ sugandhitṛṇaṃ, padmapatrakaṃ kamalapatraṃ, jātyutpale pūrvavat, agrakaravīro raktakaravīraḥ, śeṣaṃ samamiti| tasmin gṛhe dhārāgṛhe| kamalareṇvaruṇe kamaladhūlīvadraktāṅge iti dhārāgṛhaviśeṣaṇam| yatnāhṛtānilavikampitapuṣpadāmni prakārāntarānītavacālitapuṣpamālāyukte `prakārāntarapreritavātacālitapuṣpamālāyukte' iti pā.||60-61||-

lg.l: udbhinnanīlanalināmburuhākarāṇāṃ candrodayasya ca kathāḥ śṛṇuyān manojñāḥ |
mlānaṃ pratāntamanasaṃ manaso 'nukūlāḥ pīnastanorujaghanā haricandanāṅgyaḥ `ghanasāradigdhāḥ' iti pā.||63||
tā enam ārdravasanāḥ saha saṃviśeyuḥ śliṣṭvā'balāḥ śithilamekhalahārayaṣṭyaḥ ||64||

ab.seg: evaṃvidhe dhārāgṛhe śayānaḥ kiṃ kuryādityāha- hemantetyādi| hemantaḥ ṛtuḥ; malayāntairacalaśabdaḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate, tenātra vindhyavanādiparihāraḥ `hemantādibhirmalayāntairacalaśabdaḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate, tena hemantartuvindhyavanādiparihāraḥ' iti pā.| teṣāṃ viśeṣaṇatrayamāha- śītāmbhasāṃ śītapānīyānām| sakadalīharitadrumāṇāṃ kadalīharitavṛkṣasahitānām| udbhinnanīlanalināmburuhākarāṇām udbhinnāni vikasitāni nīlanalināni nīlotpalāni amburuhāṇi puṇḍarīkaraktotpalādīni teṣāmākarāḥ tadyuktajalāśayāḥ te ut ūrdhvapradeśe yeṣāmityarthaḥ; teṣāmevaṃvidhānāṃ parvatānāṃ manojñāḥ kathāḥ śṛṇuyāt| candrodayasya ceti kathāḥ śṛṇuyādityarthaḥ| manojñā manonukūlāḥ| evamapi sukhamanāpnuvantaṃ kathamupācaredityāha- mlānamityādi| mlānaṃ glāniyuktam| pratāntamanasaṃ dīnamanaskam| pīnāni māṃsalāni stanorujaghanāni yāsāṃ tāstathā; jaghanaṃ strīkaṭyagrabhāgaḥ| haricandanāṅgyaḥ raktacandanānuliptāḥ; anye ‘ghanasāradigdhā’ iti paṭhanti, tatra candanānuliptāḥ| tā iti abalā ityarthaḥ| enaṃ dāhārtimantam| ārdravasanā ārdravastrāḥ `snigdhamitavasanāḥ' iti pā.| saha saṃviśeyuriti dāhārtena saha viśrāmaṃ kuryurityarthaḥ| śliṣṭvā āliṅgya| abalāḥ striyaḥ| kimbhūtāḥ? śithilamekhalahārayaṣṭya iti śithilā lambamānā mekhalā kṣudrasuvarṇaghaṇṭikāyuktaḥ kaṭidorakaḥ, hārayaṣṭiḥ mauktikamālā yāsāṃ tāstathā| tā abalāḥ manaso'nukūlā ityādiviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭāḥ, glānaṃ pratāntamanasamāturaṃ śliṣṭvā tenaiva saha saṃviśeyuriti sambandhaḥ| kecit ‘śliṣṭvā’ ityatra ‘śliṣya’ iti paṭhanti, vyākhyānayanti ca- śliṣya āśliṣya; chandonurodhena āṅśabdalopaḥ||62-64||

lg.l: harṣayeyur naraṃ nāryaḥ svaguṇai rahasi sthitāḥ |
tāḥ śaityāc chamayeyuś ca pittapānātyayāntaram `pittapānātyayaṃ striyaḥ' iti pā.||65||

ab.seg: harṣayeyurityādi| harṣayeyuḥ tuṣṭiṃ nayeyuḥ| naramiti dāhārtam| nāryaḥ striyaḥ| kairharṣayeyuḥ? svaguṇaiḥ mṛdubhāṣaṇādibhiḥ| rahasisthitā ekānte sthitāḥ| tā nāryaḥ| śaityāt ‘ātmana’ iti śeṣaḥ| śamayeyuḥ śāntiṃ nayeyuḥ| kiṃ śamayeyuḥ? pittapānātyayāntaraṃ pittapānātyayabhedam||65||

lg.l: tṛḍdāharaktapitteṣu raktapittatṛṣādāheṣvayameva vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ' iti pā. kāryo 'yaṃ bheṣajakramaḥ |

div.ab: imaṃ vidhimanyatrāpyatidiśannāha- tṛḍityādi| tṛṭ pipāsā, dāho nānāprakāro vakṣyamāṇaḥ| ayam anantaroktaḥ| bheṣajakrama auṣadhavidhiḥ kāryaḥ|66|-

ab.seg: tṛḍādiṣu sāmānyato vidhimuddiśya dāheṣu viśeṣavidhimāha- viśeṣamityādi| dāheṣviti bahuvacanaṃ nānāprakāratvena dāhasyābhidhāsyamānatvāt; ata eva aśeṣata ityuktam, aśeṣeṣvityarthaḥ||66||

lg.l: kṛtsnadehānugaṃ raktam udriktaṃ `raktaṃ' iti hastali. pu.pā. dahati hy ati |
apraśāmyati dāhe ca rasais tṛptasya jāṅgalaiḥ |

ab.seg: idānīṃ raktādidāhalakṣaṇaṃ `pittādidāhalakṣaṇaṃ' iti hastali. pu.pā. teṣāmeva viśiṣṭaṃ cikitsitaṃ cāha- kṛtsnadehānugamityādi| kṛtsnadehānugaṃ sakaladehavyaptam| udriktaṃ pravṛddham| hiśabda evārthe| sañcūṣyate ākṛṣyata iva vedanāviśeṣaḥ| ‘dahyate’ ityatra 'uṣyate' ityanye; tatra uṣyate dahyata ityarthaḥ| tāmrābhaḥ tāmraprabhaḥ| tāmralocano lohitākṣaḥ| lohagandhaśabdo'ṅgavadanābhyāṃ sambadhyate| vahninevāvakīryate jvalitāṅgārairivātmānamācitaṃ manyate, anena dāhātiśayaḥ pratipāditaḥ| tamiti raktadāhārtam `pittadāhārtaṃ' iti ha.li.pu.pāṭhaḥ| vilaṅghayeti vividhaprakāraṃ laṅghayitvā| vidhānena krameṇa, saṃsṛṣṭāhāraṃ kṛtatarpaṇādikramaṃ, ācarediti kuryāt, ‘vaidyaprayuktaṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ| evamapyapraśāmyati dāhe kiṃ kuryādityāha- apraśāmyatītyādi| apraśāmyati dāhe jāṅgalai rasaistṛptasya śākhāśrayā bāhujaṅghāśrayāḥ rohiṇīḥ lohitāḥ sirā yathānyāyaṃ vyadhayediti sambandhaḥ; yathānyāyaṃ sirāvyadhavidhānoktena `yathābhyāsaṃ' iti pā. nyāyenetyarthaḥ||67-69||

lg.l: pittajvarasamaḥ pittāt sa cāpy asya vidhir hitaḥ |70|

div.ab: ataḥ paraṃ dāhasya pittajvareṇa saha samatvaṃ taccikitsitaṃ cāha- pittajvarasama ityādi|70|

lg.l: tṛṣṇānirodhād abdhātau kṣīṇe tejaḥ samuddhatam `samutthitam' iti pā.||70||
saṃśuṣkagalatālvoṣṭho jihvāṃ niṣkṛṣya ceṣṭate `vepate' iti pā.||71||

ab.seg: tṛṇṇirodhaje dāhe cikitsitaṃ nirdiśannāha- tṛṣṇānirodhādityādi| abdhātau pānīyadhātau| tejaḥ pittoṣmā| samuddhatam atyarthavṛddham| evaṃvidhaṃ tejo dehaṃ sabāhyābhyantaraṃ mandacetasa āturasya vai sphuṭaṃ dahedityarthaḥ| sa dahyamānadehaḥ kiṃ kuryādityāha- jihvāṃ niṣkṛṣyetyādi| jihvāṃ niṣkṛṣya niḥsāryetyarthaḥ| ceṣṭate hastapādādivikṣepaṇaṃ karoti, ‘dāhārtaḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| anye ‘jihvā niḥsṛtya vepate’ iti paṭhanti, tatra dāhārtasya jihvā niḥsṛtya kampate ityarthaḥ||70-71||

lg.l: tatropaśamayet tejas tv abdhātuṃ ca vivardhayet |
pāyayet kāmam ambhaś ca `icchayā'mbhaśca' iti 'icchāyā'mbhastaṃ' iti pā. śarkarāḍhyaṃ payo 'pi vā ||72||
śītam ikṣurasaṃ manthaṃ vitarec ceritaṃ `vitarattvaritaṃ' iti pā. vidhim |73|

div.ab: tatretyādi| tatra tṛṣṇānirodhaje dāhe| upaśamayet śāntiṃ nayet madhuraśītādibhiḥ| tejaḥ pittoṣmāṇam| atrānye ‘tasya tejaḥ praśamayet’ iti paṭhanti; tatra tasyeti dāhārtasya, śeṣaṃ samam| abdhātuṃ ca vivardhayediti svayonivardhanaiḥ madhurasnigdhaśītalaiḥ| ambhaḥ pānīyam| taṃ tṛṣṇānirodhajadāhārtam| kimbhūtamambhaḥ? śarkarāḍhyaṃ prabhūtaśarkarāyuktam| kimambha eva pāyayedityāha- payo'pi veti|- śarkarāḍhyaṃ dugdhaṃ vetyarthaḥ| manthaṃ “śaktavaḥ sarpiṣā'bhyaktāḥ śītavāripariplutāḥ” ityādyuktalakṣaṇam| vitarecceritaṃ vidhimiti pittajvaraharam| kecit ‘vitareccetaraṃ vidhim’ iti paṭhanti; tatra pittajvaroktāt itaro'nyaḥ pittaharo vidhirityarthaḥ||72||-

lg.l: asṛjā pūrṇakoṣṭhasya dāho bhavati `dāho'nyaḥ syātsudustaraḥ' iti pā. duḥsahaḥ ||73||
vidhiḥ sadyovraṇīyoktas tasya lakṣaṇam eva ca |74|

div.ab: asṛjā pūrṇakoṣṭhasyetyādi| asṛjā raktena| pūrṇakoṣṭhasya sambhṛtodarasya| duḥsahaḥ raudraḥ| vidhiḥ cikitsā| tasyeti dāhārtasya| lakṣaṇameveti sadyovraṇīyoktamityarthaḥ ‘asṛjā’ ityatra ‘asṛjaḥ’ iti ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ kecit paṭhanti, pūraṇārthe ṣaṣṭhīṃ vyākhyānayanti ca||73||-

lg.l: kṣāmasvaraḥ kriyāhīno bhṛśaṃ `sa sīdedbhṛśapīḍitaḥ' iti pā. sīdati pīḍitaḥ |

ab.seg: dhātukṣayokto yo dāha ityādi| dhātukṣayokto raktakṣayoktaḥ| yaccātra raktakṣayokta iti pāṭho na kṛtaḥ, taditaradhātukṣaye'pi dāho bhavatīti jñāpanārtham| tena dhātukṣayajadāhena| kṣāmasvaro durbalasvaraḥ| kriyāhīnaḥ kāyikamānasaceṣṭāhīnaḥ| pīḍito ‘dāhena’ iti śeṣaḥ||74-75||

‘asṛjā pūrṇakoṣṭhasya’ ityādinā koṣṭhasthena raktena dāhamabhidhāyedānīṃ prakārāntareṇāha- kṣatajenāśnataścānya ityādi| kṣatajena raktena| aśnataḥ bhojanaṃ kurvataḥ| anyo ‘dāha’ iti śeṣaḥ| śocato vā'pyanekadheti anekaprakāraṃ śokaṃ kurvataḥ| śokaṃ kurvato bhojanaṃ kurvato vā'pi narasyānyo dāho raktena bhavatīti sambandhaḥ| tena dāhena, antaḥ abhyantaraṃ dahyate| mūrcchātṛṣṇāpralāpavān ‘āturo bhavati’ iti śeṣaḥ| tam āturam| iṣṭaviṣayopetam abhilaṣitaśabdasparśādisaṃyuktam| suhṛdbhiḥ mitraiḥ| abhisaṃvṛtaṃ samantataḥ parivṛtam| vidhinoktena sādhayet dāhaśāntikareṇa prāguktena vidhānena śāntiṃ nayet||76-77||

lg.l: marmābhighātajo 'py asti sa `so'sādhyaḥ saptamo mataḥ' iti pā. cāsādhyatamaḥ smṛtaḥ |78|

div.ab: marmābhighātaja ityādi| marmābhighātajaḥ sadyaḥ kālāntare vā prāṇaharamarmābhighātajaḥ| yadyevaṃ tarhi asādhyatvaṃ prāptameva, sa cāsādhyatamaḥ smṛta iti vyartham| naivaṃ, sa cāsādhyatamaḥ smṛta ityasmādeva sadyaḥkālāntaraprāṇaharamarmajo `sadyaḥkālāntara' iti hastalikhitapustake nopalabhyate jñāyata ityadoṣaḥ| ‘sa cāsādhyatamaḥ smṛtaḥ’ ityatrānye ‘so'sādhyaḥ saptamo mata’ iti paṭhanti| ata eva ca dāhagaṇanāṃ kurvanti- tvacaṃ prāptastu pānoṣmetyādiḥ prathamo dāhaḥ, kṛtsnadehānugaṃ pittamityādirdvitīyaḥ tṛṣṇānirodhādityādistṛtīyaḥ, asṛjā pūrṇakoṣṭhasyetyādiścaturthaḥ, dhātukṣayokta ityādiḥ pañcamaḥ, kṣatajenāśnataścānyaḥ śocato vā'pītyādiḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ, saptamaśca marmābhighātajaḥ|78|-

lg.l: sarva eva ca varjyāḥ syuḥ śītagātreṣu dehiṣu ||78||
(evaṃvidho bhaved yas tu madirāmayapīḍitaḥ `ayamardhaśloko hastalikhitapustake na paṭhyate||) |

ab.seg: avasthāyāṃ sarveṣāmapi dāhānāṃ varjanamāha- sarva evetyādi| sarva eva ‘dāhā’ iti śeṣaḥ||78||
