iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantre kāsapratiṣedho nāma dvipañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||52||

div.head: svarabhedapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ svarabhedapratiṣedham adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
śvāsakāsapratiṣedhānantaramūrdhvagatatvasāmānyāt śvāsakāsacikitsitasādhyatvācca svarabhedapratiṣedhārambho yukta ityata āha- athāta ityādi| svarabhedaḥ svaropaghātaḥ||1-2||

lg.l: atyuccabhāṣaṇaviṣādhyayanātigītaśītādibhiḥ `... viṣādhyayanābhighāta ...' iti pā. prakupitāḥ pavanādayas tu |
srotaḥsu te svaravaheṣu gatāḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ hanyuḥ svaraṃ bhavati cāpi hi ṣaḍvidhaḥ saḥ ||3||

ab.seg: svarabhedahetusamprāptisaṅkhyā āha- atyuccabhāṣaṇetyādi| adhyayanam anavarataṃ vedādipāṭhaḥ| atigītaṃ nirantaraṃ maṅgalādigānam| śītādibhirityatrādiśabdāt pittakaphakopahetavo gṛhyante| yadatra atyuccabhāṣaṇādīnāṃ vātakopahetūnāmeva sākṣāt kathanaṃ kṛtaṃ na pittakaphakopahetūnāṃ tat svaropaghātakartṛtve vāyoḥ prādhānyakhyāpanārtham| anye tu śītādītyatra ādiśabdena gurulaghusnigdharūkṣādīn guṇān gṛhṇanti| svaravaheṣu srotaḥsu śabdavāhinīṣu dhamanīṣu, te vātādayaḥ, gatāḥ prāptāḥ, pratiṣṭhāṃ sthitim| ṣaḍvidhaḥ ṣaṭprakāraḥ; pṛthak vātādibhistrayaḥ, sannipātenaikaḥ, medaḥkṣayābhyāṃ pratyekamekaḥ; evaṃ ṣaṭprakāraḥ| nanu, samānatantre ‘vātāt pittāt kaphāt kāsādraktavegāt sapīnasāt’ (ca. ci. 8) ityatra yathā ṣaḍvidhaḥ svarabheda uktastena sārdhaṃ kathaṃ na virodhaḥ| satyaṃ, kāsajapratiśyāyajayorliṅgatvenoktatvādgrahaṇaṃ, raktajasya tu kaphagrahaṇenaiva grahaṇaṃ, yato raktaṃ kaphayuktaṃ svarabhedaṃ karoti samānatantroktatvāt| yadyevaṃ tarhi kathaṃ na saṅkhyādhikyaṃ? styaṃ, kāsajapratiśyāyajayorvātikatvena grahaṇam| atyuccabhāṣaṇetyādiko hetuḥ, prakupitāḥ pavanādaya ityādikā samprāptiḥ, bhavati cāpi hi ṣaḍvidhaḥ sa iti saṅkhyā||3||

lg.l: vātena kṛṣṇanayanānanamūtravarcā bhinnaṃ śanair vadati gadgadavat svaraṃ ca |4|

div.ab: vātikasvarabhedalakṣaṇamāha- vātenetyādi| kṛṣṇaśabdo nayanādibhirvarcaḥparyantaiḥ sambadhyate| bhinnam anavasthitam| uktaṃ ca tantrāntare- “svarabhedo bhavedvātādrūkṣaḥ kṣāmaścalaḥ svaraḥ” (ca. ci. 8)- iti| ‘gadgadavat svaram’ ityatra kecit ‘gardabhavat svaraṃ’ iti paṭhanti|4|-

lg.l: pittena pītavadanākṣipurīṣamūtro brūyād galena paridāhasamanvitena `ca vidāhasamanvitena' iti pā.||4||

ab.seg: pittajasvarabhedalakṣaṇamāha- pittenetyādi| pītaśabdo vadanādibhirmūtrāntaiḥ sambadhyate| 'sa vidāhasamanvitena’ iti kecit paṭhanti, tatra sa iti svarabhedī puruṣaḥ||4||

lg.l: kṛcchrāt kaphena satataṃ kapharuddhakaṇṭho mandaṃ śanair vadati cāpi divā viśeṣaḥ `viśeṣāt' iti pā.|5|

div.ab: kaphajasvarabhedalakṣaṇamāha- kṛcchrādityādi| satatam anavaratam| kapharuddhakaṇṭhaḥ śleṣmāvṛtakaṇṭhaḥ| mandaṃ śanairiti mandaṃ mandamityarthaḥ| divā viśeṣa iti divase viśeṣo bhavet, kaphakṣayāt| ‘divā viśeṣāt’ iti kecit paṭhanti; rātrau tāvat kapharuddhakaṇṭhatvānna vadatyeva, divā punaḥ kaphāpacayādviśeṣo bhavati, tasmācca viśeṣānmandaṃ mandaṃ vadatīti vyākhyānayanti|5|-

lg.l: sarvātmake bhavati sarvavikārasampad avyaktatā ca vacasas tam asādhyam āhuḥ ||5||

ab.seg: sānnipātikasvarabhedalakṣaṇamāha- sarvātmaka ityādi| sarvātmake sannipātotthasvarabhede| sarvavikārasampad vātādiliṅgaprādurbhāvaḥ| avyaktatā ca vacasaḥ aspaṣṭavāktvam| taṃ sānnipātikasvarabhedam||5||

lg.l: dhūpyeta vāk kṣayakṛte kṣayam āpnuyāc ca vāg eṣa cā(vā)pi hatavāk parivarjanīyaḥ |6|

div.ab: kṣayajasvarabhedalakṣaṇamāha- dhūpyetetyādi| dhūpyeta mukhāddhūmamivodvamati, ‘bruvan’ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ| kṣayamāpnuyād vāgiti vacanakṣayaṃ prāpnuyāt ‘vātāt’ iti śeṣaḥ|6|-

lg.l: antargalaṃ `antargatasvaraṃ' iti pā. svaram alakṣyapadaṃ cireṇa medaś cayād vadati `medo'nvayāt' iti pā. digdhagalauṣṭhatāluḥ ||6||
kṣīṇasya vṛddhasya kṛśasya cāpi cirotthito yaś ca sahopajātaḥ |
medasvinaḥ sarvasamudbhavaś ca svarāmayo yo na sa siddhim eti ||7||

ab.seg: medojasvarabhedalakṣaṇamāha- antargalamityādi| antargalaṃ galasyāntare| svaraṃ vadati śabdaṃ karoti| ‘antargataṃ’ iti kecit paṭhanti, tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ| yato'ntargalaṃ svaraṃ vadati ata eva alakṣyapadamiti, na lakṣyante padāni yasyetyarthaḥ| bhedaścayāt medovṛddheḥ| digdhaṃ medodigdhaṃ galauṣṭhatālu yasya sa tathā| ‘medo'nvayāt’ iti kecit paṭhanti||6-7||

lg.l: snigdhān svarāturanarān apakṛṣṭadoṣān nyāyena tān `saṃyojayet' iti pā. vamanarecanabastibhiś ca |
nasyāvapīḍamukhadhāvanadhūmalehaiḥ sampādayec ca vividhaiḥ kavalagrahaiś ca ||8||

ab.seg: svarabhedasya sāmānyacikitsāmāha- snigdhānityādi| yadyapi kaphajamedojayoḥ svarabhedayorapatarpaṇasādhyatvāt snehanaṃ na yuktaṃ, tathā'pi yathādoṣapratyanīkairyathādoṣapratyanīkasādhitaiśca snehaiḥ snehanaṃ yuktameva, athavā medaḥkaphajayorapi vāyusadbhāvāt snehanopadeśaḥ| apakṛṣṭadoṣān ākṛṣṭadoṣān; atra vamanavirecanabastibhiriti sambadhyate| nyāyena yathāvidhītyarthaḥ| vamanādibhirapakṛṣṭadoṣān svarabhedāturān kiṃ kuryādityāha- nasyāvapīḍetyādi| avapīḍya dīyate ityavapīḍo nasyabhedaḥ| mukhadhāvanaṃ gaṇḍūṣādi| sampādayet yojayet| vividhaiḥ doṣapratyanīkatvena nānāprakāraiḥ| kavalagrahaiḥ gaṇḍūṣabhedaiḥ| tathā ca- “sukhaṃ sañcāryate yā tu gaṇḍūṣe sā prakīrtitā| asañcāryā tu yā mātrā kavale sā prakīrtitā `bhiṣagvaraiḥ' iti pā. ”- iti||8||

lg.l: yaḥ śvāsakāsavidhir ādita eva coktas taṃ cāpy aśeṣam avatārayituṃ yateta |9|

div.ab: anyadapi svarabhedacikitsitamatideśenāha- ya ityādi| śvāsakāsapratiṣedhe sāmānyenādau yaḥ śvāsakāsavidhiruddiṣṭastaṃ vidhiṃ samastamapi yathādoṣaṃ kartuṃ yateteti piṇḍārthaḥ|9|

lg.l: vaiśeṣikaṃ ca vidhim ūrdhvam ato vadāmi taṃ vai svarāturahitaṃ nikhilaṃ nibodha ||9||

ab.seg: vaiśeṣikamityādi| ata iti sāmānyacikitsānantaram| taṃ vai svarāturahitamiti svarabhedāturahitam| nibodha jānīhi||9||

lg.l: pītaṃ ghṛtaṃ hanty anilaṃ siddham ārtagale rase |11|

div.ab: tameva vaiśeṣikavidhimāha- svaropaghāta ityādi| bhuktopari bhojanopari| mārkavo bhṛṅgarājaḥ, śṛtaṃ pakvam| anilaṃ vātajasvarabhedam, upacārāt| ārtagalaḥ kakubhaḥ||10||-
aparamapi vātaje ghṛtatrayamāha- yavakṣārājamodābhyāmityādi| agniko ajamodā| ājaṃ ‘ghṛtaṃ’ śeṣaḥ| samākṣikaṃ samadhu| atrāpi pītamiti yojyam||11||-

ab.seg: vātike pathyayogamāha- sukhodakānupāna ityādi| sukhodakam īṣaduṣṇodakam| kecidamuṃ yogaṃ paittike manyante; tanna, samānatantreṣu vātikasvarabheda eva prayuktatvāt||12||

lg.l: kṣīrānupānaṃ pitte tu pibet sarpir atandritaḥ |13|

div.ab: paittikasvarabhedacikitsāmāha- kṣīrānupānamityādi| atandritaḥ analasaḥ|13|-

ab.seg: paittike pathyayogamāha- aśnīyādityādi| yaṣṭīmadhukapāyasamiti yaṣṭīmadhukasādhitakṣīrasiddhāṃstaṇḍulān; athavā yaṣṭīmadhukānvitaṃ pāyasaṃ yaṣṭīmadhukapāyasam||13||
lihyādityādi| madhurakāṇāṃ kākolīprabhṛtīnām| śatāvarīcūrṇayogamiti śatāvarīcūrṇasya yogaḥ saṃyogo yatra tattathā, atrāpi madhughṛtāplutaṃ lihyāditi sambandhanīyam||14||

lg.l: lihyād vā madhutailābhyāṃ bhuktvā khādet kaṭūni vā ||15||

ab.seg: kaphajasvarabhedacikitsāmāha- pibedityādi| kaṭūni trikaṭukādīni| mūtreṇa gomūtreṇa prādhānyāt| svarasaṅkṣaye svarabhede| lihyādvā madhutailābhyāmityādi madhutailābhyāṃ vā kaṭūni trikaṭukaprabhṛtīni lihyāt, bhuktvā vā tāni khādet||15||

div.ab: medojasvarabhede kaphajacikitsāmatidiśannāha- svaropaghāta ityādi| kaphavat kaphajasvarabhedavat|16|-

ab.seg: sānnipātikakṣayajayorasādhyayorapi cikitsā kartavyetyāha- sarvaja ityādi| pratyākhyāya asādhyatvena nirākṛtya| ācaret kuryāt| kriyāmiti sānnipātike sarveṣāṃ vātādisvarabhedānāṃ sarvameva cikitsitaṃ kāryaṃ, kṣayaje tu kṣayoktamiti; kecidubhayorapi sāmānyacikitsitaṃ kuryādityāhuḥ||16||

atyuccabhāṣaṇotthasvarabhedasya vātātmakatve'pi nimittabhedamāśritya viśiṣṭāṃ cikitsāmāha- śarkaretyādi| madhuraiḥ kākolyādibhiḥ śṛtāni payāṃsi śarkarāmadhumiśrāṇi pibediti piṇḍārthaḥ| payāṃsītyatra bahuvacanaṃ gomahiṣyajānāṃ kṣīraparigrahāya||17||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre chardipratiṣedho nāma (pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) tripañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||53||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre svarabhedapratiṣedho nāma tripañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||53||

div.head: kṛmirogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ kṛmirogapratiṣedham adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

lg.l: svādvamladravapānaiś ca śleṣmā pittaṃ ca kupyati ||5||
dhamanyāṃ raktajānāṃ ca prasavaḥ prāyaśaḥ smṛtaḥ ||6||

ab.seg: keṣāñcit kṛmīṇāṃ sāmānyaṃ hetumāha- ajīrṇetyādi| ajīrṇam āmavidagdhādibhedabhinnaṃ, adhyaśanam ajīrṇabhojanaṃ asātmyaṃyat sevitaṃ sukhārthaṃ na sampadyate, viruddhaṃ hitāhitīyoktaṃ, malinaṃ samalam| piṣṭānnaṃ taṇḍulapiṣṭādi, vidalaṃ makuṣṭhādi, bisaṃ bisāṇḍakaṃ, śālūḥ padmakandaḥ| parṇaśākaṃ patraśākaṃ, sūktaṃ sandhānakaviśeṣaḥ| palalaḥ tilakalkaḥ , ānūpapiśitam ānūpamāṃsaṃ, piṇyākaṃ yantrapīḍitatilakhalī, 'pītā' iti loke, pṛthukaḥ cipiṭakaḥ ādiśabdādevamprakārā anye'pi| bahuvidhākārān vividhākārān| vividhāśrayāniti nānāprakārāśrayānityarthaḥ| prasava utpattiḥ| prāyograhaṇādanyatrāpi sambhavo jñātavyaḥ| kecidatra ajīrṇādhyaśanādikaṃ hetugaṇaṃ na paṭhanti, teṣāṃ ca hetvavagatirvakṣyamāṇāt 'kṣīrāṇi māṃsāni' ityādipratiṣedhavidhānāt; mayā tu sukhabodhārthaṃ hetugaṇaḥ paṭhitaḥ| apare tu ‘ajīrṇabhojī madhurāmlanityo dravapriyaḥ piṣṭaguḍopabhoktā| vyāyāmajātāni ‘vyāyāmavarjī ca divāśayāno viruddhabhuk saṃlabhate krimīṃstu' iti mādhavanidāne pā. ca varjyamānaḥ svapnādivān vai labhate krimīnnā' iti paṭhanti||1-6||

idānīṃ viṃśatisaṅkhyānāmapi kṛmijātīnāṃ kāraṇatraividhyamāha- viṃśaterityādi| jātigrahaṇaṃ kṛmīṇāmānantyakhyāpanārthaṃ; taccānantyaṃ viṃśatyāmevāvaruddhaṃ, ato viṃśatisaṅkhyākaraṇaṃ sārthakam| sambhavaḥ kāraṇam| kastrividhaḥ sambhava ityāha- purīṣetyādi| nanu, ajīrṇādhyaśanādayo hetava uktāḥ , kathaṃ purīṣādayaśca ucyante? satyaṃ, ajīrṇādayaḥ purīṣādīnāṃ hetavaḥ, purīṣādayaśca kṛmīṇāmiti| yadyapi kṛmyārambhakā na purīṣādayaḥ , tathā'pyupacārāt purīṣādīnāmapi kṛmyārambhakatvam| purīṣādyadhiṣṭhitā doṣāḥ purīṣādi, ghṛtādidagdhavat; etenājīrṇādibhiḥ prakupitā doṣāḥ purīṣādīnyadhiṣṭhāya kṛmīn janayanti tāsāṃ kṛmijātīnām| kecit ‘vistaraṃ’ ityatra ‘lakṣaṇaṃ’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ savyākhyānaṃ paṭhanti; tacca śiṣyabuddhivyākulatvahetutvāt parityaktam||7||

lg.l: ajavā vijavāḥ `ayavā viyavāḥ' iti pā. kipyāś cipyā gaṇḍūpadās tathā |
cūravo dvimukhāś caiva jñeyāḥ sapta purīṣajāḥ ||8||

ab.seg: purīṣajakṛmināmānyāha- ajavā ityādi| ajavādayo dvimukhāntāḥ sapta purīṣajāḥ kṛmayaḥ||8||

lg.l: śvetāḥ sūkṣmās tudanty ete gudaṃ pratisaranti ca |
teṣām evāpare pucchaiḥ pṛthavaś ca bhavanti hi ||9||

ab.seg: purīṣajānāṃ lakṣaṇamāha- śvetā ityādi| ya ete purīṣajāḥ kṛmayaḥ śvetāḥ sūkṣmāśca bhavanti, te bāhulyenāddaṣṭavaśādgudaṃ tudanti pratisaranti ca| teṣāmeva saptānāṃ madhye apare pucchaiḥ pṛthavo bhavanti| purīṣajaiḥ saptabhiḥ kṛmibhiḥ śūlāgnimāndyādayo bhavanti| viṣṭambho guḍaguḍāśabdaḥ| praseko lālāsrāvaḥ| viḍbhedaḥ dravapurīṣatā||9-10||
teṣāmeva saptānāṃ purīṣajānāṃ madhye gaṇḍūpadānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ karma cāha- raktā ityādi| paktināśakarā agnināśakarāḥ, kāraṇe `upacārāt' iti pā. kāryopacārāt||11||
kaphakṛmināmānyāha- darbhapuṣpā ityādi| darbhapuṣpādikā dāruṇaparyantāḥ kaphakopajāḥ ṣaṭ kṛmayaḥ||12||
teṣāmākṛtimāha- romaśā ityādi| romaśāḥ sarvato romānvitāḥ| romamūrdhānaḥ saromamastakāḥ| śyāvamaṇḍalāḥ śyāmamaṇḍalayuktāḥ||13||

div.ab: teṣāmeva karmaviśeṣeṇa sañjñāntaramāha- majjādā ityādi|14|-

ab.seg: teṣāṃ sarveṣāmeva karmāṇyāha- śirohṛdrogetyādi| rogaśabdaḥ śirohṛdbhyāṃ sambadhyate, tena śirorogo hṛdrogaśca, vamathuḥ chardiḥ| cakārāt anyānapi kaphajavyādhīn kurvanti| te kaphajāḥ kṛmayaḥ||14||
raktajakṛmināmānyāha- keśarometyādi| keśādādyāḥ parīsarpāntāḥ sapta raktajāḥ kṛmayaḥ||15||

lg.l: te saraktāś ca kṛṣṇāś ca snigdhāś ca pṛthavas tathā |16|

div.ab: teṣāmākṛtimāha- ta ityādi| te raktajāḥ kṛmayaḥ| pṛthavaḥ sthūlāḥ|16|-

ab.seg: teṣāṃ karmāṇyāha- raktādhiṣṭhānajānityādi| raktādhiṣṭhānajān vyādhisamuddeśīyoktān kuṣṭhavisarpapiḍakādīn||16||

lg.l: jvaro vivarṇatā śūlaṃ hṛdrogaḥ sadanaṃ bhramaḥ ||18||

div.ab: purīṣajādikṛmīṇāṃ sāmānyakāraṇamabhidhāyedānīṃ viśeṣakāraṇamāha- māṣapiṣṭānnavidaletyādi| piṣṭānnaṃ taṇḍulādipiṣṭajam||17-18||-

lg.l: keśādādyās tv adṛśyās te dvāv ādyau parivarjayet |20|

div.ab: idānīṃ kṛmīṇāṃ dṛśyādṛśyatvena sādhyāsādhyatvena ca vibhāgakaraṇārthamāha- dṛśyā ityādi| ādyāstrayodaśeti ajavādyā dāruṇāntā ityarthaḥ| keśādādyā iti keśādādyāḥ parīsarpāntā raktajāḥ kṛmaya ityarthaḥ| dvāvādyāviti raktajāpekṣayaiva ādyau, tena keśādaromādāvityarthaḥ| tathā coktam- “asādhyau dvau tu vijñeyau romakeśādasañjñitau” iti||19||-

lg.l: eṣām anyatamaṃ jñātvā jighāṃsuḥ snigdham āturam ||20||

div.ab: nidānamabhidhāyedānīṃ cikitsāvasaraḥ- eṣāmanyatamamityādi| eṣāṃ krimīṇāṃ madhye anyatamamekatamaṃ jighāṃsuḥ, snigdhamāturaṃ surasādigaṇavipakvena sarpiṣā snigdhamāturaṃ jñātvā, āditaśca vāntaṃ tīkṣṇatarairyogaiḥ kaphaghnairvirecanakalpoktairvirecayediti piṇḍārthaḥ| ‘duṣṭe ca koṣṭhe kṛmibhirmanuṣyaṃ na vāmayet’ ityādinā kṛmiyuktasya puṃso vamananiṣedhaḥ, tathā'pi kṛmiyuktasya prathamāvasthāyāṃ vamanaṃ śastam, ato vāntamādita ityuktam||20||-

ab.seg: virekānantaraṃ kiṃ kuryādityāha- āsthāpayedityādi| tam āturaṃ yavakolādīnāṃ kvāthena tathā surasādigaṇasya kvāthena viḍaṅgasādhitasnehayuktena saindhavalavaṇānvitenāsthāpayediti piṇḍārthaḥ| gaṇasya ceti cakārāt surasādikalko'pi grāhyaḥ||21-22||

lg.l: pratyāgate nirūhe tu naraṃ snātaṃ sukhāmbunā |
yuñjyāt kṛmighnair aśanais tataḥ śīghraṃ bhiṣagvaraḥ ||23||

div.ab: āsthāpanānantaraṃ kiṃ kuryādityāha- pratyāgata ityādi| pratyāgate vyāghuṭite patite ityarthaḥ| sukhāmbunā uṣṇodakena| kṛmighnairaśanaiḥ kṛmighnadravyasādhitaiḥ svabhāvataḥ kṛmighnaiśca| snehenoktena viḍaṅgasādhitasnehena| snehabastinā anuvāsanena||23||-

ab.seg: ato'nantaraṃ kṛtānnasaṃsargaḥ kiṃ kuryādityāha- tata ityādi| tata iti anuvāsanānantaram| kiṇihī kaṭabhī||24||

div.ab: pānāntaramāha- kevūketyādi| kevūkaḥ ‘kesura `kejaka' iti pā. ’ iti nāmnā prasiddhaḥ| pūrvavaditi kṣaudrayutamityarthaḥ| tīkṣṇabhojanaḥ tīkṣṇadravyasaṃskṛtāhāraḥ|25|-

ab.seg: aparamapi pānayogamāha- palāśabījetyādi| palāśabījasvarasaṃ kalkaṃ veti palāśabījakalkaṃ vā taṇḍulāmbunā pibedityarthaḥ||25||
aparamapi pānayogamāha- pāribhadrakapatrāṇāmityādi| pāribhadraḥ parvatanimbaḥ| pattūraḥ śiravālikā| surasādikaḥ surasādigaṇaḥ||26||

div.ab: kṛmighnamavalehayogamāha- lihyādityādi| aśvaśakṛccūrṇaṃ ghoṭakapurīṣacūrṇam| vaiḍaṅgaṃ viḍaṅgacūm| ‘vaiḍaṅgam’ ityatra ‘baiḍālam’ iti kecit paṭhanti; tatra biḍālaviṭcūrṇamiti vyākhyānam|27|-

lg.l: khādet pūpalikāḥ pakvā dhānyāmlaṃ ca pibed anu |28|

div.ab: krimighnapūpalikāmāha- patrairmūṣikaparṇyā vetyādi| mūṣikaparṇī dantī, anye mūṣikakarṇākhyaṃ dravyāntaramāhuḥ| piṣṭamiśritaiḥ yavapiṣṭamiśritaiḥ, tasya viśeṣeṇa krimiharatvāt| dhānyāmlaṃ kāñjikam| anviti pūpalikābhakṣaṇānantaram| yadyapi ‘kṣīrāṇi māṃsāni ghṛtāni ca’ ityādigranthoktādamlavarjanādatra kāñjikasyāpi varjanaṃ prāpnoti, tathā'pi kāñjikasya prāyogikatvāt krimiharatvāccātra kāñjikānupānaṃ, tathā hi guṇopavarṇane kāñjikaṃ kṛmighnatvena dṛṣṭam||27||-

lg.l: surasādigaṇe pakvaṃ tailaṃ vā pānam iṣyate ||28||
viḍaṅgacūrṇayuktair vā piṣṭair bhakṣyāṃs tu kārayet `viḍaṅgacūrṇapiṣṭābhyāṃ tasmin bhakṣyaṃ tu kārayet' iti pā.|29|

div.ab: kṛmighnatailamāha- surasādigaṇe ityādi| tailamiti surasādigaṇe ‘kvāthakalkīkṛte’ iti śeṣaḥ| viḍaṅgetyādi| piṣṭaiḥ yavādipiṣṭaiḥ| bhakṣyān laḍḍūkādīn| vikalpavidhānaṃ pūrvayogāpekṣayā||28||-

ab.seg: tatkaṣāyaprapītānāmityādi| tatkaṣāyaprapītānāṃ viḍaṅgakvāthabhāvitānām| atrāpi kārayediti sambandhanīyam||29||

div.ab: śvāvidha ityādi| śvāvidhaḥ seḍhāyāḥ, śakṛt viṣṭhā, tasyāścūrṇaṃ saptavārān viḍaṅgakvāthena bhāvitaṃ punastriphalākvāthena tathaiva bhāvitaṃ, kṣaudreṇa līḍhvā, anu paścāt, āmalakodbhavaṃ bibhītakodbhavaṃ vā harītakīrasaṃ vā'pi kṣaudreṇa pibediti sambandhaḥ||31||-

ab.seg: amumeva vidhi lauhacūrṇānāmapyatidiśannāha- vidhirityādi| eṣa vidhiḥ śvāvidhaḥ śakṛccūrṇavidhiḥ| ayasāmapīti trapusīsatāmrarajatakṛṣṇalohānāmapi| etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati- pratyekaṃ lohādicūrṇānāṃ śvāvitpurīṣacūrṇavidhānavadvidhiḥ kāryaḥ||31||

lg.l: pūtīkasvarasaṃ vā'pi pibed vā madhunā saha |
saptarātraṃ pibed ghṛṣṭaṃ trapu vā dadhimastunā |33|

ab.seg: pūtīkaḥ cirabilvaḥ| pibedityādi| ajāmūtreṇa chāgamūtreṇa| pibeddhṛṣṭamityādi| trapu raṅgaṃ, ‘kathīra’ iti loke| dadhimastugrahaṇam anyamastuniṣedhārthaṃ; anye ‘dadhimastunā’ ityatra dadhigrahaṇaṃ kūrcikāmastuparihārārthamiti vyākhyānayanti| tanna, dadhimastugrahaṇena kūrcikāmastugrahaṇamasambhavaṃ, sarvanibandhavirodhāt samānatantravirodhācca||32||

lg.l: purīṣajān kaphotthāṃś ca hanyād evaṃ kṛmīn bhiṣak ||33||

ab.seg: yat pūrvametaccikitsitamuktaṃ tat purīṣakaphajānāṃ kāryamiti darśayannāha- purīṣajānityādi| evamiti pūrvoktena vidhinetyarthaḥ||33||

purīṣakaphajānāṃ sāmānyacikitsitamabhidhāyedānīṃ kaphajānāmāśrayaviśeṣeṇa cikitsāmāha- śirohṛdghrāṇetyādi| śiraḥprabhṛtisaṃśritān nānāprakārān kṛmīn viśeṣeṇāñjanādibhiḥ sādhayediti piṇḍārthaḥ| cakārāt gaṇḍūṣakavalagrahādibhirapi| anye tu yadyapyañjanādikaṃ sāmānyenoktaṃ, tathā'pyañjanaṃ netrasthe, nasyāvapīḍau ghrāṇaśiraḥsaṃśrite ca, viśeṣeṇāñjanādīnāṃ netrādijakṛmiharatvāt; hṛdgatānāṃ karṇagatānāṃ cārthavaśādeva kṛmijahṛdrogakṛmikarṇakacikitsitaiścikitsā kāryā; cakārāt śiraḥsthitānāṃ kṛmīṇāṃ kṛmiśirorogacikitsitaiścikitsā kāryeti gṛhyata iti vyākhyānayanti| ‘saṃśritān’ ityatra ‘vraṇajān’ iti kecit paṭhanti; anye ‘saṃśritān’ ityatra ‘saṃsṛtān’ iti paṭhanti; karṇasthāne ca vaktraṃ paṭhanti||34||

lg.l: niṣkvāthena viḍaṅgānāṃ cūrṇaṃ pradhamanaṃ tu tat ||35||

ab.seg: śiraḥ prabhṛtisaṃśritakṛmighnaṃ pradhamanamāha- śakṛdrasamityādi| śakṛdrasaṃ turaṅgasyeti ghoṭakapurīṣasya rasamityarthaḥ| suśuṣkamiti purīṣarasasya viśeṣaṇam| pradhamanamiti nāsāyāṃ cūrṇaprakṣepaṇaṃ jñeyam||35||

lg.l: ayaś cūrṇāny anenaiva vidhinā yojayed bhiṣak |
sakāṃsyanīlaṃ tailaṃ ca nasyaṃ syāt surasādike ||36||

ab.seg: amumeva pradhamanavidhiṃ lohacūrṇeṣvatidiśannāha- ayaścūrṇānītyādi| aneneti ghoṭapurīṣasvarasapradhamanavidhānena| sakāṃsyanīlaṃ kāṃsyāpamārjanamasīsahitam| ‘surasādike’ ityatra ‘vipakvaṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ| tena surasādigaṇakvāthavipakvaṃ tailaṃ kāṃsyamasīsahitaṃ nasyaṃ syāditi| tathā coktāṃ,- ‘surasādiśṛtaṃ tailaṃ nasyaṃ kāṃsyamalānvitam’- iti||36||

div.ab: romādādīnāmatideśena cikitsāmāha- indraluptetyādi| romabhojiṣu romādeṣu| cakāreṇa keśabhojiṣvapīndraluptavidhiḥ kārya iti samuccīyate|37|-

ab.seg: dantādānāmapyatideśena cikitsitamāha- dantādānāmityādi| mukharogikaṃ kṛmidantoktaṃ, viśeṣeṇa kṛmidantoktacikitsitasya dantānāṃ hitatvāt| yadyapi romādadantādānāṃ raktajatvāt raktajasāmānyacikitsānantaramindraluptavidhyādikaṃ viśeṣacikitsitaṃ kartumucitaṃ bhavati, tathā'pi kaphajā api romadantabhakṣaṇaṃ kurvantīti pravyaktakaṭukaṃ bhojanaṃ hitaṃ bhavediti pratipādanārthaṃ romadantādānāṃ prathamaṃ cikitsitamuktam||37||

div.ab: idānīṃ sāmānyacikitsitaṃ raktajānāmatideśenāha- raktajānāmityādi| ‘kuṣṭhacikitsite’ ityatra pūrvoktameva samuddiṣṭamiti padaṃ sambandhanīyam| kecit ‘kuṣṭhacikitsitāt’ iti paṭhanti|38|-

ab.seg: surasādiṃ tu sarveṣvityādi| sarveṣu purīṣajādiṣu| sarvathaiva annapānasnānādividhinā||38||

div.ab: bhojane vidhyantaramāha- pravyaktetyādi| pravyaktatiktakaṭukamiti tiktakaṭukotkaṭamityarthaḥ|39|-

lg.l: kulatthakṣārasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ kṣārapānaṃ ca pūjitam `kulatthakvāthasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ kṣīrapānaṃ ca pūjitam' iti pā.||39||

ab.seg: pāne'pi vidhyantaramāha- kulatthetyādi| kulatthakṣārasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ kulatthabhasmodakasaṃyuktam? kṣārapānaṃ yavakṣārapānaṃ, tathā coktaṃ viśvāmitreṇa- ‘yāvaśūkasya pānaṃ tu kulatthakṣāravāriṇā’- iti| kecit ‘kulatthakṣāra...’ ityatra ‘viḍaṅgakṣāra...’ iti paṭhanti||39||

lg.l: kṣīrāṇi māṃsāni ghṛtāni caiva dadhīni śākāni ca parṇavanti |
samāsato 'mlān madhurān himāṃś ca kṛmīn jighāṃsuḥ parivarjayet tu ||40||

ab.seg: pravṛttilakṣaṇaṃ cikitsitamabhidhāyedānīṃ nivṛttilakṣaṇaṃ cikitsitamāha- kṣīrāṇi māṃsānītyādi| yadyapi ‘saṅkṣepataḥ kriyāyogo nidānaparivarjanam’ iti vākyādeva kṣīrādīnāṃ niṣedhavidhiḥ siddhaḥ, tathā'pi kṣīrādīnāṃ pratiṣedhakaraṇaṃ niyamārthaṃ; tena kṛmīṇāṃ nidānamapi kṣīrādikaṃ madātyaye madyavadbheṣajaṃ mā bhūdityarthaḥ||40||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre kṛmipratiṣedho nāma (ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) catuḥpañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||54||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantre kṛmipratiṣedho nāma catuḥpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||54||

div.head: udāvartapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāta udāvartapratiṣedham adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

kṛmipratiṣedhānantaraṃ kṛmicikitsitasya kaṭutiktakaṣāyāderudāvartahetutvādudāvartapratiṣedhārambho yukta ityata āha- athāta ityādi| ut ūrdhvaṃ vātaviṇmūtrādīnāṃ āvarto bhramaṇaṃ yasmin roge sa udāvartaḥ; anye purīṣaṃ vāyunā vartulīkṛtamudāvartaṃ manyante, lokaprasiddhatvāt||1-2||

lg.l: adhaś cordhvaṃ ca bhāvānāṃ pravṛttānāṃ svabhāvataḥ |
na vegān dhārayet prājño vātādīnāṃ jijīviṣuḥ ||3||

ab.seg: vegadhāraṇasyaikāntenodāvartahetutvādvegadhāraṇaniṣedhamāha- adhaścordhva cetyādi| adhobhāvā mūtrādayaḥ ūrdhvabhāvā udgārādayaḥ, teṣāṃ bhāvānāṃ vātādīnāṃ vegān na dhārayet| kimbhūtānāṃ? svabhāvataḥ pravṛttānāṃ, prakṛtyaiva svāśayacyutānāmityarthaḥ| etenaite'pravṛttā balānnodīraṇīyā iti sūcayati| jijīviṣuḥ jīvitumicchuḥ puruṣaḥ| kecit ‘prājñaḥ’ ityatra ‘prāptān’ iti paṭhanti| te ca vyākhyānayanti- vegagrahaṇenaiva prāptāniti prāptaṃ yasmādaprāpto vego na bhavati, ataḥ prāptagrahaṇamadhikaṃ `prāptagrahaṇamadhikaṃ sat keṣāñcit' iti pā., tenādhikena prāptagrahaṇena keṣāñcit prāptā api vegā dhāraṇīyā ityarthādhikyamāvedayati; tathā ca tantrāntare- “imāṃstu dhārayedvegān hitaiṣī pretya ceha ca| lobherṣyādveṣamātsaryarāgādīnāṃ yatendriyaḥ `jitendriyaḥ' iti pā. ”- iti| tacca vyākhyānaṃ na yuktaṃ, yasmādviśeṣābhidhānādeva lobhādīnāṃ vegadhāraṇaṃ siddhaṃ; tasmāt prāptān unmukhībhūtāniti vyākhyānaṃ yuktam| anye tu vātādīnāṃ prāptān yuktān vegān na dhārayet, na tu sāhasādivegān na dhārayediti vyākhyānayanti||3||

udāvartasya niruktidvārā kāraṇānyāha- vātaviṇmūtretyādi| aśru netrodakaṃ, kṣavaḥ chikkā; indriyamatra śukramabhipretaṃ, ‘śukrāśmarī tatsravaṇaṃ bhavedvā’ ityādivakṣyamāṇavacanāt; abhidhāne cendriyaśabdaḥ śukre dṛṣṭaḥ; tathāca tadvacaḥ- “śrotravāgādi sattvaṃ ca śukraṃ cendriyamucyate”- iti| vyāhanyamānaiḥ avarudhyamānaiḥ| uditairiti ūrdhvagataiḥ||4||

div.ab: anyeṣāmapi vidhāraṇādudāvartasambhavamāha- kṣuttṛṣṇetyādi| vātaviṇmūtrādikāt kṣuttṛṣṇādīnāṃ bhinnapāṭho vātādīnāṃ sannihitakāraṇatvaṃ tathā kṣudādīnāṃ viprakṛṣṭakāraṇatvaṃ sūcayati; athavā anena bhinnapāṭhena vakṣyamāṇaṃ hetumāhārāśritaṃ sūcayati| yathā- “vāyuḥ koṣṭhānugo rūkṣaiḥ kaṣāyakaṭutiktakaiḥ” ityādi| ye kṣudādīnāṃ bhinnapāṭhaṃ na paṭhanti; tanmate īdṛśaḥ pāṭhaḥ,- ‘vātaviṇmūtrajṛmbhāśrukṣavodgāravamīndriyaiḥ| kṣuttṛṣṇāśvāsanidrāṇāṃ dhṛtyodāvartasambhavaḥ’ iti| dhṛtyā dhāraṇenetyarthaḥ| nanu, adhovegarodhādapānaprakopādudāvartasambhavo yuktaḥ, aśrujṛmbhādivegadhāraṇāt kathaṃ tasyotpattiḥ ? satyaṃ, aśrujṛmbhādivegarodhāt koṣṭhagato vāyuryadā bhavati tadā'pānaprakopādudāvartasambhavaḥ|5|-

ab.seg: tasyābhidhāsye ityādi| tasya udāvartasya| abhidhāsye kathayiṣyāmi| vyāsena vistareṇa||5||

lg.l: trayodaśavidhaś cāsau bhinna etais tu kāraṇaiḥ |6|

div.ab: tasya saṅkhyāmāha- trayodaśavidha ityādi| bhinno bhedaṃ gataḥ| etaiḥ kāraṇaiḥ pūrvoktairvātaviṇmūtrādibhiḥ|6|-

ab.seg: vātādivegarodhāttrayodaśodāvartānabhidhāyedānīṃ kāraṇabhedādaparamapyāha- apathyetyādi| aparo vātādyavarodhajebhyo'nyaḥ||6||

lg.l: ādhmānaśūlau hṛdayoparodhaṃ śirorujaṃ śvāsam atīva hikkām |
kuryād apāno 'bhihataḥ svamārge hanyāt purīṣaṃ mukhataḥ kṣiped vā |8|

ab.seg: vātajodāvartalakṣaṇamāha- ādhmānaśūlāvityādi| hṛdayoparodhaṃ hṛdayāvaraṇam| balāsapittaprasaraṃ śleṣmapittaprasaraṇam| abhihataḥ avaruddhaḥ| svamārge gude| hanyāt purīṣaṃ purīṣakṣayaṃ kuryāt kṣipedvetyatrāpi purīṣamiti sambandhanīyam| galagrahāṃśceti cakārāt krimyādīnāṃ samānatantranirdiṣṭānāṃ grahaṇam| apānāvarodhena prāṇādīnāmapi prakopāt śirorukkāsādisambhavo yuktaḥ||7||

lg.l: āṭopaśūlau parikartanaṃ ca saṅgaḥ purīṣasya tathordhvavātaḥ ||8||
purīṣam āsyād api vā nireti purīṣavege 'bhihate narasya |9|

div.ab: purīṣajodāvartalakṣaṇamāha- āṭopaśūlāvityādi| āṭopa udarāpūraḥ| parikartanaṃ gudameḍhrabastyādiṣu kṛntanamiva vedanā| ūrdhvavāto bahūdgāratā| āsyāt mukhāt| nireti nirgacchati| parikartanaṃ ceti cakārāt piṇḍikodveṣṭanādayaḥ||8||-

lg.l: mūtrasya vege 'bhihate naras tu kṛcchreṇa mūtraṃ kurute 'lpam alpam ||9||
meḍhre gude vaṅkṣaṇabastimuṣkanābhipradeśeṣv athavā 'pi vaṅkṣaṇamuṣkayośca' iti pā. mūrdhni |
ānaddhabastiś ca `ānaddhabasteḥ' iti pā. bhavanti tīvrāḥ śūlāś ca śūlair iva bhinnamūrteḥ ||10||

ab.seg: mūtrodāvartalakṣaṇamāha- mūtrasyetyādi| vaṅkṣaṇam udarorusandhiḥ| muṣkau aṇḍau| mūrdhni uttamāṅge| ānaddhabastiḥ ādhmātamūtrādhāraḥ| ‘ānaddhabasteḥ’ iti kecit paṭhanti, te ca ānaddhabastermūrdhni śūlā bhavantīti yojayanti| tanna, samānatantravirodhāt| bhinnamūrteḥ bhinnaśarīrasya `viddhaśarīrasya' iti pā.||9-10||

lg.l: śrotrānanaghrāṇavilocanotthā bhavanti tīvrāś ca tathā vikārāḥ ||11||

ab.seg: jṛmbhodāvartalakṣaṇamāha- manyetyādi| stambhaśabdo manyāgalābhyāṃ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| galastambho galagrahaḥ| śirovikārāḥ sūryāvartādayaḥ| pavanātmakāḥ kampasuptyādayaḥ, cakārāt arucivibhramādayaśca||11||

lg.l: ānandajaṃ śokasamudbhavaṃ vā netrodakaṃ prāptam amuñcato hi |
śirogurutvaṃ nayanāmayāś ca bhavanti tīvrāḥ saha pīnasena ||12||

ab.seg: aśrujodāvartalakṣaṇamāha- ānandajamityādi| netrodakam aśru, prāptaṃ pravṛttyunmukham| pīnaso'tra pratiśyāyaḥ, samānatantradarśanāt| cakārāt pratiśyāyādayaḥ||12||

lg.l: bhavanti gāḍhaṃ kṣavathor vighātāc chirokṣināsāśravaṇeṣu rogāḥ |
kaṇṭhāsyapūrṇatvam atīva todaḥ kūjaś ca vāyor uta vā 'pravṛttiḥ ||13||

ab.seg: chikkājodāvartalakṣaṇamāha- bhavantītyādi| kṣavathorvighātāt chikkāvarodhāt| kaṇṭhāsyapūrṇatvamiti kaṇṭhamukhe vāyunā pūrṇe iva bhavataḥ| atīva todaḥ atīva vyathā, kaṇṭhamukhayoreva| kecit ‘kaṇṭhasya’ iti paṭhanti, tanmate kaṇṭhasyaiva pūrṇatvaṃ todaśca| kūjaḥ avyaktavacanam| vāyorapravṛttiḥ ucchvāsāvarodhaḥ| uta vā athavetyarthaḥ| cakārāt manyāstambhādayaḥ||13||

div.ab: udgārajodāvartalakṣaṇamāha- udgāravega ityādi| ghorāḥ kaṣṭatarāḥ| "ghorāḥ" ityatra "jantoḥ" iti kecit paṭhanti| pavanaprasūtāḥ kampahikkāhṛdvibandhādayaḥ|14|-

lg.l: charder vighātena bhavec ca kuṣṭhaṃ yenaiva doṣeṇa vidagdham annam ||14||

ab.seg: chardijodāvartalakṣaṇamāha- chardervighātenetyādi| kuṣṭhagrahaṇamatra śītapittakopādyupalakṣaṇārtham| yenaiva doṣeṇa vidagdhamannamiti yenaiva vātādyanyatamena doṣeṇa vidagdhaṃ duṣṭamannaṃ bhavettaddoṣādhikameva kuṣṭhaṃ syādityarthaḥ| cakārāt arocakādayaḥ||14||

lg.l: mūtrāśaye pāyuni `vā gudamuṣkayośca' iti pā. muṣkayoś ca śopho rujo mūtravinigrahaś ca |
śukrāśmarī tatsravaṇaṃ bhaved vā te te vikārā vihate tu śukre ||15||

ab.seg: śukrajodāvartalakṣaṇamāha- mūtrāśaya ityādi| mūtrāśaye bastau, pāyuni gude, śophaḥ śvayathuḥ; rujo'pi mūtrāśayādiṣveva bhavanti| mūtravinigraho mūtrāpravṛttiḥ| tatsravaṇaṃ śukrasravaṇaṃ, samānatantrapratyayāt| te te vikārā iti hṛtpīḍāṅgamardādayaḥ śukravegavighātajāḥ samānatantroktāḥ||15||

lg.l: tandrāṅgamardārucivibhramāḥ syuḥ `tandrāṅgamardāvaruciḥ śramaśca' iti pā. kṣudho 'bhighātāt kṛśatā ca dṛṣṭeḥ |16|

div.ab: kṣujjodāvartalakṣaṇamāha- tandretyādi| tandrā vaikārikī nidrā; aṅgamardaḥ aṅgodveṣṭanamiva vedanā, sphuṭaniketyanye; vibhramaḥ atyarthaṃ cakrārūḍhasyeva bhramaṇam| kṛśatā ca dṛṣṭeḥ dṛṅmāndyam cakārāt daurbalyādayastantrāntaroktā grāhyāḥ|16|-

lg.l: kaṇṭhāsyaśoṣaḥ śravaṇāvarodhas tṛṣṇābhighātād dhṛdaye vyathā ca ||16||

ab.seg: tṛṣṇājodāvartalakṣaṇamāha- kaṇṭhāsyaśoṣa ityādi| śravaṇāvarodho bādhiryam| cakārāt śramasvedādayaḥ samānatantroktāḥ||16||

div.ab: ucchvāsajodāvartalakṣaṇamāha- śrāntasyetyādi| śrāntasya drutagamanādinā `dhāvanādinā' iti pā. khinnasya| śrāntasyetyanenāśrāntasya śvāsadhāraṇādapi pīḍā na bhavatīti sūcyate| moho vaicittyam|17|-

ab.seg: nidrājodāvartalakṣaṇamāha- jṛmbhetyādi| jāḍyaśabdo'ṅgādibhiḥ sambadhyate; jāḍyam apāṭavaṃ, gauravamiti tātparyārthaḥ||17||

parityājyodāvartalakṣaṇamāha- tṛṣṇārditamityādi| parikliṣṭam atyarthamavasannaṃ, kriyārahitamiti yāvat; anye samantato bhāvena kleśamupagataṃ parikliṣṭaṃ manyante| abhidrutaṃ pīḍitam| utsṛjet parityajet||18||

lg.l: sāmānyataḥ pṛthaktvena kriyāṃ bhūyo nibodha me |20|

ab.seg: sarvadodāvarteṣu vāyoḥ sadbhāvāt sāmānyena vātaharīṃ kriyāmāha- sarveṣveteṣvityādi| vidhivat yathāvidhi| kṛtsnaśaḥ sāmastyena| kriyāḥ snehasvedādikāḥ| svamārgapratipattaye vāyorātmamārgapravartanāya| sāmānyataḥ sāmānyena| ‘sarveṣu’ ityatra ‘navasu’ iti paṭhitvā vātajodāvartādiṣu navasaṅkhyeṣu vāyoḥ kriyā vidhātavyeti vyākhyānayanti; tanna, bubhukṣodbhavādiṣvapi caturṣūdāvarteṣu vāyoḥ sadbhāvādvātaharī kriyā kriyata `vidhātavyā' iti pā. iti| pṛthaktvena kriyāmityādi| pṛthaktvena pratyekam||19||
āsthāpanamityādi| āsthāpanaṃ nirūhaḥ, taccānulomikavātaharadravyakṛtam| snigdhasvinne ‘āture’ iti śeṣaḥ| viśiṣyate viśiṣṭaṃ bhavati, viśeṣeṇa kriyata iti tātparyārthaḥ||20||

lg.l: purīṣaje tu kartavyo vidhir ānāhiko bhavet |21|

div.ab: purīṣaja ityādi| ānāhiko vidhiḥ phalavartyādiko vātavyādhyukto visūcyāṃ vakṣyamāṇo vā| tuśabdāt anuktamanyadapi parīṣānulomanaṃ kartavyam|21|-

lg.l: sauvarcalāḍhyāṃ madirāṃ mūtre tv abhihate pibet ||21||
elāṃ vā'py atha madyena kṣīraṃ vā'pi piben naraḥ |
dhātrīphalānāṃ svarasaṃ sajalaṃ vā pibet tryaham ||22||
māṃsopadaṃśaṃ madhu vā pibed vā sīdhu gauḍikam ||23||
bhadradāru ghanaṃ mūrvā haridrā madhukaṃ tathā |

div.ab: sauvarcalāḍhyāmityādi| sauvarcalāḍhyāṃ sauvarcalotkaṭām| madirāṃ madyam| tuśabdāt sarpiṣo'vapīḍanādikaṃ samānatantroktaṃ grāhyam| kiṃ madirāmeva pibedathavā'nyadapītyāha- elāmityādi| dhātrīphalānāṃ svarasaṃ sajalaṃ veti na kevalaṃ dugdhaṃ pibedāmalakarasaṃ sodakaṃ pibedityarthaḥ| ‘gardabhasya’ ityatrāpi ‘purīṣarasam’ iti sambadhyate| māṃsopadaṃśaṃ māṃsabhakṣaṇasahitaṃ, madhu madyam| tacca drākṣodbhavaṃ, samānatantradarśanāt| tathā ca tadvacaḥ,- “drākṣodbhavaṃ cāpi pibenmadyaṃ māṃsopadaṃśakam”- iti| gauḍikaṃ sīdhu guḍakṛtaṃ sasyakam; atrāpi māṃsopadaṃśamiti sambadhyate| bhadradārvityādi| bhadradāru devadāru| ghanaṃ mustā| mūrvā corasnāyuḥ| madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu| kolapramāṇāni ardhakarṣapramāṇāni| duḥsparśā durālabhā| ervāruḥ grīṣmakarkaṭikā| alavaṇīkṛtam īṣatsaindhavayuktam| pañcamūlī laghupañcamūlaṃ, samānatantrasaṃvādāt; tathā coktam- “laghunā pañcamūlena śṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ pibennaraḥ”- iti||21-25||-

lg.l: yogāṃś ca vitared atra pūrvoktān aśmarībhidaḥ ||26||

ab.seg: idānīṃ mūtrajodāvarte aśmarīmūtrakṛcchramūtrāghātacikitsitānyatidiśannāha- yogāṃśca vitaredityādi| vitaret dadyāt| atra mūtrajodāvarte| pūrvoktān ‘kuśaḥ kāśaḥ śaraḥ’ ityādinā'śmarīcikitsitoktān| bhūyaḥ atiśayena| ‘vakṣyāmi yān yogān' ityatrāpi ‘tān kuryāt’ iti sambadhyate||26-27||

div.ab: jṛmbhaṇajodāvartacikitsitamāha- snehairityādi| snehaiḥ svedairiti padadvaye'pi bahuvacanāccaturbhiḥ snehaiścaturbhiśca svedairityarthaḥ|28|-

ab.seg: aśrujodāvartacikitsāmāha- aśrumokṣa ityādi| aśrumokṣaḥ aśruniḥsāraṇam| atra luptacakāranirdeśāttīkṣṇabhañjanādikaṃ vakṣyamāṇamatrāpi sambandhanīyam||28||

div.ab: kṣavajodāvartacikitsitamāha- tīkṣṇāñjanāvapīḍābhyāmityādi| tīkṣṇaśabdo'ñjanāvapīḍābhyāṃ saha sambadhyate| avapīḍo nasyabhedaḥ| tīkṣṇagandhopaśiṅghanaiḥ maricādicūrṇāvaghrāṇaiḥ| vartiprayogā dhūmavartiprayogāḥ| atra luptādiśabdāt arkaraśmivilokanādayo gṛhyante| tathā ca- “tīkṣṇadhūmāñjanāghrāṇanāvanārkavilokanaiḥ| pravartayet kṣutiṃ saktām”- ityādi| kṣavasaktiṃ chikkāyā apravartanam| kecittīkṣṇāñjanāvapīḍābhyāmiti padamaśrujodāvarta eva manyante na kṣavaje, anaupayikatvāttantrāntaravirodhācca||29||-
udgāraje kramopetamityādi| kramopetaṃ dhūmanasyakavalagrahacikitsitoktakramasaṃyuktam| kimudgāraje snaihikaṃ dhūmamevācaredutānyadapītyāha- surāmityādi||30||-

ab.seg: chardyāghātamityādi| chardyāghātaṃ chardyāghātajamudāvartaṃ, kāraṇekāryopacārāt| yathādoṣaṃ doṣasyānatikrameṇa| ādiśabdāt vamanādayaḥ| sakṣāralavaṇopetam īṣadyavakṣārasaindhavasaṃyuktaṃ; yadyapi tantrāntare tailābhyaṅga uktastathā'pyatra vṛddhasampradāyāddhṛtābhyaṅgaḥ kāryaḥ| cakārāt vyāyāmopavāsādayo gṛhyante| 'vamyāghātaṃ' iti kecit paṭhanti||31||

lg.l: ramayeyuḥ ramayeran' iti pā. priyā nāryaḥ śukrodāvartinaṃ naram ||33||

ab.seg: bastiśuddhikarāvāpamityādi| bastiśuddhikarāvāpaṃ kūṣmāṇḍakatṛṇapañcamūlādiprakṣepam| prakṣepadravyapramāṇaṃ kṣīrāṣṭāṃśena| payaḥ kṣīram| prakāmataḥ svecchayā nāryaḥ śukrodāvartinaṃ naraṃ ramayeyuḥ bhajeyuḥ| yadatra ramaṇe strīṇāṃ kartrītvenābhidhānaṃ tat śukrodāvartino harṣādhikyasañjananārtham| priyā manonukūlāḥ| luptacakārāt tāmracūḍādayastantrāntaroktā grāhyāḥ||32-33||

lg.l: kṣudvighāte hitaṃ snigdham uṣṇam alpaṃ ca bhojanam |34|

div.ab: kṣudvighāte hitamityādi| cakārāt laghvapi|34|-

lg.l: tṛṣṇāghāte piben manthaṃ yavāgūṃ vā'pi śītalām ||34||

ab.seg: tṛṣṇāghāte pibenmanthamityādi| manthaḥ saghṛtaśītalajalaplutāḥ saktavaḥ| yavāgūratra peyā| apiśabdāt śītalajalāvagāhapānādikaṃ grāhyam||34||

div.ab: bhojyo rasenetyādi| bhojyo bhojayitavyaḥ rasena māṃsarasena|35|-

lg.l: nidrāghāte pibet kṣīraṃ svapyāc ceṣṭakathā `svapyācceṣṭakathārataḥ' iti pā. naraḥ ||35||

ab.seg: nidrāghāte pibet kṣīramityādi| kṣīraṃ gokṣīraṃ na māhiṣaṃ, pradhānakalpanāśrayaṇāt samānatantradarśanācca| tathā ca tantrāntaram,- “nidrāghāte pibet kṣīraṃ gostanādathavā naraḥ”- iti| iṣṭakathā anukūlakathāḥ `anuraktajanakathāḥ' iti pā., ‘śṛṇuyāt’ iti śeṣaḥ| ‘iṣṭakathārataḥ’ iti pāṭhāntaram| svapyāt nidrāṃ gacchet||35||

lg.l: yac ca yatra bhavet prāptaṃ tac ca tasmin prayojayet ||36||

ab.seg: udāvartacikitsitamabhidhāyedānīṃ tadupadravacikitsitamāha- ādhmānādyeṣu rogeṣvityādi| ādhmānādyeṣu vegāvarodhajāteṣu| ādiśabdāt śūlaparikartikāpurīṣasaṅgādīnāṃ grahaṇam| yathāsvaṃ yasyādhmānāderyadātmīyamauṣadhaṃ vātavyādhyādicikitsitoktaṃ tena prayateta prayatnaṃ kurvīta| anyadapyucitaṃ cikitsitamādhmānādiṣu kāryamityāha- yaccetyādi| yadauṣadhaṃ yasmin ādhmānādau prāptaṃ yuktam||36||

lg.l: bhojanaiḥ kupitaḥ sadya udāvartaṃ karoti hi ||37||
labhate ca bahūn anyān vikārān vātakopajān |41|

div.ab: ‘apathyabhojanāccāpi vakṣyate ca tathā'paraḥ’ iti yaduktaṃ tasyāvasaraḥ- vāyurityādi| koṣṭhānugo vāyuratra apānaḥ, samānatantradarśanāt| tasya lakṣaṇamāha- vātetyādi| udāvartayati ūrdhvāmāvartayati, adhovahāni srotāṃsyūrdhvavahāni karotītyarthaḥ| purīṣaṃ cātivartayediti, uṣṭrādipurīṣavat kaṭhinaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ| tataḥ tasmāddhetoḥ| vibhramo vyāpadviśeṣaḥ| anyān ādhmānapratyādhmānādīn||37-40||-

tasya cikitsitamāha- taṃ tailetyādi| tam udāvartinam| doṣata ityādi| bhinnavarcaskaṃ nirūhabhinnapurīṣaṃ puruṣaṃ doṣamapekṣya bhuktavantamanuvāsayediti sambandhaḥ| kecidatrānuvāsanaṃ niruhātiyogavyāpatpraśamanārthaṃ manyante; tanna, samānatantravirodhāt; tathā ca,- “udāvarte tvapathyotthe sunirūḍhaṃ tato bhiṣak| yathādoṣaṃ bhuktavantamāśu caivānuvāsayet”- iti| kecit ‘bhinnavarcaskaṃ’ ityatra ‘bhinnavarcāṃsi’ iti paṭhitvā anulomanīyāni bhuktavantamiti vyākhyānayanti||41||-

lg.l: na cec chāntiṃ vrajaty evam udāvartaḥ sudāruṇaḥ ||42||

div.ab: nirūhānuvāsanābhyāmapyapraśāmyatyudāvarte cikitsitamāha- na cecchāntimityādi| evaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā| enam udāvartinam| svinnaṃ snigdhasvinnam, ādilopāt| snehavirecanaireraṇḍatailādibhiḥ||42||-

lg.l: yogāv etāv udāvartaṃ śūlaṃ cānilajaṃ `cāpi niyacchataḥ' iti pā. hataḥ ||44||

ab.seg: apathyajodāvarte yogadvayamāha- pāyayetetyādi| pīluḥ uṣṭrapriyo guḍaphalaḥ, bhādānake ‘pīlu’ iti prasiddhaḥ| amlapācanaiḥ amlaṃ kāñjikaṃ, pācanāni citrakādīni, taiḥ saha pāyayedityarthaḥ| trivṛdādiḥ eko yogaḥ, hiṅgvādistu dvitīyaḥ| svarjī svarjikākṣāraḥ| dviruttaramiti ādyācca dravyāduttarottaraṃ dravyaṃ dviguṇaṃ grāhyam| dviruttaramiti padaṃ na pūrvayoge sambandhanīyaṃ, ‘dviruttarā hiṅguvacā sakuṣṭhā’ ityādinā tantrāntare darśitatvāt| yavānīrityatra yavāgūmiti kecit paṭhanti| apare ‘amlapācanaiḥ’ ityatra 'amlapānakaiḥ' iti paṭhitvā amladravairiti vyākhyānayanti||43-44||

lg.l: devadārvagnikau kuṣṭhaṃ śuṇṭhīṃ `vacāṃ' iti pā. pathyāṃ palaṅkaṣām |

div.ab: devadārvagnikāvityādi| agnikaḥ ajamodā| pathyā harītakī| palaṅkaṣā gugguluḥ| ardhāḍhakaṃ dvātriṃśatpalāni, pādāvaśiṣṭam aṣṭapalapramitaṃ, vṛddhavaidyavyavahārāttantrāntaradarśanācca| tathā ca tantrāntare uktam,- "kuṣṭhaṃ palaṅkaṣāṃ pathyāṃ śuṇṭhīṃ dārvagnipuṣkaram| dvātriṃśatā toyapalaiḥ paktvā pādāvaśeṣitam| pāyayet"- ityādi| yadyapi ‘kvāthasyāñjaliriṣyate’ iti paribhāṣā vidyate, tathā'pi mānānuktau paribhāṣāśrayaṇaṃ na punarukte māne| kecidardhāḍhakaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭipalāni manyante, te ca ṣoḍaśapalonmitaṃ kvāthaṃ pāyayanti; apare kvāthabāhulyāt kramaśaḥ kvāthapānamicchanti na punarekasminneva divase; tanna, samānatantravirodhāt||45||-

lg.l: mūlakaṃ śuṣkam ārdraṃ ca varṣābhūḥ pañcamūlakam ||46||
ārevataphalaṃ cāpsu paktvā tena ghṛtaṃ pacet |
tat pīyamānaṃ śāsty ugram udāvartam aśeṣataḥ `śamayedudāvartamaśeṣataḥ' iti pā.||47||

ab.seg: udāvarte pānārthaṃ ghṛtamāha- mūlakamityādi| śuṣkamiti mūlārdrakayorviśeṣaṇam| varṣābhūḥ punarnavā| pañcamūlakaṃ bilvādipañcamūlam| ārevataphalaṃ girimālakaphalam| paktveti kvāthapākaparibhāṣayā| tena kvāthena| śāsti hantītyarthaḥ||46-47||

lg.l: kṛṣṇāṃ nirdahanīṃ cāpi pibed uṣṇena vāriṇā ||48||

ab.seg: vacāmativiṣāmityādi| nirdahanī agnimanthaḥ, gaṇikāriketyanye||48||

lg.l: kuṣṭhaṃ kiṇvāgnikau caiva pibet tulyāni pūrvavat ||49||

ab.seg: ikṣvākumūlamityādi| ikṣvākuḥ kaṭutumbī| viśalyā kāṣṭhapāṭalā, indravāruṇītyanye| kiṇvaṃ surābījaṃ; agnikaḥ ajamodā| pūrvavaditi uṣṇodakenetyarthaḥ| mūtreṇa gomūtreṇa| agniḥ citrakaḥ||49||

div.ab: yavaprasthamityādi| kaṇṭakārīphalayavayoḥ samuditena samabhāgena prasthaṃ ṣoḍaśapalāni| jalāḍhakaṃ toyasya catuḥṣaṣṭipalāni, vṛddhavaidyavyavahārādatra toyadvaiguṇyaparibhāṣā nādriyate| ardhaprasthaśeṣam aṣṭau palāni| atra kvāthasyāṣṭau palāni bahutvāt kathaṃ pātavyānīti nāśaṅkanīyaṃ, "ṛṣayastveva jānanti drvyasaṃyogajaṃ `yogasaṃyogajaṃ' iti pā. phalam"- ityukteḥ| ye tu pūrvoktadevadārvādipānavadatrāpi toyasya mānādhikyamicchanti, te kaṇṭakāriphalānyapi prasthapramitāni gṛhṇanti| kecit ‘yavaprasthaṃ pale dve ca kaṇṭakāryā’ iti paṭhanti||50||-

lg.l: sañcūrṇya pradhamen nāḍyā viśaty etad yathā gudam |52|

div.ab: madanālābubījānītyādi| madanaṃ madanaphalaṃ, tasya bījāni vaitaraṇasaṃvādāt| tathā ca tadvacaḥ,- "madanālābunorbījaṃ kaṇṭakārīkaṇānvitam"- ityādi| nidigdhikā kaṇṭakārī| etāni sañcūrṇya nāḍyā pradhamet mukhādivāyunā kṛtvā gude prerayet||51||-

lg.l: gavāṃ mūtreṇa tā vartīḥ kārayet tu gudānugāḥ |

ab.seg: cūrṇamityādi| nikumbho dantīvṛkṣaḥ, kampillaḥ rocanikā, śyāmā aruṇamūlā trivṛt, ikṣvākuḥ kaṭutumbī, agnikaḥ ajamodā, kṛtavedhanaṃ kośātakībhedaḥ, māgadhī pippalī, lavaṇāni saindhavādīni, gudānugā gudapraveśayogyapramāṇā| śarmakarau sukhakarau| etau yogāviti madanādicūrṇapradhamanayogavartiyogau| amṛtasammitau amṛtatulyau, jīvanīyātmakatvāt| vartikalpanāṃ kathayati- nikumbhādīnāṃ cūrṇaṃ gomūtreṇa paktvā ghane śītībhūte ca sati vartīḥ kārayet||52-53||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre udāvartapratiṣedho nāma (saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) pañcapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||55||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantre udāvartapratiṣedho nāma pañcapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||55||

div.head: visūcikāpratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto visūcikāpratiṣedham adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

udāvartapratiṣedhānantaramudāvartāśritavātapratilomyakṛtamandāgnervisūcikāhetutvādvisūcikāpratiṣedhārambho yukta ityata āha- athāta ityādi| visūciketyatra ādiśabdo lupto draṣṭavyaḥ, tenālasakavilambikayorgrahaṇam||1-2||

lg.l: ajīrṇam āmaṃ viṣṭabdhaṃ vidagdhaṃ ca yad īritam |

ab.seg: visūcyādīnāṃ kāraṇamāha- ajīrṇamāmamityādi| yadīritamiti ‘annapānavidhau’ iti śeṣaḥ| tasmāt ajīrṇāt| yadatra caturthājīrṇasya rasaśeṣasyopādānaṃ na kṛtaṃ tadapariṇāmamātratvena tasya visūcyādyārambhakatvābhāvādekīyamatatvenoktatvācca| visūcyalasakābhyāṃ yadvilambikāyāḥ pṛthagvibhaktinirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ, tattasyā asādhyatvāvabodhanārtham, itarayośca prāyaḥ kṛcchrasādhyatvabodhanārtham||3||

lg.l: yasyājīrṇena sā vaidyair ucyateti `tu' iti pā. visūcikā ||4||

ab.seg: visūcyā niruktimāha- sūcībhirityādi| vaidyaiḥ ādyairityarthaḥ| ucyate ti ‘varṇāgama-’ ityādinā ikāralopāt sādhuḥ| ‘tudan’ ityatra ‘bhindan’ iti kecit paṭhanti| yadatra visūcyādīnāṃ prāgrūpaṃ na bhaṇitaṃ tadrūpāṇyevālpānyāsāṃ prāgrūpaṃ, na tu prāgrūpāntaramastīti bodhayati||4||

lg.l: mūḍhās tām ajitātmāno labhante kaluṣāśayāḥ `'śanalolupāḥ' iti pā.||5||

ab.seg: idānīmajīrṇaparivarjane yatnātiśayaḥ kārya iti pratipādanārthamāha- na tāmityādi| parimitāhārā aniṣiddhāśanaṃ bhuñjānāḥ| viditāgamā jñātabhojanopadeśāḥ| mūḍhāḥ paśutulyāḥ, sevyāsevyāhārānabhijñā ityarthaḥ| ajitātmānaḥ ajitendriyāḥ| kaluṣāśayāḥ praduṣṭāmāśayāḥ, āmāśayaduṣṭiśca duṣṭānnasamparkādvātādikopācca; kecit ‘aśanalolupāḥ’ iti paṭhanti||5||

lg.l: vaivarṇyakampau hṛdaye rujaś ca bhavanti tasyāṃ śirasaś ca bhedaḥ ||6||

ab.seg: visūcikālakṣaṇamāha- mūrcchātisārāvityādi| vamathuḥ chardiḥ| udveṣṭanaṃ jaṅghādīnāṃ moṭanaṃ, khallīti loke| tasyāṃ visūcikāyām| śirasaśca bhedaḥ śirovidāraṇamiva vedanā||6||

lg.l: niruddho mārutaś cāpi kukṣau `kukṣāvupari dhāvati' iti pā. viparidhāvati ||7||
vātavarconirodhaś ca kukṣau yasya bhṛśaṃ bhavet |
tasyālasakam ācaṣṭe tṛṣṇodgārāv arodhakau `tṛṣṇodgārau tu yasya tu' iti pā.||8||

ab.seg: alasakalakṣaṇamāha- kukṣirityādi| kukṣiḥ udaram| ānahyate ādhmānayukto bhavati| atyarthamatiśayaṃ yathā tathā| tāmyati tamasi praviśatīva| vikūjati avyaktaśabdaṃ karoti| viparidhāvati viśeṣeṇa samantādgacchati||7-8||

lg.l: duṣṭaṃ tu bhuktaṃ kaphamārutābhyāṃ pravartate nordhvam adhaś ca yasya |
vilambikāṃ tāṃ bhṛśaduścikitsyām ācakṣate `tu vivarjanīyāṃ' iti pā. śāstravidaḥ purāṇāḥ ||9||

ab.seg: vilambikālakṣaṇamāha- duṣṭamityādi| bhuktaṃ bhojanam| duṣṭamityatra ‘kaphamārutābhyām’ iti sambandhanīyam| yadyapi vilambikā bāhulyena vidagdhājīrṇājjāyate, vidagdhājīrṇācca pittaṃ duṣṭaṃ na vāyurduṣṭo bhavati na vā śleṣmā, tathā'pi pittaduṣṭyā `pittaduṣṭāvitarayorapi' iti pā. itarayorapi duṣṭiḥ, tasmāt kaphamārutābhyāṃ duṣṭamityuktam; evaṃ bāhulyena āmāviśiṣṭatvotthitayorvisūcyalasakayoḥ `āmāviṣṭabdhocchritayoḥ' iti pā. kaphavātādhikayorapītaradoṣasadbhāvo jñeyaḥ| ‘duṣṭam’ ityatra ‘līnam’ iti kecit paṭhanti| iyameva vilambikā tantrāntare ‘daṇḍālasaka’ iti nāmnā kathyate||9||

lg.l: yatrastham āmaṃ virujet tam eva deśaṃ viśeṣeṇa vikārajātaiḥ |
doṣeṇa yenāvatataṃ svaliṅgais taṃ `śarīraṃ tallakṣaṇairāmasamudbhavaiśca' iti pā. lakṣayed āmasamudbhavaiś ca ||10||

ab.seg: idānīṃ pūrvoktalakṣaṇaviśeṣamatideśenāha- yatrasthamāmamityādi| yatrasthaṃ yasmin deśe sthitaṃ, yena ca doṣeṇāvatataṃ vyāptamāmaṃ syāt, tameva deśaṃ yasmādviśeṣeṇa rujet tasmāt kāraṇāttaṃ deśaṃ taddoṣalakṣaṇairvikārajātaistodādibhirāmasamudbhavaiśca liṅgaiḥ stambhādhmānādibhirlakṣayediti piṇḍārthaḥ| nanu, yatrasthamityanena āmasthānakathanena kiṃ prayojanaṃ? yasmādyatra sthito vikṛto doṣo bhaviṣyati tatraiva rujaṃ kariṣyati? satyaṃ, naivaṃ sarvatra, yathā gaṇḍamālādau piṇḍikāsthitasyāpi doṣasya grīvādau vikārakartṛtvadarśanāt| āmapīḍitadeśāvabodhaścātra sukhacikitsākaraṇārthamuktaḥ| arthāt yatra yasmin sthāne sthitamāmamajīrṇaṃ virujedviśiṣṭaṃ rujaṃ kuryāt tameva deśaṃ lakṣayedvaidyaḥ, kairvikārajātaiḥ? āmasamudbhavaiḥ stambhagauravādibhiḥ| brahmadevastu yena doṣeṇa vātādyanyatamenānugatamāmajaṃ doṣaṃ svaliṅgairvātādyanyatamadoṣaliṅgairlakṣayediti vyākhyānayati| apare'nyathā paṭhitvā vyākhyānayanti, tacca śiṣyabuddhivyākulakartutvādgranthagauravabhayācca parihṛtam||10||

lg.l: kṣāmasvaraḥ sarvavimuktasandhir yāyān naraḥ so 'punar āgamāya ||11||

ab.seg: asādhyalakṣaṇamāha- ya ityādi| śyāvaśabdo dantādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| alpasañjño mandacetanaḥ| abhyantarayātanetraḥ kṣīṇadṛṣṭiḥ| apunarāgamāya apunarāvṛttaye||11||

lg.l: sādhyāsu pārṣṇyor dahanaṃ praśastam agnipratāpo vamanaṃ ca tīkṣṇam |
pakve tato 'nne tu vilaṅghanaṃ syāt sampācanaṃ cāpi virecanaṃ ca ||12||

ab.seg: idānīṃ cikitsitamāha- sādhyāsvityādi| sādhyāsu visūcikāsu| pārṣṇidahanamatra sañjñāprabodhanārthamadho'tipravṛttivāraṇārthaṃ ca| agnipratāpanam āmapācanārtham| tīkṣṇaṃ ca vamanamannaśalyanirharaṇārtham| sādhyāsviti padamasādhyaparihārārthaṃ, sādhyajñāne yatnātiśayapratipādanārthaṃ ca| pākābhimukhe'nne doṣaśeṣanirharaṇārthamāha `doṣaśeṣanivāraṇārthamāha' iti pā. - pakva ityādi| pakve pākābhimukhe| vilaṅghanaṃ vividhalaṅghanaṃ, tacca yathāvasthaṃ yojyaṃ; anye viśiṣṭaṃ laṅghanamāhuḥ, taccopavāsaḥ| sampācanamatra svedādibhiḥ| virecanamatra phalavartyādibhiḥ| yadyapi virecanamatra sāmānyenoktaṃ, tathā'pi viṣṭambhe `pakve viṣṭabdhe sati' iti pā. sati jñātavyam| anye tu paṭhanti ‘vānte tato'nne tu vilaṅghanaṃ syāt sampācanaṃ recanadīpane ca’ iti| te ca visūcyāṃ vamane prayukte paścādvilaṅghanādikaṃ yojyamiti manyante| pācanamatīsāroktaṃ ‘devadārvabhayā’ ityādikaṃ, dīpanaṃ pippalyādikaṃ, śeṣaṃ pūrvavat| anye ‘pakṣe tato'nye tu’ iti paṭhanti, te ca pakṣādvirecanaṃ deyamiti kecinmanyanta iti vyākhyānayanti; tatra ṭīkākṛdbhirbahu `ṭīkākudbhiryaduktaṃ' iti pā. vyāhṛtaṃ tacca granthagauravabhayāt parityaktam||12||

lg.l: viśuddhadehasya hi sadya eva mūrcchātisārādir upaiti śāntim |13|

div.ab: kasmādvisūcyāṃ vamanavirecane prayoktavye ityāha- viśuddhadehasyetyādi| hi yasmāt| upaiti gacchati|13|-

lg.l: āsthāpanaṃ cāpi vadanti pathyaṃ sarvāsu yogān aparān nibodha ||13||

ab.seg: idānīmāsthāpanasyāpi hitatvaṃ darśayitumāha- āsthāpanamityādi| yadyapi ‘tatronmādabhayaśokapipāsārocakājīrṇārśa-‘ ityādinā'jīrṇe āsthāpananiṣedha uktaḥ, tathā'pyatra pākābhimukhe'nne viṣṭambhanāśanāya pācanapūrvakamāsthāpanamapi śasyate| sarvāsu visūcīṣu; kecit sarvāsu visūcyalasakavilambikāsviti manyante| ‘sarvāsu’ ityatra kecit ‘sarvāṃśca’ iti paṭhanti, te vakṣyamāṇayogaviśeṣaṇaṃ kurvanti| yogānityādi| aparān vakṣyamāṇān| nibodha jānīhi| apakvasya pācanārthaṃ pakvasya cānulomanārthaṃ' iti śeṣaḥ||13||

lg.l: sukhāmbupītaṃ vinihanty ajīrṇaṃ śūlaṃ visūcīm aruciṃ ca sadyaḥ ||14||

ab.seg: tāneva yogānāha- pathyetyādi| kaliṅga indrayavaḥ| gṛñjano rasonabhedaḥ| ajīrṇam āmaśeṣaḥ, na tu taruṇājīrṇaṃ; tatrauṣadhaniṣedhāt| visūcīti śeṣā natu sadyotthā visūcī, tatrāpyauṣadhaniṣedhāt||14||

lg.l: kṣārāgadaṃ vā lavaṇaṃ viḍaṃ vā guḍapragāḍhān atha sarṣapān vā |
amlena vā saindhavahiṅguyuktau sabījapūrṇau saghṛtau trivargau ||15||
kaṭutrikaṃ vā lavaṇair upetaṃ pibet snuhīkṣīravimiśritaṃ tu |
kalyāṇakaṃ vā lavaṇaṃ pibet tu yad uktam ādāv anilāmayeṣu ||16||

ab.seg: kṣārāgadamityādi| kṣārāgadaṃ ‘dhavāśvakarṇaśirīṣa-’ (ka. 6 ) ityādinā dundubhisvanīyoktam| lavaṇaṃ viḍalavaṇam| atrāpyuṣṇāmbunā pibediti sambandhanīyam| guḍapragāḍhānityādi| guḍapragāḍhān guḍāḍhyān guḍotkaṭān' iti pā.| amlenetyādi| amlena kāñjikena| sabījapūrau bījapūrasahitau| saghṛtau tulyapramāṇau| trivargau triphalātrikaṭukau| 'sabījapūrau' ityatra kecit 'saśākabījau' iti paṭhitvā śākavṛkṣabījasahitāviti vyākhyānayanti| yaduktamādāviti 'gaṇḍīrapalāśa' (ci. 4 ) ityādinā vātavyādhicikitsite yaduktamityarthaḥ| 'āmeṣvanilāmayeṣu' iti kecit paṭhitvā āmavāte iti vyākhyānayanti| atrāpi amleneti sambadhyate||15-16||

lg.l: kṛṣṇājamodakṣavakāṇi vā'pi tulyau pibed vā magadhānikumbhau |
dantīyutaṃ vā magadhodbhavānāṃ kalkaṃ pibet koṣavatīrasena ||17||
uṣṇābhir adbhir magadhodbhavānāṃ kalkaṃ piben nāgarakalkayuktam |18|

div.ab: kṛṣṇājamodetyādi| kṣavaḥ phaṇijjakākāraḥ prāyaśaḥ pāriyātre bhavati| 'kṣavakāṇi vā'pi' ityatra 'kṣavakāgnikān vā' iti kecit paṭhanti| atrāpi amleneti sambadhyate| tulyau pibedvetyādi| nikumbho dantī| atrāpyamleneti sambadhyate| magadhānikumbhapānaṃ viṣṭambhe sati virekārtham| keciduṣṇodakena pānamicchanti| dantīyutamityādi| koṣavatī ghoṣakaḥ| kecit “uṣṇābhiradbhirmagadhodbhavānāṃ kalkaṃ pibennāgaracūrṇayuktam” īdṛśaṃ paṭhanti||17||-

lg.l: vyoṣaṃ karañjasya phalaṃ haridre mūlaṃ samaṃ cāpy atha mātuluṅgyāḥ ||18||
chāyāviśuṣkā guṭikāḥ kṛtās tā hanyur visūcīṃ nayanāñjanena |19|

div.ab: visūcyāṃ pramīlakādiśāntyarthamañjanamāha- vyoṣamityādi| kecinmātuluṅgīṃ madhukarkaṭīmāhuḥ| visūcīśabdena visūcījanitāḥ pramīlakaśirorogādayo gṛhyante, kāraṇe kāryopacārāt; athavā visūcīmevāñjanaprabhāvāt hanyuḥ||18||-

lg.l: suvāmitaṃ sādhuvirecitaṃ vā sulaṅghitaṃ manujaṃ viditvā ||19||

div.ab: śuddhasya sulaṅghitasya pathyadānārthamāha- suvāmitamityādi| kecidatra “kuṣṭhaṃ cāguru patraṃ ca rāsnāśigruvacātvacam| piṣṭamamlena tacchreṣṭhaṃ visūcyāmaṅgamardanam||citrakaṃ pūtipiṇyākaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ bhallātakāni ca| dvau kṣārau saindhavaṃ caiva śuklaṃ tailaṃ vipācayet|| etadudvartanaṃ kuryāt pradehaṃ vā vicakṣaṇaḥ|” iti yogadvayaṃ paṭhanti; tanna paṭhitavyaṃ, samānatantrādarśanāt||19||-

lg.l: āmaṃ śakṛd vā nicitaṃ krameṇa bhūyo vibaddhaṃ viguṇānilena ||20||
pravartamānaṃ na yathāsvam enaṃ vikāram ānāham udāharanti |21|

div.ab: idānīṃ visūcikātulyacikitsitatvādvisūcikopadravatvāccānuktamapyānāhamāha- āmamityādi| āmam apakvānnarasaḥ, śakṛt purīṣaṃ, nicitaṃ vṛddhigataṃ, vibaddham avaruddhaṃ, viguṇānilena unmārgavāyunā, na pravartamānamiti nādhaḥpravartamānamityarthaḥ, yathāsvaṃ yathāmārgamityarthaḥ; evam āmaṃ nicitaṃ viguṇānilena vibaddhaṃ sat svamārge'pravartamānaṃ śakṛdvā evambhūtamānāhaṃ vikāramudāharantīti piṇḍārthaḥ| kecidāmamiti śakṛdviśeṣaṇaṃ manyante; tanna, samānatantre āmādapyānāhasya darśitatvāt| tathā ca tadvacaḥ- “ānāhe tvāmasambhūte viḍudbhūte'pi vā bhiṣak”- ityādi||20||-

lg.l: āmāśaye śūlam atho gurutvaṃ hṛllāsa udgāravighātanaṃ ca |22|

div.ab: āmajānāhalakṣaṇamāha- tasminnityādi| tasmin ānāhe| gurutvamapi āmāśaye āmajānāhe prāyaśo bhavati| kecit ‘hṛllāsa’ ityatra ‘hṛtstambha’ iti paṭhitvā hṛdayasya vibandhatvamiti vyākhyānayanti| udgāravighātanam udgārasyāsamyakpravṛttiḥ| kecidāmasamudbhave āmāśayasamudbhave iti vyākhyānayanti, padeṣvapi padaikadeśaprayogāt; te ca āmāśayasamudbhavamāmādevecchanti; tatrāpi `tathā'pi' iti pā. sa eva tātparyārthaḥ||21||-

lg.l: stambhaḥ kaṭīpṛṣṭhapurīṣamūtre śūlo 'tha mūrcchā sa `ca śakṛdvamiśca' iti pā. śakṛd vamec ca ||22||
śvāsaś ca pakvāśayaje bhavanti liṅgāni cātrālasakodbhavāni |23|

div.ab: purīṣajānāhalakṣaṇamāha- stambha ityādi| stambhaśabdaḥ kaṭyādibhirmūtrāntaiḥ saha pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| śūlo'pyatra kaṭyādiṣveva| sa puruṣaḥ| pakvāśayaje ānāhe ityarthaḥ| ‘mañcāḥ krośanti’ itivadupacārāt pakvāśayaśabdenātra purīṣamabhipretaṃ, atha ca bāhulyena pakvāśaye bhavati| kecit pakvāśayaje pakvāśayasthe ānāhe iti vyākhyānayanti| te ca pakvāśayodbhūta ānāhaḥ purīṣādbhavati itīcchanti; tathā'pi sa pūrvokta eva pariphalitārthaḥ||22||-

ab.seg: sampratyāmotthānāhacikitsāmāha- āmodbhava ityādi| āmodbhave avipakvarasaje ānāhe| kecidāmodbhave āmāśayodbhave, padeṣvapi padaikadeśaprayogāt| eṣa pakṣaścānantarameva vivṛtaḥ| vāntaṃ kṛtavamanaṃ naram| saṃsargabhaktakramaḥ peyādikramaḥ| dīpanīyāni pipalyādisādhitāni||23||

lg.l: athetaraṃ yo na śakṛd vamet tam āmaṃ jayet svedanapācanaiś ca |24|

div.ab: purīṣajānāhacikitsāmāha- athetaramityādi| yaḥ pumān śakṛt purīṣaṃ na vamet , tasya puṃsastamānāhamitaraṃ purīṣajam āmānvitaṃ svedanādibhirjayediti sambandhaḥ| yastu śakṛdvamettasya āmaṃ na jayet, tathā satyasādhyatvāditi bhāvaḥ| kārtikakuṇḍastu itaraṃ pakvāśayajānāhavantaṃ naraṃ, matvarthīyapratyayāntatvāt|| asāvapi pakṣo'nantaraṃ vivṛtaḥ| 'svedanapācanīyaiḥ' ityatra ca kārtikakuṇḍaḥ 'svedya yathāvidhānaṃ' iti paṭhitvā vyākhyānayati- svedya svedayitvā, upasargalopāt sādhu; yathāvidhānamiti viṇmūtrānulomanavidhānena|24|-

lg.l: tāny eva vartīr viraced vicūrṇya mahiṣyajāvībhagavāṃ tu mūtraiḥ |
svinnasya pāyau viniveśya tāś ca cūrṇāni caiṣāṃ pradhamet tu nāḍyā ||25||

ab.seg: atideśenānāhacikitsāmāha- visūcikāyāmityādi| visūcikāyāṃ parikīrtitāni kathitāni yāni vairecanikāni dravyāṇi dantyādīni, tāni vicūrṇya mahiṣyādīnāṃ mūtrairvipācya vartīrviracet `vitaret dadyāt' iti pā. kuryāt| tāśca vartīḥ svinnasya narasya gude viniveśya, eṣāṃ vairecanikānāmeva cūrṇāni nāḍyā pradhamediti sambandhaḥ| ibho hastī||24-25||

lg.l: mūtreṣu saṃsādhya yathāvidhānaṃ dravyāṇi yāny ūrdhvam adhaś ca yānti |
kvāthena tenāśu nirūhayec ca mūtrārdhayuktena samākṣikeṇa ||26||
tribhaṇḍiyuktaṃ lavaṇaprakuñcaṃ dattvā viriktakramam ācarec ca |27|

div.ab: ānāhe nirūhamāha- mūtreṣu saṃsādhyetyādi| yāni dravyāṇi ūrdhvamadhaśca yānti tāni mūtreṣu yathāvidhānaṃ saṃsādhya tena kvāthenārdhamūtrānvitena samākṣikeṇa tribhaṇḍiyuktalavaṇaṃ prakuñcaṃ dattvā niruhayediti piṇḍārthaḥ| mūtreṣviti anantarokteṣu mahiṣyādijeṣu| saṃsādhya paktvā| yathāvidhānaṃ kvāthapākavidhinā| dravyāṇi yānyūrdhvamadhaśca yānti saṃśodhanasaṃśamanīyoktāni kośātakyādīni| āśu śīghram| mūtrārdhayutena ardhamūtrānvitena kvāthena| kārtikakuṇḍastu mātrārdhayukteneti paṭhati, vyākhyānayati ca- ardhamātrikeṇeti| mākṣikaṃ madhu| tribhaṇḍiyuktaṃ lavaṇaprakuñcamiti trivṛtsahitameva saindhavapalamityarthaḥ| viriktakramaṃ samyagviriktasya yaḥ kramastamācaredityarthaḥ; kecit ācaredityantarbhāvitakāritārthaṃ manyante; tena, ācaret vaidyenācārayedityarthaḥ| idamāsthāpanamānāhe pācanottarakālaṃ deyaṃ, na tvāmāvasthāyām||26||-

lg.l: eṣv eva tailena ca sādhitena prāptaṃ yadi syād anuvāsayec ca ||27||

ab.seg: ānāhe'nuvāsanamāha- eṣvevetyādi| eṣviti anantarābhihitanirūhokteṣu kośātakyādiṣu| prāptaṃ prāptakālaṃ prāptāvasthamityarthaḥ; etena paripakvāmaṃ sunirūḍhaṃ vātakope satyanuvāsayedityarthaḥ||27||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre visūcikāpratiṣedho nāma (aṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ ) ṣaṭpañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||56||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantre visūcikāpratiṣedho nāma ṣaṭpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||56||

div.head: arocakapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto 'rocakapratiṣedham adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
visūcikāpratiṣedhānantaraṃ rasadoṣajatvasāmyādagnimāndyahetutvasāmyāccārocakapratiṣedhārambhaḥ- athāta ityādi| atra ādiśabdo lupto draṣṭavyaḥ; tenāvipākasyāpi grahaṇam||1-2||

lg.l: doṣaiḥ pṛthak saha ca cittaviparyayāc ca bhaktāyaneṣu hṛdi cāvatate pragāḍham |
nānne rucir bhavati taṃ bhiṣajo vikāraṃ bhaktopaghātam iha pañcavidhaṃ vadanti ||3||

ab.seg: samprāptidvāreṇa saṅkhyāmāha- doṣairityādi| doṣaiḥ pṛthagiti trayaḥ, saha ceti samastaiḥ ekaḥ, cittaviparyayāt kāmaśokabhayādibhirviluptacittatvāt, cittaviparyayāttu ekaḥ; kecit ‘cittaviparyayāt' ityatra ‘śokasamucchrayāt’ iti paṭhanti, tanmate kāmādijānāmasaṅgrahaḥ| bhaktāyaneṣu annavaheṣu srotaḥsu| bhaktāyanamiti jihvopalakṣaṇaṃ, samānatantradarśanāt| tathā ca- “pṛthagdoṣaiḥ samastaiśca jihvāhṛdayasaṃsṛtaiḥ| jāyate'rucirāhāre dviṣṭairanyaiśca mānasaiḥ”- iti| avatate iti bhaktāyaneṣvityatrāpi vacanavipariṇāmāt sambandhanīyam| avatate vyāpte| bhaktopaghātam arocakaṃ; arocakābhaktacchandānnadveṣāḥ paryāyā boddhavyāḥ; kaiścideṣāṃ parasparaṃ bhedo'ṅgīkriyate| tathā ca vṛddhabhojaḥ- “prakṣiptaṃ tu mukhe cānnaṃ jantorna svadate muhuḥ| arocakaḥ sa vijñeyo, bhaktadveṣamataḥ śṛṇu|| cintayitvā tu manasā dṛṣṭvā śrutvā'pi bhojanam| dveṣamāyāti yajjanturbhaktadveṣaḥ `yo jantuḥ' iti pā. sa ucyate|| yasya nānne bhavecchraddhā so'bhaktacchanda ucyate”- ityādi| iha asmin śāstre| saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva saṅkhyāyāṃ siddhāyāṃ pañcavidhamiti saṅkhyākaraṇaṃ niyamārthaṃ; tena kāmādijā arocakāḥ pṛthaṅna gaṇanīyāḥ||3||

lg.l: hṛcchūlapīḍanayutaṃ virasānanatvaṃ vātātmake bhavati liṅgam arocake tu |4|

div.ab: vātikārocakalakṣaṇamāha- hṛcchūlapīḍanayutamityādi| hṛcchūlapīḍanayutamiti virasānanatvamityetasya viśeṣaṇam| apare tu hṛt hṛdayaṃ śūlapīḍanābhyāṃ yuktaṃ bhavatīti vyākhyānayanti| arocakānāṃ prāgrūpānabhidhānaṃ rūpāṇāmevāvyaktānāṃ prāgrūpatvāt|4|-

lg.l: hṛddāhacoṣabahutā mukhatiktatā ca mūrcchā satṛḍ bhavati pittakṛte tathaiva ||4||

ab.seg: pittajārocakalakṣaṇamāha- hṛddāhacoṣetyādi| hṛddāhacoṣabahuteti hṛdi hṛdaye dāhacoṣayorbāhulyamityarthaḥ| coṣa ācūṣyata iva vedanā| anye ‘hṛddāhacoṣabahulaṃ’ iti paṭhitvā hṛdayaṃ dāhacoṣabahulaṃ bhavatīti vyākhyānayanti||4||

lg.l: kaṇḍūgurutvakaphasaṃsravasādatandrāḥ śleṣmātmake madhuram āsyam arocake tu |5|

div.ab: kaphajārocakalakṣaṇamāha- kaṇḍūgurutvetyādi| kaphasaṃsravaḥ śleṣmasrutiḥ, sādaḥ aṅgaglāniḥ, āsyaṃ mukham| kecit ‘sādatandrā’ ityatra ‘kaṇṭhasādā’ iti paṭhitvā abhyavaharaṇādyaśaktiriti vyākhyānayanti|5|-

lg.l: sarvātmake pavanapittakaphā bahūni rūpāṇy athāsya hṛdaye samudīrayanti ||5||

ab.seg: sānnipātikārocakalakṣaṇamāha- sarvātmaka ityādi| sarvātmake sānnipātikārocake pavanādayo doṣā bahūni rūpāṇyasya hṛdaye samudīrayanti kurvantīti piṇḍārthaḥ| yadyapi sānnipātike hṛdroge sarvajārocake ca bāhulyena samānyeva `pavanādīnāmeva' iti pā. liṅgāni bhavanti, tathā'pi samprāptibhedāt kiñcillakṣaṇabhedācca tayorbhedaḥ| sānnipātikārocako'sādhyaḥ, “sarvātmakaṃ cāpi vivarjayeta” iti samānatantroktatvāt||5||

lg.l: saṃrāgaśokabhayaviplutacetasas tu cintākṛto bhavati so 'śucidarśanāc ca |6|

div.ab: aviśiṣṭaṃ paccamamarocakamāha- saṃrāgaśoketyādi| saṃrāgaḥ kāmaḥ| viplutacetasaḥ vikṛtacittasya| sa arocakaḥ| aśucidarśanāt amedhyavastudarśanāt bībhatsādidarśanādityarthaḥ| cintākṛtasyārocakasya bhinnalakṣaṇanirdeśāt śeṣeṣu yathādoṣaṃ lakṣaṇāni jñātavyāni, kāmādibhiḥ sarvairvātādiprakopāt| tathā ca “kāmaśokabhayādvāyuḥ krodhāt pittaṃ ca kupyati| śleṣmā tu harṣaṇāt”- iti| anye tu cintākṛtārocakasya vātādibhedena lakṣaṇāni paṭhanti; tadyathā- “vātātmake virasamāsyamarocake tu, pittena tiktakaṭukaṃ, madhuraṃ kaphena| sarvairupetamatha sarvajameva vidyāddainyaṃ bhṛśaṃ bhavati śokasamudbhave tu”- iti| anyaṃ pāṭho na paṭhanīyaḥ, anārṣatvāt|6|-

lg.l: vāte vacāmbuvamanaṃ kṛtavān pibec ca snehaiḥ surābhir athavoṣṇajalena cūrṇam ||6||

div.ab: idānīṃ vātikārocakacikitsāmāha- vāta ityādi| vāte vātaje arocake, kāraṇe kāryopacārāt| vacāmbuvamanaṃ kṛtavāniti vacākvāthena kṛtavamano naraḥ| kecit elaśabdena elavālukaṃ manyante, pade'pi padaikadeśapravṛtteḥ| ‘elajalena’ ityatra ‘uṣṇajalena’ iti pāṭhāntaram| lavaṇottamaṃ saindhavam| idaṃ cūrṇaṃ vamanaiḥ śuddhāśayasya deyam| kārtikakuṇḍo'muṃ pāṭhamanyathā paṭhati, sa cābhāvānna likhitaḥ||6||-

lg.l: pitte guḍāmbumadhurair vamanaṃ praśastaṃ snehaḥ sasaindhavasitāmadhusarpir iṣṭaḥ ||7||

ab.seg: pittajārocakacikitsāmāha- pitte ityādi| pitte pittajārocake, upacārāt| madhuraṃ kākolyādi| atrāpi pūrvavadavacāraṇam||7||

lg.l: nimbāmbuvāmitavataḥ kaphaje 'nupānaṃ rājadrumāmbu madhunā tu sadīpyakaṃ syāt |8|

div.ab: kaphārocakacikitsāmāha- nimbāmbuvāmitavata ityādi| nimbāmbu nimbakvāthaḥ, nimbāmbunā vāmitavataḥ puṃsaḥ girimālakakvāthaḥ samadhuḥ sājamodaścānupānaṃ syāt; ‘kṛtabhojanasya’ iti śeṣaḥ; samānatantradarśanāt| keciddīpyakaśabdena yavānīmāhuḥ|8|-

lg.l: cūrṇaṃ yad uktam athavā'nilaje tad eva... |8|

div.ab: kaphajārocake'tideśena cikitsāmāha- cūrṇamityādi| cūrṇaṃ yaduktamiti ‘kṛṣṇāviḍaṅgayavabhasma’ ityādikam| taccūrṇaṃ kaphaje vātānubandhe sati deyam|8|-

ab.seg: sānnipātikārocakacikitsāmāha- sarvairityādi| sarvairitivātādijārocakaharaiḥ pūrvoktaireva| sarvakṛtaṃ sānnipātikamarocakam| evamiti pūrvavat, vamanādi kārayitveti yāvat| upakrameta ‘pratyākhyāya’ iti śeṣaḥ, asādhyatvāttasya||8||

lg.l: bījaiḥ karañjanṛpavṛkṣabhavaiś ca piṣṭair lehaṃ pacet surabhimūtrayutaṃ yathāvat ||9||
mustāṃ vacāṃ trikaṭukaṃ rajanīdvayaṃ ca bhārgīṃ ca kuṣṭham atha nirdahanīṃ ca piṣṭvā |
mūtre 'vije dviradamūtrayute paced vā pāṭhāṃ tugām ativiṣāṃ rajanīṃ ca mukhyām ||10||
maṇḍūkim arkam amṛtāṃ ca salāṅgalākhyāṃ mūtre pacet tu mahiṣasya vidhānavid vā |
etān na santi caturo lihatas tu lehān gulmāruciśvasanakaṇṭhahṛdāmayāś ca ||11||

ab.seg: idānīṃ caturṇāmapyarocakānāṃ yathāsaṅkhyena caturo lehānāha- drākṣāpaṭoletyādi| drākṣādiḥ surabhimūtrayutaṃ yathāvadityanta eko lehaḥ| mustādiḥ mūtre'vije itiparyanto dvitīyaḥ| dviradamūtrādī rajanīṃ ca mukhyāmityantaḥ tṛtīyaḥ| maṇḍūkītyādiḥ caturthaḥ| karīro gūḍhapatro marudeśe'tiprasiddhaḥ kaṇṭakivṛkṣaḥ; mūrvā corasnāyuḥ; abhayā harītakī, kecidabhayaṃ manyante, tanmate uśīraṃ, akṣaṃ bibhītakaṃ; indravṛkṣaḥ kuṭajaḥ; nṛpavṛkṣaḥ girimālakaḥ| surabhimūtrayutaṃ kalkacaturguṇagomūtrayutaṃ, “mūtreṇa caturguṇena” ityādikāśyapīyasaṃvādāt| yathāvaditi lehaṃ pacedityatra yojyaṃ, tena yathāvallehaṃ pacet ; ko'rthaḥ? yāvallehapākalakṣaṇaṃ tantumudrādi jāyate tāvat pacedityarthaḥ| nirdahanī citrakaḥ, ajamodā ityanye| avije meṣotthe| asāvapi pūrvavallehavat paktavyaḥ| dviradamūtraṃ hastimūtram| tugā vaṃśarocanānukāri pārthivaṃ dravyamāhuḥ| rajanīṃ ca mukhyāṃ piṇḍaharidrām| ayamapi pūrvavidhinaiva paktavyaḥ| maṇḍūkī brāhmī, amṛtā guḍūcī, lāṅgalī kalikārikā| asāvapi pūrvavat paktavyaḥ| “etānna santi caturo'bhyasataśca” iti kecit paṭhanti| “etān vadanti bhiṣajaścaturaśca lehān gulmāruciśvasanakaṇṭhahṛdāmayeṣu” ityapare paṭhanti||9-11||

lg.l: sātmyān svadeśaracitān `sadeśaracitān' iti pā. vividhāṃś ca bhakṣyān pānāni mūlaphalaṣāḍavarāgayogān |
adyād rasāṃś ca vividhān vividhaiḥ prakārair bhuñjīta cāpi laghurūkṣamanaḥsukhāni ||12||

ab.seg: sātmyānityādi| sātmyān sukhakarān| “sātmyān svadeśaracitān vividhaiḥ prakārairbhuñjīta vā'pi laghurūkṣamanāḥ sukhena” ityanye paṭhanti| svadeśaracitān vividhāṃśca bhakṣyāniti yasmin deśe ye bhakṣyā bāhulyenopayujyante tānityarthaḥ| pānānītyatrāpi vividhānīti yojyaṃ, tena yathāruci phalāni śarkarānvitāni karpūracaturjātakasugandhīni gṛhyante| mūlaṃ pippalīmūlādi| phalaṃ dāḍimādi| ṣāḍavā rasālādyāḥ| rāgāḥ kapittharāgādayaḥ| kecit “sitārucakasindhūtthaiḥ savṛkṣāmlaparūṣakaiḥ| jambūphalarasairyukto rāgo rājikayā kṛtaḥ|| madhurāmlakaṭūnāṃ tu saṃskārāḥ ṣāḍavā matāḥ” ityāhuḥ; apare tu ṣāḍavaśabdena yavānīṣāḍavamāhuḥ, tantrāntarasaṃvādāt ; rāgaśabdena ca rāgaṣāḍavaṃ matvā drākṣādāḍimādyanvitaṃ mudgayūṣamiti ca vyākhyānayanti| rasān vividhān māṃsarasān madhurādirasān vā| laghurūkṣabhojanaṃ śleṣmasthānagatatvādarocakasya| manaḥsukhaṃ manonukūlam| kecit sātmyāniti sātmyadeśarogartuprakṛtyādīnyavekṣya bhakṣyādi kuryāditi manyante||12||

lg.l: āsthāpanaṃ vidhivad atra virecanaṃ ca kuryān mṛdūni śirasaś ca virecanāni |13|

div.ab: niṣiddhasyāpi nirūhasyārocake prayogamāha- āsthāpanamityādi| āsthāpanaṃ nirūhaḥ| vidhivat yathāvidhi| atra arocake| yadyapi ‘tatronmādabhayaśoka’ ityādinā'rocake āsthāpananiṣedhaḥ; tathā'pi vamanādikramottarakālaṃ vātānubandhe sati deyaṃ, na tvādau|13|-
trīṇyūṣaṇānītyādi| trīṇyūṣaṇānīti trikaṭukam| yavaśūkoyavakṣāraḥ| vitaret dadyāt| mukhabodhanārthamiti mukhabodhe satyarocakahānirityarthaḥ| avalehaprayoga eṣaḥ||13||-

lg.l: mustādirājataruvargadaśāṅgasiddhaiḥ kvāthair jayen madhuyutair vividhaiś ca lehaiḥ ||14||
mūtrāsavair guḍakṛtaiś ca tathā tv ariṣṭaiḥ kṣārāsavaiś ca madhumādhavatulyagandhaiḥ |15|

div.ab: anuktasaṅgrahārthamāha- anyānītyādi| mustādiḥ mustākuṣṭhaharidretyādiḥ, rājataruvargaḥ āragvadhamadanagopaghoṇṭetyādiḥ, daśāṅgaṃ daśamūlam| jayet ‘arocakaṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ| madhuyutā lehā mustādyādikṛtā eva grāhyāḥ| kecit ‘vividhaiśca yogaiḥ’ iti paṭhitvā vātaśleṣmaharairiti vyākhyānayanti| mūtrāsavairityādi mūtreṇa āsūyanta iti mūtrāsavāḥ| taiśca kimbhūtaiḥ? guḍakṛtaiḥ kuṣṭhacikitsitoktavidhinā guḍamadhvādikṛtairityarthaḥ| ariṣṭaiḥ abhayāriṣṭādibhiḥ| kṣārāsavairiti madhvādibhiḥ palāśakṣārapānīyena saha niṣpāditairmahākuṣṭhābhihitaiḥ| madhumādhavatulyagandhairiti madhu kṣaudraṃ, mādhavaṃ madhukṛtaṃ madyaṃ, tayostulyagandhairityarthaḥ||14||-

lg.l: syād eṣa eva kaphavātahate vidhiś ca śāntiṃ gate hutabhuji praśamāya tasya ||15||

ab.seg: pūrvoktameva vidhimavipāke'tidiśannāha- syādeṣa ityādi| eṣa eva vidhiranantarokta eva| yadatra kaphavātayorupādānaṃ na pittanimittasya tat pittādavipāko na bhavatīti darśayati| śāntiṃ gate hutabhuji avipāke ityarthaḥ, kāraṇe kāryopacārāt; upacāreṇa yadatrāvipākagrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ, na sākṣāttadapyagnimāndyamavipākasya kāraṇamiti sūcayati| śāntiṃ gate mandatāṃ prāpte, hutabhuji jāṭharāgnau| tasyetyatra cakāro lupto draṣṭavyaḥ, tena tasya ca praśamanāya; ko'rthaḥ? arocakasyāpi asyāgre ‘icchābhighātajasya’ ityadhikaṃ paṭhyate kvacit pustake| kārtika īdṛśaṃ vyākhyānaṃ na manyate, tasyāvipākasyaiva praśamāyeti pratipādayati| ye cāgnimāndya evainaṃ vidhimicchanti na tvarocakāvipāke, tanmate'sminnadhyāye'vipāko na vaktavyaḥ||15||

lg.l: icchābhighātabhayaśokahate 'ntaragnau bhāvān bhavāya vitaret khalu śakyarūpān |
artheṣu cāpy apaciteṣu `cātipatiteṣu' iti pā. punarbhavāya paurāṇikaiḥ śrutiśatair anumānayet tam `anubhāvayettam' iti pā.||16||
dainyaṃ gate manasi bodhanam atra śastaṃ yad yat priyaṃ tad upasevyam arocake tu ||17||

ab.seg: idānīṃ pañcamārocakacikitsāmāha- icchābhighātetyādi| icchābhighāto vāñchitasyāprāptiḥ| bhāvān padārthān| bhavāya arthavaśāt rucyutpādanāya| vitaret dadyāt| kīdṛśān bhāvān? śakyarūpān prāpyānityarthaḥ| ye tāvat prāpyā bhāvāstān icchāvighātādyarocake vitaret| ye punaraprāpyāstadviṣaye kiṃ kuryādityāha- artheṣvityādi| artheṣu padārtheṣu, apaciteṣu naṣṭeṣu aprāpteṣvityarthaḥ punariti apaciteṣvityatra yojyam| bhavāya rucyutpādanāyetyarthaḥ| paurāṇikaiḥ śrutiśatairanumānayediti nalarāmādyupākhyānairanyaiśca tathāvidhairanumānayet prabodhayedityarthaḥ| kecit paurāṇikaiḥ śrutipathairiti paṭhanti; paurāṇikaiḥ purāṇoktaiḥ, śrutipathaiḥ vākyaiḥ, śrutiḥ śravaṇaṃ saiva panthā mārgo yeṣāṃ tāni tathoktānīti vyākhyānayanti| dainyaṃ gate manasi kliṣṭacetasītyarthaḥ| bodhanam āśvāsanairhitopadeśaiśca| kecidamuṃ pāṭhaṃ na paṭhanti||16-17||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre 'rocakapratiṣedho nāma (ekonaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) saptapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||57||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantre'rocakapratiṣedho nāma saptapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||57||

div.head: mūtrāghātapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto mūtrāghātapratiṣedham adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

arocakapratiṣedhānantaraṃ pāriśeṣyānmūtrāghātapratiṣedhārambhaḥ; pariśeṣatvaṃ ca mūtrāghātamūtrakṛcchrayorekatvena vivakṣitatvāt kāyacikitsāyāṃ cāparasyādhyāyasyābhāvāt| athāta ityādi| mūtrāghāto mūtrāvarodhaḥ, kecidāghātaśabdena duṣṭimāhuḥ na tvavarodhaṃ, mūtraśukramūtrasādayormūtrāvarodhāsambhavāt||1-2||

lg.l: mūtraukasādau dvau cāpi rogā dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ ||4||

ab.seg: idānīṃ sukhabodhārthaṃ mūtrāghātānnāmabhiḥ prāha- vātetyādi| aṣṭhīleti vātāṣṭhīletyarthaḥ| yā nidānasthāne vātāṣṭhīlā bhaṇitā sā bhinnā, ādhmānādilakṣaṇarahitatvāt `... lakṣaṇahetutvāt' iti pā.| saṅkhyeyanirdeśādevasaṅkhyāyāṃ siddhāyāṃ dvādaśeti saṅkhyākaraṇaṃ tantrāntaroktādhikasaṅkhyānivāraṇārtham||3-4||

lg.l: raukṣyād vegavighātād vā vāyur antaram āśritaḥ `vāyurbastau savedanam' iti pā.|
sṛjed alpālpam athavā sarujaskaṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ |
vātakuṇḍalikāṃ taṃ tu vyādhiṃ vidyāt sudāruṇam ||6||

ab.seg: vātakuṇḍalikāyā hetusamprāptilakṣaṇānyāha- raukṣyādityādi| antaramāśrita iti bastimadhyamāśrita ityarthaḥ| mūtraṃ carati saṅgṛhyeti mūtraṃ gṛhītvā vāyuścarati bhramatītyarthaḥ| kuṇḍalīkṛta iti kuṇḍalākṛtyā vartulībhūtaḥ| sṛjet pravartayet| sarujaskaṃ savedanaṃ mūtram| raukṣyādvegavighātāditi vyavahitaḥ sannihitaśca heturuktaḥ, vāyurantaramāśrita ityādisamprāptiḥ, kuṇḍalīkṛta ityādilakṣaṇam| ‘mūtramalpālpamathavā sarujaṃ sampravartate’ iti kecit paṭhanti| apare ‘sarujaṃ sampravartayet’ iti paṭhanti| sarveṣāṃ mūtrāghātānāṃ vāyureva prāyaśaḥ kāraṇaṃ boddhavyam||5-6||

lg.l: śakṛnmārgasya basteś ca vāyur antaram āśritaḥ |
vedanā ca parā bastau vātāṣṭhīleti tāṃ viduḥ ||8||

ab.seg: aṣṭhīlāyā hetusamprāptilakṣaṇānyāha- śakṛnmārgasyetyādi| śakṛnmārgo gudaḥ, bastiḥ mūtrādhāraḥ, vāyuratra apāno gudabastistharogakaratvāt, antaraṃ madhyam| aṣṭhīlā uttarāpathe dīrghavartulapāṣāṇaviśeṣaḥ, anye carmakārāṇāṃ lauhīṃ bhāṇḍīmāhuḥ| acalam īṣaccalam| ādhmānaṃ bastau boddhavyam| apāno vāyuratra hetuḥ, śakṛnmārgasyetyādiḥ samprāptiḥ, śeṣaṃ lakṣaṇam||7-8||

lg.l: vegaṃ vidhārayed yas tu mūtrasyākuśalo naraḥ |

ab.seg: vātabasterhetusamprāptilakṣaṇānyāha- vegamityādi| akuśalo mūrkhaḥ| tasya mūrkhasya| mūtrasaṅgo mūtrasyāpravṛttiḥ| tena vyādhinā bastikukṣinipīḍita iti bastikukṣernipīḍanaṃ vidyate yasya(tra) sa tathā; nipīḍitaṃ nipīḍanaṃ vedanetyarthaḥ| kṛcchraprasādhanaḥ kaṣṭasādhyaḥ| vegaṃ vidhārayediti hetuḥ, niruṇaddhi mukhaṃ tasya basteriti samprāptiḥ, śeṣaṃ lakṣaṇam||9-10||

lg.l: vegaṃ sandhārya mūtrasya yo bhūyaḥ sraṣṭum icchati |
tasya nābhyeti yadi vā kathañ cit sampravartate ||11||
pravāhato mandarujam alpam alpaṃ punaḥ punaḥ |

ab.seg: mūtrātītasya hetuṃ samprāptiṃ lakṣaṇaṃ cāha- vegamityādi| vegaṃ pravṛttyunmukhatvaṃ, taṃ sandhārya samyagdhṛtvā, bhūyaḥ punaḥ, sraṣṭumicchati moktuṃ vāñchati| nābhyeti mūtraṃ nāgacchatītyarthaḥ| pravāhata iti nikuhanādityarthaḥ| yadyapi vegaṃ sandhārya mūtrasyetyanenaiva mūtravighātajatvamasya vyādheḥ prāptaṃ, tathā'pi punarmūtravegavighātajamiti karaṇaṃ mūtravighātotthavātajatvapratipādanārtham| vegaṃ sandhāryetyādirhetuḥ, yo bhūyaḥ sraṣṭumicchatītyādiḥ samprāptiḥ, śeṣaṃ lakṣaṇama||11-12||

lg.l: apānaḥ kupito vāyur udaraṃ pūrayed bhṛśam ||13||

ab.seg: mūtrajaṭharasya hetvādikamāha- mūtrasyetyādi| tadudāvartahetuneti tadudāvarto mūtrodāvartaḥ sa eva hetustenetyarthaḥ; etena mūtravege'varuddhe sati tadudāvartahetunā'pāno vāyuḥ kupitaḥ san udaraṃ pūrayet, tataśca nābheradhobhāge tīvrapīḍamādhmānaṃ janayet; taṃ mūtrajaṭharamadhaḥsrotonirodhanaṃ vidyāt mūtrapurīṣamārgāvarodhakaṃ jānīyādityarthaḥ| kecit ‘adhobastinirodhajam’ iti paṭhanti| ye tu ‘apānaḥ kupito vāyuḥ’ ityādikameva mūtrajaṭharaṃ paṭhanti, te ‘mūtrasya vege vihate tadudāvartahetunā’ iti pāṭhaṃ mūtrātītapāṭhamadhye paṭhanti| tathā ca sati te prakopakāraṇānuktāvapānaprakopakāraṇaṃ balavadvigrahādikaṃ manyante| tādṛśaśca pāṭho na vṛddhacittāhlādakaraḥ| mūtrasya vege vihate ityādirhetuḥ, udaraṃ pūrayedbhṛśamityādiḥ samprāptiḥ, śeṣaṃ lakṣaṇam||13-14||

lg.l: bastau vā'py athavā nāle maṇau vā yasya dehinaḥ |
mūtraṃ pravṛttaṃ sajjeta saraktaṃ `saktaṃ cāpi pravāhataḥ' iti pā. vā pravāhataḥ ||15||
sravec chanair alpam alpaṃ sarujaṃ vā'tha nīrujam |

ab.seg: mūtrotsaṅgasya hetvādikamāha- bastāvityādi| nāle meḍhrasrotasi| maṇau meḍhrāgradeśe| yadyapi nāle ityanenaiva maṇerapi grahaṇaṃ sañjātaṃ, tathā'pi maṇerupādānaṃ maṇāvatyantamūtrotsaṅgapratipādanārtham| sajjeta avarudhyeta| ‘saraktam’ ityatra ‘saṃsaktam’ iti pāṭhe saṃsaktaṃ sambaddham| pravāhataḥ nikuhanādityarthaḥ| sarujam ativātaprakopāt, nīrujaṃ hīnavātaprakopāt| viguṇānilaja iti vimārgavāyujaḥ, vāyorvimārgagamanaṃ mārgāvarodhāt svahetubhiśca; kecinmārgāvarodhameva vimārgagamane kāraṇamicchanti| viguṇānilajo vyādhiriti hetuḥ, bastāvityādiḥ samprāptiḥ, śeṣaṃ lakṣaṇam||15-16||

mṛtrakṣayasya hetvādikamāha- rūkṣasyetyādi| klāntadehasya glānadehasya| yadyapi rūkṣaglānadehatvaṃ na pittaprakopakāraṇaṃ tathā'pi vātānvitapittasya prakopakaṃ jñeyam| kuryātām utpādayetām| kṛcchraṃ kuṣṭhajananam| mūtrasaṅkṣayamiti mūtraśoṣaṇānmūtrasaṅkṣayo rogaḥ| rūkṣasyetyādiḥ hetuḥ, bastisthāvityādiḥ samprāptiḥ, śeṣaṃ lakṣaṇam| ‘bastisthau pittamārutau’ ityatra ‘bastau tiṣṭhan sadāgatiḥ’ iti kecit paṭhanti; sa cānārṣaḥ pāṭhaḥ||17||

lg.l: abhyantare bastimukhe vṛtto 'lpaḥ sthira eva ca |
vedanāvān ati sadā `vedanāvānabhiṣyandī' iti pā. mūtramārganirodhanaḥ ||18||
sa mūtragranthir ity evam ucyate vedanādibhiḥ `vedavādibhiḥ' iti pā.||19||

ab.seg: mūtragrantherhetvādikamāha- abhyantara ityādi| abhyantare bastimukhe iti bastidvārasyābhyantare ityarthaḥ| vṛtto vartulaḥ| sthiraḥ acalaḥ| mūtramārganirodhanaḥ mūtravāhisrotonirodhakārītyarthaḥ| sahasā jhaṭiti| aśmarīlakṣaṇa ityatra vedanādibhiriti sambadhyate| tena vedanābhiḥ kṛtvā aśmaryāstulyalakṣaṇo na tvadhiṣṭhānādibhiraśmarītulyalakṣaṇaḥ, eṣa evāśmarīmūtragranthyorbhedaḥ; tathā aśmaryāṃ raktasambandho nāsti, mūtragranthau tu tantrāntaradarśanādraktasambandho jñeya ityapi bhedaḥ| tathā ca tadvacaḥ- “raktaṃ vātakaphādduṣṭaṃ bastidvāre sudāruṇam| granthiṃ kuryāt sa kṛcchreṇa sṛjenmūtraṃ tadāvṛtam| aśmarīsamaśūlaṃ taṃ mūtragranthiṃ `raktagranthi' iti pā. pracakṣate”- iti| abhyantara ityādisamprāptiḥ, vedanāvānityādilakṣaṇaṃ, heturatrānukto'pi uṣṇavātahetusāhacaryāt pittaṃ jñeyaḥ| yadyevaṃ tarhi uṣṇavāte vāyurapi heturuktaḥ; so'trakimiti na gṛhyate? satyaṃ, mūtragranthervyatikramapāṭhādeva vāyuratra kāraṇaṃ na bhavatīti jñeyam||18-19||

lg.l: purastād vā'pi mūtrasya paścād vā'pi kadācana |

ab.seg: mūtraśukrasya hetvādikamāha- pratyupasthitetyādi| pratyupasthitamūtra iti sañjātamūtravega ityarthaḥ| yaḥpuruṣaḥ, maithunamabhinandati icchati karotīti tātparyārthaḥ| retaḥ śukram| purastādvā'pi mūtrasya ādāvityarthaḥ| bhasmodakapratīkāśaṃ bhasmamiśritapānīyatulyam `kṣārapānīyatulyam' iti pā.| etacca retoviśeṣaṇam| yaḥpuruṣaḥ sañjātamūtravegaḥ san maithunaṃ karoti tasya puṃso bhasmodakapratīkāśaṃ mūtrayutaṃ reto mūtrasyādau kadācit paścādvā `paścādapi' iti pā. vāyorvicitrakriyākaratvāt pravartate, tanmūtraśukramucyata iti phalito'rthaḥ| atra hetusamprāptyādikaṃ svayamapyūhya jñeyam||20-21||

lg.l: bastiṃ meḍhraṃ gudaṃ caiva pradahan srāvayed adhaḥ ||22||
mūtraṃ hāridram athavā saraktaṃ raktam eva vā |
kṛcchrāt pravartate jantor uṣṇavātaṃ vadanti tam ||23||

ab.seg: vyāyāmādhvātapairityādi| anilāvṛtaṃ vātānvitaṃ pittam| hāridraṃ haridrāvarṇam| saraktam īṣadrakta varṇamīṣacchoṇitaṃ vā| raktaṃ veti kevalaṃ śoṇitam, atyantaraktavarṇaṃ mūtraṃ vetyarthaḥ| nanu, atroddeśasūtrapāṭhānmūtragranthimūtraśukrayorupādānaṃ prāpnoti noṣṇavātasya, tat kathamatroṣṇavāto nirdiṣṭaḥ? ucyate- yathā mūtrakṣayasya vātapitte hetū tathā'syāpi ta eva hetū iti hetusāmyādvyatikrameṇoṣṇavāto nirdiṣṭaḥ| yadyevaṃ tarhi uddeśe'pyuṣṇavāto mūtrakṣayānantarameva kimiti na paṭhitaḥ? satyaṃ, mūtragranthau kevalapittasyānuvartanārthamuṣṇavāto mūtrakṣayānantaraṃ paṭhitaḥ| vyāyāmādiko hetuḥ, bastiṃ prāpyetyādiḥ samprāptiḥ, śeṣaṃ lakṣaṇam||22-23||

lg.l: viśadaṃ pītakaṃ mūtraṃ sadāhaṃ bahalaṃ tathā |
mūtraukasādaṃ taṃ vidyād rogaṃ pittakṛtaṃ budhaḥ |
mūtraukasādaṃ taṃ vidyād āmayaṃ dvādaśaṃ `cāparaṃ' iti pā. kaphāt ||26||

ab.seg: mūtraukasādalakṣaṇamāha- viśadamityādi| viśadaṃ picchilaviparītam| pītakaṃ pītavarṇam| bahalaṃ sthūlaṃ ghanamityarthaḥ| śuṣkamiti ātapādinā śuṣkam| rocanā gorocanā| dvitīyamūtraukasādalakṣaṇamāha- picchilamityādi| picchilamiti viśadaviparītam, saṃhataṃ ghanam, śvetaṃ śvetavarṇam, kṛcchrapravartanaṃ duḥkhena pravartata ityarthaḥ| dvādaśeti punarupādānaṃ mūtraukasādayorekanāmatvādeva mandamatīnāṃ cetasyekatvaṃ mā bhūditi dyotanārtham||24-26||

mūtrāghātānāṃ cikitsāmāha- kaṣāyetyādi| kaṣāyaḥ kvāthaḥ, kalko dṛṣadi peṣitaḥ sadravaḥ| bhakṣyān laḍḍukaprabhṛtīn| payāṃsi kṣīrāṇi| āsavo madyabhedaḥ| svedā upanāhādyāḥ| bastīṃścottarasañjñitāniti uttarabastīnityarthaḥ| cakārāt snehavirecanamapi| vidadhyāt kuryāt| matimāniti ūhāpohavidvaidyaḥ| tatra mūtrāghātaroge| vidhimaśmarīsādhanamaśmarīcikitsitoktam| nanu, yathā vātādibhedena bhinnā mūtrāghātā darśitāḥ, tathaiva cikitsā'pi bhinnā vaktumucitā, tat kathamatra `kuto'tra' iti pā. sāmānyena cikitsoktā? ucyate- sarveṣu mūtrāghāteṣu yato vātaḥ kāraṇam ataḥ sāmānyena cikitsitaṃ vaktumucitaṃ bhavati; evaṃ yadi tatra vāyureva kāraṇaṃ kiṃ tarhi tatra pittakaphāvapyārambhakatvena nirdiṣṭau, tat kathamekaiva cikitsā sarveṣu mṛtrāghāteṣu kriyate? satyaṃ, sarve'pi mūtrāghātāḥ prāyaśo vātajanyāḥ pittakaphau punarāvarakau; tasmātteṣāmekaiva cikitsā doṣādibalavikalpaṃ dravyatattvaṃ rogatattvaṃ ca jñātvā bhiṣajā prayojyā, ata eva matimānityuktavānācāryaḥ| kecidatra ‘ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi mūtradoṣasya bheṣajam’ ityādipāṭhaṃ paṭhanti, sa ca kaṣāyakalpamityanenopasaṅgṛhīta iti na darśitaḥ| apare tu ‘strīṇāmatiprasaṅgena’ ityādipāṭhaṃ paṭhanti, sa ca nārṣaḥ||27||

lg.l: mūtrodāvartayogāṃś ca kārtsnyenātra `kārtsnyeneha' iti pā. prayojayet ||28||

ab.seg: mūtrāghāteṣu mūtrodāvartacikitsitamatideśenāha- mūtrodāvartetyādi| mūtrodāvartayogā ya uditā bhavanti te'tra yojyā iti atrārthaḥ| mūtrodāvartayogān ‘sauvarcalāḍhyāṃ madirām’ ityādimūtrodāvartapratiṣedhoktān| kārtsnyena sāmastyena| etena yasyāmavasthāyāṃ ye mūtrodāvartayogā ucitā bhavanti te'tra yojyā ityarthaḥ| kārtsnyenetyatra kartikakuṇḍena bahudhā prajalpitaṃ, tattu śiṣyabuddhivyākulahetutvādgranthagauravabhayācca parihṛtam| atra `iha' iti pā. mūtrāghāte||28||
kalkamityādi| ervāruḥ grīṣmakarkaṭikā| akṣamātraṃ karṣapramāṇam dhānyāmlaṃ kāñjikam| kecidamuṃ pāṭhamanyathā paṭhanti, sa cābhāvānna likhitaḥ||29||

lg.l: madhu māṃsopadaṃśaṃ vā pibed vā'py atha gauḍikam ||30||

ab.seg: surāmityādi| surā piṣṭakṛtā| madhu madyaṃ; tacca madhukṛtaṃ, samānatantradarśanāt| tathā ca- ‘māṃsopadaṃśaṃ madhunā madyaṃ vā'pi pibennaraḥ’- iti| māṃsopadaṃśaṃ māṃsabhakṣaṇayutam| gauḍikaṃ guḍakṛtaṃ madyam||30||
pibedityādi| madhūdakaṃ madhuyuktamudakam| prātariti pibedityatra yojyaṃ; tena prabhāte pibedityarthaḥ||31||

lg.l: dāḍimāmlāṃ yutāṃ `dāḍimāmlayutāṃ' iti pā. mukhyām elājīrakanāgaraiḥ |

ab.seg: dāḍimāmlāmityādi| dāḍimāmlāṃ dāḍimenāmlīkṛtām| yutāmityatra elājīrakanāgarairiti yojyam| surāṃ mukhyāṃ paiṣṭīmityarthaḥ| salavaṇāṃ saundhavayuktām||32||

lg.l: kṣīrāvaśiṣṭaṃ tac chītaṃ sitākṣaudrayutaṃ `sitāghṛtayutaṃ' iti pā. pibet |

ab.seg: pṛthakparṇyādivargasyetyādi| pṛthakparṇyādivargo vidārigandhādikaḥ||33-34||
niṣpīḍyetyādi| varcaḥ purīṣam| rāsabho gardabhaḥ| vājī ghoṭakaḥ| kuḍavaṃ catvāri palāni||35||
mustetyādi| mūrvā corasnāyuḥ| madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu| akṣasamaṃ karṣapramāṇam||36||
abhayetyādi| akṣo bibhītakaḥ| badarasammitam ardhakarṣapramāṇam| ambhasā pānīyena| alavaṇopetaṃ kiñcitsaindhavayutam||37||

lg.l: pibet paryuṣitaṃ rātrau `vāri' iti pā. śītaṃ mūtrarujāpaham ||38||

ab.seg: udumbarasamaṃ karṣapramāṇaṃ, drākṣāyāḥ kalkam udumbarasamaṃ jalānvitaṃ rātriparyuṣitaṃ pibediti piṇḍārthaḥ||38||

div.ab: nidigdhikā kaṇṭakārikā| kuḍavasammitaṃ catuṣpalonmitam| kalyaṃ prātarityarthaḥ|39|-

ab.seg: athavetyādi| prapīḍyeti vāsasā gālayitvetyarthaḥ| kuḍavaṃ catvāri palāni| agadī bhavet nīrogo bhavet||39-40||

div.ab: dhātrīphalarasenaivamityādi| dhātrīphalarasena āmalakarasena| evamiti kṣaudrayutāmityarthaḥ|41|-

lg.l: tālasya taruṇaṃ mūlaṃ trapusasya rasaṃ tathā |
śvetaṃ karkaṭakaṃ caiva prātas tu payasā pibet ||42||

ab.seg: piṣṭvetyādi| tālasyābhinavaṃ mūlaṃ piṣṭvā śālitaṇḍulodakena pibet, trapusasvarasamatha vā pibet| trapusaḥ sudhāvāsaḥ| śvetamityādi| śvetaṃ karkaṭakaṃ trapusam| payasā kṣīreṇa, samānatantradarśanāt; ‘trapusaṃ vā'tha dugdhena mūtradoṣaharaṃ pibet’ iti||41-42||

lg.l: śṛtaṃ vā madhuraiḥ kṣīraṃ sarpirmiśraṃ piben naraḥ |

ab.seg: śṛtamityādi| madhuraiḥ kākolyādibhiḥ| ayaṃ yogo mūtraśukrasya bāhulyena boddhavyaḥ||43||

lg.l: akṣabījaṃ ca surayā kalkīkṛtya piben naraḥ |

ab.seg: balāśvadaṃṣṭretyādi| balā svanāmakhyātā, śvadaṃṣṭrā gokṣurakaḥ, krauñcaḥ pakṣiviśeṣaḥ, ‘kaicara’ iti loke, kokilākṣakaḥ khaggalī, śataparvako jalagaṇḍīraḥ| akṣabījaṃ bibhītakamajjā| etadbalādikaṃ kalkīkṛtya mūtradoṣaviśuddhyarthaṃ pibedityarthaḥ| tathā'śmarīcikitsitoktamapi mūtradoṣaviśuddhyarthaṃ pibedityarthaḥ| aśmarīcikitsitaṃ yadatra vāraṃvāraṃ bhaṇitaṃ, tadatyantahitatvāpādanārtham| kecit bhojasaṃvādād balādikaṃ yogacatuṣṭayaṃ manyante; tanna, vṛddhānāmasammatatvāt||44-45||

pāṭalākṣāramityādi| saptakṛtvaḥ saptavārān| parisrutaṃ gālitam| saṃsṛṣṭaṃ saṃyuktam| tailamātrayā stokena tailena| atra mātrāśabdo'lpavācī| yathā- “mātrāṃ khādedbubhukṣitaḥ” ityādiṣu| atra kṣārasya toyasya ca pramāṇaṃ kṣārakalpoktaṃ jñātavyam| tena caturguṇena jalena kṣāraḥ parisrāvaṇīyaḥ||46||

lg.l: kṣīre pariśṛtān tatra pibet sarpiḥ samāyutān ||47||

ab.seg: nalāśmabhedetyādi| nalaḥ svanāmaprasiddhaḥ śuṣiraparvā, aśmabhedaḥ pāṣāṇabhedaḥ, ervāruḥ grīṣmakarkaṭikā, bījakaḥ asanasāraḥ| kārtikakuṇḍastu vṛddhakāśyapīyasaṃvādāttrapusairvārubījānyevācakṣate, bījakānityatra svārthikāśca prakṛtiliṅgavacanānyatikrāmantītyuktatvāt puṃliṅgateti ca kathayati tatra| mūtrāghāte||47||

lg.l: pāṭalyā yāvaśūkāc ca pāribhadrāt tilād api |
pibed guḍena miśraṃ vā lihyāl lehān pṛthak pṛthak |49|

ab.seg: pāṭalyā ityādi| yāvaśūko yavakṣāraḥ| pāribhadraḥ parvatanimbaḥ, anye pāribhadraśabdena kaṇṭakivṛkṣaṃ raktakusumaṃ phalabhadrasañjñakaṃ vadanti| ūṣaṇaṃ pippalī| pāṭalyādīnāṃ kṣārodakena saha tvageloṣaṇacūrṇaṃ pibet, pāṭalyādikṣārodakaguḍakṛtān lehān vā lihyāt| kārtikakuṇḍastu ‘tvageloṣaṇacūrṇakaṃ’ ityatra ‘tvageloṣaṇasaṃyutam’ iti paṭhati| tatra pāṭalyāditilāntānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ yat cūrṇaṃ tat kṣārodakena muṣkakakṣārodakena pibet, tatkṛtānvā pṛthak pṛthak tvageloṣaṇasaṃyutān lehān guḍamiśritān lihyāditi vyākhyānayati| tathā ca viśvāmitraḥ- ‘pāṭalyāḥ pāribhadrādvā tilādvā'pi yavāgrajāt| kaṇailātvagyutaṃ cūrṇaṃ muṣkakakṣāravāriṇā|| pibedguḍena miśraṃ vā lihyāllehān pṛthak pṛthak’ iti| ‘gatimān’ ityatra ‘madirāṃ’ iti kecit paṭhanti, tathā ‘guḍena miśraṃ vā’ ityatra ‘guḍopadaṃśaṃ `guḍopadaṃśān' iti pā. vā’ iti ca paṭhanti| tacca pāṭhadvayamanārṣam||48||

lg.l: ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi mūtradoṣe kramaṃ hitam ||49||

ab.seg: sāmānyena `paramatena' iti `ekīyamatena' iti ca pā. ca kriyākramārthamāha- ata ūrdhvamityādi| teṣu mūtradoṣeṣu| ‘teṣu virecanaṃ’ ityatra ‘snehavirecanaṃ’ iti kecit paṭhanti| kārtikakuṇḍasta imaṃ pāṭhaṃ na paṭhati, ‘kaṣāyakalkasarpīṣi’ ityādinaiva gatārthatvāt| jejjaṭācāryastu snigdhaśuddhadehānāṃ pūrvoktā yogāḥ prayoktavyā ityāvedanāya paṭhati, tatpaṭhitatvānmayā'pi paṭhitaḥ||49-50||

lg.l: strīṇām atiprasaṅgena śoṇitaṃ yasya dṛśyate `sicyate' iti pā.|
maithunoparamas tasya bṛṃhaṇaś ca vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||51||
