ab.seg: idānīṃ haimantikaṃ vidhimāha- hemanta ityādi| ahimam uṣṇam| aśanaṃ bhojanaṃ, pānāni madyādīni| agurubhūṣitaḥ `agururūṣitaḥ agurucūrṇāvaguṇṭhitaḥ' iti pā. agurucūrṇāvaliptaḥ| vārikoṣṭhe pāṣāṇādiviracite kuśūlākāre jalapātre| sāṅgārayāne aṅgārapūrṇaśakaṭikāsahite, etadgarbhagṛhodare ityetasya viśeṣaṇam| mahati vistīrṇe| kauśeyāstaraṇāstṛte paṭṭavastrīyatūlikācchādite| kauśeyamityupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena prāvārājinādīni tantrāntaroktāni gṛhyante| taistairiti śītāpahaistantrāntaroktairvastraviśeṣaiḥ, vṛta iti ācchāditāṅgaḥ puruṣaḥ| garbhagṛhodare iti bṛhadgṛhamadhye aparaṃ yat kṣudragṛhaṃ tasyābhyantare| garbhagṛhodare ityupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena bhūgṛhamapi gṛhyate| śliṣṭvā āliṅgya| pīnaṃ māṃsalaṃ, ūru jānuvaṅkṣaṇayormadhyaṃ, jaghanaṃ kaṭhyā agrimabhāgaḥ| nanu, tantrāntare ‘gorasānikṣuvikṛtīḥ’ ityādinā yādṛśa āhāro hemante darśitastādṛśaḥ kimiti na nirdiṣṭaḥ? satyaṃ, hemante sañcīyamānasya kaphasya śaityāt prakupitasya vātasyopaśamanārthaṃ sādhāraṇa eva vidhiryasmādyuktaḥ, ataḥ sādhāraṇavidhiratra nirdiṣṭo na tādṛśa āhāraḥ| yadyevaṃ tarhi tantrāntare tādṛśa evāhāraḥ kuto nirdiṣṭa iti cet? ucyate- hemante śītānilasparśasaṃruddho balī vahniryadi tādṛśamāhāraṃ na labhate tadā dhātukṣayamāvahati, dhātukṣayācca tīvravātakopaḥ syāditi bhayāttantrāntare tādṛśa āhāro darśitaḥ| (athavā ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacit pustake na paṭhyate yasmāddhemante prabalāgnitvādapathyakṣamo deho bhavati)| kārtikakuṇḍo'muṃ pāṭhamanyathā paṭhati, sa cābhāvānna likhitaḥ| hemantaśiśirayostulyatvāddhaimantika eva vidhiḥ śiśire'pi sevyaḥ; ataḥ śiśiravidhānaṃ pṛthaṅgoktam| yatkecidatra varjyavidhānaṃ ‘...prāgvātaṃ rūkṣabhojanam| vātalāni ca dravyāṇi śītasnānaṃ ca varjayet’ iti paṭhanti; sa tvanārṣaḥ pāṭhaḥ, paramparāvicchedāsmaraṇāt samānatantrānabhidhānācca||21-31||

lg.l: (hemante ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacit pustake na paṭhyate nicitaḥ śleṣmā śaityāc chītaśarīriṇām |
auṣṇyād vasante kupitaḥ kurute ca gadān bahūn ||32||
varjayed vamanādīni karmāṇy api ca kārayet ||33||
vyāyāmam añjanaṃ dhūmaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ ca kavalagraham |
utsādanaṃ tathā snānaṃ vanitāḥ kānanāni ca ||38||

div.ab: vasantavidhimāha- auṣṇyādityādi| koṣṇam īṣaduṣṇam| adravaṃ dravarahitam| yavamudgamadhuprāyaṃ yavādibahulam| vyāyāmaḥ śarīrāyāsajanakaṃ karma| atra vasante| niyuddhādikaṃ vyāyāma ityetasya vivaraṇam| niyuddhaṃ bāhuyuddham, adhvā mārgagamanaṃ, śilānirghātaḥ pāṣāṇāsphālanam| utsādanam udvartanam| vanitāḥ striyaḥ| saṃśamanamabhidhāya saṃśodhanamāha- nirhareccāpītyādi| śirovirekaḥ nasyam| yadyapi bāhulyena vāte nirūho'bhihitaḥ, tathā'pi sarvadoṣaharatvāt kaphe'pi yojyaḥ| tathā ca, - “bastirvāte ca pitte ca kaphe rakte ca śasyate” ityādi| kavalo gaṇḍūṣabhedaḥ| varjyamāha- varjayedityādi| madhurādivarjanam utkleśaparihārārtham| kecidatra ‘hemante nicitaḥ śleṣmā’ ityādikaṃ pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti, sa ca granthagauravabhayāt parityaktaḥ||32-39||-

lg.l: vyāyāmam uṣṇam āyāsaṃ maithunaṃ pariśoṣi ca ||40||

ab.seg: yasmādgrīṣme `ataḥ paraṃ graiṣmaṃ vidhiṃ vivakṣurvarjyasevātastīvrarogaprādurbhūterā dau varjanīyānāha' iti pā. vyāyāmādisevanāttīvratarā rogā bhavantyato vyāyāmādisevāṃ tyajediti pratipādanārthaṃ graiṣmaṃ vidhiṃ vivakṣurādau varjanīyānāha- vyāyāmamityādi| tatrāyāsasyālpakleśatayā vyayāmato bhedaḥ| uṣṇam ātapādikam| maithunamiti yadyapi pūrvamanāgatābādhe grīṣmakāle pakṣānmaithunamuktaṃ, tathā'pyatra yattasya sarvathā niṣedhābhidhānaṃ tadgrīṣmasyātirūkṣatāpratipādanārtham| pariśoṣi śoṣaṇātmakam dvidalānnakṛtaṃ bhakṣyam' iti pā.| agniguṇodriktā rasāḥ kaṭvamlalavaṇāḥ||40||

lg.l: sarāṃsi sarito vāpīr vanāni rucirāṇi ca ||41||
śarkarākhaṇḍadigdhāni `śarkarākhaṇḍadugdhāni' iti pā. sugandhīni himāni ca ||43||
pānakāni ca seveta manthāṃś cāpi saśarkarān |
bhojanaṃ ca hitaṃ śītaṃ saghṛtaṃ madhuradravam ||44||

div.ab: ataḥparaṃ sevanīyānāha- sarāṃsītyādi| sarāṃsi amanuṣyakhātāni jalādhārāṇi, sarit nadī, vāpī pāṣāṇādibaddhā sasopānā svalpā jalādhārikā| vanāni rucirāṇīti sacchāyāni manoharāṇi kānanāni| parārdhyāni utkṛṣṭāni| tālavṛntānilān tālapatraviracitavyajanapavanān| digdhāni yuktāni| sugandhīni karpūrādivāsitāni| himāni śītalāni| pānakāni ceti cakārānmadyocitasya bahūdakaṃ madyaṃ kecidicchanti| madhuradravo rasālapānakādiryatra bhojane tanmadhuradravam| manthān jalaghṛtāktasaktūn| śṛtena payasā kvathitena dugdhena| bhojanaṃ rātrau hitamityukte divā manthādipānameveti gamyate| tathā ca tantrāntaraṃ- “divā pānāni śītāni hitaṃ rātrau ca bhojanam| sasarpiḥśarkaraṃ śītaṃ śṛtena payasā yutam” iti| pratyagrakusumākīrṇe iti nūtanapuṣpāstṛte| harmyasaṃśrite dhavalagṛhoparisthite| śayītetyatrāpi rātrāviti sambadhyate; tena rātrau harmyapṛṣṭhe śayīta, divā tu śītagṛhe| tathā ca tantrāntaram- ‘divā śītagṛhe nidrāṃ niśi candrāṃśuśītale| bhajeccandanadigdhāṅgaḥ pravāte harmyamastake’ (ca. sū. 6) iti| sukhaiḥ sukhotpādakaiḥ| atra kecidbahūni pāṭhāntarāṇi manyante; tāni tu vistarabhayānna likhitāni||41-45||-

lg.l: tāpātyaye hitā nityaṃ rasā ye guravas trayaḥ ||46||
payo māṃsarasāḥ koṣṇās tailāni ca ghṛtāni ca |
bṛṃhaṇaṃ cāpi yat kiñ cid abhiṣyandi tathaiva ca ||47||
vyāyāmaṃ ca divāsvapnaṃ vyavāyaṃ cātra varjayet ||49||
harmyamadhye nivāte ca bhajec chayyāṃ mṛdūttarām |
tad dhi sarvopayogeṣu tasmin kāle vivarjayet |
pibet prāvṛṣi jīrṇāṃs tu rātrau tān api varjayet |
kupitaṃ śamayed vāyuṃ vārṣikaṃ cācared vidhim |55|

div.ab: evaṃ naidāghaṃ vidhimupadiśyādhunā prāvṛṣeṇyaṃ bravīti- tāpātyaya ityādi| guravastrayo rasā madhurāmlalavaṇāḥ| bṛṃhaṇaṃ cāpi yatkiñcidabhiṣyandi tathaiva ceti ādānakarśitasyapyāyanārtham| yadyapi madhuratvenaiva payaḥprabhṛtikaṃ prāptaṃ tathā'pi teṣāmupādānamatyantahitatvāpādanārtham| bṛṃhaṇaṃ cātyarthakarśitasyopacayārtham| yat kiñciditi tṛptijanakam| nidāghopacitaṃ grīṣmakālasañcitaṃ, prakupyantaṃ prakopaṃ gacchantaṃ, samīraṇaṃ vātam| anilaghnena vidhinā snehasvedādinā| vidhikovido vidhānapaṇḍitaḥ| atrāpi kecit pāṭhāntaraṃ paṭhanti, tadapi `tacca jejjaṭaṭīkāyāṃ na dṛśyate' iti pā. granthagauravabhayāttyaktam| nanu, varṣāhemantagrīṣmeṣu doṣasañcaya eva vamanādinā saṃśodhanaṃ niṣevataḥ śaradvasantaprāvṛṭsu doṣaprakopa eva nāsti, kutastatrokto vidhiḥ sārthakaḥ, tathā cānyatrāpyuktaṃ, - ‘sañcaye'pahṛtā doṣā labhante nottarā gatīḥ’- iti| naivaṃ, hetvantaravaśādyatra sañcayapūrvakaḥ prakopastatra pratidoṣaprakopaṃ sañcaya eva vidhiḥ saṃśodhanākhya uktaḥ; yastu sañcayo yathartuvidhisevinaḥ, tatra svasthavṛttavidhinā saṃśamanaṃ kāryam||46-54||-

lg.l: ṛtāv ṛtau ya etena vidhinā vartate naraḥ ||55||
ghorān ṛtukṛtān rogān nāpnoti sa kadā cana |56|

div.ab: evamārtavavidhimabhidhāyedānīṃ tamanusarato `tamanubhavato guṇalābhamāha' iti pā. mānavasya svāsthyalābhamāha- ṛtāvṛtāvityādi| etena anantaroktena| ṛtukṛtāniti ṛtukṛtaśītoṣṇādibhiḥ ṛtūpādhibhiḥ śītoṣṇādibhiḥ' iti pā. kṛtān| rogān jvarādikān| kārtikasta ‘doṣān’ iti paṭhitvā doṣān vātādīn vikṛtāniti vyākhyānayati| anye tu vyākhyānayanti- ṛtakṛtāniti kṛtaśabdasyādau viśabdau lupto draṣṭavyaḥ, tena ṛtuvikṛtikṛtān vātādidoṣānnāpnuyādityarthaḥ||55|-

ab.seg: ataḥ paramaśanapravicārān vivakṣurāha- ata ūrdhvamityādi| aśanaṃ bhojanaṃ, vicāro'tra pṛthagbhāvaḥ| nanu `aśanasya bhojanasya pravicārān prakuṣṭān vicāraṇān avacāraṇarūpān kathayiṣyāmaḥ| nanu cāmayāprastutatvāt svasthavṛtte'śanapravibhāgābhidhānaṃ kathamaupayikaṃ? iti pā., dvādaśāśanapravicārasya rogaviṣayatvāt svasthavṛtte'śanapravibhāgavidhānamayuktaṃ? ucyate- svasthe'pi vayaḥprakṛtibhedena `vayasi aśanapravicārasyocitatvāt' iti pā. sātmyāsātmyatayā cāhārapravicārasyaucityāt| tāneva dvādaśāśanapravibhāgānāha- tatretyadi| tatra teṣu dvādaśāśanapravibhāgeṣu, śītādayo dvādaśavidhā āhārā api vṛttyarthāḥ||56||

lg.l: mūrcchārtān strīṣu ca kṣīṇān śītair annair upācaret ||57||

ab.seg: svasthavṛttādhikāre śītādīnāmāhārāṇāṃ krameṇa viṣayānāha- (śītāhāraviṣayamāha)- tṛṣṇetyādi| śītairiti tṛṣṇādikṣīṇāntaiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate; tṛṣṇādipīḍitān narān śītasparśaiḥ śītavīryaiścānnapānairupācaredityarthaḥ| mado madyaśoṇitottho vikāraḥ| annairiti bahuvacanena pānasyāpi svīkāraḥ||57||

lg.l: aklinnakāyāṃś ca `praklinnadehāṃśca' iti pā. narān uṣṇair annair upācaret ||58||

ab.seg: aṣṇāhāraviṣayamāha- kaphetyādi| kaphavātāmayāviṣṭāniti kaphavātarogākrāntān| aklinnakāyāniti `praklinnakāyāniti kledādisahitaśarīrān' iti, ‘kāraṇāntareṇārdratāmāpannān’ iti ca pā. kledarahitaśarīrān||58||

lg.l: vyāyāminaś cāpi narān snigdhair annair upācaret ||59||

ab.seg: snigdhāhāraviṣayamāha- vātikānityādi| vātikāniti vātaprakṛtīn| vātikānāmeva rūkṣadehatvād vātikānityetāvataiva rūkṣadehāniti siddhaṃ, viśeṣeṇābhidhānamavātikānāmapi nimittato rūkṣadehatāpannānāṃ snigdhānnenopacaraṇārtham||59||

lg.l: medasā'bhiparītāṃs tu snigdhān mehāturān api `sthūlān' iti pā.|

ab.seg: rūkṣabhojanaviṣayamāha- medasā'bhiparītānityādi| medasā'bhiparītāniti medovyāptaśarīrānityarthaḥ| kaphābhipannadehān kaphavyāptaśarīrān| snigdhāniti snigdhaśarīrān| kārtikasta snigdhānityatra sthūlāniti paṭhitvā vyākhyānayati- medasā'bhiparītānityukte sthūlāniti labdhe tadabhidhānaṃ medoduṣṭibhyo viśeṣeṇa sthālye rūkṣabhojanapratipādanārtham||60||

lg.l: śuṣkadehān pipāsārtān durbalān api ca dravaiḥ |61|

div.ab: dravabhojanaviṣayamāha- śuṣkadehānityādi| śuṣkadehādikān dravabahulairannairupācaret|61|-

lg.l: praklinnakāyān vraṇinaḥ śuṣkair mehina eva ca ||61||

ab.seg: śuṣkāhāraviṣayamāha- praklinnetyādi| praklinnakāyāniti kuṣṭhiprabhṛtīn `dhātuvṛddhyā ārdībhūtaśarīrān' iti pā. kuthitaśarīran| vraṇina iti klinnavraṇayuktān| vraṇitopāsanīye vraṇino dravottaramaśanamuktaṃ, tadaklinnaśuddhavraṇaviṣayam| yadā praklinnakāyāniti vraṇina ityasya viśeṣaṇaṃ tada avraṇānāṃ klinnakāyānāṃ śuṣkānnairupacaraṇaṃ na syāt, na ca tatheṣyate, tasmānnaivaṃ viśeṣaṇam; atra tu `anyatra' iti pā. sakledatvācchuṣkaṃ vyavasthitamiti||61||

div.ab: ekakālamityādi| ekakālamapi hīnamātra eva āhāro dātavyaḥ, vakṣyamāṇavākyāt| ‘durbalāgnivivṛddhaye’ ityatra ‘durbalāyāgnivṛddhaye’ iti kecit paṭhanti| tatra durbalaśabdenaiva dehadaurbalyādagnidaurbalyamicchanti|62|-

lg.l: samāgnaye tathā''hāro dvikālam api `deyaḥ kālamathobhayam' iti pā. pūjitaḥ ||62||

ab.seg: samāgnaya ityādi| na kevalaṃ dvikālamapi tu ‘annena kukṣerdvāvaṃśau’ ityādyuktamātrānvito'pītyaśabdena samuccīyate||62||

div.ab: auṣadhadveṣiṇa ityādi| auṣadhasamāyutaḥ ‘āhāra’ iti śeṣaḥ|63|-

ab.seg: hīnamātrasya bhojanasya viṣayamāha- mandāgnaya ityādi| mandānalāya rogayuktāya ca mātrāhīna āhāro deyaḥ; paramekakālameva, pūrvavākyāt||63||

div.ab: yathārtvityādi| yathartudatta iti ṛtuṃ ṛtuṃ prati yathābhihito yathāpravṛtta āhāro doṣapraśamanaḥ kathita ityarthaḥ|64|-

lg.l: ataḥ paraṃ tu svasthānāṃ vṛttyarthaṃ sarva eva ca |
pravicārān imān evaṃ dvādaśātra prayojayet `dvādaśānnapravicārānetāneva pracakṣate' iti pā.||64||

ab.seg: ata ityādi| ataḥ paramiti anantaroktāddoṣapramanāhārāt paramūrdhvam| vṛttyarthamiti śarīradhāraṇārtham| svasthānāmiti samadhātūnāṃ samadoṣaprakṛtīnāṃ ca| sarva eveti samasarvarasa āhāraḥ smṛta ityarthaḥ||64||

ata ūrdhvaṃ daśauṣadhakālān vakṣyāmaḥ | tatrābhaktaṃ `tatranirbhaktaṃ' iti pā. prāgbhaktam adhobhaktaṃ madhyebhaktam antarābhaktaṃ sabhaktaṃ sāmudgaṃ muhur muhur grāsaṃ grāsāntaraṃ ceti daśauṣadhakālāḥ ||65||

ato daśauṣadhakālānnirdiśannāha `idānīṃ daśauṣadhakālārambhaḥ, tānuddeśato nirdiśannāha' iti pā. - ata ūrdhvamityādi| teṣvauṣadhakāleṣvabhaktādikaṃ daśaprakāramauṣadhaṃ yojyam| auṣadhakālān pratyekaṃ nirdiśannāha- tatretyādi| ‘abhaktam’ ityasya sthāne ‘nirbhaktam’ ityante paṭhanti||65||
tatrābhaktaṃ tu yat kevalam evauṣadham upayujyate ||66||
tatrābhaktamityāderauṣadhakāloddeśasya prapañcamāha- tatrābhaktamityādi| tatra teṣvabhaktādiṣu madhye yat kevalamannarahitamauṣadhamupayujyate tadabhaktam||66||

lg.l: vīryādhikaṃ bhavati bheṣajam annahīnaṃ hanyāt tathā''mayam asaṃśayam āśu `tadāmayama...' iti pā. caiva |
tad bālavṛddhavanitāmṛdavas tu `tadvālavṛddhayuvatīmṛdavo'tha pītvā' iti pā. pītvā glāniṃ parāṃ samupayānti balakṣayaṃ ca ||67||

ab.seg: abhaktasya svarūpamabhidhāya guṇaṃ viṣayaṃ ca pratipādayannāha- vīryādhikamityādi| vanitā strī, mṛdavaḥ sukumārāḥ| balādīnāmabhaktauṣadhaniṣedhamabhidadhadbālādibhya itaraṃ tu abhaktaviṣayaṃ bodhayati| tatrābhaktaṃ tvityādikaṃ bhāṣyaṃ, vīryādhikamityādikā guṇāḥ, balavṛddhavanitāmṛduviparyayo viṣayaḥ| kārtikastu sarveṣāmabhaktādīnāṃ prāgeva svarūpamabhidhāya paścāt sarveṣāṃ guṇān viṣayāṃśca pratipādayati||67||
prāgbhaktaṃ nāma yat prāgbhaktasyopayujyate ||68||
prāgbhaktasyeti bhaktasyādāvityarthaḥ||68||

lg.l: śīghraṃ vipākam upayāti balaṃ na hiṃsyād annāvṛtaṃ na ca muhur vadanān nireti |
prāgbhaktasevitam athauṣadham etad eva dadyāc ca vṛddhaśiśubhīrukṛśāṅganābhyaḥ ||69||

ab.seg: prāgbhaktasya guṇaṃ viṣayaṃ cāha śīghramityādi| āhārāvṛtatvānmuhurmuhurvāraṃvāraṃ vaktrādbahirna nireti| vipākaṃ sukhapariṇāmam| na ceti niretītyatra sambadhyate| vadanāt mukhakuharāt| nireti nirgacchati| auṣadhametadeveti prāgbhaktākhyamauṣadham||69||
adhobhaktaṃ nāma- yad adho `yadbhuktvā pīyate' iti pā. bhaktasyeti ||70||
adhobhaktasya svarūpamāha- adhobhaktamityādi| adhobhaktasyeti bhojanānta ityarthaḥ||70||
madhye bhaktaṃ nāma- yan madhye bhaktasya pīyate ||71||
madhyebhaktamāha- mādhyebhaktamityādi||71||

lg.l: pītaṃ yad annam upayujya tad ūrdhvakāye hanyād gadān bahuvidhāṃś ca balaṃ dadāti |
madhye tu pītam apahanty avisāribhāvād ye madhyadeham abhibhūya bhavanti rogāḥ ||72||

ab.seg: adhobhaktamadhyebhaktayorguṇamāha- pītamityādi| balaṃ dadātīti ūrdhvakāya eva| madhye tu pītaṃ ‘bhaktasya’ iti śeṣaḥ| avisāribhāvāt aviprasaraṇasvabhāvāt| madhyadeśaṃ koṣṭham| abhibhūya vyāpya||72||
antarābhaktaṃ nāma `tu yat pūrvāparayorbhaktayorantare' iti pā. - yad antarā pīyate pūrvāparayor bhaktayoḥ ||73||
antarābhaktamāha antarābhaktamityādi| antarābhaktaṃ yat pūrvāparayorbhaktayorantarā madhye pīyate, pūrvāparayoriti prātaḥsāyantanayorbhejanayorityarthaḥ||73||
sabhaktaṃ nāma ‘sabhaktaṃ nāma auṣadheṣu yat sādhyate bhaktam' iti pā. - yat saha bhaktena ||74||
sabhaktamāha- sabhaktamityādi| sabhaktaṃ bhaktena saha sādhitaṃ, bhaktayuktaṃ vā||74||

lg.l: pathyaṃ sabhaktam abalābalayor hi nityaṃ tad dveṣiṇām api tathā śiśuvṛddhayoś ca |
hṛdyaṃ manobalakaraṃ tv atha dīpanaṃ ca pathyaṃ sadā bhavati cāntarabhaktakaṃ yat ||75||

ab.seg: antarābhaktasabhaktayorguṇaviṣayāvāha- hṛdyamityādi| hṛdyaṃ hṛdayāya hitam| manobalakaramiti manobalaṃ manaḥsāmarthyaṃ, tatkarotītyarthaḥ| abalābalayoriti strīdurbalayorityarthaḥ| taddveṣiṇāmiti bheṣajadveṣiṇāmityarthaḥ||75||

lg.l: sāmudgaṃ nāma `tu' iti pā. - yad bhaktasyādāv ante ca pīyate ||76||
doṣe dvidhā pravisṛte tu samudgasañjñam ādyantayor yad aśanasya niṣevyate tu ||77||

ab.seg: sāmudgamāha- sāmudgamityādi| dvidhā pravisṛte ūrdhvādhaḥprasṛte ityarthaḥ| doṣe samudgasañjñaṃ niṣevyate iti sambandhaḥ| nanu, sāmudgavivaraṇe bhaktasyādāvante cetyupādānāt ‘ādyantayoryadaśanasya’ iti gatārtham? ucyate- cūrṇakalkādīnāmapi samudgasañjñārthaṃ punaruktiḥ, anyathā'nantaroktasya ‘pītaṃ’ ityasyānuvartanāt pānasyaiva samudgasañjñā syāt||76-77||
muhur muhur nāma `muhurmuhuryat sabhaktamabhaktaṃ vā tanmuhurmuhuḥ' iti pā. - sabhaktam abhaktaṃ vā yad auṣadhaṃ muhur muhur upayujyate ||78||

lg.l: śvāse muhur muhur atiprasṛte ca kāse hikkāvamīṣu sa vadanty upayojyam etat ||79||

ab.seg: muhurmuhurauṣadhamāha- muhurmuhurityādi| muhurmuhuḥ bhaktasahitaṃ bhaktarahitaṃ vā yadauṣadhaṃ vāraṃ vāraṃ prayujyate tanmuhurmuhurityarthaḥ| muhurmuhurityetacchvāsakāsādiṣūpayojyam||78-79||
grāsaṃ tu- yat piṇḍavyāmiśram ||80||
grāsamāha- piṇḍavyāmiśramiti kavalavyāmiśramityarthaḥ| tantrāntaradarśanāt grāsaṃ grāsamiti boddhavyam||80||
grāsāntaraṃ `grāsāntaraṃ nāma yadubhayorgrāsayormadhye prayujyate' iti pā. tu yad grāsāntareṣu ||81||
grāsāntaramāha- grāsāntareṣviti kavalāntareṣvityarthaḥ||81||

lg.l: grāseṣu `grāseṣu pītamupayāti vipakvamāśu vṛddhe'baleṣu ca hitaṃ pravadanti santaḥ' iti pā. cūrṇam abalāgniṣu dīpanīyaṃ vājīkarāṇy api tu yojayituṃ yateta |
grāsāntareṣu vitared vamanīyadhūmān śvāsādiṣu prathitadṛṣṭaguṇāṃś ca lehān ||82||

ab.seg: anayorviṣayamāha- grāseṣvityādi| abalāgniṣu durbalāgniṣu| vamanīyadhūmāniti snāyucarmakhuraprabhṛtibhiḥ kṛtān||82||
evam ete daśauṣadhakālāḥ ||83||
sāmprataṃ saṅgrahamāha- evamityādi||83||

lg.l: visṛṣṭe viṇmūtre viśadakaraṇe dehe ca sulaghau viśuddhe codgāre hṛdi suvimale vāte ca sarati |
tathā'nnaśraddhāyāṃ klamaparigame kukṣau ca śithile pradeyas tv āhāro bhavati bhiṣajāṃ kālaḥ sa tu mataḥ ||84||

ab.seg: evamauṣadhakālān pradarśyā'dhunā''hārasya śreyaskaratvāttatkālamāha- visṛṣṭe ityādi| (pratyartuvihitāhāro hi kālopayuktaḥ sukhatvāya sampadyate, atastatkālaṃ niyamayannāha visṛṣṭe ityādi|) visṛṣṭe viṇmūtre iti pravṛte viṇmūtre| viśadakaraṇe iti viśadāni karaṇāni yasmin dehe sa viśadakaraṇaḥ tasmin, viśadendriye ityarthaḥ| dehe sulaghāviti śarīre gurutvarahite ityarthaḥ| viśuddhe codgāre iti madhurāmladhūmagandhiviyukte ityarthaḥ| hṛdi suvimale iti nirākule hṛdaye ityarthaḥ| vāte saratīti adhaḥ pravahati vāte ityarthaḥ| annaśraddhāyāṃ bhaktākāṅkṣāyāmityarthaḥ| klamaparigame iti anāyāsaśramarahite ityarthaḥ| kukṣau ca śithile iti bubhukṣodayāt sraste kukṣau stabdhatārahite ityarthaḥ| āhāro dātavyo bhavati bhiṣajā vaidyena, yataḥ kālaḥ sa tu mataḥ sa eva mata ityarthaḥ| tu śabdo'tra avadhāraṇārthaḥ| bhiṣaggrahaṇaṃ vaidyapratyavekṣitasyāhārasya bhojyatvapratipādanārtham||84||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantre tantrabhūṣaṇādhyāyeṣu svasvavṛttādhyāyo nāma (dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) catuḥṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||64||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāmuttaratantre catuḥṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ||64||
athātas tantrayuktim adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

svasthavṛttānantaraṃ svasthavidhyarthasya tantrayuktibhiḥ prasādhānāttantrayuktayadhyāyārambhaḥ- athāta ityādi| athāta iti pūrvavat vyākhyeyam| trāyate śarīramaneneti tantraṃ śāstraṃ cikitsā `cikitsitam' iti pā. ca, tasya yuktayo yojanāstantrayuktayaḥ, tā adhikṛtya kṛto'dhyāyaḥ, tam| vedotpattivadatra taddhitalopaḥ| tāśca tantrayojanā dvividhāḥ- vākyayojanā arthayojanāśca; tatra vākyayojanā yogoddeśanirdeśādyāḥ, arthayojanā adhikaraṇapadārthādayaḥ||1-2||

dvātriṃśat tantrayuktayo bhavanti śāstre | tad yathā- adhikaraṇaṃ(1), yogaḥ(2), padārthaḥ(3), hetvarthaḥ(4), uddeśaḥ(5), nirdeśaḥ(6), upadeśaḥ(7), apadeśaḥ(8), pradeśaḥ(9), atideśaḥ(10), apavarjaḥ(11), vākyaśeṣaḥ(12), arthāpattiḥ(13), viparyayaḥ(14), prasaṅgaḥ(15), ekāntaḥ(16), anekāntaḥ(17), pūrvapakṣaḥ(18), nirṇayaḥ(19), anumataṃ(20), vidhānam(21), anāgatāvekṣaṇam(22), atikrāntāvekṣaṇaṃ(23), saṃśayaḥ(24), vyākhyānaṃ(25), svasañjñā(26), nirvacanaṃ(27), nidarśanaṃ(28),
niyogaḥ(29), vikalpaḥ(30), samuccayaḥ(31), ūhyam(32) iti ||3||

saṅkhyābhedena `kiyatyastantrayuktaya ityāha'- iti pā. tantrayuktīrnirdiśannāha- dvātriṃśadityādi| śāstre sauśrute| adhikaraṇamityādisaṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva `samāsenetyarthaḥ| vyāsataśca ṣaṭtriṃśattantrayuktayaḥ kaiścit pratipāditāḥ| atra saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva saṅkhyālābhe sati saṅkhyopādānaṃ niyamārthaṃ kṛtam' iti pā. dvātriṃśat saṅkhyā labdhā, atastatkaraṇamanyatantroktāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśaccatvāriṃśadvā tantrayuktaya iti saṅkhyāniṣedhārtham| śāstre ityatrānye samāseneti paṭhitvā vyākhyānayanti- anyatra vistareṇa ṣaṭtriṃśaccatvāriṃśadvā tantrāyuktayaḥ; atra dvātriṃśaditi samāsenoktam| katamāstāstantrayuktaya ityāha- tadyathetyādi| tadyatheti nidarśanam| adhikaraṇādīni sūtrakāra eva vyākhyāsyati||3||
atrāsāṃ tantrayuktīnāṃ kiṃ prayojanam? ucyate- vākyayojanam arthayojanaṃ ca ||4||

evaṃ tantrayuktīruddeśataḥ pratīpādya tāsāṃ tantrayuktīnāṃ prayojanamāha- atrāsāmityādi| atra cikitsāśāstre| vākyayojanamarthayojanaṃ ceti vākyasyāsambaddhasya yojanaṃ sambandhanaṃ vākyayojanaṃ, līnasyāsaṅgatasya cārthasya prakāśanaṃ saṅgatīkaraṇaṃ cārthayojanam| tatra kāsāñcittantrayuktīnāṃ yogoddeśanirdeśādīnāṃ vākyayojanaṃ, kāsāñcidadhikaraṇapadārthohyādīnāmarthayojanaṃ prayojanam||4||

bhavanti cātra
ślokāḥ- asadvādiprayuktānāṃ vākyānāṃ pratiṣedhanam |
svavākyasiddhir api ca kriyate tantrayuktitaḥ `tantrayuktibhiḥ' iti pā.||5||

lg.l: vyaktā `vyatyāsoktāśca' iti pā. noktās tu ye hy arthā līnā ye cāpy anirmalāḥ |
leśoktā ye ca `kvacittantre’ iti pā. kecit syus teṣāṃ cāpi prasādhanam ||6||

ab.seg: atraiva pūrvācāryāpaṭhitau ślokāvadhikārthakhyāpanāyāha- asadvādiprayuktānāmityādi| asadvādino hi pratirasapākavādinaḥ pākatrayavādino guṇakartṛtvavādino vetyādayaḥ| pratiṣedhanam apadeśādibhistantrayuktibhiḥ parapakṣadūṣaṇam| svavākyasiddhiḥ svavākyasthāpanaṃ nirṇayākhyayā tantrayuktayā| yathā- pratirasaṃ pāka ityasadvādidarśanamapadeśākhyayā tantrayuktayā dravyādivijñāne nirākṛtaṃ, tatraiva dvividhaḥ pāka ityādisvamatasādhanaṃ nirṇayākhyayā tantrayuktayā kṛtam| vyaktā noktāḥ `vyatyāsoktā viparyayeṇoktāḥ' iti pā. spaṣṭatayā noktāḥ| līnā asamyagdarśitāḥ| anirmalā leśenoktāḥ| teṣāṃ prasādhanaṃ yogaprabhṛtibhiḥ kriyate `asadvādiprayuktānāṃ vacanānāṃ pratiṣedhanaṃ paramataṃ nirākṛtya svamatayojanā, asadvādivkyapratiṣedhayuktayo dravyādivijñāne darśitāḥ| svavākyaṃ madhurakaṭukāvityādikaṃ svamatasthāpanaṃ, idamapi tatraiva daśitam| vyatyāsoktā viparyayeṇoktāḥ, te viparyayākhyatantrayuktyā vyākhyāyante| līnā asamyagdaśintā viśeṣā dvitryādivācakāḥ, te prakaraṇādibhiḥ spaṣṭīkriyante| amarmopahate deśe sirāsandhyasthivarjite' ityādikā hyarthā anirmalāḥ, te vyākhyānādibhirūhādibhirvyajyante| teṣāṃ cāpi prasādhanaṃ tantrayuktibhiḥ kriyate' iti pā.||5-6||

lg.l: prabodhasya `pravodhyasya' iti pā. prakāśārthaṃ tathā tantrasya yuktayaḥ ||7||

ab.seg: kecidatra tantrayuktīnāṃ stutyartha ślokaṃ paṭhanti- yathā'mbujavanasyārka ityādi| eṣa ca ślokaṣṭīkāsu mūlatvena na varṇitaḥ||7||
tatra yam artham adhikṛtyocyate tad adhikaraṇaṃ; yathā rasaṃ doṣaṃ vā ||8||

ataḥ paramuddiṣṭānāṃ tantrayuktīnāṃ vivaraṇamāha- tatretyādi| tatra tāsu tantrayuktiṣu madhye; yamarthamadhikṛtya apare arthā abhidhīyante tadadhikaraṇasañjñaṃ bhavati udāharaṇamāha- rasaṃ doṣaṃ veti| etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati- rasaṃ doṣaṃ vā adhikṛtya yattadullekhābhāve'pyarthajātamabhihitaṃ tat sarvaṃ tadadhikāre pratīyata `asyāyamarthaḥ- yamarthamadhikṛtya ye'rthā abhidhīyante tadadhikaraṇasañjñaṃ sarvasyābhidheyasyeti| tamevārthamāha- yathā- rasaṃ doṣaṃ ceti, rasavijñāne rasamadhikṛtya doṣavijñāne doṣamadhikṛtya cocyata iti' iti pā. ityarthaḥ||8||

lg.l: siddhaṃ balābhyāṃ ca sadevadāru hitāya nityaṃ galagaṇḍaroge’ |
ity atra tailaṃ siddhaṃ pibed iti prathamaṃ vaktavye tṛtīyapāde siddham iti prayuktaṃ, evaṃ dūrasthānām api padānām ekīkaraṇaṃ yogaḥ ||9||

ab.seg: yogākhyāṃ tantrayuktimāha- yenetyādi| yena vyatyāsoktānāṃ sannikṛṣṭaviprakṛṣṭānāṃ padānāmekīkaraṇaṃ sa yoga ityarthaḥ| vyatyāsenoktaṃ padayogaṃ darśayannāha- tailamityādi| viparyayeṇoktasya padasyaikīkaraṇaṃ yoga ityarthaḥ| yenetyādi sūtraṃ, yena vyatyāsoktānāṃ ityādisūtrārthaḥ, yathetyādyudāharaṇam| evaṃ sannikṛṣṭasya viparyayoktasya padasyāpaharaṇaṃ mukhyamekīkaraṇaṃ pratipādya dūrasthānāmapyuddeśenāha- evaṃ dūrasthānāmapīti||9||

yo 'rtho 'bhihitaḥ sūtre pade vā `asyāyamarthaḥ- yamarthamadhikṛtya ye'rthā amidhīyante tadadhikaraṇasañjñaṃ sarvasyāmidheyasyeti| tamevārthamāha- yathā- rasaṃ doṣaṃ ceti, rasavijñāne rasamadhikṛtya dauṣavijñāne doṣamadhikṛtya cocyata iti' iti pā. sa padārthaḥ padasya padayoḥ padānāṃ vā'rthaḥ padārthaḥ; aparimitāś ca padārthāḥ | yathā- snehasvedāñjaneṣu nirdiṣṭeṣu dvayos trayāṇāṃ vā'rthānām upapattir dṛśyate, tatra yo 'rthaḥ pūrvāparayogasiddho bhavati sa grahītavyaḥ; yathā-
‘vedotpattim adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma’ ity ukte sandihyate buddhiḥ- katamasya vedasyotpattiṃ `vedasyāyamutpattiṃ vivakṣuriti' iti pā. vakṣyatīti, yataḥ ṛgvedādayas tu vedāḥ; ‘vida vicāraṇe, vidlṛ lābhe,’ ity etayoś ca dhātvor anekārthayoḥ prayogāt, tatra pūrvāparayogam upalabhya pratipattir bhavati- āyurvedotpattim ayaṃ vivakṣur iti; eṣa padārthaḥ ||10||

padārthābhidhāṃ tantrayuktimāha- yo'rtho'bhihita ityādi| padyate gamyate yenārtha iti sūtrasyāpi padatvāt sūtre yo'rthaḥ pratipāditaḥ sa padārthaḥ| padārthakhyatantrayuktipratipādakaṃ lakṣaṇamabhidhāyedānīṃ tadvyākhyātukāmaḥ prathamaṃ tadavayavasya samāsamabhidhatte- padasyetyādi| adhunā bahuṣu padārtheṣu nirdhārya viśiṣṭapadārthagrahaṇāya padārthabahutvaṃ pratipādayati- aparimitā ityādi| kathamityāha- yathetyādi| tatra snehaśabde nirdiṣṭe hi guṇapremasarpiṣāṃ trayāṇāmarthānāmupapattirdṛśyate, svedaśabdenāpi sāgniniragnikayoruṣmaṇoḥ prāptiḥ, añjanaśabdenāpi nayanāñjanābhyāṅgayoḥ prāptiḥ, teṣu padārthaṣu yādṛśaḥ padārtho gṛhyate tādṛśamāha- tatra yo'rtha ityādi| pūrvoktaparoktavākyasambandhenopapanno yo'rtho bhavati sa grahītavya ityarthaḥ| udāharaṇamāha- yathā vedotpattimityādi| sandihyate sandehaṃ gacchatītyarthaḥ| kathaṃ sandihyata ityāha- katamasyetyādi| yataḥ ṛgvedādayo vedāstataḥ katamasyā vedasyotpattiṃ vakṣyatīti sandihyate, tasmin sandehe yathā pratyayārthaḥ svīkartavyastathā''ha- vidityādi- ‘āyurvedamicchāma ihopadiśyamānam’ ityasminnāyurvedaśabdaḥ śrūyate, ato'tra veda āyurveda ityabhiprāyaḥ `padyate gamyate'nenārtho'sminniti vyutpattyā sūtrasyāpi padatvaṃ, ataḥ sūtroktārthasyāpi padārthatā anye tu sūtrapade iti paṭhitvā vyākhānayanti- sūtrasya padaṃ sūtrapadaṃ tasmin yo'rthaḥ sa padārthaḥ| pade ityekatvanirdeśādekasyaiva padasya yo'rthaḥ sa eva paraṃ padārthaḥ syādityata āha- padasyetyādi| anekārthaṃ padaṃ darśayannāha- tatra snehetyādi| snehaśabdo maitryāṃ rasadhātau sarpirādau ca vartate| svedaśabdo'gnisvedoṣmasvedādiṣūktaḥ, añjanaśabdo netrāñjanābhyaṅgayoḥ pūrvāparayogasiddha iti pūrvāparasambandhī yo yogaḥ prakṛtipratyayasambandhaḥ tena siddhaḥ, vṛddhavyavahārādyaḥ siddha ityanye| tameva saṃśayamāha- katamasyetdi|' iti pā.||10||

lg.l: yad anyad uktam anyārthasādhakaṃ `yaduktamubhayārthasādhakaṃ' iti pā. bhavati sa hetvarthaḥ |
yathā- mṛtpiṇḍo 'dbhiḥ praklidyate tathā māṣadugdhaprabhṛtibhir vraṇaḥ praklidyata iti ||11||

ab.seg: hetvarthatantrayukterlakṣaṇamāha- yadanyadityādi| udāharaṇamāha- yathā mṛdityādi| atra bāhyena mṛtpiṇḍadṛṣṭāntena māṣadugdhayogādibhirābhyantaro vraṇaprakledaḥ sādhyate||11||
uddeśalakṣaṇamāha- samāsetyādi| saṅkṣepeṇa bhaṇanamuddeśa ityarthaḥ| udāharaṇamāha- yathā śalyamiti| sarvamevābādhajananaṃ saṅkṣepeṇa śalyamucyate, natu śārīrāgantubhedena prapañcanāt||12||
nirdeśalakṣaṇamāha- vistaretyādi| vistareṇa bhāṣaṇaṃ nirdeśa ityarthaḥ| udāharaṇamāha- yathā śārīramāgantukaṃ ceti| śārīraśalyamāgantukaṃ ca śalyamiti śalyaṃ dvividhamucyate||13||

lg.l: yathā- ‘tathā na jāgṛyād rātrau divāsvapnaṃ ca varjayet’ iti ||14||

ab.seg: upadeśalakṣaṇamāha- evamityādi| evaṃ kuryādityupadeśa ityarthaḥ| udāharaṇamāha- yathetyādi| nanu, upadeśaniyogayoḥ ko bhedaḥ? ucyate, prāyika upadeśaḥ, yathā- rātrau na jāgṛyāditi prāyikatvenopanyastaṃ, kaphādyabhibhūte tu tatra rātrijāgaraṇasyāpi śastatvāt divā na svāpaṃ kuryādityapi prāyikaṃ, grīṣme tṛṣṇādyanvaye ca divāsvāpasyocitatvāt; niyogaścāprāyikaḥ, yathā- pathyameva bhoktavyamiti; yadyapi ‘jvarito'hitamaśnīyādyadyapyasyārucirbhavet’ ityādinā'pathyabhojanasyāpyavakāśaḥ, tathā'pi tadānīmapathyasyaiva pathyatvamiti niyogasya vyabhicāro nāsti||14||
anena kāraṇenety apadeśaḥ, yathā'padiśyate- madhuraḥ śleṣmāṇam abhivardhayatīti ||15||

apadeśalakṣaṇamāha- anenetyādi| anena kāraṇeneti kārya prati hetukathanamapadeśa ityarthaḥ| udāharaṇamāha- yathāpadiśyata ityādi| yathāpadiśyata iti udāharaṇopakrame| dravyaviśeṣo madhuraḥ kutaḥ śleṣmāṇaṃ vardhayati? atra madhuraḥ śleṣmāṇaṃ vardhayati arthānnijabhāvena madhuratvena vardhayati||15||
prakṛtasyātikrāntena sādhanaṃ pradeśaḥ | yathā- devadattasyānena śalyam uddhṛtaṃ tathā ‘tasmāt’ iti pā. yajñadattasyāpy ayam uddhariṣyatīti ||16||
pradeśamāha- prakṛtasyetyādi| udāharaṇamāha- yathā devadattasyetyādi| atra yajñadattasya śalyoddharaṇaṃ prastutaṃ, taddevadattasya śalyoddharaṇenātikrāntena sādhyate||16||

prakṛtasyānāgatasya hārāṇacandrastu `itaratra vihitasya vidheritaratra prayogāyopadeśo'tideśaḥ| yathā- `eṣa eva vidhiḥ kāryaḥ śiśire samudāhṛtaḥ' iti paṭhati, ayameva sādhupāṭhaḥ sādhanam atideśaḥ | yathā- yato 'sya vāyur ūrdhvam uttiṣṭhate tenodāvartī syād iti ||17||

atideśamāha- prakṛtasyetyādi| anāgatasya bhaviṣyataḥ| udāharaṇamāha- yathā yata ityādi| atra vāyorurdhvamutthānaṃ prakṛtam| tena prastutena anāgataṃ bhaviṣyadudāvartitvaṃ sādhyate| udāvartī syāt udāvartī sambhāvyeta||17||

lg.l: yathā- asvedyā viṣopasṛṣṭāḥ, anyatra kīṭaviṣād iti ||18||

ab.seg: apavargamāha- abhivyāpyetyādi| (guṇakriyādibhiḥ sarvato vā abhivyāpta kasyacit padārthasya tebhyo guṇakriyādibhyaḥ pṛthakkaraṇam apavargaḥ)| udāharaṇamāha- yathā asvedyā ityādi| utsargarūpatayā viṣopasṛṣṭānasvedyān pratipādyāpavādamāha- anyetretyādi||18||

lg.l: yena padenānuktena vākyaṃ samāpyeta sa vākyaśeṣaḥ |
yathā- śiraḥpāṇipādapārśvapṛṣṭhodarorasām ity ukte puruṣagrahaṇaṃ vinā'pi gamyate puruṣasyeti ||19||

ab.seg: vākyaśeṣamāha- yenetyādi| udāharaṇamāha- yathā śira ityādi| gamyate jñāyata ityarthaḥ||19||
yad akīrtitam arthād āpadyate sā'rthāpattiḥ | yathā- odanaṃ bhokṣye ity ukte 'rthād āpannaṃ bhavati- nāyaṃ pipāsur yavāgūm iti ||20||
arthāpattimāha- yadakīrtitamityādi| akīrtitam apratipāditam tadudāharaṇamāha- yathaudanamityādi| nāyaṃ pātumicchuryavāgūmityartha||20||

lg.l: yad yatrābhihitaṃ `yadvihitaṃ' iti pā. tasya prātilomyaṃ viparyayaḥ |
yathā- kṛśālpaprāṇabhīravo duścikitsyā ity ukte viparītaṃ gṛhyate dṛḍhādayaḥ sucikitsyā iti ||21||

ab.seg: viparyayamāha- yadyatrābhihitamityādi| prātilomyaṃ viparītam| udāharaṇamāha- yathā kṛśālpetyādi| viparyayeṇa viparītameva gamyate, arthāpattyā aviparīta evārthaḥ pratīyata ityanayorbhedaḥ||21||

prakaraṇāntareṇa samāpanaṃ `samānaṃ' iti pā. prasaṅgaḥ, yad vā prakaraṇāntarito yo 'rtho 'sakṛd uktaḥ `yo'rthaḥ punaruktaḥ' iti pā. samāpyate sa prasaṅgaḥ | yathā- pañcamahābhūtaśarīrisamavāyaḥ puruṣas tasmin kriyā so 'dhiṣṭhānam iti vedotpattāv abhidhāya, bhūtacintāyāṃ punar uktaṃ- yato 'bhihitaṃ pañcamahābhūtaśarīrisamavāyaḥ puruṣa iti, sa khalv eṣa karmapuruṣaś cikitsādhikṛta iti ||22||

prasaṅgamāha- prakaraṇāntareṇetyādi| prakaraṇāntareṇeti prakaraṇāntaroktenārthenetyarthaḥ| samānaṃ tulyam| udāharaṇamāha- yathetyādi| prakaraṇāntareṣu asakṛduktaḥ punaḥ punaruktaḥ| samāpyate samāptiṃ nīyate| tadeva kathyate- yathetyādi| apare tu ‘adhikaraṇāntarito yo'rtho'sakṛdukta’ iti paṭhitvā vyākhyānayanti- snehavirekādhikārayornavajvarī niṣiddhaḥ, punarjvarādhikāre taruṇajvariṇaḥ snehaśodhane niṣiddhe iti adhikaraṇe'ntaritasyarthasyāsakṛduktiḥ||22||
(sarvatra ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kacitpustake nopalabhyate )yad avadhāraṇenocyate sa ekāntaḥ | yathā- trivṛd virecayati, madanaphalaṃ vāmayati (eva) ||23||
ekāntalakṣaṇamāha- sarvatretyādi| avadhāraṇena avikalpena, niyamenetyarthaḥ; udāharaṇe'vadhāraṇavācina evakārasya nirdeśāt udāharaṇamāha- yathā trivṛdvirecayatīyi||23||
kvacit tathā kvacid anyatheti yaḥ so 'nekāntaḥ | yathā- kecid ācāryā bruvate dravyaṃ pradhānaṃ, kecid rasaṃ, kecid vīryaṃ kecid vipākam iti ||24||
anekāntamāha- kvacittathetyādi| udāharaṇamāha- yathā kecidācāryā bruvate dravyaṃ pradhānamityādi| spaṣṭārthaḥ||24||
ākṣepapūrvakaḥ praśnaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ | yathā- kathaṃ vātanimittāś catvāraḥ pramehā asādhyā bhavantīti ||25||
pūrvapakṣamāha- ākṣepetyādi| udāharaṇamāha- yathetyādi| atraiva doṣajānāṃ sādhyatvenopalabdheriti hetoḥ pūrvapakṣāvatāraḥ| nirṇayāṅgatvenārthasādhanatvameva saṃśayasyāpi||25||

lg.l: yathā- śarīraṃ prapīḍya paścād adho gatvā vasāmedomajjānuviddhaṃ mūtraṃ visṛjati vātaḥ evam asādhyā vātajā iti ||26||
tathā coktam- kṛtsnaṃ śarīraṃ niṣpīḍya medomajjāvasāyutaḥ |
adhaḥ prakupyate vāyus tenāsādhyās tu vātajāḥ ||27||

ab.seg: nirṇayamāha- tasyottaramityādi| tasya pūrvapakṣasya yaduttaraṃ sa nirṇaya ityarthaḥ| udāharaṇamāha- yathā śarīramityādi| yataḥ śarīrapīḍādikaṃ kṛtvā vasādyanvitaṃ mūtraṃ vāto visṛjati, ato majjakṣaye pūrvapūrvadhātukṣayādasādhyatvamityarthaḥ||26-27||
paramatam apratiṣiddham anumatam | yathā- anyo brūyāt- sapta rasā iti, tac cāpratiṣedhād anumanyate kathañcid iti ||28||
anumatamāha- paramatamityādi| apratiṣiddham adhigatamityarthaḥ| udāharaṇamāha- yathetyādi| kathañciditi kenāpi prakāreṇetyartha||28||
prakaraṇānupūrvyā'bhihitaṃ vidhānam | yathā- sakthimarmāṇy ekādaśa prakaraṇānupūrvyā'bhihitāni ||29||

vidhānamāha- prakaraṇetyādi| prakaraṇānupūrvyā'bhihitamiti yathākramamuktam| candranandanena ca ‘paripāṭhyā'rthakathanaṃ vidhānam’ iti vidhānalakṣaṇaṃ kṛtam| udāharaṇamāha- yathā sakthītyādi| marmaṇāṃ prakaraṇānupūrvyā abhidhānaṃ kṣiptatalahṛdayaityādikam||29||
anāgatāvekṣaṇamāha- evamityādi| anāgatasya bhaviṣyataḥ avalokanaṃ kāryārthamavekṣaṇamityarthaḥ udāharaṇamāha- yathā śloketyādi||30||

lg.l: yathā- cikitsiteṣu brūyāt- ślokasthāne yad īritam iti ||31||

ab.seg: atikrāntāvekṣaṇamāha- yadityādi| atikrāntasya atītasya avekṣanam| udāharaṇamāha- yathā cikitsiteṣvityādi||31||

ubhayahetudarśanaṃ saṃśayaḥ | yathā `ubhayathā darśanaṃ yathā- kiṃ pittavyatirekādanyo'gniḥ āhosvit pittamevāgniriti' iti pā. - talahṛdayābhighātaḥ prāṇaharaḥ, pāṇipādacchedanam aprāṇaharam iti ||32||

saṃśayamāha- ubhayetyādi| ubhayorvisadṛśayorarthayorhetuḥ tasya darśanam| udāharaṇamāha- yathā taletyādi| nanu, etat saṃśayajñānārthamudāhṛtaṃ, saṃśayo'sti kutaḥ? talahṛdayābhighātasya tathā pāṇyādicchedasya prāṇaharatvāprāṇaharatvābhyāṃ pṛthagdarśitatvāt| satyaṃ, paraṃ yatra ghātacchedayordvayoḥ sadbhāvastatra kiṃ talahṛdayābhighātānmaraṇamuta pāṇipādacchedājjīvanamityevaṃ saṃśayaḥ `atrāśrayaghātenāśritopaghātāt pāṇau pāde vā chinne sati talahṛdayasyāpyāhatatvamiti prāṇaharaṇamaprāṇaharaṇaṃ vā bhavatviti saṃśayaḥ syāditi' iti pā.||32||

tantre 'tiśayopavarṇanaṃ vyākhyānam | yathā- iha pañcaviṃśatikaḥ puruṣo vyākhyāyate, anyeṣv āyurvedatantreṣu bhūtādiprabhṛty ārabhya cintā `bhūtā dimārabhya cinteti' iti, `bhūtādiprakṛtivikṛtyārabdhacintaḥ' iti ca pā.||33||

vyākhyānamāha- tantre ityādi| tantre śāstre| atiśayasya atiriktasyārthasya upavarṇanaṃ khyāpanaṃ vyākhyānam| ‘tatrātiśaya’ iti pāṭhe tatreti nirdhāraṇe| udāharaṇamāha- yathā ihetyādi| pañcaviṃśatikaḥ puruṣa iti pañcaviṃśatitama ityarthaḥ, avyaktādīnāmaṣṭānāṃ prakṛtivikāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ saha caturviśatitvāt| puruṣa iti kṣetrajñaḥ| svamatamabhidhāya paramatamāha- anyeṣvāyurvedatantreṣvityādi| bhūtādistāmaso'haṅkāraḥ `bhūtādiprabhṛtīni ahaṅkāramārabhyetyarthaḥ| etenānyatra pañcaviṃśatikaḥ puraṣaḥ' iti pā.; etena bhūtādimahaṅkāramārabhyānyāyurvedatantreṣu cintā natvavyaktamārabhyeti||33||

anyaśāstrāsāmānyā svasañjñā | yathā- mithunam iti madhusarpiṣor grahaṇaṃ; lokaprasiddham udāharaṇaṃ vā `yathā mithunībhūtayorvātapittayorvātaśleṣmaṇoḥ pittaśleṣmaṇośca dvamdvaśabdena grahaṇaṃ, tathābhūtayośca tailasarpiṣoryamakaśabdeneti' iti pā.||34||

svasañjñāmāha- anyaśāstrāsāmānyā svasañjñetyādi| anyāni śāstrāṇi āyurvedādaparāṇi vyākaraṇādīni teṣu, asāmānyā asādhāraṇā, tatrānanugatā svaśāstreṣveva prayojanavatītyarthaḥ| udāharaṇamāha- yathā mithunamityādi| nanu, svasañjñāpraṇayanaṃ vyavahārārtha kriyate, na cātra mithunasañjñayā yanmadhusarpiṣorgrahaṇaṃ tadvāreṇa vyavahāro dṛśyate? ucyate- udāharaṇamātrametadyathākathañciditi| ata eva pakṣāntaramāha- loke prasiddhamudāharaṇaṃ vā| svasañjñāyā grāhyāmityarthaḥ- yathā caturṣu sneheṣu mahāsnehasañjñā| ataḥ paraṃ kecidadhīyate- yathoṣṇabhayāt chāyāmanusaratīti| te tūdāharaṇamapi tantrayuktiṣvicchanti| tanna yuktaṃ, uddeśasūtre udāharaṇakhyatantrayukteranukteḥ, saṅkhyādhikyaprasakteśca, tasmādyathoṣṇetyādiko'papāṭha eveti||34||
niścitaṃ vacanaṃ nirvacanam | yathā- āyur vidyate 'sminn anena vā āyur vindatīty āyurvedaḥ ||35||
nirvacanamāha- niścitamityādi| udāharaṇamāha- yathā āyurvidyate'smin ityādi||35||

lg.l: dṛṣṭāntavyaktir nidarśanam `dṛṣṭāntena darśanaṃ nidarśanam' iti, `dṛṣṭāntenārthaḥ prasādhyate yatra tannidarśanam' iti ca pā.|
yathā- agnir vāyunā sahitaḥ kakṣe `koṣṭhe' iti pā. vṛrddhi gacchati tathā vātapittakaphaduṣṭo vraṇa iti ||36||

ab.seg: nidarśanamāha- dṛṣṭāntavyaktirityādi| dṛṣṭāntena vyaktiryasmin vākye tattathā| etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati- dṛṣṭāntenārthaḥ prasādhyate yatra tannidarśanamiti| ata eva ca nidarśanāt hetvartho bhidyate, hetvarthasya dṛṣṭāntamātratvāt `anyārthasādhakamātratvāt' iti pā.| udāharaṇamāha- yathā agnirityādi| tatheti abhivṛddhiṃ gacchatītyarthaḥ||36||
idam eva kartavyam iti niyogaḥ | yathā- pathyam eva bhoktavyam iti ||37||

niyogamāha- idamityādi| udāharaṇamāha- yathā pathyamityādi| (kvacinniyogo ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate vyabhicarati, yathā- jvaritasyārucau satyāmapathyamapi dīyate; taduktaṃ- ‘jvarito'hitamaśnīyādyadyasya hyarucirbhavet| annakāle hyabhuñjānaḥ kṣīyate mriyate'thavā’ iti| tantrāntare'pyuktaṃ- ‘utpadyate hi sā'vasthā deśakālabalaṃ prati| yasyāṃ kāryamakārya syādvarjitaṃ kāryameva ca’- iti `asya cānaikāntikatvaṃ prāgeva parihṛtam' iti pā. )||37||
idaṃ cedaṃ ceti samuccayaḥ | yathā- māṃsavarge eṇahariṇādayo lāvatittiriśāraṅgaś ca pradhānānīti ||38||
samuccayamāha- idamityādi| udāharaṇamāha- yathā māṃsetyādi| eṇādayaḥ pradhānāni lāvādayaśca pradhānānīti samuccayaśca||38||

lg.l: yathā- rasaudanaḥ saghṛtā yavāgūr vā (bhavatv iti) ||39||

ab.seg: vikalpamāha- idaṃ vetyādi| pratyekaṃ vāśabdopādānamatrodāharaṇe yanna kṛtaṃ tadekenāpi vāśabdena bahuṣu vikalpatādarśanārtha; kvacid vāśabdaṃ vinā'pi vikalpo bhavati, yathaikaṃ rogaṃ prati bahuṣu yogeṣu vāśabdaṃ vinā'pyanyatamo yogo yojya iti vikalpaḥ| udāharaṇamāha- yathā rasaudana ityādi||39||

yad anirdiṣṭaṃ buddhyā 'vagamyate buddhigamyaṃ tadūhyam' iti, `buddhimatā tadūhyam' iti ca pā. tad ūhyam | yathā- abhihitam annapānavidhau caturvidhaṃ cānnam upadiśyate- bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ lehyaṃ peyam iti, evaṃ caturvidhe vaktavye dvividham abhihitam; idam atrohyam- annapāne viśiṣṭayor dvayor grahaṇe kṛte caturṇām api grahaṇaṃ bhavatīti; caturvidhaś cāhāraḥ `kiñcānyat annena bhakṣyamavaruddhamannasādharmyāt, peyena lehyaṃ, dravasādharmyāt| caturvidhaścāhāraḥ prāyeṇa dvividhaḥ prasiddha iti' iti pā. praviralaḥ, prāyeṇa dvividha eva; ato dvitvaṃ prasiddham iti | kiñ cānyat- annena bhakṣyam avaruddhaṃ, ghanasādharmyāt; peyena lehyaṃ, dravasādharmyāt ||40||

sāmpratamūhyākhyāṃ tantrayuktimāha- yadityādi| anirdiṣṭamiti sākṣādityarthaḥ| udāharaṇamāha- yathā'mihitamityādi| kathamatrohyaṃ bhavatīti kathanāyāha- bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ lehyaṃ peyamiti caturdhā vaktavye dvividhamamihitamatrohyaṃ bhavati cāturvidhyamatrohyaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| buddhigamyamūhyaṃ prāk pratipāditaṃ tat kīdṛśyā buddhyā gamyata ityāha- annapāne ityādi| annapānayorviśiṣṭayorabhyavahāryayorgrahaṇe `sāmānyalakṣaṇenaitā vyāsataḥ sampradarśitāḥ' iti pā. caturṇāmabhyavahāryaviśeṣāṇāṃ bhakṣyabhojyalehyapeyānāṃ grahaṇaṃ bhavatīti| cāturvidhyameva kimiti noktamityāśaṅkayāha- caturvidha ityādi| pravirala iti prakarṣeṇa viralaḥ kvacitkathañcidbhāvāt| prakārāntareṇāpi caturvidhatvamāha- kiñcānyadityādi| anna kecitpūrvapakṣaṃ kurvanti vākyārthasyāspaṣṭāvidyamānasya yojanādūhyaṃ na tantrayuktiriti, līnasyānirdiṣṭasya cārthasya vākyādevohanenobhayarūpasya yojanādūhyaṃ tantrayuktereva||40||

bhavanti cātra-
sāmānyadarśanenāsāṃ `sāmānyalakṣaṇenaitā vyāsataḥ sampradarśitāḥ' iti pā. vyavasthā sampradarśitā |
viśeṣas tu yathāyogam upadhāryo vipaścitā ||41||

lg.l: mayā samyag vinihitāḥ śabdārthanyāyasaṃyutāḥ `śabdanyāyārthasaṃyutāḥ' iti pā.||42||
yo hy etā vidhivad vetti dīpībhūtās tu buddhimān |
sa pūjārho bhiṣakśreṣṭha iti dhanvantarer matam ||43||

ab.seg: evaṃ tantrayuktīrabhidhāyopasaṃharan pratipāditatantrayuktiviśeṣapratipattaye ślokamāha- bhavanti cātretyādi| tantrayuktīnāṃ viśeṣo yathāsambandhaṃ viduṣā upadhāraṇīya ityarthaḥ| kārtikastu dvātriṃśadyuktaya ityādikaṃ ślokadvayaṃ paṭhati||41-43||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantre tantrabhūṣaṇādhyāyeṣu tantrayuktir nāma (tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) pañcaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||65||
iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantre pañcaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ||65||

div.head: doṣabhedavikalpādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto doṣabhedavikalpam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

tantrayuttayanantaraṃ pariśiṣṭatvāddoṣabhedādhyāyārambhaḥ- athāta ityādi| athetyādikaṃ pūrvavahyākhyeyam| dhātūn dūṣayantīti doṣā vātādayaḥ, teṣāṃ bhedaḥ pṛthaksaṃsargasannipātabhedena, tasya vikalpanamekaikadyanugamanena nānātvakaraṇaṃ prapañcanaṃ doṣabhedavikalpaḥ, tamadhikṛtya kṛtaḥ, tam||1-2||

div.ab: aṣṭāṅgetyādi| aṣṭāṅgāni śalyādīni vājīkaraṇāntāni, tānyeva veda āyurvedaḥ, tena tatra vā vidvān yastam| mahaujasaṃ mahāprabhāvam| sūkṣmā līnārthāḥ `nānārthatvāt' iti pā., agādhā duravagāhā ye āgamā evodadhayaste santyasminniti| śrīmāniti rājaśriyā brāhvayā vā alaṅkṛtaḥ| nanu, viśvāmitro gādhirājaḥ, tatsutatvena rājaśriyā yogo yuktaḥ, kathaṃ brāhmyā śriyeti? satyaṃ, viśvāmitrasya brāhmaṇyaṃ tapasā, tato brāhmyā śriyā yogo yukta eva| anye tu kṣatriyāṇāṃ brahmarṣijātatvenobhayayoga iti manyante, apare tu vidyāsamāptyā brāhmayā śriyā yoga iti manyante| tathā coktam- “vidyāsamāptau brāhmaṃ vā sattvamārṣamathāpi vā| dhruvamāviśati jñānāttasmādvaidyo dvijaḥ smṛtaḥ”- iti||3||-

lg.l: kati tatraikaśo jñeyā dviśo vā'py athavā triśaḥ |5|

div.ab: dviṣaṣṭirityādi| purastātparikīrtitāḥ iti rasabhedavikalpe| kuto dviṣaṣṭirdoṣabhedāstriṣaṣṭī rasabhedā iti? ucyate- ‘dviṣaṣṭirdoṣabhedāḥ syū rasabhedāstriṣaṣṭidhā| svāsthyaṃ triṣaṣṭaṃ vijñeyaṃ tatra ṣaḍrasayojanam’- iti| kati tatraikaśo jñeyā dviśo vā'pyathavā triśa ityāha- ‘ekaśaḥ ṣaṭ dviśastvekaviṃśatiścaturanvitā| triśo dvātriṃśadityevaṃ trayo doṣāstriṣaṣṭidhā’- ita||4||-

lg.l: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā saṃśayacchin mahātapāḥ ||5||
prītātmā nṛpaśārdūlaḥ `naraśārdūlaḥ' iti pā. suśrutāyāha tattvataḥ |6|

div.ab: śiṣyapraśnamākarṇya gururāha- tasyetyādi| tasyeti suśrutasya| tat iti pūrvoktam| saṃśayacchiditi sandehacchettā| prītātmā tṛptāntaḥkaraṇaḥ| nṛpaśārdūlo rājasattamaḥ| tattvata iti yathārthabhāvena||5||-

lg.l: trayo doṣā dhātavaś ca purīṣaṃ mūtram eva ca ||6||
dehaṃ sandhārayanty ete hy avyāpannā rasair hitaiḥ |7|

div.ab: kimāha bhagavānityāha- traya ityādi| trayo doṣā vātādayaḥ, dhātavaḥ sapta rasādayaḥ| avyāpannā avikṛtiṅgatāḥ| rasairhitairiti madhurādirasaiḥ pathyairityarthaḥ| nanu, yathāpraśnaṃ pratyuttare vācye kimarthaṃ kati tatraikaśa ityādipraśnasyottarārthe trayo doṣā ityādyabhidhānam? ucyate- dhātūnāṃ malānāṃ ca doṣasaṃsarge doṣavyapadeśa ityādipratipādanārthaṃ; ata evāsṛjā saha purā pañcadaśa prasarā abhihitāḥ| yadyevaṃ tarhi māṃsādibhiḥ saha prasaraḥ kuto na kīrtitaḥ? ucyate- asaṅkhyeyatvāt| atha kathaṃ tadadhigantavyamiti cet, doṣaliṅgenaiva| tathā cātra vakṣyati- tasmāt prasaṅgaṃ saṃyamyetyādi| nanu, doṣadhātumalamūlaṃ hi śarīramityanenaiva doṣādikāryatvamabhihitaṃ; na ca śarīrāddeho bhinnārthaḥ, tayoḥ paryāyaśabdatvāt; tatkathaṃ punarucyate- ete dehaṃ dhārayantīti? ucyate- dehaśabdenātra karmapuruṣasya cikitsādhikṛtasya vivakṣitatvāt||6||-

lg.l: rogāṇāṃ tu sahasraṃ yac chataṃ viṃśatir eva ca |
śataṃ `śatāni pañca dravyṇāṃ trisaptatyadhikāni ca' iti pā. ca pañca dravyāṇāṃ trisaptatyadhikottaram ||8||

div.ab: kīdṛśaḥ punarayaṃ dehaśabdābhigheyaḥ karmapuruṣa iti pūrvapratipāditasyaiva karmapuruṣasya svarūpaṃ vācyaṃ, tatprasaṅgenāparamapi prāṇādikaṃ yattatpratipādayituṃ sukhasmaraṇārthaṃ pratipādayati- puruṣa ityādi| atraike kalāśabdena pañcabhūtāni ekādaśendriyāṇīti ṣoḍaśavikārā iti vyācakṣate, parametannāyurvede pramāṇīkṛtam| anye tu kalāśabdamaṅgapratyaṅgeṣvāmananti- śirogrīvāpāṇipādapārśvapṛṣṭhodarāṃsītyaṣṭāṅgāni, cibukanāsauṣṭhavaṅkṣaṇāṅguṣṭhāṅgulipārṣṇigulphāḥ pratyaṅgānīti| svatantraparatantrābhiprāyānuvartibhirācāryaiḥ kalāśabdo guṇavācī paṭhitaḥ| te ca sarvabhūtacintāśārīroktasukhaduḥkhecchodvegaprayatnādīn ṣoḍaśaguṇānācakṣate `tasya puruṣasya, sukhaduḥkhecchādayo bhūtacintāśārīroktāḥ ṣoḍaśa guṇāḥ' iti pā.| catuṣpādaṃ ṣoḍaśakalaṃ bheṣajaṃ carakācāryeṇoktaṃ; tatra ṣoḍaśakalaṃ ṣoḍaśaguṇamiti vyākhyānayanti| prāṇāścaikādaśeti agniḥ somo vāyuḥ sattvaṃ rajastamaḥ pañcendriyāṇi bhūtātmeti prāṇāḥ| yo'sau bhūtātmā sa eva ṣoḍaśakalaḥ, saṃyogina eva prāṇavyapadeśabhājaḥ, ityekādaśatvam| rogāṇāṃ tu sahasraṃ yacchataṃ viṃśatireva ceti viśatyadhikaikādaśaśatāni rogāṇām| atra sauśrute tantre ṣaṭsthāneṣu proktā rogāḥ ślokairabhidhīyante|- ‘hīnātidagdhaiḥ kṣāreṇa, trayaḥ pluṣṭādayo'gninā| caturtho dhūmavihataḥ pañca śoṇitaduṣṭayaḥ||1|| doṣadhātumalādīnāṃ dvātriṃśat kṣayavṛddhitaḥ| dve sthaulyakārśye trividho visraṃsādyo balakṣayaḥ||2|| ṣaṭ śophāḥ ṣaḍ vraṇā vahnitritayaṃ viṣamādikam| āmaṃ vidagdhaṃ viṣṭabdhamajīrṇaṃ ca tathā tridhā||3|| iti ṣaṭṣaṣṭirātaṅkāḥ sūtrasthāne nidarśitāḥ| āmapakvāśaye `āmapakvāśayaśrotreṣvindriyādhiṣṭhiteṣu ca' iti pā. śrotre tathendriyacatuṣṭaye||4|| tvagāmiṣasirāsnāyusandhyasthimajjasambhavāḥ `...sandhikīkasamajjasu' iti pā.| śukre caikāṅgasarvāṅgagatāḥ saptādhikā daśa||5|| trayodaśāvṛtairanyairdoṣaiḥ syurmārutaiḥ khalu| caturvidhaṃ vātaraktamākṣepaścāpatānakaḥ| pakṣāghāto'patantraśca manyāstambho'rditastathā||6|| gṛdhrasī saha viśvācyā śiraḥ kroṣṭukapūrvakam| khañjaḥ paṅguḥ kalāyākhyaḥ kaṇṭakaḥ pādadāhakṛt||7|| pādaharṣo'vabāhuśca mūkaminmiṇagadgadāḥ| tūnyādhmānadvaye'ṣṭhīlādvayamarśāṃsi ṣaṭ tathā||8|| carmakīlaścatasraścāśmaryaḥ pañca bhagandarāḥ| tathā'ṣṭādaśa kuṣṭhāni kilāsāni punastridhā||9|| pramehā visṃhatiḥ proktāḥ piḍikā nava tatkṛtāḥ| udarāṇi `jaṭharā mṛḍhagarbhāḥ syuraṣṭāvaṣṭau tathaikaśaḥ' iti pā. tathā'ṣṭau ca mūḍhagarbhastathā'ṣṭadhā||10|| bāhyā vidradhayaḥ ṣaṭ syustathā'ntaḥsthāḥ smṛtā daśa| visarpanāḍīstanajāstathaiva pañca pañca ca||11|| granthayaḥ sapta caikā syādapacī saptadhā'rbudam| galagaṇḍāstrayaḥ sapta vṛddhayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ||12|| upadaṃśā matāḥ pañca ślīpadaṃ ca tathā tridhā| bhagnā aṣṭādaśa jñeyāḥ śūkadoṣāstathaiva ca| catvāriṃśattathā'ṣṭau ca kṣudrarogāḥ prakīrtitāḥ||13|| aṣṭāvoṣṭhabhavā dantamūleṣu daśa pañca ca||14|| aṣṭau danteṣu jihvāyāṃ pañca tālugatā nava| kaṇṭhe cāṣṭādaśa jñeyāścatuḥsarvasarā gadāḥ||15|| evaṃ mukhe saptaṣaṣṭiriti sthāne dvitīyake| dvācatvāriṃśadadhikā triśatī parikīrtitā||16|| aṣṭau śukragatā rogā aṣṭāvārtavaduṣṭayaḥ| catvāro'sṛgdarāḥ proktā apātastvaparākṛtaḥ||17|| makkallalīnaśoṣāśca naigameśāhṛtastathā| nāgodaraḥ srutirgarbhe śārīre saptaviṃśatiḥ||18|| atha medonilāvegācchvayathuḥ sarujaśca yaḥ| āḍhyavātaḥ sarvasarāḥ śophāḥ pañca prakīrtitāḥ| karṇapālyāmayāḥ pañca klaibyamuktaṃ caturvidham `klībāḥ pañcavidhāstathā' iti pā.||19|| vāntarecitayoḥ proktā vyāpado daśa pañca ca| ṣaṇnetrapraṇidhānasya netrasyaikādaśaiva tu||20|| pañca bastikṛtāstatra catvāraḥ pīḍane kṛtāḥ| ekādaśa dravyakṛtāḥ sapta śayyākṛtāstathā||21|| catvāriṃśaccatasraśca vaidyato vyāpadastathā| krodhāyāsādikāḥ pañca daśa cāturahetukāḥ||22|| snehasya kāraṇānyaṣṭāvapratyāgamakṛnti ca| iti netrādidoṣeṇa ṣaṣṭiḥ sapta samāsataḥ||23|| evaṃ cikitsitasthāne rujo'ṣṭānavatistathā| annādirakṣāvijñāne viṃśatirviṣahetukāḥ||24|| vegāḥ syuḥ sthāvare darvīkaramaṇḍalināṃ viṣe| rājilavaikarañjānāṃ pratyekaṃ sapta sapta ca||25|| mūṣikāstu daśāṣṭau ca sapta vegā alarkajāḥ| saptaṣaṣṭiśataṃ cātra kīṭānāṃ viṣadāyinām `saṣāṣṭaṃ tu śataṃ cātra kīṭānāṃ viṣadarpiṇām' iti pā.||26|| saptacatvāriṃśadyutaṃ kalpasthāne śatadvayam| nava sandhyāśrayāḥ proktā vartmajāścaikaviṃśatiḥ||27|| śuklabhāge daśaikaśca catvāraḥ kṛṣṇabhāgajāḥ| sarvāśrayāḥ saptadaśa dṛṣṭijā dvādaśaiva tu||28|| bāhyajau dvau netrarogāviti ṣaṭsaptatiḥ smṛtāḥ| kukūṇakaḥ śiśoreva karṇe'ṣṭāviṃśatirnṛṇām||29|| ekatriṃśadghrāṇagatāḥ sapratiśyāyapañcakāḥ| ekādaśa `daśa dṛṣṭāḥ śirorogāḥ' iti pā. śirorogāḥ paraṃ śālākyasañjñite||30|| ātaṅkānāṃ śataṃ proktaṃ ṣaṭcatvāriṃśatā yutam| nava bālagrahā yonivyāpado viṃśatiḥ striyāḥ||31|| evaṃ kumāratantre'sminnekonatriṃśadāmayāḥ| aṣṭau jvarā hyatīsārāḥ ṣaṭ catasraḥ pravāhikāḥ||32|| catvāro grahaṇīdoṣā yakṣmaiko gulmapañcakam| hṛdrogāḥ pañca catvāraḥ pāṇḍvākhyāḥ kāmalādvayam||33|| halīmakaḥ pānakī ca raktapitaṃ caturvidham| ṣaṭprakārā matā mūrcchā vikārāḥ sapta madyajāḥ||34|| dāhāḥ pañca tṛṣaḥ sapta chardayaḥ pañca dehinām| hikkāḥ śvāsāstathā kāsāḥ pratyekaṃ pañca pañca ca||35|| svarabhedāstathā ṣaṭ syurviśatiḥ kṛmijātayaḥ| navodāvartakā dṛṣṭā visūcyastisra eva ca||36|| ānāhau dvāvāmaviṭkau tathā'rocakapañcakam| mūtrāghātā dvādaśa syuriti kāyacikitsite||37|| āmayānāṃ śataṃ proktaṃ catvāriṃśacca sapta ca| devatā-daitya-gandharva-yakṣa-pitra-hi-rakṣasām||38|| piśacasyābhiṣaṅgeṇa gadāścāṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ| apasmārāśca catvāra unmādāḥ ṣaḍudīritāḥ||39|| aṣṭādaśagadā bhūtavidyāyāṃ sūkṣmadarśibhiḥ| evaṃ hi sauśrute tantre kāśīrājena kīrtitāḥ||40|| rogāṇāṃ tu sahasraṃ yacchataṃ viṃśatireva ca| vyāsato vistarataḥ| hiśabdo hetvarthe, yasmāt kāraṇāt||7-8||-

lg.l: dviṣaṣṭidhā bhavanty ete bhūyiṣṭham iti niścayaḥ ||9||

ab.seg: bhinnā ityādi| bhinnā bhedaṅgatā dviṣaṣṭidhā bhavantītyarthaḥ| trayo doṣā vātapittaśleṣmāṇaḥ| guṇā guṇamayāḥ sattvarajastamomayāḥ| tadyathā- rajobhūyiṣṭho mārutaḥ, rajo hi pravartakaṃ sarvabhāvānāṃ; pittaṃ sattvotkaṭaṃ, laghuprakāśakatvāt, rajoyuktaṃ vetyeke; kaphaḥ tamobahulaḥ, guruprāvaraṇātmakatvādityāhurbhiṣajaḥ| yadyevaṃ tat kathaṃ kaphaprakṛtike puṃsi sattvaguṇopapannatā paṭhitā? ucyate- guṇādvitayamapi kaphe jñātavyaṃ, ‘sattvatamobahulā āpaḥ’ ityuktatvāt||9||

lg.l: traya eva pṛthak doṣā dviśo nava samādhikaiḥ |
pañcāśad evaṃ tu saha bhavanti kṣayam āgataiḥ |

div.ab: kathamete dviṣaṣṭidhā bhavantītyāha- traya evetyādi| tatra pṛthak pratyekaṃ, doṣā vātapittaśleṣmāṇastraya eva, itarau ca dvau svasthāviti jñeyau| vṛddho vātaḥ svasthau pittaśleṣmāṇau (1), vṛddhaṃ pittaṃ svasthau vātaśleṣmāṇau (2), vṛddhaḥ śleṣmā svasthe vātapitte (3), iti| dviśo nava samādhikairiti tatra samavṛddhābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ doṣābhyāṃ trayaḥ saṃsargā bhavanti; yathā `dviśo nava, tatra samaistrayaḥ, tadyathā|' iti pā. - vātapitte same vṛddhe svasthaḥ śleṣmā (1), vātaśleṣmāṇau samau vṛddhau svasthaṃ pittaṃ (2), pittaśleṣmāṇau samau vṛddhau svastho vātaḥ (3), iti| anyatarādhikavṛddhābhyāṃ ṣaṭ `adhikaistu ṣaḍbhedāḥ' iti pā.; tadyathā- vātapittayorvṛddhayorvāto'dhiko vṛddhaḥ svasthaḥ śleṣmā (1), vātapittayorvṛddhayoḥ pittamadhikavṛddhaṃ svasthaḥ śleṣmā (2), vātaśleṣmaṇorvṛddhayorvāto'dhikavṛddhaḥ svasthaṃ pittaṃ (3), vātaśleṣmaṇorvṛddhayoḥ śleṣmā'dhikavṛddhaḥ svasthaṃ pittaṃ (4), pittaśleṣmaṇorvṛddhayoḥ pittamadhikaṃ vṛddhaṃ svastho vātaḥ (5), pittaśleṣmaṇorvṛddhayoḥ śleṣmā adhikavṛddhaḥ svastho vātaḥ (6)| triśastu vṛddhaistrayodaśa; tatra tribhiradhikairekaḥ adhikaikadoṣāstrayaḥ, adhikadvidoṣāstrayaḥ, samamadhyolbaṇadoṣāḥ ṣaṭ| tadyathā- vātapittaśleṣmaṇāṃ vṛddhānāṃ vāto'dhikavṛddhaḥ (1), vātapittaśleṣmaṇāṃ vṛddhānāṃ pittamadhikavṛddhaṃ (2), vātapittaśleṣmaṇāṃ vṛddhānāṃ śleṣmā'dhikavṛddhaḥ (3)| athādhikadvivṛddhadoṣāḥ; tadyathā- vātapittaśleṣmaṇāṃ vṛddhānāṃ vātapitte adhikavṛddhe (1), vātapittaśleṣmāṇāṃ vṛddhānāṃ vātaśleṣmāṇau adhikavṛddhau (2), vātapittaśleṣmaṇāṃ vṛddhānāṃ pittaśleṣmāṇāvadhikavṛddhau (3)| kṣīṇo vātaḥ svasthau pittaśleṣmāṇau (1), kṣīṇaṃ pittaṃ svasthau vātaśleṣmāṇau (2), kṣīṇaḥ śleṣmā svasthe vātapite (3), evaṃ pṛthak traya eva| atha hīnamadhyolbaṇavṛddhāḥ ṣaḍucyante, tatra samaḥ samavṛddho hīnavṛddha ityarthaḥ; tadyathā- hīnavṛddho vātaḥ, madhyavṛddhaṃ pittaṃ, adhikavṛddhaḥ śleṣmā (1); hīnavṛddho vātaḥ, madhyavṛddhaḥ śleṣmā, adhikavṛddhaṃ pittaṃ (2); hīnavṛddhaṃ pittaṃ, adhikavṛddho vātaḥ, madhyavṛddhaḥ śleṣmā (3), madhyavṛddho vātaḥ, hīnavṛddhaṃ pittaṃ, adhikavṛddhoḥ śleṣmā (4); hīnavṛddhaḥ śleṣmā, adhikavṛddhaṃ pittaṃ, madhyavṛddho vātaḥ (5); adhikavṛddho vātaḥ, madhyavṛddhaṃ pittaṃ hīnavṛddhaḥ śleṣmā 6| sarvadoṣaiḥ samavṛddhairekaḥ| uktaṃ ca tantrāntare- ‘dvyulbaṇaikolbaṇaiḥ ṣaṭ syurhīnamadhyādhikaiśca ṣaṭ| samaiścaiko vikārāste sannipātāstrayodaśa”- iti| pañcāśadityādi| evamanena prakāreṇa kṣayamāgataiḥ pañcaviṃśatidoṣabhedaiḥ saha pañcāśadbhavanti| tadyathā- vātapittakaphairekaikaiḥ kṣīṇaistrayo bhedā bhavanti, dviśo nava procyante| tadyathā- vātapitte samakṣīṇe svasthaḥ śleṣmā (1), vātaśleṣmāṇau samakṣīṇau svasthaṃ pittaṃ (2), pittaśleṣmāṇau samahīnau svasthe vātaḥ 3| adhikakṣīṇāḥ ṣaṭ; tadyathā- vātapittayoḥ kṣīṇayorvāto'dhikakṣīṇaḥ svasthaḥ śleṣmā (1), vātapittayoḥ kṣīṇayoḥ pittamadhikakṣīṇaṃ svasthaḥ śleṣmā (2), vātaśleṣmāṇoḥ kṣīṇayorvāto'dhikakṣīṇaḥ svasthaṃ pittaṃ (3), vātaśleṣmaṇoḥ kṣīṇayoḥ śleṣmā'dhikakṣīṇaḥ svasthaṃ pittaṃ (4), pittaśleśmaṇoḥ kṣīṇayoḥ pittamadhikakṣīṇaṃ svastho vātaḥ (5), pittaśleṣmaṇoḥ kṣīṇayoḥ śleṣma'dhikakṣīṇaḥ svastho vātaḥ (6)| atha kṣīṇadoṣatrayabhedāstrayodaśa procyante; tatra- tribhirapi samakṣīṇairekaḥ; adhikaikaikakṣīṇaiśca trayaḥ| yathā- vātapittaśleṣmaṇāṃ kṣīṇānāṃ vāto'dhikakṣīṇaḥ (1), vātapittaśleṣmaṇāṃ kṣīṇānāṃ pittamadhikakṣīṇaṃ (2), vātapittaśleṣmaṇāṃ kṣīṇānāṃ śleṣmā adhikakṣīṇaḥ (3)| athādhikakṣīṇadvidoṣāḥ; tadyathā- vātapittaśleṣmaṇāṃ kṣīṇānāṃ vātapitte adhikakṣīṇe (1), vātapittaśleṣmaṇāṃ kṣīṇānāṃ vātaśleṣmaṇāvadhikakṣīṇau (2), vātapittaśleṣmaṇāṃ kṣīṇānāṃ pittaśleṣmāṇāvadhikakṣīṇau (3)| atha hīnamadhyolbaṇakṣīṇāḥ ṣaṭ procyante; tadyathā,- hīnakṣīṇo vātaḥ, madhyakṣīṇaṃ pittaṃ, adhikakṣīṇaḥ śleṣmā (1); madhyakṣīṇo vātaḥ, hīnakṣīṇaṃ pittaṃ, adhikakṣīṇaḥ śleṣmā (2); adhikakṣīṇo vātaḥ, madhyakṣīṇaṃ pittaṃ hīnakṣīṇaḥ śleṣmā (3); hīnakṣīṇo vātaḥ, adhikakṣīṇaṃ pittaṃ madhyakṣīṇaḥ śleṣmā (4); adhikakṣīṇo vātaḥ, hīnakṣīṇaṃ pittaṃ, madhyakṣīṇaḥ śleṣmā (5); madhyakṣīṇo vātaḥ, adhikakṣīṇaṃ pittaṃ, hīnakṣīṇaḥ śleṣmā (6)| kṣīṇetyādi atra madhyaśabdena svastho'bhidhīyate, adhikaśabdena ca vṛddhaḥ| tatra kṣīṇamadhyādhikabhedena ṣaṭ| tadyathā- kṣīṇo vātaḥ, svasthaṃ pittaṃ, vṛddhaḥ śleṣmā (1); kṣīṇo vātaḥ, vṛddhaṃ pittaṃ, svasthaḥ śleṣmā (2); svastho vātaḥ, pittam kṣīṇaṃ, vṛddhaḥ śleṣmā (3); vṛddho vātaḥ, kṣīṇaṃ pittaṃ, svasthaḥ, śleṣmā (4); svastho vātaḥ, pittaṃ vṛddhaṃ, kṣīṇaḥ śleṣmā (5); vṛddho vātaḥ, svasthaṃ pittaṃ, kṣīṇaḥ śleṣmā (6)| atha dvikṣīṇaikavṛddhāstrīnāha- vātapitte kṣīṇe vṛddhaḥ śleṣmā (1), vātaśleṣmāṇau kṣīṇau pittaṃ vṛddhaṃ (2), pittaśleṣmāṇau kṣīṇau vāto vṛddhaḥ (3)| atha dvivṛddhaikakṣīṇānāha- vātapitte vṛddhe kṣīṇaḥ śleṣmā (1), vātaśleṣmāṇau vṛddhau kṣīṇaṃ pittaṃ (2), pittaśleṣmāṇau vṛddhau kṣīṇo vātaḥ (3)| evamanena prakāreṇa, samākhyātāḥ kathitāḥ, trayo doṣā vātapittaśleṣmāṇaḥ| svasthaistu vātapittaśleṣmabhiḥ svāsthyaṃ triṣaṣṭamiti ayamevārthaḥ ślokairucyate| tadyathā- pṛthagvṛddhairmarutpittakakairbhedatrayaṃ bhavet| saṃsarge tu bhavatyeṣāṃ bhedastulyādhikena ca||1|| vātapitte same vṛddhe samāvevaṃ marutkaphau| samau pittakaphāvevaṃ syustrayastulyavṛddhitaḥ||2|| vṛddhiṅgate marutpitte pavanastvadhikastayoḥ| anyasmin pittamadhikaṃ vṛddhayorvātapittayoḥ||3|| vṛddhau samīraṇakaphāvetayoradhiko'nilaḥ| adhike tu tayoreva bhavedbhedāntaraṃ kaphe||4|| vṛddhau pittakaphau tadvadetayoḥ pittamutkaṭam|| vṛddhayoretayoreva balāsastvadhikaḥ punaḥ||5|| ityekādhikasaṃsargadoṣabhedā bhavanti ṣaṭ| evametaiḥ samuddiṣṭā bhedāstulyādhikairnava||6|| pūrvaiḥ saha bhavantyevaṃ vikalpā dvau tathā daśa| sannipāteṣu jāyante doṣabhedāstrayodaśa| ekastatra vikalpaḥ syādvṛddhimprāptaiḥ samaistribhiḥ| vṛddhiṅgateṣu sarveṣu teṣu vṛddhatamo marut||7|| punaḥ pittaṃ punaḥ śleṣmetyekādhikatamaistrayaḥ| pravṛddhe vātapitte ca bhedo'nyasmin balāsataḥ||8|| marutkaphau tathā pittādvātaḥ pittakaphādapi| ādhikyena dvayorevaṃ doṣabhedāstrayo matāḥ||9|| hīnamadhyādhikairdoṣairvikalpāḥ sambhavanti ṣaṭ| anyonyāpekṣayā teṣāṃ hīnavṛddhaḥ samīraṇaḥ||10|| madhyavṛddhaṃ tathā pittaṃ śleṣmā tatrādhiko mataḥ| madhyaḥ samīraṇo'nyasmin hīnaṃ pittaṃ kapho'dhikaḥ||11|| madhyaṃ pittaṃ maruttīvraḥ svalpaḥ śleṣmā'paratra tu| madhyaḥ śleṣmolbaṇaṃ pittaṃ hīno vātastathā sthitaḥ `mando'nyatra tu mārutaḥ' iti pā.||12|| madhyaḥ śleṣmolbaṇo vāyuḥ pittaṃ hīnaṃ tathā sthitam||13|| madhyavāto'dhikaṃ pittaṃ hīnavṛddhastathā kaphaḥ| evamete bhavantyatra sannipātāstrayodaśa||14|| pūrvairdvādaśabhiḥ sārdhaṃ vikalpāḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ| yathā vṛddhaistathā kṣīṇairdoṣaiḥ syuḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ `kṣayādapyevamevaite bhaveyuḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ' iti pā.||15|| kṣīṇasvasthādhikairebhirdoṣabhedā bhavanti ṣaṭ| kṣīṇaḥ samīraṇastatra svasthaṃ pittaṃ kapho'dhikaḥ||16|| kṣīṇo vāyuḥ kaphaḥ svasthaḥ pittamatrādhikaṃ tathā| kṣīṇaṃ pittaṃ marut svastho bhedo'nyasmin balī kaphaḥ||17|| kṣīṇaṃ pittaṃ kaphaḥ svasthaḥ pravṛddhastvadhiko marut| śleṣmā kṣīṇo'nilaḥ svasthaḥ pittamatra tatholbaṇam||18|| kaphaḥ kṣīṇaḥ samaṃ pittaṃ pravṛddhastu samīraṇaḥ| kṣīṇasvasthādhikairevaṃ bhedāḥ ṣaṭ parikīrtitā||19|| kṣayaṅgate marutpitte prāpto vṛddhiṃ tathā kaphaḥ| kṣīṇau samīraṇakaphau tathā syāt pittamutkaṭam||20|| kṣīṇau pittakaphau tadvannabhasvān syāttu vṛddhimān| dvau kṣīṇāvekavṛddhaśca `dvikṣīṇairekavṛddhaiśca' iti pā. bhedatrayamiti smṛtam||21|| vātapitte gate vṛddhiṃ samprāptaśca kṣayaṃ kaphaḥ| vṛddhau vātakaphau tadvat pittaṃ cātha kṣayaṃ gatam||22|| tadvat pittakaphau vṛddhau prakṣīṇaḥ pavanaḥ punaḥ| ekakṣīṇadvivṛddhaiśca trayo bhedā bhavantyamī||23|| kṣīṇamadhyādhikaistvevaṃ bhedā dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ| prakṛtisthaiḥ samīrādyaistathaikaḥ parikīrtitaḥ||24|| triṣaṣṭirdoṣabhedānāmiti samyaṅnirūpitā|| iti| eteṣāṃ vātapittaśleṣmaṇāṃ vṛddhakṣīṇānāṃ lakṣaṇānyucyante- tadyathā- vātavṛddhau vāgbāhulyaṃ `vākpāruṣyaṃ' iti pā. kārśyaṃ kārṣṇyaṃ gātrasphuraṇamūṣmakāmitā nidrānāśo'lpabalatvaṃ gāḍhavarcastvaṃ ceti, pittavṛddhau pītāvabhāsatā santāpaḥ śītakāmitvamalpanidratā mūrcchā balahānirindriyadaurbalyaṃ pītaviṇmūtranetratvaṃ ceti, śleṣmavṛddhau śauklyaṃ śaityaṃ sthairyaṃ gauravamavasādastandrā nidrā sandhyasthiviśleṣaśca| vātakṣaye mandaceṣṭatā alpavāktvamapraharṣo mūḍhasañjñatā ca, pittakṣaye mandoṣmāgnitā niṣprabhatā ca, śleṣmakṣaye rūkṣatā'ntardāha āmāśayetaraśleṣmāśayaśirasāṃ śūnyatā sandhiśaithilyaṃ tṛṣṇā daurbalyaṃ ca| evametairlakṣaṇaiḥ prakṛtisamasamavetānāṃ vṛddhānāṃ kṣīṇānāṃ ca vātapittaśleṣmaṇāmavagamo miśraiśca lakṣaṇaiḥ saṃsargasannipātāvagama iti| kṣīṇamadhyādhikadvyekakṣīṇavṛddhānāṃ keṣāñcillakṣaṇāni likhyante| tadyathā- eko vṛddhaḥ samaścaikaḥ kṣīṇastveko yadā bhavet| kṣīṇa ekaḥ pravṛddhau dvau kṣīṇau dvau vṛddhimāṃstathā||25|| eka eva sthitastatra `sthito yatra tatra yatsyādvravīmi tat' iti pā. vyaktarūpeṇa dehini| pravṛddho mārutaḥ pittaṃ prakṛtisthaṃ kaphakṣaye||26|| gṛhītvā sthānato yatra yatrāṅgeṣu visarpati| tatra tatrāsthiro dāhaḥ śramaḥ `śramo bhedo balakṣayaḥ' iti pā. svedo balakṣayaḥ||27|| kṣīṇe pitte yadā vāyurvṛddhāvasthaḥ `vṛddhaḥ karṣetsamaṃ kapham| vidadhāti' iti pā. samaṃ kapham| vikarṣati tadā śūlaṃ śaityamatyantagauravam||28|| vṛddhaṃ kaphakṣaye pittaṃ prakṛtisthaṃ prabhañjanam|| yadā ruṇaddhyasya tadā dāhaḥ śūlaḥ prajāyate||29|| vṛddhaṃ vātakṣaye pittaṃ prakṛtisthaṃ yadā kapham| niruṇaddhi tadā tasya syustandrāgauravajvarāḥ||30|| śleṣmā vṛddho yadā vāyuḥ samaḥ pittaparikṣaye| niruṇaddhi tadā tasya gauravaṃ śītakajvaram||31|| kapho'nilakṣaye pittaṃ prakṛtisthaṃ yadā balī| niruṇaddhi tadā tasya mṛdvagnitvaṃ śirovyathā||32|| pralāpo gurutā tandrā nidrā syāttu suhṛdrujā| ṣṭhīvanaṃ pittakaphayornakhādīnāṃ ca pītatā||33|| kaphaḥ pittena saṃyukto `saṃyuktaścaran hīnabalasvaram' iti pā. balahāniṃ bhṛśaṃ kṣayam| karotyapākamaruciṃ gauravaṃ gātrasādatām||34|| mārutena yutaḥ śleṣmā hīnapittaḥ samācaran| karoti mṛdutāṃ vahnerbhakte nānnābhilāṣitām||35|| vepanaṃ gauravaṃ stambhaśaityatodāṃstathā'cirāt| śuklatvaṃ ca nakhādīnāṃ pāruṣyaṃ vapuṣo'pi ca||36|| kupitau pittapavanau parikṣīṇakaphe yadā| udveṣṭanaṃ śramaṃ todaṃ kurute sphoṭanaṃ tathā||37|| tathā'ṅgamardadāhau ca coṣaṃ dūyanadhūpane| śleṣmā'pidhatte srotāṃsi yadā pittānilakṣaye||38|| ceṣṭānāśaṃ tadā kuryānmūrcchāṃ vāgbhaṅgameva ca| dehaujaḥ sraṃsayat pittaṃ vātaśleṣmakṣye tṛṣām||39|| kuryādindriyadaurbalyaṃ mūrcchāṃ glāniṃ kriyākṣayam| marmāṇi pīḍayan vāyuḥ śleṣmapittaparikṣaye||40|| sañjñāpraṇāśaṃ kurute prakampaṃ vidadhāti ca| darśayanti pravṛddhāḥ svaṃ liṅgaṃ doṣā hi kevalam||41|| kṣīṇā jahati liṅga svaṃ samāḥ svaṃ karma kurvate| samaṃ rakṣañjayan vṛddhaṃ kṣīṇaṃ doṣaṃ ca vardhayan||42|| vidhinā'nena viṣamaṃ sannipātaṃ jayedbhiṣak| iti||10-11||-

lg.l: miśrā dhātumalair doṣā yānty asaṅkhyeyatāṃ punaḥ ||12||
bhiṣak kartā'tha karaṇaṃ rasā doṣās tu kāraṇam |

ab.seg: dhātubhirasṛgādibhirmiśrā malaiścāsaṅkhyeyatāṃ yānti| tatra vātasya dhātumalamiśrasya lakṣaṇaṃ vātavyādhinidāne proktam| pittaśleṣmaṇostu vṛddhavāgbhaṭaḥ prāha- pittaṃ tvaci sthitaṃ kuryādvisphoṭakamasūrikāḥ| rakte visarpaṃ dāhaṃ ca māṃse māṃsāvakothanam||1||
sadāhān medasi granthīn svedatṛḍvamanaṃ bhṛśam| asthidāhaṃ bhṛśaṃ majjñi hāridranakhanetratām||2||
pūtipītāvabhāsaṃ ca śukraṃ śukrasamāśritam| sirāgataṃ krodhanatāṃ pralāpaṃ snāyugaṃ tṛṣām||3||
koṣṭhagaṃ madatṛḍdāhān vyāpino'nyāṃśca yakṣmaṇaḥ| śleṣmā tvaci sthitaḥ kuryāt stambhaṃ śvetāvabhāsatām||4||
pāṇḍvāmayaṃ śoṇitago māṃsasthaścārbudāpacīḥ| ārdracarmāvanaddhābhagātratāṃ tvaci gauravam||5||
medogaḥ sthūlatāṃ mehamasthnāṃ stabdhatvamasthigaḥ| majjagaḥ śuklanetratvaṃ śukrasthaḥ śukrasañcayam||6||
vibandhaṃ gauravaṃ cāti sirāsthaḥ stabdhagātratām snāyugaḥ sandhiśūnatvaṃ koṣṭhago jaṭharonnatim||7||
arocakāvipākau ca tāṃstāṃśca kaphajān gadān| viṇmūtrayoḥ sāśrayayostatra tatropadiśyate||8||

upatāpopaghātau ca svāśrayendriyagairmalaiḥ ||iti `asyāgre 'rājamṛgāṅkābhidhānena bahavo rogāḥ pradarśitāḥ| anyaistu munibhiragniveśameḍajātukarṇaparāśarahārītakṣārapāṇinimikāṅkāyanagārgyagālavaprabhṛtibhirbahavo rogāḥ kathitāḥ| tasmāt prasaṅgaṃ saṃyamya parityajya hitamevācaraṇīyam'| ityadhikaṃ paṭhyate kvacitpustake||12-14||

lg.l: evam etad aśeṣeṇa tantram uttaram ṛddhimat ||15||
sahottaraṃ tv etad adhītya sarvaṃ brāhmaṃ vidhānena yathoditena |
na hīyate 'rthān manaso 'bhyupetād etad vaco brāhmam atīva satyam ||17||

ab.seg: nibandhān bahuśo vīkṣya vaidyaḥ śrībharatātmajaḥ| uttarasthānamakarot suspaṣṭaṃ ḍalhaṇo bhiṣak||15-17||

div.ab: iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantre doṣabhedavikalpo nāma ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||66|| iti suśrutasaṃhitāyām uttaratantraṃ samāptam | samāpteyaṃ suśrutasaṃhitā |

ab.seg: iti śrīḍalha(hla)ṇaviracitāyāṃ nibandhasaṅgrahākhyāyāṃ suśrutavyākhyāyāmuttaratantre ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ||66||
